projectDesc.p: A plain, archival TEI rendering of the text published on e-Śārṅgadhara (https://github.com/sushrutaproject/eSharngadhara), itself built from the digital edition named in the sourceDesc. The file was first generated from the site's chapter pages; since 2026-11-12 it is the master copy of the text, and the web edition (reading pages, search index and the root-text-only download) is generated from it.

editorialDecl.p: The text is given in IAST as it appears on the web edition. Chapter and verse divisions follow the source edition. Each stretch of text ending in one of the source's verse or section numbers (e.g. ||12||) is encoded as seg[@type='unit'] with that number in @n; the number itself is retained in the text.

Root text and commentary follow the source's own division of every word into registers. Root-text blocks are ab[@type='mula']; commentary blocks are ab[@type='commentary'], with @subtype naming the commentary and @resp pointing to its author(s) in the titleStmt.

The source embeds the editor's notes (variant readings marked pā., remarks on the Calcutta printing, passages judged interpolated, etc.) in the running text; the web edition gathers them as numbered notes at the foot of each chapter. Notes are placed at their point of reference as note[@place='foot'][@type='editorial'], with the source's note number in @n.
The work is divided into three khaṇḍas, encoded as div[@type='khanda'].
Each commentary block opens with a siglum (Dī. for the Dīpikā, Gū. for the Gūḍhārthadīpikā), normalized from the source's own abbreviations and encoded as label[@type='siglum'].
Two comments that carry no siglum in the source and whose attribution is uncertain (Uttarakhaṇḍa 3 and 4) are encoded as ab[@type='commentary'][@subtype='unattributed'] without @resp.
A stray line of the Carakasaṃhitā at the end of Pūrvakhaṇḍa 7 in the source is omitted.

Word spaces have been added (2026-11) between the words that the source runs together, in the root text and the commentaries but not in the editor's notes: sandhi forms are kept as they are and only a space is inserted (tasminn eva, tac chāstram, ity eke); fused vowels and compounds are not divided; a space precedes an avagraha after e or o (te 'pi). No letter, punctuation mark or element of the source was changed.

Verse in the root text is marked by metre: each half-verse (up to a daṇḍa or the verse number) is an l, the half-verses of a verse that stand together an lg. Where commentary interrupts a verse, its parts are lg[@part='I'], [@part='M'] and [@part='F'] (a single pāda split off: l[@part]). Prose and the prose headings of the recipes stay outside lg. In the commentaries, quoted or composed verses are marked as lg where two or more consecutive half-verses scan.

div.head: atha mānaparibhāṣādhyāyaḥ

lg.l: śriyaṃ sa dadyād bhavatāṃ purāri- ryadaṅgatejaḥprasare bhavānī |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. karaśirasācyutam īśaṃ bhavabhavapuṣṭikṣayālayam upāyam | svargāpavargayor api tāpatrayanāśanārtham abhivande || 1 ||
sagaṇagaṇeśaṃ matidaṃ vighnasamūhāṃś ca hanti yaḥ smaraṇe | tadanu guror api caraṇaṃ gadahānyai dīnamanujānām || 2 ||

lg.l: ye durjanāḥ paraguṇān anusūcayanti te 'pi svabhāvavaśagāḥ kimu vāraṇīyāḥ |
ye śāstrabodhaguṇadoṣavicāradakṣās te sajjanāḥ praṇutibhiḥ khalu vandanīyāḥ || 3 ||
śrīvāstavyakulaprakāśamaṇayo ye pūrvajā viśrutāḥ śrīhammīrapure mahājanatate yeṣāṃ sthitiḥ kathyate |
ye kāmaṃ madavihvalām iva ravaiḥ kṣīrābdhipāraṃgatām atyāścaryasucandrakāntivitatāṃ prakhyātakīrtiṃ gatāḥ || 4 ||
tadanvaye kiṃ bahunā prasiddhaḥ śrīcakrapāṇiḥ kulakairavenduḥ |
tasya buddhisubhagasya tanūjo bhāvasiṃha iti bhūpatimānyaḥ |
kecic chāstraviśāradāḥ katipaye divyauṣadhīkovidā nānāvyādhiparīkṣaṇeṣu caturāḥ karmotsukāś cāpare |
kāmaṃ tān adhikartum utsukamanā nāhaṃ samartho yata- steṣāṃ sannidhim etya cātra racitaṃ yatkiñcid eva śrutam || 8 ||
hastīkāntapurī purā purajitā kāśīva vidvajjanai- rvyāptā yatra saraḥsaridguṇavarā carmaṇvatī pāpahā |
yasyāṃ hṛdgatavāsudevacaraṇadvandvāmbujaḥ kṣmāpatiḥ khyāto dharma ivāsti dharmagatiṣu śrījaitrasiṃhaḥ prabhuḥ || 9 ||

ab.seg: abhinavanibandharacanāṃ śrotuṃ kaḥ ko 'tra lolupo bhavati | yaḥ kṛpayā parakāvyaṃ paśyati sarvaṃ sa vai dhīraḥ || 11 ||

atheha pṛthutaraduradhigamāyurvedatattvāṅkitasadgranthaparisamāptyarthaṃ śrotṝṇām api pratyūhavyapohārthaṃ manasi viśiṣṭeṣṭadevatāpraṇāmapūrvakam āśīrvṛttam ādau nibaddhavān granthakāraḥ | tad yathā- śriyam ityādi | yadaṅgatejaḥprasare bhavānī virājate sa purārir bhavatāṃ śriyaṃ dadyād ity anvayaḥ | yathā himādrau jvalitā mahauṣadhī rājate | kva satyāṃ | nirmalacandrikāyāṃ nirmalā yā candrikā jyotsnā tasyām ity arthaḥ | nirmalacandrikāyām ity asya sthāne nirmalacandrikāta iti kecit paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | purāriḥ puranāmā daityaviśeṣaḥ sa evārir yasya, yad vā purasyāriḥ purāriḥ śiva ity arthaḥ | śriyam iti kalyāṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ vā | bhavatām ity atra yasmai ditsā rocate dhārayate vā tat sampradānam ity anena caturthī na syād ity ata āha – ‘vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavanti’ iti nyāyād iha ditsārthe ṣaṣṭhy api bhavatīty arthaḥ | yadaṅgatejaḥprasare tejaḥsamūhe ardhāṅge iti sambandhaḥ | etena vibhūtyaliptāṅgasyāpi śubhratvād adrisāmyam | ‘bhavānī pārvatī caṇḍī’ty amaraḥ | anenāśīrnirdeśaṃ kathitavān ācāryaḥ | yataḥ– ‘‘āśīrnamaskriyāvastunirdeśo vā'pi tanmukham’ iti trividhaṃ prabandhamukhalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | āśīrgrahaṇam atra duṣkṛtādīnāṃ vipākajanyaduḥkhasvarūparoganivṛttyarthaṃ tannivṛttyā sukhaśriyaḥprāptir iti bhāvaḥ || 1 ||

atha grantho 'yaṃ sakalajanopakārārthaṃ bhavatu iti matvā sadgranthasya sambandhaḥ kathanīyaḥ | tad yathā
‘siddhiḥ śrotṛpravṛttīnāṃ sambandhakathanād yataḥ |
tasmāt sarveṣu śāstreṣu sambandhaḥ pūrvam ucyate |’ iti | anena tāvat pūrvaṃ tam āha -prasiddhayogā ityādi | ye prasiddhayogāḥ santi teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjanarañjanāya mayā śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate viśeṣeṇa kriyata ity abhiprāyaḥ | na tu kriyate yataś carakasuśrutādimunibhir itastato vistṛtā mayā saṃhṛtya prakārāntareṇa likhyata iti bhāvaḥ | etena granthasya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | kīdṛśā yogāḥ? munibhiḥ prayuktā iti | traikālikadarśī puruṣātiśayo hi munir ucyate | taiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā ity arthaḥ | etena granthasya prāmāṇyaṃ kathitam | punaḥ kīdṛśāḥ ? cikitsakair vaidyair bahuśo vāraṃ vāram anubhūtā | nāmarūpayojanādibhir dṛṣṭapratyayā ity arthaḥ | etenātra sajjanānāṃ darśanādyutkaṇṭhā syād ity abhiprāyaḥ || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. maṅgalācaraṇam - śārṅgadharasaṃhitārtham ahaṃ vyākhyātum ārabhe | tatra siddhiṃ diśatu māṃ vighnādhīśo gaṇādhipaḥ || paramanipuṇo granthakṛt prāripsitanirvighnaparisamāptaye tadadhyetṝṇām api pratyūhavyūhopaśāntaye adhyayananirvāhāya vyutpattaye ca āśīrvādarūpamaṅgalam ācarati | tasya ca kartavyatāyāṃ śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇam | śriyaṃ sa dadyād ityādi | saḥ bhavatāṃ śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ dadyāt puro daityas tasyāriḥ śrīmān mahādevaḥ, athavā śrīśabdena saṃpat | yad uktaṃ ‘lakṣmīsarasvatīdhātrivargasaṃpadvibhūtiśobhāsu | upakaraṇaveśaracanāvidhāsu ca śrīr iti prathite’ti vyāḍiḥ | sa kaḥ | yadaṅgatejaḥprasare bhavānī virājate, yasya śaṃbhor yadaṅgaṃ tasya tejaḥprasaraḥ pracāraḥ tasmin bhavānī pārvatī virājate śobhate | kasmin kasyāṃ keva? himādrau nirmalacandrikāyāṃ jvalitā mahauṣadhīva himādrau himaparvate nirmalacandrikāyāṃ candrajyotsnāyāṃ madhye yathā jvalitā mahauṣadhī rājate tadvad iyam api karpūragauravattayā himādrivat śambho pratītasya pārśve mahauṣadhīva bhavānī virājate ity arthaḥ ||1||

ādau cikitsānimittam utkṛṣṭayogasaṃhārārthaṃ padyam āha -prasiddheti | munibhiḥ prayuktā ye siddhayogāḥ cikitsakair bahuśaḥ anubhūtāś ca yogāḥ cikitsādhikāriṇaḥ teṣāṃ yogānāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate kathyate | yujyata iti yogaḥ kvāthacūrṇādigaṇaḥ || 2 ||

lg.l: prasiddhayogā munibhiḥ prayuktā- ścikitsakair ye bahuśo 'nubhūtāḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha grantho 'yaṃ sakalajanopakārārthaṃ‘'bhito namaḥ’ iti pā.; bhavatu iti matvā sadgranthasya sambandhaḥ kathanīyaḥ | tad yathā
‘siddhiḥ śrotṛpravṛttīnāṃ sambandhakathanād yataḥ |
tasmāt sarveṣu śāstreṣu sambandhaḥ pūrvam ucyate |’ iti | anena tāvat pūrvaṃ tam āha -prasiddhayogā ityādi | ye prasiddhayogāḥ santi teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjanarañjanāya mayā śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate viśeṣeṇa kriyata ity abhiprāyaḥ | na tu kriyate yataś carakasuśrutādimunibhir itastato vistṛtā mayā saṃhṛtya prakārāntareṇa likhyata iti bhāvaḥ | etena granthasya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | kīdṛśā yogāḥ? munibhiḥ prayuktā iti | traikālikadarśī puruṣātiśayo hi munir ucyate | taiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā ity arthaḥ | etena granthasya prāmāṇyaṃ kathitam | punaḥ kīdṛśāḥ ? cikitsakair vaidyair bahuśo vāraṃ vāram anubhūtā | nāmarūpayojanādibhir dṛṣṭapratyayā ity arthaḥ | etenātra sajjanānāṃ darśanādyutkaṇṭhā syād ity abhiprāyaḥ || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ādau cikitsānimittam utkṛṣṭayogasaṃhārārthaṃ padyam āha - gū. - prasiddheti | munibhiḥ prayuktā ye siddhayogāḥ cikitsakair bahuśaḥ anubhūtāś ca yogāḥ cikitsādhikāriṇaḥ teṣāṃ yogānāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ śārṅgadhareṇa vidhīyate kathyate | yujyata iti yogaḥ kvāthacūrṇādigaṇaḥ || 2 ||

lg.l: cikitsitaṃ karṣaṇabṛṃhaṇākhyaṃ kurvīta vaidyo vidhivat suyogaiḥ || 3 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ ‘rogam ādau parīkṣeta tato 'nantaram auṣadham’ ityādi matam ālocya śārṅgadharo 'py āha - hetviti | vaidya āturasarvarogān samīkṣya paścāt cikitsitaṃ vidhivat kurvīteti | anyathā doṣaḥ syāt | tathā hy uktam – ‘yas tu rogam avijñāya karmāṇy ārabhate bhiṣak | na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim’ iti | kaiḥ kṛtvā samīkṣyety āha - hetur nidānam, ādirūpaṃ pūrvarūpam, ākṛtiḥ svarūpam, sātmyam upaśayaḥ, jātiḥ samprāptir iti; eṣāṃ bhedaiḥ nānātmakatvena ete vyastāḥ samastāś ca vyādhibodhakā jñeyā ity arthaḥ | yad vā hetur ādir yeṣāṃ te hetvādayaḥ, te ca rūpādayaś ca tair ity arthaḥ | etena hetvādipañcabhiḥ rūpādibhiś ca āturarogān parīkṣyeti bhāvaḥ | tathā hi vāgbhaṭe –‘darśanasparśanapraśnaiḥ parīkṣetātha rogiṇam | rogaṃ nidānaprāgrūpalakṣaṇopaśayāptibhi:’ iti | hetvādipañcakaṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam eva | rūpāditrayaṃ yathārūpam iti cākṣuṣaṃ tena śarīrasya sthūlakṛśatāvarṇavikārādayaḥ, etena darśanajñānam alaṅkaroti | ākṛtir iti āsamantād eva kṛtiḥ kṛtikāraṇam iti samucitakauśalyenaiva nāḍyādibhiḥ śītoṣṇādikajñānarūpam ity arthaḥ, etena sparśanajñānam alaṅkaroti | sātmyena hitaṃ kathyate bhavatāṃ kiṃ sātmyam ityādivākyena praśnajñānam alaṅkaroti | athavā sātmyam abhilaṣitaṃ vadanty anye yato yena yad vāñchitaṃ bhavati tasya tenaiva doṣādīnāṃ kṣīṇavṛddhatvaṃ jñāyate, iti darśanādikaṃ trayaṃ kathitam | jātiśabdena viśiṣṭendriyajñānam abhidhīyate | yataḥ - suśrute ‘ṣaḍvidho hi rogāṇāṃ vijñānopāyaḥ, tad yathā pañcabhiḥ śrotrādibhiḥ praśnena ceti’ | ato darśanādayas traya evādau vyākhyātāḥ, śeṣāḥ śrotrādayo jātibhedena kathitāḥ | tad uktaṃ suśrutācāryeṇa ‘tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā viśeṣā rogeṣu praṇaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante saphenaṃ raktam īrayann anilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchatīty evamādayaḥ | sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ sparśaviśeṣā jvaraśoṣādiṣu | cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayāḥ | rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ | gandhendriyavijñeyā riṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānām avraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ’ | iti hetvādayo vyākhyātāḥ, tatrādyaḥ pakṣo vyavahārasiddho dvitīyas tu kalpito 'pi sādhuḥ | samīkṣyeti samyak prakāreṇa vicārya, etadgrahaṇaṃ tajjñānavicchedārtham | yataḥ ‘mithyādṛṣṭā vikārā hi durākhyātās tathaiva ca | tathā duḥparidṛṣṭāś ca mohayeyuś cikitsakam’ iti | cikitsā rogāpanayanaṃ karma vyādhipratīkāraḥ dhātusāmyārthā kriyā cetyādiparyāyavācakaiḥ śabdaiś cikitsā kathitā | tathā coktaṃ – ‘caturṇāṃ bhiṣagādīnāṃ śastānāṃ dhātuvaikṛte | pravṛttir dhātusāmyārthā cikitsety abhidhīyate’ iti | tac cātra dvividhaṃ karma karṣaṇabṛṃhaṇākhyam iti | karṣaṇam iti pravṛttadoṣāṇāṃ, bṛṃhaṇam iti kṣīṇānām; tathā ca - ‘kṣīṇā vardhayitavyā’ ityādi | tathā –‘rogas tu doṣavaiṣamyaṃ doṣasāmyam arogitā’ iti vacanāt | suyogair iti śobhanadravyakṛtaprayogaiḥ śīghram ārogyotpādakair ity arthaḥ ||3||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. auṣadhayogānāṃ prayogas tu hetvādibhir vyādhiṃ jñātvā kartavyas tadvijñānārthaṃ ślokam āha -hetvādītyādi | hetvādirūpākṛtisātmyajātibhedaiḥ āturasya sarvarogān samīkṣya dṛṣṭvā vaidyaḥ karṣaṇa-bṛṃhaṇākhyaṃ cikitsitaṃ kurvītety anvayaḥ | karṣaṇaṃ kṛśīkaraṇaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavardhanaṃ ākhyā nāma yasya tat cikitsitaṃ hetvādisarūpaṃ ca ākṛtiś ca sātmyaṃ ca jātibhedaś ca te hetvādirūpākṛtisātmyajātibhedās taiḥ hetvādīni nidānapañcakahetur nidānaṃ, rūpaṃ gaurādir varṇaviśeṣaḥ | tathā cakṣuṣā yad grāhyaṃ vastujātaṃ saṃsthānādi tad api rūpam | ākṛtis tu cakṣurādīndriyasvarapraticchāyākriyādiṣu anyeṣv api bhāveṣu prākṛteṣu nimittataḥ vikṛtir yā samāse 'riṣṭaṃ tad iti lakṣayet | sātmyaṃ deśādi taiḥ, ādiśabdāt prāgrūpārūpopaśayasaṃprāptayo gṛhyante hetvādirūpaṃ hetvādikārtsnyaṃ tena ākṛtyā ca sātmyena ca jātiḥ saṃprāptiḥ tasyā ye bhedāḥ saṃkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālāḥ | vaidyaḥ āturasya sarvarogān samīkṣya proktaṃ cikitsitaṃ kurvīta vyādheḥ kiyanto 'py upāyā bhavanti || 3 ||

lg.l: divyauṣadhīnāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedā vṛndārakāṇām iva visphuranti |
jñātveti saṃdeham apāsya dhīraiḥ saṃbhāvanīyā vividhaprabhāvāḥ || 4 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravyāṇāṃ vividhaprabhāvāḥ santi teṣāṃ hetubhiḥ parīkṣāṃ nirākartum āha -divyauṣadhīnām iti | divyauṣadhīnāṃ bahavo bhedā vṛndārakāṇām iva visphuranti prakaṭībhavanti ity arthaḥ - iti jñātvā vicārya tadā sandeham apāsya dūrīkṛtya vividhaprabhāvā aparimitaśaktayo 'vicchinnaśaktayo vā sambhāvanīyāḥ teṣāṃ sambhāvanā kartavyety arthaḥ | dhīrair iti jñeyam | etenā'cintyo hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāva iti tātparyārthaḥ | divyauṣadhīnām iti divyagrahaṇam atra dravyāṇāṃ viśiṣṭatvajñānārtham | vṛndārakāṇām iti yathā devānāṃ bhedā aparimitās tathaiva dravyabhedā ity abhiprāyaḥ | prabhāvāś cety acintanīyāḥ | dhīrair iti gambhīrabuddhibhiḥ | dhīrā hi bāhyādhyātmikānāṃ hitāhitaparicchedakāriṇo bhavanti, ato dhīragrahaṇam atrāniścayārthajñāpakatvavyavacchedārtham || 4 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. divyeti | asyārthaḥ - divyauṣadhīnāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedāḥ visphuranti tān jñātvā saṃdehaṃ vāpāsya dhīraiḥ vividhaprabhāvāḥ saṃbhāvanīyā vicāraṇīyāḥ | vṛndārakā devās teṣām iva yathā devānāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedās tathauṣadhīnām iti | divyā yā oṣadhyaḥ tāsāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedā visphuranti | keṣām iva ? vṛndārakāṇām iva tān bhedān vanasthānādibhyaḥ jñātvā saṃdehaṃ apāsya dūrīkṛtya karma kārayed ity arthaḥ ||4 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha prayojanam api sarvasyaiva syāt tathā hi – ‘sarvasyaiva hi śāstrasya karmaṇo vā'pi kasyacit | yāvat prayojanaṃ noktaṃ tāvat kena na gṛhyate’ iti, ata eva tad adhikṛtyāha -svābhāviketi - svābhāvikādayo rogāḥ karmadoṣajā bhaveyuḥ | kilety āgamaniścayārtham | tacchedanārthaṃ teṣām upaśamanimittam| yogavarān prayogaśreṣṭhān niyojayet; etena samastārṣatantrābhyantarasthān yogān vicintya ācāryeṇātra te yojyanta iti bhāvaḥ | svābhāvikā iti svabhāvena bhavāḥ svābhāvikāḥ, te kṣutpipāsājarāmṛtyunidrāprabhṛtayaḥ | āgantukā iti abhighātanimittāḥ, te vyālādikṛtāś ca | kāyikāntarā iti śārīrā antarjātāś ca śārīrās te 'nnapānamūlāḥ | vātādidoṣadvārā'sṛkpittakāsādayaḥ, antaḥśabdena mano 'bhidhīyate, tadudbhavā mānasā ity arthaḥ | te kāmakrodhādinimittā madamūrcchāsanyāsagrahabhūtonmādādaya iti | suśrute svābhāvikādayo darśitāḥ | karmadoṣajā iti | eke karmajāḥ, eke doṣajāḥ, apare karmadoṣajāś ca | tathā coktam-‘karmaprakopeṇa kadācid eke doṣaprakopeṇa bhavanti cānye | tathā'pare prāṇiṣu karmadoṣaprakopajāḥ kāyamanovikārāḥ’ iti | karmajādīnāṃ saṃjñā keṣāñcij jñāpanārthaṃ likhyate yathā-‘ye cāmayāḥ syur aparadraviṇāpahārād gurvaṅganāgamanavipravadhādibhir ye | duṣkarmabhis tanubhṛtām iha karmajās te nopakrameṇa bhiṣajām upayānti śāntim ||’ kiñca-‘dānair dayādir atithidvijadevatānāṃ gurvarcanāpraṇatibhiś ca japais tapobhiḥ | ity uktapuṣyanicayair upacīyamānāḥ prākkarmajā api rujaḥ praśamaṃ prayānti’ iti | atha doṣajā yathā-‘svahetuduṣṭair anilādidoṣair upaplutaiḥ kheṣu pariskhaladbhiḥ | bhavanti ye prāṇabhūtāṃ vikārās te doṣajā bheṣajasiddhisādhyāḥ’ | ubhayotpannā yathā-‘dānādibhiḥ karmabhir auṣadhaiś ca karmakṣaye doṣaparikṣaye ca | sidhyanti ye ratnavatāṃ kadācit te karmadoṣaprabhavā vikārāḥ ||’ iti | duritāpahāriṇa iti duritaśabdena duḥkham abhidhīyate tatsaṃyogā vyādhaya ity uktatvāt | śreyomayān iti puṇyasvarūpān | ye 'nyepi puṇyamayās te duḥkhacchedanāya sambhavanti, ucyate-‘paraduḥkhavināśārthaṃ mahānto nijaśaktibhiḥ | karma kurvanti yat puṇyaṃ tena puṇyamayāḥ smṛtāḥ’ iti || 5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svābhāvikāgantukakāyikāntarā rogāś caturdhā bhaveyuḥ karmajā doṣajāḥ karmadoṣajāś ceti tridhā bhaveyuḥ | svabhāvena bhavantīti svābhāvikāḥ kṣutpipāsājarānidrāmṛtyuprabhṛtayo bhaveyuḥ | kileti niścayena karmadoṣajā bhaveyuḥ | tacchedanārthaṃ duritāpahāriṇo yogān niyojayed ity anvayaḥ | kiṃviśiṣṭān yogān? śreyomayān tatra svābhāvikā rogāḥ kṣutpipāsādayaḥ, āgantukā bhūtābhiṣaṅgādayaḥ, kāyikā ajīrṇādayaḥ, āntarāḥ mānasikāḥ kāmādayaḥ, karmajā doṣajāḥ karmadoṣajāḥ, yathā ‘brahmahā kṣayarogī syāt’ doṣavātapittakaphajanyāḥ, tacchedanārthaṃ teṣāṃ doṣāṇāṃ chedanārthaṃ duritāpahāriṇaḥ rogāpahāriṇaḥ varān śreṣṭhān yojayet | kiṃviśiṣṭān ? śreyomayān kalyāṇadāyina ity arthaḥ || 5 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ pratyakṣasiddhayogānāṃ kathanena saṃkṣepakaraṇena ca nijagranthasya māhātmyam āha - prayogān iti | āgamādisiddhān prayogān sarvalokahitārthāya anativistarān vakṣyāmi kathayiṣyāmīty arthaḥ | anativistaraṃ yathā syād ity eke paṭhanti | āgamādīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu jaijjaṭādibhir ācāryair uktaṃ tad eva subodhārthaṃ likhyate | yathā-āgamo vedaḥ, āptānāṃ śāstraṃ vā | tathā hi-‘siddhaṃ siddhaiḥ pramāṇais tu hitaṃ cātra paratra ca | āgamaḥ śāstram āptānām āptāḥ satyārthavedinaḥ’ iti | āgamāt siddhāḥ śrūyante-yathā-‘jīved varṣasahasrāṇi yogasyāsya prabhāvataḥ| vṛddhā ca śatavarṣīyā bhavet ṣoḍaśavārṣikī’ ityādi | pratyakṣam iti yatkiñcid evārthasya sākṣātkāri jñānaṃ tad eva pratyakṣaṃ, tathā hi-
‘manokṣigatam abhrāntaṃ vastu pratyakṣam ucyate |
indriyāṇām asaṃjñānaṃ vastu tad vai bhramaḥ smṛtaḥ |’ iti | tat siddhā yathā vamanavairecanādikayogāḥ pratyakṣaphalāḥ | anumānata iti anu paścād avyabhicāriliṅgāl liṅgī jñāyate yena tad anumānam | tat siddhā yathā mṛtpāṇḍurogeṇa mṛdbhakṣaṇam anumīyate, chardyā makṣikādibhakṣaṇaṃ, tvakparipāṭanādibhiḥ pakvāmavraṇam iti | kena hetunā tvayā kriyate iti vivakṣāyāṃ sarvalokahitārthāyetigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| sarvaloka iti loko hi dvividhaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamātmakabhedena | atra puruṣaprādhānyāj janā eva lokaśabdena gṛhyante | ārṣeṇā'pi granthena jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati kim anena tadupajīvinā granthenety āśaṅkyānativistarān iti grahaṇaṃ kṛtam na atiśayena vistaro yatra tān iti | yato bahuprapañcaracitāny ūhāpohapūrvapakṣasamādhānādinā tantrāṇi sodvegakarāṇi bhavanti tasmāt saṃkṣipyānulikhāmīty arthaḥ || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pratyakṣād anumānataḥ āgamāt siddhān prayogān anativistarān alpān ity arthaḥ || 6 ||

Āḍhamalla. athānukramaṇikām āha - atheti | athaśabda ānantaryārthe maṅgalārthe vā | anukramaṇikā iti adhyāyānām anukramaṇaṃ trikhaṇḍānām ity arthaḥ| idānīṃ tām anukramaṇikāṃ darśayitum āha -prathamam ityādi | paribhāṣādirogagaṇanāntaiḥ saptabhir adhyāyaiḥ kṛtvā pūrvakhaṇḍo 'yam īritaḥ kathita ity arthaḥ, ācāryeṇa iti śeṣaḥ | te ke adhyāyā ity āha - prathamam iti | prathamam ādau paribhāṣā tulanādikam | dvitīye bhaiṣajyākhyānakam | bhaiṣajyākhyānakam ity auṣadhabhakṣaṇavidhiḥ | tatheti grahaṇāt dravyarasaguṇavipākādīnāṃ kathanaṃ ṛtuṣaṭkakathanaṃ ca | nāḍīparīkṣādividhir iti tṛtīyam | ādigrahaṇād iha svapnādīnāṃ kathanam | tato 'nantaraṃ dīpanapācanādilakṣaṇakathanaṃ caturtham | ādiśabdāt sraṃsanabhedanānulomanavamanalekhanastambhanādikathanam | tato 'nantaraṃ kalādikākhyānam iti pañcamaṃ, ādigrahaṇāt sṛṣṭikramaśārīrādikathanam | tathety anantaraṃ āhārādigatir iti ṣaṣṭham | ādiśabdāt garbhotpattikumārapoṣaṇoktaprakṛtilakṣaṇakathanaṃ ca | rogāṇāṃ gaṇanā ceti itiśabdenāvaśiṣṭaṃ saptamam ity arthaḥ, etena sādhyā ya uktā rogā jvarādayas teṣāṃ gaṇanā saṃkhyākathanam iti pūrvakhaṇḍādhyāyānukramaḥ kathitaḥ || 7-8 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tad ādau svarasaḥ puṭapākaś ca tataḥ kvāthādi tataḥ phāṇṭaḥ dvivacanāt paṃtho (?) pi | tataḥ himaḥ, tataḥ kalkaḥ, tataḥ cūrṇaṃ, tataḥ guṭikā, tato 'valehaḥ, snehaḥ ghṛtataile, tataḥ saṃdhānaṃ āsavāriṣṭaṃ, tataḥ dhātuśuddhiḥ dvivacanān māraṇarasakathanaṃ ity ayaṃ madhyamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ smṛtaḥ kathitaḥ || 9 ||

lg.l: svarasaḥ kvāthaphāṇṭau ca himaḥ‘vighnabhūtā ityatrābhūtatadbhāve cvirna sambhavati, rogāṇāmutpattita eva vighnasvarūpatvenāvighnasvarūpatvābhāvāt’ iti gaṅgādharaḥ; kalkaś ca cūrṇakam |
tathaiva guṭikālehau snehaḥ sandhānam eva ca || 9 ||
dhātuśuddhī rasāś caiva khaṇḍo 'yaṃ madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha madhyamakhaṇḍānukramaṇikāṃ darśayann āha - svarasa ityādi | svarasādirasāntair dvādaśabhir adhyāyair madhyamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ smṛtaḥ, kathita ity arthaḥ | svarasādayo vikhyātā eva te cāgre vakṣyamāṇāḥ santi | tatra svaraseṣu puṭapākavidhikathanam | kvāthe pramathyādyuṣṇodakakṣīrapākānnakriyāvidhikathanam | phāṇṭe manthavidhikathanam | snehagrahaṇād ghṛtakalpanā tailakalpanā ca | sandhānam ity anena madyabhedakathanam | dhātuśuddhir ity atra samastadhātūpadhātūnāṃ śodhanamāraṇādikathanam | rasā iti bahuvacanena sarveṣāṃ rasoparasādīnāṃ śodhanamāraṇādikathanam | iti madhyamakhaṇḍasyādhyāyānukramo vyākhyātaḥ || 9 ||

lg.l: tatas tu snehabastiḥ syāt tataś cāpi nirūhaṇam |
tataś cāpy uttaro bastis tato nasyavidhir mataḥ || 11 ||
netrakarmaprakāraś ca khaṇḍaḥ syād uttaras tv ayam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīm uttarakhaṇḍānukramam āha- snehapānam iti | snehapānādinetrakarmaprakārāntarais trayodaśabhir adhyāyair uttaraḥ khaṇḍaḥ syāt | tatra dhūmapāne vraṇadhūpanaṃ gṛhadhūpanaṃ ca, gaṇḍūṣe kavalādīnāṃ lakṣaṇagrahaṇāt kavalapratisāraṇakathanam | pralepetyādigrahaṇān mūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhikathanam | śeṣaṃ subodham | ity uttarakhaṇḍādhyāyānukramaḥ kathitaḥ ||90-12||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tatrādau caturvidhasnehapānaṃ tataḥ svedavidhiḥ tataś ca vamanaṃ tato virecanaṃ tataḥ snehabasti, tato nirūhaṇabastiḥ tato 'py uttarabastiḥ, tato nasyavidhiḥ tato dhūmapānavidhiḥ tato gaṇḍūṣaḥ ādiśabdāt kavalavidhiś ca tato lepavidhiḥ ādiśabdān mūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhiḥ tato śoṇitamokṣaḥ tato netrakarmaprakāraḥ ity evam uttarakhaṇḍaḥ || 10-12 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ saṃhitāniruktipūrvakaṃ ślokasaṃkhyām āha - dvātriṃśad iti | yataḥ pūrvoktānāṃ trikhaṇḍānāṃ dvātriṃśadadhyāyair yukteyaṃ tasmāt saṃhitā kathitā | saṃmitasthāne saṃhita iti kecit paṭhanti | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | atra saṃhitāyāṃ ślokānāṃ gaṇitāni gaṇanāni ṣaḍviṃśatiśatāni bhavantīty adhyāhāryam | adhyāya iti padasamūho vākyaṃ, vākyasamūhaḥ prakaraṇaṃ, prakaraṇasamūho 'dhyāya iti || 13 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. iyaṃ śārṅgadharanāmnī saṃhitā smṛtā kathitā | kiṃviśiṣṭeyam ? dvātriṃśadadhyāyaiḥ saṃmitā ca samyak prakāreṇa racitā ca | atra asyāṃ gaṇitāni ṣaḍviṃśatiśatāni ślokānāṃ saṃtīti śeṣaḥ || 13 ||

atha māgadhaparibhāṣā |
na mānena vinā yuktir dravyāṇāṃ jāyate kvacit || 14||

Āḍhamalla. athedānīṃ tāvat pūrvaṃ paribhāṣāṃ darśayitum āha-na māneneti | mānena parimāṇena vinā dravyāṇāṃ yuktiḥ kartavyavidhiḥ kvacit kutrā'pi na jāyate notpadyate ata ity asmāt prayogakāryārthaṃ prayogāṇāṃ yogānāṃ kāryārthaṃ kartavyavidhinimittaṃ mānaṃ tulanādi atra saṃhitāyāṃ mayā ācāryeṇa ucyate kathyate ity arthaḥ | bhakṣyamānavyavacchedārtham uktaṃ tad bhakṣyamānaṃ vakṣyamāṇam apy asti iti || 14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha paribhāṣā mānena vinā dravyāṇāṃ yuktiḥ na jñāyate notpadyate ataḥ asmāt prayogakāryārthaṃ mayā mānaṃ ucyate | tan mānaṃ dvividhaṃ, tad uktaṃ granthāntare-‘kāliṅgaṃ māgadhaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ mānam ucyate | māgadhaṃ pravaraṃ prāhuḥ kāliṅgaṃ ca tad uttaram’ iti || 14 ||

div.ab:
māgadhīyaṃ mānam--
trasareṇur budhaiḥ proktas triṃśatā paramāṇubhiḥ || 15 || trasareṇus tu paryāyanāmnā vaṃśī nigadyayate |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ paramāṇvādigamyamānārthaṃ lakṣaṇāny āha-trasareṇur iti | paramāṇubhir yas triṃśatā sa eva trasareṇuḥ proktaḥ kathito budhais tadvedibhiḥ puruṣaiḥ | paramāṇuḥ susūkṣmaḥ svabhāvato grāhyo na cakṣuṣā anumānena ceti kecit | tathā hi -
‘jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ |
tasya triṃśattamo bhāgaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa ucyate ||’ iti | triṃśateti paramāṇūnāṃ daśatrisaṃkhyair ity arthaḥ | trasareṇur eva paryāyanāmnā ekārthavācakaśabdena kṛtvā dhvaṃsīti ( vaṃśīti ) nigadyate kathyate | yatra samānārthakatā śabdānāṃ tatra te paryāyā ucyante ity arthaḥ | dhvaṃsīlakṣaṇaṃ tu etasyāgre kecit paṭhanti | yathā- ‘jālāntaragataiḥ sūryakarair dhvaṃsī vilokyate’ iti | sūryakarair ādityaraśmibhiḥ || 15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. budhais triṃśatparamāṇubhiḥ trasareṇuḥ proktaḥ sa eva trasareṇuḥ paryāyaśabdena vaṃśī nigadyate || 15 ||

lg.l: jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ || 16||
tasya triṃśattamo bhāgaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa kathyate |

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. triṃśatety atra viṃśatyādyāḥ sadaikatve bhavanti tasmād bahuvacanāntaparamāṇor lakṣaṇaṃ darśayati ‘jālāntaragate sūrye yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ | tasya triṃśattamo bhāgaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa ucyate’ bhaved iti śeṣaḥ | vaṃśaraṃdhraṃ praviṣṭaṃ yad rajas tad vaṃśī tasyās triṃśatā paramāṇunā yā saṃkhyā sā vaṃśīty arthaḥ || 16 || 17 ||

lg.l: ṣaḍvaṃśībhir marīciḥ syāt tābhiḥ ṣaḍbhis tu rājikā |
tisṛbhī rājikābhiś ca sarṣapaḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 18 ||
ṣaḍbhis tu raktikābhiḥ syān māṣako hemadhānyakau || 19||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha marīciprabhṛtīnāṃ paramparām āha -- ṣaḍvaṃśībhir iti | ṣaḍvaṃśībhir ekā marīcir bhaved iti | marīcibhir mānasaṃjñakābhir marīcibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃkhyābhir ekā rājikā kathitā ity adhyāhāraḥ | rājikā sarṣapabhedaḥ, tisṛbhī rājikābhir iti rājikātritayenaikaḥ sarṣapaḥ procyate kathyate budhair iti | sarṣapagrahaṇenātra gaurasarṣapo jñeya iti prasiddhiḥ | aṣṭasarṣapaiḥ kṛtvā eko yavaḥ kathitaḥ | yavo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ | guñjām āha - taccatuṣṭayamānena guñjā syāt, tena ekā guñjā kathitā ity abhiprāyaḥ, guñjā raktikā vācyā | atha māṣakam āha-ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaṭsaṃkhyābhī raktikābhir guñjābhir eko māṣa iti khyātaḥ, sa eva hemadhānyakaparyāyanāmnā kathita iti svamate, kvacit saptabhiḥ kvacit pañcabhir daśabhir vā guñjābhiḥ kṛtvā māṣakaḥ kathitaḥ sa eva māṣako marīcyādibhir vicāryamāṇo 'tra na viruddhaḥ, tac ca vistarabhayān na likhyate || 18 || 19 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. budhaiḥ tisṛbhiḥ rājikābhiḥ sarṣapaḥ procyate aṣṭasarṣapair yavaḥ proktaḥ taccatuṣṭayaṃ guñjā syāt ṣaḍbhī raktikābhiḥ māṣakaḥ syāt sa eva māṣakaḥ paryāyaśabdena hemaś ca nigadyate dhānyakaś ca nigadyate || 18 || 19 ||

lg.l: māṣaiś caturbhiḥ śāṇaḥ syād dharaṇaḥ sa nigadyate |
ṭaṅkaḥ sa eva kathitas taddvayaṃ kola ucyate ||20||
kṣudrako vaṭakaś caiva draṅkṣaṇaḥ sa nigadyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ śāṇaparimāṇaṃ kolaparimāṇaṃ ca vaktum āha - māṣair iti | caturbhir māṣakair ekaḥ śāṇo dharaṇaṃ ṭaṅkaś ca kathitaḥ | māṣo 'tra ṣaḍbhir guñjābhis tulita iti sarvatra | taddvayam iti śāṇadvayenaivaikaḥ kolaḥ | kolo badarasaṃjña iti kecit | tasya paryāyavācakāḥ kṣudramoṭarakadraṃkṣaṇādayaḥ, te 'tra ṭaṅkadvayamānasaṃjñakā boddhavyāḥ ||20||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. caturbhir māṣaiḥ śāṇaḥ syāt sa eva dharaṇo nigadyate sa eva śāṇaḥ paryāyaśabdena ṭaṅkaḥ kathitaḥ, taddvayaṃ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ kola ucyate sa eva kolaparyāyaśabdena kṣudraka ucyate vaṭakaś cocyate draṃkṣaṇaś ca nigadyate amūni ṭaṅkadvayasya nāmānīty abhiprāyaḥ || 20 ||

lg.l: koladvayaṃ ca karṣaḥ syāt sa proktaḥ pāṇimānikā ||21||
akṣaṃ picuḥ pāṇitalaṃ kiṃcitpāṇiś ca tindukam |
udumbaraṃ ca paryāyaiḥ karṣa eva nigadyate || 23 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. karṣam āha -- koladvayam iti | koladvitayam eva karṣaḥ syāt, sa catuḥśāṇa ity arthaḥ | tasya paryāyasaṃjñakā pāṇimānikādayaḥ | pāṇimānikā karatalaṃ vidur iti bhāvaḥ | akṣa iti vibhītakaphalaṃ tac ca karṣamānasaṃjñam | tindukaṃ tindukaphalam | viḍālapadakaṃ aṅgulitrayagrāhyaṃ cūrṇadravyaṃ tat karṣasaṃjñam ity arthaḥ | ṣoḍaśikā ṣoḍaśamāṣakaparimitety arthaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 21-23 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. koladvayaṃ kolayoḥ dvayaṃ karṣaḥ syāt pāṇimāṇikādyā uduṃbarāntaṃ karṣasya paryāyavācakāḥ caturbhiṣ ṭaṅkaiḥ karṣaḥ syād ity arthaḥ || 21-23 ||

lg.l: syāt karṣābhyām ardhapalaṃ śuktir aṣṭamikā tathā |
śuktibhyāṃ ca palaṃ jñeyaṃ muṣṭir āmraṃ caturthikā || 24 ||
prakuñcaḥ ṣoḍaśī bilvaṃ palam evātra kīrtyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. ardhapalaṃ palamānaṃ cāha--syāt karṣābhyām iti | karṣadvayenārdhapalaṃ kathitaṃ, tad eva śuktiḥ | aṣṭamikā ca śuktiḥ prasiddhā, aṣṭamikā aṣṭaśāṇasaṃjñamānaviśeṣaḥ | palam apy āha - śuktibhyām iti | śuktidvayenaiva palaṃ boddhavyam | palaṃ prasiddham | etasyāpi muṣṭyādayaḥ paryāyavācakā jñeyāḥ | atra muṣṭyādiṣu palam eva kīrtyate nānyat | muṣṭir nakhāntamuṣṭiḥ | āmraṃ phalam | caturthiketi catuḥkarṣa iti bhāvaḥ | ṣoḍaśī ṣoḍaśaśāṇamitaḥ, śāṇo 'traivokto jñātavyaḥ, na tu vyāvahārikaḥ | bilvaṃ bilvaphalaṃ etat saṃjñā pale boddhavyā || 24 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dvābhyāṃ karṣābhyām ardhapalaṃ syāt ardhapalam eva śuktiḥ aṣṭamikā ca saiva paryāyaśabdena aṣṭaṭaṅkamitā śuktir iti dvābhyāṃ śuktibhyāṃ palaṃ jñeyaṃ muṣṭyādyāḥ ṣaṭpalasya paryāyavācakāḥ ṣoḍaśaṭaṅkaṃ palaṃ jñātavyam iti śeṣaḥ || 24 ||

lg.l: palābhyāṃ prasṛtir jñeyā prasūtaś ca nigadyate || 25 ||
aṣṭamānaṃ ca sa jñeyaḥ kuḍavābhyāṃ ca mānikā ||26||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ prasṛtipūrvakaṃ mānikāntaṃ mānam āha - palābhyām iti | paladvayenaikā prasṛtir jñeyā prasāritāṅgulikaratalaṃ prasṛtiḥ saiva dvātriṃśat śāṇamitā | prasṛtibhyām iti prasṛtidvayenaikāñjaliḥ, añjalis tu karadvayamilitasampuṭakākāraḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa eva kuḍavaḥ ardhaśarāvakaś ca kathitaḥ, kuḍavaḥ prasiddhaś catuḥpalapramitaḥ ardhaśarāvakaś catuḥṣaṣṭiśāṇasaṃjñaḥ | kuḍavābhyām iti | kuḍavadvayenaikā mānikā saiva śarāvaḥ | aṣṭapalaṃ ca śarāvaḥ sa tu sāṣṭāviṃśatiśatasaṃkhyākaśāṇaiḥ kathitaḥ ||25||26||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dvābhyāṃ palābhyāṃ prasṛtir jñeyā dvātriṃśat ṭaṅkānāṃ prasṛtiḥ paryāyaśabdena prasṛtiś ca nigadyate dvābhyāṃ prasṛtibhyām añjaliḥ syāt sa evāñjaliḥ kuḍavo 'rdhaśarāvakaś ca paryāyaśabdena sa eva mānam apy añjalir jñeyaḥ catuḥṣaṣṭikānām añjalir ity abhiprāyaḥ | dvābhyāṃ kuḍavābhyāṃ mānikā, mānikāparyāyavācakaḥ śarāvaḥ aṣṭapalaṃ ca aṣṭāviṃśacchatottaraṭaṅkānāṃ mānikety arthaḥ || 25 || 26 ||

lg.l: bhājanaṃ kaṃsapātraṃ ca catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ ca tat |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha prasthā 'ḍhake darśayitum āha -- śarāvābhyām iti | śarāvadvayena ekaḥ prasthaḥ sa ca ṣoḍaśapalaparimito bhavati | catuḥprasthaiḥ kṛtvā āḍhakam ekaṃ tac ca bhājanaṃ kaṃsapātraṃ ca kathitaṃ, bhājanādayo 'py āḍhakasyaiva paryāyā ity arthaḥ | etac catuḥṣaṣṭipalaparimitaṃ boddhavyam || 27 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dvābhyāṃ śarāvābhyāṃ prastho bhavet ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaradviśataṭaṅkānāṃ prasthaḥ, catuḥprasthaiḥ āḍhakaṃ bhavet caturviṃśottarasahasraṭaṅkānām āḍhakaṃ, tad eva bhājanaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ ca tad eva paryāyaśabdena catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ cocyate ||27||

lg.l: śūrpābhyāṃ ca bhaved droṇī vāhī goṇī ca sā smṛtā |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha droṇaprabhṛti droṇīparyantamānam āha - caturbhir iti | caturbhiś catuḥsaṃkhyākair āḍhakaiḥ kṛtvā eko droṇaḥ, sa ca kalaśādiparyāyanāmabhir upalakṣito dvātriṃśaccharāvatulito jñeyaḥ | droṇābhyām iti | droṇadvayena śūrpakumbhau kathitau, śūrpaś ca kumbhaś ceti | śūrpaś catuḥṣaṣṭiśarāvako jñeyaḥ | śūrpābhyām iti | śūrpadvayena ekā droṇī saiva vāhī goṇī ca kathitā, atra catuḥṣaṣṭiprasthā bhavantīti tātparyārthaḥ || 28 || 29 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. caturbhir āḍhakair droṇa ucyate sa eva kalaśaḥ, nalvaṇaḥ, armaṇaś ca, unmānaś ca,ghaṭaś ca,rāśiś ca paryāyaśabdena sa evety uttaracatuḥsahasraṭaṅkānāṃ droṇaḥ ||28||29||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ khārīparimāṇam āha-droṇīcatuṣṭayam iti | droṇīcatuṣṭayaṃ sambhāraṃ tat khārīśabdavācyaṃ, tena ṣaṇṇavatyadhikacatuḥsahasrapalamānena sā jñātavyā, ata eva sūkṣmabuddhibhir iti grahaṇam || 30 ||

lg.l: palānāṃ dvisahasraṃ ca bhāra ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 31 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha bhāraparimāṇaṃ tulāparimāṇam apy āha - palānām iti | pūrvapratipāditānāṃ palānāṃ yat sahasradvayaṃ tena eko bhāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ kathitaḥ | etena bhāro viṃśatitulābhiḥ parimito bhavati | tulā ca palaśataparimitā jñeyā | tathā coktam - ‘tulāpalaśataṃ tāsāṃ viṃśatir bhāra ucyate | khārī bhāradvayenaiva smṛtā ṣaḍbhājanādhikā’ iti | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatraiva sarvadeśeṣv eva prayogeṣu vā jñeya ity arthaḥ, na tu kevalaṃ magadhadeśe | eveti niścayārthabodhakaḥ || 31 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ sakalamānajñāpanāryaṃ ślokenaikena mānam āha-- māṣetyādi | māṣādikhāryavasānā yathottaraṃ caturguṇā jñeyāḥ | yo yasmād uttaro yathottaraṃ, etena kim uktaṃ bhavati-māṣāc caturguṇaḥ śāṇaḥ śāṇāt karṣaś caturguṇaḥ karṣāc caturguṇaṃ bilvam ityādyā apare mitā iti | bilvam atra palaṃ, rāśir droṇasaṃjñaḥ, goṇīty anena droṇī kathitā || 32 ||

lg.l: prasthādimānam ārabhya dviguṇaṃ‘dravāderdviguṇaṃ matam’ pā. | tad dravārdrayoḥ || 34 ||
mānaṃ tathā tulāyāś ca dviguṇaṃ na kvacit smṛtam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravārdraśuṣkadravyāṇām anuktānāṃ mānaṃ nirdeṣṭum āha-guñjāprabhṛtimānam ārabhya yāvat kuḍavasthitiḥ syāt tāvad dravyādīnāṃ mānaṃ samaṃ jñeyam | guñjā ādir yeṣāṃ te māṣakakolākṣaśuktiprasṛtāḥ kuḍavaparyantāḥ | dravaṃ toyādi, ārdraṃ tatkṣaṇoddhṛtaṃ; śuṣkaṃ sūryāṃśubhiḥ śoṣitaṃ cirakālaṃ dhṛtaṃ ca | eke yāvan na kuḍavasthitir iti paṭhanti tatra kuḍavād arvāk samam iti | tathā hi—‘raktikādiṣu māneṣu yāvan na kuḍavo bhavet | śuṣke dravārdrayos tāvat tulyaṃ mānaṃ prakīrtitam’ iti | etad api tantrāntare yathā-‘prasthādi mānam ārabhya dviguṇaś ca dravārdrayoḥ | kuḍavo 'pi kvacid dṛṣṭo yathā dantīghṛte matam’ iti || 33 ||

dī.- prasthādimānam iti | prasthādiparimāṇam ārabhya yāvat tulā pūryate tāvad dravārdrayor dviguṇaparimāṇaṃ jñeyam | dviguṇaṃ tu śuṣkadravyād ity arthaḥ | tathā ca-‘śuṣkadravyasya yā mātrā tvārdrasya dviguṇā hi sā | śuṣkasya gurutīkṣṇatvāt tasmād ardhaṃ prayojayet’ | prasthādimānam ityādiśabdāt ṣoḍaśapalam ārabhya yāvat palaśataṃ pūryate tāvad ity arthaḥ | (na tathāvandhanīdhṛtapāṭho nāsti ‘kha’ pustake | tulāyāḥ |) tulāyā upari mānaṃ kvacit kutrāpi dviguṇaṃ na tat kāryaṃ dravārdrayor iti śeṣaḥ | uparimānam iti droṇādikam | tathā ca -
‘dvaiguṇyaṃ na tulāmānād iti mānavido viduḥ |
yato dravārdraśuṣkādeḥ prasiddhiś cātra lokataḥ’ | etadabhiprāyaṃ snehapākaviṣaye prāyaśo manyante kvacit || 34 ||

lg.l: vistīrṇaṃ ca tathoccaṃ ca tan mānaṃ kuḍavaṃ vadet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravamānārthaṃ kuḍavapātranirmāṇam āha- mṛd iti | mṛdādivastubhir nirmitaṃ yad bhāṇḍaṃ bhavati tat paramitaṃ dravadravyaṃ kuḍavasaṃjñitaṃ vadet | kathaṃbhūtaṃ ? āyāmaparimāṇābhyāṃ caturaṅgulapramāṇaṃ, tathā uccenāpi caturaṅgulam | veṇuṃ vaṃśaṃ, loham aṣṭavidhaṃ tac ca suvarṇarajatatāmrāraghoṣatrapusīsakalohasaṃjñam | ādigrahaṇāc carmaśrṛṅgadantopalādayaḥ | aṅgulaśabdenātrāṅguṣṭhanakhatala- bhāgaṃ gṛhṇanti | kecit ‘madhyamāṅgulikāyās tu madhyamaparvamitāṅgulami’ti | yad vā caturbhir aṅgulibhiḥ parimitaṃ caturaṅgulam iti prasiddham | etat parimāṇaṃ dravadravyārthaṃdravyāṇāṃ gurulaghutvāttaratamābhyāṃ tato'pyasaṃbhavādidaṃ kuḍavabhāṇḍaṃ samadravadravyārthaṃ boddhavyam | vastutastu ‘ārdradravyasya kuḍavaḥ palairaṣṭābhireva ca | śuṣkadravyacatuṣkeṇa kuḍavaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ’ iti hārītoktamihāpi smartavyam || boddhavyam || 35 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tad dviguṇaṃ na, tarhi tulayā vinā kutaḥ? tad āha - mṛdvṛkṣaveṇulohādeḥ caturaṅgulaṃ vistīrṇaṃ coccaṃ ca yad bhāṇḍaṃ tan mānaṃ kuḍavaṃ vadet mṛṇmayaṃ, vṛkṣakāṣṭhakṛtaṃ, vaiṇavaṃ vṛkṣavad veṇukṛtaṃ, loham āyasaṃ caturaṅgulīkṛtaṃ tan mānaṃ kuḍavam ity arthaḥ, pūrvadeśe prasiddham iti || 35 ||

lg.l: yad auṣadhaṃ tu prathamaṃ yasya yogasya kathyate || 36 ||
tannāmnaiva sa yogo hi kathyate 'tra viniścayaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha prayogāṇām ādidravyāṅkitasaṃjñā nirdeṣṭum āha- yad iti | yasya yogasya gaṇasvarūpasya prathamam ādipaṭhitam auṣadhaṃ bhavati tannāmnaiva sa yogaḥsvakalpita ityartha:| kvacittu yogasyaiva mahimajñāpanārthaṃ nāmāntaraṃ kalpitaṃ bhavati | yathā sudarśanacakravajjvareṣu cūrṇamiti luptomā etena lehatailarasādiṣu na doṣa: | kathyate ity atra viniścayo jñātavyaḥ| yathā-kṣudrādi, guḍūcyādīti tātparyārthaḥ | magadhadeśe prāyaśaḥ pracaratīty ato māgadhaparibhāṣā kathyate || 36 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yasya yogasya yat prathamaṃ auṣadhaṃ kathyate sa yogas tannāmnaiva bhaved iti niścayaḥ || 36 || iti māgadhaparibhāṣā ||

ab.seg:
atha kāliṅgaparibhāṣā |
sthitir nāsty eva mātrāyāḥ kālam agniṃ vayo balam ||37||

lg.l: prakṛtiṃ doṣadeśau ca dṛṣṭvā mātrāṃ prakalpayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kāliṅgaparibhāṣāṃ darśayitum āha -- atheti | tatrādau mātrāvyavacchedārthaṃ ślokam ekaṃ paṭhanti kecit tam āha - sthitir iti | mātrāyāḥ parimāṇasya sthitir vyavasthā nāsti, yataḥ kālādikam avekṣya parimāṇaṃ yuñjyād ity abhiprāyaḥ | kālaṃ śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇaṃ, bheṣajagrahaṇakālaṃ vā | agnir api caturvidho mandatīkṣṇaviṣamasamabhedena | vayo 'pi trividham ādimadhyāntam‘mādimadhyottaram’ pā. | | balam api hīnottamamadhyamam | prakṛtir api tridhā hīnamadhyottamā, athavā deśajātiśarīrādibhiḥ prakṛter bahavo bhedāḥ | doṣo 'pi trividho vātādibhedenaādiśabdena pittakaphagrahaṇam| | deśo 'pi dvividho bhūmidehaprabhedena | bhūmideśas tu tridhā jāṅgalānūpasādhāraṇabhedena, dehadeśo 'pi tridhaiva pūrvoktaḥ || 37 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atra mātrāyāḥ sthitir nāsty eva -

lg.l: yato mandāgnayo hrasvā hīnasattvā narāḥ kalau ||38||
atas tu mātrā tadyogyā procyate sujñasammatā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha bhakṣaṇārthaṃ prāguktā kāliṅgaparibhāṣā 'sti atas tām api darśayann āha - yata iti | yataḥ kāraṇāt kalau kaliyuge īdṛśā narāḥ santi, ataḥ sthitihetoḥ tadyogyaiṣā narāṇāṃ vihitā mātrā bhakṣaṇadravyaparimāṇaṃ procyate kathyate ity arthaḥ | kathambhūtā ? sujñasammatā iti mānavedibhiḥ puruṣair vicāryamāṇā ity arthaḥ | kīdṛśās te narāḥ | mandāgnaya iti svalpāhāriṇaḥ, hrasvāś cety alpakāyāḥ hīnasattvā iti svalpabalāḥ || 38 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kutaḥ ? yataḥ kalau mandāgnayo narāḥ hrasvāḥ hīnasattvāś ca, ataḥ kālam agniṃ vayaḥ balaṃ prakṛtiṃ doṣaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā yā tu tatsammatā tadyogyā mātrā procyate sā yojyeti śeṣaḥ || 38 ||

lg.l: yavadvayena guñjā syāt triguñjo valla ucyate |
māṣo guñjābhir aṣṭābhiḥ saptabhir vā bhavet kvacit||40||
syāc caturmāṣakaiḥ śāṇaḥ sa niṣkaṣ ṭaṅka eva ca |
gadyāṇo māṣakaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ karṣaḥ syād daśamāṣikaḥ ||41 ||
catuṣpalaiś ca kuḍavaṃ prasthādyāḥ pūrvavan matāḥ || 42 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tattulanam āha - yava ityādi | dvādaśabhir dvādaśasaṃkhyākair gaurasarṣapair eko yavaḥ, gauragrahaṇaṃ tadanyajātivyavacchedārtham | īdṛśena yavadvayena ekā guñjā syād bhavet| triguñjo guñjātrayaḥ, eko vallaḥ vallasaṃjñaḥ prasiddhaḥ parimāṇaḥ | aṣṭābhir aṣṭasaṃkhyābhir guñjābhiḥ kṛtvā eko māṣaḥ kathitaḥ, māṣo 'tra ṭaṅkasya caturthāṃśaḥ | kvacid iti kutrāpi saptabhir guñjādibhiḥ kṛtvā māṣako jñeya iti tantrāntarīyamataṃ, tac ca viṣakalpe pracaritam iti vadanti kecit sarvatrāprasiddhatvāt | guñjāpy atraivoktā jñeyā | caturmāṣakaiḥ kṛtvā ekaḥ śāṇaḥ sa eva niṣkaḥ ṭaṅkaś ca paryāyanāmnā kathitaḥ | ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃkhyākair māṣakaiḥ kṛtvā eko gadyāṇaḥ, sa ca sārdhaṭaṅkaikena parimito bhavati | gadyāṇa iti parimāṇasaṃjñāśabdaḥ | daśamāṣakair eva ekaḥ karṣaḥ syāt, karṣo 'kṣaḥ kathitaḥ sa ca sārdhadviśāṇamitaḥ | catuṣkarṣaiḥ kṛtvā palam ekaṃ proktaṃ kathitam; palaṃ prasiddhaṃ karṣeṇaivoktaṃ, mānatas tatmānamiti mūlapāṭhaṃ tyaktvā sāmeti śodhanaṃ kalikātāmudrakāṇāṃ pāṇḍityamūlakam | palaṃ daśaśāṇamitaṃ boddhavyam | īdṛśaiś caturbhiḥ palaiḥ kṛtvā kuḍavam ekaṃ tac catvāriṃśacchāṇaparitulitaṃ bhavati | prasthādyāḥ pūrvavan matāḥ | iti prasthādyavaśiṣṭaṃ māgadhaparibhāṣāvaj jñeyam anukrameṇety arthaḥiyaṃ ṭippaṇirdvādaśe pṛṣṭhe draṣṭavyā | | na tu tattulyamānaṃ‘tasyāstulitena pā. | ; etena kuḍavāc cheṣamānam apy atraiva pratipāditapalena parimitaṃ boddhavyam | na tu māgadhaparibhāṣoktapaleneti tātparyārthaḥ || 39-42 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dvādaśagaurasarṣapaiḥ kṛtvā budhair yavaḥ procyate; gaurasarṣapaiḥ pītasarṣapaiḥ | yavadvayena guñjā syāt bhavet triguñjo valla ucyate aṣṭabhiḥ guñjābhiḥ saptabhir vā kvacid bhavet caturmāṣakaiḥ śāṇaḥ syāt sa eva niṣkaḥ ṭaṅkaś ca; ṣaḍbhiḥ māṣakair gadyāṇaḥ syāt daśamāṣikaḥ karṣo bhavet catuṣkarṣaiḥ palaṃ proktaṃ kiṃ viśiṣṭaṃ daśaśāṇamitaṃ catuḥpalaiḥ kṛtvā kuḍavaṃ proktaṃ prasthādyāḥ pūrvavaj jñeyāḥ || 39-42 || iti kāliṅgaparibhāṣā ||

lg.l: kāliṅgaṃ māgadhaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ mānam ucyate || 43 ||
kāliṅgān māgadhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ mānavido‘prāhurmānavido janāḥ’ pā. | viduḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. yady api deśāntare bahūni mānāni santi tathāpi dve parimāṇe prasiddhe iti vicāryāha - kāliṅgam iti | kaliṅgam iti kecit paṭhanti | kāliṅgam iti kaliṅgadeśe pracuraṃ prasiddhaṃ yat tat kāliṅgaṃ; magadhadeśe prāyaśaḥ pracaratīti māgadhamānam | iti dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇam iti, dvividhaṃ dviprakāram ucyate mānavedibhiḥ kathyata ity arthaḥ ||43|| iti kāliṅgaparibhāṣā ||

lg.l: navāny eva hi yojyāni dravyāṇy akhilakarmasu |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravyāṇāṃ yuktāyuktavicāram āha- navānīti | akhilakarmasv iti daśadhā dravyakalpanāviṣayeṣu nūtanadravyāṇi yojyānīti bhāvaḥ | yataḥ- ’sarvaṃ ca kṣīravad vīryayuktaṃ bhavati bheṣajam | teṣām alābhe gṛhṇīyād anatikrāntavatsaram’ iti | viḍaṅgādidravyaṃ vinā tena viḍaṅgaprabhṛtikaṃ purātanaṃ guṇakaram iti tātparyārthaḥ purātanatvaṃ saṃvatsarād upari bhavati | tatra dhānyaṃ dhānyakaṃ, ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tad atrāpakvaṃ jñeyaṃ, pakvaṃ tu hīnavīryaṃ syāt | tathā hi - ‘ghṛtam abdāt paraṃ pakvaṃ hīnavīryaṃ prajāyate | tailaṃ pakvam apakvaṃ vā cirasthāyi guṇādhikam’ iti purāṇaṃ rūkṣādiguṇasaṃyuktatvāt || 44 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hīti niścayena akhilakarmasu navāny eva dravyāṇi yojyāni | viḍaṅgakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vinā, guḍadhānyājyamākṣikaiś ca vinā ||

lg.l: guḍūcī kuṭajo vāsā kūṣmāṇḍaṃ ca śatāvarī |

prayoktavyā sadaivārdrā dviguṇā‘vāsānimbapaṭolaketakabalākṛṣmāṇḍakendrīvarī varṣābhukuṭajāśca kandasahitā: sāpūtigndhāmṛatā: | aindrīnāgabalākuraṇṭakapuraśchamṛtā sarvadā sādro eva tu na kvacidviguṇitā: kāryeṣu yojyā budhai: ||’ iti bhāvamiśroktamapīha dhyeyam || naiva yojayet |
śuṣkaṃdīpikāmate prakṣiptamidam| navīnaṃ yad dravyaṃ yojyaṃ sakalakarmasu || 46 ||
ārdraṃ ca dviguṇaṃ yuñjyād eṣa sarvatra niścayaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ ye sarvakāleṣv ārdrā adviguṇā dravyaviśeṣā yojyās tān āha - guḍūcīti | guḍūcīpūrvakāḥ prasāriṇīparyantā oṣadhyaḥ sadaiva sarvasmin kāle ṛtau vā tatkālīnoddhṛtāḥ prayoktavyāḥ, ete ca dravyaviśeṣā dviguṇā na kāryā vīryotkṛṣṭatvāt | guḍūcī prasiddhā; kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ sa ca kauraiyāśabdavācyaḥ‘kuṭaiyā’ pā. | | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, sahacaraḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ piyāvāsā iti śeṣaḥ | prasāriṇī svanāmakhyātā | etasyāgre ’śuṣkaṃ navīnaṃ yad dravyaṃ yojyaṃ sakalakarmasu | ārdraṃ ca dviguṇaṃ yuñjyād eṣa sarvatra niścayaḥ’ iti ślokaṃ paṭhanti kecit sa coktam evārthaṃ draḍhayati‘ato’ iti vardhitaṃ kalikātānivāsibhiḥ | na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | dviguṇam atra ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā tat pūrvam uktaṃ na tu samasamānāt | sarvatreti kalpanāsu || 45 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. guḍūcyādyāḥ prasāriṇyantāḥ sadaivārdrāḥ prayoktavyāḥ, dviguṇā naiva kārayet || 45 ||yābhiḥ pūrvoktābhir vinā śuṣkaṃ navīnaṃ yad dravyaṃ tat sakalakarmasu yojyam | ārdraṃ yad dravyaṃ tadviguṇaṃ yuñjyāt prasthādimāneṣu tulāyā vinā dravārdradravyaṃ yad yuktaṃ bhavati tadā dviguṇaṃ kāryaṃ nānyatra eṣo mayā niścayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||4 6 ||

lg.l: kāle 'nukte prabhātaṃ syād aṅge 'nukte jaṭā bhavet|| 47 ||
bhāge 'nukte tu sāmyaṃ syāt pātre 'nukte ca mṛṇmayam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīm anuktaprayoge tadbhakṣaṇakālādikam āha - kālekalikātāmudritapustake ‘kāla’ iti | bheṣajabhakṣaṇasamaye 'nukte aprakāśite sati prabhātaṃ prātaḥkāla eva syāt, tathāṅge dravyāvayave 'nukte sati jaṭā mūlaṃ syād ity arthaḥ | bhāge dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇe 'nukte sati sāmyaṃ syāt sarveṣāṃ samatā bhavatīty arthaḥ | pātre iti dravyasya karaṇārthaṃ sthāpanārthaṃ ca bhājane 'nukte sati tadā mṛṇmayaṃ mṛtpātraṃ grāhyam | cakārād dravānuktaviṣaye pānīyaṃ, tathā coktaṃ ‘drave 'pyanukte jalam eva deyaṃ bhāge 'pyanukte samatā vidheyā | aṅge 'pyanukte vihitaṃ tu mūlaṃ kālepyanukte divasasya pūrvam’ iti || gū. - auṣadhabhakṣaṇārtham anukte kāle sati prabhātaṃ syāt | aṅge anukte sati jaṭā bhavet | anukte māne sati sāmyaṃ syāt | kvāthādikathanasamaye anukte pātre sati mṛṇmayaṃ syāt bhavet || 47 || 48 ||

lg.l: ekam apy auṣadhaṃ yoge yasmin yat punar ucyate |
mānato dviguṇaṃ kāryaṃ tad dravyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ || 49 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha yogeṣu punaruktadravyasya mānam āha- ekam iti | yatra yoge ekaṃ vāpi dravyaṃ dviparyāyanāmnā kathitaṃ tad evauṣadhaṃ mānataḥ parimāṇāt dviguṇaṃ kāryaṃ dviguṇitā ca ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā iti tattvadarśibhir āyurvedarahasyajñāpakaiḥ proktam ity arthaḥ | tathā hi –
‘ghṛte taile ca yoge ca yad dravyaṃ punar ucyate |
taj jñātavyam ihāryeṇa mānato dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||’ iti || 49 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yasmin yoge ekam apy auṣadhaṃ punar ucyate tad dravyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ vaidyair mānataḥ dviguṇaṃ proktam | anyad api sāṃpradāyikaṃ prayogaṃ vadanti granthāntarāt -
‘cūrṇasnehāsavā lehāḥ prāyaḥ syuś candanānvitāḥ |
kaṣāyalepayoś cātra yujyate raktacandanam’ || 49 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ sāmānyacandanagrahaṇaṃ yogaviśeṣeṣu vibhajann āha - cūrṇeti | cūrṇādayaḥ kalpanāḥ candanagrahaṇena śvetacandanānvitā jñeyāḥ | āsavagrahaṇena sarve sandhānakāś ca | avalehagrahaṇena guṭikāgrahaṇaṃ, yathā lavaṅgādicūrṇe lākṣāditaile triphalāghṛte drākṣāsave cyavanaprāśāvalehe draṣṭavyam | kaṣāyalepayos tu candanagrahaṇena raktacandanaṃ yojyam ity arthaḥ | kaṣāyaṃ svarasādipañcakaṃ tena svarasakvāthaphāṇṭahimakalkādayaḥ | lepo daśāṅgaprabhṛtayaḥ | prāya iti grahaṇāt kutrāpi vyādhyanurūpaṃ boddhavyam | na cātra niyamārthaṃ ‘prāyaḥśabdaḥ, yato nyūnam ācaṣṭe kvacit | tathā hi - ‘prāyaḥśabdo viśeṣārthe kvacin nyūne 'pi dṛśyate’ iti| chardyartham elādicūrṇaṃ raktacandanānvitam iti prasiddhiḥ, vyādhivihitatvāt | tathā coktaṃ - ‘raktaṃ śītaṃ guru svādu charditṛṣṇāsrapittajit | tiktaṃ netrahitaṃ vṛṣyaṃ jvaravraṇaviṣāpaham’ iti || 50 ||

lg.l: guṇahīnaṃ bhaved varṣād ūrdhvaṃ tadrūpam auṣadham |
oṣadhyo laghupākāḥ syur nirvīryā vatsarāt param |
purāṇāḥ syur guṇair yuktā āsavā dhātavo rasāḥ ||53||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ prasiddhadravyāṇāṃ kālātikrameṇa hīnaguṇatvam āha - guṇahīnam iti | varṣād ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarād upari tadrūpam auṣadhaṃ guṇahīnaṃ bhavet svakāryakaraṃ na bhavatīty arthaḥ | tadrūpam iti yādṛśaṃ dravyasvarūpaṃ tādṛśam eva tadrūpaṃ kathitaṃ na tu cūrṇādikalpitam | tathā ca - ‘dhāturūpaṃ dravyavarjaṃ na śreṣṭhaṃ vatsaroṣitami’ti | tathā cūrṇaṃ tālīsādyādikaṃ, māsadvayād upari hīnavīryasya bhāvaḥ hīnavīryatvam āpnuyāt, vīryahānir apy atra bhāvamātraṃ na tu sarvathā vīryarahitatvamata evākallakasya saptavarṣaparyantamapi guṇā na hīyante | , yatas tantrāntare dṛśyate hi lavaṇabhāskarādīnāṃ bahuparimāṇaṃ cirakālasevanārtham | tad uktaṃ -
‘pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ dhānyākaṃ kṛṣṇajīrakam |
saindhavaṃ ca viḍaṃ‘cavika’ pā. | caiva patraṃ tālīsakeśaram ||
eṣāṃ dvipalikān bhāgān pañca sauvarcalasya ca |
maricā 'jājiśuṇṭhīnām ekaikasya palaṃ palam||
tvagele cārdhabhāge ca sāmudrāt kuḍavadvayam |
dāḍimāt kuḍavaṃ caiva dve pale cāmlavetasāt ||’ iti | etat sambhāraṃ bahukālopayogikam, anyathā vyartham etat tasmād bhāvamātraṃ cūrṇasya māsadvayād upari hīnatvaṃ syād ity abhiprāyaḥ| guṭikā vijayādiguṭikā, lehāḥ khaṇḍakhādyā avalehaprabhṛtayaś cirakālasthitā api svaguṇaṃ na parityajanti kintu kiñcidguṇarīhatā iti bhāvaḥ | tathā tailaghṛtādyāś caturmāsādhikād api vatsarāt paraṃ svaguṇaṃ na parityajanti kintu kiñcidguṇarahitā iti bhāvaḥ, caturmāsādhikād vatsarāt paraṃ ṣoḍaśamāsād uparīty arthaḥ | eke caturmāsādhikās tatheti paṭhanti | tatra caturmāsagrahaṇena varṣākālaṃ manyante, ‘varṣāyām uṣitaṃ snehaṃ pakvaṃ hīnatvam āpnuyāt’ iti vacanāt | tatheti grahaṇāt atrāpi na bhāvamātraṃ kintu dravyasamūhapākajasya guṇasya hānir na tu prakṛtiguṇahāniḥ | tathā ca ‘lehaḥ siddho guḍādīnāṃ guṇahīno bhaved dhruvam | snehādyāḥ pūrvavīryāḥ syus te caturmāsatas tathā’ iti | kecit tu ‘hīnaṃ ca syād ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ tailaṃ vā vatsarāt param’ iti keṣāñcin matam avalokya paṭhanti tan na sarvasammatam | yataḥ sarvasammataṃ vākyam idaṃ dṛśyate ‘ghṛtam abdāt paraṃ kiñcid dhīnavīryatvam āpnuyāt | tailaṃ pakvam apakvaṃ vā cirasthāyi guṇādhikam’ iti | laghupākā oṣadhyo varṣād upari nirvīryāḥ syuḥ, niḥśeṣeṇa vīryarahitā ity arthaḥ | na tu hīnatvam | tāś ca yavagodhūmapramukhāḥ | tathā ca
‘eteṣu yavagodhūmatilamāṣā navā hitāḥ |
rūḍhāḥ purāṇā virasā na tathā guṇakāriṇaḥ |’ iti | atha cirakālasthitā ye utkṛṣṭaguṇāḥ syus tān āha - purāṇā ityādi | purāṇāś cirakālasthitā bahusaṃvatsaroṣitā apīty arthaḥ | guṇair yuktā iti te āsavādayo viśiṣṭaguṇānvitā bhavantīty adhyāhāryam | āsavā madyabhedāḥ, āsavā iti bahuvacanena sarve sandhānakāś ca jñeyāḥ | dhātava iti suvarṇarajatādayaḥ, bahuvacanāc ca saṃsiddhamṛgāṅkādayo 'pi boddhavyāḥ || 51-53 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. varṣāt saṃvatsarād ūrdhvaṃ tadrūpaṃ auṣadhaṃ guṇahīnaṃ bhavet | varṣād ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarād anantaraṃ na tu varṣāṛtubhya ūrdhvaṃ | tathā tena prakāreṇa māsadvayānantaraṃ cūrṇaṃ hīnavīryatvam āyāt| guṭikāvalehau etau dvau saṃvatsarāt paraṃ hīnatvaṃ labhete | tathā tena prakāreṇa varṣād adhikāḥ ghṛtatailādyāḥ hīnāḥ syuḥ bhaveyuḥ | caturmāsādhikāḥ cāturmāsyādhikā laghupākāḥ oṣadhyaḥ vatsarāt paraṃ nirvīryāḥ syuḥ | āsavā dhātavo rasāḥ purāṇā eva guṇair yuktāḥ syuḥ ||51-53||

lg.l: vyādher ayuktaṃ yad dravyaṃ gaṇoktam api tat tyajet |
anuktam api yad yuktaṃ yojayet tatra tad budhaḥ || 54 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ rogāṇām uktānuktadravyaviśeṣam āha - vyādher iti | yasya vyādher ayuktam asātmyaṃ yad dravyaṃ gaṇeṣūktam api tat tyājyam, yathā atīsāre pathyā | yad gaṇe 'nuktam api vyādheḥ sātmyaṃ tatra tad yojyam iti vyavahāraḥ | yathā 'tīsāre stambhanārthaṃ vatsakapāṭhādi | tathā coktam - ‘gaṇoktam api yad dravyaṃ bhaved vyādhau na yaugikam | tad uddhared yaugikaṃ tu prakṣiped anyayaugikam iti || 54 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vyādheḥ rogasya yat ahitam ayuktaṃ dravyaṃ tat gaṇoktam api tyajet | gaṇeṣv anuktaṃ dravyaṃ yuktaṃ bhavati ced āyojayet || 54 || iti yuktāyuktavicāraḥ ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravyāharaṇārthaṃ deśādikathanam āha‘kālā.’ pā.| - āgneyā iti | yato vindhyaśailādyā āgneyāḥ agniguṇabhūyiṣṭhāḥ | ādigrahaṇān malayasahya- pāriyātrā(parvatā)dayaḥ| himagiris tu saumyo mataḥ, saumyaguṇabhūyiṣṭha ity arthaḥ | ato hetos tadudbhavāni dravyāṇi tadrūpāṇi syur uṣṇaśītavīryāṇi bhavantīty arthaḥ | na kevalaṃ śailajātāni anyeṣv api vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca yāni prarohanti tāny api hetubhiḥ kṛtvā śītoṣṇavīryāṇi bhavantīti tātparyārthaḥ | hetur api ṛtusvarūpam iti, etena yādṛśaṃ ṛturūpaṃ śītoṣṇādikaṃ bhavati tādṛśam eva tajjātadravyasya vīryam ity arthaḥ | āgame 'pi ‘agnīṣomīyatvāj jagataḥ’ iti | vanam udyānaṃ, upavanaṃ puruṣavyāpārakṛtaṃ pūrvam uktam || 55 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vindhyaśailādyāḥ oṣadhyaḥ āgneyāḥ, himagiriḥ saumyo mataḥ, himagirau yā oṣadhyaḥ tāḥ saumyāḥ śītaguṇayuktāḥ, ato himagiriḥ parvataḥ saumyo mataḥ | kutaḥ? yataḥ tadauṣadhāni teṣāṃ parvatānām auṣadhāni hetubhiḥ anurūpāṇi syuḥ yathā śītahetubhir utpannānāṃ rogāṇāṃ uṣṇāny auṣadhāny uṣṇaheturūpāṇi śītalahetunāśakāni bhavanti evaṃ śītānyauṣadhāni uṣṇaheturūpāṇi uṣṇahetunāśakāni bhavantīty arthaḥ | na cāgneyāḥ saumyāś cauṣadhyaḥ parvateṣv evotpadyante nānyatra na hy anyeṣv api tad āha || 55 ||

lg.l: gṛhṇīyāt tāni sumanāḥ śuciḥ prātaḥ suvāsare ||56||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravyāṇām āharaṇakramam āha - gṛhṇīyād iti | sumanāḥ śobhanacittaḥ puruṣa iti śeṣaḥ, tāni pūrvoktāni dravyāṇi prātar aruṇodaye gṛhṇīyād utpāṭya dhārayed iti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃbhūtaḥ? śucir iti bāhyābhyantareṇa, ādityamukha iti pūrvābhimukhaḥ, maunīty ajalpakaḥ, suvāsare iti viśiṣṭanakṣatrādisaṃyukte dine | kiṃ kṛtvā? citte īśvaraṃ namaskṛtya | sādhāraṇadharādravyam iti sādhāraṇadharā jāṅgalānūpamiśritā‘rahitā’ pā.| pṛthvī tatrotpannadravyam | uttarāśritam iti uttaradigvibhāgasthitaṃ mūlaṃ dravyam iti śeṣaḥ | etena dravyāṇāṃ savīryatvaṃ darśitam | kecid uttarāśrita iti puruṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti | sa ca uttarābhimukho bhūtvā gṛhṇīyād iti | gṛhṇīyād iti dviruktir niścayārthajñāpanārtham, nānyathā gṛhṇīyād ity asya tātparyārthaḥ | eke tu gṛhṇīyād iti padaṃ pūrvaślokena yojanīyam iti vadanti ||56||57||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyeṣu vaneṣu parvateṣu yāny auṣadhāni prarohanti tāni śucir bhūtvā sumanāḥ pumān prātar eva suvāsare gṛhṇīyāt | grahaṇavidhānam āha - maunayuktaḥ sa pumān ādityasaṃmukho bhūtvā śivaṃ hṛdi namaskṛtya uttarāśritaṃ sādhāraṇadharādravyaṃ auṣadhaṃ gṛhṇīyād ity arthaḥ | granthāntarād bhūmer lakṣaṇam āha ‘varṇagandharasopetā ṣaḍvidhā bhūmir ucyate’ | tatra samāṃ gaurāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ lohitāṃ dṛṣadvatīṃ bahujalāṃ kaṭhināṃ ca bhūmim auṣadhagrahaṇāya parīkṣeta | tatra sādhāraṇā bhūmiḥ śreṣṭhā | suśrutaḥ sādhāraṇāṃ bhūmim āha -
‘sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā bhūmiḥ sādhāraṇā smṛtā |
dravyāṇi yatra tatraiva tadguṇāś ca viśeṣataḥ’ || 56 || 57 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kutsitasthānajātadravyasya parityāgam āha -valmīketi | valmīkādiṣu sthāneṣu jātā utpannā oṣadhyo na kāryakarāḥ tathā jantuvahnihimavyāptāś ca, ity atra vyāptaśabdo jantvādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate | kutsitaṃ bībhatsasthānaṃ, ānūpaṃ jalaprāyasthānaṃ jalavyāptam ity arthaḥ | jantuvyāptā iti kṛmijagdhāḥ, vahnivyāptā dāvāgnidagdhāḥ, himavyāptās tuṣārābhivyāptāḥ | oṣadhya iti bahuvacanenātra puṣpaphalamūlatvaksāraniryāsādayo boddhavyāḥ || 58 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. valmīkakutsitānūpaśmaśānoṣaramārgajāḥ jantuvahnihimavyāptāś cauṣadhyaḥ kāryasiddhidā na | valmīkajaṃ tu mṛṇmayaṃ, jalaprāyam ānūpaḥ | sugamam anyat || 58 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīm ṛtuviśeṣeṇa virekavamanārtham api dravyāharaṇakālam āha - śaradīti | śaradi śaratkāle akhilakāryārthaṃ sakalaprayoganimittaṃ grāhyam | vasantānte grīṣmakāle samāhared gṛhṇīyād ity arthaḥ | yady api akhilakāryagrahaṇenāpi virekavamanam api prāptam eva tathāpi vākyānāṃ dvaividhyena sāmānyaviśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam iti na doṣo 'khilagrahaṇena | tathā ca
‘grīṣme mañjarikāgreṣu varṣāsu dalacarmaṇī |
vasante mūlam āśritya vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca rasasya ca’ || 59 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śaradi akhilakāryārthaṃ sarvakāryārthaṃ sarasam auṣadhaṃ grāhyam | virekavamanārthaṃ vasantānte vasantamadhye samāharet ||59||

lg.l: atisthūlajaṭā yāḥ syus tāsāṃ grāhyās tvaco budhaiḥ |
nyagrodhādes tvaco grāhyāḥ sāraḥ syād bījakāditaḥ |
tālīsādeś ca patrāṇi phalaṃ syāt triphalāditaḥ || 61 ||

ab.seg: dhātakyādeś ca puṣpāṇi snuhyādeḥ kṣīram āharet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ pūrvakhaṇḍe paribhāṣā nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1||

Āḍhamalla. athānuktāvayavānāṃ dravyāṇām aṅgagrahaṇam āha - atisthūleti | yā oṣadhyaḥ atisthūlajaṭāḥ pṛthutaramūlāḥ tāsām oṣadhīnāṃ tvaco valkalā grāhyāḥ, tāś ca vaṭanimbāmraprabhṛtayaḥ | dhruvam iti niścayena | yāni sūkṣmamūlāni dravyāṇi tāny api sakalāni gṛhṇīyāt, buddhimān iti sadvaidyaḥ | sūkṣmamūlāni gokṣurakaṇṭakāriprabhṛtīni | sakalānīti mūlapatrapuṣpaśākhānvitānīty arthaḥ | ‘atisthūlajaṭāyāḥ syu’riti kecit paṭhanti | tatrātisthūlajaṭānāṃ tvaco grāhyā iti daśamūlapakṣe pracāraḥ || atha dravyāṇāṃ prasiddhāṅgāharaṇatvena viśeṣam āha - nyagrodhāder iti | nyagrodhāder ity anena viśeṣo darśitaḥ, nyagrodho vaṭavṛkṣas tadāder dravyasyānuktatvāt tvaco valkalā grāhyāḥ, ādiśabdāt plakṣāmrajambūkapītanakāśvatthaprabhṛtayaḥ | bījakādita iti | bījako vijayāsāro vṛkṣaviśeṣas tadāditas tatprabhṛteḥ sāro madhyasthitaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣo grāhyaḥ, ādiśabdāt khadirāsanabandhūkavavvūlādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tālīsāder iti tālīsaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ tadādes tatpūrvakāt patrāṇi palāśāni grāhyāṇi ādigrahaṇāt patrakakaumārīnāgavallīpatraśākādayaḥ | triphalādita iti triphalā prasiddhā | tadāditas tatprabhṛteḥ phalaṃ grāhyam ādigrahaṇāt priyaṅgukaṅkolamadanaphalādayaḥ | tālīsādeś ceti | cakārād anuktāny api puṣpaniryāsaśuṅgādīny anumānato boddhavyāni || 60 ||
61 || iti śrīvātsavyanvayāprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe paribhāṣā nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yā auṣadhyaḥ atisthūlajaṭāḥ syur dhruvam iti niścayena tāsāṃ tvaco grāhyāḥ | buddhimān pumān sūkṣmamūlāni auṣadhāni gṛhṇīyād ity arthaḥ | nyagrodhādeḥ sthūlavṛkṣasya tvaco grāhyāḥ bījakāditaḥ vijayasārakhadirādeḥ sāraḥ syāt triphalāditaḥ phalaṃ syāt ādiśabdāj jātīphalakaṭphalādayo 'pi || 60 ||
61 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne paribhāṣādhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ || 1 ||

div.head: atha bhaiṣajyākhyānakādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
atha bhaiṣajyākhyānakādhyāyaḥ |
bhaiṣajyam abhyavaharet prabhāte prāyaśo budhaḥ |
kaṣāyāṃś ca viśeṣeṇa tatra bhedas tu darśitaḥ || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktaṃ ‘bhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ tathā’ iti, idānīṃ tad darśayann āha -bhaiṣajyasya ākhyānakaṃ bhakṣaṇakālādikathanam – tad adhikṛtyāha - bhaiṣajyam iti | budho bhaiṣajyaṃ prāyaśo bāhulyena prabhāte abhyavaharet bhakṣayed ity arthaḥ | bhiṣajā saṃstutaṃ dravyaṃ bhaiṣajyam | budha ity anena auṣadhakālān vīkṣya svabuddhyā śīlayed ity arthaḥ | nātra prabhātam eva sarveṣāṃ niyatakālam | ata eva vakṣyante atraiva viśeṣāḥ | yathā - kaṣāyāṃś ca viśeṣeṇeti | viśeṣagrahaṇena kaṣāyān prātar evābhyavaharet nānyatra | kaṣāyān iti bahuvacanena svarasādayaḥ pañcakaṣāyasaṃjñakā jñātavyāḥ, tad yathā - ‘svarasaḥ kalpaniryūhau himaphāṇṭau ca viśrutāḥ’ iti | tatra auṣadhabhakṣaṇe bhedaḥ kālabhedo darśitaḥ kathita ity arthaḥ | vakṣyamāṇa iti śeṣaḥ || 1 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. prāyaśo bāhulyena prabhāte bhaiṣajyam avaharet prayojayet viśeṣataḥ kaṣāyāṃś ca prayojayet | tatra bhedas tu darśitaḥ ‘kālenukte prabhātaṃ syā’d ity atra || 1 ||

lg.l: sāyantane bhojane ca muhuś cāpi tathā niśi |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tadbhedam āha - jñeya iti | bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe auṣadhabhakṣaṇanimitte nṛṇāṃ pañcavidhaḥ pañcaprakāraḥ kālaḥ samayo jñeyaḥ | etac cātipātivyādhiṣu na kālaniyama ity eke bhāṣante, yataḥ ‘atipātiṣu rogeṣu necched vidhim imaṃ bhiṣak | pradīptāgāravac chīghraṃ tataḥ kuryāt pratikriyām’ iti | satyaṃ, tathāpi kartavyam etat | atha pañcaprakārān āha – kiñcid iti | tatra kiṃcit sūryodaye jāte sati ekaḥ kālaḥ, sa tu prāyaśaḥ kaṣāyārtham ādau pratipāditaḥ; ‘kaṣāyārthaṃ viśeṣeṇa’ iti vacanāt | dvitīyas tu divasabhojane bheṣajakālaḥ sa pañcavidho bhavati | bhojanāgre yathā lavaṇārdrakaṃ bhojanamiśraṃ yathā hiṅgughṛtādikaṃ, bhojanamadhye yathā pānīyādikaṃ, bhojanānte yathā lavaṅgaharītakyādi bhojanapūrvānte ceti yathā dhātrīlohamalapitte | tṛtīyakālas tu sandhyāsamayabhojane jñeyaḥ, so 'pi trividhaḥ grāse grāsāntare‘bhaktādau, bhaktamadhye, bhaktānte’ pā. | bhuktānte ceti sa cānumānato boddhavyaḥ | caturthakālas tu vāraṃ vāraṃ kathitaḥ, sa dvividhaḥ, tatra dravyaṃ sānnaṃ nirannaṃ ceti | pañcamaḥ kālas tu niśi rātrau boddhavyaḥ||2||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pañcavidhakālaḥ - tam āha - nṛṇāṃ bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe bhakṣaṇārthe pañcavidhaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ - kiñcit sūryodaye jāte prathamakālo jñeyaḥ | tathā tena prakāreṇa divasabhojanena madhyāhne dvitīyaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | ca punaḥ sāyantane bhojane tṛtīyaprahare tṛtīyaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | muhuḥ ko 'rthaḥ - caturthaprahare caturthaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | atra muhur avyayam | caturthapraharārdhe darśitaḥ | niśi sandhyāyāṃ pañcamaḥ kālo jñeyaḥ | iti pañcakālānām anukramaṇikā || 2 ||

lg.l: lekhanārthaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ prabhāte tat samāharet |
evaṃ syāt prathamaḥ kālo bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe nṛṇām || 4 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ viśeṣavivaraṇam āha - prāya iti | pittakaphodreke sati virekavamanārthayoḥ dravyaṃ prabhāte bhakṣayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | yathā pittodreke virekaḥ kaphodreke vamanam iti | udreko doṣotkaṭaḥ | anyathā asmin kāle 'pi vamanavirekayor na niṣedhaḥ | tathā hi ‘sadyo bhuktasya vā jāte jvare sāme viśeṣataḥ | vamanaṃ vamanārhasya śastam ity āha vāgbhaṭaḥ’ ityādivacanāt | vamanātiyogena virekaṃ mṛdu kārayet ity api na kevalaṃ vamanavirekanimittam | lekhanārthaṃ ca prātar eva lekhanaṃ pattalīkaraṇaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ ca | puruṣāṇāṃ yathā sthūlasya madhvambunā, doṣāṇāṃ yathā - vāyos tailaṃ, pittasya ghṛtaṃ, kaphasya madhu iti | evam iti parisamāptaḥ prathamaḥ kālaḥ || 3-4 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha prathamakālaḥ | prāyaḥ atiśayena kaphodreke pittakaphādhikye virekavamanārthayoḥ, ca punaḥ lekhanārthe kṛśīkaraṇārthe medorogādau dantadhāvanārthe ca | tatra bhaiṣajyaṃ prabhāte samāharet bhakṣayed ity arthaḥ | evam, amunā prakāreṇa bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe prathamaḥ kālaḥ syāt iti prathamaḥ || 3 || 4 ||

lg.l: arucau citrabhojyaiś ca miśraṃ ruciram āharet || 5 ||
dadyād bhojanamadhye ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak || 6 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha dvitīyakālam āha - bhaiṣajyam iti | apāne gudasthite vāte viguṇe kruddhe bhojanāgre bhuktādau bhakṣayed bhaiṣajyam iti śeṣaḥ | arucau satyāṃ citrabhojyair manojñavyañjanādikaiḥ saha miśraṃ militaṃ ruciraṃ rucikaraṃ yathā syāt tathā bhakṣayed bhaiṣajyam iti pūrvavan mantavyam | samānavāte nābhisthite vāyau viguṇe prakupite saty agnimāndye 'pi ca agnidīpanam agnikaraṃ dravyaṃ bhojanamadhye dadyād ity arthaḥ | tathā hikkākṣepakakampeṣu satsu bhojanasya pūrvam ante ca dadyāt | ākṣepako vātaroge paṭhitaḥ, kampo 'pi vātaroge || 5-7 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. apāne gudasthe vāyau viguṇe sati bhaiṣajyaṃ madhyāhne bhojanāgre bhojanādau praśasyate yujyate | dvitīye kāle madhyāhne iti sarvatraiva yojyam | arucau satyāṃ citrabhojyaiḥ saha ruciram auṣadhaṃ miśram annayuktaṃ yathā syāt tathā āharet prayojayet | citrabhojyaiḥ nānāvyañjanaiḥ, samānavāte nābhisthe vāyau, mande 'gnau ca sati agnidīpanabhaiṣajyaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak bhojanamadhye dadyāt| kuśalo bhiṣak vaidyakaśāstre nipuṇaḥ | vyānakope sarvaśarīrasthe vāyau kupite sati bhaiṣajyam auṣadhaṃ bhojanānte bhojanamadhye samāhared yojayet| hikkākṣepakakampeṣv adhikeṣu satsu bhojanāt pūrvaṃ ante ca bhaiṣajyaṃ yojayed iti śeṣaḥ | ākṣepakaḥ vāyuḥ | evam amunā prakāreṇa dvitīyaḥ kālaḥ bhaiṣajyakarmaṇi proktaḥ || 5-7 ||

lg.l: prāṇe praduṣṭe sāndhyasya bhuktasyānte ca dīyate || 9 ||
auṣadhaṃ prāyaśo dhīraiḥ kālo 'yaṃ syāt tṛtīyakaḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha tṛtīyakālam āha - udāne iti | udāne kaṇṭhasthite vāte kupite, kathaṃbhūte svarabhaṅgādikāriṇi, svarabhaṅgo vikṛtasvaratvaṃ mūkatvaṃ vā, ādigrahaṇāt kaṇṭhagatarogāṇāṃ grahaṇam | sāndhyabhojane sandhyāsamayabhojane 'gre grāse kavale grāsāntare kavalayor madhye bheṣajyaṃ deyam ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā prāṇe hṛdayasthite prāṇavāte praduṣṭe sati sāndhyasya bhuktasyāhārasya ante prānte auṣadhaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ | dhīrair iti gambhīrabuddhibhiḥ puruṣaiḥ | ayaṃ tṛtīyaḥ kālaḥ syāj jānīyāt | nanu kathaṃ vāyoḥ prāṇādayaḥ pañcabhedā darśitāḥ pittakaphayos tu nodāhṛtāḥ? ucyate - anilas tu doṣadhātumalādīnāṃ pradhānatamaḥ prakopakāraṇahetuś ca ata evāsya prakopeṇa pittakaphayoḥ prakopa eva ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvān eva prakopayet’ iti vacanāt | anyad api
‘svayambhūr eṣa bhagavān vāyur ity abhiśabditaḥ |
acintyavīryo doṣāṇāṃ netā rogasamūharāṭ’ ||8-9 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. udāne kaṇṭhasthe vāyau kupite sāndhyabhojane tṛtīyaprahare bhaiṣajyaṃ grāsagrāsāntare deyam | bhūte udāne svarabhaṅgādikāraṇaṃ śīlaṃ yasya tasmin hṛdisthe prāṇavāte praduṣṭe sati sāndhyasya bhuktasyānte tṛtīyapraharamadhye dhīraiḥ prāyaśo bāhulyena auṣadhaṃ dīyate | ity ayaṃ tṛtīyaḥ kālaḥ syāt | iti tṛtīyakālaḥ || 8 || 9 ||

lg.l: sānnaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ dadyād iti kālaś caturthakaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha caturthakālam āha -muhur muhur ityādi | tṛḍādiṣu satsu muhur muhur vāraṃ vāraṃ sānnam iti bhaktamiśritaṃ dravyaṃ dadyāt | cakārāt kvacin nirannavyavahārān na doṣaḥ | tṛṭ tṛṣṇā, garam atra viṣam | iti caturthaḥ kālaḥ || 10 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. muhus turye prahare ko 'rthaḥ | punaḥ tṛṭchardihikkāśvāsagareṣu sānnaṃ bheṣajam | tṛṭ tṛṣṇā, garaṃ viṣam | iti caturthaḥ ||10||

lg.l: pācanaṃ śamanaṃ deyam anannaṃ bheṣajaṃ niśi |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha pañcamakālam āha - ūrdhveti | rātrau pācanaśamanarūpam auṣadhaṃ cānnarahitaṃ deyam iti bhāvaḥ | kutra ? ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu tathā lekhane bṛṃhaṇe ca jatru grīvāmūlaṃ, tadūrdhvavikārāḥ śirorogādayaḥ | tathā ca - ‘ūrdhvajatrujaroge tu sāyaṃ syād avalehikā’ ityādivacanāt lekhanaṃ pravṛddharogāṇāṃ hrasvānāṃ bṛṃhaṇam iti kṣīṇadoṣavardhanam iti bhāvaḥ | niśīti sāmānyena sakalarātrāv ity eke bhāṣante, saṃpradāne tu prathamaṃ yāmaṃ varam ity arthaḥ | ‘iti pañcamakālaḥ syāt’| ity asya sthāne ‘ity evaṃ pañcamaḥ kālaḥ’ pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | bhaiṣajyahetave dravyabhakṣaṇanimitte ity evaṃ pañcamaḥ kālaḥ kathitaḥ || 11 || 12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu satsu tathā karaṇīye lekhane bṛṃhaṇe 'rthe pācanaṃ dravyaṃ sthānān malasañcayam ūrdhvam adho vā yan nayet tac chamanam ity ayaṃ bhaiṣajyahetave pañcamakālaḥ proktaḥ | iti pañcamakālaḥ || 11 || 12 ||

lg.l: dravye raso guṇo vīryaṃ vipākaḥ śaktir eva ca |
saṃbandhenasaṃvedana pā. | kramād etāḥ pañcāvasthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||13||

ab.seg:
rasaḥ -
madhuro 'mlaḥ paṭuś caiva kaṭutiktakaṣāyakāḥ |
ity ete ṣaḍrasāḥ khyātā nānādravyasamāśritāḥ||14||

guṇāḥ -
guruḥ snigdhaś ca tīkṣṇaś ca rūkṣo laghur iti kramāt |
dharāmbuvahnipavanavyomnāṃ prāyo guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||16||

eṣv evāntarbhavanty anye guṇeṣu guṇasañcayāḥ | vīryam -
vīryam uṣṇaṃ tathā śītaṃ prāyaśo dravyasaṃśrayam ||1 7||
tat sarvam agnīṣomīyaṃ dṛśyate bhuvanatraye |
atraivāntarbhaviṣyanti vīryāṇy anyāni yāny api||18||

vipākaḥ -
tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ |
miṣṭaḥ paṭuś ca madhuram amlo 'mlaṃ pacyate rasaḥ || 19 ||

lg.l: madhurāj jāyate śleṣmā pittam amlāc ca jāyate || 20 ||

ab.seg:
kaṭukāj jāyate vāyuḥ karmāṇīti vipākataḥ | prabhāvaḥ -
prabhāvas tu yathā dhātrī lakucasya rasādibhiḥ || 21 ||

lg.l: kvacit tu kevalaṃ dravyaṃ karma kuryāt prabhāvataḥ || 22 ||
kvacid raso guṇo vīryaṃ vipākaḥ śaktir eva ca ||23||
karma svaṃ svaṃ prakurvanti dravyam āśritya ye sthitāḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravye rasādīnāṃ viśeṣāvasthām āha - dravya iti | dravye pradhānabhūte rasādayaḥ pañcā 'vasthāḥ kathitāḥ, saṃbandhena kramād iti jñānakramāt, tāś ca rasaguṇavīryavipākaprabhāvādayo rasāḥ ṣaṭ madhurādayas te tu madhurāmlalavaṇatiktoṣaṇakaṣāyāḥ | guṇā viṃśatiḥ - te yathā-guru-manda-hima-snigdha-ślakṣṇa-sāndra-mṛdu-sthira-sūkṣma-viśadā iti daśa; viparyayās tu - laghu-tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣakharadravakaṭhinasarasthūlapicchilāḥ; evaṃ viṃśatiguṇāḥ kathitāḥ | vīryam iti dvividhaṃ śītam uṣṇaṃ ceti| kecid aṣṭavidham āhuḥ - śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣaviśadapicchilamṛdu tīkṣṇaṃ ceti, yataḥ - ‘vīryasaṃjñā guṇā hy ete te 'pi dravyāśrayā matāḥ’ iti vacanāt| vipākas tu trividhaḥ svādvamlakaṭukātmaka iti | kecid gurulaghudvāreṇa dvividham āhuḥ | tatra madhuraḥ kaṭukātmakaḥ yato madhurākhyo guruḥ kaṭukākhyo laghur iti | śaktiś cācintyaprabhāvo dravyāṇāṃ yathā maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ vidhiḥ | ete 'pi rasādayo dravyāśritā bhavanti tasmād dravyaṃ pradhānam ity āhuḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘pāko nāsti vinā vīryād vīryaṃ nāsti vinā rasāt | raso nāsti vinā dravyād dravyaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ smṛtam’ iti | dravyam iti sāmānyagrahaṇena mūlatvaksāraniryāsādīny abhidhīyante | tad yathā -
‘mūlatvaksāraniryāsanālasvarasapallavāḥ |
kṣīraṃ kṣāraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ bhasma tailāni kaṇṭakam ||
patrāṇi śṛṅgakandāni prarohās tūdbhidādayaḥ |
dravyaśabdena gṛhyante jaṅgamāḥ pārthivās tathā ||’ iti | jaṅgamā api yathā -
‘madhūni gorasāḥ pittaṃ vasā majjā 'sṛg āmiṣam |
viṇmūtracarmareto 'sthi snāyuśṛṅganakhaṃ khurāḥ || jaṅgamebhyaḥ prayujyante keśā lomāni rocanāḥ’ iti | pārthivāś ca yathā - ‘suvarṇaṃ samalāḥ pañca lohāś ceti kalāsu ca | manaḥ śilāle maṇayo lavaṇaṃ gairikāñjanam’ ityādi || atha teṣāṃ rasādīnāṃ svarūpam āha - madhura iti | madhurādayaḥ ṣaḍrasā dravyāśritāḥ santo 'pi vyākhyātā eva | tatra madhuro ghṛtaguḍādiḥ, amlo amlīkāmātuluṅgādiḥ, paṭur lavaṇaparyāyaḥ sa ca saindhavādiḥ, kaṭuko marīcādiḥ, tikto nimbādiḥ, kaṣāyo harītakyādiḥ || eteṣāṃ mūrtīnām utpattim āha - dharetyādi | utpatis tu bhūtadvayena bhavati | bhūtaṃ pṛthivyādi | kramād iti yuktakrameṇa tad yathā - dharāmbubhyāṃ madhuro rasaḥ, tena pṛthivyambubāhulyena madhurarasa utpadyate, evaṃ kṣmā 'nalābhyām amlaḥ, jalajvalanābhyāṃ lavaṇaḥ, ākāśamarudbhyāṃ kaṭukaḥ, vāyvagnibhyāṃ tiktaḥ, kṣmā 'nilābhyāṃ kaṣāya iti rasaḥ || atha guṇāḥ - gurur iti | gurusnigdhādayo guṇāḥ kramāt dharādīnāṃ kathitāḥ | kramo yathā - dharāyā guruḥ, ambunaḥ snigdhaḥ, vahnes tīkṣṇaḥ, pavanasya rūkṣaḥ, vyomno laghur iti | prāya iti prāyeṇa ete 'tra mukhyā guṇā guṇānāṃ madhye kathitāḥ | pañcaguṇagrahaṇaṃ bhūtakrameṇa kṛtam | eṣv eva pañcaguṇeṣu anyo 'pi ślakṣṇasāndramṛduprabhṛtiguṇasaṃcayo boddhavyaḥ | sa cāpy anumānato nirūpaṇīyaḥ | guṇā iti bahuvacanatvena vyavāyī vikāsī cākarau dvau dvāviṃśatyartham iti kecit, satvaṃ rajas tamaś ceti trayo mahāguṇāḥ kathitā iti kaiścit || atha vīryam - vīryam iti śaktiḥ | tad dvividham api prāyaśo bāhulyena dravyāśrayaṃ dravyādhīnaṃ bhavati | dvividhaṃ śītoṣṇabhedena | yasmād bhuvanatrayam agnyātmakaṃ somātmakaṃ ca dṛśyate | atraiva śītoṣṇavīrye anyāni yāni vīryāṇi tāny antarbhaviṣyantīti kecit vadanti na svamatam, yataḥ prāyaśa iti grahaṇena śītoṣṇaṃ viśiṣṭavīryam | anyānīti snigdharūkṣaviśadapicchilamṛdutīkṣṇādīni mahābhūtāni tu kṣmāmbujvalanākāśamarutaḥ || atha vipākam āha - miṣṭa iti | prāyaśo bāhulyenātra trividha eva vipākaḥ madhuro 'mlaḥ kaṭuka iti | viśiṣṭo pāko vipākas tatra miṣṭo madhuraḥ paṭur lavaṇa etayor madhura iti madhuravipāka ity abhiprāyaḥ | amlo 'mlam iti | amlo rasaḥ amlam eva pacyate | kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ rasānāṃ kaṭur iti kaṭukavipākaḥ syāt | etadabhiprāyeṇa tantrāntare coktam ‘tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ’ iti | ata eva vipākānāṃ trividhaṃ karma bhavati | tad āha -madhurād ityādi | madhurān madhuravipākāt śleṣmā prajāyate prakopam āpadyate ity arthaḥ | amlāc cety amlavipākāt pittam iti | kaṭukād iti kaṭukavipākād vāyur iti | etāni karmāṇi yat kurvanti tat karma, karmaśabdenātra doṣaprakopavyāpāralakṣaṇaṃ dharma iti || idānīṃ prabhāvam āha - prabhāva iti | viśiṣṭo bhāva utkṛṣṭā śaktir ity arthaḥ | yathā dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ rasādibhir iti rasaguṇavīryavipākādibhiḥ samā samānaguṇā laghur apy asti tathāpi tad evāmalakīphalaṃ prabhāvād doṣatrayanāśanaṃ niyatam eva | iti rasādiprabhāvaḥ || kevalaṃ dravyaprabhāvam āha - kvacid ityādi | kutrāpi kevalam ekadravyam eva prabhāvataḥ karma kuryāt | yathā sahadevījaṭā śirobaddhā satī jvaraṃ hantīti | ata evācintyo maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāva iti viśrutiḥ | eke ‘prabhāvas tu yathā dhātrīlakucasya rasādibhir i’ti paṭhanti | tatra lakucaphalasya rasādibhiḥ saha dhātrī samānadharmā, tatrāpi dhātrī prabhāvād eva doṣatrayanāśinī bhavati | lakucaphalam - lakucaḥ kṣudrapanasaḥ, nāraṅgaphalam ity eke || 13-23 ||

atha dravyāśritānāṃ rasādīnāṃ nijotkṛṣṭatām āha - kvacid iti | dravyam āśritya sthitā ye rasādayas te svaṃ svaṃ karma kurvanti | kvacid rasa iti yathā - tiktā guḍūcī uṣṇavīryāpi pittaṃ śamayati | kvacid guṇo yathā - kaṭukaṃ mūlakaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ ca vardhayati snigdhaguṇatvāt | kvacid vīryam iti yathā - mahatpañcamūlaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tiktānurasaṃ vātaṃ śamayati uṣṇavīryatvāt | nanu guṇavīryayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate, ya eva guṇā dhātrīphale ta eva harītakyāṃ santi | vīrye viśeṣo 'sti yataḥ uṣṇavīryā harītakīṃ śītavīryaṃ dhātrīphalam iti, tasmād bhinnatvaṃ pratipāditam iti na doṣaḥ | kvacid vipāka iti yad dravyaṃ pariṇāmakāle svābhāvikaṃ rasaṃ parityajya rasāntaraṃ bhajate tatra vipāketi saṃjñā, yathā śuṇṭhī kaṭukāpi vātaṃ śamayati madhurapākatvāt | kvacit śaktir iti | yathā śaktitaḥ prabhāvataḥ yato rasaguṇavīryavipākair yat karma kartuṃ na śakyate tat karma kurvan prabhāva iti saṃjñā, yathā khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ hanti | ata evāha suśrutaḥ - ‘amīmāṃsyāny acintyāni prasiddhāni svabhāvataḥ | āgamenopayojyāni bheṣajāni vicakṣaiṇaiḥ’ || iti dravyādikathanam || 13-23 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. natā rasādayaḥ pañcāvasthāḥ sambandhena dravye prakīrtitāḥ | sambandhena tatkāryānusandhānena dravye rasaḥ dravye guṇaḥ dravye vīryaṃ śītoṣṇādike dravye 'pi pākaḥ vigataḥ vikāraṃ prāptaḥ rasādipākaḥ vipākadravye śaktiḥ | śaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ sarvaṃ rasādikaṃ dravye tiṣṭhatīti | tasmād dravyaṃ pradhānam | nanu rasādikaṃ vihāya dravyam iti pradhānaṃ kriyate | kecid ācāryā bruvate - dravyaṃ pradhānam eva kasmād vyavasthitatvāt | iha khalu dravyaṃ vyavasthitaṃ na rasādayaḥ | yathā āme phale rasādayas te pakve na santi nityatvāc ca | nityaṃ hi dravyam anityā guṇāḥ, yathā pārthivaṃ dravyaṃ na rasādaya āśrayatvāc ca | dravyam āśritā rasādayo bhavanti ārambhasāmarthyāc ca dravyāśrita ārambhaḥ yathā vidāryaśvagandhādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kvāthanārthe kuṭṭanapācanādikarasārambhaḥ kriyate na tathā rasādiṣv ārambhaḥ | śāstre hi dravyaṃ pradhānam uddeśe hi yogānāṃ yathā mātuluṅgāgnimanthau ceti na rasādaya upadiśyante | kramāpekṣitvāc ca rasādīnām | rasādayo hi dravyādayaḥ sādhyante yathā mahāvṛkṣaḥ kṣīṇo 'pi yasmād dravyaṃ tasmād dravyaṃ pradhānam | dravyalakṣaṇaṃ tu kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇam iti nety āhuḥ - anye rasān pradhānān bruvate | kasmāt | āgamāt | āgamo hi śāstram ucyate | śāstre rasādhikatā yathā rasāyatta āhāra iti | tasmiṃś ca prāk upadeśāt te rasā yathā madhurāmlalavaṇā vātaṃ śamayanti | anumānāc ca | rasato hy anumīyate dravyam | yathā madhuram iti ṛṣivacanāc ca | ṛṣivacanaṃ vedo yathā kiṃcit kriyārthaṃ rasam āhared iti | tasmād rasāḥ pradhānam | raseṣu guṇasaṃjñā rasalakṣaṇam anyatrāpi lakṣayāmaḥ | nety āhuḥ | anye vīryaṃ pradhānam iti | kasmād vaṃśenauṣadhaṃ niṣpadyate | ihauṣadhakarmāṇy ūrdhvādhobhāgobhayabhāgasaṃśodhanasaṃśamanasaṃgrāhikāgnidīpanapīḍanale khanabṛṃhaṇarasāyanavājīkaraṇaśvayathuharakāraṇavilayanadahanadāraṇamanthanaprāṇaghnaviṣaghnaśamanāni vīryapradhānāni bhavanti | tad vīryaṃ dvividham | uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ ca agnīṣomīyatvāj jagataḥ | kecid aṣṭavidham āhuḥ - uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ viśadaṃ picchilaṃ mṛdu tīkṣṇaṃ ceti | etāni vīryāṇi svaguṇotkarṣāt saptabhiḥ bhūryātmakaṃ karma kurvanti | yathā tāvad anantamūlaṃ tiktānurasaṃ vātaṃ śamayaty uṣṇavīryatvāt | madhuraṃ kṣaudraṃ vā tad etan nidarśanamātram uktam | bhavanti cātra na caite karmakāriṇaḥ tasmād vīryaṃ pradhānam iti nety āhuḥ | anye pākapradhānam iti | kasmāt samyagmithyāvipakvatvāt iha sarvadravyāṇy abhāvahṛtāni samyagmithyāvipakvāni guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayanti | tatrāhuḥ - anye pratisaṃpāka iti kecit trividham icchanti | yathā kṣīramukhāgatam abhipacyamānaṃ madhuram eva syāt tathā śāliyavamudgādayaḥ prakīrṇasvabhāvam uttarakāye 'pi na parityajanti tadvad iti kecid vadanti | avalavalopaplavatāṃ vaśam āyāntīty evam anavasthitiḥ | tasmād asiddho na rasaḥ | āgamo hi dvividha eva pāko madhuraḥ kaṭuś ca tayor madhurākhyo guruḥ kaṭukākhyo laghur iti | tatra pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ dvaividhyaṃ bhavati | guṇasādharmyād gurutā laghutā ca | pṛthivy āpaś ca gurvyaḥ śeṣāṇi tu laghūni | tasmād dvividha eva pākaḥ | bhavati cātra dravyeṣu pacyamāneṣv ambupṛthivīguṇā nivartante 'dhikas tatra pāko madhura ucyate | tejonilākāśaguṇo dravyamāneṣu na nivartate 'dhikas tatra pākaḥ kaṭur ucyate | pṛthaktvadarśinām eṣa vādināṃ vādasaṃgrahaḥ | caturṇām api sāmarthyam ittham | tatra vipaścitaḥ tat dravyam ātmanā kiṃcid vīryeṇa sahitaṃ kiñcid rasavipākābhyāṃ doṣaṃ hanti karoti vā | kecana śaktiṃ pradhānam āhuḥ | nety āhur anye | dravyam eva pradhānam | kutaḥ
‘pāko nāsti vinā vīryaṃ nāsti vīryaṃ vinā rasāt |
raso nāsti vinā dravyāt dravyaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ smṛtam||
vīryaṃ saṃjñā matā yeṣṭau tepi dravyāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ |
raseṣu na bhavanty ete nirguṇās tu guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || dravye dravyāṇi yasmāc ca vipacyante na ṣaḍrasāḥ || śreṣṭhaṃ dravyam ato jñeyaṃ śeṣā bhāvās tadāśrayāḥ ||’ yato dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ tasmādrasādayo dravyeṣu pratiṣṭhitās tāny asmin nānādravyasamāśritā ity ete ṣaḍrasāḥ khyātāḥ | ata ūrdhvam utpattiṃ vakṣyāmaḥ dvābhyāṃ bhūtābhyāṃ kramāt rasabhavaḥ rasotpattir dharāmbubhyāṃ madhurarasotpattiḥ, kṣmānalābhyāṃ amlarasotpattiḥ,jalajvalanābhyāṃ kaṭurasotpattiḥ, ākāśamārutābhyāṃ kaṭurasotpattiḥ, vāyvagnibhyāṃ tiktarasotpattiḥ, ambvanilābhyāṃ kaṣāyarasotpattir iti rasotpattiḥ | rasalakṣaṇam ata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | tatra yaḥ purīṣam utpādayati, prahlādayati, tarpayati, jīvayati, mukham upalepayati, śleṣmāṇaṃ cābhivardhayati, sa madhuro 'pi dantaharṣam utpādayati, mukhasrāvaṃ janayati | sa lavaṇaḥ yo jihvāgraṃ bādhate, udvegaṃ janayati, śiro gṛhṇīte, nāsikāṃ ca srāvayati sa kaṭukaḥ yo galalakṣaṇadoṣam utpādayati, mukhavairasyaṃ janayati | sa tiktaḥ yo vakraṃ pariśoṣayati jihvāṃ stambhayati kaṇṭhaṃ badhnāti hṛdayaṃ karṣayati pīḍayati rasaḥ kaṣāya iti | ataḥ sarvāṇi dravyāṇy upadekṣyāmaḥ | tad yathā kākolyādikṣīraghṛtavasāmajjāśāliṣaṣṭikagodhūmamāṣaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukatrapusairvārukarkārukālābukaliṅgagalaughapriyaṅgupuṣkarabījakāśmaryamadhūkadrākṣākharjūrarājādanatālinālikerekṣuvikārabalātibalātmaguptāvidārīvayasyāgokṣurakajīramocarasamadhūlikākūṣmāṇḍaprabhṛtīni samāsena madhuro vargaḥ | dāḍimāmalakamātuluṅgāmrātakakapitthakara- mardakabadarakolaśacīnāmalakatintiḍīkākośāprabhavyaparevatanetraphalalakucāmlavetasaudadhitakrasurāśuktasauvīrakatuṣodakadhānyāmlaprabhṛtīni samāsena amlo vargaḥ | pippalyādiśigrumadhuśigrumūlakalaśunasusukhaśītaśivakuṣṭhadevadāru hareṇukāvalguphalacaṇḍāguggulumastulāṅgalīśukanāsāpīluprabhṛtīni śālasārādiś ca prāyaśaḥ kaṭuko vargaḥ | āragvadhādiguḍūcyādimaṇḍūkaparṇīvetrakarīraharidrādvayendravāruṇasvādukaṇṭakasaptaparṇabṛhatīdvayaṃ śaṅkhinī dravantī- tṛvṛcchatavedhanakarkoṭakakāravellakavartākakaravīrasumanaśaṅkhapuṣpābhārṅgītrāyamāṇakarohiṇīvaijayantīsuvarcalā punarnavā vṛścikālījyotiṣmatīprabhṛtīni samāsena tikto vargaḥ | nyagrodhādi rāsnādi priyaṃgvādi rodhrādi triphalā śallakībījaṃ vāmrabakulatindukaphalāni karakaśākaphalapāṣāṇabhedakavanaspatiśālasārādiś ca prāyaśaḥ kurabakādi dārakajīvantikā cillī pālaṅkyā suniṣaṇṇakaprabhṛtīni līvarakādayo mudgādayaś ca samāsena kaṣāyo vargaḥ | tatraiṣāṃ rasānāṃ saṃyogas triṣaṣṭiḥ | bhavati cātra
‘bhūtejovārijairdravyaiḥ samaṃ yāti samīraṇaḥ |
pittaṃ kṣayam avāpnoti khabhūmijalavāyujaiḥ ||
khatejo 'nilajaiḥ śleṣmā samam eti śarīriṇām |
viyatpavanajātābhyāṃ vṛddhim abhyeti mānataḥ || āgneyam eva yad dravyaṃ teneyam udīryate |
vasudhā jalajātābhyāṃ balāsaḥ parivardhate |
evam etad guṇādhikyaṃ dravye dravyaṃ viniścitam ||’ iti | rasā dharādharāmbuvahnipavanavyomnāṃ prāya atiśayena kramād guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | dharāyāṃ guṇā ambuni snigdhaguṇaṃ, vahnau tīkṣṇaguṇaṃ, pavane rūkṣaguṇaṃ, eṣu guṇeṣu antar anye guṇasañcayā bhavanti santīty arthaḥ | pañcabhūtānāṃ guṇāḥ kathitāḥ | iti guṇāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ śītaṃ coṣṇaṃ dvividhaṃ vīryam āhuḥ, evaṃ śītaṃ ekam uṣṇaṃ | kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ vīryaṃ prāyaśaḥ dravyasaṃśrayaṃ prāyaśaḥ atiśayena dravye saṃśrayaṃ sthānaṃ yasya tat | kutaḥ yad yasmāt kāraṇād bhuvanatrayam agnīṣomīyaṃ dṛśyate somātmakam agnyātmakaṃ cety arthaḥ | somātmakaṃ vīryam agnyātmakaṃ rajaḥ, tayor jaṅgamānām utpattiḥ sthāvarāṇām utpattau bhāno raśmibhir uṣṇatvād rajoguṇayuktāyāṃ bhuvi satyāṃ somātmakāt śītavīryāt meghānāṃ prāyaśaḥ bhuvi sthāvarāṇām utpattiḥ | ataḥ jagattritayaṃ somātmakaṃ anyāni vīryāṇi sarvam agniṣomīyaṃ dṛśyante vīryāṇi tāny atraiva agniṣomīye vīryam antarmadhye bhaviṣyantīty abhiprāyaḥ | iti vīryaṃ | miṣṭakaṭutiktānāṃ rasānāṃ pākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ syāt bhaved ity arthaḥ | yad uktaṃ - ‘tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ |’ tad āha ‘madhurāc chleṣmā jāyate, amlāt pittaṃ jāyate, kaṭukāt vāyuḥ jāyate etāni karmāṇi pākataḥ jāyante iti pākaḥ | prabhāvaṃ vadati | yathā api ni iti niścayena lakucasya rasādibhiḥ samāhitā dhātrī doṣatrayasya vināśaṃ kurute | anyat prabhāvam āha - kvacit kevalaṃ dravyaṃ prabhāvataḥ karma kuryāt yathā - sahadevījaṭā śirasi baddhā satī jvaraṃ hantīti sugamam anyat | iti prabhāvaḥ | kvacit kasmin sthale dravyam āśritya rasādayaḥ sthitāḥ te svaṃ svaṃ karma kurvanti, kvacid rasaḥ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacid guṇaḥ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacid vīryaṃ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacid vipākaḥ svaṃ karma karoti, kvacic chaktiḥ prabhāvaḥ svaṃ karma karoti spaṣṭam anyat | iti dravyaguṇavīryavipākaprabhāvāḥ || 13-23 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha doṣopacayaprakopopaśamān darśayann āha —cayakopaśamā iti | doṣāṇāṃ vātādīnāṃ cayakopaśamā iti cayaḥ sañcayaḥ, sa ca saṃhatirūpā vṛddhiḥ, svasthānavṛddhir ity anye | kopaḥ prakopaḥ sa ca pravilayarūpā vṛddhiḥ prakopaḥ | śama ity uparamaḥ | yathā vātapittakaphānāṃ śaraddhemantagrīṣmeṣu yathāsaṃkhyam upaśamaḥ svabhāvata eva | tad ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ grīṣmaprāvṛṅvarṣāśaraddhemantavasantākhyam ity arthaḥ | kuta ity āha - rave rāśiṣu saṃkramād iti raveḥ sūryasya rāśiṣu meṣādiṣu saṃkramāt praveśād ity arthaḥ || 24 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha ṣaṭkaṃ yasmin ṛtuṣaṭke doṣāṇāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ cayakopaśamāḥ saṃbhavanti tad eva ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ rave rāśiṣu saṃkramāt ākhyātam – tad evāha - jīvitamaraṇe ca manuṣyāṇām āpannety asūkṣmāṃ kalām api na līyate iti kālaḥ, kalayati utpādayati maraṇaṃ nayati vā bhūtānīti kālaḥ | tasya saṃvatsarātmano bhagavān ādityo gativiśeṣeṇākṣinimeṣikā kāṣṭhākalāmuhūrtāhorātrapakṣamāsartvayanasaṃvatsarayugapravibhāgaṃ karoti | tatra laghvakṣaroccāramātrokṣinimeṣaḥ, pañcādaśākṣinimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhā,triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalā viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ, triṃśanmuhūrtam ahorātraṃ, pañcadaśāhorātrāṇi pakṣaḥ, sa ca dvividhaḥ, śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaś ca, tau māsaḥ, tatra mārgaśīrṣādayo dvādaśa māsāḥ, dvimāsakam ṛtuṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍ ṛtavo bhavati tad evartuṣaṭkam | ete cayakopaśamā eke kevalaprakopāḥ || 24 ||

div.ab:
