Āḍhamalla. idānīm ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ rāśidvayena darśayann āha - grīṣma iti | meṣasaṃkrāntiprabhṛti vṛṣasakrāntyavasānaṃ grīṣmaṛtuḥ proktaḥ kathita ity arthaḥ | evaṃ mithunādikarkāntaṃ prāvṛṭ, siṃhādikanyāntaṃ varṣāṛtuḥ, tulādivṛścikāntaṃ śarat, dhanurādigrāhāntaṃ hemantaḥ, grāho makaraḥ, kumbhādimīnāntaṃ vasanta iti | etena rāśidvayena dvimāsikam api ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ bhavati | tad doṣacayādinimittam abhihitaṃ tattvajñānārtham | yad uktaṃ suśrutena - doṣopacayaprakopopaśamanimittaṃ ‘te tu bhādrapadādyena dvimāsikena varṣādayo vyākhyātāḥ’ yathāyathaṃ saṃkhyātāḥ | ye tu tantrāntare - ‘māsair dvisaṃkhyair māghādyai’r ityādinā śiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣāśaraddhemantā bhavanti te tu śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāś candrādityayoḥ kālavibhāgakaratvāc cāyananimittāḥ | yataḥ ‘māsarāśisvarūpākhyam ṛtau yal lakṣaṇatrayam i’ti vacanāt | nanu prāvṛḍvarṣayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate, prathamaḥ pravṛttaḥ kālaḥ prāvṛṭ tasyānubandho varṣā ity atra bhedaḥ | evaṃ ‘śiśire śītamadhikaṃ raukṣyaṃ cādānakālajam’ ity anena śiśirahemantayor api bhedo 'sti | pūrvam uktaṃ cayakopasamā ṛtavo bhavantīti || tayor madhyamadhye ādau suśrutādiṣv apy uktatvāt kevalaprakope ṛtum āha - te śiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣāśaraddhemantāḥ teṣāṃ māghaphālgunau śiśiraḥ, caitravaiśākhau vasantaḥ, jyeṣṭhāṣāḍhau grīṣmaḥ, śrāvaṇabhādrapadau varṣā, āśvinakārtikau śarat, mārgapauṣau hemanta iti | ete śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāś candrādityayoḥ kālavibhāgakaratvāt | ayane dve bhavato dakṣiṇam uttaraṃ ca | tayor dakṣiṇaṃ varṣāśaraddhemantās teṣu bhagavan soma āpyāyate sāmlalavaṇamadhurāś ca balavanto bhavanti uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balam abhivardhate | uttaraṃ ca śiśiravasantagrīṣmās teṣu bhagavān arka āpyāyate tiktakaṭukaṣāyā rasā balavanto bhavanti uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balam apahīyate | bhavati cātra
‘śītāṃśuḥ kledayet pūrvāṃ vivasvān śoṣayaty api |
tāv ubhāv api saṃsṛjya vāyuḥ pālayati prajāḥ ||’ iti | meṣavṛṣau etau dvau rāśī grīṣmaḥ proktaḥ, mithunakarkayor etayor dvayo rāśyoḥ prāvṛṭ , siṃhakanye ete dve varṣāḥ smṛtā, tulāvṛścikayoḥ śarat bhavati, dhanurgrāhau dvau hemantaḥ proktaḥ, kumbhamīnayormadhye vasantaḥ proktaḥ | nanu śiśiraṃ vihāya prāvṛṭgrahaṇaṃ kim iti kriyate na hi atra śiśiras tu hemante praviṣṭaḥ śleṣmaṇaś cayahetutvāt | yadi śiśiraḥ hemante na praviśati tadā śleṣmaṇaś cayāt vasantaṃ vihāya kaphasya kopaḥ śiśire syāt | nanv anye 'pi carakādayo granthāḥ santi śiśiraṃ hemante ekīkartuṃ kenāpi na śakyate bhavadbhiḥ kathaṃ kriyate tad atrāsminn āyurveda yatra dvau samavetau bhavataḥ tatra śiśiras tu hemante prayoktavyaḥ, varṣāprāvṛṣor bhedaḥ kartavyaḥ prathamo varṣākālaḥ prāvṛṭ tadanukaraṇaṃ, tasya prāvṛṣo 'ṅgam | yad āha suśrutaḥ ‘iha tu varṣāśaraddhemantavasantagrīṣmaprāvṛṣaḥ ṣaṭ ṛtavo bhavanti doṣopacayaprakopopaśamanimittaṃ te tu bhādrapadādyena dvimāsikena samākhyātāḥ | yatra cayasamāvetau na staḥ kopa evāsti tatra prāvṛṭ vihāya śiśirasahitāḥ ṣaṭ ṛtavaḥ santi | tad āha granthāntare
‘hemantavarṣāśiśireṣu vāyoḥ pittasya varṣāsu nidāghayoś ca |
kaphasya kopaṃ kusumāgame ca kurvīta yady asya hitaṃ tad eṣām ||’ atra kathitāyāḥ prāvṛṣaḥ hemante praviṣṭasya śiśirasya sandeho na kāryaḥ || 25 || 26 ||

lg.l: hemante cīyate śleṣmā vasante ca prakupyati |
prāyeṇa praśamaṃ yāti svayam eva samīraṇaḥ || 28 ||
śaratkāle vasante ca pittaṃ prāvṛḍṛtau kaphaḥ |
kārtikasyaprakṣiptamidam | dināny aṣṭāv aṣṭāv āgrayaṇasya ca || 29 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. etac cayasāmye kṛtacayakopasamān āha -grīṣme iti | vāyur grīṣme sañcīyate sañcayam āpadyata ity arthaḥ | evaṃ pittaśleṣmāṇāv api svasvaṛtuṣu cayakopāv āpadyete | samyaggrahaṇaṃ svasañcayakāraṇārthaṃ boddhavyam, tat sañcayakāraṇaṃ tantrāntarād avagantavyam | tad yathā ‘tā evauṣadhayo nidāghe niḥsārā rūkṣā atimātraṃ laghvyo bhavanty āpaś ca, tā upayujyamānāḥ sūryapratāpopaśoṣitadehānāṃ dehināṃ raukṣyāl laghutvād vaiśadyāc ca vāyoḥ sañcayam āpādayanti’ iti | nanu śītasya vāyor uṣṇe grīṣme sañcayaḥ kathaṃ saṃbhavati ? ucyate - sarveṣu vātaguṇeṣu raukṣyaṃ pradhānaṃ tenauṣadhīnām atyartharaukṣyeṇa rūkṣasya vāyor grīṣme sañcayaḥ syād ity adoṣaḥ | yadaivaṃ cayayukto bhavati | prāvṛṭkāle prakupyatīti prāvṛṭkāle prāvṛṣi, prakupyatīti praśabdo 'tra prakarṣakāraṇaṃ sūcayati; tad yathā - ‘sa sañcayaḥ prāvṛṣi cātyarthaṃ jalopaklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ dehināṃ śītavātavarṣerito vātikān vyādhīn janayati’ | vāyuḥ prakopam āpadyata iti tātparyārthaḥ | evaṃ pittam api varṣāyāṃ sañcitaṃ śaratkāle prakupyati | kapho 'pi hemante sañcayam āpadya vasante prakopaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | anayoḥ kāraṇaṃ tantrāntarād avagantavyam | keṣāñcit jñāpanārthaṃ likhyate, yathā - ‘tatra varṣāsv auṣadhayas taruṇyo 'lpavīryā ‘āpaś cāprasannāḥ kṣitimalaprāyās tā upayujyamānā bhavanti’ | meghā vasante jalapraklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātaviṣṭambhitāgnīnāṃ vidahyante, vidāhāt pittasañcayam āpādayanti | sa sañcayaḥ śaradi praviralameghe viyaty upaśuṣyati | paṅke arkakiraṇapravilāpitaḥ paittikān vyādhīn janayati | tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavanty āpaś ca prasannāḥ | snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyas tā atyarthaṃ upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvād bhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ dehinām avidagdhāḥ snehāt śaityāt gauravād upalepāc ca śleṣmaṇaḥ sañcayam āpādayanti | sa sañcayo vasante 'rkaraśmipravilāpitaḥ īṣat stabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīn janayati’ ity evaṃ doṣāṇāṃ sañcayaprakopau darśitau | nanu doṣāṇāṃ sañciteṣu ṛtuṣu kathaṃ na prakopaḥ? iti | ucyate, śītasya vāyor grīṣmasyātyuṣṇatvāt tasminn eva kāle na prakupyanti | (sañcīyamānam api pittaṃ ṛtuśaityāt tasmin kāle na prakupyati) ṛtvādisvabhāvāt kaphasya sañcīyamānasya himānīvaśāt tadānīṃ styānataiva bhavati na prakopaḥ| vasante ca prakupyati iti cakāragrahaṇenātra sañcayādikam ahorātrayor api jānīyāt | tad yathā - ‘tatra pūrvāhṇe vasantasya liṅgaṃ madhyāhne grīṣmasyāparāhṇe prāvṛṣaḥ pradoṣe vārṣikaṃ śāradam ardharātre pratyuṣasi haimantam upalakṣayet’ || atha doṣāṇām upaśamam āha - prāyeṇetyādi | samīraṇo vāyuḥ śaratkāle svayam eva kāraṇaṃ vinā praśamaṃ yāti prāpnoti | svayameveti svabhāvataḥ svalakṣaṇata ity arthaḥ | svalakṣaṇaṃ punar eṣāṃ śītoṣṇavarṣādi | evaṃ vasante 'pi pittaṃ, prāvṛṭkāle kapha iti | atra yat śaradvasantaprāvṛṭcayopaśamārtham uktaṃ tad rāśiparivartanāt anyathā tantrāntaravirodhaḥ | prāyeṇetigrahaṇāt doṣajā api vyādhayaḥ praśamaṃ yānti svayameveti suśrutaḥ | tathā hi - ‘tatra paittikānāṃ vyādhīnām upaśamo hemante, ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ nidāghe, vātikānāṃ ghanātyaye svabhāvata eva’ | atra śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇakālaprabhāvād upaśamaḥ | tasmāt pūrvebhyo na virodhaḥ || 27 || 28 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vāyuḥ grīṣme cīyate prāvṛṭkāle prakupyati pittaṃ varṣāsu cīyate śaradi prakupyati prakopaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | śleṣmā hemante cīyate vasante prakupyati | śamam āha samīraṇo 'tiśayena śaratkāle svayam eva śamaṃ yāti, pittaṃ ca vasante, hemante śamaṃ yāti | kaphaḥ prāvṛṭṝtau śamaṃ yāti | uṣṇaṛtau veti pāṭhe grīṣme śamaṃ yāti | suśrutādibhyo 'py uktatvāt | yad āha suśrutaḥ - ‘tatra vātikavyādhīnām upaśamo ghanātyaye, paittikānāṃ vyādhīnām upaśamo hemante, ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ nidāghe svabhāvāt | ete sañcayaprakopopaśamā vyākhyātāḥ | evam ahorātram api varṣamiva śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇaṃ doṣopacayaprakopopaśamair jānīyāt | tatra pūrvāhṇe vasantasya liṅgaṃ madhyāhne grīṣmasyāparāhṇe prāvṛṣaḥ pradoṣe vārṣikaṃ śāradam ardharātre pratyuṣasi haimantikam upalakṣayet || 27 || 28 ||

cayakopaśamā doṣā vihārāhārasevanaiḥ || 30 ||
samānair yānty akāle 'pi viparītair viparyayam |
laghurūkṣamitāhārād atiśītāc chramāt tathā || 31 ||
pradoṣe kāmaśokābhyāṃ bhīcintārātrijāgaraiḥ |
abhighātād apāṃ gāhāj jīrṇe 'nne dhātusaṃkṣayāt ||32||
vāyuḥ prakopaṃ yāty ebhiḥ pratyanīkaiś ca śāmyati |
vidāhikaṭukāmloṣṇabhojyair atyuṣṇasevanāt || 33 ||
madhyāhne kṣuttṛṣo rodhāj jīryaty anne 'rdharātrake |
pittaṃ prakopaṃ yāty ebhiḥ pratyanīkaiś ca śāmyati 34 ||
madhurasnigdhaśītādibhojyair divasanidrayā |
mande 'gnau ca prabhāte ca bhuktamātre tathā 'śramāt || 35||
śleṣmā prakopaṃ yāty ebhiḥ pratyanīkaiś ca śāmyati || iti dāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ pūrvakhaṇḍe bhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ dravyarasaguṇavipākaprabhāva ṛtuṣaṭkākhyānādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ doṣāṇām akāle 'pi cayādinimittaṃ hetum āha - cayetyādi | doṣā vātādayaḥ samānair vihārāhārasevanaiḥ kṛtvā cayādīn yānti prāpnuvantīty arthaḥ | viparītair asamānaiḥ kṛtvā akāle apraśamaṛtāv api viparyayaṃ nāśaṃ prāpnuvantīty arthaḥ | samānair iti doṣānurūpakāraṇaiḥ | tad yathā - laghurūkṣaśītādayo vātaguṇasamānāḥ vidāhikaṭukāmloṣṇādayaḥ pittaguṇasamānāḥ, madhurasnigdhaśītādayo 'pi śleṣmaguṇasamānā iti | eṣāṃ viparītair viparyayair yathā - gurusnigdhoṣṇādayo vātaguṇaviparyayāḥ, avidāhimadhuraśītādayaḥ pittaguṇaviparītāḥ, tiktoṣṇarūkṣādayaḥ śleṣmaguṇaviparītā’ iti || atha doṣāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ prakopaśamakāraṇāny āha - laghvityādi | laghvādidhātusaṃkṣayāntaiḥ kāraṇair vāyuḥ prakopaṃ yāti prāpnotīty arthaḥ | eteṣāṃ pratyanīkair viparītaiś ca śāmyatīty arthaḥ | āhāraśabdo laghvādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate tena laghvāhārāt rūkṣāhārāt mitāhārād ity arthaḥ | laghviti pākataḥ, rūkṣam - asnigdhaṃ, mitaṃ svalpaṃ, atiśītād ity atiśītasevanāt, atiśramād iti atiśarīrāyāsāt, atiśabdo 'trāpi boddhavyaḥ, pradoṣe rajanīmukhe, kāmaśokābhyām iti kāmo 'bhilāṣaḥ sa ca strīsaṅkalparūpaḥ abhimatakāminyādyaprāptir iti bhāvaḥ | śoko dhanabandhunāśādinā, bhītir bhayaṃ, kāmaśokabhayād vāyur iti | abhighātaḥ śastralaguḍādīnām, apāṃ gāhād atijalāvagāhāt, atiśabdo 'tra pūrvād anuvartate, jīrṇe 'nne āhāre paripākaṃ gate sati, dhātusaṅkṣayād iti rasādidhātūnāṃ kṣīṇatvāt, yad uktaṃ ‘dhātukṣayāt srute rakte mandaḥ sañjāyate 'balaḥ | pavanaś ca paraṃ kopaṃ yāti tasmāt prayatnataḥ’ ityādi | pratyanīkair iti laghvādīnāṃ viparyayais te 'py anumānato 'vagantavyāḥ || atha pittam | vidāhīti | vidāhibhojyādibhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pittaṃ prakopaṃ yāti | eṣāṃ pratyanīkair viparītaiḥ kṛtvā śāmyatīti | bhojyaśabdo vidāhādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate tena vidāhibhojyaiḥ kaṭukabhojyair amlabhojyair uṣṇabhojyair iti | yad vā vidāhīti bhinnārthasūcakaṃ jñeyam | tena vidāhī vaṃśakarīrādi pittakaratvāt | uṣṇabhojanaṃ ca vīryāt sparśād vā | atyuṣṇasevanād ity ātapāgnīnām | kṣuttṛṣo rodhād iti kṣut kṣudhā tasyā avarodhāt tṛṭ tṛṣā tasyā avarodhāt, avarodho vegadhāraṇam | eke kṣuttṛṣo roṣād iti paṭhanti | tatra kṣuttṛṣor ativegāt, roṣāt krodhāt, tathā ca ‘krodhāt pittaṃ prakupyati’ iti | pratyanīkair iti vidāhibhojyādīnāṃ viparītair iti sugamam || atha kaphaḥ | madhureti | madhurabhojyādibhiḥ śleṣmā prakopaṃ yāti | eṣāṃ pratyanīkair nāśakaraiḥ śāmyati śāntiṃ prāpnotīty arthaḥ | bhojyaśabdo 'trāpi madhurādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisambadhyate tena madhurabhojyaiḥ snigdhabhojyaiḥ śītādibhojyaiś ca | ādiśabdāt guruślakṣṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam | divasanidrayā kaphavṛddhiḥ syāt yataḥ ‘rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ snigdhaṃ prasvapanaṃ divā’ iti vacanāt | aśramād iti avyāyāmāt ‘vyāyāmaḥ kaphanāśanaṃ’ ity ukteḥ || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe bhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

ab.seg:
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. doṣā vātapittakaphāś cayaprakopaśamā yeṣu tān cayakopaśamān svasvaṛtūn parityajya samānair nirantarair vihārāhārasevanaiḥ akāle 'pi viparyayaṃ yānti | vihāro vāgdehamanonivartitatve viśeṣo vyāyāmajāgaraṇādhyayanādirūpaḥ | āhāro mithyāhāraḥ | yad uktaṃ carake ‘akāle anyadoṣaṛtau viparyayaṃ kopaṃ yāntīty arthaḥ | viparītais taddhetunāśakartṛbhir upāyaiḥ sāmyaṃ yānti | tad āha - ‘laghurūkṣamitāhārāghātaśītāt śramāt tathā |’ pradoṣe laghurūkṣamitāhārād yāti viparītaiḥ taddhetunāśakartṛbhiḥ sāmyaṃ yāti | sugamam anyat | granthāntarāt sāmyakartṛtvam āha - ‘snigdhoṣṇasthiravṛṣyavallavaṇavat svādvamlatailātapasnānābhyañjanabastimāṃsamadirāsaṃvāha- nonmardanam | snehasvedanirūhaṇaṃ ca śayanasnānopanāhādikaṃ pānāhāravihārabheṣajam idaṃ vāyuṃ praśāntiṃ nayet’ ebhiḥ prayogair vāyuḥ sāmyaṃ yāti | ebhir hetubhiḥ pittaṃ prakopaṃ yāti pratyanīkaiḥ śāntikartṛbhir upāyaiḥ śyāmyati| śāntiṃ kartum upāyān āha -
‘tiktasvādukaṣāyaśītapavanacchāyāniśāvījanaṃ jyotsnābhūtagṛhapravāsajalajastrīgātrasaṃsparśanam |
sarpiḥkṣīravirecakaiś ca rudhirasrāvapradehādikaṃ pānāhāravihārabheṣajam idaṃ pittaṃ praśāntiṃ nayet||’ ebhiḥ prayogaiḥ pittaṃ sāmyaṃ yāti | ebhir hetubhiḥ śleṣmā kopaṃ yāti aśramāt śramarahitāt | sugamam anyat | śītakartṛbhir upāyaiḥ śamaṃ yāti| śleṣmaṇaḥ śāntikartṝn upāyān āha granthāntarāt ‘rūkṣāhārakaṣāyatiktakaṭukavyāyāmaniṣṭhīvanaṃ strīsevādhvaniyuddhajāgarajalakrīḍāpaghātāt tathā | dhūmo nasyaśirovirekavamanasvedopavāsādikaṃ pānāhārāvihāra- bheṣajam idaṃ śleṣmāṇam ugraṃ jayet’ ebhir upāyair akāle 'pi kupitā doṣāḥ śāmyaṃ yāntīty abhiprāyaḥ || 30-35 ||

div.head: atha nāḍīparīkṣādividhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha nāḍīparīkṣādividhir adhyāyaḥ |
karasyāṅguṣṭhamūle yā dhamanī jīvasākṣiṇī |
tacceṣṭayā sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jñeyaṃ kāyasya paṇḍitaiḥ || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktaṃ nāḍīparīkṣādividhir iti anantaraṃ nāḍīparīkṣām āha - atheti - karasyeti | jīvasākṣiṇī yā dhamanī sā karasyāṅguṣṭhamūle 'stīti kriyāpadaṃ yojyaṃ, tacceṣṭayā kṛtvā kāyasya śarīrasya sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca jñeyaṃ paṇḍitair iti śeṣaḥ | dhamanīti | śabdavāhinī nāḍī dhamanī jīvanaṃ tanau‘dhamanti pavanaṃ tanāvityato dhamanyaḥ’ pā. | ity ato dhamanī jīvasākṣiṇīti prāṇavāyoḥ sākṣibhūtā ata eva kutracij jīvanāḍīti kathitā | tathā hi -‘pradarśayed doṣanijasvarūpaṃ vyastaṃ samastaṃ yugalīkṛtaś ca | mūkasya mugdhasya vimohitasya dīpaḥ padārthān iva jīvanāḍī’ iti || lakṣaṇam api ca - ‘asthnaḥ prakoṣṭhabāhyasya madhyamānāmikāśritā |‘madhye kāpi samāśritā ’madhyakāmasamāśritā’ pā. | jīvanāḍīti sā proktā nandinī tattvavedanā’ iti | tacceṣṭayā duḥkham iti doṣādivaiṣamyadharmaḥ | yataḥ ‘rogas tu doṣavaiṣamyam’ ityādivacanāt | paṇḍitair iti pravīṇaiḥ nāḍīgrahaṇasya samayaviśeṣajñair ity arthaḥ | yataḥ - ‘sadyaḥ snātasya bhuktasya kṣuttṛṣṇā ' 'tapaśīlinaḥ | vyāyāmaśrāntadehasya samyaṅ nāḍī na budhyate’ iti || 1 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karasyāṅguṣṭhamūle yā dhamanī sā jīvasākṣiṇī jīvo 'sti no veti bodhanī jñeyā | budhaiḥ tacceṣṭayā mandasthiracalagāminyā kāyasya dehasya sukhaṃ mukhaṃ ca jñeyam || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ doṣāṇāṃ nijasvarūpaceṣṭām āha - nāḍīti | marutkope vātaprakope jalaukāsarpayor gatiṃ gamanaṃ dhatte nāḍīti śeṣaḥ | jalaukāsarpayos tiryaggatir ity abhiprāyaḥ‘sottālagati’ pā. | tadvad atrā 'pi | pittaprakopatas tu kuliṅgādīnāṃ gatiṃ dhatte, kuliṅgo gṛhacaṭakaḥ | kākamaṇḍūkau prasiddhau eteṣām utplavanagatir ity arthaḥ‘pyartha’ pā. | | eke kuliṅgasthāne kalāpīti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kalāpī mayūraḥ | śleṣmaprakopāt haṃsapārāvatagatiṃ dhatte | atrāpi nāḍīti saṃbadhyate | etena mandagativāhinī bhavatīty abhiprāyaḥ | yato haṃsapārāvatayor api mandagatiḥ syāt || 2 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. marutkope sati nāḍī jalaukāsarpayor gatiṃ gamanaṃ dhatte | nāḍī pittasya kopataḥ kuliṅgakākamaṇḍūkagatiṃ dhatte | kuliṅgo gṛhacaṭakaḥ haṃsapārāvatagatiṃ śleṣmaprakopataḥ dhatte ||

Āḍhamalla. atha sannipātasaṃsargayor nāḍīceṣṭām āha —lāveti | sannipātatas tridoṣakopāt lāvādīnāṃ gamanaṃ nāḍī dhatte iti pūrvād anuvartate | lāvatittirau prasiddhau, vartīti vartikā (dharadhara)‘varardhara’ pā. | śabdavācyā | gaḍūrukābhidhānety anye | eteṣāṃ sottālā gatiḥ sūcyate || dvidoṣakopād api nāḍī kadācin mandagāminī kadācid vegavāhinīti ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nāḍī sannipātataḥ tridoṣaprakopataḥ lāvatittiravartikānāṃ gamanaṃ dhatte | na tv ekasya jantor gatyā nāmnāṃ prakupitasya doṣasya bodho bhaved ato dvitrijantūnāṃ gatiḥ darśitā yathā vikṛtim āpanno vāyuḥ sarpagatiṃ dhatte | sāmyaṃ gato vāyuḥ jalaukāgatiṃ dhatte evam anye 'pi jñeyāḥ ||3|| dvidoṣakopataḥ kadācin mandagamanā kadācid vegavāhinī jñeyā ||

lg.l: sthitvā sthitvā calati yā sā smṛtā prāṇanāśinī |
atikṣīṇā ca śītā ca jīvitaṃ hanty asaṃśayam || 5 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. idānīm asādhyāyā lakṣaṇam āha - hantīti | sthānavicyutā svasthānāc calitā nāḍīti śeṣaḥ | hantīti āturam iti śeṣaḥ | yā sthitvā sthitvā calati gacchati sāpi prāṇanāśinī jñeyā | etena kadācid vahati kadācin na vahatīty abhiprāyaḥ | atikṣīṇā ceti bisatantuvat, atiśītā ceti himasparśavat | asaṃśayaṃ niścayena jīvitaṃ prāṇān hanti nāḍīti śeṣaḥ | cakārāt kuṭilā cordhvādhogamanaśīlāpi prāṇanāśinī boddhavyā | tathā coktaṃ -
‘nāḍī madhyavahāṅguṣṭhamūle yātyartham ucchalet |
śanair ūrdhvārdhagamanā kuṭilā hanti mānavam ||’ iti || 4 || 5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sthānavicyutā satī hanti | yā dhamanī sthitvā sthitvā calati sā prāṇanāśinī smṛtā kathitā | atikṣīṇā śītā gacchatī satī prāṇino jīvitaṃ jīvanāśaṃ asaṃśayaṃ niḥsaṃdehena hanti dūrīkarotīty arthaḥ || 4 || 5 ||

lg.l: mandāgneḥ kṣīṇadhātoś ca nāḍī mandatarā bhavet |
asṛkpūrṇā bhavet koṣṇā gurvī sāmā garīyasī || 7 ||
laghvī vahati dīptāgnes tathā vegavatī matā |
sukhitasya sthirā jñeyā tathā balavatī smṛtā || 8 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha jvarādīnāṃ dhamanīlakṣaṇam āha -jvarakopeṇeti | jvarakopeṇa sāmānyajvarasya prakopeṇa kṛtvā dhamanī nāḍī soṣṇā uṣṇayuktā bhavet | jvarasyoṣṇātmakatvān na kevalaṃ soṣṇā vegavatī bhavet | jvarasya dehendriyamanaḥsantāpitatvāt | kāmakrodhād api vegavahā vegayuktā anauṣṇyena jvaravad bhinnā | kāmo 'bhimatakāminyādyaprāptiḥ, krodho hiṃsātmakādirūpaḥ, cintābhayapluteti cintābhayayuktā nāḍī kṣīṇā susūkṣmā jñeyā | cintā cittodvegarūpā, bhayaṃ śatruprabhṛtīnām | eke cintābhayaśramād iti paṭhanti | cintābhayaśramān nāḍī kṣīṇā susūkṣmā jñeyā | cintā mānasodvegarūpā jñeyā | tatra śramād glāneḥ mandāgneḥ kṣīṇadhātoś ca puruṣasya nāḍī mandatarā bhavet, atyarthaṃ mandagatir ity arthaḥ | asṛkpūrṇā rudhiraprakopāt pūritā nāḍī koṣṇā gurvī ca bhavet | koṣṇā īṣaduṣṇā gurvī gurutarā pāṣāṇavad ity arthaḥ | eke soṣṇeti paṭhanti | sāmā āmayuktā nāḍī garīyasī syāt atyarthaṃ gurvī bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | āmena saha vartata iti sāmā, āmo 'paripakvarasaḥ | tad yathā - ‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyād avipakvas tu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopakaḥ’ iti | athavā āmagrahaṇena āmāditrayam annajam ajīrṇaṃ gṛhyate tena tair yuktety arthaḥ | tatra āmaṃ vidagdhaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ ceti | eke sāmā garīyasīti paṭhanti | āmena saha vartata iti sāmā | te ca doṣadūṣyatādayaḥ | yataḥ ‘āmena tena saṃpṛktā doṣā dūṣyāś ca dūṣitāḥ | sāmā ity upadiśyante ye ca rogās tadudbhavāḥ’ iti | etena kim uktaṃ bhavati sāmadoṣāt sāmadūṣyāt sāmadūṣitāt sāmarogāc ceti | dūṣyā rasādayo dhātavaḥ | dūṣitāni malamūtraprabhṛtīni | dīptāgneḥ prabalāgneḥ puruṣasya laghvī vegavatī ca vahati | laghvī tūlavat saiva vegayuktā jñeyā na tu pūrvoktā | sukhitasya svasthasya sthirā prakṛtisthā bhavatīty arthaḥ | na kevalaṃ svasthā tathā balavatī balayuktā na kṣīṇety abhiprāyaḥ | kṣudhitasya bubhukṣitasyāpi capalā cañcalā na mandety arthaḥ | etena prakṛtisthitāgnir iti bhāvaḥ | tṛptasya bhojanādinā santuṣṭasya puruṣasya sthirā niścalaiva||6-8|| iti nāḍīparīkṣā ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sā dhamanī nāḍī jvarakopeṇa jvarādhikyena soṣṇā atyuṣṇā satī vegavatī bhavet kāmāt krodhāc ca vegavahā syāt cintābhayāplutā satī kṣīṇā bhaved ity arthaḥ | atiśayena mandā mandatarā asṛkpūrṇā nāḍī koṣṇā īṣaduṣṇā satī gurvī calet | koṣṇā īṣaduṣṇā gurvī alpagariṣṭhā sāmā āmayuktā nāḍī garīyasī bhavet | atiśayena gariṣṭhā garīyasī | dīptāgneḥ puruṣasya nāḍī laghvī vahati | tathā dīptāgneḥ puṃsaḥ laghvī matā smṛtā | sukhino rogarahitasya puṃsaḥ sthirā jñeyā tathā balavatī smṛtā | kṣudhitasya puṃsaḥ nāḍī capalā syāt | tṛptasya kṛtabhojanasya puṃsaḥ nāḍī sthirā vahati | anyāny api nāḍīparīkṣāsthānāny āha granthāntarāt -
‘pādayor nāḍikāsthānaṃ gulphasyādho 'ṅgulatrayam |
kaṇṭhamūleṅgulidvandve nāsāmūleṅgulādhikam|
narasyāṅguṣṭhamūle ca nāḍī caturthikā matā |
sthānāny etāni nāḍīnāṃ tāsu prāṇo vyavasthitaḥ’| karasya nāḍī sadaivāvalokanīyā anyā yās tisro nāḍyaḥ maraṇasamaye 'valokanīyā nānyatra | anyatra karasyāvalokanīyeti |
sadyaḥ snātasya bhuktasya kṣuttṛṣātapaśīlinaḥ |
vyāyāmaśrāntadehasya samyaṅ nāḍī na budhyate | bhāraprahāramūrcchābhayaśokapramukhakāraṇān nāḍī saṃmūrcchitāpi bāḍhaṃ punar api jīvanaṃ labhate || 6-8 || iti nāḍīparīkṣā ||

Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktam ādigrahaṇāt dūtasvapnādīnāṃ lakṣaṇakathanam | atha dūtalakṣaṇāny āha --dūtā iti | evaṃvidhā dūtā yadā bhiṣajaṃ vaidyaṃ prāptās tadā rogiṇa āturasya sukhahetave bhavantīty adhyāhāryam | vaidyāhvānāya praśnāya āgatāḥ puruṣā dūtāḥ kīdṛśās tān āha - svajātaya iti | svasyāṃ jātau svagotre vā jātāḥ svajātayaḥ | eke ‘sajātaya’ iti paṭhanti tatra sapakṣā ity arthaḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘pāṣaṇḍāśramavarṇānāṃ sapakṣāḥ karmasiddhaye | ta eva viparītāḥ syur dūtāḥ karmavipattaye’ iti | avyaṅgā iti | vyaṅgā hastāvayavahīnāḥ na vyaṅgā avyaṅgāḥ | paṭava iti pravīṇāḥ | etena vicitrakālajñāḥ kathitāḥ | nirmalāmbarā iti śubhravastradhāriṇaḥ, tena raktakṛṣṇavastrādirahitā ity arthaḥ | sukhina iti adīnāḥ | aśvavṛṣārūḍhā iti aśvārūḍhā vṛṣārūḍhāś ca | āsamantāt kāreṇa rūḍhāḥ iti yad grahaṇaṃ tan mahiṣoṣṭrakharādiyānaniṣedhārtham | śubhrapuṣpaphalair yutā iti śvetapuṣpair ebhiḥ sāraphalaiś ca saṃyuktā ity abhiprāyaḥ | etena raktapītakṛṣṇādibhiḥ sāraphalarahitā ity arthaḥ | yata evaṃvidhāni puṣpaphalāny amaṅgalāni bhavanti | tathā coktam
‘tailakardamadigdhāṅgā raktasraganulepanāḥ |
phalaṃ pakvam asāraṃ vā gṛhītvā 'nyac ca tadvidham | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ’ iti | sujātaya iti śobhanā jātir yeṣāṃ te tathāvidhāḥ | etenānyajātijanitā niṣiddhāḥ | pāpakṛdgarbhotpattirahitā ity arthaḥ | yad vā vijñātajātaya iti piṇḍārthaḥ | suceṣṭāś ceti ceṣṭātra kāyakṛto vyāpāraḥ śobhanavyāpāra ity abhiprāyaḥ | śobhanagrahaṇaṃ duśceṣṭitavyavacchedārtham | tathā hy uktaṃ
’chindantas tṛṇakāṣṭhāni spṛśanto nāsikāṃ stanam |
vastrāntānāmikākeśanakharomadṛśaspṛśaḥ |
sroto 'varodhahṛdgaṇḍamūrdhoraḥkukṣipāṇayaḥ |
kapālopala- bhasmāsthituṣāṅgārakarāś ca ye |
vilikhanto mahīṃ kiñcin muñcanto loṣṭabhedinaḥ |‘ ityādi duśceṣṭitā darśitāḥ | suceṣṭāś ceti cakāragrahaṇāt sudarśanāḥ suveṣā api gṛhyante anyathā garhitāḥ syuḥ | tathā hi -
’napuṃsakaḥ strībahavo naikakāryā asūyakāḥ |
pāśadaṇḍāyudhadharāḥ prāptā vā syuḥ paraṃparā |
ārdrajīrṇāpasavyaikamalinoddhatavāsasaḥ |
nyūnādhikāṅgā udvignā vikṛtā raudrarūpiṇaḥ |
vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ’ | sajīvadiśi saṅgatā iti jīvanena prāṇānilena saha yā dik nāḍī tasyāṃ saṅgatāḥ prāptā ity arthaḥ | tathā ca - ’yasyāṃ prāṇamarud vāti sā nāḍī jīvasaṃyutā’ iti | nāḍī cātra nāsāsaṃbandhinī jñeyā | yad vā - jīvena saha vartata iti yā dik diśā tasyām ity ārthaḥ | tena yāmyadikrahitadiśāyāḥ prāptā iti tātparyārthaḥ | yato yāmyadik niṣiddhā | tathā hi - ’yāmyāṃ diśaṃ prāñjalayo viṣamaikapadasthitāḥ | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ’ iti | samaye prāptā iti samaye śubhavelātithinakṣatrādiyukte kāle anyathā aśubhakarā iti bhāvaḥ | tad uktam -
‘vaidyasya paitrye daive vā kārye cotpātadarśane |
madhyāhne cārdharātre vā sandhyayoḥ kṛttikāsu ca || ārdrāśleṣāmaghāmūlapūrvāsu bharaṇīṣu ca | caturthyāṃ vā navamyāṃ vā ṣaṣṭhayāṃ saṃdhidineṣu ca ||
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ deśe tv aśucau vā hutāśanam |
jvalayantaṃ pacantaṃ vā krūrakarmaṇi codyatam||
nagnaṃ bhūmau śayānaṃ vā vegotsargeṣu vā 'śucim|
prakīrṇakeśam abhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ viklavam eva ca | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ’ iti ||9||1 .||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karmaṇaḥ samaye snānābhyaṅgādirahitakāle yasyāṃ prāṇamarud vāti sā nāḍī jīvasaṃyutā candrasūryasthāne yayor dvayor nāḍyor madhye yasyāṃ nāḍyāṃ prāṇamarud vāti gandhagrahaṇādhikārī bhūtvā saṃcārī sā nāḍī jīvasaṃyutā vācyā tasyāṅgasthaḥ pṛcchako yadā pṛcchati tadā sa rogī jīvati anyathā mriyate || anyatrāpy uktaṃ - ’candrasthāne yadā vāyuḥ sūryasthāne ca pṛcchakaḥ | tadā na jīvati rogī yadi vaidyaśatair vṛtaḥ’ | etat pūrvoktasya sa jīvasyāṅgasya vyākhyātam | iti dūtalakṣaṇāni || 9 || 10 ||

lg.l: na śubhaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ pradīptaṃ ca sukhāvaham |
cikitsāṃ rogiṇaḥ kartuṃ gacchato bhiṣajaḥ śubham || 12 ||
yātreyaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ proktaṃ dīptaṃ na śobhanam |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ gacchato dūtasya śakunāny āha --. vaidyāhvānāyeti | rogiṇa āturasya kṛte nimitte vaidyāhvānāya gacchato dūtasya saumyaśakunaṃ bherīmṛdaṅgādi na śobhanam ity arthaḥ | pradīptam asaumyaṃ sukhāvahaṃ bhavati | gacchata iti mārge calitasya | etena viparītaśakunāny atra śubhakārāṇi boddhavyāni | uktaṃ ca jyotiḥśāstre -
‘sadyo raṇe karmaṇi ca praveśe śukle gṛhe naṣṭavilokane ca |
vyādhau ca nadyuttaraṇe bhayārte śastaḥ prayāṇād viparītabhāvaḥ ||? iti dūtaśakunalakṣaṇāni saṃpūrṇāni || idānīṃ gacchato vaidyasyāpi śakunāni darśayann āha - cikitsām iti | rogiṇa āturasya cikitsāṃ rogāpanayanaṃ karma kartuṃ gacchato mārge cālitasya bhiṣajo vaidyasya yātreyaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ proktam idaṃ śubhaṃ kathitaṃ dīptam aśubham aśakunaṃ na śobhanam ity arthaḥ | yātreyaṃ yātrāyogyaṃ yathā -
bherīmṛdaṅgamṛdumardalaśaṅkhaveṇuvedadhvanirmadhuramaṅgalagītaghoṣāḥ |
putrānvitā ca yuvatiḥ surabhiḥ savatsā dhautāmbaraś ca rajako 'bhimukhaḥ praśastaḥ’ | anyac ca -‘bhṛṅgārāñjanavardhamānamakulābaddhaikapaśvāmiṣaśaṅkhakṣīranṛpānnapūrṇakalaśacchatrāṇi siddhārthakāḥ | vīṇāketanamīna paṅkajadadhikṣaudrājyagorocanāḥ, kanyāśaṅkhasitekṣuvastrasumanoviprāś ca ratnāni ca’ iti | dīptam ity atrātreyaṃ tad yathā
‘gamanaṃ dakṣiṇe vāmān na śastaṃ śvasṛgālayoḥ |
vāmaṃ nakulacāṣāṇāṃ nobhayaṃ śaśasarpayoḥ ||
bhāsakauśikayoś caiva na praśastaṃ kilobhayam |
darśanaṃ ca rutaṃ cāpi na godhākṛkalāsayoḥ ||
kulatthatilakārpāsatuṣapāṣāṇabhasmanām |
pātraṃ neṣṭaṃ tathā 'ṅgāratailakardamapūritam ||
prasannetaramadyānāṃ pūrṇaṃ vā raktasarṣapaiḥ |
śavakāṣṭhapalāśānāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ pathi saṅgamāḥ | neṣyanti patitāntasthadīnāndharipavas tathā’ iti || 11 || 12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āturam upakramamāṇena bhiṣajā āyur evādau parīkṣaṇīyam | satyāyuṣi dhṛtyagnivayodehabalasatvasātmya- prakṛtibheṣajadeśān parīkṣayet | tatra pāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhastanāgradarśanavadanaskandhalalāṭadīrghāṃgulipūrvocchvāsa- prekṣaṇabāhuvistīrṇabhūstanāntaroraḥskandhahṛjjaṅghāmeḍhragrīvāgambhīrasatvasvaranābhistanamupacitamahāromaśakarṇapaścānmaṇikatānuliptamūrdhānupūrvyāviśuṣyamāṇaśarīraṃ paścācchuṣyamāṇahṛdayaṃ puruṣaṃ jānīyāt dīrghāyuḥ khalv iti tam ekāntenopakramet | ebhir lakṣaṇair viparītair alpamiśritair madhyamāyur iti | vyādhayas tu trividhāḥ sādhyāḥ, yāpyāḥ, pratyākhyeyāś ca, tad dṛṣṭvā karma kārayet | prāg abhihitā ṛtavaḥ ‘śīte śītapratīkāram uṣṇe coṣṇanivāraṇam | kuryāt kriyāṃ prāptakālaṃ na hāpayet’ | prāg abhihitogniś caturvidhaḥ viṣamo vātena, tīkṣṇaḥ pittena, mandaḥ śleṣmaṇā, samaḥ sarvasāmānyād iti | yaḥ kadācit samyak pacati kadācit śūlādhmānādīn karoti sa viṣamaḥ | yaḥ gurvādikam āśu pacati sa tīkṣṇaḥ | yaḥ laghur api na pacati sa mandaḥ | yaḥ kālam annam upayuktaṃ pacati sa samaḥ | vayas tu trividhaṃ bālaṃ madhyaṃ vṛddham iti | tatronaṣoḍaśavarṣā bālāḥ; te tridhā kṣīrapāḥ, kṣīrānnādā, annādā, iti | teṣu saṃvatsaraparāḥ kṣīrādā dvivatsaraparāḥ kṣīrānnādāḥ parato 'nnādā iti ṣoḍaśasaptatyor antaraṃ madhyaṃ vayaḥ; tasya vikalpo vṛddhir yauvanaṃ sampūrṇatā hānir iti tatrāviṃśateḥ vṛddhir ātriṃśato yauvanam ācatvāriṃśataḥ sarvadhātvindriyabalavīryasaṃpūrṇatā ata ūrdhvam aśīteḥ paraṃ hānir yāvat saptatir iti saptates tūrdhvaṃ kṣīyamāṇadhātvindriyajīrṇāgāram ivābhivṛṣṭaśītaṃ vṛṣam ācakṣate
‘bālye vivardhate śleṣmā madhyame pittam eva tu |
bhūyiṣṭhaṃ varddhate vāyur vṛddhas tad vīkṣya varjayet |
agnikṣāravirekais tu bālavṛddhau vivarjayet|
tatsādhyeṣu vikāreṣu śuddhiṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ bhiṣak |
dehaḥ sthūlaḥ kṛśo madhya iti prāg upadeśitaḥ |
karṣayed bṛṃhayec cāpi mahāsthūlakṛśau narau |
rakṣaṇaṃ caiva madhyasya kurvīta satataṃ bhiṣak ||’ balam eva pradhānaṃ kecit kṛśā eva balavantaḥ sthūlā abalavantaḥ tasmād balaṃ parīkṣayet | satvam āha -
‘satvavān sahate sarvaṃ saṃstabhyātmānam ātmanā |
rājasas tapyamānānyaiḥ sahate nāma tāmasaḥ’ | prakṛtim agre vakṣyāmaḥ | pūrvoktaṃ bheṣajam āha - ‘bālasya prathame māsi deyā bheṣajaraktikā’ ityādi pūrvoktam | śamam āha yathāvahṛdakanagorūpaḥ kaphamārutarogavān evam anyepi jñeyāḥ | evaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā paścān mārge śakunāni parīkṣya tadā cikitsāṃ kurvanti | rogiṇaḥ cikitsāṃ kartuṃ gacchataḥ bhiṣajaḥ yātreyaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ śobhanaṃ proktaṃ dīptaṃ na | rogiṇaḥ kṛte vaidyāhvānāya gacchato dūtasya saumyaśakunaṃ śubhaṃ na pradīptaṃ sukhāvaham ity arthaḥ | iti śakunaḥ ||11||12||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha kīdṛśo rogī cikitsyas tad darśayann āha - nijaprakṛtīti | bhiṣajā vaidyena īdṛśo rogī cikitsyaḥ, cikitsā rogāpanayanaṃ karma tadyogyo bhavatīty abhiprāyaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ ? tam āha - nijaprakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yukta iti yādṛśau yasya prakṛtivarṇau staḥ tādṛgbhyām eva saṃyukta ity arthaḥ | nanu keyaṃ prakṛtiḥ ? katibhedā ? kiṃkāraṇaṃ vā asyā iti ? tad ucyate - keyaṃ prakṛtiḥ svabhāva ity arthaḥ | sa cābālapravṛttā niṣekād vā vātārabdhādyā āprayāṇād anuvartate | kati bhedā iti | sapta prakṛtayo bhavanti pṛthag doṣair dvandvaiḥ samastaiś ca | kiṃkāraṇam iti tad āha suśrutaḥ ‘śukraśoṇitasaṃyoge yo bhaved doṣa utkaṭaḥ | prakṛtir jāyate tena tasyā me lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu’ iti | sā hi prakṛtir jātyādīn ṣaḍ upādhīn apekṣate | tad uktaṃ carake ‘tatra prakṛtir hi jātiprasaktā kulaprasaktā ca deśānupātinīti ca kālānupātinī ca vayo 'nupātinī ca pratyātmaniyatā ceti’ | tatra jātiprasaktā nāma tāsu tāsu manuṣyādijātiṣu te te karacaraṇādayaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣāḥ, vacaneṣu ca nānāvidhā eva vyaktyādayo dharmaviśeṣāḥ, manasi ca dharmādharmamaithunāhāraprabhṛtayo 'pināsti ‘ka’ pustake | bhāvāḥ | kulaprasaktā nāma dvijakule tapaḥpriyatādayaḥ, kṣatriyakule samarapriyatādayo dharmaviśeṣā bhavanti | deśānupātinī nāma lāṭakarṇāṭāyanādīnāṃ kāye vāci manasi ca te te svabhāvaviśeṣā bhavanti | kālānupātinī nāma dehādiṣu daurbalyādidainyaglānyādyapekṣā | gadeṣu ca doṣādyapekṣaṇīyam | vayonupātinī nāma bālyādyavasthāsu kālādau maryādādayo dharmāḥ | pratyātmaniyatā ceti ātmani niyatā pratipuruṣaniyatety arthaḥ | te punaḥ kāye vāci manasi ca svabhāvaviśeṣāḥ prakṛtipuruṣabhedabhinnā dṛśyanta iti | kecit tu pāñcabhautikīṃ prakṛtim āhuḥ | anye tu prakṛtiṃ sattvarajastamomayīm āhuḥ | pūrvam uktaḥ prakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yuktaḥ | atas tāvat prakṛtis tu saṃkṣepeṇoktā | idānīṃ varṇam āha - varṇaśabdena prabhā kathyate | saiva cchāyāpy abhimatā | eteṣāṃ medo 'py astīty eke bhāṣante | sā yathā -
‘varṇaprabhāmiśritā yā chāyā sā parikīrtitā |
varṇam ākrāmati cchāyā prabhā varṇaprakāśinī || āsannā lakṣyate chāyā prabhā dūrāt tu lakṣyate’ iti | na kevalaṃ varṇaprabhācchāyānāṃ lakṣaṇabhedaḥ, saṃkhyābhedo 'py asti | sa yathā caturdhā varṇāḥ - gauraḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ, śyāmaḥ, gauraśyāma iti | prabhā saptavidhā - raktā, pītā, sitā, śyāvā, harit, pāṇḍurā, asiteti || chāyāpi pañcavidhā - snigdhā, vimalā, rūkṣā, malinā, saṃkṣipteti | punaḥ kīdṛśo rogī cikitsyaḥ ? sattvena saṃyuta iti | sattvaṃ tu vyasanābhyudayakriyāsthāneṣv api karmakaram | yataḥ -
‘sattvavān sahate sarvaṃ saṃstabhyātmānam ātmanā |
rājasas tabhyamāno 'nyaiḥ sahate naiva tāmasaḥ |’ iti suśrutaḥ | cakṣuṣopapannārthe pravarāvaramadhyamabalaṃ sattvaṃ trividham | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na likhitam atra granthabāhulyāt | punaḥ kīdṛśaḥ ? vaidyabhakta iti vaidyāhlādakaraḥ tadvākyapālane 'nurakta ity arthaḥ | yataḥ ‘āḍhyo rogī bhiṣagvaśyo jñāpakaḥ sattvavān api’ iti vacanāt | punaḥ kathambhūtaḥ ? jitendriyo jitendriyaviṣayaḥ, viṣayās tu srakcandanavanitādayaḥ | āturalakṣaṇam || 13 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bhiṣajā īdṛśo rogī cikitsyaḥ | kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? nijaprakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yuktaḥ | ( nanu yad vā kiṃ karoti na tu dahanaṃ sthālī tandulān odanaṃ kartuṃ kṣamaḥ | tathā ca śatapuṣpā laghus tīkṣṇā pittakṛd dīpanī kaṭur ityādivacanaṃ vahnim akurvāṇam api āmaṃ pacati yathā sthālīsthabahudugdhamuktikācūrṇaprathamajalayogāt tandulādikaṃ pacati na tv agniṃ prajvālayati ‘nāma puṣpaṃ kaṣāyoktaṃ rūkṣaṃ labdhvāmapācana’miti | tathā ca ‘citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke dīpanaḥ pācano laghu’riti | kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? satvena satvaguṇena saṃyutaḥ | punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? vaidyabhakto jitendriyaḥ | iti rogilakṣaṇam || 13 ||

lg.l: vyaṅgāṃś ca vikṛtān kṛṣṇān sapāśān sāyudhān api |
badhnato nighnataś cāpi dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āśritān ||15||
sa svastho labhate vyādhiṃ rogī yāty eva pañcatām||16||
adho yo nipataty uccāj jale 'gnau vā vilīyate |
śvāpadair hanyate yo 'pi matsyādyair gilito bhavet || 17||
yasya netre vilīyete dīpo nirvāṇatāṃ vrajet |
tailaṃ surāṃ pibed vāpi lohaṃ vā labhate tilān ||18||
sa svastho labhate rogaṃ rogī yāty eva pañcatām ||19||
duḥsvapnān evamādīṃś ca dṛṣṭvā brūyān na kasyacit |
snānaṃ kuryād uṣasy eva dadyād dhematilān apaḥ || 20 ||
paṭhet stotrāṇi devānāṃ rātrau devālaye vaset |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athānantaraṃ svapnāny āha - svapneṣviti | evaṃvidhān svapnān strīpuruṣayor madhye yaś caikaḥ paśyati sa eva yadi svastho 'nāturas tarhi vyādhiṃ labhate | yadā rogī paśyati tadā pañcatvaṃ maraṇaṃ yāti prāpnotīty arthaḥ | kīdṛśān svapnān ? tān āha - nagnān vastrādirahitān, muṇḍān iti muṇḍitān, raktakṛṣṇāmbarāvṛtān iti raktakṛṣṇavastraveṣṭitān ity arthaḥ | vyaṅgān iti avayavādirahitān nāsākartanādibhir api vyaṅgān ity abhiprāyaḥ | vikṛtān iti paṅgukubjaprabhṛtīn, kṛṣṇān iti citrakalpitavat kārṣṇyābhāsaḥ, sapāśān iti pāśayutān, pāśo dīrghaḥ paśūnāṃ bandhanarajjuḥ, badhnato nighnata iti niṣṭhuraprahananakarmakāriṇaḥ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āśritān iti | ete tu yadā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āśritā bhavanti tadā pracuram aniṣṭaṃ syād ity abhiprāyaḥ | tatra nairṛtaṃ bhāgadheyam iti vadanti | mahiṣoṣṭrakharārūḍhān iti mahiṣādivāhaneṣu ārohitā ity arthaḥ | te tu yamasaṃbandhinaś cāśubhakarā iti bhāvaḥ || athāparāṇi duḥsvapnāny āha - adha iti | svapneṣu yo 'pi evaṃvidho bhavati so 'py aniṣṭaḥ kīdṛśas tam āha - adho yo nipataty uccād ityādi | puruṣa uccād atyuccasthānād adho nimnasthāne nipatati skhalatīty arthaḥ | atyuccaṃ parvatādikam | yo jale 'gnau vā vilīyate līno bhavati | etena jale bruḍati agnau pataṅgavat patatīty abhiprāyaḥ | yo 'pi śvāpadair hanyate śunaś caraṇair ākṛṣyata iti | eke svāpadair iti paṭhanti, tatra svāpadair nijabandhunāśādibhir upahanyate pīḍyata ity arthaḥ | matsyādyair iti gilito bhakṣito yo bhavet | ādigrahaṇān makaranakraśiśumāraprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam | yasya puruṣasya ca netre vilīyete vilīnatāṃ prāpnuta iti | svapneṣviti śeṣaḥ | etena svacakṣuṣī vigalite paśyatīty arthaḥ | dīpo nirvāṇatāṃ vrajed iti | etena kim uktam | yaḥ svapne 'py akasmād dīpaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ paśyatīty abhiprāyaḥ | yaś ca tailaṃ surāṃ vā pibet yaś ca lohaṃ labhate tilān vā labhate yaś ca pakvānnaṃ siddham annaṃ labhate yaś ca tad aśnāti bhakṣayati ca yo mātaraṃ kuḍyaṃ viśet mātur gṛhaṃ praviśatīty arthaḥ | eteṣāṃ svapneṣviti saṃbandhaḥ | surātra piṣṭamayī na tu madyaviśeṣaḥ | svapne viśiṣṭamadyapānaṃ praśastam | tad uktaṃ ‘rudhiraṃ pibati svapne madyaṃ vāpi kathaṃcana | brāhmaṇo labhate vidyām itaras tu dhanaṃ labhet’ iti | loham ity asya sthāne lauham iti pāṭhāntaraṃ tatra lauhaṃ lohamayaṃ yaṣṭyādi | vāgrahaṇāt kārpāsapiṇyākalavaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam | eteṣāṃ lābhe 'pyaniṣṭaṃ bhavati | eke viśet kuḍyaṃ ca mātaram ity atra kuḍyam utsaṅgaṃ vyākhyānayanti | jananīṃ praviśen nara iti paṭhanti kecit tatra mātur udare praviśatīty arthaḥ | tatra mātrā saha śayanaṃ karotīty anye || idānīṃ duḥsvapnadarśanotpannāriṣṭanivṛttyarthaṃ kiñcit pratīkāram āha - duḥsvapnānīti | evamādīni pūrvoktanagnamuṇḍādīni duḥsvapnāni duḥkhotpādakāni dṛṣṭvā svapnāvasthāyām ālokya kasyacit purato na brūyāt na prakāśayed ity arthaḥ | paramukhenāniṣṭaśravaṇabhayāt | tadanu kiṃ kuryāt? tad āha - snānam iti | uṣasi prātar eva snānaṃ kuryāt hema tilān ayaś ca dadyāt | hema suvarṇam, tilān kṛṣṇān, ayo lohaḥ | punaḥ kiṃ kuryād ity āha - paṭhed iti | devānāṃ stotrāṇi devānāṃ viṣṇuprabhṛtīnāṃ stotrāṇi agnitrayādīni | yathā -
‘agnitrayaṃ trīṇi ca puṣkarāṇi nāmatrayaṃ trīṇi padāni viṣṇoḥ |
rudras trinetras tripathā ca gaṅgā etāni duḥsvapnavināśanāni |’ iti | iti dinakṛtyaṃ | rātrāv api devālaye devamaṇḍapaṃ vaset | tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād iti keṣāñcin matam | atha duḥsvapnam upasaṃharan phalam āha -kṛtvaivam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa snānadānādikaṃ karma kṛtvā saṃpādya tridinaṃ dinatrayaṃ yathā syāt martyaḥ puruṣaḥ duḥsvapnāt duḥkhajanakanimittāt parimucyate sukhī bhavatīty arthaḥ || 14-21 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svapneṣu naghnato ghnantaḥ strī vā pumān yaḥ paśyati dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ āśritān paśyati | yadā svasthaḥ paśyati tadā sa svasthaḥ vyādhiṃ labhate, naro yaḥ striyaḥ puṃsaḥ svapneṣu naghnato ghnantaḥ dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ āśritān nagnān paśyati, muṇḍān paśyati, raktakṛṣṇāmbarāvṛtān paśyati, vyaṅgān paśyati, vikṛtān paśyati, kṛṣṇān sapāśān paśyati, sāyudhān paśyati, mahiṣoṣṭrakharārūḍhān etān yaḥ svasthaḥ paśyati cet tadā vyādhiṃ labhate | rogī paśyati cet tadā pañcatāṃ maraṇāvasthāṃ yātīty arthaḥ | strīpuṃsa ity atrākārāntaḥ śabdaḥ, kutaḥ ‘acaturavicaturasucaturastrīpuṃsa-’ ityādyāḥ śabdā nipātyante tasmād akārānto bhavaty eva | vyaṅgān pādakhañjān vikṛtān kutsitarūpān kṛṣṇān śyāmān sapāśān bandharajjusahitān | sugamam anyat | punar bahir nāyāti sa svasthaḥ dṛṣṭvā vyādhiṃ labhate | rogī pañcatāṃ yātīti sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ | yasya puṃsaḥ svapneṣu netre vilīyete bhagnāyete, dīpaḥ nirvāṇatāṃ netrādarśanāvasthāṃ vrajet prāpnuyāt saḥ svasthaś cet evaṃ paśyati rogī bhavet, rogī pañcatāṃ yātīty arthaḥ | pumān svapneṣu tailaṃ pibet vā surāṃ pibet vā lohaṃ labhate vā kutrāpi pakvānnaṃ labhate vā tilān labhate snāti vā mānavaḥ vā kūpān viśet punar bahir na yāti sa svasthaḥ evaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyādhiṃ labhate, rogī pañcatāṃ yātīty arthaḥ | ādīni prathamāni duḥsvapnāni dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ kasyacin na kathayet | tarhi kiṃ kuryāt, uṣasi snānaṃ kṛtvā ayo lohaṃ dadyāt hema tilān dadyāt paścād devānāṃ stotrāṇi devālaye paṭhet punā rātrau tatraiva vaset martyaḥ tridinaṃ evaṃ kṛtvā duḥsvapnāt parimucyate mukto bhavati ||14-21||

div.ab:
svapneṣu yaḥ surān bhūpāñ jīvataḥ suhṛdo dvijān |
gosamiddhāgnitīrthāni paśyet sukham avāpnuyāt || 22 ||
tīrtvā kaluṣanīrāṇi jitvā śatrugaṇān api |
āruhya saudhagośailakarivāhān sukhī bhavet || 23 ||
śubhrapuṣpāṇi vāsāṃsi māṃsamatsya phalāni ca |
prāpyāturaḥ sukhī bhūyāt svastho dhanam avāpnuyāt ||24||
agamyāgamanaṃ lepo viṣṭhayā ruditaṃ mṛtiḥ |
āmamāṃsāśanaṃ svapne dhanārogyāptaye viduḥ || 25 ||
jalaukā bhramarī sarpo makṣikā vāpi yaṃ daśet |
rogī sa bhūyād ullāgha: svastho dhanam avāpnuyāt ||26|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ nāḍīparīkṣādividhir adhyāyaḥ ||

Āḍhamalla. atha duḥsvapnāni pratipādya saṃprati praśastasvapnāni darśayann āha - svapneṣviti | yaḥ puruṣaḥ svapneṣu surādīn paśyet sa sukham āpnuyād ity arthaḥ | surān itīndraprabhṛtidevān, bhūpān iti rājñaḥ, suhṛdo mitrāṇi, dvijān brāhmaṇān, ete tu jīvanta iti prakṛtiprāṇayutān ity arthaḥ | tathānyān api | gauḥ | samiddhāgniḥ prajvalitavahniḥ | tīrthāni prayāgādīni || aparāṇy āha - tīrtveti | yaḥ puruṣaḥ svapneṣu evaṃvidho bhavati sa sukhī bhaved ity arthaḥ | kīdṛśas tam āha - kaluṣanīrāṇi sakardamapānīyāni tīrtvā uttīrya sthitam iti bhāvaḥ | śatrugaṇān ripusamūhān jitvā āgata iti tātparyārthaḥ | saudhagośailādīn āruhya prāpta iti bhāvaḥ | saudho dhavalagṛhaḥ, gaur vṛṣabhaḥ, śailaḥ parvataḥ, karī hastī, vāhān aśvādīn, kaluṣanīrāṇīti bahuvacanena nadīnadasamudrādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tad uktam ‘nadīnadasamudrāṃś ca kṣubhitān kaluṣodakān | taret kalyāṇalābhāya vyādher apagamāya ca’ iti || anyāny apy āha - śubhreti | āturo rogī śubhrapuṣpādīni prāpya sukhī bhūyād anāturaḥ syād ity arthaḥ | yadā svastho 'pīdṛśaḥ syāt tadā dhanam āpnuyād iti bhāvaḥ | śubhrapuṣpāṇīti śubhrapuṣpaprabhṛtīni, vāsāṃsi cātra śubhrāṇi jñātavyāni, māṃsam atra āmaṃ na tu paripakvaṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt| phalānīti āmraprabhṛtīni || athetarāṇy āha - agamyeti | agamyāgamanaṃ anucitasthānagamanaṃ, viṣṭhāyāḥ purīṣasya lepaḥ karacaraṇādiṣu, ruditam iti rodanam | ātmanaḥ parasya vā | mṛtir maraṇaṃ āmamāṃsam ity atra pare pakvamāṃsāśanam iti paṭhanti | etac ca svapne dhanārogyāptaye dhanaprāptaye ārogyaprāptaye ca || jalauketi | jalaukādayo yaṃ puruṣaṃ daśanti bhakṣayanti svapneṣviti śeṣaḥ | sa yadā rogī bhavati tadā rogaḥ syāt | svasthopi dhanaṃ prāpnotīty abhiprāyaḥ | jalaukā prasiddhā, bhramarīti kṛṣṇavarṇamadhumakṣikābhedaḥ, makṣikāś ca svalpāḥ, sarpo 'jagaraprabhṛtikaḥ | vāgrahaṇāt varaṭā-madhumakṣikā-maśakādīnāṃ grahaṇam || iti svapnalakṣaṇam || 22-26 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe nāḍīparīkṣādividhir adhyāyas tṛtīyaḥ ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha susvapnāny āha - iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ nāḍīparīkṣādividhir adhyāyaḥ ||svapneṣu yaḥ surān devān paripaśyati, bhūpān rājñaḥ paśyati, jīvataḥ suhṛdaḥ mitrān paśyati, sa sukhaṃ āpnuyād iti || 22-26 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpinyāṃ tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

lg.l: pacen nāmaṃ vahnikṛc ca dīpanaṃ tad yathā miśiḥ |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktaṃ tato dīpanapācanaṃ, ato dīpanapācanādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāny āha - paced iti | yad dravyam āmaṃ na paced vahnikṛc ca bhavati tad dīpanaṃ jānīyāt | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | tathā coktaṃ dravyaguṇāvalyām - ‘śatapuṣpā laghus tīkṣṇā pittakṛd dīpanī kaṭuḥ’ iti | dīpanaṃ jaṭharāgneḥ | agniguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt | nanu katham etadguṇayuktamiśir nāmaghnī bhavati tadavināśakatvena katham agneḥ prabodhaḥ syāt ? ucyate - dravyāṇāṃ prabhāvo vicāraṇīya iti suśrutaḥ na hetubhir vicāryate | tad uktam -
‘nauṣadhair hetubhir vidvān parīkṣeta kathaṃcana |
sahasreṇāpi hetūnāṃ nāmbaṣṭādi virecayet ||’ iti || āma ity aparipakvarasaḥ | tad yathā -
‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyād avipakvas tu yo rasaḥ |
sa āmasaṃjñako jñeyo dehadoṣaprakopanaḥ ||’ iti ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ āmaṃ na pacet vahnikṛd asti tat dīpanaṃ | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā |

div.head: atha dīpanapācanādhyāyaḥ

lg.l: pacen nāmaṃ vahnikṛc ca dīpanaṃ tad yathā miśiḥ |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktaṃ tato dīpanapācanaṃ, ato dīpanapācanādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāny āha - paced iti | yad dravyam āmaṃ na paced vahnikṛc ca bhavati tad dīpanaṃ jānīyāt | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | tathā coktaṃ dravyaguṇāvalyām - ‘śatapuṣpā laghus tīkṣṇā pittakṛd dīpanī kaṭuḥ’ iti | dīpanaṃ jaṭharāgneḥ | agniguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt | nanu katham etadguṇayuktamiśir nāmaghnī bhavati tadavināśakatvena katham agneḥ prabodhaḥ syāt ? ucyate - dravyāṇāṃ prabhāvo vicāraṇīya iti suśrutaḥ na hetubhir vicāryate | tad uktam -
‘nauṣadhair hetubhir vidvān parīkṣeta kathaṃcana |
sahasreṇāpi hetūnāṃ nāmbaṣṭādi virecayet ||’ iti || āma ity aparipakvarasaḥ | tad yathā -
‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyād avipakvas tu yo rasaḥ |
sa āmasaṃjñako jñeyo dehadoṣaprakopanaḥ ||’ iti ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ āmaṃ na pacet vahnikṛd asti tat dīpanaṃ | yathā miśiḥ śatapuṣpā |

lg.l: pacaty āmaṃ na vahniṃ ca kuryād yat tad dhi pācanam || 1 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha pācanam āha - pacaty āmam ityādi | yad dravyam āmaṃ pacati vahniṃ na kuryāt tat pācanaṃ jñeyam | atrāpi dravyaprabhāvo boddhavyaḥ | tac ca nāgakeśaravad vidyāj jānīyāt | yataḥ ‘nāgakeśarakaṃ rūkṣam uṣṇaṃ laghv āmapācanam’ iti | āmapācanam iti virūkṣaṇam | sāmānāṃ doṣadhātumalānām ity eke | ubhayātmakam āha - citro dīpanapācana iti | citraka ubhayakāryakaro bhavati | dīpanaḥ pācanaś ca | tad uktam - ’citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke vahnikṛt pācano laghuḥ |’ iti || 1 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yat (dravyaṃ) āmaṃ pacati vahniṃ na kuryāt tat pācanam | tad āha citraḥ citrakaḥ, nāgakeśaravad dīpanapācanaṃ vidyāt jānīyāt granthāntarāt
mādhuryāc chītabhāvāc ca na punar dīpano mataḥ |
yat kāmaṃ pācanaṃ kuryāt tat tu dīpanam ucyate ||1||

lg.l: na śodhayati na dveṣṭi samān doṣāṃs tathoddhatān ||2||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha saṃśamanam āha - na śodhayatīti | yat kiñcit pītalīḍhāśitam anirhṛtya doṣaṃ saṃśamayati tat saṃśamanam | etena kim uktaṃ yad dravyaṃ na vāmayati na virecayati iti vyādhinā saha ekībhūya tatstham eva vyādhim upaśamayati tat saṃśamanam iti bhāvaḥ | doṣaśabdo 'tra doṣeṣu kāryavyādhiṣv api vartate | kārye kāraṇopacārāt | asamaṃ samaṃ karoti samīkaroti | yathā-amṛtā guḍūcī saṃśamanī prasiddhā | tad uktaṃ - ‘rasāyanī saṃśamanī doṣāṇāṃ jvaranāśinī | guḍūcī kaṭukā laghvī tiktā 'gnidīpanī matā’ iti | kecit tu - ‘na śodhayati yad doṣān samān nodīrayaty api | samīkaroti ca kruddhān tat saṃśamanam ucyate’ iti paṭhanti | atrāpi sa evā 'bhiprāyaḥ | samyak śamayatīti saṃśamanaṃ, samyag duṣṭadoṣasyānirharaṇapūrvakaṃ śamanaṃ aduṣṭasyānudīraṇaṃ ca, vyādhiśamane tu prastutavyādhiśamanaṃ, aprastutavyādher anudīraṇam iti spaṣṭārthajñāpanāya na doṣaḥ || punarbhāvakathanāt || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ uddhatān varddhitān doṣān na śodhayati upaśamaṃ no nayati samān saprakṛtisthān na dveṣṭi na vardhayati kiṃtu samīkaroti tat śamanaṃ jñeyam | yathā amṛtā guḍūcī tadvad ity arthaḥ || 2 ||

lg.l: kṛtvā pākaṃ malānāṃ yad bhittvā bandham adho nayet ||3||
tac cānulomanaṃ jñeyaṃ yathā proktā harītakī |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athānulomanam āha - kṛtveti | yad dravyaṃ malānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ pākaṃ kopaśāntiṃ kṛtvā bandhaṃ nibandhaṃ ca bhittvā bhinnatāṃ nītvā adho nayet adhaḥ karoti vātādikam iti śeṣaḥ, tena pratilomād anulomaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | tac cānulomanaṃ jñeyaṃ, anulomanaṃ vātādīnām adhaḥpravartanaṃ rasaguṇatvāt | yathā harītakī | saivā 'nulominī prasiddhaiva | bandham iti doṣāṇāṃ parasparagrathitatvaṃ | eke vātamūtrapurīṣādīnām apravṛttirūpaṃ vibandham āhuḥ || 3 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ aparipacyamānānāṃ malānāṃ pākaṃ kṛtvā bandhaṃ ca bhittvā adhaḥ nayet koṣṭhād adhaḥ pātayet tataḥ anulomanaṃ jñeyaṃ | yathā harītakī || 3 ||

lg.l: paktavyaṃ yad apaktvaiva śliṣṭaṃ koṣṭhe malādikam || 4 ||
nayaty adhaḥ sraṃsanaṃ‘śra’ ka. tad yathā syāt kṛtamālakaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha sraṃsanam āha - paktavyam iti | yad dravyaṃ malādikam apaktvaiva teṣāṃ pākam akṛtvā adho nayati adhaḥ patanaṃ karoti tat sraṃsanaṃ syāt | yathā kṛtamālakaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ malādikam ? ity āha - paktavyam iti | pacyamānam ata eva koṣṭhe āśliṣṭaṃ, koṣṭha iti pācakasthāne, āśliṣṭam ity āśritam | kecit koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādīny api gṛhyante | tathā hi -‘sthānāny āmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca | hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaś ca koṣṭha ity abhidhīyate’ iti | etadabhiprāyeṇā 'pi śodhanam asyāhuḥ || 4 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ koṣṭhe śliṣṭaṃ paktavyaṃ malādikam apaktvaivāpācayitvā adhaḥ nayati tat sraṃsanaṃ syāt | yathā kṛtamālakaḥ āragvadhaḥ || 4 ||

lg.l: malādikam abaddhaṃ ca baddhaṃ vā piṇḍitaṃ malaiḥ || 5 ||
bhittvādhaḥ pātayati tad bhedanaṃ kaṭukī yathā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha bhedanam āha - maleti | yan malādikam abaddhaṃ malabaddhaṃ vā ata eva malair doṣaiś ca kṛtvā piṇḍitaparipākāt piṇḍībhūtam | īdṛśaṃ malādikaṃ bhittvā sthānāt sañcālyādhaḥ pātayati tad bhedanaṃ jñātavyam iti śeṣaḥ | yathā kaṭukī | baddhaṃ, vibaddhaṃ, śuṣkaṃ, grathitaṃ ca | tatra śuṣkaṃ purīṣaviṣayaṃ | grathitaṃ doṣādīnām | tathā abaddham api dvividham | ekaṃ dravarūpaṃ purīṣaviṣayaṃ svatantram ekaṃ malādikam iti, malo 'tra doṣaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt rūkṣadūṣitādīnām api grahaṇam | bhittveti tat purīṣaṃ bhittvā vidāryādhaḥ pātayati dravyam iti śeṣaḥ || 5 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyam abaddhaṃ malādikaṃ piṇḍitaiḥ piṇḍībhūtair malair baddhaṃ vā bhittvādhaḥ pātayati udbhedanaṃ | yathā kaṭukī ||5||

lg.l: vipakvaṃ yad apakvaṃ vā malādi dravatāṃ nayet || 6 ||
recayaty api taj jñeyaṃ recanaṃ trivṛtā yathā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha recanam āha - vipakvam iti | yad dravyaṃ vipakvam apakvaṃ vā malādi doṣādikaṃ dravatāṃ nayet dravabhāvaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | na kevalaṃ dravatāṃ nayet recayaty api ca tad recanaṃ jñeyaṃ, yathā tṛvṛtā ‘nisotaḥ’ | yato virecanadravyāṇi gurvambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhāni tāni gurutvād adho gacchanti | gurutvād iti gurutvaṃ ceha prabhāvaviśeṣādhiṣṭhitam | trivṛtādikaṃ samavetaṃ grāhyaṃ na tu gurutvamātram | anyathā matsyapiṣṭānnamasūrādīnāṃ virecakatvaṃ syāt | ambuguṇabhūyiṣṭham ity arthaḥ, prabhāvāt | malādikam iti ādigrahaṇāt dūṣyadūṣitādīnām atra saṃgrahaḥ || 6 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ vipakvaṃ malādi apakvaṃ vā dravatāṃ nayet prāpayet punar bahir eva yāti tat recanaṃ jñeyam | yathā tṛvṛtā ||

lg.l: apakvapittaśleṣmāṇau balād ūrdhvaṃ nayet tu yat || 7 ||
vamanaṃ tad dhi vijñeyaṃ madanasya phalaṃ yathā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha vamanam āha - apakvam iti | yad dravyam apakvaṃ pākam agacchantaṃ pittaśleṣmāṇaṃ vyastaṃ miśritaṃ vā balāt haṭhātkāreṇa ūrdhvaṃ nayet mukhe kṛtvā vāmayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | tad vamanaṃ vijñeyaṃ yathā madanasya phalam | balād iti prabhāvasūcakaśabdaḥ, yato vamanadravyāṇi vāyvagniguṇabhūyiṣṭhāni, vāyvagnī hi laghutvāc ca tāny ūrdhvam uttiṣṭhanti | laghutvaṃ ceha prabhāvaviśeṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ madanaphalādidravyasamavetaṃ grāhyaṃ na tu laghutvamātram, anyathā kapiñjalalājādīnāṃ ca vāmanīyatvaṃ syāt | nanu kaphasya vamanaṃ pittasya virecanaṃ praśastam iti prasiddhiḥ, tat kathaṃ pittasya vamanam iti ? ucyate -apakvapittasya vamanād eva nibarhaṇaṃ boddhavyam | tac ca dṛśyate hi kaṭutiktaharitpītāmlavamanatvena yataḥ pittadagdham amlatām upaitīti | ata evā 'mlapittacikitsāyām ādau vamanam ity adoṣaḥ || 7 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyam apakvaṃ pittaśleṣmānnacayam ūrdhvaṃ nayet hi niścayena tat vamanaṃ vijñeyam | yathā madanasya phalam, apakvaṃ pittaṃ ca apakvaḥ śleṣmā ca apakvamannaṃ ca apakvapittaśleṣmānnānāṃ cayam apakvapittaśleṣmānnacayam atra śleṣman śabdasya nakārasya lope yāte sati lope 'śi punar na saṃdhir ity uktatvāt | sa ‘savarṇe dīrghaḥ saha’ ity anena sūtreṇa pūrvāparavarṇayor mitho ghaṭanarūpasandhir na atra punargrahād eva sandhiḥ, anyathā dāmodaḍiṣv ityādau sandhir na syāt | ato 'tra sandhir yukta eva || 7 ||

lg.l: sthānād bahir nayed ūrdhvam adho vā malasaṃcayam || 8 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha śodhanam āha - sthānād iti | yad dravyaṃ sthānāt prakupitasthānāt malasañcayaṃ doṣādīnāṃ svasthānād ūrdhvam adho vā bahir nayet bahiḥ karoti tad dehe śarīre śodhanaṃ kathitam | yathā devadālīphalam | devadālīvallīsaṃjñā | ūrdhvaṃ mukhanāsikābhyāṃ, adhaḥ pāyumeḍhramārgeṇa | dehagrahaṇena śoṇitāvasecanam api gṛhyate śodhanatvāt | yataḥ śodhanaṃ dvividham ācakṣate bahirāśrayam abhyantarāśrayaṃ ca | tatra bahirāśrayaṃ śastrakṣārāgnipralepādayaḥ | abhyantarāśrayaṃ tu catuḥprakāraṃ vamanarecanāsthāpanaśoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca | eke śirovirecanaṃ manyante | tac cātra vamanāntarbhūtaṃ boddhavyam, ūrdhvaśodhanatvāt || 8 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ sthānād bahiḥ sthānān nirasya ūrdhvaṃ vā adhaḥ malasañcayaṃ nayet tad dehe saṃśodhanaṃ syāt | yathā devadālīphalam || 8 ||

lg.l: śliṣṭān kaphādikān doṣān unmūlayati yad balāt ||9||
chedanaṃ tad yathā kṣārā maricāni śilājatu ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha chedanam āha - śliṣṭān iti | yad dravyaṃ śliṣṭān sañcitān, parasparagrathitān ity eke, atyarthaṃ kupitān ity apare, kaphādikān doṣān, ādigrahaṇena vātapittaśoṇitakṛmigrahaṇaṃ na tu dūṣyadūṣyatādikaṃ, yataḥ doṣān iti punargrahaṇaṃ kṛmiśoṇitayor api doṣasaṃjñā | tad uktaṃ suśrute ‘narte dehaḥ kaphād asti na pittān na ca mārutāt | śoṇitād api vā nityaṃ deha etais tu dhāryate’ ityādipratipāditatvāt | kṛmis tu guggulukalpe yathā pañcādidoṣān śamayed ityādipraśne kṛmidoṣanibarhaṇād ityādinā, tanmate kṛmes tu doṣasaṃjñā | balād iti svaśaktitaḥ, unmūlayati ucchedayati, tac chedanaṃ jñeyam | yathā kṣārā yavakṣārādayaḥ, maricānīti bahuvacanatvena śvetamaricam api grāhyam | nanu vātādikramaṃ parityajya kaphādikrameṇa ślokaḥ kasmād iha kṛtaḥ ? tad ucyate, dehasya ūrdhvamūlatvam adhaḥśākhatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ pūrvācāryaiḥ, ūrdhvabhāge ca kaphādhiṣṭhānatvāt tato 'nena kapha eva prathamaṃ darśitaḥ | tad uktam -
‘ūrdhvamūlam adhaḥśākhaṃ tristhūṇaṃ pañcadaivatam |
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidvān yo vai veda sa vedavit ’ || 9 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ śliṣṭān lagnān malādikān doṣān balād unmūlayati svabhāvān nāśayati tac chedanaṃ jñeyam | yathā kṣārā maricāni śilājatu || 9 ||

lg.l: dhātūn malān vā dehasya viśoṣyollekhayec ca yat ||1 .||
lekhanaṃ tad yathā kṣaudraṃ nīram uṣṇaṃ vacā yavāḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha lekhanam āha - dhātūn iti | yad dravyaṃ dhātūn rasādīn malān vā | atra malān veti yad grahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tan manodoṣavyavacchedārtham | yato manodoṣapratīkārakam anyad apy astīti | tathā hi ‘dhīr dhṛtir jñānavijñānaṃ manodoṣauṣadhaṃ param’ iti | ke te manodoṣāḥ ? ity uttaram āha ‘rajas tamaś ca manaso dvau ca doṣāv udāhṛtau’ ityādi | eke - ‘lekhanaṃ tad yathā kṣaudranīrakoṣṇaṃ vacā yavāḥ ’ iti paṭhanti | tatra kṣaudranīre madhvambunī milite iti yogo lekhanasaṃjñaḥ, koṣṇam ity uṣṇapānīyaṃ ‘kaṃ śiro jalam ākhyātam’ iti vacanāt| uṣṇaṃ ca tat kaṃ ceti koṣṇaṃ alpasvaratvāt pūrvanipātaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ svakapolakalpanayā kenā 'pi likhitaḥ yato bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate | yavā iti bahuvacanagrahaṇena evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭā anye 'pi boddhavyāḥ || 10 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ dehasthān dhātūn malān viśoṣya śuṣkaṃ kṛtvā lekhayet sthūlasya kṛśādi kārayet tal lekhanam | yathā kṣaudram uṣṇaṃ nīraṃ vacā yavāḥ || 10 ||

lg.l: dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ yat syād uṣṇatvād dravaśoṣakam || 11 ||
grāhi tac ca yathā śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ gajapippalī |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha grāhilakṣaṇam āha - dīpanam iti | yad dravyaṃ dīpanam agnikaraṃ - pācanam āmādīnāṃ, dravaśoṣakam iti dravasvarūpāṇāṃ doṣadhātumalādīnāṃ śoṣakam ity arthaḥ, uṣṇatvāt uṣṇavīryatvāt | dravaśoṣakam iti yojyaṃ, dīpanādikāryakaratvena upalakṣitam iti bhāvaḥ| tad grāhi vijñeyam | yathā śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ, gajapippalī, gajapippalī cavyaphalam | nanu saṃgrāhakam anilaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ yato 'nilasya śoṣaṇātmakatvāt | tat katham uktam uṣṇatvād iti | ucyate - pakvāmagrāhakatvena dvividhaṃ hi saṃgrāhakatvaṃ tatra yad grahaṇyām āmaṃ sampācya vahniṃ kṛtvā tatrasthaṃ dravaṃ ca śoṣayitvā stambhanaṃ karoti tad uṣṇagrāhakaṃ jñeyam | yad dravyam atīsārādau pakvamalādikaṃ saṃstabhya saṃgrahaṃ karoti tac chītagrāhakaṃ jñeyam etad anilaguṇabhūyiṣṭham ity adoṣaḥ || 11||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyam uṣṇatvād dravaśoṣakaṃ dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ syāt tad grāhi yathā śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ gajapippalī || 11 ||

lg.l: raukṣyāc chaityāt kaṣāyatvāl laghupākāc ca yad bhavet || 12 ||
vātakṛt stambhanaṃ tat syād yathā vatsakaṭuṇṭukau |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha ca tad eva stambhanam āha - raukṣyād iti | yad dravyaṃ raukṣyāt | rūkṣaguṇatvāt, śaityād iti śītavīryatvāt, kaṣāyād iti kaṣāyarasatvāt, laghupākāc ca laghuparipākād vātakṛd bhavati tat stambhanaṃ syāt | vātaguṇasādharmyaṃ hetucatuṣṭayam | anilasya śoṣaṇātmakatvenānilaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ dravyaṃ stambhanaṃ bhavatīty abhiprāyaḥ | yathā vatsakaṭuṇṭukau, yatheti dṛṣṭāntatvenopadarśitam | vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ | vātakṛd ity anena koṣṭhavāyor viṣṭambhakaḥ | tasmāt tad dravyaṃ stambhanaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ || 12 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ raukṣyāc chaityāt kaṣāyatvāt laghupākād vātakṛt tat stambhanaṃ syāt | yathā vatsakaṭuṇṭukau | vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ || 12 ||

lg.l: rasāyanaṃ ca taj jñeyaṃ yaj jarāvyādhināśanam || 13 ||
yathā 'mṛtā rudantī ca gugguluś ca harītakī |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha rasāyanam āha -- rasāyanaṃ ceti | yad dravyaṃ jarāvyādhināśanaṃ bhavati tad rasāyanaṃ jñeyam | rasādīnāṃ dhātūnām ayanam āpyāyanarūpaṃ rasāyanam | yathā amṛtā guḍūcī, rudantī śākabhedaḥ paścime atīva vikhyātaḥ | gugguluḥ śālaniryāsaḥ prasiddhaḥ | harītakī prasiddhā | jarā vārdhakyaṃ, vyādhayo jvarādayo rogā grāhyāḥ | nanu vyādhigrahaṇena jarāgrahaṇaṃ tat katham atra jarā pṛthag abhihitā ? ucyate - jarā svābhāvikī jñeyā svabhāvakathanatvena pṛthagabhidhānam ity adoṣaḥ | yataḥ saptater ūrdhvaṃ svabhāvavad bhavatīti ||13||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ jarāvyādhināśanaṃ tat rasāyanaṃ syāt | yathā 'mṛtā, rudantī ca, gugguluś ca, harītakī ( ca) || 13 ||

lg.l: yasmādravyād bhavet strīṣu harṣo vājīkaraṃ ca tat || 14 ||
yathā nāgabalādyāḥ syur bījaṃ ca kapikacchujam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha vājīkaraṇam āha - yasmād iti | yasmād dravyāt strīṣu strīpuruṣayoḥ harṣaḥ kāmaśaktisuratasukhaṃ bhavet tad vājīkaraṃ jñātavyam | yathā nāgabalādyāḥ syur iti nāgabalā gāṅgerukī ādiśabdāt jātiphalāhiphenabhaṅgāprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam | kapikacchubījam api vājīkaraṇaṃ kapikacchur vānarī | dvividhadṛṣṭāntenātra dvividhaṃ vājīkaraṇaṃ sūcitam | ekaṃ vīryastambhanarūpam aparaṃ vīryavardhanam ity anena paunaruktyāpy adoṣaḥ || 14 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yasmād dravyāt strīṣu harṣo bhavet tat vājīkaraṃ, yathā nāgabalādyāḥ syuḥ, kapikacchujaṃ bījaṃ ca || 14 ||

lg.l: yasmāc chukrasya vṛddhiḥ syāc chukralaṃ ca tad ucyate || 15||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athātra tad eva vīryakaradravyaṃ prakaṭayann āha - yasmād iti | śukralam iti śukravṛddhikaram | śeṣaṃ subodham || 15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yasmād dravyāt śukrasya vṛddhiḥ syāt tat śukralaṃ syāt | yathā aśvagandhādyā jñeyāḥ || 15 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha śukrasya janakāni pravartakāni ca dravyāṇy āha - dugdham iti | retasaḥ śukrasya dugdhādīni dravyāṇi pravartakāni kathyante | na kevalaṃ pravartakāni utpādakarāṇi ca ? kathyante prabhāvāt | māṣo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, āmalānīti āmalakaphalāni | śeṣaṃ prasiddham || 16 ||

lg.l: jātīphalaṃ stambhakaṃ ca śoṣaṇī ca harītakī |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. vājīkaraṇānām auṣadhānāṃ viśeṣān āha - pravartanīti | śukrasya vīryasya pravartanī prakaṭakāriṇī strī kathitety arthaḥ | recanaṃ bṛhatīphalam iti śukrasyety atrāpi sambandhaḥ | bṛhatī bṛhatkaṇṭakārikā tasyāḥ phalam | stambhakam avarodhakaraṃ jātīphalaṃ bhavati | atrāpi vīryasyeti sambandhaḥ | śoṣaṇī hīnakāriṇī harītakī kathitā | cakārād atrāpi śukrasyety arthaḥ | eke śoṣaṇī ca harītakīty asya sthāne kāliṅgaṃ kṣayakāri ceti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca kāliṅgaṃ phalavartulam iti || 17 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. srī śukrasya pravartanī, yad dravyaṃ tad recanaṃ yathā bṛhatīphalaṃ puṃso nāryāḥ śukrasya staṃbhanaṃ jātīphalaṃ syāt, kaliṅgaṃ brahmaśīrṣaṃ kṣayakāri syāt || 17 ||

lg.l: dehasya sūkṣmachidreṣu viśed yat sūkṣmam ucyate || 18 ||
tad yathā saindhavaṃ kṣaudraṃ nimbatailaṃ rubūdbhavam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha sūkṣmadravyam āha - dehasyeti | yad dravyaṃ dehasya śarīrasya sūkṣmachidreṣu romakūpaprabhṛtiṣu viśet praveśaṃ karoti tat sūkṣmam ucyate | yathā saindhavādikam | sūkṣmo guṇaviśeṣaḥ, srotonusaraṇaśīlatvāt | saindhavaṃ prasiddhaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu nimbatailaṃ nimbaṃ ca tailaṃ ca, yad vā nimbasya tailaṃ rubūdbhavaṃ tailaṃ ca, rubūdbhavam eraṇḍasaṃbhavam || 18 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ dehasya sūkṣmacchidreṣu viśet praviśet tat sūkṣmam ucyate | yathā saindhavaṃ kṣaudraṃ nimbatailaṃ eraṇḍatailaṃ ( ca) || 18 ||

lg.l: pūrvaṃ vyāpyākhilaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ pākaṃ ca gacchati ||19||
vyavāyi tad yathā bhaṅgā phenaṃ cāhisamudbhavam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha vyavāyidravyam āha -- vyavāyīti | vyavāyīti guṇaviśeṣaḥ | apakvam evākhilaṃ dehaṃ vyāpnoti paścān madyaviṣayavat pākaṃ yāti | evaṃ bhaṅgā, ahiphenaṃ ca, ahiphenaṃ “aphū” śabdavācyam | anye tu ‘tadabhāvāya kalpate’ iti paṭhanti | tatrā 'pi sthitaye kalpate nordhvam adho vā pravartata iti sa evārthaḥ | anye punar bhāvaśabdam abhiprāyārtham icchanti | tatra niyatadravyaprabhāveṇātmaśaktyanurūpaṃ tad dravyaṃ madyaviṣayavat viśeṣābhiprāyāya kalpate ity arthaḥ || 19 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ pūrvam akhilaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ kāyaṃ vyāpya paścāt pākaṃ gacchati tad vyavāyi | yathā bhaṅgā ahisamudbhavaṃ phenam || 19 ||

lg.l: sandhibandhāṃs tu śithilān yat karoti vikāśi tat || 20 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha vikāśidravyasyāpi kiñcid bhedaṃ darśayann āha - sandhibandhān iti | yad dravyaṃ sandhibandhān śithilībhūtān karoti tad vikāśi boddhavyaṃ, vikāśi ity api guṇaviśeṣaḥ, na kevalaṃ sandhibandhān śithilān karoti kintu dhātubhya ojo balaṃ viśleṣya vibhajya pākaṃ gacchati ity adhyāhāraḥ | dhātuśaithilyam api karoti ity abhiprāyaḥ | cakārād apakvam evety atrāpi saṃbandhaḥ | kramukakodravā iti | kramukaṃ pūgaphalam, kodravaṃ kudhānyaviśeṣaḥ | ataḥ kramukakodravā madakarā jñeyāḥ | dhātuśaithilyāt ojo balam iti | suśrutena tad uktam - ‘rasādīnāṃ śukrāntānāṃ dhātūnāṃ yat paraṃ tejas tat khalv ojas tad eva balam ity ucyate’ yataḥ - ‘dehaḥ sāvayavas tena vyāpto bhavati dehinām’’ iti | sandhiprabhṛtīnāṃ śithilatvena śramāṇāṃ cotpadyate tena ojaḥkṣayo bhavatīty abhiprāyaḥ | ata evāha kaścit - ’abhighātāt kṣayāt kopād yānāc chokāc chramāt kṣudhaḥ | ojaḥ saṃkṣīyate hy ebhyo dhātugrahaṇaniḥsṛtam’ iti | anye tu saviśeṣo vyavāyī tīkṣṇaviśeṣo vikāśīti bruvate, tan na sarvamatam || 20 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ dhātubhyaḥ ojaḥ vīryaṃ viśleṣya sandhibandhān śithilān karoti tad vikāśi yathā kramukaḥ, pūgīphalaṃ, kodravāś ca || 20 ||

lg.l: buddhiṃ lumpati yad dravyaṃ madakāri tad ucyate || 21 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha madakāridravyasya lakṣaṇāni darśayann āha -- buddhim iti | yad dravyaṃ buddhiṃ jñānaviṣayaṃ lumpati ācchādayati tan madakāri kathyate, ata eva tamoguṇapradhānaṃ tamoguṇabahulam ity arthaḥ | yathā surādikaṃ madyādikam | buddhis tu medhādhṛtismṛtimatipratipattiṣu vartate | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prasaṅgād ucyate | tad yathā medhā granthākarṣaṇasāmarthyaṃ, dhṛtiḥ santuṣṭiḥ,anye niyamātmikāṃ buddhim āhuḥ | smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasya smaraṇam | arthadhāraṇāśaktir ity anye | matir anāgataviṣayopadeśaḥ, trikālaviṣayā buddhir ity anye; pratipattir arthāvabodhaprāgalbhyam iti | surādikam ityādigrahaṇāt sarve madyavikārā gṛhyante | nanu madyaṃ tu buddhismṛtivāgviceṣṭādikaram uktam | tad uktaṃ - ‘buddhismṛtiprītikaraḥ sukhaṃ ca pānānnanidrārativardhanaṃ ca | sampāṭhagītasvaravardhanaṃ ca prokto 'tiramyaḥ prathamo mado hi’ tat kathaṃ buddhilopakam abhihitam ?, ucyate - madasya catvāraḥ pānāvasthāḥ kathitāḥ tatra prathamaṃ madapānaṃ buddhyādikaṃ karoti, śeṣās tu buddhyādikaṃ lumpantīty adoṣaḥ | tad uktaṃ mādhavena - ‘avyaktabuddhismṛtivāgviceṣṭaḥ sonmattalīlākṛtir apraśāntaḥ | ālasyanidrābhihito muhuś ca madhyena mattaḥ puruṣo madena’ ityādi || 21 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ buddhiṃ lumpati tan madakāri ucyate | yathā tamoguṇapradhānaṃ madyaṃ surā || 21 ||

lg.l: vyavāyi ca vikāśi syāt sūkṣmaṃ chedi madāvaham || 22 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha prāṇaharadravyam āha - vyavāyi ceti | yad dravyaṃ vyavāyādiguṇayuktaṃ bhavati taj jīvitaharaṃ prāṇaharaṃ smṛtaṃ kathitam | yathā viṣam | tad eva yogavāhi smṛtam ity arthaḥ | vyavāyīti samastadehaṃ vyāpya paścāt pākaṃ gacchatīti vyavāyī guṇaḥ, vikāśī guṇaś ca sakaladehaṃ vyāpya dhātuśaithilyaṃ karoti | sūkṣmo guṇas tu sūkṣmāt sūkṣmeṣu srotassv anusvaraḥ smṛtaḥ | chedanaṃ manodoṣadhātumalādīn balād unmūlayati tac chedi kathitam | madāvaham iti madakārakam | āgne- yam ity āgneyaguṇabhūyiṣṭham | yogavāhīti rasādiṣu draṣṭavyam || 22 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. jīvitaharaṃ jīvanāśakaṃ yad dravyaṃ tad akhilakāyavyāpakatvāt vyavāyi sandhibandhaśithilakāritvāt | vikāśi syāt, sūkṣmaṃ madāvahaṃ syāt, chedichedanam pā. syāt, āgneyaṃ ca syāt, yathā yogavāhi smṛtaṃ viṣam ||22||

lg.l: nirasyati pramāthi syāt tad yathā maricaṃ vacā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha pramāthidravyam āha - nijavīryeṇeti | yad dravyaṃ nijavīryeṇa svaprabhāveṇa kṛtvā srotobhyaḥ karṇamukhanāsādīnāṃ anyavivarebhyaś ca vā doṣabāhulyaṃ nirasyati tat pramāthisaṃjñaṃ kathitam | yathā maricaṃ vacā | doṣaśabdo 'tra vyādhiṣv api vartate kāraṇe kāryopacārāt, tena vyādhisañcayam apīty arthaḥ || 23 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ nijavīryeṇa svaprabhāveṇa srotobhyaḥ rasavāhiśirāmārgebhyaḥ doṣasaṃcayaṃ nirasya dūrīkaroti tat pramāthi syāt| yathā maricaṃ vacā || 23 ||

div.ab:
paicchilyād gauravād dravyaṃ ruddhvā rasavahāḥ śirāḥ || 24 ||
dhatte yad gauravaṃ tat syād abhiṣyandi yathā dadhi || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dīpanapācanā'dhyāyaś caturthaḥ |

Āḍhamalla. athābhiṣyandilakṣaṇam āha - paicchilyād iti | yad dravyaṃ paicchilyāt picchilaguṇayogāt, gauravāt guruguṇayogāt, gurupākasvabhāvād vā rasavahāś caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ śirāḥ rudhvā saṃrudhya gauravaṃ gurutāṃ dhatte tad abhiṣyandi kathitam | yathā dadhi abhiṣyandīti | śleṣmaprakopīti rūḍhiḥ guṇasādharmyāt śleṣmā'pi picchilagauravādiguṇayuktaḥ || 24 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe dīpanapācanādividhir adhyāyaś caturthaḥ ||iti sūtrasthānam ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yad dravyaṃ paicchalyāc caikkaṇyāt gauravāt rasavahāḥ śirā rudhvā gauravaṃ dhatte tad abhiṣyandi syāt | yathā dadhi ||24|| iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthapradīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dīpanapācanādiguṇoktividhir nāmādhyāyaś caturthaḥ| (śārīram)

div.head: atha kalādikākhyānādhyāyaḥ

lg.l: dhātvāśayāntarasthas tupnakṣiptamidam | yaḥ kledas tv adhitiṣṭhati |
dehoṣmaṇā vipakvo yaḥ sā kalety abhidhīyate ||1||
) kalāḥ saptāśayāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ sapta tanmalāḥ |
trayo doṣā navaśataṃ snāyūnāṃ saṃdhayas tathā |
daśā'dhikaṃ ca dviśatam asthnāṃ ca triśataṃ tathā ||2||
strīṇāṃ ca viṃśatyadhikāḥ kaṇḍarāś caiva ṣoḍaśa ||4||

ab.seg:
atha sapta kalāḥ |
kalāsvarūpaṃ-‘snāyubhiśca praticchannānsantatāṃśca jarāyuṇā | śleṣmaṇā veṣṭitāṃścāpi kalābhāgāṃstu tān viduḥ || dhātvāśayāntare dhāturyaḥ kledastvadhitiṣṭhati| dehoṣmaṇābhipakvaśca sā kaletyamidhīyate ||’ iti | māṃsāsṛṅmedasāṃ tisro yakṛtplīhnoś caturthikā |
pañcamī ca tathā'ntrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhī cāgnidharā matā || 6 ||

lg.l: retodharā saptamī syād iti sapta kalāḥ smṛtāḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktaṃ kalādikākhyāna iti | atas tad darśayann āha - kalā iti | kalādi - pratānānām etan nāmasaṃkhyākathanam‘randhrāṇāṃ’ pā. | | samāsataḥ saṃkṣepāt | proktaṃ kathitam ity artha: | tad yathā - kalāḥ saptasaṃkhyākāḥ tāś ca dhātvāśayāntaramaryādā | tathā hi -
‘dhātvāśayāntarais tasya yat kledas tv adhitiṣṭhati |
dehoṣmaṇā vipakvo yaḥ sā kalety abhidhīyate ||’ iti | āśayāḥ sapta, āśayāḥ sthānāni tāni koṣṭhaśabdenopalakṣitāni tathā hi -
‘sthānāny āmāni pakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca |
hṛduṇḍukaḥcarake purīṣāntraśabdopalakṣita uṇḍukaḥ pratipāditaḥ | phupphusaś ca koṣṭha ity abhidhīyate ||’ iti | dhātavaḥ sapta kathitāḥ, dhātavo rasādayaḥ, te-‘rasā'sṛṅmāṃsamedo 'sthimajjaśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ’ iti | sapta tanmalā dhātumalāḥ, teṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ pratipākataḥ kaphādisaṃjñā ity arthaḥ | saptopadhātava iti | dhātusamīpe bhavā upadhātavaḥ, yathā gomayādibhyodadhimiśritagomayeneti tātparyam | vṛścikādisaṃbhavaḥ, te stanyarajaḥprabhṛtayaḥ | tvacaḥ sapta prakīrtitāḥ iti śukraśoṇitasyābhipacyamānakṣīrasyeva santānikāḥ saptatvaco bhavanti | trayo doṣāḥ vātapittakaphasaṃjñāḥ, dhātvādīn dūṣayantīti | sandhir avayavādīnā sandhānam | granthir iti loke | atra cakāragrahaṇāt daśottaraśatadvayād api adhikā boddhavyāḥ | tad uktam - ‘jñeyaṃ cikitsakair nūnaṃ sandhīnāṃ ca śatadvayam | daśottaraṃ sahasre dve nijagādā'trinandana:’ iti | asthnāṃ ca triśataṃ matam iti | asthi sārabhūtaṃ śarīrasyādhārarūpaṃ ca kathitam | saptottaraṃ marmaśatam iti | marmāṇi jīvasyādhārarūpāṇi tāni saptā'dhikaśatasaṃkhyāni | tathā śirāḥ saptaśatāni ceti | doṣadhātujalavāhinyaḥ śirāḥ kathitāḥ, cakārād atra na ca saptaśataṃ niyatam anyāś ca santīty eke bhāṣante; tad uktaṃ -
“dvisaptatisahasrāṇi nāḍīnāṃ tadvinirgatāḥ |
tābhyo vinirgatā nāḍyas tābhyo 'thānyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || tāvatyo nāḍyo dehe yāvatyo romakūpakāḥ | sthūlamūlāḥ susūkṣmāgrāḥ patrarekhāpratānavat” iti | dhamanyo nāḍīviśeṣāś caturviśatisaṃkhyakāḥ kathitās tāś ca rasavahā jñeyāḥ, śirā dhamanyo nāḍyaś ca parasparaparyāyavācakā jñeyāḥ, bhinnatvam āsāṃ kāryatvāt | māṃsapeśya iti - nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ māṃsapeśyaḥ pañcaśatasaṃkhyakāḥ samākhyātāḥ | budhair iti śeṣaḥ | peśī dīrghākṛtimāṃsakhaṇḍaḥ, aparaiś caturasrā peśīty ucyate | tathā coktam ‘caturasrā bhavet peśī vṛttaḥ piṇḍo‘piṇḍaugha’ pā.| ghanaḥ smṛtaḥ | śālmalīmukulākārām arbudaṃ paricakṣate’ iti | strīṇāṃ viṃśatyadhikā ity anena māṃsapeśyaḥ kathitāḥ, adhikāś ca pañcaśatāt, tena viṃśatyadhikapañcaśatamāṃsapeśyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhavantīty abhiprāyaḥ | viṃśater vivaraṇam āha - stanayoḥ pañca pañca, catasraś ca yonau, garbhamārge tisraḥ, garbhāśaye ca tisra iti | kaṇḍarāś caiva ṣoḍaśeti - kaṇḍarā mahāsnāyuḥ | ṣoḍaśeti ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyakāḥ | tad yathā - catasraḥ pādayoḥ, hastayoś catasraḥ, grīvāyāṃ catasraḥ, pṛṣṭhe catasraḥ | nṛdehe daśa randhrāṇi | nārīdehe trayodaśeti | nṛdehe puruṣaśarīre daśasaṃkhyakāni randhrāṇi chidrāṇi santīty adhyāhāryam | nārīdehe strīśarīre trayodaśa randhrāṇīti bhāvaḥ | tāny agre vakṣyamāṇāni jñātavyāni | etat sarvaṃ kalādikaṃ samāsataḥ saṃkṣepāt proktaṃ kathitam ity arthaḥ ||1-5||

atha ‘vistareṇādhunocyata’ ity uktaṃ prāk idānīṃ vistaram eteṣāṃ darśayann āha -māṃseti | māṃsāsṛṅmedasāṃ tisraḥ kalāḥ, tāsāṃ saṃjñā yathā - māṃsadharā, raktadharā, medodharā iti caturthikā yakṛtplīhno: sā śleṣmadharā yakṛtplīhnor madhye ity abhiprāyaḥ | pañcamī kalā cāntrāṇāṃ sā purīṣadharā | ṣaṣṭhī cāgneḥ sā pittadharā | saptamī kalā retodharā iti sapta kalāḥ smṛtāḥ kathitāḥ | tad uktaṃ suśrute - “tāsāṃ prathamā māṃsadharā nāma yasyāṃ māṃse śirāsnāyudhamanīsrotasāṃ pratānā bhavanti |
yathā viṣamṛṇālāni vivardhante samantataḥ |
bhūmau paṅkodakasthāni tathā māṃse śirādayaḥ ||” iti | nanu rasād raktaṃ tato māṃsam ityādikramaḥ tat kathaṃ prāg eva māṃsadharā kathitā ? ucyate - śarīrapoṣaṇārthaṃ rasādikramo 'yaṃ na tu dhāraṇe | ata eva māṃsadharatvena pūrvaṃ pratipādya kalā nirdiṣṭāḥ parasparānugrahāt | dvitīyā raktadharā (nāma) māṃsasyābhyantaratas tasyāṃ śoṇita viśeṣataś ca śirā snāyuyakṛtplīhnoś ca bhavati | “vṛkṣād yathābhiprahatāt kṣīriṇaḥ kṣīram āvahet | māṃsād evaṃ kṣatāt kṣipraṃ śoṇitaṃ saṃprasicyate” iti | tṛtīyā medodharā (nāma,) medo hi sarvabhūtānām udarastham aṇvasthiṣu ca mahatsu ca majjā bhavati | “sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tv abhyantarāśritaḥ| athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate’ iti || caturthī śleṣmadharā nāma sarvasandhiṣu prāṇabhṛtāṃ bhavati |
snehābhyakte yathā hy akṣe cakraṃ sādhu pravartate |
sandhayaḥ sādhu vartante saṃśliṣṭāḥ śleṣmaṇā tathā ||’ iti | pañcamī purīṣadharā (nāma) yā'ntaḥkoṣṭhe malam abhivibhajate pakvāśayasthā |
“yakṛt samantāt koṣṭhaṃ ca tathā'ntrāṇi samāśritā
uṇḍukasthaṃ vibhajate malaṃ maladharā kalā ||” iti | ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā caturvidham annapānam upayuktam āmāśayāt pracyutaṃ pakvāśayopasthitaṃ dhārayati |
“aśitaṃ khāditaṃ pītaṃ līḍhaṃ koṣṭhagataṃ nṛṇām |
taj jīryati yathākālaṃ śoṣitaṃ pittatejasā||” iti | saptamī śukadharā (nāma) yā sarvaprāṇināṃ sarvaśarīravyāpinī |
“yathā payasi sarpis tu gūḍhaś cekṣau raso yathā |
śarīreṣu tathā śukraṃ nṛṇāṃ vidyād bhiṣagvaraḥ |
dvyaṅgule dakṣiṇe pārśve bastidvārasya cāpy adhaḥ |
mūtrasrotaḥpathāc chukraṃ puruṣasya pravartate |
kṛtsnadehāśritaṃ śukraṃ prasannamanasas tathā |
strīṣu vyāyacchataś cāpi harṣāt tat sampravartate ||” || 6 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. adhunā sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ kalādyaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | nṛdehe sapta kalāḥ santi, sapta āśayāḥ santi,sapta dhātavaḥ santi, tanmalāḥ teṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ saptopadhātavaḥ santi, sapta tvacaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | dehe traya: doṣāḥ santi, navaśataṃ snāyūnāṃ sandhayaḥ santi | tathety uktatvāt daśādhikaṃ snāyavaḥ santi, tās tu snāyūnāṃ sandhaya uktāḥ, dehe asthisaṃgrahaṃ triśataṃ, dehe saptottaraśataṃ marmasthalam asti, tathā śirā sūkṣmā nāḍī saptasaptaśatam asti, nṛdehe rasavāhikā dhamanyaḥ caturviṃśatiḥ ākhyātāḥ kathitāḥ | atra śirāsnāyudhamanīnāṃ bhedosti svakarmakarttṛtvāt | nṛṇāṃ dehe māṃsapeśyaḥ māṃsagranthayaḥ budhaiḥ pañcaśataṃ samākhyātāḥ | strīṇāṃ dehe māṃsapeśyaḥ viṃśatyadhikā ākhyātāḥ |dehināṃ dehe kaṇḍarā mahānāḍya ṣoḍaśa samākhyātāḥ | nṛdehe daśa randhrāṇi santi nārīdehe trayodaśa randhrāṇi chidrāṇi santīty arthaḥ | etat kalādikaṃ samāsataḥ proktaṃ vistareṇa adhunā ucyate || 1-5 ||

māṃsāsṛṅmedasāṃ tisraḥ kalāḥ, yakṛtplīhor etayor dvayoś caturthī kalā, āntrāṇāṃ pañcamī kalā, ṣaṣṭhī kalā agnidharā matā smṛtā, retodharā saptamī kalā syāt ity anena krameṇa sapta kalāḥ smṛtāḥ kathitāḥ | tarhi kalā kā ? māṃsāsṛkmedasāṃ sīmā kalāḥ, rañjakapittasya sthānaṃ yakṛt, raktavāhinī yā śirā tasyāḥ mūlaṃ plīhā || 6 ||

lg.l: śleṣmāśayaḥ syād urasi tasmād āmāśayas tv adhaḥ || 7 ||
tasyopari tilaṃ jñeyaṃ tad adhaḥ pavanāśayaḥ || 8 ||
malāśayas tv adhas tasmād astir mūtrāśayas tv adhaḥ |
jīvaraktāśayam uro jñeyāḥ saptāśayās tv amī || 9 ||
dharā garbhāśayaḥ proktaḥ stanau stanyāśayau matau ||10||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ saptā'śayān āha - śleṣmāśaya iti | urasi vakṣasthale śleṣmāśayaḥ, āśayo 'dhiṣṭhānaṃ tadviśiṣṭasthānaṃ kaphasyety arthaḥ | tasmāt śleṣmāśayād adhaḥ āmāśayaḥ, āmopari pakvāhāraḥ tasyā'śayaḥ sthānam ity arthaḥ | sa eva stanāntarāt kiñcid adho jñātavyaḥ; tathā coktam - “nābhistanāntaraṃ jantor āmāśaya udāhṛtaḥ |” nābher ūrdhvam agnyāśayaḥ sa eva grahaṇīsthānaṃ kathitam | “agnyadhiṣṭhānam annasya grahaṇād grahaṇī matā | nābher upari sa hy agnibalopastambhavāhi ca” iti vacanāt | vāmabhāge vyavasthita iti so 'py agnyāśayas tu nābher vāmabhāge āśrita ity arthaḥ | vāmabhāge puruṣasya iti vyākhyānaṃ vā tasyopari tilaṃ jñeyam | tilam ity anena kloma kathitam tat pipāsāsthānam ity abhiprāyaḥ | ata eva jalavāhi- śirāmūlaṃ tilam ity uktam ācāryeṇa | eke tasyopari jalaṃ jñeyam ity evaṃ paṭhantināsti ‘ka’ pustake vyākhyānayanti ca | tathā hy uktam –
“agner ūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpyaṃ tad annaṃ ca jalopari |
agner adhaḥ svayaṃ vāyuḥ sthito 'gniṃ dhamate śanaiḥ || vāyunā- dhamamāno 'gnir atyuṣṇaṃ kurute jalam | tad annam uṣṇatoyena samantāt pacyate śanaiḥ” iti | tad adhaḥ pavanāśaya iti | tat tasyāgnyāśayasyādhaḥ pavanāśayo vāyoḥ sthānam ity arthaḥ | tasya vāyoḥ samāna iti saṃjñā | malāśayas tv adhas tasyeti | tasya pavanāśayasyādho malāśayaḥ sa ca pakvāśayaḥ kathitaḥ | tasyaikadeśe vā vibhaktamaladhāraka uṇḍuko vidyate ata evoṇḍukāt pakvāśayo bhinnaḥ iti ḍuṃ ( tu) ḍuka, poha ( ṭa) lakaḥ iti loke | carake tu purīṣāntraśabdenoṇḍukaḥ pratipāditaḥ iti | bastir mūtrāśayaḥ smṛta iti atrāpi pavanāśayasyādhaḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ | bastis tu carmakhallāṭa- kākāro mūtrādhāraḥ sa ca pakvāśayasamīpe sthitaḥ | jīvaraktāśaya iti - ‘jīvatulyaṃ raktaṃ, tasyāśayasthānaṃ tac ca ‘plīhā’ iti prasiddhaṃ hṛdayasya vāmabhāgāśritaṃ bhavati | ata eva jīvaraktāśayam ura iti pratipāditaṃ jñeyaṃ saptāśayāstkyī iti amī pūrvoktāḥ saptāśayā boddhavyāḥ | tad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭena - “tāḥ sapta sapta cādhārā raktasyādyāḥ kramāt pare | kaphāmapittapakvānāṃ vāyormūtrasya ca smṛtāḥ” iti | nārīṇām āśayās traya iti puruṣāśayebhyo 'dhikāḥ strīṇāṃ traya evāśayā vijñeyā eko garbhāśayaḥ, dvau stanyāśayau ca | garbhāśayaś ca pakvāśayāntare vartate, stanyāśayau kṣīrāśayau || 7-10 ||

div.ab:
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āśayānāha - śleṣmāśaya urasi syāt tasmād urasaḥ āmāśayaḥ adhaḥ syāt, puṃsaḥ vāmabhāge nābher ūrdhvaṃ agnyāśayaḥ sthitaḥ asti, tasyāgnyaśayopari tilaṃ pācakapittaṃ jñeyaṃ, tasya tilasyādhaḥ pavanāśayo jñeyaḥ, tasya vāyoḥ adhaḥ malāśayo jñeyaḥ ,mūtrāśayaḥ mūtrasthalaṃ bastir jñeyaḥ jīvaraktāśayaḥ uro jñeyaḥ jīvaraktasya ya āśayaḥ jīvaraktāśayaḥ jīvaraktasthānam ity arthaḥ | amī śleṣmādyāḥ saptāśayā jñeyāḥ, puruṣebhyaḥ nārīṇāṃ traya āśayā adhikā: santi tān āha - ekas tu dharā garbhāśayaḥ ; dvāvāśayau stanau matau kiṃviśiṣṭau stanyāśayau dugdhasyādhārau āvartau yonis tasyā yaḥ tṛtīya āvartaḥ cakrākāraḥ sa eva garbhāśayaḥ | suśrute 'py uktam
“śaṅkhanābhyākṛtir yonir āvartaḥ sā prakīrtitā |
tasyās tṛtīye tv āvarte garbhaśayyā prakīrtitā || 7 -10” ||

lg.l: (rasād raktaṃprakṣiptamidam | tato māṃsaṃ māṃsān medaḥ prajāyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha dhātūnāṃ saptasaṃkhyāvivaraṇaṃ darśayann āha - raseti | rasādayaḥ sarve dhātavaḥ pittatejasā pratidhātvāgninā pācitāḥ paripācyamānā anyonyataḥ parasparānugrahāj jāyante utpadyanta iti bhāvaḥ | tad uktam - ‘rasād raktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsān medaḥ prajāyate | medaso 'sthi tato majjāṃ majjāyāḥ‘majjña: śukraṃ tu jāyate’ pāṭhāntaram | śukrasaṃbhavaḥ’ iti | pariṇāmas trividha eva dhātūnāṃ malasthūlāṇabhāgaviśeṣeṇa bhavati | tad yathā - annāt pacyamānād viṇmūtraṃ malaḥ sāro rasaḥ | rasād agnipakvāt malaṃ kaphaḥ sthūlo bhāgo rasaḥ, sūkṣmabhāgo raktam | raktād agnipakvāt malaṃ pittaṃ, sthūlabhāgaḥ śoṇitam, aṇubhāgo māṃsam iti | māṃsād agnipacyamānāt malaḥ śrotranāsāprajananādi srotomalaṃ, sthūlo bhāgo māṃsaṃ, sūkṣmabhāgo medaḥ, tato 'pi nijavahnipacyamānān malaḥ svedaḥ, sthūloṃ'śo medaḥ, sūkṣmabhāgo 'sthi | tato 'pi pacyamānāt malaḥ keśalomaśmaśrūṇi, sthūlo 'sthi, sūkṣmas tu majjā | tato majjñaḥ pāvakapacyamānād api malo nayanapurīṣatvacāṃ snehaḥ, sthūlo bhāgo majjā, sūkṣmabhāgaḥ śukraḥ | tataḥ punaḥ pacyamānād api malo notpadyate | sa hi sahasradhādhmātaḥ suvarṇavat sthūlo bhāgaḥ | śukram eva snehabhāgasūkṣmas tejobhūtaṃ oja iti || 11-12 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha dhātavaḥ | rasādayaḥ saptaite dhātavaḥ pittatejasā pācitāḥ santaḥ sarve 'nyonyataḥ jāyante utpadyante | tān āha - bhakṣitas tu nopadravatvaṃ prāptaṃ taṃ rasavāhinyo nāḍyaḥ hṛtsthānīyavāyunā pradhamanti tatra hṛdayasthaṃ yat pittaṃ tad rasaṃ paripācya raktatvaṃ nayanti raktato māṃsaṃ bhavati (māṃsan medo bhavati) medato 'sthi bhavati, asthna: majjā bhavati majjāyāḥ śukraṃ bhavati evaṃ saptaasya ṭippaṇī 47 śatpṛṣṭhe dṛṣṭavyā | dhātavaḥ jāyanta ity aryaḥ || 1 1- 12 ||

lg.l: kaphaḥ pittaṃ malaṃ kheṣu prasvedo nakharoma ca |
netraviṭ tvakṣu ca sneho dhātūnāṃ kramaśo malāḥ ||15||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ malān āha - jihveti | saptadhātūnāṃ rasādīnāṃ etāni malāny anukramāj jāyante | jihvānetrakapolānāṃ jalam iti | tena jihvājalaṃ netrajalaṃ | jalam atra kaphadravam etad rasasya malam iti bhāvaḥ | rañjakaṃ pittaṃ raktasya malaṃ rañjakaṃ rasasya rāgakaram ity uktatvāt | karṇaviṭ māṃsasya malaṃ nāsāmalaṃ cety anye | rasanādantakakṣāmeḍhrādijaṃ malaṃ medasaḥ | ā- digrahaṇāt svedam api kecit, na svamataṃ, yataḥ svedas tu upadhātuṣu patita eva nakhā iti asthnāṃ malaṃ nakhā iti bahuvacanatvena keśalomādīnāṃ grahaṇam | (netramalaṃ vaktrasnigdhatā ca majjñobandhanīdhṛta pāṭho nāsti ‘ka’ ‘kha’ pustakayoḥ | malaṃ) netramalaṃ nayanapurīṣam | piṇḍikā iti śukasya | piṇḍikātra yauvanodbhavā | tatheti grahaṇāt śmaśrūṇy api gṛhyante yataḥ ākṛṣṭāṇḍakoṣasya puṃsaḥ śmaśrupātāt śmaśru śukramalam ity eke | apare ṣaḍ eva malān yathākramaṃ kathayanti | te tu netramalaṃ vaktrasnigdhatvaṃ piṇḍikādikaṃ ca majjño malam iti vyākhyānayanti | tad uktaṃ
‘kiṭṭam annasya viṇmūtraṃ rasasya tu kapho 'sṛjaḥ |
pittaṃ māṃsasya tu malaṃ kheṣu svedas tu medasaḥ ||
nakham asthnas tu lomādyā majjñaḥ sneho 'kṣiviṭtvacaḥ |
prasādaḥ kiṭṭadhātūnāṃ pākād eva vivardhate || śukrasyātiprasannatvān malābhāva iti smṛtiḥ |” iti || 13 - 15 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha saptadhātūnāṃ malāḥ | jihvānetrakapolānāṃ yad rañjakaṃ kāntikaraṃ pittaṃ tad eva rasamalaṃ, kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ pittaṃ jalaṃ dravarūpaṃ, athavā jihvānetrakapolayor yad rañjakaṃ kāṃtidaṃ, punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ pittaṃ dravatvāt pittarūpaṃ karṇaviṭ karṇamalaṃ raktamalaṃ, rasanādantamalaṃ māṃsamalaṃ, kakṣāmeḍhrādijaṃ malaṃ medomalaṃ, nakham asthimalaṃ, netramalaṃ majjāmalaṃ,vaktrasnigdhatvaṃ piḍikāś ca śukramalaṃ, vaktrapiḍikā yauvanapiḍikāḥ navam anukramāt saptadhātūnāṃ malāni jāyante yathā rasāsṛṅmāṃsādīni tadvad idam api || 13-15 ||

lg.l: stanyaṃ rajaś ca nārīṇāṃ kāle bhavati gacchati |
svedo dantās tathā keśās tathaivojaś ca saptamam|
ojaḥ sarvaśarīrasthaṃ śītaṃ snigdhaṃ‘snigdhaṃ sāndraṃ sthiraṃ’ iti ‘ka’ ‘snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ sthiraṃ guruḥ’ iti ‘kha’ pustake| sthitaṃ matam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīm upadhātūnām api vivaraṇaṃ darśayann āha - stanyam iti | stanyādayaḥ saptopadhātavo dhātubhavā boddhavyāḥ | stanyaṃ kṣīraṃ rasasyopadhātuḥ, rajaś cārtavo dhātuḥ etadvayaṃ ca strīṇāṃ kāle samaye bhavati gacchati ca | tathā ca romarājyādayaś cāviśeṣā nārīṇāṃ kālāntareṇābhivyaktiṃ gacchanti iti saṃbandhaḥ | atrādiśabdāt stanyārtavādayo gṛhyante | ārtavam api tantrāntare yathā -
‘rasād eva striyā raktaṃ rajaḥsaṃjñaṃ pravartate |
tad varṣād dvādaśād ūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam ||’ iti | śuddhamāṃsabhavaḥ sneho māṃsasyopadhātu eṣaḥ eva vasā kathitā śuddhamāṃsasthūlabhāvaprāptamāṃsam iti bhāvaḥ | tatrastho yaḥ snehaḥ sa eva ca vasāśabdavācyaḥ | ‘māṃsasneho vasā matā’ iti vacanāt | svedo medasa upadhātuḥ, svedaḥ prasvedaḥ | dantā asthnām upadhātuḥ, keśā majjopadhātuḥ, ojaḥ śukrasyopadhātuḥ | ojaso lakṣaṇam etasyāgre paṭhanti kecit tad yathā - āja ityādi | dhātūdbhavā iti dhātūtpannā teṣāṃ paripākaviṣayatvāt kutracid ete tu malāntarbhūtatvena tatraiva gaṇitāḥ | etāḥ saptopadhātavaḥ ity anena saptopadhātavaḥ niyatā jñeyāḥ | anyatrā'py uktaṃ
‘rasāt stanyaṃ tato raktam asṛjaḥ snāyukaṇḍarāḥ |
māṃsād vasā tvacaḥ svedo medasaḥ snāyusandhayaḥ |
asthno dantās tathā majjñaḥ keśā ojaś ca saptamāt | dhātubhyaś copajāyante tasmāt te upadhātavaḥ’ iti || 16-18 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha saptopadhātavaḥ - nārīṇāṃ stanyaṃ dugdhaṃ rajaś ca kāle svasamaye bhavati gacchati ca rasopadhātuḥ stanyaṃ raktopadhātū rajaḥ | nanu nārīṇāṃ kathitāv etau dvāv upadhātū kāle bhavatāṃ vā gacchatāṃ vā, atra puṃsāṃ rasaraktayor upadhātuḥ kaḥ, yady evaṃ vācyaṃ rasaraktayor upadhātuḥ strīṇām eva bhavati na nṛṇāṃ tarhi, nṛṣu rasaraktāny api no syātāṃ, na hi, tau tu bhavataḥ tarhi yatra rasaraktau tatra tayor upadhātuḥ sambhavaty evety āśaṅkya rasopadhātum āha - apakvo vikṛtim āpanno raso yadā nirgacchati sa eva puṃsāṃ rasopadhātuḥ vikṛtim āpanno raktaḥ yadā pittaprakopata ūrdhvaṃ gacchati sa eva raktopadhātur nānyaḥ | upadhātor arthaṃ vivṛṇoti | upagataḥ vaikṛtyaṃ prāpto dhātuḥ upadhātuḥ, śuddhamāṃsabhava utpanno yaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā saṃkīrtyate iti tṛtīyaḥ, sopadhātuḥ medopadhātuḥ svedaḥ, asthyupadhātur dantāḥ majjopadhātuḥ keśāḥ, śukropadhātuḥ saptamaṃ nāma ojaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ tat sarvaśarīrasthaṃ punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ snigdhaṃ, sacikkaṇaṃ, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ śītaṃ uṣṇaṃ na, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ sitaṃ śubhraṃ, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ somātmakaṃ sṛṣṭyutpādakatvāt, punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ śarīrasya balapuṣṭikaraṃ malaṃ khyātam | iti korthaḥ, dhātubhavāḥ saptopadhātavo jñeyāḥ || 17 || 18 ||

lg.l: jñeyāvabhāsinī pūrvaṃ sidhmasthānaṃ ca sā matā |
śvetā tṛtīyā saṃkhyātā sthānaṃ carmadalasya ca |
sthūlā tvak saptamī khyātā vidradhyādeḥ sthitiś ca sā |
iti sapta tvacaḥ proktāḥ sthūlā vrīhidvimātrayā ||22||
