ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. jñeyā'vabhāsinīti | iti vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa | vrīhidvayamātrayā yavadvayaparimāṇena sthūlā sotsedhāḥ sapta- tvaco jñeyāḥ | kathaṃ yathā ? tat prakāram āha - tatra pūrvaṃ avabhāsinī nāma avabhāsayati parājayatīti bhrājakāgninā savarṇāṃ pañcavidhāṃ chāyāṃ prakāśayati | saiva sidhmasthānaṃ kathitam | cakārāt padmakaṇṭakādhiṣṭhānam api jñeyaṃ sā vrīher aṣṭādaśabhāgapramāṇā | dvitīyā lohitā jñeyā ityādi dvitīyā tvak lohitā nāma kathitā | sā tilakālakajanmabhūr jñeyā | tilakālakagrahaṇenaiva nyacchavyaṅgādayo 'pi gṛhyante | tilakālakaprabhṛtayaś ca kṣudraroge paṭhitāḥ, saiva vrīheḥ ṣoḍaśabhāgapramāṇā boddhavyā | śvetā tṛtīyā saṃkhyātetyādi | tṛtīyā tvak śvetā nāma kathitā, sā carmadalasya sthānam | carmadalaḥ kuṣṭhabhedaḥ | cakārān maśakājagallīprabhṛtīnāṃ sthānaṃ sā vrīher dvādaśabhāgapramāṇā | tāmrā caturthī vijñeyetyādi | caturthī tvak tāmrā nāma vijñeyā, sā kilāsaśvitrabhūmikā kathitā | kilāsaḥ kuṣṭhabhedaḥ, śvitraṃ prasiddhaṃ, saiva vrīher aṣṭabhāgapramāṇā | pañcamī tvak vedanī nāma khyātā sā sarvakuṣṭhodbhavā jñeyā sarvakuṣṭhāny aṣṭādaśasaṃkhyākāni, tata iti grahaṇena visarpādīnām adhiṣṭhānā, saiva vrīheḥ pañcabhāgapramāṇā vikhyātā | lohitā ṣaṣṭhīti | ṣaṣṭhī tvak lohitā nāma vikhyātā sā granthigaṇḍāpacīsthitiḥ kathitā | granthyādayaḥ kaphamedaḥ pradhānāḥ ataḥ sādharmyāt ślīpadārbudādīnām api sthānaṃ sā ca vrīhipramāṇā | sthūlā tvak saptamī khyātā ityādi saptamī tvak sthūlā nāma kathitā sā vidradhyādeḥ sthitir bhavati | ādigrahaṇāt bhagandarārśaso grahaṇaṃ | saiva vrīhidvayapramāṇena boddhavyā māṃsamaleṣu mānam idaṃ na lalāṭasūkṣmāṅgulyādiṣu yato vakṣyaty udareṣu vrīhimukhenāṅguṣṭho- darapramāṇam avagāḍhaṃ vidhyed iti || 19-22 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ saptatvaco‘kṣīrasya pacyamānasya yathā santānikā bhavet | pacyamānasya śukrasya rajasaśca tathā tvacaḥ’ ityuktalakṣaṇāḥ || nidarśayann āha - tāsāṃ madhye avabhāsinīnāmnī tvak pūrvaṃ jñeyā, sāvabhāsinī sidhmasthānaṃ matā sidhmanām utpattisthalaṃ kathitā; dvitīyā tvak lohitā jñeyā, kiṃviśiṣṭā sā tilakālakajanmabhūḥ tilakālako liṅgārśaḥ tasya janmabhūḥ utpattibhūmiḥ; tṛtīyā tvak śvetā saṃkhyātā, sā tvak carmadalasya kuṣṭhamedasya sthānaṃ; caturthī tvak tāmrā vijñeyā sā kilāsaśvitrayoḥ bhūmikā utpattisthānā, kilāsaṃ sidhmabhedaṃ; pañcamī tvak vedanī khyātā tataḥ sarvakuṣṭhodbhavaḥ; ṣaṣṭhī tvak lohitā khyātā, sā granthigaṇḍāpacīsthitiḥ granthigaṇḍāpacīnāṃ sthitiḥ sthānabhūtā; sthūlā nāmnī tvak saptamī khyātā, kiṃviśiṣṭā sā vidradhyādeḥ rogāṇāṃ sthitiḥ sthānabhūtā | kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ saptatvacaḥ vrīhidvimātrayā sthūlā: dviyavapramāṇasthūlā ity artha iti saptatvaco vyākhyātāḥ | iti ko 'rthaḥ, proktāḥ saptatvacaḥ samāptāḥ | itipadaṃ samāptyarthaṃ dyotayati || 19-22 ||

lg.l: vāyuḥ pittaṃ kapho doṣā dhātavaś ca malā matāḥ |
) pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ |
vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti meghavat ||25||
malāśaye caret koṣṭhe vahnisthāne tathā hṛdi |
apānaḥ syāt samānaś ca prāṇodānau tathaiva ca |
vyānaś ceti samīrasya nāmāny uktāny anukramāt ||28||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha doṣāṇāṃ vivaraṇam āha - vāyur iti | vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ca trayo doṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ | ata eva dehadhāraṇāt dhātavaḥ kathitāḥ | dhātūnāṃ malinīkaraṇāt malāś ca matāḥ kathitāḥ | tatrāpi dehadhāraṇatvena pratyekaṃ pañcadhā pañca prakārā vyākhyātāḥ | tad uktaṃ suśrute ‘tatra prasyandanodvahanapūraṇavivekadhāraṇalakṣaṇo vāyuḥ pañcadhā pravibhaktaḥ śarīraṃ dhārayati, rāgapaktyojastejomedhoṣmakṛt pittaṃ pañcadhā pravibhaktam agnikarmaṇā'nugrahaṃ karoti vṛddhisandhiśleṣaṇa- snehanaropaṇapūraṇaiḥ pañcadhā pravibhaktaḥ śleṣmā udakakarmaṇā'nugrahaṃ karotī’ti | idānīṃ teṣu vātaprādhānyapūrvakaṃ tatsvarūpam āha - pavana iti | teṣu vātādidoṣeṣu pavano vāyuḥ vibhāgakaraṇāt pṛthakkaraṇatve balavān mataḥ | tad uktam ‘pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ | vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti meghavat’ iti | tatsvarūpam āha -rajoguṇamaya ityādi | anilo rajoguṇamayo rajoguṇabhūyiṣṭha iti bhāvaḥ | sūkṣma iti srotaḥ - praveśitvāt | śītaḥ śītasvabhāvāt | rūkṣo rūkṣaguṇayogāt, laghur aguruḥ, calo naikatrasthitiśīlaḥ | sa evoktasthāneṣu cānugacchan vāyuḥ pañcaprakāro jñeyaḥ | keṣv ity āha - malāśaya ityādi | malāśaye pakvāśaye, koṣṭhavahnisthāna iti koṣṭhāgnisthāne koṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ dhātvagninirāsārtham | hṛdi uraḥsthāne, kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhadeśe, sarvāṅgadeheṣv iti sarvāṃṅgayukto dehaḥ | tāny aṅgāni ṣaṭ prasiddhāni | nanu - dehagrahaṇenaivāṅgāny eva prāpyante tat kathaṃ pṛthag grahaṇaṃ ? ucyate -aṅgagrahaṇam atra pratyaṅgadīnāṃ nirāsārtham | teṣu pratyaṅgeṣu vātasya viśeṣasthānaṃ na pratipāditam | tasmād viśeṣasthānatvena sarvāṅgadehagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam ity adoṣaḥ | tathaivāsyānuktanāmāni yathā apāna ityādi | apāno vātaviśeṣaḥ | samāno nābhideśe syāt | samāno vrahnisthāne prāṇo hṛdi udānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe vyānaḥ sarvaśarīreṣv iti | tad uktam - ‘hṛdi prāṇo gude 'pānaḥ samāno nābhisaṃsthitaḥ | udānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśastho vyānaḥ sarvaśarīragaḥ’ iti | kecid anilanāmāny anyāny apiidaṃ ca yogasūtrāsmaraṇamūlakameva-bhautikavāyoḥ paryāyanāmānyetāni na santi, apitu daśaprāṇanāmāni; teṣveva santi nāgādīnyapi tadyathā ‘aṣṭāviṃśāni śagmāni saha yogaṃ bhajantu me’ iti śrutiḥ | aṣṭāviṃśāni tāni daśa | prāṇāni daśendriyāṇi, manobudhdyaiṃkāracittavidyāśarīrasva- bhāvabalāni iti | paṭhanti tad yathā - ‘nāgaḥ kūrmo 'tha kṛkalo devadatto dhanañjayaḥ’ iti | ete tv anyatra pradhānanāḍīṣu jñātavyāḥ ||

ab.seg:
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vāyuḥ pittaṃ kapha ete trayo doṣāḥ paryāyaśabdena dhātavaḥ ākhyātāḥ, malāś cākhyātāḥ, tatrāpi dhātumalasaṃjñākathanānantaraṃ pañca dehadhāraṇāt pratyekaṃ sthānaṃ sthānaṃ prati ekaṃ pratyekaṃ, sthānādhikaṃ kṛtvā pañcadhā khyātāḥ kathitāḥ | anyatrāpy uktaṃ
‘śarīradūṣaṇād doṣā dhātavo dehadhāraṇāt |
vātapittakaphā jñeyā malinīkaraṇāt malāḥ’ | doṣāṇāṃ paryāyaśabdās tadrūpāḥ teṣu doṣeṣu vibhāgakaraṇāt doṣakopapracaye sāhāyyakaraṇāt anena pavanena vinā teṣāṃ na kāpi śaktir ity arthaḥ | tad āha granthāntare
‘pittaṃ paṅgu, kaphaḥ paṅguḥ, paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ |
vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra varṣanti meghavat’ | kīdṛśaḥ guṇamayaḥ, punaḥ kīdṛśaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvavyāpī, punaḥ śītaḥ, punaḥ rūkṣaḥ laghuḥ, punaś calaḥ sthiro na | adhunā vāyūnāṃ pūrvoktapañcasthalāny āha - pañcaprakārataḥ vāyūnāṃ madhye apānavāyuḥ malāśraye caret vyānavāyuḥ sarvāṅgadeśeṣu caret sarvāṅgagāmī bhūtvā vicaret ity arthaḥ | adhunā pañcavāyūnāṃ nāmāny āha - pañcānāṃ madhye eka apānaḥ apānavāyuḥ syāt, dvitīyaḥ samānaḥ syāt, tṛtīyaḥ prāṇaḥ syāt, caturthaḥ udānaḥ syāt, pañcamo vyānaḥ syāt | iti ko 'rthaḥ anukramād uktāni samīrasya pañca nāmāni || 23-28 ||

lg.l: pittam uṣṇaṃ dravaṃ pītaṃ nīlaṃ sattvaguṇottaram |
dṛśyaṃ yakṛti yat pittaṃ tad rasaṃ śoṇitaṃ nayet |
yat pittaṃ hṛdaye tiṣṭhen medhāprajñākaraṃ ca tat |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ pittavivaraṇam āha -- pittam iti | pittam uṣṇam ity uṣṇayogāt, dravam akaṭhinaṃ, pītaṃ varṇataḥ, nīlaṃ ca tan nīlavarṇaṃ sāmā'vasthāyāṃ bhavati pītaṃ nirāmā'vasthāyāṃ ca | sattvaguṇottaraṃ sattvaguṇabahutvaṃ, kaṭutiktarasaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ prasiddham | yadā vidagdhaṃ tadāmlatāṃ vrajed iti vahniguṇatvāt, tad uktaṃ ‘pittaṃ vidagdhatām amlatām upaiti āgneyatvāt’ iti | ata evāha kaścit -‘vidagdhājīrṇasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ punar amlarasaṃ bhavet’ iti | vidagdhaṃ pittaṃ punar amlapittam iti romaviśeṣam apare pratipādayanti iti| tatsthānāni yathā - agnyāśaye pittam agnirūpaṃ tilonmitaṃ ca jñeyaṃ, pakvāmāśayamadhye agnyāśayam iti vācyam | tatrasthaṃ caturvidham annapānaṃ pacati na kevalaṃ tilonmitam anyarūpaṃ ca vadanty eke | tad yathā -
‘sthūlakāyeṣu sattveṣu yavamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ|
hrasvamātreṣu sattveṣu tilamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ || kṛmikīṭapataṅgeṣu vālamātraṃ hi tiṣṭhati ||’ iti || yat pittaṃ tvacy asti tat kāntikaraṃ jñeyaṃ lepābhyaṅgādipācakaṃ ca bhavati taduṣṇaguṇayogāt | ūṣmā śarīrasyoṣṇatvam | lepābhyaṅgādītyādigrahaṇāt snānāvagāhanādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tvag atra avabhāsinī nāma jñeyā bāhyatvag ity abhiprāyaḥ | yat pittaṃ yakṛti kālakhaṇḍe dṛśyaṃ dṛṣṭigocaraṃ tad rasaṃ śoṇatāṃ nayet karotīty arthaḥ | tādṛśam iti yādṛk plīhāsthāne 'sti tādṛk bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yat pittaṃ netrayugale 'sti tad rūpadarśanakāri bhavati rūpaṃ pītaśuklādikam| yat pittaṃ hṛdaye cetanāsthāne 'sti tan medhāprajñākaraṃ boddhavyam | kasmāt hṛdayasthakaphatamopanodanavispaṣṭīkṛtatvāt | medhā dhīr dhāraṇā buddhiḥ, prajñā anāgatopadeśarūpā matiḥ | cakārād abhiprārthitamanorathasādhanakṛd ity uktam | pittanāmāny āha - pācakam ityādi | pittanāmāni kramāt pañcaiva jñātavyāni kramo yathā - pācakam agnisthāne, bhrājakaṃ tvaci, rañjakaṃ yakṛti, ālocakaṃ netrayoḥ, sādhakaṃ hṛdīti || 29-32 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. adhunā pañca pittasya guṇān āha - nanu ‘miṣṭaḥ paṭuś ca madhuramalomlaṃ pacyate rasaḥ | kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ pākaḥ syāt prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ’ iti rasaviśeṣāṇāṃ vipākaviśeṣā uktāḥ kathitāḥ | ṣaḍrarasān apy āha - āhāro mādhuryaṃ labhate pācakapittena vidagdhomlatāṃ vrajet grahaṇyāṃ pācitaḥ kaṭur bhavatīti kathaṃ saṃgacchate ? ucyate miṣṭarasaḥ paṭurasaś cāhāra āmāśaye pūrvaṃ madhuraraso bhavati tataḥ pācakapittena vidagdho 'mlatāṃ vrajet grahaṇyāṃ pācitaḥ kaṭuraso bhavati kaṭutiktakaṣāyā madhurā amlā: kaṭavaś ca bhūtvā kaṭava eva bhavanti | atra kecid ācāryāḥ prāhuḥ ṣaṇṇām api rasānāṃ vipākāt ta evāpi rasā atiśayena bhavanti yathā āmaṃ dugdhamadhuraṃ tat pakvaṃ sat viśeṣato madhuraṃ bhavati evaṃ pittam uṣṇaṃ dravaṃ pītam | asyārthaḥ pittam uṣṇam uṣṇaguṇaṃ, dravaṃ dravarūpaṃ, pītaṃ pītavarṇaṃ, nīlaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ, satvaṃ satvaguṇottaram adhikaṃ yasmin tat kaṭu kaṭurasaṃ tiktaṃ tiktarasaṃ vidagdhaṃ atipakvaṃ amlatāṃ vrajet | tasya pañcasthānāny āha - agnyāśayetyādi | agnyāśaye yat pittaṃ bhavet tat pācakaṃ jñeyam | kiṃbhūtaṃ agnirūpam, punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ tilonmitaṃ tilapramāṇaṃ tvaci bhrājakaṃ jñeyam | kiṃbhūtaṃ, kāntikaram | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ lepābhyaṅgādipācakaṃ pākakāri | yat tu tvaci pittaṃ tasya bhrājako 'gniriti saṃjñā so 'py abhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhalepādīnāṃ kriyādravyāṇāṃ paktā iti suśrutaḥ, ayam arthaḥ prakṛtir yat pittaṃ darśanīyaṃ rañjakākhyaṃ tad rasaṃ śoṇatāṃ nayet darśanīyaṃ dṛśyātmakam | bhrājakam ityādinā yady asya darśanayogyaṃ kāntikaratvāt pūrvabhrājakena sambadhyate cet tadā ayam arthaḥ | tatra samyak kāntikaram ity anena darśanīyārthatā prāptā tasmād ādya evārthaḥ, prakṛtidṛśyaṃ darśanayogyaṃ yat pittaṃ tad rañjakaṃ rañjakākhyaṃ jñeyam | kiṃbhūtaṃ tad rasaṃ śoṇitatāṃ raktatāṃ nayet yat pittaṃ netrayugale tad ālocakaṃ ālocakākhyaṃ caturtham | kiṃbhūtaṃ rūpadarśanakāri yat pittaṃ hṛdaye tiṣṭhet tat sādhakaṃ pañcamam | kiṃbhūtaṃ, medhāprajñākaraṃ medhāprajñe buddhiviśeṣau | evaṃ kramāt pañca pittanāmāni jñeyāni| iti pittavibhāgaḥ || 29 || 32 ||

lg.l: kaphaḥ snigdho guruḥ śvetaḥ picchilaḥ śītalas tathā ||33||
kaphaś cāmāśaye mūrdhni kaṇṭhe hṛdi ca saṃdhiṣu || 34 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kaphasya vivaraṇaṃ darśayitum āha - kapha iti | kaphasyoktāny anukramād iti kapho 'pi īdṛśaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ tam āha - snigdha iti snehaguṇayogāt | gurur alaghuḥ śveto varṇataḥ, picchila iti mṛdyamānaḥ sann aṅgulagrāhī śītalo 'nuṣṇaḥ saumyatvāt | tamoguṇapradhānas tamoguṇabahulaḥ, svādur madhuraḥ madhuratvam atrāvidagdhatvāt, vidagdhas tu lavaṇo bhaved iti tad uktam -‘prakṛtistho 'vidagdhaś cāpradruṣṭo madhuraḥ kaphaḥ | vidagdho vikṛtasya syāt praduṣṭo lavaṇas tathā’ iti | yad vā vidagdhāmlapākāl lavaṇaḥ | sthānāni yathā kapha ityādi | kapho 'py eteṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhan deheṣu sthairyaṃ karoti sarvāṅgapāṭavaṃ karoti | katham ity āha - āmāśaye caturvidhasyāhārasyādhāro mādhuryāt picchilatvāt | prakle- ditvān madhuraśītalo 'pi svaśaktyā śleṣmasthānānāṃ śarīrasya udakakarmaṇā kṛtvopakāraṃ karoti | mūrdhni śirasi sthitaḥ snehena tarpaṇādhikṛtatvād indriyāṇāṃ svakāryasāmarthyaṃ janayati | kaṇṭhe jihvāmūle sthitaḥ saumyatvāj ji- hvendriyasya rasajñānājñānayor vartate | hṛdi urasi sthitaḥ śiro bāhudvayasandhānasthānasya sandhāraṇaṃ prākṛtaguṇena sahitena hṛdaye svakāryasāmarthyaṃ karoti | sandhiṣu saṃsthitaḥ sarvasandhisaṃśleṣād anugrahaṃ karoti | atha nāmā- nyanukramād uktāni - tāni kānīty āha | kledana āmāśaye tad atra sodakair guṇair āhāraḥ praklinno bhinnasaṃghātaḥ sukhakaro bhavatīti kledanasyābhiprāyaḥ | snehano mūrdhni bhavati tatra sthitasya snehaviṣayasya santarpaṇaṃ karotīti tātparyārthaḥ | snehaguṇasādharmyāt | rasanaḥ kaphaparyāyaḥ, kaṇṭhe 'sti sa ca rasajñāne vartate | avalambano hṛdi vartate | sa ca hṛdayāvalambanaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | śleṣmakaḥ sandhiṣv iti sa ca sandhisaṃśleṣaṇakṛd bhavati sandhisandhānaṃ karotīty abhiprāyaḥ || 3 3- 35 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kaphasya guṇasthānanāmāny āha - kapha ityādi | kaphaḥ snigdhaḥ sacikkaṇaḥ ,gudaḥ mātrāguruḥ, śvetaḥ śuklavarṇaḥ, picchilaḥ āmasadṛśaḥ, śītalaḥ śītaguṇaḥ tamoguṇādhikaḥ tamoguṇapradhānaḥ, svādur madhurasaḥ, vidgdha īṣattyakta:, yad vā viśeṣeṇa dagdhakatāṃ prāptaḥ lavaṇo lavaṇaraso bhavati | idānīṃ kaphasya sthānanāmāny āha - āmāśaye kledanaḥ kaphaḥ, mūrdhni snehana:, kaṇṭhe rasanaḥ, hṛdi ālambanaḥ, sandhiṣu śleṣmakaḥ | eṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhan dehasya sthairyaṃ sarvāṅgapāṭavaṃ ca kramāt karotīti yojanā iti śleṣmavibhāgaḥ, doṣanirūpaṇam || 33-35 ||

lg.l: ādhāraś ca tathā sāraḥ kāye 'sthīni budhā viduḥ||37||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. idānī snāyūnāṃ vivaraṇaṃ darśayann āha - snāyava iti | snāyavomedasaḥ sāramādāya śirā snāyutvamāpnuyāt || navaśatasaṃkhyākās te tu pratānavanto vṛttāḥ pṛthavaḥ, śuṣirāś ca dehe māṃsāsthi medasāṃ bandhanaṃ proktāḥ kathitā ity arthaḥ | tad yathā śākhāsu ṣaṭśatānikoṣṭhe 230, grīvordhvadeśe 70, pādāṅguliṣu 30, tala-kūrca-gulpheṣu 30, jaṃghāyāṃ 30, jānuni 10, ūrau 40, vaṅkṣaṇe 10, sakthidvaye 150, kaṭyāṃ 60, pṛṣṭhe 80, pārśvayoḥ 60, urasi 30, grīvāyāṃ 36, mūrdhni 34 | tāḥ pratānavatyo vṛttāś ca bisamṛṇālasadṛśāḥ pratānavatyaḥ vṛttāḥ vartulā mahāsnāyava ity arthaḥ | dve śate triṃśac ca koṣṭhe tāḥ śuṣirāḥ pṛthulāś ca, grīvāṃ praty ūrdhvasaptatiḥ tā api pṛthulāḥ, śuṣirāś ca evaṃ navaśatasaṃkhyā: snāyavo vyākhyātāḥ | bandhanam iti sarvaśarīrāvayavanibandhanaṃ tad uktaṃ -
‘naur yathā phalakāstīrṇā bandhanair bahubhir yutā |
bhārakṣamā bhaved atsu nṛyuktā susamāhitā || evam eva śarīre 'smin yāvantaḥ sandhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | snāyubhir bahubhir baddhās tena bhārasahā narāḥ’ iti | sandhilakṣaṇam āha - sandhayate ca 210 sandhayaḥ santi | śākhāsu 68, koṣṭhe 59, grīvordhvadeśe ca 83 ( grīvāyāṃ 8, kaṇṭhe 3 hṛtphupphusaklomanibaddhanāḍīṣu 18, dantamaleṣu 32 kaṇṭhamaṇau 1 nāsikāyāṃ 2, cakṣuṣi 2, gaṇḍasthale 2, śaṅkhe1, karṇayoḥ 1 (pratyekaṃ)| hanusandhyo: 2, bhruvoḥ. 2, śaṅkhopari 2, mastake 1, śiraḥkapāleṣu 5|| iti | aṅgagrahaṇena pratyaṅgāny api gṛhyante | sandhayo dvividhāś calā acalāś ca | yad uktaṃ - ‘hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca śākhāsu sandhayas tu calāḥ smṛtāḥ | śeṣās tu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñeyā acalā budhaiḥ’ kaṭyāṃ ceti cakārād grīvāyām api calā jñeyāḥ| kecid atra sandhilakṣaṇapade dvayaṃ paṭhanti | tān sandhīn asthnāśritā nava manyante | athāsthilakṣaṇam āha - ādhāraś ceti | asthīni pañcavidhāni bhavanti kapālarucakavalayataruṇanalakasaṃjñāni | kāye ādhāraḥ śarīradhāraṇaviṣayaḥ tad uktam-‘māṃsāny atra nibaddhāni śirābhiḥ snāyubhis tathā | asthīny ālambanaṃ kṛtvā na śīryante patanti ca’ iti | tathā sāra iti | asthīni śarīre sārabhūtaḥ kathitaḥ yathā
‘ābhyantaragataiḥ sārair nūnaṃ tiṣṭhanti bhūruhāḥ |
asthisārais tathā dehā dhriyante dehināṃ dhruvam |
tasmāc ciravinaṣṭeṣu tvaṅmāṃseṣu śarīriṇām | asthīni na vinaśyanti sārāṇy etāni dehinām’ iti | idānīṃ marmāṇi nidarśayann āha - marmāṇīti | marmāṇi saptottaraśatasaṃkhyāni prāyeṇa bāhulyena jīvādhārāṇi prāṇādhārāṇi jaguḥ, munaya iti śeṣaḥ | tāni marmāṇi pañcaprakārāṇi bhavanti | tad yathā - māṃsamarmāṇi tāny ekādaśa saṃkhyāni, śirāmarmāṇi ekacatvāriṃśat, snāyumarmāṇi saptaviṃśatiḥ | asthimarmāṇi aṣṭau | sandhimarmāṇi viṃśatiś ceti | etāny api sadyaḥ prāṇaharāṇi kālāntaraprāṇaharāṇi viśalyaghnāni vaikalyakarāṇi rujākarāṇīti kathitāni, eteṣāṃ svarūpaṃ na likhitam atra vistarabhayāt | jīvādhārāṇīti jīva ātmā tasyādhārāṇīty arthaḥ | tad uttam -
‘somamārutatejāṃsi rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca |
marmasu prāyaśaḥ puṃsāṃ bhūtātmā cāvatiṣṭhate || marmasv abhihitās tasmān na jīvanti śarīriṇaḥ’ iti ||36||37||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha snāyavaḥ | navaśataṃ snāyūnām iti pūrvoktatvāt | saṃkhyā tu etenaivoktā | idānīṃ snāyūnāṃ karmāṇy āha - dehe māṃsāsthimedasāṃ bandhanaṃ snāyava eva proktāḥ idam evaitāsāṃ prayojanam | nanu śārṅgadhareṇa snāyūnāṃ svarūpaṃ aṅgavibhāgaś ca noktas tat kathaṃ jñāyate tadvodhārthaṃ granthāntarāl likhyate | atha snāyoḥ svarūpam āha -
‘medasaḥ sāram ādāya śirā snāyutvam āpruyāt |
śirāṇāṃ hi mṛduḥ pākaḥ snāyūnāṃ tu tataḥ kharaḥ ||’ tāsāṃ saṃkhyām āha -
‘śatāni nava jāyante śarīre snāyavo nṛṇām |
tāsāṃ vivaraṇaṃ brūmaḥ śiṣyā: śṛṇuta yatnataḥ |
śākhāsu ca śatāni syu:, koṣṭhe triṃśac chatadvayam||
grīvāyā ūrdhvadeśe tu snāyūnāṃ saptatiḥ smṛtā |
evam eva śarīre 'smin yāvantaḥ sandhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | snāyubhir bahubhir baddhās tena bhārasahā narāḥ’ iti snāyunirūpaṇam | asthīni asthnāṃ ca triśataṃ matam iti saṃkhyā pūrvoktaiva teṣāṃ prayojanam āha - tāny eva śatatrayasaṃkhyākāny asthīni kāye ādhāras tathā sāraś ca budhāḥ paṇḍitāḥ jaguḥ ūcuḥ | śārṅgadharānuktatvāt asthnāṃ sthānādinirūpaṇam ucyate tad yathā
‘śalyatantre 'sthikhaṇḍāntaṃ śatatrayam udāhṛtam |
tāny evātra nigadyante teṣāṃ sthānāni yāni tu |
saviṃśatiśataṃ tv asthnāṃ śākhāsu kathitaṃ budhaiḥ |
pārśvayoḥ śroṇiphalake vakṣaḥpṛṣṭhodareṣu ca |
jānīyāt subhiṣak teṣu śataṃ saptadaśottaram |
grīvāyā ūrdhvagaṃ vidyād asthnāṃ triṣaṣṭisaṃyutamekaikasyāṃ pādāṅgulyāṃ 3 evaṃ 15, talakūrca gulphasaṃśritāni 10, pārṣṇyā 1, jaṃghāyāṃ 2, jānuni 1, ūrau 1; ekasminsakthini 30, śroṇyāṃ 5 ( gudabhaganitambeṣu 4; trike 1 ), pārśvayoḥ 72, pṛṣṭhe 30 urasi 8, cakṣusi 2, grīvāyāṃ 9, kaṇḍanāḍyāṃ 4, hanvoḥ 2, dantāḥ 32, nāsāyāṃ 3, tāluni 1, gaṇḍakarṇaśaṅkheṣu 3, śirasi 6 iti śeṣaḥ | ||’ asthīni navadhā bhavanti tad apy āha -
‘taruṇāni kapālāni rucakāni bhavanti ca |
valayāny api tāni syur nalakāś caiva pañcadhā ||’ teṣām api pañcānāṃ sthānāny āha -
‘akṣakaḥ saśrutighrāṇagrīvāsu taruṇāni hi |
śiraḥśaṅkhakapāleṣu tālvaṃśaprothajānuṣu |
kapālāni vijānīyāt rucakāni radā matāḥ |
pāṇyoḥ pārśvayuge pṛṣṭhe vakṣojaṭharapāyuṣu |
pādayor valayāni syur nalakāni bruve 'dhunā ||
hastapādāṅgulitale kūrce ca maṇibandhayoḥ |
bāhujaṅghādvaye cāpi jānīyān nalakāni tu ||’ asthnāṃ prayojanam āha - māṃsāny apabaddhāni śirābhiḥ snāyubhis tathā | asthīny ālambanaṃ kṛtvā na śīryante patanti na ||’ ity asthivivaraṇam || atha marmavibhāgaḥ | saptottaraṃ marmaśatam ity uktatvāt marmaṇāṃ saṃkhyā proktā teṣāṃ prayojanam āha - marmāṇītyādi | yāvanti marmāṇi tāvanti jīvādhārāṇīti munayo jaguḥ prāyeṇa atiśayenety arthaḥ | śārṅgadhareṇa marmavibhāgas tu viśeṣeṇa noktaḥ ato granthāntarāt kiṃcit sthānādikaṃ procyate -
‘sannipātaśirāsrāyupakṣamāṃsāsthisaṃbhavaḥ |
marmāṇi tatra tiṣṭhanti prāṇās teṣu viśeṣataḥ |’ teṣāṃ saṃkhyām āha - ‘saptottaraśataṃ santi dehe marmāṇi dehinām |’ teṣāṃ sthānāny āha -
‘tāny ekādaśa māṃse syur aṣṭāv asthiṣu santi hi |
saṃdhīnāṃ viśatis tāni snāyūnāṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ |
catvāriṃśat tathaikaṃ ca śirāmarmāṇi tatra tu | dvāviṃśatiśastriyuge tāvanty eva bhujadvayoḥ |
dvādaśorati kukṣau ca pṛṣṭhadeśe caturdaśa |
grīvāyā ūrdhvabhāge tu saptatriṃśan matāni tu |’ sadyaḥprāṇaharatvādibhedena marmāṇi pañcadhā bhavantīti | bhedam apy āha
‘sadyaḥprāṇaharāṇi syur marmāṇy ekonaviṃśatiḥ |
marmadeśās trayastriṃśat syuḥ kālāntaramārakāḥ |
catvāriṃśac ca catvāri vaikalyaṃ janayanti ca |
marmāṣṭakaṃ tvacākāri viṣaghnaṃ ca trikaṃ matam |’ iti marmavibhāgaḥ || 36 || 37 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ śirālakṣaṇaṃ prakaṭayann āha - sandhīti | śirāś ca sthūlasūkṣmabhedena dvividhāḥ tāsāṃ nābhir mūlaṃ tataḥ prasaranty ūrdhvam adhas tiryak vā | tathā hy uktam -
‘yāvatyas tu śirāḥ kāye saṃbhavanti śarīriṇām |
nābhyāṃ sarvā nibaddhās tāḥ pratanvanti samantataḥ ||’ iti | tāsāṃ vibhāgam apy uktaṃ yathā - tāsāṃ mūlaśirāś catvāriṃśat, tatra daśa vātavāhinyaḥ, daśa pittavāhinyaḥ, daśa śleṣmavāhinyaḥ, daśa raktavāhinyaḥ iti | tāsāṃ vātavāhinīnāṃ vātasthānagatānāṃ pañcasaptatyadhikaśataṃ bhavanti | tāvantya eva pittavāhinyaḥ pittasthāne, kaphavāhinyaḥ kaphasthāne, raktavāhinyaś ca yakṛtplīhnoḥ | sandhibandhanakāriṇya iti | ākuñcanaprasaraṇādibhir viśeṣair ity arthaḥ | idānīṃ dhamanīlakṣaṇam āha - dhamanya iti | dhamanād anilapūraṇāt dhamanyaḥ rasavāhinya iti caturviśatisaṃkhyākāḥ | tāsāṃ ca nābhiprabhavāṇām ūrdhvagāūrdhvagā rūparasagandhasparśaśabdapraśvāsocchvāsastambhakṣuddhāsyabhāṣaṇarodanagānādikarma sampādayanti dehaṃ dhārayanti tāśca hṛdayaṃ gatvā śākhātrayaṃ vistārayantya: 30 śatsaṃkhyākāḥ saṃbhavanti | tāsu pratyekaṃ dve dve kṛtvā daśa dhamanyo vātapittakaphaśoṇitarasān vahanti aṣṭau ca rūpādīni gṛhṇanti, śiṣṭāsu dvādaśasu dvābhyāṃ vāṅniṣpattiḥ, dvābhyāṃ ghoṣaṇaṃ, dvābhyāṃ nidrā, dvābhyāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ, dvābhyāṃ ca raktavahanaṃ bhavati śiṣṭena stanasaṃsthitena dvayena ca sriyā stanyavahanaṃ puṃsaśca śukravahanaṃ stanābhyāṃ bhavati || daśa, daśaadhogāstu daśa pittāśayamadhigamya 30 śatsampannāḥ | tāsu dve dve vātapittakapharaktarasān vahataḥ | śiṣṭābhyāñca dve annamāśrityānnaṃ vahataḥ | dve jalaṃ vahataḥ | dve bastimāśritya mūtraṃ vahataḥ dvābhyāṃ puruṣasya śukraṃ striya ārtavaṃ ca prādurbhavati, dve ca tadvayaṃ niḥsārayataḥ, dve sthūlā anibaddhe bhūtvā purīṣaṃ niḥsārayataḥ | avaśiṣṭāścāṣṭau tiryagyāminyaḥ svedaṃ niḥsārayanti | etāścādhogā dhamanyaḥ pakvāśayakaṭimūtrapurīṣaguhyabastimeḍhrapādaprabhṛtīnyāśritya teṣāṃ poṣaṇaṃ sampādayanti | cādhogāminyaś catasras tiryaggāminyotiryagyaṃ ca dhamanīcatuṣṭayaṃ pratyekamasaṃkhyaśākhāvibhaktaṃ dehaṃ randhrabhūyiṣṭhaṃ karoti | etāsāṃ ca mukhāni pratilomakūpasaṃlagnāni | tebhyaśca mukhebhya: svedā nirgacchanti, deharaso bahirantaśca santarpayati, abhyaṅgādinā ca tailādivīryamanta: śarīraṃ praviśya tvakpākādikaṃ karoti tenaiva ca śubhāśubhasparśajñānaṃ bhavati| bhavanti | tās tu vātamūtrapurīṣa śukrārtavāny adho vahanti | annapānarasavāhinyo daśordhvagāḥ | tiryaggānāṃ tu catasṛṇāṃ dhamanīnām ekaikā śatadhā sahasradhā cottarottaraṃ vibhajyante | tās tv asaṃkhyeyās tābhir idaṃ śarīraṃ jālakair iva vyāptaṃ tāsāṃ tu mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhāni yaiḥ svedam abhivahanti, rasaṃ cāpi santarpayanty antarbahiś ca, tair eva cābhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhāle- panavīryāṇy antaḥśarīram abhipratipadyante || 38 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha śirāvibhāgaḥ - śirāṇāṃ śatasaptakety uktatvāc chirāṇāṃ śatasaptakaṃ bhavati | tāsāṃ prayojanam āha - śirāḥ sandhibandhanakāriṇyaḥ | atha ca doṣadhātuvahā idam eva prayojanam etāsām | atha granthāntarāt śirāṇāṃ viśeṣanirūpaṇam āha -
‘sandhibandhanakāriṇyo doṣadhātuvahāḥ śirāḥ |
nābhyāṃ sarvāṇi baddhās tāḥ pratanvanti samaṃtataḥ |
śarīraṃ sakalaṃ caitat śirābhiḥ poṣyate sadā |
praṇālibhir ivārāmakulyābhiḥ kṣetradhānyavat ||
prasāraṇākuñcanābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ satataṃ tanau|
śirāṇy evopakurvanti tāḥ syu: saptaśatāni tu |
yathā drumadale śākhā dṛśyante pratatāḥ śirāḥ |
tathaiva dehināṃ dehe vartante sakale śirāḥ |’ idānīṃ śirāṇāṃ prāṇānāṃ cādhārādheyatvaṃ darśayann āha -
‘nābhisthāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇā nābhiṃ vyavasthitāḥ |
śirābhir eva tābhiś ca cakranābhir ivārakaiḥ ||’ suśrutāt prāṇināṃ prāṇā nābhisthāḥ ity anena nābhyāṃ cakrasya arā iva sthitāḥ | prāṇavāyuṃ prakarṣeṇa ānanti gacchantīti prāṇāḥ prāṇavāyavaḥ | te prāṇabhedena nāgādibhedena ca daśadhā | kutaḥ ? nābhisthānataḥ prāṇāḥ prāṇavāyuvahāḥ śirā nābhiṃ vyapāśritāḥ | nābhiṃ vyupāśritāḥ kutaḥ ? yataḥ nābhiśabdavācyaḥ ādikaiḥ paribadhyate tadvan nābhiḥ śarīramadhyabhāgaḥ śirābhiḥ | vāgbhaṭe tu evaṃ likhitaṃ ‘dhamanyo nābhisaṃbaddhās triṃśatiś ca tanutarāḥ | nābhiḥ paritatas tābhiś cakranābhir ivārakaiḥ |’ ataḥ śārṅgadhareṇa dvayor grahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
śirādhamanyo nābhisthāḥ sarvāṃ vyāpya sthitās tanum|
puṣṇanti cāniśaṃ vāyoḥ saṃyogāt sarvadhātubhiḥ | ato dhamanyaḥ śirābhedabhinnā | yataḥ suśrute likhitam śirādhamanīsrotasām avibhāgaḥ, avibhāgaḥ apṛthaktvaṃ ‘śirāvikāra eva dhamanyaḥ śaraṇāt śirā dhamanāt dhamanyaḥ iti nirukteḥ ||’ atha śirāṇāṃ saṃkhyām āha - suśrutāt ‘tāsāṃ khalu mūlaśirāś catvāriṃśat tāsāṃ daśa vātavahā daśa pittavahā daśa śleṣmavahā daśa raktavahāḥ tāsāṃ khalu vātavahānāṃ vātasthānagatānāṃ sapañcasaptaśataṃ bhavati tatra vātavahā ekasmin sakthani pañcaviṃśatiḥ, dvitīye pañcaviṃśatiḥ, haste pañcaviṃśatiḥ, dvitīye pañcaviṃśatiḥ, evaṃ śataṃ śākhāsu koṣṭhe catustriṃśat tasya vivaraṇaṃ tāsu śroṇyāṃ gudameḍhrāśritā aṣṭau, dve dve pārśve, ṣaṭ pṛṣṭhe, ṣaṭ udare,daśa vakṣasi, evaṃ catustriṃśat| ekacatvāriṃśaj jatruṇa ūrdhvaṃ tāsāṃ caturdaśa grīvāyāṃ, catasraḥ karṇayoḥ, nava jihvāyāṃ, ṣaṭ nāsikāyāṃ, aṣṭau netrayoḥ| evaṃ vātavahānāṃ sapañcasaptatiśataṃ bhavati eṣa vibhāgaḥ pittaśleṣmaraktavahānāṃ jñeyaḥ | evaṃ śirāṇāṃ saptaśatāni saṃkhyātāni |
tatrāruṇā vātavahāḥ pūrvaṃ te vāyunā śirāḥ |
pittād uṣmāc cānilāc cāsitā gaurāḥ śirāḥ kaphāt |
asṛgvahās tu raktāḥ syus tathā nātyuṣṇaśītalāḥ ||’ iti śirāvivaraṇam || atha dhamanya āha - caturviṃśati dhamanya iti pūrvoktaṃ tāsāṃ prayojanam āha - ‘dhamanyo rasavāhinyo dhamanti pavanaṃ tanau |’ rasavāhinyaḥ dhamanyaḥ tanau dehe pavanaṃ dhamantīti prayojanam | atha śārṅgadharānuktaṃ dhamanī jñānārthaṃ vivaraṇaṃ granthāntarād āha -
‘dhamanyo nābhito yātāś caturviṃśatisaṃkhyayā |
daśordhvagā daśādhogāḥ śeṣās tiryagvarāḥ smṛtāḥ |
yathā svabhāvataḥ khāni mṛṇāleṣu bhavanti hi |
dhamanīnāṃ tathā khāni raso yair antataś caret |
pañcābhibhūtas tv atha pañcakṛtvaḥ pañcendriyaṃ pañcasu vartamānā |
pañcendriyaṃ pañcasu bhāvayitvā pañcatvam āyānti vināśakāle ||’ asyāyam arthaḥ pañcābhibhūtāḥ pañcavyāptā dhamanyaḥ pañcakṛtvaḥ pañcacārān pañcendriyaṃ karmapuruṣaṃ bhāvayanti yojayanti keṣu ? pañcasu śrotrādiṣv indriyādhiṣṭhāneṣu bhāvayitvā saṃyojya vināśakāle dhamanyo vināśam āyāntīti yojanā | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? dhamanyaḥ pañcasu vartamānāḥ pañcasu ākāśādibhūteṣu vartamānāḥ sthitāḥ pañcābhibhūtā iti pañcabhyo bhūtebhyo 'bhisamantato bhūtāḥ śabdasparśa- rasarūpagandhās taiḥ, yad vā ākāśapavanadahanatoyabhūmibhir vā abhibhūtāḥ vyāptā dhamanyaḥ pañcakṛtvaḥ pañcavārān āyānti āgacchanti kāḥ dhamanyaḥ ? kiṃ tat pañcendriyaṃ indriyapañcakaṃ sūkṣmarūpam | iti dhamanīvibhāgaḥ ||38||

Āḍhamalla. atha peśīvarṇanam āha - māṃsapeśya iti | māṃsāvayavasaṅghātāḥ parasparaṃ vibhaktāḥ peśya ity ucyante‘budhduda: saptarātreṇa māṃsapeśī bhavettataḥ | dvisaptāhādbhavetpeśī raktamāṃsacitā dṛḍhā | bījasyevāṅkurāḥ peśya: pañcaviṃśatirātrataḥ’|| iti lakṣaṇam | | tās tu balāya ojase syuḥ kathitāḥ | ata evāha kaścit - ‘śirāsnāyvasthiparvāṇi sandhayaḥ syu: śarīriṇām | peśībhiḥ saṃvṛtāny atra balavanti bhavanty ataḥ’ iti | tāsāṃ tu sthānaviśeṣān nānāsvarūpatvaṃ darśitam | tad yathā - bahalaḥ pelavaḥ sthūlāṇupṛthuvṛttahrasvadīrghasthiramṛduślakṣṇakakaśabhāvaḥ | pratyekalakṣaṇam eteṣāṃ ca na likhitam atra granthagauravabhayāt | atha kaṇḍarāḥ - kaṇḍarā mahāsnāyavaḥ | aṅgānāṃ hastapādaśiraḥpṛṣṭhaprabhṛtīnāṃ prasāraṇākuñcane karmaviśeṣau tayor vyāpāro yeṣāṃ te | mūlakaṇḍarāḥ ṣoḍaśa, eteṣāṃ prarohā yathā hastapādagatānāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ nakhā agraprarohāḥ, grīvā hṛdayanibandhinīnāṃ, adhobhāgagatānāṃ meḍhram, śroṇipṛṣṭhanibandhinīnām adhobhāgagatānāṃ nitambamaṇḍalam mūrdhoruvakṣo 'kṣipiṇḍādīnāṃ ca | ṣoḍaśagrahaṇam atra śastravyāpāraniṣedhārtham, tathā hi -
‘jālāni kaṇḍarāś cāṅge pṛthak ṣoḍaśa nirdiśet |
ṣaṭ kūrcāḥ sapta sīvanyo meḍhrajihvāśirogatāḥ | śastreṇa tāḥ pariharec catasro māṃsarajjavaḥ’ iti || 39 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha māṃsapeśyaḥ | pañcaśatāni bhavantīty uktaṃ teṣāṃ prayojanam āha - māṃsapeśyaḥ balāya bhavanti tathā dehināṃ avaṣṭambhāya avasthityartham | idam āsāṃ prayojanaṃ śārṅgadharānuktaṃ
‘māṃsapeśyaḥ samākhyātā nṛṇāṃ pañcaśatāni tu |
tāsāṃ śatāni catvāri śākhāsu kathitā yathā ||
- koṣṭhe ṣaḍgaṇanā ṣaṣṭiḥ kathitā munipuṅgavaiḥ |
grīvāyā ūrdhvatas tāsu catustriṃśat prakīrtitāḥ |
puṃsāṃ peśyaḥ purastād yāḥ proktā mehanamuṣkajāḥ|
strīṇām āvṛtya tiṣṭhanti phalam antargataṃ hi tāḥ | puṃsāṃ mehanamuṣkayoḥ striyās tisro māṃsapeśyaḥ pūrvam uktās tāḥ strīṇāṃ mehanamuṣkābhāvāt phalaṃ garbhāśayaṃ āvṛtya tiṣṭhanti| gayadāsas tv āha - strīṇāṃ māṃsapeśyas tisṛbhir hīnāni pañcaśatāni | tathā bhojaḥ -
‘pañcapeśīśatāny eva strīvarjaṃ viddhi bhūmipa |
ataś catasro hīyante strīṇāṃ mehanamuṣkayoḥśākhāsu tatsaṃkhyā-pādāṅgulīṣu 15, pādāgre 10, pādopari kūrcasanniviṣṭāḥ 10, gulphatalayoḥ 10, gulphajānunorantare 20, jānuni 5, ūrau 20, vaṃkṣaṇe 10, evamekatra sakthini 100, anyabāhusakthinyapi 100; koṣṭheṣu yathā-gude 3, śephasi 1, sevanyā 1, vṛṣaṇayoḥ 2, sphicoḥ 10, bastimūrdhani 2, udare 5, nābhau 1, pṛṣṭhārdhobhayataḥ 10, pārśvayoḥ 6, vakṣasi 10, akṣakāṃsau prati samantāt 7, hṛdi 2, yakṛti 2, plīhni 2, uṇḍuke 2, grīvārdhe 34 yathā-grīvāyāṃ 4, hanvoḥ 8, kaṇṭhamaṇau 1, gale 1, tāluni 2, jihvāyāṃ 1, oṣṭhayoḥ 2, nāsāyāṃ 2, netrayoḥ 2, gaṇḍayoḥ 4, karṇayoḥ 2, lalāṭe 4, śirasi 1 | strīṇāmadhikāviṃśatiḥ-garbhāśaye 3, śukrārtavapraveśinyāṃ 3, yonyabhyantare mukhāśrite prasūte 2 yonikarṇike 2 stanayo 10 ityapi jñeyam | ||’ māṃsapeśīnāṃ karmāṇy āha -
‘śiśnadeśe 'sthiparvāṇi saṃdhayaś ca śarīriṇām |
peśībhiḥ saṃvṛtāny eva balavantaṃ bhavanti hi ||’ iti māṃsapeśīvivaraṇam || atha kaṇḍarāḥ | tatra kaṇḍarāś caiva ṣoḍaśety uktatvāt ṣoḍaśakaṇḍarā bhavanti tāsāṃ prayojanam āha - prasāraṇā- kuñcanayor aṅgānāṃ kaṇḍarā matā | aṅgānāṃ prasāraṇākuñcane tāsāṃ prayojanam | tāsāṃ vivaraṇaṃ śārṅgadharānuktam api granthāntarād āha -
‘mahatyaḥ snāyavaḥ proktāḥ kaṇḍarāś caiva ṣoḍaśa |
prasāraṇākuñcanayor dṛṣṭaṃ tāsāṃ prayojanam |
catasro hastayos tāsāṃ tāvantyaḥ pādayoḥ smṛtāḥ | grīvāyām api tāvantyas tāvatyaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśagāḥ’ iti kaṇḍarāvivaraṇam || 39 ||

lg.l: daśamaṃ mastake proktaṃ randhrāṇīti nṛṇāṃ viduḥ ||41||
strīṇāṃ trīṇy adhikāni syuḥ stanayor garbhavartmanaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha randhrāṇy āha - nāsetyādi | nāsādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ dve dve randhre prakīrtite | tena dve nāsāyāṃ, dve nayanayoḥ, dve karṇayor iti | mehanāpānavakrāṇām ekaikaṃ | mehanaṃ meḍhram, apānaṃ gudasaṃjñam, vakraṃ mukhakuharaṃ, daśamaṃ randhraṃ mastake coktam | tad brahmarandhram ity āhur eke, etāni navasrotāṃsi narāṇāṃ bahirmukhāni bhavanti daśamaṃ mastake pracchannam iti | strīṇām aparāṇi ca trīṇi tāni kāni ? ity āha - strīṇām iti | dve stanayoḥ kṣīravahe, ekaṃ garbhavartmanaḥ adhastāt tad raktavaham ity arthaḥ | anyāny api srotāṃsi santīty āha - sūkṣmacchidrāṇīti | janmināṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tvaci viṣaye anyāni sūkṣmacchidrāṇi matāni kathitānīty arthaḥ | tāny asaṃkhyeyāni yasmāt sūkṣmatvān na dṛśyante ato 'ntarmukhāni vadanty anye | cakārād anyāny api srotāṃsi manyante kecit | tāni tu prāṇā- nnodakarasaraktamāṃsamedomūtrapurīṣaśukrārtavavahāni | eteṣāṃ svarūpam atra bāhulyān na likhitam || 40-42 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nāsānayanakarṇānāṃ dve dve randhre chidre prakīrtite kathite | mehanam indriyam, apānaṃ gudam, vakraṃ mukham eṣu ekaikaṃ randhraṃ, evaṃ nava randhrāṇi, daśamaṃ mastake proktaṃ kathitam, evaṃ daśa randhrāṇi nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ viduḥ | anyāni sūkṣmacchidrāṇi janmināṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tvaci matāni kathitāni |
‘srotāṃsi syur manaḥprāṇā doṣadhātūpadhātavaḥ |
dhātūnāṃ ca malā mūtraṃ malam ityādayas tanau |
sañcaranti hi yair mārgais tāni srotāṃsi saṃjaguḥ’ || saṃjaguḥ vadanti tāni saṃkhyayāpi na śakyante bhāṣituṃ, vāgbhaṭe trayodaśa, suśrṛte dvāviṃśatiḥ, kecid agaṇitāny āhuḥ | iti srotovivaraṇam || 40-42 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. phupphusādīny āha - idānīṃ śārīrakathanaprasaṅgenānyeṣām api phupphusādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ nidarśayann āha - tadvāma iti | tadvāme hṛdayasya vāmabhāge phupphusaplīhānau ca bhavataḥ | phupphusaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ śoṇitaphenaprabhavo hṛdayanāḍikālagna: plīhā śoṇitajaḥ svanāmnā prasiddhaḥ | etadvayaṃ ca vāmapārśve sthitam iti bhāvaḥ | dakṣiṇāṅge dakṣiṇapārśve yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaṃ mataṃ etad api śoṇitajam | atha teṣāṃ śarīre vyāpāram āha - udānavāyor ityādi | phupphusaḥ udānavāyoḥ kaṇṭhasthitavāyor ādhāraḥ āśrayaḥ procyate budhair iti śeṣaḥ | plīhā raktavāhiśirāmūlam ākhyātam | plīheti ‘vunarūvā’ śabdavācyaḥ | yakṛt rañjakasya pittasya sthānaṃ raktasya ca sthānam iti | tilaṃ tu śoṇitakiṭṭaprabhavaṃ dakṣiṇāśritaṃ yakṛtsamīpe klomasaṃjñakaṃ bhavati | tac ca jalavāhiśirāmūlaṃ kathitam, ata eva tṛṣṇācchādanakaṃ pratipāditam | tṛṣṇā pipāsā tasyāś chādanaṃ karotīty arthaḥ || 43 || 44 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tadvāme hṛdayādayo vāmabhāge phupphusaṃ plīhā ca dakṣiṇe yakṛttilaṃ ca | tad uktaṃ suśrute -
‘kaphaśoṇitayoś cāpi prasādo hṛdayaṃ smṛtam |
tasyādho vāmataḥ plīhā dakṣiṇe kloma ucyate ||’ tatraiva yakṛto vidhānāt hṛdayaṃ cetanaṃ smṛtam iti spaṣṭam || plīhām āha - raktavāhiśirāmūlaṃ (iti) | raktasya saṃśrayaḥ āśrayaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat | tilavṛkkau āhārajalavāhiśirāmūlau, tilaṃ kiṃ bhūtaṃ tṛṣṇācchādanakam || 43 || 44 ||

Āḍhamalla. vṛṣaṇaliṅgayoḥ svarūpam āha - vṛkkau kukṣigolakau tau tu raktamedaḥ prasādasaṃbhavau, prasādaḥ sāraḥ; ata eva jaṭharasthasya medasaḥ puṣṭikarau kathitau tatsaṃbhavatvāt | jaṭharagrahaṇam anyasthānāśritamedoniṣedhārtham | tathā hi - ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tv abhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate’ iti | vṛṣaṇau aṇḍau tau ca māṃsā'sṛkkaphamedaḥprasādasaṃbhavau vīryavāhināṃ śirāṇām ādhārāvayavāśritāv ity arthaḥ | ata eva pauruṣāvahau puruṣasya dharmaḥ pauruṣaṃ puruṣārthakāriṇāv ity arthaḥ | yataḥ ‘ākṛṣṭāṇḍasya puṃsaś ca strīpraharṣo na jāyate’ iti || garbhādhānakaram iti | liṅgaṃ mehanaṃ tac ca grīvayā saha hṛdayanibandhanīnāṃ catasṝṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ praroham iti garbhā- dhānakaraṃ garbhotpādakam ity arthaḥ | ata eva śukramūtrayor ayanaṃ mārgam iti | tad uktaṃ - ‘dvyaṅgule dakṣiṇe pārśve bastidvārasya cāpy adhaḥ | mūtrasrotaḥ pathaḥ śukraṃ puruṣasya pravartate’ iti | hṛdayaṃ kamalamukulākāram adhomukhaṃ tac ca śoṇitakaphaprasādajaṃ cetanāsthānam iti | tad viśeṣeṇa caitanyapadaṃ kathitam | sāmānyena tu sakalaśarīram eva cetanāsthānam | tad uktaṃ carake -‘cetanānām adhiṣṭhānaṃ mano dehaś ca sendriyaḥ | keśalomanakhāgrāntamaladravaguṇair vinā’ iti | ojasaś cāśrayaṃ matam iti | ojo 'pi kṛtsnadhātusnehaḥ | yathā kṛtsnaśarīroddhṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ dhātūnāṃ tejaḥśabdenāmananti | yad uktaṃ ‘rasādīnāṃ śukrāntānāṃ dhātūnāṃ snehaḥ| yathā kṛtsnaṃ yat paraṃ tejaḥ tat khalv ojas tad eva balam ity ucyate’ | tantrāntare tu oja:śabdena raso 'py ucyate | jīvaśoṇitam api oja:śabdena kathayanti kecit | śleṣmāṇam avikṛtam ojaḥśabdenāpare vadantīti || 45||46||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. jaṭharasthasya medasaḥ vṛkkau puṣṭikarau jñeyau, bukkāgramāṃsaṃ vṛkkam iti vaidyāḥ | vṛṣaṇau aṇḍau bījavāhiśirādhārau proktau, bījaṃ vīryaṃ tadvāhinī yā śirā tasyā ādhārau kiṃbhūtau pauruṣāvahau | liṅgaṃ garbhādhānakaraṃ, tad bījamūtrayoḥ ayanaṃ sthānaṃ, bījaṃ śukram | hṛdayaprayojanam āha cetanāsthānaṃ jñānasthānaṃ tathā ojasaḥ āśrayaṃ sthānaṃ ojaḥ sarvadhātūnāṃ sāraḥ | tathā ca vāgbhaṭe ojas tejo hi dhātūnāṃ śukrāntam || 45 || 46 ||

lg.l: śirā dhamanyo nābhisthāḥ sarvā vyāpya sthitās tanum |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ śarīrapoṣaṇavyāpāram āha - śireti | nābhisthā: nābhisthitamūlā: sarvaṃ sakalaśarīraṃ vyāpya sthitāś ca matāḥ | śirā dhamanyaḥ saraṇāt sirāḥ, dhamanād dhamanyaḥ, aniśam ity aharniśam | tanuṃ śarīraṃ puṣyanti poṣayanti tatra taruṇānāṃ śarīraṃ puṣṇanti | vṛddhānāṃ ca pālayantīty abhiprāyaḥ | cakārād anugṛhṇanti arthāt paripālayantīty arthaḥ | tad uktaṃ - ‘sa evānnaraso vṛddhānāṃ paripakvaśarīratvād aprīṇano bhavati’ iti | kutaḥ poṣayantīty ata āha - vāyoḥ saṃyogād ityādi | vāyor anilasya saṃyogāt prākṛtasahāyāt | tathā hy uktaṃ ‘kriyāṇām apratighātam amoho buddhikarmaṇām | karoty anyān guṇāṃś cāpi svāḥ sirāḥ pavanaś caran’ iti | kaiḥ kṛtvā ity āha - sarvadhātubhir iti | sarve dhātavo rasādyāḥ | etena sarvāsāṃ sāmānyaṃ karma nirdiṣṭam, tathā ca - ‘yābhir idaṃ śarīram ārāma iva jalahāriṇībhiḥ kedāra iva ca kulyābhir upasnihyate anugṛhyate cākuñcanaprasāraṇādibhir viśeṣair iti’ | nanu - nābhisthā: kathaṃ sakalaśarīraṃ puṣṇantīty āśaṅkya tantrāntarāt samādhānam āha | tad yathā - ‘vyāpnuvanty abhito dehaṃ nābhitaḥ prasṛtāḥ śirāḥ | pratānaṃ padminīkandād bisādīnāṃ yathā jalam’ iti || 47 ||

lg.l: pītvā cāmbarapīyūṣaṃayameva pāścātyaiḥ Oxygen ‘~oksijana’ nāmnā vyavahriyamāṇaḥ prāṇapradavāyuviśeṣa ihāvagantavyaḥ | idaṃ ca tatvaṃ vāyau 29 tibhāgātmakatvena jale ca 16 śabhāgātmakatvena vyavasthitam | tathāca śrutiḥ - ‘apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā | agniñca viśvaśambhuvamāpaśca viśvabheṣajīḥ’ ( ka. saṃ. 1,23,20) iti, ‘apsu jyoti: pratiṣṭhitam’ (tai. ā. 9,8) iti ca | vāyau cāpi ‘udutye aruṇapsavaścitrāyāmemirīrate | vāśrā adhiṣṇunā diva: |’ (kra.sa. 7,7) iti vāyūnāmaruṇatvaṃ, citradarśatvaṃ vidyudruṇayuktatvaṃ prāṇadavāyunaiveti | punar āyāti vegataḥ || 49 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha prāṇānilasya śarīravyāpāram āha - nābhistha iti | prāṇapavanaḥ prāṇānilaḥ prāṇāśrito vāyur iti tātparyārthaḥ | prāṇā agnisomādayaḥ, nābhistha iti kāraṇāt nābhau sthitaḥ sakalaśarīravyāpakatvāt, etena nābhyāvṛtaśirāsv api sthita iti bhāvaḥ | tad uktaṃ -nābhisthāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇān nābhir vyupāśritā | śirābhir āvṛtā nābhiś cakranābhir ivārakaiḥ’ iti | yathā -
‘brahmarandhrān nābhicakraṃ dvādaśāram avasthitam |
lūteva tantujālasthā tatra jīvo bhramaty ayam || suṣumnayā brahmarandhram ārohaty avarohati | jīvaḥ prāṇasamārūḍho rañjakaḥ sphaṭiko yathā’ iti | tasya kāraṇatvaṃ ca tantrāntare 'pi kathitam | yathā -
‘teṣām uṣṇatamaḥ prāṇo nābhikandād adhaḥsthitaḥ |
caraty āsye nāsikāyāṃ nābhau hṛdayapaṅkaje || śabdoccāraṇaniśvāsocchvāsakāsādikāraṇam |’ iti | evaṃvidhaḥ prāṇānilaḥ hṛtkamalāntaraṃ hṛdayakamalasyābhyantaraṃ spṛṣṭvā prabodhya kaṇṭhād bahir viniryāti | arthāt kaṇṭham ullaṅghya śirasi prāpta iti tātparyārthaḥ | kuta ity āha -viṣṇupadāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ viṣṇupadaṃ brahmarandhrāśritaṃupalakṣaṇamidam | tena śrutivijñātā bhautikabāyābapsvapi viṣṇupadāmṛtasya sattā astyeva | tatrāśritam amṛtaṃ pīyūṣam | ata evāhur ācāryāḥ - ‘cakraṃ sahasrapatraṃ tu brahmarandhre sudhādharam | tatsudhāsāradhārābhir abhivardhayate tanum’ iti | mūlabhārate 'pi - ‘brahmarandhre sthito jīvaḥ sudhayā saṃpluto yadā | tuṣṭigītādikāryāṇi saprakarṣāṇi sādhayet’ iti | pītvetyādi | sa evānilaḥ ambarapīyūṣaṃ brahma- randhrāśritam amṛtaṃ pītvā arthāt samādāya punar iti tenaiva pathā vegatas tatkṣaṇād eva āyāti svasthāna iti śeṣaḥ | tādṛśasya tasya kāryam āha - prīṇayann ityādi | akhilaṃ dehaṃ prīṇayan sann āste iti bhāvaḥ | akhilam iti | śikhādicaraṇaparyantaṃ na kevalaṃ dehaṃ puṣṇāti api tu jīvaṃ jaṭharānalaṃ ca | jīvaḥ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātaḥ | sa ca brahmarandhre sthitaḥ jaṭharānalaḥ pācakāgniḥ tasya pācakādiśaktiṃ karotīty abhiprāyaḥ | nanu dehagrahaṇena jīvānalādīnāṃ grahaṇam eva tat kathaṃ pṛthag uktaḥ ? ucyate - dehagrahaṇasāmānyenāṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgo 'bhihitaḥ | jīvānilau tu viśeṣeṇa tanmūlau | ata eva ‘śarīrād bhinno jīva’ iti śrutiḥ | tasmāt pṛthag uktau na doṣaḥ | yataḥ -
‘āyur varṇo balaṃ svāsthyam utsāho 'pacayaprabhāḥ |
ojas tejo 'gnayaḥ prāṇāś coktā dehe 'gnihetukāḥ || śānte 'gnau mriyate yukte ciraṃ jīvaty anāmayaḥ | rogī syād vikṛte mūlam agnis tasmān nirucyate’ iti || 48 ||

div.ab:
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyad api vāyoḥ kāryam āha - prāṇapavanaṃ hṛdayastho vāyuḥ viṣṇupadāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ kaṇṭhād bahiḥ viniryāti ambarapīyūṣaṃ pītvā punaḥ vegataḥ āyāti | kiṃ kṛtvā hṛtkamalāntaraṃ spṛṣṭvā nābhisthaḥ san jaṭharānalaṃ jīvayan akhilaṃ dehaṃ prīṇayan punar yātīti yojanā | yad vā nābhisthaḥ prāṇapavana iti pāṭhas tatra evam anvayaḥ | prāṇināṃ yaḥ pavano nābhisthaḥ san hṛtkamalāntaraṃ spṛṣṭveti jñeyaṃ; śeṣaṃ tathaiva || nanu - ‘hṛdi prāṇo gude 'pānaḥ samāno nābhisaṃsthitaḥ’ ity uktatvāt kathaṃ nābhisthaḥ prāṇapavano bhavatīti dūṣaṇam ? ucyate nābhistho yo 'dhaḥ | asya vyākhyā ca prāṇināṃ prāṇā nābhisthāḥ yataḥ prāṇaśirā nābhiṃ vyapāśritāḥ, tat kutaḥ; yataḥ nābhiḥ śirābhir āvṛtā kevalaṃ ārāś cakranābhir iveti yojanā | prakarṣeṇa anantīti prāṇāḥ prāṇavāyavas tenāṅgādibhedena daśadhā ‘evaṃ daśavidho vāyuḥ prāṇarūpeṇa saṃñcare’d ity ukteḥ | yady api prāṇaśabdena indriyārohī jīvātmādivāyavo gṛhyante tathāpy atra śirāsu gatimattvād vāyor eva grahaṇaṃ daśavidhāḥ prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca tatra prāṇo hṛnnābhipādāṅguṣṭhapravṛttiḥ apānas trikakaṭipṛṣṭhapārśvapādapāyūpasthavṛttiḥ, samāno hṛnnābhisarvasandhipravṛttiḥ, udāno hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyavṛttiḥ, vyānas tvagvṛttir iti pañcavāyavaḥ sāṃkhyenoktā iti bhāvaḥ | vṛttir gamanaṃ striyāṃ ktin | vṛtyate iti vṛttiḥ vāyus tasyaiva prāṇasaṃjñeti suśrutābhiprāyaḥ | tathaiva śirāvarṇane śārīre dhanvantarivacanam
‘nābhisthāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇanābhiṃ vyapāśritāḥ |
śirābhir āvṛtā nābhiś cakranābhir ivārakaiḥ’ || prāṇāḥ pañcaprāṇāḥ, yad vā daśa prāṇāḥ daśadhā prāṇavāyur ity uktatvāt ‘evaṃ daśavidho vāyuḥ prāṇarūpeṇa sañcare’d iti vāsudevānubhavaḥ | tathā ca rāvaṇavacanaṃ ‘niyamitaprāṇair muhur mṛgyate’ niyamitāḥ prāṇā daśadhā prāṇavāyavo yais te niyamitaprāṇāḥ yoginaḥ taiḥ parameśvaro hṛdi muhuḥ mṛgyate vicāryate ity etasyārthaḥ, tasmān na doṣaḥ || 48 || 49 ||

lg.l: kālena tadviyogāc ca pañcatvaṃ kathyate budhaiḥ |
na jantuḥ kaścid amaraḥ pṛthivyāṃ jāyate kvacit |
ato mṛtyur avārya: syāt kiṃtu rogān nivārayet ||51 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ āyuṣaḥ svarūpam āha -- athāyur lakṣaṇaṃ tadviparītalakṣaṇaṃ cāha śarīreti | evaṃ pūrvoktābhiprāyāt śarīraprāṇayoḥ saṃyogād āyur ucyate kathyate, āyur iti bhūtātmanaḥ śarīranidhanaparyantaṃ dharmādharmanimittakasāṃsārikasukhaduḥkhopabhogasādhanam | tadviparītam āha - kālenetyādi | kālo 'pi svayambhūr eva kathitaḥ | tathā ca - ‘kālo hi nāma svayambhūr anādimadhyanidhanaḥ’ ityādi | bhūtāni saṅkalayati saṃharaṇād iti kālaḥ, sukhaduḥkhābhyāṃ bhūtāni yojayatīti vā kālaḥ | athavā kalayati mṛtyusamīpaṃ nayati iti kālaḥ, īdṛgvidhenety arthaḥ | tadviyogād iti tayoḥ prāṇaśarīrayor viyogāt viśleṣāt pañcatvaṃ maraṇaṃ kathyate budhair iti śeṣaḥ | ata evāha ācāryaḥ - na jantur ityādi | rogān nivārayet | vaidya iti śeṣaḥ | tad uktaṃ vaidyalakṣaṇe - ‘vyādhes tattvaparijñānaṃ vedanāyāś ca nigrahaḥ | etad vaidyasya vaidyatvaṃ na vaidyaḥ prabhur āyuṣaḥ’ iti | śeṣaṃ subodham || 50 || 51 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. budhaiḥ śarīraprāṇayogād āyuḥ ucyate, kāle āyuṣo niḥśeṣeṇa tadviyogāt prāṇaviyogāt pañcatvaṃ kathyate, pañcatvaṃ maraṇam, yataḥ mṛtyoḥ pratīkāro nāsti rogāṇāṃ pratīkārosti ato rugbhyas tanuṃ rakṣed ity āha na jantur iti | avāryo dūrīkartum aśakyaḥ || 50 || 51 ||

lg.l: yāpyatvaṃ yāti sādhyas tu yāpyo gacchaty asādhyatām |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ sādhyasya vyādher apratikriyamāṇatvād avasthāntaraprāptim āha - yāpyatvam iti | apratikāriṇo narasyāturasya susādhyo vyādhir yāpyatvaṃ yāti, kintu uktavyādhiḥ sādhyatāṃ prāpya paścād yāpyatvaṃ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | yāpyo 'py asādhyatāṃ gacchati asādhyo 'pi jīvitaṃ hantīti | apratikāriṇa iti rogāpanayanādikakriyārahitasya, ata evotpannamātraṃ eva vyādhiḥ pratikāryaḥ | tad uktaṃ - ‘jātamātre cikitsyas tu nopekṣyo 'lpatayā gadaḥ | vahniśatruvidhais tulyaḥ svalpo 'pi vikaroty asau’ iti | yāpya ity asādhyabhedaḥ | tathā ca - ‘asādhyo dvividho jñeyo yāpyo yaś cāpratikriya:’ iti | tatra tu ‘yāpanīyaṃ tu jānīyāt kriyāṃ dhārayate tu ya: | kriyāyāṃ tu vinivṛttāyāṃ sadya eva vinaśyati ||’ iti | apratikriyaś cikitsāvarjitaḥ, niyataprāṇahara ity arthaḥ | sādhyo 'pi dvividhaḥ susādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaś ca | tatraikadoṣotpanno nirupadravo 'cirotpanna ityādilakṣaṇaḥ sukhasādhyaḥ śastrādisādhanaḥ kṛcchra iti || 52 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. roganivāraṇe sādhyādibhedam āha | apratikāriṇaḥ cikitsām akurvataḥ puruṣasya sādhyo roga: yāpyatāṃ yāti | yāpyaḥ asādhyatāṃ yāti gacchati | asādhyo jīvitaṃ hantīti yojanā || 52 ||

lg.l: ato rugbhyas tanuṃ rakṣen naraḥ karmavipākavit || 53 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dharmādisādhanaśarīrasya rakṣāṃ nirdiśann āha - idānīṃ dehasya catuḥpadārthasādhanabhūtasya rakṣāṃ nirdiśann āha - dharmeti | yato hetoḥ śarīraṃ dharmādīnāṃ sādhanam asti ataḥ kāraṇāt rugbhyo vyādhibhyas tanuṃ śarīraṃ rakṣet | ko rakṣet ? ity āha - naraḥ karmavipākavid iti karma śubhāśubhaṃ tasya vipākaḥ phalaṃ taṃ jānātīti karmavipākavit, etenādṛṣṭajanyaphalaṃ saccintya tatparo bhūtvā kṛtadānapūrvakaṃ karma kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | yata: -
‘pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vyādhirūpeṇa tiṣṭhati |
ato dānādikaṃ kuryāt prasamīkṣya vicakṣaṇaḥ ||’ iti ||53||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yataḥ dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śarīraṃ sādhanaṃ ataḥ rugbhyo rakṣed iti pūrveṇaiva saṃbandhaḥ | ataḥ karmavipākavit naras tanuṃ rakṣet karmavipākavit tannidānajñaḥ || 53 ||

lg.l: dhātavas tanmalā doṣā nāśayanty asamās tanum |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha doṣādīnāṃ vaiṣamyenāvasthām āha -- dhātava iti | sukhaṃ svasthatā, balam āṅgikam ojaḥsaṃjñakam upacayaṃ śarīrasya vṛddhirūpā santatiḥ | tanmalā iti dhātumalāḥ | samā iti svaparimāṇasthitāḥ iti yad vivaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat teṣāṃ svabhāvaparimāṇaṃ ca tantrāntarīyavākyena darśayann āha | tad yathā -
‘yaḥ prasādaparo 'nnasya paraṃ jīrṇasya sarvaśaḥ |
sa raso 'ñjalayas tasya nava deheṣu dehinaḥ |
raktasyāñjalayas tv aṣṭau śakṛtaḥ sapta sarvaśaḥ |
pittasyāñjalayaḥ pañca ṣaṭ kaphasya pracakṣate ||
mūtrasya vidyāc catvāro vasāyāś cāñjalitrayam |
dvāv añjalī medasas tu majjña ekāñjalir mataḥ ||
śukrasyārdhāñjalir jñeyo mastiṣkasyojasas tathā |
catvāro 'ñjalayaḥ strīṇāṃ rajasaḥ prakṛtisthitiḥ ||
dvāv añjalī prasūtāyā: stanyasyāpi hi yoṣitaḥ |
pramāṇam etad dhātūnām aduṣṭānām udāhṛtam || hīnāḥ syus tatpramāṇāt tu pravṛddhāś cāpi dhātavaḥ | yojayanti vikāreṣu doṣā vṛddhikṣayapradāḥ’ iti | ata evāha vāgbhaṭaḥ – ‘rogas tu doṣavaiṣamyaṃ doṣasāmyam arogatā’ iti | anyac ca - ‘vikṛtāḥ prakṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vardhayanti ca’ iti | tathā ca carake 'pi - ‘vikāro dhātuvaiṣamyaṃ sāmyaṃ prakṛtir ucyate | sukhasaṃjñakam ārogyaṃ vikāraḥ svayam eva ca’ iti || 54 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dhātvādīnām asamatvasamatvābhyāṃ śarīrasya duḥkhasukhe āha - dhātavaḥ rasādyāḥ sapta tanmalāḥ dhātumalāḥ, doṣā vātādaya asamāḥ hīnādhikāḥ tanuṃ nāśayanti samāḥ svapramāṇasthā: sukhā jñeyāḥ tathā balāya dhātuvṛddhau upacayāya sthaulyāya || 54 || iti kālādivivaraṇaṃ samāptam ||

ab.seg:
atha sṛṣṭikramaḥ |
jagadyoner anicchasya cidānamdaikarūpiṇaḥ |
puṃso 'sti prakṛtir nityā praticchāyeva bhāsvataḥ ||55||

Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktam ādiśabdāt sṛṣṭikramaśārīragrahaṇaṃ atas taṃ darśayann āha --jagadyoner iti | jagadyoner ityādiṣu sā nityā prakṛtir asti iti viṣayaḥ | yathā bhāsvato mārtaṇḍasya praticchāyeva pratibimbam iva sā nityā astīti śrutiḥ | prakṛteḥ paryāyam avyaktaṃ nāma kathitam | kīdṛśasya ? tam āha -jagadyoner iti | akhilasya jagato yoni saṃbhavahetus tasyeti | yad vā jagacchabdena pṛthivyādayo 'bhidhīyante kārye kāraṇopacārāt | teṣāṃ yonir utpattis tasyety arthaḥ | etenābhivyaktihetutvam uktam | punaḥ kīdṛśasya ? anicchasyeti | icchā ahaṃkārasyotpādinī pratipāditā tayā rahitasyety arthaḥ | etena nirvikāratvam uktam | punaḥ kiṃbhūtasya ? cidānandaikarūpiṇa iti | cit jñānam ānandaṃ parabrahmāvabodhalakṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ, tadvayam evaikaṃ rūpaṃ yasya | yad vā - cit svarūpānandam evaikaṃ rūpaṃ yasya jñānānandasyety abhiprāyaḥ | tathā hy uktam -
‘asti brahma cidānandaṃ svayaṃ jyotir nirañjunam|
īśvaro liṅgam ity uktam advitīyam ayaṃ vibhuḥ ||
nirvikāraṃ nirākāraṃ sarveśvaram anīśvaram |
sarvaśakti ca sarvajñaṃ tadaṃśā jīvasaṃjñakāḥ | anādyavidyopahitā yathāgner visphuliṅgakāḥ’ iti || 55 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha sṛṣṭikramaḥ | āyurvedasya phalaṃ cikitsā puruṣasya, puruṣas tu caturviṃśatitattcajīvātmanaś ca svarūpa- nirūpaṇāya sṛṣṭikramam āha | puṃsaḥ cidānandanirūpitasya prakṛtiḥ nityā asti | keva bhāsvataḥ sūryasya praticchāyā iva | kathaṃbhūtasya puṃsaḥ | jagadyoneḥ jagadutpādakasya | jagacchabdena pṛthivyādayaḥ | nanu gacchatīti jagat teṣā- mutpatau samavāyikāraṇam | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtasya | anicchasya icchārahitasya | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtasya | cidānandaikarūpiṇaḥ cidānandam eva ekaṃ rūpaṃ yasya | anena īśvarasya nityatvāt tair api nityatvaṃ pratipāditam || 55 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ acetaso nāryāḥ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya caitanyayāgena sṛṣṭyutpattim āha - atha kartṛttvanimittatayā pūrvaślokena saṃbandhaḥ | tena sā mūlaprakṛtiḥ paramātmano yogena kṛtvā akhilaṃ viśvam akarod iti tātparyārthaḥ | yogaś cittavṛttinirodhalakṣaṇaḥ | akhilaṃ carācarātmakaṃ, kīdṛśaṃ ? tad āha - aceta- nādīti | acetanam avyaktam ādir yasya tad acetanādi, caitanyam iti cetanānvitam | nanu katham acetanasya kāraṇatvaṃ prava- rtate ? tad asaṅgatam iti, satyaṃ - yathā vatsavivṛddhyarthaṃ kṣīrasaṃjñaṃ kāraṇatvena pravartate tadvad iti | anyat savistaraṃ vistarabhayān na likhitam | punaḥ kīdṛśam ? anityam iti vināśighaṭapaṭādivat | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtaṃ ? nāṭakākṛti nāṭakasvarūpaṃ aindrajālikavastuvad iti bhāvaḥ || 56 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. acetanetyādi | acetanā jaḍā api prakṛtiḥ paramātmanaḥ caitanyayogena akhilaṃ viśvam akarot, kibhūtaṃ viśvam | anityaṃ naśvaram, punaḥ kiṃbhūtam | nāṭakākṛti indrajālavat akhilaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamādilakṣaṇaṃ viśvaśabdasya sarvāditvāt triṣu caritatvād atra napuṃsake || 56 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ sṛṣṭyutpattyupakrame prakṛte buddhyādīn āha – idānīm ekena kāraṇena sarveṣāṃ kāryāṇām utpattikramam āha - prakṛtir iti | prakṛtir ity avyaktāparaparyāyā pūrvam ādau buddhiṃ mahān iti vikārasaṃjñaṃ ajījanad utpādayāmāsa | kīdṛśīm ? icchāmayīṃ, sattvarajastamoguṇa- svabhāvair nānātmikām ity arthaḥ | punaḥ kīdṛśīṃ ? mahudrūpām iti mahān iti rūpaṃ paryāyanāma yasyāḥ sā tathā tāṃ | yad vā nirmalasphaṭikopalaprakhyāṃ sattvasamudrekatvāt| tata iti buddhitattvāt ahaṅkāro 'bhimānavyāpāralakṣaṇo 'bhavat | sa eva sattvādiguṇaiḥ kṛtvā trividhaḥ sañjātaḥ, trividha iti vaikārikas taijaso bhūtādir ity artha: | tatra vaikārikaḥ sāttvikaḥ, taijaso rājasaḥ, bhūtādis tāmasa iti || 57 || 58 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. prakṛtītyādi | kiṃbhūtāṃ buddhiṃ icchāmayīṃ | punaḥ mahadrūpāṃ, tataḥ buddheḥ sakāśād abhavad iti yojanā | prakṛtīti prakarṣeṇa kriyate anayā iti prakṛtiḥ guṇānāṃ sāmyaṃ prakṛtiḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyādyavasthā prakṛtir iti sāṃkhye sā prakṛtir aṣṭadhā bhedabhinnā | tathā coktaṃ suśrute - ‘avyaktaṃ mahān ahaṃkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇīty aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ’ | gītāyāṃ coktam - ‘bhūmir āpo 'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhir eva ca | ahaṃkāra’ iti pañcabhedabhinnā prakṛtir aṣṭadhā ato buddhyādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ prakṛter bhedā buddhijñānasvarūpā icchāmayīṃ icchāsvarūpāṃ mahadrūpāṃ bahurūpām | yataḥ gītāyām uktam - ‘bahuśākhā hy anantāś ca buddhayo vyavasāyinā’m iti | sa ahaṃkāras trividho bhavatīty āha - so 'py ahaṃkāraḥ rajaḥsattvatamoguṇais trividhaḥ saṃjātaḥ abhavat || 57 || 58 ||

lg.l: manaś ca jātaṃ tāny āhuḥ śrotratvaṅnayanaṃ tathā || 59 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. tasmād indriyāṇi bhavantīty āha - atha trividhasyāpi tasya kāryam āha - tasmād iti | tasmād ity ahaṅkārāt daśendriyāṇy abhavan na kevalaṃ daśasaṃkhyākāni - mano 'pi indriyasaṃjñam utpannam | kīdṛśād ahaṅkārād ity āha - sattvarajoyuktād iti | sattvarajograhaṇāt tamo 'pi prāptam eva yataḥ sāttvikād ahaṅkārāt rājasasahāyāt tamomātrayānuviddhād ekādaśendriyāṇy utpadyanta iti bhāvaḥ | eke tasmād ity asya sthāne 'tra sattvarajoyuktād iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tānīndriyāṇi ca | sāṃkhye tu ahaṅkārāṇi kathitāni vaidyake bhautikānīty abhiprāyaḥ | tatra pañca prāktanāni śrotrādīni buddhīndriyāṇy āhuḥ | buddher āśrayatvāt | prāktanāni pūrvapaṭhitāni itarāṇy avaśiṣṭāni pañca karmendriyāṇi kathyante teṣu karmaṇām āśrayatvāt | pūrvāṇi pañca śrotratvaṅnayanajihvāghrāṇāni itarāṇi ca pañca vacohastapādopasthagudādīni | sūkṣmabuddhibhir iti grahaṇena mano 'py ubhayātmakaṃ sūcyate | buddhyātmakakarmātmakam ity arthaḥ | buddhīndriyāṇāṃ karmendriyāṇāṃ ca manodhi'ṣṭhānānām eva pravṛtteḥ || 59 || 60 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tasmāt sattvarajoyuktād ahaṃkārāt daśa indriyāṇi abhavan, ekādaśaṃ manaḥ | teṣāṃ nāmāny āha mana ekādaśaṃ tāni daśa śrotraṃ karṇadvayaṃ tvak tvacā, nayanaṃ netrayugmaṃ jihvā prasiddhā, ghrāṇaṃ nāsārandhre vaco vadanaṃ hastau dvau, pādaṃ dve upasthaṃ meḍhraṃ yoniś ca gudaṃ prasiddham | daśendriyāṇāṃ madhye pañca buddhīndriyāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi bhavanti tayor bhedam āha - pañca buddhīndriyāṇy āhuḥ proktāni tānītarāṇi ceti prāktanāni śrotrādīni pañca buddhīndriyāṇi buddhir āśrayatvāt itarāṇi vācaḥprabhṛtīni pañca karmendriyāṇi karmāśrayatvāt sūkṣmabuddhibhir etāni kathyante iti yojanā ||59||60||

lg.l: rajaḥsattvaguṇotkṛṣṭād ahaṅkārād athābhavat‘tama’ iti gūḍhārthadīpikāsammata: pāṭhaḥ” | || 61 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. trividhāhaṃkārāt tanmātrāpañcakaṃ bhavati atas tad āha - raja ityādi | athānantaram, ahaṃkārād iti ahaṃkāro bhūtādisaṃjñā tasmād iti tāmasarūpād ity abhiprāyaḥ | kīdṛśād ity āha - rajaḥsattvaguṇotkṛṣṭād iti rājasasahāyāt sattvamātrayā'nuviddhāt tāmasād ahaṅkārād ity arthaḥ | īdṛśāt tanmātrapañcakaṃ bhavatīti tātparyārtha: | sā sā mātrā yasmin tat tanmātraṃ tac cānudbhūtasvabhāvaṃ bāhyendriyāgrāhyaṃ vakṣyamāṇaśabdādīny eva pañcatanmātrāṇīti | tac ca yogibhir eva grāhyam | tanmātrapañcakād iti | tasmāt pūrvoktāt tanmātrapañcakāt, śabdāder bhūtapañcakaṃ vyomādikaṃ sañjātaṃ samyak prakāreṇotpadyata iti | samyak prakāragrahaṇenaikottaraparivṛddhiḥ sūcyate | tad yathā śabdatanmātrāc chabdatadguṇaṃ vyoma, śabdatanmātrasahitāt sparśatanmātrāt śabdasparśaguṇo vāyuḥ, śabdasparśatanmātrasahitāt rūpatanmātrāc chabdasparśaguṇaṃ tejaḥ, śabdasparśarūpa- tanmātrasahitād rasatanmātrāt śabdasparśarūparasaguṇā āpaḥ, śabdasparśarūparasatanmātrasahitāt gandhatanmātrāt śabdasparśarūparasagandhaguṇā pṛthivī | patañjalimatānusāriṇaś ca śabdādibhyo vyomādīnām utpattim icchanti ||61-63||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tamaḥsattvaguṇotkṛṣṭād ahaṃkārāt tanmātrapañcakam abhavat, tasya nāmāni sūribhiḥ uktāni tāni nāmāny āha -śabdatanmātrakaṃ śrotrasvarūpam, sparśatanmātrakaṃ tvagmātrakaṃ tvaksvarūpam; rūpatanmātrakaṃ nayanamātrakaṃ nayanasvarūpam; rasatanmātrakaṃ jihvāmātrakaṃ jihvāsvarūpam, gandhatanmātraṃ ghrāṇamātraṃ ghrāṇasvarūpam, tanmātrapaṃñcakāt bhūtapañcakaṃ jāyata ity āha - tasmāt śrotrādipañcatanmātrāt bhūtapañcakaṃ saṃjātaṃ bhavatīty adhyāhāraḥ | tad bhūtapañcakaṃ vyomānilānalajalakṣoṇīrūpaṃ mataṃ kathitaṃ vyoma ākāśaṃ, anilo vāyu:, analo 'gniḥ, jalaṃ prasiddhaṃ, kṣoṇī pṛthivī, tadrūpaṃ teṣāṃ svarūpam || 61-63 ||

lg.l: śabda: sparśaś ca rūpaṃ ca rasagandhāv anukramāt ||64||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tanmātrāṇāṃ viśeṣān āha - idānīṃ pañcakānāṃ tanmātrakāṇāṃ viśeṣā ucyante - śabda iti | anubhavayogyaiḥ sukhaduḥkhamo- harūpadharmair viśeṣyanta iti viśeṣāḥ, te śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ | tanmātrāṇi tv aviśeṣāṇi yatas tāni anubhavayogyaiḥ sukhādibhir viśeṣaṃ kartuṃ na śakyate sūkṣmatvāt | ata eva sthūlabhāgam upāgatā amī viśeṣā ity arthaḥ | kecid amuṃ ślokaṃ tanmātrapañcakād anantaraṃ paṭhanti saṅgatatvāt || 64 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śabdaḥ śrotraviśeṣabhāvaḥ, rūpaṃ netraviśeṣabhāvaḥ, raso jihvāviśeṣabhāvaḥ; gandhaḥ ghrāṇaviśeṣabhāvaḥ ete tanmātrāṇāṃ viśeṣāḥ syu:| kiṃbhūtā sthūlabhāvatvaṃ prāptāḥ | ete śabdādayaḥ || 64 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athendriyāṇāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ viṣayān darśayann āha - buddhīndriyāṇām iti | śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇānāṃ śabdādyā iti śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ ete tu teṣām anukrameṇa boddhavyāḥ | karmendriyāṇām iti vacohastapādopasthagudānāṃ yathākramaṃ bhāṣādānavihārānandotsargā viṣayāḥ kathitāḥ, bhāṣā vacanaṃ, ādānaṃ grahaṇam, vihāro 'tra calanādikam, ānando harṣaḥ, utsargo malaparityāgaḥ, iti tattvadarśibhiḥ puruṣaiś caturviṃśatitattvarahasyajñāpakair ity arthaḥ ||65||66 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pañcajñānendriyāṇāṃ viṣayāḥ kathitāḥ, tatra śabdaḥ śrotraviṣayaḥ, sparśaḥ tvagviṣayaḥ, rūpaṃ netraviṣayaḥ; rasaḥ jihvāviṣayaḥ, gandhaḥ ghrāṇaviṣayaḥ; karmendriyāṇāṃ bhāvādayo viṣayāḥ kathitāḥ | viśeṣā anubhavāḥ; pakṣe sukhaduḥkhamoharūpair dharmair viśeṣyanta iti viśeṣāḥ atra karmaṇi ghañ pratyayaḥ | tanmātrāṇi tvagviśeṣāṇi patyas tāny anubhavayogyaiḥ mukhādibhir viśeṣeṣu na śakyante sūkṣmatvāt | tataḥ vacasaḥ bhāṣā bhāṣaṇaṃ, jihvayā adanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ, pādasya vihāratā gamanāgamanam, upasthasya yoniliṅgayoḥ ānandaḥ strīpuruṣasaukhyaviśeṣaḥ, gudasya visarjaḥ purīṣatyāgaḥ || 65-66 ||

lg.l: pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ śaktir nityā cāvikṛtis tathā |
etāni tasyā nāmāni śivam āśritya yā sthitā || 67 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ mūlaprakṛteḥ paryāyanāmāny āha - pradhānam iti | pradhānaṃ prakṛtir iti mūlaprakṛtiḥ śaktir iti kāraṇarūpā, nityā avināśinī, avikṛtir vikārarahitā, tasyāḥ prakṛteḥ, śivam iti parabrahmalakṣaṇam āśritya yā sthitā sūryasya pratibimbavat sā ca sattvarajastamaḥsvarūpā bhavati | tad uktaṃ - ‘sarvabhūtāni kāraṇam akāraṇaṃ sattvarajastamolakṣaṇam aṣṭarūpam akhilasya jagataḥ saṃbhave hetur avyaktaṃ nāma’ iti || 67 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha prakṛtivivaraṇam ( tatra) prakṛter nāmāny āha - yā prakṛtiḥ śaktiḥ śivaṃ parameśvaram āśritya sthitā tasyā etāni nāmāni bhavantīti yojanā | evaṃ prakṛteḥ pradhānaṃ nāma ekaṃ prakṛtiḥ ekā śaktiḥ ekā nityā ekā avikṛtiḥ | suśrutamate avyaktaṃ ca prakṛternāma | na vyajyate sma ity avyaktaṃ mūlaprakṛtiparyāyā iti ḍallaṇaḥ || 67 ||

lg.l: prakṛtir vikṛtiś caiba saptaitāni budhā jaguḥ || 68 ||
daśendriyāṇi cittaṃ ca mahābhūtāni pañca ca |
vikārāḥ ṣoḍaśa jñeyāḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya jagat sthitāḥ || 69 ||
vyāpto baddhaś ca manasā kṛtrimaiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ || 71 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ caturviṃśatike tattvarāśau prakṛtitvaṃ nirasyan kathitam upasaṃharann āha - mahān iti | etāni sapta mahadādīny eva prakṛtir vikṛtiś ca bhavantīti piṇḍārthaḥ | prakṛtir ity apareṣāṃ kāraṇabhūtā, vikṛtir iti mūlaprakṛteḥ kāryarūpā, atra yad avyaktagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtaṃ tad vikṛtipadagrahaṇāt, avyaktaṃ tu kevalaṃ hetubhāvena prakṛtir eva | mahadādayaḥ sapta kāryatvena vikṛtayo 'pi jñeyāḥ | pañcatanmātrāṇīti śabdādīni | ity evaṃ budhāḥ paṇḍitā jaguḥ kathitavantaḥ | idānīṃ ṣoḍaśavikārān darśayann āha - daśendriyāṇīti | ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ kāryāṇi te vikārāḥ daśendriyāṇīti śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇavāghastopasthapāyupādāni, cittaṃ ceti mano 'pīridrayabhūtam iti bhāvaḥ | mahābhūtāni ākāśapavanadahanatoyabhūmaya iti | evaṃ ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ, ete tu sarvaṃ carācarātmakaṃ jagat saṃsāraṃ vyāpya sthitā ity arthaḥ | evam iti pūrvottāprakāreṇa | caturviṃśatibhis tattvair iti avyaktaṃ mahān ahaṅkāraḥ, śabdatanmātraṃ, sparśatanmātraṃ, rūpatanmātraṃ, rasatanmātraṃ, gandhatanmātraṃ, śrotraṃ, tvak, cakṣuḥ, ghrāṇaṃ, rasanā, tvak, hastapādam, upasthaṃ, pāyuḥ, manaḥ, pṛthivī, āpaḥ, tejaḥ, vāyuḥ, ākāśaṃ, caturviṃśatikatattvāni pṛthag darśitāni, ebhiḥ saha jīvātmā liṅgaśarīraṃ nityam avināśi niyataḥ sarvakālaṃ vapurgṛhe sthūlaśarīre vasati tiṣṭhatīty arthaḥ | kīdṛśas tam āha - svāntadūtavān iti | svāntaṃ manas tad eva dūto yasya sa tathā manodūta ity arthaḥ | ‘svāntaṃ hṛn mānasaṃ manaḥ’ ity abhidhānāt | sa dehī kathyate iti | sa jīvātmā dehī puruṣavyaktiḥ | dehaṃ mahadādikṛtasūkṣmaliṅgaśarīram ucyate tad asyāstīti dehī kathyate | so 'pi karmapuruṣo vācyaḥ pañcaviṃśatitamaḥ kathitaḥ | ata eva pāpapuṇyasukhaduḥkhādibhir vyāptaḥ | manasā kṛtrimaiḥ karmabandhanaiś ca baddhaḥ, etena karmapuruṣasya śarīrātmanoḥ saṃyogakārakeṇa manasā saṃyoge pāpapuṇyaṃ sukhaduḥkhādayo guṇā utpadyanta iti bhāvaḥ | ādiśabdāt icchādveṣaprayatnaprāṇāpānonmeṣabuddhimanaḥsaṅkalpavicāraṇāsmṛtivijñānādhyavasāyaviṣayopalabdhiguṇā jñātavyāḥ | nanv avikṛto jīvātmā kathaṃ vikārivastvabhivyāptaḥ ? satyaṃ, nirvikārasyāpi vikāravastusaṃyogena vikāritvaṃ syāt yathā sandhyārāśigirivikārinikarasaṃyogād aruṇaṃ gaganatalaṃ tadopamaṃ bhavati tadvad ity abhiprāyaḥ | tat liṅgaśarīre vikārāḥ pratibimbito iva tiṣṭhantīty eke bhāṣante | yathā taḍāgodake pratibimbito drumas taḍāgodakaprakampeṇa prakampātmakaḥ kathyate iti || 68-71 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ samāptikāmaḥ kathyate -- mahān ityādi | mahān buddhiḥ ahaṃkṛtir ahaṃkāraḥ, pañcatanmātrāṇi śabdādīni etāni sapta budhāḥ prakṛtiṃ vikṛtiṃ ca jaguḥ | prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ na tu kasyacit kāryam ity arthaḥ | mahattattvādayaḥ sapta mahān ahaṃkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇīti śaktiprakṛter vikṛter vikṛtāpakāryāṇīti suśrutaḥ | tathā ca granthāntare
‘indriyāṇāṃ saṃbhūtīnāṃ kāraṇatvān maharṣibhiḥ |
mahattattvādayaḥ sapta proktā vikṛtayo 'pi ca |’ atha ṣoḍaśa vikārān āha - daśendriyāṇi śrotrādīni, cittaṃ manaḥ mahadbhūtāni pañca pṛthivyādīni ete ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ jagad vyāpya sthitāḥ | vikārāḥ kāryāṇi | evaṃbhūte gṛhe jīvātmā vasatīty āha - evam amunā prakāreṇa caturviṃśatibhis tattvaiḥ siddhe vapurgṛhe jīvātmā vasati | kiṃbhūtaḥ ? niyateḥ śubhāśubhakarmaṇaḥ, nighraḥ āpannaḥ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaḥ ? svāntastavān svāntaṃ mana eva dūto yasya saḥ manodūtayukta ity arthaḥ | sa jīvātmā dehī kathyate ity āha - sa jīvātmā pāpādibhiḥ manasā kṛtrimaiḥ karmabandhanair vyāpto baddhaś ca dehī kathyate | deho 'syāstīti dehī jīvātmā ||68-71 ||

lg.l: daśendriyāṇi buddhiś ca tasya bandhāya dehinaḥ ||72||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. karmabandhanair baddhaś ceti yad uktaṃ tad idānīṃ tasya bandhanāny āha - kāmakrodhāv iti | tasya dehina iti pūrvoktasya puruṣasya kāmādayo bandhanāya bhavantīty arthaḥ | kāmo manasaḥ saṃkalpaviśeṣaḥ, tad uktaṃ - ‘strīṣu jāto manuṣyāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca puruṣeṣu vā | parasparakṛtaḥ snehaḥ kāma ity abhidhīyate’ iti | krodhas tu manaso vyādhirūpo hiṃsātmakaḥ | tathā hi ‘yadūṣmā hṛdayāñ jantoḥ samuttiṣṭhati vai sakṛt | parahiṃsātmakaḥ kleśaḥ krodha ity abhidhīyate iti | lobho gardhaḥ tṛṣṇā | tathā coktaṃ - ‘parārthaṃ parabhogāṃś ca parasāmarthyam eva ca | dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca yā tṛṣṇā jāyate lobha eva saḥ’ iti | mohas tu mithyāvabodhaḥ sarvapāpastvaṃ yathā - ?aśreyaḥśreyasor madhye bhramaṇaṃ saṃśayo bhavet | mithyājñānaṃ tu taṃ prāhur ahite hitadarśanam iti | ahaṅkāro 'bhimānavyāpāralakṣaṇaḥ | yathā - ‘aham ity abhimānena yaḥ kriyāsu pravartate | kāryakāraṇayuktasta tad ahaṅkāralakṣaṇam’ iti | daśendriyāṇi prasiddhāni buddhiś ceti manovyāpāraḥ || 72 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tasya dehino yāni bandhāya bhavanti tāny āha - tasya dehino jīvasya kāmādayo bandhāya bhavantīti yojanā || 72 ||

lg.l: āpnoti bandham ajñānād ātmajñānāc ca mucyate |

ab.seg: iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ kalādikākhyānādhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

Āḍhamalla. yena baddho muktaś ca bhavati sukhaduḥkhe ca bhavatas tatprakāram āha - idānīṃ bandhanam āha - prāpnotīti | ajñānād iti mohād bandhanaṃ kleśam āpnotīti puruṣa iti śeṣaḥ, sa eva puruṣa ātmajñānād dharmādharmavicāraṇān mucyate bandhanād eva, kaivalyaṃ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ata eva vyādhis tu duḥkhayogakṛd bhavati tat sukhāvaroham ārogyam iti tadduḥkhayogakṛd iti tat tayoḥ śarīraśarīriṇoḥ śarīramanasor iti kecit, duḥkhasaṃyogakṛd iti duḥkhaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ pratikūlavedanīyam | sukhaṃ tu svabhāvato 'nukūlavedanīyam | ārogyaṃ svāsthyavyāpāralakṣaṇam | iti sṛṣṭikramaśārīram || 73 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajena āḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ prathamakhaṇḍe kalādikākhyānaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ajñānāt karmādibhir vyāptaḥ bandhaṃ prāpnoti | ātmajñānāt tattvajñānāt mucyate janmādibhir iti śeṣaḥ | vyādhis tu taddu:khayogakṛt tasya dehinaḥ duḥkhayogaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | taddu:khasaṃyogād vyādhaya iti suśrutoktavyādhilakṣaṇatvāt ārogyaṃ tu tatsukhāvahaṃ bhavatīti sambandhaḥ | iti sṛṣṭikramakathanam || 73 ||
iti śrīśārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ śārīrakalādikathanasṛṣṭikramakathanādhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

div.head: athāhārādigatir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ | athāhārādigatir adhyāyaḥ |
yāty āmāśayam āhāraḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇānilerita: |
mādhuryaṃ phenabhāvaṃ ca ṣaḍraso 'pi labheta saḥ || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīm āhārādigatir adhyāyaḥ pūrvaṃ darśitas tam āha - atheti | yātītyādi | āhāraḥ pāñcabhautikasvarūpo 'śanam ity arthaḥ | tad uktaṃ suśrute - ‘pañcabhūtātmake‘caturdhā ṣaḍrasopeto'nekavidhyupayuktakaḥ | dvividhoṣṭavidho bījairāharaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ iti ‘ka’ pā. | dehe āhāraḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ’ iti | evaṃvidhaḥ sa āhāraḥ pūrvam ādau āmāśayaṃ yāti prāpnotīty arthaḥ | āmāśayaṃ ca nābhistanāntare koṣṭhaviśeṣam āhuḥ, yathā - ‘nābhistanāntare jantor āhur āmāśayaṃ budhāḥ’ iti | kīdṛśas tam āha -prāṇānilerita iti | prāṇavāyunā prerita iti bhāvaḥ | ‘hṛdi prāṇānilo mataḥ’ iti vacanāt | tatra ṣaḍrasayukto 'pi sa āhāro mādhuryaṃ madhurarasabāhulyaṃ phenabhāvaṃ ca labhate prāpnoti kaphasthānagatatvāt, kapho 'pi madhura iti prasiddhaḥ; ata evāha tantrāntare - bhuktvādau kaphasya vṛddhir iti rasasādharmyāt asyaivāmājīrṇasaṃjñā, yataḥ ‘mādhuryam annaṃ smṛtam āmasaṃjñam iti || 1 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yadā śarīrī jātas tadā āhārāpekṣā jātā, ata āhārapākakramam āha - yātītyādi | pūrvaṃ prathamataḥ prāṇānileritaḥ prāṇavāyupreritaḥ āhāraḥ coṣmādipañcavidhalakṣaṇaḥ āmāśayaṃ yāti nābhistanāntaram āmāśayaḥ tatra gatvā mādhuryaṃ madhurabhāvaṃ phenabhāvaṃ ca labhate | kiṃbhūtaḥ āhāraḥ ṣaḍrasaḥ | vāgbhaṭe caivaṃ ‘ādau ṣaḍarasam apy annaṃ madhurībhūtam īrayet| phenabhāvaṃ rasaṃ jātaṃ vidāhi hy amlatāṃ gatam’ iti || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha sthānāntaraprāptim āha - atha pācaketi | athānantaram sa evāmāśayasthitāhāraḥ pācakapittena pācakāgnitejasā vidagdhaḥ san pacyamānā'bhimukhaḥ sann amlatāṃ vrajet, yato 'mlāt pittaṃ jāyate tatrāvasthāyāṃ vidagdhājīrṇasaṃjñaṃ gatam amlabhāvam iti | āmāśayāc calito 'prāptagrahaṇīpado yadā bhavati tatra sthānāntaraṃ vadanty eke, naivaṃ sarvamataṃ, kintu pācakāgnisthānasamīpavartī yadā bhavati tadā vidagdho bhavatīty eke bhāṣante | svamate tu āmāśayāvasthāyām eva pittavaidagdhyād amla eva syāt yataḥ pittavidagdham amlatām upaiti | idānīṃ tṛtīyāvasthāgatasya kāryam āha - tata ityādi | tatas tasmāt sthānāt samānamarutā nābhigatavāyunā kṛtvā grahaṇīṃ vahnisthānam abhinīyate prāpyate āhāra iti śeṣaḥ | etat sthānaṃ kalāśabdena vācyaṃ yataḥ
‘ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā kalā parikīrtitā |
pakvāmāśayamadhyasthā grahaṇī sā prakīrtitā |’ iti | grahaṇyām api koṣṭhavahninā kṛtvā pācyate, koṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ dhātvagninirāsārtham | tasmāt kaṭuko jāyate iti tātparyārthaḥ | yat kaṭukāj jāyate vāyur iti tad viṣṭabdhājī- rṇanāhur ity eke | yad uktaṃ ‘kiñcid vipakvaṃ bhṛśatodaśūlaṃ viṣṭabdham ānaddhaviruddhavātam’ iti || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. amlatvaṃ ca prāpnotīty āha -- athety anantaraṃ pācakapittena vidagdhaḥ amlatāṃ vrajet tataḥ samānamarutā grahaṇī abhinīyate prāpyate | grahaṇī kalā | grahaṇyāṃ kiṃ bhavatīty āha - koṣṭhavahninā yadā grahaṇyāṃ pacyate tadā kaṭur jāyate tadvidho bhavati saṃpakvāt samyak pakvāt rasaḥ bhavati apakvād āmasaṃbhavo bhavatīti yojanā || 2 ||

lg.l: vahner balena mādhuryaṃ snigdhatāṃ yāti tadrasaḥ |
mandavahnividagdhaś ca kaṭuś cāmlo bhaved rasaḥ |
viṣabhāvaṃ vrajed vāpi kuryād vā rogasaṃkaram || 6 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha tādṛśasyāhārasya dvividhām avasthāṃ vaktum āha - rasa iti | vahnisthāne sthitasyāhārasya samyak pākād raso bhavati | asamyak pākād āmaḥ sambhavati iti | rasa iti samāgniparipācitatvāt sārabhūto yo dravāṃśaḥ sa rasa ity ucyate, āmaś ca aparipākād bhavati | tad uktaṃ ‘jaṭharānaladaurbalyād avipakvas tu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopakaḥ’ iti | idānīṃ tayo rasāmayor vyāpāraṃ darśayann āha - vahner iti | tad rasa iti pūrvoktaḥ, vahner baleneti rasagatā'gniprābalyāt madhuratāṃ snigdhatāṃ ca yāti prāpnoti sapta vākhilān raktādīn dhātūn puṣṇāti tasmāt samyak pakvo rasaḥ amṛtopamaḥ syāt | yathā ‘amṛto jīvano madhurādiguṇayuktaḥ’ iti śrutiḥ | tathāyam api jīvanadhāraṇatarpaṇādiguṇayukta ity abhiprāyaḥ saumyatvāt | tad uktaṃ suśrute - ‘sa khalu dravonusārī snehanajīvanatarpaṇadhāraṇādiviśeṣaiḥ saumya ity avagamyate’ iti | asyaiva svarūpāntaram āha - mandavahnividagdha ityādi | sa eva raso yadā mandavahnividagdho bhavati agner māndyenāsamyak pakva iti bhāvaḥ, tadā kaṭur amlo vā bhūtvā viṣabhāvaṃ māraṇaṃ māraṇātmakarūpatāṃ vrajet prāpnoti | vā yadi māraṇātmako na bhavati alpatvāt tadā rogasaṅkaraṃ rogasastaṃ kuryāt doṣadūṣitatvāt na tu svayam eva, yataḥ snehadagdhavyapadeśavat, tad uktaṃ ‘rasādistheṣu doṣeṣu vyādhayaḥ saṃbhavanti ye | te jñāyanta ity upacāreṇa tān āhur ghṛtadagdhavat’ iti ||3-6||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. punaḥ vahninā pakvaḥ kiṃ bhavatīty āha - punaḥ vahner balena pakvaḥ mādhuryaṃ snigdhatāṃ ca yāti, cet samyak pakvaḥ tadā akhilān dhātūn puṣṇāti | mandavahnipakve doṣam āha - viṣabhāvaṃ viṣasvarūpaṃ vrajet viṣūcyādibhir māraṇātmakatvāt | rogasaṃkaraṃ bahurogasamūhaṃ vā kuryāt || 3-6 ||

lg.l: śirābhis taj jalaṃ nītaṃ bastau mūtratvam āpnuyāt ||7||
tat kiṭṭaṃ ca malaṃ jñeyaṃ tiṣṭhet pakvāśaye ca tat |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athāhārasya rasasāratvaṃ nirūpya nirasasya niḥsāratvaṃ darśayann āha - āhārasyeti | āhārasya pūrvapratipāditasya yo raso viditasvarūpaḥ sa sāra ity abhihitaḥ, sāro mukhyatvena tarpaṇādikṛtatvāt sārahīna iti rasarahita āhārasyāṃśo vartate sa maladravasaṃjñaḥ | malaṃ purīṣaṃ dravaṃ mūtraṃ | tayor bhinnagamanasthānaviśeṣam āha - śirābhir ityādi | taj jalam iti purīṣaniḥsṛtaṃ dravaviśeṣaṃ śirābhir mūtravāhinībhiḥ kṛtvā bastau mūtrādhāre nītaṃ tad eva mūtrattvam āpnuyād iti bhāvaḥ | tat kiṭṭaṃ malam iti mūtrāvaśiṣṭaṃ malaṃ kiṭṭasaṃjñakaṃ jñeyaṃ nirdravatvāt tac ca pakvāśaye tiṣṭhed iti tātparyārthaḥ || atha pakvāśayasya sthitasya tādṛśasya tasyādhogamanaśīlatvaṃ darśayann āha - valīti | apānena gudasthitavāyunā noditaṃ preritaṃ malam iti śeṣaḥ, tac ca valitritayamārgeṇa kṛtvā yāti bahir niḥsaratīty arthaḥ | valitritayanāmāny āha -pravāhiṇītyādi | pravāhiṇī sarjanī grāhiketi tāsāṃ nāmabhir evākṛtayo boddhavyā: | valayas tu gudasyāvayavabhūtās tās tisro valaya uparyuparivyavasthitāḥ śaṅkhavartanibhā iti || 7 || 8 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āhārasya kaḥ sāraḥ kiṃ ca malam ity āha - āhārasya sārabhūto rasaḥ sārahīno yaḥ sa maladravo bhavati taj jalaṃ śirābhiḥ bastau nītaṃ mūtratvaṃ āpnuyāt tat kiṭṭaṃ malaṃ bhavati | tasya vyavasthām āha - tat kiṭṭaṃ tasyāhārapakvaṃ yat kiṭṭaṃ tan malaṃ jñeyam ? tat pakvāśaye tiṣṭhet | tat apānena noditaṃ valitrayamārgeṇa yāti | tasya valitritayasya nāmāny āha - atra pramāṇaṃ noktaṃ tad granthāntarād viśeṣato likhyate | tad yathā
‘gudasya mānaṃ sarvasya sārdhaṃ syāc caturaṅgulam |
tetra syur valayas tisraḥ śaṅkhavartanibhās tu tāḥ ||
pravāhaṇī bhavet pūrvā sā sārdhāṅgulasaṃmatā |
utsarjanī tu tad adhaḥ sā sārdhāṅgulasaṃmitā ||
tasyā adhaḥ saṃvaraṇī syād ekāṅgulasaṃmitā |
ardhāṅgulapramāṇaṃ tu budhair gudamukhaṃ matam |
malotsargasya mārgo 'yaṃ pāyur dehavinirmitaḥ ||7||8||

lg.l: snigdhaṃ guru calaṃ svādu vidagdhaṃ pittavad bhavet |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ maladravaṃ nirūpya sārabhūtasya rasasyāpi kāryatvena sthānāntaraprāptim āha - rasas tv iti | sa rasaḥ samānamarutā nābhigatavāyunā kṛtvā īritaḥ ūrdhvaṃ prerito hṛdayaṃ yāti prāpnoti, etena kim uktam ? sārabhūto raso grahaṇīsthānāt hṛdayam āgacchatīti bhāvaḥ | sakalaśarīragamanaśīlatvāt | tad uktaṃ suśrute - ‘sarvadehānusāritve 'pi tasya hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ sa hṛdayāc caturviṃśatidhamanīr anupraviśyordhvagā daśa daśa cādhogāminya- ścatasras tiryaggās tāḥ kṛtsnaṃ śarīram ahar ahas tarpayanti, vardhayanti, dhārayanti, yāpayanti, jīvayanti cādṛṣṭahetukena karmaṇā tasya śarīram anudhāvato 'numānād gatir upalakṣayitavyā’ iti | hṛdayaśabdopalakṣitam ojaḥsthānam ucyate | tatra so 'pi rasaḥ pittena rañjakapittena kṛtvā pācitaḥ ata eva rañjitaḥ rāgaṃ prāptaḥ san raktatāṃ yāti prāpnoti | yato rasād raktaṃ bhavatīti vacanāt | raktasya bhāvo raktatā | tena ādāv īṣadraktabhāvaṃ prāpya paścāt krameṇa āraktaḥ syāt | tad uktaṃ - ‘rasaḥ‘rasaḥ kilaikāhenaiva sampadyate dvitīye varṇābhaḥ pittasthāneṣu tiṣṭhati divase tṛtīye caturthe vā yaḥ pravarṇo bhavet pañcame'hani ṣaṣṭhe vā kiṃśukābhaḥ saptame'hani saṃprāpte śakragopakābhaḥ evaṃ saptāhādrasādraktaṃ bhavati’ pā. | 2 saptāhād arvāk parivartamānaḥ śvetakapotaharitahāridrapadmakiṃśukālaktakarasaprakhyaś cāyaṃ yathākramaṃ divasaparivartād varṇaparivartam āpadyamānaḥ pittoṣmoparāgāt śoṇitatvam āpadyate’ iti || atha raktaprādhānyaṃ darśayann āha - raktam iti | tad raktaṃ sarvaśarīrasthitaṃ bhavati pāñcabhautikatvāt, yataḥ ‘visratā dravatā rāgaḥ syandanaṃ laghutā tathā | bhūmyādīnāṃ guṇā hy ete dṛśyante cātra śoṇite’ iti | jīvasyottamam ādhāraś ceti dehamūlatvāt | tad uktaṃ - dehasya rudhiraṃ mūlaṃ rudhireṇaiva dhāryate | tasmād yatnena saṃrakṣyaṃ‘tasmādrakṣedbhi rudhiraṃ rudhiraṃ jīvamucyate’ iti pāṭhāntaram | raktaṃ jīva iti sthitiḥ iti | punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ tad āha - snigdham ityādi | snigdham arukṣaṃ, guru alaghu, calaṃ naikatrasthitiśīlaṃ dravatvāt | svādu madhuraṃ svabhāvāt yadā vidagdhaṃ tadā pittavad bhavet iti | yadā vidagdhaṃ pittam apy amlatāṃ vrajet kaṭukaṃ ca bhavet tathedam apīti bhāvaḥ | uktam anyatrā'pi ‘anuṣṇaśītaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ raktaṃ ca varṇataḥ | śoṇitaṃ guru visraṃ syād vidāhaś cāsya pittavat ? iti | kāryatvenā'pi tasya laghutā ca darśitā iti na doṣaḥ || 9 || 10 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. iti pakvo rasaḥ kutra sthitvā raktādīn karotīty āha -- samānamaruteritarasaḥ ādau hṛdayaṃ yāti tatra pittena rañjitaḥ pācitaś ca raktatāṃ yāti tatrobhayoḥ sthāne raktasya hṛdayapāke dūṣaṇaprasaṅgāt | tathā coktaṃ suśrute - ‘sa khalv āpyo raso yakṛtplīhānau prāpya rāgam upaitī’ty uktatvāt || 9 || 10 ||

lg.l: śukratvaṃ yānti māsena tathā strīṇāṃ rajo bhavet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dhātūnām utpattiparamparāpūrvakaṃ śukrasyāpi viṣayaṃ darśayann āha - pācitā iti | pittatāpena pittatejasā pācitāḥ paripācitā rasādyā dhātavaḥ krameṇa śukratvaṃ māsena yānti prāpnuvanti | rasādyā ity atra rasagrahaṇāt rasa eva śukratvaṃ prāpnoti | ata eva yātīty ekavacanaṃ kṛtam | ādigrahaṇāt raktamāṃsamedomajjāsthīnīti | eke rasādyā dhātavo māsena śukratvaṃ yāntīti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca, teṣāṃ mate tu kāryakāraṇayor abhedopacārāt na kevalaṃ śukratvaṃ strīṇām api rajo bhavet | tad uktaṃ ‘rasād eva striyā raktaṃ rajaḥsaṃjñaṃ pravartate | tad varṣādvādaśād ūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam iti | tatheti grahaṇāt śukratvam api strīṇām eva bhavati | yato dṛśyate hi tatsrāvaṇādibhiḥ prayogaiḥ, anyathā tāsāṃ saṃharṣaḥ kathaṃ syād iti | tad uktaṃ - saumyaṃ tvagāśrayaṃ svacchaṃ snigdhaṃ yonimukhodgamam | strīṇāṃ śukraṃ na garbhāya bhaved garbhāya cārtavam’ iti | māseneti | triṃśaddinair iti bhāvaḥ | triṃśaddinavivaraṇaṃ suśrutācāryeṇoktaṃ tad yathā - ‘sa khalu trīṇi trīṇi kalāsahasrāṇi pañca daśa ca kalā ekaikasmin dhātavas tiṣṭhante, evaṃ māsena rasaḥ śukrībhavati strīṇāṃ cārtavam’ iti | uktam api samuccayena darśayati -
‘aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi saṃkhyā yasmin samuccaye |
kalaikā navatiś coktā svatantraparatantrayoḥ ||’ iti viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ kalā daśabhāgaś cetyādinā māsasaṃkhyā jñātavyā | etena kim uktaṃ rasaḥ kilaikāhenaiva sampadyate anye ye dhātavas te pañcabhiḥ pañcabhir ahobhiḥ sampadyanta iti bhāvaḥ || 11||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. raktaprasaṅgena anyeṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ pakvakramam āha - pittatāpena pācitā rasādyā dhātavaḥ māsena śukratvaṃ yāntīti yojyam | tathā retaḥprakāreṇa strīṇāṃ rajaś ca māsena bhavet | viśeṣapākakramas tu dhātuvicāraṇe proktaḥ || 11 ||

lg.l: garbhaḥ saṃjāyate nāryāḥ sa jāto bāla ucyate |
ādhikye rajasaḥ kanyā putraḥ śukrādhike bhavet||13||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. garbhotpattim āha - kāmād iti | śuddhaśoṇitaśukrajo garbho nāryāḥ striyāḥ saṃjāyata iti, kutaḥ ? kāmāt, kāmo 'bhilāṣaḥ, kva ? mithunasaṃyoge, mithunaṃ dvandraṃ strīpuruṣaviṣayaṃ tasya saṃyogo melanaṃ tasmin sati | śuddhaśoṇitaśukrayor lakṣaṇaṃ ca tantrāntare yathā -
‘śaśāsṛkpratimaṃ yac ca yad vā lākṣārasopamam |
tad ārtavaṃ praśaṃsanti yad vāso na virañjayet ||
dinatrayaṃ pravṛttiś ca kurute śoṇitaṃ striyāḥ |
vyavāyasrutaśukreṇa garbhas tasyās tato bhavet || tad evā'tiprasaṅgena pravṛttam anṛtāv api | asṛgdaraṃ vijānīyād atonyad uktalakṣaṇāt’ iti || śuddhaṃ śukraṃ yathā - ‘sphaṭikābhaṃ dravaṃ snigdhaṃ madhuraṃ madhuragandhi ca | śukram icchanti kecit tu tailakṣaudranibhaṃ tathā’ iti | ‘vātādidūṣitaṃ pūti kuṇapaṃ granthirūpi ca | kṣīṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣābhyāṃ gandhiśukraṃ tu niṣphalam’ iti | garbha iti | śukraśoṇitaṃ garbhāśayastham ātmaprativikārasaṃmūrcchitaṃ garbha ity ucyate | sa jāto bāla ucyate iti | sa garbho yadā jāto bahir niḥsarati tadā bāla ity ucyate | bālaśabdaḥ kanyāpuruṣanapuṃsakeṣv api vartate | ata evāhācāryaḥ - ādhikya iti | tatra ca garbhāśaye yadā rajasa ārtavasya ādhikyaṃ bhavati tadā kanyā jāyate utpadyate ārtavādhikaśukrād ity abhiprāyaḥ | yadi śukādhikas tarhi putraḥ śukrādhikārtavād ity arthaḥ | samatveneti śukraśoṇitayoḥ sāmyena samabhāgena kṛtvā napuṃsakaṃ syāt | yathā pārameśvarīcchāsti tathaiva bhavati nātra vicāraḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ | icchety anenaiva yamalajātam api sūcitam | tad yathā - ‘bīje 'ntarvāyunā bhinne dvau jīvau kukṣim āgatau | yamāv ity abhidhīyete dharmetarapuraḥsarau’ iti|| 12 || 13 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuddhaśoṇitaśukrād garbho bhavatīty api saṃkṣepeṇāha -- yataḥ aśuddhaśukraśoṇitayor api garbho bhavati ata āha - kāmād iti | śuddhaśoṇitaśukrajaḥ śuddhagarbhaḥ yato vātādiduṣṭaretasaḥ prajotpādane na sāmarthyam iti suśrutaḥ | atra śuddhaprajotpādane na sāmarthyaṃ iti boddhavyam rogādinā aśuddhās tu prajā vātādiduṣṭaśukre 'pi janayanti janmāndhabadhirapaṃgvādisaṃbhavāt | idānīṃ rajaḥśukrādhikyena kiṃ bhavatīty āha – rajasaḥ kanyā bhavati adhike śukre vīrye puruṣaḥ bhavet dvayoḥ sāmyena napuṃsakaṃ bhavet ataḥ paraṃ pārameśvarī icchā adṛṣṭasya balavattvāt ||12-13||

lg.l: vardhayet tāvad ekaikāṃ yāvad bhavati vatsaraḥ ||15||
māṣair vṛddhis tadūrdhvaṃ syād yāvat ṣoḍaśavatsaraḥ |
tataḥ sthirā bhavet tāvad yāvad varṣāṇi saptatiḥ || 16 ||
tato bālakavan mātrā hāsanīyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ bālasya prathamamāsād ārabhya bheṣajakriyāṃ darśayann āha - bālasyeti | bālasya prathame māsi bheṣajaraktikā deyā | bālo 'tra kṣīrādaḥ yatas trividho bāla āṣoḍaśavarṣād bhavati | tatra kṣīrādaḥ | kṣīrānnādaḥ annāda iti | ata eva kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtair iti bahavo 'nupānādayo darśitāḥ yathāsambhavopayogitvena | bheṣajam atra suvarṇarajataśilājatvādikaṃ, raktikā guñjā tatparimāṇam ity arthaḥ | prathame māsīti prathamagrahaṇaṃ jātadinam ārabhya bheṣajaṃ dadyād ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā ca suśrute - ‘atha kumāraṃ śītābhir adbhir āśvāsya jātakarmaṇi kṛte madhusarpir anantacūrṇamiśram aṅgulyanāmikayā lehayet’ iti | anantacūrṇaṃ suvarṇacūrṇaṃ, ‘bheṣajaraktiketi sāmānyabheṣa- jagrahaṇena granthāntaroktam api yogacatuṣṭayam atra boddhavyam | tad yathā -
‘sauvarṇaṃ sukṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ kuṣṭaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ vacā |
matsyākhyakaḥ śaṅkhapuṣpī madhu sarpiḥ sakāñcanam ||
arkapuṣpī ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ cūrṇitaṃ kanakaṃ vacā |
hemacūrṇāni vaidūryai: śvetadūrvā ghṛtaṃ madhu || catvāro 'bhihitāḥ prāśāḥ ślokārdheṣu caturṣv api | kumārāṇāṃ vapurmedhābalabuddhivivardhanāḥ’ iti | eke prāktanāṃ mātrām anicchatām āmananti tanmate tu viśvāmitroktā mātrā pracarati | tad yathā -
‘viḍaṅgaphalamātraṃ tu jātamātrasya bheṣajam |
etenaiva pramāṇena māsi māsi pravardhitam || kolā'sthimātraṃ kṣīrāde dadyād bhaiṣajyakovidaḥ | kṣīrānnāde kolamātram annāde (u)dumbaropamam’ iti | avalehīkṛtaikaivetyādi | ekaiva raktikā avalehīkṛtā, kaiḥ kṛtvety āha - kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtair iti | etena kṣīrādibhir vyastair yathāyogyaṃ samplāvyāvacārayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | kṣīraṃ strīsambhavam, ājaṃ vā | ghṛtam atra gavyam || atha meṣajasyāsya vṛddhihrāsatvam apy āha - vardhayet tāvad ekaikām ityādi | sā bheṣajaraktikā tāvad ekaikāṃ vardhayed yāvat vatsaro bhavati | etena pratimāsavṛddhāḥ dvādaśamāseṣu dvādaśaiva raktikā bhavantīty aryaḥ | anyad apy āha - tadūrdhvam iti | vatsarād upari tāvan māṣakair vṛddhir yāvat ṣoḍaśavatsaro bhavati; etena prativarṣavṛdhdyā ṣoḍaśamāṣakā bhavantīty arthaḥ | māṣo 'tra māgadhaparibhāṣoktaḥ ṣaḍguñjāparimitaḥ | tata iti ṣoḍaśavarṣād upari tāvat sthirā syād yāvat saptativarṣāṇi bhavanti | sthireti ṣoḍaśamāṣakā na tu vṛddhiḥ | tata iti saptater ūrdhvaṃ saiva mātrā bālavac chanaiḥ śanair hrāsanīyā tena sā mātrā yathaiva pūrvaṃ vardhitā tathaivāpakarṣaṇīyā ity abhiprāyaḥ | ata eva bālavṛddhayoḥ sāmyakriyā kāryeti na tu sarveṣām | kalkacūrṇādīnām iyam eva mātrā sammatā kim utānyā vā tad āha - mātreyam ityādi | iyaṃ pūrvoktā mātrā kalkacūrṇānāṃ tadyogānāṃ ca, kaṣāyāṇāṃ caturguṇā vijñeyā | etena kim uktaṃ raktiparimāṇe catvāri raktikāḥ kāryāḥ, māṣakaparimāṇe caturmāṣaka iti || 14-17 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bālasya bheṣajapramāṇādyuttarāṃ kriyām āha - bālasya prathame māsi ekaiva bheṣajaraktikā deyā | kiṃbhūtā bheṣajamātrā kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtaiḥ avalehīkṛtā | yāvad vatsaro bhavet tāvad ekām ekāṃ raktikāṃ māsi māsi vardhayet | vatsarād ūrdhvaṃ bheṣajapramāṇam āha - tadūrdhvaṃ vatsarād ūrdhvaṃ māṣair vṛddhiḥ syāt yāvat ṣoḍaśa vatsaro bhavati tāvat, ṣoḍaśānantaraṃ sthirā mātrā bhavet yāvat saptati na vardhanam ity arthaḥ | vardhanakramam abhidhāya hrāsakramam āha - tato bālakavat ekā raktikādimātrāvat mātrā hrāsanīyā ūnā kartavyā | iyaṃ mātrā kalkacūrṇānāṃ, kaṣāyāṇāṃ etanmātrātaś caturguṇā || 14-17 ||

lg.l: añjanaṃ ca tathā lepaḥ snānam abhyaṅgakarma ca |
kavalaḥ pañcamād varṣād aṣṭamān nasyakarma ca |
virekaḥ ṣoḍaśād varṣād viṃśateś caiva maithunam || 19 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tasya bālakasyāñjanādikaṃ karma nidarśayann āha - añjanam iti | bālakasyāñjanādi pratimarśaparyantaṃ janmaprabhṛtir eva praśasyate, janmadinād ārabhya yad yatra vihitaṃ tat tatra kuryād iti bhāvaḥ | añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanādikaṃ, lepam udvartanaprabhṛtikaṃ, snānaṃ pariṣekaḥ, abhyaṅgaṃ abhyañjanam, vamanaṃ vāntiḥ, pratimarśena bṛṃhaṇam iti | aparāṇy āha - kavala ityādi | kavalo gaṇḍūṣabhedaḥ, sa tu pañcamād varṣād upari kāryo na tu tadarvāk | nasyakarmeti | nāsāyāṃ yad dīyate tan nasyam iti, tasya karma kriyā caturthe, tac cāṣṭamād varṣād upari kāryaṃ, ṣoḍaśavarṣād upari vireko deyaḥ, viśeṣeṇa reko vireka ity anena apūrṇavīryasya koṣṭhasya recanasya niṣedhaḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣābhyantare bhavati | na tu mṛdurecanasya niṣedhaḥ | tad uktaṃ ‘agnikṣāravirekais tu bālavṛddhau vivarjayet |’ tat sādhyeṣu vikāreṣu ‘mṛdvīṃ kuryāl laghukriyām’ iti | viṃśateś caiva maithunam iti | maithunaṃ strīpuruṣasaṃyogalakṣaṇaṃ tac ca viṃśativarṣād upari samānavīryatvaṃ syād ity āha | tathā ca - ‘pañcaviṃśatitame varṣe pumān nārī tu ṣoḍaśe | samatvāgatavīryau tu jānīyāt kuśalo bhiṣak’ iti || 18 || 19 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. añjanādīnām api kartavyatāyāṃ vidhānam āha - etad añjanādyaṃ bālānāṃ janmaprabhṛti śasyate pratimarśo nasyabhedaḥ mṛdu na tu tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇasya aṣṭamā- bdād abhidhānāt | idānīṃ kavalādīnāṃ vidhānam āha - kavalaḥ gaṇḍūṣaḥ, pañcamād varṣāt kartavyaḥ tasya karma aṣṭamāt karyavyaṃ virekaḥ ṣoḍaśād varṣāt kartavyaḥ, maithunaṃ strīprasaṅgaḥ viṃśateḥ kartavyaḥ || 18 || 19 ||
