div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pramathyāvidhijñānārthaṃ atraiva pramathyādaya ucyante | dravyapalāt kalkīkṛtāj jalena saha piṣṭān aṣṭa- guṇitatoye śṛtāt sā pramathyā maṇḍaviśeṣaḥ procyate tasyāḥ pānaphalam āha | sā yathā sugamam || 150-151 || iti pramathyā|

ab.seg:
idānīṃ yavāgūparibhāṣām āha -
sādhyaṃ catuṣpalaṃ dravyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale 'mbunijale pā. | |
tatkāthenārdhaśiṣṭena yavāgūṃ sādhayed dhanām || 152 ||

sā yathā -
āmrāmrātakajambūtvakkaṣāye vipaced budhaḥ |
yavāgūṃ śālibhir yuktāṃ tāṃ bhuktvā grahaṇīṃ jayet ||153||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. sādhyam iti | iyaṃ dravyakvāthe taṇḍulādibhiḥ paripācikā yavāgūśabdavācyā | catuḥṣaṣṭipale 'mbunīti dravyabhāgāt ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ | ghanām ity anena śālyādinā sādhayet yāvat dravarahitā syāt | ata eva taṇḍulādīnāṃ parimāṇam anumānato nirūpaṇīyam | na tu annaprakṛtyoktāyā mānam | yathā - “pañcakolena saṃsiddhā yavāgūr dīpanī tathā | balāmūlakaṣāyeṇa sādhitā grāhiṇī matā” iti | atrāpi mānaṃ doṣādyapekṣayānumānato nirūpaṇīyam | atra catuḥpalagrahaṇaṃ yat tat sāmānyaṃ viśeṣato nyūnam api dṛśyate | tathā ca tantrāntare - “vṛddhavaidyā: palaṃ dravyaṃ grāhayanty āḍhake 'mbhasi | bheṣajasyātibāhulyāt kadācid arucir bhavet” iti | atha sā yathety anena tasyāḥ svarūpam āha - āmreti | āmro vṛkṣaviśeṣo vikhyātaḥ āmrātakas tadbhedaḥ, rājāmra iti kecit | jambūḥ prasiddha eva, eṣāṃ tvak challī grāhyā kaṣāya iti grahaṇena svarasādayo 'pi pañcakaṣāyās tair api kṛtāyāṃ na doṣo vyavahārāt | yataḥ - pañcakolabalādīnāṃ kalkarasenaiva sādhitā bahavo yavāgavo dṛśyante | bāhulyaṃ ca dravyaguṇāvalyām uktaṃ yathā -“yair yair evauṣadhaguṇair yavāgū: sādhu sādhitā | tāṃs tān evauṣadhaguṇān puṣṇāti vidhiyojitā” iti budha iti grahaṇenānnādiparimāṇena randhanavidhau dakṣa ity arthaḥ || 152 || 153 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha yavāgū: catuṣpalaṃ dravyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale 'mbuni jale sādhyam ardhaśiṣṭena kvāthena ca yavāgūṃ sādhayet | sā yathā - āmraṃ, āmrātakam ambarātakā jambū prasiddhaḥ, eṣāṃ tvak catuḥṣaṣṭipale jale sādhyam ardhaśiṣṭe jale śālitaṇḍulacatuṣpalasādhyaṃ sā yavāgūḥ bhavati tāṃ bhuktvā grahaṇīṃ jayet || 152 || 153 ||iti dravyakṛtayavāgū: ||

ab.seg:
saṃprati yūṣam āha -
kalkadravyapalaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī cārdhakārṣikī |
vāriprasthena vipacet sa dravo pūṣa ucyate || 154 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. ayaṃ dravyakṛtayūṣo 'pi vikhyāta eva | kīdṛśaḥ ? tatparibhāṣām apy ādāv āha - kalkadravyam iti | kalkārhaṃ dravyaṃ tac ca dhānyamūlakaśuṇṭhikādikaṃ | yathā śuṇṭhī pippalī cārdhakārṣikī pratyekaṃ tīkṣṇatvāt | kecit tu śuṇṭhī pippalīcūrṇaṃ paścāt prakṣepe kṣipanti | vāriprastheneti dravadvaiguṇyāt dvātriṃśatpalamitena jalena sa dravo dravaprāyaḥ | atrāpy annaparimāṇādikaṃ yan noktaṃ tad anumānato grāhyaṃ, yad vā jalānusārato randhanavidhida- kṣasakāśād dṛṣṭaparipākaparipāṭyā kuryād ity aryaḥ |

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha yūṣaḥ | yūṣe rulkadvayasya palaṃ deyaṃ, śuṇṭhī pippalī ced ardhakārṣikasamuditā deyā, vāriprasthena vipacet, sa dravaḥ jalamātraḥ yūṣaḥ ucyate | sa yathā kulatthādibhir yuktaiḥ kṛtaḥ yūṣaḥ śleṣmānilāpaho bhavati yavo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, kolaṃ badaraṃ, mūlakaśuṇṭhaṃ śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍam | śeṣaṃ sugamam | muṣṭipalamātraṃ, saptānāṃ

ab.seg:
saptamuṣṭiyūṣaḥ | sa yathā -
kulatthayavakolaiś ca mudgair mūlakaśuṇṭhakaiḥ |
śuṇṭhīdhānyākayuktaiś ca yūṣaḥ śleṣmānilāpahaḥ ||155||

Āḍhamalla. sa yathety anena vakṣyamāṇasaptamuṣṭikayūṣavidhi darśayann āha - kulattha iti | ayaṃ satamuṣṭikasaṃjñako yūṣaḥ prasiddha eva | kulattho 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, kolaṃ badaraphalaṃ, mūlakaśuṇṭhakair iti laghumūlakaśuṇṭhaiḥ śuṇṭham atra nālagranthiḥ | mūlakapotiketi kecid guṇaprābalyāt | tathā hi - ”kaṭutiktarasā hṛccā rocanī vahnidīpanī | sarvadoṣaharā laghvī kaṇṭhyā mūlakapotikā iti | dhānyākaṃ kustumburu, saptamuṣṭika ity anena kulatthādīnāṃ muṣṭisaptakaṃ grāhyaṃ, tantrāntaradarśanāt yathā - ekaikamuṣṭim āhṛtya ityādi muṣṭimukhāntarmuṣṭiḥ na tu muṣṭipalam, ayam eva pakṣaḥ kaiścid ādriyate | cakras tu pratyekam eṣāṃ palaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvasammatatvāt | nanu sakalam eva dravyam ucitamātrayānvitaṃ, yat kvāthavidhānena yūṣaḥ kriyate tad asmatsaṃpradāye na manoharaṃ, kiṃtu vyavahārāt kartavyavidhau yavakulatthamudgā anyadravyāpekṣayā bahu deyāḥ śuṇṭhyāś cūrṇaṃ paścāt kaṭukārthaṃ tāvad deyaṃ yāvat kaṭumātraṃ syāt | evam amlārthaṃ badarādīnāṃ dānaṃ, kvātho dhānyakamūlakaśuṇṭhayoḥ pṛthak palaparimitayoś ca dānam iti kartavyavidhiḥ sādhuḥ | kaṇṭhahṛdvakrāṇāṃ viśodhana iti | kaṇṭhaviśodhanaḥ hṛdviśodhanaḥ vakraviśodhanaś ca | viśodhanaṃ kaphasyety arthaḥ ||154-156||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. muṣṭimātraprayogād ayaṃ saptamuṣṭikaḥ | eke tu saptamuṣṭiprayogāt saptamuṣṭikāḥ, yataḥ yūṣakriyāyā yūṣadravyasya palamātragṛhītatvāt anye saptānām ekaikamuṣṭim ādāya pacet toye caturguṇe tatraivaṃ vyākhyātaṃ pratyekam eṣāṃ sakṣamuṣṭim āhṛtya na tu muṣṭiḥ palaṃ, dravyatvād ayam eva pakṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ | cakras tu pratyekam eṣāṃ palaṃ dravyabahutvaṃ vyavahāradravyatvān na doṣaḥ | iti saptamuṣṭiyūṣaḥ || 154-156 || iti dravyakṛtayūṣaprakriyā ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ pānādikalpanām āha -
kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ sādhyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale jale |
ardhaśiṣṭaṃ ca tad deyaṃ pāne bhaktādisaṃvidhau || 157 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kṣuṇṇam iti | iyaṃ pānādikalpanāyāḥ paribhāṣā | kṣuṇṇaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ, dravyaṃ vyādhivihitaṃ‘vidhi’ pā.| , sādhyaṃ kvathitam | tad iti dravaṃ ardhāvaśeṣitaṃ jalam ity arthaḥ | pāne iti pānasvarūpe yathā vakṣyamāṇaṃ ṣaḍaṅgādipānīyam | bhaktādisaṃvidhāv iti yūṣarasayavāgvādirūpe |
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pānādikalpanā | bhaktādisaṃvidhau pāne bhojanādau auṣadhapānārtham | etad dhimalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ |

ab.seg:
ṣaḍaṅgapānam | sā‘sā’ pānādikalpanā ityartha:| yathā -
uśīraparpaṭodīcyamustanāgaracandanaiḥ |
jalaṃ śṛtaṃ himaṃ peyaṃ pipāsājvaranāśanam || 158 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. sā yatheti vākyena pānādikārthaṃ prakriyāṃ prakaṭayati granthakāraḥ | uśīreti | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅgasaṃjñakaḥ | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ, himaṃ śītasparśaṃ, peyam iti vāraṃ vāram yataḥ - ‘muhur muhuś ca tṛṭchardihikvāśvāsagareṣu ca’ iti vacanāt | atrodīcyaṃ vālakaṃ, pānīyaṃ śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, candanaṃ raktam | eṣāṃ yogo jvarādau yuktaḥ | tathā hi ”ṣaḍaṅgādeḥ śṛtaṃ toyaṃ deyam ādau jvarasya vai” || 157 || 158 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sā yathā uśīrādibhiḥ pūrvakriyāśṛtaṃ toyaṃ himaṃ himasaṃjñaṃ jñeyaṃ pipāsājvaranāśakaṃ bhavati | parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ, udīcyaṃ bālakaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat || 157 || 158 || iti pānādikalpanā ||

ab.seg:
jvarādau uṣṇodakavidhiṃ darśayann āha --
aṣṭamenāṃśaśeṣeṇa caturthenārdhakena vā |
athavā kathanenaiva siddham uṣṇodakaṃ vadet || 159 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. aṣṭameneti | yat kevalam eva pānīyam aṣṭamāṃśādikalpanayā siddhaṃ bhavati tad uṣṇodakam iti saṃjñaṃ vaded iti | aṃśaśeṣeṇāṣṭādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate; tena aṣṭāṃśena caturthāṃśenārdhāṃśenety arthaḥ | aṃśas tv atra kvathanāvaśiṣṭaḥ | athavety anena pakṣāntaram āha | kvathanenaivetyādi | kvathanam ity atra tripādaśeṣam ity arthaḥ | etat kriyācatuṣṭayaṃ doṣāpekṣayābhihitam | tathā hi - “tatpādahīnaṃ pittaghnaṃ taccheṣam anilāpaham | ardhaṃ kṣayakaphaharaṃ śeṣaṃ grāhi tridoṣajit” iti | nanu yathaivaṃ tarhi suśrutena “tatpādahīnavātaghnam ardhahīnaṃ tu pittajit | kaphaghnaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ ca pānīyaṃ dīpanaṃ smṛtam” iti katham etad viparītam uktam ? | satyam | ādyaḥ pakṣo vyavahārī sa ca jvaradīnāṃ doṣaprakope praśastaḥ, dvitīyas tu ṣaḍṛtuṣu doṣāpekṣayā'bhihitaḥ | suśrute uktaṃ ca
“śāradaṃ cārdhapādonaṃ pādahīnaṃ tu haimakam |
śiśire ca vasante ca grīṣme pādāvaśeṣitam | viparītam ṛtuṃ dṛṣṭvā vārṣikaṃ cāṣṭabhāgikam” iti | yad virodhaparihāraḥ kṛtas tat sādhubhir vicāraṇīyaḥ atra vistarabhayān na likhitaḥ | siddham iti yad grahaṇaṃ laghūktikvathananimittam | yataḥ “yat kvāthyamānaṃ nirvegaṃ niṣphenaṃ nirmalaṃ tathā | śṛtaśītaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ vāṣpāntarbhāvaśītalam” iti | anyathā doṣakaraḥ syāt | tathā hi - “dhārāpātena viṣṭambhi durjaraṃ pavanāhṛtam | śṛtaśītaṃ punas taptaṃ tat sarvaṃ doṣalaṃ smṛtam” iti | athoṣṇodakasya niśi pītasya guṇam āha - kāseti | etad uṣṇodakaṃ yadā niśi pītaṃ tadā śleṣmādikān hantīti | uṣṇodakaṃ vaded iti | īṣaduṣṇam uṣṇodakaṃ kathitaṃ | vātamedoghnam iti vātaghnaṃ medoghnaṃ ca | śleṣmāmavātamedoghnam iti vā pāṭhāntaram | bastiśodhanaṃ mūtrāśayaśuddhikaraṃ, dīpanam agneḥ | pītam uṣṇodakam iti | īṣaduṣṇaṃ pītam | niśīti niśāmukhe śayanakāle vā na tu sakalaniśāyāṃ muhur muhuḥ pānaṃ tatra niṣedhaparatvāt | tathā hi - “yathā divā tathā rātrau yadi toyaṃ piben naraḥ | bhavet tatra rasādhikyaṃ taccheṣād doṣakopanam” iti satyam | eṣa svasthe prasaṅga iti vartate vyavahārād āture na kutracit pratiṣedhaḥ | tathā hy uktam - “pānīyaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇā viśvam eva ca tanmayam | ato 'tyantaniṣedhena na kvacid vāri vāryate” iti || 159 || 160 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha jvarādau uṣṇodakavidhi: | aṣṭamenāṃśena caturthena caturthāṃśaśeṣe ardhakenārdhāṃśaśeṣeṇa athavā kvathanena kvathitamātreṇa siddham uṣṇodakaṃ vadet uṣṇodakaṃ niśi pītaṃ śleṣmāmavātādīn hantīti yojanā | atrānukramam api granthāntarāt jvarādau uṣṇajalavidhānam āha - kaphavātajvarā iti | kaphajvare vātajvare kaphavātajvare vā vyaste samaste vā uṣṇam ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ deyaṃ, “ardhāvaśiṣṭatoyaṃ yat tad uṣṇodakam ucyate” ity uktatvāt pittamadyaviṣotthajvareṣu tiktakaiḥ smṛtaṃ śītalaṃ deyaṃ, tiktakaśṛtas tu ṣaḍaṅgakas taruṇajvare tasyaiva vidhānāt, tathā coktaṃ
‘tiktaparpaṭakośīracandanodīcyanāgaraiḥ |
śṛtaśītaṃ jalaṃ dadyāt pipāsājvaraśāntaye’ | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅgas tiktakaḥ smṛtaḥ, asyaiva taruṇajvare vidhānam uktaṃ suśrute - “laṅghanaṃ kārayet kāle yāvanas tiktako rasaḥ | pācanāny apy apakvānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ taruṇajvare” suśrutād etat | svedanaṃ taruṇajvare niṣiddham api sannipātajvare vihitatvād uktaṃ kālo 'pi pāvanatvena gṛhītas tathā vātakaḥ saptarātreṇetyādi | anya evam āhuḥ
“pādaśeṣaṃ ca vātaghnam ardhaśeṣaṃ ca pittajit |
kaphaghnaṃ pādāśeṣaṃ syāt pānīyaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu” | iti madanavinodāt || 159 || 160|| ity uṣṇodakavidhi: ||

idānīṃ kṣīrapākavidhim āha -
kṣīram aṣṭaguṇaṃ dravyāt kṣīrān nīraṃ caturguṇam |
kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ tat pītaṃ śūlam āmodbhavaṃ jayet || 161 || pañcamūlapayaḥ |
(sarvajvarāṇāṃ jīrṇānāṃ kṣīraṃ bhaiṣajyam uttamam |
śvāsāt kāsāc chiraḥśūlāt pārśvaśūlāt sapīnasāt ||162||
mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ payaḥ | trikaṇṭakapayaḥ |
trikaṇṭakabalāvyāghrīguḍanāgarasādhitam || 163 ||
varcomūtravibandhaghnaṃ kaphajvaraharaṃ payaḥprakṣiptam |)

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. kṣīram iti | kṣīram atra gavyam | atrānuktatvāt | dravyam iti śuṇṭhīvitunnakādikam anyato darśanāt | tathā hi -“śuṇṭhīvitunnakairaṇḍaśṛtaṃ śūlaharaṃ payaḥ” iti | kartavyatāsya dravyāṇāṃ bhāgaikaṃ yathā doṣāpekṣayā parimitaṃ kṣīrasya bhāgāṣṭakaṃ, pānīyaṃ dvātriṃśadbhāgayutam | etat sakalaṃ kvāthya kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ vastreṇa saṃsrāvya pibet | pānamānaṃ cāsya kvāthavad boddhavyam | doṣānusārato vā | āmodbhavaṃ śūlam iti | āmaśūlaṃ nanu āmavātajanitapīḍāṃ tatra kṣīrasya niṣiddhatvāt | tad uktam - “dadhimatsyaguḍakṣīrapotakīmāṣapiṣṭakam | varjayed āmavātārto māṃsam ānūpajaṃ tathā” iti | āmaḥ aparipakvo 'nnarasaḥ | tathā hi - “jaṭharānaladaurbalyād avipakvas tu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopajaḥ” iti | kecid atrāmaśūlaṃ pariṇāmajaṃ śūlam āmananti etad api saṅgatam | dravyād iti sāmānyagrahaṇenānyeṣām api kṣīrayogānāṃ vidhānam eva boddhavyam | yathā - “bastiśuddhikarāvāpaṃ caturguṇajalaṃ payaḥ | āvārināśāt kvathitaṃ śukrodāvartanāśanam” iti | etad api prasaṅgato vyācaṣṭe | atra bastiśuddhikarāṇi tṛṇapañcamūlīvīratarvādīni āvāpa iha kṣīraśodhanārthaṃ kalkaḥ | tathā hy uktam -
“kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaro darbha ikṣuś ceti tṛṇodbhavam |
pittakṛcchraharaṃ pañcamūlaṃ bastiviśodhanam || etat siddhaṃ payaḥ pītaṃ meḍhragaṃ hanti śoṇitam” iti ||161-163||

div.ab:
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kṣīrapākavidhiḥ | dravyam auṣadhaṃ tathā ca vṛndaḥ -
“pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pippalī vāpi tacchṛtaṃ |
śiṃśipā gaṇḍikā nimbā dhāroṣṇaṃ vājvarāpaham” | śiṃśipāyā: gaṇḍikā na bhinnaṃ dravyaṃ śiṃśipāyāḥ suśrute sāro gṛhītaḥ, tathā ca
‘udakāddviguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ śiṃśipāsārasaṃyutaṃ |
kvāthitaṃ kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca sarvajvaragadāpaham’ ||161-1 63|| iti kṣīrapākavidhiḥ ||

ab.seg:
saṃprati yavāgūprabhṛtikānnaprakriyām āha -
athānnaprakriyātraiva procyate nātivistarāt || 164 ||

lg.l: yavāgūḥ ṣaṅguṇajale siddhā syāt kṛśarā ghanā |
taṇḍulair mudgamāṣaiś ca tilair vā sādhitā hitā || 165 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athānneti | athety anantaram | annaprakriyeti yavāgūvilepīpeyādirūpā | atrāsmin granthe nātivistarāt saṃkṣepamātrāt, yato vistarakathanaṃ sarveṣām apy ālasyakaraṃ bhavati | teṣu pūrvaṃ yavāgūvidhim āha - yavāgūr ityādi | ṣaḍguṇe jale pānīye yā siddhā sā yavāgūśabdavācyā, ṣaḍguṇam ity annaparimāṇāt | eṣā taṇḍulair eva sādhyā vyavahārāt tathā sādhyā yathā viraladravā bhavati | yataḥ - ‘yavāgūr vidravā’ iti vacanāt | asyā bhedaḥ kṛśareti nāmnā kathitā, sā ghanā dravarahitā ity arthaḥ | iyam api taṇḍulādibhiḥ sādhitā bhavati atra mudgamāṣaiś ceti cakārāt vyastaṃ grāhyaṃ tena mudgasādhitā māṣasādhitā vā | tilāny atrobhayatra yojyāni | tantrāntare 'pi tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtā yavāgūr eva kṛśarā kathyate | kecid anuktatvāt tilamāṣataṇḍulānām atra sāmyaṃ manyante, tan na manoharam, kintu vyavahārāt taṇḍulānāṃ bhāgadvayaṃ, māṣasya bhāgaikam, ardhabhāgikaṃ tilānām iti | sakalebhyaḥ ṣaḍguṇajalam ity arthaḥ | yavāgūr iti sāmānyenāsyā bahavo bhedāḥ santi | tad yathā dugdhataṇḍulayavāgū:, ghṛtataṇḍulayavāgūḥ, māṃsataṇḍulayavāgūḥ, phalakandataṇḍulayavāgūr ity etāḥ sarvā yavāgvo dravyā'nusārato guṇakarāḥ sādhanīyāś ca bhavanti | idānīṃ tasyā guṇam āha - yavāgūr ityādi | grāhiṇī saṃgrāhikā atīsārādīnāṃ, balyā balakāriṇī ojovṛddhikarīty arthaḥ | tarpaṇī dhātūnāṃ tṛptijananī | vātapraṇāśinī ceti svabhāvāt ||164||1 65||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athānnaprakriyā | ṣaḍguṇe jale siddhā yavāgū: syāt | tataḥ ghanā kṛśarā syāt, sā taṇḍulair mudgamāṣaiś ca tilair vā sādhitā vātādīnāṃ, kṛśarānnaprakārabhedabhinnā ||164||65||ity annaprakriyāyāṃ yavāgū ||

ab.seg:
atha vilepīvivaraṇaṃ darśayann āha -
vilepī ghanasikthā syāt siddhā nīre caturguṇe ||166||

Āḍhamalla. vilepīti | yā caturguṇe nīre pānīye siddhā niṣpannā sā vilepīśabdavācyā | svarūpeṇa ghanasikthā bhavati caturguṇanīratvāt | caturguṇam ity atra annaparimāṇāt | iyam apy atra kevalaṃ taṇḍulaiḥ siddheti rūḍhi: | asau gulahathīti loke kathitā | guṇān apy asyā darśayann āha - tarpaṇītyādi | tarpaṇī tṛptijanikā, hṛdyety āhlādakāriṇī, madhurā miṣṭarasā, ata eva pittavināśini vihitā || 166 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vilepītyādi spaṣṭam || 166 |

ab.seg:
idānīṃ peyāyūṣāv apy āha -
dravādhikā svalpasikthā caturdaśaguṇe jale ||167||

lg.l: siddhā peyā budhair jñeyā yūṣaḥ kiṃcid ghanas tataḥ |
yūṣo balyas tataḥ kaṇṭhyo laghupākaḥ kaphāpahaḥ |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. dravādhikā iti | yā caturdaśaguṇe jale siddhā bhavati sā peyā jñeyā | svarūpeṇa ca sā dravādhikā svalpasikthā| kecit sa bhaktamaṇḍa iti vadanti | maṇḍas tu siktharahita iti prasiddhaḥ | tathā hi -
“yavāgū: ṣaḍguṇe toye saṃsiddhā viraladravā |
caturguṇāmbusaṃsiddhā vilepī ghanasikthakā || peyā sikthānvitā toye caturdaśaguṇe kṛtā | maṇḍaś caturdaśaguṇe siddhas toye sasikthakaḥ” iti | yūṣam apy āha - tata iti | tasmāt peyā rūpadravyāt yaḥ kiñcid ghanasāndro bhavati sa yūṣa ity ucyate | eṣa yūṣaḥ kevalamudgaiḥ kṛtaḥ iti sāmānyenāsya kecit | yato mudgarasa iti loke atrāpi caturdaśaguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyam | annaparimāṇāt yūṣa iti sāmānyenāsya bahavo bhedāḥ santi te cāṣṭādaśaguṇe jale sādhyā iti tantrāntarīyamatam | tathā hi “syād dhitaḥ sādhito yūṣas tv aṣṭādaśaguṇe jale” iti | guṇam anayor vaktum āha - peyā laghutaretyādi | laghutarā atyarthaṃ laghupākā, grāhiṇī grāhikā atisārādīnāṃ | nanu dravam annam atīsāre niṣiddhaṃ | yad uktam | “varjayed vidalaṃ śūlī kuṣṭhī māṃsaṃ kṣayī striyam | dravam annam atīsārī sarvaṃ ca taruṇajvarī” tat kathaṃ peyā'tīsāre vihitā ? ucyate, avihitadravā'nnaniṣedhārthaṃ vākyam idam, peyāyavāgvādivihitam eva | tathā coktaṃ suśrute “kāryaṃ cānaśanasyānte pradravaṃ laghubhojanam” iti | atra pradravaṃ prakṛṣṭadravaṃ, laghu yavāgvādi | tathaiva niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ bhojenā'pyuktam “vraṇodarasthāpanapātitānāṃ pramehiṇāṃ chardyātisāriṇāṃ ca | dravaṃ na dayād athavāpi koṣṇaṃ svalpaṃ hitaṃ bheṣajasaṃprayuktam” iti | yūṣo 'pi balyo balakaraḥ, kaṇṭhyaḥ kaṇṭhe hitaḥ, pāke laghuḥ kaphāpahaś ca ata evātra mudgayūṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaś ca kathitaḥ | tathā hi “kaphaghno dīpano hṛdyaḥ śuddhānāṃ vraṇinām api | uktaḥ pathyatamaś cāpi mudgayūṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaḥ” iti || 167 || 168 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. peyāyūṣau kṛtānnabhedau || 167 || 168 || iti peyāyūṣau ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ bhaktavidhim āha -
jale caturdaśaguṇe taṇḍulānāṃ catuṣpalam ||169 ||

lg.l: vipacet srāvayen maṇḍaṃ sa bhakto madhuro laghuḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. jala iti | taṇḍulānāṃ catuṣpalaṃ kuḍavamitaṃ grāhyam | caturdaśaguṇe pānīye vipācya tad dravaṃ pānīyo 'vaśiṣṭaḥ sa bhakta iti prasiddhaḥ | guṇo 'pi rase madhuraḥ, pāke laghur iti | etad bahujalaparimāṇaṃ parisrutārtham | na tu tantrāntare bhaktaṃ pañcaguṇe sādhyam iti | tathā hi - “śṛtaṃ pañcaguṇe bhaktaṃ vilepīti caturguṇe” iti | tat kathaṃ caturdaśaguṇam atra jalam ? ucyate - bhaktaṃ dvividhaṃ sudhautaprasrutam adhautāsrutaṃ ca, yat sudhautaprasrutaṃ tac ca caturdaśaguṇe jale sādhyam, adhautāsrataṃ ca pañcaguṇe iti bhāvaḥ | tathā coktam - “sudhautaprasrutaṃ coṣṇaṃ viśadaṃ guṇavan matam | adhautaprasrutaṃ śītaṃ guru vṛṣyaṃ kaphapradam” iti ||169||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. jala iti sarvaṃ sugamam || 169 ||

adhunā śuddhamaṇḍamāha -
nīre caturdaśaguṇe siddho maṇḍas tv asikthakaḥ ||170||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. nīre iti | caturdaśaguṇe nīre taṇḍulaparimāṇāt siddho niṣpannaḥ | asikthaka iti siktho bhaktāvayavaḥ tena rahita ity arthaḥ | ya īdṛśaḥ maṇḍasaṃjñayā prasiddhaḥ | eṣa yadā śuṇḍīsaindhavacūrṇena prakṣiptas tadā pācana āmādīnām, dīpano jaṭharāgneś ca smṛtaḥ kathita ity arthaḥ.| ayam abhṛṣṭataṇḍulair janitaḥ | ata eva śuddhamaṇḍo 'bhihitaḥ | yato maṇḍas tantrāntare trividho darśitaḥ | tad yathā
“maṇḍas tu trividho jñeya ekadvitriparisrutaḥ |
lājair bhṛṣṭair abhṛṣṭaiś ca taṇḍulaiḥ parisaṃskṛtaḥ | catustriṃśadguṇaṃ bhaktāt pūrvaḥ pūrvo laghur hitaḥ” iti ||170|| iti śuddhamaṇḍaḥ ||

ab.seg:
athāṣṭaguṇamaṇḍam āha --
dhānyatrikaṭusindhūtthamudgataṇḍulayojitaḥ‘yuktastakreṇa’ pā.| || 171 ||

lg.l: bhṛṣṭaś ca hiṅgutailābhyāṃ sa maṇḍo 'ṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. dhānyeti | dhānyādibhir dravyaiḥ saṃskṛto hiṅgutailābhyāṃ saha bhṛṣṭo bharjitaḥ sa maṇḍo 'ṣṭaguṇasaṃjñaḥ kathitaḥ | atra taṇḍulamudgayor dānam annaprakaraṇād avagantavyam | tathā ca tantrāntare “sutaṇḍulānāṃ prasṛtidvayaṃ ca tadardhamudgāḥ kaṭukatrayaṃ ca | kustumbarīsaindhavahiṅgutakrair ebhiḥ samastaiḥ kriyate ca maṇḍaḥ” ityādi | atra yat śārṅgadhareṇa tailagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat bharjanārthaṃ taṇḍulamudgayoḥ | anyatrāpy uktam
“taṇḍulair ardhamudgāṃśaiḥ kiṃcid bhṛṣṭaiḥ supācitaḥ |
hiṅgusindhū- tthadhanikātakratrikaṭusaṃskṛtaḥ || jñeyaḥ so 'ṣṭaguṇo maṇḍo jvaradoṣatrayāpahaḥ” ityādi | kecit kartavyavidhau cāsya kaṭukatrayacūrṇaṃ paścāt prakṣepe manāg deyam iti vadanti | sa maṇḍa iti sthāne sa bhakta ity apare paṭhanti; tanmate tu īṣatsikthayuta ity arthaḥ, gato 'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ | aṣṭaguṇa iti yat pūrvaṃ tān āha - dīpana ityādi | agner dīpanaḥ, prāṇado balakaraḥ, bastiśodhano bastiśuddhikaraḥ, bastir mūtrādhāraḥ, ata eva mūtralo vikhyātaḥ | raktavardhana iti śoṇitavṛddhi- karaḥ | jvarajit sarvajvaraharaḥ prabhāvāt | sarvadoṣaghna iti vātapittakaphānāṃ pratyekaṃ hantā na tu sannipātajvaraharaḥ aṣṭasaṃjñatvāt | tathā ca tantrāntare
“kṣuddīpano bastiviśodhanaś ca prāṇaprado raktavivardhanaś ca |
jvarāpahārī kaphapitta- hantā vāyuṃ jayed aṣṭaguṇo hi maṇḍaḥ” || 171 || 172 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha maṇḍaḥ | asikthakaḥ siktharahitaḥ dhānyādibhir yojitaḥ hiṅgutailābhyāṃ bhṛṣṭaś ca sa maṇḍo 'ṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ kathitaḥ | aṣṭau dīpanādayo guṇā yasya sudīpanādvayo jvarāntāḥ pañca | sarvadoṣaghna iti vātapittakaphaghneti tritayaṃ evam aṣṭaguṇaḥ | taṇḍulaṃ mudraṃ palamātraṃ, dhānyaṃ trikaṭusindhūtthaṃ yathāparimitam | anye 'ṣṭaguṇamaṇḍam evāhuḥ, sugamam anyat || 171 || 172 || ity aṣṭaguṇamaṇḍa: ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ vāṭyamaṇḍam āha -
sukaṇḍitais tathā bhṛṣṭair vāṭyamaṇḍo yavair bhayet ||173||

Āḍhamalla. sukaṇḍitair iti | ayaṃ vāṭyamaṇḍo dalitayavagodhūmādikṛto vyakta eva tathā'pi kiñcid vyācaṣṭe sukaṇḍitair iti | musalādibhir ulūkhale saṅkuṭṭitaiḥ tuṣavarjitair ity aryaḥ | tathā bhṛṣṭair iti bharjitaiḥ | tatheti grahaṇena yathā na dagdhair ity arthaḥ | īdṛśaiḥ yavaiḥ, yavo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, bahuvacanatvena godhūmādayo grāhyāḥ | sa ca kaphapittaharaḥ, kaphaharaḥ pittaharaś ca | saṃyogaharo vā | kaṇṭhya iti kaṇṭharogebhyo hitaḥ | raktapittaprasādan iti prakarṣeṇa sādayati iti sādanaḥ kupitāsrapittaśāntikara ity arthaḥ, na tu raktapittapravṛddhikaraḥ | tathā hi “vāṭyamaṇḍo laghur grāhī śūlānāhāsrapittajit” iti| kecid iti vyākhyānayanti | prakupitaṃ raktapittaṃ nirmalaṃ karoti svaprakṛtisthitaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | apare raktapittaniṣūdana iti paṭhanti | tad yaktam || 173 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ | sukaṇḍitaiḥ kṛtanistuṣai: bhraṣṭair yavair vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kaṇṭharogeṣu hitaḥ rakta- pittaprasādanaḥ śamakaḥ ||173 || iti vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ ||

atha lājamaṇḍam āha -
lājair vā taṇḍulair bhṛṣṭair lājamaṇḍa: prakīrtitaḥ || 174||
śleṣmapittaharo grāhī pipāsājvarajin mataḥ | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kvāthakalpanā- dhyāyo dvitīyaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. lājair iti | bhṛṣṭaśālibhavā lājā ity ucyante| taiḥ kṛtvā yaḥ sādhitaḥ sa lājamaṇḍaḥ kathitaḥ | sādhanam atra pūrvavat jñātavyam | athavā bhṛṣṭais taṇḍulaiś ca kṛto yaḥ so 'pi lājamaṇḍasaṃjñitaḥ | asya guṇam āha - śleṣmapittaharaḥ ityādi| śleṣmaharaḥ pittaharaś ca | grāhī saṃprāhakaḥ | pipāsājvarajin mata iti | pipāsā pātum icchā iti sāmānyagrahaṇenāṣṭadhā | atra lājādīnāṃ parimāṇaṃ pūrvamaṇḍavaj jñātavyam | nanu yady evaṃ tarhi kim asau pṛthak darśitaḥ ? ucyate, lājamaṇḍasaṃjñādijñāpanārthaṃ pṛthag uktam| iti na doṣaḥ ||174||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kvāthakalpanādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ || 2 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha lājamaṇḍa: | lājā purātanabharjitaśālidhānyajāḥ taiḥ kṛtaḥ tadvat tair vā bhṛṣṭaiḥ kṛtaḥ sa lājamaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ sa śleṣmādiharaḥ grāhī grahaṇyatisārasaṃbhaktaḥ || 174 ||
iti lājamaṇḍaḥ | iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kvāthādikalpanādhyāyaḥ ||2||

div.head: atha phāṇṭādikalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ | phāṇṭakalpanā |
kṣuṇṇe dravyapale samyag jalam uṣṇaṃ vinikṣipet |
mṛtpātre kuḍavonmānaṃ tatas tu srāvayet paṭāt || 1 ||

lg.l: tasya?sa syāccū.? pā. cūrṇadravaḥ phāṇṭas tanmānaṃ dvipalonmitam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ phāṇṭakalpanāṃ darśayitum āha -- kṣuṇṇe dravyeti | anena phāṇṭaparibhāṣā abhihitā | kṣuṇṇe dravyapale iti samyak kṣuṇṇe atyantakuṭṭite, cūrṇasadṛśa ity arthaḥ | uṣṇam ity ardhaviśoṣitaṃ kvathitamātram iti kecit | vinikṣipet viśeṣeṇa kṣiped iti grahaṇena dravyasya pramāṇādikaṃ sūcitam | etenoktaparimitaṃ dravyaṃ jale nirmathya visrāvyam ity arthaḥ | tasya dravarūpaphāṇṭasya paryāyavācakaśabdaś cūrṇadravaḥ proktaḥ | tanmānam iti pānārtham | atha tatprakṣepārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - sitetyādi | atra ādiśabdāt kṣīraghṛtatailamūtralavaṇakṣārahiṅgutrikaṭukaprabhṛtayo gṛhyante eteṣāṃ prakṣepamānaṃ kvāthavaj jñātavyam ||1||2||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha phāṇṭakalpanā | kvāthānantaraṃ phāṇṭavidhānāt kṣuṇṇe kuṭṭite dravyapale mṛtpātre kuḍavonmitacatuṣpalaṃ uṣṇajale vinikṣipet | tataḥ paṭād vastrāt srāvayet | sa cūrṇadravaḥ syāt, tathā phāṇṭaparyāyeṇa tanmānaṃ bhakṣaṇamānaṃ tu dvipalaṃ madhukādīni kvāthavat ||1||2||

ab.seg:
atha bṛhanmadhūkaphāṇṭaḥ | sa yathā -
madhūkapuṣpaṃ madhukaṃ candanaṃ saparūṣakam |
mṛṇālaṃ kamalaṃ lodhraṃ kambhārī nāgakeśaram ||3||

lg.l: raktapittaṃ madaṃ hanyān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||5||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. sa yathety anena tad darśayati granthakāraḥ | idānīṃ vivaraṇam asmābhir api likhyate | madhūkapuṣpam iti | ayaṃ madhūkapuṣpādiphāṇṭasaṃjñaḥ himasaṃjño vā kalpanādvayabhedāt | atra madhūko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, tasya puṣpāṇi, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, candanam atra raktaṃ, parūṣakam iti phalaviśeṣaṃ, ‘phalasā ’‘pheruṣā’ pā. | iti loke | mṛṇālaṃ kamalanālaṃ, ‘bhasīḍa’ iti loke; kamalaṃ puṣpaviśeṣaṃ vikhyātam | tadabhāve padmabījam iti sarvatra | kambhārīti kambhārīphalaṃ, triphalā iti harītakyādikaṃ, sārivā āsphotā, ’āsphoī’ iti śabdavācyā | lājān iti bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavān, (etat sarvaṃnāsti ‘ka’ pustake | samamānena palaikaṃ grāhyam | samatā'trānuktatvāt) koṣṇa itīṣaduṣṇaḥ, sitā madhu ca prakṣepe praśastam | himo 'pi purato yad apekṣamāṇo 'stīti | aratim asaukhyam | bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyeva, madaṃ duṣṭapūgadhattūrakodravādijanitam | atra vicāraṇā na kāryeti yad grahaṇam, tat “acintyo hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāvaḥ” iti vākyānurodhāt | tathā coktam “nauṣadhīr hetubhir vidvān parīkṣeta kathañcana | sahasreṇāpi hetūnāṃ nāmbaṣṭhādir virecayet” iti | ata eva vṛddhavaidyavyavahāreṇānusartavya iti janaśrutir ity arthaḥ | kecit pratyekadvitīyāntadravyagrahaṇena vyastayogān api praśaṃsanti etad api manoharaṃ na doṣaḥ | “nātra kāryā vicāraṇā” iti vacanāt ||3-5||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. madhūkapuṣpaṃ‘mahuvā’ hi.bhā. | guḍapuṣpaṃ, madhukayaṣṭī, candanaṃ raktaṃ, parūṣakaṃ‘phalasā’ hi.bhā. | giripīluḥ, mṛṇālaṃ‘miṣa’ hi.bhā. | kandaḥ, kamalaṃ kamalapatraṃ phalaṃ vā | lodhraṃ prasiddhaṃ, kambhārī gambhārī, sārivā anantamūlaṃ yad vā sugandhadravyaṃ, lājā dhānyakṛtā | koṣṇajale īṣaduṣṇe palamātraṃ yad dravyaṃ catuṣpale jale sthitaṃ vastrapūtaṃ dvipalaṃ peyam | sitā matsyaṇḍī, tathā madhuyutaṃ peyam | asau phāṇṭaḥ athavā himaḥ kriyate rātristhitatvāt vātajvarādīn hanyān madarogaṃ ca | iti madhūkapuṣpādiphāṇṭaḥ || 3-5 ||

athāmrādiphāṇṭaḥ jvarādau |
āmrajambukisalayair vaṭaśuṅgaprarohakaiḥ |
uśīreṇa kṛtaḥ phāṇṭa: sakṣaudro jvaranāśanaḥ || 6 ||

Āḍhamalla. athāmrādiphāṇṭam āha - āmrajambūkisalayair iti | āmrakisalayair jambūkisalayaiś ca kisalayaṃ komalapatram | vaṭaśuṅgaprarohakair iti vaṭavṛkṣasya śuṅgāni komalapallavāni, prarohakā vaṭāvarohāḥ, varārohā iti loke | uśīras tṛṇabhedaḥ sugandhāṅghiḥ prasiddhaḥ | kartavyatāsya pūrvavat | kṣaudram atra prakṣepe | dustarām ity anivāryām || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āmrasya tathā jambūkisalayaiḥ pallavair vaṭaśuṅgaḥ vaṭaprarohaḥ‘varāroha’ baḍakī dāḍhī, hi.bhā. vaṭāṅkuraḥ, uśīraḥ etaiḥ kṛtaḥ phāṇṭaḥ kṣaudreṇa jvarādināśakaḥ ||6||

laghumadhūkapuṣpādiphāṇṭo dāhapittādau |
madhūkapuṣpakambhārīcandanośīradhānyakaiḥ || 7 ||

lg.l: drākṣayā ca kṛtaḥ phāṇṭaḥ śītaḥ śarkarayā yutaḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ laghumadhūkapuṣpādikaphāṇṭaṃ darśayann āha - madhūkapuṣpeti | madhūkapuṣpaṃ vikhyātaṃ, ‘mahuvā’ śabdavācyam | kambhārī kāśmarī, tasyāḥ phalāni, candanam atra raktacandanam, uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ, dhānyakaṃ kustumbarī, drākṣā phalottamā | śīta iti sparśāt, yad vā śīto himaḥ kaṣāyo 'yaṃ kartavyaḥ, pūrvavākyānurodhāt | śarkarā atra prakṣepe | tṛṣṇāharaḥ pittaharaś ca, pittaṃ prakupitam || 7 || 8 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 7 || 8 || iti phāṇṭaḥ ||

ab.seg:
manthavidhiḥ |
mantho 'pi phāṇṭabhedaḥ syāt tena cātraiva kathyate |
jale catuḥpale śīte kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ kṣipet || 9 ||

lg.l: mṛtpātre manthayet samyak tasmāc ca dvipalaṃ pibet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ manthavidhim āha - mantha iti | yato 'yaṃ manthaḥ phāṇṭasya bhedo darśitaḥ | tadvedibhis tena kāraṇenātra kalpanayā kathyate | ācāryeṇeti śeṣaḥ | śīte jala iti grahaṇenaiva phāṇṭād bhinno 'yaṃ kathitaḥ | ‘jale catuḥpale’ ityādiko 'yaṃ ślokaḥ prakṣepaka iti vadanti kecit, yato bahuṣu pustakeṣu na dṛśyate | jalamānaṃ tu dravyānumānato boddhavyaṃ yathā vakṣyamāṇe saktumanthake ||9||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha manthaḥ | sa yathā kṣuṇṇaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ dravyaṃ palaṃ, catuḥpale śītajale kṣipet punaḥ manthayet tasmād dvipalaṃ pibet | ato 'yaṃ bhinnaḥ || 9 ||

madātyayādau kharjūrādimanthaḥ | sa yathā -
kharjūradāḍimīdrākṣātintiḍīkāmlikāmalaiḥ ||10||

Āḍhamalla. sa yatheti manthasūcakaṃ vākyam idam | atas taṃ darśayann āha - kharjūreti | atra kharjūrādīnāṃ phalāni grāhyāṇi | kharjūrī bṛhatkharjūrikā, tasyāḥ phalāni ‘utatī’ti loke; dāḍimaṃ dāḍimīphalaṃ, tintiḍīkaṃ viṭapiviśeṣaḥ, tasya phalāni amlāni bhavanti | amlikā ciñcā, tasyāḥ phalāni prasiddhāni, āgalam āmalakaphalaṃ, parūṣakaṃ phālasāśabdavācyaṃ hrasvaviṭapaṃ, tasyāpi phalaiḥ kṛta ity eṣāṃ paripakvaphalaiḥ saṃskārita ity arthaḥ | sarvaṃ madyaṃ duṣṭapūgakodravāriṣṭādikaṃ tajjanitaṃ vikāraṃ madātyayādikaṃ, taṃ nāśayatīty arthaḥ | eke cātra śarkarāṃ vadanti pānakatvāt ||10||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kharjūraḥ prasiddhaḥ, dāḍimaphalaṃ tasya bījāni, drākṣā gostanī, tintiḍīkaṃ vṛkṣāmlam, amlikā prasiddhā, āmalam āmalakaṃ, paṣarūko giripīluḥ | etaiḥ kṛtaḥ manthaḥ madyavikāraṃ madātyayādikaṃ harati | iti kharjūrādimantho madātyayādau ||10||

atha masūrādimanthaḥ chardyām -
kṣaudrayuktā masūrāṇāṃ saktavo dāḍimāmbhasā || 11||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ masūrādimanthavivaraṇam āha - kṣaudrayuktā iti | kṣaudrayuktā madhuplāvitāḥ | masūro 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, sa ca bharjitaḥ saktunimittatvāt | dāḍimāmbhasā paripakvadāḍimaphalatoyena mathitā nirmathitā | doṣatrayodbhavām iti vyastāṃ samastāṃ vā |
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. masūrāṇāṃ bharjitānāṃ saktavaḥ dāḍimāṃbhasā dāḍimajalena amlena vā pīto doṣatrayodbhavāṃ tridoṣajāṃ chardiṃ vānti jayanti |

tṛṣṇādāhādau yavasaktumanthaḥ |
plāvitaiḥ śītanīreṇa saghṛtair yavasaktubhiḥ ||12||
nātisāndradravo manthas tṛṣṇādāhāstrapittahā | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe phāṇṭādikalpanā nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha yavasaktum āha - plāvitair iti | yavasaktubhiḥ kṛtvā kṛto yo mantha: sa tṛṣṇādāhāsrapittahā bhavati | kīdṛśaiḥ ? śītanīreṇa śītalapānīyena plāvitair āloḍitaiḥ | eke plāvitaiḥ śītanīreṇety asya sthāne “plāvitaiḥ śarkarātoyaiḥ” iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | punaḥ kīdṛśaiḥ ? saghṛtaiḥ uktaparimāṇaghṛtayuktaiḥ | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ ? nātisāndradravai: nātiśayena sāndradravās tair iti | sāndraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, dravaṃ toyasadṛśam | tathā ca tantrāntare
“saktavaḥ sarpiṣābhyaktāḥ śītavāripariplutāḥ |
nātidravā nātisāndrā mantha ity abhidhīyate” | eke “nātisāndrair dravair mantha” iti paṭhanti | tanmate tu sāndratvaṃ niṣiddhaṃ dravatvaṃ praśastam iti | tathā ca matāntare vākyadvayam āha “gurvī piṇḍī kharātyarthaṃ laghvī saiva viparyayāt | na jalāntīratān dviḥ saktūn adyān na kevalān” iti drave 'pi sāphalyam anugrāhakena darśayitum āha | tad yathā
“pītāḥ satarpaṇā hṛdyāḥ sadyo balavivardhanāḥ |
vātātapādhvavyāyāmakarśitānāṃ śramāpahā || madhurā laghavaḥ śītāḥ saktavo raktapittahā iti | ayam api śarkarādisaṃyuktaḥ kartavyo vyavahārāt | uktaṃ ca
“śarkarekṣumadhudrākṣāyukta: pitta- vikāranut |
drākṣāmadhusamāyuktaḥ kapharogaharaḥ smṛtaḥ || vargatrayeṇopahito maladoṣānulomanaḥ iti ||11 ||
12|| iti śrīvāstavyānvabaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyakhaṇḍe phāṇṭa- kalpanā nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha yavaśaktumanthaḥ | plāvitaiḥ bharjitaiḥ ghṛtasahitair yavaśaktubhir nātisāndradravaiḥ nātighanair nātidravaiḥ kṛtaḥ manthaḥ tṛṣṇādihā; asrapittaṃ raktapittam || 11 ||
12 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpakāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne phāṇṭādikalpanādhyāyaḥ ||3||

div.head: atha himakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ |
kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ samyak ṣaḍbhir nīrapalaiḥ plutam |
niśoṣitaṃ himaḥ sa syāt tathā śītakaṣāyakaḥ ||1||

Āḍhamalla. atha himakalpanāṃ nidarśayann āha - kṣuṇṇam iti | ayaṃ himakaṣāyo 'nayā paribhāṣayā prathito bhavati | kathaṃ ? yathā “kṣuṇṇaṃ samyak kuṭṭitaṃ ṣaḍbhir nīrapalaiḥ” iti dravyaparimāṇāt | niśoṣitam iti sakalaniśāyām adhyuṣitaṃ, tena prātaḥ saṃsrāvya dravaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | etasya paryāyanāmnā śītakaṣāyaḥ kathitaḥ | tad uktaṃ tantrāntare - “śīto rātriṃ drave sthitaḥ” iti | tanmānaṃ tu phāṇṭavaj jñeyam iti tasya parimāṇaṃ pānārthaṃ phāṇṭavaj jñātam | mānagrahaṇenāpi prakṣepādayo 'pi phāṇṭavaj jñātavyāḥ | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatraiva nānyat || 1 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. himakalpanā | kṣuṇṇaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ dravyapalaiḥ ṣaḍbhir nīrapalaiḥ plutaṃ niśoṣitaṃ rātristhāpitaṃ himaḥ syāt tanmānaṃ bhakṣaṇamānaṃ phāṇṭavad dvipalam || 1||

āmrādihimo raktapitte | sa yathā -
āmra-jambū ca kakubhaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya jale kṣipet ||2||

lg.l: himaṃ tasya pibet prātaḥ sukṣaudraṃ raktapittajit |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. sa yatheti vākyena himakaṣāyayogāt darśayati | āmreti | tad yathā - ayam āmrādikasaṃjñako himo madhuprakṣipto raktapittajid bhavati | atra kakubho 'rjunaḥ sa ca vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | āmrādīnāṃ tvakcūrṇam iti vyavahārāt ||2||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kakubho 'rjunavṛkṣaḥ, sakṣaudro madhusahitaḥ ||2||

atha marīcyādihimas tṛṣṇādau -
marīcaṃ madhuyaṣṭī ca kākodumbarapallavāḥ || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha marīcādisaṃjñako himaḥ | atra kākodumbarikā ’kaṭumbarī’śabdavācyā, ‘kaṭvarī’śabdavācyā ca | nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, tadabhāve padmabījam iti vyavahārāt | tajja iti marīcādidravyair jātaḥ | eke marīcacūrṇaṃ manāk prakṣepe 'py āhuḥ tīkṣṇatvāt || 3 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. madhuyaṣṭī madhukaṃ, kākodumbarīpallavaḥ kaṭumbarapallavaḥ ||3||

vātapittādau nīlotpalādihimaḥ |
nīlotpalaṃ balā drākṣā madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ tathā || 4 ||

lg.l: uśīraṃ padmakaṃ caiva kāśmarī ca parūṣakam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha nīlotpalādijaṃ himam āha, nīlotpalam iti | nīlotpalam atra vikhyātaṃ, tac cendīvarasaṃjñam | balā prasiddhā | madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, loke mahuāśabdavācyam | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, uśīraṃ tṛṇabhedaṃ sugandhamūlam, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣam | kāśmarī kambhārī, tasyāḥ phalāni, parūṣakaṃ prasiddham | śītakaṣāyo himakaṣāyaḥ kathitaḥ pralāpo 'sambaddhabhāṣaṇaṃ, bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyevārthasaṃvittiḥ, moho mūrcchābhedaḥ || 4 || 5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, balā prasiddhā, madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, padmakaṃ paḍmakāṣṭhaṃ, kāśmarī gambhārī, parūṣakaṃ giripīluḥ | śītakaṣāyaḥ vātapittajvarādīn jayet | pralopo 'narthakaṃ vaca ity amaraḥ | bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyeva | moho mūrcchā || 4 || 5 ||

ab.seg:
guḍūcīhimaḥ jīrṇajvare -
amṛtāyā himaḥ peyo jīrṇajvaraharaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6 ||

lg.l: vāsāyāś ca himaḥ kāsaṃ raktapittajvarāñ jayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīm amṛtāṭarūṣakasaṃjñakau himāv āha - amṛtāyā iti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyā vallī grāhyā | atrāpare madhu prakṣipanti tantrāntare darśanāt | tathā hi “amṛtāyāḥ kaṣāyaṃ tu śītaṃ samyak paladvayam | madhupādayutaṃ pītaṃ jīrṇajvaraharaṃ param” iti | aparaṃ ca vāsā aṭarūṣakaḥ, sa cātra pañcāṅgo vyavahārāt || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. amṛtā guḍūcī tasyā himaṃ jīrṇajvaraṃ pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ sthitaḥ | atha vāsāhima: raktapitte | vāsāyāś ca himaḥ kāsaraktapittajvarāñ jayet, sugamam ||6||

atha dhānyādihimo 'ntardāhādau -
prātaḥ saśarkaraḥ peyo himo dhānyākasaṃbhavaḥ || 7 ||
Āḍhamalla. prātar iti | eṣa dhānyākahimo 'ntardāhādau praśastaḥ, dhānyākaṃ kustumburu | srotoviśodhana iti mūtramārgasya śuddhikaraḥ mūtrakṛcchrādihara ity arthaḥ || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. srotoviśodhanaḥ srotaḥśuddhikaraḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 7 ||

div.ab:
atha dhānyākādir himaḥ raktapittādau -
dhānyākadhātrīvāsānāṃ drākṣāparpaṭayor himaḥ || 8 ||
raktapittajvaraṃ dāhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ śoṣaṃ ca nāśayet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe himakalpanā nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. dhānyāketi | ayaṃ dhānyākādisaṃjñako himo raktapittādikān hantīti | atra dhātrī āmalakīphalam, vāsā aṭarūṣakas tasya mūlaṃ grāhyaṃ, parpaṭaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ | etat sakalaṃ samaṃ tulitaṃ saṃgṛhya himakaṣāyaḥ kartavyaḥ | atrāpi śarkarāprakṣepam āhuḥ pūrvayogānusārāt | śoṣaṃ mukhaśoṣaṃ, kṣayabhedo vā, eke yogadvayam āhuḥ ||8||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe himakalpanādhyāyaś caturthaḥ || 4 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dhātrī āmalakī, parpaṭaḥ kamupatraḥ raktapittaṃ mukhāde raktasrāvaḥ, śoṣaṃ, yad vā śoṣaḥ kṣayabhedaḥ nāśayet || 8 ||
iti śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne himakalpanādhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

div.head: atha kalkakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ | athedānīṃ kalkakalpanāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ -
dravyam ārdraṃ śilāpiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ vā sajalaṃ bhavet |
prakṣepāvāpakalkās te tanmānaṃ karṣasaṃmitam || 1 ||

lg.l: kalke madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ deyaṃ dviguṇamātrayā |
sitāguḍaṃ samaṃ dadyād dravā deyāś caturguṇāḥ || 2 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. dravyam ityādi | iyam anena prakāreṇa kalkaparibhāṣā kathyate | dravyaṃ vyādhivihitam | ārdraṃ sadya uddhṛtam | pakṣāntarakalkavidhau śuṣkam api dravyaṃ jalena piṣṭaṃ kalkasaṃjñakaṃ bhavati | te prakṣepāvāpakalkā iti paryāyaśabdavācakaiḥ kathitāḥ | tanmānakalkaparimāṇaṃ karṣamitaṃ sārdhaṭaṃkadvayaṃ, etac ca bhakṣaṇe mānam anuktānām | athātra prakṣepadravyāṇy āha -kalke madhughṛtam ityādi | kalke pūrvoktaṃ madhughṛtatailaṃ dviguṇamātrayā deyam | dviguṇatā kalkād ity arthaḥ | sitā guḍaś ca samaṃ samam api kalkāc ca dravā iti avaśiṣṭajalakṣīrādyāś caturguṇā deyāḥ kalkād apīty arthaḥ | kalkaḥ prakṣepasaṃjñaḥ proktaḥ | tasmāt draveṣu prakṣepako yojya iti tātparyārthaḥ | yathāgre vakṣyamāṇāḥ pippalīvardhamānādayo dṛśyante ata eva karṣaparimāṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ, viśeṣatas tu doṣādyanurūpataḥ pramāṇāḥ boddhavyā: || 1 || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kalkakalpanā | ārdraṃ dravyam auṣadhaṃ śilāpiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ jalapiṣṭaṃ bhavet | tanmānaṃ karṣasaṃmitaṃ bhavet | te nāmataḥ prakṣepa āvāpakalkā bhavanti | kalke madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ dviguṇamātrayā deyaṃ kvāthato dviguṇamātrayeti pūrvoktaiḥ sitāguḍasamaṃ dravā jaladugdhādyāḥ caturguṇā iti || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg:
vardhamānapippalyaḥ | sa‘sa’kalka ityartha:| yathā -
trivṛddhyā pañcavṛddhyā vā saptavṛddhyāthavā kaṇāḥ |
pibet piṣṭvā daśadinaṃ tās tathaivāpakarṣayet ||3||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. sa yatheti śiṣyavākyena tadvidhiṃ darśayati granthakāraḥ trivṛddhyetyādinā | ayaṃ pippalīvardhamānaprayogo vidhīyate| vṛddhis tu tāvad yāvad daśadinam iti | tās tathaivāpakarṣayed iti tāḥ pippalyaḥ tathaiveti vṛddhi- yuktyāpakarṣayet hrāsayet yāvad daśadinam iti | evaṃ viṃśatidinaiḥ kṛtvā pippalīvardhamānaprayogaḥ siddho bhavati | etena kim uktaṃ bhavati tribhis tribhiḥ parivṛddhiḥ kṛtā yāvaddaśadināni, vṛddhis tu pratidinam eva, tatas tisra- stisro 'pakarṣayed yāvat tisraḥ pippalya eva tiṣṭhanti, evaṃ pañcavṛddhir apakarṣaś ca tathā saptavṛddhir apakarṣaś ca | athaveti grahaṇena daśapippalīnāṃ vṛddhir apakarṣaś ca boddhavyaḥ anyato darśanāt | tad yathā “tribhir atha parivṛddhaṃ pañcabhiḥ saptabhir vā daśabhir atha vivṛddhaṃ pippalīvardhamānam | iti pibati pumān yas tasya na śvāsakāsajvarajaṭharagadārśovātaraktakṣayāḥ syuḥ iti” | piṣṭvā ity atrāpi kṣīrapiṣṭā iti manyante kecit || 3 || 4 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sa yathā sugamam | pippalīvardhamānaṃ pāṇḍujvarādau | trivṛddhyā pañcavṛddhyā vā kaṇāḥ pippalyaḥ piṣṭvā kalkavidhānena caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā pibed daśadinaṃ punar daśadinaṃ apakarṣayet tato hrāsayet evaṃ viśaddinaiḥ siddhaṃ pippalīvardhamānasiddhaṃ bhavati tena vyādhayo naśyantīti yojanā ||3||4 ||

ab.seg:
atha nimbakalko vraṇacchardyādau -
lepān nimbadalaiḥ kalko vraṇaśodhanaropaṇaḥ || 5 ||

Āḍhamalla. lepād iti | nimbapatrāṇi śilāpiṣṭāni kṛtvā vraṇeṣu lepaḥ kāryaḥ | peṣaṇam atra jalena, lepaparimāṇa- tvād ārdramahiṣacarmotsedham | vyavahāratas tu vraṇānukāri kuryāt | nātra niyatapramāṇam | kāryāntaram āha - bhakṣaṇād iti | nimbapatrakalkabhakṣaṇād api kuṣṭhādayo vinaśyantīti prabhāvāt | nimba iti nimbakalkaḥ || 5 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nimbadalaiḥ patraiḥ kṛtaḥ kalkaḥ pūraṇād vraṇaśodhano ropaṇo bhavati bhakṣaṇāt chardyādīn jayet | anubhūtaṃ chardyām ||5||

atha mahānimbakalko gṛdhrasyām -
mahānimbajaṭākalko gṛdhrasīnāśanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 6 ||
Āḍhamalla. aparam api yogam āha mahānimbeti | mahānimbaḥ kārmukaḥ, ‘vakāini’ iti loke | tasya jaṭā mūlam | gṛdhrasī vātaroge paṭhitā, rāndhanīti loke prasiddhā || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mahānimbaḥ‘bakāyana’ hi.bhā. kārmukaḥ, tasya jaṭākalka: bhakṣitaḥ gṛdhrasī ‘rīcaṇa’ vātanāśakaḥ || 6 ||

atha rasonakalkaḥ vātarogaviṣamajvarādau -
śuddhaḥ kalko rasonasya tilatailena miśrita: |
vātarogāñ jayet tīvrān viṣamajvaranāśanaḥ || 7 ||

Āḍhamalla. anyad apy āha - śuddha iti | rasonaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ | śuddha iti tvagādirahitaḥ | tilatailena miśrita iti rasonakalkādviguṇitena tilatailena saṃplāvya bhakṣayed ity arthaḥ | vātarogān gṛdhrasyarditapakṣāghātaprabhṛtīn tīvran iti- dustarān, viṣamajvarāḥ satatakādayaḥ || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rasonaṃ laśunaṃ, tasya kalkaḥ śuddhaḥ dravyāntararahitaḥ tilatailena miśritaḥ vātarogāñ jayet | viṣamajvare tilatailarahito deyaḥ || 7 ||

atha dvitīyarasonakalko vātavyādhau -
pakvakandarasonasya gulikā nistuṣīkṛtāḥ |
pāṭayitvā ca madhyasthaṃ dūrīkuryāt tadaṅkuram || 8 ||

lg.l: apanīya ca tanmadhyāc chilāyāṃ peṣayet tataḥ || 9 ||
sauvarcalaṃ yavānīṃ ca bharjitaṃ hiṅgu saindhavam || 10||
ajīrṇam ātapaṃ roṣam atinīraṃ payo guḍam || 14 ||
rasonam aśnan puruṣas tyajed etan nirantaram |
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathāmlaṃ ca rasaṃ seveta nityaśaḥ || 15 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dvitīyarasonakalkaṃ darśayitum āha - pakveti | bṛhatsaṃjñako 'yaṃ rasonakalko yady api sugamas tathāpi keṣāṃcit subodhārthaṃ kiṃcid vyācaṣṭe, pakvakandarasonasyetyādi | pakvaṃ kālāntareṇa pariṇataṃ, gulikāḥ kanda- syāvayavaviśeṣāḥ, pothīti śabdavācyāḥ | nistuṣīkṛtā iti nakhaiḥ saṃcholitāḥ paścāt pāṭayitvā dvidhā vidārya, tadaṅkuram iti rasonagulikamadhyasthaharitavarṇāṅkuram tanmadhyād iti takramadhyāt apanīya samādāyety arthaḥ | atra rasonakalke uktadravyāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ pañcamāṃśena kṛtvā kṣipet | pañcamāṃśam iti rasonakalkāt, tena rasonakalkaṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayaṃ, dravyacūrṇaṃ bhāgaikam iti, bharjitaṃ hiṅgvantrotkledavyavacchedārtham | tathā hi “yogeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛd bhavet” iti | evaṃ sarvatra | kaṭutrikaṃ śuṇṭhīmarīcapippalyaḥ, kalkakarṣapramāṇata iti rasonadravyacūrṇamilitaṃ kalkaṃ na tu kevalaṃ karṣapramāṇam | ata eva doṣāgnibalāpekṣīti vacanenātra mānābhāvaḥ sūcitaḥ | eraṇḍamūlakvathitam atrānupānam uktaparimāṇaṃ pratyaham eva kuryāt | ekāṅgajam iti pakṣaghātaḥ | apatantrakaṃ vātaroge paṭhitalakṣaṇam | pīḍāśabdaḥ ura.prabhṛtibhiḥ pratyekam abhisambaddhaḥ, tena uraḥpīḍā pṛṣṭhapīḍā pārśvapīḍā kaṭipīḍā kukṣipīḍā ity arthaḥ | nanu sarvāṅgagrahaṇenaiva sarve vātavikārāḥ prāptāḥ tat kathaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam ? ucyate - sarvāṅgeṇa sarvaśarīraprakupito vāto 'bhihitaḥ avayavāśritaḥ, tasmāt sarvāṅgaprakupitam ekadeśaprakupitaṃ cānilaṃ nāśayed iti na doṣaḥ | asyābhyāsād eva tyājyam āha ajīrṇam ityādi | nirantaraṃ sarvakālaṃ, ajīrṇam annādijanitam | ātapaṃ ca gharmasevāṃ, roṣaṃ krodhaṃ, atinīram atyambupānaṃ, payaḥ kṣīraṃ, guḍaṃ prasiddhaṃ | eke guḍopalakṣitatvāt sarvekṣuvikārās tyājyā iti vadanti | sevyam āha madyam ityādi | madyaṃ surāsavaprabhṛtikaṃ, māṃsaṃ jāṅgalikaṃ guṇaprādhānyāt | amlam amlarasaṃ, tac ca mātuluṅgādikaṃ, rasaṃ māsajanitaṃ prasahāmety arthaḥ | nityaśaḥ pratidinam || 8-15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. eraṇḍajaṭākvāthaḥ palamātraṃ dravyam | payo mahiṣīpayaḥ tasya vātakartṛkatvāt na gopayaḥ, tasya pathyavarge likhitatvāt, roṣaṃ krodham, atinīraṃ bahujalaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat ||8-15 ||

pippalyādikalka ūrustambhe -
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ bhallātakaphalāni ca |
etatkalkaś ca sakṣaudra ūrustambhanivāraṇaḥ ||16 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīm ūrustambhe kalkasvarūpaṃ yogam āha, eteṣāṃ kalka iti | etatkalkaḥ | pippalīpippalīmūle vikhyāte, bhallātakaphalāny atra nirasthīni yojyāni, kutrāpy eṣāṃ pippalyādīnāṃ kvātho 'pi pracarati | tathā hi “pippalīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ bhallātakaśṛtaṃ pibet | kalko vā samadhur deya ūrustambhavināśanaḥ” iti || 16 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sakṣaudraḥ madhusahitaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 16 ||

atha viṣṇukrāntākalkaḥ pariṇāmaśūle -
viṣṇukrāntājaṭākalkaḥ sitākṣaudraghṛtair yutaḥ |
pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlaṃ nāśayet saptabhir dinaiḥ || 17 ||

Āḍhamalla. pariṇāmaśūle 'parājitākalkam āha - viṣṇukrānteti | viṣṇukrāntā aparājitā pratītā, śatāvarī vāasamīcīnamidaṃ viṣṇukrāntā bhinnā śatāvarī ca bhinnā| | sitādayo 'py atra pūrvaparimāṇena prakṣiptāḥ | saptadinair iti yogasyāsya dṛṣṭaphalatvaṃ darśayati | pariṇāmaśūlaṃ paktiśūlaṃ, tac ca śūlaroge spaṣṭam eva || 17 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. viṣṇukrāntā aparājitā śvetapuṣpī vā nīlī vā tāṃ kecid dhanvantarā āhuḥ, tasyā jaṭākalkaḥ sitādibhir yuktaḥ pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlaṃ nāśayet “anne jīryati yac chūlaṃ tad evaṃ pariṇāmajam” || 17 ||

aparam api pariṇāmaśūlārthaṃ prayogam āha -
śuṇṭhītilaguḍaiḥ kalko dugdhena saha yojayet |
pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlam āmavātaṃ ca nāśayet || 18 ||

Āḍhamalla. śuṇṭhīti | atrāsya kartavyavidhau śuṇṭhītilābhyāṃ kalkaḥ kāryaḥ | guḍam atra dvayoḥ santulitaṃ caturguṇena kṣīreṇa saha sādhayitvā bhakṣayed iti bhāvaḥ | cakārād ayam api saptadinābhyantare dṛṣṭaphalaḥ | uktam anyatrādi “nāgaratilaguḍakalkaṃ payasā saṃsādhya yaḥ pumān adyāt | ugraṃ pariṇāmaśūlaṃ tasyāpaity api ca saptarātreṇa” iti || 18 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha śuṇṭhīkalkaḥ pariṇāmaśūle tathāmavāte | sugamam || 18 ||

athāpāmārgakalkaḥ raktārśasi -
apāmārgasya bījānāṃ kalkas taṇḍulavāriṇā |
pīto raktārśasāṃ nāśaṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ ||19||

Āḍhamalla. atha raktārśasāṃ prayogaṃ darśayann āha - apāmārgasyeti | apāmārgaḥ prasiddhaḥ | taṇḍulavāri taṇḍulakṣālanajalaṃ, tac ca puṭapāke darśitaṃ, anena caturguṇenāpāmārgasya bījānāṃ kalka: peyaḥ, na tu tena mānena peṣitaḥ, peṣaṇārthaṃ tv aparimitaṃ jalam, etad eva yojyam | nāsti saṃśaya iti dṛṣṭaphalatvenāsya prabhāvātiśayo varṇitaḥ || 19 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. taṇḍulajalena || 19 ||

atha badarīmūlakalkaḥ raktātīsāre -
badarīmūlakalkena tilakalkaś ca yojitaḥ |
madhukṣārayutaḥ kuryād raktātīsāranāśanaḥ ||20||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ raktātīsāre badarīmūlakalkam āha - badarīmūlakalkena tilakalkaś ceti | kalkadvayagrahaṇena samaṃ melayitvā kalkaḥ kāryaḥ, ity asmadīyasampradāyas tena dvayoḥ sāmyena karṣaikaṃ, peṣaṇārthaṃ jalam atrānuktatvāt | madhukṣārau coktaparimāṇena prakṣepe yojyau | kecin madhukṣīrayuta iti paṭhanti | tatra kṣīraṃ chāgodbhavaṃ vyādhivihitatvāt | ayam eva pakṣo vyāvahāriko dṛśyate | guṇenāpy uktam “ājaṃ śoṣajvare śvāsaraktapittātisārajit” iti || 20 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. badarī laghuḥ tasyā jaṭā tatkalka: | kṣīraṃ gavyam ājaṃ vā || 20 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha raktapitte kūṣmāṇḍayogam āha - kūṣmāṇḍaka iti | kūṣmāṇḍakaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasya phalasvarasenaiva karṣamātrāṃ lākṣāṃ piṣṭvā tenaiva caturguṇena saha pibet | caturguṇatātra palamānaṃ eṣa vidhiḥ pānād iti vākye darśitaḥ | lākṣā'laktakasya jananī | atrāpi madhuprakṣepaṃ kurvanti vṛddhāḥ, kutaḥ ? pūrvānuyogāvṛteḥ || 21 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. lākṣāyogaḥ raktakṣaye - lākṣāṃ pippalajāṃ badarijāṃ vā || 21 ||

atha taṇḍulīyakalkaḥ raktapradare -
taṇḍulīyajaṭākalkaḥ sakṣaudraḥ sarasāñjanaḥ
taṇḍulodakasaṃpīto raktapradaranāśanaḥ || 22 ||

Āḍhamalla. raktapradare 'py āha - taṇḍulīyeti | taṇḍulīyaḥ śākaviśeṣaḥ ‘caurāi’ iti śabdavācyaḥ, tasya jaṭā mūlaṃ, kartavyatāsya taṇḍulīyajaṭā rasāñjanaṃ ca sāmyena karṣaparimitaṃ grāhyam | tadanu jalena saṃpiṣya madhuyuktaś caturguṇena taṇḍulajalena saha pātavyaḥ | taṇḍulajalaṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam | rasāñjanaṃ svanāmakhyātam | tac ca dārvīkvāthasamu- dbhavam iti prasiddham | raktapradaraḥ strīroge paṭhitaḥ ||22||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. taṇḍulīyaḥcaurāī hi. bhā. | meghanādaḥ, tasya jaṭākalkaḥ sakṣaudraḥ, rasāñjanaṃrasota hi.bhā.| prasiddhaṃ, taṇḍulodakaṃ taṇḍulaprakṣālanajalaṃ, pradaraḥ yonyā raktādisrāvaḥ || 22 ||

athāṅkoṭakakalko 'tīsārādau -
aṅkoṭamūlakalkaś ca sakṣaudras taṇḍulāmbunā |
atīsāraharaḥ proktas tathā viṣaharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23 ||

lg.l: ghṛtena bilvamūlaṃ vā dvividhaṃ nāśayed viṣam ||24||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha viṣaharaṇārthaṃ yogavarān āha - aṅkoṭamūleti | aṅkoṭo vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasya mūlam | kṣaudram atra prakṣepe sādhu | taṇḍulāmbuneti caturguṇena, caturguṇatā ca kalkadravyāt | viṣo 'tra sthāvaraḥ | viṣanimittaṃ tu jalenaiva peya iti sampradāyaḥ | aparāṇy āha - bandhyeti | etadyogatrayaṃ ghṛtena saha peyam | viṣaṃ nāśayati iti, tac ca dvividhaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamātmakam | kecid vandhyākarkoṭakīmūlakalkena nasyam āhuḥ | tathā hi - ‘vandhyākarkoṭakīmūlaṃ chāgīmūtreṇa bhāvitam | nasyaṃ kāñjikasaṃpiṣṭaṃ viṣopahatacetasaḥ’ iti | evaṃ bilvamūlam añjanārtham iti vadanty eke || 23 || 24 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. aṃkoṭo bṛhat tasya jaṭākalkaḥ mūlakalkaḥ, sthāvarajaṅgamaviṣam || 23 || 24 ||

ab.seg:
athābhayādikalkaḥ pācanādau -
abhayāsaindhavakaṇāśuṇṭhīkalkas tridoṣahā |
pathyāsaindhavaśuṇṭhībhiḥ kalko dīpanapācanaḥ ||25||

Āḍhamalla. athaikena ślokena yogadvayam āha - abhayeti | abhayādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ samatulitānāṃ militvā karṣeṇa kalkas tridoṣajid bhavati | abhayā harītakī, kaṇā pippalī | aparaḥ | pathyādibhir dravyaiḥ kalko dīpanapācano bhavati| atrāpi samatā dravyāṇāṃ, bhakṣaṇamānaṃ tu pūrvavat | dīpanam agneḥ, pācanam āmādīnām ||25||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. abhayā harītakī, kaṇā pippalī || 25 ||

atha trivṛtādikalkaḥ kṛmiroge -
trivṛtpalāśabījāni pārasīkayamānikā |
kampillakaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca guḍaś ca samabhāgikam ||26||

Āḍhamalla. kṛmiroge kalkam āha - trivṛd iti | trivṛdādīnāṃ saguḍānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ sāmānyena militānāṃ karṣapramāṇena kalkaṃ kṛtvā caturguṇena takreṇa sahāloḍya pibet | etac ca kṛmisamūhān uddharatīti | trivṛt ni:sṛtā, palāśabījāni prasiddhāni | pārasīkayamāniketi pārasyadeśabhavā pārasī khurāsānīśabdavācyā, kampillako recanakaḥ, loke ‘kavīlā’ śabdena vikhyātaḥ | ayaṃ yogaḥ koṣṭhagatakṛmināśanārtham uktaḥ | eke trivṛdādīnāṃ guḍaḥ sama iti vadanti tena guḍasyaiko bhāgaḥ śeṣadravyāṇāṃ bhāgaikam ity arthaḥ | satyam | tanmate tu guḍaṃ prathamato bhakṣayitvā paścāt trivṛdādīnāṃ kalkaṃ takreṇa saha pibed iti | tathā ca tantrāntare prayogāntaram api dṛśyate | tad yathā “pārasīkayamānī pītā paryuṣitavāriṇā prātaḥ | guḍapūrvā kṛmijālaṃ koṣṭhagataṃ pātayaty āśu || 26 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. trivṛt niḥsṛtā‘niśotha’ hi. bhā. | , palāśabījānipalāśapāparā, hi. bhā. | prasiddhāni, pārasīkayamānikā‘khurāsānīajavāyana’ hi.bhā. | prasiddhā ‘ajavāyaṇi’ gurjaradeśe prasiddhā, kāmpillakaṃ‘kavīlā’ hi. bhā. | raktāṅgakaḥ, viḍaṅgaḥ krimighnaḥ | sugamam anyat || 26 ||

raktārśasi tilakalkaḥ |
navanītatilaiḥ kalko jetā raktārśasāṃ smṛtaḥ ||27||

Āḍhamalla. atha raktārśasām api yogadvayam āha navanīteti | atroktaparimāṇena tilakalko dviguṇitena navanītena saṃplāvya bhakṣyaḥ | asau raktārśasāṃ jetā kathita ity arthaḥ | raktārśasām iti bahuvacanatvenānyeṣām apy arśasāṃ praśastaḥ | aparo 'pi navanītasitānāgakeśaraiś ca yuktyā kalkas tadvidho 'yaṃ bhavati | tadvidha iti raktārśasāṃ hantā ity arthaḥ | navanītatyāgenāpi yogo 'yaṃ pracarati | tena sitā śarkarā nāgakeśaraś ca sāmyena māṣāṣṭakaṃ pratyahaṃ bhakṣyaṃ, prayogāt || 27 ||

div.ab:
saṃgrahaṇyāṃ śuṇṭhīkalkaḥ |
pīto masūrayūṣeṇa kalkaḥ śuṇṭhīśalāṭuja: ||28 ||
jayet saṃgrahaṇīṃ tadvat takreṇa bṛhatībhavaḥ | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kalkakalpanā nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha grahaṇyāṃ yogadvayaṃ darśayann āha - pīta iti | śuṇṭhīśalāṭujaḥ kalka uktaparimāṇena kṛtaś caturguṇena masūrayūṣeṇa saha pibet | śalāṭu bilvaphalaṃ, masūrayūṣavidhis tu kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kathita eva | aparo 'pi bṛhatībhavo bṛhatkaṃṭakārikāmūlakalka iti nāmnā prathitaḥ | atrāpi caturguṇaṃ takraṃ kalkāj jñātavyam | tadvad iti grahaṇīnāśakaraḥ || 28 ||
iti śrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kalkakalpanādhyāyaḥ pañcamaḥ || 5 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. grahaṇyāṃ masūrakalkaḥ, masūrayūṣeṇa masūramaṇḍena pīta: śuṇṭhīlāṭujaḥ kalkaḥ saṃgrahaṇīṃ jayet | tadvat takreṇa bṛhatībhava: bṛhatkaṇṭakārīphalakalka: ‘āme phale śalāṭu: syād i’ty amara: | apakva ity artha:| sugamam ||28|| iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kalkakalpanādhyāya: ||

div.head: atha cūrṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ |
atyantaśuṣkaṃ yad dravyaṃ supiṣṭaṃ vastragālitam |
tat syāc cūrṇaṃ rajaḥ kṣodas tanmātrā karṣasaṃmitā || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ cūrṇakalpanāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | prathamatas tatsvarūpam āha - atyantaśuṣkam iti | sūryāṃśubhiḥ śoṣitadravāṃśaṃ yad dravyam iti | puṣpaphalapatratvaṅmūlaniryāsādisaṃjñam | supiṣṭam ityādi supiṣṭam ity atiśayena cūrṇitaṃ śilāyām iti śeṣaḥ | vastragālitaṃ vastrapūtaṃ, tat tu cūrṇaṃ rajaḥ kṣoda iti paryāyanāmabhyāṃ saṃjñitam | tanmātreti bhakṣaṇārthaṃ mānaṃ karṣasaṃmitaṃ jñeyam ity anuktaprayogeṣu || 1 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha cūrṇakalpanā | yad atyantaśuṣkaṃ dravyaṃ cūrṇauṣadhaṃ saṃpiṣṭaṃ vastragālitaṃ vastrapūtaṃ tac cūrṇaṃ syāt tad eva rajaḥ kṣoda ityādīni cūrṇanāmāni bhavanti | tanmātrā bhakṣaṇamātrā karṣasaṃmitā balavāṃś cet, alpabale ekaṭaṅkād vardhitavyā | cūrṇādīnām anupānakam || 1 ||

cūrṇe guḍādimānakalpanā | idānīm aviśeṣokteṣu śarkarāguḍayor mānapūrvakaṃ prakṣepavidhim āha -
cūrṇe guḍaḥ samo deyaḥ śarkarā dviguṇā bhavet |
cūrṇeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛd bhavet ||2||

lg.l: lihec cūrṇaṃ dravaiḥ sarvair ghṛtādyair dviguṇonmitaiḥ |
pibec caturguṇair eva cūrṇam āloḍitaṃ dravaiḥ ||3||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. cūrṇa iti | guḍasāmyaṃ cūrṇāṃśāt, śarkarāpi dviguṇitā cūrṇaparimāṇād ity arthaḥ | cūrṇeṣv iti bahuvacanatvena guṭikālehādiṣv api bhājataṃ hiṅgu boddhavyam | sarvair ity ato ghṛtādyair iti yat punargrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat toyakṣīramadyamūtrādīnāṃ vyavacchedārtham | yata etaiḥ saha cūrṇasya pānam uktam etasyāgre, lehas tu madhughṛtatailadīnāṃ praśastaḥ | pibed ityādi caturguṇitātra cūrṇabhāgāt, dravair iti toyakṣīramadyamūtrādibhiḥ ||2||3||

ab.seg:
atha cūrṇādīnām anupānamātrāṃ darśayann āha -
cūrṇāvalehaguṭikākalkānāmanupānakam |
vātapittakaphātaṅke tridvyekapalam āharet || 4 ||

lg.l: yathā tailaṃ jale kṣiptaṃ kṣaṇenaiva prasarpati |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. cūrṇāvaleheti | anupānam iti anu paścāt pānam | auṣadhabhakṣaṇopari yat pītaṃ tad anupānam ity arthaḥ | “vātapittakaphātaṅke tridvyekapalam āharet” ity anukramo jñeyaḥ | ātaṅko rogaḥ tena vātātaṅke tripalaṃ, pittātaṅke dvipalaṃ, kaphātaṅke palaikam iti tātparyārthaḥ | anukteṣv anupāneṣu jalānupānaṃ praśastam | tathā hi - ‘sarveṣāmanupānaṃ syān māhendraṃ toyam uttamam’ iti | suśrute 'pi - “sarvānupāneṣu varaṃ vadanti medhyaṃ yad antaḥśucibhājanastham | lokasya janmaprabhṛtipraśastaṃ toyātmakāḥ sarvarasāḥ pradiṣṭāḥ” iti | athānupānasya prayojanaṃ nirdeṣṭum āha - yatheti | bhiṣajā saṃskṛtaṃ dravyaṃ tathā aṅgeṣu prasarpati, kutaḥ ? anupānabalād anupānaśaktitaḥ | yatheti dṛṣṭāntam āha - tailam ityādi sugamam || 4 || 5 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pittakaphātaṅke pittādīnāṃ tridvyekapalaṃ haret pitte tripalaṃ, vāte dvipalaṃ, kapha ekapalaṃ | draveṇa nimbādidraveṇa || 4 || 5 ||

ab.seg:
atha cūrṇārthaṃ bhāvanāparimāṇam āha -
draveṇa yāvatā samyak cūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ plutaṃ bhavet |
bhāvanāyāḥ pramāṇaṃ tu cūrṇe proktaṃ bhiṣagvarai: || 6 ||

Āḍhamalla. draveṇeti | sāmānyena sarvaṃ toyādikam | anyad api yad dravīkṛtaṃ tad api grāhyaṃ na doṣaḥ | plutam iti plāvitaṃ, yathā manthasvarasasvarūpaṃ tadvad iti bhiṣagvarair ity anena yuktyā kartavyam iti bhāvaḥ || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yāvat plutaṃ vyāptaṃ bhavet tad bhāvanāpramāṇam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 6 ||

athāmalakyādicūrṇaṃ jvarādau -
āmalaṃ citrakaṃ pathyā pippalī saindhavas tathā |
cūrṇito 'yaṃ gaṇo jñeyaḥ sarvajvaravināśanaḥ || 7 ||

Āḍhamalla. sa yathety anena cūrṇāni darśayati granthakāraḥ | āmalam iti āmalādiko 'yaṃ gaṇaḥ sarvajvaravināśano bhavati | āmalam ity āmalakaphalaṃ, pathyā harītakī, etat sakalaṃ sāmyam anuktatvāt | sarvajvaram ity aṣṭavidhaṃ vyavahāratas tu viṣamajvareṣu prāyaśaḥ pracarati | bhedī rucikaraḥ ityādipadadvayaṃ kecit paṭhanti || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āmalakaṃ,pathyā harītakī, śeṣaṃ sugamam ||7||

atha pippalīcūrṇaṃ jvare -
madhunā pippalīcūrṇaṃ lihet kāsajvarāpaham || 8 ||

Āḍhamalla. madhunā iti | ayaṃ madhupippalīyogaḥ kāsajvarādīn hanti | viśeṣeṇa bālānām ucitaḥ | bālaketi sāmānyena traividhyaṃ sūcayati | tad yathā āṣoḍaśād bālaḥ sa trividhaḥ kṣīrapaḥ, kṣīrānnādaḥ, annāda iti ||8||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pippalīcūrṇaṃ māṣamātraṃ madhunā lihet na tu karṣamātraṃ tīkṣṇadravyatvāt || 8 ||

mehādikeṣu triphalācūrṇam -
ekā harītakī yojyā dvau ca yojyau bibhītikau ||9 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha triphalācūrṇam āha - eketi | uktaparimāṇena mehādikān hantīti | yadā saiva triphalā sarpi- rmadhubhyām avalehitā tadā netrāmayān jayed iti | avalehas tu sāyam upayojyaḥ | tathā hy uktam ‘ūrdhvajatrugarogaghnī sāyaṃ syād avalehikā’iti | kīdṛśam uktaparimāṇaṃ tad āha - ekā harītakītyādi | etad gaṇanāparimāṇaṃ triphalāyāḥ kathitaṃ na tu tulanāyāṃ viṣamamānaṃ, yataḥ guṇakasaṃkhyāmānenaiva samatvam asyāḥ, kutaḥ ? dvikārṣikī harītakīti vākyānurodhāt | tathā hi - ‘navādiguṇasampannaṃ tathaikatvaṃ dvikarṣatā | harītakyāḥ phale yatra trayaṃ tat śreṣṭham ucyate’ iti | navādiguṇo 'pi prasaṅgato likhyate | yathā “navā snigdhā ghanā vṛttā gurvī kṣiptā tathā'mbhasi | nimajjed yā praśastatvād guṇakṛt sā prakīrtitā” iti | vibhītakam api karṣākṣaparyāyanāmabhyāṃ kathitam iti prasiddhiḥ | uktaṃ nighaṇṭau ‘vibhītakaḥ karṣaphalo vāsanto 'kṣaḥ kalidrumaḥ’ iti tena dve bibhītakaphale kathite | āmalam api kolasaṃjñaṃ vadanti, kolas tv ardhakarṣasya paryāyanāmeti | tena catvāry āmalakāni bhavanti | etena triphalāyās tulanā sāmyam api darśitam | gaṇanāyāṃ ca viṣamatvam iti, na tu tasyā bhāgeṣu viṣamatā, yato dṛśyate hi vṛddhavaidyānāṃ vyavahāro 'yam eva | yady api triphalā dvitīyāpy asti tathāpi sarvatraivāviśeṣoktau triphalāśabdena harītakyādikam eva gṛhyate | yad uktam “drākṣākāśmaryakharjūraphalānīti phalatrikā | iyaṃ proktā ca dvitīyā triphalā carakādibhiḥ” iti || 9-11 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ekā harītakī, dvau bibhītakau, catvāri āmalakāny evaṃ triphalā syāt | anye tv evam āhuḥ ekā ekabhāgā haratikī, dvau vibhāgau vibhītakaṃ, āmalakaṃ catvāri bhāgāni, tathā ca vacanaṃ - ‘bhāgam ekaṃ harītakyā dvau bhāgau ca vibhītakāt | āmalakyās trayo bhāgāḥ sahaikatra prayojayet’ iti | anye suśrutavāgbhaṭādayo bhāgapramāṇaṃ necchanti | tathā ca ‘harītakī cāmalakaṃ bibhītakādibhis trayam| triphaleyaṃ smṛtā sadbhir āyurvedaviśāradaiḥ’iti | māne 'nukte sāmyaṃ syād ity ukte: samabhāgā triphalā'tra suśrutādimate kecid bhāgam āhuḥ | ataḥ akṣadvayaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhūnimbo dṛśyate, śārṅgadhareṇa yuktabhāgavṛdvyā triphalā likhitā kevalaṃ triphalācūrṇakvāthaviṣayānupānaguṇaviṣayāṇy anyathā navāyasacūrṇādau virodhaḥ syāt, yataḥ kevalatriphalākvāthe cūrṇe ca bhāgavṛddhiḥ dṛśyate | tathā ca “pathyās tisro bibhītakyaḥ ṣaḍ dhātryo dvādaśeti ca | prasthārdhasalile kvātham aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣita”miti, netraroge ekā harītakyādicūrṇamātraiva ato na virodhaḥ | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ netrabhayahāri sarpir ghṛtaṃ madhu ca ato dvayam, atulyaṃ gṛhyate tulyayor madhusarpiṣor viruddhatvāt | atha ca anyair likhitaṃ havirmadhubhyāṃ samābhyām iti triphalāprayoge likhitam | iti triphalācūrṇam || 1-11 ||

atha tryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ dīpanādau -
pippalī maricaṃ śuṇṭhī tribhis tryūṣaṇam ucyate |
dīpanaṃ śleṣmamedoghnaṃ kuṣṭhapīnasanāśanam || 12 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha tryūṣaṇacūrṇam āha - pippalīti | idam api trikaṭukaparyāyanāmnā kathitaṃ, trayāṇāṃ sāmyam ity anuktatvāt | sāmam ity arocakaṃ doṣaṃ vā | mehagulmagalāmayān iti mehāmayān gulmāmayān galāmayān || 12 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 12 ||

atha pañcakolam arucyādau -
pippalīcavyaviśvāhnāpippalīmūlacitrakaiḥ || 13 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. pañcakolam apy āha - pippalīti | atra cavyaṃ gajapippalīmūlaṃ, viśvāhvā śuṇṭhī, pippalīmūlaṃ pippalījaṭā, citrakaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ | atrāpi pañcānāṃ samatvam | rucyaṃ rucikaraṃ, dīpanam agneḥ, pācanam āmādīnām, ānāha udarāpūraḥ | (ūṣakādigaṇaḥnāsti ‘kha’ pustake | -‘ūṣakaṃūṣa: kṣāramṛttikā | saindhavaṃ hiṅgu kāśīsadvayagugguluḥ | śilājatu tutthakaṃ ca ūṣakādir udāhṛtaḥ | ūṣakādiḥ kaphaṃ hanti gaṇo medoviśodhanaḥ | aśmarīśarkarāmūtraśūlaghnaḥ kaphagulmanut’ iti | ayam api pāṭhaḥ kvacit) || 13 || 14 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 13 || 14 ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ trigandhacāturjātakacūrṇam āha -
trigandham elātvakpatraiś caturjātaṃ sakeśaraiḥ |
trigandhaṃ sacaturjātaṃ rūkṣoṣṇaṃ laghu pittakṛt ||15||

Āḍhamalla. trigandham iti | elātvakpatraiḥ kṛtvā trigandhaṃ kathitaṃ, cāturjātaṃ tu sakeśarair elātvakpatrair eva proktam, elā sūkṣmailā, tvak guḍatvak, patraṃ patrakaṃ, keśaraṃ nāgakeśaram | rūkṣoṣṇam iti vīryataḥ laghupākitvāt | varṇyaṃ kāntikaram| tīkṣṇaṃ marīcādivat || 15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha trisugandham | elā tvakpatrajam‘tejapatra’ hi.bhā. etais tribhis trigandham ucyate | caturjātakaṃ sakeśarair etaiś caturjātaṃ keśaram | spaṣṭam anyat || 15 ||

atha jīvanīyagaṇaḥ -
kākolī kṣīrakākolī jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||16||

lg.l: medā cānyā mahāmedā jīvantī madhukaṃ tathā |
mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī jīvanīyo gaṇas tv ayam || 17 ||
stanyakṛd bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ snigdhaḥ śītas tṛṣāpahaḥ ||18||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. jīvanīyagaṇam āha - kākolītyādi | atra jīvanīyagaṇe kākolī kṣīrakākolī ca svanāmataḥ prasiddhā | kiñcid anayor jñāpanārthaṃ lakṣaṇam apy āha tad yathā - kākolī madhurā carvaṇataḥ kṣīraprāyā varṇataḥ śuklā ca | kṣīrakālolī atyantakṣīrayuktā | etad dvayaṃ viṭapaviśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇottaretīva prasiddham | jīvakarṣabhakāv iti | jīvakaś ca ṛṣabhakaś caitau, jīvako madhurarasaḥ hrasvaviṭapaḥ kūrcaśīrṣakaḥ, ṛṣabhako 'pi hrasvavṛkṣaḥ sahasrachidro viṣāṇīti | tatheti grahaṇena etad dvayam api dakṣiṇadeśe pracarati medā cānyā mahāmedā iti medā svalpaparṇī | medagandholpavṛkṣasaṃjñakaḥvṛkṣeti bhramamātram kandasvarūpeṇānyatra pratipādanāt | mede kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakāviti rājñāmapi durlabhāḥ, uttarāpathe tvasandigdha eva | , sa ca kāṣṭhaviśeṣo nakhacchedyo deśāntarād avagantavyaḥ | mahāmedā'ṣṭacchidrānvitā kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ, sa ca dakṣiṇottarapathe parvateṣu prasiddhaḥ | tatra devamaṇir iti prasiddhaḥ | jīvantī śākaviśeṣaḥ | sā cottarāpathe parvateṣu, vandā vṛkṣaśākhāsu tatraivotpadyate | madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭīti jalajātā vallīviśeṣaḥ, madhurā bhakṣaṇataś ca, asau vikhyātā sarvatraiva, mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī ceti dravyayugmaṃ nijanāmnā prasiddham | mudgavat parṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā mudgaparṇī | evaṃ māṣaparṇīti sāpi kṣudrā vanasambhavā | mārjāramodinīti māṣaparṇī ca kṛṣṇanālā hayapucchikākārā parvatodbhavāparvatetyupalakṣaṇam tena samabhūmāvapyudbhavati madhurā ca | ebhir ayaṃ jīvanīyagaṇasaṃjñaḥ svādur madhurarasaḥ | garbhasandhānakṛd iti vandhyāgarbhakaraḥ prabhāvāt, stanyakṛd iti kṣīravṛddhikaraḥ, bṛṃhaṇo dhātuvṛddhikaraḥ, vṛṣyaḥ śukravṛddhikaraḥ || || 16-18 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ayaṃ jīvanīyagaṇaḥ kāśmīrādau prasiddhaḥ | kākolyādīnāṃ lakṣaṇam āha granthāntarāt -
”pīvarīsannibhaḥ kandaḥ śuṣkasāraṃ sugandhikam |
kākolī kṣīrakākolī ardhordhaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet ||
īṣacchuklā tu kākolī kṣīravat pāṇḍurā parā |
jīvakarṣabhakau śvetau hemādriśikharodbhavau || jīvakaḥ kūrcikākāra ṛṣabho vṛṣaśṛṅgavat ||
śuṣkārdrakanibhaṃ kandaṃ snigdhaṃ madhuraśītalam |
mahāmedeti vikhyātā durgandho bheda ucyate” || jīvantī doḍīśākaḥ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, mudgaparṇī mugonī, māṣaparṇī māṣonī || 16-18 ||

athāṣṭakavargaḥ -
dve mede dve ca kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||19||

lg.l: ṛddhivṛddhī ca taiḥ sarvair aṣṭavarga udāhṛtaḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athāṣṭavargam apy āha - dve mede iti| asau guṇaiḥ kṛtvā jīvanīyagaṇasāmya: sa cāṣṭabhir dravyair militaḥ | tad yathā - “dve mede dve ca kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakau tathā |” dvau ca ṛddhivṛddhī ca dve, atra ṛddhivṛddhī tu nāmnā prasiddhe | tayoś cihnam iti yasya gṛhe ṛddhivṛddhī staḥ tasya vasuvṛddhir bhavatīti prasiddhiḥ | ayaṃ ca suśrutagaṇasaṃgrahe jīvanīyāṣṭakasaṃjñaḥ | carakayoge tat pūrvoktaṃ jīvanīyadaśakam iti || 19 || 20 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dve mede medā, mahāmedā, dve kākolyau, kākolī kṣīrakākolī, jīvakaṛṣabhakau etau dvau eṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jīvanīyagaṇa uktam | ṛddhivṛddhilakṣaṇam āha -
‘śvetalomānvitaṃ kandaṃ latājātaṃ sachidrakam |
ṛddhir vṛddhiḥ sā vijñeyā vikhyātā koṣayāmale |
bhūmigranthisamā ṛddhir vāmavartaphalaṃ tathā |
vṛddhis tu dakṣiṇāvartā phalālakṣyākuyā kṛtā| eṣām abhāve auṣadhāntaram āhaaṣṭavargapratinidhiḥ - medāmahāmedā'bhāve śatāvarī, jīvakarṣabhakābhāve bhūtikūṣmāṇḍamūlaṃ, kākolīdvayābhāve aśvagandhā, ṛddhivṛddhyabhāve ca vārāhīkanda (bhā. mū. bha 1) ‘medā'bhāve aśvagandhā, mahāmede ca śārivā | jīvakarṣabhakābhāve guḍūcī vaṃśalocanā || ṛddhyabhāve balā deyā vṛddhyabhāve mahābalā ityapi matāntaram || -
“medo jīvaś ca kākolī ṛddhir dvandve 'pi cā'sati |
yaṣṭī vidāry aśvagandhā vārāhaś ca kramāt kṣipet ||
vārāhyāś ca tathā'bhāve carmakārākulāmatā |
vārāhīkanda evātra carmakārāluko mataḥ || anūpe sa bhaved deśe vārāha iva lomavān | vārāhīkandasaṃjñas tu paścime gṛṣṭisaṃjñaka” ayam aṣṭakavargo guṇair jīrvanīyasamaḥ stanyagarbhasandhānādikārakaḥ ||19||20||

ab.seg:
atha lavaṇapañcakaṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtrādau -
sindhu sauvarcalaṃ caiva biḍaṃ sāmudrikaṃ gaḍam |
ekadvitricatuṣpañcalavaṇāni kramād viduḥ || 21 ||

lg.l: teṣu mukhyaṃ saindhavaṃ syād anukte tat prayojayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. lavaṇapañcakam āha - sindhviti | ayaṃ lavaṇapañcakasaṃjñako gaṇaḥ sindhu saindhavaṃ tac ca sindhūdbhavam ity arthaḥ | sauvarcalaṃ prasiddham | tad eva nirgandhaṃ kācalavaṇam ity ucyate | biḍaṃ kṛtrimaṃ, tac ca prasāraṇīṃ kalkam uktalavaṇasaṃyogād agnidāhena nirvṛtaṃ biḍam iti khyātam | sāmudrikam iti dakṣiṇasamudrasamīpe bhavaṃ sāmudrikaṃ, tac ca gaḍalavaṇākāraṃ vimalataraṃ jñeyam | gaḍaṃ tac ca romakaṃ, tac ca śākambharīdeśotpannam | ekadvitricatuḥpañceti lavaṇakramo vyastasamastagrahaṇārthaṃ sūcita: yathā “dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam” ityādivacanāt | trilavaṇaṃ saindhavasauvarcalaviḍam ity arthaḥ | evam anyad api bodhyam | teṣu mukhyaṃ saindhavaṃ syād ity anenānuktameṣu mukhyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tac ca saindhavaṃ yojyam iti bhāvaḥ | ( nanunāsti ’kha pustake | saindhavādyaṃ romakāntaṃ lavaṇapañcakasaṃjñaṃ punaḥ kimarthaṃ kṛtam | ucyate - ādau saindhavamante romakasya ca grahaṇaṃ tantrāntare 'pi niyataṃ madhye kvacid viparītam iti | tathā ca suśrute “saindhavasāmudrabiḍasauvarcalaromakāṇi pañca mukhyāni” iti matadvayābhiprāyeṇa punargrahaṇaṃ na doṣaḥ | pūrvamataṃ tu carake pratītam | madhuraṃ paripākāt, suśrute tu yathāpūrvaṃ svādūni | svādur atra guṇaḥ | yataḥ raseṣu guṇasaṃjñā iti kecit | apare tu lavaṇeṣu madhuratvam anurasajñakam āmananti | sṛṣṭaviṇmūtram iti sraṃsakaṃ, sūkṣmam iti romakūpādipraveśakatvāt, tīkṣṇaṃ marīcādivat || 21-23 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sindhu saindhavaṃ, sauvarcalaṃ prasiddham, biḍalavaṇaṃ kācalavaṇam āhuḥ | sāmudraṃ samudralavaṇaṃ gaḍaṃ kṛtrimaṃ kṣāralavaṇaṃ tad evam etāni ekadvitricatuṣpañcalavaṇāni kramād evaṃ vidur ṛṣaya iti śeṣaḥ | ekādikathanaṃ tu eka- dvitricatuḥpañcalavaṇādikṣepaṇārtham | cūrṇādau teṣu saindhavaṃ mukhyaṃ tad anukte 'pi kṣipet | saindhavādyaṃ romakāntaṃ jñeyaṃ lavaṇapañcakam iti punaḥ pañcalavaṇābhidhānaṃ rogādau pañcalavaṇabhakṣaṇārtham etad uktam | madhuraṃ madhurapākaḥ na tu | madhurarasaḥ | yataḥ miṣṭaḥ madhuram iti pākakrame likhitaṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtraṃ pravartanaśīlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ srotaḥpraveśi kaphavardhanaṃ madhurapākāt pittavardhanaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇatvāt || 21-23 ||

atha kṣārayogaṃ darśayann āha -
svarjikā yāvaśūkaś ca kṣārayugmam udāhṛtam |
jñeyau vahnisamau kṣārau svarjikāyāvaśūkajau || 24||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. svarjiketi | tatra svarjikā prasiddhā, ‘sājī’ śabdavācyā | yāvaśūko yavakṣāraḥ | vahnisamau uṣṇavīryatamau | yāvaśūkaś ceti cakārāṭ ṭaṅkaṇakṣāram api kṣāratritayagrahaṇena yojyam | yathā ‘kṣāratrīṇi rasendraśuddham amṛtam’ ityādivacanāt | anye kṣārāś ceti | anye muṣkakapāṭalāpāmārgagojihvikākadalīsudhāprabhṛtayaḥ | gulmārśo grahaṇīrukchidā iti | atra rukśabdo gulmādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisambadhyate | tena gulmaruk arśoruk grahaṇīrug iti | sarāḥ sraṃsakāḥ, kṛmighnāḥ puṃstvaghnāś ca pustvaṃ vīryam || 24 || 25 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kṣārakathanam | svarjikā sarjīkṣāraḥ, yāvaśūko yavakṣāraḥ etau dvau kṣārau svarjikā yāvaśūkajau vahnisamau agnitulyau | anye ṭaṅkaṇena saha kṣāratrayam āhuḥ | anye 'pi arkasehuṇḍacitrasaubhāñjanamūlakadalyapāmārgādijās te gulmādichidaḥ te kṣārakarmaṇi cūrṇādau ca yojanīyāḥ || 24 || 25 ||

ab.seg:
sudarśanacūrṇam
triphalā rajanīyugmaṃ kaṇṭakārīyugaṃ śaṭhī |
trikaṭu granthikaṃ mūrvā guḍūcī dhanvayāsakaḥ || 26 ||

lg.l: kaṭukā parpaṭo mustaṃ trāyamāṇā ca vālakam |
nimba: puṣkaramūlaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭī ca vatsakam || 27 ||
citrako devadāruś ca cavyaṃ patraṃ paṭolajam || 29 ||
jvarāṃś ca nikhilān hanyān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||32||
śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ ca pāṇḍuṃ ca hṛdrogaṃ hanti kāmalām||34||
tadvaj jvarāṇāṃ sarveṣām idaṃ cūrṇaṃ praṇāśanam ||36||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ sudarśanacūrṇaṃ nidarśayann āha - triphaleti | rajanīyugmam iti haridrādvayam | kaṇṭakārīyugam iti laghukaṇṭakārī bṛhatkaṇṭakārī ca | śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, trāyamaṇā svanāmakhyātā | vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, śigrubījaṃ śobhāñjanaṃ, śvetamaricam iti prasiddham | surāṣṭrakaṃ mṛttikāviśeṣaḥ | phaṭakarīti loke | kecit surāṣṭrakam ity asya sthāne śvadaṃṣṭrakam iti paṭhanti | tatra śvadaṃṣṭrako gokṣuraḥ, tvak varāṅgaja iti loke | candanaṃ śvetaṃ, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ, śāliparṇī, pṛṣṭhaparṇī kavaradvayaśabdavācyam | tagaraṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ paṭolapatraṃ, jīvakarṣabhakau nijanāmnā prasiddhau, puṇḍarīkaṃ kamalaṃ, tālīsapatraṃ prasiddhaṃ, bhūmyāmalakī āmalīviṭapaviśeṣaḥ śeṣaṃ subodham | etat sakalaṃ śāṇamātraṃ gṛhītvā cūrṇaṃ kartavyam | kairāto bhūnimbaḥ, tac ca samastacūrṇasya dvau bhāgau kairātacūrṇasya caiko bhāga iti | kecit sarvacūrṇasya cārdhāṃśam ity anena sarvacūrṇasyaiko bhāgaḥ bhūnimbasya bhāgaika iti vyākhyānayanti | aparaṃ tu ardhāṃśam ity anenārdhasya aṃśaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ tena samam iti vyākhyānayanti ca | aṃśaś caturthāṃśa iti prasiddhaḥ | etenāṣṭamāṃśaṃ kairātam ity arthaḥ | etad vyākhyānadvayam asaṅgatam | kutaḥ ? sarvajanāsammatatvāt doṣatrayāpaham iti prakupitadoṣatrayaṃ, vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā | nikhilān ity aṣṭadhā | nanu pṛthag dvandvāgantujāṃś ceti yat punargrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tad vyarthaṃ akhilān ity anenaiva labhyate ? ucyate paunaruktyaṃ tu jvarāṇāṃ yat tad asya jvaranāśanatve viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | ata eva nātra kāpi vicāraṇeti grahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ, tad vā sarvajvareṣv ayaṃ prāyaśaḥ pracarati nānyeṣu | tena punarjvaragrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ na doṣaḥ | aikāhikādīniti | ādiśabdāt tṛtīyakacāturthakādayaḥ | śūlaśabdas trikādikaṃ pratyekam abhisambadhyate | tatra trikaṃ vātasthānam | yathā sudarśanaṃ viṣṇucakraṃ dānavavināśanaṃ bhavati, tathā sarvajvarāṇām ayam api nāśanaḥ, tasmāt sudarśana iti saṃjñā ||26-36 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha jvare sudarśanacūrṇam | triphalā harītakyāmalakavibhītakānīti auṣadhatrayaṃ, pratyekabhāgam ekaṃ trayāṇāṃ phalānāṃ samāhāras triphaleti uktatvāt | rajanīyugmaṃ haridrā dāruharidreti dvayaṃ pratyekabhāgam ekaṃ, kaṇṭakārīyugmaṃ bṛhatīdvayaṃ, pratyekaṃ bhāgam ekaṃ, saṭhī karcūraḥ, trikaṭu śuṇṭhī maricaṃ pippalī pratyekabhāgaṃ, granthiḥ pippalīmūlaṃ, mūrvā‘moraharī’ hi.bhā.| moraṭā, gaḍūcī amṛtā, dhanvayāsakaṃ yavāsā, kaṭukī prasiddhā, parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ, mustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, trāyamāṇā prasiddhā, bālakam udīcyaṃ, nimbaḥ nimbatvak, puṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ, madhuyaṣṭī madhukaṃ, vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, yavānī ajamodā, indrayavaḥ kuṭajabījaṃ, bhāraṅgī śigrubījaṃ, śobhāñjanaṃ tasya bījaṃ, surāṣṭrajā sphaṭikā vā vacā, tvak taja, padmakāṣṭhaṃ, uśīraṃ, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, ativiṣāatīsa| prasiddhā, balā prasiddhā, śāliparṇī śālipatrī, pṛṣṭhaparṇī sañjīvanī, viḍaṅgaṃ, tagaraṃ, citrakaṃ, devadāru, cavyaṃ, paṭolapatraṃ paṭolajaṃ, jīvakarṣabhakāv aṣṭavargoktau, tadabhāve lavaṅgavaṃśalocanau, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalam | kākolī aṣṭavargoktā tadabhāve patrajaṃ, jātipatraṃ tālīsapatram, etāni samabhāgāni sarvacūrṇasyārdhabhāgaṃ kairātaṃ bhūnimbaṃ etat sudarśanaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ doṣatrayādināśakaṃ tathā nānāvidhān jvarān hanyāt | sugamam anyat || 26-36 ||

atha jvare pippalīcūrṇam |
kāsaśvāsajvaraharī triphalā pippalīyutā |
cūrṇitā madhunā līḍhā bhedinī cāgnibodhinī||37||
Āḍhamalla. athāparāṇi cūrṇāny āha - kāseti | atra triphalā samatulitā grāhyā | pippalīyuteti | pippalī ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, madhv atrāvalehayogyaṃ cūrṇamānaṃ tu doṣabalāpekṣayā || 37 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. triphalā harītakyāmalakavibhītakāni bhāgatrayaṃ, pippalībhāgaikā evaṃbhūtā cūrṇitā madhunāloḍya triphalā kāsaśvāsajvaraharā bhavati | yad vā bhāgavṛddhyā triphalā, ekā harītakī, dvau vibhītakau, catvāri āmalakāni evaṃbhūtā triphalā pippalīyutā pippalī triphalātulyā kāsādijvaraharā bhavati | kevalatriphalācūrṇasya bhāgavṛddhir na bahuguṇayuktatvāt || 37 ||

lg.l: kaṭphalaṃ mustakaṃ tiktā śaṭhī śṛṅgī ca pauṣkaram |
cūrṇam eṣāṃ ca madhunā śṛṅgaberarasena vā || 38 ||
vāyuśūlaṃ tathā chardiṃ kṣayaṃ caiva vyapohati || 39 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kaṭphalam iti | ayaṃ kaṭphalādisaṃjñakaś cūrṇagaṇaḥ | tatra tiktā kaṭurohiṇī, śṛṃgī karkaṭākhyā, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlam | tadabhāve kuṣṭhaṃ grāhyam | śṛṅgaberaraseneti ārdrakarasena caturguṇena saha pānamuktaṃ vyavahārān na tu lehyam | leham asya madhunā dviguṇenety arthaḥ | vāyuśūlam iti grahaṇaṃ vātajanitaśūlam | eke vāyuśūlam iti paṭhanti tatra gudāgatavātapīḍām ity arthaḥ | nanu vātād eva sakalaśūlasyopapattir iti, yataḥ ‘na vātena vinā śūlam’ ityādivacanaṃ, tat katham atra pṛthag vātaśūlagrahaṇam ? ucyate vāyuśūlaṃ vātaprāyaṃ śūlaṃ na pittakaphādiprāyaṃ, yasmāt ‘śūlāny aṣṭau budhā jaguḥ’ iti || 38 || 39 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kaṭphalādicūrṇaṃ jvarādau - kaṭphalaṃ kāphalaṃ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ, mustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, tiktā kaṭukī, saṭhī karcūra:, śṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhunā śṛṃgaberamārdrakaṃ tadrasena ca lihejvparaharaṃ syāt || 38 || 39 ||

ab.seg:
atha bṛhatkaṭphalādicūrṇa -
kaṭphalaṃbīpikāyāṃ nā'sti| pauṣkaraṃ śṛṅgī mustā trikaṭukaṃ śaṭhī |
samastāny ekaśo vāpi sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||40||

lg.l: kaṭphalaṃ pauṣkaraṃ kṛṣṇā śṛṅgī ca madhunā saha |

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. trikaṭukaṃ trikaṭu samastāni militvaikaśa: bhinnaṃ vā cūrṇaṃ tulyaṃ melayet | ārdrakasvarasais tathā kṣaudrair lehayet kaphādināśakaṃ bhavati || 40-42 ||

śṛṅgīcūrṇam |
śṛṅgīṃ prativiṣāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ cūrṇitāṃ madhunā lihet |
śiśoḥ kāsajvaracchardiśāntyai vā kevalāṃ viṣām ||43||

Āḍhamalla. śṛṃgīm iti | etat śṛṃgyādicūrṇaṃ bālaroge 'tīva praśastam | śṛṅgī karkaṭākhyā, prativiṣā śuklakanta, kṛṣṇā pippalī | vety anena yogāntaram āha - kevalāṃ viṣam iti | evam ativiṣāṃ madhunā sahāvalihya bālo jvarebhyo vimuktaḥ syād ity arthaḥ | tathā ca tantrāntare “śṛṃgīṃ sakṛṣṇātiviṣāṃ vicūrṇya lehaṃ vidadhyān madhunā śiśūnām | kāsajvaracchardibhir arditānāṃ samākṣikaṃ cātiviṣām athaikām’ iti | bālānām atīsāre 'pi mustānvito 'yaṃ yogaḥ pracarati | caturbhujīti tatra cauhaṣad iti‘caudī’ pā | śabdavācyaḥ | tathā hi ‘ghanakṛṣṇāruṇāśṛṅgīcūrṇaṃ kṣaudreṇa saṃyutam | śiśor jvarātisāraghnaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ vamiṃ jayet iti || 43 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śṛṃgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, prativiṣā ativiṣā, kṛṣṇā pippalī, eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhunā lihet śiśur bālas tasya kāsādiśāntyai kevalam ekāṃ viṣām ativiṣāṃ madhunā lihet | iti śṛṅgīcūrṇaṃ bālajvarādau ||43||

div.ab:
yavakṣārādicūrṇam -
(yavakṣāraprakṣiptam| viṣāśṛṅgīmāgadhīpauṣkarodbhavam |
cūrṇaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ līḍhaṃ pañcakāsāñ jayec chiśoḥ ||44||)

ab.seg:
atīsāre śuṇṭhyādicūrṇam āha -
śuṇṭhīprativiṣāhiṅgumustākuṭajacitrakaiḥ |
cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pītam āmātīsāranāśanam || 45 ||

Āḍhamalla. śuṇṭhīti | hiṅgv atra bharjitaṃ deyam | kuṭajam atrendrayavaṃ pācanatvāt | uṣṇāmbuneti caturguṇitoṣṇapānīyena sahāloḍya tridoṣeṇa tu phāṇṭavad viplāvya pibet cūrṇakalpanāyāṃ kathitatvāt || 44-45 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha śuṇṭhyādicūrṇam āmātīsārādau | prativiṣā ativiṣā || 45 ||

atha harītakyādicūrṇam āmātīsārādau -
harītakī prativiṣā sindhu sauvarcalaṃ vacā |
hiṅgu ceti kṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ pibed uṣṇena vāriṇā ||46||

Āḍhamalla. aparam apy āha - harītakīti | sindhu saindhavaṃ hiṅgv atra bharjitaṃ deyam | pānamānaṃ tu pūrvavat| ayaṃ yogo grahaṇyām api praśastaḥ | eke harītakītyāgenāpi yogam enaṃ kurvanti | tad uktam atraiva paribhāṣādhyāye ‘vyādher anuktaṃ yad dravyaṃ gaṇoktam api tat tyajet’ ityādivacanāt||46 ||

laghugaṅgādharacūrṇam |
mustam indrayavaṃ bilvaṃ lodhraṃ mocarasaṃ tathā || 47 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ gaṅgādharasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇadvayam āha mustam ityādi | etal laghugaṅgādharaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ saṃgrāhakaṃ paraṃ vikhyātam | atra bilvaṃ bilvapeśikā, mocarasaḥ śālmalīniryāsaḥ, dhātakī dhātakīkusumāni | atra takropalakṣitatvāt mathitam api grāhyam | anyato darśanād vā ‘mathitaguḍasāmprayuktam’ iti | nanu mathitatakrayoḥ ko bhedaḥ ? ucyate ‘sajala gorasaṃ gholaṃ mastu tac cārdhavārikam | takraṃ tribhāgabhinnaṃ tu kevalaṃ mathitaṃ smṛtam’ iti | kalpanā cāsya mustādicūrṇaṃ kārṣikaṃ mathitacaturguṇena guḍakarṣavimādatena saha pītam | pakvātīsāre yogo 'yam ||47||48||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pravāhikāṃ niruṇaddhi rodhayet ||47 ||48||

ab.seg:
atha bṛhadgaṅgādharacūrṇam -
mustāralukaśuṇṭhībhir dhātakīlodhravālakaiḥ || 49 ||

lg.l: vṛddhagaṅgādharaṃ cūrṇaṃ saridvegasya rodhakamge'pi bandhakam” pā.| |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. anyad api | musteti | atrāraluko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ | vatsakaḥ kuṭajatvak | āmrabījam iti āmraphalāsthimajjā, lajjāluvikhyātā | atrāpi dviguṇitena kṣaudreṇa vimṛdya caturguṇena taṇḍulajalena peyam | saridvegasya rodhakam iti nadīpravāhāvarodhakatvenotkṛṣṭaprabhāvayuktaḥ, ata eva gaṅgādharasaṃjñā ||49||51||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, aralukaḥ syonākaḥ, dhātakī vṛkṣas tasya puṣpāṇi, lodhraḥ prasiddhaḥ, vālakaṃ udīcyaṃ, lajjāluḥ lajjāvantī | spaṣṭam anyat || 49-51 ||

athājamodādicūrṇam atīsāre -
ajamodā mocarasaṃ saśṛṃgaberaṃ sadhātakī kumumam |
godadhimathitayuktaṃ gaṃgām api vāhinīṃ rudhyāt ||52||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ajamodā, mocarasaḥ, śṛṅgaberaṃ - śuṇṭhī, dhātakī, godadhimathitaṃ ghola ucyate | gaṅgām api vāhinīṃ vahanaśīlāṃ pravāhiṇīṃ rundhyāt || 52 || 53 ||

ab.seg:
maricādicūrṇaṃ -
takreṇa yaḥ piben nityaṃ cūrṇaṃ maricasaṃbhavam |
citrasauvarcalopetaṃ grahaṇī tasya naśyati |
udaraplīhamandāgnigulmārśonāśanaṃ bhavet || 53 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha grahaṇyāṃ prayogān āha - takreṇeti | idaṃ maricādyaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyāṃ praśastam | maricacitrakasauvarcalaṃ samacūrṇaṃ sārdhaśāṇadvayaṃ caturguṇena takreṇa saha pibet | nityam ity anena sevyam idaṃ mahārogopayuktatvāt ||52||53||

ab.seg:
atha kapitthāṣṭakaṃ cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyādau -
aṣṭau bhāgāḥ kapitthasya ṣaḍbhāgā śarkarā matā |
dāḍimaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca śrīphalaṃ dhātakī tathā ||54||

lg.l: ajamodā pippalī ca pratyekaṃ syus tribhāgikāḥ |
maricaṃ jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ granthikaṃ vālakaṃ tathā || 55 ||
atīsāraṃ kṣayaṃ gulmaṃ grahaṇīṃ ca vyapohati || 57 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kapitthakāṣṭakaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - aṣṭāv iti | dāḍimam atrāmlam, ‘anāradānā? śabdavācyam | tintiḍīkaṃ svanāmaprasiddham | amlaphalam ity eke | śrīphalaṃ bilvam | atrāpi tintiḍīkasthāne vṛkṣāmlam iti, granthikasthāne ca tintiḍīkam iti kecit | cāturjātakam iti tvakpatrailaṃ sakeśaram ity arthaḥ | kartavyavidhāv api kapitthaphalam aṣṭabhāgikam ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, dravyaṃ tu ekabhāgasaṃjñitam | śarkarā ṣaḍbhāgā, dāḍimādini pippalīparyantāni pratyekaṃ tribhāgikaṃ, maricādināgarāntaṃ bhāgaikaṃ satyekam iti bhāvaḥ | etena kim uktam ? kapitthaṃ karṣāṣṭakaṃ, sitā ṣaṭkarṣapramitā, dāḍimādiṣaṭdravyam aṣṭādaśakarṣamitaṃ, maricāditrayodaśadravyāṇi trayoda- śakarṣāṇīty arthaḥ | asya khāṇḍavasaṃjñā tantrāntare | kutaḥ ? “lavaṇāmlasitāyuktaṃ cūrṇaṃ syāt khāṇḍavaṃ matam” ityā- divacanāt | kapitthāṣṭakasaṃjñayā'sya rūḍhiḥ ||54-57||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pitthasyāṣṭau bhāgāḥ palāni vā karṣāṇi vā ṭaṅkāni vā bhāgaśabdena palādīnāṃ abhidhānāt| śarkarā sitā ṣaḍbhāgā ṣaṭpalādikā, dāḍimādyāḥ ṣaṭ, pratyekaṃ tribhāgikā syād etac cūrṇitaṃ kapitthāṣṭhakaṃ syāt tac ca galāmayādikān vyapohatīti spaṣṭārtha: | atra kapitthāṣṭake kecit prakārāntareṇa bhāgam anicchanti tadarthaṃ śataślokyāṃ bopadevamatam āha - “dhānyājājīyamānī rucakajalacaturjātaviśvoṣaṇāgnigranthyekāṃśaṃ tribhāgaṃ kara- kakaṇamadādīpyavṛkṣāmlabilvam | śvetāṣaṭkaṃ kapitthāṣṭakam idam aruciṃ gulmayakṣmātisāraṃ sāgnīsādaṃ grahaṇiga- lagadaśvāsakāsān nihanti”| asya vyākhyānaṃ ca dhānyādigranthikāntaṃ trayodaśauṣadham ekāṃśaṃ pratyekam ekakarṣaṃ, karakādivilvāntaṃ ṣoḍaśauṣadhaṃ tribhāgaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣatrayamātraṃ, karakaṃ dāḍimaṃ, kaṇā pippalī, madā dhātakī, dīpyo ajamodaḥ, vṛkṣāmlaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ, bilvaphalaṃ, śvetā śarkarā, tasyāḥ ṣaṭkaṃ pūrvavat ṣaṭkarṣāḥ kapitthaṃ dadhiphalaṃ śeṣaṃ spaṣṭaṃ pūrvavat | aṣṭau karṣā atra kapitthāṣṭake ye 'nye bhāgaprakāram icchanti, tatra sūktiśūnyatvāt tyaktā iti bopadevamataṃ, vaṅgasenādinibandhakārapāṭhe na kecid bhāgaprakārāntaram āhus tad api likhyate | tad uktaṃ vaṅgasene
“yamānīpippalīmūlacaturjātakanāgaraiḥ |
mīracāgnijalājājīdhānyasauvarcalaiḥ samaiḥ ||
vṛkṣāmladhā- takīkṛṣṇābilvadāḍimadīpyakaiḥ |
triguṇaiḥ ṣaḍguṇasitaiḥ kapitthāṣṭaguṇīkṛtaiḥ|| cūrṇo 'tīsāragrahaṇīkṣayagulmagalā- mayān | kāsaśvāsāgnimāṃdyārśaḥpīnasārocakān jayet” iti | yavānyādisauvarcalāntaiḥ samaiḥ pratyekamekabhāgaiḥ vṛkṣāmlādidīpyakāntais triguṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ tribhāgaiḥ ṣaḍguṇasitaiḥ kapitthāṣṭaguṇaiḥ kṛtaiḥ kapitthāṣṭabhāgair iti pūrvokta evārtha ity eke | bopadevenāpy aṣṭau vyākhyātatvāt| cūrṇa iti prastutatvāt puṃliṅge | tathā ca śataślokyāṃ cūrṇastulyasito balāgnirucibhyaś ceti cāturjātādicūrṇe likhitaṃ anya evaṃ vyākhyānayanti ‘yavānyāditrayodaśauṣadhayaḥ samāḥ’ pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkakamātrās trayodaśaṭaṅkā etai: tintiḍīkādyaiḥ ṣaḍbhis triguṇais trayodaśebhyas triguṇair ekonacatvāriṃśaṭaṅkaiḥ ṣaṅguṇasitais trayodaśebhya evāṣṭasaptatiṭaṅkaiḥ’ | asmin pakṣe sarvato dviguṇā sitā bhavati yathā lumbādau ardhāṃśāṃ kecic charkarāṃ melayanti || 54-57 ||

dāḍimāṣṭakam |
dāḍimī dvipalā grāhyā khaṇḍād daśapalani ca |
trigandhasya palaṃ caikaṃ trikaṭu syāt palatrayam || 58 ||

lg.l: etad ekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cūrṇaṃ syād dāḍimāṣṭakam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. dāḍimīti | ayaṃ laghugurubhedena dāḍimāṣṭhakasaṃjñako yogo 'tīsārādīnāṃ praśastaḥ | khaṇḍād daśapalānīti saṃmilitacūrṇāt paladvayanyūnā dviguṇā śarkarā jñeyā tīkṣṇatvāt | trigandhasya palam ekaṃ militasyety arthaḥ| tryūṣaṇasyāpi palatrayaṃ pratyekaṃ palam ity arthaḥ | khaṇḍād daśapalāni cety atra sthāne khaṇḍād aṣṭapalāni ceti kecit paṭhanti| tanmate cūrṇasamaṃ khaṇḍam iti vyādhivihitatvāt, ayaṃ pakṣaḥ pracarati | sāmyārthaṃ trigandhasya pratyekaṃ palaṃ grāhyam| dāḍimāṣṭhakety aṣṭamaṃ dravyam atra dāḍimaṃ tena dāḍimāṣṭakaṃ proktam || 58 || 59 ||
