Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha dāḍimāṣṭakam | dāḍimād amladāḍimāt dve pale, khaṇḍāt sitāyā aṣṭapalāni, trigandhasyailātva- kpatrakāṇām ekaṃ palaṃ samuditasya trigandhasya palaṃ, trikaṭu śuṇṭhīmaricapippalyaḥ eṣāṃ palatrayaṃ, pratyekam etad ekīkṛtaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakaṃ bhavati | dāḍimādīni aṣṭau dravyāṇi yatra tad dāḍimāṣṭakam | spaṣṭam anyat ||58 || 59 ||

ab.seg:
atha bṛhaddāḍimāṣṭakam atīsārādau -
dāḍimasya palāny aṣṭau śarkarāyāḥ palāṣṭakam |
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ yamānī maricaṃ tathā || 60||

lg.l: pratyekaṃ kolamātrāḥ syus tac cūrṇaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakam |
atīsāraṃ kṣayaṃ gulmaṃ grahaṇīṃ ca galagraham || 62 ||
mandāgniṃ pīnasaṃ kāsaṃ cūrṇam etad vyapohati |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. dvitīyaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakam āha - dāḍimasyeti | etad vṛddhadāḍimāṣṭakasaṃjñaṃ cūrṇam atīsārādīn hanti | atra tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanā tadabhāve tavakṣīraṃ grāhyam | tavakṣīraṃ karcūrakṛtaḥ prakāraḥ | sā karṣapramāṇā tvak varāṅgam, patram patrakam, elā sūkṣmailā, keśaraṃ nāgakeśaram, etac catuṣṭayaṃ kolamātram | kolaṃ karṣārdhaṃ, tena saṃmilitaṃ ṭaṅkāṣṭakam ity arthaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam | galagrahaṃ galarogam | asyāṣṭakasaṃjñā palāṣṭakena boddhavyā na tu dravyasaṃkhyaya ||60-62||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tugākṣīrī vāṃśī tadādau karṣamātrā, kolaḥ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ syāt | dāḍimam aṣṭau aṣṭapalāni yatra tad dāḍimāṣṭakaṃ atra bhāgāniruktiḥ, auṣadhabahutvāt pūrvam adharaṃ bhāgālpatvāt pūrvaṃ laghudāḍimāṣṭakaṃ tato 'tīsārādikaṃ vyapohati ||60-62||

div.ab:
pippalyādicūrṇam |
(pippalī bṛhatī vyāghrī yavakṣārakaliṅgakāḥ ||63||
citrakaṃ sārivā pāṭhā śaṭhī lavaṇapañcakam |
tac cūrṇaṃ pāyayed dadhnā surayoṣṇāmbunāpi vā || 64 ||
mārutagrahaṇīdoṣaśamanaṃ paramaṃ hitam |)

ab.seg:
atha lavaṅgādicūrṇam arocakādau -
lavaṅgaṃ śuddhakarpūram elātvaṅnāgakeśaram || 65 ||

lg.l: candanaṃ tagaraṃ vālaṃ kaṅkolaṃ ceti cūrṇayet |
hṛdrogaṃ kaṇṭharogaṃ ca kāsaṃ hikvāṃ ca pīnasam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha lavaṅgādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - lavaṅgam iti | śuddhakarpūram iti śuddhaṃ ca tat karpūraṃ ceti, pakvakarpūram ity arthaḥ | atilaghutvāt| tathā hi - “pakvas tu dvividhaḥ prokto sadalo nirdalastathā | dṛḍhaś ca pītavarṇaś ca viśeṣāl laghutāṃ gataḥ” iti| kecit tu śuddhaśabdena jātyutkṛṣṭaṃ gṛhṇanti, tac ca īśāvāsa iti saṃgītam | tathā hy uktam - “īśāvāso himasaṃjñaḥ potāśraya iti tridhā | apakve kathyate bhedaḥ karpūre tu bhiṣavaraiḥ” | svarūpeṇā'pi - “īśāvāso bhṛśaṃ śveto himasaṃjñas tu pāṇḍuraḥ | śvetapotāśrayaś ceti” sarve | guṇenāpi “rasavīryavipākataḥ | prabhāveṇāpi te proktāḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ guṇādhikāḥ | prakṛṣṭhatvenāpi - “tatrāpi yo na ca kṣudraḥ sphaṭikābhaḥ sa uttamaḥ” iti | kṛṣṇajīrakam iti pāścātyaṃ khurāsānīti loke | kṛṣṇāguru agurviti prasiddham | tugākṣīrī vāṃśī māṃsī jaṭākhyā | nīlotpalopalakṣitatvāt padmabījaṃ grāhyaṃ, kaṇā pippalī, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, tagaraṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, vālaṃ vālakaṃ, kaṅkolaphaladravyaṃ nijanāmaprasiddhaṃ, tac ca dvividhaṃ marīcakaṅkolaṃ kṣīrakaṅkolaṃ ceti | etat sakalaṃ dravyaṃ samabhāgaṃ cūrṇayitavyaṃ, sarvebhyaḥ sitārdhā bhavet | tena sakalacūrṇasya bhāgaikaṃ, sitāyāś ca bhāgaikaṃ, taccūrṇasamānā ca sitety arthaḥ | eke sitārdhā bhaved ity anena saṃmitacūrṇasya dvau bhāgau sitāyā eko bhāga iti vyākhyānayanti, etad asaṅgataṃ vyavahārāt | rājārham iti prabhuyogyam atisugandhatvāt bahulaguṇakaratvāc ca | ropaṇaṃ śarīrasthirakaraṃ vraṇaropaṇaṃ ca, tarpaṇaṃ dhātūnāṃ tṛptijanakaṃ, vṛṣyaṃ śukravṛddhikāri, balam ojas tatpradam ity arthaḥ | tamakaḥ śvāsabhedaḥ, uraḥkṣataṃ kṣayaroge paṭhitam | asyāgre karpūrādyaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ kecit paṭhanti | tac ca bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate, kṣepako 'yam iti manyamānair asmābhir na likhitaḥ | karpūrādiḥnāsti ‘kha’ pustake | kvacil likhitaḥ
“sakarpūraṃ ca kaṅkolaṃ jātīphaladalaṃ samam |
lavaṅganāgamaricakṛṣṇāśuṇṭhīvivardhitam |
cūrṇaṃ sitāsamaṃ grāhyaṃ rocanaṃ kṣayakāsanut |
vaisvaryaśvāsagulmārśaḥkaṇṭhāmayabhayāpaham |
prayuktaṃ cānnapāneṣu bhiṣajā rogiṇāṃ hitat” | iti karpūrādyaṃ cūrṇam | atha laghulavaṅgādicūrṇaṃ tantrāntare -
“lavaṅgajātīphalapippalīnāṃ bhāgān prakalpyākṣasamānaśeṣān |
palārdhamekaṃ maricasya datvā palāni catvāri mahauṣadhasya || sitāsamaṃ cūrṇam idaṃ prasahya rogān imān āśu balān nihanti | kāsajvarārocakagulmamehaśvāsāgnimāndyaṃ grahaṇīvikārān” iti | laghulavaṅgādicūrṇam || 63-69 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuddhakarpūraḥ nirmalabhīmasena, tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanā, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, kaṇā pippalī, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, agaru, vālam udīcyaṃ, kaṅkolaṃ maricakaṃkolaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat || 63-69 ||

atha jātīphalādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyādau -
jātī phalalavaṅgailāpatratvaṅnāgakeśaraiḥ ||70||

lg.l: yāvanty etāni sarvāṇi kuryād bhaṅgāṃ ca tāvatīm ||72||
karṣamātraṃ tataḥ khāden madhunā plāvitaṃ sudhīḥ ||73||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ jātīphalādyaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - jātīphaleti | atra candanaṃ śvetaṃ cūrṇatvāt | tilair iti kṛṣṇatilāḥ nistuṣā grāhyāḥ | tvakkṣīrī vaṃśarocanā, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, (āmalam āmalakaphalaṃnāsti ‘kha’ pustake | , pathyā harītakī, sthūlajīrakaḥ kṛṣṇajīrakaḥ etat sakalaṃ samabhāgaṃ gṛhītvā cūrṇitam) asya bhāgam ekaṃ bhaṅgāyā bhāgaikam iti tena sakalacūrṇasamānā bhaṅgā deyā iti | bhaṅgā'tra bharjitā deyā vyavahārāt | sarvacūrṇasamā deyā śarkarā ceti tena dvayo: samā śarkarety arthaḥ| etat siddhaṃ yathocitamātraṃ madhunā plāvya bhakṣyaṃ, nātra karṣamānaṃ niyataṃ yataḥ - “mātrāyā nāsty avasthānam” ityādivacanāt ||70-74 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. elā sūkṣmā, patraṃ patrajatvak‘taja’ hi.m?. | kṛṣṇā agaru, tvakkṣīrī vāṃśī, tagaram, āmalakaṃ, tālīsaṃ, pathyā harītakī, sthūlajīrakaṃ śvetajīrakam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 70-74 ||

atha mahākhāṇḍavacūrṇam arucyādau -
maricaṃ nāgapuṣpāṇi tālīsaṃ lavaṇāni ca |
pratyekam ekabhāgāḥ syuḥ pippalīmūlacitrakaiḥ || 75 ||

lg.l: tvakvaṇā tintiḍīkaṃ ca jīrakaṃ ca dvibhāgikam |
chardiṃ pañcavidhāṃ śvāsaṃ cūrṇam etad vyapohati ||80||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha mahākhāṇḍavasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇam āha - maricam iti | nāgapuṣpāṇīti nāgakeśaram | lavaṇānīti bahuvacanatvena pañcalavaṇāni grāhyāṇi, tāni ca ‘sindhusauvarcalopetaṃ biḍaṃ sāmudrakaṃ gaḍam’ iti | asmatsaṃpradāye lavaṇānīty anena saindhavam eva grāhyaṃ nānyat svajātyutkṛṣṭatvena bahuvacanagrahaṇam | tvak tajaśabdavācyam | atra maricādilavaṇāntaṃ pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkaikaṃ; pippalīmūlādijīrakāntaṃ pratyekam ṭaṅkadvimitaṃ; amlavetasaṃ svanāmaprasiddham, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, bhadrailā bṛhadelā, badarāṇi badaraphalāni, ajamodā'tra yamānī | evaṃ sarvatrāntaḥparimārjane, bahi:parimārjane tu ajamodā ajamodaiva | tathā hi “antaḥsaṃmārjane prāyaś cājamodā yamānikā | bahiḥsaṃmārjane yojyā tv ajamodaiva niścitam” iti | yatrājamodāyamānyau stas tatra yamāny eva dviguṇā antaḥparimārjane | jaladharo mustam | dhānyādi jaladharāntaṃ pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkatrayam iti; etatsakalacūrṇasya caturthāṃśaṃ dāḍimaphalaṃ tena māṣādhikadaśaṭaṅkam ity arthaḥ | dāḍimaphalam atrāmlaṃ yal loke ‘anāradānā’ śabdavācyam| khāṇḍavatvāt samastadravyebhyaḥ sitā śarkarā ardhabhāgikā deyā, tena sakalacūrṇasāmyam ity arthaḥ | sakalacūrṇasāmyaṃ kiyatpramāṇaṃ ? ṭaṅkādhikakuḍavamānam iti bhāvaḥ | mahākhāṇḍavam iti ‘lavaṇāmlasitāyuktaḥ khāṇḍavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram iti | nanu “cūrṇe guḍaḥ samo deyaḥ śarkarā dviguṇā bhavet” iti niyamena katham atra cūrṇasamatulitā sitā ? ucyate, ayam api yogo 'gnimāndye pradhānatamaḥ, agnisādo hi prāyeṇa śleṣmādhikaḥ syāt śleṣmaṇi ca madhuro bahutaro na yukta ity adoṣaḥ | yad vā ‘dviguṇamānam anukteṣu yad uktaṃ tat tathaiva ca’ iti ||75-80||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nāgapuṣpāṇi nāgakeśaraṃ,lavaṇāni pañca lavaṇāni bahuvacanāt | etāni pratyekabhāgāni pañcalavaṇānām api pratyekabhāgam | tvak taja:, kaṇā pippalī, dhānyaṃ prasiddham, amlavetasaḥ tasya cukraṃ vā raso vā gṛhyate, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, bhadrailā bṛhadelā, badaraṃ laghubadaraṃ, jaladharo mustam | mahākhāṇḍavasaṃjñametat surocanaṃ suṣṭhu rucikaraṃ arocakādhikāritvāt tathāgnimāndyādiharaṃ khāṇḍavo dvividhaḥ eko lehyaḥ aparaś cūrṇasaṃjñaḥ | yathā coktam
“āme hy amlapalaṃ caiva khaṇḍapakvaṃ ghṛtānvitam |
elāmaricasaṃyuktaṃ jñātavyaḥ sa ca khāṇḍavaḥ” | anye tv evam āhuḥ -“kapitthatintiḍīkabījakarpūrakadāḍimaiḥ | tathāmalakayuktaiś ca saṣaḍbhi: khāṇḍava: smṛtaḥ”| pūrvoktas tu avalehyaḥ | tathā coktam “āmlamadhuraiḥ spaṣṭaḥ, kaṣāyalavaṇauṣaṇaḥ atiktakhāṇḍavaḥ kolakapitthādyapakvaṃ hi” iti || 75-80 ||

atha nārāyaṇacūrṇam udarādau -
citrakaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ jīrakaṃ hapuṣā vacā |
yamānī pippalīmūlaṃ śatapuṣpā'jagandhikā || 81 ||

lg.l: kuṣṭhaṃ ceti samāṃśāni viśālā syād dvibhāgikā |
trivṛt tribhāgā vijñeyā dantyā bhāgatrayaṃ bhavet||83||
caturbhāgā śātalā syāt sarvāṇy ekatra cūrṇayet |
hṛdroge pāṇḍuroge ca kāse śvāse bhagandare ||85||
mandāgnau ca jvare kuṣṭhe grahaṇyāṃ ca galagrahe |
dvividhe ca viṣe dadyāt ghṛtena viṣanāśanam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ nārāyaṇacūrṇaṃ prakaṭayann āha - citram iti | triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam | havuṣeti svanāmataḥ prasiddham | kecit tu ‘ruu’ śabdavācyaṃ vadanti | kṣārāv iti dvau kṣāro tena svarjikā yavakṣāraś ceti | lavaṇapañcakaṃ prasiddham | kuṣṭhaṃ ceti samāṃśānīti | viśālendravāruṇī sā dvibhāgikā ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, trivṛn niśothaḥ dvibhāgā, atrāpi dravyaikabhāgāpekṣayā, dantī ca prasiddhā tasyā bhāgatrayaṃ, dravyaikamānād api boddhavyam | śātalā carmakaṣā iti loke śehuṇḍabheda iti trisaṭenāpi yavatiktakaśabdena likhitaḥ | sa ca dravyaikabhāgāpekṣayā caturbhāgaḥ | pācanasnehādyair iti | pācanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pācanaṃ vyādhivihitaṃ, snehanaṃ ghṛtapānādikam | ādiśabdāt svedādikaṃ ca, etena kṛtapūrvaiḥ pācanādyaiḥ kṛtvā snigdhakoṣṭhasya rogiṇa etac cūrṇaṃ virekāya dadyād ity arthaḥ | tathā hi -“vātodaraṃ balavataḥ pūrvaṃ snehair upācaret | snigdhāya sveditāṅgāya dadyāt snehavirecanam” iti | nanv iha “vivarjayet snehapānam ajīrṇī codarī jvarī” iti vacanāt sneho niṣiddhaḥ, “naite svedyā nodarī nātisārī” ity anena svedasyāpi niṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ | tat kathaṃ svedasnuhopadeśaḥ ? ucyate, svatantrayoḥ snehasvedayor niṣedho boddhavyaḥ, na tu śodhanāṅgabhūtayos tayoḥ anyathā doṣaharaṇasya duṣkaratvāt | dadyād yuktānupāneneti | yuktānupānam atraiva kathyate tad yathā - ādhmāne surādibhir iti | ādigrahaṇād āsavāriṣṭasīdhumādhvīkādibhiḥ | gulme badaranīreṇeti badarakvāthenety arthaḥ | viḍbhaṅge dadhimastuneti dadhi ca mastu ca yad vā dadhno mastu nānājātikaṃ, yata: mastu saptavidhaṃ bhavet | tad yathā - ‘svādvamlam atyamlakamandajātaṃ tathāmṛtakṣīrabhavaṃ saraś ca | asāram evaṃvidhasaptadhā'smin varge smṛtaṃ mastuguṇās tathaiva’ iti | prasaṃgato 'syārthaṃ prakaṭayann āha - svādvamlam ityādi sthādu dadhi amlaṃ dadhi atyamlaṃ dadhi rasajātam atyamlaṃ dadhi manyajātaṃ dadhi ebhyo jatim ity arthaḥ | tathā'mṛtakṣīrabhavam iti | vinaṣṭadugdhajātaṃ sara iti dadhna upari ghano bhāgaḥ snehabahulaḥ sara iti prasiddha: | asāraṃ sārarahitam uddhṛtasnehasya dadhno vinirmitam ity arthaḥ | iti saptavidhaṃ mastu darśitam | anye kūrcikā dadhitakrabhedena mastu dvividham iti paṭhanti, uṣṇāmbunā saha peyam iti vyavahāraḥ | uṣṇāmbubhir iti bahuvacanatvenāṣṭamāṃśāvaśeṣādikaṃ grāhyam | tac ca yathādoṣānurūpam iti yojyam | vṛkṣāmlair iti asya kvāthenety arthaḥ | parikartiṣviti | gude parikartanam iva vedanāvṛddhir iti parikartikā kathyate | uṣṭrīdugdhena gavāṃ takreṇa vā | udareṣu iti sarvodareṣv ity arthaḥ | prasannayā vātaroge iti | prasannā surāmaṇḍaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tathā coktaṃ
‘prasannā syāt surāmaṇḍas tasmāt kādambarī ghanā |
jagalas tadadhaḥ prokto jagalān madako ghanaḥ || vakkaso hṛtasāraḥ syāt surābījaṃ tu kiṇvakam’ iti guṇenāpi prasannām āha - ‘gulmārśaśchardyarocakavātanut’ iti rāsnayā vātarogeṣv iti vā pāṭhaḥ | tatra rāsnākvāthena sahetyarthaḥ | dāḍimāmbubhir arśasīti | dāḍimaphalasvarasaiḥ kvacit phalarasair vā | dvividhe viṣe iti sthāvarajaṅgamātmake | viṣṇusaṃhitāyām uktaṃ nārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ yad vā viṣṇuvīryatulyaṃ nārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ yathā viṣṇutejasā daityagaṇāḥ palāyante tathaivāsya prabhāveṇa duṣṭā rogagaṇā naśyantīti tātparyārthaḥ ||81-89||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. triphalā harītakīvibhītakam āmalakaṃ pratyekam ekabhāgaṃ, vyoṣaṃ śuṇṭhīmaricapippalya:, pratyekam ekabhāgaṃ; hapuṣā‘hāḍavera’ hi.bhā.| vigandhikā, ajagandhikā‘vāvarī’ hi.bhā.| vanatulasī, śaṭhī karcūraṃ, sthūlajīrakaṃ sthūlakaṇā, hemāhvā coṣaṃ pauṣkaramūlaṃ, kṣārau dvau svarjīyavakṣārau, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddham, etāni samāṃśāni pratyekam ekabhāgaṃ viśālā indravāruṇī tasyā jaṭācūrṇaṃ dvibhāgaṃ trivṛt niśothaḥ dvibhāgā dantī dātyeṇī tasyā bhāgatrayaṃ, śātalā pītasehuṇḍas tadabhāve sehuṇḍajaṭā tvag vā patrāṇi vā tasyāś caturbhāgā etān dvitricaturguṇān; citrakādicūrṇāni manyante kecid anyauṣadhāni manyante tat sarvaṃ saṃpradāyato jñeyam | pācanaṃ pācanakvāthaṃ dhānyatrikādi āragvadhādi vā | snehanaṃ ghṛtapānādi tadādyaiḥ snigdhakoṣṭhatya rogiṇaḥ virekāya cūrṇaṃ dadyāt | sarvarogapraṇāśanaṃ hṛdrogādau dadyāt vṛkṣāmlaṃ tintiḍīkam | taiḥ parikartiṣu gude kartanavat pīḍā | suprasannā madirābhedaḥ, nārāyaṇaṃ nārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ tadvad roganāśakatvāt || 81-89 ||

atha hapuṣādyaṃ cūrṇamajīrṇodarādau -
hapuṣā triphalā caiva trāyamāṇā ca pippalī |
hemakṣīrī trivṛc caiva śātalā kaṭukā vacā || 90 ||

lg.l: nīlinī saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ ceti cūrṇayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha hapuṣādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - hapuṣeti | hapuṣā svanāmākhyātā sā ca jambuvad viṭapaviśeṣaḥ, trāyamāṇā lokataḥ prasiddhā hemakṣīrī svarṇakṣīrī, kaṃkuṣṭhabheda ity arthaḥ | coka iti loke | trivṛn niśothaḥ, śātalā sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ sauvarcalaṃ sauvarcalasamam anyad vety ato yad uktaṃ “na kālalavaṇe gandhaḥ sauvarcalasamo guṇai:” iti | mūtreṇeti gomūtreṇa śreṣṭhatvāt | dāḍimatriphalārasair iti kvathitaiḥ | māṃsarasaḥ pralehaśabdavācyaḥ | yathāyogyam iti vyādhyanurūpam| viṣamāgniṣv iti viṣamatīkṣṇamandādiṣv api halīmaṃ halīmakam || 90-92 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hapuṣā vigandhikā, trāyamāṇā hemakṣīrī, trivṛt, śātalā, sehuṇḍaḥ, kuṭakī, nīlapuṣpī aparājitā, kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ sauvarcalam, uṣṇodakādyaiḥ pibet | halīmaṃ halīmakaṃ, spaṣṭaṃ cānyat || 90-92 ||

atha pañcasamaṃ cūrṇaṃ śūlādau -
śuṇṭhī harītakī kṛṣṇā trivṛt sauvarcalaṃ tathā ||93||

lg.l: jñeyaṃ pañcasamaṃ cūrṇam etac chūlaharaṃ param || 94 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. ādhmānādau pañcasamacūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - śuṇṭhīti | atra kṛṣṇā pippalī, trivṛn niśothaḥ, śeṣaṃ subodham || 93 || 94 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 93 || 94 ||

ab.seg:
atha nārācacūrṇam ādhmānaśūlādau -
karṣamātrā bhavet kṛṣṇā trivṛtā syāt palonmitā ||95||

lg.l: khaṇḍāt palaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ cūrṇam ekatra kārayet|

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ nārācakaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ vivarṇayann āha - karṣamātreti | karṣamātram iti bhakṣaṇārthaṃ, kṣaudraṃ tu yāvad avalehaḥ syāt tāvanmātram | etac ca prātar eva bhakṣyaṃ virekārthatvāt tathā hy uktaṃ - “khaṇḍaṃ palaṃ trivṛtā samam upakulyā karṣacūrṇitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ | prāgbhojane ca madhunā biḍālapadakaṃ lihet prājñaḥ’ iti gāḍhaviṭkam atibaddhapurīṣam iti || || 95 || 96 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kṛṣṇā pippalī, trivṛt niḥsṛtā | spaṣṭam anyat || 95 || 96 ||

ab.seg:
atha lavaṇatritayādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ yakṛtplīhaśūlādau -
lavaṇatritayaṃ kṣārau śatapuṣpādvayaṃ vacā ||97||

lg.l: hiṅguś ca hiṅgupatrī ca śaṭhī pāṭhopakuñcikā |
dāḍimaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca trivṛd dantī śatāvarī |
śivā ceti samāṃśāni cūrṇam ekatra kārayet|| 101||
tat pibet sarpiṣā jīrṇe madyenoṣṇodakena vā || 102 ||
etair evauṣadhaiḥ samyag ghṛtaṃ vā sādhayet sudhīḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha trilavaṇādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - lavaṇatritayam iti | ayaṃ trilavaṇādyo yogaś cūrṇasaṃjñakaḥ | anenaiva ghṛtam api sādhayet| sudhīr iti snehayuktyā vipaced ity arthaḥ | atra trilavaṇaṃ ca saindhavasauvarcalaviḍasaṃjñaṃ kṣārāv iti dvau kṣārau tena svarjikākṣāro yavakṣāraś ca | śatapuṣpādvayam iti laghusthūlabhedena | ekā ‘saupha’ iti prasiddhā | aparā ‘sovā’ śabdavācyā, ajagandhā varvarikā, hapuṣā nijanāmakhyātā, jīrakadvayam iti pītakṛṣṇabhedena pratītam, kustumburu dhānyakaṃ, tumburu svanāmaprasiddhaṃ, pauṣkaraṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ, hiṅgupatrī, viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ patrāṇi hiṅgugandhasadṛśāni bhavanti | sā dvividhā ekā cāruṇapatrikā tanvī aparā veṇupatrikā hiṃgulaphalā | upakuñcikā jīrakabhedaḥ ‘karauṃjī śabdavācya: | badarāṇi badaraphalāni, śivā harītakī śeṣaṃ subodham | etat sakalaṃ samabhāgena ślakṣṇacūrṇīkṛtaṃ cārdrakarasair bījapūrarasaiś ca pratyekaṃ bhāvayet; rasair iti bahuvacanatvena saptavārān bhāvayed iti bhāvaḥ | tathā coktaṃ -‘bījapūrārdrakarasenāsakṛd bhāvitam’ iti | ghṛtasādhane tu caturguṇo raso deyaḥ | snehaparimāṇāt caturguṇatā ca pratyekaṃ | tatpibet sarpiṣā jīrṇe iti | anne jīrṇe sati pibed ity arthaḥ | anyarogotpattibhayāt | tathā hi - ‘auṣadhaśeṣe bhuktaṃ pītaṃ tathauṣadhaṃ saśeṣe 'nne | na karoti gadopaśamaṃ prakopayaty anyarogāṃś ca’ iti | kolāmbhasā badarakvāthena | ‘vā’ grahaṇāt kulatthayūṣeṇa kṣāraniścyotanena dāḍimarasena doṣāpekṣayā pibed iti tātparyārtha: | yakṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭīśūlam iti | yakṛtśūlaṃ pṛṣṭhaśūlaṃ kaṭiśūlaṃ ceti gudakukṣihṛdāmayam iti | āmayo gudādibhiḥ saha pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate ||97-104||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. lavaṇatritayaṃ saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viḍalavaṇaṃ, kṣārau dvau sarjīyavakṣārau, śatapuṣpā dvayamsovā, sauṃphaśabdavācyau| | ajagandhā bākucī, hapuṣā prasiddhā, jīrakadvayaṃ śvetakṛṣṇajīrakam | pippalī gajapippalī, tadabhāve pippalī, hiṅgu bharjitaṃ, hiṅgupatrīḥ‘hiṅgoṭa’ hi.bhā.| , śaṭhī karcūra: pāṭhāpāḍhā | prasiddhā, upakuñcikākalauṃjī | kalavañjīkā, amlavetasaḥ cukraṃ vā raso vā, dāḍimam amlatintiḍīkaṃ, trivṛt niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, śatāvarī, indravāruṇī prasiddhā tasyā jaṭā, kustumburur dhānyakaṃ, tumburuḥ śūlaghnaḥ, pauṣkaramūlaṃ, badarāṇi, śivā harītakī, kolāmbhasā badarajalena, mastunā dadhijalena | spaṣṭam anyat || 97-104 ||

atha śūlādau tumburādicūrṇam |
tumburūṇi trilavaṇaṃ yamānī puṣkarāhvayam || 105 ||

lg.l: pibed uṣṇena toyena yavakvāthena vā pibet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha tumburādicūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - tumburūṇīti ayaṃ tumburādiko yogaḥ aṣṭavidhaśūleṣu praśastaḥ | tatra tumburūṇi phalaviśeṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ, trilavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viḍaṃ, puṣkarāhvayaṃ puṣkaramūlam, tadabhāve kuṣṭaṃ, abhayā harītakī, hiṃgv atra bharjitam, etat sakalaṃ samabhāgaṃ, trivṛt tribhāgiketi ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, yavakvātheneti yavo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ || 105-107 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. saiṃdhavasauvarcalabiḍeti lavaṇāni, yamānī, puṣkaraṃ, puṣkaramūlaṃ, yavakṣāraḥ, abhayā harītakī, hiṅgu bharjitaṃ, viḍaṅgaṃ etāni samāni pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkamātrāṇi sarvoṣadhāni; trivṛt niḥsṛtā bhāgatrayaṃ ādyauṣadhāt | apare sarvān dhātṛguṇān āhuḥ | tathā ca bopadevaśataślokyāṃ ‘dīpyas tumburupauṣkaraṃ trilavaṇaṃ kṣārābhayā jaṃtujit vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu tatas tṛvṛt trir udarādyarśograhe buddhimān | vyākhyātaṃ ca trivṛt triguṇaḥ, tataḥ dīpyādicūrṇāt - dīpyād iti samāṃśāt| tathā ca vṛndepi
“tumburūṇi trilavaṇaṃ pāṭhā kṛṣṇā mahauṣadham |
etāni svarjikākṣāro yavakṣārābhayā niśiḥ ||
lavaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ hiṅgu samāny ekatra cūrṇayet |
trivṛt triguṇitaṃ cūrṇam etad uṣṇāmbunā pibet |
śūlaṃ nivārayaty eṣa ādhmānam udarāṇi ca ||” vṛndāt bṛhattumburādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ śūlādau ||105-107 ||

atha citrakādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ mandāgnyādau -
citrakaṃ nāgaraṃ hiṅgu pippalī pippalījaṭā |
cavyājamodā maricaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣasaṃmitam || 108 ||

lg.l: svarjikā ca yavakṣāraḥ sindhu sauvarcalaṃ biḍam |
rasair dāḍimajair vāpi śoṣayed ātapena ca || 110||
etac cūrṇaṃ jayed gulmaṃ grahaṇīm āmajāṃ rujam |
agniṃ ca kurute dīptaṃ rucikṛt kaphanāśanam || 111 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. citrakādyaṃ cūrṇam āha – citrakam iti | atra nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, pippalī, pippalījaṭā pippalī mūlaṃ,citrakādi maricāntaṃ dravyaṃ karṣapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ, svarjikādiromakāntaṃ kolamātraṃ, pratyekam ity arthaḥ | kolaṃ karṣārdhasaṃjñaṃ romakaṃ gaḍa- lavaṇam | etat sarvaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya mātuluṅgadāḍimaphalodbhavaiḥ rasaiḥ pṛthag bhāvayet, mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ | vāgrahaṇā- detac cūrṇaṃ mātuluṅgadāḍimarasenāplāvya guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ granthāntaradarśanāc ca | tathā hi
“citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam |
vyoṣaṃ hiṃgvajamodaṃ ca cavyaṃ caikatra cūrṇayet |
guṭikā mātuluṅgasya dāḍimasya rasena vā | kṛtā vipācayanty āmaṃ dīpayanty āśu cānalam” iti||108-111||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hiṅgu bharjitaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat ||108-111||

atha vaḍavānalacūrṇaṃ mandāgnyādau -
saindhavaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalī cavyacitrakam |
śuṇṭhī harītakī ceti kramavṛddhāni cūrṇayet ||112||

Āḍhamalla. atha vaḍavānalacūrṇam āha - saindhavam iti | cavyam iti viṭapaviśeṣo nijanāmapraptītaḥ tasya phalaṃ gajapippalī iti| kramavṛddhyā vṛddhiṃ kṛtvā yojyaṃ, vṛddhis tu ādidravyād bhavati | tad yathā saindhavam ekabhāgaṃ, pippalīmūlaṃ dvibhāgikaṃ, pippalī tribhāgā, cavyaṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayaṃ, citrakaṃ pañcabhāgaṃ śuṇṭhī ṣaḍbhāgā harītakī saptabhāgeti kramavṛddhiḥ | atyantāgnikaratvāt vaḍavānalasaṃjñam || || 112 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kamavṛddhāni - saindhavam ekaṃ, pippalīmūlaṃ dvayaṃ, pippalī catvāri, cavyam aṣṭau, citrakaṃ ṣoḍaśa, śuṇṭhī dvātriṃśat, harītakī catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ, evam eva kramavṛddham ||112||

atha ajamodādyaṃ cūrṇam āmavātaśothādau -
ajamodā viḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ devadāru ca || 113 ||

lg.l: maricaṃ ceti karṣāṃśaṃ pratyekaṃ kārayed budhaḥ ||114||
karṣās tu pañca pathyāyā daśa syur vṛddhadārukāt |
nāgarāc ca daśaiva syuḥ sarvāṇy ekatra cūrṇayet ||115||
kaṭipṛṣṭhagudasthāṃ ca jaṅghayoś ca rujāṃ jayet |
samena vā guḍenāsya vaṭakān kārayed bhiṣak |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha ajamodādyaṃ cūrṇam api darśayann āha - ajamodeti | ayam ajamodādisaṃjñako yogaś cūrṇarūpo guṭikārūpaś ca | ajamodādimaricāntaṃ navadravyaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣamātram | pathyā harītakī tasyās tvak pañcakarṣamitā, vṛddhadārakaṃ daśakarṣaṃ, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī caiva daśakarṣānvitā etat sakalaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā ucitamātrayā koṣṇajalena pānaṃ boddhavyam | athavā pakṣāntaram api | idam eva cūrṇaṃ guḍamiśritaṃ guḍasamānaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣayet | guḍasāmyam atra cūrṇatvāt | atrāpi koṣṇajalānupānaṃ boddhavyam| kaṭipṛṣṭhagudasthāṃ ceti | atra rujām ity anvayaḥ | jaṅghayor ubhayoḥ atrāpi rujāṃ | tūnīpratūṇī vātaroge paṭhitā viśvācī ca || 113-117 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ajamodādi pratyekaṃ karṣāṃśaṃ, pathyā harītakī pañcakarṣāḥ, vṛddhadāruḥ‘vidhārā’ hi.bhā.| prasiddhaḥ etasmād daśakarṣāḥ syuḥ, śuṇṭhī nāgaraśuṇṭhī tasmāc ca daśakarṣāḥ syu:, etāni sarvāṇi ekatra cūrṇayet | etac cūrṇam ajamodādikaṃ koṣṇajalena pibet śothādināśakaṃ bhavati | samena guḍena vā asya vaṭakān kārayet || 113-117 ||

cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā peyaṃ śvāsahṛdrogaśāntaye |) atha hiṃgvādicūrṇaṃ śūlādau -
hiṅgu pāṭhā'bhayā dhānyaṃ dāḍimaṃ citrakaḥ śaṭhī ||119||

lg.l: prāg bhojanasya madhye vā cūrṇam etat prayojayet ||121||
hikvāyāṃ yakṛti plīhni śvāse kāse galagrahe |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā hiṃgvādyaṃ cūrṇam āha - hiṃgviti | atra hiṅgu bharjitaṃ yojyaṃ, pāṭhā prasiddhā tasyā mūlam, abhayā harītakī, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalabījāni, hapuṣā jambuvad viṭapaviśeṣo vikhyātaḥ, ajagandhā barbarikā, tintiḍīkam amlaphalaṃ prasiddhaṃ, puṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ, kṣāradvayam iti yavakṣāraḥ svarjikākṣāraḥ | pañcalavaṇāni saindhavaprabhṛtikāni | prāg bhojanasyeti prātaḥkāle madhye vā bhojanamiśram | jīrṇamadyeneti jīrṇaṃ purātanaṃ guṇādhikatvāt | tathā hi ‘navaṃ madyam abhiṣyandi gudadoṣakaraṃ param | jīrṇaṃ ca sarvadoṣaghnaṃ laghutvaṃ ca kaphāpaham’ iti | kalpanāntaram āha | athavā etac cūrṇaṃ mātuluṅgasya rasena vā bahuśo bhāvayitvā guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ | tāś ca vātaśleṣmāmayāpahā bhavanti | bahuśa iti saptavārān | bahvīr iti dviśāṇapramitāḥ ||118-125 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hiṅgu bharjitaṃ, pāṭhā, abhayā harītakī, dhānyaṃ prasiddhaṃ, dāḍimaṃ, citrakaṃ, śaṭhī karcūra:, ajamodā, trikaṭu, hapuṣā prasiddhā, amlavetasya raso vā cukraṃ vā, ajagandhā‘vāvarī’ hi.bhā.| vanatulasī, tintiḍīkaṃ, pauruṣaṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ; vacā, cavyaṃ, kṣāradvayaṃ sarjī iti dvayaṃ, yavakṣāraṃ, pañcalavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ śākambharīyaṃ sauvarcala sāmudraṃ biḍaṃ iti| sarvaṃ cūrṇaṃ madyādinā pibet | keṣu gulmādiṣu etaccūrṇaṃ praśasyate | mātuluṅgasya svarasena vā guṭikāṃ kuryāt || 118-125 ||

atha yamānīkhāṇḍavacūrṇam arocakādau -
yamānī dāḍimaṃ śuṇṭhī tintinīkāmlavetasau |
badarāmlaṃ ca kurvīta catuḥśāṇamitāni ca || 126 ||

lg.l: cūrṇaṃ jayet pāṇḍurogaṃ hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīṃ jvaram |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha yamānīkhāṇḍavasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇam āha - yamānīti | yamānī prasiddhā, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalabījāni, tintiḍīkaṃ prasiddhaṃ, badarāmlam iti badaraṃ prasiddham, amlaṃ vṛkṣāmlaṃ vṛkṣabhedaḥ sa ca phalāmlaḥ, yad vā badarāmlam amlabadaraṃ khāṇḍavatvāt, catuḥśāṇamitānīti pratyekaṃ sārdhadviśāṇaṃ | maricam iti tena daśamāṣakam ity arthaḥ | tvagā- dijīrakāntaṃ pratyekaṃ dviśāṇaṃ tvak sauvarcaladhānyakam ity asya sthāne “kṛmighnam akṣaṃ dhānyatvak” iti paṭhanti tatrāpi akṣaṃ sauvarcalaṃ khāṇḍavābhidham iti prasiddheḥ | yataḥ “lavaṇāmlasitāyukta: khāṇḍavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ” iti | śoṣo mukhaśoṣaḥ kṣayabhedo vā, ānāha udarāpūraḥ, vibandho vātādīnām apravṛttiḥ, jihvāgalāmayān iti jihvāmayān, galāmayān ity artha:||126-129 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yamānyādīni catuḥśāṇamitāni, maricaṃ sārdhadviśāṇam ardhaṭaṅkopari dviṭaṅkaṃ, pippalī daśaśāṇā, tvagādikaṃ dvidviśāṇakam | atra śarkarāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭimitaśāṇair yojayet | etat yamānīkhāṇḍavābhidhaṃ pāṇḍurogādīn jayet| dāḍimam amlaṃ madhuraṃ vā, sauvarcalaṃ prasiddham, amlavetasya svarasaṃ vā, cukraṃ karṣamātraṃ, pippalīnām ekaṃ śataṃ, maricasya dve śate, guṇanayanāt tv anyasaṃkhyayā atra śarkarāyāś catvāri phalāni, palam atra ṣoḍaśaṭaṅkānām, anyathā catuḥṣaṣṭimitaiḥ śāṇaiḥ śarkarām atra yojayed ity anena virodhaḥ syāt | kecit khāṇḍave lavaṇaṃ madhurayoge sādhu svabhāvāt, lavaṇaṃ nikṣiped iti vadanti || atha pṛthvīkādyaṃ cūrṇam arocakādau granthāntarāt -
“pṛthvīkā jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ dāḍimaṃ ca tathaiva ca |
citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ nāgakeśarakaṃ tathā |
maricaṃ dīpyakaṃ caiva vṛkṣāmlaṃ cāmlavetasam ||
ajamodājagandhā ca dadhitthaṃ ceti kārṣikān |
pradeyaṃ cātiśuddhāyāḥ śarkarāyāḥ palāṣṭakaṃ ||
cūrṇam etat prasādaṃ syāt paramaṃ rucivardhanaṃ |
tīvrakāsāmayārśāṃsi śūlaṃ kāsaṃ vamiṃ jvaraṃ || nihanti dīpayaty agniṃ balavarṇapradaṃ paraṃ | vātānulomanaṃ hṛdyaṃ kaṇṭhajihvāviśodhanam” iti | pṛthvīkā sūkṣmailā, ajagandhā vāvarī, dadhitthaṃ kapitthaṃ | idam api khāṇḍavaṃ cūrṇam || 126-129 ||

atha tālīsādicūrṇam arocakādau -
tālīsaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī vaṃśarocanam ||130||

lg.l: elātvacos tu karṣārdhaṃ pratyekaṃ bhāgam ācaret || 131||
tālīsādyam idaṃ cūrṇaṃ rocanaṃ pācanaṃ smṛtam|| 132||
paktvā vā śarkarāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṣipet syād guṭikā tataḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. tālīsādikam apy āha - tālīsam iti | tālīsaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, vaṃśarocanaṃ vaṃśakṣīrī, etaddravyapañcakam ādi- dravyāt karṣaikaikena vardhitaṃ grāhyam | tena tālīsaṃ karṣaikaṃ, maricaṃ karṣadvayaṃ, śuṇṭhī karṣatrayā, pippalī catuḥkarṣā, vaṃśa- rocanaṃ pañcakarṣam, elātvacos tu karṣārdham iti | elā kṣudrailā, tvag varāṅgaṃ karṣārdham iti śāṇadvayam ity arthaḥ | pratyekam iti pṛthag ity arthaḥ | śarkarā'tra dvātriṃśat karṣatulitā deyā, etena sakalacūrṇād dviguṇā śarkarā bhavati tīkṣṇatvāt | veti grahaṇena pakṣāntaram āha - samajale śarkarāṃ paktvā tatra cūrṇaṃ prakṣipya guṭikā kāryā laghutaratvāt tathā hi - “kalpayed guṭikāś caitac cūrṇāt paktvā sitopalām | guṭikā hy agnisaṃyogāc cūrṇāl laghutarāḥ smṛtā? iti | etad api vāṃśīṃ vinā pracarati | tathā ca tantrāntare - “tālīśaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhī pippaly ekāṃśakottarā | tvagelārdhāṃśakaṃ dadyāt śarkarā kuḍakaṃ bhavet” ityādi | anyatrāpi “tālīsamaricanāgaraṃ kṛṣṇāḥ karṣottarāḥ kramas tvagele cārdhāṃśe kuḍavaṃ sitā guṭikā vipācya kṛtāḥ” iti kecid vadanti | pitte vaṃśarocanā deyeti | tathā hy uktam - “’pittayukte bhavec chreṣṭhaṃ vaṃśarocanayānvitam” iti granthāntaradarśanāt | tad uktaṃ -
“vāṃśīpippaliśuṇṭhīnāṃ tālīsoṣaṇayos tathā |
bhāgavṛddhiḥ kramād antyā tvagele cāpi sārdhake || kṛṣṇā tv aṣṭaguṇā cātra pradeyā sitaśarkarā” ityādi ||130-133||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tālīsam ekakarṣaṃ, maricaṃ dvikarṣaṃ, śuṇḍī trikarṣā, pippalī catuḥkarṣā, vāṃśī rocanā pañcakarṣā, evaṃ bhāgān prakalpayet, elā laghvelā, tvak tajaḥ, etayoḥ pratyekaṃ karṣārdhaṃ śarkarāyā dvātriṃśatkarṣāḥ | śarkarāṃ paktvā cūrṇe nikṣipet | tato guṭikā syāt | idaṃ tālīsādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ rocanaṃ pācanaṃ tathā kāsādiharam ||130-133 ||

atha sitopalādicūrṇaṃ kāsakṣayapittadāhādau -
sitopalā ṣoḍaśa syād aṣṭau syād vaṃśarocanā ||134||

lg.l: pippalī syāc catuṣkarṣā syād elā ca dvikārṣikī |
ekaḥ karṣas tvacaḥ kāryaś cūrṇayet sarvam ekataḥ ||135||
jvaram ūrdhvagataṃ raktaṃ pittam āśu vyapohati ||137||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha sitopalādicūrṇam āha - sitopaleti | sitopalā śarkarābhedaḥ | ṣoḍaśeti ṣoḍaśakarṣamitā | vaṃśarocanā aṣṭau syād iti aṣṭakarṣamitā, agrimakarṣagrahaṇāt | antyāt dviguṇitatvān mānanirdeśo 'yam | tathā coktaṃ -
“sitopalā tugākṣīrī pippalībahulā tvacaḥ |
antyād ūrdhvaṃ dviguṇita lehayen madhusarpiṣā||” iti | bahulā kṣudrailā, madhu sarpiś cātra lehavat parimitaṃ | hastapādāṅgadāhajid iti | tena hastadāhaṃ, pādadāhaṃ, aṅgadāham iti suptajihvatvam iti jihvāroge paṭhitam || 134-137 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sitopalā prasiddhā, aṣṭau karṣāḥ vaṃśarocanā, pippalī catuḥkarṣā syāt, elā dvikārṣikī, tvacaḥ ekakarṣaḥ, evaṃ ṣoḍaśakarṣaṃ syāt| etat sitopalādicūrṇaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ lihet ścāsādikān vyapohati ||134-137||

atha lavaṇabhāskaracūrṇaṃ grahaṇīgulmādau -
sāmudralavaṇaṃ kāryam aṣṭakarṣamitaṃ budhaiḥ |
pañca sauvarcalaṃ grāhyaṃ niḍaṃ saindhavadhānyakāt || 138||

lg.l: vātaśleṣmabhavaṃ gulmaṃ plīhānam udaraṃ kṣayam‘kṣataṃ’ pā. | || 142||
arśāṃsi grahaṇīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vibandha‘vividhaṃ’ pā. | ca bhagandaram |
śophaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsakāsāv āmavātaṃ ca hṛdrujam || 143||
mandāgniṃ nāśayed etad dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ param |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ lavaṇabhāskaraṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ prakaṭayann āha - sāmudralavaṇam iti | dakṣiṇasamudrasamīpe bhavaṃ sāmudraṃ lavaṇaṃ tac ca samaṭīśabdavācyam aṣṭakarṣaṃ paladvayam, pañca sauvarcalaṃ grāhyam iti sauvarcalalavaṇaṃ pañcakarṣaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | biḍalavaṇādyamlavetasāntaṃ dviguṇakarṣapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ, biḍaṃ kṛtrimaṃ lavaṇaṃ tac ca prasāriṇī kalka- bhaktalavaṇasaṃyogād agnidāhena nivṛttam ity eke, sindhubhavaṃ saindhavaṃ, kṛṣṇajīrakaṃ pāścātyaṃ,tac ca khurāsānaśabdavācyaṃ, maricādiviśvāntaṃ dravyatrayaṃ karṣaṃ pratyekam ity arthaḥ | jīrakam atra śuklaṃ , viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, dāḍimaṃ syāc catuḥkarṣam iti dāḍi- maphalabījāni grāhyāṇi tac ca anāradānāśabdavācyaṃ, catuḥkarṣaṃ palaparimitaṃ | tvagele cārdhakārṣika iti militvā karṣamātram ity artha: | bhakṣaṇe ca śāṇapramāṇaṃ ṭaṅkamātraṃ deyaṃ, tīkṣṇatvāt | tat punaḥ iti grahaṇenādhikamātram api praca- rati doṣādīnāṃ balātiśayatvāt| mastutakrasurāsavair iti | mastu dadhno 'dhastoyaviśeṣaḥ | ‘dadhnas tu yad adhas toyaṃ tan mastu parikīrtitam |’ takram iti tribhāgabhinnaṃ, surāsavau prasiddhau, surā lohitavarṇā, piṣṭakiṇvakalkena kiñcit kaluṣā āśu kriyante ye te āsavāḥ, bhāskareṇa bhāskarācāryeṇa uditaṃ kathitaṃ purā pūrvapauruṣeyagranthānām ādāv ity arthaḥ | na tu ṛṣipraṇītebhya iti kecit || 138-144 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sāmudralavaṇaṃ budhaiḥ aṣṭakarṣaṃ kāryaṃ, pañcakarṣaṃ saptaircalaṃ, biḍaṃ biḍalavaṇaṃ tadādyamlavetasakāntaṃ daśauṣadhaṃ pratyekaṃ dvidvikarṣaṃ, āmlavetasasya rasaṃ vā cukraṃ vā grāhyaṃ, maricaṃ jīrakaṃ, viśvam etat pratyekaṃ karṣamātraṃ, jīrakaṃ śvetaṃ, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, dāḍimaṃ catuḥkarṣaṃ, tvagelā ca ardhakārṣikaṃ pratyekaṃ dvidviṭaṅkaṃ | etac cūrṇakṛtaṃ lavaṇabhāskaraṃ bhavati śāṇapramāṇaṃ ṭaṅkapramāṇaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ deyaṃ, ārśādīni ca nāśayati | idaṃ bhāskareṇa sūryeṇa uditam ||138-144||

div.ab:
atha elādicūrṇaṃ chardiroge -
elāpriyaṅgumustāni kolamajjā ca pippalī |
śrīcandanaṃ tathā lājā lavaṅgaṃ nāgakeśaram || 145||
etac cūrṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ lihet |
vātapittakaphodbhūtāṃ chardiṃ hanty ativegataḥ ||146 || vyāghrīcūrṇam |
(vyāghrījīrakadhātrīṇāṃprakṣiptam | cūrṇaṃ madhuyutaṃ lihet |
ūrdhvavātamahāśvāsatamakair mucyate kṣaṇāt ||147||)

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. elādicūrṇam āha - elā priyaṅgumustānīti | elā sūkṣmailā, priyaṅgur latāviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, kolamajjā badaraphalāsthimadhyagatadravyaviśeṣaḥ, śrīcandanaṃ śvetacandanaṃ, lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavā | etat sakalaṃ samamātraṃ saṃgṛhya vastrapūtaṃ cūrṇaṃ kuryāt | bhakṣaṇamānam asya doṣāgnibalāpekṣayā kāryam | sitākṣaudrayutam itīty arthaḥ | (sitānāsti ‘kha’ pustake | śarkarā sā dhānyacūrṇasamā grāhyā, madhumānaṃ ca yāvad avalehatvaṃ syāt tāvad deyam ity arthaḥ) | ativegata iti vacanenāsya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam ||145-147 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kolaṃ badaraṃ tan majjā, śrīcandanaṃ malayajaṃ lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyajāṃ sarvasamaṃ sitā sitopalā || 145 -147 ||

ab.seg:
atha pañcanimbacūrṇaṃ kuṣṭhādau -
mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvacaṃ nimbāt samāharet |
sūkṣmacūrṇam idaṃ kuryāt palapañcadaśonmitam || 148||

lg.l: gokṣuraś ca palonmānam ekaikaṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 150 ||
bhāvayitvā ca saṃśoṣya karṣamātraṃ tataḥ pibet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. adhunā pañcanimbacūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - mūlam iti | mūlam ityādinā nimbavṛkṣasya pañcāṅgaṃ kathitaṃ; mūlaṃ jaṭā patraṃ palāśaṃ phalam āmabījaṃ puṣpaṃ kusumaṃ tvak challī | samāhared iti samyak prakāreṇa āhared iti yad uktaṃ tat kālaviśeṣaṃ sūcayati | tathā hi “puṣpakāle ca puṣpāṇi phalakāle phalāni ca | saṃcūrṇya picumardasya tvaṅmūlāni dalāni ca” iti| eke mūlasthāne sāram iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tatra sāraṃ madhyabhāgasthitaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣam, uktam anyatrāpi “kāle tvagdalasārabījakusumair nimbasya tulyāṃśakaiḥ” ityādi | pañcadaśonmitaṃ phalam iti sakalapañcāṅgaṃ pañcadaśapalaparimitaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | tena pratyekaṃ tripalamitaṃ bhavati | lohabhasmeti mṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, cakramardakaḥ prapunnāṭabījāni, āmalam āmalakīphalaṃ, niśā haridrā, kṛtamālako rājavṛkṣaḥ etal lohabhasmādigokṣurakāntaṃ pṛthak palamānaṃ grāhyam, tena nimbacūrṇasamaṃ bhavati | etat sakalaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ dravyaṃ bhṛṅgarājarasena bhāvitaṃ kṛtvā paścād aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣeṇa khadirakvāthena tat paścād asanakvāthena ca bhāvyam, asanaḥ pītamāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, paścāt saṃśoṣya karṣaparimāṇamitaṃ vakṣyamāṇānupānena saha pibed ity arthaḥ | anupānāny āha - khadirāsanatoyeneti | khadirakāṣṭhakvathitena asanakāṣṭhakvathitena vety arthaḥ | athavā sarpiṣā payasā ca atra doṣāpekṣā boddhavyā | rasāyanam iti jarāvyādhināśakatvena rasāyanaṃ kathitaṃ| paccanimbam iti nimbasambandhipuṣpādipañcakam eva nimbapañcakaṃ kathitaṃ | tathā hi “nimbapatraṃ tathā puṣpaṃ tvaṅmūlaṃ phalam ucyate | pañcanimbam iti khyātaṃ nāmataḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ” iti | sarvarogapraṇāśanam iti | sarvarogā bhagandarapramukhāḥ | tathā hy uktam -
“bhagaṃdaraḥ ślīpadavātaraktajaḍāndhanāḍīvraṇaśīrṣarogān |
sarvān pramehān pradarāṃś ca sarvān daṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ mūlaviṣaṃ nihanti ||
sthūlodaraḥ siṃhakṛśodaraḥ syāt suśliṣṭasandhir madhunopayogāt |
sadopayogād api ye daśanti sarpādayo yāṃti vināśam āśu || jīvec ciraṃ vyādhijarāvimuktaḥ śubhetaraś caṃdrasamānakāntiḥ” iti ||148-153 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nimbānmūlādikaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ samāharet| idaṃ paścadaśonmitaiḥ palaiś cūrṇaṃ kuryāt| ekam ekapalalohabhasmādikam ekaikaṃ palonmitaṃ kārayet | cakramardaḥ‘panabāḍa’ hi.bhā. | prapunnāṭaḥ, śarkarā sitopalā, niśā haridrā, bākucī kṛmighnaḥ, kṛtamālaḥ āragvadhaḥ, khadiraḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasya sāraḥ, asanaḥvijayasāra’ hi.bhā.| pītamāraḥ eṣāṃ kvāthena bhāvayet vāratrayaṃ vā sapta vā punaḥ saṃśoṣya karṣaṃ khadirāsanaṃ pibet || 148-153||

śatāvarīcūrṇam -
śatāvarī gokṣuraś ca bījaṃ ca kapikacchujam |
gāṅgerukī cātibalā bījam ikṣurakodbhavam || 154 ||

lg.l: cūrṇitaṃ sarvam ekatra godugdhena piben niśi |
na tṛptiṃ yāti nārībhir naraś cūrṇaprabhāvataḥ ||155||

ab.seg:
aśvagandhādicūrṇam -
aśvagandhā daśapalā tanmātro vṛddhadāruka: |
cūrṇīkṛtyobhayaṃ vidvān ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||156||

lg.l: karṣaikaṃ payasā pītvā nārībhir naiva tṛpyati |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ vājīkaraṇacūrṇadvayam āha - śatāvarītyādi | kapikacchujaṃ | bījam iti vānarībījaṃ, gāṃgerukīti nāgabalā “guḍasakarīti” śabdavācyā, atibalā bṛhadvalā, bījam ikṣurakodbhavam iti ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣa: “tālamakhānā” iti loke, etat sarvaṃ cūrṇīkṛtam uktamānaparimitaṃ ca caturguṇena godugdhena saha pibet | niśi rātrau | vājīkaraṇam iti vājīvātyarthamaithunasāmarthyāt bājīkaraṇaṃ, kiṃ vā vāja śukraṃ tad asyāstīti vājī avājī vājī kriyate yena puruṣas tad vājīkaraṇaṃ | tad uktam “yena nārīṣu sāmarthyaṃ vājīval labhate naraḥ | yena vātyadhikaṃ bījaṃ vājīkaraṇam eva tat” iti | tat tu trividhaṃ pravartakaṃ janakaṃ pravartakajanakaṃ ca | uktaṃ ca tantrāntare - “śukravṛddhikaraṃ kiñcit kiñcit śukrapravartakam| cyutivṛddhikaraṃ kiñcit trividhaṃ vṛṣyam ucyate” iti | vṛṣyaṃ tu vājīkaraṇasaṃjñam | tathā ca yuvatisparśādi cyutikaraṃ, kṣīrādi vṛddhikaraṃ, māṣo janakaḥ pravartakaś ca | dvitīyavājīkaraṇacūrṇaṃ subodhaṃ kecin nātra paṭhanti || 154-157 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athāśvagandhādicūrṇaṃ puṣṭau sugamaṃ vṛddhadāruka: prasiddha:|| 154-157||

div.ab:
musalīcūrṇam -
(musalīkandacūrṇaṃprakṣiptam | tu guḍūcīsattvasaṃyutam |
vānarīgokṣurābhyāṃ ca śālmalīśarkarāmalaiḥ ||158 ||
āloḍya ghṛtadugdhena pāyayet kāmavardhanam |)

ab.seg:
navāyasacūrṇam -
citrakas triphalā mustaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ tryūṣaṇāni ca ||159||

lg.l: pāṇḍurogaṃ jayaty ugraṃ hṛdrogaṃ ca bhagandaram ||161||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha navāyasaṃ cūrṇam āha - citraka iti | citrakaś citrakajaṭās tvak, triphalā harītakyādi, tryūṣaṇaṃ kaṭutrikaṃ etac citrakāditryūṣaṇāntaṃ navadravyaṃ pratyekaṃ samamātraṃ, navabhāgā hatāyasa iti hatāyaso mṛtalohasya eka- dravyabhāgāpekṣayā navabhāgā grāhyā:, tenaikatra militānāṃ citrakādīnāṃ cūrṇena samam ayaścūrṇam ity arthaḥ | madhusarpiṣī cātra lehaparimāṇavad grāhye || 158-161 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. citrakaḥ, triphalā, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, viḍaṅgaṃ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭu etāni pratyekaṃ śāṇamātrāṇi hatāyasaṃ mṛtalohaṃ sarvatulyaṃ madhusarpir ghṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ lihet | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 158-161 ||

div.ab:
ākārakarabhādicūrṇaṃ stambhanādau -
ākārakarabhaḥ śuṇṭhī kaṅkolaṃ kuṅkamaṃ kaṇā ||162||
jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca candanaṃ ceti kārṣikān |
cūrṇāni mānataḥ kuryād ahiphenaṃ palonmitam|| 163||
sarvam ekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ māṣaikaṃ madhunā lihet |
śukrastambhakaraṃ cūrṇaṃ puṃsām ānandakārakam ||164||
nārīṇāṃ prītijananaṃ seveta niśi kāmukaḥ || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe cūrṇakalpanā nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athākārakarabhādicūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - ākārakarabha iti | ‘akarakarahā’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ, kaṃkolaṃ vikhyātaṃ kaṇā pippalī, candanaṃ śvetam, etat sarvaṃ karṣonmitaṃ pratyekam iti | ahiphenaṃ palonmitam iti ahiphenam āphūśabdavācyam ‘aphīma’ iti loke, palonmitaṃ palapramāṇam, tena pūrvacūrṇabhāgadvayaṃ ahiphenasya bhāgaikam ity arthaḥ | śarkarārahitatvāt kutracit sitāsahitam api pracarati, tatra ahiphenaṃ pūrvadravyacūrṇasāmyaṃ | tad uktaṃ
“jātīphalārkakarahāṭalavaṅgaśuṇṭhīkaṃkolakuṃkumakaṇāharicandanāni |
etaiḥ samānam ahiphenam anena tulyāṃ sitāṃ nidhāya madhunā vaṭakaṃ vidadhyāt || māṣadvayonmitam amuṃ niśi bhakṣayitvā miṣṭaṃ payas tadanu māhiṣam āśu pītvā | kurvantu kāmukajanā na tu bindupātaṃ cetāṃsi tāni cakitāni kalāvatīnām” iti || 162-164 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe cūrṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ || 6 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ākārakarabhaḥ ākallakaḥ, śuṇṭhī, kaṃkolaṃ, kuṅkumaṃ keśaram, kaṇā pippalī, jātiphalaṃ, lavaṅgaṃ, candanaṃ ceti, kaṅkolaṃ kecit śītalacīnīti kecit pūgam ity āhuḥ | kārṣikān pratyekaṃ kārṣikān | ahiphenaṃ palonmitaṃ karṣacatuṣṭayaṃ tat śuddhaṃ kṛtvā deyaṃ | tasya śodhanam ārdrakadraveṇa sehuṇḍapatradraveṇa vā nimbadraveṇa vā nimbūkadraveṇa bhāvanābhiḥ saptabhir vā śodhayitvā śoṣayitvā deyam || 162-164 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne cūrṇādhyāyaḥ || 6||

div.head: atha guṭikādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ |
vaṭakāś cātha kathyante tannāma guṭikā vaṭī |
modako vaṭikā piṇḍī guḍo vartis tathocyate ||1||

lg.l: lehavat sādhyate vahnau guḍo vā śarkarā tathā |
guggulur vā kṣipet tatra cūrṇaṃ tannirmitā vaṭī ||2||
draveṇa madhunā vāpi guṭikāṃ kārayed budhaḥ ||3||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ guṭikāḥ kathyante - vaṭakāś ceti | atheti cūrṇakalpanānantaraṃ vaṭakā guṭikādisaṃjñāḥ ata eva tannāma guṭikāvaṭīprabhṛtayo jñātavyāḥ | tasya vaṭakasya nāma paryāyavācakāḥ śabdā yathā tannāmeti tasya vaṭakasya nāma paryāyavākyaṃ guṭikādikam ity arthaḥ | atha teṣāṃ kartavyavidhim āha - lehavat sādhyata iti | yathāvalehārthaṃ guḍādikaṃ sādhyate tathaivā'tra guḍaḥ, śarkarā, guggulur vāpi paktavya:, pāke sati cūrṇaṃ prakṣipya vaṭakādīn kuryād iti bhāva: | pakṣāntaram āha - kvacid iti | na sarvatra avahnisiddhena kuṭṭitena guggulunā vaṭakāḥ kāryāḥ guḍādikenāpi kvacid iti saṃcārād vā, athavā draveṇa toyakṣīrādinā madhunā kṣaudreṇāpi saṃplāvya guṭikāṃ kārayet budhaḥ paṇḍitaḥ atrāpi vahniṃ vineti sambandhaḥ ||1-3 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha guṭikādhikāraḥ || 1-3 ||

lg.l: sitā caturguṇā deyā vaṭīṣu dviguṇo guḍaḥ |
cūrṇāc cūrṇasamaḥ kāryo guggulur madhu tatsamam || 4 ||
dravaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ deyaṃ modakeṣu bhiṣagvaraiḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīm anukteṣu guḍaśarkarādīnāṃ mānam āha - siteti | sitā śarkarā caturguṇā deyā cūrṇād ity arthaḥ | guḍo 'tra dviguṇaḥ, atrā'pi cūrṇabhāgād iti bhāvaḥ | (gugguluś canāsti ‘kha’ pustake | cūrṇasamaḥ cūrṇabhāgasamāna ity arthaḥ | madhu tatsamam iti madhu kṣaudraṃ tatsamaṃ cūrṇasamaṃ dravyaṃ kṣīratoyādikaṃ dviguṇaṃ cūrṇabhāgād ity arthaḥ) | cūrṇam atra sakaladravyāṇāṃ bhiṣagvarair iti grahaṇena svabuddhyā vā yathāyogyam avacārayed iti sāṃpradāyikāḥ || 4 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha bhakṣaṇamānam anuktānāṃ darśayann āha - karṣapramāṇam iti | karṣapramāṇaṃ karṣamātraṃ tanmānam iti tat teṣāṃ vaṭakādīnāṃ mānaṃ parimāṇaṃ | balam iti dehabalaṃ doṣabalaṃ vyādhibalaṃ ca | balagrahaṇena karṣamānam atra sāmānyaṃ sūcitam | ata eva dṛṣṭvā vicāryety arthaḥ | vicāraṇātra bālavṛddhānām eva madhyānāṃ tu karṣamātraiva || 5 ||

atha śrībāhuśālo guḍaḥ arśādau - sa yathā -
indravāruṇikā mustaṃ śuṇṭhī dantī harītakī |
trivṛc chaṭhī viḍaṅgāni gokṣuraś citrakas tathā || 6 ||

lg.l: tejohvā ca dvikarṣāṇi pṛthag dravyāṇi kārayet |
catuṣpalaṃ syād bhallātaḥ kvāthayet sarvam ekataḥ |
kvāthyadravyāt triguṇitaṃ guḍaṃ kṣiptvā punaḥ pacet |
samyak pakvaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā cūrṇam etat pradāpayet ||9||
nikṣipen madhu śīte ca tasmin prasthapramāṇataḥ |
jayed arśāṃsi sarvāṇi gulmaṃ vātodaraṃ tathā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. sa yatheti vacanaṃ guṭikāsamūhapratipādanārtham abhihitam ācāryeṇa | tatrādau śrībāhuśālo nāma guḍas taṃ darśayann āha - indravāruṇiketi | ayaṃ bāhuśālaguḍo 'rśovyādhau śastaḥ, tathendravāruṇikā cirbhaṭī tasyā mūlaṃ, dantī viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tasyāpi mūlaṃ; trivṛn niśothamūlam eva, śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, tejohvā'tra cavyaṃ yatra ca tejohvā cavikā tatra tejohvā jyotiṣmatī evaṃ sarvatra | ( etat sarvaṃ‘nāsti ‘kha’ pustake | pratyekaṃ dvikarṣaparimitaṃ bhavati | śūraṇasya palāny aṣṭāv iti sūraṇaḥ kandaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasyāṣṭau palāni bhavanti; vṛddhadāru catuṣpalam iti niśothabhedaḥ tasya catuṣpalāni, bhallātam iti bhallātakaphalāni tāni catuṣpalamitāni bhavanti) etat sakalaṃ pānīyadroṇe saṃkvāthya caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhṇīyāt| jaladroṇam iti caturāḍhakaparimitaṃ jalaṃ tena ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśatadvayapalāni jalaparimāṇaṃ bhavati | u- ttamam iti vastragālitādikaṃ tenottamatā kvathitasyety arthaḥ | caturthāṃśam ity āḍhakamātraṃ kvāthyadravyāt triguṇitaṃ guḍa- m iti guḍam atra jīrṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, kvāthyadravyād iti indravāruṇikāditejohvāntāt triguṇitaṃ tribhāgam etad uḍaṃ pāda- śeṣakāthe kṣiptvā punaḥ paced yāvat sāndro bhavati | atra cūrṇam āha - citraketyādi | citrakaś citrakajaṭā, trivṛn niśothaḥ, dantī prasiddhā, tejohvā cavī etaddravyacatuṣṭayaṃ palapramāṇam, anyad apy āha - vyoṣailāmalakatvaca ityādi | vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tvak guḍatvak idam api dravyaṣaṭkaṃ tripalapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ | śrībāhuśālo guḍa evaṃ siddho bhavati | bāhuśāla ācāryaviśeṣas tena nirmito guḍaḥ vaṭakasaṃjña ity arthaḥ | āḍhyavāta ūrustambhabhedaḥ | mahāntaṃ prabalam ity arthaḥ | rasāyana iti prabhāvāt | tad yathā “yaj jarāvyādhividhvaṃsi bheṣajaṃ tad rasāyanam” iti || 6-12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sa yathā sugamam | tejohvātejabala | tumburuḥ, kvāthāṃśadravyam indravāruṇikādyā tasmātriguṇaṃ guḍaṃ saṃpakve citrakādīni dāpayet | trivṛtā niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, tejohvā tumburuḥ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, elā sūkṣmā; maricaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ trikaṭumadhye grahaṇāt “ekam apy auṣadhaṃ yasmin yoge yat punar ucyate | mānato dviguṇaṃ jñeyam” ity uktatvāt | dviguṇaṃ maricakaṃ yad vā maricakaṅkolaṃ, tvakdālacīnī | prasiddhaṃ, madhu prasthapramitaṃ prasthamānam, evaṃ prasiddhaḥ śrībāhuśālaguḍaḥ bāhuśālo nāma kaścit, tadarthaṃ praṇītatvāt bāhuśālaḥ śrīmān śrīkaratvāt spaṣṭam anyat | nanu ādau jvaraghnī guṭikā kathaṃ noktā rogagaṇanāyāṃ jvarasyaiva prādhānyāt ? ucyate ? asya rasāyanatvāt jvarādivyādhināśakatvaṃ samāgataṃ, “yaj jarāvyādhividhvaṃsi bheṣajaṃ tad rasāyana”m ity ukteḥ | vyādhimātragrahaṇe jvarasyā'pi grahaṇāt | yad vā arśorogasyāpi jvarādivyādhisaṃjñakatvād ādāv abhidhānaṃ kramābhāvād vyatikramābhidhānam || 6-12 ||

atha maricādiguṭikā kāsādau -
maricaṃ karṣamātraṃ syāt pippalī karṣasaṃmitā || 13 ||

lg.l: asyā: prabhāvāt sarve 'pi kāsā yānty eva saṃkṣayam ||15||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ maricādiguṭikāṃ darśayann āha - maricam iti | asyā maricādikāyā vaṭikāyāḥ prabhāvād acintyaśaktiḥ | sarve kāsā iti pañcaprakārāḥ | atra dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalabījāni karṣayugmam iti karṣadvayaṃ vakre dhārayed iti, atra vakradhāraṇād idam auṣadhaṃ dhūmarūpam ity āhur eke, cakreṇa tu svasaṃgrahe bhakṣaṇacūrṇadvayaṃ vakre dhārayed iti prastāve likhitaṃ vaidyaprasārake 'pi ||

ab.seg:
śvāsakāsādau guḍavaṭikā |
guḍaśuṇṭhīśivāmustair guṭikāṃ dhārayen mukhe |
śvāsakāseṣu sarveṣu bibhītaṃ vāpi kevalam ||16||
Āḍhamalla. ( guṭikāsvarūpabhakṣaṇam asyoktam, etadabhiprāyeṇātra likhitaṃ | guḍaśuṇṭhīti spaṣṭam) ||13-16||

āmalakyādiguṭikā tṛṣṇādau -
āmalaṃ kamalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lājāś ca vaṭarohakaḥ |
etaccūrṇasya madhunā guṭikāṃ dhārayen mukhe ||17||

lg.l: tṛṣṇā pravṛddhāṃ hanty eṣā mukhaśoṣaṃ ca dāruṇam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athāmalakyādiguṭikām āha - āmalam iti | āmalam āmalakaphalaṃ kamalam utpalaṃ tadabhāve kamalabījāni grāhyāṇi, lājāḥ bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavāḥ, vaṭarohaka iti vaṭavṛkṣaprarohaḥ sa ca vaṭarohaśabdavācya:, madhv atra guṭikākaraṇamānaṃ paribhāṣoktam, dhārayen mukha iti | etena yathā yathā guṭikā dravati tathā tathā śīlanīyā punar imāṃ sahasaivābhyavahared iti dṛṣṭaparicayaḥ | pravṛddhām iti kair api yogair anivāryām | mukhaśoṣaṃ ca dāruṇam iti dāruṇaṃ duḥkhakaram asādhyam ity arthaḥ || 17 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āmalam āmalakaṃ, kamalaṃ kamalapatraṃ phalaṃ vā, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddhaṃ, lājā dhānyajā, vaṭarohakaṃ vaṭārohaḥ, kuṣṭhā'bhāve drākṣā vā deyā kuṣṭhasyātīvoṣṇatvāt ||17 ||

atha jvare sañjīvanīvaṭī tridoṣe ca -
viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kṛṣṇā pathyāmalabibhītakam ||18||

lg.l: vacā guḍūcī bhallātaṃ sadviṣaṃ cātra yojayet |
guñjābhā guṭikā kāryā dadyād ārdrakajai rasaiḥ |
tisraś ca sarpadaṣṭe tu catasraḥ sāṃnipātike |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha sañjīvanīguṭikāṃ darśayann āha - viḍaṅgam iti | atra nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, pathyā harītakī, āmalam āmalakaphalaṃ, bhallātaṃ bhallātakaphalaṃ, sadviṣam iti śuddhaṃ viṣaṃ eteṣāṃ samānamātrā boddhavyā | gomūtram atra guṭikārdhaparimitaṃ | guñjābhā guñjāparimāṇā vaṭī kāryā, ārdrakaraso 'trānupānaṃ, ajīrṇagulmayor ekaikāvaṭī deyā, visūcyāṃ dve vaṭyau, sarpadaṣṭe tisro guṭikāḥ, sannipāte catasra iti nāmnā kṛtvā sañjīvanī kathitā yato 'syāḥ prabhāvān mānavo yadā mumūrṣus tadā jīvatīti | vicāraṇātra na kāryā, “avicintyo hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāvaḥ” iti vacanāt ||18-21 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, pathyā harītakī, āmalakaṃ, bibhītakam akṣa:; bhallātakaṃ prasiddhaṃ | tadabhāve bākucir deyā, sadviṣam uttamaṃ viṣaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat || 18-21 ||

atha vyoṣādiguṭikā pīnasādau -
vyoṣāmlavetasaṃ cavyaṃ tālīsaṃ citrakaṃ tathā |
jīrakaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca pratyekaṃ karṣabhāgikam || 22 ||

lg.l: trisugandhaṃ triśāṇaṃ syād guḍaḥ syāt karṣaviṃśatiḥ |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ vyoṣādiguṭikām āha - vyoṣeti | vyoṣam atra trikaṭukam, amlavetasaḥ prasiddhaḥ, cavyaṃ loke cāvaśabdavācyaṃ, tālīsaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, tintiḍīkam ity amlaphaladravyaṃ, trisugandhaṃ triśāṇam iti | elā-tvak-patrakaṃ, tac ca militaṃ trikaṃ na tu pratyekaṃ, vyoṣādi tintiḍīkāntaṃ dravyaṃ ca pratyekaṃ karṣamātram ity arthaḥ | guḍaḥ syāt karṣaviṃśatir iti | guḍo 'tra purātano grāhyaḥ | karṣaviṃśatir iti pañcapalāni tena sakaladravyād dviguṇito guḍa ity arthaḥ, tathā hi -
‘vyoṣacitrakatālīsatintiḍīkāmlavetasam |
sa cavyājājitulyāṃśam elātvakpatrapādikam | vyoṣādikam idaṃ cūrṇaṃ purāṇaguḍasaṃyutam’ iti ||22||23||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vyoṣa trikaṭu; amlo 'mlavetas tasya cukraṃ vā rasaṃ vā deyaṃ, trisugandhaṃ tvak-tvaja-elā etat triśāṇam pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat || 22 || 23 ||

ab.seg:
atha guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikā āmādau -
āmeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīm ajīrṇe guḍapippalīm ||24||

Āḍhamalla. atha guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikāṃ vyācaṣṭe - āmeṣviti | guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikā iti ko 'rthaḥ ? guḍena saha catvāro yogāḥ kathitā ity arthaḥ | tad yathā āmeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīm ity eko yogaḥ, āmeṣu āmadoṣeṣu saguḍām ity atra guḍadvaiguṇyam evaṃ yogacatuṣṭayeṣu boddhavyam; ajīrṇe guḍapippalīm iti dvitīyaḥ, ajīrṇe viṣṭabdike, kṛcchre jīrakaguḍaṃ dadyād iti tṛtīyo yogaḥ, kṛcchre matrakṛcchre; arśaḥsu ca saguḍābhayām iti caturtho yoga iti || 24 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āmeṣu āmarogeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadyāt | vaṭīṃ tulyaguḍāṃ kṛtvā ajīrṇe ṣaḍvidhājīrṇe guḍapippalīṃ dadyāt; kṛcchre mūtrakṛcchre jīraguḍaṃ jīraṃ śvetajīrakam; arśaḥsu guḍābhayāṃ guḍayuktām abhayāṃ harītakīm ||24||

atha vṛddhadārumodakaḥ -
vṛddhadārukabhallātaśuṇṭhīcūrṇena yojitaḥ || 25 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ vṛddhadārukamodakam āha - vṛddhādāruketi vṛddhadāruko vikhyātaḥ tadabhāve niśothā grāhyā yato 'syā bhedo vṛddhadāraka iti | eteṣāṃ dravyatrayāṇāṃ cūrṇa samamātram āhuḥ | saguḍa ity atra modakatvena guḍo dviguṇito jñeyaḥ | kecit tu nādriyante yatas tatra catuḥsamagrahaṇena sama eva guḍo yujyate sāmyenā'pi kiñcid dravaṃ datvā agnau modakāḥ kāryāḥ | rujam iti pīḍām || 25 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vṛddhadārukaḥ prasiddhaḥ, bhallātakaḥ pratiddhaḥ, tadasahane raktacandanaṃ deyam | ayaṃ modakaḥ ṣahidhārśaḥkṛtāṃ rujāṃ hanyāt || 25 ||

atha sūraṇapiṇḍī arśoroge -
śuṣkasūraṇacūrṇasya bhāgān dvātriṃśad āharet || 26||

lg.l: dvau bhāgau maricasyāpi sarvāṇy ekatra cūrṇayet || 27 ||
guḍena piṇḍikāṃ kuryād arśasāṃ nāśanīṃ parām |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha sūraṇapiṇḍīm āha - śuṣkasūraṇeti | sūraṇaḥ kandaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa ca śuṣkaḥ kṛtvā cūrṇaṃ kāryaṃ, dvātriṃśad bhāgāḥ pañcadvayabhāgāḥ sūraṇasyety arthaḥ | citrakasya citrakamūlasya tvacaḥ ṣoḍaśabhāgāḥ, śuṭhyāś catvāro bhāgāḥ, maricasya dvau bhāgau guḍena piṇḍikāṃ kuryād iti sakaladravyadviguṇitenety arthaḥ | arśasām iti bahuvacanatvena ṣaḍvidhatvam ity arthaḥ | parām ity anena viśiṣṭatvam asyā darśitam || 26 || 27 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. citrasya citrakasya | spaṣṭam anyat||26||27||

ab.seg:
sūraṇavaṭakāḥ |
sūraṇo vṛddhadāruś ca bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛthak || 28 ||

lg.l: śivā bibhītakī dhātrī viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kaṇā ||29||
bhallātaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ tālīsaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak |
dvibhāgamātrāṇi pṛthak tatas tv ekatra cūrṇayet |
plīhānaṃ ślīpadaṃ śothaṃ pramehaṃ ca bhagandaram |
nihānyu: palitaṃ vṛdhyās tathā medhyā rasāyanā: ||33||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha sūraṇavaṭakān āha sūraṇa iti| sūraṇa: śuṣkasūraṇacūrṇaṃ tac ca ṣoḍaśakarṣapramāṇaṃ, vṛddhadāruko 'py evaṃ, muśalī tālamūlī, loke mūśarīśabdavācyā, sāṣṭakarṣam iti bhavati, citrakajaṭācūrṇam apy evam eva, śivāditālīsāntaṃ navadravyaṃ pratyekaṃ catuḥkarṣamitam | tatra śivā harītakī, dhātrī āmalakī, kaṇā pippalī, bhallāta: bhallātakaphalāni, tālīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tvagelāmaricam api dvikarṣamātraṃ pratyekaṃ | tenaiva cūrṇayed ity anena cūrṇoktavidhinā cūrṇayed ity arthaḥ | dviguṇena guḍeneti sakalacūrṇadravyāt guḍo dviguṇito grāhyaḥ | grahaṇīṃ vātakaphajām iti vātajāṃ kaphajāṃ (vātakaphajāṃ vā, kṣayāmayaṃ kṣayarogaṃ, palitaṃ vārdhakyaṃ vṛddhyā eke vṛddhyeti sthāne vṛṣyeti paṭhanti) vyākhyānayanti ca medhyā iti | buddhipradāḥ rasāyanā iti jarāvyādhividhvaṃsakāḥ || 28-33 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. arśoroge (sūraṇavaṭakān āha - ) śivā harītakī, dhātrī āmalakī, tvak tajaḥ || 28-33 ||

maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ kāmalādau -
triphalā tryūṣaṇaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau |
dāru mākṣikadhātuś ca dārvī mustaṃ viḍaṅgakam || 34 ||

lg.l: paktvā ca vaṭakān kṛtvā dadyāt takrānupānataḥ |
ūrustambham ajīrṇaṃ ca plīhānaṃ nāśayed api |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ maṇḍūravaṭakān āha - triphaleti | triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, dāru devadāru, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, dārvī dāruharidrā, eke ‘dārumākṣikadhātus tvag dārvyā mustaṃ viḍaṅgakam’ iti paṭhanti tatra dāruharidrāyās tvag eva grāhyā śreṣṭhatvāt, kāṣṭhaṃ tvagabhāve gṛhyate, na tu tvakśabdena guḍatvak grāhyā; yatas tantrāntare caturdaśadravyaṃ militaṃ | sarvadviguṇitaṃ tatheti maṇḍūram ity anena saṃbadhyate | samānamilitāt sakaladravyacūrṇāt maṇḍūracūrṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ | maṇḍūraṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ, lohamalam ity arthaḥ | yad vā purāṇamaṇḍūram iti vikhyātaṃ guṇādhikyāt | tathā hi ‘śatottham uttamaṃ kiṭṭaṃ madhyaṃ cāśītivārṣikam | adhamaṃ ṣaṣṭivārṣīyaṃ tato hīnaṃ viṣopamaṃ’ iti | kecit lohakiṭṭāt pṛthak pārthivadravyaṃ maṇḍūram iti vadanti (śuddham iti maṇḍūram ity arthaḥ | ‘maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇitaṃ śuddham’ iti vacanāt| atra cūrṇam añjanasadṛśaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ etādṛśam eva śreṣṭhaṃ bhavati) śuddham iti dhmāyanena saptadhā gomūtre nirvāpaṇādinā śuddhiḥ, ata evoktaṃ tantrāntare - ‘nirvāpitaṃ hi gomūtre maṇḍūraṃ grāhyam iṣyate’ iti | kartavyatāsya maṇḍūracūrṇam eva pṛthag gomūtre paktavyam āsannapāke ca tasmin triphalādicūrṇaprakṣepaḥ yataḥ cūrṇānāṃ pāko nāstīti (atrārthenāsti ‘kha’ pustake | kvacit ślokaḥ
‘prāyo na pākaś cūrṇānāṃ bhūricūrṇasya tena hi |
āsannapāke prakṣepaḥ svalpasya pākam āgate’ | pākalakṣaṇam api prasaṅgato likhyate yathā - ‘rāgo gandhaḥ śubhaḥ pāke vartiḥ syād gāḍhapīḍanāt’ iti | aṣṭaguṇe gomūtre iti mūtraṃ tu maṇḍūrād aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavati | tathā hi ‘grāhyaṃ tvaṣṭaguṇaṃ mūtraṃ śuddhamaṇḍūracūrṇataḥ’ iti | eke ‘maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayet sarvaṃ gomūtre 'ṣṭaguṇe kṣipet’ tatra sakaladravyād aṣṭaguṇaṃ gomūtraṃ grāhyam iti paṭhanti, etad asaṅgatam, ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu na dṛṣṭatvāt | kaphāmayān iti kṣayakāsaprabhṛtīn || 34-36 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. triphalā, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, dāru devadāru:, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddhā nirvamanā māritā ca deyā, maṇḍūraṃ mṛtaṃ purātanaṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ sarvato 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ gomūtraṃ datvā pacet | takreṇa ca deyam ||34-36||

div.ab:
dhātugatajvarādau pippalīmodakaḥ -
(kṣaudrād dviguṇitaṃprakṣiptam | tasyā: pippalyā: | kṣīraṃ gavyaṃ, cāturjātaṃ cūrṇādhikāroktam | sarpir ghṛtād dviguṇapippalī || 37 ||
sitā dviguṇitā tasyāḥ kṣīraṃ deyaṃ caturguṇam |
cāturjātaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ paktvā kuryāc ca modakān ||38||
dhātusthāṃś ca jvarān sarvān vāsaṃ kāsaṃ ca pāṇḍutām |
dhātukṣayaṃ vahnimāndyaṃ pippalīmodako jayet ||39||)

ab.seg:
atha candraprabhāgugguluḥ pramehādau -
candraprabhā vacā mustaṃ bhūnimbāmṛtadārukam |
haridrātiviṣā dārvī pippalīmūlacitrakau ||40||

lg.l: vyoṣaṃ mākṣikadhātuś ca dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam ||41||
dvikarṣaṃ hatalohaṃ syāc catuṣkarṣā sitā bhavet ||43||
śilājatv aṣṭakarṣaṃ syād aṣṭau karṣāś ca gugguloḥ |
ebhir ekatra saṃkṣuṇṇaiḥ kartavyā guṭikā śubhā ||44 ||
aṇḍavṛddhiṃ tathā pāṇḍuṃ kāmalāṃ ca halīmakam |
puṃsāṃ śukragatān doṣān mandāgnim aruciṃ tathā || 48 ||
vāyuṃ pittaṃ kaphaṃ hanyād balyā vṛṣyā rasāyanī |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ candraprabhāguṭikāṃ darśayann āha - candraprabhetyādi | candraprabhā karpūraḥ, eke candraprabhāśabdena śaṭhīṃ śatāvarīṃ vā kathayanti saṃjñāśabdatvāt | bhūnimbaḥ kairātaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī, dārukaṃ devadāru, kvacid bhūnimbāmaradārukam iti pāṭho dṛṣṭaḥ | tatrāmaradāru devadrāru, dārvī dāruharidrā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikam, dvau kṣārāv iti svarjikākṣārayavakṣārau, lavaṇatrayam iti saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viḍam iti lavaṇatrayaṃ trivṛn niśothaḥ, dantīti dantīmūlatvak, tadabhāve dantībījāny api manāg deyāni iti kasmiṃścit sampradāye na sarvatra | hatalohaṃ samyaṅmṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, śilājatu prasiddhaṃ, tac cātra śuddhaṃ grāhyaṃ, śuddhir asyānyatroktā jñātavyā vistareṇa | śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ subodham | mātrāpi caiteṣāṃ vyastā subodhā jñātavyā | candraprabhādivikhyāteti candraprabheyaṃ vaṭī ādivikhyātā pūrvaṃ prasiddhety arthaḥ, candraprabhevety arthaḥ | asyāḥ satatābhyāsāc candrasyeva prabhā kāntir bhavatīti, yad vā candraprabhā nāma dravyam ādir yasyāḥ | sarvarogam ity avaśiṣṭaṃ rogajātam uktarogasamūhāt, tam api nāśayituṃ yogyā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, vibandho vātādīnām apravṛttiḥ, ānāha udarāpūraḥ, mehanam iti grahaṇenaivopadaṃśaśūkadoṣādayo 'bhidhīyante, balyā balakarī, vṛṣyā śukravṛddhikarī, rasāyanī jarāvyādhivināśinīty anena paunaruktyena prabhāvotkṛṣṭatvam asyā darśitaṃ | “candraprabhāyāṃ karṣas tu catuḥśāṇo vidhīyate’ iti pādadvayaṃ kṣepakam āmananti kecit ||40-49 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. candraprabhā karpūraḥ, candravatprabhā yasyeti vyutpattyā, yad vā candraprabhā gandhālikākhyakarpūrabhedaḥ tathānvayavṛttyā| ‘pathye gandhālikā gandhavadhū: pṛthupalāśikā | śaṭhī sagandhacaṇḍā syāt somabhā somasaṃbhavā’,amaradāru devadāru, dārvī dāruharidrā, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddhaṃ māritaṃ ca, etāni pratyekaṃ śāṇamātrāṇi ṭaṅkamātrāṇi | trivṛt niḥsṛtāṃ, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, patrakaṃ tajaḥ, elā, vaṃśalocanā, etāni pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi | hatalohaṃ mṛtalohaṃ dvikarṣaṃ, sitā sitopalā catuḥkarṣā, śilājatusatvam aṣṭakarṣāṇi, guggulur daśakarṣaḥ evam ekatrīkṛtaḥ candraprabhā bhavati | iyaṃ candraprabhāditvāt candraprabhāguṭikā | kecit tu evaṃ vyākhyānayanti candravatprabhā yasyāsau candraprabho gugguluḥ sa tu ādau viḍaṅgam adhikṛtya likhitas tathāpi candraprabhānāmnā candraprasādena prāptā, sā vaṅgasenādibhiḥ pramehādhikāre likhitā | tathā ca ‘krimiripudahanavyoṣatriphalāmaradārucavyabhūnimbaṃ | māgadhimūlaṃ mustaṃ śaṭhī vacādhātumākṣike caiva’ ityādi || 40-49 ||

atha kāṅkāyanaguṭikā gulmādau -
yamānī jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ maricaṃ girikarṇikā |
ajamodopakuñcī ca catuḥśāṇāḥ pṛthak pūthak ||50||

lg.l: trivṛc cāṣṭamitaiḥ śāṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ kalpayet sudhīḥ ||51||
dantī śaṭhī pauṣkaraṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ dāḍimaṃ śivā |
ghṛtena payasā madyair amlair uṣṇodakena vā || 53 ||
madyena vātikaṃ gulmaṃ gokṣīreṇa ca paittikam ||54||
hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīṃ śūlaṃ krimīn arśāṃsi nāśayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha kāṅkāyanaguṭikāvivaraṇam āha - yamānīti | atra girikarṇikā ‘gaṇiyārī’ śabdavācyā, loke ‘isphanda’ iti prasiddhā, upakuñcī kṛṣṇajīrakaḥ, hiṃgv atra bharjitaṃ deyaṃ, kṣārāv iti yavakṣāraḥ svarjikākṣāraś ca, lavaṇapañcakaṃ prasiddhaṃ, trivṛn niśothaḥ, dantī prasiddhā, śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ tadabhāve kuṣṭham eva, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimabījaṃ, śivātra harītakī, citraś citrakajaṭā eteṣām uktamānatulitānāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā guṭikākaraṇārthaparimitena bījapūrarasenāplāvya modakāḥ kāryāḥ | ghṛtādyanupānaṃ sāmānyam uktvā viśeṣānumānaṃ madyādikaṃ yad uktaṃ tadviśiṣṭaroganivṛttyartham iti na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | mūtram atra gomūtraṃ, daśamūlair iti kvathitadaśamūlajalaiḥ | kāṅkāyanaproktām iti kāṅkāyanācāryeṇa proktāṃ kathitāṃ guṭikām ity arthaḥ | tantrāntare guṭikeyam arśovināśinī vihitā | tathā hi - ‘kāṅkāyanena śiṣyebhyaḥ śastrakṣārāgnibhir vinā | kathito vaṭako hy eṣa gudajānāṃ vināśanaḥ’ iti ||50-55||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. girikarṇikā aparājitā, upakuñcī kalañjikā, dvau kṣārau svarjitayavakṣārau, trivṛd iti niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, śivā harītakī, citraś citrakaḥ, amlo 'mlavetasas tasya cukraṃ vā raso vā, ṣoḍaśaśāṇaṃ | kāṅkāyano munis tatproktāṃ guṭikāṃ, spaṣṭam anyat ||50-55||

athaṃ yogarājaguggulur vātaroge āmavāte vā -
nāgaraṃ pippalī cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau ||56||

lg.l: dravyebhyaḥ sakalebhyaś ca triphalā dviguṇā bhavet |
ebhiś cūrṇīkṛtaiḥ sarvaiḥ samo deyaś ca gugguluḥ || 59 ||
(vaṅgaṃ raupyaṃ ca nāgaṃ ca lohasāras tathābhrakam |
guṭikāḥ śāṇamātrās tu kṛtvā grāhyā yathocitāḥ |
mandāgniṃ śvāsakāsaṃ ca nāśayed aruciṃ tathā |
dārvīśṛtena mehāṃś ca gomūtreṇa ca pāṇḍutām || 67||
medovṛddhiṃ ca madhunā kuṣṭhaṃ nimbaśṛtena ca |
chinnākvāthena vātāsraṃ śothaṃ śūlaṃ kaṇā‘mūlakajāt’ pā. | śṛtāt||68||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha yogarājagugguluvaṭakam āha - nāgaram iti | nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, hiṃgvajamodeti bhṛṣṭaṃ bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ utkledabhayāt, ( yataḥ ‘cūrṇeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛd bhavetnāsti kha pustake | ’ iti ) | ajamodā'tra yamānī grāhyā, antaḥparimārjanatvāt, jīrakadvayam iti śvetakṛṣṇabhedena vihitaṃ, reṇukā prasiddhā, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, śeṣaṃ prasiddham, etadviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ dravyagaṇaṃ viṃśatiśāṇatulitam ity arthaḥ | pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkamitam āhuḥ | sakaladravyebhyas tu triphalācūrṇaṃ dviguṇitaṃ deyam, tac ca catvāriṃśat śāṇamitam ity arthaḥ | triphalā'py atra samamātrā boddhavyā gaṇanāyāṃ tulanāyāṃ vā sāmyatvam asyāḥ, sarvasamo guggulur deya iti | tena ṣaṣṭiśāṇamito guggulur bhavati | ekapiṇḍam ityādi vākyenāsya karaṇārthaṃ yāvat piṇḍībhūtaṃ syāt tāvat parimāṇena ghṛtaṃ grāhyam iti vṛddhānāṃ vyavahāro 'sti | piṇḍam atra kuṭṭananirghātādinākuṭṭanaṃ ca lakṣasaṃkhyākanirghātairavicchedaṃ kāryamiti sampradāyaḥ | yāvat sikthatulyamāyāti tāvadvā'ṣṭapraharamavicchedamiti kecit | ghṛtaṃ kuṭṭanasamaya eva vāraṃ-vāraṃ dātavyam | , tata eva ghṛtabhājane dhārayet | atisnigdhatvāt | guṭikāḥ śāṇamātrās tv iti | yady api śāṇaparimitā guṭikā bhavati tathāpi bhakṣaṇavidhau yathocitā grāhyā, tena doṣādikaṃ vīkṣya deyā iti tātparyārthaḥ | tathā hy uktaṃ - ‘catvāro māṣakā hīne madhye tv aṣṭau ca māṣakāḥ | śreṣṭhe dvādaśakāḥ proktāḥ koṣṭhaṃ vijñāya tat tridhā’ iti | yad vā śodhanārthaṃ ca gugguloḥ karṣaḥ śamanārthe tu māṣacatuṣṭayam iti vyavahāraḥ | maithunāhārapānānām ityādi asyābhyāse maithunādayo na tyājyāḥ maithunaṃ strīsevā, eke maithunāhārapānābhyāṃ prayojanaṃ cātra vidyād iti paṭhanti | etat saṅgataṃ; tena maithunādayo bāhulyamātraṃ bhavantīty arthaḥ | kiṃtu ucyate yataḥ ‘kṣārāmlarasayūṣāktaṃ doṣadhātvavalocitam | bubhukṣito mātrapānam adyād guggulusevakaḥ’ ityādivacanāt ucitaṃ yathā maithunam api| tathā hi -
‘seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ tṛpto vājīkṛtair hime |
tryahād vasaṃtaśaradoḥ pakṣād vṛṣṭinidāghayoḥ ||
prakāmaṃ ca niṣeveta maithunaṃ śiśirāgame |
śīte rātrau divā grīṣme prāvṛṭvarjitavarṣaṇe || vasante ca divā rātrau nā smaret śaradi smaram’ iti | asyānupānaviśeṣam āha - rāsnādikvāthasaṃyukta ityādi | rāsnādikvātha: kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kathitaḥ sa ca bṛhadrāsnādir laghur vā kāṅkolyādicūrṇakalpanāyāṃ jñātavyaḥ, tac ca jīvanīyādigaṇasaṃjñam, asya śṛtena kvāthenety arthaḥ | āragvadhādineti āragvadhādigaṇakvāthenetyarthaḥ | ayam api kvāthakalpanāyām uktaḥ | dārvīśṛteneti | dārvī dāruharidrā tasyāḥ śṛtena kvāthena | gomūtreṇa ca pāṇḍutām iti atra ājaṃ vā mūtraṃ praśastaṃ vyavahārāt | madhunā kṣaudreṇa, nimbaśṛteneti nimbakvāthenetyarthaḥ | chinnā guḍūcī tasyāḥ kvāthena | pāṭalā prasiddhā tasyā mūlatvak grāhyā, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ punarnavādikvāthaḥ kvāthakalpanāyāṃ prasiddhaḥ || 56-69 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, tadādiviṃśatidravyāṇi śāṇamātrāṇi, sarvebhyas triphalā dviguṇā catvāriṃśat ṭaṅkamitā pratyekaṃ trayodaśaṭaṅkagugguluḥ sarvaiḥ samaḥ ṣaṣṭiṭaṅkamitaḥ cūrṇīkṛtya gugguluḥ kavakākhyaḥ ghṛtena saṃkuṭya guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ | śāṇamitaṃ bhakṣayet | kecit gugguluṃ vātaharadravyair daśamūlādibhir utkvāthya vastrapūtaṃ kṛtvā kṣipanti | tathā ca
‘gandhavarṇarasopeto guggulur mātrayā punaḥ|
bhaiṣajyaiḥ sahitaḥ kvāthyo yathā vyādhiharaḥ pṛthak ||
mātrāvaśiṣṭaṃ taṃ jñātvā gālayet śuṣkavāsasā |
athavā mardayet kvāthe yad uṣṇe sādhusādhite || mṛṇmaye hemapātre vā rājate sphāṭikepi vā’ | iti gugguluśodhanaṃ guggulukalpāt || 56-69 ||

atha kaiśoraguggulur vātaraktādau -
triphalāyās trayaḥ prasthāḥ prasthaikā cāmṛtā bhavet||70||

lg.l: tataḥ kvāthe kṣipec chuddhaṃ gugguluṃ prasthasaṃmitam |
punaḥ paced ayaḥpātre darvyā saṃgharṣayen muhuḥ || 72 ||
triphalā dvipalā jñeyā guḍūcī palikā matā|
dantī karṣamitā kāryā trivṛt karṣamitā smṛtā |
anupāne bhiṣag dadyāt koṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payo 'thavā || 76 ||
amlaṃ tīkṣṇam ajīrṇaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ‘vyavāyaṃ’ pā. | śramam ātapam |
madyaṃ roṣaṃ tyajet samyag guṇārthī purasevakaḥ || 81 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. adhunā kaiśoragugguluvaṭakān āha - triphalāyā ityādi | sammilitatrayasya traya eva prasthāḥ tena dvādaśakuḍavā ity arthaḥ | prasthaikā cāmṛtā bhavet iti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyāḥ prasthaikaṃ, eke ‘dviprastham amṛtā bhavet’ iti paṭhanti | ayam api pāṭhaḥ pracarati ādṛtatvāt granthāntaradarśanād vā | tathā ca ‘dvātriṃśac chinnaruhāyāḥ phalāni deyāni yatnata’ iti| saṃkuṭyeti triphalāguḍūcīm ity arthaḥ | droṇāmbunā paced iti etad dravyaṃ caturāḍhakaparimitena jalena sārdhaṃ paripaced iti | kvāthavidhānena kvāthārdhāvaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ vastragālitaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | aparakāryam āha - śuddhaṃ guggulum ityādi | śuddhatā'sya niṣpātrāditvena saptarātraṃ ghṛtoṣitatvāt | yad vā śuddhaṃ jātyutkṛṣṭam ity āmananti | yataḥ gugguloḥ pañca jātayaḥ, tad yathā
‘suvarṇavarṇaḥ prathamo dvitīyaḥ kusumadyutiḥ‘kumudāhvayaḥ’ pā.| |
tṛtīyaḥ padmarāgas tu caturthaś candranīlakaḥ || pañcamo mahiṣākṣaś ca nāmataḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ’ iti | tatra mahiṣākṣaṃ vihitam | uktaṃ ca tantrāntare -‘varamahiṣalocanodarasannibhavarṇasya gugguloḥ prastham’ ityādi | ayaḥpātre lohapātre | darvyā saṅgharṣayen muhur iti | darvī sañcālanakriyāyāṃ prasiddhaiva | muhur iti vāraṃ vāraṃ, kutaḥ ? dagdhabhayāt guḍapākasamākṛtim iti yathā guḍapākaṃ tathā gugguloḥ pākam ity arthaḥ | yataḥ ‘guḍavad gugguloḥ pākaḥ sugandhas tu viśeṣataḥ’ iti | lakṣaṇam api guḍapākasya tantrāntare prathitaṃ tad yathā -
‘toyapūrṇe yadā pātre kṣipto na plavate guḍaḥ |
kṣiptas tu niścalas tiṣṭhet patitas tu na śīryate || eṣa pāko guḍādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitaḥ’ iti | aparakāryam āha - cūrṇīkṛtya tatas tatreti | tata iti guḍapākād anantaraṃ tatra iti guggulupākadravye | triphalā dvipalā jñeyetyādi | saṃmilitatriphalāyā dvipalamitaṃ cūrṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, guḍūcī palaparimitā | vyavahāras tu guḍūcyāḥ satvam ādāya kṣiped iti manoharam | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tac ca militvā ṣaḍakṣam, viḍaṅgacūrṇam apy ardhapalaṃ, dantīmūlaṃ jayapālamūlaṃ karṣapramāṇam | kecit tu dantībījāny atra kṣipanti | tac ca sarvamataṃ | trivṛn niśothaḥ| tataḥ piṇḍīkṛtam ityādinātra kartavyavidhir api yogarājavad boddhavyaḥ | guṭikā iti | śāṇamātreti śāṇaparimitā guṭikāḥ kṛtvā doṣādyapekṣayā, na tu niyataśāṇamātram eva | doṣāpekṣayā yathā - kaphe niṣkaikaṃ, pitte dviniṣkaṃ vāyau triniṣkam iti | koṣṭhāpekṣayā yathā ‘catvāro māṣakā hīne, madhye tv aṣṭau ca māṣakāḥ | śreṣṭhe dvādaśakāḥ proktāḥ koṣṭhaṃ vijñāya tat tridhā’ iti | ṛtvapekṣayā yathā
‘prāvṛṭkāle ca grīṣme ca ghṛtayuktaṃ pradāpayet |
śaratkāle vasante ca dāpayet triphalāyutam | hemante śiśire caiva gomūtreṇa samāyutam’ iti | anupāne tu koṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payo 'thavetyādi | payaḥ kṣīraṃ, mañjiṣṭhādiśṛtam iti mañjiṣṭhādikvāthaṃ kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kvathitaṃ, yuktiyuktam utāparam iti utāthavā aparam anupānaṃ yuktiyuktaṃ rogasātmyaṃ dadyād iti sambandhaḥ | tathā hi - ‘yasya rogasya yat sātmyaṃ dadyāt tadanupānakam’ iti | etac cāgre vakṣyamāṇam asti | vāsādinā netragadān iti vāsādinā vāsādikvāthena, varuṇādinā varuṇādikvāthena kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, gulmādīniti ādigrahaṇāt kṛcchrāśmarīprabhṛtīn, khadirasya kvātheneti khadiro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya mūlatvak| asyābhyāse tyājyam āha amlam ityādi | amlam amlīkā mātuluṅgādi, tīkṣṇaṃ rājikādi, ajīrṇam annādijaṃ, vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma śramaṃ vahvāyāsakṛtakaṣṭaṃ karma, ātapaṃ dharmasevā, madyaṃ madyapānaṃ, roṣaṃ krodhaṃ, samyak tyajed iti yato 'mlādīni vātaraktaprakopīṇi bhavanti | eke amlaṃ tīkṣṇamityādi ślokaṃ na paṭhanti kṣepako 'yam iti manyante | kaiśoraguggulur iti kaiśoro bālakaḥ tasya rūpaṃ kaiśorakaṃ tenāsyābhyāse bālakasyeva rūpaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ | ata eva kāntikārakaḥ kathitaḥ || 70-81 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. triphalā trayaḥ prasthā iti | ekaṃ prasthaṃ harītakī, ekaṃ bibhītakaṃ, ekam āmalakam evaṃ trayaḥ; amṛtā guḍūcī prasthaikā saṃkuṭya lohapātre sārdhadroṇajale pacet, ardhajalaṃ gṛhītvā vastrapūtaṃ punaḥ pacet | darvyā muhuḥ saṃghaṭṭayet, sāndrībhūtaṃ guḍapākaṃ jñātvā imāni kṣipet | triphalārdhapalā jñeyā pratyekam ardhapalā, guḍūcī palikā tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭu ṣaḍakṣaṃ pratyekaṃ dvyakṣaṃ, viḍaṅgānām ardhapalaṃ, dantī karṣamitā, trivṛtkarṣamitā | tat piṇḍīkṛtvā ghṛtapātre kṣipet | śāṇikā guṭikā doṣāpekṣayā śuddhaṃ gugguluṃ tṛṇavālaśarkarādirahitaṃ, yad vā vātaraktādau auṣadhaṃ kvāthaśothitaṃ kṣipet | anupāne koṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payaḥ dugdhaṃ mañjiṣṭhādir vā | spaṣṭam anyat | purasevakaḥ guggulubhakṣakaḥ guṇārthī amlādīn tyajet | ayaṃ gugguluḥ kaiśorakābhidhānaḥ kiśorāvasthāvadrūpakaraḥ syāt || 70-81 ||

atha triphalāguggulur bhagandarādau -
tripalaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇācūrṇaṃ palonmitam |
gugguluṃ pāñcapalikaṃ kṣodayet sarvam ekataḥ || 82 ||

lg.l: tatas tu guṭikāṃ kṛtvā prayuñjyād vahnyapekṣayā |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ triphalāgugguluvaṭakam āha - tripalam ityādi | saṃmilitaphalatrikacūrṇaṃ tripalapramāṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, tena harītakī palamānaṃ, vibhītakaṃ palapramāṇaṃ, āmalakam api palamānam iti kṛṣṇā pippalī tasyāś cūrṇaṃ palapramitam iti | gugguluṃ pāñcapalikam iti | pañcapalapramāṇaṃ gugguluṃ saṃgṛhya ghṛtena saha saṃkuṭya cūrṇena saha modakāḥ kāryāḥ, ata eva kṣodayed ity uktaṃ ghṛtam atra vyavahāradarśanāt| vahnyapekṣayetyādinā bhakṣyamāṇasyeti boddhavyam | gulmaśothāv iti gulmaś ca śothaś ca | eke ‘bhagandaraṃ gulmaśotham arśāṃsi ca vināśayet’ iti paṭhanti | tatra gulmena janitaṃ śotham iti ||82||83||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tripalaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ pratyekaṃ palaṃ harītakyādīnāṃ, kṛṣṇacūrṇa pippalīcūrṇaṃ palonmitaṃ, gugguluḥ pañcapalaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat || 82 || 83 ||

ab.seg:
atha gokṣurādigugguluḥ pramehādau -
aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni palāny ānīya gokṣurāt |
vipacet ṣaḍguṇe nīre kvātho grāhyo 'rdhaśeṣitaḥ ||84||

lg.l: tataḥ punaḥ pacet tatra puraṃ saptapalaṃ kṣipet |
hanyāt pramehaṃ kṛcchraṃ ca pradaraṃ mūtraghātakam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha gokṣurādigugguluṃ darśayann āha - aṣṭāviṃśatīti | gokṣurād iti pañcāṅgagokṣurakasyāṣṭāviṃśatipalāni grāhyāṇi, tāni saṃkuṭya ṣaḍguṇe pānīye saṃkvāthyārdhāvaśeṣo grāhyaḥ, ṣaḍguṇatā ca gokṣuraparimāṇāt ardhāvaśeṣo jalaparimāṇāt | tataḥ punaḥ paced ityādi punaḥ paced ity ardhāvaśeṣitaḥ kvāthaḥ | tatrārdhāvaśeṣite puraṃ gugguluṃ saptapalaparimitam | guḍapākasamākāram iti | yathā guḍapāko bhavati tathāyam api kartavyaḥ, tac ca guḍapākalakṣaṇaṃ pūrvam uktaṃ | tatra vinikṣiped iti tatra guggulupāke vinikṣiped vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇītyarthaḥ | tāni kāni ity atrāha - trikaṭutriphalāmustam iti | trikaṭu tryūṣaṇaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, mustaṃ prasiddham, etat sakalaṃ palasaptakaṃ grāhyaṃ, pratyekaṃ palamātram ity arthaḥ | guṭikā mukhayojiteti | asya guṭikā śāṇamātrā prakalpya yathādoṣaṃ bhakṣaṇīyā iti bhāvaḥ | kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, vātarogān hanustambhākṣepakādīn || 84-87 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. gokṣuram aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni palāny ānīya ṣaḍguṇe nīre vipacet ardhaśeṣaḥ kvātho grāhyaḥ | punaḥ saptapalaṃ puraṃ gugguluṃ datvā pacet trikaṭu triphalāmustaṃ etāni saptadravyāṇi saptapalāni pratyekaṃ palam | iti gokṣurādiḥ pramehādau || 84-87 ||

atha triphalāmodakaḥ kuṣṭhādau -
triphalāṣṭapalā kāryā bhallātaṃ ca catuṣpalam |
vākucī pañcapalikā viḍaṅgānāṃ catuṣpalam || 88 ||

lg.l: hatalohaṃ trivṛc caiva gugguluś ca śilājatu |
ekaikaṃ palamātraṃ syāt palārdhaṃ pauṣkaraṃ bhavet || 89 ||
citrakasya palārdhaṃ syād dviśāṇaṃ maricaṃ bhavet |
śāṇonmitaṃ syād ekaikaṃ cūrṇayet sarvam ekataḥ |
tatas tat prakṣipec cūrṇaṃ pakvakhaṇḍe ca tatsame ||91||
prāgbhojanasya deyaṃ syād adhaḥ kāyasthite gade |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha triphalāmodakam apy āha - triphaletyādi| sammilitaphalatrikam aṣṭapalaparimitaṃ bhavati | bhallātaṃ bhallātakaphalaṃ, hataloham iti samyaṅmṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, ‘hatalohaṃ gugguluś ca śilājatu trikatrikam’ iti pāṭhe trikatrikaṃ tripalam ity arthaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhas tv asaṅgata eva, kintu “hatalohaṃ trivṛc caiva gugguluś ca śilājatu” iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | tatra trivṛn niśothaṃ, tena lohacūrṇādiśilājatuparyantaṃ palamātram āhuḥ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ palārdhaṃ grāhyaṃ, nāgarādikuṅkumāntaṃ dravyasaptakaṃ śāṇonmitaṃ, pratyekam iti bhāvaḥ | pakvakhaṇḍe ca tatsame iti tatsame sakala dravyasambhārasāmye tena saptaviṃśatipalānītyarthaḥ | yathocitān iti, yathā doṣāpekṣayā jihvātālugalāmayāni- tyanena jihvāmayān, tālvāmayān, galāmayān, ete mukharoge paṭhitāḥ, hanyāt pṛṣṭhāgatān rogān ity arthaḥ | prāgbhojanasyeti prātaḥkāle; adhaḥkāyasthite gade iti gṛdhrasyādau; jaṭharasaṃsthite udarādau ūrdhvajatrugadeṣv iti śirorogādiṣu bhojanasyopari sāyaṃkāle ||88-94||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pakvakhaṇḍaṃ pakvatāṃ prāpte khaṇḍe triphalā'ṣṭapalā pratyekam aṣṭapalā, tvak tajaḥ, elā, patraṃ patrajaṃ, kuṅkumaṃ keśaraṃ; spaṣṭam anyat || iti triphalāmodakaḥ || 88-94 ||

atha kāñcanāragugguluḥ gaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthībhagandarādau -
kāñcanāratvaco grāhyaṃ palānāṃ daśakaṃ budhaiḥ ||95||

lg.l: triphalā ṣaṭpalā kāryā trikaṭu syāt palatrayam |
ekaikaṃ karṣamātraṃ syāt sarvāṇy ekatra cūrṇayet |
yāvac cūrṇam idaṃ sarvaṃ tāvanmātras tu gugguluḥ || 97 ||
saṃkuṇṭhya sarvam ekatra piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā ca dhārayet |
gaṇḍamālāṃ jayaty ugrām apacīm arbudāni ca |
granthīn vraṇāṃś ca gulmāṃś ca kuṣṭhāni ca bhagandaram|| 99 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha kāñcanāragugguluṃ prakaṭayann āha - kāñcanāratvaca iti | kāñcanāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddha eva nijanāmnā, tasya tvak daśapalaparimitā grāhyā | triphaleti saṃmilitaphalatrikaṃ ṣaṭpalapramitaṃ; trikaṭor api militvā palatrayaṃ bhavati varuṇo 'pi svanāmaprasiddho vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasyāpi tvag eva grāhyā | elā tvak patrakam iti sugandhatrayaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣamātraṃ deyaṃ, guggulur atra sakalacūrṇasamaḥ, tena trikarṣottarāṇi viṃśatipalāni bhavanti; piṇḍaṃ kṛtvetyādinā ghṛtena saha saṃkuṭya snigdhabhāṇḍe dhārayed iti saṃpradāyaḥ | yathocitam iti yathādoṣāpekṣayā anupānārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - kvātho muṇḍatikābhava iti | muṇḍatikā bhūkadambakaṃ kedāramuṇḍī iti loke, khadiraḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya sāro madhyabhāgasthitakāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | pathyā harītakī koṣṇam ity uṣṇodakaṃ, yataḥ - ‘kaṃ śirombunoḥ’ iti kośaḥ || 95-100 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kāñcanāraḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasya tvacaḥ viṃśatipalaṃ, trikaṭu dvādaśapalaṃ samuditaṃ pratyekaṃ, śuṇṭhyādīnāṃ catuḥpalaṃ, triphalā ṣaṭpalā samuditā ca pratyekaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikā, varuṇaṃ palaikam, elā tvakpatrakam, ekaikaṃ karṣaṃ gugguluḥ sarvasamaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 95-100 ||

div.ab:
atha māṣādimodakaḥ puṣṭau -
nistuṣaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ syāt tathā godhūmasaṃbhavam |
nistuṣaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ ca śālitaṇḍulajaṃ tathā || 101 ||
sūkṣmaṃ ca pippalīcūrṇaṃ palikāny upakalpayet |
tata ekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bharjayed goghṛtena ca || 102 ||
ardhamātreṇa sarvebhyas tataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samaṃ kṣipet |
jalaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dattvā pācayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 103 ||
tataḥ pakvaṃ samuddhṛtya vṛttān kurvīta modakān |
bhuktvā sāyaṃ palaikaṃ ca pibet kṣīraṃ caturguṇam|| 104 ||
varjanīyau viśeṣeṇa kṣārāmlau dvau rasāv api |
kṛtvaivaṃ ramayen nārīr bahvīr na kṣīyate naraḥ || 105 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe vaṭakakalpanā nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha māṣādimodakam āha - nistuṣam ityādi | māṣacūrṇaṃ nistuṣaṃ tuṣarahitaṃ grāhyaṃ, tatheti grahaṇād godhūcūrṇam api nistuṣam ity arthaḥ | śālir dhānyaviśeṣaḥ sa ca ṣaṣṭiko grāhyaḥ tasya taṇḍulān kṛtvā tajjātaṃ cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ palikānīti bahuvacanena māṣacūrṇādipippalīcūrṇāntaṃ dravyaṃ pratyekaṃ palamātram āhuḥ kartavyavidhāv atra | tata ekīkṛtamityādi cūrṇād ardhamātreṇa goghṛtena cūrṇaṃ manāg bharjayitvā tadanu sakalacūrṇasamānaṃ khaṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhya khaṇḍādviguṇitena jalena saha paktvā palapramitā modakāḥ kāryāḥ | sāyaṃ sandhyāsamaye | pibet kṣīraṃ caturguṇam iti palapramāṇaṃ dravyaṃ bhakṣayitvā palacatuṣṭayaṃ kṣīram anupeyam ity arthaḥ | kṣārāmlau dvau rasau viśeṣeṇa varjanīyau yatas tau śukracyutikarau bhavataḥ, na kṣīyate nara iti śukrahānir na bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ || 101-105 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe guṭikākalpanādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || 7 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nistuṣaṃ tvagrahitaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ, pippalīcūrṇam etāni palikāni palamānāni, sarvebhyo 'rdhena goghṛtena bharjayet | tataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samaṃ dviguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā pācayet dviguṇaṃ khaṇḍāt tataḥ pakvamodakaṃ palamātraṃ khādet evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ bahvīr nārī ramayet kṣīyate na || || 101-105 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne guṭikādhikāraḥ || 7 ||

div.head: atha avalehādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ |
kvāthādīnāṃ punaḥ pākād ghanatvaṃ sā rasakriyā |
so 'valehaś ca lehaḥ syāt tanmātrā syāt palonmitā ||1 ||

Āḍhamalla. adhunāvalehānāṃ prathamatas tatsvarūpaviṣayaṃ darśayann āha - kvāthādīnām iti | kvāthādīnām ityādi grahaṇāt svarasaphāṇṭakalkādayo 'bhidhīyante ghanatvam iti | sāndratvaṃ yāvad bhavati tāvat pākaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ | pākas tu kvāthādīnāṃ bhavati, yataḥ prathamataḥ kvāthavidhinā pākaṃ kṛtvā paścāt pākena lehaḥ syād iti | tanmātreti tasyā'valehabhakṣaṇārthaṃ mānaṃ palamitaṃ boddhavyaṃ, iti sāmānyamānaṃ bhakṣaṇe 'bhihitam || 1 ||

lg.l: sitā caturguṇā kāryā cūrṇāc ca dviguṇo guḍaḥ |
dravaṃ caturguṇaṃ dadyād iti sarvatra niścaya || 2 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīm anukte sitādīnāṃ parimāṇam āha -- anuktamānāvalehe sitā caturguṇā deyā | caturguṇatā'tra sakaladravyād ity arthaḥ | guḍas tu dviguṇa iti cūrṇadravyāt | dravaṃ toyakṣīrādikaṃ caturguṇam | atrāpi cūrṇād iti bhāvaḥ | sarvatra niścaya iti svatantre paratantre vā || 2 ||

athāvalehasya siddhilakṣaṇam āha -
supakve tantumattvaṃ syād avaleho 'psu majjati |
kharatvaṃ pīḍite mudrāgandhavarṇarasodbhavaḥ || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. supakva iti | samyak pakve 'valehe etādṛśaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, kīdṛśaṃ tad āha - tantumattvam ityādi | darvyā sañcālanena tantusaṃyukta iva dṛśyate, tena mṛdyamāno 'ṅguligrāhī bhavatīty arthaḥ | apsu majjatīti pānīyamadhye yadā kṣiptas tadā nimagno bhavati | sthiratvam iti niścalatvam etena dravarahita ity arthaḥ | tathā hi -
“toyapūrṇe yadā pātre kṣipto na plavate guḍaḥ |
kṣiptas tu niścalas tiṣṭhet patitas tu na śīryate || eṣa pāko guḍādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitaḥ” iti | pīḍite mudreti tasminn aṅgulyādipīḍite sati mudrādīnām udbhavo bhavati, mudrā'tra nimnatā | yad uktaṃ “pīḍite tu yadāṅgulyā nimnatā tatra jāyate” iti | gandhavarṇarasodbhava iti sugandhopetaḥ surasopeta iti | yo 'valeho bhavati sa supakva ity arthaḥ || 3 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kvāthādeḥ kaṣāyāder yat punaḥ pakvāt sā rasakriyā ucyate avaleho lehaś ca ucyate nāmataḥ tanmātrā palonmitā syāt | cūrṇāt sitā caturguṇā, guḍo dviguṇaḥ, evaṃ caturguṇam iti niścayaḥ | avalehe supakve tantumattvaṃ syāt, sparśena pīḍite svarasatve mudrā ca bhavati | gandhavarṇarasodbhavas tadā siddhaṃ bhavet || 3 ||

idānīm anukteṣv anupānam āha -
dugdham ikṣuraso yūṣaḥ pañcamūlīkaṣāyajam |
vāsākātho yathāyogyam anupānaṃ praśasyate || 4 ||

Āḍhamalla. dugdham iti | dugdham iti sāmānyagrahaṇena sarvāṇi kṣīrāṇi yathādoṣaṃ grāhyāṇi | ikṣurasagrahaṇena sarve ikṣuvikārā gṛhyante | pañcamūlī mahatī hrasvā vā yathā vyādhivihitā grāhyā | kaṣāyajam iti yūṣam ity arthaḥ | tena pañcamūlasya kaṣāyeṇa kṛtvā yūṣaḥ so 'nupānam iti bhāvaḥ | kaṣāyagrahaṇena svarasakvāthakalkādayo grāhyāḥ | vāsākvātha iti | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, yathāyogyam iti yad yasya doṣasya yogyaṃ tad yathāyogyam | etena doṣānurūpam iti vyādhyanusāraṃ kathitaḥ, tad yathā - vāte 'mlamadhuralavaṇaprāyāḥ snigdhādayaḥ, pitte madhurakaṣāyatiktaprāyāḥ śītādayaḥ, kaphe tiktoṣaṇakaṣāyaprāyā rūkṣādayaḥ | mātrā yathā tathā hy uktam - “anupānaṃ prayoktavyaṃ kaphavyādhau palaṃ bhavet | paladvayaṃ tu pitte vānilaje ca palatrayam” iti | yad vā “gaṇḍūṣaṃ mātrayā deyaṃ mṛdau krūre tu pañca ca | anupānaṃ prayoktavyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā” iti | anupānam iti | anu paścāt pānaṃ tat kutaḥ tad āha - “yathā jalagataṃ tailaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva sarpati | tathā bhaiṣajyam aṅgeṣu prasarpaty anupānataḥ” iti || 4 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. avalehe dugdhādir yathāyogyam anupānam ||4||

atha kāsaśvāsādau kaṇṭakāryavalehaḥ - sa yathā -
kaṇṭakārītulāṃ nīradroṇe paktvā kaṣāyakam |
pādaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā ca tasmiṃś cūrṇāni dāpayet || 5 ||

lg.l: bhārgī rāsnā śaṭhī caiva śarkarā palaviṃśatiḥ |
pratyekaṃ ca palāny aṣṭau pradadyād ghṛtatailayoḥ || 7 ||
kṣiptvā nidadhyāt sudṛḍhe mṛṇmaye bhājane śubhe |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. sa yatheti taṃ darśayann āha - kaṇṭakārīti | laghukaṇṭakārikā sā samūlaphalaśākhā grāhyā | nīradroṇa iti caturāḍhakaparimite pānīye tryūṣaṇaṃ pratyekaṃ palapramāṇam āhuḥ | dhanvayāsakaḥ durālabhā rāsnā, surabhī, śarkarā palaviṃśatir iti sugamam | ghṛtatailayor iti militvā ṣoḍaśapalāni | ghṛtam atra goghṛtam ājaṃ vā vyādhivihitatvāt tailaṃ kaṭutailam atra vadanty eke | yataḥ “kāse śvāse ca hikvāyāṃ kaṭutailaṃ prayojayet” iti | kvacid asya prayogo 'pi dṛśyate “guḍaṃ kaṭukatailena miśrayitvā samaṃ lihet | trisaptāhaprayogeṇa śvāsaṃ nirmūlato jayet” iti | śīte madhupalāṣṭakam iti| madhukṣaudram aṣṭapalapramāṇaṃ śīte himasparśe vinikṣiped ity arthaḥ | yataḥ ‘uṣṇārtam uṣṇair uṣṇe ca tan nihanti yathā viṣam’ iti vacanāt | aparāṇi dravyāṇy āha - catuṣpalaṃ tvagākṣīryā ityādi | tvagākṣīrī vāṃśī | pippalī prasiddhā sudṛḍhe tv aticikkaṇe bhājane pātre śubhe abhagne maṅgalatvāt | ayaṃ lehaḥ kaṇṭakārī saṃjñaḥ | aśeṣata iti sampūrṇāriṣṭadarśanād api āsaṃcayād ity arthaḥ | etenāsya prāmāṇyaṃ darśitam || 5-9 ||

atha cyavanaprāśaḥ kṣayakṣīṇādau -
pāṭalā'raṇikāśmaryabilvāralukagokṣurāḥ |
parṇyau bṛhatyau pippalyaḥ śṛṅgī drākṣāmṛtābhayāḥ||10||

lg.l: balā bhūmyāmalī vāsā ṛddhir jīvantikā śaṭhī |
tatas tu tāny āmalāni niṣkulīkṛtya vāsasā ||14||
dṛḍhahastena saṃpīḍya kṣiptvā tatra tato ghṛtam|
tatas tatra kṣipet kvāthaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cārdhatulonmitam |
tatas tv ekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣipet kṣaudraṃ ca ṣaṭpalam |
lehaṃ vahnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā khādet kṣīṇo rasāyanam |
hṛdrogiṇaḥ svarakṣīṇā ye narās teṣu yujyate |
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ pipāsāṃ ca vātāsram uraso graham ||20||
medhāṃ smṛtiṃ strīṣu harṣaṃ krāntiṃ varṇaprasannatām ||21||
