ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā cyavanaprāśāvaleham āha - pāṭaletyādi| pāṭalā prasiddhā, araṇiḥ agnimanthakaḥ, kāśyaryaḥ gāmbhārī, bilvaṃ prasiddham, aralukaḥ syonākaḥ, parṇyau dve tena śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī ceti, tac ca dvayaṃ ‘kavarādvayaśabdavācyaṃ, bṛhatyāv iti dve bṛhatyau kaṇṭakārīdvayam itity arthaḥ | śṛṅgī karkaṭākhyā, bhūmyāmalī tāmalakī, ṛddhī iti dvivacanatvena ṛddhivṛddhī grāhye, jīvantī śākaviśeṣaḥ jīvakarṣabhakāv iti dvau tena jīvaka ṛṣabhakaś ceti, kākanā- sikā ‘kauvāḍoḍīti’ loke, vidārī kandaviśeṣaḥ, kākolyāv iti dravyadvayaṃ tena kākolī kṣīrakākolī ceti, kama- lam utpalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījaṃ grāhyaṃ, mede dve medā mahāmedā ca, agaruḥ kṛṣṇāgaruḥ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, sthūlacūrṇam iti udūkhale musalādibhiḥ kuṭṭitam ity artha: | na tu vastragālituṃ, pañcāmalaśatāni ceti | āmalakaphalānāṃ guṭikāni pañcaśatāni atra gaṇanāmānam | evaṃ sarvatra palādimānābhāve yathā vakṣyamāṇavarge agastyaharītakyavalehe “harītakīśataṃ bhadram” ityādi | evaṃ bhallātakaguḍe “bhallātakasahasre dve” iti | yatra palādimānam uktaṃ tatra tu palādimānenaiva vyavahāraḥ | yathā pūrvoktā bāhuśālaguḍe “catuṣpalaṃ syād bhallātam” iti | paced iti hastaparipāṭīvyavahārāt, tad yathā akhaṇḍitāmalakaphalaṃ karpaṭe poṭṭalīṃ badhvā kvāthanīyaṃ tena tāni sugrahāṇi syu: | aṣṭāvaśeṣitam ity atra yad grahaṇaṃ tad vṛndaṭippaṇakāramatam ālokya kṛtam | vṛnde tu “jñātvā gatarasaṃ dravyaṃ rasaṃ gṛhṇīta gālitam” ity asya vyākhyāyāṃ aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣeṇa dravyāṇāṃ gatarasatvaṃ syāt iti | kecit tu grāhyaṃ pādāvaśeṣitam iti paṭhanti tatra suśrute vāgbhaṭe ca pādaśeṣe rase ity evoktam | niṣkulīkṛtyeti | niṣkulam iti kṣaumādigharṣaṇāt peṣaṇād vā tena asthitvagādirahitam ity arthaḥ | saptapalaparimitena sarpiṣā tadbharjanaṃ kāryaṃ cakradattoktaṃ - “sitā matsyaṇḍikābhāve dhātryāś ca mṛdubharjanaṃ | caturbhāge jale prāyo dravyaṃ gatarasaṃ bhavet” iti | khaṇḍasya kvātham iti śīrāśabdavācyaṃ, khaṇḍenāpi kecid vyavaharanti | kṣaudram atra śītībhūte dadyāt cyavanaproktam iti cyavano nāma munis tena proktaṃ kathitam, prāśyata iti prāśaḥ cyavanasya prāśa iti bhāvaḥ | kṣīṇo dhātukṣayo rasāyanam iti jarāvyādhināśanaṃ, naro jīrṇavivarjita iti naro 'sya sevī puruṣaḥ jīrṇavivarjitaḥ jarārahito bhavatīty arthaḥ | yad vā ajīrṇavivarjī bhavati, tad api rogamūlam eva yataḥ “prāyeṇāhāravaiṣamyād ajīrṇaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | tanmūlo rogasaṃghātas tadvināśād vinaśyati” iti ||10-21||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pāṭalādikam auṣadhaṃ pratyekam ekaikaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ sthūlacūrṇitam auṣadhaṃ mahatpātre bṛhatpātre ekīkṛtya pañcāmalakaśatāni droṇajalaṃ kṣiptvā pacet | aṣṭāvaśeṣitaṃ prāhyaṃ, tatas tasmāt tāny āmalakāni niṣkulīkṛtya nistvacāni vāsasā dṛḍhahastena saṃmardya saptapalamitaṃ ghṛtaṃ datvā tāni kiñcid bhṛṣṭāni ardhatulonmitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca datvā kvāthaṃ pacet | lehavat sādhayitvā punaḥ imāni cūrṇāni dāpayet | imāni pippalyādīni kṣaudraṃ ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣipet | pāṭalā pāṇḍurā, araṇi:, kāśmarī gambhārī, bilvaḥ śrīphalaḥ, araluḥ syonākaḥ, gokṣuraḥ trikaṇḍakaḥ, parṇyau śāliparṇī mudgaparṇī ca, bṛhatyau bṛhallaghukaṇṭhakārīdvayaṃ, pippalyaḥ, śṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, drākṣā gostanī, amṛtā guḍūcī, abhayā harītakī, balā prasiddhā, bhūmyāmalakī prasiddhā, vāsā, ṛddhiḥ, jīvantī, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, jīvakarṣabhakau aṣṭavargoktau, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, puṣkaramūlaṃ kākanāsikā , viṣṇukrāntā, mudgaparṇī, māṣaparṇī, vidārīkandaḥ, punarnavā, kākolī, kamalaṃ, medā sūkṣmailā, agaru candanam etāni pratyekapalāni kvāthyadravyāṇi aṣṭavargavidhānām abhāve jātimelanīyāni | spaṣṭam anyat | etac cyavanaṛṣiṇā proktaṃ cyavanaprāśasaṃjñaṃ bhavati || 10-21||

atha kūṣmāṇḍāvalehaḥ -
niṣkulīkṛtya kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāt palaśataṃ pacet ||22||

lg.l: nikṣipya dviguṇaṃ nīram ardhaśiṣṭaṃ ca gṛhyate |
ātape śoṣayet kiṃcic chūlāgrair bahuśo vyadhet |
kṣiptvā tāmrakaṭāhe ca dadyād aṣṭapalaṃ ghṛtam || 24 ||
tena kiṃcid bharjayitvā pūrvoktaṃ taj jalaṃ kṣipet |
khaṇḍāt palaśataṃ dattvā sarvam ekatra pācayet || 25 ||
supakve pippalī śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ dvipalaṃ pṛthak |
pṛthak palārdhaṃ dhānyākaṃ patrailā maricaṃ tvacam || 26||
cūrṇīkṛtya kṣipet tatra ghṛtārdhaṃ kṣaudram āvapet |
khāded agnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā raktapittī kṣayī jvarī ||27 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha kūṣmāṇḍāvalehavivaraṇaṃ darśayann āha - niṣkulīti | niṣkulīkṛtyeti tvaṅmajjādirahitāni kūṣmā- ṇḍaśakalāni saṃgṛhyety arthaḥ | dviguṇaṃ nīram iti kūṣmāṇḍaparimāṇāt tena kūṣmāṇḍaśakalāni tulāparimitāni dvitulāmitaṃ nīram iti ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvātharūpaṃ jalam | śūlāgrair iti kāṣṭhamayaśaṅkumukhaiḥ | bahuśo vyadhed iti bahucchidrā- ṇi kūṣmāṇḍaśakalāni kārayed iti bhāvaḥ | uktaṃ ca - hastapāṭyāṃ pūrvaṃ niṣkulīkṛtaṃ tadanu kṛtacchidraṃ paścāt saṃsvedya kṣaumeṇa veṣṭayitvā pīḍayet, ātape manāk saṃśoṣya piṣṭvā palaśataṃ gṛhītvā paktavyaṃ, tena kiñcid bharjayitveti kiṃcid atra yathāpākaṃ bharjayet | tathā hi “muktasarpiṣi kūṣmāṇḍe pāko gandhena mudrayet” iti | taj jalam ity ardhāvaśeṣitaṃ pūvāktaṃ kvātham | khaṇḍāt palaśatam iti śarkarāpalaśatam | ghṛtārdhaṃ kṣaudram āvaped iti ghṛtamānād ardhaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu kṣiped iti bhāvaḥ | āvaped iti grahaṇena śītībhūte tasmin paścāt melayed ity arthaḥ | āturaśabda: śoṣādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate | bālavṛddheṣu yojayed iti saumyatvāt dhātupoṣakatvāc ca vṛṣyaḥ śukravṛddhikaraḥ bṛṃhaṇo dhātuvṛddhikaraḥ balakṛd ojaso vṛddhikara iti || || 22-28 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. palaśataṃ niṣkulīkṛtakūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāt dvitulānīre nikṣipya pacet ardhaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhyate tāni kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāni dṛḍhavāsasā pīḍayet | punaḥ kiñcid ātape śoṣayet | punar bahuśūlāgrair vedhayet | punaḥ kaṭāhe kṣiptvā aṣṭapalaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyāt | tena ghṛtena kiñcit bharjayet pūrvoktaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet khaṇḍāt palaśataṃ datvā sarvam ekatra kārayet | supakve pippalī-śuṇṭhī jīraṃ jīrakam eṣāṃ pṛthak dvipalaṃ, dhānyākaṃ, patraja, elā, maricaṃ, tvak taja eṣāṃ pṛthak palārdhaṃ ghṛtārdha catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu | spaṣṭam anyat || 22-28 ||

atha khaṇḍasūraṇāvalehaḥ arśoroge -
yuktyā kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍasya sūraṇaṃ vipacet sudhīḥ ||29||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ khaṇḍasūraṇāvaleham āha - yuktyeti | kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍasya yuktyā kartavyavidhinā ayam api sūraṇā'valehaḥ kartavyaḥ | sudhīr iti grahaṇena pūrvoktakūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍe yad dravyaṃ yan mānaṃ yā kartavyatā tat sakalaṃ vicārya tenaiva prakāreṇa sūraṇāvalehaḥ sādhyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa mūḍhavātānāṃ mandāgnīnāṃ ca yujyate || 29 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 29 ||

atha agastyaharītakyavalehaḥ -
harītakīśataṃ bhadraṃ yavānām āḍhakaṃ tathā || 30||

lg.l: pacet pañcāḍhake nīre yavaiḥ svinnai: śṛtaṃ nayet |
tac cābhayāśataṃ dadyāt kvāthe tasmin vicakṣaṇaḥ || 36 ||
paktvā lehatvamānīya siddhe śīte pṛthak pṛthak ||34||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athāgastyaharītakyavalehaṃ darśayann āha - harītakīśatam ityādi | harītakīśataṃ harītakīguṭikāśataṃ na tu harītakīpalaśataṃ ‘saṃkhyā phalānāṃ śataśaḥ palānām’ iti vacanāt | bhadram iti śreṣṭhaṃ harītakīphalaśataṃ tena navādiguṇasahitam ity arthaḥ | tathā hy uktam - ‘navā snigdhā ghanā vṛttā gurvī kṣiptā tathā'mbhasi | nimajjed yā praśa- statvād guṇakṛt sā prakīrtitā’ iti | yavānām āḍhakam iti | yavo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ tasya catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni | kecit tu ‘harītakīśataṃ bhadrayavānām āḍhakaṃ tathā’ iti paṭhanti, tatra bhadrayavā indrayavā iti vyākhyānayanti, etan na pracarati sarveṣāṃ saṃpradāyavirodhāt | tasmād dharītakīśataṃ bhadram iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | daśamūlasya viṃśatipalāni pratyekaṃ dvipalam ity arthaḥ | śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ prasiddhaṃ | yavaiḥ svinnair iti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | yavasvinnatā ca caturbhāgāvaśeṣe jale eva bhavati tena caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭam eva grāhyaṃ | tantrāntare 'py uktaṃ - ‘yavāḍhakaiḥ pañcabhir aṅghriśeṣaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet’ ityādi | paktvāvalehatvam ānīyeti vyavahārāt | harītakīśatasya karpaṭe poṭṭalaṃ baddhvā kvathanaṃ paścād utsvinnaharītakīśatasya ghṛtatailayor bharjanaṃ taddṛḍhārthaṃ | yathā tantrāntare sarvārthasiddhaharītakyāṃ harītakībharjanam uktaṃ | tadanu kvāthe guḍatulāṃ loḍayitvā pākaḥ karyavyaḥ, avataraṇasamaye pippalīcūrṇaprakṣepaḥ | śītībhūte cāpare 'hni madhudānam iti vṛddhānāṃ mataṃ; sugandhārthaṃ manāk cāturjām iti kecit | tad uktaṃ - ‘pippalīcūrṇakuḍavaṃ cāturjātāvacūrṇitam’ iti | sarpistailāṣṭakapalam iti yad uktaṃ tan militvā grāhyaṃ | ‘harītakīdvayaṃ khādet tena lehena nityaśa’ iti | yady api guḍasya bhakṣaṇamānaṃ noktaṃ tathāpi harītakīdvirūpagrahaṇena lehasya palamānaṃ bhavaty eva yathā tantrāntare bhārgīguḍe ‘bhakṣayed abhayād ekāṃ lehasyārdhapalaṃ lihet’ iti | tenā'tra harītakībhakṣaṇavidhānād guḍapalaṃ bhakṣyam iti | anye tu gulmocchede harītikīnyāyād guḍaṃ dvipalam āhuḥ, etat sarvam eva vyādher balābalatvāt pracarati | agastyamunivihitatvenāsya siddhaphalatvam ucyate || 30-37 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. harītakīśataṃ bhadram uttamaṃ śataṃ gaṇanayā, yavānām āḍhakaṃ yavo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, daśamūlasya viṃśatipalāni pratyekaṃ dvipalaṃ śāliparṇyādikaṃ daśauṣadhaṃ citrakādīni ca pṛthaṅmātrayā dvipalaṃ, apāmārgaḥ, śaṭhī karcūra kapikacchur vānarī tasyā bījaṃ, śaṅkhapuṣpakaṃ śvetapuṣpī, bhārgī, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, tadabhāve cavyaṃ vā, balā prasiddhā, puṣkaramūlaṃ etāni pañcāḍhake nīre pacet | khinnaiḥ pakvair yavaiḥ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet | tasmin kvāthe abhayāśataṃ dadyāt pakvaṃ śuṣkaṃ punaḥ pacet yad vā paścād abhayāpākaḥ paktvā lehatvam ānīya sarpir ghṛtam aṣṭapalikaṃ tilajaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu guḍaṃ catuḥpalaṃ pippalīcūrṇaṃ ca kuḍavaṃ | tena lehena siddhena harītakīdvayaṃ khādet balāpekṣayā ekaṃ vā ādau, kṣayādikaṃ haret | ayaṃ agastyamuninā'bhihita agastyāvalehaḥ || 30-37 ||

arśādau kuṭajāvalehaḥ |
kuṭajatvaktulāṃ droṇe jalasya vipacet sudhīḥ |
kaṣāyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ ca gṛhṇīyād vastragālitam || 38 ||

lg.l: triṃśatpalaṃ guḍasyātra dattvā ca vipacet punaḥ|
lajjāluṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhāṃ bilvam indrayavaṃ tvacām ||40||
siddhaśīte tato dadyān madhunaḥ kuḍavaṃ tathā |
jayed eṣo 'valehas tu sarvāṇy arśāṃsi vegata: || 42 ||
grahaṇīṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca raktapittaṃ ca kāmalām ||43||
amlapittaṃ tathā śothaṃ kārśyaṃ caiva pravāhikām |
anupāne prayoktavyam ājaṃ takraṃ payo dadhi || 44 |
ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ vā jīrṇe ca pathyabhojī bhaven naraḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kuṭajāvaleham āha - kuṭajatvag iti | kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak challī sā palaśataparimitā grāhyā | pādaśeṣam iti caturthāṃśaṃ kaṣāyaṃ vastrapūtaṃ kṛtvā grāhyaṃ | kutracid etan na pracarati kintu pādaśeṣam iti pādasya caturthāṃśasya yac cheṣaṃ caturbhāgaṃ tad grāhyam, etenāṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ kathitam; tathā ca tantrāntare -
‘kuṭajatvakpalaśataṃ jaladroṇe vipācayet |
aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu kaṣāyam avatārayet | vastrapūtaṃ tataḥ kvāthaṃ pacel lehatvam āgatam’ iti | triṃśatpalaṃ guḍasyātreti atra kvāthe guḍasya purātanasya triṃśatpalaṃ datvā punar vipaced iti yāvat sāndratvaṃ bhavati | cūrṇārthamaparāṇi dravyāṇy āha - rasāñjanam iti rasāñjanaṃ pratītaṃ tac ca dārvīkvāthasamudbhavam iti prasiddhiḥ, mocarasaṃ śālmalīveṣṭakam, indrayavaṃ tvacam iti indrayavaṃ kuṭajabījaṃ, tvak guḍatvak | durnāmaprabhavān rogān iti gulmodaraprabhṛtīn, anupāne prayoktavyam iti ājaṃ takraṃ, ājaṃ payaḥ, ājaṃ dadhi, ājaṃ ghṛtaṃ ceti | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ, takrādīnām abhāvāt etat sakalam anupānaṃ yathāsātmyaṃ niṣeved ity arthaḥ | jīrṇe ceti dravye parimite sati pathyabhojī bhaven nara iti bhāvaḥ | yataḥ - ‘auṣadhaśeṣe bhukta’mityādivākyānurodhāt || 38-44 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kuṭajaḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasya tvak tulāṃ palaśataṃ jalasya droṇe vipacet | sāndratvaṃ ghanatvam āgataṃ dṛṣṭvā imāni rasāñjanādīni pratyekaṃ palamānāni kṣipet | rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ, prativiṣā ativiṣā, bālakam udīcyaṃ, lajjāluḥ lajjāvatī, spaṣṭam anyat || 38 -44 ||

ab.seg:
atīsārādau kuṭajāṣṭakāvaleham āha -
kuṭajatvaktulām ārdrāṃ droṇanīre vipācayet || 45 ||

lg.l: pādaśeṣa śṛtaṃ nītvā cūrṇāny etāni dāpayet |
lajjālur dhātakī bilvaṃ pāṭhā mocarasas tathā || 46 ||
mustaṃ prativiṣā caiva pratyekaṃ syāt palaṃ palam |
tatas tu vipaced bhūyo yāvad darvīpralepanam || 47 ||
jalena chāgadugdhena pīto maṇḍena vā jayet |

ab.seg: asṛgdaraṃ samastaṃ ca sarvārśāṃsi pravāhikām | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe 'valehakalpanā nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||

Āḍhamalla. kuṭajeti | ayaṃ kuṭajāṣṭakāvaleho vyākhyāyāṃ sugama evāvagantavyaḥ | kartavyavidhis tu pūrvavad roddhavyaḥ | darvīpralepanam ity avalehasya saṃsiddhilakṣaṇaṃ sūcitaṃ pūrvoktāvalehavidhau jñātavyam || 45-48 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śūrṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyama- khaṇḍe 'valehakalpanādhyāyo 'ṣṭamaḥ || 8 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kuṭajāṣṭakam atīsārādau - ārdrā kuṭajatvak tulāṃ droṇanīre vipācayet, pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nītvā imāni cūrṇāni dāpayet | lajjālur lajjāvatī, dhātakī vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasya puṣpāṇi, bilvaṃ, pāṭhā, mocarasaḥ, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, ativiṣā etāni pratyekaṃ palaṃ tato bhūyo vipacet yāvad darvyāḥ pralepalepanaṃ bhavati liptvā tiṣṭhati darvī lohanirmitā| tato jalādibhiḥ pibet | spaṣṭam anyat ||45-48 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyām avalehādhikāraḥ ||8 ||

div.head: atha tailādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
navamo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha snehaparibhāṣā |
kalkāc caturguṇīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ vā tailam eva vā |
caturguṇe drave sādhyaṃ tasya mātrā palonmitā ||1||

lg.l: pādaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhītvā ca snehaṃ tenaiva sādhayet ||2||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ snehakalpanāṃ darśayann āha - kalkād iti | anukte kalkāt kalkayogadravyāt ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā caturguṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, na tu dṛṣadi peṣitāt kalkāt| dravam api caturguṇaṃ snehaparimāṇāt dravaṃ toyādi | tasya mātrā palonmiteti | tasya saṃsiddhasnehasya pānārthaṃ palonmitā palapramāṇā mātrā jñeyā ity anukteṣu mānam idaṃ sāmānyaṃ | paribhāṣāyām ayam api sāmānyasnehapākavidhau boddhavyaḥ, tathā hi - ‘kalkāc caturguṇaḥ snehaḥ snehāt kvāthaś caturguṇaḥ | kvāthāc caturguṇaṃ vāri kvāthaḥ kvāthyasamo mataḥ’ iti | viśeṣo 'pi kvacid vartate yathā tantrāntare vāsāghṛte balādye ghṛte vā tad yathā -“atrāpy aṣṭaguṇais toyaiḥ kvathitaṃ kvāthadugdhayoḥ | pratyekaṃ dviguṇo bhāgo bhiṣak sarpiṣi nikṣipet” iti || 1 || 2||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha sneheti | tatra tāvat prathamataḥ paribhāṣām asya vyācaṣṭe | atha ghṛtādhikāraḥ | tatrādau ghṛtatailādisādhanam āha - tatkalketyādi | kalkāt dravyāt ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ caturguṇe dravye dugdhādau sādhyam agnidvārā kaṭāhādau paktvā siddhaṃ bhavati | tasya mātrā vātādirogaviṣaye mānamātrā palonmitā palapramāṇā | idānīṃ snehasādhane kvāthavidhānam āha - nikṣipyetyādi | kvāthadravyāc caturguṇaṃ toyaṃ jalaṃ nikṣipya kvāthayet| punaḥ pādaśiṣṭaṃ ca caturthāṃśāvaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā'nena kvāthena snehaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā sādhayet | kvāthaṃ kvāthayogyaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ yad dravyaṃ daśamūlādi tasmād isyarthaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg:
mṛdudravyādau kvathane jalapramāṇam āha -
caturguṇaṃ mṛdudravye kaṭhine 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam |
tathā ca madhyame dravye dadyād aṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravyaviśeṣe kvāthanimittaṃ jalamānam āha - caturguṇam iti | atra caturguṇaprabhṛtikaṃ dravyaparimāṇād dhoddhavyam | yāvatparimāṇaṃ kvāthyaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tāvatparimāṇāc caturguṇitaṃ jalaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | mṛdu kaṭhinaṃ kaṭhinataraṃ ca dravyaṃ tatraivānumānato 'vagantavyam | tathā ca madhyame dravye dadyād aṣṭaguṇaṃ paya iti | madhyame mṛdvādisaṃbhāre payaḥ pānīyaṃ yatra mṛdukaṭhinataradravyam ekatra militvā kvāthyaṃ tatrāṣṭaguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyam iti sarvatra | tathā hi - ‘mṛdvādikvāthyasaṃghāte mānānukte cikitsakāḥ | madhyasyobhayabhāgitvād icchanty aṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam’ iti || 3 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mṛdudravye guḍūcyādau caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ, kaṭhine daśamūlādau aṣṭaguṇaṃ, tathā ca madhyamadravye āragvadhādau aṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ | payo 'tra jalaṃ | atyantakaṭhine padmakādau ṣoḍaśikaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ mataṃ kathitaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhyate || 3 ||

atha matāntare parimāṇaviśeṣam āha -
karṣāditaḥ palaṃ yāvat kṣipet ṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam || 4 ||

lg.l: tadūrdhvaṃ kuḍavaṃ yāvad bhaved aṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ |
prasthāditaḥ kṣipen nīraṃ khārī yāvac caturguṇam || 5 ||
kalkasyāṃśaṃ tatra dadyāc caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭham aṣṭamam || 6 ||
dugdhe dadhni rase nakre kalko deyo 'ṣṭamāṃśakaḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. karṣādita iti | karṣādita ityādiparimāṇaṃ sāmānyadravyaviṣaye vartate anyathā svatantravirodhaḥ, yāva- tkvāthyadravyaṃ karṣādiparimāṇāt palaṃ bhavati tāvat tatra ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ jalaṃ datvā kvāthaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyaṃ | ṣoḍaśikam atra kvāthyadravyaparimāṇāt, tatas tu palād upari yāvat kuḍavaṃ kvāthyadravyaparimāṇaṃ bhavati tāvad atra toyaṃ pānīyam aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet, kvāthyadravyād ity arthaḥ | atra kvāthaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ grāhyam iti sarvatra | prasthādita iti | prasthādiparimāṇāt yāvat khārī bhavati tāvad atra caturguṇaṃ nīraṃ pānīyaṃ prakṣipya saṃkvāthya ca pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyam iti tātparyārthaḥ | ādiśabdāt āḍhakadroṇaśūrpadroṇīprabhṛtayo grāhyāḥ | yad vā prasthasyādiḥ prasthādis tasmāt tena śarāvam api gṛhyate, śarāvādita ity arthaḥ || 4 || 5 ||aparam apy anuktam āha - ambukvātheti | yatra snehapāke pānīyāditrayāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ madhye yadā ekena pākaḥ syāt tadā kalkasya kalkadravyasya caturthāṃśaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśam aṣṭamāṃśaṃ yathā'nukrameṇa deyam | anukramo yathā - yadi ambunā kevalena pākas tarhi kalkadravyasya caturthāśaṃ deyam, snehaparimāṇād ity arthaḥ | yadā kevalena kvāthenaiva pākas tadā kalkadravyasya ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ deyam, atrāpi snehaparimāṇād ity arthaḥ | yatra tu kevalasvarasenaiva sādhyate srehaḥ tatra kalkadravyasyāṣṭamāṃśaṃ deyam | snehamānād ity atrāpi sambandhaḥ ity anukramaḥ | aparam api - dugdhe ity atrāpi ekadravyasādhyatā sūcyate tadā kalkadravyaṃ snehaparimāṇād aṣṭamāṃśaṃ deyam iti bhāvaḥ | kalkasyeti | yatra tu anyadravaiḥ kevalakalkenaiva sādhyate snehas tadā caturguṇaṃ kalkadravyaṃ caturguṇaṃ toyaṃ nikṣiped iti sarvatra | samyak pākārthaṃ boddhavyam | etena kim uktaṃ yadā kṣīrādibhiḥ pratyekena svakalkena pākas tadā caturguṇaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ pānīyaṃ deyam | pānīyaṃ vinā pāko nāstīti sarvamatam || 6 || 7 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karṣādārabhya khārīparyantaṃ kvāthyadravye jalamānam āha - karṣāditaḥ yāvat palaṃ pramāṇaṃ tāvat ṣoḍaśikaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet| tadūrdhvaṃ palādūrdhvaṃ yāvat kuḍavaṃ kuḍavapramāṇaṃ tāvad aṣṭaguṇaṃ payo jalaṃ bhavet | prasthāditaḥ yāvat khārīpramāṇaṃ tāvac caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet | pūrvaṃ caturguṇādijalaṃ yal likhitaṃ tan mṛdudravyādiviṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ | karṣādita idaṃ tu mānaviṣayam ataḥ kecin mṛdvādito gṛhṇanti kecin mānato gṛhṇanti || 4 || 5|| ambvādibhir yatra snehamānaṃ tatra kalkapramāṇam āha - ‘tatrāmbupiṣṭam uktaṃ syāj jalaṃ cātra caturguṇam’, yatra bhinnaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavati, tatra kalkasyāṃśaṃ caturguṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ kramāt ambupāke caturthāṃśaṃ raso māṃsarasas tatpāke aṣṭamāṃśam | ukto 'py ambvādau pāke dugdhādau aṣṭamāṃśa eva kalkapāka ity āha - kalkasya samyag iti | dugdhe tathā dadhni tathā takre pākānantaraṃ kalkaḥ aṣṭamāṃśakādayaḥ raso māṃsarasaḥ | yad vā raso dhattūrarasaḥ māṃsarasasya pūrvoktatvāt kalkasya samyak pākārthaṃ caturguṇaṃ snehād ity arthaḥ || 6 || 7 ||

lg.l: dravāṇi yatra sneheṣu pañcādīni bhavanti hi |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīm anuktadravāṇāṃ mānam āha - davāṇīti | yatra snehapakvadravāṇi kṣīratakrarasamūtrakvāthāni anyāny api pañcādīni pañcaprabhṛtīni bhavanti anuktamānānīti viṣayaḥ | tatra tāni dravāṇi snehasamāni pratyekam āhur ācāryāḥ | yathā vakṣyamāṇatriphalāghṛte arvāk dravaṃ catvāras trayo vā tarhi snehaparimāṇāc caturguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ pratyekam ity arthaḥ | eke yathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇam iti paṭhanti tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | kutracit dravyāṇīti pāṭho dṛśyate so 'saṅgata eva || 8 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dravyāṇīti | yatra pañcādhikāni dravyāṇi tatra sneheṣu kiyatparimitaṃ dravyaṃ deyaṃ tad āha - sneheṣu ghṛtatailādiṣu dravāṇi dugdhādīni yatra pañcaprabhṛtīni bhavanti tatra snehasamānaṃ bhavati na caturguṇānīti yāvat | yathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇam ity etasyāyam artha: | eko dravas tatra pākena cāturguṇyaṃ, dvau dravau yatra tatra dvābhyāṃ cāturguṇyaṃ yad uktaṃ jaijjaṭe ‘ekadvitridravair dravyaiḥ kuryāt snehāc caturguṇaṃ | kṣīraṃ snehasamaṃ dadyāt caturbhiś ca caturguṇam, iti | asyāyam arthaḥ yatraiko dravas tatraikena cāturguṇyaṃ, evaṃ dvābhyāṃ, tribhir militvā cāturguṇyam ity arthaḥ | yatra pañcādhikāni bhavanti tatra snehasamānīti pūrvārthaḥ| ‘tailasyārdhapramāṇena dadyād ikṣurasaṃ budhaḥ | tathā māṃsarasaṃ cārdhaṃ datvā snehaṃ vipācayet’ snehasamāny āhur ity asya truṭim āhur ity arthaḥ ity anye | tad yathā -
sakṛn māṃsauṣadhirasaṃ mūtrasauvīrakādikaṃ |
snehatulyaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ jalaṃ caiva caturguṇam || granthajñānārtham edvyavākhyāprasaṅgenoktam ||8||

kevalakvāthapāke vidhānam āha -
dravyeṇa kevalenaiva snehapāko bhaved yadi |
tatrāmbupiṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ syāj jalaṃ cātra caturguṇam || 9||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha kevaladravyasya snehapākārthaṃ mānam āha - dravyeṇeti | atra dravyaṃ snehāc caturthāṃśaṃ kalkārthaṃ vāri tāvad deyaṃ yāvat kalkaḥ syāt | yataḥ peṣaṇe jalasya parimāṇaṃ na syāt | jalaṃ cātra caturguṇam iti | atra kalke jalaṃ pānīyam | caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ snehamānād ity arthaḥ | eke dravyamānāc caturguṇaṃ jalam iti vyākhyānayanti tan na manoharaṃ kalkadravyālpatvāt | aparam apy āha - kvātheneti | yatra snehe kvacid iti anukte kevalena kvāthena kṛtvā pākaḥ kathitaḥ tatra snehe kvāthyadravyasya kalka: kāryaḥ, kalkārthaṃ cātra caturguṇaṃ jalam iti tena yenaiva dravyeṇa kvāthaḥ kriyate tainaiva tatparimitena ca dravyeṇāyam api kṛtvā'tra caturguṇena ca jalena saha sādhyaḥ | pūrvaṃ kvāthena sādhyaḥ paścāt kalkenety arthaḥ ||9||10||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kevalena kvāthena yadi snehapāko bhavet tatrāmbupiṣṭaḥ kalko jalaṃ caturguṇakvātheneti | idaṃ padyaṃ pūrvaślokasyaikārthatvāt prakṣiptaṃ jñeyaṃ || 9 || 10 ||

lg.l: kalkahīnas tu yaḥ srehaḥ sa sādhyaḥ kevale drave |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kalkahīna iti | yaḥ sneho ghṛtaṃ tailādikaḥ kalkahīnaḥ kalkarahito bhavet saḥ kevale drave sādhyaḥ| dravam atra caturguṇaṃ snehaparimāṇāt ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kevaladravasādhanam āha - kalkahīne snehe sādhanam āha - yaḥ kalkahīnaḥ snehaḥ sa kevale drave sādhyaḥ|

lg.l: puṣpakalkas tu yaḥ snehas tatra toyaṃ caturguṇam || 11 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ puṣpakalkasya parimāṇam āha puṣpakalka iti | yaḥ puṣpakalkasaṃjñaḥ snehaḥ tatra snehe toyaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ caturguṇatā ca snehāt snehaparimāṇād ity arthaḥ | saḥ puṣpakalkaḥ snehāṣṭamāṃśo yojyata ity arthaḥ | snehasyāṣṭamāṃśaṃ tena sāmyo yojya ity arthaḥ | puṣpāṇi yathā nāgakeśarakuṅkumalavaṅgadamanakasurapuṣpacampakotpalapuṇḍarīkaketakījātī-kusumbhaprabhṛtīni | eke puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyata ity asya sthāne 'tra kalkaṃ prayujyate iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti tat patrakalkaṃ prakṣepam āhuḥ, tathā hi -
‘gandhaniryāsapuṣpāṇāṃ siddhaśīte 'vatārite |
prakṣepo gandhavṛddhyarthaṃ patrakalkaṃ tu tad viduḥ’ || 11 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. puṣpakalkai: snehasādhanam āha - puṣpeti | yasmin snehe puṣpakalko dīyate sa puṣpakalkaḥ snehaḥ, tatra toyaṃ jalaṃ caturguṇaṃ snehāt puṣpakalkaḥ kiyatparimito dīyate ity atrāha - snehāṣṭamāṃśaś ca puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyate iti || 11 ||

lg.l: yadā phenodgamas taile phenaśāntiś ca sarpiṣi ||13||
snehapākas tridhā prokto mṛdur madhyaḥ kharas tathā ||14||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ snehānāṃ saṃsiddhilakṣaṇāny āha - vartivad iti | yadā snehe paripācitaḥ kalkaḥ aṅgulyā vimardito vartisadṛśo bhavati tadā siddho jñeyaḥ | athavā sa eva kalkaḥ yadā'gnau nikṣiptaḥ śabdarahito bhavati tadā siddho jñātavyaḥ iti sāmānyam | aparam api viśeṣam āha - yadā snehasya pākānte taile phenodgamo bhavati sarpiṣi ca phenaśāntir bhavati tadā siddhalakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ | varṇagandharasotpattir api snehasiddhiḥ syāt varṇādikam api taile sarpiṣi ca jñātavyam | adhunā trividhasnehapākasya lakṣaṇam āha - īṣatsarasakalka iti | yadā kalke sāndratā kiñcid bhavati agnau nikṣipte sati caṭacaṭāśabdo bhavati tadā mṛdupāko jñeyaḥ, yadā nīraso kalko bhavati komalaś ca nātikaṭhino nātimṛdur iti tadā madhyapākaḥ, yadā kiñcit kaṭhinakalko jātaḥ nīrasaś ca bhavati tadā kharapāka iti | eteṣāṃ parīkṣaṇam anumānato 'vagantavyaṃ gurusakāśadarśanād vā | tadūrdhvaṃ kharapākādūrdhvaṃ yadā snehakalkaḥ kaṭhinataro bhavati tadā dagdho jñeyaḥ, sa ca sarvakarmasu niṣphalaḥ syāt dāhakaraś ca bhavati ||12-16||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ snehasiddhalakṣaṇam āha - yadā snehakalkaḥ aṅgulyā vartitaḥ vartīkṛtaḥ vartivad bhavet agninikṣiptaḥ śabdahīnaś ca bhavet tadā siddhaṃ vadet | yadā varṇagandharasotpattis tadāpi snehasiddhir bhavet| iti ca lakṣaṇaṃ varṇas tailapakvavarṇo raktādiḥ, gandhaḥ sugandhatvaṃ, rasotpattir madhurādirasotpattiḥ, tadā svedanāl lakṣyate | snehapākasya trividhatvam āha - eko mṛdu:, eko madhyaḥ, ekaḥ kharaḥ; evaṃ tridhā snehapākaḥ | teṣāṃ lakṣaṇam āha - īṣatsarasakalkaḥ īṣajjalakalkaḥ mṛdusnehapākaḥ nīrasakomale kalke siddhaḥ pāko madhyapākaḥ nīrasakomale jalasahite ārdre īṣatkaṭhinakalkaḥ snehapākaḥ kharaḥ tadūrdhvaṃ dagdhapāko dāhakṛn niṣprayojanaḥ, na kāryakārī ||12||16||

lg.l: nasyārthaṃ stan mṛdu: pāko madhyamaḥ sarvakarmasu ||17||
abhyaṅgārthaṃ kharaḥ prokto yuñjyād evaṃ yathohitam |
prakurvanty uṣitā hy ete viśeṣād guṇasaṃcayam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idrānīṃ tasya caturvidhapākasya guṇam āha - āmapākaś ceti | āmapāko 'paripākakalka: sneho nirvīryo bhavati, niḥśeṣeṇa vīryarahita ity arthaḥ | vahnimāndyakṛd bhakṣaṇayoge ca bhavati | nasyaviṣaye mṛdupākaḥ snehaḥ | madhyapākas tu sarvakarmasu yujyate sarvakarma nasyābhyaṅgapānādikaṃ | kharapākasnehaḥ kevalābhyaṅge vihitaḥ nānyakarmasu | yathocitam iti yathāyogyaṃ yuṃjyād ity arthaḥ | eke nasyābhyaṅge kharaḥ prokta iti paṭhanti, tan na sarvasaṃmatam, nasye tu saumyam āhuḥ | snehas tu kim ekāhenaiva sādhyaḥ uta dīrghadavasaiḥ tadviṣayam āha - ghṛteti | ghṛtataile prasiddhe guḍo 'valehaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt īdṛśasambhārā ye cā'nye prayogāḥ te sarve ekasminn eva vāsare na sādhyā: na pācanīyā ity arthaḥ | kutas tad āha - prakurvanti ityādi | te snehādayas tu yadā uṣitāḥ santi tadā guṇasañcayaṃ prakurvanti | ata eva bahudivasaiḥ kṛtvā sādhanīyā iti bhāvaḥ | tantrāntareṣu etad bahudravyasambhāraviṣayam, asmatsampradāye 'pi svalpam api snehaṃ kiñci- dvipācyāpare 'hni siddho 'vatāryaḥ guḍādikam api cāpare 'hni madhudānādikam uktaṃ kuryāt naivaṃ sarvamatavirodhaḥ || || 17 || 18 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āmapākas trividhapākād dhīnaḥ sajala evety arthaḥ, sa vahnimāndyakaraḥ, tathā guruḥ | yeṣu mṛdvādayaḥ prayujyante, tān āha - nasyārtham iti | nasyārthaṃ mṛdupākaḥ sarvakarmasu, bhakṣaṇāvasthāyāṃ madhyamaḥ, abhyaṅgārthaṃ kharaḥ evaṃ yathocitaṃ yuñjyāt prayojayet, ghṛtatailādīn ekasminn eva dine na sādhayet, kutaḥ ? uṣitā rātrau vāsitā viśeṣād guṇasañcayaṃ kurvanti || śārṅgadharānuktam api tailasādhanam ātreyād āha -
“sneho vārisamaṃ nītvā pācayet mṛduvahninā |
pañcapallavakalkena dvātriṃśāṃśena saṃyutam ||
kiṃcitsarasagarbheṇa vastrapūtaṃ prakalpayet |
itye- tad duṣṭagandhādidoṣas tailād vimucyate || nirdoṣakaraṇād etat kṛtvā tailaṃ vipācayet” iti | granthāntare evaṃ śodhanaṃ - “tailaṃ kṛtvā kaṭāhe dṛḍhataravimale mandamandāgninā ca pakvaṃ niṣphenabhāvaṃ gatam iha hi yadā śaityabhāvaṃ tadaiva | muñjiṣṭhārātrilodhrair jaladharanalikaiḥ sāmalai: sākṣapathyaiḥ sūcīpuṣpāvarohair nayati satataṃ gandhayogaṃ jahāti” || mañjiṣṭhādyair militaiḥ agninīraiḥ pādāṃśakaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet, rātrir haridrā, jaladharo mustakaḥ, nalikā gandhanalikā uttaradeśe prasiddhā tadabhāve tvak; sāmalai: sāmalakaiḥ, akṣaṃ bibhītakaṃ, pathyā harītakī, sūcīpuṣpaṃ ketakī, avarohaḥ vaṭāvarohaḥ, cakārāt granthāntare caiva
“tailasyendukalāṃśakena vikacā grāhyā tu mūrcchāvidhau ye cānye triphalādayas tu rajanīhrīberalodhrānvitāḥ |
sūcīpuṣpavaṭāvarohanalikādravyās tu pādāṃśikāḥ procyās tailajagandhadoṣaharaṇe kalkīkṛtās tadvidaiḥ? | vikacā mañjiṣṭhā, indukalāṃśena tailāt ṣoḍaśāṃśena grāhyāḥ, mūrcchāvidhau tailamūrcchāvidhau, ye cānye triphalādayas te militvā kalkīkṛtāḥ | payodo mustā, rajanī haridrā, hrībera udīcyaṃ, lodhraḥ prasiddhaḥ, sūcī- puṣpaṃ ketakī, vaṭāvarohaḥ, nalikā gandhanalikā, tathā ca -
‘madhye sāravihīnā ca sarasā kīṭavarjitā |
nalikā sā bhaved bhadrā viparītā tu ninditā’ | kecin nalikāṃ tvacam āhuḥ | iti ghṛtatailasādhanaprakāraḥ || || 17 || 18 ||

ab.seg:
atha ghṛtakalpanā sa yathā-
pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ || 19 ||

lg.l: kṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā tad ghṛtaṃ plīhanāśanam || 20||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. sa yathety anena taṃ snehapākasamūhaṃ darśayati granthakāraḥ | tatrādau pūrvaṃ tāvad vṛtakalpanāṃ darśayann āha yatas tailād viśiṣṭo ghṛtakalpaḥ pūrvācāryair darśitaḥ tathaivātrāpi likhitaḥ | prathamataḥ kṣīraṣaṭpalakaghṛtavyākhyānam āha - pippalīti | atra pippalyādikaṃ pañcadravyaṃ pañcakolasaṃjñaṃ boddhavyam, yatas tantrāntare pañcakolaghṛtam asya nāma prasiddham, atra cavyam iti viṭapaviśeṣaḥ, yasya phalaṃ gajapippalīti śrutiḥ, palikair iti palapramāṇatā pratyekam āhuḥ | ata eva kṣīraṣaṭpalakaghṛtam idam, caturguṇakṣīreṇa saha ṣaṭpalapramāṇaṣaḍdravyaiś ca sādhitam ity arthaḥ | atra caturguṇaṃ nīram api deyam, samyakpākā- rtham ity asmatsampradāyābhiprāyaḥ | ghṛtaprastham iti | ṣoḍaśapalamitam ‘kṣīrasya caturguṇatātra ghṛtaparimāṇāt tatsiddham iti siddhatā'sya paribhāṣoktavidhānāt ||19||20||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kṣīraṣaṭpalaghṛtam – tatrādau ghṛtādhikāraḥ pippalyādyaiḥ ṣaṭpalaiḥ kalkitair ghṛtāc caturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ datvā pacet tad ghṛtaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ bhavati pippalyādīnāṃ ṣaṭpalatvāt | plīhā dakṣiṇāṅge rogaviśeṣaḥ hṛdayād adhaḥ, viṣamajvaraharaṃ tathā rucikaraṃ, viṣamajvarāḥ saṃtatādayaḥ pañca || 19 || 20 ||

ab.seg:
atha cāṃgerīghṛtaṃ atīsāragrahaṇyoḥ -
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ citrako hastipippalī ||21||

lg.l: śvadaṃṣṭrā nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ pāṭhā bilvaṃ yavānikā |
dravyaiś ca palikair etaiś catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ ghṛtam || 22 ||
tathā caturguṇaṃ dattvā dadhi sarpir vipācayet ||23||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha cāṅgerīghṛtam āha - pippalīti | atra hastipippalī gajapippalī, śvadaṃṣṭrā gokṣurakaḥ, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, bilvam atra bilvaśalāṭu, palikair iti palapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ, cāṅgerīsvarasam iti cāṅgerī prasiddhā, sā cāmlarasā āmacāṅgerīti loke prasiddhā, tasyāḥ svarasam iti sadyorasaṃ, budhair iti grahaṇena sadyorasābhāve kvātham api deyam dadhi caturguṇaṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ paktavyam iti mandapācanapācitam iti bhāvo dagdhabhayāt || 21-24 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hastipippalī gajapippalī, cāṃgerī‘khaṭṭīmīṭhī’ hi.bhā.| tatsvarasaḥ dadhi godadhi || 21-24 ||

atha masūraghṛtam atīsārādau -
masūrāṇāṃ palaśataṃ nīradroṇe vipācayet ||25||

lg.l: grahaṇīṃ bhinnaviṭkaṃ ca nāśayec ca pravāhikām |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha masūrādyaṃ ghṛtam apy āha - masūrāṇām iti | masūro 'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, nīradroṇe jaladroṇe catuḥṣaṣṭikuḍavaparimitaṃ bhavati | bilvaṃ palāṣṭakamitaṃ bhavati bilvaṃ bilvamajjā tac ca kalkīkṛtaṃ jalena saha deyam, kartavyavidhāv api masūrāḥ karpaṭabaddhāḥ kvāthyāḥ, mṛdvagninā ca sādhanaṃ kāryam ||25||26||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam ||25||26||

ab.seg:
atha kāmadevaghṛtaṃ raktapittādau -
aśvagandhā‘aśvagandhā palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ matam | punarnavāśvatthaśuṇṭhīkāśmaryāstu phalānyapi || padmabījaṃ māṣabījaṃ daṣāddaśapalaṃ pṛthak | caturdroṇāmbhasā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet || jīvanīyagaṇaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ padmakaṃ raktacandanam | patrakaṃ pippalī drākṣā kapikacchuphalaṃ tathā || nīlotpalaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ sārive dve bale tathā | pṛthakvarṣasamā bhāgāḥ śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam || rasaśca pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmāḍhakaikaṃ samāharet | ghṛtasya cāḍhakaṃ dattvā pācayenmṛdunāgninā || ghṛtametannihantyāśu raktapittamuraḥkṣatam | halīmakaṃ paṇḍurogaṃ varṇabhedaṃ svarakṣayam || vātaraktaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca kāmalām | śukrakṣayamurodāhaṃ kārśyamojaḥkṣayaṃ tathā || strīṇāṃ caivāprajātānāṃ garbhadaṃ śukradaṃ nṛṇām | kāmadevaghṛtaṃ nāma hṛdyaṃ balyaṃ rasāyanam’ || iti pāṭhāntaram | palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ smṛtam |
śatāvarī vidārī ca śālaparṇī balāmṛtā || 27 ||

lg.l: kāśmaryāś ca phalaṃ caiva māṣabījaṃ tathaiva ca || 28 ||
droṇe śeṣe rase tasmin pacec caiva ghṛtāḍhakam ||29||
nīlotpalaṃ sārive dve jīvanīyo gaṇas tathā |
ghṛtam etan nihanty āśu raktapittam uraḥkṣatam |
kāmadeva iti khyātaṃ sarpir uktaṃ mahāguṇam || 37 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kāmadevaghṛtavivaraṇaṃ darśayann āha - aśvagandheti | aśvagandhāmūlaṃ palaśataṃ grāhyam tadardho gokṣura iti pañcāśatpalaṃ; gokṣuro 'tra pañcāṅgo grāhyaḥ, aparāṇi daśadravyāṇi daśapalam iti pratyekam āhuḥ, tāni kānīty atrāha -śatāvarītyādi sugamam | tatra tu aśvatthasya ca śuṅgānīti pippalaśuṅgāni siddhāni, kāśmarī gambhārī tasyāḥ phalāni, padmabījaṃ prasiddhaṃ ‘kamalagaṭā’ śabdavācyam, māṣabījam iti maṣāḥ pratītaḥ, etat sakalaṃ pānīyadroṇacatuṣṭaye saṃkvāthya pādaśeṣaṃ vastragālitaṃ grāhyam | aparāṇy api kalkayogyāni dravyāṇy āha - mṛdvīketyādi | mṛdvīkā drākṣā, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ tat tu campakavad vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, ātmaguptā kapikacchuḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalavācyam, tadabhāve kamalabījaṃ grāhyam | sārive dve iti kṛṣṇasārivā śuklasārive | te ‘aphoī’ śabdavācye; kṛṣṇasārivā kalahaṃsavatpatrā sugandhā, śuklasārivā jambūvatpatrā vratatiḥ, jīvanīyo gaṇa iti jīvanīyo jīvantīśākaviśeṣaḥ, tadādisaṃjñako jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ, tathā hi - ‘jīvantī sūryaparṇīyukvākolyau jīvakarṣabhau | mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyo gaṇo mataḥ’ iti | tasyā'prasiddhatvāt tatsāmyaguṇadravyāṇi yojyāni iti vṛddhavaidyānāṃ sammatam, etāni mṛdvīkādīni dravyāṇi pṛthak karṣapramāṇāni grāhyāṇi, śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam iti | kecit siddhe 'smin śarkarāyāḥ prakṣepam āhuḥ | rasasya pauṇḍrakekṣūṇām iti | pauṇḍrako vikhyātaḥ ikṣuviśeṣaḥ, ikṣuḥ sāmānyaḥ sa ca lohitekṣu prabhṛtiko yathālābhaṃ grāhyaḥ, nanu ikṣugrahaṇenaiva pauṇḍrakagrahaṇaprāptiḥ tat kathaṃ bhinnagrahaṇam ? ucyate - pauṇḍrakagrahaṇaṃ guṇaprābalyāt kṛtaṃ yataḥ ‘pauṇḍrakaḥ śītalaḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇo kaphakṛt saraḥ’ iti | tasmāt pauṇḍrako viśeṣeṇātra pācanīyaḥ | asya rasasyāḍhakaṃ pratyekaṃ dvirāḍhakagrahaṇāt ghṛtāḍhakam ekam, godugdhaṃ caturāḍhakam iti ||27-37 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. amṛtā guḍūcī, kāśmarī, gambhārī, padyabījaṃ kamalabījaṃ, māṣabījam annaṃ, jīvantīyagaṇaś cūrṇoktaḥ, nāgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, sārive dve śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, dve bale balā nāgabalā, śarkarā sitā; pauṇḍrapauṃḍā | kekṣūṇāṃgāṇḍā (nnā) | rasaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat ||27-37 ||

apasmārādau pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ -
triphalā dve niśe kauntī sārive dve priyaṅgukā |
śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī devadārvyelavālukam || 38 ||

lg.l: nataṃ viśālā dantī ca dāḍimaṃ nāgakeśaram |
jātipuṣpaṃ candanaṃ ca tālīsaṃ bṛhatī tathā |
etaiḥ karṣasamaiḥ kalkair jalaṃ dattvā caturguṇam || 40 ||
ghṛtaprasthaṃ paced dhīmān apasmāre jvare kṣaye |
unmāde vātarakte ca kāse mandānale tathā || 41 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtam āha - triphaleti | triphalātra harītakīprabhṛtiphalatrayam, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, kauntī reṇukā, sārive dve kṛṣṇaśuklabhedena, priyaṅgur latāviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī ceti kavarādvayaśabdavācyam, elavālukaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ tac ca kuṣṭhagandhi ṣaṭphalasadṛśam; nataṃ tagarapādikā, viśālā indravāruṇī, dantī prasiddhā, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalaṃ bījāni ca, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, tadabhāve padmabījaṃ dravyaṃ grāhyaṃ, elā bṛhatphalā, jātī mālatī tasyāḥ kusumāni, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, tālīsaṃ svanāmaprasiddham, bṛhatī bṛhatkaṇṭakārikā etāni karṣapramāṇāni pratyekaṃ | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt | ghṛtaprastham iti kuḍavacatuṣṭayapramitaṃ gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhavati kevalapānīyaparipācanāt pānīyakalyāṇakam asya saṃjñārūḍhiḥ ||38-43||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kauntī reṇukā, elavālukaṃ prasiddhaṃ, viśālā indravāruṇī, dāḍimaṃ prasiddhaṃ tasya bījāni, padmakaṃ jātipuṣpaṃ, mālatīpuṣpāṇi, kalkadravyāt caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ pacet | tat pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāmataḥ ||38-43||

amṛtāghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhādau -
amṛtākvāthakalkābhyāṃ sakṣīraṃ vipaced ghṛtam |
vātaraktaṃ jayaty āśu kuṣṭhaṃ jayati dustaram || 44 ||

Āḍhamalla. amṛtādyaghṛtavivaraṇam apy āha - amṛteti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyāḥ kvāthakalkābhyāṃ kṛtvā sakṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vipācya vātaraktādike deyam, tena kvāthaś caturguṇajalena siddhaḥ sa ca ghṛtāc caturguṇa iti paribhāṣāyāṃ pratītaḥ | kalkaṃ dṛṣadi peṣitaṃ tac ca ghṛtāṃśaṃ tena kalkadravyaṃ ghṛtāc caturthāṃśaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ | sakṣīram iti caturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt| kecit tu snehasamaṃ proktam iti paṭhanti etad api saṅgataṃ na viruddhaṃ dravāntaratvāt | kalke 'pi caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā pācanīyam iti vyavahāraḥ | asya pānam āhur abhyaṅgaṃ ca || 44 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. amṛtā guḍūcī, tasyāḥ kvāthaḥ kalkaś ca, kṣīraṃ dugdhaṃ ghṛtāc caturguṇaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat || 44 ||

atha mahātiktakaghṛtaṃ vātaraktakuṣṭhādau -
saptacchadaḥ prativiṣā śyāmākaḥ kaṭurohiṇī |
pāṭhā mustam uśīraṃ ca triphalā parpaṭas tathā || 45 ||

lg.l: candanaṃ dhanvayāsaś ca viśāle dve niśe tathā || 46 ||
guḍūcī sārive dve ca mūrvā vāsā śatāvarī |
dviguṇaḥ sarpiṣaś cātra jalam aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || 48 ||
kuṣṭhāni raktapittaṃ ca raktārśāṃsi ca pāṇḍutām ||49||
kṣudrarogān jvarāṃś caiva mahātiktam idaṃ jayet ||50||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ mahātiktakaghṛtam āha - saptacchada iti | saptacchadaḥ saptaparṇaśabdavācyaḥ sa ca śālmalīpatrasadṛśo yugmapatraḥ; prativiṣā ativiṣā śyāmāko rājavṛkṣas tasya phalaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, viśāle dve itīndravāruṇīdvayaṃ, dve niśe iti haridrādvayaṃ, sārive dve iti śuklakṛṣṇabhedena, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, trāyantī trāyamāṇā, śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ prasiddham, akṣabhāgikāḥ karṣapramāṇāḥ, pratyekaṃ ghṛtaṃ caturguṇam iti pūrvadravyasambhārāt āmalakaphalasvaraso dviguṇo ghṛtaparimāṇāt svarasābhāve kvātho 'pi deyaḥ na doṣaḥ, jalaṃ pānīyaṃ cāṣṭaguṇaṃ deyaṃ samyakpākārthaṃ sarpiṣo ghṛtaparimāṇāt, etat siddhaṃ mahātiktakaṃ nāma ghṛtaṃ vātaraktādiṣu praśastam || 47-50 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. saptacchadaḥ saptapuṭā, prativiṣā ativiṣā, śyāmāka āragvadhaḥ, kaṭurohiṇī kaṭukī, pāṭhā, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikā, parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ. paṭolaṃ‘paravala’ hi.bhā.| phalaśākas tasya patrāṇi, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, śaṭhī karcūra:, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ; dhanvayāsako yavāsakaḥ, viśālā indravāruṇī, dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā ca, dve sārive śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, mūrvā moraṭā, trāyantī trāyamāṇā, indrayavaḥ, yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, bhūnimbaḥ tiktakam | akṣabhāgikā: pratyekaṃ karṣabhāgāḥ | ghṛtaṃ caturguṇaṃ sarvadravyebhyaś caturguṇaṃ | ghṛtāt dviguṇa āmalakīrasaḥ sarpiṣo ghṛtāt jalam aṣṭaguṇaṃ sarvaṃ paktvā siddhaṃ kārayet | spaṣṭam anyat | mahātiktakaṃ siddhatvāt ||45-50||

atha kāsīsādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhe dadrūpāmāśira:sphoṭādau -
kāsīsaṃ dve niśe mustaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilām |
kampillakaṃ gandhakaṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ gugguluṃ tathā || 51 ||

lg.l: tatas tac cūrṇam āloḍya triṃśatpalamite ghṛte || 54 ||
sthāpayet tāmrapātre ca gharme sapta dināvadhi |
śotho bhagandaraś caiva lūtāḥ śāmyanti dehinām |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā kāsīsādyaghṛtavivaraṇam āha - kāsīsam iti | kāsīsaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ bhasmavad alpabhṛt asya bhedaḥ puṣpakāsīsaṃ, tac ca kiñcit pītam, dve niśe dve haridre, kampillako rorīśabdavācyo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, kampillety apare, sikthakaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, sindūraṃ prasiddhaṃ śrīvāsaṃ niryāsadravyaṃ rālaśabdavācyaṃ, irimedo viṭkhadira ojaśabdavācyaḥ karañjo bṛhatkarañjo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ loke colā iti prasiddhaḥ | sārivā āsphotā ‘āphoī’ loke; māṃsī gandhamāṃsī jaṭāvad viṭapaḥ, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, prapunnāṭaṃ cakramardabījāni, etāni pṛthak karṣapramitāni cūrṇīkṛtya triṃśatpalaparimite ghṛte āloḍya tāmrapātre | nidhāya gharme dhārayet yāvat sapta dināni bhavanti | etac cādravāgnisiddhaṃ sūryapākasaṃjñam iti boddhavyam | asmatsaṃpradāye tu kalkārhaṃ dravyaṃ kalkībhūtaṃ kṛtvā caturguṇena pānīyena saha ghṛtaṃ vipācya paścāt prakṣepayogyaṃ dravyaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya tatra prakṣipyāloḍya gharme saptadinaṃ yāvad dhārayet evaṃ siddho bhavati | kalkārthaṃ dravyaṃ yathā - haridrāmustaraktacandanerimedanimbapatrakarañjasārivāvacāmañjiṣṭhā- madhumāṃsīśirīṣalodhrapadmakaharītakīprabhṛtikaṃ śeṣaṃ prakṣepārthaṃ jñeyam || 51-57 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kāsīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ prasiddhaṃ, śirīṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, prapunnāṭaṃ‘panavāḍa’ hi.bhā.| cakramardas tasya bījāni, etān pṛthak karṣamitān triṃśatpalamite ghṛte tāmrapātre gharme saptadinaṃ sthāpayet || 51-57 ||

atha vraṇe jātyādighṛtaṃ-
jatinimbapaṭolaṃ ca dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī |
mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ sikthaṃ karañjośīrasārivāḥ || 58 ||

lg.l: tutthaṃ va vipacet samyak valkair ebhir ghṛtaṃ budhaḥ |
marmāśritāḥ kledinaś ca gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ jātyādikaṃ ghṛtam āha - jātītyādi | jātīnimbapaṭolam ity atra trayāṇāṃ patrāṇi grāhyāṇi tantrāntaradarśanāt | tathā ca - ‘jātīnimbapaṭolānāṃ naktamālasya pallavā’ ityādi | dve niśe dve haridre, tena haridrā dāruharidrā, kaṭurohiṇī kaṭukī śabdavācyam, madhukaṃ yaṣṭhīmadhu, sikthakaṃ madanakaṃ, karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ tasya patrāṇi phalāni vā, uśīraṃ sugandhadravyam | sārivā āsphotā, tutthaṃ haritapāṣāṇavat kṛtrimaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ, etat sāmyamānaṃ sakaladravyād ghṛtaṃ caturguṇā sādhyam | atra kalkapācanārthaṃ caturguṇitaṃ jalaṃ deyam | eke sikthatutthayoḥ siddhe prakṣepam āhuḥ | tathā ca - ‘prakṣepaṃ kārayed dhīmān siddhe sikthakatutthayoḥ’ ityādi | jātīkādyaṃ gaurādyaṃ ca tailam api pacyate| tathā ca cakraḥ - ‘gaurādyaṃ jātīkādyaṃ ca tailam evaṃ prasādhyate | tailaṃ sūkṣmānane duṣṭe vraṇe gambhīra eva ca’ iti || 58 || 59 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. jātī mālatī tasyāḥ patrāṇi, nimbapatrāṇi, dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu,sikthaṃ karañjamūlaṃ, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, sārivā anantā, tutthaṃnīlāthothā prasiddhaṃ, ebhiḥ kalkair ghṛtaṃ pacet kalkadravyāt ghṛtaṃ caturguṇam | asya lepāt sūkṣmā nāḍīvraṇā rohanti || 58 || 59 ||

ab.seg:
atha bindughṛtaṃ jalodaravirecanādau-
citrakaṃ śaṅkinī pathyā kampillas trivṛtāyugam ||60||

lg.l: vṛddhadāruś ca śamyāko dantī dantīphalaṃ tathā |
hemakṣīrī ca vipacet kalkair ebhiḥ picūnmitaiḥ ||62||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā bindughṛtam āha - citrakam iti | atra citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ, śaṅkhinī yavatiktā, śaṅkhapuṣpīśabdavācyā, kaṃpillaḥ kaṃvīlā vikhyātā ‘rorī’ śabdavācyam iti kecit | trivṛtāyugam iti śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, ‘niśotha’ dvayaṃ, vṛddhadāru mahāśyāmo dīrghapatraḥ sa ca tridhārāśabdavācyaḥ, śamyākaḥ kṛtamālakaḥ, dantī loke ‘dantivanī’ti vācyā, tasyāḥ phalaṃ jayapālaśabdavācyaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, kośātakī ghoṣārī, devadālī vallīviśeṣaḥ | girikarṇikā ‘śophandaīśaphanda’ iti prasiddhaḥ | sātalā sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, ‘ghaṭaghava’ iti loke | hemakṣīrī kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ kecic cokaśabdavācyam iti vadanti | picūnmitair iti karṣapramāṇaiḥ pratyekam atra kalkārthaṃ toyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ vyavahārāt | tathā ca - ‘snuhyarkapayasor atra pākārtham upapattitaḥ | caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyam’ ityādi | snuhīkṣīraṃ sehuṇḍasya kṣīraṃ ṣaṭpalapramitaṃ deyam, arkakṣīraṃ tu paladvayam iti vadanti kecit | asmatsaṃpradāye tu aṣṭapalaparimitaṃ snuhīkṣīraṃ etatparimāṇaṃ tu arkakṣīram iti | nipītaṃ bindusaṃkhyayā iti ‘binduḥ syāt tarjanīparvadvayam agrārdhato mitaḥ’ iti vyavahārāt | ṣaḍaṣṭamāṣakā deyā binduvegair iti yāvatsaṃkhyān bindūn pibet tāvanmātreṇa viricyata ity arthaḥ | ‘nābhilepād viricyate’ ity anenāsya prabhāvotkṛṣṭatvaṃ darśitam || 60-65 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śaṅkhinī śaṅkhapuṣpī, pathyā harītakī, kampillaḥ, trivṛtāyugmaṃ niḥsṛtādvayaṃ śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, vṛddhadāruḥ prasiddhaḥ, śamyākaḥ kṛtamālaḥ, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, dantīphalaṃ jayapālaṃ, kośātakī kaṭur grāhyā, devadālī vaṃdālī, nīlinī nīlapuṣpī, girikarṇikā aparājitā, śvetapuṣpī parājitā, sātalā sehuṇḍaḥ, hemakṣīrī prasiddhā | picūnmitaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ snuhīkṣīre sehuṇḍadugdhe ṣaṭpale pacet, paladvaye arkakṣīrasya vipacet tat siddhaṃ bindughṛtaṃ bhavati | binduprayogāt bindughṛtaṃ nāmnā prasiddham || || 60-65 ||

atha triphalāghṛtaṃ netraroge timirādau -
triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ prasthaṃ vāsārasodbhavam || 66 ||

lg.l: dattvā tatra ghṛtaprasthaṃ kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pṛthak || 67 ||
triphalā pippalī drākṣā candanaṃ saindhavaṃ balā |
śarkarā puṇḍarīkaṃ ca kamalaṃ ca punarnavā |
niśāyugmaṃ ca madhukaṃ sarvair ebhir vipācayet || 69 ||
naktāndhyaṃ nakulāndhyaṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ pillaṃ tathaiva ca |
netrasrāvaṃ ca paṭalaṃ timiraṃ kācakaṃ jayet || 70||
traiphalaṃ ghṛtam etad dhi pāne nasyādiṣūcitam || 71 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ triphalāghṛtavyākhyānam āha - triphaleti | triphalāyā rasaprastham iti | svarasābhāve kvāthaḥ kalkaṃ vā pracarati | vāsārasodbhavaṃ prastham iti vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, bhṛṅgarājo mārkavaḥ loke ghamarāśabdavācyaḥ, ājaṃ payaś chāgīdugdham, eke ‘prastham ājaṃ payaḥ smṛta’m ity asyāgre ‘guḍūcyāś ca rasaprastham āmalātvagrasaṃ tathā | prasthaṃ prasthaṃ samāhṛtya sarvair ebhir ghṛtaṃ pacet’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kalkair iti vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ tad yathā - triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ kamalasāmānyatvena raktaṃ nīlaṃ vā; niśāyugmam iti haridrādvayaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, etat siddhaṃ bhojanāgre bhojanamadhye bhojanānte ca vihitam | tathā ca tantrāntare - ‘ūrdhvapānam adhaḥpānaṃ madhyapānaṃ ca śasyate’ iti | śarkarāyāḥ siddhe prakṣepam āhur eke | naktāndhyādayo netramṛge vikhyātāḥ || 66-71 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. triphalārasaprastham ity atra harītakīsvarasaprasthaḥ, āmalakarasaprasthaḥ, pratyekaṃ triphalāprastho jalaṃ na tu ṣaḍāḍhakamitaṃ, kaiśoraguggulvādau nirṇītatvāt | tīsaṭe spaṣṭam eva likhitaṃ, - ‘pathyākṣāmalakījale payasi ca cchāge 'tha vāsārase bhṛṅgasya svarase vipācitam iti proktaiś ca kalkauṣadhaiḥ | kākolītriphalāmṛtotpalakaṇā hy uṣṇā- sitāṣaṣṭikāvyāghrībhiḥ saha netraruk praśamate sarpir mahātraiphalam’ iti || harītakyādīnāṃ svarasas tu agnisaṃyogaṃ vinā kartavyaḥ | yad vā svarasaṃ prāpyāgnisaṃyogakaraṇād agnisaṃyogaḥ | svarasaḥ kvāthas tatra prasthaṃ harītakī, caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā kvāthaḥ, dviguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā svarasaḥ prasthamātraṃ gṛhyate evam anyeṣām | nanu samuditasya triphalāyāḥ svarasaḥ prasthaḥ, uktāyāṃ ca triphalāyāṃ āmalakīrasasya bhinnagrahaṇāt, tathā ca vṛndavaṅgasenādayaḥ
‘triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ prasthaṃ bhṛṅgarasasya ca |
vṛṣasya ca rasaḥ prasthaṃ śatāvaryāś ca tatsamam |
ajākṣīraṃ guḍūcyāś ca āmalakyā rasaṃ tathā |
prasthaṃ prasthaṃ samāhṛtya sarvair ebhir ghṛtaṃ pacet | atra guḍūcīsvarasata āmalakīsvaraso 'dhikaḥ, śārṅgadhare tu nāsti tat kathaṃ na virodhaḥ | ucyate, śārṅgadhareṇa tu tīsaṭamataṃ gṛhītam iti tasya na doṣaḥ || 66-71 ||

atha gaurādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vraṇe -
dve haridre sthirā mūrvā sārivā candanadvayam |
madhuparṇī ca madhukaṃ paḍmakeśarapadmakam || 72 ||

lg.l: gaurādyam iti vikhyātaṃ sarpir viṣaharaṃ param || 74 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā gaurādyaṃ ghṛtam āha - dve haridre iti | haridrā dāruharidrā, sthirā śāliparṇī, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, sārivā āsphotā, candanadvayam iti śvetaraktabhedena, madhuparṇī yaṣṭīmadhubhedaḥ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī | kecit tu madhuyaṣṭyā eva bhāgadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ dviḥpāṭhāt | padmakaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ, pañcavalkalair ity asyāgre ‘jātīnimbapaṭolaṃ ca karañjaṃ tiktasikthakam’ iti paṭhanti tad vahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate| atrāpi kalkapākārthaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇamitaṃ deyam | paribhāṣāmatānusārataḥ gaurādikameti | gaurā haridrā || || 72-74 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dve haridre haridrā dāruharidrā ca, śāliparṇī, mūrvā moraṭā, sārivā anantā, candanadvayaiḥ raktacandanaḥ śvetacandanaḥ, madhuparṇī māṣaparṇī, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, padmakeśaraṃ, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭham, utpalaṃ raktakamalaṃ, uśīraṃ medā aṣṭavargoktā pañcavalkalaiḥ vaṭa-udumbara-śirīṣa-parkaṭī-vetasa eṣāṃ valkalaiḥ etaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pratyekaṃ jalapiṣṭaiḥ pacet | gaurā haridrā tadādyatvāt idaṃ gaurādighṛtaṃ spaṣṭam anyat || 72-74 ||

atha mayūraghṛtaṃ śirorogādau -
balāmadhukarāsnābhir daśamūlaphalatrikaiḥ |
pṛthag dvipalikair ebhir droṇanīreṇa pācayet || 75 ||

lg.l: pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā kṣīraṃ dattvā ca tatsamam ||76||
tat siddhaṃ śirasaḥ pīḍāṃ manyāpṛṣṭhagrahaṃ tathā || 77 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha mayūrādyaṃ ghṛtam āha - balā iti | balā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, rāsnā surabhiḥ, daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | phalatrikaṃ harītakyādi pṛthak dvipalikair ebhir ity asya sthāne kecit triphalikair iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | pakṣapittāntrayakṛtpādāsyavarjitaṃ mayūram ekaṃ droṇanīreṇeti caturāḍhakamitena pānīyena pācayet, kintu vyavahārataḥ adhikaṃ jalaṃ deyam | yataḥ mayūreṇa saha dravyāṇāṃ kvāthavidhānaṃ bhavati | tathā ca cakraḥ ‘daśamūladibhis tulyo mayūra iha gṛhyate’ iti | evaṃ militvā yāvat kvāthaṃ bhavati tāvaj jalaṃ deyam, tatra ‘kvāthyāc caturguṇaṃ vāri’ ityādi paribhāṣayā jalavyavastheti pūrvavyākhyāpracāraḥ | kṣīraṃ dattvā ca tatsamam iti kvāthasamam ity arthaḥ, eke ghṛtasamaṃ kṣīram iti manyante, tad api saṅgataṃ dravāntaratvāt, jīvanīyaiḥ picūnmitair iti jīvanīyo madhuragaṇaḥ sa yathālābhaṃ grāhyaḥ | picūnmitaiḥ karṣapramāṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ jīvanīyas tu kalparūpa ity āhuḥ | etad ghṛtaṃ pānābhyaṅganasyādiṣu yojyam | hemantakālaśiśiravasanteṣu iti | anyathā doṣakṛt syāt | tathā hy uktam
‘hemantakāle śiśire ca sevyaṃ vasantakāle ca mayūrasarpiḥ |
uṣṇād vidāhī viṣabhakṣaṇāc ca varṣāśaradgrīṣmamukheṣv apathyam|
āhārajātaṃ hi vihaṃgamasya kīṭāś ca sarpāś ca sarīsṛpāś ca |
pipīlikā matkuṇamakṣikāś ca tenoṣṇakāleṣv ahito mayūra: |
tathaiva kāle jaladābhirāme visṛjya śukraṃ caṃ balaṃ ca barhī | kṛśatvam āyāty atidīnabhāvāt śaranmukhe tena vivarjanīyam’ iti || 75-78 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. balā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, rāsnā, daśamūlaṃ, triphalā etaiḥ ṣoḍaśadravyai: dvipalikaiḥ droṇanīreṇa mayūraṃ kṣiptvā pācayet| pādaśeṣaṃ nayet tatsamaṃ rasasamaṃ kṣīraṃ datvā pacet | ghṛtaprasthaṃ picūnmitaiḥ jīvanīyadravyagaṇaiḥ jīvanīyacūrṇoktaiḥ | kiṃbhūtaṃ mayūraṃ pakṣapitta-aṃtrayakṛtpādaṃ āsyaṃ mukhaṃ tadrahitaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat || 75-78 ||

atha phalaghṛtaṃ vandhyādoṣe -
triphalā madhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī || 79 ||

lg.l: viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī mustaṃ viśālā kaṭphalaṃ vacā |
dve mede dve ca kākolyau sārive dve priyaṅgukā ||80||
ajamodā ca dantī ca kalkair etaiś ca kārṣikaiḥ |
tataḥ pibec chubhadine nārī vā puruṣo 'thavā |
etat sarpir naraḥ pītvā strīṣu nityaṃ vṛṣāyate || 84 ||
putrān utpādayed dhīmān vandhyāpi labhate sutam |
anāyuṣaṃ vā janayed yā ca sūtā punaḥ sthitā ||85||
putraṃ prāpnoti sā nārī buddhimantaṃ śatāyuṣam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ bṛhatphalaghṛtam āha - triphaleti | viśālendravāruṇī, dve mede iti medā mahāmedā, dvau ca kākolyāv iti kākolī kṣīrakākolī, sārive dve iti sārivā kṛṣṇasārivā ‘sāva’ iti loke, priyaṅgur latāviśeṣaḥ, rāsnā surabhī, jātī sumanā tasyāḥ puṣpaṃ, kamalam utpalaṃ śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ subodham | eteṣāṃ pratyekaṃ karṣapramitānāṃ kalkam āhuḥ | jīvadvatsā ekavarṇā vā gaus tasyā ghṛtam iti jīvadvatsāprahaṇam iti maṅgalatvāt| caturguṇena payaseti ghṛtaparimāṇāt| āraṇyagomayair iti mandapāvakapācanatvāt, anuktaṃ lakṣmaṇāmūlam iti kvacit paṭhyate | lakṣmaṇā śvetakaṇṭakārikā anye alpaviṭapam āhuḥ, tathā hi -
‘putrakā'kāraraktālpabindubhir lāñchitā sadā |
lakṣmaṇā putrajananī bastagandhākṛtir bhavet |
śaratkāle bhavati sā phalapuṣpā'nvitā sadā | gṛhṇīyāt puṣyamūlārke hastārke cābhimaṃtrya ca’ ityādi || 79-86 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. madhukaṃ yaṣṭī|, viśālā indravāruṇī, jātīpuṣpaṃ mālatīpuṣpaṃ, tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanaṃ, śarkarā sitopalā, daṃtī jayapālamūlaṃ, payasā dugdhena | spaṣṭam anyat || 79-86 ||

atha laghuphalaghṛtaṃ yoniroge -
triphalāṃ dve sahacare guḍūcīṃ sapunarnavām |
śukanāsāṃ haridre dve rāsnāṃ medāṃ śatāvarīm ||87||

lg.l: pīḍitā calitā yā ca niḥsṛtā vivṛtā ca yā |
pittayoniś ca vibhrāntā ṣaṇḍhayoniś ca yā smṛtā ||89||
prapadyante hi tāḥ sthānaṃ garbhaṃ gṛhṇanti cāsakṛt |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha laghuphalaghṛtam āha - triphalam iti | sahacare dve pītaraktabhedena (śukanāsānāsti ‘kha’ pustake | syonākaḥ, rāsnā surabhiḥ) śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ sugamam | etat sakalaṃ ghṛtacaturthāśaṃ grāhyaṃ, kalkaṃ kṛtvā kṣīracaturguṇena saha ghṛtaṃ sādhyam, atra kalkārthaṃ caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ deyam | caturguṇāt snehaparimāṇāt | etad ghṛtaṃ yonidoṣeṣu prāyaśaḥ pracarati palitācalitetyādayo yonigadaviśeṣāḥ kathitāḥ | te tu tatraiva boddhavyā: || 87-90 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śukanāsā, haridre dve haridrā dāruharidrā, medā aṣṭhavargoktā tadabhāve | (dadhyaṃ) deyaṃ, kalkadravyāṇi ghṛtāt caturthāṃśaghṛtāt kṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ pīḍitāyā yonir yonivyāpatsūktā || 87-90||

atha pañcatiktakaṃ ghṛtaṃ viṣamajvarādau -
vṛṣanimbāmṛtāvyāghrīpaṭolānāṃ śṛtena ca ||91||

lg.l: kalkena pakvaṃ sarpis tu nihanyād viṣamajvarān |
pāṇḍuṃ kuṣṭhaṃ visarpaṃ ca kṛmīn arśāṃsi nāśayet ||92||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha pañcatiktakaghṛtam āha - vṛṣeti | āṭarūṣaka:, nimbaḥ prasiddhaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī, vyāghrī kaṇṭakārikā, paṭolaḥ prasiddhaḥ, eteṣāṃ śṛtena kvāthena kvāthārthaṃ dravyaṃ snehadviguṇam | pānīyamatra caturguṇaṃ kvāthaś caturthāvaśeṣo grāhyaḥ | kalkeneti vṛṣādīnām api kalkena pākam āhu: | kalkārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ dravyakadambam āhuḥ - pānīyam apy atra caturguṇaṃ śobhanapākārtham | asya pānābhyaṅgam āhuḥ | iti ghṛtaṃ samāptam || 91 || 92 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vṛṣa āṭarūṣakaḥ eṣāṃ pañcānāṃ śṛtena kvāthena kalkena ca, pakvakalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ pañcatiktakaṃ bhavati || 91 || 92 || iti śrīkāśirāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ghṛtādhikāraḥ ||

lg.l: kaṭukīṃ reṇukāṃ mūrvāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭikām |
kaṇḍūṃ śūlaṃ ca daurgandhyaṃ gātrāṇāṃ sphuraṇaṃ jayet |
puṣṭagarbhā bhaved asya garbhiṇy amyaṅgato bhṛśam || 98 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tailakalpanāyāṃ prathamato lākṣāditailam āha - lākṣāḍhakam iti | atra lākṣārasaṃ tailāc caturguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ lākṣāyā āḍhakam api niryāsatvād bahutaraṃ mastvāḍhakam api tailāc caturguṇaṃ jñeyam ity arthaḥ | godadhna iti godadhisaṃbhavaṃ mastu na tu dadhyāḍhakam api taile pacanīyaṃ yatas tantrāntare 'pi ‘lākṣārasaṃ samādāya tailaprasthāc caturguṇam | mastunaś cāḍhakaṃ dadyād dravyair ebhiś ca kārṣikaiḥ’ ityādi | dadhigrahaṇam atra dadhisaṃbhavamastuprāptinimittaṃ kṛtaṃ, yataḥ mastu saptavidhaṃ bhavati ‘svādvamlamatyamlakamandajātaṃ tathā mṛtakṣīrabhavaṃ saraś ca| asāram evaṃvidhasaptamastuvarge smṛtaṃ mastuguṇās tathaiva’ iti | dravyāṇy atra prasiddhāni, kecit tu ‘kuṣṭhaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭhikām’ ity asyāgre mañjiṣṭhāpadmakośīramāṃsīlohitacandanam’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kalkāt tailaṃ caturguṇaṃ iti paribhāṣayā yad dravyagrahaṇaṃ tad anuktakalkaparimāṇārthaṃ manoharam, cūrṇayed ity atra cūrṇopalakṣitatvāt prathamaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ kṛtvā paścād dṛṣadi peṣitaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ | trikapṛṣṭhagrahā iti tṛtīyakajvarabhedaḥ kathitaḥ, yataḥ ‘kaphapittāt trikagrāhī pṛṣṭhād vātakaphātmakaḥ’ iti vacanāt | yady api pūrvaṃ viṣamajvaragrahaṇenaiva tṛtīyakajvaraprāptis tathāpi viśeṣeṇa tṛtīyakajvaranāśane 'sya prabhāva ity adoṣaḥ | asya tailasyābhyaṅgāt garbhiṇī strī puṣṭagarbhā bhavet iti pānād vāsyeti kecit || 93-98 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tailāni | lāśāḍhakaṃ caturāḍhake jale kvāthayitvā caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nītvā tailaprasthe vinikṣipet āḍhakaṃ godadhnaḥ mastu dadhijalaṃ tatraiva nikṣipet, śatapuṣpādīni pṛthak karṣapramāṇataḥ kalkaṃ kṛtvā tatra nikṣipya mṛduvahninā tailaṃ sādhayet, tailaṃ tilatailaṃ, śatapuṣpā prasiddhā, haridrā śuddhā grāhyā, ṭaṅkaṇādibhiḥ yad vāri nikṣipyate tailaṃ pītaṃ syāt | candanaṃ taile anuktāny api sugandhadravyāṇi deyāni, saurabhārthaṃ yathā- karpūraśvetacandanakeśaralavaṅgajātipatrījātiphalaṃ sihlakamañjiṣṭhānalikā-kuṣṭha-pataṃgabharjitanakhāni karṣamātrāṇi saugandhīni prayojayet; anuktāny api lākṣādau saurabhārthaṃ mahībhṛtaṃ | nanu granthāntare tailāt samo lākṣārasaḥ atra caturguṇaḥ, tathā ca - ‘mūrvāvṛṃdārukarakāmadhukāsragandhārāsnāhareṇumisicandanarugniśābhiḥ | lākṣārasena ca samena samastasiddhaṃ tailaṃ jvarāpaharam etad atiprasiddham’ iti tat katham ? ucyate - aśvinīkumāramate tailāc caturguṇaṃ lākṣārasaḥ iti ato na doṣaḥ, tathā ca ‘lākṣārasāḍhake prasthaṃ tailasya vipaced bhiṣak | mastvāḍhakasamāyuktaṃ piṣṭvā cātra samācaret’ ityādi | atra lākṣākvāthe svarjikāpalaṃ lodhraṃ palaṃ cūrṇitaṃ adhikaraktavarṇārthaṃ kṣipet asyābhyaṃgāt jvarādayaḥ saṃyānti || 93-98 ||

(aṅgāratailamprakṣiptam| )-
mūrvā lākṣā haridre dve mañjiṣṭhā sendravāruṇī |
bṛhatī saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rāsnā māṃsī śatāvarī ||99 ||

atha vātarogādau nārāyaṇatailam -
aśvagandhāṃ balāṃ bilvaṃ pāṭalāṃ bṛhatīdvayam |
adaṃṣṭrātibalā nimbaṃ syonākaṃ ca punarnavā || 101||

lg.l: caturdroṇe jale paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet ||102||
kṣipet tatra ca gokṣīraṃ tailāt tasyāc caturguṇam ||103||
śanair vipācayed ebhiḥ kalkair dvipalikaiḥ pṛthak |
tat tailaṃ nāvane 'bhyaṅge pāne bastau ca yojayet |
pārśvaśūlaṃ ca pāṅgulyaṃ buddhihāniṃ ca gṛdhrasīm ||109||
anyāṃś ca viṣamān vātāñ jayet sarvāṅgasaṃśrayān |
asya prabhāvād vandhyāpi nārī putraṃ prasūyate || 109 ||
martyo gajo vā turagas tailād asmāt sukhī bhavet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha nārāyaṇatailavyākhyānam āha - aśvagandhām iti | atrāśvagandhādīni prasiddhāni, eteṣāṃ mūlaṃ grāhyam | kecit tu “śvadaṃṣṭrātibalābhadram” iti paṭhanti | tatra bhadraḥ pāribhadro raktakusumaḥ kaṇṭako vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ svanāmnā prasiddhaḥ, phalahadāmūlam ity anye tadabhāve devadāru grāhyam | daśapalam iti pratyekam | pādaśeṣam iti droṇam ekaṃ, śatāvarī prasiddhā, tasyāḥ sadyoraso yantrapīḍanādinā grāhyaḥ tadabhāve kvathitaraso vā | tatra gokṣīraṃ kṣiped iti | tatra taile cakārād ājaṃ vā grāhyam, granthāntaradarśanāc ca | tathā hi - “ājaṃ vā yadi gavyaṃ ca” ityādi | kutracid gavyājapayasor yady api guṇasāmyaṃ tathāpi chāgīkṣīreṇa pakvam anabhiṣyandi tridoṣaharaṃ ca bhavati | kalkair iti kalkārdradravyaiḥ pṛthag dvipalikair ity arthaḥ | tad yathā kuṣṭhailetyādi | atra candanaṃ śvetaṃ śaileyaṃ śilāpuṣpaṃ balā atibalā indradāru devadāru parṇīcatuṣṭayeneti tena śāliparṇī, pṛṣṭhiparṇī, māṣaparṇī, mudgaparṇī ceti parṇīcatuṣṭayaṃ kathitam, tagaraṃ tagarapādikā tadabhāve granthiparṇam iti sarvatra | etat siddhaṃ tailaṃ nāvanādiṣu yojyam, khallatvaṃ mandavacanam, indriyadhvaṃsa itīndriyaviṣayanāśaḥ| gajaturagāv api vātavikārapīḍitau| kecit tu sugandhārtham avataraṇasamaye sugandhadravyāṇy anuktāny api prakṣipanti | tad yathā -
‘samaṅgānakhakaṅkolanalikājātikoṣakam |
tvak kunduruṣkakarpūraturuṣkaśrīnivāsakaṃ || spṛkvākuṅkumakastūrī dadyād atrāvatāritesamaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā | nalikā sugandhatṛṇaviśeṣaḥ, kunduruskaḥ-dhūpaḥ niryāsaviśepaḥ, turuṣkaḥ sihlakaniryāsaviśeṣaḥ, spṛkkā-mālatī | ’ iti | evam anyatrāpi boddhavyam | asya granthāntare patrakalkasaṃjñā yataḥ ‘gandhaniryāsapuṣpāṇāṃ siddhe śīte 'vatārite | prakṣepo gandhavṛddhyarthaṃ patrakalkaṃ tu tad viduḥ’ iti | nārāyaṇasaṃjñā viṣṇukṛtatvāt śatāvarī sādhanād vā jñeyā | yataḥ nārāyaṇīti śatāvaryāḥ paryāyo 'sti | yad vā'traivoktatvāt ‘yathā nārāyaṇo devo duṣṭadaityavināśanaḥ | tathedaṃ vātarogāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ tailam uttamam’ iti | ata eva nārāyaṇasaṃjñā | śatāvarīsādhanāt śatāvarī nārāyaṇatailasaṃjñā iti prasiddhiḥ || ||101-110||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha nārāyaṇaṃ tailaṃ vātavyādhau - aśvagandhā hṛyagandhā, balā prasiddhā, bilvaṃ bilvamūlaṃ, pāṭalā, bṛhatīdvayaṃ laghubṛhatkaṇṭakārī, śvadaṃṣṭrā gokṣuraḥ, atibalā gāṅgerukī, nimbatvak, syonākaḥ araluḥ, punarnavā, prasāriṇī pūrvadeśe prasiddhā, agnimanthaḥ araṇiḥ, balādikaṃ daśapalaṃ caturdroṇe jale paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet tailāḍhakena saṃyojya pacet śatāvaryā rasaṃ ca āḍhakaṃ pacet tailāt caturguṇaṃ gokṣīraṃ pacet ādau tailam atīva taptaṃ kṛtvā pañcapalaṃ datvā saṃśodhya dugdhe pacet tataḥ śatāvarīrase pacet tataḥ kvāthe pacet tataḥ kalkadravye pacet kalkadravyāṇi kuṣṭhādīni elā candanaṃ bālakam udīcyaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, śaileyaḥ saindhavam, indradāru devadāru, parṇīcatuṣṭayena śāliparṇī māṣaparṇī mudgaparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇīti | ebhiḥ kalkadravyair jalapiṣṭaiḥ pacet| sagandhā ādikā candanamalayāgarū ādīni paścād dīyante 'nuktāny api || 101-110||

(vāruṇītailaṃ kamparoge)
vāruṇyāprakṣiptam | vāruṇī-indravāruṇī auttaraṃ mūlaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ tu palatrayam |
paladvādaśakaṃ tailaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vahnau vipācitam || 111 ||

atha balādyaṃ tailaṃ vātavyādhau -
balāmūlakaṣāyeṇa daśamūlaśṛtena ca || 113 ||

lg.l: rājayogyam idaṃ tailaṃ sukhināṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ balātailam āha - balāmūleti | balāmūlakaṣāyeṇeti kaṣāyo 'tra kvātharūpaḥ kalkasvarūpo veti kecit | daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | tacchṛtena kvāthenety arthaḥ | kulatthayavakolānāṃ militvā kvāthyaḥ | payo 'tra gavyam ājaṃ vā | aṣṭāṣṭabhāgayukteneti tena balakvāthasyāṣṭau bhāgāḥ | tailabhāgāpekṣayā daśamūlakvāthasyāpy aṣṭau saṃmilitayavādīnāṃ kvāthasyāpy aṣṭau payasaś cāṣṭau bhāgāḥ tailasyaiko bhāgaḥ | jīvanīyagaṇo madhuravargaḥ, tad yathā - ‘jīvaṃtī sūryaparṇīyuk kākolyau jīvakarṣabhau | mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyagaṇo mataḥ’ iti | śeṣaṃ subodham, tantrāntare 'sya daśapākabalātailam iti saṃjñā tatraiva yathoktamānena daśavāraṃ yāvat paktavyam | vīryotkarṣārthaṃ bahupākena snehakṣayo 'py atra nāsti kṣīragatasnehapūraṇāt | etadabhiprāyeṇaiva kecid ity atra manyante tad yathā - balāmūlakaṣāyeṇaikaḥ pākaḥ, daśamūlaśṛtena dvitīyaḥ, kulatthādīnāṃ pṛthak trayaḥ pākāḥ, tatra kulatthādīnāṃ pṛthak tailād aṣṭaguṇo jñeyaḥ, payasā ṣaṣṭhaḥ pākaḥ, jīvanīyaśṛtena saptamaḥ, śatāvarīrasenāṣṭamaḥ, devadāruśṛtena kevalena navamaḥ, devadāruparimāṇaṃ kvāthavat | yataḥ jīvanīyagaṇaśatāvarīdevadārūṇāṃ trayaḥ pākās tṛtīyāntapadatvena vyākhyātāḥ, vakṣyamāṇaṃ mañjiṣṭhādikalkena daśama iti | tasmād daśapākabalā iti saṃjñām asya vadanti kecit | asmatsaṃpradāye pūrvapakṣaḥ pracarati | kecit tu sakaloci- tadravyair daśavāraṃ yāvat pākasya punarāvṛttir bhavatīti manyante tad avyavahārād asaṅgatam || 113-118 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. balā prasiddhā, tanmūlakaṣāyeṇa tathā daśamūlaśṛtena tathā kulatthādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ kvāthena; - kolaṃ badaraṃ, payasā dugdhena, balādīnām aṣṭau bhāgāḥ, tailasyaikaḥ evaṃ pacet | paścāt jīvanīyādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pācayet | jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ cūrṇoktaḥ, śaileyaḥ prasiddhaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 113-118 ||

vātakaphāmayādau prasāriṇītailam āha -
prasāriṇīpalaśataṃ jaladroṇena pācayet |
pādaśiṣṭaḥ śṛto grāhyas tailaṃ dadhi ca tatsamam|| 119||

lg.l: kāñjikaṃ ca samaṃ tailāt kṣīraṃ tailāc caturguṇam |
bhallātaḥ śatapuṣpā ca māṃsī caibhir vipācayet |
anyāṃś ca viṣamān vātān sarvān āśu vyapohati |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. prasāriṇīti | prasāriṇī prasiddhā tanmūlaṃ kuṭṭayitvā palaśataṃ saṃgṛhya droṇaparimitena jalena saṃkvāthya pādāvaśeṣo grāhyaḥ, tena samaṃ tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavaṃ grāhyam, droṇas tu caturāḍhaka iti | āḍhakaś catuḥṣaṣṭipalam ity arthaḥ | dadhi ca tailasamaṃ kāñjikam api tailasamaṃ kṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ tailaparimāṇāt | tailasyāṣṭamāṃśena kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ bhāgaḥ | tatra madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, bhallāto bhallātakaphalaṃ, māṃsī jaṭākhyā | etac ca tantrāntareṣu kubjaprasāriṇītailam iti saṃjñitaṃ kaubje 'tyarthaṃ vihitatvāt | hanupṛṣṭhaśirogrīvākaṭīstambham iti tena stambhaśabdo hanvādibhi: pratyekam abhisambadhyate||119-123||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha prasāriṇītailaṃ | prasāriṇī gandhamādāli pūrvadeśe; palaśate droṇajale pācayet, pādaśeṣam āḍhakaṃ gṛhyate, tailaṃ tatsamam | āḍhakam iti | dadhi tailasamaṃ kāñjikaṃ ca tailāt samaṃ tailād aṣṭamāṃśena kalkāni dravyāṇi tāni madhukādīni madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu spaṣṭam anyat || 119-123 ||

atha māṣāditailaṃ vātavikārādau -
māṣo yavātasī kṣudrā sarkaṭī ca kuraṇṭakaḥ || 124 ||

lg.l: gokaṇṭaṣ ṭuṇṭukaś caiṣāṃ kuryāt saptapalaṃ pṛthak |
nikṣipya pācayed dhīmān pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet |
tailaprasthe tata: sarvān kvāthān etān vinikṣipet ||128||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. samprati māṣāditailam āha - māṣa iti | māṣādiṭuṇṭukāntaṃ dravyaṃ pṛthak saptapalamitaṃ militvā ṣaṭpañcāśatpalāni bhavanti | tatra atasī umābījaṃ, kṣudrā kaṇṭakārikā, markaṭī kapikacchuḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, gokaṇṭaḥ gokṣurakaḥ, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ, kārpāsāsthiprabhṛti kulatthāntaṃ pṛthak caturdaśapalaṃ, tena militvā ṣaṭpañcāśatpalāni bhavanti | atra badaraṃ badarīphalāni | chāgamāṃsasyehāpy uktaparimāṇasya kvāthaḥ tailasya prasthaṃ | kvāthān etān iti pūrvoktān ebhis tribhir dravair militvā cāturguṇyaṃ dravatvāt tailabhāgādityarthaḥ | kalkārthadravyāṇy api pṛthagardhapalamitāni bhavanti | tatrāmṛtā guḍūcī, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, eraṇḍaḥ eraṇḍamūlaṃ, śatapuṣpā misī, māṃsī jaṭākhyā, kaṭukā rohiṇī | etat tailaṃ prāyeṇa nāsyārthamāhuḥ | ‘sarvavātavikāranut’ ity anena vātanāśanāyātra pracurataram asya māhātmyaṃ darśitam ||124-132 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. māṣo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, yavaḥ, atasī, kṣudrā kaṇṭakārī, markaṭī kapikacchuḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ pītavāsā, gokaṇṭakaḥ gokṣuru:, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ eṣāṃ pṛthak samapalaṃ caturguṇāmbunā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet| kārpāsakāsthi, badarī badaraṃ, śaṇabījaṃ, kulatthaṃ, pṛthak caturdaśapalaṃ badarādikaṃ caturguṇe jale pacet | caturthāṃśāvaśiṣṭam uttamaṃ kvāthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, chāgamāṃsasya prasthaikaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalair vinikṣipya pācayet | pādaśeṣe rasaṃ nayet tailaprasthe etān kvāthān nikṣipya pacet | punaḥ amṛtādyaiḥ kalkaiḥ pacet pṛthag ardhapalair amṛtādyaiḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī, rāsnā, prasāriṇī gandhamādāli, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, kaṭukī spaṣṭam anyat ||124-132 ||

div.ab:
atha śatāvarītailaṃ vātādau -
śatāvarī balāyugmaṃ parṇyau gandharvahastakaḥ |
aśvagandhā śvadaṃṣṭraś ca bilvaḥ kāśaḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ ||133||
etān sārdhapalān bhāgān kalkayec ca vipācayet |
caturguṇena nīreṇa pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet || 194 ||
niyojya tailaprasthe ca kṣīraprasthaṃ vinikṣipet |
śatāvarīrasaprasthaṃ jalaprasthaṃ ca yojayet || 135 ||
śatāvarīdevadārumāṃsītagaracandanam |
śatapuṣpā balā kuṣṭham elā śaileyam utpalam ||136||
ṛddhir medā ca madhukaṃ kākolī jīvakas tathā |
eṣā karṣasamaiḥ kalkais tailaṃ gomayavahninā ||137 ||
pacet tan mūrdhatailena naraḥ strīṣu vṛṣāyate |
nārī ca labhate putraṃ yoniśūlaṃ ca naśyati ||138||
aṅgaśūlaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ kāmalāṃ pāṇḍutāṃ garam |
gṛdhrasīplīhaśoṣāṃś ca mehān daṇḍāpatānakam ||139||
sadāhaṃ vātaraktaṃ ca vātapittagadārditam |
asṛgdaraṃ tathādhmānaṃ raktapittaṃ ca naśyati ||140||
śatāvarītailam idaṃ kṛṣṇātreyeṇa bhāṣitam |
oum nārāyaṇyai svāhā ||
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā khanet khadiraśaṅkunā ||141 || oum sarvavyādhināśinyai svāhā | ity utpāṭanamantraḥ | oum kumārījīvanyai svāhā | iti pānamantraḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha śatāvarītailam apy āha - śatāvarīti | śatāvarī divyauṣadhiḥ balāyugmam iti balā atibalā nāgabalā, parṇyau dve te śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī ceti, gandharvahastakaḥ eraṇḍaḥ, śvadaṃṣṭro gokṣurakaḥ, bilva ity atra bilvamūlaṃ, kāśaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya mūlaṃ, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, asyāpi mūlam eva | etān sārdhapalān bhāgān iti | etān pūrvoktān bhāgān iti, pṛthagbhūtān sārdhapalān iti, ardhapalena saha palaṃ tena ṣaṭkarṣamitaṃ pratyekam āhuḥ | militvā prastham ekam | jalaprasthaṃ ca yojayed iti | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ tac cātra kalkapākārtham abhihitam | tat kalkadravyam āha śatāvarītyādi | tatra māṃsī gandhākhyā, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, śaileyaṃ śilāpuṣpam, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ, tadabhāve padmabījam | ṛddhyādi jīvakāntadravyasyālābhāt tatsāmyaguṇadravyaṃ prayojyam iti sarvatra | gomayavahnineti grahaṇaṃ mṛdvagnisādhanārthaṃ | mūrdhataileneti śreṣṭhatailena tathā mūrdhni pūritena tailenety arthaḥ | naraḥ puruṣaḥ asya pānād abhyaṅgato vā strīṣu vṛṣāyate harṣaṃ prāpnotīty arthaḥ | kṛṣṇātreyeṇeti kṛṣṇātreyaḥ punarvasur iti tena kathitam ity arthaḥ | atra kvāthasvarasakalkārthaṃ yat śatāvarīmūlaṃ proktaṃ tad anenaiva mantreṇotpāṭyam, kutaḥ ? vandhyāpatyādikaraṇārthaṃ; tad yathā - vakṣyamāṇenoṅkārapūrvakāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa kṛtvottarābhimukho bhūtvā khadiraśaṅkunā khadirakāṣṭhakīlakena khanet | paścāt oumṅkārasahitenaikādaśākṣaramantreṇotpāṭanaṃ kuryāt | mantras tv asyāgre kathitaḥ | atha pānamantram āha oumkārayutena daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa snehapānam iti | ete mantrāḥ mūle prasiddhāḥ te tata eva jñātavyāḥ śatāvarī divyauṣadhir ity anena yāḥ sarvāḥ śatāvarīsadṛśā oṣadhyas tāḥ sarvā evam eva grāhyā ity arthaḥ || 133-141 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. balāyugmaṃ gāṃgerukī, parṇyau śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī, gandharvahastakaḥ eraṇḍaḥ, śvadaṃṣṭraḥ gokṣuraḥ, kāśaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ, pītavāsā eṣām ardhapalān pṛthag eva | śaileyaḥ prasiddhaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 133-141 ||

lg.l: kāsīsaṃ lāṅgalī kuṣṭhaṃ śuṇṭhī kṛṣṇā ca saindhavam |
caturguṇaṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ datvā samyak prasādhayet ||144||
kṣāravat pātayaty etad arśāṃsy abhyaṅgato bhṛśam ||145||
valīr na dūṣayaty etat kṣārakarmakaraṃ smṛtam ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīm aparāṇi kṣudratailāny āha - tatrādau arśādau kāsīsādyaṃ tailaṃ darśayann āha - kāsīsam iti | kāsīsaṃ dravyaviśeṣaḥ, bhasmavad alpamṛt tadbhedaḥ puṣpakāsīsaṃ kiṃcit pītam, lāṅgalī kalihārikā, kṛṣṇapippalī, aśvamāraḥ karavīrakaḥ drumaḥ, kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, kośātakī jālinī tasyā bīja- miti, hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī sattā tu raktakṣīrasehuṇḍabhedaviśeṣā yasyā mūlaṃ coka iti prasiddham | tailaprastham iti catuṣkuḍavam | snuhyarkapayasī iti snuhī sehuṇḍaḥ, arkaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tayoḥ payasā pṛthak dvipalamitena sādhitam ity arthaḥ | gomūtraṃ caturguṇam atra tailaparimāṇāt | kharanādācāryeṇa kathitam idaṃ durnāmanikṛntanārtham, etac ca kṣārakarmakaratvena na gudadūṣakam ity arthaḥ || 142-145 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kāsīsādyaṃ tailaṃ arśoroge | kāsīsaṃ, lāṅgalau kalihārī, manaḥśilā, snuhī arkaḥ, - anayor dugdhaṃ pṛthak dvipalaṃ kāsīsādyaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ ebhis tailaprasthaṃ pacet || 142-145 ||

atha piṇḍatailaṃ vātarakte -
mañjiṣṭhāsārivāsarjayaṣṭīsikthaiḥ palonmitaiḥ || 146||

Āḍhamalla. atha piṇḍatailam āha - mañjiṣṭheti | atra sārivā āsphotā sā ca dvividhā śuklā kṛṣṇā ca yā jambūvatpatravratatiḥ sā śuklā yā kalahaṃsavatpatrā sugandhā sā kṛṣṇeti, sarjo dhūpanaḥ loke rāla iti prasiddhaḥ | yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī siktho madhūcchiṣṭaḥ ‘mayana’ śabdavācya:, etad dravyaṃ tailāṃśaṃ kalpyam aṃśaś caturthāṃśaḥ | granthāntare payonvitair iti pāṭhaḥ tatra payaḥ kṣīraṃ tac ca dravatvāc caturguṇaṃ tailaparimāṇāt naitan manoharam, yataḥ piṇḍākhyatvena sakalaṃ dravyaṃ kṣīreṇa piṇḍaphalasadṛśaṃ kalkībhūtaṃ kṛtvā sādhayed iti saṃpradāyo bahūnāṃ dṛśyate ata eva piṇḍākhyam iti piṇḍībhūtattvāt piṇḍanāmakaṃ tailaṃ piṇḍatailam ity arthaḥ | piṇḍarūpatvāt kalko 'sya na gholanīya ity āhuḥ | tailam atrairaṇḍajam api gṛhṇanti anyato darśanāt tathā hi - ‘sārivā sarjayaṣṭyāhvā madhūcchiṣṭaiḥ payonvitaiḥ| siddham airaṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ vātaraktarujāpaham’ iti | payo 'tra sāmānyatvād gavyam ||146 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mañjiṣṭhā, sārivā anantā, sarjaḥ, madhukaṃ, siktham etaiḥ palonmitaiḥ kalkadravyāc caturguṇaṃ tailaṃ datvā pacet ||146||

kuṣṭharogādau arkatailam --
arkapatrarase pakvaṃ haridrākalkasaṃyutam || 147 ||

lg.l: nāśayet sārṣape tailaṃ pāmāṃ kacchūṃ vicarcikām |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athārkatailam āha - arketi | arkapatrasvaraso 'tra caturguṇas tailaparimāṇād iti vyavahāraḥ dravyatvāt | haridrā caturthāṃśā tailamānāt asyāḥ kalkārthaṃ jalam āhuḥ | tasya mānaṃ yāvat kalkaṃ syāt sārṣapagrahaṇaṃ vyādhivihitatvāt | pāmādayo rogāḥ kuṣṭharoge paṭhitāḥ || 147 ||

atha maricāditailaṃ kuṣṭhavraṇādau --
maricaṃ haritālaṃ ca trivṛtaṃ raktacandanam || 148 ||

lg.l: mustaṃ manaḥśilā māṃsī dve niśe devadāru ca |
viśālā karavīraṃ ca kuṣṭham arkapayas tathā || 149 ||
viṣaṃ cārdhapalaṃ deyaṃ prasthaṃ ca kaṭutailakam || 150 ||
gomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ dadyāj jalaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ bhavet |
pāmāṃ śvitrāṇi raktaṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ kacchūṃ praṇāśayet || 152||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. maricādyaṃ tailam āha - maricam iti | atra trivṛn niśo dve niśetha: haridre dve tena haridrā dāruharidrā viśālendravāruṇī, karavīra aśvaghnaḥ, arkapayaḥ, gomaya: rasaś ca kiṃcid adhiko deyaḥ dravadravyatvāt | prastham iti caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ pramitaṃ kuḍavo catuṣpala iti gomūtraṃ dviguṇam iti | atra yad gomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ kathitaṃ tad dviguṇitajalagrahaṇāt, anyac ca caturguṇaṃ gomūtram iti tatra jalaṃ nāsti jalam atra samyak pākārtham uktaṃ kecid iti manyante | atra kalkāloḍanārthaṃ jalam uktaṃ na tu kevalajalapākārtham etad api saṃgataṃ na virodhaḥ | kuṣṭhavraṇāpaham iti kuṣṭhāntaṃ vraṇāni tān apahantīti | śvitrapuṇḍarīkādayo bhedāḥ kuṣṭhasyaivāvagantavyāḥ || 148-152 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. trivṛt niḥsṛtā, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, dve niśe, haridrā dāruharidrā, viśālā indravāruṇī, karavīram aśvamāraḥ, kuṣṭham, arkapayaḥ, gomayaḥ tadrasaṃ, maricādīni pṛthak karṣamitāni viṣam ardhapalaṃ kaṭutailaṃ prasthaṃ gomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ tailāni deyaṃ pācanaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati pāmā dadruviśeṣaḥ, kacchūḥ vṛṣaṇasandhigatamalajo rogaḥ || 148 -152||

ab.seg:
arūṃṣikāyāṃ triphalāditailam -
triphalāriṣṭabhūnimbaṃ dve niśe raktacandanam |
etaiḥ siddham arūṃṣīṇāṃ tailam abhyañjane hitam ||153||

Āḍhamalla. atha triphalādyaṃ tailam āha - triphalāriṣṭeti | atra triphalā harītakīprabhṛtikam, ariṣṭo nimbaḥ, bhūnimbaḥ kirātatiktaḥ, dve niśe haridre dve | etair iti dravyaiḥ kalkaṃ kṛtvā tailaṃ sādhyam; tatra tailāc caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyaṃ samyak pākārthaṃ dravānuktatvāt tailāṃśaṃ kalkadravyam iti etad api tailaṃ kuṣṭhoktaṃ savarṇakaram āhuḥ || 153 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ariṣṭo nimbaḥ, bhūnimba: kirātatiktaḥ, dvai niśe haridrādvayam etaiḥ kalkais tailaṃ pācitam, arūṃṣikāyāṃ ‘kaphāsṛkkṛmikopena nṛṇāṃ vidyād arūṣikā’ iti ||153||

atha nimbabījatailaṃ palite -
bhāvayen nimbabījāni bhṛṅgarājarasena hi |
tathāsanasya toyena tat tailaṃ hanti nasyataḥ ||154||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ keśarañjanārthaṃ nimbabījatailam āha - bhāvayed iti | etena nimbabījāni nistuṣāṇi gṛhītvā bhṛṅgarājarasena asakṛd bhāvya tadanu bījasārakvāthenāpi bahuśo bhāvayitvā punas tāni saṃśoṣya yantre saṃpīḍya tailaṃ grāhyam | asya nāvanam akālapalitaghnaṃ bhavati | pathyam atra dugdhaudanaṃ bhavati ||154 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bhṛṅgarājarasena nimbabījāni bhāvayet, athāsanasya bījakasya toyena bhāvayet | tat tailaṃ pīḍanāj jātam akālapalitaṃ nasyataḥ hanti ||154||

atha yaṣṭīmadhukatailaṃ palite -
yaṣṭīmadhukakṣārabhyāṃ‘kṣīrābhyā’miti gūḍhārtha. sammata: pāṭhaḥ | navadhātrīphalaiḥ śṛtam ||155||

lg.l: tailaṃ nasyakṛtaṃ kuryāt keśāñ śmaśrūṇi saṅghaśaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha yaṣṭīmadhukatailam āha - yaṣṭīmadhuketi | atra yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ ‘mulahaṭī’ śabdavācyaṃ, kṣāraḥ yavakṣāraḥ, etad dvayaṃ samaṃ tailāc caturthāṃśaṃ bhavati | navadhātrīphalair iti nūtanāmalakīphalāni | etenābhinavadhātrīsvarasena tailāc caturguṇena kṛtvā tailaṃ pācyaṃ paścān madhuyaṣṭīyavakṣārakalkena sādhyam ity arthaḥ | asya nāvanāt keśān śiroruhān śmaśrūṇi mukhalomāni saṅghaśa iti sughanān kuryād ity arthaḥ ||155||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, kṣīraṃ gokṣīraṃ, tābhyāṃ tathā navadhātrīphalaiḥ śṛtaiḥ nasyena janayati keśān śmaśrūṇi cāpy atha || 155 ||

atha karañjatailam indralupte -
karañjaś citrako jātī karavīraś ca pācitam || 156||

lg.l: tailam ebhir drutaṃ hanyād abhyaṅgād indraluptakam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ karañjādyaṃ tailam āha - karañja iti | karañjo bṛhatkarañjo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya phalāni pallavāni vā, citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya mūlaṃ patrāṇi vā, jātī sumanā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, karavīro aśvaghnaḥ tasyā'pi patrāṇi, etad yathoktaparimitena kalkena pācitaṃ tailam indraluptāpahaṃ vātapittajaḥ bhavati indraluptaṃ keśapracyāvakaḥkeśaśātanaṃ khīrāśabdavācyam dī. śirorogaḥ asyābhyaṅgam āhuḥ ||156||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. keśanāśaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 156 ||

atha nīlikādyaṃ tailaṃ keśakalpādau -
nīlikā ketakīkandaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ ||157||

lg.l: kṛṣṇās tilāś ca tagaraṃ samūlaṃ kamalaṃ tathā ||158||
triphalā padmapaṅkaś ca kalkair ebhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||159||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā nīlikādyaṃ tailam āha - nīliketi | nīlikā nīlinī prasiddhā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, ketakī vikhyātā tasyāḥ kandaṃ mūlaviśeṣa:, bhṛṅgarājakuraṇṭakayoḥ patrāṇi, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, arjuno vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasya kusumāni, bījako 'sanas tasya sāro grāhyaḥ, sumanā jātī tasyāḥ patrāṇi, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, samūlakamalam iti, sakandakamalam ity arthaḥ, ayorajo lohacūrṇaṃ, priyaṅgur latāviśeṣas tasyāḥ phalāni | dāḍimatvak dāḍimaphalatvak, triphalā harītakyāditrikam, padmapaṅkaṃ kamalamūlasthitamṛttikā tadabhāve 'nyataḍāgodbhavā kṛṣṇamṛttikā grāhyā | etāni pṛthak karṣapramāṇāni gṛhītvā kalkaḥ kāryaḥ | tailam atra tilatailaṃ, tatra sakaladravyāc caturguṇaṃ, triphalākvātho 'tra caturguṇas tailaparimāṇāc ca bhṛṅgarājaraso 'pi triphalākvāthasamaḥ, etat tailaṃ keśakṛṣṇīkaraṇayogyam ity āhuḥ satatābhyaṅgatvāt, dāruṇas tu kaphamārutajakopajaḥ śirorogaḥ ||157-160||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nīlikā nīlaṃ, ketakīkandaṃ kelākandaṃ, bhṛṅgarājaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ pītavāsā, arjunavṛkṣasya puṣpāṇi kṛṣṇatilā yamalaṃ kamalakandaḥ, ayorajaḥ lohacūrṇaṃ, priyaṅguḥ, dāḍimatvak, guḍūcī, triphalā, kamalapaṅkaḥ etaiḥ karṣamātraiḥ pṛthak kalkadravyāc caturguṇaṃ tailaṃ tailātriphalākvāthaś caturguṇaṃ tathā bhṛṅgarājarasaḥ ebhiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ nīlikādyaṃ nāma ||157-160 ||

akālapalitādau bhṛṅgarājatailam --
bhṛṅgarājarasenaiva lohakiṭṭaṃ phalatrikam ||161||

lg.l: sārivāṃ ca pacet kalkais tailaṃ dāruṇanāśanam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha bhṛṅgarājatailamāha - bhṛṅgarājeti | bhṛṅgarājaraso 'tra caturguṇaḥ snehāt lohakiṭṭādikaṃ sarvaṃ tailāc caturthāṃśaṃ kuryāt kalkatvāt; kecit tu bhṛṅgarājapatrāṇi kalkamilitāny āhuḥ | tathā hi ‘bhṛṅgarājatriphalotpalaśāri lohapurīṣasamanvitakāri | tailam idaṃ paca dāruṇahāri kuñcitakeśaghanasthirakāri’ iti | etac ca kasyacit sampradāye kartavyavidhānam ||161||162||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha bhṛṅgarājatailam akālapalitādau | bhṛṅgarājarasaṃ tailāc caturguṇaṃ, lohakiṭṭaṃ, phalatrikaṃ, sārivā anantā eṣāṃ kalkaiḥ pacet | dāruṇaṃ keśamūlanāśakaṃ rogaṃ nāśayet || 161 || 162 ||

ab.seg:
irimedādyaṃ tailaṃ mukhadantarogādau -
irimedatvacaṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ pacec chatapalonmitām |
jaladroṇe tataḥ kvāthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt pādaśeṣitam|| 163||

lg.l: kaṭphalena ca saṃsiddhaṃ tailaṃ mukharujaṃ jayet ||166||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha irimedādyaṃ tailam āha - irimedeti | irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ‘durgandhakhadira’ śabdavācyam | ‘reuja’ śabdavācyaḥ tasya tvak challī palaśatonmitā tulaikamānā grāhyā tāṃ ca saṃkuṭya jaladroṇe niṣkvāthya pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyaṃ tailamānādviguṇitam ity arthaḥ | tailasyārdhāḍhakam iti tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavam ardhāḍhakaṃ dvātriṃśatpalamitam | kalkair iti kalkārthadravyaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pratyekaṃ | tatra irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ; atredaṃ yat punargrahaṇaṃ kalkārthaṃ grāhyam | aguruḥ kṛṣṇāguruḥ, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu; lākṣā'tra lākṣārasaḥ kiñcid adhiko deyaḥ dravatvāt | nyagrodho vaṭavṛkṣas tasya patrāṇi tvag vā, tvak varāṅgaṃ, khadiraḥ khadirasāraḥ, pataṅgaṃ kucandanaṃ, kaṭphalaṃ prasiddham, karpūram atra prakṣepe sādhu bhavati | tailam idaṃ mukharoge prāyaśo gaṇḍūṣatvena pracarati praduṣṭamāṃsādidantasphuraṇāntaṃ sarvaṃ dantaroge jñātavyam | daurgandhyaṃ mukhekuharasya jihvātālvoṣṭhajāṃ rujam iti tena jihvārujaṃ tālurujam oṣṭharujaṃ vā || 163-167 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. irimedo durgandhakhadiraḥ tasya tvacaṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ kuṭṭitāṃ śatapalonmitajaladroṇe pacet pādaśeṣitaṃ kvāthaṃ gṛhītvā tailasyārdhāḍhakaṃ pacet | irimedādyaiḥ kārṣikaiḥ kalkadravyaiḥ punaḥ pacet | agaru, gairikaṃ, padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, nyagrodho vaṭaḥ, tvak tajaḥ, karpūraḥ, kaṅkolaḥ, khadiraḥ, pataṅgaḥ, dhātrīpuṣpāṇi, sūkṣmailā, nāgakeśaraṃ etaiḥ kalkadravyaiḥ pacet | spaṣṭam anyat || 163-167 ||

div.ab:
jātyāditailam |
(jātīprakṣiptam | naktamāla:-karañja: | nimbapaṭolānāṃ naktamālasya pallavāḥ ||168||
sikthaṃ samadhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī |
mañjiṣṭhā padmakaṃ lodhram abhayā nīlam utpalam ||169||
tutthakaṃ sārivā bījaṃ naktamālasya dāpayet |
etāni samabhāgāni piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||170||
nāḍīvraṇe samutpanne sphoṭake kacchurogiṣu |
sadyaḥ śastraprahāreṣu dagdhaviddheṣu caiva hi ||171||
nakhadantakṣate dehe vraṇe duṣṭe praśasyate |)

ab.seg:
atha hiṃgvādyaṃ tailaṃ karṇaśūle -
hiṅgutumburuśuṇṭhībhiḥ kaṭutailaṃ vipācayet ||172||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ hiṃgvādyaṃ tailam āha - hiṃgviti | hiṃgvādīnāṃ dravyāṇām atra samabhāgena kalkam āhuḥ | vipācayed iti grahaṇāt | kalkārthaṃ toyam āhur anuktatvāt | asmatsampradāye 'pi chāgamūtreṇa kalkaṃ kṛtvā tenaiva mūtreṇāloḍya hiṃgvādi pacet | kaṭutailaṃ sārṣapam atra tīkṣṇatvāt | pūraṇam atra karṇapūraṇaṃ tac ca granthāntarād avagantavyaṃ tad yathā - ‘dhārayet pūraṇaṃ karṇe karṇaśūlavimardanāt | rujaḥ syān mārdavaṃ yāvan mātrā śatam avedanaḥ’ iti | mātrālakṣaṇam api prasaṅgato likhyate
‘yāvat paryeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇo jānumaṇḍale |
nimeṣonmeṣakālaṃ vā sā mātrā parikīrtitā’ | tumburu svanāmaprasiddham ||168-172||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kalkadravyāt hiṃgvādeś caturguṇaṃ tailam ||

ab.seg:
atha bilvādyaṃ tailaṃ bādhirye -
bālabilvāni gomūtre piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||173||

lg.l: sājakṣīraṃ ca nīraṃ ca bādhiryaṃ hanti pūraṇāt |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha bālabilvatailaṃ yathā bāleti | bālabilvāni bilvaśalāṭūni, tāni gomūtreṇa kalkīkṛtāni gomūtreṇaivāvaloḍya taile pācyāni | tailam atra sārṣapaṃ pūrvayogānuvartanāt ājaṃ kṣīraṃ nīraṃ ca tailāc caturguṇaṃ pratyekam āhuḥ, kutracij jalapāko na dṛśyate kevalaṃ kṣīrapāko bilvakalkapākaś ceti sampradāyo vṛddhānāṃ, tantrāntare 'pi ‘phalaṃ bilvasya mūtreṇa piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet | sakṣīraṃ tac ca vipaced bādhirye karṇapūraṇam’ iti | atra yan nīram uktaṃ tat samyak pākārthaṃ pānīyaṃ vinā snehapāko na sugama iti kecit || 173 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bālabilvāni laghubilvāni, gomūtre piṣṭvā tailaṃ pacet sājakṣīram ajādugdhaṃ caturguṇatailān nīraṃ jalaṃ ca datvā pacet || 173 ||

atha kṣāratailaṃ karṇarogeṣu -
bālamūlakaśuṅgānāṃ kṣāraḥ kṣārayugaṃ tathā || 174 ||

lg.l: lavaṇāni ca pañcaiva hiṅgu śigru mahauṣadham |
granthikaṃ bhadramustaṃ ca kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pṛthak |
anyāṃś ca karṇajān rogān mukharogāṃś ca nāśayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha kṣāratailamāha - bālamūlaketi | bālamūlakaṃ laghumūlakaṃ tasya śuṅgā nālaviśeṣās tajjātaṃ kṣāram iti | kṣārayugam iti kṣāradvandvaṃ tena svarjikākṣāro yavakṣāraś ceti | pañjalavaṇāni prasiddhāni, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ asya mūlasvaraso grāhyaḥ, mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī, rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ nijanāmnā, tadabhāve dāruharidrā grāhyā tanmūlatvāt, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, bhadramustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, tailaṃ sarṣapam atrāpy āhuḥ, prasthaṃ ṣoḍaśapalāni kadalīkandasvarasaṃ bījapūraphalarasaṃ ca pratyekaṃ tailāc caturguṇam āhuḥ dravatvāt | madhuśuktam api caturguṇam | pūyasrāvaṃ karṇasyeti śūlam api karṇasambandhikṛmayas tv atra karṇasaṃbhavāś ca | etad api tailaṃ mukharoge praśastaṃ gaṇḍūṣakaraṇatvāt || 174-177 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bālamūlakaśuṇṭhīnāṃ kṣāraḥ bālamūlakaṃ teṣāṃ śuṃḍāni gaṃḍikāḥ śuṣkās teṣāṃ dagdhvā kṣāraḥ kāryaḥ, tathā kṣārayugaṃ svarjī yavakṣāraḥ, śobhāñjanaṃ, mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī, rasāñjanaṃ, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, bhadramustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, etaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ tailaprasthaṃ pacet | kadalīsvarase bījapūraphalarase ca caturguṇālābhe tulyenāpi pacet madhuśuktena ca tailāc cāturguṇyena pacet || 174-177 ||

kecit tu madhuśuktalakṣaṇam etasyāgre paṭhanti tad yathā - madhuśuktam |
jambīrāṇāṃ phalarasaḥ prasthaikaḥ kuḍavonmitam ||178||
