lg.l: mākṣikaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ palaikā pippalī smṛtā |
etad ekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mṛdbhāṇḍe ca nidhāpayet ||179||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. tantrāntare tu - ‘yavāṃbho madhuyuktaṃ ca śṛṃgaveraguḍānvitam | dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ madhuśuktam udāhṛtam’ iti | athavā ‘yan mastv aśucau bhāṇḍe sakṣaudraguḍakāñjikam | dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ śuktaṃ cukraṃ tad ucyate’ iti | eteṣāṃ yathālābhaṃ deyam iti na doṣaḥ || || 178-180 ||

atha pāṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ pīnase -
pāṭhā dve ca niśe mūrvā pippalī jātipallavaiḥ||181||

lg.l: dantyā ca tailaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ nasyaṃ syāhuṣṭapīnase |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. saṃprati pāṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ darśayann āha - pāṭheti | pāṭhā prasiddhā, dve niśe iti haridrādvayaṃ, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ jātipallavair iti jātī sumanā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, dantī prasiddhā, pāṭhādidravyāṇāṃ samānamilitānāṃ kalkaṃ tailāṃśam āhuḥ || 181 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pāṭhā, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, mūrvā moraṭā; pippalī jātī mālatīpatrāṇi, dantī jayapālamūlam ebhiḥ saṃsiddhaṃ kalkīkṛtaṃ kalkāt tailaṃ caturguṇam ||181||

atha vyāghrītailaṃ pīnase -
vyāghrīdantīvacāśigrutulasīvyoṣasaindhavaiḥ ||182||

Āḍhamalla. atha vyāghrītailamāha - vyāghrīti | vyāghrīkaṇṭakārikā, dantī prasiddhā, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, tulasī pratītā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, tena śuṇṭhīmaricapippalya iti | eteṣāṃ kalkaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ kaphasya pācanam uktam pānatvāt | pūtināsodakāpaham iti ca pūtināso nāsādurgandhaḥ | nāsodakaṃ nāsāsrāvaḥ etad dvayaṃ hanti nasyābhyāsāt ||182||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vyāghrī, kaṇṭakārī, dantī, śigruḥ śobhāñjanaṃ, tulasī, vyoṣaṃ, trikaṭu, pūtināsāgadaṃ pīnasam||182||

atha kuṣṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ chikvāyāṃ -
kuṣṭhaṃ bilvakaṇāśuṇṭhīdrākṣākalkakaṣāyavat || 183||

lg.l: sādhitaṃ tailam ājyaṃ vā nasyāt kṣavathunāśanam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kuṣṭhatailamāha - kuṣṭham iti | bilvam atra bilvaphalaṃ mūlaṃ vā tadabhāve kaṇā pippalī kalkakaṣāyavad iti kalkarūpas tena sādhitam ity arthaḥ | pañcakaṣāyāḥ kathitāḥ | yad vā kuṣṭhādīnāṃ kalkena kaṣāyeṇa ca tailaṃ sādhyam | kaṣāyaśabdaḥ kvāthe prāyaśaḥ pracarati tatra kvāthārtham etad dravyaṃ snehasamaṃ grāhyaṃ, caturguṇena nīreṇa saṃkvāthya pādaśeṣeṇa sādhyaṃ, kalkārthaṃ ca tailāṃśena sāmyam ity arthaḥ | evam ājyaṃ ghṛtam api sādhyam | kṣavathuś chikkā ||183||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kuptādīnāṃ kalkaḥ kaṣāyavat kāryas tena tailam ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ na syāt kṣavathunāśanaḥ kṣavathuś chikkā ||183||

gṛhadhūmatailaṃ nāsārśasi -
gṛhadhūmakaṇādārukṣāranaktāhvasaindhavaiḥ || 184 ||

lg.l: siddhaṃ śikharibījaiś ca tailaṃ nāsārśasāṃ hitam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha gṛhadhūmatailamāha - gṛhadhūmeti | gṛhadhūmaḥ vikhyātaḥ, kaṇā pippalī, dāru devadāru, kṣāraṃ yavakṣāraṃ, naktāhvaṃ karañjaphalaṃ | śikharibījaiś ceti | śikharī apāmārgaḥ tasya bījai: phalaiḥ | eke siddhaṃ śirīṣabījaiś ceti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | eteṣāṃ kalkaṃ tailāṃśam āhuḥ | siddham idaṃ nāvane 'bhyaṅge vā praśastam ||184||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. gṛhadhūmaḥ ‘aṅgāradhūmaḥ’, kaṇā pippalī, dāru devadāru, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ naktāhva karañjaḥ, saindhavaṃ, śikharibījaṃ tugābījam ebhiḥ kalkitaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ nāsārśasāṃ haraṃ bhavati || 184 ||

atha vajrītailaṃ kuṣṭhādau -
vajrīkṣīraṃ ravikṣīraṃ dravaṃ dhattūracitrajam || 185 ||

lg.l: tailāvaśeṣaṃ paktvā ca tat tailaṃ prasthamātrakam |
devadāru ca karṣāṃśaṃ cūrṇaṃ taile vinikṣipet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā vajrītailamāha - vajrīti | vajrī sehuṇḍas tasya kṣīraṃ dugdhaṃ ravikṣīram ity arkadugdhaṃ dhattūrakacitrakapatrayordravaṃ svarasam ity arthaḥ | mahiṣīviḍbhavaṃ drāvaṃ mahiṣīśakṛtsvarasam | sarvāṃśaṃ tilatailakam iti sarvaṃ vajrīkṣīrādi pañcadravaṃ tasyāṃśaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ bhāgaṃ tatsamam iti tailam ity arthaḥ | eke sarvāṃśaṃ tailam ity anena sarvapañcadravyasāmyaṃ tailam iti vadanti etan na pracarati yataḥ pañcadravatvena pratyekaṃ tailasamam āhuḥ | tathā coktam atraiva paribhāṣāyām ‘dravāṇi yatra sneheṣu pañcādīni’ ityādivākyam | punar api tad gomūtracaturguṇena paktvā tailāvaśeṣaṃ prasthamātraṃ gṛhītvā vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ karṣapramitānāṃ cūrṇaṃ tat taile miśrayitvā svanuguptaṃ dhārayet| gomūtraṃ pṛthaguktatvāc caturguṇam| cūrṇadravyāṇy āha -tatrāgnir bhallātakaḥ, citrakajaṭā vā, śilā manaḥśilā, tālaṃ haritālaṃ, viṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tiktakośātakī kaṭukośātakīphalam iti, māṃsī jaṭākhyā kaṭutrayaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, pītadāru dāruharidrā, yaṣṭyāhvaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, sva- rjikākṣāraṃ prasiddhaṃ tat teṣāṃ cūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇām api kalkam āhur eke sarvakuṣṭhanud iti | sarvakuṣṭham aṣṭādaśaprakāram|| ||185-189 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vajrīkṣīraṃ, ravir arkas tasya kṣīraṃ, dravaṃ taj jalaṃ, dhattūrapatrasvarasaḥ, citrakasvarasaś ca, mahiṣīviḍdravaṃ, tilatailakaṃ sarvāṃśaṃ sarvasamaṃ, gomūtraṃ caturguṇaṃ tailāt | tatsiddhaṃ tailaṃ prasthamātrakaṃ tasmin gandhakādīn kṣipet agniś citrakaḥ, śilā manaḥśilā, tālaṃ haritālaṃ, viṣā ativiṣā, viṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tiktakośātakī jālinī, pītadāruḥ, haridrā, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, karṣāṃśaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kṣipet | sarvakuṣṭhahṛt dadruvicarcikādikakuṣṭhaharam ||185-189 ||

karavīrāditailam |
karavīraśikhādantītrivṛtkośātakīphakṣam |
rambhākṣārodake tailaṃ praśastaṃ lomaśātanam ||190||
Āḍhamalla. atha karavīrāditailamāha - karavīreti | sugamam ||190||

div.ab:
candanāditailam -
(candanāmbunakhair yābhyaṃprakṣiptapāṭhā: yaṣṭīśaileyapadmakam |
mañjiṣṭhā saralaṃ dāru sevyailaṃ pūtikesaram ||191||
patrakailaṃ murā māṃsī kaṅkolaṃ vanitāmbudam |
haridrā sārivā tiktā lavaṅgāgarukuṅkumam || 192||
tvagreṇunalikā ceti tailaṃ mastu caturguṇam |
lākṣārasasamaṃ siddhaṃ grahaghnaṃ balavardhanam || 193 ||
apasmārajvaronmādakṛtyālakṣmīvināśanam |
āyuḥpuṣṭikaraṃ caiva vaśīkaraṇam uttamam || 194 ||
viśeṣāt kṣayarogaghnaṃ raktapittaharaṃ param|)

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. ambu mustakaṃ, nakhaṃ sugandhauṣadhiḥ, yāmyaṃ candanaṃ, saralaṃ dhūpavṛkṣaḥ, sevyam uśīraṃ, pūtikesaraṃ gandhamārjārī, murā gandhadravyaṃ, vanitā priyaṅguḥ, ambudaṃ mustaṃ, tiktā latākastūrī, nalikā indīvarā || 191-194 ||
vacātailam - (vacāṃprakṣiptapāṭhāḥ śaṭhīṃ haridre dve devadāruhamahauṣadhī ||195||

lg.l: etat tailaṃ nihanty āśu gaṇḍamālāṃ sudāruṇām|

div.ab:
lāṅgalītailam |
(nirguṇḍīsvarase tailaṃ lāṅgalīlāṅgalī-kalihārī keṣucitpustakeṣvetat pāṭhabhedatrayaṃ dṛśyate | mūlakalkitam ||198||
tailaṃ nasyān nihanty āśu gaṇḍamālāṃ sudāruṇām |)

dhattūratailam -
‘dhattūrarasam ādāya hayamārāntikārasam |
bhṛṅgarājarasaś caiva sāriṇī nimbapatrakam || 199 ||
śobhāñjanaś citrakaś ca aśvagandhāprasāriṇī |
śirīṣaḥ kuṭajo 'nantā śālmalī naktapatrakam||200||
ravipriyo mahānimbo ḍiṇḍighoṣā maheraṇā |
balā jyotiṣmatī caiva śyāmākaś cakramardakaḥ||20 1||
etais tu rasam ādāya tailatulyaṃ ca dīyate |
devadāru haridre dve māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ sacandanam ||202||
maricaṃ trivṛtā dantī haritālaṃ manaḥśilā |
kampillako gandhakaś ca khadiraḥ pippalī vacā ||203||
rasāñjanaṃ ca sindūraṃ śrīvāso raktacandanam |
irimedas tathā tumbī mañjiṣṭhā sinduvārakaḥ ||204||
karavīrajaṭā rāsnā viśvā śreṣṭhā ca pauṣkaram |
śaṭhī tālīsapatraṃ ca priyaṅgū reṇukā tathā ||205||
cāturjātakam añjīraṃ kaṅkolaṃ jātipatrikā |
jyotiṣmatī ca palikā viṣasya dvipalaṃ bhavet ||206||
āḍhakaṃ kaṭutailasya gomūtraṃ ca caturguṇam |
mṛtpātre lohapātre ca śanair mṛdvagninā pacet ||207||
majjāśritaṃ tvaggataṃ ca vātaṃ cāsthigataṃ tathā |
ūrugrahaṃ cāḍhyavātaṃ kṛcchraṃ daṇḍāpatānakam ||208||
kubjatvaṃ cātha śothaṃ ca pakṣāghātaṃ tathārditam |
hanustambhaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭivibhramam ||209||
apasmāraṃ tathonmādaṃ tathā caivā'patantrakam |
ākṣepakaṃ cāsthibhagnaṃ sandhibhagnaṃ ca nāśayet||210|| ity apy adhikaḥ pāṭho dṛśyate | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ ghṛtatailakalpanā nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ |

Āḍhamalla. hayamāro karavīraḥ, naktapatrakaṃ kañjapatrakaṃ, ravipriyo raktakamalaṃ, ḍiṇḍīghoṣā raktairaṇḍaḥ, maheraṇā sallakīvṛkṣaḥ, śrīvāsaḥ saralaniryāsaḥ, sinduvārakaḥ nirguṇḍī, śreṣṭhā sthalapadminī || 199-210 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe snehakalpanā'dhyāyo navamaḥ ||9|| iti kāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ tailādhikāraḥ ||

div.head: atha āsavāriṣṭakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ |
draveṣu cirakālasthaṃ dramyaṃ yat saṃdhitaṃ bhavet |
āsavāriṣṭabhedais tu procyate bheṣajocitam ||1||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ saṃdhānakalpanāṃ darśayann āha - draveṣv iti| tatra sāmānyaṃ yathā draveṣu kalpanāgaṇiteṣu dravadravyeṣu yad dravyaṃ cirakālaṃ saṃdhānībhūtaṃ bhavati tac ca āsavāriṣṭādibhedaiḥ kṛtvā madyam ity ucyate | āsavāriṣṭabhedair iti bahuvacanatvena sīdhusurādikam api gṛhyate | āsava iti prasiddhaḥ, surā paiṣṭī, āsavo guḍayoniḥ | sūyate toyakāryaṃ kriyate yasmin sa āsavaḥ | sthiramada iti cirakālamattatākārī | ariṣṭam iti dravyapradhānaḥ asya bhedaḥ | sīdhur iti | sīdhuśabdena madyabhedam āhuḥ, tac cobhayapradhānam | etad api trividham iti kecit | paiṣṭikaṃ mādhvīkaṃ gauḍam iti | maireyaka ity api bhedo 'sya vadanty eke | sa yathā - surāsavayoḥ pratyekaniṣpāditayor ekīkṛtya punaḥsandhāno maireya iti saṃkṣepeṇoktā madyabhedāḥ || 1||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha āsavāriṣṭādhyāyam āha | yad dravyam auṣadhādidravyeṣu pānīyādiṣu cirakālasthaṃ sandhitaṃ tat ucitaṃ bheṣajaṃ āsavāriṣṭabhedaiḥ procyate | ucitaṃ svarogocitam || 1 ||

lg.l: yad apakvauṣadhāmbubhyāṃ siddhaṃ madyaṃ sa āsavaḥ |
ariṣṭaḥ kvāthasiddhaḥ syāt tayor mānaṃ jalonmitam ||2||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tasya viśeṣalakṣaṇāny āha - yad iti | tayor āsavāriṣṭayor mānaṃ pānārthaṃ tulanārūpaṃ jalonmitam iti | jalapānamātraṃ jalapānaṃ tu alpam eva kathitaṃ naitan manoharam, kuto madātyayaviṣayatvāt | nīrujānāṃ tantrāntarīyamānaṃ yat taj jalaśabdena kalpyate | tad yathā - “śuddhakāyaḥ pibet prātaḥ sopadaṃśaṃ paladvayam | madhyāhne dviguṇaṃ tac ca snigdhāhāreṇa pāyayet” ityādi vacanāt | eke tripalonmitam iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tatrāpi āsavāriṣṭayor bhedam āha -- yat apakvauṣadhāmbubhyāṃ siddhaṃ madyaṃ sa āsavaḥ tadguṇāḥ - ‘chedī madhvāsavas tīkṣṇā’ iti procyate | apakvauṣadham ambu ca vahnipākarahitaṃ | yas tu kvāthasiddhaḥ sa ariṣṭaḥ syāt | vahniyogād bhūyān bhedaḥ | tayor āsavāriṣṭayor mānaṃ bhakṣaṇapramāṇaṃ, tadguṇās tu “yathā dravyaguṇo 'riṣṭaḥ sarvamadyaguṇādhikaḥ” || 2 ||

anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu jalādipramāṇam āha -
anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu dravadroṇe tulāṃ guḍam |
kṣaudraṃ kṣiped guḍād ardhaṃ prakṣepaṃ daśamāṃśikam || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. athāriṣṭeṣu dravyaparimāṇam anuktatvād darśayann āha - anuktamāneti | dravyadroṇe droṇadvayaparimite drave kvāthādike | tatra tulām iti sandhānikadravyāṇāṃ kṣipet | tāni madhukapuṣpaprabhṛtīni guḍaparimāṇād ardhaparimāṇam | madhv iti guḍamānam api kvāthadravyaparimāṇād ardhaṃ boddhavyam | tathā ca paribhāṣāyāṃ -
“kvāthyadravyasya hi samaṃ kvāthaṃ nītvā tu dhārayet |
pātre mṛṇmayake bhūmau nikhāte tu guḍaṃ nyaset |
kvāthād ardhaṃ tato dravyaṃ pradeyaṃ cāṣṭamāṃśikam |
kṣaudraṃ kṣiped guḍād ardham śarkarāṃ ca tathā nyaset |
karkandhūmūlaprabhṛtīn guḍatulyaṃ pradāpayet |
dhātakīkusumaṃ deyaṃ śarkarākṣaudrayor dvikam | samyak pakvaṃ tato jñātvā nyased yantre prasādhayet” iti | prakṣepaṃ daśamāṃśikam iti | prakṣepaṃ paścād deyaṃ dravyaṃ daśamāṃśikaṃ‘tacca’ māṣāṃśakavācyam | guḍaparimāṇād ity arthaḥ || 3 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu dravadroṇe sati guḍaṃ tulāṃ kṣipet | tulāṃ palaśatapramāṇaṃ, anuktamānaṃ guḍapramāṇaṃ yeṣu evaṃbhūteṣv āsavāriṣṭeṣu kṣaudraṃ madhu guḍād ardhaṃ kṣipet | anukta evaṃ prakṣepaṃ cūrṇādiprakṣepam | daśamāṃśikaṃ cūrṇaprakṣepaṃ daśamāśikam iti || 3 ||

atha kvāthabhedena sīdhulakṣaṇam āha -
jñeyaḥ śītarasaḥ sīdhur apakvamadhuradravaiḥ |
paripakvānnasandhānasamutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ |
siddhaḥ pakvarasaḥ sīdhuḥ saṃpakvamadhuradravaiḥ || 4 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ sīdhuprabhṛtīnāṃ pratyekalakṣaṇāny āha - jñeya iti | yaḥ sīdhuḥ apakvamadhuradravair ikṣurasaprabhṛtikaiḥ siddho jñātaḥ sa śītarasasaṃjño jñeyaḥ | yaḥ saṃpakvamadhuradravaiḥ siddhaḥ sa pakvarasasaṃjñaḥ etad dvayaṃ tatkarmakārakasakāśād avagantavyamloke ‘thānu’ śabdavācya iti vadanti | dī. | ||4||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. apakvamadhuradravaiḥ siddhaḥ śītarasaḥ sīdhur jñeyaḥ yathā sirakāsam | pakvamadhuradravaiḥ siddhaḥ pakvarasaḥ sīdhur jñeyaḥ, apakvarasasīdhuḥ, pakvarasasīdhuś ca bhedadvayaṃ jñeyaṃ, tadguṇās tu - “vātapittakaraḥ sīdhuḥ snehaśleṣmavikārahā | meda:śophodarārśoghnas tatra pakvaraso varaḥ? iti ||4||

atha surāprasannādīnāṃ madyabhedānāṃ lakṣaṇam āha -
paripakvānnasaṃdhānasamutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ |
surāmaṇḍaḥ prasannā syāt tataḥ kādambarī ghanaḥ || 5 ||

lg.l: tad adho jagalo jñeyo medako jagalād dhanaḥ |
vakvaso hṛtasāraḥ syāt surābījaṃ ca kiṇvakam ||6||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ surāviśeṣaṇalakṣaṇam āha - paripakvānneti | yat śālyādikaṃ sampācya punaḥ sandhitaṃ bhavati tena yat samutpannaṃ tāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | eṣā paiṣṭī surā loke ‘vaganī’ śabdavācyā vikhyātā | athānye bahavo bhedās tān āha -surāmaṇḍa ityādi | yaḥ surāmaṇḍaḥ upary accho bhāgaḥ sā prasannā kathitā, yo ghanaḥ sa eva kādambarīśabdena vācya: | ghanas tu surābhāga eva, yaḥ surāyā adhasthito bhavati sa jagalo jñeyaḥ | yo jagalāt kiñcid ghanaḥ sa medakasurāsaṃjñaḥ kādambaryā bhinnaḥ kiñciddhanatvāt | yo hṛtasāraḥ sa ‘vakkasa’saṃjñaḥ | surābījaṃ tu kiṇvakam iti | śālipiṣṭaprabhavaṃ kiṇvakam iti kathitam | ete surābhedā darśitāḥ | te ca lokato jñātavyāḥ || 5 || 6 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha surā | paripakvasya pācitānnasya yat sadhānaṃ tasmāt samutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | atha prasannāṃ kādambarīṃ cāha -uktāyāḥ surāyāḥ maṇḍaḥ phenaḥ prasannā syāt tataḥ ghanā dṛḍhā kādambarī syāt | atha jagalaṃ medakaṃ cāha - tad adhaḥ surāyā adhaḥ yo dravabhāgaḥ sa jagalas tasmāt yaś cyavaḥ medakaḥ | atha surābījaṃ kiṇvakam āha - sa medakaḥ hṛtasāraḥ surābījaṃ bhavati ca punaḥ kiṇvakaṃ bhavati bījam utpattisthānaṃ vivakalahastīti bhāṣāyām || 5 || 6 ||

atha vāruṇīm āha -
yat tālakharjūrarasaiḥ saṃdhitā sā hi vāruṇī |

Āḍhamalla. atha vāruṇīlakṣaṇam āha - yat tāleti | idam api surābhedaḥ | tālaḥ tālavṛkṣaḥ, kharjūro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, rasa iti phalarasaḥ, sandhitam iti pūrvavat, yad vā tālakharjūravṛkṣayor uparibhāgaṃ chitvā tatra ghaṭam āropya yo raso ghaṭe patitas tatraiva cirakālastho bhavati sā vāruṇī; loke ‘sendhī’ śabdavācyā | ‘tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghutīkṣṇā nihaṃti ca’ ||

ab.seg:
atha śuktam āha -
kandamūlaphalādīni sasnehalavaṇāni ca || 7 ||

lg.l: vinaṣṭam amlatāṃ yātaṃ madyaṃ vā madhuradravam || 8 ||
vinaṣṭaḥ saṃdhito yas tu tac cukram abhidhīyate |
saṃdhitaṃ cāmlatāṃ yātaṃ guḍaśuktaṃ tad ucyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā śuktādilakṣaṇaṃ darśayann āha - kandamūleti | etac ca sāmānyalakṣaṇam abhihitam, kandamūlaphalādīni iti | kandāni sūraṇaprabhṛtīni, mūlāni mūlakaprabhṛtīni, phalāni karamardakaraṃbhāphalaprabhṛtīni, ādiśabdāt patrapuṣpanālādayo gṛhyante | na kevalaṃ lavaṇatailaṃ, cakārād rājikāharidrādīnām api grahaṇaṃ, vyavahāratas tu lavaṇatyāgenāpi pracarati | yatra drave pānīyaprabhṛtike etāni vastūni sūyante sandhānībhūtāni kriyante tat śuktam abhidhīyate iti | nanu ‘śuktaṃ cukram ucyate’ iti vadanti tat katham asya śuktasaṃjñā kathyate ? satyam | śuktavat sandhitānāṃ kandādīnām api cukrasaṃjñātrāpy abhihitā na tu sākṣāt śuktaṃ coktam | atha atrāpi madyalakṣaṇam āha etad api śuktabhedam āhuḥ | tad uktaṃ guṇāvalyāṃ “gauḍāni rasaśuktāni madyaśuktāni yāni ca | yathāpūrvaṃ gurutarā- ṇy abhiṣyandakarāṇi ca” iti | vinaṣṭam amlatāṃ yātaṃ madyam iti tad ucyate | sarvaṃ madyaṃ pañcarasaṃ kālāntaravaśād yadā saṃtyajya param amlatvaṃ yāti śuktaṃ tad ucyate iti | madhuradravam iti | guḍekṣurasamadhuprabhṛtikam | tathā hi - ‘yan madhvādau śucau bhāṇḍe saguḍakṣaudrakāñjikam | dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ śuktaṃ cukraṃ tad ucyate’ iti | vinaṣṭa iti vigatarasaḥ | sandhitaḥ sandhānībhūtaḥ | idānīṃ guḍādiśuktalakṣaṇam āha - guḍeti | guḍaśuktam iti guḍapradhānaṃ śuktam ity arthaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 7-9 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuktaguṇāḥ - ‘raktapittakaphotkledi śuktaṃ vātānulomanam ? abhiṣūyante kṣipyante, spaṣṭam anyat | cukram āhuḥ cukraṃ madyabhedaḥ, atha guḍaśuktam evam evekṣuśuktam iti madyabhedaḥ || 7-9||

ikṣuśuktam -
evam evekṣuśuktaṃ syān mṛdvīkāsaṃbhavaṃ tathā ||10||

Āḍhamalla. evam eveti | guḍaśuktavad ikṣurasaśuktaṃ sandheyam | ikṣuśuktam itīkṣurasādikṛtaṃ, mṛdvīkā drākṣā tatsambhavaṃ śuktam | etad api pūrvavat sandheyam | eke mṛdvīkāsambhavam ity asya sthāne ‘madhunā saṃbhava’m iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | madhunā saṃbhavam iti madhukṛtaśuktam ucyate tad uktaṃ
“jambīrāṇāṃ phalarasaṃ pippalīmūlasaṃyutam |
madhubhāṇḍe vinikṣipya dhānyarāśau nidhāpayet || tryaheṇa taj jātarasaṃ madhuśuktam udāhṛtam” iti | madhubhāṇḍe madhupūrṇaprāye bhāṇḍe ity arthaḥ | tadguṇāḥ krameṇa “guḍekṣumadyamārdvīkaśuktaṃ laghu yathottaram” || 10 ||

div.ab:
idānīṃ tuṣāmbukāñjikam apy āha -
tuṣāmbu saṃdhitaṃ jñeyam āmair vidalitair yavaiḥ |
yavais tu nistuṣaiḥ pakvaiḥ sauvīraṃ saṃdhitaṃ bhavet || 1 1||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. tuṣāmbv iti | āmair aparipakvair vidalitaiḥ khaṇḍitaiḥ īdṛśair yavair yat sandhānaṃ kriyate tat tuṣāmbu kathitaṃ, yavais tu nistuṣaiḥ pakvaiḥ sauvīram iti | nistuṣais tuṣarahitaiḥ pakvaiḥ svinnair yavair iti śeṣaḥ, yavaiḥ nistuṣair iti grahaṇenāpi godhūmasaṃbhavam iti sūcayati | tathā hi - ‘sauvīrakaṃ suvīrāmlaṃ jñeyaṃ godhūmasaṃbhavam’ iti | tuṣāmbu sauvīrakaṃ ca kāñjikabhedam āhuḥ, te tu virecanaprakaraṇe prāyaśaḥ pracarataḥ || 11 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tuṣāmbu, vidalitaiḥ āmair apakvaiḥ yavaiḥ saṃdhitaṃ tuṣāmbu jñeyam | atha sauvīraṃ nistuṣaiḥ pakvaiḥ kvathitair yavaiḥ saṃdhitaṃ sauvīraṃ bhavet || 11 ||

div.ab:
atha kāñjikam -
kulmāṣadhānyamaṇḍādi saṃdhitaṃ kāñjikaṃ viduḥ |

Āḍhamalla. saṃprati kāñjikasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ prakaṭayann āha - kulmāṣeti | kāñjikaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ, kulmāṣāḥ kutsitamāṣāḥ, dhānyaṃ raktaśālyādi, tena ca tṛṇāhvakodravādikam api gṛhyate | maṇḍaṃ śāliprabhavaṃ prasiddham | eke kulmāṣabhavaṃ dhānyabhavaṃ maṇḍaṃ ca vyākhyānayanti, ādiśabdāt yavacūrṇādikṛtam api boddhavyam, yataḥ asya bahavo bhedāḥ dṛśyante te tu dakṣiṇe 'tīva prasiddhāḥ ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kulmāṣadhānyamaṇḍādi yat sandhitaṃ tat kāñjikaṃ viduḥ | kulmāṣaḥ ardhasvinnamāṣaḥ, dhānyaṃ ṣaṣṭikādi tayor maṇḍasaṃdhitaṃ, tadguṇāḥ - ‘dhānyāmlaṃ bhedi tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ pittakṛt sparśaśītalam ||’

ab.seg:
atha saṇḍākī --
saṇḍākī saṃdhitā jñeyā mūlakaiḥ sārṣapādibhiḥ || 12||
Āḍhamalla. atha saṇḍākīm āha - saṇḍākīti | sandhānakabhedaḥkāpi śabdavācyā dī. | , mūlakaṃ prasiddham, sārṣapādibhir iti sārṣapaśākena saṃdhānam ādigrahaṇād anyaśākair api kriyate || 12 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mūlakais tathā sarṣapādibhiḥ saṃdhitaṃ saṇḍākīnāmnī jñeyā || 12 ||

atha āsavāḥ - raktapittādau uśīrāsavaḥ -
uśīraṃ vālakaṃ padmaṃ kāśmarīṃ nīlam utpalam |
priyaṅguṃ padmakaṃ lodhraṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ dhanvayāsakam ||13 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīm āsavānāṃ prakārabhedam āha - uśīram iti | etad uśīrāsavavyākhyānaṃ subodham eva | māsaṃ māsaikaparyantaṃ sthāpayet saṃdhānavad ity arthaḥ | bhāṇḍe māṃsīmaricadhūpite iti | māṃsī jaṭākhyā bhāṇḍe sādhanapātre kecit tu atra māṃsīmaricacūrṇasya prakṣepam āhuḥ, raktapittam iti vyastaṃ militaṃ vā || 13-17||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. uśīraṃ bālakaṃ padmaṃ kamalaṃ, kāśmarī gambhārī, nīlam utpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, priyaṅgu, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, lodhraṃ prasiddhaṃ, mañjiṣṭhā, dhanvayāsakaṃ yavāsā, pāṭhā, bhūnimbaḥ, nyagrodho vaṭaḥ, udumbaro yajñīyavṛkṣaḥ, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, paṭolaṃ patraṃ, kāñcanāraṃ jambūlā, jambūśālmalīniryāsaḥ mocarasaḥ, etān pratyekān palasaṃmitān drākṣā viṃśatipalāni dhātakīpuṣpāṇi ṣoḍaśapalāni jaladroṇadvaye kṣipet, śarkarāyās tulāṃ palaśataṃ kṣaudrasya madhunas tulāṃ śatapalaṃ māṃsīmaricadhūpite bhāṇḍe māsam ekaṃ sthāpayet | uśīrāsavaḥ raktapittādiharaḥ | iti uśīrāsavaḥ || 13-17 ||

div.ab:
kumāryāsavaḥ --
(supakvarasasaṃśuddhaṃprakṣiptam | mākṣikaṃ madhu na tu mākṣikadhātu:, pakvalohaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ, cāturjātakaṃ cūrṇādhyāyoktaṃ, kramukaṃ pūgīphalaṃ, phalatrikaṃ harītakyādikaṃ, madhurasā drākṣā|| kumāryāḥ patram āharet || 18 ||
yatnena rasam ādāya pātre pāṣāṇamṛnmaye |
droṇe guḍatulāṃ dattvā ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||12 ||
mākṣikaṃ pakvalohaṃ ca tasminn ardhatulāṃ kṣipet |
kaṭutrikaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca cāturjātakam eva ca || 20||
citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī |
cavikaṃ hapuṣā dhānyaṃ kramukaṃ kaṭurohiṇī || 21 ||
mustā phalatrikaṃ rāsnā devadāru niśādvayam |
mūrvā madhurasā dantī mūlaṃ puṣkarasaṃbhavam || 22 ||
balā cātibalā caiva kapikacchūs trikaṇṭakam|
śatapuṣpā hiṅgupatrī ākallakam uṭiṅgaṇam || 23 ||
punarnavādvayaṃ lodhraṃ dhātumākṣikam eva ca |
eṣāṃ cārdhapalaṃ dattvā dhātakyās tu palāṣṭakam ||24||
palaṃ cārdhapalaṃ caiva paladvayam udāhṛtam |
vapurvayaḥpramāṇena balavarṇāgnidīpanam || 25 ||
bṛhaṇaṃ rocanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ paṅktiśūlanivāraṇam |
aṣṭāv udarajān rogān kṣayam ugraṃ ca nāśayet || 26 ||
viṃśatiṃ mehajān rogān udāvartam apasmṛtim |
mūtrakṛcchram apasmāraṃ śukradoṣaṃ tathāśmarīm || 27 ||
kṛmijaṃ raktapittaṃ ca nāśayet tu na saṃśayaḥ |)

lg.l: pippalī maricaṃ cavyaṃ haridrā citrako ghanaḥ ||28||
viḍaṅgaṃ kramuko lodhraḥ pāṭhā dhātry elavālukam |
uśīraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lavaṅgaṃ tagaraṃ tathā || 29 ||
palāni daśa dhātakyā drākṣā ṣaṣṭipalā bhavet ||31 ||
etāny ekatra saṃyojya mṛdbhāṇḍe ca vinikṣipet |
kṣayaṃ gulmodaraṃ kārśyaṃ grahaṇīṃ pāṇḍutāṃ gadam |
arśāṃsi nāśayec chīghraṃ pippalyādyāsavas tv ayam||33||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha pippalyāsavam āha - pippalīti | ayaṃ pippalyādyāsavaḥ kṣayādiroge praśastaḥ | atra ghano mustaṃ, kramukaḥ pūgīphalaṃ, dhātrī āmalakī, elavālukaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ gandhi kaṭphalasadṛśadravyaviśeṣaṃ, tvak varāṅgaṃ, śeṣaṃ prasiddham | śubhān iti ślakṣṇān vastragālitān ity arthaḥ | jñātvāgatarasam iti āgatarasaṃ jñātvā tadanu daṇḍena kṛtvā gharṣayet | paścād vastragālitaṃ prāpayet | eke māsenāgatarasaṃ bhavatīti vadanti samīcīnam etat | agnyapekṣayā agnibalāpekṣayā etad āturaviṣayaṃ, svasthānāṃ tu paribhāṣoktamātrayā pānaṃ | tad yathā -
‘dvāv añjalī hy uttamāyāṃ mātrā hīnā ca ṣaṭpalā |
catuṣpalā madhyamā ca grāhyā sānnaṃ ca sāmiṣam |
ato 'nyathā bhakṣaṇe hi śaradgrīṣmaṛtau tathā | śoṣādikaṃ prakurute vidhivat tena gṛhyate’ iti || 28-33 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ghano mustakaḥ, pūgīphalaṃ, dhātrī āmalakī, elavālukaṃ harivālukaṃ sugandhadravyaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, pallavaṃ patraṃ, eṣāṃ pippalyādīnām ardhapalāṃś cūrṇīkṛtān | jaladroṇadvaye kṣiptvā guḍatulātrayaṃ dadyāt | tulāpalaśataṃ dhātakyā daśapalāni drākṣā ṣaṣṭipalā etāni cātra yojyāni | mṛdbhāṇḍe vinikṣipet āgatarasaṃ prāptarasaṃ jñātvā agnyapekṣayā pāyayet | kṣayaṃ gulmādikaṃ ca nāśayet | ayaṃ pippalyāsavaḥ | iti pippalyāsavaḥ || 28-33 ||

pāṇḍvādau lohāsavaḥ |
lohacūrṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ triphalāṃ ca yavānikām |
viḍaṅgaṃ mustakaṃ citraṃ catuḥsaṃkhyāpalaṃ pṛthak || 34 ||

lg.l: lohāsavam amuṃ martyaḥ pibed vahnikaraṃ param |
kuṣṭhaṃ plīhāmayaṃ kaṇḍūṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ bhagandaram |
arocakaṃ ca grahaṇīṃ hṛdrogaṃ ca vināśayet || 38 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ lohāsavavivaraṇam āha - lohacūrṇam iti | imaṃ lohāsavaṃ martyaḥ puruṣaḥ pibet, yasmāt paraṃ vahnikaraṃ bhavati lohacūrṇam ayacūrṇaṃ, trikaṭukaṃ prasiddham | triphalāṃ harītakyādikaṃ catuṣpalamitaṃ, pṛthag iti pratyekaṃ kuḍavapramāṇam ity arthaḥ | ghṛtabhāṇḍa iti cikkaṇatvād dṛḍhatvāt | māsaikaṃ yāvat saṃdhitavyaṃ tato jātarasaṃ bhavati | dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍasya ca ( tulāṃ kṣipet) || 34-38 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha lohāsavaḥ | lohacūrṇādikaṃ pṛthak catuḥsaṃkhyāpalaṃ | citraṃ citrakaṃ, kṣaudraṃ madhu catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ guḍatulāṃ jaladroṇadvaye ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya māsamātraṃ sthāpayet | imaṃ lohāsavaṃ martyaḥ pibet | spaṣṭam anyat || 34-38 ||

div.ab:
mṛdvīkāriṣṭaḥ |
(mṛdvīkāyāḥprakṣiptam| tatra mṛdvīkā gostanīṃ, kesaraṃ nāgakesaram| palaśataṃ caturdroṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacet |
droṇaśeṣe suśīte ca pūte tasmin pradāpayet || 39 ||
tule dve kṣaudrakhaṇḍābhyāṃ dhātakyāḥ prastham eva ca |
kaṅkolakaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca phalaṃ jātyās tathaiva ca || 40 ||
palāṃśakaṃ ca maricatvagelāpatrakesaram |
pippalī citrakaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīmūlareṇuke || 41 ||
ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya candanāgarudhūpite |
karpūravāsito hy eṣa grahaṇyā dīpanaḥ paraḥ || 42 ||
arśasāṃ nāśane śreṣṭha udāvartasya gulmanut |
jaṭharakrimikuṣṭhāni vraṇās tu vividhās tathā || 43 ||
akṣirogaśirorogagalarogāṃś ca nāśayet |)

ab.seg:
athāriṣṭāḥ, tatrādau kuṭajāriṣṭaḥ jvarādau -
tulāṃ kuṭajamūlasya mṛdvīkārdhatulāṃ tathā || 44 ||

lg.l: dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍasya ca tulāṃ kṣipet |
jvarān praśamayet sarvān kuryāt tīkṣṇaṃ dhanañjayam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīm ariṣṭaṃ darśayann āha - tulām iti | ayaṃ kuṭajāriṣṭaḥ sarvajvarān hanti iti | sarvān iti aṣṭaprakārān | atha ca dhanañjayam agniṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pācanasāmarthyaṃ yathā syāt tathā kuryāt | atra kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, mṛdvīkā drākṣā, tulā palaśataṃ jñeyaṃ, madhūkapuṣpakāśmaryaphalānāṃ pṛthak daśapalāni deyāni | kāśmaryaphalābhāve challī grāhyā | etat sakalaṃ māsamātraṃ yāvat saṃdhitavyam || 44-46 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kuṭajamūlasya vatsakamūlasya tulāṃ palaśataṃ | mṛdvīkā drākṣā tasyā ardhatulāṃ pañcāśatpalāni, madhukadravā tatpuṣpaṃ, kāśmaryaṃ gambhārī, etau daśapalau bahuvacanaṃ puṣpāṇāṃ bahutvāt, ambhasaś caturdroṇaśeṣe kvāthe dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍasya ca tulāṃ śatapalaṃ kṣipet māsam ekaṃ ca sthāpayet | tataḥ pibet | ariṣṭaḥ kvāthasiddhatvāt kvāthakaraṇam || 44-46 ||

atha viḍaṅgāriṣṭaḥ vidradhyādau -
viḍaṅgaṃ granthikaṃ rāsnā kuṭajatvakphalāni ca || 47 ||

lg.l: pūte śīte kṣipet tatra kṣaudraṃ palaśatatrayam |
vyoṣasya ca palāny aṣṭau cūrṇīkṛtya pradāpayet ||50||
tataḥ pibed yathārhaṃ tu jayed vidradhim utthitam || 52||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha viḍaṅgāriṣṭam āha - viḍaṅgam iti | eṣa viḍaṅgāriṣṭo vidradhiprabhṛtīn rogān jayet | tatrāśmarīrogaṃ | dravyāṇi tu granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ | kecid granthikasthāne kramukam iti paṭhanti tatra kramukaṃ pūgīphalaṃ, rāsnā surabhī, phalānīti kuṭajaphalāni, pāṭhā ambaṣṭhā, elavālukaṃ prasiddham, dhātrī āmalakī etat pṛthak pañcapalaparimitaṃ pūte vastragālite śīte himasparśe | śītagrahaṇam atra madhumelanatvāt | ‘uṣṇair virudhyate madhu’ iti vacanāt | trijātam iti trisugandhaṃ vikhyātaṃ,tac ca militvā dvipalam ity arthaḥ | vyoṣasya trikaṭukasya militvā'ṣṭau palāni | kartavyatā'sya vyavahārato boddhavyā | yathārham iti yathāyogyaṃ tena doṣāgnyapekṣayā dātavyam ity arthaḥ ||47-52 ||

atha devadārvyādyariṣṭaḥ pramehādau -
tulārdhaṃ devadāroḥ syād vāsā ca palaviṃśati: |
mañjiṣṭhendrayavā dantī tagaraṃ rajanīdvayam || 53 ||

lg.l: rāsnā kṛmighnaṃ mustaṃ ca śirīṣaṃ khadirārjunau |
bhāgān daśapalān dadyād yavānyā vatsakasya ca || 54 ||
candanasya guḍūcyāś ca rohiṇyāś citrakasya ca |
droṇaśeṣe kaṣāye ca pūte śīte pradāpayet |
māsādūrdhvaṃ pibed enaṃ pramehaṃ hanti durjayam || 458 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha devadārvādikāriṣṭam āha - tulārdham iti | devadāror iti ṣaṣṭhyantatvāt kāṣṭhaṃ grāhyaṃ, vāsā āṭarūṣakas tasya mūlaṃ grāhyaṃ, indrayavāḥ kuṭajabījāni, dantī prasiddhā, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, rajanīdvayaṃ haridrādvayaṃ, rāsnā prasiddhā, kṛmighnaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ, śirīṣo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, khadiro 'pi vṛkṣaḥ, arjuna iti ca vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, etat sakalaṃ pṛthak daśapalaparimitam| sakalam iti mañjiṣṭhādi arjunāntaṃ yamānyādicitrakāntaṃ pṛthak cāṣṭapalamitaṃ tatra vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ rohiṇī kaṭukīśabdavācyā pūte vastragālite śīte śītībhūte vyoṣasya militvā dvipalaṃ trijātasyāpi militvā catuṣpalāni| trijātaṃ trisugandhaṃ | priyaṅgor iti phalāni | eṣa pūrvayuktyā kartavyaḥ dṛṣṭavyavahāreṇa vā ||53-59||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kṛmighnaṃ viḍaṅgam, arjunaṃ arjunavṛkṣaḥ, vatsakasya kuṭajasya, candanasya raktasya, rohiṇyā kaṭurohiṇyā aṣṭadroṇe jale | spaṣṭam anyat || 53-59 ||

atha khadirāriṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhādau -
khadirasya tulārdhaṃ tu devadāru ca tatsamam |
bākucī dvādaśapalā dārvī syāt palaviṃśatiḥ || 60 ||

lg.l: kaṣāye droṇaśeṣe ca pūte śīte vinikṣipet || 61 ||
gulmaṃ granthiṃ kṛmīn kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ plīhodaraṃ jayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha khadirāriṣṭam āha - khadirasyeti | khadiraḥ prasiddhaḥ tathāsya sāro grāhyaḥ, devadāroḥ kāṣṭhaṃ tatsamam iti khadirasāraparimāṇaṃ, bākucī somarājī tasyāḥ phalāni dārvī dāruharidrā, triphalā harītakīprabhṛtikaphalatrayaṃ tac ca militvā viṃśatipalāni etat sakalaṃ saṃkuṭya aṣṭadroṇe pānīye saṃkvāthya droṇaśeṣaṃ grāhyam | tatra vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇi prakṣipet | tāni kāni ity atrāha - mākṣikasya madhunaḥ tulaiketi | tulā palaśatam iti | dhānakyā iti dhātakīkusumāni, kaṃkolaṃ prasiddham, tvag varāṅgaṃ | kṛṣṇā pippalī tasyāḥ palacatuṣṭayaṃ | ghṛtabhāṇḍe iti | ghṛtāvalipte bhāṇḍe iti vā yojyam | eṣa khadirāriṣṭaḥ kuṣṭheṣv api prasiddhaḥ || 60-65 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bākucī bakucī, dārvī dāruharidrā, kaṃkolaṃ maricakaṃkolaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat || 60-65 ||

atha babbūlāriṣṭaḥ kṣayakāsādau --
tulādvayaṃ tu babbūlyāś caturdroṇe jale pacet |
droṇaśeṣe rase śīte guḍasya ca tulāṃ kṣipet ||66||

lg.l: dhātakīṃ ṣoḍaśapalāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ca dvipalāṃ tathā |
māsaṃ bhāṇḍe sthitas tv eṣa babbūlāriṣṭako jayet|| 68||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha babbūlāriṣṭam āha - tulādvayaṃ ceti | babbūlaḥ kaṇṭakīvṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | tasya tvag grāhyā, kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇapippalī, śeṣaṃ sugamam | kartavyatā'sya pūrvavat || 66-68 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. babbūlyā babbūlatvacaḥ tulādvayaṃ dviśatapalāni caturdroṇajale pacet, pādaśeṣe tulāṃ guḍasya kṣipet | spaṣṭam anyat || 66-38 ||

atha drākṣāriṣṭaḥ puṣṭyādau -
drākṣātulārdhaṃ dvidroṇe jalasya vipacet sudhīḥ || 69 ||

lg.l: pādaśeṣe kaṣāye ca pūte śīte vinikṣipet |
priyaṅgur maricaṃ kṛṣṇā viḍaṅgaṃ ceti cūrṇayet |
pṛthak palonmitair bhāgais tato bhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||71||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha drākṣāriṣṭam āha - drākṣeti | samantato ghaṭṭayitveti samantataḥ sarvataḥ saṅgharṣayed ity arthaḥ | jātarasam iti māsam ekaṃ yāvad bhavati tāvad saṃdhitaṃ dhārayet tasmāj jātarasaṃ bhavati | malaśodhano vātādīnāṃ śodhanaḥ purīṣādiśodhano vā, śeṣaṃ sugamam || 69-72 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. drākṣātulārdhaṃ jalasya dvidroṇe pacet pādaśeṣe kaṣāye sati pūte vastrapūte śīte vā guḍasya dvitulāṃ kṣipet samantataḥ mudrayitvā jātarasaṃ pibet ||69-72||

atha rohitakāriṣṭaḥ gudajagrahaṇyādau -
rohitakatulām ekāṃ caturdroṇe jale pacet || 73 ||

lg.l: pañcakolaṃ trijātaṃ ca triphalāṃ ca vinikṣipet |
māsādūrdhvaṃ ca pibatāṃ gudajā yānti sakṣayam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha rohitakāriṣṭam āha - rohitako vṛkṣaviśeṣo vikhyātaḥ tasya mūlatvak grāhyā, pādaśeṣe droṇāvaśiṣṭe rase kvāthe pūte vastragālite śīte himasparśe palaśatadvayam iti tulādvayaṃ guḍasyety anvayaḥ | pañcakolam iti | pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ, cavyaṃ, citrakaṃ, nāgaram iti pañcakolam, trijātam iti trisugandhaṃ tac ca elātvakpatrakaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ etat pañcakolaprabhṛdikaṃ pṛthak palaparimitaṃ grāhyaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam || || 73-76 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rohitakaṃ rohiṣatṛṇaḥ, pañcakolaṃ pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ cavyacitrakanāgarair iti, trijātaṃ elātvakpatrajam iti, triphalā harītakyādikā || 73 -76 ||

atha daśamūlāriṣṭaḥ vātādau -
(parṇyau bṛhatyau gokaṇṭo bilvo 'gnimanthako 'raluḥ || 77 ||
pāṭhalā kāśmarī ceti daśamūlam ihocyate |
) daśamūlāni kurvīta bhāgaiḥ pañcapalaiḥ pṛthak || 78 ||
pañcaviṃśatpalaṃ kuryāc citrakaṃ pauṣkaraṃ tathā |
kuryād viṃśatpalaṃ lodhraṃ guḍūcī tatsamā bhavet ||79 ||
palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir dhātrī ravisaṃkhyair durālabhā |
khadiro bījasāraś ca pathyā ceti pṛthak palaiḥ || 80 ||
aṣṭabhir gaṇitaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ mañjiṣṭhā devadāru ca |
viḍaṅgaṃ madhukaṃ bhārgī kapittho 'kṣaḥ punarnavā || 81 ||
cavyaṃ māṃsī priyaṅguś ca sārivā kṛṣṇajīrakam |
trivṛtā reṇukaṃ rāsnā pippalī kramukaḥ śaṭhī ||82 ||
haridrā śatapuṣpā ca padmakaṃ nāgakeśaram |
mustam indrayavaḥ śuṇṭhī jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||83||
medā cānyā mahāmedā kākolyau ṛddhivṛddhike |
kuryāt pṛthag vipalikān paced aṣṭaguṇe jale || 84 ||
caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā mṛdbhāṇḍe saṃnidhāpayet |
tataḥ ṣaṣṭipalāṃ drākṣāṃ pacen nīre caturguṇe || 85 ||
tripādaśeṣaṃ śītaṃ ca pūrvakvāthe śṛtaṃ kṣipet |
dvātriṃśatpalikaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyād guḍacatuḥśatam || 364 ||
triṃśatpalāni dhātakyāḥ kaṅkolaṃ jalacandanam |
jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca tvagelāpatrakeśaram || 87 ||
pippalī ceti saṃcūrṇya bhāgair dvipalikaiḥ pṛthak |
śāṇamātrāṃ ca kastūrīṃ sarvam ekatra nikṣipet ||88||
bhūmau nikhātayed bhāṇḍaṃ tato jātarasaṃ pibet |
katakasya phalaṃ kṣiptvā rasaṃ nirmalatāṃ nayet ||89||
grahaṇīm aruciṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ gulmaṃ bhagandaram |
vātavyādhiṃ kṣayaṃ chardiṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca kāmalām ||90||
kuṣṭhāny arśāṃsi mehāṃś ca mandāgnim udarāṇi ca |
śarkarām aśmarīṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ dhātukṣayaṃ jayet || 91 ||
kṛśānāṃ puṣṭijanano vandhyānāṃ garbhadaḥ paraḥ |
ariṣṭo daśamūlākhyas tejaḥśukrabalapradaḥ ||92|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe āsavāriṣṭakalpanā nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha daśamūlāriṣṭam āha – daśamūlāni kurvīteti | daśamūlaṃ vikhyātam eva | tathā hi - ‘parṇyau bṛhatyau gokaṇṭo bilvo 'gnimanthano 'ralu: | pāṭalā kāśmarī ceti daśamūlam ihocyate’ iti | tac ca pṛthak pañcapalamitaṃ bhavati | militvā pañcāśatpalāni ity arthaḥ | puṣkaraṃ tatheti puṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ tadabhāve kuṣṭhaṃ grāhyam | tatheti grahaṇenaitad api pañcaviṃśatipalamitaṃ syāt | guḍūcī tatsamā bhaved iti | tatsamā lodhraparimāṇasamā tena viṃśatipalapramāṇeyam api boddhavyā | ravisaṃkhyair durālabheti durālabho dhanvayāsakaḥ | sa ca ravisaṃkhyair dvādaśakaiḥ palair iti śeṣaḥ | khadiraḥ khadirasāraḥ, bījasāraḥ, raktapītako vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, pathyā harītakī etat trayaṃ pṛthak palāṣṭakaṃ deyaṃ kuṣṭhapūrvakaṃ vṛddhiprāptaṃ dravyaṃ pañcatriṃśadgaṇitaṃ ca pṛthak dvipalapramāṇaṃ jñeyam | tatra madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, ikṣur atra ikṣurasaḥ etan na pracarati | tatra ‘kapittho 'kṣaḥ, punarnavā’ iti pāṭhaḥ | tenākṣaḥ vibhītakaṃ, priyaṅgur latāviśeṣaḥ, sārivā āsphotā, trivṛn niśothaḥ, reṇukā svanāmataḥ khyātā, kramukaḥ pūgīphalaṃ, śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ na tu kamalam | ihāṣṭavarge 'syāprasiddhatvāt| samadravyāṇi yojyāni | aṣṭaguṇe jala iti sakalakvāthyadravyaparimāṇāt | śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ pādaśeṣam | tataḥ iti paścāt | ṣaṣṭipalamitāṃ drākṣāṃ caturguṇe pānīye kvāthayitvā tripādaśeṣaṃ grāhyaṃ pādahīnam ity arthaḥ | caturguṇatā'tra drākṣāparimāṇāt etad api pūrvakvāthe kṣiped ity arthaḥ | dadyād guḍacatuḥśatam iti | guḍasya tulācatuṣkaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | kaṃkolaprabhṛtipippalīparyavasānaṃ daśadravyaṃ pṛthak dvipalamitaṃ bhavati tatra jalaṃ vālakaṃ, candanaṃ śvetam | jātarasaḥ jātarasatā'tra tatkarmakārakasakāśād avagantavyā | katakaphalaprakṣepaṃ tannirmalārtham | idānīm ete ariṣṭādayo 'pi kacchapayantreṇa sādhitā dṛśyante tadguṇā eva bhavanti ca atas tajjñāpanārthaṃ yantravidhim āha -
‘āsavādikam uktaṃ yat sandhānaṃ ced vipācayet |
kacchapekacchapayantraṃ ‘bhaṭṭī’ śabdavācyam | bhiṣajāṃ śreṣṭhas tadguṇaṃ tasya nirdiśet |
samyak pakvaṃ tato jñātvā nyased yantre prasādhayet |
dravyaṃ saugandhikaṃ yac ca nyaset paścāc ca pātayet |
dhārā'dho dāpayed anyaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca kuṅkumam |
tenāsau tu bhaven nūnaṃ sugandhaś ca manoramaḥ |
kledadāhādidoṣaṃ yac chīghraṃ tenopaśāmyati | iti
āsavādikasidhyartham ayam eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ|
kāñcane rājate pātre kāce vāpi manohare | rakṣaṇīyaḥ prayatnena vṛddhavaidyopadeśataḥ’ iti | saugandhikaṃ dravyam iti candanādi prabhṛtikaṃ nyased iti | ‘saṃdhānapātre kecid āsavādikam uktaṃ yat’ ityādi pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti ākṣepako 'yam iti vadanti yato bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate ||77 -92 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe saṃdhānakalpanādhyāyo daśamaḥ || 10 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. parṇyau śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī, bṛhatyau kaṇṭakārīdvayaṃ kṣudrā bṛhatī ca, gokaṇṭakaḥ gokṣuraḥ, bilvaḥ, agnimanthaḥ araṇiḥ, araluḥ syonākaḥ, pāṭalā, kāśmarī gambhārī, idaṃ daśaṃmūlaṃ daśamūlāni pañcapalaiḥ, pratyekam ardhapalaṃ, pañcaviśatpalaṃ citrakaḥ tāvat, puṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ, guḍūcī viṃśatpalā, dhātrī āmalakī ṣoḍaśapalaiḥ, durālabhā yavāsā ravisaṃkhyair dvādaśapalaiḥ, khadiraḥ, vijayasāraḥ, pampā harītakī, ete pṛthak aṣṭabhiḥ palair gaṇitāḥ | kuṣṭhādyai: ṛddhivṛddhyantaiḥ pṛthak dvipalaiḥ | granthāntare -
‘āsavādikam uktaṃ yat saṃdhānaṃ ced vipācitaṃ |
kacchape bhiṣajā śreṣṭhaṃ tadguṇaṃ tasya nirdiśet |
samyak pakvaṃ tato jñātvā nyased yaṃtre prasādhayet |
dravyaṃ saugandhikaṃ yac ca nyaset paścāc ca pācayet |
dhārādho dāpayen nūnaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca kuṃkumam |
tena saumyaṃ bhaven nūnaṃ sugandhaṃ ca manoramam |
kledadāhādidoṣaṃ yat śīghraṃ tenopaśāmyati |
āsavādikasiddhyartham ayam eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
kāñcane rajate pātre kāce vāpi manohare | rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena ādivaidyopadeśataḥ’ iti | āsavādyariṣṭasattvapātanam || 77-92 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne āsavāriṣṭādhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

div.head: atha dhātuśodhanamāraṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ | athedānīṃ dhātūnāṃ samudāyena śodhanamāraṇaṃ darśayann āha -
svarṇatārāratāmrāṇi nāgavaṅgau ca tīkṣṇakam |
dhātavaḥ sapta vijñeyās tatas tān śodhayed budhaḥ ||1||

idānīṃ tacchodhanamāraṇam āha --
svarṇatārāratāmrāyaḥpatrāṇy agnau pratāpayet| |
niṣiñcet taptataptāni taile takre ca kāñjike || 2 ||

lg.l: gomūtre ca kulatthānāṃ kaṣāye ca tridhā tridhā |
nāgavaṅgau prataptau ca gālitau tau niṣiṃcayet |
tridhā tridhā viśuddhiḥ syād ravidugdhena ca tridhā ||4||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. tāvat pūrvaṃ tatsaṃkhyāha yathā svarṇeti | svarṇāditīkṣṇāntāḥ sapta dhātavo vijñeyāḥ | viśeṣeṇa sapta dhātavo boddhavyā: | yatas tantrāntare aṣṭa dhātava iti manyante tatrā'ṣṭadhā lohasaṃjñā | tathā hi -
‘svarṇaṃ tāraṃ tāmranāgaṃ raṅgaṃ kāntaṃ ca tīkṣṇakaṃ |
muṇḍāntam aṣṭadhā lohaṃ kāṃsyāraṃ ghoṣakaṃ tridhā | upalohaṃ samākhyātam’ ityādi | tatas tān śodhayed adha iti budhas tadviśeṣajñaḥ | tān svarṇādīn atra svarṇaṃ prasiddham, tāraṃ raupyam, āraṃ pītalohaṃ tac ca tāmraghoṣabhedābhyāṃ saṃjātam ity eke bhāṣante | atraiva ghoṣabhedo loke jasada iti vācyaḥ | śivamate tu devajātatvena ṣaḍ eva grāhyāḥ | tathā hi -
śivasya tejaḥ prathito rasendro devībhavaṃ gandham athābhrakaṃ ca |
śulvaṃ tu sūryasya sahasraraśmeś candrasya raupyaṃ parameśvarasya || hemaṃ tu viṣṇoḥ prabhavaṃ vadanti nāgaṃ ca nāgasya tu vāsukeś ca | lohaṃ yamasyaiva tu kālamūrter vaṅgaṃ ca śukrasya purāvido budhāḥ’ iti | tasmād ārasaṃjñas tv aupādhikaḥ || 1 ||

svarṇeti | suvarṇādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ patrāṇi kṛtvā tāni cāgnau punaḥ saṃtaptāni kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇadravyeṣu tridhā trivelaṃ yathā syān niṣiṃcayet pratyekam iti śeṣaḥ | evaṃ suvarṇādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ viśuddhir bhavati svarṇādilohānam iti grahaṇena tīkṣṇādīnām api śuddhir evaṃ boddhavyā | atra tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavaṃ ca takraṃ tribhāgabhinnaṃ kāñjikaṃ prasiddham kulattho 'nnaviśeṣaḥ | atha nāgavaṅgayor viśeṣaśuddhiṃ darśayan āha - nāgeti | prataptāv ity agnau saṃtāpitau ata eva gālitāv iti dravībhūtau kṛtvā tair niṣiñcayed itihaṃḍikāyāṃ dravāṇi pūrayitvā haṃḍikāmukhe ‘cilama’ saṃjñakaṃ dhūmrapānayantroparyagnipātramadhonālīṃ kṛtvā bandhayet, tacchidreṇaiva nāgavaṅgau punaḥpunaḥ nirvāpyau na tu drāvite vaṅge dravāṇi sphuṭatayā niṣiṃcayet | utplutya hi tau upadravaṃ kurutaḥ | , taiḥ pūrvoktatailatakrādidravaiḥ, tridhā tridheti pratyekaṃ tailādi- bhir niṣiñcayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | viśeṣam api na kevalaṃ pūrvoktadravyair niṣiñcayet kiṃtu ravidugdhenārkakṣīreṇā'pi tridhā kṛtvā śodhayed iti pūrvaśodhanād ayam eva viśeṣaḥ || 2-4 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha dhātuśodhanam | svarṇādayaḥ ete saptadhātavo vijñeyās tān budhaḥ taddoṣaniḥsāraṇārthaṃ śodhayet | tāraḥ raupyam iti, pittalo nāgaḥ, sīsakaḥ sīsakaṃ, tīkṣṇaloham || 1 ||

atha dhātuśodhanaṃ | svarṇādidhātūnāṃ patrāṇi tailādau tridhā trivāraṃ agnau pratāpayet taptvā taptvā niṣiṃcayet nirvāpayet | evaṃ svarṇādilohānāṃ śuddhiḥ saṃprajāyate | nāgavaṅgayor viśeṣeṇa śodhanam āha - tadā viśuddhiḥ syāt| nanu pittalaḥ kṛtrimas tat kathaṃ sapta ? -- ucyante, eke yaśadena saha sapta āhuḥ | tathā ca ‘svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ ca tāmraṃ ca raṅgaṃ yaśadam eva ca | sīsaṃ lohaṃ ca saptaite dhātavo girisambhavā iti | athaṃ svarṇādidhātumāraṇaṃ tatrādau śārṅgadharānuktam api svarṇotpattibhedaśuddhāśuddhalakṣaṇam āha - athotpattiḥ
‘purā nijāśramasthānāṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ jitātmanāṃ |
patnyo vilokya lāvaṇyaṃ lakṣmīsampannayauvanāḥ ||
kandarpadarpavidhvastacetaso jātavedasaḥ |
patitaṃ yad dharāpṛṣṭhe retaḥ sauvarṇatām agāt ||’ atha bhedāḥ
‘prākṛtaṃ sahajaṃ vahnisaṃbhūtaṃ khanijaṃ tathā |
rasendravedhasaṃjātaṃ svarṇaṃ pañcavidhaṃ mataṃ ||
brahmāṇḍaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ yena durlabhaṃ prākṛtaṃ hi tat |
brahmavrataṃ tu sahajaṃ vahnijaṃ parikīrtitam |
etatsvarṇatrayaṃ divyaṃ varṇair yac cāśubhir yutaṃ |
dhāraṇād eva tat kuryāc charīram ajarāmaraṃ ||
khanijaṃ khananāj jātaṃ vedhajaṃ rasavedhataḥ |
tac caturdaśavarṇāḍhyaṃ bhakṣitaṃ sarvarogajit’ || athāśuddhasvarṇaparīkṣā -
‘śvetāṅgaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ vivarṇaṃ ca samardalam |
dāhe cchede sitaṃ śvetaṃ gharṣe cāpi malaṃ tyajet’ ||2-4||

atha svarṇamāraṇam --
svarṇāñ ca dviguṇaṃ sūtam amlena saha mardayet |
tadgolakasamaṃ gandhaṃ nidadhyād adharottaram || 5 ||

lg.l: nirutthaṃ jāyate bhasma gandho deyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha dhātumadhye svarṇamāraṇam āha - svarṇāc ceti | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ tac ca suvarṇaparimāṇāt dviguṇaṃ grāhyam | amlena bījapūrādinā tadgolakasamaṃ gandham iti tat svarṇapāradakṛtena golakena sāmyaṃ śodhitagandhakaṃ saṃgṛhya tadgolakasyādhaḥ upari ca datvā śarāvasaṃpuṭe saṃdhārya puṭed iti granthābhiprāyaḥ | sampradāye kiñcid gandhakaṃ datvā golakaṃ kāryaṃ paścāt śeṣaṃ gandham upari deyam | dṛḍhasaṃpuṭa iti | dṛḍhagrahaṇena mṛtkarpaṭakaṃ sūcyate tena mṛtkarpaṭakenā'tra dṛḍhatā kāryā | evaṃ caturdaśapuṭaiḥ kṛtvā nirutthaṃ jāyate suvarṇam iti śeṣaḥ | nirutthatā'trātyarthamūrcchanā kathyate na tu svarṇasya mṛtir bhavatiādhunikā rasāyanaśāstrajñāḥ svarṇasyātyantamūrcchanaiva bhavati na tu bhasma iti vadanti | vividhaprakāraiḥ niṣpannasvarṇavibhūte rasāyanaśāstrato viśleṣaṇāt parīkṣāyāṃ jīvatyeva | kevalaṃ tu cikkaṇaprastara(saṅgamarmara) caṇakāmlalavaṇayogataścotpannaṃ svarṇāmlaṃ nirutthaṃ bhavati iti vadanti | | puṭam atra triṃśadvanopalaiḥ kṛtvā deyam | tac ca kukkuṭapuṭasaṃjñayā vihitam | vanopalaṃ śuṣkagomayam, tac ca karaṇḍāśabdavācyam | gandho deyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ iti | śuddhagandhakaṃ ca pūrvoktavidhānena pratyekaṃ puṭaṃ yojyam ity arthaḥ || 5 || 6 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svarṇasya bhūrjavat patrīkṛtasya kuṭṭanenety arthaḥ | sūtaṃ śuddhaṃ hiṅgulotthaṃ vā dviguṇam amlena nimbukādirasena saha mardayet | tadgolakasamaṃ gandhakam adharottaraṃ dadyāt ūrdhvādhaḥ sa eva madhye mudrayitvā triṃśadvanopalaiḥ puṭet | evaṃ caturdaśapuṭāt nirūtthaṃ jāyate | gandhakas tulyaḥ puṭe puṭe deyaḥ || 5 || 6||

ab.seg:
athāparo vidhiḥ-
kāñcane gālite nāgaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśena nikṣipet || 7 ||

lg.l: cūrṇayitvā tathāmlena ghṛṣṭvā kṛtvā ca golakam |
evaṃ saptapuṭair hema nirūtthaṃ bhasma jāyate || 9 ||

ab.seg:
anyac ca svarṇamāraṇam āha -
kāñcanārarasair ghṛṣṭvā samasūtakagandhayoḥ |
kajjalyā hemapatrāṇi lepayet samamātrayā || 10 ||

lg.l: nidhāya saṃdhirodhaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃśoṣya kokilaiḥ |
vahniṃ kharataraṃ kuryād evaṃ dadyāt puṭatrayam || 12 ||

ab.seg:
jvālāmukhī yathā hanyāt tathā hanti manaḥśilā | athānyad api svarṇamāraṇaprakāram āha -
śilāsindūrayoś cūrṇaṃ samayor arkadugdhakaiḥ ||14||

lg.l: saptaiva bhāvanā dadyāc choṣayec ca punaḥ punaḥ |
tatas tu gālite hemni kalko 'yaṃ dīyate samaḥ || 15||
punar dhamed atitarāṃ yathā kalko vilīyate |
evaṃ velātrayaṃkṣāratrayaṃ iti pā. | dadyāt kalkaṃ hemamṛtir bhavet || 16 ||

ab.seg:
athānyaprakāram āha -
pārāvatamalair limped athavā kukkuṭodbhavaiḥ |
hemapatrāṇi teṣāṃ ca pradadyād antarāntaram ||17 ||

lg.l: evaṃ navapuṭān dadyād daśamaṃ ca mahāpuṭam |
(suvarṇaṃkecidimaṃ na paṭhanti | ca bhavet svādu tiktaṃ snigdhaṃ himaṃ guru |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. aparam api svarṇamāraṇam āha - kāñcana iti | kāñcane svarṇe gālite drāvite sati tatra nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ nikṣipet ṣoḍaśāṃśena kāñcanaparimāṇāt nāgaṃ grāhyam | amlaṃ mātuluṅgapratīkaṃ | adharottaram iti | golakasyopari cādhaś ca gandhakaṃ deyam | saṃpuṭavidhānaṃ ca pūrvavat kāryam | kecid atra vanopalair viṃśatisaṃkhyakair eva manyante evam ity anena prakāreṇa saptapuṭaiḥ kṛtvā hemabhasma bhavati ||7-5||

kāñcanāreti | kāñcanāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tasya patrāṇāṃ tvaco vā rasaḥ svarasaḥ, sūtakaḥ pāradaḥ gandhakaś ca samānas tayoḥ kajjalī kāryeti sambandhaḥ | hemapatrāṇi svarṇapatrāṇi samamātrayeti | tayā kajjalyā samayā svarṇapatraparimāṇayā śeṣaṃ vidhānaṃ pūrvavat | kokilair iti śuṣkagomayasaṃjñaiḥ aṅgārair vā yataḥ vahniṃ kharataraṃ kuryād iti grahaṇāt evam ity amunā prakāreṇa puṭatrayam ity atrāgner boddhavyam | athavā kāñcanāraprakāreṇa lāṅgalīprakāram api jānīyāt | lāṅgalī kalihārī, athavā jvālāmukhīprakāram api kāñcanāraprakāravad boddhavyam| jvālāmukhī jayantī sā caturvidhā bhavati ‘śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā jvālāmukhī bhavet’ iti | etajjāticatuṣṭayaṃ śvetā raktā raktādikusumaiḥ kṛtvā jānīyāt || 10-13 | śileti | śilā manaḥśilā, sindūraḥ prasiddhaḥ, samayoḥ samānamānayoḥ, bhāvanāparimāṇaṃ ca yāvad dravyaṃ plutaṃ bhavati gālite pradrāvite hemni suvarṇe kalko 'yam iti | ayaṃ kalkaḥ śilāsiṃdūrajaḥ | kalkagrahaṇena sāndro yojyaḥ | sama iti | svarṇamānasamaḥ kalka evam ity amunā prakāreṇa velātrayaṃ trivāram ity arthaḥ || 14-16 ||

pārāvateti | pārāvataḥ prasiddhaḥ malaṃ purīṣaṃ liṃpet iti hemapatrāṇīty arthaḥ | athavā kukkuṭodbhavair iti kukkuṭas tāmracūḍaḥ tadudbhavair malair iti sambandhaḥ, teṣāṃ svarṇapatrāṇām antarāntarāntaraṃ yathā syāt tathā svarṇapatrasamaṃ gandhakacūrṇaṃ deyaṃ tāni ca śarāvayugmasaṃpuṭe dhṛtvā tatsaṃpuṭaṃ kukkuṭapuṭavidhānena pācyam, pañcabhir gomayopalair iti pañcasaṃkhyākaiḥ śuṣkagomayaiḥ evam ity anena prakāreṇa navasaṃkhyākāni puṭāni dadyāt | daśamaṃ ca mahāpuṭam iti mahāpuṭaṃ triṃśadvanopalaiḥ kṛtvā deyam || 17-20 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kāñcane svarṇe gālite nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśena nikṣipet | tac cūrṇayitvā amlena ghṛṣṭvā golakaṃ kṛtvā samaṃ gandhakaṃ ūrdhvādhaḥ śarāvasaṃpuṭe pūrvavat || 7-9 ||
anyac ca kāñcanārarasaiḥ samasūtakagandhayoḥ kajjalī hemapatrāṇi lepayet | samamātrayā svarṇasamamātrayā, spaṣṭam anyat || 10-13 ||

anyad api svarṇamāraṇaṃ | śilā manaḥśilā sindūraṃ tayoḥ samayos tulyayoś cūrṇam arkadugdhaṃ dadyāt | dhamet tato hemni dugdhakaiḥ samaiva bhāgato dadyāt dhamet tato hemni gālite samaḥ hemasamaḥ kalkaḥ dīyeta tato dhamet | yathā kalko na tiṣṭhati evaṃ kṣāratrayaṃ dadyāt svarṇamṛtir bhavet || 14-16 ||

tathā ca pārāvateti sugamam | anyac ca granthāntarāt | daradaṃ hiṃgulaṃ svarṇatulyaṃ nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ mṛtanāgacūrṇaṃ vajrīkṣīreṇa marditam asya madhye suvarṇasya kalkaś ca mriyate iti svarṇamāraṇam || 17-20 ||

idānīṃ raupyamāraṇaṃ prakaṭayann āha -
bhāgaikaṃ tālakaṃ mardyaṃ jambenāmlena kenacit |
tena bhāgatrayaṃ tārapatrāṇi parilepayet || 21 ||

lg.l: samuddhṛtya punas tālaṃ dattvā ruddhvā puṭe pacet || 22 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. bhāgaikam iti | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ bhāgaikaṃ tārapatrabhāgād ity arthaḥ, jambena jambīrakarasena amlagrahaṇaṃ madhurajambīraniṣedhārthaṃ, kenacid ity anena kenāpy amlena vā kutaḥ jambīrābhāvāt tena cukrādikam api grāhyam, tena tālakena saha bhāgatrayam iti tārapatrāṇi raupyapatrāṇi pralepayet bhāgatrayaṃ tālakaparimāṇāt puṭavidhānaṃ pūrvavat triṃśadvanopalair ity anena mahāpuṭaṃ darśitam | evam ity uktapuṭavidhānena caturdaśapuṭakaṃ boddhavyam || 21 || 22 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha rajatotpattibhedān āha granthāntarāt -
‘tripurasya vadhārthāya nirnimeṣair vilocanaiḥ |
nirīkṣayāmāsa śivaḥ krodhena paripūritaḥ ||
tatas tūlkābhisamaye tasmāt kasmāc ca locanāt |
tato rudraḥ samabhavad vaiśvānara iva jvalan || dvitīyasmāt paraṃ netrād daśabindus tu krāmukāt | tasmād rajatam udbhūtaṃ śukrakarmasu saṃsthitam’ iti | atha tadbhedāḥ -
‘sahajaṃ khanisaṃbhūtaṃ kṛtrimaṃ ca tridhā mataṃ |
rajataṃ pūrvapūrvaṃ hi svaguṇair uttarottaraṃ |
kṛtrimaṃ rasavādotthaṃ kiṃ vā rāmapadodbhavaṃ |
ni:kalmaṣaṃ prabhāhīnaṃ dāhe cchede sitaṃ śubhaṃ | aśuddhaṃ sarvathā śodhyaṃ nāgaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaiḥ? iti | atha māraṇaṃ bhāgaikam iti | spaṣṭam anyat || 21 || 22 |

ab.seg:
aparam api tāramāraṇam āha -
snuhīkṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭaṃ mākṣikaṃ tena lepayet || 23 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. snuhīkṣīreṇeti | pūrvoktaharitālavidhānavan mākṣikavidhānena kṛtvā caturdaśapuṭāni yāvat bhavanti tāvat tāraṃ raupyaṃ bhasma syāt | mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ snuhīkṣīreṇeti snuhī sehuṇḍabhedaḥ || 23 || 24 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyac ca | snuhīkṣīreṇa sehuṇḍadugdhena saṃpiṣṭamākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ mūtrādau śuddhaṃ tālakasya prakāreṇa bhāgaikatārapatrāṇi vibhāgaṃ trilepayet punaḥ mūṣāsaṃpuṭena ruddhvā caturdaśapuṭaiḥ puṭet | tāraṃ bhasma prajāyate | granthāntare pāradena māraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tad api likhyate tathā ca ‘vidhāya piṣṭaṃ sūtena rajatasyātha melayet| | tālaṃ gandhaṃ samaṃ paścān mardayen nimbukadravaiḥ | dvitripuṭair bhaved bhasma yojyam etad rasādiṣu’ iti | atha guṇāḥ
‘rūpyaṃ śītaṃ kaṣāyāmlaṃ svādupākarasaṃ saraṃ |
vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ snigdhaṃ lekhanaṃ vātapittajit |
pramehādikarogāṃś ca nāśayaty aciraṃ dhruvam || 23 || 24 ||

ab.seg:
pītalohamāraṇam āha -
arkakṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭo gandhakas tena lepayet |
samenārasya patrāṇi śuddhāny amladravair muhuḥ || 25 ||

lg.l: tato mūṣāpuṭe dhṛtvā puṭed gajapuṭena ca |

ab.seg:
āravat kāṃsyam apy evaṃ bhasmatāṃ yāti niścitam | aparam apy āha -
arkakṣīravadājaṃarkakṣīraṃ vaṭakṣīraṃ nirguṇḍī kṣīrikā tathā i. pā. | syāt kṣīranirguṇḍikā tathā || 27 ||

Āḍhamalla. arkakṣīreṇeti | āraṃ pītalohaṃ tac ca tāmrasaṃbhavaṃ vadanty eke, tena gandhakakalkena samenārasamānena śuddhāny amladravair muhur iti pūrvam ārapatrāṇi amladravair jambīraprabhṛtikaiḥ muhur iti velātrayaṃ viśuddhāni kṛtvā paścād gandhakakalkena lepayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | gajapuṭaṃ pūrvaṃ darśitam eva evam ity amunā prakāreṇa puṭadvayaṃ kāryam | āravad ityādi | kāṃsyaṃ prasiddham | āravad ity anena śodhanamāraṇe cāsya tadvad eveti boddhavyam | ekam iti grahaṇena ghoṣam api āravad iti jñeyam | viśuddhau māraṇe ca | tathā hi
‘kāṃsyāraghoṣapatrāṇi tena kalkena lepayet |
ruddhvā gajapuṭe paktvā śuddhim āyānti niścitam | tāmravac ca mṛtiṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā sarvatra yojayet’ iti | ghoṣaṃ kāṃsyabhedaḥ ‘jasada’ iti loke || 25 ||

26 || arkakṣīravad ityādi | arkakṣīraprakāravad ajākṣīreṇa gandhakakalkaṃ kāryam | tathā'nena prakāreṇa nirguṇḍīsvarasena gandhakakalkaṃ kāryam iti prayogāntaram | tāmradīnāṃ vadhe māraṇe | tāmrārarītyāraṃ, dhvaniḥ kāṃsyaṃ, samagandhakayogata iti | dhātusamānagandhako grāhya ity abhiprāyaḥ || 27 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha āramāraṇam | ārasya pītalohasya patrāṇi amladravair nimbukādyaiḥ śuddhe mūṣāpuṭe pacet || 25 ||
26 || nirguṇḍikā, tāmraṃ prasiddhaṃ, rītiḥ pittaliḥ, dhvaniḥ kāsyaṃ tadvadhe tanmāraṇe spaṣṭam anyat ||27 ||

samprati tāmramāraṇaṃ darśayann āha -
sūkṣmāṇi tāmrapatrāṇi kṛtvā saṃsvedayed budhaḥ |
vāsaratrayam amlena tataḥ khalve vinikṣipet || 28 ||

lg.l: pādāṃśaṃ sūtakaṃ dattvā yāmam amlena mardayet |
tata uddhṛtya patrāṇi lepayed dviguṇena ca || 29 ||
tataḥ ṣiṣṭvā ca mīnākṣīṃ cāṅgerīṃ vā punarnavām ||30||
dhṛtvā tadgolakaṃ bhāṇḍe śarāveṇa ca rodhayet ||31||
dattvā bhāṇḍamukhe mudrāṃ tataś cullyāṃ vipācayet||32||
saghṛtena tato mūṣāṃ puṭe gajapuṭe pacet || 34 ||
sāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ śubhaṃ bhavet |
vāntiṃ bhrāntiṃ klamaṃ mūrcchāṃ na karoti kadācana ||35||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. sūkṣmāṇi tāmrapatrāṇi iti | sūkṣmatvam atra kaṇṭakavedhisaṃjñam | saṃsvedayed budha iti amlena kāñjikādinā vāsaratrayaṃ dinatritayaṃ yāvad dolāyantreṇa svedanaṃ kuryād iti bhāvaḥ | patrāṇām iti śeṣaḥ | samyakgrahaṇaṃ tāmrasyātidoṣanivṛttiṃ sūcayati | yady api śuddhir asya pūrvaṃ kathitā, tathā'pi punaḥ śodhanam asya viṣanivṛttyarthaṃ kālimā'pagamārthaṃ ca vihitam, | yataḥ
‘na viṣaṃ‘na viṣaṃ viṣamityāhustāmraṃ tu viṣamucyate | eka eva viṣe tāmre tvaṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | bhramo mūrcchā vidāhaśca svedaḥ kledo vamistathā | aruciścittasaṃtāpa iti doṣā viṣopamāḥ | tasmāt śuddhaṃ tu saṃgrāhyaṃ tāmraṃ rogapraśāntaye ||’ i. pā. | viṣam ity āhus tāmram eva mahāviṣaṃ |
viṣasya caikadoṣas tu śulbadoṣo 'ṣṭadhā mataḥ’| tad yathā - ‘viṣaṃ mūrcchā vidāhaś ca chardiḥ kledanabhedane | santāpaś cāruciś caiva śulbadoṣo viṣopamaḥ’ isi | kālimārahitam api | ‘śukatuṇḍakiṃśukābhaṃ chede raktaṃ tathā mṛdusnigdham | tāmraṃ bhavati sakṛṣṇaṃ tac chuddhaṃ kālimārahitam’ ata evāmlena punaḥ śodhanam abhihitaṃ na doṣaḥ | budha iti tajjātyādiviśeṣajñaḥ | yatas tat tāmraṃ dvividham | ekaṃ mlecchasaṃjñam aparaṃ nepālam iti | tathā hi -
‘mlecchaṃ nepālakaṃ tāmraṃ tayor nepālam uttamam |
nepālād anyadeśotthaṃ śulbaṃ mleccham iti smṛtaṃ |
sitakṛṣṇāruṇacchāyaṃ vāntibhedakaraṃ ca yat |
kṣālanāc ca punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tāmraṃ mleccham udāhṛtam |
susnigdhaṃ mṛdulaṃ raktaṃ viśodhanakṣamaṃ guru |
tridoṣaharaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṣārāmlair naiti vaikṛtim |
tan nepālakam ity uktaṃ dehalohavidhāyakam | vāntibhrāntijvaraharaṃ kledabhedabhramāpaham’ iti | tata iti paścāt | pādāṃśaṃ sūtakam iti | sūtakaṃ pāradaṃ pādāṃśaṃ, tāmramānacaturthāśaṃ yāmaṃ praharam ekaṃ yāvat amlena jambīranimbukaprabhūtirasena mardayet iti bhāvaḥ | punas tenaivā'mlena ghṛṣṭena dviguṇagandhakena kṛtvā lepayet patrāṇīti śeṣaḥ | dviguṇatā rasaparimāṇāt | na tu tāmramānāt asmatsampradāye tu gandhakaṃ bahutaraṃ yojyaṃ tena tāmramānād dviguṇam ity arthaḥ | anyatrā'py uktam
‘tāmrapādena sūtena sārdhaṃ patraṃ pralepayet |
tāmrād dviguṇagandhena hy amlapiṣṭena tat punaḥ |
liptvā hy adhordhvagaṃ deyaṃ supiṣṭāṃ cāmlapatrikām | tat piṇḍaṃ bhāṇḍagarbhe tu ruddhvā cullyāṃ vipācayet ityādi | tasya kuryāc ca golakam iti tasya tāmramayadravyasya mīnākṣī ‘machechī’ śabdavācyā | cāṅgerī amlapatrikā prasiddhā tatkalkeneti trayāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ vyastānāṃ militānāṃ vā kalkaṃ vadanti tajjñāḥ | aṅgulonmitam iti aṅgulotsedhaṃ trayāṇām ekasya vā aṅgulam atra madhyamāṅgulimadhyaparvasaṃjñam | rodhayed ity anena vibhūtilavaṇāmbubhiḥ kṛtvā śarāvasandhau mudrāṃ kārayed iti bhāvaḥ | bhāṇḍamukhe ca kārayet | vibhūtir gomayabhasma lavaṇam atra pāṃśulavaṇam | ambu pānīyaṃ kramavṛddhāgnineti mṛdumadhyakharā'gninā śeṣaṃ subodham | (athanāsti ‘kha’ pustake| ca māritasyā'sya śuddhyarthaṃ vidhim apy āha -‘svāṃgaśītalam uddhṛtyetyādi tat tāmraṃ svāṅgaśītalaṃ saṃgṛhya paścāt sūraṇadravaiḥ kṛtvā dinam ekaṃ saṃmardya paścād golakaṃ kṛtvā saghṛtenārdhagandhakakalkena golakaṃ lepayitvā tadanu mūṣāntar dhṛtvā nirodhya ca gajapuṭe pacet | anena tat kṣaṇena bhakṣaṇayogyaṃ bhavati ardhagandhakaṃ tāmraparimāṇāt | tena tāmraṃ bhāgadvayaṃ gandhakam ekabhāgam ity arthaḥ | ghṛtam api gandhakasāmyaṃ bhavati) || 28-35 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tāmrādyutpattibhedamāraṇaguṇāḥ - ‘ulbaṃ yat kārtikeyasya patitaṃ dharaṇītale | tasmād etat samudbhūtaṃ tāmram āhuḥ purāvidaḥ’ iti | atha bhedāḥ
‘dvāv arkau nepālamlecchau rase nepālamuttamaṃ |
sitaṃ kṛṣṇāruṇacchāyaṃ mlecchakaṃ tv ativāmi ca |
susnigdhaṃ mṛdulaṃ śoṇaṃ nepālaṃ nirvikārakam |
imaṃ rūkṣam atistabdhaṃ śvetaṃ vāpi ca vāsahaṃ |
lohanāgayutaṃ ceti śrutvā tad doṣasaptakam |
eko doṣo viṣe, tāmre tv aṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
bhramo mūrcchā vidāhaś ca svedotkledanavāntayaḥ |
aruciś cittasaṃtāpaḥ pāne doṣā viṣopamāḥ | viṣavat sthāpitaṃ tāmraṃ yatnataḥ sādhyate hi tat’ iti | atha māraṇaṃ | mīnākṣī matsyagandhā cāṃgerī spaṣṭam anyat | anyac ca
‘sūkṣmāṇi tāmrapatrāṇi paladvitayamātrayā |
gomūtre svedayen nityam ekaviṃśativāsaraṃ ||
punar amle vinikṣipya sthāpayed dinasaptakaṃ |
sūtatūryāṃśakaṃ datvā tattulyaṃ viḍacūrṇakaṃ ||
patrāṇi khalve nikṣipya mardayet sarvam eva tat |
dinasaptapramāṇena sarvatulyaṃ ca gandhakaṃ ||
kajjalīkṛtya patreṣu adha ūrdhvaṃ pradāpayet |
haṃḍikāyāṃ śarāveṇa mudrayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
vālukābhiḥ prapūryātha pācayet praharadvayaṃ |
svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya bhakṣayed raktikādvayam ||
lavaṅgaṃ pippalīsārdhaṃ kapharogavināśanam |
śvāsakāsaharaṃ tāmraṃ vātaghnaṃ vahnimāṃdyajit || atyantakapharogeṣu vāsā kṣudrā pibed anu’ iti granthāntarāt tāmreśvaraḥ |
‘tāmraṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ satiktam amlaṃ ca pāke kaṭu sārakaṃ ca |
pittāpahaṃ śleṣmaharaṃ ca śītaṃ tad ropaṇaṃ syāl laghulekhanaṃ vā || pāṇḍurarśo jvaraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ kāsaś ca kṣatasakṣayān’ | ‘pītaṃ samastapittaṃ śothakaphaṃ śūlam upākaroti | prāhuḥ pare bṛṃhaṇam alpam etat’ iti tāmraguṇāḥ || 28-35 ||

atha sīsakamāraṇam āha -
tāmbūlīrasasaṃpiṣṭaśilālepāt punaḥ punaḥ || 36 ||

lg.l: dvātriṃśadbhiḥ puṭair nāgo niruttho yāti bhasmatām |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. tāmbūlīti | tāmbūlī tāmbūlavallī prasiddhā | nāgaḥ sīsakam | śilā manaḥśilā, sā caturthāṃśā sampra- dāyāt | punaḥ punar iti | pratyekapuṭe manaḥśilayā pralipya puṭet | evaṃ dvātriṃśatpuṭāni prasiddhāni bhavanti | na tu pratyekapuṭe vāraṃ vāraṃ pralepanam | pralepanaṃ tv ekavāram ekapuṭaṃ pratīty arthaḥ || 36 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha nāgotpattibhedavivaraṇam
‘dṛṣṭvā bhogisutāṃ ramyāṃ vāsukir vyamucad yataḥ |
vīryaṃ jātas tato nāgaḥ sarvarogāpaho nṛṇāṃ || dravadrāvaṃ mahābhāraṃ chede kṛṣṇaṃ samujjvalaṃ | pūtigandhi bahiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śuddhaṃ sīsam ato 'nyathā’ iti | atha māraṇaṃ | śilā manaḥśilā tāmbūlarasasaṃpiṣṭanāgapatralepaḥ triṃśadbhiḥ puṭair bhogī nirutthaṃ bhasmatāṃ yāti || 36 ||

lg.l: yāmaikena bhaved bhasma tattulyāṃ ca manaḥśilām ||38||
svāṅgaśītaṃ punaḥ piṣṭvā śilayā kāñjikena ca ||39||
punaḥ puṭec charāvābhyām evaṃ ṣaṣṭipuṭair mṛtiḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. aśvatthaciñcātvakcūrṇam iti | aśvatthaḥ, pippalaḥ, ciñcā amlikā, caturthāṃśaṃ bhasmataḥ sīsakaparimāṇāt, etena vāraṃ vāraṃ bhasmanaḥ kṣepaṇam uktam, na tu ekavāraṃ, yato vakṣyamāṇavaṅgamāraṇe proktaṃ ‘kṣiptvā’ iti tadvad atrāpi | tena yāvan nāgasya bhasma bhavati tāvat kṣāraṃ deyaṃ; paścān nāgabhasmanaḥ śilāṃ ca kāñjikena samaṃ piṣṭvā saha dṛḍhapuṭe gajapuṭasaṃjñake pacet | evaṃ ṣaṣṭipuṭaiḥ kṛtvā mṛtir bhavati | ṣaṣṭipuṭāny atra śilayaiva saha kāryāṇi na tu ciñcāśvatthayor bhasmanā, bhasmasaṃskāras tv ekadaiva ||37-39||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyac ca | aśvatthaḥ pippalaḥ, ciñcā amlikā, tasyos tvakcūrṇam | anyac ca ‘tribhiḥ kumbhipuṭair nāgo vāsārasavimarditaḥ | saśilo bhasmatām eti tad rajaḥ sarvarogahṛt’ iti granthāntarāt | kumbhapuṭaiḥ gajapuṭaiḥ saśilaḥ manaḥśilayā sahitaḥ | iti nāgamāraṇam || 37-39 ||

idānīṃ vaṅgamāraṇaṃ darśayann āha -
mṛtpātre drāvite baṅge ciñcāśvatthatvaco rajaḥ || 40 ||

lg.l: tato gajapuṭe paktvā punar amlena mardayet || 42 ||
tālena daśamāṃśena yāmam ekaṃ tataḥ puṭet |
evaṃ daśapuṭaiḥ pakvo vaṅgas tu mriyate dhruvam || 43 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. mṛtpatreti | mṛtpātraṃ kharparaṃ, ciñcā amlikā, aśvatthaḥ pippalaḥ, rajaś cūrṇam anayor valkalasya kṣiptvā kṣiptvā iti vāraṃ vāraṃ caturthāṃśam iti vaṅgaparimāṇāt, valkalacūrṇasya etat parimāṇam ekavāraṃ kṣepaṇārthaṃ atas tāvat kṣiped yāvad bhasma bhavati tena vaṅgaparimāṇasamaṃ valkalarajaḥ kāryam iti sampradāyaḥ | ayodarvyā lohamayadaṇḍena atheti paścāt kāryakarmāha - bhasmasamam ityādi | tālaṃ haritālaṃ, tad vaṅgabhasma sāmyaṃ bhavati, tena kim uktaṃ ? vaṅgabhasma haritālaṃ ca samamātraṃ saṃgṛhya amlena kāñjikādinā vimardya tadgolakākāraṃ kṛtvā śarāvasampuṭe dhāryaṃ saṃpuṭanirodhaṃ ca kṛtvā gajapuṭe pacet tatpaścāt tam uddhṛtya punar daśamāṃśena tālakena saha saṃmardyāmlarasaiḥ kṛtvā tataḥ puṭet| daśa evaṃ sampuṭavidhānavad iti śeṣaḥ | agnipuṭaṃ tu kiñcin nyūnam iti sampradāyaḥ evaṃ daśapuṭaiḥ kṛtvā vaṅgo mṛto bhavati || 40-43 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vaṅgaṃ |
‘miśrakaṃ khurakaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ vaṅgam ucyate |
khurakaṃ tu guṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ miśrakaṃ na rase hitaṃ || capalaṃ mṛdulaṃ snigdhaṃ drutadrāvaś ca gauravaṃ | niḥśabdaṃ khuravaṅgaṃ syāt miśrakaṃ śyābhaśubhrakam’ iti | spaṣṭam anyat atha māraṇaṃ | ‘vaṅgo dāhakaraḥ śītaḥ kaphapīḍāmayān jayet | krimīn aṣṭādaśavidhān pramehān nātra saṃśayaḥ’ iti | kecid dāhaharaḥ śīta’ iti paṭhanti tatra madanavinodapathyāpathyanighaṇṭvādau vaṅgasyoṣṇaguṇasya likhitatvāt| viśeṣatas tālena mṛta uṣṇa eva bhavatīti | granthāntarāt vaṅgeśvaraḥ
‘śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ śuddhavaṅgaṃ drāvayitvaikataś caret |
tālakaṃ tu dvayos tulyaṃ śaṭhīdrāveṇa mardayet |
śuṣkaṃ kācamaye pātre paced yāmacatuṣṭayaṃ |
turyāṃśaṃ tālakaṃ datvā punar vāratrayaṃ pacet |
guñjārdhaṃ vātha guñjaikaṃ bala- mānena bhakṣayet |
jayed vātaṃ kaphaśvāsaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kāsaṃ bhagandaraṃ |
vātaraktaṃ kṣayaṃ vāpi vahnimāṃdyaṃ tridoṣakaṃ |
nāmnā vaṅgeśvaraḥ sūtaḥ sarvarogeṣu pūjitaḥ | pakṣāghātādivāteṣu prasūtyādau viśeṣataḥ’ iti vaṅgeśvaraḥ granthāntarāt | atha vaṅgaśodhanamāraṇānupānāś ca viśeṣata ucyate
‘gomūtre prathamaṃ dadyāt takre dadyād dvitīyakaṃ |
tṛtīyaṃ kāñjike deyaṃ caturthaṃ kaṭutailake |
śubhalagnena yogena śodhanaṃ kārayed bhiṣak | nirliptaṃ drāvitaṃ vaṅgaṃ sarvarogeṣu yojayet’ iti vaṅgaśodhanam | atha māraṇaṃ ‘cully upari sthitaṃ pātraṃ pācayed yāmakadvayaṃ |
gharṣaṇaṃ lohadaṇḍena cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
prathamaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ dīpyakaṃ ca dvitīyakaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ jīrakaṃ dvayaṃ caturthaṃ tiṃtiḍītvacam |
evaṃ krameṇa cūrṇena vaṅgaṃ niścandrikaṃ bhavet |
svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya bhasma candrasamaṃ sitaṃ |
guñjāmātraṃ pradātavyaṃ vaṅgabhasma subhakṣitam |
anupānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvyādhyanupānataḥ |
dhātrīsvarasasaṃyuktaṃ pramehaṃ hanti dustaraṃ |
śatāvarīrasenaiva mūtrakṛcchravināśanaṃ |
bahumūtraharaṃ tat tu pāribhadrarasena tu |
rajanīcūrṇamadhukaṃ dhātrīphalarasena tu |
catuḥprakāraṃ pradaraṃ nāśayen nātra saṃśayaḥ |
pañcatiktakaṣāyeṇa pāyayet sarvakuṣṭhajit |
śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaṃ kūṣṇāṃḍasya rasena tu |
raktapittakṣayaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ hanti sudustaraṃ|
kaṇṭakārīrasenaiva pātavyaṃ pañcakāsajit |
mudgaṃ saśarkaraṃ kṣaudraṃ jāṃgalaṃ piśitaṃ rasam |
uduṃbaraphalaṃ caiva tandulīyakavāstukaṃ |
rambhāprasūtaṃ cāṅgerīmayakaṃ kadalīphalaṃ |
navanītaṃ tathā kṣīram abhyaṅgasnānam ācaret’ | iti vaṅgakalpaḥ || 40-43 ||

atha lohamāraṇam āha -
śuddhaṃ lohabhavaṃ cūrṇaṃ pātālagaruḍīrasaiḥ |
mardayitvā puṭed vahnau dadyād evaṃ puṭatrayam || 44 ||

lg.l: puṭaṣaṭkaṃ tato dadyād evaṃ tīkṣṇamṛtir bhavet || 45 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. śuddham iti | śuddhaṃ śodhitaṃ jātyutkṛṣṭaṃ vā śodhanam asya pūrvaṃ kathitam eva | jātibhedāḥ keṣāñcij jñāpanārthaṃ likhyante yathā -
‘devāḥ surasamājena mathyamāne mahodadhau |
samutpannaṃ purā tasminn amṛtaṃ devajīvanam ||
pīyamānāt surais tasmād utthitāḥ kṣudrabindavaḥ |
jñātvā tān bhūgatān bindūn yogam āsādya dhūrjaṭiḥ ||
lohapāṣāṇarūpeṇa kṛtvā tān vasudhātale |
pāparogābhibhūtā ye mānavās te bhajantu tān || ity evaṃ śivaguptā ye sudhāyā bindavaḥ param | teṣāṃ mayā samāsena kathyate sādhanaṃ sphuṭam’ iti | atha jātibhedā yathā yady api nāgārjunamate aṣṭādaśa lohajātayaḥ santi tad yathā māṇḍūraṃ, māṇḍūkaṃ, sāraṃ, lohaṃ, madhyasāralohaṃ, sthūlasāralohaṃ, cakramardalohaṃ, bandhalohaṃ, vajrakalohaṃ, surāyasaṃ, kaliṅgaṃ, bhadralohaṃ, garalasthitalohaṃ, vajraṃ, pāṇḍiniravam, arbudakam, kāntaṃ, kuliśam iti tathāpy anyeṣāṃ mate tv aṣṭaiva śreṣṭhatamā | tathā hi
‘sāmānyād dviguṇaṃ sāraṃ tasmād aṣṭaguṇaṃ kaliḥ |
kaleḥ śataguṇaṃ bhadraṃ bhadrād vajraṃ sahasradhā |
vajrāt ṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ pāṇḍinirivād daśabhir guṇaiḥ | tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ tasmād ayasaḥ kāntakaṃ matam’ iti | eteṣāṃ vyañjanaṃ ca tantrāntarād eva likhyate lakṣaṇaviśeṣaṃ vinā śreṣṭham aśreṣṭhaṃ na jñāyate tasmāl likhyate | yathā
‘kṣamābhṛcchikharākāraliṅgāny evāmlite sati |
dṛśyante yatra sūkṣmāṇi sāraṃ ca tad udāhṛtam ||
yatra kṛṣṇāyase viṃśal lakṣaṇāni sitāni ca |
pallavālpakṛtīny āhus tad budhāḥ kṛṣṇavajrakam ||
yatra kṛṣṇatarā bhūmir vartulāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ |
rekhā syād dhemavarṇā ca tat piṇḍī ca vidhīyate ||
kalis tarasamāvarto yad uktaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
kiṃcit tatsthe jale kṣiptaṃ tailabindur na sarpati ||
api kenāpi kālena nirmalatvaṃ na muñcati |
bhraśyate yan na kālena nirdravaṃ tad ayo matam |
yena parvatasāreṇa bhidyante śuṣkakāṣṭhavat |
anyāni girisārāṇi tat tīkṣṇaṃ kāntam ucyate’ || kāntasya lakṣaṇam anya- trāpy uktam |
‘pātre yasmin praviśati jale tailabindur niṣikto hiṅgur gandhaṃ visṛjati nijaṃ tiktatāṃ nimbakalkaḥ |
pāke dugdhaṃ bhavati śikharākārakaṃ naiti bhūmau kāntaṃ lohaṃ bhavati tad idaṃ lakṣaṇoktaṃ na cānyat ||’ iti tasmād eteṣāṃ madhye kāntalohaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ, yataḥ -
‘kiṭṭād daśaguṇaṃ muṇḍaṃ muṇḍāt tīkṣṇaṃ śatonmitam |
tīkṣṇāl lakṣaguṇaṃ kāntaṃ bhakṣaṇāt kurute guṇam || tasmāt kāntaṃ sadā sevyaṃ jarāmṛtyuharaṃ nṛṇām’ iti | tac ca kāntaṃ caturvidhaṃ bhavati | tathā hi ‘bhrāmakaṃ śakaṭaṃ caiva cumbakaṃ drāvakaṃ tathā | caturvidhaṃ bhavet kāntam ekaikaṃ dviguṇaṃ matam’ iti | jātibhedāḥ saṃkṣepeṇoktāḥ | samprati māraṇavidhir api teṣāṃ kathyate - lohabhavaṃ cūrṇam ityādi | pātālagaruḍī pātālamūlī prasiddhā sā ca cchinnaruhā'kṛtis tadbhedaś ca tadabhāve chirahaṇṭaiva grāhyā puṭam atra jagapuṭam | kumārī prasiddhāsā ca vāri śabdavācyā dī. | kuṭhārakulattharasair iti| kuṭhāraḥsā ca kuraiyā śabdavācyo dravyaviśeṣaḥ | kuṭhāracchinnā kuṭajabheda ity anye tadabhāve jambūtvak gṛhṇanty apare; asmatsampradāye kuṭhāracchinnā loke tipānītiśabdavācyo dravyaviśeṣo grāhyaḥ | kulattho 'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | puṭaṣaṭkam ity anena pratyekaṃ puṭatrayaṃ pūrvavad boddhyam || 44 || 45 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha lohamāraṇaṃ | pātālagaruḍī pātālamūlī kuṭhāraḥ anyac ca daradaṃ hiṃgulaṃ tīkṣṇagatavallīcūrṇam ||||44 ||45||

ab.seg:
anyac cety aparam api māraṇam āha -
kṣiped vā daśamāṃśena daradaṃ tīkṣṇacūrṇataḥ |
mardayet kanyakādrāvair yāmayugmaṃ tataḥ puṭet || 46 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kṣiped iti | daradaṃ hiṅgulam | daśamāṃśaṃ daradaṃ lohacūrṇāt | kanyakā kumārī | puṭam atra gajapuṭavidhānaṃ yāmayugmam iti mardanaparimāṇam | evam ity anena saptapuṭaiḥ kṛtvā siddhaṃ bhavati | athavā kuṭhāracchinnāyā rasaiḥ kṛtvā daradaṃ lohacarṇaṃ ca pūrvavat saṃmardya puṭet | anenāpi saptapuṭaiḥ siddham etat | athavā pātālagaruḍīrasais tadvad eva vā athavā stanyena pūrvavad yogaḥ kartavyaḥ | arkadugdhena tadvad eva pracāraḥ | etadyogacatuṣṭayaṃ daradasaṃbandhi bhavati | saptapuṭasaṃbandhi vā vijñeyam | atra kuṭhāracchinnā prasiddhā ‘tipānī’ śabdavācyety apare, pātālagaruḍī chirahaṇṭaḥ stanyaṃ strībhavaṃ nānyat prayogāntaradarśanāt | tathā ca ‘hiṅgulasya palān pañca nārīstanyena peṣayet | tena lohasya patrāṇi lepayet palapañcakam’ ityādi || 46 || 47 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyac ca | rasair iti | anyad api sugamam ||46 || 47 ||

ab.seg:
anyad api māraṇam āha -
sūtakād dviguṇaṃ gandhaṃ dattvā kuryāc ca kajjalīm ||48||

lg.l: yāmayugmaṃ tataḥ piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tāmrasya pātrake ||49||
gharme dhṛtvā rubūkasya patrair ācchādayed budhaḥ |
piṣṭvā ca gālayed vastrād evaṃ vāritaraṃ bhavet || 51 ||
evaṃ sarvāṇi lohāni svarṇādīny api mārayet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. sūtakād iti | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ, dvayor iti pāradagandhakayoḥ | kanyakā kumārī, yāmārdhenoṣṇatā bhūyād ity anena taddravyapiṇḍaṃ ghaṭikācatuṣṭayaṃ yāvad dharme dhārayed ity arthaḥ | tata iti paścāt | dattvopari śarāvam ity anena taddravyapiṇḍaṃ pūrvam | eraṇḍapatrair veṣṭayitvā paścāt tāmrasaṃpuṭe mṛṇmayasaṃpuṭe vā sannidhāya tadanu dhānyarāśau sthāpayed ity arthaḥ | tathā hi -
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ kṛtvā khalvena kajjalīm |
dvayoḥ samaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ mardayet kanyakādravaiḥ|| yāmadvayāt samuddhṛtya tad golaṃ tāmrapātrake | ācchādyairaṇḍapatraiś ca yāmārdhenoṣṇatā bhavet’ ityādi | evam iti pūrvoktavidhinā sarvāṇi lohāni kāntatīkṣṇamuṇḍaprabhṛtīni svarṇādīni api anayā yuktyā ca mārayed iti bhāvaḥ | ādiśabdagrahaṇāt raupyatāmrādayaḥ | aparam api śilāgandhārkadugdhāktā ityādi sugamam | satyam ity anena vāritaraṃ bhaved ity arthaḥ | yathā guruvacas tathā'tra boddhavyam | etena kim uktaṃ ? mṛtaṃ lohaṃ tu paścāt saṃskāritaṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā hi -
‘ghṛtatulyaṃ mṛtaṃ lohaṃ lohapātragataṃ pacet |
jīrṇe ghṛtaṃ samādāya yogavāheṣu yojayet | ityādi || 48-52||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha lohakalpaḥ | ‘pātañjale tathā tantre lohā bahuvidhā matāḥ | duṣprāpyatvān niṣphalatvāc ca likhyate hi bhidā mayā|
cārutvād bhadravajraṃ tu pāṇḍikāntādayo yathā |
rūpair guṇaiś ca kathyante te nāgārjunadeśataḥ || sāmānyād dviguṇaṃ proktaṃ tasmād aṣṭaguṇaṃ kaliḥ | kaler daśaguṇa bhadraṃ bhadrād vajraṃ sahasradhā ||
vajrāt sahasraguṇitāt pāḍinī daśabhir guṇaiḥ |
tataḥ koṭisahasratvād ayaḥ kāntaṃ mahāphalam ||’ iti | tatra viśeṣa ucyate
‘kāñjījitaṃ tulāṅgaṃ syād ājyavarṇam ayo viduḥ |
kāśatāḍaṃ kṛśāṅgaṃ ca śulāṃ gandho dudeśatam ||
paṃḍitaṃ dvividhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śuklañ ca samatārdrakaṃ |
bhadram eraṇḍabījābhaṃ snuhīpatranibhaṃ tathā ||
vajraṃ damanapatrābham īṣat svarṇacchavis tathā |
kāntaṃ mṛdutaraṃ tārarukmakānto sitākaraṃ ||
svādur yatra bhaven nimbakalko rātridivoṣitaḥ |
kāntaṃ tad uttamaṃ yac ca śilārūpeṇa vārtikaṃ ||
kahvoṇam uttamaṃ kāntam ato 'nyan madhyamaṃ mataṃ |
kṣudrāṃḍaṃ gurutāḍaṃ syāt kaliṅgajam ayo mataṃ ||
rukmārukmapratīkāśaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ mṛduphalaṃ mataṃ
tattadā'karasaṃbhūtaṃ tattadrogavināśanaṃ || tena tasya parīkṣāyāṃ yāte madimadetakam’ iti | lohabhedāḥ| atha māraṇaṃ - ‘vajraṃ pañcādikaṃ teṣāṃ bhedā yājyatamaṃ śubhaṃ | prākpañcapalād ūrdhvaṃ yāvad āṣoḍaśaṃ palam’ | atha lohaśodhanaṃ
‘triphalātriguṇais toyais triphalā ṣoḍaśaṃ palaṃ |
tatkvāthe pādaśeṣe tu lohasya palapañcakaṃ || kṛtvā patrāṇi taptāni saptavāraṃ niṣecayet | evaṃ pralīyate doṣo girijo lohasaṃbhavaḥ’ iti | atha māraṇe puṭapraśaṃsā -
‘puṭair doṣavināśaḥ syāt puṭād eva guṇodayaḥ |
mriyate ca puṭāl lohaṃ puṭāṃs tasmāt samācaret ||
yathā yathā pradīyante puṭāś ca bahavo 'yasi |
tathā tathā pravardhante guṇāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ |
tāval lohaṃ puṭed vaidyo yāvac cūrṇīkṛtaṃ jale |
tan nistarel laghutvena nīre tarati haṃsavat ||
tāvan na cūrṇayed evaṃ yāvat kajjalisaṃnibhaṃ |
karoti nihitaṃ netre naiva pīḍāṃ manāg api || puṭe puṭe kvāthayitvā sthālīpākaṃ pradāpayet | puṭaikam antare vāpi kṣālanaṃ vyayabhītitaḥ’ iti | atha doṣabhedena puṭān āha -
‘pākaḥ phalāmbudaśamūlarasena vāyau pitte tu śītamadhurais triphalair vidāryāḥ |
tajjñaiḥ śatāvarijaṭāsvarasena deyaḥ śleṣmāṇake tu daśamūlarasārdrakeṇa || vātaśleṣmavikāreṣu śvayathau vividhātmake | varṣābhūśṛṅgaverābhyāṃ māṇakena viśeṣataḥ’ iti | māṇakaḥ māṇakandaḥ, ‘pittānile pittayute ca rakte drākṣāvidārīśatamūlikābhiḥ | kṣīrakākolī kākolyā ca madhūkapuṣpaiḥ kharjūrakeṇāpi tathaiva deyāḥ | atha vyādhibhedena puṭān āha - ‘jīrṇajvare guḍūcī kāse śvāse ca śasyate vyāghrī| yakṣmā'sṛk pittarujor vāsā śastā balā nāma || nāsāvraṇaśoṇitaśāṃtyarthaṃ svarasayavadūrvāyāḥ| kaṅkellicchallasalilaṃ śastaṃ pradareṣu sarveṣu || niculadalodbhavasalilaiḥ pravāhikāyāṃ ca śasyate sutarāṃ | grahaṇīṣu mustakānāṃ kuṭajakvāthātisāreṣu || mehe varāvare kṛcchre pāṣāṇabhedikātivane | varṣābhūnāgarayoḥ kvāthaḥ śvayathupraśāntyarthaṃ || gomūtraṃ triṣu śastam udarāpasmārapāṇḍurogeṣu | astreṣu māṇakaṃdo gulme rohītakaḥ kvāthaḥ || hikvāśvāse brāhmībhārgīsvarasena śastaś ca | eraṇḍanāgarayoḥ kvāthaḥ sāme 'tiśastaḥ || śūleṣu daśamūlena gomūtreṇa phalāmbunā | yakṛti plīhni dātavyo gṛhanyārkajaṃ payaḥ ||
devadāruviḍaṅgena palāśena kṛmau mataḥ |
kuṣṭhe saṃpākaniṃbena saptaparṇāṭarūṣakaiḥ||
bhallātakena bākucyavṛndārkeṇāśanena ca |
madhurekṣurasaṃpākaiḥ abhīrūvaruṇena ca |
eraṇḍatṛṇapañcānāṃ mūlai śailūṣakena ca |
triphalena ca kartavyo mūlastambhe tridoṣaje ||
aśmarīṣu ca sarvāsu mūtrāghāte viśeṣataḥ |
vṛkṣakṣīrāmṛtā drākṣā abhīrūdaśamūlakaiḥ ||
vājigandhānvitair ebhiḥ kṣayeṣu ca nigadyate |
amlapitte śatā- varyāḥ puṭā deyāś ca sarvataḥ’ | muṇḍikā śatamūlī ca citrāṅgakarikarṇakeśarājais tu | madhukaguḍūcīmārkavamuśalībhallā- takaiḥ kalpe, rasāyane nāgabalā hayagandhā gokarṇakavṛddhadārakāmalakī, vājīkaraṇe vihitā vānarīśatamūlikā kṣurikā jñātvaivaṃ | rogaviśeṣān ebhir vāratrayaṃ puṭena sthālīpāke adhikataḥ puruṣasvabhāvaṃ buddhimān kathitam api hemam auṣadham ucitam upādeyam anyad api | ‘yaḥ kalpakāmaḥ kurute ca lohaṃ sa sarvaśaṅkāparivarjitāṅgaḥ | dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtir eṣa nityaṃ jīvet pṛthivyām amaropamānaḥ’ iti | lohakalpaḥ samāptaḥ || atha kiṭṭaṃ - ‘gomūtratriphalākvāthe taptaṃ śodhyaṃ trisaptadhā | svarṇādisarvalohānāṃ kiṭṭasya ca guṇāvaham’ iti lohādikiṭṭamāraṇam | atha svarṇādidhātubhakṣaṇapramāṇaṃ -
‘yavadvayaṃ prayoktavyaṃ hemaguñjāṣṭakā'vadhi |
tāraṃ taddviguṇaṃ loham anyat tattriguṇātmakam’ || 48-52 ||

athopadhātuśodhanamāraṇaṃ, te ke upadhātavaḥ ? iti darśayann āha -
mākṣikaṃ tutthakābhre ca nīlāñjanaśilālakāḥ ||53||

Āḍhamalla. mākṣikam iti | mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ | tad dvividham ekaṃ svarṇamākṣikam aparaṃ tāramākṣikaṃ kāṃsyamākṣikam iti | tutthakaṃ prasiddham | abhram abhrakaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ prasiddham, śilā manaḥśilā, tālakaṃ haritālaṃ, rasakaṃ kharparakaḥ, sa ca tutthakabhedaḥ | ete saptopadhātavaḥ kathitāḥ || 53 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athopadhātuśodhanaṃ māraṇaṃ | mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, tutthaṃ tutthakam, abhram abhrakaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇāñjanam, manaḥśilā, ālakaḥ haritālakaḥ, rasakaḥ kharparam | ete sapta upadhātavo jñeyāḥ || 53 ||

atha mākṣikaśodhanamāraṇam -
mākṣikasya trayo bhāgā bhāgaikaṃ saindhavasya ca ||54||

lg.l: cālayel lohaje pātre yāvat pātraṃ tu lohitam ||55||
bhavet tatas tu saṃśuddhiṃ svarṇamākṣikam ṛcchati |
kulatthasya kaṣāyeṇa ghṛṣṭvā tailena vā puṭet || 56 ||
bhāvayed ātape tīvre vimalā śudhyati dhruvam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānī pratyekena śodhanamāraṇam āha - athetyādi | mākṣikasyeti spaṣṭam | karkoṭīti | vimalā svarṇa- mākṣikabhedaḥ, karkoṭī vandhyākarkoṭī grāhyā, meṣaśṛṅgī vallīsaṃjñā prasiddhā, etayor dravaiḥ sadyorasaiḥ patrāṇām iti śeṣaḥ | jambīrajair iti jambīraphalarasaiḥ dinam iti mardayet iti śeṣaḥ | tena pratyekarasena kṛtvā dinaikaṃ mardayed ity arthaḥ | ātape tīvra iti tīvragharme | tīvragharmābhāve agnau śodhayed ity api sampradāyaḥ | uktaṃ ca ‘jambīrāṇāṃ rasaiḥ svinnaṃ meṣaśṛṅgīrase 'thavā | rambhātoyena vā pācyaṃ ghasraṃ vimalaśodhanam’ iti || 54-57 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yāvat pātraṃ lohitaṃ raktaṃ bhavati tāvat pacet | tadā mākṣikaṃ śuddhim ṛcchati śuddhiṃ prāpnoti | ṛ gatāv ity asya ṛcchādeśe prayogaḥ | mākṣikaṃ kṛdbhūbhūtaṃ napuṃsakatvāt | atha māraṇaṃ | kulatthasyeti spaṣṭam anyat | atha tāramākṣikaśodhanamāraṇaṃ | karkoṭī vandhyākarkoṭī, meṣaśṛṃgī prasiddhā | atha māraṇaṃ svarṇamākṣikavat || 54-57 ||

atha tutthakaśodhanam āha --
viṣṭhayā mardayet tutthaṃ mārjārakakapotayoḥ || 58 |
daśāṃśaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ dattvā pacen mṛdupuṭena tu |
puṭaṃ dadhnā puṭaṃ kṣaudrair deyaṃ tutthaviśuddhaye || 59 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. viṣṭhayā mardayet iti viṣṭhā purīṣam | mārjārakakapotayor iti mārjārako biḍālaḥ, kapotaḥ prasiddhaḥ anayoḥ purīṣaṃ tv anumānato grāhyam, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ daśāṃśam iti tutthakaparimāṇāt | mṛdupuṭaṃ tu kukkuṭapuṭaprabhṛtikaṃ paścād dadhnā kṛtvā puṭam ekaṃ deyam | tadanu kṣaudrair api puṭam ekaṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ || 58 || 59 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tutthaśodhanaṃ viṣṭhayeti | granthāntare caivaṃ śodhanam -
‘ataḥ viṣṭhāsamaṃ tutthaṃ sakṣaudraṃ ṭaṃkaṇaṃ kṛtam |
trivāraṃ puṭitaṃ śuddhaṃ vāntibhrāntivivarjanam’ ||58||59||

athābhrakaśodhanam -
kṛṣṇābhrakaṃ dhamed vahnau tataḥ kṣīre vinikṣipet |
bhinnapatraṃ tu tat kṛtvā taṇḍulīyāmlayor dravaiḥ ||60|
bhāvayed aṣṭayāmaṃ tad evaṃ śuddhyati cābhrakam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. adhunā abhrakaśodhanam āha - kṛṣṇeti | kṛṣṇābhrakaṃ vajrajātisaṃjñaṃ kathitam | yatas tv abhrakaṃ tu caturvidhaṃ bhavati | tathā hi tantrāntarād utpattiprabhṛtikaṃ likhyate yathā
‘purā vadhāya vṛtrasya vajriṇā vajram uddhṛtam |
visphuliṅgās tatas tasya gaganaṃ parisarpitāḥ ||
nipetur meghanirghoṣāt śikhareṣu mahībhṛtām |
tebhya eva samutpannaṃ tattadgiriṣu cābhrakam ||
tad vajraṃ vajrajātatvād abhram abhraravodbhavāt |
gaganacyutajātatvād ūcire gaganaṃ surāḥ ||
tad brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrabhedāc caturvidhaṃ |
krameṇaiva sitaṃ raktaṃ pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇataḥ ||
pinākaṃ darduraṃ nāgaṃ vajraṃ ceti caturvidham|
pinākādyās trayo varjyā vajrajātiṃ samāharet ||
muñcaty agnau vinikṣiptaṃ pinākaṃ dalasaṃcayam |
darduraṃ nihitaṃ hy agnau kurute darduradhvanim ||
nāgaṃ cāgnau vinikṣiptaṃ phūtkāraṃ ca vimuñcati |
vajrābhrakaṃ tu vahnisthaṃ na kvacid vikṛtiṃ vrajet ||
tasmād vajrābhrakaṃ yojyaṃ vyādhivārdhakyamṛtyujit |
tatra dakṣiṇaśaile 'rkaśoṣād alpaguṇaṃ hi tat ||
alpasatvaṃ tadā dhatte abhre satvaṃ guṇapradam |
atha cottaraśailotthaṃ bahusatvaṃ guṇādhikaṃ | śaṃsanti munayaḥ sarve prayoge kṛṣṇam abhrakam’ iti | śodhanaṃ cāha - taṇḍulīyāmlayor iti | taṇḍulīyocaurāīśabdavācya:| meghanādaḥ, amlaḥ kāñjikaṃ, tadabhāve jambīraprabhṛtikaṃ grāhyam | aṣṭayāmaṃ dvayor dravyayos tena pratyekaṃ caturyāmam ity arthaḥ ||60||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kṛṣṇābhrakam iti | nanu granthāntare caturvidham abhrakam uktaṃ, tad yathā -
‘pinākaṃ darduraṃ nāgaṃ vajraṃ ceti caturvidham |
tat punnapuṃsakaṃ jñeyaṃ pratyekaṃ tatra lakṣaṇaiḥ | vaṅgasenādāyas trividham āhuḥ ‘vajraṃ bhekavapuḥ kṛṣṇābhrakaṃ ca trividhaṃ mataṃ | tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samādāya pācayet kāṃjike śubhe’ iti | etad vivṛṇoti trivikramaḥ | tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samādāyety anena kṛṣṇatvasāmyād vajrakṛṣṇābhrayor grahaṇaṃ | bhekavapuḥ haritapītādivarṇaṃ tyājyam | ataḥ śārṅgadhareṇa kṛṣṇasyaiva grahaṇaṃ kṛtam ||60||

atha māraṇam |
kṛtvā dhānyābhrakaṃ tat tu śoṣayitvātha mardayet || 61||

lg.l: arkakṣīrair dinaṃ khalve cakrākāraṃ ca kārayet |
veṣṭayed arkapatraiś ca samyag gajapuṭe pacet || 62 ||
punar mardyaṃ punaḥ pācyaṃ saptavāraṃ prayatnataḥ |
ghṛte jīrṇe tad abhraṃ tu sarvayogeṣu yojayet |
mṛtaṃ tv abhraṃ haren mṛtyuṃ jarāpalitanāśanam || 65 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha māraṇaṃ yathā - kṛtvā dhānyābhrakam ityādi | dhānyābhrakavidhānaṃ tu tantrāntarād avagantavyaṃ | tad yathā -‘baddhvā dhānyayute vastre mardayet kāñjikaiḥ saha | ādāyā'dhogataṃ śuddhaṃ śuṣkaṃ dhānyābhrakaṃ bhavet’ iti | athavā ‘cūrṇābhraṃ śālisaṃyuktaṃ baddhvā kambalake tathā trirātraṃ kāṃjike sthāpyaṃ tat klinnaṃ mardayed dṛḍham | kambalād galitaṃ ślakṣṇo māraṇādau praśasyate iti | veṣṭayed arkapatraiś cety anena cakrākāraṃ dravyaṃ patrair veṣṭayitvā'gnau puṭet | samyag iti grahaṇena tat patraveṣṭitaṃ cakrākāraṃ dravyaṃ kharpare nidhāya, upari ca kharparaṃ datvā tadūrdhvādhaḥ āraṇyakopalāni ca dattvāgniṃ prajvālya gajapuṭe puṭed iti tātparyārthaḥ | evaṃ saptavāraṃ yāvat puṭet | arkakṣīrair evety arthaḥ | tataḥ paścād vaṭajaṭākvāthaiḥ kṛtvā puṭatrayam eva deyam | atha mṛtābhrasyā'pi śuddhim āha - tulyam ityādi sugamam | adhunā mṛtābhrasya guṇam apy āha - mṛtam iti | kecid amuṃ ślokaṃ na paṭhanti, bahusthāneṣv apracāratvāt || 61-65 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 61-65 ||

athānyaprakāro 'bhrakamāraṇasya tam api vyācaṣṭe -
śuddhaṃ dhānyābhrakaṃ mustaṃ śuṇṭhīṣaḍbhāgayojitam||66||

lg.l: tato gajapuṭaṃ dadyāt tasmād uddhṛtya mardayet || 67 ||
triphalāvāriṇā tadvat puṭed evaṃ puṭais tribhiḥ |
marditaṃ puṭitaṃ vahnau tritrivelaṃ vrajen mṛtim |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. śuddhaṃ dhānyābhrakam iti | śuddhiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā | dhānyābhrakavidhānaṃ pūrvam eva pradarśitam | mustaṃ śuṇṭhī ca ṣaḍbhāgayojitaṃ pratyekaṃ | ṣaḍbhāgatā'tra abhrakaparimāṇāt | kāñjikena mardanaṃ caikadinam ity arthaḥ | triphalāvāriṇā triphalākvāthenety arthaḥ | tadvat puṭed iti gajapuṭavidhānena | evaṃ puṭais tribhir iti triphalākvāthena puṭatrayaṃ dadyā- dity abhiprāyaḥ | evam iti gajapuṭavidhānādinā balāprabhṛtīnāṃ pañcadravyāṇāṃ dravaiḥ kṛtvā pratyekena trivelaṃ marditaṃ pañcād vahnau puṭitaṃ cābhrakaṃ mṛtiṃ vrajed ity arthaḥ | eke cātra yogatrayaṃ manyante tanmate tu mustaprabhṛti citrakāntair eko yogaḥ | kevalatriphalāyā dvitīyaḥ | balāprabhṛti sūraṇāntais tṛtīya iti || 66-68 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athānyaprakāraḥ | puṭe saṃpuṭe puṭatrayaṃ deyaṃ | balā prasiddhā | spaṣṭam anyat | ity abhrakamāraṇam || || 66-68 ||

abhrasatvaprakāraḥ |
kṣepakamidam| dhānyābhrakasya bhāgaikaṃ dvau bhāgau ṭaṅkaṇasya na |
piṣṭvā tad andhamūṣāyāṃ ruddhvā tīvrāgninā pacet ||69||

atha nīlāñjanam -
nīlāñjanaṃ cūrṇayitvā jambīradravabhāvitam || 70 ||

lg.l: dinaikam ātape śuddhaṃ bhavet kāryeṣu yojayet |
taurī śaṅkhaṃ ca kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ śuddhim āyāti niścitam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. samprati nīlāñjanaśodhanavidhim āha - nīlāñjanam iti | nīlāñjanaṃ prasiddham | asya bhedaḥ sauvīrāñjanaṃ śvetakṛṣṇavarṇabhedāt | etasmād api sīsakotpattir jāyate | jambīradravabhāvitam iti jambīraphalarasena bhāvitaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam | evam ityādi | evaṃ nīlāñjanaśodhanaprakāreṇaiva gairikādayo viśodhyāḥ | gairikaṃ prasiddham | gairikaṃ svarṇagairikaṃ ca | kāsīsam iti | tac ca dvividhaṃ | kāsīsaṃ puṣpakāsīsaṃ ca | kāsīsaṃ bhasmavad alpamṛt puṣpakāsīsaṃ tadbhedaḥ kiñcit pītaḥ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraḥ, varāṭikā kapardikā, śeṣaṃ prasiddham | taurī sphaṭikā ‘phiṭkārī’ śabdavācyo mṛdbhedaḥ | kaṅguṣṭhaṃ suvarṇakṣīrī, asya bhedaḥ coka iti prasiddhaḥ | sa ca raktakṣīrasehuṇḍa iti pratīteḥ | niścitam ity anenānyat śodhanam api nāpekṣayet | yatas tanttrāntareṣv api nānāprakāreṇa śodhanam asti tasmād anenaivā'tra śodhanam eteṣāṃ pratipāditam || 70 || 71 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha gairikakāsīsaṭaṃkaṇavarāṭakāśaṅkhatorīśodhanaṃ sugabham | evaṃ nīlāñjanaprakāreṇa jambīrabhāvanayety arthaḥ | gairikaṃ prasiddhaṃ, kāsīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ kṣāraḥ, varāṭikā, śaṅkhaṃ, torī sphaṭikā, kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ cokaniryāsaḥ||70|| 71||

ab.seg:
atha manaḥśilāśodhanam --
pacet tryaham ajāmūtrair dolāyantre manaḥśilām || 72 ||

lg.l: bhāvayet saptadhā pittair ajāyāḥ śuddhim ṛcchati |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha mana:śilāśodhanam āha - paced iti | manaḥśilā prasiddhā | dolāyanttravidhānaṃ ca sampradāyato likhyate | manaḥśilāṃ kaṇaśaḥ kṛtvā kadalīdalaiḥ saṃveṣṭya tadanu caturguṇena vastreṇa ca poṭṭalīṃ baddhvā mūtrapūrite bhāṇḍe vidhivat svedayet yāvad dinatrayaṃ bhavati | dinagrahaṇena rātrir api gṛhyate | tenāhorātram api svedayet ity abhiprāyaḥ eke tu dinatrayam eva na tu rātrau svedanaṃ vihitam, yato rātrāv adṛḍhatve dagdhādibhayāt tathā hi -
‘sudṛḍhe kadalīpatre vastrakhaṇḍe caturguṇe |
tanmadhye tān vinikṣipya badhnīyāc ca supoṭṭalīm |
kṣārāmlamūtravargeṇa svedayec ca dinatrayam |
tathā svedaḥ prakartavyo majjayet poṭalī yathā | bhaven na ca talasparśā bhāṇḍasyāpi kadācana’ iti manyante | tato dolāyantrapramāṇam api |
‘dravadravyeṇa bhāṇḍasya pūritārdhasya tasya ca |
mukhe tiryakkṛte daṇḍe yad dravyaṃ sūtralambitam | svedayet tanmadhyagataṃ dolāyanttram iti smṛtam’ iti | bhāvayet saptadhānāsti khapustake | pittair iti | tadanu sveditā manaḥśilā ajāyāḥ pittadravaiḥ kṛtvā saptadhā gharme bhāvayet| bhāvanārthadravas tu yāvad dravyaṃ drāvitaṃ bhavati evaṃ śuddhim ṛcchatīti | eke ‘kṣālayed āranāle vā sarvayogeṣu yojayet’ iti paṭhanti tathā vyākhyānayanti ca || 72 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pacet tryaham iti | anye evam āhuḥ -
‘jayantīrasasaṃpiṣṭhā śilā śuddhyati gharmaṇā |
viṣaghnī ca tridoṣaghnī sā śuddhā parikīrtitā ’|| 72 ||

atha tālakaśuddhiḥ -
