tālakaṃ kaṇaśaḥ kṛtvā sacūrṇaṃ kāñjike kṣipet ||73||

lg.l: tilataile paced yāmaṃ yāmaṃ ca triphalājalaiḥ || 74 ||
evaṃ yantre caturyāmaṃ pācyaṃ śudhyati tālakam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tālakaśodhanaṃ prakaṭayann āha - tālakam iti | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ sacūrṇakāñjike kṣiped iti cūrṇaṃ kaṇikābhāvam ity arthaḥ | kathaṃ ? yathā īṣaccūrṇayuktaṃ kāñjikaṃ bhāṇḍe kṣiptvā dolāyantravidhānena svedayet| dolāyantravidhis tu pūrvaṃ darśita eva | tata ity anena yāmaikaṃ svedanaṃ sūcitam | kūṣmāṇḍajair dravair iti kūṣmāṇḍaphalasya sadyorasaiḥ kvāthair vā | triphalājalair iti | kvathitatriphalājalaiḥ kvathitatriphalātoyaiḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||73||74||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kaṇaśaḥ khaṇḍaśas tālaṃ haritālacūrṇaṃ kalicūrṇasahitakāñjike kṣipet | dolāpātre yāmaṃ pacet haṇḍikāyāṃ kāṣṭhaṃ datvā kāṣṭhe lambamānāṃ poṭṭalikāṃ sthāpayet | idaṃ dolāyantraṃ | spaṣṭam anyat ||73||74||

ab.seg:
atha rasakaśuddhiḥ --
naramūtraiś ca gomūtraiḥ saptāhaṃ rasakaṃ pacet || 75 ||

lg.l: dolāyantreṇa śuddhiḥ syāt tataḥ kāryeṣu yojayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha rasakaśodhanaṃ vyācaṣṭe - naramūtrair iti | rasakaṃ kharparakaṃ, tac ca tutthabhedaḥ | naramūtrair gomūtraiś ca pṛthak pacet na tu militamūtradvayaiḥ | naramūtraṃ saptāhaṃ yāvat cet dolāyantreṇa athavā gomūtraiḥ ‘saptāhāt sveditaḥ śuddho rasako naravāriṇā’ ityādi vacanāt || 75 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rasakaṃ kharparamsaṃgavasarīti loke | || 75 ||

athedānīṃ samudāyena sattvanirgamaṃ prakaṭayann āha -
lākṣā mīnā payaś chāgaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ mṛgaśṛṅgakam ||76||

lg.l: yavās tiktā ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ yathālābhaṃ vicūrṇayet ||77||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. lākṣeti | lākṣā prasiddhā | śigrur śobhāñjanatvak mūlaṃ vā | guñjāphalāni, ūrṇā meṣaromāṇi, guḍasaindhave prasiddhe | yavatiktā sarpākṣī | yathālābham iti vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā grāhyam | sarve dhātava iti dhātugrahaṇena upadhātava uparasāś ca grāhyāḥ | yataḥ ‘yantropari svabhāge 'sti rase tatsarvabhājane | kartavyaṃ tadguṇādhikyād rasajñair iti niścitam’ iti | gāḍhavahninā mūṣādhmātā iti | tena pātālayantreṇa vā yathāyogyaṃ satvanirgamaṃ kārayed ity arthaḥ | tathā hi -
‘sarvatulyaṃ ca dhānyāmlaṃ bhūnāgaṃ mṛttikā punaḥ |
tathā pāṣāṇacūrṇāni kaṭhinoparasāś ca ye |
melayen māhiṣaiḥ pañcadugdhādiśakṛdantakaiḥ|
dṛḍhaṃ mardya vaṭīṃ kuryāt karṣamātraṃ ca śoṣayet |
koṭīyantrair dhamed vahnāv aṅgāre khādirodbhavaiḥ |
trivāraṃ dhmāpayed evaṃ satvaṃ patati nirmalam | asādhyān mocayet satvam abhrakādes tu kā kathā’ koṭīyantraṃ prasiddham etat | pātālayantranalikāyantrayoḥ svarūpaṃ likhyate - nāla sāgaragolikā bhū- | mūṣāsatva. garta nalikāsampuṭayantram etat atrāgniḥ bhū bhū kṣīram ga. pātālayantram eteṣāṃ satvanirgamaḥ sampradāyato yathā gurusakāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā vā kāryo na doṣaḥ || 76-78 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha satvanirgamaḥ | dhamanadravyāt lākṣādayaḥ pratyekam aṣṭamāṃśāḥ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ caturthāṃśam iti grathāntarāt | dhamanād dhātava iti nirukteḥ | abhrādisatvadravyāṇi tena nāgatāmrādidravyāṇi grāhyāṇi | mīnāḥ kṣudramatsyāḥ | yavattiktā sarpākṣī | yad vā yavaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tiktā kaṭukī || 76 -78 ||

ab.seg:
atha ratnānāṃ śodhanamāraṇam -
kulatthakodravakvāthair dolāyantre vipācayet |
vyāghrīkandagataṃ vajraṃ tridinaṃ tad viśudhyati || 79 ||

lg.l: taptaṃ taptaṃ tu tad vajraṃ kharamūtrair niṣecayet |
punas tapyaṃ punaḥ secyam evaṃ kuryāt trisaptadhā || 80 ||
matkuṇais tālakaṃ piṣṭvā yāvad bhavati golakam |
tad gole nihitaṃ vajraṃ tad golaṃ vahninā dhamet || 81 ||
siñcayed aśvamūtreṇa tad gole ca kṣipet punaḥ |
ruddhvā dhmātaṃ punaḥ secyam evaṃ kuryāt trisaptadhā ||82||
evaṃ ca mriyate vajraṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvatra yojayet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. ratnānāṃ śodhanamāraṇam apy āha - tāvat pūrvaṃ vajrasya śodhanam āha - kulatthaketi | vajraṃ hīrakaṃ | tac caturvidhaṃ bhavati | tathā hi - ‘śvetaraktapītakṛṣṇāś caturdhā vajrajātayaḥ | rasāyane bhaved vipraḥ śubhraḥ siddhyaṣṭadāyakaḥ ||
kṣatriyo mṛtyujid rakto valīpalitarogahā |
dhanaprado bhaved vaiśyaḥ pīto dehasya dārḍhyakṛt ||
kṛṣṇaḥ śūdro rujāṃ hantā vapustambhaṃ karoti ca |
puṃstrīnapuṃsakāś caite lakṣaṇena tu lakṣayet||
suvṛttāḥ phalasaṃpūrṇās tejovanto bṛhattarāḥ |
puruṣās te samākhyātā rekhābinduvivarjitā: ||
rekhābindusamāyuktāḥ ṣaḍasrās tāḥ striyaḥ smṛtāḥ |
trikoṇadehadīrghaṃ ca tan napuṃsakam eva ca ||
pūrvapūrvaṃ tu te śreṣṭhāḥ puruṣā rasabandhakāḥ |
śarīrakāntijanakā bhogadā vajrayoṣitaḥ |
napuṃsakās tv alpavīryā akāmā: satvavarjitāḥ |
striyaḥ strīṇāṃ pradātavyāḥ klībe klībaṃ tathaiva ca || sarveṣāṃ sarvadā yojyāḥ puruṣā balavattarāḥ’ iti | anyatrā'pi
‘pañca doṣā guṇāḥ pañca chāyā caiva caturvidhā |
śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā caiva nigṛhyate || ṣaṭkoṇaṃ laghu tīkṣṇaṃ ca bṛhad aṣṭadalaṃ ca yat | jale tarati tad vajraṃ tad grāhyaṃ rasakarmaṇi’ iti | etasya śodhanādikam apy āha - kulatthetyādi | kulattho 'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | kodravo 'pyannaviśeṣaḥ | kvāthena kṛtvā dolāyantre vipācayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | taptam iti dolāyantrasveditaṃ tad vajraṃ paścād agnau saṃtaptaṃ kṛtvā tadanu kharamūtre niṣecayet | evaṃ trisaptadhā kṛtvā mṛtaṃ vajraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ | kecit tu dolāyantre svedanam ahorātreṇaiva bhavati | tathā ca tantrāntare ‘kulatthakodravakvāthe dolāyantreṇa pācayet | ahorātrāt samuddhṛtya hayamūtreṇa bhāvayet’ iti || 79-82 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athety anantaraṃ śārṅgadharānuktam api ratnasaṃkhyām āha - tatra pañca navaratnāni bhavanti tāny āha -
‘pañcaratnāni mukhyāni uparatnacatuṣṭayaṃ |
vajraṃ muktāphalaṃ caiva pravālaṃ mārkataṃ tathā |
puṣparāgaṃ nīlavajraṃ gomedaṃ ca viḍūryakaṃ | navaratnāni caitāni śodhayen mārayed bhiṣak’ iti | vajraṃ hīrakaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ, marakataḥ tad dharitavarṇaṃ, puṣparāgaṃ campakahemavarṇābhaṃ, nīlaṃ indranīlaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ, vaiḍūryakaṃ vaidūryamaṇir biḍālanetravarṇaṃ nīlapītavarṇam | atha vajraśodhanaṃ -vyāghrīkandaṃ guharīkandam iti śodhanam | atha māraṇaṃ | kharo gardabhaḥ | matkuṇaḥ khaṭvamallaḥ | anyad api hiṃgviti | anyac ca sugamam ||79-82||

athānyad api vajramāraṇam āhvajrakamṛtirnaiva sugamā | kharadaṃṣṭrāmadhye bhavatyeva iti kecana | -
hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyukte kvāthe kaulatthaje kṣipet || 83 ||

taptaṃ taptaṃ punar vajraṃ bhūryāc cūrṇaṃ trisaptadhā | aparam api vajramāraṇam āha -
maṇḍūkaṃ kāṃsyaje pātre nigṛhya sthāpayet sudhīḥ ||84||

lg.l: sa bhīto mūtrayet tatra tanmūtre vajram āvapet |
taptaṃ taptaṃ ca bahudhā vajrasyaivaṃ mṛtir bhavet || 85 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. hiṅgusaindhaveti | kulatthaṃ prasiddham | tadbhave kvāthe hiṅgusaindhavakalkena vajraṃ liptvā'gnau saṃtāpya kula- tthakvāthenaiva secayed iti sampradāyaḥ || 83 || maṇḍūkam iti | maṇḍūkānāṃ mūtravidhānam atra subodhaṃ jñātavyam | tatrādau vajram agnau saṃtaptaṃ kṛtvā tanmaṇḍūkamūtre āvapet | secayed ity arthaḥ | taptaṃ ca bahudhā iti ko 'rthaḥ saptavāraṃ yāvat kuryād ity arthaḥ ||84||85||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ vaikrāntamāraṇam āha -
vaikrāntaṃ vajravac chodhyaṃ nīlaṃ vā lohitaṃ tathā |
hayamūtreṇa tat secyaṃ taptaṃ taptaṃ dvisaptadhā || 86 ||

lg.l: tatas tu meṣadugdhasya pañcāṅge golakaṃ kṣipet |
puṭenmūṣāpuṭe ruddhvā kuryād evaṃ ca saptadhā || 87 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. vaikrāntam iti | vajravac chodhyam iti | yathā, vajraṃ pūrvaṃ śodhitaṃ kulatthādikvāthena tathā vaikrāntam api saṃśodhya paścān mārayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | yato ‘vaikrāntaṃ vajrabhedaṃ syāt’ iti | keṣāṃcin mate caturvidhaṃ bhavati | vajram atra dvividham eva grāhyaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt hayamūtreṇa ghoṭakamūtreṇa | taptaṃ taptam iti ko 'rthaḥ ? taptvāgnau saṃtāpya mūtre āvaped ity arthaḥ | evaṃ caturdaśavāraṃ yāvat kuryāt | tataḥ paścāt | vaikrāntaṃ meṣadugdhaṃ tasya pañcāṅgaṃ tasya golakaṃ kṛtvā tatra vaikrāntaṃ melayitvā paścān mūṣāpuṭe saṃrudhyā'gnau pacet | meṣadugdhaṃ meṣadugdhikā tasyāḥ pañcāṅgam ity arthaḥ, pañcāṅgaṃ tvakpatrapuṣpaphalamūlāni | evaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā bhasmatāṃ yāti | kecit tu meṣadugdhasyety asya sthāne ‘latās tvottara- vāruṇyā’ iti paṭhanti tasmāt pañcāṅgaṃ laghvindravāruṇyā grāhyam | granthāntaradarśanāc ca | (tathā hi
‘tataś cottaravā- ruṇyā pañcāṅgaṃ golakaṃ kṣipet |
ruddhvā mūṣāpuṭe paścāt paced uddhṛtya golakāt | kṣiptvā ruddhvā paceś caivaṃ saptadhā bhasmatāṃ nayet’ iti | vajrasthāne niyojayed iti tad vaikrāntaṃ tasya kārye niyojayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | ata eva vaikrāntaṃ vajravac chodhyam iti kathitam || 86 || 87 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vaikrāntamāraṇaṃ | vaikrāntaṃ vikṛtim āpannaṃ hīrakaṃ hīrakajātiviśeṣaḥ | kapha iti ratnaparīkṣakāḥ prāñcaḥ | meṣadugdhī prasiddhā || 86 || 87 ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ śeṣaratnaśodhanamāraṇam apy āha --
svedayed dolikāyantre jayantyāḥ svarasena ca || 88 ||

Āḍhamalla. svedayed iti | jayantī śākabhedaḥ | maṇimuktapravālānīti | maṇayo nānāvidhās te māṇikyapuṣpa- rāganīlamaṇivaidūryagārutmataprabhṛtayaḥ | muktā mauktikaṃ | te 'pi bahudhā bhavanti | pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ tad api bahuvidham, kumārī nārīśabdavācyā, taṇḍulīyo meghanādaḥcaurāīśabdavācyaḥ| , stanyaṃ kṣīraṃ, tena kim uktam | ratnādīni pūrvaṃ dolāyantre jayantyāḥ svarasena saṃsvedya yāmaikaṃ yāvat paścāt tad agnau saṃtaptaṃ kṛtvā kumāryādīnām ekatamarasena niṣiṃcayet | evaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā mṛtāni bhavantīty arthaḥ | mauktānīti bahuvacanatvenāṣṭaprakārāṇi teṣām ucyante | tad yathā -
‘meghānām atha śaṅkhānāṃ varāhasya ca dantinaḥ |
mīnajaṃ vaṃśajaṃ caiva phaṇijaṃ śuktijaṃ tathā |
aṣṭau muktāphalāny eva sadā jāraṇakarmaṇi |
guṇayuktāni gṛhyante doṣayuktāni varjayet’ | yataḥ - ‘sthūlaṃ vṛttaṃ guru snigdhaṃ raśmitārajalānvitam | śvetam āhlādakaṃ svacchaṃ muktāyāś ca guṇā daśa’ iti | pravālānīti bahuvacanenā'trāpi jātiguṇadoṣādikaṃ sūcayati | tathā hi
‘atiriktaṃ ca dīptaṃ ca vidrumaṃ parimaṇḍalam |
snigdhaṃ ca svaccharūpaṃ ca baddhaṃ śuddhaṃ samaṃ guru ||
aṅgārasadṛśaṃ piṇḍaṃ pravāle 'mī guṇā daśa |
gauraṃ raṅgajalākrāntaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vakraṃ sakoṭaraṃ || rukṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ laghu śvetaṃ pravālam aśubhaṃ tyajet | tathā ratnāny aśeṣata’ iti | aśeṣato 'pi tajjñasakāśād avagantavyāni | teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇāni likhyante yathā - ‘padmarāgaṃ kuruvindaṃ sugandhaṃ nīlagandhakam | māṇikyaṃ caiva vijñeyaṃ brāhmaṇādikrameṇa tu ||
nirdhūmaṃ jvaladaṅgāram indrago- pasamaprabham |
guñjārāgapratīkāśaṃ māṇikyaṃ rasakarmaṇi ||
cāmpeyakasamo varṇair hemavarṇaḥ sunirmalaḥ |
atidīpto bhaved yas tu padmarāgaḥ sa ucyate |
sthūlavṛddhamadhucchāyaṃ bhrājiṣṇu śvetam ujjvalam ||
guru snigdhaṃ tathā proktaṃ rasarājasya karmaṇi |
indranīlo mahānīlo nīlaś ca kṛṣṇanīlakaḥ |
ete nīlās tu catvāro brāhmaṇādikrameṇa tu |
atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ nīlajīmūtasannibham||
yaḥ karoti payonīlaṃ mahānīlaṃ tad ucyate |
biḍālanetrasaṃkāśaṃ nīlapītaṃ sunirmalam ||
calaṃ lasunamadhyasthaṃ vaidūryaṃ rasakarmaṇi |
vijñeyo garuḍodgāraḥ kīrapakṣo dvitīyakaḥ ||
tṛtīyo vaṃśapatraś ca caturtho dhūlidhūsaraḥ |
khadyotadyutisaṃkāśo mayūrakaṃṭhasannibhaḥ || komalatvaṃ caturṇāṃ supraśastaṃ rasakarmaṇi, iti | kim uktaṃ bahunā
‘pañcadoṣā guṇāḥ pañca cchāyā caiva caturvidhā |
śvetā pītā tathā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva nigṛhyate || sarve bhānunibhā dīptā doṣāḥ paṭalavarjitāḥ | nijair varṇaiḥ samāyuktā utkṛṣṭā rasakarmaṇi’ iti | atha prayogāntaram āha -uktamākṣikavad ityādi | pūrvoktasvarṇamākṣikaśodhanavidhānavat muktāpravālāni śodhayet sarvaratnāni ca vajraśodhanamāraṇavidhivat samprasādhayed ity abhiprāyaḥ || 88-91 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha śeṣaratnaśodhanamāraṇaṃ | jayantīsvarasena dolāyantre maṇikādīni svedayet | maṇiḥ sūryacandrakāntādimaṇiḥ | yad vā maṇiḥ | tathā ca ‘bhramaraśikhikaṇṭhavarṇaśikhā samaprabho bhujaṅgānāṃ bhavati maṇiḥ kila mūrdhapriyo 'narghyaguṇaḥ sa vijñeya’ iti | pravālaṃ vidrumam | atha māraṇaṃ tandulīyakaḥ meghanādaḥ śākaḥ, stanyena strīdugdhena uktamākṣikavat svarṇamākṣikavat māraṇaṃ jambīrarasādau || 88-91 ||

athedānīṃ śilājatuśodhanaprakāraṃ darśayann āha --
śilājatu samānīya grīṣmataptaśilācyutam ||92||

lg.l: ātape dinam ekaikaṃ tac chuddhaṃ śuddhatāṃ vrajet || 93 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. śilājatvityādi | jatur lākṣā tatprakāśavat śilābhyaḥ prasrutaṃ dravaviśeṣaṃ tat śilājatuśabdavācyam | tantrāntare 'pi
‘māsi śukre śucau caiva śilāḥ sūryāṃśutāpitāḥ |
catuḥprakāśaṃ svarasaṃ śilābhyaḥ prasravanti hi | śilājatviti vikhyātaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam’ iti | nanu rūkṣakaṭhinānāṃ śilānāṃ kathaṃ snigdhadravaḥ svarasaḥ saṃbhavati ? | satyam | atra śilopalakṣitatvāt tattaddhātava eva prasravanti | tathā coktam ‘śailasya dhātoḥ svarasaṃ śilābhyaḥ sūryapratāpāj jatusaṃprakāśam | kṛṣṇaṃ bhaven mūtrasamānagandhi tad eva ramyaṃ tu śilājatu syāt’ iti | matāntare 'pi ‘hemādyāḥ sūryasaṃtaptāḥ sravanti giridhātavaḥ| jatvābhaṃ mṛdu mṛtsnācchaṃ yan malaṃ tac chilājatu’ iti | iti tantrāntare 'pi prasiddham etat| tad yathā ‘taptādīnāṃ tu lohānāṃ ṣaṇṇām anyatamānvayam | jñeyaṃ svagandhataś cāpi ṣaḍyoniprathitaṃ kṣitau’ iti | yataḥ lohād bhavati tad yasmāc chilājatu jatuprabhaṃ | tasya lohasya yad vīryaṃ rasaṃ vāpi bibharti tat’ iti | prasaṅgato 'pi catuṣṭayaṃ yathā - ‘hemno vai rajatāt tāmrāt tathā syād ayasād api | gomūtragandhi sarveṣāṃ yathāpūrvam anuttamam’ iti | anyatrāpy uktam ‘trapusīsāyasādīni pradhānāny uttarottaram | yathā tathā prayoge 'pi śreṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ’ iti | caturṇām api mukhyānāṃ prasravaṃ śilājatu catuṣṭayam atra guṇakhyāpanāya cānyayonivāraṇāya ca bhavatīti| samānīyeti atra samyag grahaṇaṃ śreṣṭhagrahaṇanimittam avagantavyam | katham asya śreṣṭhatvam ity atrāha kaścit - ‘teṣu kṛṣṇaṃ malaṃ snigdhaṃ laghu ni:śarkaraṃ bhavet| gomūtragandhavac cāpi tat pradhānaṃ pracakṣate’ iti | grīṣmataḥ praśilācyutam iti yady apy anyasmin kāle śilājatuprasravaṃ dṛśyate tathāpi grīṣme kharatarakiraṇatāpitābhyaḥ śilābhyo guṇavattaraṃ bhavati | godugdhair ityādibahuvacanāntaiḥ kṛtvā bahuvāraṃ bhāvayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ ‘ghamarā’ iti loke | atra bhāvyasamānakvathanīyaṃ dravyaṃ grāhyam | kvathanīyadravyam aṣṭaguṇe jale niṣkvāthya caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭe kaṣāye bhāvayet | tac chuddhaṃ śuddhatāṃ vajred iti | nanu pūrvaṃ yac chuddhaṃ syāt tat kathaṃ paścāc chuddhatāṃ vrajed ity atra śuddhaśabdadvayaṃ ca kimartham ? ucyate, pūrvaṃ śilājatupiṇḍaṃ dhūpādinā saṃśodhya paścād anena vidhinā śodhayed ity adoṣaḥ | tathā hi - ‘duṣṭauṣadhikīṭapataṅgadaṃśasaṃtālikādoṣanivāraṇārtham | lohāḍhakau nimbaguḍūcisarpiryavair yathāvat paridhūpayec ca’ iti | pūrvaśodhitam eveti sarvasaṃmatam || 92 || 93 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha śilājatuśodhanaṃ | grīṣme grīṣmakāle taptaśilācyutaṃ śilājatu samānīya yathā bhūmau na patati godugdhādibhir mardayet śuddhyatīti | atha bhūmipati tasya śodhanaṃ mukhyam | uttamaśilājatupāṣāṇaṃ sūkṣmakhaṇḍaprakalpitaṃ kṛtam atyuṣṇapānīye nikṣipya yāmaikaṃ sthāpayet | mardayitvā tan nīraṃ vastragālitaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, mṛtpātre sthāpayitvā ātape dhārayet | granthāntare lohapātre niṣkāsanam uktaṃ | catvāri pātrāṇy asitāyasānīty uktatvāt | uparisthe yat ghanaṃ tat anyapātre kṣipet | tatra jalaṃ datvā tasmād anyasmin evaṃ dvimāsābhyāṃ jveṣṭhāṣāḍhābhyāṃ niḥsārayet tato vahnikṣiptau liṅgopamaṃ liṅgākāraṃ bhavet tadā kāryakṣamaṃ kāryasādhakaṃ bhūyād iti parīkṣā | spaṣṭam anyat || 92 || 93 ||

ab.seg:
athānyakaraṇaprakāram āha --
mukhyāṃ śilājatuśilāṃ sūkṣmakhaṇḍaprakalpitām |
nikṣipyātyuṣṇapānīye yāmaikaṃ sthāpayet sudhīḥ || 94 ||

lg.l: sthāpayitvā ca mṛtpātre dhārayed ātape budhaḥ || 95 ||
uparisthaṃ dhanaṃ yat syāt tat kṣiped anyapātrake |
dhārayed ātape tasmād uparisthaṃ ghanaṃ nayet || 96 ||
evaṃ punaḥ punar nītvā dvimāsābhyāṃ śilājatu |
bhūyāt kāryakṣamaṃ vahnau kṣiptaṃ liṅgopamaṃ bhavet || 97 ||
nirdhūmaṃ ca tataḥ śuddhaṃ sarvakarmasu yojayet |
adhaḥsthitaṃ ca yac cheṣaṃ tasmin nīraṃ vinikṣipet || 98 ||
vimardya dhārayed dharme pūrvavac caiva tan nayet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. mukhyāṃ śilājatuśilam iti | mukhyā pūrvaṃ darśitā tajjātiṣu śreṣṭhā | śilājatuśilām iti śilājatoḥ śilāvat saghanapiṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhya paścāt pūrvoktavidhinā saṃśoṣya tadanu sūkṣmakhaṇḍaṃ yathā syāt prakalpyātyuṣṇapānīyaṃ prakṣipya yāmaikaṃ yāvat sthāpayet | tatas tapyate sudhīr iti sadvaidyaḥ | sudhīr iti grahaṇamatra sukaraṇavidhānārthaṃ | yato 'sya karaṇaṃ kālādikam apekṣate | yathoktam
‘athoṣṇakāle ravitāpayukte vyabhre vivāte samabhūmibhāge |
pātreṣu kṛṣṇāyasanirmiteṣu vidhānavad drāvayituṃ pacet tu’ | katham ? yathā ‘śilājatu śreṣṭham avāpya pātre prakṣipya tasmād viguṇaṃ ca toyam | uṣṇaṃ tadartha bhṛśam atra dattvā viśoṣayet tan mṛditaṃ yathāvat ||
tatas tu yat kṛṣṇam upaiti cordhvaṃ vilīyamānaṃ raviraśmitaptam |
tat kācapātre 'nyatame vidhāya tatrāparaṃ koṣṇajalaṃ kṣipet tu ||
punaś ca tasmād aparan tu pātrād asmāc ca pātrād aparan tu bhūyaḥ |
punas tato 'rdhvaṃ tu nidhāya kṛṣṇaṃ yad uddhṛtaṃ tat punar āharec ca || yadā viśuddhaṃ jalam acchamardya pracchannabhāvān malayet tu tasmāt | tadā tyajet tacchrimalaṃ śilājatu syāj jalam aśuddham evam iti bhūyāt | kāryakṣamam iti anena prakāreṇa yac chilājatu snehaṃ śuddhaṃ (kṛtaṃnāsti khapustake tat sarvakāryeṣu yojayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā hi - ‘śuddhaṃ bhāvitayuktaṃ tu vidhinānena mānavaḥ | śilājatu prayuñjānaḥ sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate’ iti | vahnau kṣiptam iti evaṃ saṃskāritasyā'sya śreṣṭhatvaṃ tadā syād yadā'gnau kṣipte sati nirdhūmaṃ bhavati | liṅgopamaṃ ca bhavati | tathā hi -
‘vahnau kṣiptaṃ tu nirdhūmaṃ yac ca liṅgopamaṃ bhavet |
śuddhaṃ yojyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ hārītādyair maharṣibhiḥ’ || 94-58 ||

atha maṇḍūrakaraṇam -
akṣāṅgārair dhamet kiṭṭaṃ lohajaṃ tad gavāṃ jalaiḥ || 99 ||

lg.l: secayet taptataptaṃ ca saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
āloḍya bharjayed vahnau maṇḍūraṃ jāyate varam |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. atha maṇḍūrakaraṇavidhānam āha - akṣeti | akṣāṅgārair iti bahuvacanatvenānyakāṣṭhodbhavair api dhamed iti na doṣaḥ | kiṭṭaṃ lohamalaṃ tad bahuvārṣikaṃ grāhyaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt| tathā hi - ‘śatottham uttamaṃ kiṭṭaṃ madhyaṃ cāśītivārṣikam | adhamaṃ ṣaṣṭivarṣīyaṃ tato hīnaṃ viṣopamam’ iti | lohajam iti sāmānyalohagrahaṇena muṇḍādisamastalohasaṃbhavaṃ tadguṇam api ca jñātavyaṃ | yataḥ -
‘yāni lohāni tat saṃjñālakṣaṇāni guṇāni ca |
maṇḍūraṃ tadguṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yal loham api yadguṇam | ata eva ‘kiṭṭād daśaguṇaṃ muṇḍaṃ muṇḍāt tīkṣṇaṃ śatonmitam’ ityādi | anyac ca - ‘ye guṇā mārite muṇḍe te guṇā muṇḍakiṭṭake | tasmāt sarvatra maṇḍūraṃ rogaśāntau niyojayet’ iti | gavāṃ jalair gomūtraiḥ | tathā ca nirvāpya bahumūtre secayed iti | evaṃ saptavāraṃ kuryāt | punaḥ punar iti grahaṇenā'tra saptavāraṃ niyataṃ, kiṃtu yāvat śīryate tāvan nirvāpayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā coktaṃ ‘lohakiṭṭaṃ susaṃtaptaṃ yāvat tat śīryate svayaṃ | tac chīrṇaṃ grāhayet teṣāṃ maṇḍūraṃ tu prayojayet’ iti | evaṃ saptavāraṃ kuryāt triphalākvāthasya dviguṇitā'tra | maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayet varam iti śreṣṭhaṃ | śreṣṭhatā'syāñjanasādṛśyāt bhavati ||99 ||100||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. aṅgārair bibhītakāṅgārais triphalākvāthair maṇḍūradviguṇaḥ || 99 || 100 ||

atha kṣārakalpanāṃ darśayitum āha --
kṣīravṛkṣasya kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇy agnau pradīpayet || 101||
nītvā tad bhasma mṛtpātre kṣiptvā nīre caturguṇe |
vimardya dhārayed rātrau prātar acchaṃ jalaṃ nayet || 102 ||
tan nīraṃ kvāthayed vahnau yāvat sarvaṃ viśuṣyati |
tataḥ pātrāt samullikhya kṣāro grāhyaḥ sitaprabhaḥ || 103||
cūrṇābhaḥ pratisāryaḥ syāt peyaḥ syāt kvāthavat sthitaḥ |
iti kṣāradvayaṃ dhīmān yuktakāryeṣu yojayet || 104 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracittāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe dhātuśodhanamāraṇaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. kṣīravṛkṣasyeti | kṣīravṛkṣo 'tra muṣkakaḥ kathitaḥ; sa ca parvatajaḥ morava iti loke | kecit sāmā- nyagrahaṇenaivānye kṣīravṛkṣā api gṛhyante ity āhuḥ | tad yathā - ‘kuṭajapalāśāśvakarṇapāribhadrabibhītakāragvadha- bilvakā'rkasnuhyapāmārgapāṭalānaktamālavṛkṣakadalīcitrakapūtīkendravṛkṣāsphotāśvamārakasaptacchadāgnimanthaguñjāś ca-tasraḥ kośātakī samūlaphalapatraśākhā dahet’ iti | kāṣṭhānīti bahuvacanenātra kṣīravṛkṣasya kāṣṭhānāṃ bahūn khaṇḍān kṛtvā pāṭya dahed ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā tantrāntare ‘taṃ cikīrṣuḥ śaradi girisānujaṃ śucir upoṣya praśaste 'hani praśastadeśajātam anupahatamadhyamavayasaṃ mahāntam asitamuṣkakam adhivāsyāparedyuḥ pāṭayitvā khaṇḍaśaḥ prakalpyāvapāṭya nivātadeśe nicitaṃ kṛtvā tilanālair ādīpayet | athopaśānte 'gnau tad bhasma pṛthag gṛhṇīyāt’ iti | cūrṇābhaḥ pratisārya iti pratisāryaḥ pratisāraṇīyaḥ | yaḥ kvāthavat sthitaḥ peyaḥ sa pānīya iti saṃjñaḥ | evaṃ kṣārasya dvaividhyaṃ bhavati | iti yuktakāryeṣu yuktavyādhiṣu yathāyogyaṃ yojayed ity arthaḥ | yuktavyādhiṣu yathā tatra pratisāraṇīyaḥ | kuṣṭhakiṭibhadadrumaṇḍalakilāsabhagandarārbudārśoduṣṭavraṇanāḍīcarmakīlatilakālakanyacchavyaṅgamaśakabāhyavidradhikṛmi-viṣādiṣūcyate | saptasu ca mukharogeṣūpajihvā'dhijihvopakuśadantavaidarbheṣu tisṛṣu ca rohiṇīṣv ete- ṣv anuśastravidhānam uktam| pānīyas tu gulmodaragarāgniśūlājīrṇānāha śarkarāśmaryābhyantaravidradhiḥ kṛmiviṣārśaḥ - sūpayujyate iti | pānīyaḥ pānārhaḥ kṣārodakam ity arthaḥ | ye cānye 'pi pākyasvarjikāyavakṣārā yathāyogyaṃ vaktavyā- steṣāṃ cūrṇavaṭakāvalehādiṣu prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ | dhīmān iti | grahaṇaṃ kṣārakarmaṇi caturo bhiṣak tathā prayateta na yathā kṣāro 'guṇo bhavati | tad yathā ‘naivātitīkṣṇe na mṛduḥ śuklaḥ ślakṣṇo 'tha picchilaḥ | abhiṣyandī śivaḥ śīghraḥ kṣāro hy aṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ’ iti | doṣāś cāsya yathā -
‘atyauṣṇyam atipaicchilyam atitīkṣṇavisarpitā |
atyarthaṃ mārdavaṃ śaityama- tyarthaṃ sāndram eva ca | nyūnauṣadhavipakvatvaṃ kṣāradoṣā nava smṛtāḥ’ iti || 101-104 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe śodhanamāraṇakalpanaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||11||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kṣārakalpanā | kṣīravṛkṣasya kāṣṭhāni apāmārgaciṃcākadalīpalāśasehuṇḍacitrakaśigrūkaṇṭakārīprabhṛtīni | pradīpayet jvālayet, acchaṃ nirmalaṃ jalaṃ lohapātre kvāthayet| yas tu cūrṇābhaḥ kṣāraḥ sa pratisāryaḥ, masakādau prayojyaḥ, yas tu kvāthavat dravarūpaḥ sthitaḥ, sa gulmādau peyaḥ ity uktaṃ kṣāradvayaṃ | cūrṇalakṣaṇaṃ yuktakāryeṣu gulmādau cārayet| tathā ca vāgbhaṭaḥ -
‘peyokṣārāgnisādāśmagulmodarajarādiṣu |
yojyaḥ sākṣo masaścitrabāhyārśaḥkuṣṭhasuptiṣu’ || 101-104 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dhātuśodhanamāraṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

div.head: atha rasakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ athedānīṃ rasapraśaṃsāpūrvakaṃ tacchodhanamāraṇādikam āha -
pāradaḥ sarvarogāṇāṃ jetā puṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ |
sudine‘sujñena’ gū.dī. sammata: | sādhitaḥ kuryāt saṃsiddhiṃ dehalohayoḥ || 1||

Āḍhamalla. pārada iti | bhavasindhoḥ pāraṃ dadātīti pāradaḥ | ata eva rasapraśaṃsāyām uktam ‘tejo mṛgāṅkamauleḥ soḍhaṃ svenaiva tejasāṃ puñjaiḥ | ajarāmaratvavitaraṇakalpataruṃ taṃ raseśvaraṃ vande’ | aparam api - ‘aṇimādyaṣṭaguṇair vibhūtidoṣaṃ na saṃsāram apārapāradaḥ | muktvaikaṃ rasarājaṃ konyo 'thāste jarāpaho hy aparaḥ’ iti | īdṛk pāradaḥ sudine sādhitaḥ | sa ca dehalohayoḥ siddhiṃ kuryād iti tātparyārthaḥ | dehasiddhir vyādhiharatvena | śarīrārogyatā lohasiddhiś ca svarṇarajataśodhanakaraṇādikaḥ | punaḥ kīdṛśo rasaḥ | sarvarogāṇāṃ jetā | sarve ca te rogāḥ śarīramano 'bhipannā jvaramadamūrcchādayaḥ, teṣāṃ jetā vināśakara ity arthaḥ | punaḥ kiṃbhūto rasaḥ ? puṣṭikara iti | puṣṭir dhātupoṣaṇaṃ tāṃ karoti iti puṣṭikaraḥ | ata eva poṣaṇād vājīkaraṇaśaktyāyam api vikhyātaḥ | sudine iti | śobhanadivase jyotiḥśāstroktasaumyatithinakṣatrādiyukte dine ity arthaḥ | tathā coktam -
‘natvā guruṃ bhairavakanyakābaṭuṃ dvīpānanaṃ siddham amuṣya rakṣitam |
anta: sunīlaṃ bahir ujjvalaṃ rasaṃ niveśayet khalvatale śubhe dine’| anyatrāpy uktam - ‘vijane pavanādivarjite vā deśe saumyadine dinādikāle | balim atra vidhāya pūjanaṃ ca tadanu vidhiḥ pratimantritaṃ vidhijñaiḥ’ iti | sādhita iti parimāṇādikena saṃskāritaḥ | tad yathā -
‘raso grāhyaḥ sunakṣatre palānāṃ śatamātrakaṃ |
pañcāśat pa- ñcaviṃśad vā daśa pañcaikam eva vā |
palān nyūnaṃ na kartavyaṃ rasasaṃskāram uttamam |
tasmāt sūtaviśuddhyarthaṃ sahāyair nipuṇair yutaḥ | sarvopaskaram ādāya rasakarma samārabhet’ ityādi | saṃsiddhim iti | aihikīm āmuṣmikīṃ ca | uktaṃ ca yataḥ - ‘baddhaḥ khecaratāṃ padaṃ nayed dharate vyādhisamūhaṃ mūrcchitaḥ | jārito janmajarāvināśanaḥ krāmito rañjito bhaktimuktidaḥ || yadi pañcatvagataṃ hi sūtakaṃ bhakṣitaṃ syād amaratvakārakam | jalaukāranibaddhaḥ sarvajo grathito manmatharasadāyakaḥ | bhasmākā- ragataṃ girīśajam asitaṃ bhūcarabhūtisiddhidaṃ | pārāpāram apārapāradaṃ tasmāt kaḥ karuṇākaro 'paraḥ’ iti | deha- lohayor iti | dehaṃ śarīraṃ tasya siddhir jarāvyādhirāhityaṃ lohaṃ suvarṇādi tasya siddhiḥ saṃskāratvam atra vistarabhayān na likhitam || 1 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha rasakalpanā | pāradaḥ sarvarogāṇāṃ jvarādīnāṃ jetā | tathā puṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ | sujñena tatsādhakena sādhitaḥ tadā dehalohayoḥ siddhaṃ kuryāt || 1 ||

idānīṃ rasarājasya paryāyanāmāny āha -
rasendraḥ pāradaḥ sūto harajaḥ sūtako rasaḥ |
budhais tasyeti‘mukundaśce’ti gū.dī. sammata: | nāmani jñeyāni rasakarmasu || 2 ||

Āḍhamalla. rasendreti | rasendretyādirasāntāni pāradasya nāmāni rasakarmasu jñeyāni | kaiḥ budhaiḥ | tasyeti rasasya, iti grahaṇena saṃkṣepanāmāny abhihitāni | anyāny api santi vistareṇa | tathā hi -
‘raso mahārasaḥ sūtas trinetraś ca trilocanaḥ |
harabījaś calaś caiva bījendro 'tha rasāyanaḥ |
pāradaś ca suvarṇākhyo mahāvahnis tathaiva ca ||
lokeśa: khecaro divyaḥ saubhāgyaḥ paramā'mṛtaḥ |
śaśihemanidhiś caiva ananto jñānam eva ca || sūkṣmaḥ śāntaḥ prabhuś caiva kalikāntakaraḥ smṛtaḥ | etāni rasanāmāni tathānyāni śive yathā’ iti || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pāradanāmāny āha - rasendraḥ rasānām indra adhyakṣaḥ, rasendraḥ pāradaḥ | rogādisamudrāt pāradānāt pāradaḥ sūtaḥ | svarṇādisiddhiprasavāt sūtaḥ | harajaḥ harāt jāta iti harajaḥ | sūtakaḥ sūta eva sūtakaḥ svārthe kaḥ | rasyata āsvādyate ṣaḍrasatvād rasaḥ | mukundaḥ mukun mokṣaṃ dadātīti mukundaḥ | auṇādikatvād aḥ ||2||

lg.l: kāṃsyakaṃ kāntalohaṃ ca dhātavo nava ye smṛtāḥ ||3||
sūryādīnāṃ grahāṇāṃ te kathitā nāmabhiḥ kramāt |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. pūrvaṃ dehalohayor iti yal lohagrahaṇaṃ, teṣāṃ lohānāṃ navagrahanāmāṅkitatvena navasaṃkhyākathanam āha - tāmreti | tāmrādayo navasaṃkhyā dhātavo matās te sūryādīnāṃ navagrahāṇāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtvā kramāt kathitāḥ | etena kim uktam - tāmram ādityasaṃjñaṃ, tāraṃ raupyaṃ somasaṃjñam, āraṃ pītalohaṃ tan maṅgalasaṃjñaṃ, nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ tad budhasaṃjñaṃ, hemaṃ suvarṇaṃ tad bṛhaspatisaṃjñaṃ, vaṅgaṃ śukrasaṃjñaṃ, tīkṣṇakam ayas tac chanisaṃjñaṃ, kāṃsyaṃ rāhusaṃjñaṃ, vṛttalohaṃ ketusaṃjñam iti kramaḥ | ete dhātavo navagrahanāmabhir boddhavyā: || 3 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tāmrādidhātūnāṃ sūryādīnām adhiṣṭhānam āha - sugamam | āraḥ pittaliḥ, nāgaḥ sīsakaḥ, hema svarṇaṃ, vaṅgaṃ raṅgaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇalohaṃ, kāntalohaṃ vṛtaloham || 3 ||

idānīṃ rasaśodhanakarmāha -
rājīrasonamūṣāyāṃ rasaṃ kṣiptvā vibandhayet || 4 ||

lg.l: kākamācīrasais tadvad dinam ekaṃ ca mardayet || 6 ||
triphalāyās tathā kvāthai raso mardyaḥ prayatnataḥ |
tatas tebhyaḥ pṛthak kuryāt sūtaṃ prakṣālya kāñjikaiḥ || 7 ||
tataḥ kṣiptvā rasaṃ khalve rasād ardhaṃ ca saindhavam |
tato rājī rasonaś ca mukhyaś ca navasādaraḥ |
etai rasasamais tadvat sūto mardyas tuṣāmbunā || 9 ||
tataḥ saṃśoṣya cakrābhaṃ kṛtvā liptvā ca hiṅgunā |
adhaḥ sthālīṃ tato mudrāṃ dadyādṛḍhatarāṃ budhaḥ |
tatas tu kuryāt tīvrāgniṃ tad adhaḥ praharatrayam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. rājīti | rājīrasonetyādinā prathamataḥ svedanasaṃskāravidhir ārabhyate | yato santi bhūyāṃsaḥ saṃskārāḥ, te ke ity atrāha - ‘saṃsvedanaṃ mardanamūrcchane ca utthāpanaṃ pātanabodhane ca | niyāmanaṃ dīpanam eva cāṣṭau pūrve kṛtāḥ karmaṇi sūtakasya’ iti | anyatrāpy uktam - ‘aṣṭau ca rasasaṃskārā dravye rāsāyane samāḥ | ete prathamaṃ kāryāḥ syuḥ paścāt sarvatra yojayet’ | rasād iti rasaśodhanakarma yat pūrvam uktaṃ tatkarmaśabdaḥ upaskārādīn praśaṃsayati | yataḥ - ‘sarvopaskaram ādāya rasakarma samārabhet’ ityādivacanam | tathā hi - ‘upaskaraṃ na yo vetti tasya siddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet’ ity api | tasmād upa- skarāṇi katipayāni likhyante | tad yathā - tulābhājanaṃ tac ca dvividhaṃ tulā ghaṇṭakaṃ ceti; khalvabhājanaṃ tac ca trividhaṃ pāṣāṇakhalvaṃ, lohakhalaṃ, tāmrakhalvaṃ ca; kaṇḍanī sā ca dvividhā śilākaṇḍanī, pāṣāṇakaṇḍanī ca; vicitrakha- rparāṇi tāmrādīnāṃ bhājanāni mṛṇmayāni ca; koṣṭhikā sā ca trividhā jālakoṣṭhikā kharparakoṣṭhikā bhūmikoṣṭhikā ceti; bhasrikā sā ca trividhā carmabhastrikā, karparabhastrikā, mukhabhastrikā ceti, nalikā sā ca dvividhā nalikā, vakranalikā ceti | nalikā lohamayī vakranalikā mṛṇmayī, mūṣā sā ca dvividhā pakvā apakvā ca, apakvāyā bhedo vajramūṣāyāḥ kumbhakāreṇa sumṛttikayā kṛtā sā pakvamūṣā; tayor bhedā yathā mūṣā, gostanā, andhamūṣā, nalikāmūṣā, sampuṭīmūṣā, ḍholīmūṣā, iṣṭikāmūṣā, kṣāramūṣā, saindhavādilavaṇamūṣā kharparamūṣā, kokilākhyamūṣā, hematāratāmralohasīsakamūṣādayaḥ | saṇḍiśaś ca tad dvividhaḥ patrasaṇḍiśaḥ, kākamukhasaṇḍiśaś ceti | hastakuṭṭakanirghā- tādayaḥ sarvāṇi suvarṇakāropaskarāṇi ca | puṭaṃ tac caturvidhaṃ tuṣapuṭaṃ, karīṣapuṭam, upalapuṭaṃ, khadirādikāṣṭhapuṭaṃ ceti | yantrāṇi ca tad yathā - śilāyantraṃ, pāṣāṇayantraṃ, bhūdharayantraṃ, vaṃśanalikāyantraṃ, gajadantabhājanayantraṃ, dolāyantraṃ, adhaḥpātanayantram, ūrdhvapātanayantraṃ, niyāmakayantraṃ, ḍamarukayantraṃ, kaṭāhayantraṃ, kāṃsyabhājanayantraṃ, pātālayantraṃ, tulāyantraṃ, kacchapayantraṃ, cakrayantraṃ, cākīyantraṃ, vālukāyantram, agnisomayantraṃ, gandhakaṭahikāyantraṃ, mūṣāyantraṃ, bāṇayantraṃ, garuḍayantraṃ, sāraṇayantraṃ, jālikāyantraṃ, cāraṇayantrādīni anyāny api yathāyogyaṃ bhavanti | tatra tatra eva jñātavyāni | tatra teṣv ādau svedanavidhim āha - ‘rājīrasonamūṣāyāṃ rasaṃ kṣiptvā vibandhayet’ ityādivyākhyānaṃ sampradāyato likhyate | yathā rājīkādikalkena mūṣāṃ kṛtvā tatra rasaṃ melayitvā upari kadalīdalair veṣṭayitvā tad upari caturguṇena vastreṇa poṭṭalikāṃ baddhvā kāñjikādipūrite bhāṇḍe dolāyantravidhānena svedayet | yāvad dinatrayaṃ bhavati | dinagrahaṇena rātrir api gṛhyate tenāhorātraṃ svedayed ity abhiprāya:, etad api vidhānaṃ tantrāntare coktaṃ tad yathā -
‘rājikā lavaṇaṃ hiṅgu citrakaṃ vyoṣasaṃyutam |
sūtapādamitaṃ sarvaṃ svarjikākṣārasaṃyutam ||
śigrapatrarasenaiva piṣṭvā kuṇḍalikākṛtam |
kuryād bhūrjadale samyag athavā kadalīdale ||
supakve ca dṛḍhe vā'pi vastrakhaṇḍe caturguṇe |
rasaṃ madhye vinikṣipya badhnīyāt tu supoṭṭalīm ||
kṣārāmlamūtravargeṇa svedayec ca dinatrayam |
tathā svedaḥ prakartavyo majjitā poṭṭalī yathā || bhaven na ca talasparśo bhāṇḍasyā'pi kadācana’ iti | dolāyanttrapramāṇam |
‘dravadravyeṇa bhāṇḍasya pūrito 'rdhasya tasya ca |
mukhe tiryak kṛte daṇḍe rasaṃ sūtreṇa lambitam |
taṃ svedayen madhyagataṃ dolāyantram iti smṛtam|’ atha pratyekasaṃskārānte mardanam uktaṃ tat karma darśayann āha - dinaikaṃ mardayet sūtaṃ kumārīsambhavair dravair ityādi | eteṣāṃ vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ dravaiḥ kṛtvā khalve sūtaṃ mardayet, tena pratyekarasena kṛtvā dinaikaṃ mardayed ity arthaḥ | kumārī prasiddhā, citrakaṃ citrakajaṭā, kākamācī loke ‘kāmaiyā’śabdavācyā, triphalā harītakyādikam ebhir yantrapūrvakaṃ saṃmardya paścāt kāñjikaiḥ prakṣālya śodhayed ity arthaḥ| kāñjikair iti bahuvacanatvena jalena takreṇa vā kṣālanīyam | tathā ca - tantrāntare-‘bhaved ekaikasaṃskāraprānteṣu dṛḍhamardanam |
marditaṃ sthāpayed dharme yāvac chuṣkataro bhavet |
takreṇa kāñjikenātha śuktenoṣṇodakena vā |
tataḥ sarvaṃ samānīya kṣālayed iti buddhimān || tathā yantraṃ prakurvīta yathā na kṣīyate rasaḥ’ iti | atha svedanasaṃskāram abhidhāya samprati mardanasaṃskāraṃ darśayann āha - tataḥ kṣiptvā rasaṃ khalve rasād ardhaṃ ca saindhavam ityādi | tata iti | svedanapūrvakamardanānantara tad rasaṃ khalve kṣiptvā mardayed iti | kaiḥ kṛtvā ? vakṣyamāṇasaindhavapramukhadravyaiḥ, etan mardanaṃ taptakhalve 'bhihitam iti sampradāyaḥ | tathā hi
‘yuktaṃ sūtasya sarvasya taptakhalve vimardanam |
ajāśakṛttuṣāgniṃ tu bhūgarbhe tritayaṃ kṣipet || tasyopari sthitaṃ khalvaṃ taptakhalvam idaṃ bhavet’ iti | ‘athavā tīvragharme ca kārayec ca pramardanam’ iti sampradāyaḥ | anāratam iti anālasyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā mardayed iti bhāvaḥ | anāratagrahaṇenāpi anyavihitadravyair api mardanīyaṃ na doṣo granthāntare darśanāt | tathā hi
‘kṣārāmlair lavaṇair mūtrair viṣair upaviṣais tathā |
divyauṣadhisamūhena mardayed divasatrayam’ | anuktamānānāṃ mardanārthadravyāṇāṃ ca parimāṇaṃ granthāntarād avagantavyam | tad yathā - ‘pāradasya kalāṃśena bheṣajena pramardayet | dravyeṇa yāvatā sarvaṃ plutaṃ bhavati mardane’ iti | idānīṃ mardanasaṃskārād anantaraṃ mūrcchanasaṃskāravidhim āha - tato rājī rasonaś cetyādi | tata iti mardanasaṃskārād anantaram | rājī rājikā, rasonaḥ lasuna iti prasiddhaḥ, mukhyaś ca navasādara iti| navasādaraś culikālavaṇa: mukhya: śreṣṭho grāhya ity arthaḥ | tasya śreṣṭhatā paigāmīśabdavācyā prasiddhā | tadvad iti | mardanoktaprakāreṇa mardyaṃ tuṣāmbuneti | kāñjikena kṛtvā kṣālanaṃ svedanaṃ ca pūrvavat kāryaṃ, rasasyotthāpanārthaṃ yato mūrcchanānantaram utthāpanam api kāryam iti sarvatra | tathā hi - ‘utthitaḥ kāñjikasvedāt pātayet khalvasaṃyutam’ iti saṃpradāyaḥ | yathā - ‘dolāsvedaṃ prakurvīta madhukṣārāmlamūtrakaiḥ | utthāpya mūrcchayet paścāt trivāraṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ’ iti | athavā ‘tataḥ khalvena taptena amlenotthāpayed rasam | kṣārā mukhakarāḥ sarve sarve hy amlāḥ prabodhakāḥ’ iti || mūrcchanotthāpanavidhim abhidhāya samprati pātanāny āha - tataḥ saṃśoṣya cakrābham ityādi | tata iti mūrcchanotthāpanānantaram | saṃśoṣyeti | eke saṃśoṣyetyanena mūrcchitam eva rasaṃ cakrābhaṃ kṛtvā pātayed iti vyākhyānayanti tan na saṃmataṃ bahusampradāyeṣu, mūrcchitasyotthāpanaṃ kṛtvā paścād uktadravyaiḥ saha piṣṭikāṃ kṛtvā cakrikāṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | anyatrāpy uktam |
‘bhāgās trayo rasasyārkacūrṇa- pādāṃśasaṃyutam |
datvā'mlaṃ mardayet - tāvad yāvat piṣṭiḥ prajāyate | yadā na jāyate piṣṭiḥ - kiñcit tutthaṃ tadā kṣipet’ iti sarvatra | piṣṭikṛtarasacakrī hiṅgunā liptvā dhāryā | hiṅgumānam api ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ pāradaparimāṇāt, dvisthālīsampuṭa iti | vikhyātaṃ lavaṇapūraṇaṃ sampradāyadarśanād boddhavyam | dṛḍhatarāṃ mudrām iti mudrā'tra sāmpradāyikī kāryā yathā gurusakāśād vā dṛṣṭvā | tathā athavā sadbuddhīnāṃ jñāpanārthaṃ sadābhyastā mudrā'tra likhyante tathā ca
‘valmīkamṛttikāpārapūraṇaṃ lohakiṭṭakam |
śvetapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva tat sarvaṃ cūrṇayet samam ||
sarvatulyaṃ viṣaṃ dagdhaṃ sarvaṃ toyair vimardayet |
mūṣādisampuṭaṃ kuryāt sarvasandhipralepane’ | athavā
‘tuṣaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ, bhāgaikaṃ vastrakhaṇḍakaṃ |
mṛdaś caturguṇo bhāgo jalaṃ datvā pramardayet ||
narakeśaṃ śaṇaṃ kiñcit datvā tāvat prakuṭṭayet |
yāvat sikthasamābhāsaṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ jāyate tadā ||
yathā na śuṣkatāṃ yāti tathā yantraṃ samācaret |
evaṃ saptadinād ūrdhvaṃ mṛdaṃ yoge prayojayet || kūpikādivilepārthaṃ yantrārthaṃ ca bhiṣak kramāt’ | aparam api |
‘harītakīṭaṅkaṇaparṇacūrṇaṃ kharī guḍaṃ pāṃśu paṭuṃ samāṃśam|
valmīkamṛt sarvasamā tadardhaṃ vastraṃ tathā gomayakaṃ ca sarvam || jalena mardyaṃ madanopamaṃ tad yantrādisandhau viniveśanīyam’ iti | aparāṇy api -
‘lohakiṭṭaṃ tuṣaṃ dagdhaṃ śukticūrṇaṃ ca karkarā |
etāni samabhāgāni tāvad bhāgena mṛttikā |
karpaṭena samāyuktā sā hi vajropamā bhavet | dagdhatuṣasyaikabhāgo mṛdbhāgatrayam eva ca |
karpaṭaṃ śaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vajramṛtsneti yojayet |
iṣṭakācūrṇabhāgaikaṃ samabhāgā tu mṛttikā ||
mūṣābandhaḥ prakartavyo dhamanād vajratāṃ vrajet |
bhāgaikaṃ lohakiṭṭasya tuṣadagdhadvayaṃ tathā ||
mṛdbhāgatrayasaṃyuktaṃ kiñcit kupyaṃ pradāpayet |
ekatra kuṭṭayet sarvaṃ mṛttikāvajravad bha- yet || niṣiñced ambunopari’ iti | upari ambunā niṣiñced iti ko 'rthaḥ ? tat sthālīsampuṭayantraṃ cullyāṃ nidhāyāgniṃ prajvālya tad upari śītaṃ jalaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kṣiped ity abhiprāyaḥ | sajalavastrakhaṇḍam api tad upari dhāryam iti sampradāyaḥ | anyatrāpy uktam -
‘saṃruddhya bhāṇḍadvayagarbhamadhye piṣṭiṃ tataḥ sampuṭam avraṇaṃ tam |
niveśya cullyāṃ tu śanaiḥ pradīpapramāṇam asyādyatale vidadhyāt || agniṃ śirasy asya jalārdram ekaṃ vastraṃ kṣiped alpam anuṣṇam eva’ iti | doṣavivarjita iti yad grahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ doṣarahitaḥ pāradaḥ ebhiḥ pañcabhiḥ saṃskāropāyair eva bhavatīty asyābhiprāyaḥ | tasmāt pañcaiva saṃskārā anenā'tra svīkṛtāḥ | ke te doṣāḥ ? tathā hi - ‘malaṃ viṣaṃ vahnigurutvacāpalaṃ naisargikaṃ doṣam uśanti tajjñāḥ | upādhikau dvau trapunāgasambhavau rasendrarāje kathayanti vaidyāḥ’| nanu pātanatrayeṇaiva nāgavaṅgakṛtadoṣo vinaṣṭo bhavati nānyaiḥ, tathā hi - ’miśritau ced rase nāgavaṅgau vikrayahetunā | syāt tābhyāṃ kṛtrimo doṣas tanmuktiḥ pātanatrayāt’ iti| tat katham atra pañcabhir eva sarvadoṣavivarjito bhavati ? satyam, ūrdhvapātanāntargatam adhastiryakpātanam astīti tasyābhiprāyaḥ, tat pātanadvayaṃ tantrāntarād avagantavyam | athavā ‘athordhvapiṭharīmadhye lagno grāhyo rasottamaḥ’ ity atrā'thagrahaṇenāvaśiṣṭasaṃskārāṇi sūcyante tāni ca pātanabodhananiyāmakānīty adoṣaḥ || atha keṣāṃcij jñāpanārthaṃ prasaṅgataḥ pātanatrayam āha - ūrdhvapātanam atraiva kathitam | adhaḥpātanaṃ tiryakpātanaṃ ca darśayann āha - tathā ca tantrāntare -
‘kaṭāhaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtvā tasyādho lepayed rasam |
dviguṇena ca gandhena jārayed bradhnakādayaḥ ||
vastrāntāni mṛdā liptvā jalaṃ sthāly upari nyaset |
sthālīkaṭāhayoḥ sandhiṃ lepayet sudṛḍhaṃ mṛdā || kaṭāhopari kartavyam upalāgnipradīpanam | jalamadhye raso yāti śuddhaṃ tiṣṭhati bradhnake ||
śulbād raso rasāt tāmraṃ pātanīyaṃ pṛthak kṛtam |
sasūtabhāṇḍavadanepy anyan milati bhāṇḍakam |
tathā sandhir dvayoḥ kāryā pātanatrayayantrake | jalasthāne kāñjikaṃ ca dāpayen nātra saṃśayaḥ’ iti | tiryakpātanam apy āha - tathā hi
‘ghaṭe rasaṃ vinikṣipya sajalaṃ ghaṭam anyakam |
tiryaṅmukhaṃ dvayoḥ kuryāt tanmukhaṃ rodhayet sudhīḥ || rasādho jvālayed agniṃ yāvat sūto jalaṃ viśet | tiryakpātanam ity uktaṃ siddhair nāgārjunādibhiḥ’ iti | athāparāṇy api prasaṅgato likhyante tathā hi -
‘sthūlasaindhavapoṭṭalyāṃ kāryaṃ mūṣāpuṭadvayam |
sthāpayitvā rasaṃ tatra navasāraṃ kalāṃśakam |
sandhiṃ nirudhya yatnena veṣṭayet karpaṭaṃ mṛdā |
sthāpayed bhūdhare yantre vahniṃ kuryād dinatrayam |
yantrād uddhṛtya sūto 'sau svedayet tadanantaram |
bījapūraphalaṃ vātha vṛntaṃ santyajya kārayet ||
saindhavena samaṃ sūtaṃ tasya madhyaṃ vinikṣipet |
svedayed dolikāyantre hy amlavarge dinatrayam || evaṃ hy agnisaho jāto rasendraḥ sarvakarmasu’ iti niyāmakam | atha bodhanam āha -
‘atha sūtaṃ samuddhṛtya kācakūpye vinikṣipet |
śuktāmlenātha sampūrya dvāre mudrāṃ pradāpayet ||
sthāpayed bhūdhare yantre svedayed dinasaptakam |
svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya kaṣāyaiḥ svedayet punaḥ || karkoṭīkañcukīvahnisarpākṣyambujamādravaiḥ | dinatrayaṃ sāranālaiḥ svedyaś cāñcalyaśāntaye’ iti bodhanam | atha dīpanam āha -
‘lavaṇaṃ rājikāhiṅgukanyākṣāracatuṣṭayam |
tryūṣaṇaṃ lasunaṃ caiva mātuluṅgarasaplutam ||
piṇḍamadhye rasaṃ kṛtvā svedayet saptadhā punaḥ |
anudgārī bhavet tena grāsājīrṇe 'pi jīryati || anenaiva bhavec chuddhaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ’ | athavā - ‘kīratuṇḍagaruḍī ṛṣicchaṭā kanyakā kumārikā ca vāyasī | āsurī ca vijayā jayā tathā vahnidīpanakarāś ca sūtake’ ity aṣṭau saṃskārāḥ saṃkṣepeṇoktāḥcatu:prasthe pārade gandhakanavasādarayordvitrivārākṛṣṭamatitīkṣṇaṃ tejāpasaṃjñaṃ pañcapañca tolakaṃ datvā darvyā cālayedūrdhvagataṃ malaṃ bhūyobhūstyajedevaṃ vinaiṣa saṃskārairlaghunopāyena śudhyati| || 4-12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha rasaśodhanaṃ | rājikā, rasono lasunaḥ, etayor mūṣāyāṃ rasaṃ pāradaṃ vibandhayet | iti svedanam | atha mardanaṃ | dinaikaṃ mardayet khalve iti | kākamācī prasiddhā | ayānyair mardanaṃ mūrcchanaṃ vā ity ūrdhvapātanam || || 4-12 ||

atha gandhakaśodhanam -
lohapātre vinikṣipya ghṛtam agnau pratāpayet || 13 ||

lg.l: tapte ghṛte tatsamānaṃ kṣiped gandhakajaṃ rajaḥ |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ gandhakaśodhanaṃ darśayann āha - lohapātre iti | gandhakajaṃ raja iti | gandhāj jāto gandhakaḥ| tad yathā
‘śvetadvīpe purā devyāḥ krīḍantyāḥ prasṛtaṃ rajaḥ |
kṣīrārṇave tu snātāyā dukūlaṃ rajasā'nvitam ||
dhautaṃ yan mathitaṃ vastraṃ gandhavad gandhakaṃ smṛtam |
caturdhā gandhakaḥ prokto rakta: pīto 'sitaḥ sitaḥ ||
rakto hemakriyāsūkta: pītaś caiva rasāyane |
vraṇādilepane śvetaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sudurlabhaḥ | evaṃ gandhakaśuddhiḥ syāt sarvakarmasu yojayet’ iti | evam iti grahaṇena śodhanāntaram api darśitaṃ tad granthāntarād avagantavyam | yathā
‘kṣīreṇa bhāṇḍam āpūrya vastreṇāveṣṭya tanmukham |
vastramadhye kṣiped gandhaṃ mukhaṃ yatnāt pidhāpayet ||
śarāveṇa tato vahniṃ prajvālyordhvam avasthitam |
bhāṇḍake nipated yāvat gandhas tāvat samindhayet || kṛśānau tu svayaṃ nīte gandhakaṃ tu samuddharet’ iti || 13 || 14 ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ daradaśodhanam apy āha -
meṣīkṣīreṇa daradam amlavargaiś ca bhāvitam || 15 ||

Āḍhamalla. meṣīkṣīreṇeti | meṣī avi: | amlavargaiś ceti | ‘jambīramātuluṅgādyair amlavargagaṇo mataḥ’ iti | amlavargaiś cety atra cakāragrahaṇenānyac chodhanam amumīyate | tathā ca - ‘śuddha: syād daradaḥ saptakṛtvo lākṣāmbubhāvitaḥ | maladoṣādikaṃ nāsti sarvakāryeṣu yojayet’ iti | asya jātyādikaṃ ca likhyate keṣāñcit subodhāryam | yathā
‘rasagandhakasambhūtaṃ hiṅgulaṃ procyate budhaiḥ |
tasmāt sūtaṃ ca yad grāhyaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitam ||
daradas trividho jñeyaś carmāraḥ śukatuṇḍakaḥ |
haṃsapādas tṛtīyaḥ syāt guṇavān uttarottaram ||
haṃsapādaṃ ca tatrādyaṃ tārakarmaṇi yojayet |
tad dhemakiṭṭasadṛśaṃ tadanyas tīkṣṇamāraṇe ||
carmāraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ syāt sapītaḥ śukatuṇḍakaḥ |
satvapāte ca tat proktaṃ śodhyam aurabhradugdhake’ || tathā ca - ‘japākusumasaṃkāśo haṃsapādo mahottamaḥ | rasāyane sarvalohamāraṇe rasarañjane’ iti || 15 ||

atha daradād rasākṛṣṭir bhavati tām api darśayann āha -
nimbūrasair nimbapatrarasair vā yāmamātrakam || 16 ||

lg.l: piṣṭvā daradam ūrdhvaṃ ca pātayet sūtayuktivat |
tataḥ śuddharasaṃ tasmān nītvā kāryeṣu yojayet ||17 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. nimbūrasair iti | nimbūrasanimbapatrarasamānaṃ bhāvanāyuktivad boddhavyam | kecit tu nimbūrasaiḥ nimbapa- trarasair ity asya sthāne jambīraiḥ pāribhadrarasair iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca granthāntaradarśanāt | tathā hi - ‘pāri- bhadrarasaiḥ peṣyaṃ hiṅgulaṃ yāmamātrakam | jambīrāṇāṃ dravair vā'tha pātyaṃ pātanayantrake’ iti | atra pāribhadraḥ ‘phalahadā’ śabdavācyo na tu nimbakaṇṭakapālāśa ity apare | pātayet sūtayuktivad iti sūtayuktiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā sā tu pātanayantrādhikṛtā bhavati || 16 || 17 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha daradāt pāradān niṣkāsanaṃ | daradaṃ hiṅgulaḥ, daradaṃ ūrdhvaṃ pātayet ḍamaruyantreḍamaruyantretyupalakṣaṇam, tena daradāddviguṇavastrakhaṇḍai: golakaṃ kṛtvā prajvālya vastranirdhūmaṃ haṇḍikayā pidhāya sthālyāṃ rakṣet | tata: śītībhūtāyāṃ haṃḍikāyāmudghāṭya pāradaṃ gṛhṇīyāditi sugamaḥ prakāraḥ | sūtavat | smaṣṭam anyat ||16 || 17 ||

ab.seg:
athoddhṛtasya sukhakaraṇam -
kālakūṭo vatsanābhaḥ śṛṅgakaś ca pradīpaka: |
hālāhalo brahmaputro hāridraḥ saktukas tathā ||18 ||

lg.l: saurāṣṭrika iti proktā viṣabhedā amī nava |
mukhaṃ ca jāyate tasya dhātūṃś ca grasate kṣaṇāt |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha rasamukhakaraṇam āha - kālakūṭa iti | kālakūṭaprabhṛtikaṃ viṣabhedaṃ tatparīkṣakasakāśād avagantavyam | kiñcil lakṣaṇam api likhyate yathā -
‘ghanaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca kaṭhinaṃ bhinnāñjanasamaprabham |
kandākāraṃ samākhyātaṃ kālakūṭaṃ mahāviṣaṃ ||
vatsanābhaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ ca kiñcid rūkṣaṃ ghanaṃ tathā |
ghanaṃ guru ca nibiḍaṃ śṛṅgākāraṃ ca śṛṅgikaṃ ||
pradīpanaṃ śikhiśikhākāraṃ ca gurucikkaṇam |
cakrākāraṃ bhaved vakraṃ nīlaṃ hālāhalaṃ mataṃ ||
brahmaputraḥ pāṇḍuraḥ syāt haridrābhaṃ haridrakam |
citram utpalakandābhaṃ saktukaṃ saktuvad bhavet || saurāṣṭrikaṃ śaṅkhavarṇaṃ vijñeyaṃ viṣalakṣaṇam’ iti | eteṣāṃ madhye ekadvitrisakalāni yathālābhaṃ saṃgṛhya rasasya ṣoḍaśāṃśena kṛtvā mardanīyāni | ṣoḍaśāṃśatā'tra ekasyaivety arthaḥ | upaviṣeṣu lāṅgalīkakaravīrakam ahiphenam iti | ahiphenaṃ viṣamatsyasamudbhavam iti jñeyam | tathā hi -
‘samudre caiva jāyante viṣamatsyāś caturvidhāḥ |
tebhyaḥ phenaṃ samutpannam ahiphenaṃ caturvidham || kecid vadanti sarpāṇāṃ phenaṃ syād ahiphenakam |’ yathā -
‘dhāraṇaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ca raktavarṇaṃ ca jārakam |
sāraṇaṃ pītavarṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca māraṇam || viṣavad dhy uttamaṃ phenaṃ yujyate rasakarmaṇi’ iti | kecit tu khākhasajaṃ kṣīraviśeṣam iti manyante tadabhāvāt | evaṃ sarvatra śeṣaṃ sugamam | mānam apy eteṣāṃ pūrvavat || 18-20 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. amī kālakūṭādayo nava viṣabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ kathitāḥ | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ viṣaparīkṣakebhyo jñeyam | atha upaviṣāṇy āha - lāṅgalī kalihārī, karavīrakaḥ aśvamārajaṭārasaḥ, ahiphenam āphūkam, etāḥ sapta upaviṣajātayaḥ | etair marditaḥ sūtaḥ chinnapakṣaḥ jāyate mukhaṃ dhātugrasanaśīlaṃ ato dhātūn tvarayā grasate || kālakūṭādīnāṃ dravaiḥ sapta sapta dinaṃ mardanaṃ prakṣālanaṃ ca || || 18-20 ||

anyad api mukhakaraṇam āha -
athavā kaṭukakṣārau rājī lavaṇapañcakam || 21 ||

lg.l: rasono navasāraś ca śigruś caikatra cūrṇitaiḥ |
samāṃśaiḥ pāradād etair jambīreṇa draveṇa vā || 22 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athavā kaṭukakṣārāv iti | kaṭukaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, kṣāro yavakṣāraprabhṛtikaḥ, lavaṇapañcakaṃ prasiddham | rasona iti laśunaḥ, navasāraś cūlikālavaṇaḥ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanam, etat sakalaṃ samamātreṇa kṛtvā pāradasāmyaṃ grāhyam | śeṣaṃ sugamam | dhātucaram iti ko 'rthaḥ dhātugrasanārtham iti bhāvaḥ || 21 -2 3 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyad api mukhakaraṇaṃ | kṣārau svarjīyavakṣārau, rājī rājikā, rasonaṃ laśunaṃ, navasāro navasāgaraḥ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanaṃ | dhātucaraṃ dhātugrasanaśāli||21-23||

aparam api mukhakaraṃ darśayitum āha -
athavā bindulīkīṭai raso mardyas trivāsaram |
lavaṇāmlair mukhaṃ tasya jāyate dhātuhṛttvarā‘dhātughasmaraṃ’ gū. dī. sammataḥ | || 24 ||

Āḍhamalla. athaveti | ebhir vakṣyamāṇadravyais tridinaṃ mardyam raso yadā bhavati tadā tasya tvarā śīghraṃ dhātuhṛt suvarṇādidhātugrahaṇasamarthaṃ mukhaṃ bhavati | bindulīti kaṭiviśeṣaḥ sa ca ṣaḍbindur iti prasiddhaḥ | tathā hi - ‘ṣaḍbindukasya kīṭasya śvetāḥ syuḥ pañca bindavaḥ | bhinnavarṇas tathā caikaḥ susnigdhaś cātivarṇataḥ’ iti | lavaṇā- mlair iti | lavaṇaṃ pañcalavaṇam, amlo 'mlavargaḥ sa ca jambīramātuluṅgaprabhṛtikaḥ || 24 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyac ca | bindulīkīṭaiḥ kīṭaviśeṣaiḥ, lavaṇaṃ saindhavam, amlair nimbukādyai: dhātughasmaraṃ dhātubhakṣakaṃ mukhaṃ jāyate ||24 ||

idānīṃ gandhakajāraṇanimittaṃ karma darśayann āha -
atha kacchapayantreṇa gandhajāraṇam ucyate |
mṛtkuṇḍe nikṣipet toyaṃ tanmadhye ca śarāvakam||25||

lg.l: liptvā ca mekhalāmadhyaṃ cūrṇenātra rasaṃ kṣipet||2 6||
evaṃ punaḥ punar gandhaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ jārayed budhaḥ || 28 ||
gandhe jīrṇe bhavet sūtas tīkṣṇāgniḥ sarvakarmasu |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atheti | athaśabdo 'tra mukhakaraṇānantaryaḥ | kacchapayantraṃ prasiddham | tatsvarūpaṃ darśitam eva | tatparimāṇaṃ yathā
‘prasūtagopalonmānaṃ sūtakotpalakaḥ smṛtaḥ |
lāvakaḥ puṭako jñeyaḥ pradattaḥ saptadhāḍhakaiḥ |
kacchapas triguṇais tais tu kaukkuṭaḥ kacchapais tribhiḥ |
kaukkuṭaiḥ pañcabhi: siṃho meghanādo 'sya yugmakaiḥ |
durge gajapuṭaḥ khyāto deyaḥ ṣaṣṭikapālakaiḥ | tais tu triguṇitair jñeyo dṛḍhāgniś ca mahāpuṭaḥ’ iti | cūrṇeneti śuktikācūrṇena samāṃśakam iti rasasāmyaṃ gandhakaṃ yojyam | sāmyatā'tra pratyekapuṭam ity arthaḥ | tena ṣaḍguṇagandhakaṃ ṣaṭpuṭaiḥ kṛtvā bhavati pāradaparimāṇāt || bhasmamudrām iti | vibhūtipāṃśulavaṇābhyāṃ kṛtam iti sampradāyaḥ | śarāvo 'tra lohamayaḥ | manyante kecit tathā hy uktam -
‘jalapūrṇaṃ dṛḍhaṃ pātraṃ suviśālaṃ samāharet |
tadantaḥ kharparaṃ dadyāt suvistīrṇaṃ dṛḍhaṃ navam ||
binduṃ datvā tad upari bījapūrarasaṃ kṣipet |
upariṣṭād biḍaṃ dadyāt tato lohakaṭorikām ||
ayaskāntamayīṃ vāpi paittalīṃ bhūtavigraham |
upariṣṭād adhovakrāṃ datvā samyag vilepayet ||
khaṭīpuṭaṃ śivībhaktaṃ samyaṅ niṣpiṣya mudrayet |
ūrdhvaṃ deyaṃ puṭaṃ tasya yantraṃ kacchapasaṃjñakam || jāraṇārthaṃ rasasyoktaṃ gandhādīnām aśeṣataḥ’ iti | atra gandhakavidhānaṃ tu asyaiva sampradāyato vyākhyātam | anyatra rasasyopari cādhaś ceti | tīkṣṇāgnir iti atyarthaṃ bubhukṣito bhavati rākṣasasaṃjñaka ity apare sarvakarmasv iti yojya ity abhiprāyaḥ || 25-28 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kacchapayantreṇa gandhakajāraṇam ucyate | tatrādau kacchapayantram āha - atheti, mṛtkuṇḍe nīraṃ nikṣipet tanmadhye mṛtkuṇḍapidhānaṃ śarāvakaṃ sthāpāyet | kiṃbhūtaṃ ? madhyaṃ mekhalayā yutaṃ tryaṅgulonnatā mṛdracitā mekhalā madhyaṃ cūrṇena lepayet | tanmadhye pāradaṃ datvā tulyagandhakacūrṇaṃ datvā upari śarāvaṃ datvā bhasmalavaṇamudrāḥ kāryāś caturbhir utpalaiḥ puṭet| evaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ gandhaṃ jīryate | gandhakasaṃge viṣaṃ ca deyam | atra svarṇajāraṇaṃ noktaṃ granthāntarāl likhyate abījajīrṇasya māritasya doṣarūpatvāt | tathā ca
‘ajīrṇaṃ śambhubījaṃ tu sūtakaṃ yas tu jārayet|
brahmahā sa durācārī mama drohī maheśvari ||’ atha jāraṇaṃ - ‘catuḥṣaṣṭyāṃśaṃ hemapatraṃ māyūramāyunā |
viliptaṃ taptakhalvasthaṃ rasaṃ datvā vimardayet|
punar jambīratoyena grāse grāse tv ayaṃ vidhiḥ |
śanaiḥ saṃsvedayed bhūyo baddhvā sampuṭakāṃjike |
bhāṇḍike tridinaṃ sthāsya sūtaṃ jīrṇaṃ samuddharet |
adhikaṃ tolitaṃ cet syāt punaḥ svedyaṃ samāvadhi |
dvātriṃśat ṣoḍaśāṣṭāṃśaṃ krameṇa vasujāraṇaṃ |
rūpyādiṣu ca satveṣu vidhir eva paraṃ smṛtaḥ’ | māyūramāyunā māyūrapittena ca hemapatraṃ susvarṇam ||25-28||

atha pāradamāraṇam -
dhūmasāraṃ rasaṃ torīṃ gandhakaṃ navasādaram || 29 ||

lg.l: yāmaikaṃ mardayed amlair bhāgaṃ kṛtvā samāṃśakam |
vilipya parito vakre mudrāṃ dattvā ca śoṣayet |
niveśya cullyāṃ tadadhaḥ kuryād vahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||32||
tasmād apy adhikaṃ kiṃcit pāvakaṃ jvālayet kramāt |
sphoṭayet svāṅgaśītaṃ tam ūrdhvagaṃ gandhakaṃ tyajet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. saṃprati rasamāraṇavidhim āha - dhūmasāram iti | dhūmasāraṃ gṛhadhūmaṃ, rasaṃ pāradam, torī sphaṭikā navasādaraṃ prasiddham | amlair iti | jambīranimbūkarasair ity arthaḥ | samāṃśakaṃ bhāgam iti | etena kim uktaṃ ? pūrvoktaṃ sakaladravyaṃ pratyekaṃ rasamānaṃ melayed iti krama iti bhāvaḥ | tathā hy uktaṃ ‘pṛthak samaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā pāradaṃ gandhakaṃ tathā navasāraṃ dhūmasāraṃ sphaṭikaṃ yāmamātrakam ||
nimbūnīreṇa saṃmardya kācakūpyāṃ vipācayet |
mukhe pāṣāṇakhaṭikāṃ datvā mudrāṃ pradāpayet ||
saptabhir mṛttikāvastraiḥ pṛthak saṃśoṣya veṣṭayet |
sachidrāyāṃ mṛdaḥ sthālyāṃ kūpikāṃ sanniveśayet |
pūrayet sikatāpūrair āgalaṃ matimān bhiṣak |
niveśya cullyāṃ dahanaṃ mandamadhyakharakramāt|| prajvālya dvādaśayāmaṃ svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddharet | visphoṭayitvā'tha yuktyā ca ūrdhvalagnaṃ baliṃ tyajet’ || ‘adhaḥsthaṃadhaḥsthaṃ gandhakanalikādhaḥsthaṃ na tu kupyadhaḥstham | rasasindūraṃ sarvakarmasu yojayet’ iti | kecit tu dhūmasārasthāne sīsakaṃ paṭhanti tac ca saṅgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt
‘pṛthak pṛthak samaṃ kṛtvā pāradaṃ gandhakaṃ tathā |
navasāraṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ sanāgaṃ yāmamātrakaṃ ||
nimbūnīreṇa saṃmardya kācakūpyāṃ vinikṣipet |
budhaś ca vālukāyantre yāmadvādaśakaṃ pacet || svāṅgaṃ śītaṃ sphoṭayitvā ūrdhvalagnaṃ baliṃ tyajet | adhaḥsthaṃ rasasindūraṃ yojayed rasakarmaṇi’ iti | śeṣaṃ subodham || 29-34 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dhūmasāram aṅgāradhūmaṃ śuddhaṃ pāradaṃ torī gurjaradeśodbhavā sphaṭikā yā raktavarṇā bhavati | gandhakaṃ śuddhaṃ, navasādaraṃ navasāgaraṃ | etat sarvaṃ samaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat || 29-34 ||

anyad api rasamāraṇam āha -
apāmārgasya bījānāṃ mūṣāyugmaṃ prakalpayet |
tatsaṃpuṭe nyaset sūtaṃ malayūdugdhamiśritam || 35 ||

lg.l: etac cūrṇam adhordhvaṃ ca dattvā mudrāṃ pradīyate || 36 ||
taṃ golaṃ sandhayet samyag mṛnmūṣāsaṃpuṭe sudhīḥ |
mudrāṃ dattvā śoṣayitvā tato gajapuṭe pacet ||37||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. apāmārgeti | apāmārgaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya bījāni jalena piṣṭvā sampuṭākārā mūṣā kāryā tatsampuṭamadhye sūtaṃ pāradaṃ malayūdugdhamardanaṃ kṛtvā nyaset pārayed ity arthaḥ | malayū kāṣṭhodumbarikā paścād uktadravyacūrṇaṃ tad upari adhaś ca datvā saṃmardya mṛṇmūṣāyāṃ mudrayet| droṇapuṣpī nahula iti prasiddhā | loke ‘gūmā’ śabdavācyā | tasyāḥ prasūnāni puṣpāṇi viḍaṅgaṃ prasiddham | iti | irimedako viṭkhadiraḥ tasya tvak grāhyā tad golaṃ mardayed iti | taṃ rasādijanitagolakaṃ samyag avarodhayet mūṣāyām iti śeṣaḥ || 35-37 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tathāparaṃ ca | apāmārga urdhvakaṇṭakaḥ, malayūdugdhaṃ kāṣṭhodumbīrakādugdhaṃ, droṇapuṣpī prasiddhā tatpuṣpaṇi, viḍaṅgam, irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ cūrṇam etac cūrṇam ūrdhvordhvaṃ dīyate spaṣṭam anyat || 35-37 ||

anyad api rasamāraṇaṃ prakaṭayann āha -
kāṣṭhodumbarikādugdhai rasaṃ kiṃcid vimardayet || 38 ||

lg.l: kṣiptvā tatsaṃpuṭe sūtaṃ tatra mudrāṃ pradāpayet || 39 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. kāṣṭhodumbarikādugdhair iti | kāṣṭhodumbarikā kuḍumbarī śabdavācyā | taddugdhaghṛṣṭahiṅgoś ceti kāṣṭhoḍu- mbarikādugdhenaiva hiṅguṃ plāvya tena mūṣāṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye rasaṃ melayitvā sarvaṃ golakaṃ kṛtvā paścāt mṛṇmayamūṣāyām andhayet avarodhayed ity arthaḥ | mṛdupuṭenaiveti laghugajapuṭenaivety arthaḥ | laghugajapuṭalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntare 'bhihitam | tad yathā -
‘nipuṇavihitagartaḥ ṣoḍaśair aṅgulair yo mitasakalavibhāgas tasya madhye nidhāya |
jvalanam ativiśuṣkair gomayaiḥ pāradasya laghugajapuṭam etat proktam evaṃ munīndraiḥ’ || 38-40 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyañ ca |kāṣṭhodumbarikā prasiddhā ||38-40||

aparam api pāradamāraṇaṃ darśayann āha -
nāgavallīrasair ghṛṣṭaḥ karkoṭīkandagarbhitaḥ |
mṛṇmūṣāsaṃpuṭe paktvā sūto vāty eva bhasmatām || 41||

Āḍhamalla. nāgavallīti | nāgavallī tāmbūlavallī tasyāḥ patrarasena ghṛṣṭo marditaḥ pāradaḥ karkoṭīkandagarbhitaḥ san mṛṇmūṣāsampuṭe nirudhya mudrayitvā gajapuṭe pacet | karkoṭī vandhyākarkoṭakīvallī tasyāḥ kandam | śeṣaṃ subodham ||41||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyac ca | nāgavallīti spaṣṭam || 41 ||

atha jvarādau rasāḥ procyante – jvarāṅkuśaḥ |
khaṇḍitaṃ mṛgaśrṛṅgaṃ ca jvālāmukhyā rasaiḥ samam |
ruddhvā bhāṇḍe pacec culyāṃ yāmayugmaṃ tato nayet ||42||

lg.l: aṣṭāṃśaṃ trikaṭuṃ dadyān niṣkamātraṃ ca bhakṣayet |
aikāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ ca tryāhikaṃ vā na saṃśayaḥ ||44||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ saṃsiddharasānām adhyāyaṃ prakaṭayann āha - tatrādau jvarāṅkuśanāmarasaṃ vyācaṣṭe - khaṇḍitam iti | hariṇasyedaṃ hāriṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ viṣāṇaṃ tac ca khaṇḍitaṃ śakalīkṛtaṃ, saṃkṣuṇṇam ity arthaḥ | jvālāmukhyā rasair iti jvālāmukhī jayantī tasyāḥ patrāṇāṃ svarasaḥ | sā jvālāmukhī caturdhā bhavati | tathā hi - ‘śuklā pītā tathā raktā kṛṣṇā jvālāmukhī bhavet’ iti | loke ‘khasinī’śabdavācyā | kecit tu jvālāmukhīty anena bhallātakam iti vyākhyānayanti tan na sarvasaṃmatam | samam ity atra samaśabdo militārthe vartata iti kecit | na tu samam atra sāmyaṃ, yataḥ sampradāyeṣv api jvālāmukhyā rasaiḥ kṛtvā mṛgaśṛṅgaṃ bahuśo bhāvayitvā jārayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | yad uktam - ‘asakṛd bhāvitaṃ śṛṅgaṃ hāriṇaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ rasaiḥ | jvālāmukhyāḥ paced bhāṇḍagataṃ tad bhasma cūrṇayet’ ityādi | aṣṭāṃśaṃ trikaṭuṃ dadyād iti śṛṅgabhāgān militakaṭutrayasya sarvajvarāpaha ity anenānvayaḥ | tena sannipātajanitam api nāśayed ity arthaḥ ||42-44 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. jvālāmukhīagīyā | prasiddhā || 42-44 ||

atha jvarārirasaḥ --
pāradaṃ rasakaṃ tālaṃ tutthaṃ ṭaṅkaṇagandhakaṃ |
sarvam etat samaṃ śuddhaṃ kāravellīrasair dinam || 45 ||

lg.l: pacet taṃ vālukāyanttre kṣiptvā dhānyāni tanmukhe ||47||
yadā sphuṭanti dhānyāni tadā siddhaṃ vinirdiśet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha jvarārirasavivaraṇam āha - pāradam iti | atra rasakaṃ kharparakaṃ, tālaṃ haritālaṃ, tutthaṃ prasiddham, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāram | eke ‘tutthakaṃ kaṇā gandham’ iti paṭhanti | tatra kaṇā manaḥśilā | etad bahusthāneṣu na pracarati, anyato darśanāt | ‘rasaṃ ca rasakaṃ tālaṃ śikhituṇḍaṃ ca ṭaṅkaṇaṃ | gandhakaṃ ca samaṃ piṣṭvā kāravellyā rasair dinam’ ityādi | kāravellī loke ‘karelā’ śabdavācyā | hastaparipāṭyāṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ sakaladravyaṃ samamātraṃ saṃgṛhya kāravellīpatrarasena trivāraṃ rasaṃ saṃmardya tatkalkena tāmrapātrodaram aṅgulārdhapramāṇaṃ pralipya haṇḍikāmadhye 'dhomukhaṃ saṃsthāpya mudrāṃ kṛtvā tadanu vālukāyantre paced yāvat tad upari vrīhayaḥ sphuṭanti, aṅgulam aṅguṣṭhodaramadhyam | māsamānam atra viṣamatīvrajvaranimittam anyatrālpam iti | tathā hi - ‘raso jvarārisiddho 'yaṃ dviguñjo vātaje jvare | dātavyaḥ parṇakhaṇḍena tatkṣaṇān nāśayej jvaram iti || || 45-49 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pāradaṃ śuddhaṃ, rasakaṃ kharparaṃ, tālaṃ, tutthaṃ śuddhaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ, kāravellī śākaviśeṣaḥ | tāmrapātraṃ, gomūtrapañcāmṛtādau śuddhaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat | pathyaṃ dugdhaudanaṃ mudgaṃ vā || 45-49 ||

atha śītajvarārirasaḥ |
tālakaṃ tutthakaṃ tāmraṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ manaḥśilām ||50||

lg.l: golaṃ nyaset saṃpuṭake puṭaṃ dadyāt prayatnataḥ || 51 ||
kvāthena dantyāḥ śyāmāyā bhāvayet saptadhā punaḥ ||52||
māṣamātraṃ rasaṃ divyaṃ pañcāśan maricair yutam |
bhakṣayet tridinaṃ bhaktyā śītārir durlabhaḥ paraḥ |
dvyāhikaṃ satataṃ caiva vaivarṇyaṃ ca niyacchati || 55 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ śītajvarāriṃ prakaṭayann āha - tālakam iti | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ, tāmram iti śuddhatāmrabhasma, rasaṃ pāradam, gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ | karṣam iti dviruktena pratyekaṃ karṣapramāṇam ity arthaḥ | triphalāmbubhir iti triphalā harītakyādikaṃ tasyā kvāthenety arthaḥ | puṭaṃ dadyād iti | sakaladravyacūrṇaṃ triphalākvāthena saṃmardya golakaṃ kṛtvā tadanu śarāvasampuṭe dhṛtvā tad upari mṛttikāṃ liptvā gajapuṭe paced ity arthaḥ | prayatnata iti | gurusakāśāt karmanaipuṇyāt | paścāt tad rasaṃ śarāvābhyantarāt saṃgṛhya arkadugdhena dantīmūlasvarasena śyāmārasena ca saptadhā bhāvyaṃ saptadhā bhāvanā pratyekenety arthaḥ | vajrī sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, dantīmūlasvarasabhāve kvātho grāhyaḥ, śyāmā niśotha:, tasyā mūlasvarasabhāve kvāthaṃ vā, evaṃ siddho bhavati | asmatsa- mpradāye 'pi dravyacatuṣṭayena bhāvanāṃ dattvā paścāt pūrvoktavidhānena gajapuṭe paktvā siddho bhavatīti | anyatrāpi dṛśyate tathā hi - ‘paścād vajrīravikṣīrair dantīśyāmārasena ca | saṃmardya saptadhā gharme śarāvapuṭakaṃ pacet’ ityādi | etan māṣaparimitaṃ pañcāśan maricaiḥ saha guḍagadyānakayutaṃ ca tulasīpatradvayaṃ ca saṃveṣṭya bhakṣayed ity arthaḥ | divyam iti śreṣṭhaṃ ṛṣipraṇītatvāt | pañcāśan maricair iti gaṇanāmātram | gadyānakam iti ṣaṇmāsakasaṃjñam | eke guḍatulasī- patrayor anupānam āhuḥ | bhaktyeti pūrvaṃ dvijagurupūjanaṃ sambhāvya paścād āstikyapūrvakaṃ bhakṣayed iti bhāvaḥ | vaivarṇyam atra jvarajanitam anyarogajanitaṃ vā || 50-55 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ, vajrī sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, trivṛn niśothaḥ, māṣamātraṃ siddhaṃ rasaṃ pañcāśanmaricaṃ guḍaṃ gadyāṇakaṃ ṣaṇmāṣakaṃ tulasīdalapalaṃ dvayaṃ dvigadyāṇakaṃ etat pramāṇaṃ tridinaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣayet | yad vā sapta- dinam auṣadhabāhulyāt || 50-55 ||

jvaraghnī guṭikā |
bhāgaikaḥ syād rasāc chuddhād aileyaḥ pippalī śivā |
ākārakarabho gandhaḥ kaṭutailena śodhitaḥ ||56||

lg.l: māṣonmitāṃ guṭīṃ kṛtvā dadyāt sarvajvare budha: |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha jvaraghnīṃ guṭikām āha - bhāgaikaḥ syād rasāc chuddhād iti | śuddhiś cāsya pūrvaṃ kathitā | rasaṃ pāradaṃ tasyaiko bhāgaḥ| elīyaḥ kumārīrasajanitaniryāsadravyaviśeṣaḥ ‘eluvā’ iti prasiddhaḥ | tadabhāve kumārīpatrarasam eva grāhyam ity apare, kecid elīyaśabdena elavālukaṃ vadanti | tac ca kuṣṭhagandhikaphalasadṛśaṃ bhavati loke prasiddhaṃ ca | etan na sarvamatam | śivā harītakī ākārakarabha iti ākallakaḥ prasiddhaḥ | kaṭutailena śodhitagandhaka iti śeṣaḥ | kaṭutailaṃ sārṣapam | phalāni cendravāruṇyā iti | indravāruṇī cirbhaṭī, tasyāḥ phalāni | eke mūlāni cendravāruṇyā vadanti tad bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate | tasmād asaṅgato 'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ | caturbhāgamitā amī iti | amī elīyapramukhaṣaṭdravyaviśeṣāś caturbhāgamitā bhavanti bhāgo 'tra pāradaparimāṇāt | etat sakalaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ kṛtvā indravāruṇikāmūlarasena mardayed ity arthaḥ | svarasaparimāṇam atra dravyabhāvanāyogyaṃ deyam | tac ca yāvac cūrṇaṃ plāvitaṃ bhavati tāvad deyam iti bhāvaḥ | chinnārasānupāneneti | chinnā guḍūcī tasyāḥ svarasenānupānam | anupānamātrā'tra tantrāntarād avagantavyā | tad yathā ‘rasānām anupānaṃ syād dvipalaṃ palam ardhakam | vātapittakaphaprāye yathāyogyam anukramāt’ iti | jvaraghnīti sāmānyena sarvajvaraharety arthaḥ || 56-58 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rasāt pāradāt śuddhāt bhāgaikaḥ, elīyaḥ elavālukaṃ, pippalī, śivā harītakī, ākārakarabhaḥ ākallakaḥ, gandho gandhakaḥ kaṭutailena drāvayitvā śodhitaḥ, indravāruṇyāḥ phalāni, amī elīyādayaḥ caturbhāgāḥ pratyekaṃ punaḥ indravāruṇikārasaiḥ mardayet, māṣamātrāṃ vaṭīṃ khādet | indravāruṇikāphalaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ kāryam || 56-58 ||

div.ab:
atha lokanātharasaḥ kṣayādau -
śuddho bubhukṣitaḥ sūto bhāgadvayamito bhavet |
tathā gandhasya bhāgau dvau kuryāt kajjalikāṃ tayoḥ ||59||
sūtāc caturguṇeṣv eva kapardeṣu vinikṣipet |
bhāgaikaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ dattvā gokṣīreṇa vimardayet || 60 ||
tathā śaṅkhasya khaṇḍānāṃ bhāgān aṣṭau prakalpayet |
kṣipet sarvaṃ puṭasyāntaś cūrṇaliptaśarāvayoḥ || 61 ||
garte hastonmite dhṛtvā puṭed gajapuṭena ca |
svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya piṣṭvā tat sarvam ekataḥ || 62 ||
ṣaḍguñjāsaṃmitaṃ cūrṇam ekonatriṃśad ūṣaṇaiḥ |
ghṛtena vātaje dadyān navanītena pittaje || 63 ||
kṣaudreṇa śleṣmaje dadyād atīsāre kṣaye tathā |
arucau grahaṇīroge kārśye mandānale tathā || 64 ||
kāsaśvāseṣu gulmeṣu lokanātharaso hitaḥ |
tasyopari ghṛtānnaṃ ca bhuñjīta kavalatrayam || 65 ||
mañce kṣaṇaikam uttānaḥ śayītānupadhānake |
anamlam annaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhuñjīta madhuraṃ dadhi || 66 ||
prāyeṇa jāṅgalaṃ māṃsaṃ pradeyaṃ ghṛtapācitam |
sudugdhabhaktaṃ dadyāc ca jāte 'gnau sāṃdhyabhojane ||67||
saghṛtān mudgavaṭakān vyañjaneṣv avacārayet |
tilāmalakakalkena snāpayet sarpiṣā'thavā || 68 ||
abhyañjayet sarpiṣā ca snānaṃ koṣṇodakena ca |
kvacit tailaṃ na gṛhṇīyān na bilvaṃ kāravellakam ||69||
vārtākaṃ śapharīṃ ciñcāṃ tyajed vyāyāmamaithune |
madyaṃ saṃdhānakaṃ hiṅgu śuṇṭhīṃ māṣān masūrakān ||70||
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ rājikāṃ kopaṃ‘kola’ pā.| kāñjikaṃ caiva varjayet |
tyajed ayuktanidrāṃ ca kāṃsyapātre ca bhojanam ||71||
kakārādiyutaṃ sarvaṃ tyajec chākaphalādikam |
pathyo 'yaṃ‘grāhyo’ pā.| lokanāthas tu śubhanakṣatravāsare || 72 ||
pūrṇātithau site pakṣe jāte candrabale tathā |
pūjayitvā lokanāthaṃ kumārī bhojayet tataḥ || 73||
dānaṃ dattvā dvighaṭikāmadhye grāhyo rasottamaḥ |
rasāc cej jāyate tāpas tadā śarkarayā sutam || 74 ||
sattvaṃ guḍūcyā gṛhṇīyād vaṃśarocanayā yutam |
kharjūraṃ dāḍimaṃ drākṣām ikṣukhaṇḍāni cārayet‘śca dāpayet’ pā.| ||75||
arucau nistuṣaṃ dhānyaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ saśarkaram |
dadyāt tathā jvare dhānyaguḍūcīkvātham āharet || 76 ||
uśīravāsakakvāthaṃ dadyāt samadhuśarkaram |
raktapitte kaphe śvāse kāse ca svarasaṃkṣaye || 77 ||
agnibhṛṣṭajayācūrṇaṃ madhunā niśi dīyate |
nidrānāśe 'tisāre ca grahaṇyāṃ mandapāvake ||78||
sauvarcalābhayākṛṣṇācūrṇam uṣṇodakaiḥ pibet |
śūle 'jīrṇe tathā kṛṣṇā madhuyuktā jvare hitā ||79||
plīhodare vātarakte chardyāṃ caiva gudāṅkure |
nāsikādiṣu rakteṣu rasaṃ dāḍimapuṣpajam || 80 ||
dūrvāyāḥ svarasaṃ nasye pradadyāc charkarāyutam |
kolamajjā kaṇā barhipakṣabhasma saśarkaram || 81 ||
madhunā lehayec chardihikkākopopaśāntaye |
vidhir eṣa prayojyas tu sarvasmin poṭṭalīrase || 82 ||
mṛgāṅke hemagarbhe ca mauktikākhye 'pareṣu ca |
ity ayaṃ lokanāthākhyo rasaḥ sarvarujo jayet ||83||
(varāṭabhasma maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayitvā ghṛte pacet |
tatsamaṃ maricaṃ cūrṇaṃ nāgavallyā vibhāvitam || 84 ||
tac cūrṇaṃ madhunā lehyam athavā navanītakaiḥ |
māṣamātraṃ kṣayaṃ hanti yāme yāme ca bhakṣitam ||85||
lokanātharaso hy eṣa maṇḍalād rājayakṣmanut |)

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ lokanātharasaṃ prakaṭayann āha - śuddha iti | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ śuddhaḥ saṃskāritaḥ, saṃskārā hy asya pūrvaṃ kathitāḥ, bubhukṣitaḥ kṣudhitaḥ, kāritaḥ dravyair iti śeṣaḥ, sa ca bhāgadvayaparimitaḥ, tathā gandhasya dvau bhāgau tatheti grahaṇena gandhakasyāpi śodhanaṃ darśitam | tayor iti gandhakapāradayoḥ, sūtāc caturguṇeṣv evetyādi sūtāt sūtaparimāṇāt | kapardakeṣu varāṭakeṣu kapardakalakṣaṇaṃ ca tantrāntarād avagantavyam | tad yathā - ‘tulanāyāṃ gurutarān pañca gulmān daśa dvijān | varāṭān sthūlapītāṃś ca rasakarmaṇi yojayet’ iti | bhāgaikaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ dadyād iti ko 'rthaḥ pāradaparimāṇād ardhabhāgaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ saṃgṛhya gokṣīreṇa saha kalkīkṛtyānenaiva kalkena tān rasagarbhitavarāṭān vimudrayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā śaṅkhasya khaṇḍānām iti śodhitaśaṅkhasya khaṇḍānāṃ śakalānāṃ bhāgā aṣṭau grāhyāḥ | pāradasyaikabhāgāpekṣayety arthaḥ | saṃpradāyas tu śaṅkhaśakalāni kṣīre saṃśodhya paścāt tenaiva kṣīreṇa saha ślakṣṇāni sampiṣya paścād anenaiva kalkena tān varāṭān lepayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | anye tu śaṅkhaśakalāni varāṭikābhiḥ saha puṭet| cūrṇaliptaśarāvayor iti | cūrṇaṃ śuktikādisaṃbhavaṃ tac ca kaliśabdavācyaṃ tenāliptaśarāvakau kṛtvā tābhyāṃ sampuṭaṃ kārayed ity arthaḥ | śarāvasampuṭasandhiṣu sāmpradāyikī mudrā kāryeti vyavahāraḥ | tad upari ca mṛllepaḥ kārya ity api vyavahāraḥ | gajapuṭeneti | yathā gajapuṭavidhānaṃ tathaivā'tra puṭed ity arthaḥ | tac ca gomayādinā garte kṛtam | ekonatriṃśad ūṣaṇair iti ekena yad ūnaṃ maricānāṃ triśat tena saha ṣaḍraktikapramāṇaṃ bhakṣayet| ghṛtena vātaje dadyād ityādi | atra vātaje pittaje kaphaje ca atīsārādāv agre vakṣyamāṇā niyamā boddhavyāḥ | tasyopari ghṛtānnam iti pūrvaṃ rasaṃ bhakṣayitvā paścāt tad upari kavalatrayaṃ ghṛtānnaṃ bhuñjīta ghṛtena yuktam annaṃ ghṛtānnam | annam atrodanam | mañce khaṭvāyām | anupadhānake upadhānaṃ gendukaṃ tena rahite mañce iti śeṣaḥ | etena samyag uttānaṃ yathā syāt tathā saṃviśed ity arthaḥ | paścāt pathyāpathyam āha - anamlam ityādi | anamlam amlarasarahitam amlañ ca mātuluṅgaprabhṛtikam | annaṃ saṃskṛtam annaṃ tena bhaktādikam | ghṛtam iti ghṛtayuktaṃ | madhuraṃ dadhīti | madhuraṃ komalajīvitaṃ yad vā madhurayuktaṃ tat tu rasālādi | prāyeṇa jāṅgalaṃ māṃsam iti māṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ cātra vihitaṃ bāhulyena jāṅgalaṃ pradhānatamaṃ tad api ghṛtapācitaṃ kāryaṃ | yady api jāṅgalavargo 'ṣṭavidhaḥ | tad yathā - jāṅgalā viṣkarāḥ pratudā guheśayāḥ prasahā parṇamṛgā bileśayāḥ grāmyāś ceti | tathāpy ete tu rogāpekṣayā deyāḥ, ghṛtapācitam iti tailaniṣedhāt guṇādhikyāc ca | tathā hi -
‘māṃsaṃ yat tailasiddhaṃ tu vīryoṣṇaṃ pittakṛd guru |
laghv agnidīpanaṃ grāhyaṃ ruciṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanam | anuṣṇavīryaṃ pittaghnaṃ manojñaṃ ghṛtasādhitam’ iti | ghṛtān iti ghṛtasādhitān athavā sarpiṣā ghṛtena snānaṃ kuryāt, koṣṇodakena snānaṃ tu adhaḥkāyasyeti | yataḥ ‘uṣṇāmbunādha:kāyasya pariṣeko balāvahaḥ | tenaiva tūttamāṅgasya balahṛt keśacakṣuṣām’ iti | kvacit tailaṃ na gṛhṇīyād iti kvacit kutrāpi tailagrahaṇaṃ na kāryaṃ tena dīpādiṣv api tailaṃ niṣiddhaṃ syāt | atha tyājyam āha -bilvam iti| bilvaphalaṃ, kāravellakaṃ loke ‘karelā’śabdavācyam | phalam iti | vārtākaṃ vṛntākaṃ, śapharīṃ kṣudramatsyān, ciñcā prasiddhā, vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajananaṃ karma, maithunaṃ strīsevā, madyādikam iti sugamam | tyajed ayuktanidrāṃ ceti ayuktanidrā divānidrādikaṃ | kakārādiyutaṃ sarvam iti sarvam āhāranimittaṃ kakārapūrvakaṃ śākaphalādikaṃ tyajet | site pakṣe śukle pakṣe agnibhṛṣṭaṃ | jayācūrṇam iti jayābhaṅgā, barhipakṣabhasmeti barhī mayūra: | mṛgāṅke mṛgāṅkapoṭṭalike, hemagarbhe hemagarbhapoṭṭalike, mauktikākhye mauktikākhyapoṭṭalike apareṣv api pañcarajapoṭṭalikaprabhṛtiṣu eṣa vidhiḥ prayojya iti || 59-85 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuddho sūtaḥ pāradaḥ bhāgadvayam iti ṭaṃkadvayaṃ karṣadvayaṃ tathā gandhakasya śuddhasya dvau bhāgau tayoḥ pāradagandhakayoḥ kajjalikāṃ kuryāt | sūtāt caturguṇeṣu aṣṭabhāgeṣu kapardeṣu kṣipet bhāgaikaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ datvā gokṣīreṇa mardayitvā varāṭānāṃ mukhaṃ mudrayet, śaṃkhasya śaṃkhānām aṣṭau bhāgān śarāvamadhye varāṭakānām adha ūrdhvaṃ datvā mudrāṃ vidhāya gajapuṭe pacet kapardo varāṭakaḥkauḍīti loke | puṭasyāntaḥ saṃpuṭasyāntaḥ sarvaṃ kṣipet cūrṇaṃ kajjalīcūrṇaṃ talliptaśarāvayoḥ saṃpuṭasyāntaḥ madhye ṣaṅguñjāsammite rasaṃ siddham ekonatriṃśat ūṣaṇair maricair deyaṃ vātaroge ghṛtena dadyāt | śapharī kṣudramatsyaḥ | pathyavarge hi tasya gṛhītatvāt | ‘varo matsyeṣu rohita’ iti suśrutokteḥ | ayuktanidrāṃ divājanyāṃ jayā vijayā tac cūrṇaṃ kolamajjāṃ badaramajjāṃ kaṇā pippalī barhir mayūras tatpakṣabhasma || 59-85 ||

atha mṛgāṅkapoṭṭalīrasaḥ kṣayādau -
bhūrjavat tanupatrāṇi hemnaḥ sūkṣmāṇi kārayet ||86||

lg.l: tulyāni tāni sūtena khalve kṣiptvā vimardayet |
lāṅgalyā vā rasais tāvad yāvad bhavati piṣṭikā |
tato hemnaś caturthāṃśaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ tatra nikṣipet || 88 ||
teṣu sarvasamaṃ gandhaṃ kṣiptvā caikatra mardayet || 89 ||
teṣāṃ kṛtvā tato golaṃ vāsobhiḥ pariveṣṭayet |
paścān mṛdā veṣṭayitvā śoṣayitvā ca dhārayet||90||
lavaṇāpūrite bhāṇḍe dhārayet taṃ ca saṃpuṭam || 91 ||
mudrāṃ dattvā śoṣayitvā bahubhir gomayaiḥ puṭet |
tataḥ śīte samāhṛtya gandhaṃ sūtasamaṃ kṣipet ||92||
ghṛṣṭvā ca pūrvavat khalve puṭed gajapuṭena ca |
śleṣmāṇaṃ grahaṇīṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ kṣayam arocakam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha mṛgāṅkapoṭṭalīrasaṃ vyācaṣṭe - bhūrjavad iti | bhūrjo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak tadākārāṇi tanupatrāṇi | tanugrahaṇena yathā aṅgādīnāṃ manoharārthaṃ svarṇakārāḥ kurvanti tadvad atrāpi kāryāṇīty arthaḥ | sūkṣmāṇīti tāni tanupatrāṇi tilavat khaṇḍitāni kṛtvety artha: | sūtena pāradena samaṃ saṃgṛhya khalve kṣiptvā mardanīyam | kathaṃ yathā kāñcanārarasenetyādi | kāñcanāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddha eva jvālāmukhī jayantī sā caturvidhā bhavati | tathā hi -‘śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā jvālāmukhī bhavet’ iti | lāṅgalī kalahārikā, yāvad bhavati piṣṭiketi ko 'rthaḥ ? tatsuvarṇarasadravyaṃ yāvad dravatvaṃ prāpya piṣṭikā syāt tāvad rasair mardanīyam | asmatsampradāye tu pūrvoktaśodhitarase suvarṇapatrāṇi datvā tadanu īṣadgandharajo datvā upari pātraṃ saṃsthāpya gāḍhaṃ mardayet, yāvad dhanabhasmavad bhavati paścād uktarasaiḥ saha saṃmardya golakārthaṃ piṣṭikāṃ kārayed ity arthaḥ | tato hemnaś caturthāṃśaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ tatra nikṣipet iti | tataḥ piṣṭīkaraṇānantaraṃ tatra piṣṭīkṛtadravye ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ hemnaḥ suvarṇasya caturthāṃśaṃ kṣipet, tena yadā suvarṇaṃ catuḥśāṇaṃ bhavati tadā ṭaṅkaṇaṃ śāṇam ekam ity arthaḥ | piṣṭamauktikacūrṇam iti | śodhitamauktikacūrṇaṃ suvarṇaparimāṇād dviguṇaṃ saṃgṛhya melayed iti bhāvaḥ | teṣu pūrvoktadravyeṣu sarvasamaṃ samastadravyasāmyaṃ gandhakaṃ kṣiptvā sarvam ekatra mardayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | mardanam atra pūrvoktarasair iti vyavahāraḥ | sarvasamam iti sarvaṃ pāradasuvarṇaṭaṅkaṇamauktikam ity artha:| teṣāṃ kṛtvā tato golaṃ vāsobhiḥ pariveṣṭayed iti hastapāṭyāṃ tuṃ tadgolakarūpaṃ dravyaṃ pūrvaṃ śarāvasampuṭe kṛtvā tatsandhau sāmpradāyikīṃ mudrāṃ ca datvā tad bhāṇḍaṃ gajapuṭavidhānena puṭet | paścāt svāṅgaśītatvaṃ dravyaṃ saṃgṛhya yāvat parimāṇaṃ pāradaṃ pūrvaṃ tāvat parimāṇam anyad gandhakaṃ ca datvā saṃmardya ca pūrvavat puṭet mardanam atra pūrvoktarasaiḥ evaṃ siddho bhavati | śeṣaṃ subodhanam || 86- 96 ||

ab.seg:
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bhūrjapatravat tanu sūkṣmaṃ yathā syāt tathā hemnaḥ suvarṇasya patrāṇi kārayet | tāni sūtena śuddhapāradena tulyāni khalve kṛtvā mardayet | kāñcanāras tadrasena jvālāmukhī jayantī tadrasena vā lāṃgalyā kalihāryā vā rasena yāvat piṣṭikā bhavati tato hemnaś caturthāṃśaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyapiṣṭamauktikācūrṇaṃ hema dviguṇam āvapet melayet teṣu sarvasamaṃ svarṇādisamaṃ gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ kṣipet śuddhaṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ golaṃ vāsobhir veṣṭayitvā śoṣayitvā ca dhārayet | kutra ? śarāvasaṃpuṭasya ante madhye tatra mudrāṃ pradāpayet lavaṇapūrite bhāṇḍe taṃ saṃpuṭaṃ dhārayet | mudrāṃ datvā śoṣayitvā bahubhir gomayaiḥ puṭet cullyāṃ vā agniṃ dāpayet tataḥ śīte samākṛṣya gandhasūtaṃ samaṃ golakaṃ samaṃ kṣipet pūrvavat khalve piṣṭvā gajapuṭe pacet svāṅgaśītaṃ guñjayugmam atra yojayet | aṣṭābhiḥ maricair vā tribhi: sarpiṣā ghṛtena madhunā vā doṣāpekṣayā deyā | pathyaṃ lokanāthasamaṃ | svacchamanāḥ punaḥ śuciḥ pavitro rogī ayaṃ mṛgāṅkaḥ śleṣmādīn hanyāt mṛgāṅkaś candras tannāmā mṛtāmayatvād roganāśakaḥ | yad vā pūrve mṛgāṅke ca kṣayarogatvāt pūrvaṃ dattas tasmād ayaṃ mṛgāṅkaḥ | kecit mṛtasvarṇena mṛtapāradena gaṃdhakaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ muktācūrṇena mṛgāṅkasādhanam āhuḥ | tac ca yathā
“bhasmīkṛtasvarṇasamaṃ rasasya bhasmāsureṇāpi rasena tulyaṃ |
dinauktikaṃ pādikaṭaṅkaṇaṃ ca jambīranīre vaṭakīkṛtaṃ tat | mṛttakarpaṭair āvṛtavajrayantre pakvoditaṃ syāt kṣayajin mṛgāṅkaḥ”| rasarājasya asureśo gaṃdhakaḥ | granthāṃtare kumudeśvaratvena kathitaḥ | tathā ca ‘hemabhasma rasabhasma mauktikaṃ pāradaṃ kaṇakagandhakaṃ ca kuru sarvatulyakaṃ |
kāñjikena parimardya golakaṃ mūṣayā ca pariveṣṭya pācayet |
uddharet tam atha sampuṭāt tataḥ siddhim eti kumudeśvaro rasaḥ |
pītam asya tu kaṇair madhuplutai rājadugdham atha yojayet tathā |
pathyam atra ghṛtapācitopari kṣārahiṃgurahite himaṃ mataṃ’| bhasmīkṛtasvarṇaṃ tolakaṃ, mṛtapāradaṃ tolakaṃ, mṛtamauktikaṃ tolakaṃ, kāñjikena nimbūkena vā golaṃ kṛtvā mūṣābhyantare niruddhya lavaṇena pūrya haṇḍikāyāṃ madhye sthāpayitvā vahniṃ jvālayet | śīte raktikaikāṃ madhunā khādet | chāgadugdhaṃ pibet pathyaṃ yathoktaṃ kumudeśvara eva mṛgāṅkaḥ ||86-96||

kṣayaśvāsādau hemagarbhapoṭṭalīrasaḥ |
sūtāt pādapramāṇena hemnaḥ piṣṭaṃ prakalpayet |
tayoḥ syād dviguṇo gandho mardayet kāñcanārakaiḥ ||97||

lg.l: kṛtvā golaṃ kṣipen mūṣāsaṃpuṭe mudrayet tataḥ |
tata uddhṛtya tat sarvaṃ dadyād gandhaṃ ca tatsamam |
mudrayet tena kalkena varāṭānāṃ mukhāni ca || 101||
bhāṇḍe cūrṇapralipte ca dhṛtvā mudrāṃ pradāpayet |
garte hastonmite dhṛtvā puṭed gajapuṭena ca || 102 ||
pathyaṃ mṛgāṅkavaj jñeyaṃ tridinaṃ lavaṇaṃ tyajet || 103 ||
yadā chardir bhavet tasya dadyāc chinnāśṛtaṃ‘rasaṃ’ pā. | tadā |
jayet kāsaṃ kṣayaṃ śvāsaṃ grahaṇīm aruciṃ tathā || 105 ||
agniṃ ca kurute dīptaṃ kaphavātaṃ niyacchati |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha hemagarbhapoṭṭalīnāmakarasaṃ prakaṭayann āha - sūtāt pādapramāṇenetyādi | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ sa ca śodhito grāhyas tasya pādaś caturthāṃśas tena samaṃ hema grāhyam | hemna iti grahaṇenāsya patrāṇi kāryāṇīty arthaḥ | tāni pūrvoktānīti sambandhaḥ | piṣṭīvidhānaṃ tu pūrvavad boddhavyam | tayoḥ syāt dviguṇo gandha iti | tayoḥ pāradasuvarṇayor dviguṇaḥ parimāṇāt tena pāradasuvarṇayor eko bhāgaḥ, gandhakasya dvau bhāgau, kāñcanāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, tasya patrāṇāṃ svarasena mardayet yāvat piṣṭikākāraṃ bhavati, mūṣāsampuṭe śarāvasampuṭe sandhau ca mudrāṃ kārayet, mudrā sāmpradāyikī kāryā | tata iti grahaṇena tatsampuṭaṃ mṛtkarpaṭakaiś ca lepayed iti bhāvaḥ | paced bhūdharayantreṇa vāsaratritayaṃ budha iti | vāsaratrayaṃ yāvad bhūdharayantreṇa kṛtvā pacet | asmatsampradāye 'pi gomayaiḥ kṛtvā punaḥ punar agniṃ prajvālayet yāvad dinatrayaṃ bhavati ity abhiprāyaḥ | tatas tu puṭaṣaṭkaṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ | puṭaṣaṭkaṃ ca gomayāgninā na tu śarāvasampuṭaṃ ṣaḍvāraṃ kāryaṃ tad ekavāram eva | paścāt kāryam āha - tata uddhṛtyetyādi tat sarvaṃ dravyaṃ gandhakena samaṃ kṛtvā paścād ārdrakarasena citrakajaṭāsvarasena ca saṃmardya tena piṣṭadravyeṇa varāṭakān pūrayet, paścāt tanmukhāni ṭaṅkaṇaviṣaṃ sehuṇḍadugdhena piṣṭvā tena mudrayet ṭaṅkaṇamānaṃ pūrvadravyasambhārād aṣṭamāṃśaṃ grāhyaṃ viṣaṃ tu ṭaṅkaṇārdham ity arthaḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham ||97-106 ||

atha dvitīyo hemagarbhapoṭṭalīrasaḥ -
rasasya bhāgāś catvāras tāvantaḥ kanakasya ca |
tayoś ca ṣiṣṭikāṃ kṛtvā gandho dvādaśabhāgikaḥ ||107 ||

lg.l: kuryāt kajjalikāṃ teṣāṃ muktābhāgāś ca ṣoḍaśa |
caturviṃśac ca śaṅkhasya bhāgaikaṃ ṭaṅkaṇasya ca || 108 ||
kṛtvā teṣāṃ tato golaṃ mūṣāsaṃpuṭake nyaset ||109||
mudrāṃ dattvā tato hastamātre garte ca gomayaiḥ |
rājate mṛnmaye pātre kācaje‘kāñcane’ pā. | vā'valehayet |
lokanāthasamaṃ pathyaṃ kuryāc ca svasthamānasaḥ‘prayata’ pā. | || 112||
kāse śvāse kṣaye vāte kaphe grahaṇikāgade |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha dvitīyā hebhagarbhapoṭṭalī tām api darśayann āha - rasasyeti | vyākhyāyām asyābhiprāyaḥ sakalaṃ svasvaparimitaṃ rasasuvarṇādikam ekatra saṃmardya paced iti tātparyārthaḥ | keṣāñcid dhastapāṭyām eva yathā śuddhapāradaṃ prathamato mūrcchitaṃ kṛtvā paścāt taduktadravyai: golakaṃ kārayet | asmatsampradāye tu lokanāthapoṭṭalīvat kartavyā, sā ca pūrvaṃ kathitaiva muktāś cātra śaṅkhavat prakṣiptā jñeyāḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 107-113 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rasasya śuddhapāradasya catvāro bhāgāḥ kanakasya svarṇasya tāvantaḥ, spaṣṭam anyat || 107-116 ||

atha mahājvarāṅkuśaḥ viṣamajvarādau -
śuddhasūto viṣaṃ gandhaḥ pratyekaṃ śāṇasaṃmitam |
dhūrtabījaṃ triśāṇaṃ syāt sarvebhyo dviguṇā bhavet ||114||

lg.l: hemāhvā kārayed eṣāṃ sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ prayatnataḥ |
aikāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ vā tryāhikaṃ vā caturthakam ||116||
viṣamaṃ ca jvaraṃ hanyād vikhyāto 'yaṃ jvarāṅkuśaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha dvitīyajvarāṅkuśarasam āha - śuddhasūta iti | śuddhaḥ saṃskāritaḥ | saṃskārā hy asya pūrvaṃ kathitāḥ, viṣam api śuddhaṃ tac cāpi pūrvaṃ vihitam eva, gandho gandhakas tam api śuddhaṃ kṛtvā grāhyam, śāṇaṃ ṭaṅkaikaṃ pratyekam ity arthaḥ | dhūrtabījam iti dhattūrabījāni tāni triṭaṅkamitāni, hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī sā ca cokaśabdavācyā | eṣā tu sarvebhyaś caturdravyebhyo dviguṇā grāhyā tena ṣaṭśāṇadviguṇitety arthaḥ | jambīraphalamajjārdrakaraso 'pi doṣāpekṣayā boddhavyaḥ | parasparābhāve 'pi tridoṣajam iti vyastaṃ samastaṃ, viṣamajvaram iti punargrahaṇena prāyaśo viṣamajvaranāśanārtham asya prabhāvo na doṣaḥ; kutaḥ? vikhyātatvāt || 114-116 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śāṇasaṃmitaḥ ṭaṃkaṇapramāṇaḥ śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhaṃ ceti, dhattūrabījaṃ triśāṇaṃ sarvebhyo dviguṇā dvādaśabhāgā hemāhvā hemakṣīrī tasya sthāne vyoṣaṃ trikaṭur ity eke | spaṣṭam anyat || 114-116 ||

lg.l: daradaṃ vatsanābhaṃ ca maricaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ kaṇām || 117 ||
guñjaikaṃ vā dviguñjaṃ vā balaṃ jñātvā prayojayet ||118 ||
madhunā lehayec cānu kuṭajasya phalaṃ tvacam |
dadhyannaṃ dāpayet pathyaṃ gavājyaṃ takram eva ca |
pipāsāyāṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ vijayā ca hitā niśi ||120||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athānandabhairavarasasya vyākhyānaṃ darśayitum āha - daradam iti | daradaṃ hiṅgulaṃ, vatsanābhaṃ viṣaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ, kuṭajasya phalam indrayavaṃ tvak challī kuṭajasyaiva militvā karṣam ity arthaḥ | etad anupānaṃ pathyaṃ ca prāyaśo 'tīsāre praśastam | gavyājaṃ gosambhavam ajāsambhavaṃ ca takraṃ tat tu tribhāgabhinnam | tathā hi - ‘udaśvitvardhavārikam | takraṃ tribhāgabhinnaṃ tu kevalaṃ mathitaṃ smṛtam’ iti | kevalo 'yaṃ kaphāgnimadhye yojyaḥ iti vyavahāro vṛddhavaidyānāṃ dṛśyate | pipāsāyāṃ satyāṃ śītalaṃ jalaṃ deyaṃ, na tūṣṇaṃ rasanimittatvāt | niśi rātrau vijayā bhaṅgā hitā pathyā atraiva prayoge tena prātar evāyaṃ rasaḥ śīlanīya iti bhāvaḥ || 117-120 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athānandabhairavaḥ atīsārādau - daradaṃ hiṃgulaṃ, vatsanābhaṃ viṣaṃ, maricaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ samabhāgaṃ cūrṇaṃ guñjaikaṃ deyam, anupānaṃ kuṭajasya phalam indrayavaṃ tathā kuṭajatvacaṃ karṣamātraṃ madhunā deyaṃ gavyam ājyaṃ vā takram | sugamam anyat || 117-120 ||

atha laghusūcikābharaṇo rasas tridoṣe -
viṣaṃ palamitaṃ sūtaḥ śāṇikaś cūrṇayed dvayam |
tac cūrṇaṃ saṃpuṭe kṣiptvā kācaliptaśarāvayoḥ || 121 ||

lg.l: mudrāṃ dattvā ca saṃśoṣya tataś culyāṃ niveśayet |
saṃlagno yo bhavet sūtas taṃ gṛhṇīyāc chanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 123||
vāyusparśo yathā na syāt tathā kupyāṃ niveśayet |
yāvat sūcyā mukhe lagnaṃ kupyā niryāti bheṣajam ||124||
kṣureṇa pracchite mūrdhni tatrāṅgulyā ca gharṣayet||125||
yadā tāpo bhavet tasya madhuraṃ tatra dīyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha laghusūcikābharaṇarasaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | viṣam iti | viṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ palamitaṃ ṣoḍaśaśāṇamitaṃ, sūtaḥ pāradaḥ śāṇikaṣ ṭaṅkaikaḥ, prathamato 'bhyantare kācaliptaṃ kṛtvā tayoḥ sampuṭe cūrṇaṃ melayitvā sāmpradāyikī mudrā tatsandhau kāryā tataś cullyāṃ niveśayet | iti ko 'rthaḥ ? tadrasagarbhasampuṭaṃ vālukāyantre nidhāyādhaḥ śarāvalagnaṃ yathā syād vipaced ity abhiprāyo 'smatsāmpradāyikaḥ | yathā karpūrapākārthaṃ yantravidhis tadvad atrāpi uparisthasarāvakalagno dhūmasadṛśaḥ kajjalavad rasaḥ, sūcī tu rasagrahaṇārthaṃ śalākā kathyate sā tu masūradalasaṃsthā mukhī bhavati tanmukhe yāval lagno raso bhavati tāvad deyo rasa iti rasavādināṃ vyavahāraḥ mūrcchite mṛtaprāye sannipātini puruṣe tathaiva sarpadaṣṭe 'pīti | yathā sannipāte bhakṣaṇaṃ mūrdhni mardanaṃ cābhihitaṃ tathaiva sarpadaṣṭe ity arthaḥ | tāpaḥ santāpo rasajanita ityādi | madhuram ikṣuvikāraṃ drākṣā dāḍimakharjūrādikam api sampradāyataḥ || 121-126 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 121-126 ||

atha jalabandhurasaḥ sannipāte -
sūtabhasmasamaṃ gandhaṃ dhātryā dadyān manaḥśilā || 127||

lg.l: mākṣikaṃ pippalī vyoṣaṃ pratyekaṃ śilayā samam |
saptadhā bhāvayec chuṣkaṃ deyaṃ guñjādvayaṃ hitam |
jalayogaś ca kartavyas tena vīryaṃ bhaved rase || 130 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ jalabandhusaṃjñako nāma rasas tam āha - bhasmasūtasamaṃ gandham iti | sūtasya pāradasya bhasma tatsamānaṃ gandhakam ity arthaḥ | dhātryā dantyāḥ phalāny atra yojyāni etan manoharam | atra gandhāt pādaṃ mana:śilā iti pāṭhaḥ saṅgataḥ | tena gandhakaparimāṇasya caturthāṃśasamānā manaḥśilā grāhyā, ata eva ‘pratyekaṃ śilayā samam’ iti vacanam | mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, vyoṣaṃ śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñakam | pippalī dviruktatayā dviguṇā grāhyā | ekadravyaparimāṇāt, eke jalapippalīty atra vyākhyānayanti tan na sarvamatam | matsyo mīnaḥ sāmānyatvena parijñātamatsyo grāhyaḥ, sa ca rohitaḥ, tādṛśaś cānyo 'pi | mayūro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ | ‘saptadhā bhāvayet’ iti pratyekaṃ saptavāram ity arthaḥ | hitam iti doṣānupāne yojyam | pañcakolaṃ yathā - ‘pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ cavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ | pañcakolam iti khyātam’ ityādi | jalayogaś ca kartavya iti | etena śītalajalapānaṃ tajjalenā'pi hṛdayanetraproñchanam iti sampradāyaḥ || || 127-130||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tālaparṇī musalīraso deyaḥ | pañcakolaśṛto vā kvātho deyaḥ | kaphādhikāḥ sannipātāḥ || || 127-130 ||

pañcavakrarasaḥ |
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhaṃ maricaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ kaṇām |
mardayed dhūrtajadrāvair dinam ekaṃ ca śoṣayet || 131 ||

lg.l: yuktaṃ dadhyodanaṃ pathyaṃ jalayogaṃ ca kārayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. adhunā pañcavakrarasaṃ darśayann āha - śuddham ityādi | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, viṣaṃ prasiddham, gandhaṃ gandhakam etat trayaṃ śuddham api boddhavyam | śuddhir eṣā pūrvakathitaiva | ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāram etasyāpi śodhanaṃ vihitaṃ tad bharjitam eke bhāṣante | dhūrto dhattūras tasya patrāṇāṃ svarasair ity arthaḥ | dhattūraphalarasair vā vadanti | parato vakṣyamāṇonmattarase dhattūraphalarasair iti vacanāt | dinam ekaṃ ca śoṣayed iti | tat sakalaṃ dravyaṃ vastragālitaṃ kṛtvā paścād dhattūrarasena saptavāraṃ bhāvayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | pratyekabhāvanāyāṃ mardanaṃ ca kāryam | tryūṣam iti | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tac ca śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñam | eteṣāṃ cūrṇena saṃyuktam arkamūlakaṣāyaṃ tv anupānam āhuḥ | yuktaṃ dadhyodanaṃ pathyam iti doṣāgnibalādikānurūpam | jalayogaś cātra jalabandhurasavat kāryaḥ | tat pūrvaṃ pratipāditam eva | sakṣaudreṇeti | kṣaudraṃ madhu tena sahāvalehitaḥ | kaphodbhavāḥ śophakṣayādaya iti | agnivṛddhaye tu madhvārdrakarasam anu pibet | rasaparimāṇaṃ tu pūrvoktam eva | anena pāvako 'gniḥ śaktaḥ samartho bhavati pākārtham iti yāvat || 131-134 ||

athonmatto rasaḥ sannipāte -
rasaṃ gandhakatulyāṃśaṃ dhattūraphalajadravaiḥ |
mardayed dinam ekaṃ tu tattulyaṃ trikaṭu kṣipet || 135 ||

lg.l: unmattākhyo raso nāmnā nasye syāt saṃnipātajit |
