ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athonmattarasas tam api darśayann āha - rasagandhakatulyāṃśam iti | ayaṃ raso nāvane yojyaḥ | sa tu pradhamanarūpo jñeyaḥ | utkaṭasannipāte raktikādvayaparimitaṃ ca, bhakṣaṇe 'pi deyam ity asmatsaṃpradāye 'nubhūtam | tattulyaṃ trikaṭu kṣiped iti tattulyaṃ rasagandhakasamam | trikaṭu śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīkaṃ | śeṣaṃ subodham || 135||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam ||135||

atha sannipāte 'ñjanaṃ rasāḥ -
nistvagjaipālabījaṃ ca daśaniṣkaṃ vicūrṇayet ||136||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha sannipātāñjanaṃ vyācaṣṭe - nistvagjaipālabījam iti | jaipālabījaṃ tan nistvak nistuṣaṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ | etādṛśaṃ daśaṭaṅkamitaṃ grāhyam | maricapippalīsūtaṃ ca pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkaikaṃ sūtaṃ pāradaṃ tac cātra mūrcchitaṃ grāhyam | jambīrajair iti| jambīraphalarasaiḥ sannipātam iti sāmānyena sarvaṃ sannipātaṃ viśeṣeṇa tāndrike yojyo 'yam ity abhiprāyaḥ ||136|| 137 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nistvak tvacārahitaṃ jaipālaṃ daśaniṣkaṃ daśaṭaṅkaṃ maricaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pāradaṃ gandhamūrcchitaṃ pratiniṣkaṃ pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ | saptāhaṃ saptadinaṃ jambīrajair drāvair bhāvyaṃ | tadā vaṭī kāryā sā añjanena sannipātaṃ hanti || ||136 ||137||

ab.seg:
atha mahānārācarasaḥ śūlādau -
sūtaṃ ṭaṅkaṇakaṃ tulyaṃ maricaṃ sūtatulyakam || 138 ||

lg.l: gandhakaṃ pippalīṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dvau dvau bhāgau vicūrṇayet|

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha mahānārāco 'yaṃ rasaḥ sūtam iti | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ tulyaṃ samaṃ maricam api pāradasamam iti, gandhakaḥ, pippalī, śuṇṭhī ca dvibhāgā jñeyā | tenaikadravyabhāgāpekṣayā pratyekaṃ dvau bhāgau sarvatulyaṃ dantībījam iti pūrvoktaṣaḍdravyasāmyaṃ dantībījaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | nistuṣitaṃ tuṣarahitaṃ jaipālam iti yāvat | recanam iti bhedanaparyāyam| nanu recanabhedanayoḥ ko bhedaḥ ? ucyate, tatraiva dīpanapācanādhyāye yad apakvaṃ cetyādi boddhavyam || 138-140 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ bharjitaṃ ca | sugamam anyat || 138-140 ||

atha icchābhedī rasaḥ śūlādau --
daradaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī caikakārṣikā |
hemāhvā palamātrā syād dantībījaṃ ca tatsamam ||141 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athecchābhedīnāmarasas tam āha - daradam iti | ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ, hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī loke coka iti prasiddhā | dantībījaṃ ca tatsamam iti | svarṇakṣīrīparimāṇasamam etat sarvaṃ saṃcūrṇya godugdhena kṛtvā sādhayet | sādhanaṃ tu vahnau tāvad uktaṃ yāvat kṣīrahīnaṃ bhavati | kṣīraparimāṇaṃ tu dravyasambhārāc caturguṇaṃ grāhyam iti sampradāyaḥ || 141 || 142 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. daradaṃ hiṅgulaṃ, hemāhvā cokapatramātraṃ, hiṅgulādyā: karṣamātraṃ, dantībījaṃ tatsamaṃ godugdhena triguñjaṃ pibet | spaṣṭam anyat || 140 || 141 ||

ab.seg:
vasantakusumākararasaḥprakṣiptamidaṃ | hemabhūtiḥ svarṇabhasma, gaganam abhrakabhasma, pravālaṃ vidrumabhasma, mauktikaṃ muktāphalabhasma, āṭaruṣakaḥ sahacaraḥ | haridrāvāriṇā haridrāsvarasenetyarthaḥ | tadabhāve haridrākvāthena kāryā | mocakandaḥ śālmalīniryāsaḥ, śatapatraḥ sevaṃtīkusumaḥ ‘gulāba’ hati prasiddhaḥ | candraḥ karpūra: bhīmasenī grāhya: || |
dvau bhāgau hemabhūteś ca gaganaṃ cāpi tatsamam |
lohabhasma trayo bhāgāś catvāro rasabhasmanaḥ || 143 ||

lg.l: vaṅgabhasma tribhāgaṃ syāt sarvam ekatra mardayet |

ab.seg:
kṣayādau rājamṛgāṅkarasaḥ |
sūtabhasma trayo bhāgā bhāgaikaṃ hemabhasmakam ||148 ||

lg.l: piṣṭvā tena mukhaṃ ruddhvā mṛdbhāṇḍe tan nirodhayet ||150||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha rājamṛgāṅkarasam āha - sūtabhasmeti | atra mṛtapāradasya trayo bhāgāḥ, mṛtasvarṇasya bhāgaikaṃ, mṛtatāmrasya ca bhāgaikam | eke mṛtābhrakasya bhāgaikam iti paṭhanti | tan na sarvasaṃmatam | śilāgandhakaṃ tālakam iti śilā manaḥśilā, gandhakaṃ pratītaṃ, tālakaṃ haritālaṃ, śuddhānām eteṣāṃ ca bhāgadvayaṃ pratyekam | varāṭīlakṣaṇaṃ ca pūrvoktalokanātharase draṣṭavyam | tena pūrvoktasakaladravyacūrṇena ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ mṛdbhāṇḍe mṛtkarpaṭanirmite pātre gajapuṭopalakṣaṇatvāt ṣoḍaśāṅgulagarte paced iti sampradāyaḥ | anyathā bahutarajvalanasamparkād dagdhena tv anarthakaro bhavati anupānaṃ doṣāpekṣayā pṛthag eva; tena daśapippalikākṣaudraiḥ sahāvaleho rasasya jñātavyaḥ | ekonatriṃśadūṣaṇair iti, athavā ekahīnatriṃśatsaṃkhyākamaricaiḥ sakṣaudraiś cāvaleho boddhavyam | eke ‘sājyena triṃśadūṣaṇai’riti paṭhanti, tatra ghṛtamaricaiḥ saha pracāraḥ sādhuḥ | kevalakṣaudreṇāpīti kecit | tathā ca bhinnaṃ mṛgāṅkaṃ tantrāntare dṛṣṭvā pratipāditam | yataḥ
‘aṣṭabhir maricair yuktā kṛṣṇātrayayutā'thavā |
vilokya deyā doṣādi hy ekaikarasaraktikā | sarpiṣā madhunā vā'pi dadyād doṣādyapekṣayā’ ityādi || 148-152 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha rājamṛgāṅko rasaḥ kṣayādau | śilā manaḥśilā, tālakaṃ haritālaṃ, varāṭīḥ kapardikās tena pūrayet | chāgīkṣīreṇa ṭaṅkaṇaṃ piṣṭvā mukhaṃ rundhayet | punaḥ mṛdbhāṇḍe ruddhvā gajapuṭe pacet, spaṣṭam anyat ||148 - 152||

ab.seg:
athāgnināmā rasa kṣayaśvāsādau -
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ kuryāt khalvena kajjalīm ||153||

lg.l: saṃcūrṇya gālayed vastre satyaṃ vāritaraṃ bhavet |
saptadhā tu pṛthag drāvair bhāvyaṃ śoṣyaṃ tathātape |
siddhayogo hy ayaṃ khyātaḥ siddhānāṃ ca mukhāgataḥ ||158||
svarṇādīn mārayed evaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya tu lohavat ||159||
saṃcūrṇya loḍayet kṣaudrair bhakṣyaṃ niṣkadvayaṃ dvayam || 161||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha agnirasavivaraṇam āha - śuddhaṃ sūtam iti| dvidhā gandham iti | śuddhapāradaparimāṇāt | gandhakam apy atra śodhitaṃ grāhyaṃ, tayoḥ samaṃ tīkṣṇacūrṇam iti tīkṣṇacūrṇaṃ pāṣāṇādigharṣaṇān niṣpannaṃ mṛtalohacūrṇaṃ ceti; tayoḥ samam iti gandhakapāradasāmyaṃ bhavati | kanyakā kumārī, mardanasya yāvat ślakṣṇatvaṃ syāt bahutarāyāsenety arthaḥ | hastapāṭyāṃ tu pūrvoktadravyapiṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhya eraṇḍapatrair āveṣṭya paścāt tāmrasampuṭake dhṛtvā tadanu sampuṭam api patrair ācchādya gharme dhārayed yāvad uṣṇaṃ bhavati paścāt tat sampuṭaṃ yathoktam eva dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpayet | ahorātraṃ yāvat sampradāye tu tridinaparyantaṃ dhārayet | vakṣyamāṇaloharasāyane vihitatvāt | evaṃ siddho raso 'paradravyaiḥ saha sāmyo bhakṣyaḥ | tad yathā - ‘trikaṭukaṃ prasiddham, triphalā harītakyādikam, elā bṛhadelā, jātīphalaṃ pratītam, lavaṅgam api vikhyātam, etac ca navadravyaṃ pūrvarasasāmyaṃ saṃcūrṇya niṣkadvayaṃ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ kṣaudraiḥ sahāvalehyam ity arthaḥ || 153-161 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ pāradaṃ bhāgaikaṃ, dvidhā dvibhāgaṃ gandhakaṃ, tīkṣṇacūrṇaṃ dvayoḥ samaṃ tribhāgaṃ, bhṛṅgajo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, kākamācī prasiddhā, kuraṇṭaḥ pītavāsā | muṇḍī punarnavā, sahadevī, amṛtā guḍūcī, nīlapuṣpī parājitā, nirguṇḍī, citraṃ citrakaṃ, teṣāṃ dravaiḥ sapta sapta bhāvanā deyā | elā bṛhadelā niṣkadvayaṃ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ bhakṣyam || 153-161 ||

amṛtārṇavarasaḥprakṣiptam | |
pāradaṃ gandhakaṃ śuddhaṃ mṛtalohaṃ ca ṭaṅkaṇam || 162 ||

triguñjaṃ sarvakāsārtaḥ sevayed amṛtārṇavam | atha sūryāvarto rasaḥ śvāse -
sūtārdho gandhako mardyo yāmaikaṃ kanyakādravaiḥ || 164 ||

lg.l: sūryāvarto raso hy eṣa dviguñjaḥ śvāsajid bhavet |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. atha sūryāvartarasam āha - sūtārdho gandhako mardya iti | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ sa ca gandhakaparimāṇād ardho grāhya ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā ca tantrāntare -
‘sūtam ekaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ yāmaṃ kanyāvimarditam |
dvayos tulye tāmrapātre sthālyāṃ garbhe nirodhayet | samyaṅ mṛllavaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ caturyāmaṃ pacet sudhīḥ’ ityādi | śeṣaṃ subodham | anupānam apy atra doṣaviśeṣeṇa deyaṃ na doṣa: || 164 || 165 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sthālikāyantre dvihaṇḍikāsampuṭe kayacīyantre || 164 || 165 ||

ab.seg:
atha svacchandabhairavaraso vātaroge -
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ mṛtaṃ lohaṃ tāpyaṃ gandhakatālake || 166 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha svacchandabhairavarasam āha - śuddhaṃ sūtam iti | saṃskāritaṃ rasaṃ mūrcchitam ity arthaḥ | tāpyaṃ svarṇamākṣikam, etad api śodhitaṃ grāhyam | gandhakatālakam api śuddham atra deyam | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ, pathyā harītakī, agnimantho 'raṇibhedaḥ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ, tac cātra bharjitaṃ grāhyaṃ, viṣam api ekadravyabhāgasāmyaṃ sakaladravyam api samamātram | nirguṇḍikādravair iti nirguṇḍīpatrasvarasaiḥ, muṇḍī kedāramuṇḍī vikhyātā, asyāḥ svarasair api dinaikaṃ mardanīyam | anupānam āha - rāsnā surabhī, amṛtā guḍūcī, vātārijam eraṇḍamūlaṃ, devadāru, śuṇṭhī ca prasiddhā eteṣāṃ samānāṃ śṛtaṃ kvathitam ity arthaḥ | guggulum atra prakṣepam āhuḥ || 166-169 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tāpyaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddhaṃ, pathyā harītakī, agnimanthaḥ araṇī, nirguṇḍī prasiddhā, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ tac ca bharjitaṃ, viṣaṃ śuddhaṃ dviguñjaṃ bhakṣayet rāsnādikvāthānupānaṃ vā | vātāriḥ eraṇḍamūlam ||166-169||

atha haṃsapoṭṭalīrasaḥ grahaṇīroge -
dagdhvā kapardakaṃ piṣṭvā tryūṣaṇaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ viṣam |
gandhakaṃ śuddhasūtaṃ ca tulyaṃ jambīrajair dravaiḥ || 170 ||

lg.l: mardayed bhakṣayen māṣaṃ maricājyaṃ lihed anu |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha haṃsapoṭṭalīrasaḥ | dagdhvā kapardakam iti | kapardakaṃ varāṭakaṃ tadabhāve śaṅkho 'py atra grāhyaḥ | mardanam atra yāmacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvad iti sampradāyaḥ | maricājyapramāṇaṃ tu doṣāpekṣayā'vagantavyam | atrājyaṃ ghṛtam | takraudanam iti takraṃ tribhāgabhinnam | tathā hi - ‘tripādāmbūddhṛtasnehaṃ takraṃ grāhi laghu smṛtam’ iti | nihanti rogam iti rogam atīsāraprabhṛtikam || 170|| 171||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 170 || 171 ||

ab.seg:
atha trivikramarasaḥ aśmaryāṃ -
mṛtaṃ tāmram ajākṣīraiḥ pācyaṃ tulyair gatadravam |
tat tāmraṃ śuddhasūtaṃ ca gandhakaṃ ca samaṃ samam ||172||

nirguṇḍīsvararasair mardyaṃ tad golaṃ sandhayed dinam |
yāmaikaṃ vālukāyantre pācyaṃ bhojyaṃ dviguñjakam ||173 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha trivikramarasam āha - mṛtaṃ tāmram ajākṣīrair iti | mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ tāmrabhasma, chāgīkṣīreṇa sāmyaṃ kṛtvā lohapātre mṛṇmayapātre vā sampācayet | yāvad gatadravaṃ bhavati ity anena mṛtatāmraśuddhiḥ kathitety abhiprāyaḥ | tad golaṃ sandhayed iti taddravyagolakaṃ mūṣāsampuṭe melayitvā tanmukhaṃ saṃmudya vālukayantre saṃpācya siddho bhavati | vālukāyantraṃ rasamāraṇādhyāye proktam | bhojyaṃ dviguñjakam iti bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ dviguñjam ity arthaḥ | bījapūrajaṭākalkānupānam atra doṣādyapekṣayā || 172-174 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mṛtaṃ tāmram ajākṣīraṃ tulyaṃ pācyaṃ tolakamitaṃ dugdhaṃ tulyād aṣṭaguṇam adhikaṃ deyam anyathā pākaḥ samyag bhavati | gatadravais tu tāmraṃ śuddhasūtaṃ gandhakaṃ ca samaṃ tolakaṃ vālukāyantre pācyaṃ | haṇḍikāyāṃ golakaṃ sthāpya upari śarāvakaṃ datvā lavamudrā deyā upari vālukāṃ datvā mudrāṃ dāpayet | idaṃ vālukāyantram | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 172-174||

sarvakuṣṭhādau mahātāleśvararasaḥ -
tālaṃ‘tāraṃ’ | tāpyaṃ śilā sūtaṃ śuddhaṃ saindhavaṭaṅkaṇe |
samāṃśaṃ cūrṇayet khalve sūtād dviguṇagandhakam ||175||

lg.l: mardyaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ puṭaiḥ pācyaṃ bhūdhare saṃpuṭodare ||176||
puṭe puṭe dravair mardyaṃ sarvam etat tu ṣaṭpalam |
dvipalaṃ māritaṃ‘maricaṃ’ pā.| tāmraṃ lohabhasma catuṣpalam ||177||
jambīrāmlena tat sarvaṃ dinaṃ mardyaṃ puṭel laghu |
triṃśadaṃśaṃ viṣaṃ cāsya kṣiptvā sarvaṃ vicūrṇayet ||178 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha mahātāleśvararasam āha - tāram iti | tāraṃ raupyaṃ, tāpyaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, śilā manaḥśilā, sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, śuddhaśabdaḥ tārādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate; ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāram eteṣāṃ sāmyamānam ity artha: | śodhitaṃ gandhakam | mṛtatāmraṃ ca dviguṇaṃ grāhyaṃ parimāṇāt | jambīrair iti jambīraphalarasair dinapañcakaṃ yāvat | puna: punar jambīrarasaṃ datvā mardanīyaṃ gharme iti śeṣaḥ | paścād bhūdharayantre mṛṇmayamūṣāsampuṭodare kṣiptaṃ mudritaṃ ca sakalaṃ dravyaṃ pācitam ity arthaḥ | evaṃ ṣaḍvāraṃ yāvat puṭaṃ deyaṃ pratipuṭe tu jambīrarasaiḥ kṛtvā mardanīyam | etan mardanaṃ yathākālaṃ nātra pañcadinamardanaṃ niyatam iti sampradāyaḥ | athavā vakṣyamāṇamardanābhiprāyeṇa dinam ekaṃ yāvat | bhūdharayantraṃ tu pūrvoktahemagarbharase draṣṭavyam | evaṃ saṃsiddham idaṃ ṣaṭpalapramitaṃ saṃgṛhya vakṣyamāṇadravyai: saha punar mardayet | dinam ekaṃ tu jambīrarasenety arthaḥ | tudanu laghupuṭaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānena deyam | kukkuṭapuṭam ity anye | punar api evaṃ siddhasyāsya yat triṃśadbhāgaṃ tena samaṃ viṣaṃ yojyam ity arthaḥ | māhiṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ cātra cūrṇatvāl lehyaparimāṇaṃ deyam | ṭaṅkārdhaṃ māṣakadvayam | sadā śabdo 'tra rasasaṃsevyaviṣayaṃ sūcayati tena sevyo 'yaṃ rasa iti tātparyārthaḥ | anupāne tu bākucī somarājīphalāni ājyam atrāpi māhiṣam || 175-179||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha mahātāleśvaro rasaḥ kuṣṭhādau | tālaṃ haritālaṃ śuddhaṃ, tāpyaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddham | śilā manaḥśilā, sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, saindhavaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ bhūdhare kacchapayantre saṃpuṭe saṃpuṭodare śarāvasaṃpuṭamadhye etat siddhaṃ rasaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ gṛhītvā tatpaścād agnau melayet | dvipalaṃ tāmraṃ catuḥpalaṃ lohabhasma jambīrāmlena mardyaṃ laghupuṭena vahnau saṃyojya triṃśadaṃśaṃ viṣaṃ melayet | mahiṣājyena mahiṣīghṛtena niṣkārdhaṃ ṭaṅkārdhaṃ bhakṣayet | bākucīcūrṇaṃ karṣamātram anulihet ||175-179||

atha kuṣṭhakuṭhāro rasaḥ -
bhasmasūtasamo gandho mṛtāyastāmraguggulūn ||180||

lg.l: triphalā ca mahānimbaś citrakaś ca śilājatu |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha kuṣṭhakuṭhārarasam āha - bhasmasūtasama mata | bhasmasūtasamo gandha ity anena rasādiśilājatuparyantaṃ dravyaṃ pṛthak ṣoḍaśaśāṇamitaṃ grāhyaṃ tatra mṛtāyo māritalohacūrṇaṃ mṛtatāmracūrṇaṃ ca triphalāharītakyādikaṃ mahānimbo loke ‘vakāina’ śabdavācyaḥ | karañjo bṛhatkarañja: asya bījaṃ phalaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiśāṇam ity arthaṃ: | madhughṛtaparimāṇaṃ tu yāvat sakalaṃ dravyam āloḍitaṃ syāt | tāvan mānaṃ yojyam iti | dviniṣkaṃ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ dviniṣkād adhikamānam api deyaṃ na doṣa: | uktam anyatrāpi
‘raso balis tāmram ayaḥ purāgnī śilājatuḥ syād viṣatindukaś ca |
varā ca tulyaṃ gaganaṃ karañjaṃ pṛthak pṛthak śāṇacatuṣṭayaṃ ca ||
saṃmardya sarvaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ghṛtasya pātre nihitaṃ prayatnāt |
kathaṃ bhajet pratyaham asya yasya śālyodanaṃ dugdhamadhutrayaṃ ca |
viśīrṇakarṇāṅgulināsiko 'pi bhaved anena smaratulyamūrti:| dārāparityāga iha praviṣṭo jalodare vāyubaddhamūle’ ||iti || 180-183 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bhasmasūtaṃ mṛtaṃ pāradaṃ tatsamo gandhaḥ gandhakaṃ, mṛtāya: mṛtalohaṃ, mṛtatāmraṃ, gugguluḥ, mahānimba iti, citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ, śilājatusatvam etat pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśaśāṇaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiśāṇaṃ mṛtam abhraṃ sarvaṃ madhvājyābhyāṃ viloḍayet | snigdhabhāṇḍe sacikkaṇabhāṇḍe dhṛtaṃ sāritaṃ khādet | dviniṣkaṃ ṭaṅkam ||180-183 ||

athodayādirasaḥ śvetakuṣṭhādau -
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ mardyaṃ kanyādravair dinam |
tad golaṃ piṭharīmadhye tāmrapātreṇa rodhayet || 184 ||

lg.l: pārśve bhasma nidhāyātha pātrordhvaṃ gomayaṃ jalam ||185 ||
kiṃcit kiṃcit pradātavyaṃ cullyāṃ yāmadvayaṃ pacet |
triśāṇaṃ tad gavāṃ kṣīraiḥ kvāthair vā traiphalaiḥ pibet |
tridinānte bhavet sphoṭaḥ saptāhād vā kilāsake ||190||
nīlīṃ guñjāṃ ca kāsīsaṃ dhattūraṃ haṃsapādikām |
sūryabhaktāṃ ca cāṅgerīṃ piṣṭvā mūlāt pralepayet || 191 ||
śvetakuṣṭhaṃ nihanty āśu sādhyāsādhyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ||192||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athodayādityarasam āha - śuddhaṃ sūtam iti | dvidhā gandhaṃ dviguṇitaṃ gandhakaṃ pāradabhāgād iti śeṣaḥ | kanyā kumārī, dinaṃ dinam ekaṃ yāvat piṭharī mṛdānirmitapātraviśeṣaḥ | sūtakāt triguṇeneti | etena tāmraśarāvakaṃ pāradaparimāṇāt | triguṇitamānena ghaṭitaṃ vidyāt śuddheneti | śuddhatāmranirmitena athavā'mladravyādinā śodhitaśarāvakeṇety arthaḥ | śuddhaṃ tāmraṃ svasvajātyutkṛṣṭam | yataḥ tat tāmraṃ dvividham ekaṃ mlecchasaṃjñam | aparaṃ naipālam iti | tathā hi - ‘mlecchaṃ naipālakaṃ tāmraṃ tayor nepālam uttamam’ hati | kartavyavidhir apy asya yathā tadgolakākāraṃ dravyaṃ dṛḍhatalahaṇḍikānte niveśya tad upari tāmrapidhānakaṃ datvā paścāt sandhiṃ mudrayitvā viśoṣya tadanu mudropari aṅguladvayotsedhaṃ sarvato bhasmāvakīrya paścāt tāmraśarāvopary eva sajalagomayaṃ kiñcit kiñcid iti vāraṃ vāraṃ dāpayet | yāvad yāmadvayaṃ bhavati tāvat kharāgninā paced ity abhiprāyaḥ | atha paścāt kāryam āha - evaṃ niṣpanno 'yaṃ rasaḥ saṃcūrṇya paścāt kāṣṭhodumbarikādīnāṃ kvāthena bhāvayet tena siddho bhavati dinaikam iti pratyekaṃ dravyam ekaikaṃ dinaṃ bhāvayet | kāṣṭhodumbarikā loke ‘kaṭgulari’ śabdavācyā | rājavṛkṣakaḥ kṛtamālakaḥ tasya patrāṇi | asyānupānam āha - khadirasya khadirasārasya kaṣāyeṇa kvathitarūpeṇa samena bākucīphalacūrṇasamānamānena saha paripācitaṃ tad iti bākucīcūrṇaṃ tac ca triśāṇaṃ ṭaṅkatrayaṃ saṃgṛhya gavāṃ kṣīraiḥ triphalaiḥ kvāthair vā pibet | rasam iti kilāsake kuṣṭhaviśeṣe | śvitrabhedo vā kilāsa iti vācyaḥ | eke kilāsa ity asya sthāne na saṃśayam iti paṭhanti tathā vyākhyānayanti ca | paścāt te sphoṭā vakṣyamāṇapralepāt āmūlaṃ yathā syāt tathā pralepitā kāryāḥ | tena sakalasphoṭāḥ saghanaṃ pralepitāḥ kāryā iti bhāvaḥ | kecit ‘piṣṭvā mūlāt pralepayet’ ity asya sthāne ‘tulyaṃ piṣṭvā pralepayet’ iti paṭhanti | lepārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - nīlīm ityādi | nīlīsthāne tila iti | kecit ‘athāparau vakṣyamāṇapralepau kṣepakau’ iti manyamānāḥ paṭhanti || 184-193 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. piṭharīmadhye haṇḍikāmadhye tāmrapātreṇa sūtakāt triguṇena punaḥ adhomukhena pārśve tatpārśve bhasma utpalādijā jāritaṃ sthāpayet | upari pātraṃ datvā mudrathitvā tad upari gomayaṃ jalaṃ kiñcit pradātavyaṃ yāmadvayaṃ cullyāṃ pacet | spaṣṭam anyat | atha citralepaḥ guñjāphalaṃ agniś citrakas taccūrṇaṃ lepitaṃ śvetakuṣṭhanud bhavati | śilā manaḥśilā apāmārgas tadbhasmāpi liptaḥ śvitraṃ vināśayet || 184-193 ||
atha kuṣṭhādau sarveśvaro rasaḥ -- śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ caturgandhaṃ palaṃ yāmaṃ vicūrṇeyet || 194||

lg.l: māṣaikaṃ mṛtavajraṃ ca tālaṃ śuddhaṃ paladvayam |
mardyaṃ hayārijair drāvaiḥ pratyekena dinaṃ dinam |
evaṃ saptadinaṃ mardyaṃ tad golaṃ vastraveṣṭitam ||197 ||
ādāya cūrṇayec chlakṣṇaṃ palaikaṃ yojayed viṣam || 198||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha sarveśvararasam āha - śuddhaṃ sūtam ityādi | śodhitaṃ pāradaṃ palapramāṇaṃ grāhyam | gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ catur iti catuṣpalaṃ vakṣyamāṇapalagrahaṇāt | tena raso 'pi palapramāṇa iti bhāvaḥ | yāmaṃ vicūrṇayed iti tayoḥ śuddharasagandhakayoḥ kajjalīṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | mṛtatāmrābhralohānām iti mṛtatāmraṃ mṛtam abhrakaṃ mṛtaloham iti mṛtagrahaṇena daradaṃ hiṅgulam api śodhitaṃ grāhyam | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ caiveti cakāragrahaṇāt suvarṇaraupyam api mṛtaṃ deyam | mṛtavajraṃ mṛtahīrakaṃ tālasatvaṃ haritālasatvam | atha bhāvanārthaṃ dravyam āha - jambīretyādi | unmatto dhattūrakaḥ snuhyarkayoḥ patrarasaḥ snuhī sehuṇḍā, viṣamuṣṭiḥ kucalabhedaśabdavācyaḥ | eke viṣamuṣṭiśabdena mahānimba iti manyaṃte tan na sarvamatam | hayāriḥ karavīraḥ vālukāyantragaṃ svedyam iti | vālukāyantraṃ prasiddham | asmatsaṃpradāye tu tat poṭṭalīkam uktadravyakalkena pralepitaṃ kṛtvā paścād vālukāyāṃ bhūmigatāyāṃ madhye kṣiptvā tad upari saptāṣṭabhir gomayair ādīpayet | tena siddho bhavati | evaṃ tridinam ity anena trivelam iti vyākhyātam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 194-200 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. unmatto dhattūraḥ, snuhī sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, arkaḥ raviḥ, viṣamuṣṭir mahānimbam | hayāriḥ karavīraḥ | pratyekena auṣadharasena dinaṃ dinaṃ mardyam evaṃ saptadinaṃ mardyaṃ vastraveṣṭitaṃ tad golaṃ vālukāyantragaṃ ca svedyaṃ pācyam ity arthaḥ | devakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru, spaṣṭam anyat || 194-200 ||

atha suptyādau svarṇakṣīrīrasaḥ -
hemāhvāṃ pañcapalikāṃ kṣiptvā takraghaṭe pacet |
takre jīrṇe samuddhṛtya punaḥ kṣīraghaṭe pacet ||201||

lg.l: palaikaṃ mūrcchitaṃ sūtam ekīkṛtya tu bhakṣayet |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha svarṇakṣīrīrasavivaraṇam āha - hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī ‘coka’ iti prasiddhaḥ | takraghaṭādividhānañ cāsya śuddhau kathitam | mūrcchitaṃrasasindūra iti yāvat| sūtam iti rujāharatvāt | tathā hi ‘mṛto hanti jarāmṛtyuṃ mūrcchito vyādhighātakaḥ | vaddhaṃ khecaratāṃ dadyāt ko 'nyaḥ sūtāt kṛpākara:’ iti | kṣālayitvā viśodhayed ity asya sthāne jalaiḥ prakṣālya viśoṣayed iti pāṭhaḥ || 201- 203 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī mūrcchitaṃ sūtaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat || 201-203 ||

atha mehabaddho rasaḥ pramehe -
bhasmasūtaṃ mṛtaṃ kāntaṃ muṇḍabhasma śilājatu |
śuddhaṃ tāpyaṃ śilā vyoma triphalāṃ kolabījakam ||204||

lg.l: niṣkamātro haren mehān mehabaddho raso mahān |
ekīkṛtya pibec cānu hanti mehaṃ ciratanam ||207||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ mehabaddharasam āha - bhasmasūtam iti | bhasmasūtaṃ pāradabhasma, mṛtaṃ kāntam iti mṛtakāntalohacūrṇaṃ kāntalohaṃ lohamāraṇe pūrvaṃ darśitam | muṇḍabhasmeti muṇḍam api lohaviśeṣaḥ | etad api pūrvaṃ kathitam eva eke muṇḍam iti kiṭṭaviśeṣaṃ manyante tan na sarvamatam | kecin muṇḍasthāne uragabhasmeti paṭhanti | tatra uragabhasma nāgabhasmeti kasyacin matam | śuddhaṃ tāpyam iti | tāpyaṃ suvarṇamākṣikaṃ śilā manaḥśilā, vyoma abhrakam eke vyomasthāne vyoṣam iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca tathā | tatra vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, kaṅkolabījaṃ prasiddhaṃ, kapitthaṃ kapitthaphalaṃ, rajanī haridrā, bhṛṅgarājo mārkavaśabdavācyaḥ etat sakalaṃ dravyaṃ samamātraṃ grāhyam iti sampradāyaḥ | eke bhṛṅgarājena bhāvayed ity asya sthāne ‘samaṃ bhāvyaṃ ca bhṛṅginā’miti paṭhanti | niṣkamātra iti | caturmāṣakaḥ anupāne tu mahānimbo ‘bakāina’ saṃjñakaḥ | tasya bījāni phalāni tāni ca ṣaṭsaṃkhyāni grāhyāṇi taṇḍulatoyaṃ palapramāṇam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 204-207 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bhasmasūtaṃ, mṛtaṃ kāntalohaṃ, muṇḍo 'pi lohaviśeṣaḥ | tāpyaṃ, śilā manaḥśilā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, triphalā, kolabījaṃ, kapittham | etat sarvaṃ tulyaṃ bhṛṅgarājena ekaviṃśatir bhāvayet, niṣkaṃ ṭaṅkamātraṃ madhuyuktaṃ lihet | spaṣṭam anyat || 204-207 ||

atha mahāvahnirasam āha -
catuḥsūtasya gandhāṣṭau rajanī triphalā śivā |
pratyekaṃ na dvibhāgaṃ syāt trivṛjjaipālacitrakam ||208||

lg.l: pratyekaṃ ca tribhāgaṃ syātryūṣaṃ dantī ca jīrakam |
pratyekena kramād bhāvyaṃ saptavāraṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 210||
dinānte dāpayet pathyaṃ varjayec chītalaṃ jalam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. catuḥsūtasyeti | sūtasya pāradasya catvāro bhāgāḥ, gandhakasya cāṣṭau bhāgāḥ | rajanīprabhūtipañcadravyāṇi pṛthag dvibhāgayutāni bhavanti | rajanī haridrā, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, śivā harītakī anena harītakīdviruktena bhāgāt saiva dviguṇā kāryā | kecic chivāsthāne śilā iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tatra śilā manaḥśilā, trivṛjjaipālacitrakaṃ pratyekaṃ tribhāgayutaṃ grāhyam | trivṛn niśothaḥ | jaipālaṃ dantibījaṃ, citrakaṃ citrakajaṭātvak, tryūṣaṇaṃ dantī ca jīrakam api pratyekam aṣṭabhāgaṃ jñeyam | tryūṣaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ tac ca śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñam | dantī prasiddhā, jīrakaṃ śvetam | atha bhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - jayantītyādi | jayantī śākabhedaḥ jīvantīty apare, snukpayaḥ sehuṇḍakṣīraṃ, bhṛṅgaṃ mākavaṃ tac ca ghamarāśavdavācyam, na tu bhṛṅgam atra guḍatvak, vahniś citrakaḥ, vātāritailam eraṇḍatailam | śeṣaṃ subodham || || 208-212 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vahniraso jalodarādau - śivā harītakī dviguṇā punaruktatvāt | trivṛt nisotaḥ, dantībījaṃ jaipālaṃ, citrakaṃ prasiddham etat tribhāgaṃ pratyekaṃ | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭu, dantījaṭā, jīrakaṃ pratyekam aṣṭabhāgaṃ, jayantī śākaviśeṣaḥ, snuk sehuṇḍadugdhaṃ, bhṛṅgaṃ mārkavaḥ, vahniś citrakaḥ, vātāritailam eraṇḍatailaṃ, pratyekena rasena saptasaptavāraṃ bhāvyam ||208-212 ||

atha vidyādharo rasaḥ gulmaplīhādau -
gandhakaṃ tālakaṃ tāpyaṃ mṛtatāmraṃ manaḥśilām |
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ ca tulyāṃśaṃ mardayed bhāvayed dinam ||213||

lg.l: niṣkārdhaṃ bhakṣayet kṣaudrair gulmaṃ plīhādikaṃ jayet||214||
raso vidyādharo nāma gomūtraṃ ca pibed anu |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha vidyādhararasam āha - gandham iti | tāpyam atra suvarṇamākṣikaṃ | śuddhasūtam iti | saṃskāritasūtam etat sakalaṃ samamātraṃ mardayet| bhāvayed dinam iti pūrvaṃ dravyaṃ sakalaṃ saṃmardya paścād uktadraveṇa bhāvayet | dinam iti pratyekaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam || 213 || 214 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vajrī sehuṇḍaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||213||214||

ab.seg:
atha trinetro rasaḥ paktiśūlādau -
ṭaṅkaṇaṃ hāriṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ svarṇaṃ śulbaṃ mṛtaṃ rasam ||215||

lg.l: dinaikam ārdrakadrāvair mardyaṃ ruddhvā puṭe pacet |
saindhavaṃ jīrakaṃ hiṅgu madhvājyābhyāṃ lihed anu |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. saubhāgyakṣāraṃ tac cātra bharjitaṃ deyaṃ, svarṇaṃ śulbam api mṛtam atra deyaṃ | rodhanam atra śarāvasampuṭavidhānaṃ puṭam atra gajapuṭam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 215-217 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ, hāriṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ, svarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, śuddhaṃ tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ, ruddhvā śarāvasaṃpuṭe vanopalaiḥ pacet | spaṣṭam anyat || 215-217 ||

atha śūlagajakesarīrasaḥ śūle -
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ yāmaikaṃ mardayed dṛḍham |
dvayos tulyaṃ śuddhatāmraṃ saṃpuṭe tan nirodhayet ||218||

lg.l: ūrdhvādho lavaṇaṃ dattvā mṛdbhāṇḍe dhārayed bhiṣak |
bhakṣayet sarvaśūlārto hiṅgu śuṇṭhī ca jīrakam ||220||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha gajakesarīrasam āha - śuddhaṃ sūtam iti | dṛḍhamardanenātra rasagandhakayoḥ kajjalīṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | sampradāyas tu amlarasaiḥ saha dṛḍhamardanaṃ kāryaṃ na doṣaḥ | dvayos tulyaṃ śuddhatāmram iti | dvayoḥ pāradagandhakayoḥ śuddhatāmraṃ mṛtatāmram | eke dvayos tulye śuddhatāmrasampuṭe iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | sampuṭaṃ cūrṇayed iti vacanād ayam eva pakṣaḥ samīcīnaḥ| tena tāmrasampuṭe eva rasagandhakabhasma rodhayed ity artham iti | anupānaṃ hiṃgvādicūrṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ karṣamānaṃ saṃgṛhya caturguṇenoṣṇodakena saha pibet ||218-221||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 218-221 ||

athāgnituṇḍavaṭīsarasaḥ agnimāndyādau -
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandham ajamodāṃ phalatrayam |
svarjikṣāraṃ yavakṣāraṃ vahnisaindhavajīrakam || 222 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. athāgnituṇḍavaṭīrasam āha - śuddhasūtam ityādi | eke śuddhasūtasamaṃ gandham iti paṭhanti viṣaṃ na paṭhanti tad asaṅgataṃ | bahusthāneṣu dṛṣṭatvāt | viṣamuṣṭiḥ kucelāśabdavācyaḥ sa ca sakaladravyaparimāṇena sāmyo yojyaḥ | eke vahnimāndyapraśāntaye ity asyānte tadanupānaślokam ekaṃ paṭhanti mānayanti ca
‘pathyā śuṇṭhī guḍaṃ cānu palārdhaṃ bhakṣayet sadā |
agnituṇḍā vaṭī khyātā sarvarogakulāntakā’ || 222 || 223 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vahniś citrakaḥ, viṣamuṣṭiḥ mahānimbaphalaṃ kucelaṃ vā dvayor abhāve samudraphalaṃ vā deyam || 222 ||

athājīrṇakaṇṭako rasaḥ -
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhaṃ samaṃ sarvaṃ vicūrṇayet || 224 ||

Āḍhamalla. athājīrṇakaṇṭakarasam āha - śuddhasūtam ityādi | śuddharasaṃ śuddhaviṣaṃ śuddhagandhakaṃ ca etat trikaṃ ca samamātraṃ saṃgṛhya tadanu ebhis tribhiḥ sāmyaṃ ca maricacūrṇaṃ kṛtvā khalve tac catuṣkaṃ saṃcūrṇya paścād uktadraveṇa bhāvayet | yāvad ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakaṃ bhavati tāvad bhāvayed ity arthaḥ | kaṇṭakāryā iti laghukaṇṭakāriphalāni | kecid anupānārthaṃ ślokam ekaṃ paṭhanti | ‘anu syād īśvarīmūlaṃ toyapiṣṭaṃ ca pāyayet | śaṅkhaṃ cāśvatthamūlaṃ vā vāriṇā'jīrṇajid bhavet’ etan na pracarati || 224-226 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 224-226 ||

kaphādau manthānabhairavarasaḥ |
mṛtaṃ sūtaṃ mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ hiṅgu puṣkaramūlakam |
saindhavaṃ gandhakaṃ tālaṃ kaṭukīṃ cūrṇayet samam ||227||
Āḍhamalla. atha manthānabhairavarasam āha - mṛtaṃ sūtam ityādi | atra puṣkaramūlābhāve kuṣṭhaṃ grāhyam | gandhakaṃ tālam api śodhitaṃ grāhyam | tālaṃ haritālaṃ taṇḍulīyo meghanādaḥ || 227-229 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tālaṃ haritālaṃ kaṭukī etat samaṃ mṛtsūtādyam aṣṭauṣadhaṃ cūrṇitam ebhiḥ punarnavādibhir bhāvayet | punarnavā varṣābhūḥ devadālī nirguṇḍī taṇḍulīyakaṃ meghanādaḥ tiktakośātakī jālinī eṣāṃ drāvair dinaikaṃ mardayet | punar dugdhena mardayet | māṣamātraṃ kṣaudrair lihet upari nimbapatrakvāthaṃ pibet | eraṇḍanālena vānti kārayet | kaphakṣayakāsādayo yānti || 227-229 ||

atha vātanāśano rasaḥ -
sūtahāṭakavajrāṇi tāmraṃ lohaṃ ca mākṣikam|
tālaṃ nīlāñjanaṃ tuttham ahiphenaṃ samāṃśakam ||230||

lg.l: pañcānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca bhāgam ekaṃ vimardayet |
vajrīkṣīrair dinaikaṃ tu ruddhvādho bhūdhare pacet || 231 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha vātanāśanarasam āha - sūtahāṭakavajrāṇīti | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, hāṭakaṃ suvarṇaṃ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ | eke mākṣikasthāne gandhakam iti paṭhanti etan manoharam | tālaṃ haritālaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tadabhāve sīsakaṃ grāhyam | tatsambhavatvāt abdhiphenaṃ samudraphenam | etat sakalaṃ samamātram | pañcānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ pañcabhāgā ity arthaḥ | ‘sindhusauvarcalopetaṃ biḍaṃ sāmudrajaṃ gaḍam’ iti pañcalavaṇam | ruddhvādho bhūdhare paced iti | tat sakalaṃ dinaikam ekadinaṃ saṃmardya paścād bhūdharayantre paced ity abhiprāyaḥ | bhūdharayantraṃ tu pūrvaṃ darśitam eva | anupāne sakṛṣṇam iti pippalīcūrṇaṃ, prakṣepaṇaṃ kuryāt | ayam eva raso granthāntare bhūtonmādārthaṃ paṭhitaḥ | atra kvacid viparītatā dṛśyate tathā hi -
sūtāyastāmram abhraṃ ca mṛtaṃ svarṇaṃ samaṃ samam |
sūtapādaṃ mṛtaṃ vajraṃ tālaṃ gandhaṃ manaḥśilām ||
tutthaṃ nīlāñjanaṃ śuddham abdhiphenaṃ samaṃ rasāt |
pañcānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca pratibhāgaṃ rasonmitam ||
citrakair bhṛṅgarājaiś ca vajrīdugdhaiś ca mardayet |
dinānte golakaṃ kṛtvā ruddhvā gajapuṭe pacet||
mahābhūtāṅkuśo nāma raso guñjādvayaṃ lihet |
ārdrakasya rasair eva bhūtonmādapraśāntaye || pippalyā'ktaṃ pibec cānu daśamūlaṃ kaṣāyakam’ (iti) || 230-232 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sūtaṃ mṛtaṃ pāradaṃ, hāṭakaṃ svarṇaṃ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ, mṛtam abhrakaṃ vā, lohaṃ, mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, tālaṃ haritālaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ, tutthaṃ śuddhaṃ māritaṃ, tadabhāve tāmraṃ vā deyaṃ vamanabhayāt | ahiphenam akūkam etat samaṃ vajrakṣāraiḥ vimardayet ||230-232 ||

atha kanakasundaraḥ sannipātādau -
kanakasyāṣṭaśāṇāḥ syuḥ sūto dvādaśabhir mataḥ ||233 ||

lg.l: abhrakaṃ syāc catuḥśāṇaṃ mākṣikaṃ ca dviśāṇikam ||234||
vaṅgo dviśāṇaḥ sauvīraṃ triśāṇaṃ loham aṣṭakam |
mardayed dinam ekaṃ tu rasair amlaphalodbhavaiḥ |
dadyān mṛdupuṭaṃ vahnau tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ vicūrṇayet ||236||
jvaraṃ garam ajīrṇaṃ ca jayed rogaharo rasaḥ ||238 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha kanakasundararasam āha - kanakasyetyādi | kanakādīny atra mṛtāni grāhyāṇi śāṇopalakṣitatvād atra bhāga eva boddhavyaḥ yathāsambhavatvāt | kanakam atra suvarṇaṃ, sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, gandho gandhakaḥ, sauvīraṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ,lohaṃ sārasaṃjñam, lāṅgalī kalihārikā, amlaphalāni bījapūrajambīraprabhṛtīni | mṛdupuṭam atra gajapuṭaviśeṣam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 233-238 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kanakasya dhattūrabījasya aṣṭa śāṇāḥ aṣṭa ṭaṅkāḥ, sūtaḥ śuddhaḥ dvādaśa ṭaṅkaḥ, tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ dviśāṇam, abhrakaṃ catuḥśāṇaṃ, mākṣikaṃ mṛtaṃ dviśāṇaṃ, vaṅgo mṛtaḥ dviśāṇaḥ, sauvīraḥ añjanaṃ triśāṇaṃ, lohaṃ mṛtam aṣṭaśāṇam | viṣaṃ triśāṇaṃ, lāṅgalī kalihārī palapramāṇā, amlavetasādyai: mṛdupuṭaṃ dadyāt | punaḥ māṣamātro deyaḥ | ādrakarasena rasonarasena vā kilāsaṃ citrakuṣṭhāni visarpabhagaṃdaraṃ jvaraṃ viṣam ajīrṇaṃ jayet etad rogaharo rasaḥ kanakasundaraḥ || 233-238 ||

atha sannipātabhairavo rasaḥ --
raso gandhas trikarṣaḥ syāt kuryāt kajjalikāṃ tayoḥ |
tāmratārāravaṅgāhisārāś caikaikakārṣikāḥ ||239||

lg.l: kṛtvā golaṃ vṛtaṃ vastre lavaṇāpūrite nyaset |
tata uddhṛtya taṃ golaṃ cūrṇayitvā vimiśrayet ||242||
tagaraṃ muśalī māṃsī hemāhvā cetasaḥ kaṇā |
nīlinī patrakaṃ cailā citrakaś ca kuṭherakaḥ || 244 ||
pratyekam ekavelaṃ ca tataḥ saṃśoṣya dhārayet |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha sannipātabhairavarasam āha - raso gandhas trikarṣaḥ syād ityādi | rasaḥ pāradaḥ, gandho gandhakaḥ etad dvayaṃ militaṃ trikarṣaṃ syād ity arthaḥ | tāmratārāravaṅgāhisārāś caikaikakārṣikā iti | tāmraṃ prasiddham | tāraṃ raupyam, āraṃ pītalohaṃ, vaṅgaṃ raṅgavācyam, ahiḥ sīsakaṃ | sāro lohaḥ etat tāmrādikaṃ sarvaṃ mṛtaṃ grāhyam iti sampradāyaḥ | ekaikakārṣikā iti | pratyekaṃ karṣasaṃmitā ity abhiprāyaḥ | aparam api śigru śobhāñjanaṃ jvālāmukhī jayantī bilvebhya iti | bilvamūlād rasair iti śeṣaḥ | taṇḍulīyaḥ meghanādaśabdavācyaḥ | svarasam atra sadyaskaṃ kvathitarasaṃ vā | atha prakṣepārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - tatra siddharase pravāṇacūrṇakarṣeṇeti | pravāṇacūrṇaṃ viṣacūrṇaṃ ca miśrayet | pravāṇacūrṇaṃ karṣapramāṇaṃ, viṣacūrṇaṃ śāṇamātram iti | pravāṇam iti prakarṣeṇa vāṇaṃ sudhācūrṇam ity arthaḥ | eke pravālacūrṇaṃ paṭhanti tatra pravālacūrṇaṃ vidrumacūrṇaṃ| śuktikācūrṇam ity apare tadabhāve śaṅkhacūrṇam ity asmadīyaḥ sampradāyaḥ | bhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - kṛṣṇasarpasya garalaiḥ kṛtvā tat pūrvoktaṃ dravyaṃ dvivelaṃ yāvad bhāvayet | garalaṃ tadviṣaṃ viśeṣam | tagarādibhiś ca tad vāram ekaṃ bhāvayet | pratyekam iti pṛthak pṛthak | tagaraṃ prasiddham | māṃsī jaṭākhyā, hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī, vetaso jalavetasaḥ, kaṇā pippalī, nīlinīpatrakam iti nīlikāpatram eke nīlinī patrakaṃ ca dravyadvayaṃ vyākhyānayanti tac ca na sarvamataṃ, kuṭherakaḥ‘rāsnā’ pā. | prasiddhaḥ, devadālī vallīviśeṣaḥ, muṇḍikā kedāramuṇḍī, madhūkaṃ madhūkavṛkṣaḥ, jātī mālatīraso 'tra sadyaskaḥ kvathito vā yathālābhāt | ayaṃ siddharaso dviguñjāpramitaḥ ṣoḍaśamaricānvito bījapūrārdrakarasena saha bhakṣayet ||239|| 247 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pāradaḥ, gandhakaḥ trikarṣau etau, mṛtaṃ tāraṃ mṛtaṃ rūpyam | abhram abhrakaṃ, vaṅgam, ahiḥ nāgaṃ, sāraṃ loham ete ekaikakarṣakāḥ | śigru śobhāñjanam, jvālāmukhī jayantī, taṇḍulīyakaḥ, ebhir golakaṃ kṛtvā punar vastrair vṛtaṃ kācapātrasthaṃ lavaṇapūrite bhāṇḍe nyaset | vahniṃ dadyāt | yāmadvayam | tataḥ punaḥ pravālacūrṇakarṣeṇa śāṇamātraviṣeṇa melayitvā kṛṣṇasarpasya garalair bhāvayet divasam ekaṃ dinaṃ paścāt sthālikāyāṃ haṇḍikāyāṃ ca kupīṃ niveśayet | hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī, nīlinī aparājitā, kuṭherakaḥ śvetatulasī, devadālī | madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, jātī mālatī, madanaphalaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat || 239-247 ||

atīsārādau grahaṇīkapāṭaḥ -
tāramauktikahemāni sāraś caikaikabhāgikāḥ |
dvibhāgo gandhakaḥ sūtas tribhāgo mardayed imān||248||

lg.l: pratyekam eṣāṃ svarasair bhāvanā syāt tridhā tridhā |
māṣamātro raso deyo madhunā maricais tathā || 251 ||
hanyāt sarvān atīsārān grahaṇīṃ sarvajām api |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha grahaṇīkapāṭarasam āha - tāramauktikahemānītyādi sugamam | madhyapuṭaṃ tu laghupuṭasaṃjñaṃ tac ca ṣoḍaśāṅgulagarte pratipāditam | tathā hi - ‘nipuṇavihitagartaḥ ṣoḍaśair aṅgulair vā mitasakalavibhāgas tasya madhye nidhāya | jvalanam ativiśuṣkair gomayaiḥ sūtasiddhyai laghugajapuṭam evaṃ pūrvam uktaṃ munīndraiḥ’ iti | maricamānam apy atra māṣamātram | athavā doṣāpekṣayā deyam || 248-252 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ mauktikaṃ, muktāphalaṃ, hema svarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, sāro mṛtalohaḥ, ete pratyekabhāgikāḥ | dvibhāgo gandhaḥ, sūtaḥ pāradaḥ śuddhatribhāgaḥ | etān kajjalīkṛtya kapitthaphalasvarasair mardya mṛgaśṛṅge sthāpayet | mṛtkarpaṭaṃ datvā madhyapuṭe puṭet | balā prasiddhā tadrasaiḥ saptavelaṃ saptavāraṃ bhāvayet | apāmārga ūrdhvakaṇṭakaḥ tadrasais tridhā bhāvayet | lodhraṃ prasiddhaṃ, prativiṣā ativiṣā, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, dhātakīpuṣpāṇi, indrayavaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī eṣāṃ svarasaiḥ pratyekaṃ tridhā bhāvanā syāt | tadādisiddho māṣamātro deyaḥ | madhunā tathā maricair api māṣamātraiḥ sarvān atīsārān tathā sarvajāṃ grahaṇīṃ hanyāt || 248-252 ||

atha grahaṇīvajrakapāṭaḥ -
mṛtasūtābhrakaṃ gandhaṃ yavakṣāraṃ saṭaṅkaṇam |
agnimanthaṃ vacāṃ kuryāt sūtatulyān imān sudhīḥ ||253||

lg.l: trivāsaraṃ tato golaṃ kṛtvā saṃśoṣya dhārayet ||254||
adho vahniṃ śanaiḥ kuryād yāmārdhaṃ tata uddharet||255||
vahniṃ śuṇṭhīṃ biḍaṃ bilvaṃ lavaṇaṃ cūrṇayet samam ||258||
pibed uṣṇāmbunā cānu sarvajāṃ grahaṇīṃ jayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha grahaṇīvajrakapāṭarasam āha - mṛtasūtābhrakam iti | mṛtasūtaṃ pāradaṃ bhavati tāvat parimāṇaṃ pṛthak ṣaḍdravyāṇi grāhyāṇi | eke ṣaḍdravyaṃ tu pāradasāmyaṃ deyam iti manyaṃte tan na sarvamatam| kiṃtu mṛtapāradasyaiko bhāgaḥ | abhrakādīnāṃ ṣaḍbhāgā iti sarvamatam | tatas tasmāt | jayantī śākabhedaḥ | jambīraṃ jambīraphalarasaḥ | bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ | trivāsaram ity anenaikadravyasyaikāham eva bhāvanā deyety abhiprāyaḥ | lohapātra ityādinā piṭharīyaṃ vālukābhiḥ prapūryety asmadīyasampradāyāt kāryo na doṣaḥ | yāmārdham ity anena ghaṭikācatuṣṭayaṃ yāvat etat siddhaṃ bhavati tadā prativiṣāṃ mocarasaṃ ca pṛthak siddhaṃ rasatulyaṃ melayitvā paścād uktadravyasya rasaiḥ kṛtvā bhāvayet | prativiṣā ativiṣāśabdavācyā | mocarasaṃ śālmalīniryāsam | eke prativiṣāmocarasayor api bhāvanām āhuḥ | vijayā'tra bhaṅgā, saptadhā bhāvanā ekadravyeṇa kāryā, anyeṣāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ pṛthag ekavāraṃ tatra dhātakī dhātakīkusumāni, indrayavaṃ kuṭajabījaṃ, rāsnā surabhī, madhv atra lehane yāvat tāvan mānaṃ deyam | anupānārthadravyeṣu vahniś citrakajaṭā, biḍaṃ biḍalavaṇaṃ, lavaṇaṃ saindhavam || 253-258 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mṛtasūtaṃ mṛtapāradam, abhrakaṃ, gandhakaṃ, yavakṣāraṃ, saubhāgyam, agnimantho, vacā etāni sūtatulyāni kuryāt | yāvat sūtaṃ pratyekabhāgaṃ mataḥ | tato jayantyādibhir vimardayet | trivāsaraṃ tridinaṃ tato golaṃ kṛtvā saṃśoṣya lohapātre kaṭāhikādau dhṛtvā upari śarāvaṃ datvā mudrayet | śanair yāmārdhaṃ vahṇiṃ kuryāt | golakatulyāṃ prativiṣāṃ tathā mocarasaṃ datvā kapitthādibhiḥ sapta sapta bhāvayet | vijayā bhaṅgā, kapitthaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tair dhātakyādibhir vāraikaṃ bhāvayet | dhātakīpuṣpāṇi, indrayavaḥ mustaṃ, lodhraṃ, bilvaṃ, guḍūcī etaiḥ śāṇaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ madhunā lihet | vahniś citrakaṃ, śuṇṭhī, biḍaṃ biḍalavaṇaṃ, saindhavam etad anupānaṃ pibet || 253-258 ||

atha madanakāmadevo vājīkaraṇe -
tāraṃ vajraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tāmraṃ sūtakagandhakam || 259 ||

lg.l: piṭharīṃ mudrayet samyak tataś cullyāṃ niveśayet||261 ||
vahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kuryād dinaikaṃ tata uddharet |
aśvagandhā ca kākolī vānarī muśalīkṣurā‘kṣuka:’ pā. | |
tritrivelaṃ rasair āsāṃ śatāvaryāś ca bhāvayet || 263 ||
sarvai: samāṃ śarkarāṃ ca dattvā śāṇonmitāṃ pibet ||265 ||
taruṇī ramayed vahvīḥ śukrahānir na jāyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha madanakāmadevarasam āha - tāram ityādi | tāraṃ raupyaṃ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ, tadabhāve vaikrāntaṃ grāhyam iti vyavahārāt | sūtakaḥ pāradaḥ lohaṃ sārasaṃjñam | atra kramavṛddhis tu pūrvadravyād uttaravṛddhir boddhavyā, asmatsampradāye tu rajatādīni dravyāṇi atra mṛtāni deyānīti vyavahāro 'pi dṛśyate | kanyakā kaumārī | vimudrām iti kācakupīm iti śeṣaḥ | saindhavacūrṇaṃ ca kācakupīm ubhayato deyam | siddharasasya bhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - arkadugdham arkabhavaṃ kṣīraṃ, kālolī prasiddhā, vānarī kapikacchūḥ, muśalī kandaviśeṣaḥ, ikṣukaḥ kokilākṣaḥ tālamūlī, padmakandaḥ kamalakandaḥ kaseruko 'pi vikhyātaḥ kāśatṛṇasaṃjñaḥ prasiddhaḥ | paścāc cūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - kastūrītyādi | kastūrī mṛganābhijā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, pūrvacūrṇād bhāvanābhiḥ pratipāditadravyād aṣṭamāṃśaṃ dadyāt | tena pūrvacūrṇaṃ saptabhāgaṃ kastūrīpramukhaṃ caikabhāgam iti ||259-266 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ vajraṃ hīrakam abhrakaṃ vā, suvarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, gandhakaṃ, sūtakaṃ śuddhaṃ, tīkṣṇam etāni kramavṛddhāni tāraṃ bhāgaikaṃ, vajraṃ dvibhāgaṃ, suvarṇaṃ tribhāgaṃ, tāmraṃ caturbhāgaṃ, sūtaṃ saptabhāgaṃ, loham aṣṭabhāgam evam arkadugdhair mardya kācakupyāṃ vālukāyantre pācayet | tato 'śvagandhādibhir mardya bhakṣayet | arkadugdhaṃ yady api bhāvanādravye likhitaṃ tathāpi kumāryā sahaiva deyam arkadugdhasya bhakṣaṇānucitatvāt | vānarī kapikacchūḥ, muśalī, ikṣurā tālamūlī, spaṣṭam anyat || 259-266 ||

vājīkaraṇe kandarpasundararasam āha -
sūto vajram ahir muktā tāraṃ hemāsitābhrakam ||267||

lg.l: parūṣakaṃ kaseruś ca madhūkaṃ vānarī tathā |
mustaṃ mṛgamadaḥ kṛṣṇā jalaṃ candraś ca miśrayet ||272||
khādec chāṇamitaṃ rātrau sitā dhātrī vidārikā ||273||
ramaṇī ramayed bahvīr na hāniṃ kvāpi gacchati |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. sūta ityādi | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, vajraṃ hīrakam, ahiḥ sīsakaṃ, muktā prasiddhā, tāraṃ raupyaṃ, hema suvarṇam, asitābhrakaṃ kṛṣṇābhrakam etat sarvam api māritaṃ grāhyam ity atra vyavahāraḥ | eteṣāṃ mānam api karṣapramāṇaṃ pratyekam | irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ, sa ca loke ‘reoja’ śabdavācya tasya tvak grāhyā | aparadravyadvayam api melanārthaṃ dvidvikarṣaṃ pratyekaṃ deyam | tac ca pravālacūrṇaṃ vidrumacūrṇaṃ, gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ, mṛgaśṛṅgake mṛgaśṛṅgasampuṭe tad auṣadhaṃ dhāryam ity abhiprāyaḥ | mṛdusampuṭaṃ ca laghugajapuṭam ity arthaḥ | paścād bhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - dhātakī dhātakīkusumāni, kākolī svanāmakhyātā, madhukaṃ madhukayaṣṭī, māṃsī jaṭākhyaṃ sugandhadravyam | balātrayaṃ prasiddham tac ca balā atibalā nāgabaleti, bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ, bhasīṇḍaśavdavācyaṃ loke, iṅgudaṃ vṛkṣeṅgudaṃ, drākṣā prasiddhā, pippalavandākam iti pippalavṛkṣasya vandā, vandā ca viṭapalagno gulmaviśeṣaḥ, eke pippalavandākaṃ dravyadvayaṃ varṇayanti tatra pippalaḥ pippalatvak vandāvṛkṣaḥ vandā prasiddhā apare pippalīvandākam iti vyākhyānayanti, vāṇaḥ sahacaraḥ eke vāṇasthāne varīti paṭhanti, parṇīcatuṣṭayam iti | māṣaparṇī mudgaparṇī, śālaparṇī, pṛṣṭhiparṇī, ceti, parūṣakaṃ phālasāśabdavācyaṃ kaserukaṃ prasiddham | madhūkaṃ bhadhūkavṛkṣapuṣpāṇi, vānarī kapikacchūḥ, eteṣāṃ svarasena pratyekaṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ | atha cūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇy āha - elātvakpatrakam ityādi | vāṃśī tvakkṣīrī vaṃśarocanā iti prasiddhā, agaru prasiddham, keśaraṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, mustaṃ prasiddham, mṛgamadaḥ kastūrī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, jalaṃ vālakaṃ, candraḥ karpūraḥ etat sakalaṃ śāṇamitaṃ ṭaṅkapramāṇaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ rātrau niśāmukhe | anupānam āha - dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet, kathambhūtam ? sitādīnāṃ dravyatrayāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ melayitvā karṣamātraṃ saṃgṛhya karṣamānena ca ghṛtena saha saṃmardya tanmiśritam | sitā matsyaṇḍī, dhātrī āmalakī, vidārī vidārīkandaḥ, sukhitamānasaḥ svasthaḥ, na tu āturaḥ, tasya vihitatvāt na hāniṃ kvāpi gacchatīti sa puruṣaḥ | vīryahāniṃ na prāpnoti ity arthaḥ || 267-274 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha kandarpasundaro rasaḥ | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ vā abhrakam, ahiḥ sīsakaḥ, muktā prasiddhā, tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ hema svarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, sitābhrakaṃ, śvetābhrakaṃ māritam, etān karṣāṃśikān pratyekān irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ tena mardayet | pravālo vidrumaḥ dvikarṣo gandhako dvikarṣaḥ | aśvagandhāsvarasair mardyaḥ, mṛgaśṛṅgake kṛtvā mṛdupuṭe pacet | tato dhātakīrasair bhāvayet| parūṣakaphalaviśeṣaḥ kaseruḥ prasiddhaḥ, madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaḥ, vānarī kapikacchūḥ eṣāṃ rasair bhāvayitvā śoṣayitvā vicūrṇayet | elādikaiḥ pratyekaṃ śāṇamitair miśrayet | punaḥ kandarpasundaraṃ śāṇamitaṃ rātrau, sitā dhātrī vidārikā eteṣāṃ karṣacūrṇena yutaṃ sarpiḥ karṣeṇa saṃyutaṃ khādet | tasyānu dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet | susthiramānasaḥ ramaṇī ramayet | elā kṣudrailā, patraṃ patrajaṃ, vāṃśī rocanā, lavaṅgam, agaru, kesaraṃ mustaṃ, mṛgamadaṃ kastūrī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, jalaṃ vālakaṃ, candraḥ karpūraḥ, sitā prasiddhā, dhātrī āmalakī, vidārīkandaṃ, sarpir ghṛtaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat || 267-274 ||

atha loharasāyanam -
śuddhaṃ rasendraṃ bhāgaikaṃ dvibhāgaṃ śuddhagandhakam ||275||

lg.l: kṣipet kajjalikāṃ kuryāt tatra tīkṣṇabhavaṃ rajaḥ |
tataḥ saṃjāyate tasya soṣṇo dhūmodgamo mahān ||277||
uddhṛtya tasmāt khalve ca kṣiptvā gharme nidhāya ca |
saṃśoṣya gharme kvāthaiś ca bhāvayet trikaṭos tridhā |
vātāsraṃ mūtradoṣāṃś ca grahaṇīṃ gudajāṃ rujam |
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ tilatailaṃ ca māṣānnaṃ rājikāṃ tathā |
madyam amlarasaṃ caiva tyajel lohasya sevakaḥ ||289||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha loharasāyanam āha - śuddhaṃ rasendrabhāgaikam ityādi | śuddhaṃ saṃskāritaṃ, rasendraḥ pāradaḥ tasyaiko bhāgaḥ, śuddhagandhakasya dvau bhāgau, gandhakaśuddhiś ca pūrvaṃ kathitaiva | tatra kajjalikāyāṃ tīkṣṇabhavaṃ raja iti | lohacūrṇaṃ śuddhaṃ mṛtasāracūrṇam ity eke | tac ca pūrvakajjalikāsāmyaṃ grāhyam | praharaikaṃ mardanaṃ kevalaṃ kajjalikā lohacūrṇayor eva kathitaṃ na tu svarasādinā, vakṣyamāṇasvarasair eva tridinaṃ yāvad ity abhiprāyaḥ | gharma iti kharatarasūryāṃśutāpite ata eva tasya soṣṇo mahān dhūmodgamo bhavati iti | tenaivaṃ lohamṛtiḥ syād ity eke | svamate tu dhānyakuśūloṣitaṃ trirātraṃ yāvad bhavati paścād yad uddharet tatkālam eva gharme dhāraṇena mṛtiḥ syāt | atyantapiṇḍitam ity anena eraṇḍapatraveṣṭanādikam abhipretam | paścāt kāryam āha - rasair ityādi | kuṭhāracchinnā loke tipānīśabdavācyā | kurejā ity apare | trivelam ity anenāparadravyāṇām api saṃbandhaḥ | tenaikaikarasena trivelaṃ bhāvayed ity arthaḥ | gharme ca pratyekaṃ śoṣaṇam api vihitam | trikaṭoḥ tryūṣaṇasya ‘śuṇṭhīmaricapippalyas trikaṭus ttryūṣaṇaṃ smṛtam’ iti | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī | lohapātre tat kṣiptveti pūrvaṃ mṛtpātre dhāryam iti prāptam | pāṣāṇakhalve vā triphalājalaiḥ triphalākvāthaiḥ triphalāharītakyādi dāḍimatvak valkalaṃ, vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, palāśakadalīdrāvair iti palāśaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasya drāvaḥ svaniryāsaḥ, kadalīdrāvaḥ kadalīkandaniryāsaḥ, vījako vijayasāro vṛkṣaviśeṣas tasya śṛtena kvāthena, nīlikā nīlī, alambuṣā muṇḍī, babbūlaphalikā babbūlavṛkṣasya phalānīty arthaḥ, nāgabalā gāṅgerukī, śatāvarī, gokṣurakau prasiddhau, pātālagaruḍī chirahaṇṭiśabdavācyā | anupāne varākvāthaṃ triphalākvātham, chinnāsatvaṃ guḍūcīsatvaṃ | śeṣaṃ subodham ||275-289||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuddhaṃ rasendraṃ bhāgaikaṃ, dvibhāgaṃ gandhakaṃ śuddhaṃ tayoḥ kajjalikāṃ kṛtvā tatra tīkṣṇabhavaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvatulyaṃ kanyādrāvair mardayet, tato golakaṃ kṛtvā eraṇḍapatrair veṣṭayitvā tāmrasampuṭe dhānyarāśau sthāpayet tataḥ kuṭhāra- chinnādyair bhāvayet | kuṭhārachinnā, bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ, bhṛṅgo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ pītavāsā, nīlikā aparājitā, alambuṣā muṇḍī, varī śatāvarī || 275-289 ||

jaipālaśodhanam -
(jaipālaṃprakṣiptam | rahitaṃ tvagaṅkurarasajñābhir male māhiṣe nikṣiptaṃ tryaham uṣṇatoyavimalaṃ khalve savāso 'rditam
liptaṃ nūtanakharpareṣu vigatasnehaṃ rajaḥsaṃnibhaṃ nimbūkāmbuvibhāvitaṃ ca bahuśaḥ śuddhaṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ bhavet ||290||

div.ab:
viṣaśodhanam |
viṣaṃ tu khaṇḍaśa: kṛtvā vastrakhaṇḍena bandhayet |
gomūtramadhye nikṣipya sthāpayed ātape tryaham ||291||
gomūtraṃ ca pradātavyaṃ nūtanaṃ pratyahaṃ budhaiḥ |
tryahe 'tīte samuddhṛtya śoṣayen mṛdu peṣayet ||292||
śuddhyaty evaṃ viṣaṃ tac ca yogyaṃ bhavati cārtijit |
khaṇḍīkṛtya viṣaṃ vastraparibaddhaṃ tu dolayā || 293 ||
ajāpayasi saṃsvinnaṃ yāmataḥ śuddhim āpnuyāt |
ajādugdhābhāvatas tu gavyakṣīreṇa śodhayet ||294|| ) iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe rasakalpanā nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ | samāpto 'yaṃ madhyamakhaṇḍaḥ ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla.
vividhamuninibandhā ye mahatsu prasiddhāḥ sumatiduravabodhās te mayā naiva dṛṣṭāḥ |
tad api gurusakāśād yac chrutaṃ tad vyalekhi hy aḍhamalabhiṣajā'syāṃ bhāvasiṃhātmajena || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe saṃsiddharasādhyāyo dvādaśaḥ || 12 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne rasakarma nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

div.head: atha snehādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha uttarakhaṇḍaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte | tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ madhyamakhaṇḍānte rasāyanavājīkaraṇārthaṃ rasā uktāḥ, te cāviśuddhaśarīre na svakāryakaraṇakṣamāḥ; uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ | vājīkaro vā maline vastre raṅga ivāphalaḥ’ ( vā. u. 39-4) iti | ’tasmāc charīraśuddhyarthaṃ pañcakarmāṇi yojayet | tāni ca snehasvedābhyāṃ vinā na saṃbhavanti, uktaṃ ca - ’snehasvedāv anabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ | dāruśuṣkam ivāyāme śarīraṃ tasya dīryate (vā. sū. 18-59) iti tasmāt snehā'dhyāyam eva prathamaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ --
atha snehapānavidhiḥ |

Āḍhamalla. snehasya ghṛtādeḥ pānasya vidhir vidhānaṃ, sa ca vidhiś carake yathā sapraśna uktas tam āha -
?sāṃkhyaiḥ saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaiḥ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasum |
jagaddhitārthaṃ papraccha vahniveśaḥ svasaṃśayam ||
kiṃyonayaḥ kati snehāḥ ke ca snehaguṇāḥ pṛthak |
kālānupāne kaḥ kasya katidhā ca vicāraṇāḥ ||
kati mātrāḥ kathaṃ mānāḥ kā ca keṣūpadiśyate |
kaś ca kebhyo hitaḥ snehaḥ prakarṣaḥ snehane ca kaḥ ||
snehyāḥ ke ke ca na snehyāḥ, snigdhā'tisnigdhalakṣaṇam |
kiṃ pānāt prathamaṃ pīte jīrṇe kiṃ ca hitāhitam ||
ke mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhāḥ kā vyāpadaḥ siddhayaś ca kāḥ |
śodhane śamane caiva snehe kā vṛttir iṣyate || nareṣu keṣu vidhinā kena yojyā vicāraṇāḥ | snehasyāpy amitajñāna ! jñānam icchāmi veditum? (ca. sū. 13,1-6) iti | ’tatra saṃkhyānam adhīyante vindate vā te sāṃkhyāḥ, taiḥ; kiṃviśiṣṭaiḥ ? saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaiḥ, saṃkhyātā saṃkhyā yais te saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyāḥ | jñātajñeyā ity arthaḥ | taiḥ saha āsīnam, uta cāsaṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaṃ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasum iti pāṭhaḥ. | etad uktaṃ bhavati - sākhyaiḥ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasuṃ saṃkhyāvikārakāyāṃ kathāyāṃ vartamānaṃ tatkālānurūpam agniveśo 'pi svasaṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭavān | dvikarmako 'yam | tatra ’ kati snehāḥ ? etasyottaram āha -
snehaś caturvidhaḥ prokto ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā vasā | majjā ca -

Āḍhamalla. sa snehaḥ catuḥprakāraḥ, ghṛtādibhedāt | tatra ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt; tailaṃ tilasnehaḥ; vasā-’śuddhamāṃsasya yaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā iti | majjā iti majjā mastakamajjā asthimajjā vā | tathā ca - ’sthūlā'sthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tv abhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate’ iti | tad uktaṃ carake -
’tilāḥ priyālābhiṣukau bibhītakaś citrābhayairaṇḍamadhūkasarṣapāḥ |
kusumbhabilvārukamūlakātasī nikocakākṣoṭakarañjaśigrujāḥ || snehāśayāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamās tathā syur jaṅgamā matsyamṛgāḥ sapakṣiṇaḥ | teṣāṃ dadhi kṣīraghṛtāmiṣaṃ vasā sneheṣu majjā ca tathopadiśyate’ iti | abhayā harītakī, citrā dantī iti || ( ca. sū. 13,8)

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athottarakhaṇḍaḥ procyate | atha pañcakarmādau snehapānaṃ ghṛtaṃ, tailaṃ, vasā, majjā, iti caturvidhaḥ snehaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | caturvidhasneheṣu ghṛtasya mukhyatvād ādāv abhidhānaṃ, tatas tailaṃ tilasaṃbhūtaṃ, tato vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, (tato) majjā, asthimadhyasnehaḥ | nanu pañcakarmādau vamanaṃ tad yathā – ‘vamanaṃ recanaṃ nasyaṃ nirūham anuvāsanam | jñeyaṃ pañcavidhaṃ karma vidhānaṃ tasya kathyate’ iti | tat kathaṃ snehapānam ādau ucyate ? ( satyam, snehapānaṃ vinā vamanādisaṃśodhanānāṃ hānikaratvāt ) pañcakarmādau snehapānaṃ, tataḥ svedaḥ, tato vamanaṃ, tato recanam; ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||

ab.seg: kaḥ kāla ’ etasya uttaram āha -- taṃ piben martyaḥ kiṃcid abhyudite ravau || 1 ||
Āḍhamalla. ’ śītakāle divā sneham uṣṇakāle piben niśi ’ iti || 1 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. taṃ caturvidhaṃ snehaṃ kiṃcid abhyudite ravau pibet || 1 ||

div.ab:
‘kiṃyonayaḥ’ etasyottaram āha -
sthāvaro jaṃgamaś caiva dviyoniḥ sneha ucyate |

Āḍhamalla. tatra sthāvarāś caturvidhāḥ, vanaspatayaḥ, vṛkṣāḥ, vīrudhaḥ, oṣadhaya iti | jaṃgamāḥ khalv api caturvidhāḥ – jarāyujā-ṇḍaja-svedajo-dbhijjāḥ eteṣāṃ svarūpam anyato jñātavyam | tathā ca carake – ’snehānāṃ dvividhā saumya yoniḥ sthāvarajaṅgamā’ (ca. sū. 13,7) iti |
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sthāvarajaṅgamabhedena snehasya dvividhatvam āha | sugamam ||

ab.seg:
varāvaratvam āha -
tilatailaṃ sthāvareṣu jaṅgameṣu ghṛtaṃ varam || 2 ||

Āḍhamalla. tailaghṛtayor varatvaṃ ca saṃskārasyānuvartanād iti | uktaṃ ca - ’tailaṃ saṃyogasaṃskārāt sarvarogāpahaṃ matam’ iti | atraivodāharaṇaṃ candanādyaṃ tailam | tat ghṛtam api śāstre vyavahārārtham || 2 ||

div.ab:
militasnehanāmāny āha -
dvābhyāṃ tribhiś caturbhis tair yamakas trivṛto mahān |
Āḍhamalla. yo dvābhyāṃ snehābhyāṃ milito yogaḥ sa yamakaḥ kathitaḥ | yas tribhiḥ snehair militaḥ sa trivṛtaḥ | yaś caturbhiḥ snehaiḥ saṃyutaḥ sa mahān kathita ity abhiprāyaḥ |
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yamakādisnehabhedān āha - dvābhyāṃ ghṛtatailābhyāṃ yamakaḥ | tribhir ghṛtatailavasābhis trivṛtaḥ | caturbhir ghṛtatailavasāmajjābhir mahān ity arthaḥ ||

ab.seg:
snehasātmye kālāvadhim āha --
pibetryahaṃ caturahaṃ pañcāhaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ tathā || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. kutracit snehaḥ sevitaḥ san tryahāt paraṃ sātmyībhavati | kvacit caturahaṃ, pañcāhaṃ, ṣaḍahaṃ ca | saptāhāt param iti saptadinaṃ yāvat | iyam aharādimaryādā koṣṭhasya mṛdumadhyakṛtā jñeyā, paraṃ saptarātrād ūrdhvaṃ sevitaḥ sātmībhavati | sātmībhūtasya snehasya guṇāḥ vāgbhaṭe – ’sātmībhūto hi kurute na malānām udīraṇam’ iti | carake tu - ’snehanasya prakarṣau tu saptarātratrirātrakau ( ca. sū. 13,49) iti | vāgbhaṭe tu - ’tryaham acchaṃ mṛdukoṣṭhe krūre saptadinaṃ pibet’ iti ( vā. sū. 16,29) ihatyavirodhaḥ? maivaṃ - sarveṣāṃ viṣayabhedāt, mṛdu-mṛdutara-madhya-madhyatara-krūra-krūratara-koṣṭhaviṣayāṇi vacanāni jñātavyāni || 3 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pibet ghṛtaṃ tryahaṃ, tailaṃ caturahaṃ, vasā pañcāhaṃ, majjā ṣaḍaham evaṃ krameṇa snehaḥ kadā sātmībhavatīty āha - sneho ghṛtādiḥ sevitaḥ saptarātrāt paraṃ sātmībhavati || 3 ||

atha snehapānamātrāviṣayam āha -
doṣakālāgnivayasāṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayojayet || 4 ||

lg.l: hīnāṃ ca madhyamāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ mātrāṃ snehasya buddhimān |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. mātrālakṣaṇam agre vakṣyamāṇam | doṣās trividhāś caturvidhā vā teṣāṃ balam utkṛṣṭa-madhyā-lpādibhedena jñeyam | kālāḥ śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇās trividhāḥ eṣāṃ balaṃ hīnamadhyātimātrasvarūpaṃ, bheṣajagrahaṇakālaṃ vā | agnir api sama-viṣama-manda-tīkṣṇamedena caturvidhaḥ asya balaṃ pācakāpācakarūpam | vayo 'pi bāla-madhyottarabhedena trividhaṃ tasyāpi balaṃ svaśaktisāmarthyam | buddhimān iti sadvaidya iti śeṣaḥ | tathā hi - ’yathādoṣaṃ yathākālaṃ yathāvyādhiṃ yathābalaṃ | snehapakvam apakvaṃ vā pākaṃ yuñjyāc cikitsakaḥ’ iti | doṣādīn apekṣya snehasya hīnādimātrāṃ prayojayet, hīnatarām api prayojayet | uktaṃ ca -
hīnamadhyottamā mātrā tās tābhyaś ca hṛsīyasīm |
kalpayed vīkṣya doṣādīn prāg eva tu kanīyasīm || ( vā. sū 16|17) ‘ajñātakoṣṭhe hi bahu kuryāj jīvitasaṃśayam’ iti || 4 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. taṃ doṣādīnāṃ balaṃ sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭvā buddhimān paṇḍitaḥ snehasya hīnāṃ madhyamāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ mātrāṃ prayojayet | yasmin doṣe, yasmin kāle, yasminn agnau yasmin vayasi yad ucitaṃ tat deyam || 4 ||

amātrādisevitasya snehasya doṣam āha -
amātrayā tathā'kāle mithyāhāravihārataḥ || 5 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. sneho 'mātrayā ( mātrā hrasvādiparimāṇās tābhyo 'nyathā ) viṣamapramāṇena | akāle asamaye | tathā mithyā'hāravihārato vā sevitaḥ śophādīn karoti | mithyā'hāro yathā – ‘ akāle cātisātmyaṃ vā asātmyaṃ yac ca bhojanam | viṣamāśanaṃ ca yad bhuktaṃ mithyāhāraḥ sa kathyate ’ iti | mithyāvihāro malaparityāgastrīsevādiṣu anyathā viharaṇam | visaṃjñatā mūrcchābhedaḥ | ( asyāgre - prakuryāl laṅghanaṃ tatra svedaṃ jñātvā virecanam || 6 || iti kecit paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca) || 5 || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. amātrayā grahaṇe doṣam āha - amātrayā tathā'kāle tathā mithyā''hārataḥ snehaḥ śophādīn karoti || 5 || 6 ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ snehapānamātrām āha -
deyā dīptāgnaye mātrā snehasya palasaṃmitā |
madhyamāya trikarṣā syāj jaghanyāya dvikārṣikī || 7 ||

Āḍhamalla. dīptāgnaye iti pradīptakoṣṭhapuruṣāyety arthaḥ | jaghanyasaṃjñādoṣaviśeṣeṣu manyante tad api saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | mātrā evaṃ madhyamāya trikārṣikī syāt ,jaghanyāya hīnabalānalāya dvikārṣikī | eke prabalamadhyajaghanyasaṃjñā doṣaviṣeṣu manyante tad api saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | uktaṃ ca --’uttamasya palaṃ mātrā tribhiś cākṣaiś ca madhyamā | jaghanyasya palārdhena snehakvāthauṣadheṣu ca’ iti || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dīptāgnyādiṣu kīdṛśī mātrā deyā tām āha | madhyamāya madhyamāgnaye, jaghanyāya alpāgnaye || 7 ||

atha vikalpāntaravihitāṃ mātrāṃ darśayann āha -
athavā snehamātrāḥ syus tisro 'nyāḥ sarvasaṃmatāḥ |
ahorātreṇa mahatī jīryaty ahni tu madhyamā || 8 ||

lg.l: jīryaty alpā dinārdhena sā vijñeyā sukhāvahā |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athaveti prakāreṇa kālabhedena ity arthaḥ | anyāḥ palādibhyo 'nyāḥ vilakṣaṇāḥ, vailakṣaṇyatvād asaṃmatatvam ity ata āha - sarvasaṃmatā iti | carakavāgbhaṭādisaṃmatā | uktaṃ ca carake -
‘ahorātram ahaḥ kṛtsnam ardhāhaṃ ca pratīkṣyate |
pradhānā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati | iti tisraḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ mātrāḥ snehasya mānataḥ ( ca. sū 13, 27 | 28) iti | vāgbhaṭe 'pi - ’ dvābhyāṃ caturbhir aṣṭābhir yāmair jīryanti yāḥ kramāt | hasvamadhyottamā mātrā ’ (vā. sū 16,17) iti | ahorātreṇa mahatī jīryatīti | nanv ahorātragrahaṇaṃ sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādakaraṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ ? ahani dvayor nāḍikayor anantaraṃ pītasya snehasya pare 'hni ghaṭikādvayānantaraṃ pākaḥ sa cāhorātragrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate | ahorātragrahaṇam aṣṭau praharapramāṇakālaparaṃ jñeyam | evaṃ paramacatureṇa vāgbhaṭenāṣṭau praharādipramāṇam evoktaṃ tadvad atrāpy ahorātram aṣṭau praharaparaṃ jñeyam | evam uttaratrā'pi vyākhyeyam | seti | sā alpā hrasvā sukhāvahā jñātavyā | sukhakāriṇīty arthaḥ | śīghrapākatvāt || 8 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. alpāṃ mātrām āha - athavā pakṣāntare | anyās tisraḥ snehamātrā āha - mahatī ahorātreṇa pacyate sā palapramāṇā, madhyamā trikarṣā yā sā ahni yāmacatuṣṭayena jīryati, alpā dvikārṣikī dinārdhena yāmadvayena jīryati sā sukhāvahā vijñeyā || 8 ||

alpādīnāṃ guṇān āha -
alpā syād dīpanī vṛṣyā svalpadoṣeṣu pūjitā || 9 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. atha tāsāṃ viṣayam āha - alpā mātrā snehasya dīpanī bhavati agnidīptikarīty arthaḥ | vṛṣyā śukravṛddhikarī, svalpadoṣeṣu hīnabaleṣu doṣeṣu vā pūjitā | kāraṇe kāryopacārāt | svalpadoṣe svalparogeṣu vā iti svalpanidānenālpasaṃcite | madhyamā catuḥpraharair yā pākaṃ prāpnoti sā madhyamā | sā snehanī rūkṣāṇāṃ | bṛṃhaṇī sarvadhātūnām | bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyevārthasaṃvittiḥ | vastudarśanam | jyeṣṭheti | jyeṣṭhā uttamā kuṣṭhādihāriṇī bhavati | carake tu hrasvādimātrāṇāṃ viṣayaguṇāś coktā yathā -
’ye tu vṛddhāś ca bālāś ca sukumārāḥ sukhocitāḥ |
riktakoṣṭhatvam ahitaṃ yeṣāṃ mandāgnayaś ca ye ||
jvarātīsāra- kāsāś ca yeṣāṃ cirasamutthitāḥ |
snehamātrāṃ pibeyus te hrasvā ye cāvarā bale ||
parihāre sukhā caiṣā mātrā snehanabṛṃhaṇī |
vṛṣyā balyā nirābādhā ciraṃ cāpy anuvartate ||’ (ca. sū. 13,36 - 38) atra vṛddhādayaḥ kleśāsahiṣṇutvāt hrasvasnehamātrārhāḥ | sukhocitā iti na kumāraviśeṣaṇaṃ kiṃtu pṛthag eva sukhasātmyā abhimatāḥ | riktakoṣṭhatvam ahitam iti | vātaprakṛtivikārāṇām ahitaṃ ye cāvarā bale alpabalā ity arthaḥ | parihārasukheti vyāyāmam uccairvacanam ityādike parihāre sati sukham iyam ādhatte ato hrasvā'pi mātrā parihāre sati sukham ādadhyāt | tatra madhyamottamayor nitarāṃ parihāraḥ kartavyaḥ | ity evaṃ ’yato’ nirdeśa iti kaścit | anyas tu vyācaṣṭe - parihāraviṣaye sukheyam akriyamāṇāpi parihāre na doṣāvahety arthaḥ |
’prabhūtasnehasātmyā ye kṣutpipāsāsahā narāḥ |
pāvakaś cottamabalo yeṣāṃ ye cottamā bale ||
gulminaḥ sarpadaṣṭāś ca visarpopahatāś ca ye |
unmattāḥ kṛcchramūtrāś ca gāḍhavarcasa eva ca ||
pibeyur uttamāṃ mātrāṃ tasyāḥ pāne guṇān śṛṇu |
vikārān śamayaty eṣā śīghraṃ samyak prayojitā |
doṣānukarṣiṇī mātrā sarvamārgānusāriṇī |
balyā punarnavakarī śarīrendriyacetasām || ity uttamā | madhyamām āha -
aruṣkasphoṭapiṭikākaṇḍūpāmābhir arditāḥ |
kuṣṭhinaś ca pramīṭhāś ca vātaśoṇitikāś ca ye |
nātibahvāśinaś caiva mṛdukoṣṭhās tathaiva ca |
pibeyur madhyamāṃ mātrāṃ madhyamāś cāpi ye bale ||
mātraiṣā mandavibhraṃśā na cātibaladāyinī |
sukhena ca snehayati śodhanārthe ca yujyate ||’ iti (ca.sū 13|29-35) | arūṃṣyevārūṃṣyā | arūṃṣikā śirorogaviśeṣaḥ | arditāḥ pīḍitāḥ | pramīṭhā atyarthaṃ pramehapīḍitāḥ | tasyā guṇān āha - mātraiṣā mandavibhraṃśeti | mandā alpā vibhraṃśāḥ balahānyādayo yasyāṃ sā | yadā āturādidoṣābhāvāt vibhraṃśo notpadyate tadā sukhena snehayati | śodhanārthe yujyate ity anenaitat kathayati uttamā mātrā śamanāya | tathā ca carake -- ’vikārān śamayaty eṣā śīghraṃ samyak prayojitā’ iti | hrasvāt bṛṃhaṇārthā | uktaṃ ca ’mātrā snehanabṛṃhaṇī’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|38)| asyārthaḥ - snehanabṛṃhaṇakarmakāriṇī iyaṃ bhuvanakāmānāṃ virecanakāmānāṃ ca prayujyate | iti mātrāvivaraṇam || 9 || 10 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 9 || 10 ||

ab.seg:
atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa snehaviṣayam āha -
kevalaṃ paittike sarpir vātike lavaṇānvitam |
peyaṃ bahukaphe cāpi vyoṣakṣārasamanvitam || 11 ||

Āḍhamalla. kevalaṃ prakṣeparahitaṃ paittike vyādhau lavaṇam atra saindhavaṃ, vyādhivihitaṃ cānyad api lavaṇaṃ grāhyam | bahukaphe kaphaprāye vyādhau vyoṣādiyutaṃ hitaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, kṣāraṃ yavakṣārādi || 11 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. doṣe anupānaviśeṣam āha - kevalam iti | paittike kevalam anupānena rahitam | vātike lavaṇānvitam | bahukaphe vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, tadyutam | vātaṃ vihāya pittābhidhānaṃ ghṛtasyādau gṛhītatvāt pittaśamakatvāc ca lavaṇādayo māṣamitā deyāḥ || 11 ||

yeṣāṃ sarpir dīyate tān āha -
rūkṣakṣataviṣārtānāṃ vātapittavikāriṇām |
hīnamedhāsmṛtīnāṃ ca sarpiṣpānaṃ praśasyate || 12 ||

Āḍhamalla. hitaṃ | rūkṣādibhis tribhir ārtāḥ rūkṣaṃ rūkṣaguṇaṃ dhānyaṃ rūkṣaguṇo vāyuś ca vātaprakṛtīnām ity eke | kṣatam uraḥkṣataṃ, tena ārtaḥ | viṣaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca tena ārtaḥ pīḍitaḥ vātapittavikāriṇām iti | vātapitte atra pṛthak milite vā | tathā hīnamedhāsmṛtīnām iti | medhā granthākarṣaṇasāmarthyaṃ, smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasmaraṇam | anubandhātmikā buddhir iti yāvat | carake tu --
‘vātapittaprakṛtayo vātapittavikāriṇaḥ |
cakṣuḥkāmāḥ kṣatakṣīṇā vṛddhā bālās tathā'balāḥ ||
āyuḥprakarṣakāmāś ca --balavarṇasvarārthinaḥ |
puṣṭikāmāḥ prajākāmāḥ saukumāryārthinaś ca ye ||
dīptyojaḥsmṛtimedhā'gnibuddhī- ndriyabalārthinaḥ |
pibeyuḥ sarpir ārtāś ca dāhaśastraviṣāgnibhiḥ ||’ (ca. sū 13|39-41) iti | dīptiḥ prabhā | ojas tu hṛdi tiṣṭhati yat śuddham īṣat lolitapītakam | vāgbhaṭe 'pi - ‘tatra dhīsmṛtimedhāgnikāṅkṣiṇāṃ śasyate ghṛtam’ iti (vā.sū. 16|8) | ‘medhā'gnir ity atra’ ’medhādikāṅkṣiṇām’ iti samyakpāṭhaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt --
’śastaṃ dhīsmṛtimedhāgnibalāyuḥśukra-cakṣuṣām |
bālavṛddhaprajākāntisaukumāryasvarārthinām ||
kṣatakṣīṇaparīsarpaśastrāgniglapitātmanām |
vātapittaviṣonmādaśoṣālakṣmījvarāpaham || snehānām uttamaṃ śītaṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ param | sahasravīryaṃ vidhibhir ghṛtaṃ karmasahasrakṛt’ iti || 12 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 12 ||

tailayogyān āha --
kṛmikoṣṭhānilāviddhāḥ pravṛdhdakaphamedasaḥ |
pibeyus tailasātmyā ye tailaṃ dārḍhyārthinas tu ye || 13||

Āḍhamalla. tailasya viṣayam āha - kṛmikoṣṭhānilāviddhādayas tailaṃ pibeyuḥ | kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ koṣṭhāntaḥ kṛmayaḥ | analāviddhāḥ vātavyādhibhir vyāptaśarīrāḥ | dārḍhyārthinaḥ dṛḍhaśarīrākāṅkṣiṇaḥ | tailaṃ tilasnehaḥ | carake tu -
pravṛddhaśleṣmamedaskāś calasthūlagalodarāḥ|
vātavyādhibhir āviṣṭā vātaprakṛtayaś ca ye ||
balaṃ tanutvaṃ laghutāṃ sthiratāṃ dṛḍhagātratām |
snigdhaślakṣṇatanutvaktvaṃ ye ca kāṅkṣanti dehinaḥ || kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ krūrakoṣṭhās tathā nāḍībhir arditāḥ | pibeyuḥ śītale kāle tailaṃ tailocitāś ca ye’ iti (ca.sū.13|42-44)| tanutvaṃ-kṛśatvaṃ, laghutā-lāghavaṃ, sthiratā-niścalatā, dārḍhyaṃ-kāṭhinyam iti || 13 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kṛmayaḥ koṣṭhe yeṣāṃ te kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ | anilāviṣṭā vāyuyuktāḥ pravṛddhakaphamedaso dīptāgnayaḥ ye tailasātmyās te tailaṃ pibeyuḥ || 13 ||

vasāyogyān āha -
vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ śuṣkaretoraktā mahārujaḥ |
mahāgnimārutaprāṇā vasāyogyā narāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14||

Āḍhamalla. atha vasāviṣayam āha - vyāyāmeti | evaṃvidhā narāḥ puruṣāḥ vasāyogyāḥ | vyāyāmena durbalaśarīrāḥ, śuṣkaṃ retaḥ śukraṃ, raktaṃ rudhiraṃ ca yeṣāṃ te tathā | ata eva carake - ’saṃśuṣkaretorudhirā (ca. sū.13|45) ity uktam | mahāgnimārutaprāṇā iti mahāgnis tīkṣṇāgnir bhasmako vā | mahāmārutaḥ balavān mārutaḥ | sa cānyo 'nyasaṃcāralakṣaṇair jñeyaḥ | uktaṃ ca carake -- ’balavān māruto yeṣāṃ khāni cāvṛtya tiṣṭhati’ iti (ca. sū 13|46) | vāgbhaṭe 'pi - ‘vātāvṛtapatheṣu ca’ iti | mahāprāṇā mahābalāḥ | uktaṃ ca carake - mahac cāgnibalaṃ yeṣām iti (ca. sū. 13|47) | athavā prāṇo vāyuḥ | suśrute ca - ’agniḥ somo vāyuḥ sattvarajastamaḥ pañcendriyāṇi bhūtātmeti prāṇāḥ’ | kleśakṣamatvaṃ ca mahābalena | ata evoktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -- ‘rūkṣakleśakṣamātyagnivātāvṛtapatheṣu ca’ iti ( vā. sū.16|10) || 14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. evaṃbhūtā narā vasāyogyā bhavanti iti yojyaṃ | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ, vyāyāmo mallādiyuddhadhanurākarṣaṇādiḥ, tatkarṣitāḥ | kṣīṇāḥ, śuṣkaṃ kṣīṇaṃ reto vīryaṃ raktaṃ ca yeṣāṃ te śuṣkaretoraktāḥ | punaḥ mahārujaḥ vyathāvantaḥ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtāḥ ? mahān agnir māruto vāyuḥ prāṇāḥ balaṃ ca yeṣāṃ te mahāgnimārutaprāṇāḥ || 14 ||

majjāyogyān āha --
krūrāśayāḥ kleśasahā vātārtā dīptavahnayaḥ |
majjānaṃ ca pibeyus te sarpir vā sarvato hitam || 15 ||

Āḍhamalla. majjāviṣayam āha -- krūreti | krūrāśayāḥ krūrakoṣṭhāḥ, kleśasahāḥ ghasmarāḥ, vātārtāḥ vātarogiṇaḥ, dīptavahnayas tīkṣṇāgnayaḥ | majjāyā alābhe sarpiḥprayogam āha - sarpir vā sarvato hitam iti | sarvataḥ sarvasnehaviṣaye sarvavyādhau ca, sarpir ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ pathyam | etac ca majjālābhe jñeyam || 15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. krūrāśayādinarā majjānaṃ pibeyuḥ | krūra āśayaḥ koṣṭho yeṣāṃ te krūrāśayāḥ | punaḥ kleśasahāḥ duḥkhasahāḥ | punaḥ vātārtāḥ | punaḥ dīptavahnayaḥ ||15||

div.ab:
snehapānakālaḥ |
śītakāle divā sneham uṣṇakāle piben niśi |
vātapittādhike rātrau vātaśleṣmādhike divā ||1 6||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. ātyayike vyādhau snehasya kālam āha -- śīteti | vātapittādhike iti | atra vātasya yogavāhitvāt pittādhikaś ca gṛhyate | evaṃ vātaśleṣmādhika ity atrāpi vyākhyeyam | pittaśleṣmādhikas tu nokto 'py atra sādhāraṇaḥ śīta eva kāle pibed iti draṣṭavyam | rātrāv iti sāyam || 16 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śītakālādau snehaḥ kadā peya ity āha -- śītakāle iti | sugamam || 16 ||

atha tailaghṛtayor viśiṣṭakarma darśayann āha —
nasyābhyañjanagaṇḍūṣamūrdhakarṇākṣitarpaṇaiḥ |
tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā yuñjīta dṛṣṭvā doṣabalābalam || 17 ||

Āḍhamalla. doṣaśabdo 'tra śarīradūṣaṇād doṣāḥ vātādayaḥ, dhātavo rasādyāḥ,, malāś ca grāhyāḥ | teṣāṃ balābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā samyag vicārya tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā yatra tailasātmyaṃ doṣabalaṃ tatra tailam eva yujyāt | yatra ghṛtasātmyaṃ tatra ghṛtam eveti tattatsātmyānāṃ tattad yuñjīta || 17 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nasyādau ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā yojyaṃ tad āha -- nasyeti | nasā peyaṃ nasyam, abhyañjanaṃ mardanaṃ, gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaḥ, mūrdhā mastakaṃ, karṇaṃ śrotram, akṣi netram | tattarpaṇe āpyāyane ghṛtaṃ vā tailaṃ vā yojyam || 17 ||

idānīṃ snehānām anupānāny āha -
ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyaṃ taile yūṣaḥ praśasyate |
vasāmajjñoḥ piben maṇḍam anupānaṃ sukhāvaham || 18 ||

Āḍhamalla. ghṛte iti | anu paścāt niyataṃ pānam anupānaṃ ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyam | taile yūṣam anupānam | vasāmajjñoḥ maṇḍam anupānam | kecin maṇḍaśabdenātra strotoviśodhanatvāt dadhimaṇḍam āhuḥ, tan na - yato bhaktamaṇḍo 'pi mṛdūkaroti srotāṃsi | uktaṃ ca - ‘maṇḍo vātānulomanaḥ, tṛḍglānimedodoṣaghnaḥ, pācano, dhātusāmyakṛt’ iti | sukhāvaham iti | sukham āvahati karoti tat sukhāvaham, samyak pākādikaraṇāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘anupānaṃ karoty ūrjāṃ tṛptiṃ vyāptiṃ dṛḍhāṅgatām | annasaṃghātaśaithilyavikḷptijaraṇāni ca’ iti | anyac ca -
’jīrṇājīrṇaviśaṅkāyāṃ punar uṣṇodakaṃ pibet |
tenodgāre viśuddhiḥ syāt tataś ca laghutā ruciḥ ||’ ( vā. sū.16|23) iti | etad uṣṇodakaṃ sāmānyena sarvasnehe 'pi hitam | uktaṃ ca - ’uṣṇodakānupānaṃ ca snehānām atha śasyate | ṛte bhallātakasnehāt tatra toyaṃ tu śītalam’ iti || 18 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ghṛtapānādau anupānam āha - ghṛte iti | ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyam | taile yūṣaḥ | vasāmajjādiṣu maṇḍaṃ bhaktādibhūtaṃ tad anupānaṃ, anupāne sukhāvaham || 18 ||

sānnasnehasya viṣayam āha -
snehadviṣaḥ śiśūn vṛddhān sukumārān kṛśān api |
udyākāmān uṣṇakāle saha bhaktena pāyayet || 19 ||

Āḍhamalla. sānnasnehasya viṣayam āha - sneheti | snehadviṣaḥ snehārucayaḥ ‘uṣṇakāmān’ ity atra ‘tṛṣṇālukān’ iti paṭhanti kecit | saha bhakteneti | bhaktam odanaḥ cakāro 'tra luptodayaḥ tena carakoktāś caturviṃśatisnehavicāraṇā grāhyāḥ, tā yathā -
‘odanaś ca vilepī ca raso māṃsaṃ payo dadhi |
yavāgūḥ sūpaśāke ca yūṣaḥ kāmbalikaṃ khaḍaḥ ||
śaktavas tilapiṣṭaṃ ca madyaṃ lehās tathaiva ca |
bhakṣyam abhyañjanaṃ bastis tathaivottarabastayaḥ ||
gaṇḍūṣaḥ karṇatailaṃ ca nasyaṃ mūrdhākṣitarpaṇam |
caturviṃśatir ity etāḥ snehasya pravicāraṇāḥ ||’ iti (ca. sū. 13|21-23) vāgbhaṭoktāś catuḥṣaṣṭivicāraṇāś cātraiva grāhyāḥ, tā yathā - ‘rasabhedaikakatvābhyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭir vicāraṇā’ iti | (vā. sū. 16| 15) nanu - ’acchapeyas tu yaḥ sneho na tām āhur vicāraṇām (ca. sū. 13|24) iti carakavacanāt kathaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭidhā iti virodhaḥ ? maivaṃ nādyaḥ, peyo vicāraṇā ity asyāyam arthaḥ - acchapeyasnehaḥ sā na vicāraṇā, sātmyartuvyādhyādiṣu vicāraṇāsty eva | uktaṃ ca carake -
’rasaiś copahitaḥ snehaḥ samāsavyāsayogibhiḥ |
ṣaḍbhis triṣaṣṭidhā saṃkhyā prāpnoty ekaś ca kevalaḥ || evam etāś catuḥṣaṣṭisnehānāṃ pravicāraṇāḥ | sātmyartuvyādhipuruṣān prayojyā jānatā bhavet ’ iti | ( ca. sū.13|23-26) puruṣagrahaṇena deśasātmyam avaruddhaṃ, yato deśam apekṣya puruṣasya tatsātmyaṃ, tathā puruṣagrahaṇena prakṛtibalavayaḥśarīraprabhṛtayo 'varuddhvā iti || 19 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣāṃ snehaṃ pāyayet tān āha - sneha iti | uṣṇakāle grīṣmādau etān bhaktena saha snehaṃ pāyayet | snehaṃ dviṣantīti snehadviṣaḥ tān atiprītau śiśūn , bālān , vṛddhān , sukumārān , kṛśādīn , tṛṣṇāturāṃś cāpi| || 19 ||

idānīṃ snehaṃ vināpi yavāgvā snehanam āha -
sarpiṣmatī bahutilā yavāgūḥ svalpataṇḍulā |
sukhoṣṇā sevyamānā tu sadyaḥ snehanakāriṇī ||20||

lg.l: dugdhvā kṣīraṃ ṣibed uṣṇaṃ sadyaḥ snehanam ucyate || 21 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. rūkṣāṇāṃ sadyaḥ snehanayogadvayam āha - sarpiṣmatīti | sarpiṣmatī bahughṛtā | sadya iti tasminn eva divase tvarayā snehanaṃ karoti | sadyograhaṇaṃ stutiparam ity anye tryaheṇa snehayatīty arthaḥ | ata evoktaṃ sevyamāneneti | aparam api - śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe iti | dohanasthe dohanabhāṇḍe sthite ghṛte | kiṃbhūte ? śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe śarkarāmiśrite | tadbhāṇḍe gāṃ dugdhvā rūkṣaḥ puruṣaḥ taddugdhaṃ sadyaḥ svalpakālena sneham ucyate iti || 20 || 21 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ snehaṃ vināpi yavāgvā snehanam āha - sarpiṣmatīti | evaṃbhūtā yavāgūḥ sadyaḥ snehanakāriṇī bhavati | kiṃbhūtā ? sarpiṣmatī, punaḥ bahutilā svalpataṇḍulā, punaḥ sukhoṣṇā | kṣīram api sadyaḥ snehanaṃ bhavati | tad āha śarkarācūrṇasaṃbhṛṣṭe bharjite dohanasthe gāṃ dugdhvā kṣīram uṣṇaṃ pibet sadyaḥ snehanaṃ bhavati || 20 || 21 ||

ab.seg:
atha snehājīrṇe cikitsām āha —
mithyācārād bahutvād vā yasya sneho na jīryati |
viṣṭabhya vāpi jīryeta vāriṇoṣṇena vāmayet ||22||

Āḍhamalla. atha snehājīrṇe cikitsām āha — mithyeti | mithyācaraṇād uṣṇodakādīnām | amithyācāras tu vāgbhaṭenoktaḥ -
’uṣṇodakopacārī syād brahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ |
na vegarodhavyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān||
pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitīḥ |
nīcātyuccopadhānāhaḥ svapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca || yāny ahāni pibet tāni tāvanty anyāny api tyajet | iti | (vā. sū. 16|25-27) bahutvāt samānādhikyād vā | athavā viṣṭabhya viṣṭambhaṃ kṛtvā jīryati tam api vāmayed ity arthaḥ | asyāgre kecit paṭhanti - ’tataḥ snehaṃ punar dadyāt laghukoṣṭhāya dehinaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭho bahuṣu pustakeṣu na dṛśyate vaidyasaṃpradāye tu - ’tataḥ snehaṃ punar dadyāt’ iti dināntare jātabale deyam iti || 22 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mithyācārāder yasya sneho na jīryati tatpratīkāram āha - mithyeti | mithyācārān mithyācaraṇāt, bahutvāt snehādhikyād vā yasya sneho na jīryati viṣṭabhya viṣṭambhaṃ kṛtvā vā jīryati tam uṣṇavāriṇā vāmayet || 22 ||

snehājīrṇe anyad api pratīkāram āha --
srehasyājīrṇaśaṅkāyāṃ pibed uṣṇodakaṃ naraḥ |
tenodgāre bhavec chuddho bhaktaṃ prati rucis tathā || 23 ||

Āḍhamalla. sneheti | ‘snehasyājīrṇaśaṅkāyām api uṣṇodakaṃ pibet kim uta jīrṇe ity anena sarvāsv apy avasthāsu uṣṇodakam anupāne praśastam ity abhiprāyaḥ | phalam āha - teneti | tena uṣṇodakena udgāraśuddhiḥ ruciś ca bhaktaṃ prati jāyate, bhojane rucir jāyate ity api | tantrāntare tu - ’syuḥ pacyamāne tṛṭdāhabhramasādāruciklamāḥ | pariṣicyādbhir uṣṇābhir jīrṇe snehe tato naram ’ iti || 23 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sneheti | sugamam || 23 ||

snehopadravabhūtāyās tṛṣṇāyāś cikitsām āha -
snehena paittikasyāgnir yadā tīkṣṇatarīkṛtaḥ |
tadāsyodīrayet tṛṣṇāṃ viṣamāṃ tasya vāmayet || 24 ||

lg.l: śītaṃ jalaṃ pāyayec ca pipāsā tena śāmyati |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. sneheneti | paittikasya pittaprakṛteḥ puruṣasya tīkṣṇatarīkṛta iti atyarthaṃ tīkṣṇatvaṃ prāptaḥ | tadā tasmin kāle asya puruṣasya tṛṣṇāṃ viṣamāṃ kaṭhinām udīrayet utpādayet tadā vāmayet uṣṇāmbu pītvā sneham iti śeṣaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ’snehapītasya cet tṛṣṇā pibed uṣṇodakaṃ naraḥ | evaṃ cānupaśāmyantyāṃ sneham uṣṇāmbunā vamet (suśru. ci. 31/24) iti | uddharet vāmayed ity arthaḥ | ’ ca ’ śabdaḥ prakārāntare | śītaṃ jalaṃ pāyayet tena hetunā pipāsā śāmyati || 24 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snehe pittaprakopāt pratīkāram āha - sreheneti | paittikasya pittapradhānapuṃsaḥ || 24 ||

atha snehā'yogyān āha -
ajīrṇī varjayet sneham udarī taruṇajvarī || 25 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. ajīrṇīti | ajīrṇī snehaṃ varjayet na pibet | tathā jīrṇajvarī āmajvarī | durbalo balahīnaḥ | arocakī arocakārtaḥ | sthūlo meduraḥ | madapīḍitaḥ madātyayī | dattabastiḥ yasya bastikarma kṛtam | viriktaḥ kṛtavirekaḥ kṛtavāntiś ca | tṛṣṇāyuktaḥ śramayuktaś ca | akālaprasavā nārīti | garbhapātasrāvābhyāṃ yuktā strī | ṣoḍaśavarṣād arvāg api prasavo 'kālaprasava ity eke | durdinaṃ meghacchanne 'hni durdinam | cakārād vāgbhaṭoktāḥ -
‘snehyā na tv atimandāgnitīkṣṇāgnisthūladurbalāḥ |
ūrustambhātisārāmagalarogagarodaraiḥ || mūrcchāchardyaruciśleṣmatṛṣṇāmadyaiś ca pīḍitāḥ | apaprasūtā yukte ca nasye bastau virecane’ iti ( vā. sū. 16|6, 7) || 25 || 26 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣāṃ snehapānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ tān āha - ajīrṇīti | ajīrṇī ajīrṇavān snehaṃ varjayet, tathā udarī udararogavān taruṇajvarī arocakarogayuktaḥ | durdinaṃ ’meghacchanne 'hni durdinam |’ spaṣṭam anyat || 25 ||

yeṣāṃ snehapānaṃ praśastaṃ tān āha -
svedyasaṃśodhyamadyastrīvyāyāmāsaktamānasāḥ || 27 ||

lg.l: vṛddhā bālāḥ kṛśā rūkṣāḥ kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaretasaḥ |
vātārtās timirārtā ye teṣāṃ snehanam uttamam || 28 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. snehyān āha - svedyeti | svedyādīnāṃ snehanam uttamam | ete snehārhāḥ, svedyāḥ svedārhāḥ, saṃśodhyā vamanavirecanārhāḥ | madyādiṣu āsaktaṃ mānasaṃ cittaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā | tathā kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaraktāḥ, kṣīṇaretasaḥ kṣīṇaśukrāḥ, vātārtā iti vātenārtāḥ pīḍitāḥ, timirārtāḥ taimirikāḥ iti || 27 || 28 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svedyeti | evaṃbhūtā ye teṣāṃ snehapānam uttamam | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? svedyāḥ svedanārhāḥ, śodhyā vamanādiśodhanocitāḥ | madyastrīvyāyāmasaktāḥ anuraktāḥ cintakās tu cintanaparāś ca | kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaraktāḥ kṣīṇavīryāḥ || 27 || 28 ||

samyak snigdhasya lakṣaṇam āha -
vātānulomyaṃ dīpto 'gnir varcaḥ snigdham asaṃhatam |
mṛdusnigdhāṅgatā glāniḥ snehodvego 'tha lāghavam ||29|| vimalendriyatā samyak snigdhe

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. vātānulomyam iti | samyak snigdhe etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti | vātānulomyaṃ vātasya anulomatā, agnir jaṭharāgnir dīptaḥ | varcaḥ purīṣaṃ snigdhaṃ cikkaṇam asaṃhataṃ śithilaṃ mṛdusnigdhāṅgatā ca bhavati | glānir ojaḥkṣayaḥ snehodvegaḥ snehapāne dveṣaḥ, lāghavaṃ śarīralaghutā | vimalendriyateti - cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ vimalatvaṃ svasvaviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyam | etair lakṣaṇaiḥ samyak snigdho jñeyaḥ || 29 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snehe pīte samyaksnigdhalakṣaṇam āha - vātānulomyam iti | samyak snigdhe vātānulomyādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | vātānulomyaṃ vātasya samyakpravṛttiḥ, agnir dīptaḥ, varcaḥ purīṣaṃ, snigdhaḥ sacikkaṇam, asaṃhatam amilitam | mṛdvaṅgatā komalāṅgatā, snigdhāṅgatā sacikkaṇāṅgatā, aglāniḥ aklamaḥ, snehāvegaḥ snehopadravābhāvaḥ | lāghavaṃ dehasya, vimalendriyatā nirmalendriyatā || 29 ||

div.ab: rūkṣe lakṣaṇam āha – ---- rūkṣe viparyayaḥ |

Āḍhamalla. rūkṣe viparyayaś ca bhavati | sa cāsnigdhalakṣaṇasya | uktaṃ ca carake - ’purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ rūkṣaṃ vāyur apraguṇo mṛduḥ | paktā kharatvaṃ raukṣyaṃ ca gātrasyāsnigdhalakṣaṇam’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|55) vāyur atra guṇaḥ mṛduḥ paktā agnimāndyam | anyatrāpy uktaṃ -
’rūkṣaṃ purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ pakvānnaṃ na vipacyate |
uro vidahyate vāyuḥ koṣṭhād upari dhāvati || nirbalo durbalaś cāpi rūkṣo bhavati mānavaḥ’ iti ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rūkṣe tu etadviparyayaḥ ||

ab.seg:
atisnigdhalakṣaṇam āha --
bhaktadveṣo mukhasrāvo gude dāhaḥ pravāhikā ||30||

Āḍhamalla. bhaktadveṣa iti | bhṛśasnigdhasyātisnigdhasya bhaktadveṣādilakṣaṇam | tatra bhaktadveṣo bhojanānākāṅkṣā | mukhasrāvaḥ hṛllāsaḥ, gude dāhaḥ | ’gude pākaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ | pravāhikā atīsārabhedaḥ | tandrā prāg vyākhyātā | atīsaraṇam atīsāraḥ | pāṇḍutvaṃ śarīrasya | carake tu - pāṇḍutā gauravaṃ jāḍyaṃ purīṣasyāvipakvatā | atyutkleśo 'rucis tandrī syād atisnigdhalakṣaṇam’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|57) sadanaṃ aṅgānāṃ jāḍyaṃ jaḍībhāvaḥ kāyasya, purīṣasyāvipākatā'samatā, atyutkleśo hṛllāsaḥ, nidrārtasya viṣayāgrahaṇaṃ tandrīti || 30 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atisnigdhapāne lakṣaṇam āha - bhakteti | bhṛśaṃ snigdhasya atisnehapītasya, idaṃ bhaktadveṣādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti yojyam | bhakte dveṣaḥ bhaktāruciḥ, mukhasrāvaḥ mukhasyāsamantāt srāvaḥ lālāsravaṇaṃ, gude dāhaḥ | pravāhikā atīsārabhedaḥ, tandrā īṣanmudritanetratvam, atīsaraṇaṃ, pāṇḍutvaṃ pītavarṇatā || 30 ||

atha hīnātisnigdhasyopakramam āha -
rūkṣasya snehanaṃ snehair atisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇam || 31 ||
Āḍhamalla. atha hīnātisnigdhasyopakramam āha - rūkṣasyeti | rūkṣasya puruṣasya snehaiḥ sadyaḥsnehanakāribhis tailaghṛtādibhiḥ snehanaṃ kāryaṃ, atisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇaṃ kāryam || 31 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rūkṣasya snigdharūkṣaṇam iti | pratīkāram āha - rūkṣasya snehanaiḥ snehanam | atisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇai rūkṣaṇam || 31 ||

div.ab:
rūkṣayogam āha -
śyāmākacaṇakādyaiś ca takrapiṇyākasaktubhiḥ |

Āḍhamalla. rūkṣayogam āha - śyāmāketi | śyāmākādibhī rūkṣaṇaṃ kāryam | ādigrahaṇāt vāgbhaṭoktaṃ sarvaṃ grāhyam | yathā –
‘kṣuttṛṣṇollekhanasvedarūkṣapānānnabheṣajam |
takrāriṣṭakhaloddālayavaśyāmākakodravam || pippalī triphalā kṣaudraṃ pathyā gomūtragugguluḥ | yathāsvaṃ pratirogaṃ ca snehavyāpadi sādhanam’ iti || kecit ’śyāmākacaṇakādyaiḥ’ ity atra ‘śyāmākakoradūṣānnaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti | piṇyākaṃ niḥsnehatilakalkam ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kaiḥ ? takrapiṇyākādyaiḥ snehanam | śyāmākacaṇakādyai rūkṣai rūkṣaṇam | śyāmākaḥ dhānyaviśeṣaḥ | (sāva) piṇyākas tilakalkaḥ ||

ab.seg:
atha snehasevino lakṣaṇam āha -
dīptāgniḥ śuddhakoṣṭhaś ca puṣṭadhātur dṛḍhendriyaḥ || 32 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha snehasevino lakṣaṇam āha - dīpteti | snehasevī naraḥ dīptāgniḥ syāt | agnir atra jaṭharāgniḥ | śuddhakoṣṭha iti madhyakoṣṭhakrūrakoṣṭhādirahitaḥ | puṣṭadhātuḥ rasādipuṣṭadhātuḥ | dṛḍhendriyaḥ cakṣurādīndriyabalayuktaḥ’ | nirjaraḥ, balavarṇāḍhyaḥ, varṇāḍhyaś ca, surūpaś ca | vāgbhaṭe tu – ’dīptāntarāgniḥ pariśuddhakoṣṭhaḥ pratyagradhātur balavarṇayuktaḥ | dṛḍhendriyo mandajaraḥ śatāyuḥ snehopasevī puruṣaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ iti (vā. sū. 16|46) || 32 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snehasevī yādṛśo bhavati tādṛśam āha - dīpteti | nirjaraḥ jarārahitaḥ | balavarṇayuktaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 32 ||

snehasevāyāṃ varjyāny āha -
snehe vyāyāmasaṃśītavegāghātaprajāgarān || 33 ||

divāsvapnam abhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet |
divāsvapnam abhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa praṇītāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe snehavidhir nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. snehasevāyāṃ varjyāny āha - snehe snehapāne | vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajananakarma | saṃśītam iti atyarthaśītavātādikaṃ | vegāghātam iti vegānāṃ mūtrapurīṣotsargecchānām āghātam avarodhaṃ vegadhāraṇam ity arthaḥ | prajāgaram iti rātrijāgaraṇam | abhiṣyandi śleṣmaprakopi dadhyādikam ity arthaḥ | rūkṣānnam iti śyāmākacaṇakādikam | etac ca sāmānyasnehapānaviṣaye yatra ca atisnigdhatā bhavati tatra rūkṣānnaṃ vihitam eva | tatpūrvam eva || 33 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe snehapānādhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ || 1 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snehapāne yan niṣiddhaṃ tad āha - snehe iti | snehe snehapāne, vyāyāmādīn vivarjayet | saṃśītam atiśītalaṃ, vegāghātaṃ vātamūtrapurīṣādirodham | divāsvapnam abhiṣyandivirodhi | rūkṣāś cāṇakādi | spaṣṭam anyat || 33 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi snehapānaṃ prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

div.head: atha svedavidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha snehādhyāyānantaraṃ svedavidhiṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte -
atha svedavidhiḥ

Āḍhamalla. athaśabda ānantarye | snehavidhikathanānantaraṃ svedavidhiḥ | svedasya vidhir vidhānam | uktaṃ ca prāk - ’ snehasvedāv anabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ | dāruśuṣkam ivānāme śarīraṃ tasya dīryate’ iti | carake 'pri snehapūrvaprayuktena svedam āvarjite 'nile | purīṣamūtraretāṃsi na sajjanti kadācana’ iti | vāgbhaṭe 'pi - śuṣkāny api hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ | śakyaṃ karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ kimu gātrāṇi jīvatām’ iti | tena yuktaṃ snehānantaraṃ svedā'bhidhānam |
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snehapānānantaraṃ svedasya vihitatvāt ||

ab.seg:
tatra tāvat pūrvaṃ svedasaṃkhyām āha -
svedaś caturvidhaḥ proktas tāpoṣmasvedasaṃjñakau |
upanāho dravaḥ svedaḥ sarve vātārtihāriṇaḥ || 1 ||

lg.l: upanāhas tu vātaghnaḥ pittasaṅge dravo hitaḥ || 2 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. sveda iti | svidyate 'neneti vyutpattyā svedo 'gniḥ, tasya vidhiḥ karmacāturī | caturvidhatvam āha - ekas tāpasaṃjñaḥ svedaḥ| dvitīyas tūṣmāsaṃjñaḥ| tṛtīya upanāhaḥ upanāho nibandhanam iti pralepena | asya bhedaḥ sālvaṇa iti | caturtho dravasveda iti | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ anyatrāpy uktaṃ ca ’kṣāmaḥsaikatapārṣṇikāsyavasanaiḥ svedo 'thavāṃgārakair lepair vātaharaiḥ sahāmlalavaṇaiḥ snehaiḥ sukhomlair bhavet | evaṃ taptapayombuvātaśamanakvāthādisekādibhis taptais toyaniṣecanāhatamahābāṣpaiḥ sitādyaiḥ kramā’diti | eṣv eva caturṣu yathākramaṃ carakoktasaṃkarasvedādyavarodhaḥ | śaṃkarādisvedā yathā
’śaṃkaraḥ prastaro nāḍī pariṣeko 'vagāhanaṃ |
jetākoṣmaghanaḥ karṣaḥ kuṭī bhūḥ kumbhir eva ca | kūpo dolaka ity ete svedayanti trayodaśa itiśaṃkaraḥ sukhakaraḥ | tasyābhidhānamagre praśastatvāt | eteṣāṃ svedānāṃ vaidyānāṃ vijñānārthaṃ svarūpamuktaṃ carake - ‘ tatra vastrāntaritaiḥ piṇḍairyathoktairupasvedanaṃ śaṅkarasveda’ iti | tasyoṣmasvede'ntarbhāvaḥ | vastrāntaritatvamavastrāntaritatvañca sukumārāsukumāraviṣayaṃ jñeyam | prastaramāha - ‘ śūka-śimbi-dhānya-pulākānāṃ , veśavāra-pāyasa-kṛśaro-tkarikādīnāṃ vā prastare kauśeyā-'vikottarapracchade vā, pañcāṅgulorubukādīnāṃ vā , kauśeyāvikottarārkapatrapracchanne vā svabhyaktagātrasya śayānasyopasvedanaṃ prastarasvedanaṃ iti vidyāt ’ | ayaṃ coṣmasveda eva | śūka-śimbi-dhānya-pulākānāmiti bhāvaḥ | anyatrāpyuktaṃ - ‘ pulākamatrametāvaddravyāṇāmiha ṣaṭśatam | svabuddhyaiva sahasrāṇi koṭīrvā samprakalpayet’ iti | athavā ‘pulāka’ śabdaḥ svinnavacanaḥ , śūkaśimbidhānyānāṃ svinnānāṃ prastare ityarthaḥ | anye tu pulākā gavedhukākārā deśāntare prasiddhāḥ | iti vyākhyānayanti | tadayuktaṃ śūkaśimbidhānyeṣvevāntarbhāvāt | tāsāṃ ca na svedavattāyogyatā pratipattuṃ śakyā , doṣaviśeṣāharaṇāt | kauśeyāvikottarapracchannadeśe-kauśeyāvikābhyāṃ vā upari pracchanne prastare ityarthaḥ | uttaracchadagrahaṇādadhastādapi pracchado'stīti gamyate | iti prastarasvedaḥ ||2|| nāḍīsvedamāha - ‘ svedanadravyāṇāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ mūlapatraphalabhaṅgādīnāṃ mṛgaśakunipiśitaśirasādīnām uṣṇasvabhāvānāṃ yathā'mlalavaṇaṃ snehopahitānāṃ mūtrādīnāṃ kumbhyāṃ voṣmamanu dhamantyāmutkvathitānāṃ nāḍyā vaṃśadalakarañjārkapatrāṇāmanyatamakṛtayā gajāgrahastasaṃsthānayā vyāyāmadīrghayā vyāyāmārdhadīrghayā vā svāyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgamūlāgrapariṇāhasrotasā sarvato vātaharapatrasaṃvṛtacchidrayā dvistrirvā vinamitayā vātaharasnehābhyaktagātrasya voṣmamupāharet , bāṣpo'hyanṛjugāmī vihitacaṇḍavegastvacamavidahan sukhaṃ svedayatīti nāḍīsvedaḥ ’ | bhaṅgāḥ pallavāḥ | svāyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgamūlāgra-pariṇāhasrotaseti | vyāyāmadīrghayā vyāyāmārdhadīrghayā ceti | pramāṇaniyame ko hetuḥ ? brūmaḥ – vyādhyāturabalāpekṣayā , uttamabalavyādhāvāture ca vyāyāmadīrghā karttavyā , madhyabalaṃ hi vyādhimāturaṃ cāvekṣyamāṇena vyāyāmādhyardhadīrghayā dūragatvena vihitacaṇḍavegatā bhāvayet iti | iti nāḍīsvedaḥ bāṣpasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ ||3|| pariṣekasvedamāha -
