‘ vātikottaravātikānāṃ punarmūlaphalādīnāmutkvāthaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ kumbhīrvarṣaṇikāḥ praṇāḍīrvā pūrayitvā yathārthasiddhasnehābhyaktagātravastrāvacchannaṃ pariṣecayet iti pariṣekasvedaḥ’ dravasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ | iti pariṣekasvedaḥ ||4|| avagāhasvedamāha - ‘ vātaharotkvāthakṣīraghṛtapiśitarasonasalilakoṣṭakāvagāhastu yathokta evāvagāho jñeyaḥ’ | utkvāthairiti utkṛṣṭakvāthairityarthaḥ | dravyāccaturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaḥ kṛta utkṛṣṭaḥ kvātho bhavati ayaṃ dravasvedaḥ | ityavagāhasvedaḥ | jetākasvedamāha – atha jetākaṃ cikīrṣurbhūmiṃ parīkṣyeta – tatra pūrvasyāṃ diśi uttarasyāṃ vā guṇavati praśastabhūmibhāge deśe kṛṣmamṛttike suvarṇavarṇamṛttike vā nadīparivāpaḥ vāpīpuṣkariṇyādīnāṃ jalāśayānāmanyatamasya kūle dakṣiṇe paścime vā sutīrthe samavibhaktabhūmibhāgadeśe saptāṣṭau vā'ratnīḥ parikramodakān prāṅmukhodaṅmukhaṃ vā'bhimukhatīrthaṃ vā kūṭāgāraṃ kārayet | utsedhavistārasampannaṃ anekavātāyanamasya kūṭāgārasyāntaḥ samantato'bhivistārotsedhāṃ piḍikāṃ kārayet ākapāṭāt | madhye cāsya kūṭāgārasya catuḥkiṣkumātraṃ dvipuruṣapramāṇaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ kandukasaṃsthānaṃ bahusūkṣmacchidramaṅgārakoṣṭakastambhaṃ sapidhānaṃ kārayet | taṃ ca khādirāṇāmāśvakarṇikānāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā dīpayet | sa yadā jānīyāt dagdhāni kāṣṭhāni vigatadhūmāni avataptaṃ kevalamagninā tadagnigṛhaṃ svedayogyena yoṣmaṇā yuktamiti | tatra cainaṃ vātaharābhyaṅgābhyaktagātraṃ vastrācchannaṃ praveśayet | praveśayaṃścānuśiṣyet - ‘ saumya ! praviśārogyakalyāṇāya vā ’ iti praviśya caināṃ piṇḍikāmadhiruhya pārśvābhyāṃ yathāsukhaṃ śayīthāḥ | na ca te svedamūrchāparītenā'pi satā piṇḍikaiṣā prayoktavyā āprāṇocchvāsāt | bhraśyamāno hi yataḥ piṇḍikāvaśāt dvāramavadhiṃ gacchan svedamūrchāparītatayā sadyaḥ prāṇān jahyāt , tasmāt piṇḍikāṃ na kathañcana muñcethāḥ | sa yadā jānīyādvigatābhiṣyandamātmānaṃ samyak prastutasvedapicchaṃ sarvasrotovinirmuktaṃ laghubhūtamapagataṃ vibandhastambhagauravasuptivedanamiti | tatastāṃ piṭikāmanusaran dvāraṃ prapadyeta niṣkramya ca na sahasā cakṣuṣoḥ paripālanārthaṃ śītodakamanupraviśet | vyapagatasaṃtāpaklamaḥ sumuhūrtāt sukhoṣṇena vāriṇā yathānyāyaṃ pariṣikto'śnīyāt ’ iti jetākaḥ | ayaṃ cāgārakoṣṭastambho jetāka ucyate ‘bhūgṛheṣu sa jetākeṣu ’ iti vacanāt | taṃ khādirāṇāmāśvakarṇikānāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā dīpayet | iti jetākasvedaḥ sa ūṣmasvedāntarbhūtaḥ | iti jetākasvedaḥ ||6|| athāśmaghanasvedamāha - ‘ śayanasya pramāṇenā'śmamayīṃ śilāṃ tāpayitvā'nilaghnaistu dārubhiḥ sampradīpitaiḥ vyapohya sarvānaṅgārān prokṣya coṣṇavāriṇā śilāmatha kurvīta kauśeyā'vikasaṃstarām , kauśeyaprāvārādyaiḥ susaṃvṛttaḥ ityukto'śmaghanasvedaḥ ’ iti || ghanāṃ sthūlāṃ | nanu śilā yā sā'śmamayyeva punaraśmamayīmiti viśeṣaṇamanarthakam ? ucyate – sannahyārthāntarāṇi samānaśabdābhihitāni tenāśmaśabdaḥ kāṭhinye vartate iti | kaucavo mṛgaromamayīralikā, ajinaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgacarma, kauśeyaṃ traśaraṃ prāvāraḥ paṭṭikā ādigrahaṇātkambalorṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam | iti aśmaghanasvedaḥ, tāpasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ | ityaśmaghanasvedaḥ ||7|| atha karpūsvedaḥ pracakṣyate - ‘ khānayecchayanasyādhaḥ karpūsthānavibhāgavit | dīptairvidhūmairaṅgāraistāṃ karpūṃ pūrayennaraḥ | tatropariṣṭācchayane svapan svidyati nā sukham ’ iti karpūsveda ūṣmasvedabhedaḥ | iti karpūsvedaḥ ||8|| atha kuṭīsvedamāha - ‘ anatyutsedhavistarāṃ vṛttākārāmalocanām | ghanamitiṃ kuṭiṃ kṛtvā kuṣṭhādyaiḥ sampralepayet | kuṭīmadhye bhiṣak śayyāṃ svāstīrṇāṃ copakalpayet | prāvārājinakauśeyakuthakambalagauṇakaiḥ | hasantikābhiraṅgārapūrṇābhistāṃ ca sarvataḥ | āroheta parīvāryābhyaktaḥ svidyati nā sukham ’ iti || parivārya pariveṣṭya | iti kuṭīsvede svedabhedaḥ | iti kuṭīsvedaḥ ||9|| bhūsvedamāha - ‘ya evāśmaghanasvede vidhirbhūmau sa eva tu | praśastāyāṃ nivātāyāṃ samāyāmupadiśyate’ iti | ayamapyuṣṇasvedabhedaḥ | iti bhūsvedaḥ ||10|| atha kumbhīsvedamāha – kumbhīṃ vātaharakvāthapūrṇāṃ bhūmau nikhānayet | ardhamātraṃ tribhāgaṃ vā śayanaṃ tatra copari || sthāpayedāsanaṃ vā'pi nātisāndraparicchadam | atha kuṃbhyāṃ bhiṣak dadyātsutaptānāyaso guḍān || pāṣāṇān voṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati nā sukham | suvṛttāṅgaḥ svabhyaktaḥ snehairanilanāśanaiḥ || athavāpyūṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati pūrvavat ’ iti | ayamapyūṣmasvedāntarbhūtaḥ | iti kumbhīsvedaḥ | kūpasvedamāha - ‘ kūpaṃ śayanavistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ vāpi vaidyataḥ | deśe nivāte śakte ca sumṛṣṭaṃ kārayettataḥ || hastyaśvagokharoṣṭrāṇāṃ karīṣairdagdhapūritam ’ iti kūpasvedaḥ | ayaṃ coṣmasvedabheda eva kūpasvedaḥ ||12|| atha holākasvedamāha - ‘vītikāṃ tu karīṣāṇāṃ yathoktānāṃ pradīpayet | śayanāntaḥ pramāṇena śayyāmupari tatra ca | sudagdhāyāṃ vidhūmāyāṃ yathoktāmupakalpayet | svavacchannāṃ svayaṃ tasyāṃ svoktaḥ svidyati mānavaḥ || holākasveda ityeṣa sukhaḥ prokto maharṣiṇā’ iti | vītikā kumārikā holāsañjñitaḥ svedaḥ holāsvedaḥ | iti holāsvedaḥ | iti carakoktāstrayodaśasvedāste caturṣu svedādiṣvantarbhūtāḥ | ’rū. ’ | pittasaṃge dravo hita iti | pittayukte vāte dravasvedo hitaḥ pittasaṃge 'tra svedasaṃghāto vihitaḥ | vātakaphayor evaṃ svedaśaṃkaraḥ | yad uktaṃ carake - vātaśleṣmaṇi vāte vā kaphe vā sveda iṣyata iti | alpe pittasaṃsarge vāte dravasvedaḥ | sa coṣṇatvāt prabalau vātakaphau hanti | hīnapittaṃ tu dravatvena saukṣmyatvāt | vāgbhaṭe 'pi - ‘ svedas tāpopanāhoṣmadravabhedāś caturvidhāḥ ’ iti ||1||2||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svedaś caturvidhaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | caturvidhatvam āha – tāpoṣmau etau dvau svedasaṃjñitau bhavataḥ | upanāho dravaś ca etau dvau , evaṃ catvāraḥ sarvato vātaharāḥ vātahāriṇo bhavanti | caturvidhasvedasya vātanāśakatve 'pi viśeṣam āha – svedāv iti | topoṣmajau svedau śleṣmaghnau samudīritau kathitau | upanāhaḥ svedaḥ vātaghnaḥ pittasaṃyoge dravo dravaḥ svedyam atipittasaṅge vā tau | tathā ca suśrutaḥ - ‘tatra tāpoṣmasvedau viśeṣataḥ śleṣmaghnau, upanāhasvedo vātaghnaḥ | anyatarasmin pittasaṃsṛṣṭe dravasvedaḥ’ iti | anyatarasaṃsṛṣṭe vātamiśrite pitte dravaḥ svedo 'bhihitaḥ iti suśrutā'bhiprāyaḥ | kevalapitte tu sarva eva svedā niṣiddhāḥ | kiṃtu śītalajalāvagāha eva praśastaḥ tathā coktaṃ - ‘pariṣekāvagāheṣu vyañjanānāṃ ca sevanam | śasyate śiśiraṃ toyaṃ tṛṣṇāpittoṣmaśāntaye’ iti ||1||2||

ab.seg:
atha trividhasvedasya viśeṣam āha -
mahābale mahāvyādhau śīte svedo mahān smṛtaḥ |
durbale durbalaḥ svedo madhye madhyatamo mataḥ || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. mahābalapuruṣe mahāvyādhau ca kapholbaṇavātavikārādau | śīte śītale śītārditapuruṣe vā mahān svedo vihitaḥ | durbale puruṣe pittaprāye vā durbalaḥ svedo dravaprāyo vihitaḥ | madhye madhyamabalapuruṣe vātaprāye vā madhyaḥ madhyamaḥ sveda upanāhaprāyo vihitaḥ | tathā coktaṃ -‘tāpopanāhadravabāṣpapūrvāḥ svedās tato 'ntyaḥ prathamau kaphe staḥ | vāyau dvitīyaḥ pavanaṃ kaphe ca pittopasṛṣṭe vihitas tṛtīyaḥ ’ iti || 3 ||

atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa svedaviśeṣam āha –
balāse rūkṣaṇasvedo rūkṣasnigdhaṃ kaphānile |
kaphamedovṛte vāte koṣṇaṃ gehaṃ raveḥ karān ||4||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. balāse kaphe |rūkṣasvedaṃ vālukāvastrakapālāṃgārādinimittaṃ | kaphānile iti kaphānilasaṃsarge rūkṣasnigdham iti | tac ca śālvaṇaprabhṛtikaṃ | kaphamedovṛte vāte iti | medo hi sarvaśarīrāṇām udarastham aṇvasthiṣu ca | tathā hi ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tv abhyantarasthitā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate ’ iti | anena sakaphenāvṛte vāyau koṣṇagehādikaṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | koṣṇageham aṅgārādibhiḥ saṃtaptam ity arthaḥ | raveḥ karān sūryakiraṇān | niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddhaṃ | guruprāvaraṇam iti pravarājinakauśeyapraveṇīkuthakaprabhṛtikaṃ | kruddhaṃ kopaṃ pittajanakaṃ cintācittabhrāṃtikaraṃ vidhānaṃ medonāśakaratvāt | vyāyāmam iti śarīrāyāsajananam | viyuddhādivyatiriktaṃ karma etān āmayamuktaye kaphamedovṛtavātajanitarogaśāntyai seveta ātura iti śeṣaḥ | cintāsthāne bhayam iti kecit | tenāpi manaḥsaṃtāpatvāt krodhavat | tathā hi ‘vyāyāmoṣṇagṛhakṣudgurubalakrodhamānabhayasamarāḥ | upanāhasūryatāpau daśāgniguṇavarjitāḥ svedāḥ’ | bhayaṃ tu yathā unmādakāraṇam api tanmādyakaṃ syāt | yathā dṛśyate yat svedanaṃ calitasya sandheḥ punar ghaṭṭanena tena samyagavasthānaṃ tadvad ihāpi jñeyam ||4||5||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yādṛśe vāyau yādṛśaḥ svedo vihitaḥ tatprakāram āha – balāse iti | balāse kaphe | rūkṣaṇaḥ svedo vālukādibhir hitaḥ | kaphānile rūkṣasnigdhaṃ | kaphānile kaphavāte | kaphamedovṛte vāte koṣṇaṃ gehaṃ saṃseveta | raveḥ karān kiraṇān seveta | niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddham | mārgagamanaṃ guruprāvaraṇam | kopaṃ balādidhāraṇaṃ śītādīnāṃ śamanaṃ , cintāvyāyāmabharāṃś ca seveta | āmayamuktaye roganāśāya ||4||5||

ab.seg:
prāksvedyāḥ -
yeṣāṃ nasyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bastiś cāpi hi dehinām |
śodhanīyāś ca ye kecit pūrvaṃ svedyāś ca te matāḥ ||6||

Āḍhamalla. atha krameṇa ye pūrvaṃ svedyās tān āha - yeṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ nasyaṃ vidhātavyam iti nasyaṃ dātavyaṃ te nasyātmakasvedyā ity arthaḥ | na tu nasyaṃ vidhāya paścāt svedyā iti bhāvaḥ | yeṣāṃ dehināṃ bastir anuvāsananirūhākhyā dātavyā teṣām api pūrvaṃ svedakarma kāryaṃ, ye kiṃcic chodhanīyāḥ vamanavirekādiyogyās te 'pi pūrvaṃ svedyā ity artha: | paramārthatas tu virecane vidhātavye sati tryahaṃ snehapānaṃ paramam | vamane punar ekāhoparame svedaḥ | yad āha kaścit sudāntasenaḥ - ekāhaṃ dinam anyac ca kaphanut kleśyatakṣarair iti (?) || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pūrvaṃ ye svedyās tān āha - yeṣām iti | bhagandarī aśmaryāturaś ca ete trayaḥ pūrvaṃ svedyāḥ || 6 ||

paścāt svedyāḥ -
paścāt svedyā gate śalye mūḍhagarbhagade tathā |
kāle prajātā'kāle vā paścāt svedyā nitambinī ||7||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ ye paścāt svedyās tān āha - mūḍhagarbhādyupadrava ity eke | mūḍhagarbhagate tathety apīti pāṭhaḥ kaścit | arthād raktasrāvādyupadravarahitāḥ paścāt svedyā ity arthaḥ | kāle prasavasamaye prajātakāle samyagjātasamaye | nitambinī strī | tantrāntare 'pi ’paścāt svedyā hṛte śalye mūḍhagarbhā'nupadravā | samyakprajātakāle ca paścāt svedyā vijānateti’ | (cakradatte) ||7 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ye paścāt svedyās tān āha - paścād iti | gate śalye tathā mūḍhagarbhagade paścāt svedyāḥ | kāle prajātā navamamāsād agre prasūtā | akāle navamamāsād adhaḥ prasūtā vā nitambinī strī paścāt prasavāt svedyā ||7||

kāladvayasvedyān āha --
svedyā: pūrvaṃ trayaḥ’traya’ iti padaṃ plīhādīnāṃ labdhe tritve tridoṣajanyatvaparaṃ jñeyam | arśasa iti arśorogī ’arśa āditvādac’ plīhabhagandaryarśasas tathā |
aśmaryaś cāturo jantuḥ samaye śastrakarmaṇaḥ || 8 ||

Āḍhamalla. athobhayataḥ śodhyās tān āha | plīhabhagandarārśasāṃ traya eva doṣāḥ | traya evopadravā vāte cāpi vātādidoṣajanitā ity arthaḥ | tathetigrahaṇān naite pūrvaṃ svedyā: kiṃtu paścāt svedyā iti tātparyārthaḥ | tathā – coktaṃ - ’svedyāḥ punar ayathādāhanāntaram uṣṇāmbutaptakaṭāhopaveśanarūpam’ | evam anyad api yathāyogyaṃ boddhavyaṃ | jantur āturaḥ śastrakarmaṇaḥ śastravidhānasya samaye kāle plīhabhagandarādīn ity arthaḥ | śastrakarmaṇaḥ paścāt pūrvaṃ caite svedyā ity abhiprāyaḥ || 8 ||

div.ab:
svedakālaḥ -
savān svedān nivāte ca jīrṇāhāre ca kārayet |

Āḍhamalla. atha svedakālāvasthāṃ darśayitum āha | sarvān iti tāpoṣṇopanāhadravasaṃjñān nivāte vātarahitasthāne jīrṇāhāre sati ca | jīrṇāhāralakṣaṇaṃ coktam | tathā hi - ‘udgāraśuddhir utsāho vegotsargo yatheritā | laghutā kṣutpipāsā ca jīrṇāhārasya lakṣaṇami’ti | prāyeṇa tu viṣṭavdhe 'jīrṇepi svedo vihitaḥ | uktaṃ hi - ’viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ kārya’miti vacanāt ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svedān kārayed ity āha - sarvān iti | nivāte nirvātasthāne | tathā''hāre jīrṇe paripakve sati sarvān caturvidhān svedān kārayet ||

ab.seg:
svedaphalam -
svedād dhātusthitā doṣāḥ snehaklinnasya dehinaḥ ||9||

Āḍhamalla. atha svedād doṣasya yena vidhyapagamas tam āhala - doṣā vātādayaḥ | dhātusthitā iti | rasādidhātugatāḥ snehaklinnasya dehina iti | snehasvedābhyaktaśarīrasya puruṣasya | yataḥ snehasvedapūrvakam eva śodhanaṃ | dravatvaṃ prāpyeti doṣa eva yataḥ | ye mārgeṣu līnā svasthānasthā vā dhātusaṃsthā api vā te samyaksvedair yojitāḥ saṃtaḥ dravatvaṃ prāpya koṣṭhāntargatāḥ paścāc chodhanaiḥ kṛtvā śāntiṃ yāntīty abhiprāyaḥ | tathā coktaṃ ’snehāt klinnā dhātusaṃsthāś ca doṣāḥ svasthānasthā ye ca mārgeṣu līnāḥ | samyaksvedair yojitās te dravatvaṃ nītā: koṣṭhaṃ śodhane yānti śāntim’ iti || 9 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svedād doṣaḥ kathaṃ yātīty āha - svedād iti | svedād vālukādisvedāt | tathā snehasvinnasya tailāvagāhanādyaiḥ svinnasya dehinaḥ puruṣasya dhātusthitā doṣāḥ koṣṭhāntargatvā dravatvaṃ prāpya virekatāṃ yāntīti yojanā || 9 ||

sveditasya rakṣā |
svidyamānaśarīrasya hṛdayaṃnanu hṛdayadṛṣṭayoḥ prāk rakṣaṇamuktaṃ, iha tu mṛdusve- do'bhihita iti viruddham? maivam, carake tūttaratantre śūlādau svedo vihitaḥ sa tu saṃmilitākṣairbāhye kriyate, na dṛṣṭau | carake'pyayameva pāṭho likhitaḥ | tadagre ca madhyamaṃ akṣṇau śeṣamaṅgāvayavamiṣṭataḥ svedayet | ru. śītalaiḥ spṛśet || 10 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha sveditasyāśvāsanārthaṃ viṣayam āha -- svidyamānaśarīrasya snehābhyaktaśarīrasyeti pādadvayasyety ayam abhiprāyaḥ - anena pūrvaṃ snehābhyaktaśarīrasya paścāt sveditasya puruṣasyety arthaḥ | yataḥ sarvasvedeṣv api snehābhyaṅgo vihita iti prasiddhaḥ | tathā coktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena | nānābhyaktenāpi ca snigdhadehe svedo yojyaḥ svedavidbhiḥ kathaṃcit | dṛṣṭaṃ loke kāṣṭham asnigdham āśu tāpād bhayaṃ sveda- yogair gṛhītam iti | śītair ācchādya cakṣuṣī iti | sarvāṃgeṣu svede kriyamāṇe cakṣūrakṣaṇārtham uktaṃ śītair iti padmāpatrādibhiḥ | asyāgre ’hṛdayaṃ vṛṣaṇau dṛṣṭiṃ svedayen mṛdu naiva ve’ti kecit paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | atra cakṣuṣī ity upalakṣaṇatvāt hṛdayādirakṣaṇam eva kāryam ity anenaiva gṛhītārthatvāt || 10||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. doṣavireke jāte tatsthāpanārthaṃ cikitsitam āha - svidyamānaśarīrasyeti | bālukādeḥ svinnasya vireke sati hṛdayaṃ śītalaiḥ candanādibhiḥ spṛśet | snehābhyaktaśarīrasya snehasvinnasya śītaiḥ kamalakadalīpatrādyaiḥ cakṣuṣī ācchādya virekāt upācaret ity uttarakriyāsaṃbandhaḥ || 10 ||

asvedārhāḥ -
ajīrṇī durbalo mehī kṣatakṣīṇaḥ pipāsitaḥ ||11||

lg.l: madārto garbhiṇī caiva na hi svedyā vijānatā || 12||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha ye 'pi rogiṇo 'svedyās tān āha - ajīrṇītyādi | ete rogiṇo na svedyāḥ | yataḥ svedād api teṣāṃ dehanāśo bhavati, kadācin na bhavati tadā eteṣāṃ vikārā api sādhyatvaṃ yāntīti bhāvaḥ | ata eva vijānatā puruṣeṇeti grahaṇam | tathā hi - ’svedād doṣā yānti dehāvināśaṃ saṃsādhyatvaṃ yāṃti caiṣāṃ vikārāḥ’ iti bhāvaḥ | ajīrṇīti ajīrṇe bhakta iti sāmānyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa viṣṭabdhājīrṇī svedo vihitaḥ viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ kāryam iti vacanāt | yad uktam anyatrāpi - ‘svedaiḥ sādhyo durbalo 'jīrṇabhaktaḥ syātāṃ cedvau svedanīyau tatas tā’viti | śeṣaṃ subodhaṃcarake tu - ’kaṣāyamadyanityānāṃ garbhiṇyā raktapittinām| pittināṃ sātisārāṇāṃ rūkṣāṇāṃ madhumehināṃ | vida-gdhabhraṣṭabadhnānāṃ viṣamadyavikāriṇām | santāpānnaṣṭasaṃjñānāṃ sthūlānāṃ pittamehinām | tṛṣyatāṃ kṣudhitānāṃ ca kruddhānāṃ śocatāmapi | kāmalyudariṇāṃ caiva kṣatānāmāḍhyarogiṇāṃ | durvalātiviśuṣkāṇāmupakṣīṇaujasāṃ tathā | bhiṣakutaimirikāṇāṃ ca na svedamavatārayet’ iti | atra ’kaṣāya’śabdena kaṣāyamadyaṃ kaṣāyadravyakṛtamathavā kaṣāyaṃ madhu grāhyam | tasya ca kaṣāyavarge madhuravarge ca pāṭhāt | tasya ca svedāyogyatvāt | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ’pītadugdhadadhisnehamadhūnī’tyādi | etānityādi etānajīrṇyādīn svedasādhyān ātyayike rogotpattau mṛdu svedayet | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ’mṛdu vātyāyike gade’ iti| | || 11 || 12 ||

ab.seg:
kecid atrārdhaṃ paṭhanti-
’mṛdusvedaṃ prayuñjīta tathā hṛnmuṣkadṛṣṭiṣu || 13 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣāṃ svedo nocitas tān āha - ajīrṇīti | etān api mṛdusvedaiḥ svedasādhyān upācaret | ajīrṇo ajīrṇavān, durbalaḥ, mehī pramehavān, kṣatakṣīṇaḥ uraḥkṣatakṣīṇaḥ, mado madyajanitarogī | etān api svedasādhyān upācaret | keṣu ? mṛdusvedaṃ prayuñjīta ity āha | hṛt hṛdayam, muṣko 'ṇḍakoṣaḥ | dṛṣṭir netram || 13 ||

svedātiyogajā rogāḥ -
atisvedāt sandhipīḍā dāhatṛṣṇā klamo bhramaḥ |
pittāsṛkpiḍakākopas tatra śītair upācaret || 14 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha svedasyātiyogas tena doṣam āha - piḍakākoṭha iti sphoṭādīnām | athavā piḍakākoṭha iti pāṭhaḥ | koṭho varaṭīdaṣṭasaṃkāśaḥ tatra śītair upācared iti | pānābhyañjane cātra śītāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā vidhijñena iti śeṣaḥ | yad uktam ‘atisvinnam athāśvāsya śītāmbuvamanaṃ hita’miti | carake tu uktaḥ - ‘uktas tasyātiśaye graiṣmikaḥ sarvaśo vidhiḥ | sotisvinnasya kartavyo madhurasnigdhaśītalam’ iti || 14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atisvedāt kiṃ bhavatīty āha - atisvedād iti | atisvedāt saṃdhipīḍādayo bhavanti | klamaḥ glāniḥ, bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyeva | pittāsṛk pittaraktam | piṃḍakā sphoṭikā | tatra śītair upācared ity anvayaḥ | tathā coktaṃ - ‘svinne 'tyarthaṃ saṃdhipīḍāvidāhaḥ sphoṭotpattiḥ pittaraktaprakopaḥ | mūrcchā bhrāṃtir dāhatṛṣṇe klamaś ca kuryāt tūrṇaṃ tatra śītaṃ vidhānam’ iti || 14 ||

tāpasvedaḥ -
teṣu tāpābhidhaḥ svedo vālukāvastrapāṇibhiḥ |
kapālakandukāṅgārair yathāyogyaḥ prayujyate || 15 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ yat pūrvaṃ cāturvidhyam uktaṃ tad yogadvāreṇa prakaṭayann āha - teṣu pūrvoktatāpādisvedeṣu | tāpābhidhas tāpasvedaḥ | kapāla: kharparaḥ vālukādayo 'tra vahnisaṃtaptā jñeyāḥ | yathāyogya iti | yathādoṣāpekṣayā yathāsthānasthitavyādhyanurūpa ity arthaḥ | ayaṃ tāpasvedo 'bhihitaḥ || 15 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tāpādisvedānāṃ lakṣaṇam āha - teṣv iti | teṣu caturvidhasvedeṣu tāpādayaḥ svedā vālukādibhir yathāyogyaṃ prajāyante utpadyante | vālukā sikatā vastraṃ cīram, pāṇibhir hastaiḥ, kapālaḥ kharparaḥ, kandukaḥ vastrakandukaḥ, yad vā bahucchidro gṛhamadhye racitaḥ kandusaṃjñaḥ | tad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -’bahucchidro gṛhāntasthaḥ kandur jetāka ucyate’ iti | tasya nirmāṇaṃ carake likhitam - ‘aṅgāraiḥ khadirādyaiś ca nirdhūmair vālukātaptaṃ kṛtvā evaṃ pātrāntaritaiḥ svedaḥ aṅgārasya mṛtpātre sthāpayitvā svedaḥ kartavyaḥ’ iti || 15 ||

ūṣmasvedaḥ -
ūṣmasvedaḥ prayoktavyo lohapiṇḍeṣṭakāśmabhiḥ |
ataptair amlasiktaiś ca kāye naktakaveṣṭite || 16 ||

lg.l: uṣṇair ghaṭaṃ pūrayitvā pārśve chidraṃ vidhāya ca || 17 ||
evaṃ māṣādibhiḥ svinnaiḥ śayānaṃ svedam ācaret ||21||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athoṣmasvedavivakṣāyāṃ yogadvāreṇa taptarūpam āha - kāye naktakaveṣṭite iti | naktakāḥ vātaharavaṭapallavādayaḥ | tair veṣṭitaṃ śarīraṃ kṛtvā paścād vihitasvedadravyeṇa svedayed iti bhāvaḥ | anyad apy āha - athaveti | vātanirnāśadravyāṇi daśamūlaprabhṛtīni | teṣāṃ kvāthaṃ svarasaṃ ca yathāsaṃbhavaṃ ca grāhyaṃ pārśve chidraṃ vidhāyeti ghaṭapārśve nāḍikāmukhapramāṇaṃ randhraṃ kārayet | vimudryāsyam iti| ghaṭamukhaṃ mudrayed ity arthaḥ | nāḍikāghaṭasaṃdhim api mudrayed iti saṃpradāyaḥ | nāḍīsvarūpam āha -trikhaṇḍam ityādi | trikhaṇḍāṃ mṛdumadhyaprabalasvedaviṣayatvāt khaṇḍatrayayuktām ity arthaḥ | dhātujām iti suvarṇādidhātunirmitam | athavāpy abhāve kāṣṭhajām iti vaṃśādikāṣṭhaghaṭitām | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyām iti ṣaḍaṅgulaiḥ kuṇḍalākṛtim uttaralagnaṃ nāḍikāmukham iti bhāvaḥ | kiṃcid vimañcaghaṭalagnamukhaṃ bhavatīti gopucchākārānukārābhidhānatvāt saṃpradāyaviṣayaḥ | tena laghumukhaṃ ghaṭalagnaṃ kārayet | bṛhanmukham āturalagnam iti bhāvaḥ | dvihastakām iti dvihastaparimāṇaṃ trikhaṇḍānām ity arthaḥ | guruprāvaraṇaṃ tūlīprabhṛtikam | hastiśuṇḍikayety uktam api nāḍyākāraṃ draḍhayati na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | athavā hastiśuṇḍiketi nāmnā'sya svedasya saṃjñā vihitā | hastiśuṇḍiko 'yaṃ sveda iti tātparyārthaḥ | anyoṣmasvedavidhānam āha - puruṣāyāmamātrām iti | puruṣapramāṇaṃ yathā syāt| āyāmañ ca dīrghavistārayoḥ khādiraiḥ kāṣṭhair iti | khadiro raktasāraḥ | dagdhveti bhūgartasthānam iti śeṣaḥ | tatra kāṣṭhajvalanaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | tatheti paścāt kṣīrādibhiḥ kṛtvābhyukṣyeti | na tu kāṣṭhāṅgārāṇi tatratyopanīya kṣīradhānyāmlaprabhṛtīnām ekatamena kṛtvā tad eva sevayed iti bhāvaḥ | dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikaviśeṣam | tadabhāve takraṃ grāhyam iti vyavahārāt| paścāt kāryam āha - vātaghnapatrair ityādi | tatra vātaghnapatrair eraṇḍaprabhṛtikaiḥ | tac chayanaṃ bhūgartanirmitarūpam | tatpatrair ācchādya tatra vātārtapuruṣaṃ saṃviśya svedayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | evam ity anenaiva prakāreṇa svinnair māṣādibhir api śayanasvedam āvaraṇīyam | etad uktaṃ bhavati | māṣakvāthajalenāpi bhūgartasyeti siṃcanam | athavā svinnabāṣpaiḥ bāṣpaparisvinnaṃ vātārtam adhaḥsthaṃ svedayed ity eke || 16-21 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athoṣṇasvedaḥ - lohapiṇḍikeṣṭakādibhiḥ taptai: amlasaṃsiktaiḥ, punaḥ kāye dehe, rallakaveṣṭitair yaḥ svedaḥ sa uṣṇasvedaḥ | athavā pakṣāntare | vātanirnāśidravyakvātharasādibhiḥ ghaṭaṃ pūrayitvā pārśve tiryak chidraṃ kṛtvā āsyaṃ mukhaṃ vimudrya tasmin pārśve chidre dvihastikāṃ nāḍīṃ yuñjyāt | kiṃbhūtāṃ nāḍīṃ ? trikhaṇḍāṃ trigranthivaṃśajām | kāṣṭhajāṃ, dhātujāṃ dvihastikāṃ nāḍīṃ yuñjyāt | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāṃ gopucchāṃ veti vikalpaḥ | sukhopaviṣṭaṃ sukhena sthitam | svabhyaktaṃ kṛtatailābhyaṅgam | punaḥ guruprāvaraṇaṃ tūlādyair āvṛtam | anayā hastiśuṇḍikādhārayā nāḍyā vātarogiṇaṃ svedayet | apara uṣṇasvedaprakāraḥ - puruṣāyāmamātrāṃ puruṣapramāṇamātrāṃ bhūmim utkīrya khanayitvā khādiraiḥ kāṣṭhair dagdhvā tathā'mlamūtrādibhir abhyukṣyābhiṣiṃcya vātaghnapatrair ācchādya śayānaṃ svedayet || 16-21 ||

upanāhasvedam āha -
athopanāhasvedaṃ ca kuryād vātaharauṣadhaiḥ |
pradihya dehaṃ vātārtaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasānvitaiḥ || 22 ||

lg.l: kṣuṇṇaiḥ svinnaiś ca vastreṇa baddhaiḥ saṃsvedayen naram ||27||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athopanāhasvedavidhānam āha | upanāhaḥ koṣṇabahalālepaḥ bandhanam ity eke | vātaharauṣadhair iti kākolyādigaṇād yathālābhaṃ grāhyam iti vyavahāraḥ | kṣīramāṃsarasānvitair iti kṣīraṃ gavyaṃ tadabhāve ājaṃ sāmānyatvāc ca yathāyogyaṃ deyam iti | māṃsam atra grāmyānūpasaṃbhavaṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tasya rasaṃ māṃsarasam ity arthaḥ | amlapiṣṭair iti amlaiḥ kāñjikādibhiḥ | salavaṇair iti lavaṇo 'tra saindhavaṃ | snehasaṃyutair iti sneho 'tra caturvidho deyo yathāyogyasaṃbhavāt | ayam api śālvaṇasaṃjñaḥ | aparam apy upanāhavidhānam āha | grāmyānūpamāṃsādivānarībījaparyantadravye yathālābhaprāptaiḥ kṣuṇṇai: sūkṣmakuṭṭitaiḥ svinnaiḥ kathitaiḥ tadanu vastreṇa baddhvā poṭṭalikākāraiḥ saṃsvedayet | naram iti vātārtaṃ puruṣam | ayaṃ mahāśālvaṇasaṃjñayogaḥ prasiddha eva | yad uktam - ‘ānūpagrāmyamāṃsādyaiḥ svedaḥ śālvaṇako mata’ iti | grāmyāḥ aśvāśvataragokharorabhramedaḥpucchakaprabhṛtaya: | ānūpavargas tu | pañcavidha:| tad yathā kūlacarāḥ, pallavāḥ, kośasthāḥ, pādinaḥ, matsyāś ceti | tatra kūle caranti, te yathā -
‘tatrebha-mahiṣa-nyaṅku-ruru-rohita-śūkarāḥ |
khaṅgi-gokarṇa-camarāḥ - sṛmarāḥ kālapucchakaḥ |
kodrakāramaledyāś ca paśavaḥ kūlacāriṇaḥ’ | plavā yathā -
’haṃsa-sārasa-kādamba-krauñca-kāraṇḍava-plavāḥ|
balākā-baka-cakrāhvajīvajīvāmbukukkuṭā: |
utkrośa-puṇḍarīkākṣa-śaśarīmaṇituṇḍikāḥ |
kākatuṇḍadhanānāvamadgupuṣkaraśāyikāḥ |
kāvākṣimallikāśvetavarāhādyāḥ plavā smṛtāḥ’ | kośasthā yathā - ‘śaṅkhaḥ śaṅkhāṇakaḥ śuktir bhallūkaśambukādayaḥ | kośasthāś ca - udrakumbhīraśiśumārakumbhīrakāḥ | nakrakūrma-bhallūkādyāḥ pādinaḥ parikīrtitāḥ’ | matsyā yathā-‘gomatsyo marulaḥ kṛṣṇamatsyako bahulo rasaḥ | rājī cilici-mādyāś ca matsyāḥ proktāḥ samāsataḥ’ iti | ity ānūpamāṃsavargaḥ | eteṣāṃ svarūpam atra vistarabhayān na likhitaṃ | jīvanīyagaṇena veti | tad uktaṃ suśrute – kākolīkṣīrakākolījīvakarṣabhakau | mudgaparṇīmāṣaparṇīmedāmahāmedācchinnaruhākarkaṭa-śṛṅgītugākṣīrīṛddhivṛddhimṛdvīkājīvantyo madhukaṃ ceti jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ | dadhisauvīrakakṣīrair iti | sauvīrakaḥ kāñjikabhedaḥ | vīratarvādinā tatheti | vīratarvādigaṇaḥ suśrute 'vagantavyaḥ | vīratarusahacaradarbhavṛkṣādanīguṇḍānalakuśakāśāśmabhedakāgnimanthamoraṭavasukavasirabhallakakundurūke-ndīvarakapotavaṅkāśvadaṃṣṭrā ceti| śephālīsthūlajīrakair iti | śephālī nirguṇḍī ‘saṃbhārū’ iti loke | sthūlajīrakaḥ kṛṣṇajīraka:| eraṇḍasya mūlaṃ bījaṃ, ca grāhyaṃ | miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | kuṭherakaḥ khanāmaprasiddhaḥ | lavaṇair iti bahuvacanenātra pañcalavaṇāni yathāyogyaṃ deyāni | aparāṇy api pāṃśukṣāraprabhṛtīni grāhyāṇi na doṣaḥ | amlasaṃyutair iti amloṣṇavargo hito grāhyaḥ | balābhir iti bahuvacanād balācatuṣṭayeṣu yathālābham iti yojyam | daśamūlaḥ prasiddhaḥ sa ca daśadravyair militaḥ | tad yathā -
’śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā |
tathā gokṣurakaś caiva laghumūlam iti smṛtam |
bilvo 'gnimanthaḥ syonākaḥ kāśmaryaḥ pāṭalās tathā | jñeyaṃ mahatvaṃ mūlaṃ ca daśamūlam ubhe smṛta’miti | vānarībījair iti kapikacchūbījaiḥ | etair dravyair vyastair vā yogā boddhavyāḥ bhinnatṛtīyāntapadatvāt | śeṣaṃ subodham || 22-27 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athopanāhasvedaḥ - vātaharauṣadhair daśamūlādibhir upanāhaṃ svedaṃ kuryāt | kiṃ kṛtvā ? vātārtadehaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasānvitaiḥ pradihya pralepaṃ kṛtvā | uta amlapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiś ca pradihya | atha mahāśālvaṇasvedavidhānam āha - grāmyāḥ chāgorabhrādayaḥ, anūpā matsyacakravākādayaḥ | jīvanīyagaṇaś cūrṇoktaḥ | sauvīraṃ kāñjikam | kṣārair yavakṣārasvarjīṭaṅkaṇaiḥ | vīratarvādiś ca pūrvoktaḥ | atasī prasiddhā, śephālī nirguṇḍī, miśiḥ śatapuṣpā, kuṭheraḥ vāvarī | lavaṇaiḥ saindhavādyaiḥ | pañcabhir amlair dāḍimādyaiḥ | vānarī kapikacchū: | etair yathālābhaṃ samāhṛtair ānītaiḥ, kṣuṇṇaiḥ kuṭṭitaiḥ, svinnaiḥ sveditaiḥ, punarvastreṇa baddhaiḥ svedayet || || 22-27 ||

dravasvedavidhi: |
dravasvedas tu vātaghno dravyakvāthena pūritam || 28 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dravasvedavidhim āha - dravasveda iti | pittasaṃge dravo hita iti pūrvoktatvāt | vātaghnadravyakvātheneti vātaghnadravyaṃ kākolyādigaṇapramukhaṃ tac ca pūrvaṃ vyākhyātaṃ | kaṭāhaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ ca | dvividham iti dravasvedaṃ | vā grahaṇāt carmadroṇīprabhṛtikam api yathālābhaṃ dravasvedavidhau grāhyam || 28 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vātaghnaṃ daśamūlādyaṃ dravyam | tatkvāthena pūrite kaṭāhe tāmrādikoṣṭhake vā sūpaviṣṭaḥ sukhena sthitaḥ avagāhayet || 28 ||

idānīṃ dravasya parimāṇam āha -
nābheḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvan magnaḥ kvāthasya dhārayā || 29 ||

lg.l: koṣṇayā skandhayoḥ siktas tiṣṭhet snigdhatanur naraḥ |
evaṃ tailena, dugdhena, sarpiṣā svedayen naram || 30 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. ’nābher ityādi | yāvan nāmer ūrdhvaṃ sūpaviṣṭaḥ puruṣo magno bhavati tāvat kvāthādikaṃ dhārayet yojayed ity arthaḥ | ity evaṃ kaṭāhāvagāha iva parimāṇam | koṣṭhe tūtthitaḥ puruṣo yāvat skandhayor upari sikto magnaḥ tāvat tiṣṭhed ity abhiprāyaḥ | snigdhatanutā sarvasvede 'pi boddhavyā evam uktaprakāreṇaiva tailādināpi yathāyogyaṃ svedayedinanu snigdhasyaiva svedādhikārātpunaḥ snigdhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? ucyate - punargrahaṇaṃ tatsamayasnigdhatādyotanārtham | ru. tyarthaḥ || 29 || 30 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tasya vidhānam āha - snigdhatanuḥ kṛtatailābhyaṅgaḥ | koṣṇayā dhārayā sthitaḥ skandhayoḥ siktaḥ | kvāthena dhārayā nābheḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvan magnas tāvat tiṣṭhet | evaṃ tailena dugdhena sarpiṣā ghṛtena vā svedayet | ayaṃ dravasvedaḥ || 29 || 30 || avagāhanakālaniyamaḥ |

Āḍhamalla. athāvagāhanakālaniyamam āha - athāvagāhane yathādau snehayuktaḥ snehāvagāhas tadā ekāntara ekadyantara: dvyantaro dvidināntaro vā kartavya iti vyavasthāviṣayaḥ | na tu sarvāvagāhane niyamanam idaṃ | nanv atra kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ, tantrāntare tu na kṛtaḥ, tathā pūrvam uktaṃ - nābher ūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaṃ kvāthatailādidhāraṇam | tantrāntare tu anyathā | vaidyālaṃkāre -
’kaṭāhe mṛṇmaye pātre kiṃ vā pāṣāṇasaṃbhave |
ākaṇṭhamagno nivaset praharaṃ prātar eva vā ||
romānteṣv anukūpeṣu sthitvā mātrā śatatrayam |
tataḥ praviśati snehaiś caturbhir gacchati tvacam |
pañcabhiś ca bhajed raktaṃ ṣaḍbhir māṃsaṃ prapadyate |
medaḥ - sthānaṃ saptaśatair aṣṭabhiś cāsthiṣu vrajet ||
navabhir yāti majjānaṃ tato mātrāṃ na kārayet |
tatas tu rogān saṃgṛhya vātapittakaphodbhavān ||
srotasāṃ mārdavakaraḥ kaphavātavināśanaḥ |
dhātūnāṃ puṣṭijanano balavarṇakaraḥ paraḥ || vātarogān aśeṣāṃś ca jayed eṣa viśeṣataḥ’ iti | anyatrāpi kaṇṭhaparyantadhāraṇam uktaṃ yathā -
droṇīkāṣṭhasya tailena sukhoṣṇena prapūrayet |
tatra sthitvā yathā mātrā kaṇṭhaparyantam āhanum ||
sukhinaḥ sukumārasya sukhārthī śramapīḍitaḥ |
gāhayet ghaṭikāsārdhaṃ tailadroṇyāṃ ca yatnataḥ ||
tato niḥsṛtya hastābhyāṃ khaṭvāyāṃ carmake punaḥ |
sukhena mardanaṃ kṛtvā yāvat tailaṃ viśudhyati || udvartanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt snānaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam || tvaci kāntikaraṃ sadyaḥ pāruṣyaṃ na vinaśyati ||
balapuṣṭikaraṃ sadyo vātarogaṃ ca nāśayet |
anye ca tvagbhavā rogā mandānalasamudbhavāḥ ||
yasya śuṣyati sarvāṅgaṃ gatiryasya tu vihvalā |
tasya droṇyāṃ ca taileṣu gāhayed ghaṭikātrayam ||
kṣīṇendriyāḥ kṣīṇaśukrā jvarakṣīṇāś ca ye narāḥ |
vātārtau vṛṣaṇau yeṣām antravṛddhiś ca dāruṇā ||
paṅgulaḥ pīṭhasarpī ca gṛdhrasī vātaśūlavān |
kalāyakhañjakaṃ tūnīṃ pratūnīṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || etat sarvān nihanty āśu channābhram iva mārutam’ iti | tenātra śārṅgadharoktaṃ kālaniyamavacanaṃ sukumārādiviṣayam | tathā nābher ūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulagrahaṇaṃ hṛdayarakṣārthaṃ, tantrāntaroktaṃ dāruṇavātarogagrastaviṣayaṃ | kaṇṭhaparyantāvagāhanaṃ tu sukumārādiviṣayam | ata evoktaṃ carake -
‘padmotpalapalāśair vā svedyaḥ saṃvṛttya cakṣuṣī |
muktāvalībhiḥ śuddhābhiḥ śītalair bhojanair api || jalārdraiḥ sajalair hastaiḥ svidyato hṛdayaṃ spṛśet’ iti | netrahṛdayarakṣārthaviṣayam idaṃ śārṅgadharavacanaṃ jñeyam ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yathāyogyam ekāntare dvyantare vā'vagāho yuktaḥ ||

ab.seg:
avagāhanaphalam -
sirāmukhai romakūpair dhamanībhiś ca tarpayet || 31 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha samyaksnehāvagāhane phalam āha - avagāhane yuktaḥ sneha ekāntarādividhinā samyak prayuktaśīlaḥ | tādṛśa eva śirādis tarpayan san śarīre balam ādhatte tarpayan dhātūn iti śeṣaḥ | yad uktaṃ -‘mātrābhis triścatuḥpaccaṣaṭsaptāṣṭabhir āvrajet | rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjādhātūn yathākrama’miti | mātrāyāś ca prasaṃgato lakṣaṇaṃ saṃkhyā ca likhyate | yathā –
sphajāūnaḥ - karāvartaṃ kuryāt tāṃ sphoṭikāyutām |
eṣā mātrā bhaved ekā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ | saṃkhyā yathā - ‘vedanopaśamaḥ pañcaśatasaptaśatāni vā | sahasraṃ vāpi mātrāṇāṃ kuryād doṣabalābala’mityādi | śirāmukhai romakūpair iti | śirāṇāṃ mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhānīti bhāvaḥ | sirāś ca doṣādivahā iti granthakāraḥ sandhibandhanakāriṇyo doṣādhātuvahāḥ śirā iti | tāś ca sthūlasūkṣmabhedenāpi dvidhā bhavanti tāsāṃ nābhimūlatvād adhas tiryak ca prasaraḥ | tathā hy uktam - ’yāvantyas tu sirāḥ kāye saṃbhavanti śarīriṇām | nābhipravṛddhāḥ sarvās tāḥ pratanvanti samantata’ iti | dhamanībhiś ceti | dhmānād anilāpūraṇād dhamanyo rasavahāś caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ | etāś cāpi nābhiprabhavā abhihitāḥ | cakārāt tāsām api mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhāni jñātavyāni | yataḥ ye svedam abhivahanti rasaṃ cābhitarpayanty antarbahiś ca | tair eva cābhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhālepanavīryāṇy antaḥ śarīram abhipratipadyanta iti ||31 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tasya phalam āha - sirāmukhair lomakūpair lomavivarair dhamanībhir nāḍībhiś ca tarpayet | tadā śarīre balam ādhatte || 31 ||

dhātuvardhanam āha -
jalasiktasya vardhante yathā mūle 'ṅkurās taroḥ || 32 ||

lg.l: dīptāgnau mārdave jāte svedanād viratir matā || 34 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha snehāvagāhanād vāyuvṛddhau satyāṃ taddṛṣṭāntenāsya prādhānyam āha | mūle pānīyasiktasya vṛkṣasya yathāṅkurāḥ pallavādirūpā vardhante tadvad atrāpi dhātuvṛddhau boddhavyaṃ | nātaḥ para iti | asmāt snehāvagāhanāt aparo vātanāśako yogo na pradhāna iti bhāvaḥ | atha svedakarmaṇo virativiṣayam āha - śītaśīlādyuparame iti | śūlaśāntau satyāṃ śūlaśabdena vātādijanito vedanāsamūho boddhavyaḥ | stambho gauravaṃ cāṃgānāṃ tayor nirgraho nāśaḥ | tasmiñ jāte sati dīptāgnau sati | mārdavam api aṅgānāṃ mṛdutā tasminn api jāte sati viratir viśrāmaḥ; tena ebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ svedaguṇo 'vagantavyaḥ | tathā hy uktam - ’agnau dīpte mārdavaṃ tvakprasādaṃ bhaktaśraddhāṃ srotasāṃ nirmalatvam | kuryāt svedas tandranidre ca hanyāt sandhīn bandhāṃś ceṣṭayed āśu yukta’ iti | sauṣadhasvedātiyogalakṣaṇam uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -
’pittāsrakopatṛṇmūrcchāsvarāṅgasadanabhramāḥ |
sandhipīḍājvaraḥ śyāvaraktamaṇḍaladarśanam | svedātiyogāc chardiś ca tatra stambhanam auṣadham’ iti || 32-34 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svedanāt kadā nivṛttirbhavati ? ity atrāha - śīta iti | śītaśūlādīnām uparame nivṛtte sati stambhagauravayor nigrahe sati, mārdave mṛdutve sati dehasyaiva tadā svedanād viratir nivṛttir matā || 32-34 ||

susvinnasya paścāt karma darśayati -
samyak svinnaṃ vimṛditaṃ snānam uṣṇāmbubhiḥ śanaiḥ |
bhojayec cānabhiṣyandi vyāyāmaṃ na ca kārayet ||35||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe svedavidhir nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

Āḍhamalla. vimṛditam iti | snehāvagāhānantaraṃ sukhamardanam, uṣṇāmbubhir uṣṇodakaiḥ snānam, anabhiṣyandi bhojayet | jāṭharāgne: saṃdīpanārthaṃ vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma | kecit - ’vyāyāmaṃ na ca kārayet’ ity atra - ‘sarvatrācāram ācaret’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti | tatra ācāraḥ snehācaraṇaṃ, tac ca vāgbhaṭe 'py uktam -
‘uṣṇodakopacārī syād brahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ |
na vegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān |
pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitīḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhaḥsvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti || 35 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe svedādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svedānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryād ity āha - samyak svinnaṃ samyak sveditam | punaḥ vimṛditaṃ kṛtābhyaṅgam | paścāc channair uṣṇāmbunā kuryād iti pūrvakriyāsambandha: | anabhiṣyandi sroto rodhi bhojayet | vyāyāmaṃ śramādyaṃ na kārayet | suśrute caturvidhaḥ navasvedaḥ kathitaḥ | cakārād vāgbhaṭādau trayodaśavidhaḥ | granthajñāpanārthaṃ tad api likhyate | tad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -
’śaṅkaraḥ prastaro nāḍī pariṣeko 'vagāhanam |
jetāko 'śmaghanaḥ karpū: kuṭī, kumbhī tathā ca bhūḥ || kūpo lohākaraś caite svedāś caiva trayodaśa’ iti | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe darśitam || 35 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe svedādhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

div.head: atha vamanavidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athedānīṃ kṛtasnehasvedasya śodhanādhikāraḥ | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā vā srotolīnā ye ca śākhā'sthisaṃsthāḥ | doṣāḥ svedais te dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyak śuddhibhir nirhriyante’ iti | atra śuddhibhir iti bahuvacanagrahaṇāt pañcakarmaṇāṃ grahaṇam | tenā'trādau sthānānurodhāt prāk vacanaṃ paścād virecanādīti | ata evāha -

ab.seg:
vamanapradhāno vidhiḥ vamanavidhiḥ śodhanaprakāraḥ | ata evāha -
śaratkāle vasante ca prāvṛṭkāle ca dehinām |
vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva kārayet kuśalo bhiṣak || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. ūrdhvabhāgadoṣanirharaṇaṃ vamanam, adhobhāgadoṣanirharaṇaṃ virecanam | cakārād vastinasyādayaḥ | vamanādīnāṃ kālam āha - śaratkāle ityādi | śaratkālādiśabdais tatsamīpasādhāraṇakāla upalakṣyate | uktaṃ ca - ’śrāvaṇe kārtike caiva māsi sādhāraṇe kramāt | grīṣmavarṣāhimacitān vāyvādīn āśu nirharet’ iti | kuśalo bhiṣag iti | doṣadeśakālasātmyaprakṛtivayovahridhātumalaviśeṣajñāne śodhane ca kuśala: iti || 1 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svedānantaraṃ vamanasyoktatvād vamanam āha - tatrādau vamanakālam āha - śarad iti | śaratkāle vasante prāvṛṭkāle eṣu triṣv eva ca dehināṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vamanaṃ recanaṃ ca kārayet | yaḥ kuśalo bhiṣak pravīṇavaidyaḥ sañcayaṃ jñātvā vamanonmukhaṃ doṣaṃ jñātvā, anyathā svasthaviṣaye doṣadarśanāt | tathā coktaṃ granthāntare - ’bhiṣajaḥ śodhanaṃ prāhur varjyaḥ svasthena sarvadā | pannagasya vadhovaṃkṣṇe doṣasya samudīraṇam’ iti | nanu śaratkāle pittasyā'pi vamanaṃ yuktaṃ vasante kaphasyā'pi vamanaṃ recanaṃ yuktam | dvayoḥ prāvṛṭkāle vā hetutvāt kathaṃ vamanaṃ recanaṃ dīyate tatra vātādhikyaṃ kathaṃ syāt ? ucyate - varṣākāle niṣedho, na prāvṛṭkāle | tathā coktam agniveśena - ‘ativiṣṭenātigharme prāvṛḍ ity abhidhīyate | tatraiva śodhanaṃ pathyaṃ varṣāsu kadācana’ iti | śodhanena sarvadoṣanāśo bhavatīty eke | tathā coktaṃ tīsaṭe - ’prāvṛṭghanātyayavasantadineṣu yasmāt prādurbhavanti pavanādirujas tataś ca | vātādidoṣavigamāc ca śarīraśuddhiḥ’ iti | ambudāgamaśaranmadhuvāsareṣu agniveśena triṣv eva ca śodhanaṃ nānyeṣu | tathā coktaṃ - ’triṣu tv anuśītatvāt preṣṭhaṃ śeṣeṣu śodhanam | hitaṃ bhavati yasmāc ca tatra hetuṃ nibodha me’ iti || 1 ||

vāmyāḥ -
balavantaṃ kaphavyāptaṃ hṛllāsādinipīḍitam |
tathā vamanasātmyaṃ ca dhīracittaṃ ca vāmayet ||2||

Āḍhamalla. saṃprati vamanārhatvam āha - balavantam iti vamanasāmarthyayuktaṃ | kaphavyāptam iti kapholbaṇagadāvyāptahṛllāsaḥ uparisthitivamanatā tadādirogapīḍitam ity arthaḥ | ādiśabdāt kāsaśvāsātmapittate ca vāgbhaṭoktāḥ - ‘viśeṣaṇa tu vāmayet | navajvarātisārādha:pittāsṛgrājayakṣmiṇaḥ | kuṣṭhamehāpacīgranthiśrlīpadonmādakāsinaḥ | śvāsahṛllāsavīsarpastanyadoṣordhvarogiṇa’ iti prabhṛtayaḥ | vamanasātmyam iti | vamanaṃ sātmyaṃ yasya tat tathā te | puruṣam iti śeṣaḥ | dhīracittaṃ na kātaram ity aryaḥ || 2 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣu vamanaṃ deyaṃ tān āha - hṛllāso hṛdayanirgamaḥ | upasthitavamanam ity anye | vamanasātmyaṃ vamanasahajam || 2 || vamanārhā rogāḥ -

ab.seg:
vamanārhā rogāḥ -
viṣadoṣe stanyadoṣe mando 'gnau śrlīpade 'rbude |
hṛdroga-kuṣṭha-vīsarpa-mehā-jīrṇa-bhrameṣu ca || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha ye rogā vāmyās tān āha - viṣa iti | nanu apasmārādīnām anilapradhānatvāt katham atra vamanaṃ yuktam ? ucyate, pāṇḍurogī kṛmivyāpta iti vakṣyamāṇavyāptaśabdena pravṛddhapāṇḍuroge niṣiddhopakrame kaphāvasthāyāṃ ca mṛdu jñeyaṃ | yad uktaṃ ‘pāṇḍuroge bhiṣak kuryād ūrdhvādhaḥśodhanaṃ sadā’ iti | atra ūrṣvaśodhanaṃ vamanādikam | adhaḥ śodhanaṃ virecanaṃ | virecanaṃ cātra tīkṣṇam eva, ‘vātasya tīkṣṇāny anulomanānī’ti vacanāt || 3-5 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. stanyadoṣe mātṛdugdhodbhave | vidārī rogaviśeṣaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 3-5 ||

athāvāmyān āha -
na vāmanīyas timirī na gulmī nodarī kṛśaḥ || 6 ||

lg.l: nātivṛddho garbhiṇīṃ ca na sthūlo na kṣudhāturaḥ |
madārto bālako rūkṣaḥ śudhitaś ca nirūhitaḥ || 7 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. timiraprabhṛtibhir vyādhibhir vyāptāḥ puruṣā na vāmanīyā ity abhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ -‘avamyavamanād rogāḥ kṛcchratāṃ yānti dehinaḥ | asādhyatāṃ vā gacchanti naite vāmyā hy atiśrutā’ iti | duśchardir ity anena yat sāmānyaṃ tathāpi bahudoṣānvitaś chardyāṃ vamanaṃ kāryaṃ na doṣaḥ | yad uktaṃ suśrute -‘chardiṣu bahudoṣāsu vamanaṃ hitam ucyate’ iti || 6-8 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣāṃ vamanaṃ na deyaṃ tān āha - ete timiryādayaḥ na vāmanīyāḥ || 6-8 ||

atha yady apy ete 'py ajīrṇādivyāpitās tadā vāmanīyā iti vicāryāha -
ete 'py ajīrṇavyathitā vāmyā ye viṣapīḍitāḥ |
kaphavyāptāś ca te vāmyā madhukvāthasya pānataḥ || 9 ||

lg.l: sukumāraṃ kṛśaṃ bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ bhīruṃ ca vāmayet |
asātmyaiḥ śleṣmalair bhojyair doṣān utkliśya dehinaḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. ete pūrvoktās timiryādayaḥ te yadā ajīrṇavyathitā upaviṣapīḍitāḥ kaphavyāptā vā bhavanti tadā vāmyā ity abhiprāyaḥ | kaphavyāptā iti niyatam | tathā hi - ‘kaphaje vamanaṃ śastaṃ recanaṃ pittaje gade | bastir vātagate kāye āmaye tv āmapācana’m iti | kena vāmyās tam āha - madhukvāthasya pānata iti | madhukvātho madhuyaṣṭīkvāthaḥ | yad vā madhu kṣaudraṃ | kvāthaṃ kvathitaṃ jalaṃ | anyad vihitadravyaśṛtaṃ vā prakaraṇatvāt | kaṣāyaś cātra sarvaḥ koṣṇaḥ kārya iti carakavacanāt | uṣṇavirodhitvena madhūṣṇaṃ niṣiddham iti vivakṣāyāṃ na cātra madhūṣṇaṃ viruddhaṃ | yad uktaṃ - ‘pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivārayet | alaghvapākam āśv eva tayos tasmān nivartate’ iti | ata eva yāty adhodoṣam ādāya pacyamānaṃ virecanaṃ | guṇotkarṣaṇāt dūrdhvam apakvaṃ vamanaṃ punar iti | yadā'jīrṇādipīḍitatimirādayo 'pi sukumārādiṣu bhavanti tadā vakṣyamāṇaprayogenaiva vāmyā ity ata āha - vamanasādhyavikārapīḍitāḥ sukumārādayo 'pi yavāgvādīnām anyatamenākaṇṭhaṃ pāyayitvā vāmayed ity arthaḥ | yavāgv apy anena kaphakaratvāt kaphotkleśanārthamityabhiprāyaḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘pāṃśudhānye yathā vṛṣṭiḥ kledayaty atikardamam | tathā śleṣmaṇi saṃvṛddhe yavāgū śleṣmavardhanī’ti | ity abhiprāyaviṣayaṃ vakṣyamāṇenaiva caritārthatvāt | kṣīratakradadhi yathādoṣāpekṣayā vyastaṃ deyaṃ | pūrvam uktaṃ vakṣyamāṇenaiva caritārthatvāt tān āha -
‘asātmyaiḥ śleṣmalair bhojyair doṣān ukteś ca dehinaḥ |
snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate | snigdhasvinnāyeti snehapānapūrvakāya khedapūrvakāya puruṣāyety arthaḥ | na tu snehasvedāyeti, yataḥ snehapānād ekāham uparatam aparādinā etat svinnam iti prasiddhiḥ | bhālukinā snehapānāt tryahena vamanaṃ darśitaṃ | tad yathā ‘snigdhasvinnaśarīrasya dadyāt pracchardanaṃ tryahāt | daśarātre gate vānte bhūyo dadyād virecana’m iti || 9-11 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. eteṣv api ajīrṇavyathitā vāmyāḥ, kaphavyāptāś ca vāmyāḥ | madhūko guḍapuṣpaḥ tatkvāthapānataḥ | kṛśabālavṛddhānām api punaruktiviśeṣaniṣedhārthaḥ | vamanādau yad vihitaṃ tad āha -
‘naraḥ śvo vamanaṃ pātā bhuñjīta kaphavardhanam |
sujaraṃ dravabhūyiṣṭhaṃ laghu śītaṃ virecanam ||’ iti | yavāgūm ākaṇṭhaṃ pītvā asātmyaiḥ arucyaiḥ śleṣmavardhakai: bhojyair vā doṣān utkleśya dehinaḥ puruṣasya snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate | snigdhāya kṛtaghṛtapānāya sveditāya | nanu snehapānāt svedāt kadā vamanaṃ deyam ? tad āha granthāntarāt - atra nāsti | tathā ca bheḍaḥ
‘ekāhaṃ parataḥ snehāt sthitvā pracchardanaṃ pibet |
bhuktvā grāmyodakair māṃsair anūpaiś ca susaṃskṛtaiḥ | trirātrāt paratas tadvat svedāt prakledanaṃ pibet iti || 9-11 ||

div.ab:
?madhusaindhavayoḥ prādhānyam -
vamaneṣu ca sarveṣu saindhavaṃ madhu‘vā’ śabdo'tra na bhinnakrame, apiśabdārthe dvayorapyekatra yogāt | uktaṃca vāmmaṭe-’yathāvikāravihitāṃ madhusaindhavasaṃyutām | koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajvamātrāṃ madhābhimadhitām | brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkā'nilā'nalāḥ | ṛṣaya: sauṣaghigrāmā bhūtasaṃghāśca pāṃtu vaḥ | rasāyanamivaṣīṃṇāmamarāṇāmivā'mṛtam | sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamastu te || oum namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyagurave vaiḍūrya prabharājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | tadyathā- oum bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajye mahābhaiṣajye samudgate svāhā | prāḍmukhaṃ pālyetpīte muhartamanupāyayet’ ityādi | ru. vā hitam |

Āḍhamalla. atha vamanadravyeṣu madhusaindhavayor viśeṣeṇaivopādeyatvam āha | madhusaindhavayor abhimantraṇaṃ ca sarvatraiva jñeyaṃ | yad uttaṃ ‘yathāvyādhi ca vihitaṃ madhusaindhavasaṃyutaṃ | koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajyamātrāṃ maṃtrābhimantritā’m ityādi | atroṣṇe 'pi kaṣāye madhusaindhave na viruddhe | namanasyāpakvasyaivordhvagamanatvāt | vaidyās tv atra yoge pākasaṃbhavaṃ manyamānā madhu na prakṣipante iti kecit | mantraś ca ‘brahmadakṣāśvirudrendre’tyādiśloko jñeyaḥ |
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. carakāt vamaneṣu yad dhitaṃ tad āha - vamaneṣu vamanadravyeṣu sarveṣu vakṣyamāṇeṣu saindhavaṃ madhu vā hitam ||

ab.seg:
vamanārhaṃ dravyam -
bībhatsaṃ vamanaṃ dadyāt viparītaṃ virecanam || 12 ||

Āḍhamalla. kīdṛśaṃ vamanārhaṃ dravyaṃ deyaṃ tad āha - bībhatsavikṛtarasavarṇaprāyaṃ vamanaṃ vamanadravyam ity arthaḥ | tena lālādullāsakaradravyam ity abhiprāyaḥ | viparītaṃ virecanam iti viparītaṃ bībhatsadravyāt | tena bhakṣaṇe manojñam avikṛtam ity arthaḥ || 12 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamanaṃ bībhatsaṃ saghṛṇaṃ, virecanaṃ ghṛṇādirahitam || 12 ||

kvāthyakvāthayor mānam -
kvāthyadravyasya kuḍavaṃ śrapayitvā jalāḍhake |
ardhabhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca vamaneṣv avacārayet || 13 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ kvāthyakvāthayor mānam āha - kvāthyadravyaṃ paṭolavāsānimbaprabhṛtikaṃ, teṣu kuḍavamitaṃ catuḥpalapramāṇaṃ | jalāḍhaka iti catuḥṣaṣṭipalamite pānīye ardhabhāgāvaśiṣṭam iti prasthadvayamitaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | ayaṃ parimāṇo 'py aikadaiva pānāśaktatvād vibhajya deyaḥ | kvāthabahutve tu sajalaguṇo yady ayogaḥ syāt tadā sa eva punaḥ peya iti vyavahārād ayam evāvagantavyaḥ | kaṣāyam api pūrṇaśarāvaṃ pāpayed ity uktaṃ tathehā'pi kaṣāyapānavyavastheti kecit || 13 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamane kvāthyadravyaparimāṇam āha - kuḍavaṃ catuḥpalam | kvāthyadravyasya jalādeḥ catuḥprasthake śrapayitvā ardhaṃ śritaṃ vamaneṣv avacārayet || 13 ||

bheḍamatena vamane kvāthapānamātrā -
kvāthapāne navaprasthā jyeṣṭhā mātrā prakīrtitā |
madhyamā ṣaṇmitā proktā triprasthā ca kanīyasī ||14||

Āḍhamalla. atha kvāthyakvāthādīnāṃ pāne 'tra mānam āha - ṣaṇmiteti | ṣaṭprasthā kanīyasī laghvī | etat parimāṇaṃ paścāj jalapānasyāhuḥ | anyathā pūrvāparayor avyavasthā syāt | yad vā pūrvaparimāṇaṃ tu yavāgvādīnāṃ pācanārtham abhihitaṃ | paścāt kvāthapānasyety arthaḥ | tatra yavāgvā dyupakalpayed iti pāṭhāntare vṛndoktamātrayā vyavahāraḥ iti cakra: | carake tu ‘madanaphalakaṣāyamātrāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ tu khalu sarvasaṃśodhanamātrāpramāṇāni pratipuruṣamavekṣitavyāni bhavanti | yāvad dhi yasya saṃśodhanaṃ pītaṃ vaikārikadoṣaharaṇāyopapadyate | na cātiyogāya tāvad asya mātrāpramāṇaṃ veditavyam’ iti (ca.sū.15|12) | tatra vāgbhaṭena koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajyamātrām ityādivacanenaiva darśitaṃ koṣṭhaś ca pratipuruṣaṃ bhinna eva | dṛḍhabalena śarāvamātrā coktā | ekavāraṃ pānārthaṃ jalāḍhakāviśiṣṭaṃ praśastaṃ ca | dvitrivāraṃ pānam ity eke | śarāvasya pūrṇatvābhidhānaṃ maṅgalam iti jaijjaṭacakrau iti || 14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kvāthapāne navaprasthā jyeṣṭhā mātrā madhyamā ṣaṭprasthā triprasthā kanīyasī idaṃ kvāthapānapramāṇam | nanuyadyapyayaṃ pāṭhaḥ ‘ajīrṇaṃ śītapānīya’ mityantima śloke'dhyāyasamāptau mātṛkāsu dṛśyate paramasmābhiḥ yo- myatvādyāthāsthāne niveśita rati bodhyam || śārṅgadhareṇa kuḍavadravye āḍhakaṃ jalaṃ datvā ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvāthaṃ vamane deyam ity uktaṃ punaḥ kvāthasya navaprasthapramāṇā jyeṣṭhā mātrā likhitā tat kathaṃ na virodhaḥ ? ucyate, etatpramāṇe śārṅgadhareṇa bheḍamataṃ likhitaṃ tadā - kaṇṭhapānārthaṃ viṣādau jñeyam | mahākāyaviṣayaṃ vā | tathā ca bheḍaḥ
‘navaprasthā tu jyeṣṭhā syān madhyamā ṣaṭprakīrtitā |
niḥkvāthasya traya: prasthā māgadhī tu kanīyasī’ | carake tv evaṃ likhitaṃ ‘madhumadhukasaindhavaphāṇitopahatāṃ madanakalkakaṣāyamātrāṃ pāyayet | madanaphalakaṣāyamātrāpramāṇaṃ tu sarvasaṃśodhanamātrāpramāṇāni ca pratipuruṣāpekṣitavyāni bhavanti yāvad viṣasya śodhanaṃ pītaṃ vaikārikadoṣaharaṇāyopapadyate bhavati na cātiyogāsya tāvad asya mātrā pramāṇaṃ veditavyam’ || 14 ||

kalkādimānam -
kalkacūrṇāvalehānāṃ viphalaṃ śreṣṭhamātrayā |
madhyamāṃ dvipalāṃ vidyāt kanīyā palasaṃmitā ||15||
Āḍhamalla. aparam api dravyaviśeṣeṣu mānaviśeṣam āha - iyaṃ tu doṣavyādhīn avekṣya prayoktavyā | kalkaṃ dṛṣadi peṣitam | cūrṇaṃ vastragālitam | avaleho lehyadravyam||15||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamane kvāthaparimāṇam uktvā kalkādīnāṃ parimāṇam āha - spaṣṭam || 15 ||

vamanavegāḥ -
vamane cā'pi vegāḥ syur aṣṭau pittāntam uttamāḥ |
ṣaḍvegā madhyamā vegāś catvāras tv avare smṛtāḥ ||16||

Āḍhamalla. atha vamanasaṃkhyām āha - vamane tu madhyamottamāvaravegānāṃ ṣaḍ aṣṭau catvāro vihitāḥ | iyam eva doṣādivyavasthā kalpitā | aṣṭau vegā iti aṣṭavāraṃ yad vāmayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ ṣaṭ catvāro 'vagantavyāḥ | pittānte iti kaphe | athavā pittāntaṃ yāvat ity anena suvāntalakṣaṇaṃ pratipāditam eva | yad uktaṃ - ‘pitte kaphasyānumukhaṃ pravṛtte śuddheṣu hṛtkaṇṭhaśiraḥsu cāpi | laghau ca dehe kaphasaṃsrave ca sthite suvātaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasye’d iti || 16 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamane uttamamadhyamakaniṣṭhavegaparimāṇam āha - vamana iti | anyat sugamam || 16 ||

prasthamānam |
vamane ca vireke ca tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe |
sārdhatrayodaśapalaṃ prastham āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 17 ||

Āḍhamalla. athedānīṃ vegānāṃ parimāṇam āha - ardham ity anena dviguṇitaṃ jñeyo 'yam iti dviguṇitaṃ tathā hi - ‘jaghanyamadhyaprabaleṣu vegāś catvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍ aṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke svasthas tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe ce’ti || 17 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ardhenādhikena vartamānaṃ trayodaśapalam ity ucyate || 17 ||

atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa dravyaviśeṣam āha -
kaphaṃ kaṭukatīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pittaṃ svāduhimair jayet |
susvādulavaṇāmloṣṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyunā kapham ||18||

lg.l: kṛṣṇā rāṭhaphalaṃ sindhu kaphe koṣṇajalaiḥ pibet |
ajīrṇe koṣṇapānīyaiḥ sindhu pītvā vamet sudhīḥ ||20||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. kaṭukaṃ maricādi | tīkṣṇaṃ rājikādi | uṣṇam agnisaṃtaptam ity arthaḥ | uṣṇavīryaprāyaṃ dravyaṃ vā | svāduhimair iti | svādu madhurarasāyikaṃ dravyaṃ, himaṃ śītasparśaṃ śītavīryaṃ vā | susvādulavaṇāmloṣṇair iti | madhurarasasahitābhyām amlalavaṇarasābhyām ity arthaḥ | uṣṇam apy atra sparśāt | saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyunā kapham iti | ata eva kevalānilaṃ vamane niṣiddham iti pūrvaṃ darśitam eva | vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘kaphe tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭukaiḥ pitte svāduhimair api | vamet snigdhāmlalavaṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ mārutā kaphe’ iti || yad etad doṣaviśeṣeṇa dravyaviṣayam uktaṃ tadarthaṃ yogasaṃdhānam āha - kṛṣṇā, rāṭhaphalaṃ madanaphalaṃ, siṃdhu saindhavam, etac ca kalkīkṛtam uṣṇapānīyenāloḍya pītvā vamed ity arthaḥ | kṛṣṇādīnāṃ militvā karṣa iti kecit | vyavahārāc ca kṛṣṇādīnāṃ pṛthakkarṣamātraṃ deyam iti saṃpradāyaḥ | paṭolavāsanimbaiś ceti | paṭolādibhiḥ kṛtvā śītaḥ kāryaḥ | paṭoladīnāṃ militvā palaṃ, pākārthaṃ jalāḍhakaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ sakṣīramadanaṃ pibed iti | kṣīreṇa madanaphalaṃ kalkīkṛtya tenaiva sahāloḍya pibet ity abhiprāyaḥ | madanaphalakalkasya karṣaḥ prakṣepeṇa pracāraḥ | ajīrṇetyādi | atra saindhavaprakṣepam āhuḥ || 18-20 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamanādau nādhikakaṭukādibhir dravyaiḥ kaphādikaṃ jayed ity āha - kaṭutīkṣṇena vamanadravyeṇa kaphaṃ jayet | svādur madhuraḥ | himaṃ śītalam | tathā madhuraiḥ pittaṃ jayet| susvādulavaṇāmloṣṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ militaṃ vāyunā kaphaṃ jayet | vamanāyāha - kṛṣṇā-pippalī, rāṭhaphalair madana-phalaiḥ, sindhu saindhavam | kaphavamanāya etān koṣṇajalaiḥ pibet | paṭolaṃ paṭolapatram, vāsānimbau prasiddhau | etān pitte śītajalaiḥ pibet | saśleṣmavātapīḍāyāṃ sakṣīraṃ sadugdhaṃ madanaphalaṃ pibet | kvāthakalkādīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ pūrvoktam eva || 18-20 ||

uttamaśuddhiparyantaṃ vamanasūcanārthaṃ vamanavidhim āha -
vamanaṃ pāyayitvā ca jānumātrāsane sthitam |
kaṇṭham eraṇḍanālena spṛśantaṃ vāmayed bhiṣak || 21 ||

lg.l: lalāṭaṃ vamataḥ puṃsaḥ pārśve dve ca pradāpayet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. vamanaṃ vamanakvāthaṃ pāyayitvā bhiṣak vāmayet | kaṃ | jānumātre āsane sthitaṃ rogiṇam | kiṃbhūtam eraṇḍanālena kaṇṭhaṃ spṛśantaṃ, tasya vamataḥ lalāṭaṃ dve pārśve dhārayet |
uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘pīte muhūrtamanupālayet |
tanmanā jātahṛllāsaprasekaḥ chardayet tataḥ |
aṅgulibhyām anāgrasto nālena mṛdunā'thavā |
galatālvarujatvena nāpravṛttān pravartayan |
pravartayan pravṛttāṃś ca jānubhyām āsane sthitaḥ | ubhe pārśve lalāṭaṃ ca vamataś cāsya dhārayet’ iti || 21 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamanakaraṇe vidhānam āha - spaṣṭam || 21 ||

durvāntalakṣaṇam āha -
praseko hadgrahaḥ koṭha: kaṇḍūr duśchardite bhavet ||22||

Āḍhamalla. atha durvānte lakṣaṇam āha – duśchardite durvānte puruṣe kiñcid vānte ity abhiprāyaḥ | praseko mukhasya kaphastrāva ity arthaḥ | hṛdgraho hṛdayāviśuddhiḥ | hṛdroga ity apare | koṭhaḥ kṣudraroge paṭhitaḥ sa yathā ‘varaṭīdaṣṭasaṃkāśaḥ kaṇḍūmān lohitāmrakaphapittān | kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñai’r iti | duścharditā ca vāntividhāraṇād eva proktā | tasmād api koṭhādayaḥ saṃbhavanti | tathā hi - ‘visarpakoṭhakuṣṭhākṣikaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmayajvarāḥ | sakāsaśvāsahṛllāsavyaṅgaś ca śvayathur vame’r iti | vamer iti vāntividhāraṇād ity arthaḥ | asyānte taccikitsārthaṃ sārdhaṃ ślokaṃ kecit paṭhanti | tad yathā -
‘gaṇḍūṣadhūmānāhārān rūkṣaṃ bhuktvā tadudvamaḥ |
vyāyāmaṃ śrutirasrasya śastaṃ cātra virecanaṃ | sakṣāralavaṇaṃ tailam abhyaṅgārthe ca śasyata’ iti prakṣepakamanyamānair asmābhir api na likhitaṃ, yato bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate || 22 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vikriyāprāptachardilakṣaṇam āha - praseko mukhaśaraṇam | hṛdgrahaḥ pīḍā, koṭho varaṭīdaṣṭavanmaṇḍalotpattiḥ, kaṇḍūḥ kaṇḍūti: , duśchardita etal lakṣaṇam || 22 ||

ativānter lakṣaṇam āha -
ativānte bhavet tṛṣṇā hikkodgārau visaṃjñitā |
jihvāniḥsarpaṇaṃ cākṣṇor vyāvṛttir hanusaṃhatiḥ || 23 ||

lg.l: raktacchardiḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ ca kaṇṭhapīḍā ca jāyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ ativānter lakṣaṇāny āha - visaṃjñitā mūrcchābhedaḥ, jihvāniḥsarpaṇaṃ ca bhavati | jihvāyāḥ niḥsarpaṇam atra dvividhaṃ ekam antaḥpraviṣṭarūpam aparaṃ bahirnirgamanaviṣayaṃ akṣyor vyāvṛttir netrayoḥ parivartanaṃ | athavā vyāvṛttir ity ākuñcanaṃ | hanusaṃhatir iti cibukacalanādirāhityaṃ | ṣṭhīvantaṃ raktasyety asakṛc ca || 23 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ativānteḥ kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīty āha - visaṃjñitā saṃjñānāśaḥ, jihvāniḥsaṃraṇam, akṣṇor vyāvṛttiḥ, niḥsaraṇam eva bhrāntir vā, hanusaṃhatiḥ stabdhatā pīḍā vā, raktacchardi: raktodgiraṇam | kaphena niḥsaraṇam | kaṇṭhe ca pīḍā vyathā || 23 ||

vamanotpannarogacikitsām āha -
vamanasyātiyoge tu mṛdu kuryād virecanam || 24 ||

lg.l: phalāny amlāni khādeyus tasya cānye 'grato narā:|
vyāvṛtte 'kṣṇi ghṛtābhyakte pīḍayec ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
hanumokṣe smṛtaḥ svedo nasyaṃ ca śleṣmavātahṛt ||27||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha vamanātiśayotpannānāṃ rogāṇāṃ cikitsām āha - snigdhāmlalavaṇair hṛdyair ghṛtamanatiśīlanena prabhavā tṛṣṇādirogā ebhir vihiprayogaiḥ śāmyantīty abhiprāyaḥ | kathaṃ yathety āha - yadā vamanātiyogo bhavati tadā mṛduvirecanaṃ dadyāt | mṛduvirecanaṃ mastukṣīrādinā | aparam api dvividhaprakāraniḥsarpitajihvāyā yogacatuṣṭayam uktaṃ tadvyākhyānam āha - vamanāntaḥpraviṣṭāyām ityādi | antaḥpraviṣṭāyām iti saṃkucitāyām, atra kavalagrahāḥ snigdhādyaiḥ kalpitāḥ hitāḥ pathyā ity arthaḥ | snigdhaṃ tailādi, amlo amlikā mātuluṅgādiḥ, lavaṇaḥ saindhavādiḥ | eteṣāṃ madhye hṛdyair manohlādakarair ity arthaḥ | ghṛtakṣīrasamair iti | ghṛtakṣīramilitair ity arthaḥ | nanu snehagrahaṇenaiva ghṛtagrahaṇaprāptir eva tat kathaṃ punar ghṛtagrahaṇam ? ucyate, snigdhaśabdety ukte punar ghṛtopādānaṃ snehakriyātiśayadyotanārtham | aparam apy upāyam āha - phalānītyādi | amlānīti jambīranimbukaprabhṛtīni tasyāgrata iti | tasya jihvārtasya puruṣasyety arthaḥ | purato 'grataḥ sthitveti śeṣaḥ | anyanarā iti anyapuruṣāḥ | anena jihvā calitā bhavatīty abhiprāyaḥ | etac cāntaḥpraviṣṭāyāṃ bahir niḥsṛtāyāṃ ca jihvāyāṃ boddhavyam | atha ni:sṛtāyāḥ pṛthagyogadvayam āha - niḥsṛtām ityādi | niḥsṛtāṃ bahir nirgatāṃ jihvām iti śeṣaḥ | tiladrākṣākalkam atra sāmyena kevalam āhuḥ | aparam api vyāvṛtte 'kṣṇi yogam āha - ghṛtābhyakta iti | vyāvṛd ity api pāṭhāntaraṃ | vyāvṛd iti jihvā pūrvakalkādinā calitety arthaḥ | yadi calitā jātā drākṣākṣīraghṛtābhyakte sati jihvāṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kṛtvā pīḍayet | antar nayed iti bhāvaḥ | hanumokṣārtham apy āha hanumokṣe smṛtaḥ sveda ityādi | khedo 'tra caturṇāṃ madhye vihitasveda eva kāryaḥ | nasyam api tadvihitam | tac ca śleṣmavātaghnadravyarahitam ity arthaḥ | tena śleṣmavātaghnaṃ yan nasyaṃ tad deyaṃ; apare yogam enaṃ śleṣmavātaghnaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānayanti | yataḥ kaphavātanirharaṇatvena hanumokṣaḥ syāt tanmūlatvāt | anye śleṣmavātaghnaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānayanti | yataḥ kaphavātanirharaṇatvena hanumokṣaḥ syāt, tanmūlatvāt anye śleṣmavātahṛd ity anenāparam apy upāyaṃ kathayanti | tad vicārya yojyānīti | raktacchardyām api yogam āha - raktapittavidhānenetyādi | raktapittavidhānaṃ raktapittacikitsāyām anyatamena jñātavyaṃ | anyopadravāṇāṃ cikitsitam āha - dhātrīrasāñjanośīretyādi | dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavam, uśīraṃ mṛṇālaṃ, lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyaprabhavāḥ | candanaṃ raktaṃ | vāribhir iti | eteṣāṃ vāri toyaṃ grāhyaṃ | śṛtatvāt kalkatvāc ca || 24-29 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamanātivyāptau tadrogaśāntyarthaṃ cikitsitam āha - vamanasyātiyogaś cet tadā recanaṃ kuryāt | vamanātiyoge jihvāpratīkāram āha - vamane antaḥpraviṣṭāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ snigdhāmlalavaṇair ghṛtakṣīrarasaiḥ kavalagraho hitaḥ | tasyāgrato 'neke narāḥ amlanimbukādīni phalāni khādeyu: sugamam | vyāvṛtte 'kṣṇi cikitsitam āha - vyāvṛttekṣṇi prasārite 'kṣṇi ghṛtābhyakte śanaiḥ pīḍayet | hanumokṣe kriyām āha - stambhād dhanumokṣakaraṇe svedaḥ smṛtaḥ | śleṣmavātaharaṃ nasyam | atha raktacchardipratīkāram āha - raktapittavidhānena raktapittacitkitsitena raktacchardim upācaret cikitset | aticchardijanitatṛṣṇācikitsitam āha - dhātrī āmalakī, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhūtam, uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ lājā dhānyajāḥ, candanaṃ śītaṃ, vāri netravālakam | ebhir manthaṃ kṛtvā pāyayet | kiṃbhūtaṃ manthaṃ ? saghṛtaṃ kṣaudraśarkaraṃ, ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ, kṣaudraṃ madhu, śarkarā sitā etaiḥ sahitam | anena manthena yā tṛṣṇās tāḥ śāmyanti | tathā chardisamudbhavāḥ pīḍāḥ śāmyanti || 24-29 ||

atha samyagvāntalakṣaṇam āha -
hṛtkaṇṭhaśirasāṃ śuddhir dīptāgnitvaṃ ca lāghavam |
kaphapittavināśaś ca samyagvātasya lakṣaṇam || 30 ||

Āḍhamalla. hṛcchuddhiḥ hṛdayalaghutārūpā, kaṇṭhaśuddhiḥ kaṇṭhe pāṭavaṃ kaṇṭhasthaśleṣmāpagamāt | śiraḥśuddhiḥ śirolaghutvaṃ tatsthapīḍādivināśāt | dīptāgnitvam iti | nanu vāntasya sahasā mando 'gnir bhavati | uktaṃ ca - ‘saṃśodhanāsravisrāvasnehayojanalaṅghanaiḥ | yāty agnir mandatāṃ tasmāt kramaṃ peyādikaṃ bhajet’ iti | tat katham atra dīptāgnitvam ? iti | ucyate - atra śodhanenāgnir upaghāto bhavati nāgner hāniḥ, tasyopaghātasya peyādipathyadānena punardīptatvāt dīptatvam | uktaṃ ca dṛḍhabalena -‘peyāṃ vilepīm akṛtaṃ kṛtañ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīn ubhayaṃ tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro 'nnakālaṃ pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddha:’ iti | tathā'ṇur agnis tṛṇagomayādyaiḥ saṃdhukṣamāṇo bhavati krameṇa | mahān sthiraḥ sarvasamaṃ tathaiva śuddhasya peyādibhir antarāgnir iti | tasmād dīptāgnitvaṃ yuktaṃ, tathā lāghavaṃ śarīsya, ata eva kaphapittavināśaś ca iti | ity anena śarīrapāṭavam apy uktam | athavā vāntisamaye taddina evāgnihānir durvānte ca | samyagvānte aparadine ca dīpto 'gnir ity adoṣaḥ | ata eva vakṣyamāṇaśloke ‘ajīrṇārditaṃ varjayet’ sudhīr iti grahaṇāt || 30 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athānantaraṃ samyagvāntasya puruṣasya idaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati tad āha - hṛtkaṇṭhaśirasāṃ śuddhiḥ kaphādirahitatvam | agnir dīptaḥ, lāghavaṃ dehasya kaphapittavināśaś ca iti || 30 ||

atha vāntasya pathyam āha -
tato 'parāhṇe dīptā'gniṃ mudgaṣaṣṭikaśālibhiḥ |
hṛdyaiś ca jāṅgalarasaiḥ kṛtvā yūṣaṃ ca bhojayet || 31 ||

Āḍhamalla. tato 'nantaraṃ śuddher anantaram ity arthaḥ | dīptāgnim, aparāhṇe aparadine tṛtīyayāmāvasāne vā | ata eva dīptāgnitvam iti bhāvaḥ | mudgaṣaṣṭikaśālibhirbhojayet | mudgādayo 'tra peyādikaraṇopayogitvena mudgādīnāṃ yūṣapeyāvilepya: kāryāḥ | adīptāgniś ceti dvitīye divase | uktaṃ ca -
‘tataḥ sāyaṃ prabhāte vā snātaḥ śuddhān sukhāmbunā |
purāṇaraktaśālīnām asnehalavaṇauṣaṇam | bhuñjāno raktaśālyannaṃ bhojet peyādikaṃ kramam’ iti | tathā yūṣaṃ ca paraṃ jāṅgalarasaiḥ hṛdyaiḥ kṛtvā bhojayet | tenā'yam arthaḥ - yūṣarasādīnām akṛtakṛtatvena hṛdyatvaṃ jñeyam | uktaṃ ca - ‘peyāṃ vilepīm akṛtaṃ kṛtañ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīn ubhayaṃ tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro 'nnakālaṃ pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ’ iti | ‘jñeyā: kṛtākṛtāste ca snehādiyutavarjitā’ iti | ṣaṣṭiko 'tra gauraṣaṣṭikaḥ ‘gauraś cāsitagaurata’ iti vacanāt | śālir atra raktaśāliḥ evaṃvidhā mahāśālyādayaḥ || 31 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pathyavidhānam āha - jāṅgalarasair māṃsarasair lavādyaiḥ || 31 ||

suvāntasyaite pīḍādyarthaṃ na bhavanti ity āha -
tandrā nidrāsyadaurgandhyaṃ kaṇḍūś ca grahaṇī viṣam |
suvāntasya na pīḍāyai bhavanty ete kadācana || 32||

Āḍhamalla. tandrā ardhonmīlananetratvam, nidrā prāg vyākhyātā, āsyadaurgandhyaṃ mukhadurgandhatā, viṣaṃ viṣajanitopasargāḥ | yad uktaṃ - ’kaphaprasekaṃ svarabhedanidrātandrāsyadaurgandhyaviṣopasargāḥ | gurutvakaṇḍūgrahaṇīvikārā na santi jantor vamataḥ kadācit’ iti | kadācana iti na kasmiṃścit kāle bhavantīty arthaḥ | yathā - ‘chinne tarau puṣpaphalaprarohā yathā vināśaṃ sahasā vrajanti | tathā hṛtaślaiṣmaṇi chardane ca tajjā vikārāḥ pralayaṃ prayanti’ iti || 32 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. suvāntasya tandrādyā na bhavantīty āha - tandrā tathā nidrā, āsyadaurgandhyaṃ mukhadurgandhatā, kaṇḍūḥ kharjūḥ grahaṇī saṃgrahaṇī viṣaṃ sthāvaraṃ kṛtrimaṃ ca suvāntasyaite pīḍāyai na bhavanti || 32||

vamane yan niṣiddhaṃ tad āha -
ajīrṇaṃ śītapānīyaṃ vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ tathā |
snehābhyaṅgaṃ prakopaṃ ca dinaikaṃ varjayet sudhī: || 33 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa praṇītāyāṃ śārṅgādharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe vamanavidhir nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. kṛtavamanasya pathyam āha - ajīrṇam iti | peyādyannasyājīrṇam atimātrapānāt, tatrāgner mandatvāt | śītapānīyaṃ śītajalasya srotaḥśuddher akaraṇāt | ata evoktam -
‘uṣṇodakopacārī syād brahmacārī kṣapākṣayaḥ |
avegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān || pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyātyāsanasaṃsthitiḥ | nidrātyuccopadhānāhasvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti | ata evoktaṃ -
‘tṛṣṇāyām alpam uṣṇāmbu pibed vātakaphajvare |
tat kaphaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā tṛṣṇām āśu nivartayet ||
udīrya cāgniṃ srotāṃsi mṛdukṛtya viśodhayet |
līnapittānilasvedaśakṛnmūtrānulomanam || nidrājāḍyāruciharaṃ prāṇānām avalambanam | viparītam ataḥ śīghraṃ doṣasaṃghātavardhanam’ iti | vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma dinaikam ity upalakṣaṇaṃ tenā'nyad api kālaṃ boddhavyam | yad uktaṃ -‘vamanādividhāneṣu yāvatkālaṃ tu gacchati | tāvat tu parihartavyaṃ śītatoyādimaithunam’ iti || 33 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe vamanādhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ajīrṇe ca śītapānīyaṃ varjayet | uṣṇam eva praśastam | vyāyāmaṃ śramādikam | maithunaṃ strīsevanam, snehābhyaṅgaṃ tailamardanam, visūcyādau praśastaṃ na kṛtrimaṃ vamane prakopaṃ krodhaṃ sudhī: paṇḍitaḥ etat sarvaṃ dinaikaṃ varjayet || 33 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpi- kāyām uttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi vamanaprakaraṇaṃ samāptam ||

div.head: atha virecanavidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha virecanādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ - atha virecanavidhiḥ |
Āḍhamalla. sambandhas tu prāg ukta eva |

virecanaviṣayam āha -
snigdhasvinnasya vāntasya dadyāt samyag virecanam |

Āḍhamalla. pūrvasnehapānayuktasya svedayuktasya cety arthaḥ | vāntasyeti vamanaṃ kṛtvā | etena snehapānādīnām anantareṇa virecanaṃ na kāryam ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā hi - ‘pittam atyulbaṇīkṛtya snehasvede kṛte sati | vamane ca kṛte pūrvam ataḥ samyag virecayet’ iti | vamanāntaram api snigdhasvinnasyeti | yad uktaṃ - ‘karmaṇāṃ vamanādīnām antaraṃ tv antare punaḥ | snehasvedau prayuñjīta saṃśodhanam anantaram’ iti | snigdhasvinnam atra kimarthaṃ tat dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati | yathā ‘snehasvedāv akṛtvā'gre yas tu saṃśodhanaṃ pibet | dāruśuṣkam ivānāmaṃ dehastasya viśīryata’ iti ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vamanānantaraṃ virecanasya vihitatvād virecanam āha - snigdhasya pītasnehasya, svinnasya kṛtasvedasya ||

ab.seg:
vamane 'py akṛte sati doṣam āha -
avāntasya tv adhaḥ srasto grahaṇīṃ chādayet kaphaḥ || 1 ||

lg.l: mandāgniṃ gauravaṃ kuryāj janayed vā pravāhikām |
athavā pācanair āmaṃ balāsaṃ ca vipācayet || 2 ||
snigdhasya snehanaiḥ kāryaṃ svedaiḥ svinnasya recanam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. avāntasyetyādi | adhaḥsrastodhaḥ prāptaḥ recanadravyaprabhāvavaśāt | etādṛśaḥ kaphas tadā grahaṇīm ācchādayet | grahaṇīm agnisthitānnasthānaṃ | yad uktam - ‘agnyadhiṣṭhānam annasya grahaṇād grahaṇī mate’ti | ata evādau vamanenātra kaphanigraho vidheyaḥ | so 'py āśrayasamāśrayaṇāt sroto 'varodhahetuḥ na kevalaṃ grahaṇīcchādanaṃ karoti | mandāgnim ityādi | atra gauravaṃ śarīrasyeti | pravāhikātīsārabhedaḥ | atha kāryāntaram āha - pācanair iti | pācanadravyaiḥ sāmam ity aparipakvarasaṃ || tathā hi - ’jaṭharānaladaurbalyād avipakvas tu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopaka’ iti | na kevalam āmaṃ śrleṣmāṇaṃ ca vipācayet | etena kṛtavamanasyāpi pūrvaṃ pācanaṃ dattvā paścād virecayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | athaveti grahaṇāt tena vamanaṃ vinā pācanaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ | saṃśodhanakrame 'pi pācanasya prādhānyam uktaṃ | tathā tīsaṭe coktaṃ - ‘prāk pācanaṃ snehavidhir vidheyaḥ svedas tataḥ syād vamanaṃ virekaḥ | nirūhaṇaṃ snehanabastikarma nasyaṃ kramaś ceti bhiṣagvarāṇām’ iti | eṣāṃ kramābhiprāyeṇa vināpi virecanasya pūrvaṃ pācanaṃ kartavyam eveti vyavahāraḥ saṅgata eva | atha pācanam abhidhāya virecanam api kasya kathaṃ dātavyam ity āha - snigdhasyeti | pūrvakṛtasnigdhapācanasya, kaiḥ snehanair ghṛtādibhiḥ | na kevalaṃ snigdhasya recanaṃ kiṃtu svedair api svinnasya sveditasya virecanaṃ praśastaṃ | yad vā snehanaiḥ svedair iti saṃbandhaḥ | snehasvedair ity anena doṣāṇāṃ sukham utpāṭanaṃ sūcitaṃ | yataḥ ‘snehasvedaiḥ pracalitā rasaiḥ snigdhair udīritāḥ | doṣāḥ koṣṭhagatā jantoḥ sukhaṃ haṃti virecanai’r iti | pūrvam uktam apy adaḥ punar eva draḍhayati na doṣaḥ paunaruktyena | kecid vakṣyamāṇena śaradṛtāv iti ślokena militvā vyākhyānayanti | tatra śaradṛtau snigdhasya snehanaiḥ kṛtvā virecanaṃ kāryaṃ | vasante ca svedaiḥ svinnam eva recanaṃ deyaṃ | na tu snigdhasya iti na sarvamatam || 1 || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. adhaḥsrastaḥ patitaḥ, grahaṇīṃ pittadhāriṇīṃ kṛtvā kapha ācchādayet | yadā kaphaḥ grahaṇīm ācchādayet tadā kiṃ kuryāt ity āha - mandāgniṃ gauravaṃ ca kuryāt | pravāhikātīsārabhedas tāṃ janayet | adhasrastasya kaphasya pratīkāram āha - athavā pakṣāntare | āmaṃ balāsaṃ kaphaṃ ca pācanaiḥ śuṇṭhyairaṇḍādibhiḥ pācayet | yad vā snehanair ghṛtadugdhādibhiḥ snigdhasya sveditasya recanaṃ kāryam iti vidhiḥ tatrocyate | vamanād virecanaṃ kadā deyam ity apekṣāyām atrānuktam iti likhyate | tatra bhedaḥ |
samyak pravṛtte vamane saptarātre gate sati |
susaṃskṛtaśarīrasya pradātavyaṃ virecanaṃ’ | carake ca ‘vātaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ saṃsnehitaṃ tathā | uṣṇaṃ laghu tryahaṃ bhuktaiḥ ṣoḍaśe 'hni virecayet’ | ṣoḍaśadine yad vā pakṣāntare pakṣād vireko vāntasyeti suśrutavacanam | asyārthaḥ vātaṃ kṛtaṃ samyagvamanaṃ ṣaḍahasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ ṣaḍahety uktavamanaṃ punas tryahaṃ saṃsnehitaṃ punas tryaham uṣṇakṛtasvedaṃ punas tryahaṃ laghubhuktaṃ
athainaṃ vāmitaṃ bhūyaḥ snehasvedopapāditaṃ |
śleṣmakāle gate jñātvā koṣṭhaṃ samyag virecayet’ | vāgbhaṭe evaṃ likhitam | asyārthaḥ. athainaṃ puruṣaṃ vāmitaṃ kṛtavamanaṃ ṣaḍahānantaraṃ snehasvedopapāditaṃ bhūyaḥ punaḥ śleṣmakāle dvādaśadivase gate sati punas trayahaṃ laghu bhaktaṃ ṣoḍaśe hy eva koṣṭhaṃ samyag virecayed iti vāgbhaṭārthaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg:
svamate tu - virecanakālam āha -
śaradṛtau vasante ca deyaṃ śuddhau virecanam || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. atra śuddhau cāsvasthasya śodhanāya śaradṛtau vasante ca virecanaṃ deyaṃ | cakārād varṣāsv api | tad uktam - ‘śītodbhavaṃ doṣacayaṃ vasante viśodhayan grīṣmajam abhrakāle | ghanātyaye vārṣikam āśu samyak prāpnoti rogān ṛtujān na jātu’ iti | virecanam ity anena viśeṣeṇa recanaṃ śaradāditriṣv eva | anyadā himaśiśiragrīṣme kāle akārye tasmin virecanaṃ kṛte sati pūrvaṃ paścād vihitaśodhanaṃ śīlayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | ata eva budha iti kālaviśeṣajño doṣaviśeṣajñaś ca || 3 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ virecanayogye virecanakālam āha - śaradṛtau āśvinakārtike tathā vasante caitravaiśākhe dehaśuddhau bhiṣag virecayet | anyadā anyasmin kāle vā saty api rogotpattau budhaḥ śodhanaṃ śīlayet || 3 ||

śarīraśuddhau śodhanam uktaṃ tasya phalam āha -
doṣāḥ kadācit kupyanti jitā laṅghanapācanaiḥ ||4||

lg.l: ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punar udbhavaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. laṃghanam atropavāsaḥ, pācanasya pṛthug upādānāt | saptasu śamaneṣu dvayor grahaṇaṃ pradhānatvāt | ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā doṣās teṣāṃ na punar udbhavaḥ | ayam arthaḥ laṅghanādayaḥ śamanatvāt saṃcitān doṣān mūlān nonmūlayaṃti kiṃtu śamayanti te kadācit svalpahetunā'pi kupyanti ye śodhanaiḥ śuddhāḥ teṣāṃ punar udbhavo na bhavati chinnasaṃcayatvāt | uktaṃ ca suśrute - ‘sañcayopahṛtā doṣā labhante nottarā gatīḥ’ iti | bahupustakeṣu ‘doṣāḥ kadācit kupyanti’ amuṃ ślokaṃ ‘pittaṃ virecanaṃ yuñjyāt’ asyāgre paṭhanti tad asaṅgatam eva śodhanaparataivāsya ślokasya pūrvaślokaḥ | ‘śaratkāle vasante ca’ ity ayaṃ śodhanapara eva tena śodhanaphalārtha evāyaṃ ślokaḥ | tena - ‘śaratkāle vasante ca’ asya ślokasyāgre ‘doṣāḥ kadācit kupyanti ayaṃ ślokaḥ paṭhanīyaḥ | virecanasyā'pi śodhanatvād yathākathañcit samādheyaṃ vā || 4 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. doṣanāśe śodhanotkṛṣṭam āha - sugamam ||4||

atha pittādau virecanam |
pitte virecanaṃ yuñjyād āmodbhūte gade tathā || 5 ||

lg.l: udare cacakārāt pittasaṃyoge'pi pittolbaṇe yojyam - uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘kaphe vidadhyādvamanaṃ saṃyāge vā kapholbeṇe | tadvadvirecanaṃ pitte’ iti | tathā'dhmāne koṣṭhaśuddhyai viśeṣataḥ ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha virecanaṃ keṣāṃ niyataṃ tān āha - ‘pittavirecanam iti | pittajanitānām upadravāṇāṃ pittātmakānāṃ niyato vināśa iti kevalapitte 'pi virecanam abhihitam | tathā ca tantrāntare 'pi -‘śarīrajātānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadhaṃ | bastir vireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaghṛtaṃ madhv iti’ | āmodbhūte gade tatheti | āmajanitavyādhau | āmavātavikārādāv ity aryaḥ | udara iti udararogarūḍhi:| ādhmānodarāpūraḥ | koṣṭhāśuddhāv iti | koṣṭhasya aśuddhiḥ baddhakoṣṭha iti prasiddhiḥ | viśeṣata ity anenaivamādīnām apareṣām api virecanaṃ viśeṣeṇa kuryād ity arthaḥ | atha śodhanasya prādhānyaviṣayatvena virecanamukhyatvam āha - ayaṃ ślokaḥ śodhanapadagrahaṇenānyac chodhanaparo 'pi bhavati | atrācāryeṇa laṅghanapācanair ity uktena vamanaviṣayasya niṣedhaparatvād virecanādhyāye svīkṛtaḥ | nanu ye 'pi laṅghanapācanair jitās te punaḥ kathaṃ saṃbhavanti ? ucyate | kadācid atisvalpahetulābhena jitā apy ajitāḥ doṣamūlānucchedāt mūlabhūtāśayagatadoṣadūṣyasamudbhavāt samyag jitāḥ alpam api hetuṃ prāpya punaḥ kupyantīti bhāvaḥ | tena teṣāṃ punar udbhava iti | saṃśodhanena mūladoṣajanyād alpahetunā na kadāpi prakopaḥ balavattarahetunā bhavaty eva || 5 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣu rogeṣu virecanaṃ dīyate tān āha - pitte pittavikāre, āmodbhūte āmavātādau | udare udararoge | ādhmāne koṣṭhāśuddhau baddhakoṣṭhādau || 5 ||

idānīṃ ye virecane niṣiddhās tān āha -
bālavṛddhāv atisnigdhaḥ kṣatakṣīṇo bhayānvitaḥ || 6 ||

lg.l: śrāntas tṛṣārtaḥ sthūlaś ca garbhiṇī ca navajvarī |
navaprasūtā nārī ca mandāgniś ca madātyayī || 7 ||
śalyārditaś ca rūkṣaś ca na virecyā vijānatā |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. virecyā iti | viśeṣeṇa recyā na bhavantīty abhiprāyeṇālparecanasyā prāptir eva | ata eva bālavṛddhayor apy ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ sāmānyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa tu virekasādhyavyādhyupagrastayoḥ kiṃcid deyam ity uktaṃ | tathā ca - ‘agnikṣāravirekais tu bālavṛddhau vivarjayet | tatsādhyeṣu vikāreṣu mṛdvīṃ kuryāt laghukriyām’ iti | niṣiddhācaraṇam anyatrāpy uktam - ‘atyantapittād viparītadehān vireca- yet tān api mandamandam’ iti | tān api niṣiddhabālavṛddhādīn | atisnigdha ity atisnehapānādiyuktaḥ | tathā hi ‘navā'tisnigdhakāyasya dadyāt snehavirecanaṃ | doṣāḥ prabhāvitā bhūyo līyante tena vartmasu’ iti | kṣatakṣīṇā iti | dhātuśoṣaṇatvena śoṣī kathitaḥ | sa ca rājayakṣmabhedaḥ | bhayānvito bhayayuktaḥ | bhayagrahaṇatvena śokābhitaptasya dīnasya vā niṣedho darśitaḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘kṣīṇas tathā rūkṣitabālavṛddhadīno 'tha śoṣī bhayaśokataptaḥ’ ityādi | sthūlo bahumedonvitaḥ | mandāgnir api kapholbaṇatvāt | rūkṣo vātolbaṇa iti | athavā rūkṣa ity asnigdhaḥ | tathā hy uktaṃ ‘virūkṣaṃ snehasātmyaṃ tu bhūyaḥ saṃsnihya recaye’d iti | vijānatety anena virecanaviṣayavikalpaviśeṣajñena vaidyenety arthaḥ | yataḥ ‘virecanair yānti narā vināśam ajñaprayuktair avirecanīyā’ iti || 6 || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. avirecanayogyān āha - ete bālādayo vijānatā viśeṣajñapuruṣeṇa na virecyāḥ || 6 || 7 ||

ab.seg:
virecanayogyān āha -
jīrṇajvarī garavyāpto vātaraktī bhagandarī || 8 ||

Āḍhamalla. virekasādhyān rogān āha - jīrṇajvarādayo virekārhāḥ narā matāḥ | ācāryāṇām iti śeṣaḥ | jīrṇajvarīti purāṇajvarī tasya virekasādhyatvāt | garavyāpta iti garaṃ kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ tena vyāptaḥ duḥkhitaḥ | tathā'rśādipīḍitāḥ | tathā yonirogādibhir arditāḥ | tathā vidradhyādiyutāḥ | tathā karṇanāsāśirovakragudameḍhrāmayānvitā iti | karṇādijanitāmayānvitā ity arthaḥ | tenāmayaśabdo karṇādibhiḥ saha saṃbadhyate | plīhaśothākṣirogārtā iti plīhādirogavyāptā ity arthaḥ | krimikṣīṇānilārditā iti | kṛmyādibhir arditāḥ pīḍitāḥ | virekārhā iti virecanayogyā ity arthaḥ || 8-11 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. jīrṇajvarī cirajvarī, garavyāpto viṣayukta:, udaram udararogiṇaṃ, granthirogaḥ | nanūdaraṃ pūrvam uktam atrāpy ucyate tat kathaṃ na punaruktiḥ ? ucyate - udare punaruktir virecanārthaṃ | yad vā udaragranthir bhinnarogaḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 8-11 ||

atha virecanajñānārthaṃ koṣṭhabhedān āha -
bahupitto mṛduḥ koṣṭho jahuśleṣmā ca madhyamaḥ |
bahuvātaḥ krūrakoṣṭho durvirecya: sa kathyate || 12 ||

Āḍhamalla. bahupittaḥ koṣṭhaḥ mṛduḥ, bahukapho madhyaḥ, bahuvātaḥ krūraḥ | madhyamena śodhanena hīnayogī krūraḥ | atiyogī mṛduḥ, samyagyogī madhyaḥ | saṃsargasannipātajakoṣṭhe yogavāhitvaṃ kaphasya jñeyaṃ vacanabalāt | yad āha khāraṇādiḥ - ‘vātolbaṇā syād bhahaṇī krūrakoṣṭhasya dehinaḥ | pittalā mṛdukoṣṭhasya yogavāhī tayoḥ kaphaḥ’ iti | tena vātakaphābhyāṃ krūraḥ, madhyo vātapittābhyāṃ, sannipātāc ca mṛduḥ | nanu bahuvātaśleṣmabhyāṃ krūraḥ, iti suśrutena bahukaphasya krūratvam uktam | iha tu madhyamatvam iti virodhaḥ ? maivaṃ - suśrutavākyasya saṃsargaparatvād iti bopadevapaṇḍitāḥ | durvirecya iti kṛcchrāt sāmādiko 'py avirecyaḥ || 12 ||

koṣṭhānurūpāṃ
mātrām āha - mṛdvī mātrā mṛdukoṣṭhe madhyakoṣṭhe ca madhyamā |
krūre tīkṣṇā matā dravyair mṛdumadhyamatīkṣṇakaiḥ ||13||

Āḍhamalla. mṛdvādidravyaiḥ mṛdvādikoṣṭhakeṣu mṛdvādimātrā matā, ācāryāṇām iti śeṣaḥ | nanu mṛdur dravyair mṛdvādyā mātrā bhavati kimarthaṃ mṛdvādimātretītyādi ? ucyate -hīnayogātiyogasamyagyogāya, te ca vaidyādhīnāḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘alpasyāpi mahārthatvaṃ prabhūtasyālpakarmatām | kuryāt saṃśleṣaviśleṣakālasaṃskārayuktitaḥ’ ityādi mātrājñānārtham uktam || 13 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virecane mṛdumadhyakrūrakoṣṭham āha - mṛdviti | mṛdumadhyamatīkṣṇakair dravyair mṛdvīmātrādayo matāḥ| sugamam ||13||

mṛdvādidravyāṇi kāni tāni ity ata āha -
mṛdur drākṣāpayaś cāmbutailair api viricyate |
madhyamas trivṛtātiktārājavṛkṣair viricyate || 14 ||

Āḍhamalla. mṛdur iti | mṛduḥ koṣṭhaḥ drākṣādibhiḥ samyak viricyate | tatra drākṣā gostanī, payaḥ godugdham uṣṇāmbu uṣṇodakam, pānīyatvena madhyame 'pi grahaṇam | athavāmbuśabdaḥ sārakamastvādidravopalakṣaṇaḥ, tailam airaṇḍatailam | madhyas tu madhyakoṣṭhaḥ na krūro na mṛdur iti madhyapadābhidhānāt | sa ca trivṛtādibhiḥ samyak viricyate | trivṛtā śyāmā, tiktā kaṭukī, rājavṛkṣo girimālakaḥ| krūra iti | krūrakoṣṭhaḥ snukpayohemakṣīryādibhir viricyate | snuk sehuṇḍaḥ, hemakṣīrī svarṇakṣīrī, dantīphalaṃ jayapālaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt kumbhātilvakādayaḥ || 14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tāni dravyāṇy evāha - payo dugdham, tailaiḥ eraṇḍāditailaiḥ, trivṛtā niḥsṛtā, tiktā kaṭukī, rājavṛkṣo girimālakaḥ, snuk sehuṇḍaḥ tasya dugdham, hemakṣīrī svarṇakṣīrī dantī jayapālaḥ | ādiśabdāt indravāruṇībrahmalavaṇyādayaḥ || 14 ||

virekasyottamādimātrāyai vāṅgakailiṅgakaparimāṇam āha -
mātrottamā virekasya triṃśad vegaiḥ kaphāntagā || 15||

Āḍhamalla. mātrottameti | pravarā vegamātrā triṃśad vegair jñaiyā, tathā kaphāntageti kailiṅgakaṃ mānam | tathā viṃśatibhir vegair madhyā, tathā daśabhir vegair hīnā | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegāś catvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍ aṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthas tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe ca’ iti | tulāmānam apy uktaṃ tenaiva - ‘prasthas tathā syād dvicaturguṇaś ca | dvitrān saviṭkān apanīya vegān meyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītam’ iti | kecid uttamasya vāyoḥ krūrakoṣṭasya ca uttamā mātrā tīkṣṇā'bhimatā, ata eva kaphāntagān meyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītam iti, madhyamā'pi tasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya hīnā iti vyākhyānayanti || 15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. uttamādibhedena virekapramāṇam āha - mātrottameti | sugamam || 15 ||

idānīṃ kaṣāyaguṭikācūrṇātmakānāṃ virecanadravyāṇāṃ parimāṇam āha -
dvipalaṃ śreṣṭham ākhyātaṃ madhyamaṃ ca palaṃ bhavet || 16||

lg.l: palārdhaṃ ca kaṣāyāṇāṃ kanīyas tu virecanam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kaṣāyāṇām iti | kaṣāyaśabdena rasaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaphāṇṭānāṃ caturṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ kalkasya pṛthag upādānāt | dvipalaṃ śreṣṭham ity anena vātajanitakoṣṭhasyety arthaḥ | virecanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ kaṣāyāṇām uttamā mātrety arthaḥ | palaṃ madhyamaṃ madhyamā mātrā pittajanitamṛdukoṣṭhasyety arthaḥ | ardhapalaṃ kanīyo mātrā hīnā mātrety arthaḥ | kaphena madhyamakoṣṭhaḥ kathitaḥ | kalkamodakacūrṇānām iti | kalkādīnāṃ karṣaṃ madhvājyayogataḥ virecanam | vā athavā vayorogādyapekṣayā karṣadvayaṃ palaṃ vā virecanam | madhughṛtamānaṃ viṣamatayā yojyam | uktaṃ ca - ‘bhajato viṣarūpatvaṃ tulyāṃśau madhusarpiṣī’ iti | ādigrahaṇāt koṣṭhādi jñātvā virecanaṃ deyam || 16 || 17 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vireke kaṣāyādīnāṃ mātrākathanam - virecanaṃ dvipalaṃ śreṣṭham, palaṃ madhyamaṃ, palārdhaṃ kanīyaḥ svalpam | kaṣāyānantaraṃ virecane kalkādīnāṃ pramāṇam āha - madhvājyalehataḥ karṣadvayaṃ trayaṃ vā'pi deyam | vayorogādyapekṣā vicāraṇīyam || 16 || 17 ||

ab.seg:
trivṛtācūrṇam | atha vātādīnāṃ koṣṭhamātrādibhedena katipayayogān darśayann āha -
pittottare trivṛccūrṇaṃ drākṣākkāthādibhiḥ pibet ||18||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. pitte virecanasya prādhānyakhyāpanārthaṃ prāk | pittottaragrahaṇam | pittottare koṣṭhe drākṣākvāthādibhiḥ trivṛccūrṇaṃ pibet | ādigrahaṇāt kṣīrekṣukāśmaryasvāduskandavarārasādibhiḥ | kaphārditaḥ triphalākvāthagomūtraiḥ vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ trivṛccūrṇaṃ ca pibet| atrāpi virekāyeti saṃbandhaḥ | vātārditaḥ trivṛtśuṇṭhīsaindhavānāṃ cūrṇam amlair madyakāñjikabījapūrarasādibhiḥ athavā jāṅgalānāṃ rasair hariṇaiṇatittiralāvādīnāṃ rasair māṃsarasair virecanaṃ pibet | vāgbhaṭe tu -
‘atha kāle tu tac cūrṇaṃ kiṃcinnāgarasaindhavam |
vātāmaye pibed amlaiḥ pitte sājyasitāmadhu |
kṣīradrākṣekṣukāśmaryasvāduskandhavarārasaiḥ |
kaphāmaye pīlurasamūtramadyāmlakāñjikaiḥ |
pañcakolādicūrṇaiś ca yuktyā yuktaṃ kaphāpahaiḥ |
trivṛtkalkakaṣāyeṇa sādhitaḥ sasito himaḥ |
madhu trijātasaṃyukto leho hṛdyaṃ virecanam |
ajagandhā tavakṣīrī vidārī śarkarā trivṛt |
cūrṇitaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ līḍhvā sādhu viricyate |
sannipātajvarastambhapipāsādāhapīḍitaḥ |
tvagelābhyāṃ samā nīlī tais trivṛttaiś ca śarkarā |
cūrṇaṃ phalarasakṣaudrasaktubhis tarpaṇaṃ pibet |
vātapittakaphottheṣu rogeṣv alpānaleṣv api |
nareṣu sukumāreṣu nirapāyaṃ virecanam’ || iti | cakradatte tu - ‘bhittvā dvidhekṣu parilipya kalkais tribhaṇḍijātaiḥ pariveṣṭya rajjvā | pakvaṃ tu samyak puṭapākayuktyā khādet tu taṃ pittagadī suśītam’ iti || 18 || 19 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. trivṛtādivirecanaṃ kathaṃ pibet ? ity āha - pittottare pittādhikye trivṛccūrṇaṃ drākṣākkāthādibhi: pibet | kaphārditaḥ triphalākkāthaṃ gomūtraiḥ pītvā trikaṭukaṃ pibet | vātārditaḥ vātapīḍitaḥ trivṛtsaindhavaśuṇṭhīnāṃ cūrṇam amlair nimbādibhiḥ pibet | jāṅgalānāṃ jāṅgalamāṃsānāṃ vā rasena iti pakṣāntare || 18 || 19 ||

lg.l: yuktaṃ pītaṃ payobhir vā nacireṇa viricyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha krūrakoṣṭhādīnām api tatkṣaṇam eva virekārthaṃ prakāram āha - eraṇḍataileti | ayaṃ yogas trikoṣṭhaviṣaye yojyaḥ | tatra payobhir veti | ’vā’ śabdo vikalpārthe | tena triphalākvāthadugdhābhyāṃ militvaiva tailaṃ peyam ity eke | vyāsena vā payasaiva kevalena dviguṇenety anye || 20 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyad api auṣadhayoge virecanavidhānam āha - eraṇḍataile | dviguṇena triphalākvāthena yuktaṃ pītvā, payobhir dugdhair vā pītvā pumān nacireṇa śīghreṇa viricyate || 20 ||

ṣaḍṛtuvirecanam |
trivṛtā kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ pippalī viśvabheṣajam || 21 ||

lg.l: pippalī nāgaraṃ sindhu śyāmā ca trivṛtā saha ||23 ||
lihet kṣaudreṇa śiśire vasante ca virecanam |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ ṣaḍṛtuvirekaviṣayatvena tadyogānurūpān yogān āha - trivṛteti | trivṛtādibhir varṣākāle prāvṛṣi virecanaṃ tatra doṣasañcayāt | trivṛt śyāmā, kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ indrayavā:, pippalī māgadhī, viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī, drākṣā gostanī, tasyā rasaḥ, kṣaudraṃ madhu iti | varṣāgrahaṇena prāvṛṭgrahaṇaṃ doṣopacayaprakopanimittāt | ghanātyaye śaratkāle yogam āha - trivṛddurālabhetyādi | trivṛt śyāmā, durālabhā samudrāntā tasyā alābhe yavāsakaḥ, mustā bhadramustā, śarkarā sitopalā, udīcyaṃ vālakaṃ, candanaṃ śvetacandanaṃ cūrṇayogyatvāt | drākṣāmbunā gostanīkvāthena rasena vā | sayaṣṭyāhvaṃ yaṣṭīmadhusahitaṃ, śītalaṃ śītaguṇaṃ śītasparśaṃ ca tena pittaghnatvamasya yogasya kathitam | ata eva śaratkāle yogyatā'sya yogasya iti | śiśire vasante ca virecanam āha - pippalī nāgaram iti | pippalī kaṇā, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, saindhavam, śyāmā śyāmamūlā, trivṛt mālavikākhyā aruṇamūlā ca | uktaṃ ca - ‘vidyād dvidhā ca tan mūlaṃ śyāmaṃ śyāmāruṇaṃ trivṛt’ iti | śiśiragrahaṇena hemantasyā'pi grahaṇam | vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘trivṛtāṃbahuṣu pustakeṣu mūlapāṭhe nāyaṃ ślokaḥ paṭhitaḥ | citrakaṃ pāṭhām ajājīsaralaṃ vacām | svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pibet’ iti | grīṣme virecanam āha - tulyā śarkarā grīṣmakāle grīṣmākhye kāle virecanaṃ deyam | anyat sugamam | atra kecit sarvartukaṃ yogaṃ paṭhanti || 21-24 ||

tad yathā -
trivṛtāṃ hapuṣāṃ dantīṃ saptalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm |
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca saṃcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayetryaham ||25||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. varṣākāle virecanavidhānam āha - trivṛtā niḥsṛtā, kauṭajaṃ bījam indrayavāḥ, viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī, mṛdvīkā drākṣā tadrasaṃ, kṣaudraṃ madhu, varṣākāle idaṃ virecanam | śaradvirecanam āha -trivṛt niḥsṛtā, durālabhā yavāsā, śarkarā sitā, candanaṃ śvetam, udīcyaṃ vālakam, yaṣṭayāhvaṃ madhuyaṣṭī | etad drākṣāmbunā drākṣājalena ghanātyaye śaradvirecanam | atha hemantavirecanam - sindhu saindhavam, śyāmā vṛddhadārakaḥ trivṛt niḥsṛtā | grīṣme virecanam - sugamam anyat || 25 ||

asya ślokasya dantīsthāne vāgbhaṭe trāyantī paṭhitā | trivṛt trāyantī, hapuṣā sātalā, kaṭurohiṇī samānaṃ jñeyam | ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate kṣepako 'yam iti manyamānair asmābhir api na vyākhyātaḥ || 25 ||

abhayādimodakāḥ |
abhayā maricaṃ śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgāmalakāni ca || 26 ||

lg.l: pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ tvakpatraṃ mustam eva ca |
etāni samabhāgāni dantī ca dviguṇā bhavet ||27||
ekaikaṃ bhakṣayet prātaḥ śītaṃ cānu pibej jalam |
tāvad viricyate jantur yāvad uṣṇaṃ na sevate || 29 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha sarvakālīnaśīlanārthaṃ abhayāmodakān āha - abhayeti | ete abhayāmodakāḥ sarvartuṣu prasiddhāḥ | kvāpi śītavirecanasaṃjñaḥ| tvak guḍatvak, dantī triguṇā pṛthagbhārayāpekṣayā, evaṃ trivṛd api cāṣṭaguṇā, śarkarāpy evaṃ ṣaḍguṇā | kecit sakaladravyebhyaḥ ṣaḍguṇatvam aṣṭhaguṇatvaṃ vyākhyānayanti, tan na tantrāntarasaṃvādāt uktaṃ ca -
abhayā, pippalīmūlaṃ, maricaṃ, nāgaraṃ, tathā |
tvak, patraṃ, pippalī mustaṃ viḍaṅgāmalakāni ca ||
karṣaḥ pratyekam eṣāṃ tu dantyāḥ karṣatrayaṃ tathā |
ṣaṭkarṣās tu sitā deyā dvipalaṃ trivṛtā bhavet ||
sarvaṃ saṃcūrṇitaṃ kṛtvā madhunā modakaṃ tathā |
khādet pratidinaṃ caikaṃ śītaṃ cānu pibej jalam ||
tāvad viricyate jantur yāvad uṣṇaṃ na sevate |
pāṇḍurogaṃ viṣaṃ kāsaṃ jaṅghāpārśvarujas tathā ||
pṛṣṭyartimūtrakṛcchūṃ ca durnāmaṃ sabhagandaram |
aśmarī mehakuṣṭhaṃ ca dāhaśothodarāṇi ca || yakṣmāṇaṃ cakṣūrogaṃ ca kramaṃ vaidyena jānatā | yojito 'yaṃ nihanty āśu abhayā nāma modakaḥ’ iti | dṛḍhabalena elācādhikā'sti -
‘vyoṣatvak patramustailāṃ viḍaṅgāmalakābhayāḥ|
samabhāgā bhiṣak dadyāt triguṇaṃ ca mukūlakam | trivṛtā'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhāgaṃ śarkarāyāś ca ṣaḍguṇam’ ityādi | mukūlaṃ dantī, madhuneti modakakaraṇocitamānena | śītāmbunā pibej jalam iti yogaprabhāvo 'yam | anyatra ‘śītāmbhasā stambhaḥ syāt rasāyanam’ iti | rasādikaraṇād rasāyanam | puṣṭibalavarṇakṛt | athavā rasāyanāṅgam idaṃ virecanaṃ rasāyanam iti prāṇadā modakāḥ || 26-33 ||
