Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha sukhavirecanam āha - abhayā harītakī, āmalakaṃ, tvak guḍatvak, patraṃ patrajaṃ, mustaṃ bhadramustakam, etāni samabhāgāni, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ triguṇā tribhāgā, tṛvṛt śyāmā aṣṭabhāgā, śarkarā ṣaḍguṇā ṣaḍbhāgā | kecid dantyādīn cūrṇān bhāgavṛddhān āhuḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 26-33 ||

virecanaṃ pītvā kiṃ kuryāt tad āha --
pītvā virecanaṃ śītajalaiḥ saṃsicya cakṣuṣī |
sugandhiṃ kiñcid āghrāya tāmbūlaṃ śīlayed varam ||34||

lg.l: nivātastho na vegāṃś ca dhārayen na svapet tathā |
śītāmbu na spṛśet kkāpi koṣṇanīraṃ piben muhuḥ ||35||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. śītajalair iti | virekauṣadhaklamanāśārthaṃ śītalajalena netrasecanam | tathā sugandhaṃ mṛgamadasurabhi uttamacandanādīny āghrāya paścād varaṃ śreṣṭhajīrṇatāmbūlīpatrakṛtaṃ śīlayet | nivātastha iti vegapravṛttyarthaṃ vegāṃś ca na dhārayet, ūrdhvavātādirogotpādakatvāt | svāpena virekauṣadhaśaktihāniḥ syāt | śītāmbu ityādi | śītalodakaṃ kvāpi pānādau na spṛśet | rekastambhakatvāt | ata evāha - koṣṇanīraṃ piben muhur iti | vāraṃ vāraṃ koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyaṃ rekaikakaraṇārtham ity arthaḥ ||34||35||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virecanānte yat kartavyaṃ tad āha - sugandhaṃ dravyam | vireke jāte kathaṃ tiṣṭhed ity āha - vegān vātādīn na dhārayet, na svapet nidrāṃ na kuryāt, koṣṇanīraṃ muhuḥ pibet | kvāpi kadāpi uṣṇatve śītāmbunā spṛśet na sarvadā || 34 || 35 ||

ab.seg:
samyagvāntalakṣaṇena samyagvirekalakṣaṇam āha -
balāsauṣadhapittāni vāyur vānte yathā vrajet |
rekāt tathā malaṃ pittaṃ bheṣajaṃ ca kapho vrajet ||36||

Āḍhamalla. yathā vamane prathamaṃ balāsaḥ kaphaḥ pravartate | paścād vamanadravyaṃ nirgacchet | tadanu pittāni | bahuvacanatvena haritapītāni kaṭutittaprāyāṇīti | tatpaścād vāyur iti | tathā evam api virekāt prathamaṃ malaṃ purīṣaṃ tadanu pittaṃ tatpaścād virecanaṃ dravyaṃ | tadanu kaphaḥ pravartata iti | tena kaphānte ca virecanam iti vacanāt | etena samyag vā'samyag viriktaś ca kathita ity abhiprāyaḥ | anyathā durvānto durvirikta iti | tena durvāntalakṣaṇam anādhyāye 'bhihitaṃ durviriktalakṣaṇam atraivāgre vakṣyati | nābher iti ṣaṣṭhaṃ vadanti kecit | tatra nābher eva srastatvam ||36||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virekāt kiṃ niḥsaratīty āha - vānte sati yathā balāsauṣadhapittāni vāyuḥ vrajet tathā raikāt kaphaḥ malaṃ pittaṃ bheṣajaṃ ca gamayet balāsaḥ kapham, auṣadhaṃ bhakṣitaṃ malaṃ purīṣam ||36||

atha durviriktalakṣaṇam āha -
durviriktasya nābhes tu stabdhatvaṃ kukṣiśūlatā |
purīṣavātasaṃgaś ca kaṇḍūmaṇḍalagauravaḥ || 37 ||

lg.l: vidāho 'rucir ādhmānaṃ bhramaś chardiś ca jāyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. durviriktasya na samyag viriktasya narasya nābheḥ stabdhatvādayo jāyante | nābher iti | nābheḥ nābhyupalakṣitasya pradeśasya pakvāśayākhyasya stabdhatvaṃ stabdhatā, tathā kukṣiśūlatā kukṣyoḥ śūlaṃ | purīṣavātasaṅgaś ceti malavātayoḥ saṅgo rodhaḥ | tathā kaṇḍūmaṇḍalagauravam iti kaṇḍūḥ śarīre, maṇḍalaśabdenātra varaṭīdaṃśasadṛśaṃ gauravaṃ śarīrodarayoḥ | vidāhaḥ pittavad dāhaḥ | arucir arocakaḥ | ādhmānam udarāpūraḥ | bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyeva vastudarśanam | vāntiḥ chardiś ceti | iti durviriktasya lakṣaṇam ||37||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vireke durviriktalakṣaṇam āha - durviriktasya asamyag viriktasya nābheḥ stambhatvaṃ stabdhatā, tu punaḥ kukṣiśūlatā, purīṣavātayoḥ saṃgaḥ apravṛttiḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 37 ||

athāsya durviriktasya punaḥ cikitsām āha --
taṃ puna: pācanaiḥ snehaiḥ paktvā saṃsnehya recayet ||38||

Āḍhamalla. tam iti | durviriktaṃ puruṣaṃ pācanaiḥ pācanauṣadhaiḥ paktvā arthād āmaṃ doṣaṃ ca snehaiḥ saṃsnehya recayet | teneti | tena svedanasnehanenāsya durviriktasyopadravā yānti naśyantīty arthaḥ | tataḥ dīptāgnir bhavet | laghutā ca śarīrasya bhavati || 38 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ durvirecitacitsām āha - āragvadhādibhis tathā snehair ghṛtapācanādyair āmaṃ paktvā saṃsnehya snehanaṃ kṛtvā virecayet || 38||

idānīṃ virekātiśayasya lakṣaṇam āha -
virekasyātiyogena mūrcchā bhraṃśo gudasya ca ||39||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. virekasyātiyogena mūrcchādayo bhavanti | gudasya bhraṃśa iti | gudasya bahirnirgamanaṃ, tac cātisaṃpravāhaṇād bhavati | uktaṃ ca - ‘pravāhikā'tisārābhyāṃ nirgacchati gudo bahi:’ iti | śūlaṃ nānāprakārakam atra jñeyam | tena parikartikā'py atra bhavati | kaphātiyogaḥ syāt kaphasya atisaraṇaṃ bhavati | ‘tathā māṃsadhāvanasaṃnibhādikaṃ viricyate māṃsadhāvanodakatulyaṃ, medonibhaṃ medaḥsadṛśam | jalābhāsam iti | jalasadṛśaṃ svaccham ity arthaḥ | raktaṃ vā'pi viricyata iti raktam eva vā viricyate | anye māṃsadhāvanādīni cāsya viśeṣaṇāni manyante niṣpurīṣatvāt | iti virekātiyogalakṣaṇam || 39 || 40 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virekasyātiyogenādhikyena mūrcchādayo bhavanti | māṃsadhāvanādinibhaṃ viricyate ceti ||39||40||

ab.seg:
atha virekātiyogacikitsām āha --
tasya śītāmbubhiḥ siktvā śarīraṃ taṇḍulāmbubhiḥ |
madhumiśrais tathā śītaiḥ kārayed vamanaṃ mṛdu || 41 ||

lg.l: ajākṣīraṃ rasaṃ vā'pi vaiṣkiraṃ hāriṇaṃ tathā |
śālibhiḥ ṣaṣṭikaiḥ svalpaṃ masūrair vāpi bhojayet ||43||
śītaiḥ saṃgrāhibhir dravyaiḥ kuryāt saṃgrahaṇaṃ bhiṣak |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. tasya vamanaṃ mṛdu kārayet | tasya virekārditasya vamanaṃ mṛdu kārayet | kiṃ kṛtvā ? śītāmbubhiḥ śītajalaiḥ śarīraṃ siktvā siñcayitvā | taṇḍulāmbubhir iti | taṇḍuladhāvanodakaiḥ | madhumiśrair iti | taṇḍuladhāvanair madhumiśrair ity arthaḥ | śītair iti | śītavīryadravyair lepam āha - sahakāratvaca ityādi | sahakāra āmraḥ tasya tvacaḥ kalkaḥ dadhnā sauvīrakeṇa kāñjikabhedena peṣayitvā nābhipralepena ulbaṇam atīsāraṃ hanyāt | bhojanam āha - ajākṣīram ityādi | kṣīrādikaṃ raktaśālibhiḥ ṣaṣṭikair vā saha bhojayet | kṣīrasya kevalasyā'pi pānam āhur eke saṃgrāhakatvāt | rasaṃ māṃsarasaṃ, vaiṣkiraṃ hāriṇaṃ vā | viṣkirā lāvatittirādayaḥ | śālibhir iti raktaśālyādibhiḥ | ṣaṣṭikair iti prasiddhaiḥ | svalpam ity anena bhṛṣṭataṇḍulabhavaṃ śāktukam api deyaṃ | masūrair api svalpaṃ bhojanaṃ deyam | svalpam ajīrṇabhayāt | athavā śītaiḥ śītavīryair dravyaiḥ saṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt iti || 41-43 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ativiriktopadrave pratīkāram āha - tasya śītāmbubhiḥ śītajalai: śarīraṃ siktaṃ sevitaṃ kuryāt | tathā madhumiśrais taṇḍulāmbubhir mṛdu vamanaṃ kārayet | pratīkārāntaram āha - sahakāraḥ āmraḥ tasya tvacaḥ dadhnā sauvīraṃ kāñjikaṃ tena piṣṭvā lepayet | sa lepaḥ ulvaṇam atīsāraṃ hanti | atirekagrahaṇārthaṃ pathyam āha - śīteḥ saṃgrāhibhir dravyaiḥ saṃgrahaṇaṃ bhiṣak kuryāt, ajākṣīraṃ pāyayet tathā hāriṇaṃ hariṇamāṃsajaṃ rasaṃ vaiṣkiraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ māṃsarasaṃ vā ṣaṣṭikaiḥ śālibhir masūrair vā bhojayet | svalpaṃ tuccham | tathā śuṇṭhyādibhiḥ śītair dravyair dāḍimādyair bhiṣak saṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt || 41-43 ||

samyag viriktasya pācanādiprakāram āha -
lāghavaṃ manasas tuṣṭir anulomaṃ gate 'nile || 44||

lg.l: suviriktaṃ naraṃ jñātvā pācanaṃ pāyayen niśi |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. lāghavaṃ śarīrasyeti | manasas tuṣṭir iti | cittasaṃtoṣaḥ | anile vāyau anulomam adhobhāgaṃ gate sati etādṛśalakṣaṇena suviriktaṃ naraṃ jānīyāt | evaṃ jñātvā tasyā'pi pācanaṃ niśi dadyāt | pācanam aśeṣasyātra boddhavyaṃ | tac ca mudgayūṣādikam ity eke | yad uktaṃ ‘virecanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dadhyannaṃ stambhane hitam | āmānte ca pradātavyam anyathā mudgamūṣaka’m iti | kecit tu pācanaṃ pāyayen niśītipadaṃ vinā paṭhanti na tu samyag viriktasyāyam eva kramaḥ | yathāprāptiś ca viṭpittakaphānilā na samyag viriktasya bhaveyuḥ krameṇeti | na caivaṃ kaphāntapadavyāghātaḥ | tena pācanapādaḥ keṣāṃcin manoharaṃ | yato vāyur hi niḥśeṣaṃ kaphe kṛte āmāśaye śūnyatayā kevalaḥ saratīti | yad vā ācāryeṇa padapūraṇārthaṃ likhitam | tenāsyā'nyo 'bhiprāyaḥ | pācanaṃ rātrāv evety arthaḥ || 44||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ suviriktalakṣaṇam āha - dehasya lāghave sati manaḥ saṃtuṣṭyāṃ satyām anile vāyau anulomaṃ gate svamārge prāpte sati lakṣaṇair naraṃ suviriktaṃ jñātvā niśi pācanaṃ eraṇḍaśuṇṭhīdhānyajaṃ pāyayet || 44 ||

virecanasya phalam āha --
indriyāṇāṃ balaṃ buddheḥ prasādaṃ vahnidīpanam || 45 ||

Āḍhamalla. indriyāṇām iti | cakṣurādīnāṃ balaṃ svasvaviṣayagrāhakatāśaktyatiśayaḥ | buddheḥ prasādaḥ prasannatā, vahneḥ kāyāgneḥ dīpanaṃ bhavati | dhātūnāṃ rasādīnāṃ sthairyaṃ mārgasya śuddhatvāt | tenaiva hetunā vayasaḥ sthairyaṃ karoti | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘buddheḥ prasādaṃ balam indriyāṇāṃ dhātusthiratvaṃ jvalanasya dīptiḥ | cirāc ca pākaṃ, vayasaḥ karoti saṃśodhanaṃ samyag upāsyamānam’ iti ||45||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. recanasevanāt kiṃ bhavati ? ity āha - indriyāṇāṃ netrādīnāṃ balaṃ sthairyaṃ buddheḥ prasādam || 45 ||

kṛtavirecanasya pravātādīn niṣedhayati -
pradātasevāśītāmbusnehābhyaṅgam ajīrṇatām || 46 ||

lg.l: vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ caiva na seveta virecitaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. virecitaḥ kṛtavirecanaḥ pravātasevādīn na seveta, prakṛṣṭavātasevanaṃ tasya ca doṣakaratvāt | śītāmbusevanaṃ srotorodhādikāraṇāt | snehābhyaṅgasyāgnimāndyakaratvāt | uktaṃ ca - ‘varjyo 'bhyaṅgaḥ kaphagrastas tathāsaṃśuṣyajīrṇibhiḥ’ iti | cakārāt kṣaṇajāgaraṇavegānāṃ ca rodhanaṃ krodhaśokahimātapātibhāṣyatyāsanasaṃsthitinīcātyuccopavidhānāhaḥsvapnāni ||46||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virecananiṣedhavargam āha - virekataḥ pravātasevādyaṃ na seveta ity anvayaḥ || 46 ||

atha viriktasya pathyārthaṃ peyādi dravyāṇy āha -
śāliṣaṣṭikamudgādyair yavāgūṃ bhojayet kṛtām || 47 ||
jaṅghālaviṣkirāṇāṃ vā rasaiḥ śālyodanaṃ hitam | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharapraṇītāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe virecanavidhir nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. yavāgūśabdaḥ peyādyupalakṣaṇārthaḥ | tena śālyādibhiḥ kṛtāḥ peyādayo sevyāḥ | sā yavāgū: nānāvidhaṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātā | tathā jaṅghālaviṣkirāṇāṃ rasaiḥ śālyodanaṃ hitam | uktaṃ ca -‘krameṇānena bhuñjāno bhajet prakṛtibhojanam’ iti | saṃśodhane peyādikrama eva hitaḥ | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe -
‘śodhanāsravavisrāvasnehayojanalaṅghanaiḥ |
yāty agnir mandatāṃ tasmāt kramaṃ peyādikaṃ bhajet’ | sa ca yathā - ‘peyāṃ vilepīm akṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīn ubhayaṃ tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro 'nnakālān pradhānasādhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ’ iti | tatra jaṅghālā hariṇaiṇādayaḥ | viṣkirā lāvatittirādayaḥ | pradhānaśuddhyā śuddhaḥ puruṣaḥ trīn, annakālān peyādīn seveta | madhyaśuddhyā śuddhaḥ dvau dvau annakālau | avaraśuddhyā śuddhaḥ ekaikam annakālaṃ peyādikaṃ seveta iti || 47 || iti śrīvāstatryānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe virecādhyāya:||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vireke pathyavargam āha - virekānantaraṃ śālyādibhiḥ kṛtāṃ yavāgūṃ bhojayet jāṅgalair jāṅgalamāṃsarasair viṣkirāṇāṃ viṣkirasaṃjñānāṃ vā māṃsarasaiḥ śālyodanaṃ hitaṃ bhavati | virekauṣadhipīte asamyagvireke punaḥ kriyām āha vireko nikṣepakaḥ || 47 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadhara- gūḍhārthadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi virecanādhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

div.head: atha snehabastividhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
atha bastividhiṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte - atha bastividhiḥ | tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ - ‘pañcakarma vamī, reko, nirūho 'nvāsa-nāvanam’ iti | vamanavirekayor uktatvāt pāriśeṣyād vastividhim āha -
bastir dvidhānuvāsākhyo nirūhaś ca tataḥ param |
bastibhir dīyate vasmāt tasmād vastir iti smṛtaḥ || 1 ||
Āḍhamalla. bastir dvidhā dviprakāraḥ, eko 'nuvāsanākhyaḥ, dvitīyo nirūhasaṃjña: | bastiniruktim āha - yasmād bastibhiś carmapuṭakair dīyate tasmād bastiḥ || 1||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virekānantaraṃ bastividhānād vastividhānam āha - bastir yasmād bastibhir dīyate gudadeśe tasmād bastir iti smṛtaḥ | bastibhir eraṇḍakośādyaiḥ tad vakṣyati | sa bastir dvidhā eko 'nuvāsākhyaḥ aparo nirūhākhyaḥ || 1 ||

tayor lakṣaṇam āha -
yaḥ snehair dīyate sa syād anuvāsananāmakaḥ |
kaṣāya-kṣīra-tailair yo nirūhaḥ sa nigadyate || 2 ||

Āḍhamalla. athānurāsananirūhayoḥ saṃprāptim āha - snehaiḥ pakvasnehai: yaḥ dīyate so 'nuvāsākhyaḥ | yaḥ kaṣāyādibhiḥ sa nirūho nigadyate | nirūhaḥ baster bheda evāsthāpanakṣīrakaṣāyādibhir evāyaṃ dīyate || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yaḥ snehais tailādyai: dīyate so 'nuvāsanākhyaḥ, aparo yaḥ kaṣāyādyair dīyate sa nirūha: | anuvāsanaṃ kevalatailaina dīyate, nirūhe kaṣāyakṣīramiśritaṃ tailam ataḥ pūrvasmād bhinnaḥ || 2 ||

athānuvāsanādīnām anukramavidhānam āha --
tatrānuvāsanākhyo hi bastir yaḥ so 'tra kathyate |
pūrvam eva tato bastir nirūhākhyo bhaviṣyati || 3 ||

lg.l: nirūhād uttaraṃ caiva bastiḥ syād uttarābhidhaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. tatra teṣu bastiṣu madhye yaḥ anuvāsananāmā bastiḥ sa pūrvam evā'trā'dhyāye kathyate | pūrvam eveti sambandhaḥ | tata iti | anuvāsanānantaraṃ nirūhākhyaḥ bastir bhaviṣyati | kathayiṣyata ity abhiprāyaḥ | nirūhād uttaraṃ nirūhabaster anantaram uttarābhidhaḥ uttaranāmā bastiḥ kathayiṣyata iti sambandhaḥ tena traya evādhyāyāḥ pṛthak jñātavyāḥ | yad vā pūrvam evānuvāsanabastiḥ kāryaḥ | tat paścān nirūhabastiḥ kāryaḥ | tadanu uttarabastir iti | iti kramaviṣayānukramaḥ | tathā hi - ‘basteḥ snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā tataḥ paścān nirūhayet’ ityādivacanāt ||3||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tayoḥ kathanapratijñām āha - pūrvaṃ prathamataḥ anuvāsanākhyo yo bastiḥ so 'tra kathyate tasmād anantaraṃ nirūhākhyo bastir bhaviṣyati nirūhāgre uttarābhidhaḥ uttarākhyabastir bhaviṣyati || 3 ||

athavā kathanakrameṇaiva bastir anuvāsanabheda eva ity ata āha -
anuvāsanabhedaś ca mātrā bastir udīritaḥ || 4 ||
Āḍhamalla. mātrākṛtabhedatvān mātrābastiḥ || 4 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anuvāsanabheda eva mātrābastir udīritaḥ kathitaḥ | ete catvāro bastibhedabhedāḥ || 4 ||

div.ab:
tasya mātrām āha -
paladvayaṃ tasya mātrā tasmād ardhā'pi vā bhavet |

Āḍhamalla. tasyeti mātrā basteḥ paladvayaṃ dvipalapramāṇaṃ | tasmād iti dvipalārdhapalapramāṇamātrā bhavet | etenāyam artha: saṃpannaḥ yasyottamā palādimātrārhati tasya dvipalāṃ prathamaṃ | tataḥ palārdhena vṛddhiḥ evaṃ navabhir dinaiḥ ṣaṭpalī mātrā pūrṇā bhavati | tathā yasya tripalī mātrārhati tasya palaṃ prathamaṃ deyaṃ tataś ca karṣeṇa vṛddhiḥ evaṃ navabhir dinaiḥ tripalī mātrā bhavati | evaṃ kanīyasī mātrā'pi jñeyā sāpi vāgrahaṇād boddhavyā | tā mātrā agre prakaṭayiṣyati granthakṛt ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. teṣāṃ mātrām āha - tasya basteḥ snehādīnāṃ mātrā paladvayaṃ tasmād ardhaṃ vā palaṃ bhavet ||

ab.seg:
anuvāsanayogyāḥ |
anuvāsyas tu rūkṣaḥ syāt tīkṣṇāgniḥ kevalānilī ||5||

Āḍhamalla. athānuvāsanayogam āha rūkṣaḥ puruṣo 'nuvāsana anuvāsanayogya ity arthaḥ | tīkṣṇāgnir iti bhasmakākhyavahniyutaḥ | kevalānilīti | nanu ‘bastir vāte ca pitte ca kaphe caiva hi śasyate | saṃsarge sannipāte ca bastir eva hitaḥ sade’tyādivacanāt kathaṃ kevalānilī anuvāsya iti | ucyate | trīn api doṣān pakvāśayagatān bastir jayati | āmāśayagatabastiḥ pacyamānā saṃyogaṃ taṃ pittavirekaḥ | iti paramaṃ matpūrvapakkasiddhāntaḥ | anyatrāpy uktaṃ - ‘pittaṃ vā kaphapittaṃ vā pittāśayagataṃ haret | asanaṃ trīn malān bastir jayet pakkāśayasthitān’ iti | evaṃ raktam api duṣṭaraktaprasādanivṛtto bastiḥ prasādayati | svamate tu kevalānilīty asya samādhānam etat | tad yathā āsthāpanānuvāsanaṃ khalu sarvopakramebhyo vāte pradhānatamaṃ | rogaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ boddhavyam ity adoṣaḥ | anyad api samādhānaṃ savistaraṃ tad atra vistarabhatathāhi rudrabhaṭe na vistarato likhitaṃ - kevalānilīti kevalānilī cānuvāsya: | iti viruddhamivābhāti ta- nnāntarasaṃvādāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘vātolvaṇeṣu doṣeṣu vāte vā bastiriṣyate’ iti | suśrute'pi - ’bastivati pitte ca kaphe rakte ca śasyate | saṃsarge sannipāte ca bastireva sadā hitaḥ’ iti | atrocyate vastirhi pakvāśayagataṃ kaphapittavātaṃ nirharati | uktaṃ ca carake - ‘pittaṃ vā kaphapittaṃ vā pittāśayagataṃ haret | sraṃsanaṃ trīn malān bastiḥ pakvāśayagataṃ haret’ | iti | saṃsargādau ca vātādhika eva bastiḥ | anenaivābhisaṃdhinā prāha vāgbhaṭaḥ - ‘vātolvaṇeṣu’ iti | raktaprasādanadravyeṇa datto bastiḥ raktaṃ prasādayati tatsthānagataṃ ca pakvāśayasya viśeṣato vā tatsthānatvācca kevalānītyuktam | uktaṃ ca - ‘pakvāśayakaṭisavithaśrotrāsthisparśanendriyaṃ sthānaṃ vātasya tatrā'pi pakvādhānaṃ viśeṣata’ iti | ata evoktaṃ - ‘śarīrajānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramauṣadham | bastirvireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtam’ iti | athavā vātarogaviṣayaṃ jñātavyam | uktaṃ ca -‘dāruṇāṃścānilāmayān’ iti sarvamavadātam | yān na likhitaṃ || 5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anuvāsanayogyam āha - rūkṣaḥ snehapānarahitaḥ pumān anuvāsyaḥ syāt | tathā tīkṣṇāgnir vṛddhāgniḥ | tathā kevalānilīti kevalavātarogavān | evaṃbhūta anuvāsyaḥ anuvāsanayogyaḥ syāt || 5 ||

athānuvāsane ye tyājyās tān āha -
nānuvāsyas tu kuṣṭhī syān mehī sthūlas tathodarī |
nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyāś cājīrṇonmādatṛḍarditāḥ ||6||

Āḍhamalla. kuṣṭhī tathā pramehī sthūlo medasvī tathā udarī ca ete 'nuvāsyā na bhavantīty arthaḥ | tu punar iti grahaṇāt ete tu āsthāpanīyā ity abhiprāyaḥ | yad uktam anyatrāpi - ‘udarī ca pramehī ca kuṣṭhī sthūlaś ca mānavaḥ | avaśyaṃ sthāpanīyās te nānuvāsyāḥ kathaṃcane’ti | atha ye tūbhayakarmarahitās tān āha - jīrṇeti | anirvārdhakyatvād vyāptaśarīrāḥ | ‘nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyās te 'jīrṇonmādatṛḍarditāḥ’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ | atra ajīrṇārdita ity arthaḥ | ajīrṇam atrāmaṃ vidigdhaṃ vā na tu viṣṭabdhājīrṇaṃ | tatra tu vihitam evety eke | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 6 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anuvāsanāyogyān āha - kuṣṭhī mehī sthūlas tathā udarī na anuvāsya: na anuvāsanayogyaḥ | anye ye nānuvāsyās tān āha - ete 'pi ajīrṇyādayo 'nuvāsyā na syu: yathāsthitasthāpanīyāḥ | tathā ca suśrute - ’udarī ca pramehī ca kuṣṭhī sthūlaś ca mānavaḥ | avaśyaṃ sthāpanīyāś ca nānu'vāsyā kathaṃcana’ iti ||6||

bastikaraṇadravyāṇi -
netraṃ kāryaṃ suvarṇādidhātubhir vṛkṣaveṇubhiḥ || 7 ||

lg.l: nalair dantair viṣāṇāgrair maṇibhir vā vidhīyate |
ekavarṣāt tu ṣaḍvarṣaṃ yāvan mānaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam || 8 ||
tato dvādaśakaṃ yāvan mānaṃ syād aṣṭasaṃmitam |
tanmūle karṇike dve ca kārye bhāgāc caturthakāt |
kaṣāyaraktaḥ sumṛdur bastiḥ snigdho dṛḍho hitaḥ |
vraṇabastes tu netraṃ syāc chlakṣṇam aṣṭāṅgulonmitam || 14||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. netram ityādi | netraṃ yantraṃ bastigatasnehakaṣāyādidravyaṃ nayanaṃ cārutvān netram iti saṃjñā | kimarthaṃ bastividhānārthaṃ bastidārḍhyārthaṃ | tac ca suvarṇādidhātubhir vidhīyate kriyate | ādigrahaṇād raupyatāmratrapulohādīnāṃ grahaṇam | tathā veṇvādibhir veṇur vaṃśaḥ | nalair nalikādibhiḥ tṛṇaviśeṣajātaiḥ | dantair hastidantaiḥ | viṣāṇāgrair iti śṛṅgāgraiḥ | uparitanasūkṣmabhāgaiḥ| maṇibhir marakatapuṣparāgavaiḍūryādibhiḥ | etena śuddhapāṣāṇair api vidhīyata iti sampradāyaḥ | uktaṃ ca dṛḍhabalena - ‘suvarṇarūpyatraputāmrarītikāṃsyāya‘sthi śastra’ iti carake pāṭhaḥ | sāsphigdrumaveṇudantaiḥ | nalair viṣāṇair maṇibhiś ca tais taiḥ kāryāṇi netrāṇi trikarṇikāni |
ṣaḍdvādaśāṣṭāṅgulasaṃmitāni ṣaḍṃviśatidvādaśavarṣajānām |
syur mudgakarkandhusatīnavāhi chidrāṇi vartyā pihitāni cāpi |
yathāvayo 'ṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ mūlāgrayoḥ syu: pariṇāhavanti |
ṛjūni gopucchasamākṛtīni ślakṣṇāni vā syur guṭikāmukhāni |
syāt karṇikaikāgracaturthabhāge mūlāśrite bandhanibandhane dve | jaradgavo māhiṣahāriṇo vā syāc chaukaro bastir ajasya vā'pi’ iti ( ca. saṃ. 3) | sphigasthi | atha netraparimāṇam āha - ekavarṣād iti | ekavarṣāt prathamavarṣāt ṣaḍvarṣaṃ yāvat tāvan mānaṃ netrasya ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvan mānaṃ ṣaḍvarṣam, etat parimāṇam āyāmena kathitaṃ | ṣaḍvarṣād ūrdhvaṃ yāvat dvādaśavarṣāṇi tāvan netrāyāmaparimāṇaṃ daśāṅgulam | eke - ‘mānaṃ syād aṣṭasaṃmitam’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tataḥ param iti dvādaśavarṣād ārabhya yāvad viṃśativarṣāṇi tāvad dvādaśāṅgulaṃ netrāyāmam, ataḥ paraṃ netrāyāmatā nāstīty uktatvāt | vāgbhaṭe tu -
‘ūne 'bde pañcapūrṇe 'sminnā saptabhyo 'ṅgulāni ṣaṭ |
saptame sapta tāny aṣṭau dvādaśe ṣoḍaśe nava | dvādaśaiva paraṃ viśād vīkṣya varṣāntareṣu ca | vayo balaśarīrāṇi pramāṇam abhivardhayet’ iti | atha netrāgrarandhraparimāṇam āha - mudgetyādi | ṣaḍaṅgulanetrasya mudgapramāṇaṃ ākāreṇa vartulatvāt | tac ca svinnam, evaṃ māṣādir api khinnam eva | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘mudga māṣaṃ kalāyānnaṃ svinnaṃ karkandhukaṃ kramāt’ iti | kaṣāyo 'tra vartulakalāyaḥ satīnasaṃjña | yathāsaṃkhyam iti krameṇa ity arthaḥ | tac ca netraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ komalaṃ | gopucchākāram iti | ākāreṇa āturāṅguṣṭhamānena mūlasthūlam | mūlam atra carmabandhanamukham | agre ca netrāgre kaniṣṭhikāpariṇāhatā jñeyā | agre iti gudāsannihitamukhe | guṭikāmukham iti | tadagramukhe ca guṭikā kāryā vartulā ity arthaṃ: | tanmūle iti | netrasya mūle carmalagnamukhe dve karṇike kārye | karṇikā mekhalāśabdavācyā yayoś carmapuṭakāgraṃ saṃnahyate | ata evāha - ‘yojayet tatra bastiṃ ca bandhadvayavidhānata’ iti | dvābhyāṃ bandhanābhyāṃ netre bastiṃ badhvā gudādau yojayet praveśayed ity arthaḥ | caturthabhāgād ityādi | etena uttaramukhe caturthabhāgaparyantam ekā karṇikā kāryā iti vaidyasampradāyaḥ | tatas tāṃ maryādīkṛtya gudamadhye praveśayed ity arthaḥ | uktaṃ ca cakradatte - ‘syāt karṇe cāgracaturthabhāge mūlāśrite bastinibandhane dve’ ityādi | bastinetrakaraṇadravyaprasaṃgād vraṇabastim āha - tu punaḥ vraṇabasteḥ, vraṇo nāḍīvraṇaḥ tannimittaṃ yan netraṃ yantraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ komalaṃ tathā'ṣṭāṅgulonmitaṃ parimāṇaṃ netraṃ kāryam | etac ca pūrvoktabastidravyasya mudgacchidraṃ nalikāyantraṃ sacchidraṃ bahīrandhraṃ kāryam | tathā gṛdhrapakṣanalikāpariṇāhi, tena nalikāpariṇāhamānam uktam || 7-14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bastimukhasthāpanārthaṃ suvarṇādīnāṃ netram āha - netraṃ gudapraveśanalikārūpaṃ suvarṇādidhātubhiḥ kāryaṃ tathā vṛkṣaveṇubhiḥ veṇur vaṃśaḥ tathā nalair dantaiḥ hastidantaiḥ viṣāṇaḥ ślakṣṇas tadagrabhūtair maṇibhiḥ sūryakāntādibhir vā vidhīyate | vayaḥpramāṇe netrapramāṇam āha - ekavarṣād ārabhya yāvat ṣaḍvarṣaṃ tāvat ṣaḍaṅgulamātraṃ bhavati | tataḥ ṣaḍvarṣād yāvat dvādaśavarṣaṃ syāt tāvad aṣṭasaṃmitam aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇaṃ netraṃ syāt | tataḥ paraṃ dvādaśavarṣānantaraṃ dvādaśabhir aṅgulair netraṃ īryatāṃ prāpyatāṃ tasya yādṛśaṃ chidraṃ bhavati tādṛśam āha mṛducchidraṃ netraṃ kalāpo vartulakaḥ tatsadṛśaṃ punaḥ kolāsthisannibhaṃ kolaṃ badaraṃ tadasthisadṛśaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ caturaṅgulādipramāṇaṃ bhavet | punaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ cikkaṇaṃ punar gopucchasannibhaṃ gopucchākāraṃ mūle sthūlam agre sūkṣmaṃ mūle sthūlaṃ tu mānena aṅguṣṭhākāraṃ vidhīyate kriyate agre kaniṣṭhikāpariṇāham - agrabhāge kaniṣṭhikāṅgulisthūlaṃ tathā guṭikāmukhaṃ vartulaṃ tanmūle caturthakān bhāgān dve karṇike kārye karṇike kamalapatrākāre | bandhadvayavidhānataḥ bandhadvayayogataḥ tatra bastiṃ yojayet | bastiḥ kasya mūtrakośasya bhavatīty āha - mūtrakośo 'ṇḍas tasya bastiḥ | sa mūtrakośo mṛgādīnāṃ bhavati tadalābhena cāṇḍalābho carmajo 'pi bhavati | kiṃbhūto bastiḥ kaṣāyaraktaḥ kaṣāyeṇa badaryādicūrṇakaṣāyeṇa raktaḥ rañjitaḥ mṛdu komalaḥ snigdhaḥ sacikkaṇaḥ dṛḍho navaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ | vraṇabasteś ca pramāṇam āha - vraṇasya śarīrāder vraṇasya yo bastis tasya evaṃbhūtaṃ netraṃ syāt | ślakṣṇaṃ cikkaṇam aṣṭāṅgulaṃ tathā mudgacchidraṃ tathā gṛdhrapakṣanalikācchidradīrgham || 7-14 ||

bastisevāguṇān āha -
śarīropacayaṃ varṇaṃ balam ārogyam āyuṣaḥ || 15 ||

lg.l: kurute parivṛddhiṃ ca bastiḥ samyag upāsitaḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. samyaktayā yathoktatayā upāsita: sevito bastiḥ śarīropacayādīn kurute | uktaṃ ca - ‘bastir vayaḥ sthāpayitā sukhāyurvarṇāgnimedhāsvaravarṇakṛc ca | sarvārthakārī śiśuvṛddhayūnāṃ niratyayaḥ sarvagadāpahaś ca’ iti | suśrute 'pi - ‘vīryeṇa bastir ādatte doṣān āpādamastakāt | pakvāśayasthaḥ svastho 'rkaś cāpo yadvan mahītalāt’ iti | atha basteḥ sevāphalam āha | vidhikramaṃ tu tantrāntare 'py uktam | yathā
‘dattas tu prathamo basti: snehayed vastivaṃkṣaṇau |
samyag datto dvitīyas tu koṣṭhastham anilaṃ jayet |
balavarṇau ca janayet tṛtīyas tu prayojitaḥ | raktaṃ caturthaḥ paṃcamaḥ snehayen māṃsamedasaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhaḥ snihyati sarvatra saptamo 'pi tathā mataḥ |
aṣṭamo navamaś caiva vasāmajjānam eva ca | evam uktaṃ tān doṣād dviguṇaṃ sādhayed iti || 15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. samyag upāsito bastiḥ kiṃ kuryād ity āha -- śarīropacayaṃ, sthaulyaṃ, balaṃ, varṇam, ārogyam, āyuṣaḥ vṛddhiṃ ca kurute || 15 ||

atha basteḥ kālaniyamam āha -
divā śīte vasante ca snehabastiḥ pradīyate || 16 ||

lg.l: madaṃ mūrcchāṃ ca janayed vidhisnehaḥ prayojitaḥ |
rūkṣaṃ bhuktavato 'tyannaṃ balaṃ varṇaṃ ca dīyate || 18 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. śīte hemantaśiśirākhye vasante ca | snehe bastir divā divase pradīyate na tu rātrau atiśītārditatvāt | yad uktaṃ - ‘uṣṇābhibhūteṣu tathātiśītān śītābhibhūteṣu tathā sukhoṣṇān | tatpratyanīkeṣu samaṃ prayuktān sarvatra bastīn pravibhajya dadyā’diti | rātrau syād anuvāsanam iti | kasmin samaye grīṣmavarṣāśaratkāle iti | anuvāsūno nirūhāṃgatvena yasya ca virecanaṃ nocitaṃ sañcitaṃ ca malaṃ, bastiṃ tasya ca tanmalāpagamārthaṃ kṣīravaitaraṇaṃ vā bastiṃ datvānuvāsanaṃ deyaṃ | triśuddhasya snehabastyupadeśāt | tad uktaṃ - ‘snehabastir vidheyas tu nāviśuddhasya dehina’ iti | kṛtāhārāyānuvāsanaṃ deyam ity ukte 'tisnigdhabhojane 'nuvāsanaṃ niṣiddham | tad āha - ‘dvidhā prayojitaḥ sneha iti’ sugamaḥtaduktaṃ dṛḍhabale'pi - ‘jīrṇe tu sāyaṃ laghu cālpamātraṃ bhukto'nuvāsya paribṛṃhaṇārtham’ iti | || 16-18 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bastiḥ kadā śasyate ? ity āha - snehabasti: vasante divasānte dīyate grīṣmādau anuvāsanaṃ rātrau syāt | atisnigdham asamaṃ bhojayitvā na anuvāsayet | dvidhā prayojitaḥ snehaḥ madaṃ mūrcchāṃ ca janayet ||16-18||

atha baster hīnātimātrayor niṣedham āha -
hīnamātrāv ubhau bastī nātikāryakarau smṛtau |
atimātrau tathā'nāhaklamātīsārakārakau || 19 ||
Āḍhamalla. ubhau bastīti | anuvāsananirūhākhyau āsthāpanānuvāsanāv ity eke || 19 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hīnamātrau atimātrau bastī kāryakarau na ity āha - hīneti | ubhau anuvāsananirūhākhyau hīnamātrau mātrā'lpau atikāryakarau na | atimātrau tau klamātīsārakārakau bhavataḥ mātrāyā baster bahuphalatvāt || 19||

bastimātrā
uttamasya palaiḥ ṣaḍbhir madhyamasya palais tribhiḥ |
palasyārdhena hīnasya yuktā mātrā'nuvāsane || 20 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha ca mātrāvidhānam āha - uttamasyeti | balānalādibhir uttamasya puruṣasya | evaṃ madhyamahīnayor boddhavyam | asyābhiprāyam āha - yasyottamā ṣaṭpalā mātrārhati tasya dvipalaṃ prathamaṃ deyaṃ | tataś ca karṣeṇa vṛddhiḥ evaṃ navabhir dinais tripalā mātrā syāt | kanīyasī yasya mātrā sārdhā palamātrānvitā tasya prathamam ardhapalocitaṃ | tato vṛddhir aṣṭamāṣakair eva navabhir dinaiḥ sārdhapalaṃ syāt | navadinadānam uktaṃ tenāto 'rvāg api snehalakṣaṇodaye 'nuvāsananivṛttiḥ kāryā | yad uktaṃ -
‘prasṛtasya palārdhena palasyāpi punas tathā |
palārdhaṃ sārdhakarṣeṇa vṛddhiḥ kāryā yathākramam’ | kramo yathā tad uktaṃ - ‘prāgdānam ādye dvipalaṃ palārdhaṃ vṛddhir dvitīye palam asya vṛddhiḥ | karṣadvayenaiva samāṣavṛddhir bastau tṛtīye krama eṣa ukta’ iti | iyaṃ mātrā dravaviṣaye || 20||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. uttamādimātrām āha - anuvāsane iyaṃ mātrā yuktā | uttamasya uttamabalapuruṣasya ṣadbhiḥ palaiḥ, madhyamasya madhyabalasya tribhiḥ palaiḥ sārdhapalena hīnasya hīnabalasya mātrā anuvāsane yuktā | ardhāpi vā bhaved iti yad uktaṃ ‘paladvayaṃ tasya mātrā tasmād ardhā'pi vā bhavet’ iti yuktaṃ tan mātrābastiviṣayaṃ na tv anuvāsanaviṣayam || 20 ||

sa ca snehaḥ kenopahito deyaḥ ? ity āha -
śatāhvā saindhavābhyāṃ ca deyaṃ snehe ca cūrṇakam |
tanmātrottamamadhyāntā ṣaṭcaturdvayamāṣakaiḥ || 21||

Āḍhamalla. śatāhvāsaindhavacūrṇasya māṣaparimāṇena pracāraḥ | tatra snehasya palamānam iti pakṣāntaram ity eke | yataḥ cūrṇaṃ māṣaḥ pale snehe sindhu janmaśatāhvayor ityādivacanāt | etena kim uktaṃ yasyaiva anuvāsano deyas tasya kadācit antaḥkṣayaṃ vrajed ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā hi yasyaivaṃ vānuvāsaḥ syāt sakṛd antaḥkṣayaṃ vrajed iti paramārthatas tu uttamamadhyamādhameṣu ṣaṭ catvāraḥ dvau ca māṣakā yathākramaṃ jñeyāḥ | yad uktaṃ - ‘devadāruvacārāsnāśatāhvākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ | ataś cūrṇaṃ pradātavyaṃ ṣaṭcaturdvayamāṣakai’riti || 21 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snehe saindhavaśatāhvāpramāṇam āha - snehe taile śatāhvāsaindhavacūrṇaṃ kiṃpramāṇaṃ deyaṃ tad āha tanmātrā ṣaṭcaturdvayamāṣakaiḥ krameṇa uttamā ṣaṇmāṣā, madhmamā caturmāṣā, antyā kaniṣṭhā dvimāṣā etat pramāṇam || 21 ||

anuvāsanaviṣayam āha -
virecanāt saptarātre gate jātabalāya ca |
bhuktānnāyānuvāsyāya bastir deyo 'nuvāsanaḥ ||22||

lg.l: triṃśanmātrāmitaḥ kālaḥ prokto bastes tu pīḍane |
tataḥ praṇihitaḥ sneha uttāno vākśataṃ bhavet ||27||
ekā mātrā bhaved eṣā sarvatraiṣa viniścayaḥ. || 28 ||
tāḍayet talayor enaṃ trīn vārāṃś ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 29 ||
sphijoś caivaṃ tataḥ śroṇīṃ śayyāṃ caivotkṣipet tataḥ |
jāte vidhāne tu tataḥ kuryān nidrāṃ yathāsukham ||30||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. virecanād iti | virecanāt saptarātre gate sati virecanadivasāt prabhṛti saptarātraṃ yāvad bhavati tad upari anuvāsanaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ | ata eva jātabalāya prāptabalāya balavate ity abhiprāyaḥ | bhuktānnāyeti kṛtabhojanāya | ānuvāsyāyeti anuvāsanayogyāya | eke bhuktānnāyānuvāsyāyety asya sthāne kṛtāhārāya sāyam ahni iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | athānuvāsanasya vidhiṃ vaktum āha - anuvāsyam iti | anuvāsanayogyam anuvāsyaṃ puruṣam iti śeṣaḥ | eke nirūhaviṣayam enam āmananti | tat tu anuvāsyam ity anena pūrvam anuvāsanaṃ puruṣaṃ kṛtyety abhiprāyaḥ | yad uktam anuvāsitam abhyaktaṃ svinnadehaṃ nirūhayed ityādi | bhojayitvā yathāśāstram ity anenātibhojananiṣedho 'vagantavyaḥ | utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtre dāpayet | viṇmūtram iti parityaktaviṇmūtrādikaṃ anyathā baster antaḥ - praveśo na bhavati | tathā hi - ‘utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtre nare bastiṃ nidhāpayet | anyathā nihito bastir naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyata’ iti | yojayet snehabastineti vaidya iti śeṣaḥ | kecin nirūhabastiviṣayam eveti vadanti tat tu na samyak | kṛtānuvāsanasya nirūhasyoktatvāt | uktaṃ ca - ‘anuvāsitam abhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ dehaṃ nirūhayet’ iti | atha bastiṃ kathaṃ yojayed ity āha - suptasya vāmapārśveneti | suptasya śayānasya | bhāvini bhūtavad upacāraḥ | tena prathamaṃ jāgratas tasya paścāt suptasyety arthaḥ | śayane ity adhyāhāryam | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe -
‘kṛtacaṅkramaṇaṃ muktaviṇmūtraṃ śayane sukhe |
nātyucchrite na cocchiṣṭe saṃviṣṭe vāmapārśvataḥ || saṃkocya dakṣiṇaṃ sakthiṃ prasārya ca tato 'param | athāsya netraṃ praṇayet snigdhasvinnagude mukhe’ iti | vāmapārśveneti bastidānaṃ praśastaṃ bhavati | yad uktaṃ ‘vāmāśrayognir grahaṇīgudaṃ ca tatpārśvasaṃsthasya sukhopalabdhiḥ | līyanta evaṃ valayaś ca tasmāt savyaṃ śayāno 'rhati bastidāna’miti | ata eva vāmajaṅghāprasāriṇaḥ puruṣasya kuñcitāparajaṅghasya | vāmajaṅghāyāṃ prasāritāyāṃ tad upari dakṣiṇajaṅghā ākuñcitā kāryā ity abhiprāyaḥ | netram iti vāme puṭakasahitaṃ nalikākāraṃ snigdhe gude iti snigdhasvinne gude gudamukhe | atha paścātkarmāha iti bastividhānād anantaraṃ snehe snehabastau praṇihite sthāpite | antaḥpraviṣṭe iti bhāvaḥ | uttānaḥ puruṣaḥ vākśataṃ yāvat tiṣṭhet | te ca bastidānārthaṃ pūrvaṃ vāmapārśvaṃ bhūtvā paścād bastidāne kṛte sati bhūtvā vāṃchitaṃ yāvat tiṣṭhed ity abhiprāyaḥ | vākśatam iti choṭikāśataṃ | ‘tataḥ praṇihite snehe uttāne vāṃchitaṃ bhave’dity api pāṭhaḥ | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | prasāritaiḥ sarvagātraiḥ kṛtvā yathā puruṣo bhavati tathā vastivīryaṃ prasarpatīti bhāvaḥ | asyāgre ‘ākuñcayec chanais tris triḥ sakthibāhū tataḥ para’miti padadvayaṃ paṭhanti kecit | tanmate tu jaṅghābāhulatayor gṛhītvā trir utkṣipya saṃkocayet sakthibāhvākuñcanaṃ ca snehavīryavisarpaṇārtham | evaṃ hi śiromukhānāṃ sphuṭatvaṃ bhavati | tāḍayet talayor enam ityādi | talayor iti hastapādatalayo: sphijoś ca tāḍanaṃ | basteḥ śīghragamanadhāraṇārtham | yad uktaṃ - dṛḍhabale ‘datvā sphijau pāṇitalena hanyāt snehasya śīghrāgamarakṣaṇārtha’miti | tata ity anenātra trivāragrahaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ | tena śayyāṃ trir utkṣiped iti | śayyāṃ prati śroṇīs trir ukṣipet ity arthaḥ | anenaiva carakoktagātramardanādikam api yathecchasthitihetuḥ saṃgṛhyate | yad uktaṃ - ‘snehena pārṣṇyaṅgulipiṇḍikāś ca ye vāsya gātrāvayavā rujārtāḥ | tāṃś cāvamṛdyāt sasukhaṃ tataś ca nidrām upāsīta kṛtopadhāna’ iti | asyāgre tu ‘evaṃ praṇihite bastau mandāyāso 'tha mandavāk | uttānāṅgo bhavet tāvad yāvan mātrā śataṃ bhaved iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti | ‘kūrpare jānunī caiva kuryāt trīṇi gatāgataṃ | trikasarvalanāṃ vāpi kuryād dvāraṃ ca tantrita’ ity api ślokaṃ paṭhanti, kecit | vāgbhaṭe 'pi -
‘datte cottānadehasya pāṇinā tāḍayet sphijau |
tatpārṣṇibhyāṃ tathā śayyāṃ pādataś ca trir utkṣipet || tataḥ prasāritāṃgasya sopadhānasya pārṣṇike | āhanyān muṣṭināṃgaṃ ca snehenābhyajya mardayet’ iti || tataḥ kiṃ kuryāt ? ity ata āha - jāte iti | yathāsukham ity anenācārakakramaṃ smaran nidrāṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘svāstīrṇe śayanaṃ kāmaṃ śayītācārake rataḥ’ iti || 22-30 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virecanād anuvāsanaḥ kadā dīyate ity āha - virecanāt saptarātre gate sati jātabalāya puruṣāya bhuktānnāya anuvāsyāya anuvāsanayogyāya anuvāsano bastir deyaḥ | tathā coktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -‘pakṣād vireko vamite tataḥ pakṣān nirūhaṇaṃ | sadyo nirūḍhaś cānvāsya saptarātrād virecita’ iti | snehabastinā yena prakāreṇa yojayet tat prakāram āha - athānantaram anuvāsyam anuvāsanayogyaṃ puruṣaṃ svabhyaktaṃ kṛtasnehābhyaṅgaṃ punaḥ uṣṇāmbusveditaṃ snāpitaṃ bhojayitvā caṃkramaṇam itastataś calitaṃ punaḥ utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ niḥsṛtavātādyaṃ puruṣaṃ snehabastinā yojayet | yojanaprakāram āha - suptasyetyādi | vāmapārśvena suptasya vāmajaṅghāprasāriṇaḥ kuñcitāparajaṅghasya saṃkocitāparajaṅghasya snigdhe gude netraṃ vāmahastena dhārayet | dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇahastena pīḍayet madhyasthavegena madhyavegenety arthaḥ | dhīraḥ dhairyavān punar bastidānakāle jṛmbhādīn na kārayet | kiyatparyantaṃ bastir dhāryā iti mātrām āha -bastipīḍite triṃśanmātramitaḥ kālaḥ proktaḥ tataḥ praṇihitaḥ snehaśaḥ prātasneha uttānaḥ vākśataṃ vacanaśataṃ tiṣṭhet | mātrālakṣaṇaṃ tu jānviti jñeyaṃ prasāritair ityādi | prasāritaiḥ sarvagātrair hastapādādikair yathā | vīryaṃ visarpati tathā enaṃ trīṃs talayos tāḍayet | sphikpradeśe tāḍayet | tathā śroṇīr nitambaṃ tāḍayet tataḥ śayyāṃ kṣipet sthāpayet | tataḥ vidhāne jāte nidrāṃ kārayet || 22-30 ||

samyaganuvāsitalakṣaṇam āha -
sānilaḥ sapurīṣaś ca snehaṃ pratyeti yasya vai |
upadravaṃ vinā śīghraṃ sa samyag anuvāsitaḥ || 31||

Āḍhamalla. yasya snehaḥ sānilaḥ savātaḥ sapurīṣaḥ viṣṭhāsahitaḥ pratyeti niḥsarati | kathaṃ ? upadravaṃ vinā upadravo 'tra ūṣacoṣādiḥ | ata eva kecid evaṃ paṭhanti - ‘ūṣacoṣau vinā śīghraṃ sa samyag anuvāsitam’ iti | ūṣaḥ prādeśiko dāhaḥ, coṣo vedanāviśeṣaḥ pipāsety apare | suśrute 'py ayam eva pāṭhaḥ iti bhānumatī | śīghram iti yāmād ūrdhvam || 31 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. samyag anuvāsitasya lakṣaṇam āha - sānila ityādi | sānilaḥ savātaḥ sapurīṣaś ca yasya snehaḥ pratyeti gacchati upadravaṃ vinā samyag anuvāsito bhavatīty arthaḥ || 31 ||

snehāgate vidhim āha -
jīrṇānnas tv atha sāyāhne snehe pratyāgate punaḥ |
laghvannaṃ bhojayet kāmaṃ dīptāgnis tu naro yadi ||32||

Āḍhamalla. srehe pratyāgate sati sadya iti jñeyaṃ, dīptāgniḥ sa naraḥ yadi tathā kāmaṃ bhojayet | sāyāhne pratyāgate laghvannaṃ bhojayet iti viṣamavibhāgaḥ | kecid apare 'hni bhojayed ity āhuḥ || 32 ||

anuvāsanavyāpattau pratīkāram āha -
anuvāsitāya dātavyam itare 'hni sukhodakam |
dhānyaśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ vā snehavyāpattināśanam ||33||

Āḍhamalla. itare 'hni aparadine sukhodakam uṣṇodakam | athavā dhānyaśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ vā tad api koṣṇaṃ dadyāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhāṭe - ‘prātar nāgaradhānyāmbhaḥ koṣṇaṃ kevalam eva ca’ iti | asyāgre kecit paṭhanti - ‘ekāntaropayogena dhānyaśuṇṭhījalaṃ pibet | tenā'sya dīpyate vahnir bhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti | tanmate tu ekāntarānuvāsanaṃ, dhānyaśuṇṭhīkkātha: paradine prātaḥ deya iti | dhānyanāgarasiddhaṃ ca toyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā iti cakraḥ | koṣṇodakaṃ ca pittottare deyam | uktañ ca cakre -
‘kvāthārdhamātrayā prātar dhānyaśuṇṭhījalaṃ pibet |
pittottare kaduṣṇāmbu tāvanmātraṃ pibed atha | tenāsya dīpyate vahnir bhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti || 33 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snehānuvāsanānantaraṃ snehavyāpattiharaṇavidhānam āha - anuvāsitāya kṛtānuvāsanāya | itare 'hni tadagrimadine sukhodakaṃ deyam | tat snehavyāpattināśanaṃ bhavati | snehasya vā kācid vyāpattir vikriyārūpā || 33 ||

div.ab:
athoktaprakāram upasaṃharan bastidānasaṃkhyām āha -
anena vidhinā sapta cāṣṭau vātha navā'pi vā |
vidheyā bastayas teṣām antarā tu nirūhaṇam || 34||
(dattas tuprakṣiptamidam | prathamo bastiḥ snehayet bastivaṃkṣaṇaiḥ |
samyag datto dvitīyas tu mūrdhastham anilaṃ jayet ||35||
balaṃ varṇaṃ ca janayet tṛtīyas tu prayojitaḥ |
caturthapañcamau dattau snehayetāṃ rasāsṛjī || 36 ||
ṣaṣṭho māṃsaṃ snehayati saptamo meda eva ca |
aṣṭamo navamaś cāpi majjānaṃ ca yathākramam || 37 ||
evaṃ śukragatān doṣān dviguṇaḥ sādhu sādhayet |
aṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśakān bastīnāṃ yo niṣevate || 38 ||
sa kuñjarabalo 'py aśvaṃ jayet tulyo 'maraprabhaḥ |
rūkṣāya bahuvātāya snehabastiṃ dine dine || 39 ||
dadyād vaidyas tathānyeṣām anyāṃ bādhām apāharet |
sneho 'lpamātro rūkṣāṇāṃ dīrghakālam anatyayaḥ ||40||
tathā nirūhaḥ snigdhānām alpamātraḥ praśasyate |)

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. anena pūrvoktavidhineti | pūrvoktaprakāreṇa ṣaṭ, sapta, aṣṭau, nava bastayaḥ krameṇa vidheyāḥ yojyāḥ | kramo yathā kaphaje vikāre ṣaṭ, vāgrahaṇāt ekaḥ trayo vā prāptāḥ | pittātmake ca sapta aṣṭau vā | cakārāt pañcagrahaṇaprāptiḥ | vāte nava iti vāgrahaṇād ekādaśaprāptiḥ | nanu tantrāntare -‘rūkṣasya bahuvātasya dvau trīn vāpy anuvāsanam | datvā snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā tataḥ paścān nirūhayet’ ity anena virodhaḥ tat katham atra ṣaṭsaptādisaṃkhyā ? satyam, rūkṣasya bahuvātasya yadi mṛdukoṣṭhatvaṃ tadā dvau vā trayo vā snehabastayaḥ | ata eva ‘snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā’ iti kṛtavān | na tu snigdhatanutā dvitrisnehabastidānasya carake vihitatvāt | yathā - ‘ekaṃ tathā trīn kaphaje vikāre pittātmake pañca ca sapta vā'pi | vāte 'pi caikādaśadhā punar vā bastīn ayugmān kuśalo vidadhyāt’ iti | ucyate -ayugmadānaṃ svatantrānuvāsanaviṣayam na tu nirūhāṅgānuvāsanaviṣayaṃ | nirūhāṅgānuvāsane carakeṇā'pi yugmadānaṃ darśitam | yathā -‘trīn pañca vā caturo vā bastīn datvottaranirūhaṇaṃ vinā punaḥ snehadānena yugmān tathā kuryād iti darśayati nirūhāntaritaṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | viṣayasaṃkhyopādānaṃ dvicaturādibaster api madhyaviṣayaṃ parigrahārtham’ iti| rūkṣasyetyādividhānaṃ tu kṣīṇaviṣayabhedād avirodhaḥ | teṣām antarā tu nirūhaṇam iti teṣāṃ snehanabastīnām antarā nirūhaṇaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ | yad uktaṃ -
‘snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ vā naikam evātra śīlayet |
snehāt pittakaphotkleśau syātāṃ na pavanād bhayam|
tasmān nirūho 'nuvāso nirūhyaś cānuvāsitaḥ|
naivaṃ pittakaphotkkeśau syātāṃ ca pavanād bhayam’ ||34-40||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vātādau kiyanto bastayo deyās tatpramāṇam āha - anena vidhinā pūrvoktavidhinā ṣaḍ vā sapta vā aṣṭa vā nava vā etatpramāṇā bastayo deyāḥ | teṣāṃ bastīnām antarā nirūhaṇaṃ vidheyam | vāgbhaṭe triṃśad bastayaḥ kathitāḥ | tathā ca - ‘prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte dvādaśāsthāpanāni tu | sānvāsakāni karmaiva bastayas triṃśad īritāḥ’ iti || 34-40 ||

nivṛtte 'nuvāsane snehe punar api anuvāsanam āha -
athavā yasya tatkālaṃ sneho niryāti kevalaḥ ||41||

lg.l: tasyānyo 'lpataro deyo na hi snihyaty atiṣṭhati |
aśuddhasya malonmiśra: sneho naiti yadā punaḥ ||42||
tadā śaithilyam ādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsaś ca jāyate |
pakvāśaye gurutvaṃ ca tatra dadyān nirūhaṇam || 43 ||
tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhair yuktā phalavartir hitā tathā |
yathānulomanaṃ vāyur malaṃ snehaś ca jāyate || 44 ||
yathā virecanaṃ dadyāt tīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca śasyate |
sarvo 'lpo vā vṛte raukṣyād upekṣyaḥ sa vijānatā |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athavā anuvāsanasnehaḥ yasya puruṣasya tatkālaṃ śīghram eva niryāti tasya puruṣasyānyo 'lpataro 'nuvāsanasneho deyaḥ | kuta ity ata āha - atiṣṭhati ityādi | atiṣṭhati snehena hi snihyati | alpatara iti pūrvadattāt | tantrāntare tu -
‘yasyānuvāsano dattaḥ sakṛd antaḥkṣayaṃ vrajet |
atyuṣṇo vā'titīkṣṇo vā vāyunā vā prapīḍitaḥ || savāte caikamātro vā gurutvād vā subheṣajaḥ | tasyānyo 'lpataro deyo na hi strihyaty atiṣṭhati’ iti | atra vāyunā iti koṣṭhasthena vātena ity arthaḥ | savāta iti | anucchvāsya vihitabandhādinā bastipuṭakasthitavāyusahite tu snehe mukhakaṣāyatā jṛmbhā vātarujas tās tā vepathur viṣamajvara iti | atha ca snehānirgame 'pi vidhānam āha - aśuddhasyeti | akṛtaśodhanasya puruṣasyety arthaḥ | ata eva malonmiśraḥ sneha iti | tathā hi ‘snehabastir vidheyas tu nāviśuddhasya dehinaḥ | snehavīryaṃ tathā datte dehenānuvisarpatī’ti | yadā naiti na pratyāgacchati sneha iti sambandhaḥ na tadā śithilāṅgādayo bhavanti | śithilasthāne sadanam iti pāṭhāntaram | tatra dadyān nirūhaṇam iti | tīkṣṇam iti nirūham ity asya viśeṣaṇam athavā tīkṣṇauṣadhair evaṃ sadyuktyā phalavartir apy atra vihitā | pāṭhāntaro 'pi ‘tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhair yuktā phalavartir hitā'thaveti’ phalavartis tu vakṣyamāṇottarabastau draṣṭavyā | eke ‘tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhair evaṃ siddhaṃ vāpy anuvāsanami’ti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | ‘yady anulomanavāyuḥ malaṃ snehaś ca jāyate | tadā virecanaṃ dadyāt tīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca śasyate |’ tīkṣṇaṃ virecanaṃ nasyaṃ ca tīkṣṇam ity arthaḥ | athāniḥsṛto 'pi bastir na vikārāya bhavatīty ata āha - nopadravām iti upadravo 'tra rogaḥ sa ca mukhakaṣāyatvādikaḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘upadravābhibhūteṣu snehe bastikaṣāyatā | jṛmbhāvātarujas tās tā vepathur viṣamajvara’ iti | raukṣyād iti | śarīraraukṣyād asnigdhaḥ yato rūkṣaṃ śarīraṃ bhāvayet tenopakṣīṇaḥ sa khalu snehaḥ tat tenopadravaṃ karoti | ata evopekṣita ity uktaṃ | upekṣya iti | tanniḥsaraṇāya pratikriyāṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
‘anāyātaṃ tv ahorātrāt snehaṃ saṃśodhanair haret |
snehabastāv anāyāte nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyate’ ||41-45||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athavā yasya puruṣasya snehas tatkālaṃ niryāti na tiṣṭhati tasya anyo 'nyataras tasmād anyo bastir deyaḥ | sneho vā bastyantare | yadā sneho naiti tadā kiṃ kartavyam ity āha - aśuddhasya vamanādiśuddhirahitasya malonmiśraḥ snehaḥ yadā na yāti tathā śaithilyam ādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsaś ca jāyate utpadyate tatra kiṃ kuryād ity āha | tatra nirūhaṇaṃ dadyāt | anyad api tatra dīyate tad āha | tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhayuktaphalavarttir hitā yathā vāyuḥ anulomanam anulomanatvaṃ vāyur yāti malaṃ snehaś ca jāyate tathā kāryam iti tathā virecanaṃ dadyāt | tīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca tatra śasyate | snehabastir yatra upadravaṃ na kuryāt tatra kiṃ vidhātavyam ity āha - aniḥsṛtaḥ aniṣkāsitaḥ | snehabastir yasya upadravaṃ śvāsaśūlādikaṃ na kuryāt sarvaḥ alpaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ rokṣyād vijānatā sa upekṣyaḥ ciraṃ sthāpyaḥ || 41-45 ||

ahorātrād aniḥsṛte pratīkāram āha --
anāyātaṃ tv ahorātre snehaṃ saṃśodhanair haret |
snehabastāv anāyāte nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyate || 46 ||

Āḍhamalla. anāyātaṃ aniḥsṛtaṃ snehaṃ saṃśodhanaiḥ śodhanabastibhir haret | kecit śodhanair ity atra sopadravam iti paṭhanti | tatropadravāḥ pūrvoktāḥ | anyaḥ snehaḥ snehabastir na vidhīyate | snehābhibhavāt śodhanabastis tu deyaḥ | anāyātam ity asya ślokasyāgre adhikaṃ paṭhanti yathā -
‘kuṣṭhakramukakalkaṃ tu pāyayec cāmlasaṃyutam |
auṣṇyāt taikṣṇyāt saratvāc ca bastiḥ so 'syānulomayet
gomūtreṇa tṛvṛtpathyākalkaṃ vātrānulomanam |’ ityādi pāṭho bahupustakeṣv adṛṣṭaḥ, tasmād asmābhir api na vyākhyātaḥ | ‘nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyata’ ity atra ‘tābhyāṃ sekaḥ praśasyata’ iti kecit pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti || 46 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ahorātre yadā snehaṃ na yāti tadā kiṃ kuryāt ? ity āha - ahorātre 'nāyātaṃ snehaṃ saṃśodhanair haret | asnehabastau snehe anāyāte tadā tābhyāṃ sneho vidhīyate viśeṣeṇa sthāpyate || 46 ||

athānuvāsanārthaṃ guḍūcyāditailam āha -
guḍūcyeraṇḍapūtīkabhārṅgīvṛṣakarohiṣam || 47 ||

Āḍhamalla. guḍūcyādīni kākanāsāntāni pratyekaṃ palonmitāni grāhyāṇi | tatra guḍūcī chinnaruhā, eraṇḍaḥ pañcāṅgulaḥ, pūtīkaḥ pūtikarañjaḥ, bhārṅgī dvijā, vṛṣo vāsakaḥ, rohiṣaḥ sugandhitṛṇaṃ, śatāvarī nārāyaṇī, sahacaraḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ, kākanāsā prasiddhā iti | yavādīni prasiddhāni prasṛtonmitāni paladvayamitāni pratyekaṃ grāhyāṇi | tailāḍhakaṃ kṛṣṇatilasnehaḥ āḍhakamitaḥ peṣyai: jīvanīyaiḥ pūrvoktakalkīkṛtaiḥ pratyekaṃ palonmitaiḥ iti | jīvanīyagaṇo yathā -
‘jīvantī sūryaparṇīyuk kākolyau jīvakarṣabhau |
mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyo gaṇo mataḥ’ || iti || 47-49 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athānuvāsanatailam āha - pūtīkaḥ karañja:, vṛṣakaḥ āṭarūṣakaḥ, rohiṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sahacaraḥ pītavāsā, kākanāsā kākajaṅghā, etāḥ palamitāḥ pratyekaṃ | yavādīn prasṛtonmitān paladvayonmitān | kolaṃ badaraṃ, jīvanīyair jīvanīyagaṇadravyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet | etad anuvāsanatailam || 47-49 ||

idānīṃ snehavyāpatcikitsām āha
ṣaṭsaptativyāpadas tu‘ata ūrdhvaṃ vyāpado vakṣyāma: - tatra netracalitaṃ (1) vivartitaṃ (2) pārśvāvapīḍitaṃ (3,) atyutkṣiptam (4) avasannaṃ (5) tiryakkṣiptam (6) iti ṣaṭ praṇidhānadoṣāḥ, atisthūlaṃ (7) karkaśam (8) avanatam (9) aṇu (10) bhinnaṃ (11) sannikṛṣṭa-(12) viprakṛṣṭakarṇikaṃ (13) sūkṣmā- (14) tichidraṃ (15) atidīrgham (16) atihrasvaṃ (17) ityekādaśa netradoṣāḥ | bahalatā (18) alpatā (19) sacchidratā (20) prastīrṇatā (21) durbaddhatā (22) iti pañca bastidoṣāḥ | atipīḍitatā (23) śithilapīḍitatā (24) bhūyobhūyo'vapīḍanaṃ (25) kālātikramaḥ (26) iti catvāraḥ pīḍanadoṣāḥ | āmatā (27) hīnatā (28) atimātratā (29) atiśītatā (30) atyuṣṇatā (31) atitīkṣṇatā (32) atimṛdutā (33) atisnigdhatā (34) atirūkṣatā (35) atisāndratā (36) atidravatā (37) ityekādaśa dravyadoṣāḥ | (38) avāk- (39) śīrṣo-(40)cchīrṣa-nyubjo-(41) ttāna (42)saṅkucita (43) dehasthitatā-dakṣiṇā(44)pārśvaśāyina: pradānam, iti sapta śayyādoṣāḥ | evametāścatuścatvāriṃśat (44) vyāpado vaidyanimittāḥ | āturanimittā: pañcadaśa (15) āturopadravacikitsite vakṣyante (59)| snehastvaṣṭābhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pratihato na pratyāgacchati, tribhirdoṣaiḥ (1) aśanābhibhūto, (2) malavyāmiśro, (3) dūrānupraviṣṭo, (4) asvinnasya, (5) anuṣṇo, (6) alpaṃ bhuktavato, (7) alpaśceti (8) vaidyāturanimittā bhavanti (68) | 1 ayogastūbhayo-2 rādhmānaṃ, 3 parikartikā, 4 parisrāvaḥ, 5 pravāhikā, 6 hṛdayopasaraṇaṃ, 7 aṅgapragraho, 8 atiyogo jīvādānaṃ iti nava vyāpado vaidyanimittā bhavanti | (76) || suśru. ci. a. 36 jāyante bastikarmaṇā |
dūṣitāt samudāyena tāś cikitsyās tu suśrutāteṣāṃ cikitsā coktā suśrute - atha netre vicalite tathā caiva vivartite | gude kṣataṃ rujā vā syāttatra sadyaḥ kṣatakriyāḥ || atyutkṣipte'vasanne ca netre pāyau bhavedrujā | vidhiratrā'pi pittaghnaḥ kāryaḥ snehaiśca secanam || tiryakpraṇihite netre tathā pārśvāvapīḍite | mukhasyāvaraṇādbastirna samyakpratipadyate || ṛju netraṃ vidheyaṃ syāttatra samyagvijānatā | atisthūle karkaśe ca netre cāvanate tathā || gude bhavet kṣataṃ rukca sādhanaṃ pūrvavatsmṛtam | āsannakarṇike netre bhinne'ṇau vāpyapārthakaḥ || avaseko bhavedbastestasmāddoṣān vivarjayet | prakṛṣṭakarṇike raktaṃ gudamarmaprapīḍanāt || kṣaratyatrā'pi pittaghno vidhirbastiśca picchilaḥ | pratyāgacchaṃstataḥ kuryādrogān bastivighātajān || dīrghe mahāsrotasi ca jñeyamatyavapīḍavat | prastīrṇe bahale cāpi bastau durbaddhadoṣavat || bastāvalpe'lpatā vā'pi dravyasyā'lpaguṇā matāḥ | durbaddhe cāṇubhinne ca vijñeyaṃ bhinnanetravat || atiprapīḍito bastiḥ prayātyāmāśayaṃ tataḥ | vāterito nāsikābhyāṃ mukhato vā prapadyate || tatra tūrṇaṃ galāpīḍaṃ kuryāccāpyavadhūnanam | śiraḥkāyavirekau ca tīkṣṇau sekāṃśca śītalān || śanaiḥ prapīḍito bastiḥ pakvādhānaṃ na gacchati | na ca sampādayatyarthāṃstasmādyuktaṃ prapīḍayet || bhūyo bhūyo'vapīḍena vāyurantaḥ prapīḍyate | tenādhmānaṃ rujaścogrā yathāsvaṃ tatra bastayaḥ || kālātikramaṇātkleśo vyādhiścābhipravardhate| tatra vyādhibalaghnaṃ tu bhūyo vastiṃ nidhāpayet || gudopadehaśophau tu sneho'pakva: karoti hi | tatra saṃśodhano bastirhitaṃ cāpi virecanam || hīnamātrāvubhau bastī nātikāryakarau matau | atimātrau tathā'nāhaklamātīsārakārakau || mūrcchāṃ dāhamatīsāraṃ pittaṃ cātyuṣṇatīkṣṇakau | mṛduśītāvubhau vātavibandhādhmānakārakau || tatra hīnādiṣu hitaḥ pratyanīkaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ| tatra sāndre tanuṃ basti tanau sāndraṃ ca dāpayet|| snigdho'tijāḍyakṛdrūkṣastambhādhmānakṛducyate | basti rūkṣamatisnigdhe snigdhaṃ rūkṣe ca dāpayet || atipīḍitavaddoṣān vidhiṃ cāpyavaśīrṣake |ucchīryake samunnāhaṃ bastiḥ kuryācca mehanam || tatrottaro hito bastiḥ sukhinnasya sukhāvahaḥ | nyubjasya bastirnāpnoti pakvādhānaṃ vimārgagaḥ || hṛdgudaṃ bādhate cātra vāyuḥ koṣṭhamathāpi ca | uttānasyāvṛte mārge bastirnāntaḥ prapadyate || netrasaṃvejanabhrānto vāyuścāntaḥ prakupyati | dehe saṅkucite dattaḥ sakthnorapyubhayastathā || na samyaganilāviṣṭo bastiḥ pratyeti dehinaḥ | sthitasya bastirdattastu kṣipramāyātyavāṅmukhaḥ || na cāśayaṃ tarpayati tasmānnārthakaro hi saḥ | nāpnoti bastirdattastu kṛtsnaṃ pakvāśayaṃ punaḥ || dakṣiṇāśritapārśvasya vāmapārśvānugo yataḥ | nyubjādīnāṃ pradānaṃ ca basternaiva praśasyate || paścādanilakopo'tra yathāsvaṃ tatra kārayet | vyāpadaḥ snehabastestu vakṣyante taccikitsite || ayogādyāstu vakṣyāmi vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ | anuṣṇo'lpauṣadho hīno bastirnaiti prayojitaḥ || viṣṭambhādhmānaśūlaiśca tamayogaṃ pracakṣate | tatra tīkṣṇā hito bastistīkṣṇaṃ cāpi virecanam || saśeṣānne'thavā bhukte bahudoṣe ca yojitaḥ | atyāśitasyātibahurbastirmandoṣṇa eva ca || anuṣṇalavaṇasneho hyatimātro'thavā punaḥ | tathā bahupurīṣaśca kṣipramādhmāpayennaram || hṛtkaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭheṣu śūlaṃ tatrātidāruṇam | tatra tīkṣṇataro bastirhitaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇo rūkṣo bastiḥ prayojitaḥ | sapittaṃ kopayedvāyuṃ kuryācca parikartikām || nābhibastigudaṃ tatra chinattīvātidehinaḥ | picchābastirhitastasya snehaśca madhuraiḥ śṛtaḥ || atyamlalavaṇastīkṣṇaḥ parisrāvāya kalpate | daurbalyamaṅgasādaśca jāyate tatra dehinaḥ || parisravettataḥ pittaṃ dāhaṃ sañjanayedgude | picchābastirhitastatra bastiḥ kṣīraghṛtena ca || pravāhikā bhavettīkṣṇānnirūhāt sānuvāsanam | sadāhaśūlaṃ kṛcchreṇa kaphāsṛgupaveśyate || picchābastirhitastatra payasā caiva bhojanam | sarpirmadhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇo nirūho vā savāte cānuvāsanaḥ | hṛdayasyopasaraṇaṃ kurute cāṅgapīḍanam || doṣaistatra rujāstāstā mado mūrcchāṅgagauravam | sarvadoṣaharaṃ bastiṃ śodhanaṃ tatra dāpayet || rūkṣasya bahuvātasya tathā duḥśayitasya ca | bastiraṅgagrahaṃ kuryādrūkṣo mṛdvalpabheṣajaḥ || tatrāṅgasādaḥ prastambho jumbhodveṣṭanavepakāḥ | parvabhedaśca tatreṣṭā: svedābhyañjanabastayaḥ || atyuṣṇatīkṣṇo'tibahurdatto'tisveditasya ca | alpadoṣasya vā bastiratiyogāya kalpate || virecanātiyogena samānaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam | picchābastiprayogaśca tatra śītaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || atiyogātparaṃ yatra jīvādānaṃ viriktavat | deyastatra hitaścāpi picchābastiḥ saśoṇitaḥ || navaitā vyāpado yāstu nirūhaṃ pratyudāhṛtāḥ | snehabastiṣvapi hitā vijñeyāḥ kuśalairiha || ityuktā vyāpadaḥ sarvāḥ salakṣaṇacikitsitāḥ | bhiṣajā ca tathā kāryaṃ yathaitā na bhavanti hi || iti ||50||

Āḍhamalla. bastivyāpadaś ca suśrutāc cikitsyā ity ata āha - asyāgre kecid adhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti tad yathā -
snehapītasya vātasya viriktasya sṛtāsṛjaḥ |
nirūḍhasya ca kāyāgnir mando bhavati dehinaḥ ||
sa cālpair laghubhiś cānnair upayuktair vivardhate |
kāṣṭhair aṇubhir alpaiś ca saṃdhukṣita ivānalaḥ ||
yukte 'gnau jīvati ciraṃ rogī syād vikṛtiṃ gate |
śānte pañcatvam āyāti dehī tasmād balo 'nalaḥ’ || iti | etadarthaṃ cikitsāpi - ‘prātar uṣṇodakaṃ deyaṃ dhānyanāgarasādhitam | tenā'sya dīpyate vahnir bhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti | snehapītasya ityādipāṭhaḥ kṣepaka iti kṛtvā asmābhir api nātra vyākhyātaḥ ||50||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bastikarmaṇaḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ vyāpadaḥ rogā jāyante utpadyante | tāḥ vyāpadaḥ suśrutāt cikitsyāḥ | kiṃbhūtād bastikarmaṇaḥ | dūṣitāt taddoṣair duṣṭā bastikriyāyāḥ ||50||

div.ab:
anuvāsane pānādipathyam āha -
pānāhāravihāraś ca parihāraś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ |
snehapānasamāḥ kāryā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 51 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe snehabastividhir nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

Āḍhamalla. snehapānasamā iti | ye pānā'hāravihārādaya: snehapānaviṣaye pūrvaṃ darśitāḥ, te 'py atra kramaśa: kāryāḥ | tenā'tra vicāraṇā na kāryā | āgamoktatvāt | pānādayo 'py atra tatratyā avagantavyāḥ | asyāgre paṭhanti, kecit -
‘aṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśakaṃ bastīnāṃ yo niṣevate |
yathoktena vidhānena parihārakrameṇa ca || sa kuñjarabalo 'śvatya javatulyo 'maraprabhaḥ | nītivākyaśrutidharaḥ sahasrāyur naro bhavet’ iti | anyad api - ‘mūlasekād yathā vṛkṣa: snigdhaś ca navapallava: | tathā bastipradānāt syān nara: kāntibalādimān’ iti || 51 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttare khaṇḍe bastividhir adhyāya: ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pathyasaṃgraham āha - pānāhāreti | sugamam || anuvāsananiruktim āha suśrutāt -‘anuvasann api na dūṣyate, anudivasaṃ nāpi na dūṣyate, anudivasaṃ vā dīyate ity anuvāsanam’|| 51 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ pañcakarmaṇi anuvāsana- bastyadhikāraḥ || 5 ||

div.head: atha nirūhabastividhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
atha ṣaṣṭho 'dhpāyaḥ | atha (pāriśeṣyāt) nirūhabastividhim āha - tatra tadbhedān āha -
nirūhabastir bahudhā bhidyate kāraṇāntarai: |
tair eva tasya nāmāni kṛtāti muniṣuṅgavaiḥ ||1||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. yo nirūhabasti: pūrvaṃ saṃgṛhīta:| so 'py atra kāraṇāntarai: kṛtvā bahudhā bhidyate kathyata ity artha: | kāraṇāntarāṇi vakṣyamāṇadoṣahara-saṃśamana-śodhana-lekhana-bṛṃhaṇāni picchila-yāpana-vaitaraṇabastiprabhūtīni boddhavyāni | tair eva kāraṇāntarair eva tasyā nirūhabaste: nāmāni munipuṅgavai: ṛṣiśreṣṭhai: kṛtāni kathitāni ity abhiprāyaḥ, doṣaharabastir ityādīni tasya viśeṣanāmāny āha -nirūhasyeti | budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ nirūhasya nāma āsthānaṃ proktaṃ, āsthāpayati vaya: iti āsthāpanaṃ param utkṛṣṭam utkṛṣṭatvaṃ ca vayaḥsthāpanenaiva | athavā doṣadhātūnāṃ svasthāne sthāpanād āsthāpanaṃ, tac ca kṣīreṇa kvāthaiś ca kriyate| uktaṃ ca - ‘snehair yo dīyate sa syād anuvāsananāmaka:| eke ‘svasthāpanaṃ sthāpanād doṣadhātūnāṃ sthāpanaṃ matam’ iti nāma paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | suśrute 'pi -‘sadoṣanirharaṇāc charīrarohaṇād vā nirūha iti so 'sthāpana iti nāma | asyām api niruktau sa eva | yathā vaya:sthāpanād vā'yu:sthāpanād vā''sthāpanaṃ, tataś ca sarvadoṣanirharaṇān nirūha iti vamanādikam ||1||2||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha nirūhaṇabastividhi: | nirūhasya nāmāntaram āha - sa doṣanirharaṇād vā nirūha:, tasya nirūhasya aparam āsthāpitaṃ nāma budhai: doṣadhātūnāṃ svasthāne sthāpanād vā nāma matam ||1||2||

ab.seg:
atha doṣādyapekṣayā mātrām āha -
nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ ca prasthaṃ pādottaraṃ param |
madhyamaṃ prastham uddiṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ ca kuḍavās traya: ||3||

Āḍhamalla. nirūhsya nirūhasaṃjñasyāsthāpanasya paramam utkṛṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ pādottaraṃ prasthaṃ sapādaprasthaṃ madhyaṃ prasthaṃ uddiṣṭham | traya: kuḍavā: hīnaṃ mānam | uktaṃ ca pārāśare - ‘nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ tu prastha: pādottara: para:| madhyaprasthas tu nirdiṣṭo vijñeyā: kuḍavās traya:’ iti| uttamādimānaṃ ca doṣabalāpekṣayā'vagantavyam | nanu carakādāv anyathā paṭhitaṃ tad yathā - ‘ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi nirūhasyopakalpanam | dvādaśaprastutasyādau tato 'nyān upakalpayet’ iti | tat katham atra viṃśatipalāny uttamamātrāyāṃ pratipāditāni ? | satyam, dvādaśaprasṛtamāno nirūha: pañcāṅgamāno yuktyā darśita: | tathā hi -
‘madhusnehanakalkākhyakaṣāyā vāpyata: kramāt |
trīṇi, ṣaṭ, dve, daśa, trīṇi palāny anilarogiṇām || pitte catvāri catvāri tri pañca ca catuṣṭayam | ṣaṭ, trīṇi, dve, daśa, trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam’ iti | anyac ca –
‘datvākṣaṃ saidhavasyādau madhuna: prasṛtidvayam|
vinirmathya tato dadyāt snehasya prasṛtitrayam ||
ekībhūte tata: snnehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet |
saṃmūrcchite kaṣāyaṃ tu catu:prasṛtasaṃmitam ||
vitarec ca tathā'vāpam ante dviprasṛtonmitam |
vastrapūtaṃ tathoṣṇāmbukumbhībāṣpena tāpita: |
evaṃ prakalpito bastir dvādaśaprasṛto bhavet || na dhāvaty auṣadhaṃ prāṇair na tiṣṭhaty avalipya ca| na karoti ca sīmāntaṃ sa nirūha: suyojita’ iti | etenotkṛṣṭadoṣabale dvādaśaprasṛtamāna: madhyabale viṃśatipalānīty adoṣa: | sāmānyaviśeṣakathanād adoṣa: | svakīyamate sāmānyaḥ paramate viśeṣa ity adoṣaḥ | yad vā śodhanasaṃśamanalekhanaprabhṛtīnāṃ bastīnāṃ viṣayatvena viṃśatiprabhṛtikaṃ caturviṃśatiprabhṛtikaṃ mānam upadiśanti tadanumānato jñātavyaṃ granthagauravabhayān na likhitam ity adoṣa: ||3||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nirūhapramāṇam āha - nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ pādottaraṃ vaṃkṣaṇādhikaṃ prasthaṃ mataṃ, prasthaṃ madhyamaṃ mataṃ, trayaḥ kuḍavā hīnaṃ matam || 3 ||

athānāsthāpanīyān āha -
atisnigdhotkliṣṭadoṣau kṣatoraska: kṛśas tathā |
ādhmānacchardihikkārśa: kāsaśvāsaprapīḍitaḥ || 4 ||

lg.l: garbhiṇī madhumehī ca nāsthāpyaś ca jalodarī || 5 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣāṃ na vihitaṃ tān āha - vaya:sthāpanād āyuḥ sthāpanād vā sthāpanam āsthāpanaśabdena nirūhaṇam ucyate’ tan nirūhaṇakarma atisnigdhādīnāṃ na vidhīyate | utkliṣṭadoṣo vamanonmukhadoṣaḥ, kṣatamuro yasyāsau kṣatoraska:, kṛśo durbalaḥ, spaṣṭam anyat || 4 || 5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ete nāsthāpyāḥ, cakārād anuvāsyāś ca na | uktaṃ ca -
‘bhayonmādas tathā śoṣājīrṇārucipramehinaḥ|
mūrcchākuṣṭhodarasthaulyaśvāsakāsakṣayāturāḥ || śothabhramamadacchardiyutā bastyamalācalāḥ | nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyāś ca vātarogād ṛte narāḥ’ iti | kuṣṭhaśabdenātra mahākuṣṭhaṃ grāhyaṃ na kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ tasya vihitatvāt | pramehagrahaṇāt sarvaprameheṣu hitam | evaṃ jalodaragrahaṇena anyodareṣu hitam | uktaṃ ca - ‘udarī ca pramehī ca kuṣṭhī sthūlaś ca mānavaḥ | avaśyaṃ sthāpanīyās te nānuvāsyās ta eva‘kathaṃcana’ pā. | ca’ iti || 4 || 5 ||

ab.seg:
atha nirūhyān āha -
vātavyādhāv udāvarte vātāsṛgviṣamajvare |
mūrcchātṛṣṇodarānāhamūtrakṛcchrāśmarīṣu ca ||6||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. vātavyādhāv iti | vātavyādhyādiṣu nirūhaṇam āsthāpanasaṃjñaṃ yojayet | vātavyādhiḥ ākṣepakādi:, udāvarta udarāpūra:, vātāsṛk vātaraktaṃ, viṣamajvara: ekāhikādi:, udaram atra jalodaravyatiriktaṃ sarvodaraṃ grāhyam | eke - ‘mūtrakṛcchrodarānāhamūtradoṣāśmarīṣu ca’ iti paṭhanti | tatra mūtradoṣaṃ mūtrāghātam api jñeyam | athavā mūtragrahaṇena strīṇām api mūtraretorajodoṣā api gṛhyante | yad uktaṃ – ‘mūtraretorajodoṣān asṛgdaragrahaṇaṃ premeheṣu ity atrāpi madhumehavyatirekeṇānye pramehā grāhyā:| tasya niṣiddhatvāt | vidhivad ity anena tantrāntaroktavidhānaṃ boddhavyam | tad yathā -
‘nātyucchritaṃ nāpy atinīcapādaṃ sapādapīṭhaṃ śayanaṃ praśastam |
pradhānamṛdvāstaraṇopapannaṃ prākśīrṣakaṃ śuklapaṭottarīyam ||
prakṣipya bastau mathitaṃ khajena subaddhapucchāsya ca nirvalīkam |
āṅguṣṭhamadhyena mukhaṃ pidhāya netrāgrasaṃsthām apanīya vartim |
tailāktagātraṃ kṛtamūtraviṭkaṃ nātikṣudhārtaṃ śayane manuṣyam ||
samethaveṣannataśairase vā nātyucchrite svāstaraṇopapanne |
savyena pārśvena sukhaṃ śayānaṃ kṛtvā jayed asya bhujopanāham ||
niṣkuñcya savyetarad asya sakthiṃ vāmaṃ prasārya praṇayec ca bastim |
snnigdhe gude netracaturthabhāgaṃ snnigdhair janair jānu ca pṛṣṭhavaṃśam || akampanā'vepanalāghavādīn pāṇyaṅgulīś cāpi nidarśayanti | prapīḍya caikagrahaṇena datte netraṃ śanair eva tato 'pakarṣayet || tiryakpraṇītena tu yāti dhārā gude vraṇa: syāc calite ca netre | datta: śanair nāśayam eti basti: kaṇṭhaṃ pradhāvaty atipīḍitas tu’ ityādi ||6||7||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yeṣāṃ nirūhaṇaṃ vihitaṃ tān āha - vātavyādhau vātaroge, udāvarte udāvartaroge tathāsṛgdararogādau nirūhaṇaṃ yojayet | jalodare niṣedhaḥ nānyasmin udare || 6 || 7||

ab.seg:
yena prakāreṇa nirūhaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ tad āha -
utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ snigdhasvinnam abhojitam |
madhyāhne gṛhamadhye ca yathāyogyaṃ nirūhayet || 8 ||

lg.l: jāte nirūhe ca tato bhaved utkaṭakāsanaḥ || 9 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. evaṃvidhaṃ nirūhayet | utsaṣṭetyādi | utsaṣṭaṃ parityaktaṃ vātamūtrapurīṣaṃ yena | snigdhaṃ kṛtasnehanaṃ | svinnaṃ sveditam | abhojitam akṛtabhojanaṃ | madhyāhneti tasyocitakālatvakhyāpanārtham | gṛhamadhye iti | vātātaparajodoṣādinirāsārtham | snehabastividhānaṃ pūrvam evānuvāsanādhyāye uktam | budhagrahaṇaṃ nirūhadāne 'tikuśalatvakhyāpanārtham | nirūhadānānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyam ? ity ata āha - jāte iti | anāyate nirūhaṃ śodhanair nirūhair haret | śodhananirūhāḥ kṣārādibhiḥ kartavyāḥ | utkaṭakāsanaḥ ūrdhvajānusthitaḥ muhūrtaṃ ghaṭikādvayaparyantam | yadā muhūrtād upari anāyātaṃ nirūhaṃ syāt, tadā śodhanair nirūhaiḥ kṛtvā āharet kṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavair nirūhaṇair iti saṃbandhaḥ || anāyātasya vyāpattir uktā cakradatte -
‘aśuddhaś ca malonmiśraḥ sreho naiti yadā punaḥ |
tadāṅge sadanādhmānaśūlā: śvāsaś ca jāyate || pakvāśayagurutvaṃ ca tatra dadyān nirūhaṇam | tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhair evaṃ siddhaṃ cāpy anuvāsanam’ iti || 8-10 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. evam utsṛṣṭānilamūtrādilakṣaṇaṃ nirūhayet | yathāyogyaṃ yathāvihitam utsṛṣṭaḥ niḥsṛtaḥ anilo vāyur viṭ purīṣaṃ, mūtraṃ ca yasya tam | snigdhaṃ snehitaṃ, svinnaṃ sveditam, abhojitam akṛtāhāraṃ, madhyāhne madhyāhnakāle gṛhamadhye gṛhābhyantare | nirūhaṇaṃ kena vidhinā kuryād ity āha -pūrvokto yaḥ snehabastis tadvidhānena budhaḥ nirūhaṇaṃ kuryāt | nirūhe jāte utkaṭakāsanaḥ utkaṭaṃ bhavet | punaḥ nirūhāgamanecchayā muhūrtamātraṃ tiṣṭhet | muhūrtāt anāyāntaṃ nirūhaṃ tataḥ śodhanairnirūhai: kṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavair eva śodhayet || 8-10 ||

atha sunirūḍhalakṣaṇam āha -
yasya krameṇa gacchanti viṭpittakaphavāyavaḥ |
lāghavaṃ copajāyeta sunirūhaṃ tam ādiśet ||11 ||

Āḍhamalla. yasya krameṇa tantrāntarokte 'gnimūtrapittakaphavāyavaḥ gacchanti lāghavaṃ copajāyate sunirūhaṃ tam ādiśet | uktaṃ ca dṛḍhabalena - ‘prasṛṣṭaviṇmūtrasamīraṇatvaṃ rucyagnivṛdhyāśayalāghavāni | rogopaśāṃtiḥ prakṛtisthatā ca balaṃ ca tat syāt sunirūḍhaliṅgam’ iti | sunirūḍham ityādinā caikadvitriprabhṛtinirūhadānaviṣayamuktam | uktaṃ ca - ‘eko 'pakarṣaty anilaṃ svamārgāt pittaṃ dvitīyas tu kaphaṃ tṛtīya’ ityādi || 11 ||

atha durnirūhalakṣaṇam āha --
yasya syād vastir alpālpavego hīnamalānilaḥ |
mūrcchārtijāḍyārujimān durnirūhaṃ tam ādiśet ||12||

Āḍhamalla. alpālpavega iti | bastidānena svalpadravānām antaḥ praveśananiṣayaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘dattaḥ śanair nāśayam eti bastiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ pradhāvaty atipīḍitas tu’ iti | etena tūrṇam avalambitam iti | hīnamala iti hīnamalo bastir ity arthaḥ | na purīṣādinirgamaḥ | yataḥ - ‘alpālpavego viḍvātahīno hīnanirūhaṇaḥ | mūrcchācchardikaphaprāyo mahāvego 'tiśabditaḥ’ iti | mūrcchārtijāḍyārucimān iti | mūrcchāsthāne mūtrārtir iti pāṭhāntaram | jāḍyaṃ jaḍatā kaphaprāyety abhiprāyaḥ | kecida- trāsthāpanasnehabastyoḥ samyagdānalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti | tad yathā - ‘viviktatā manastuṣṭiḥ snigdhatā vyādhinigrahaḥ | āsthāpanasnehabastyoḥ samyagdāne tu lakṣaṇam’ iti || viviktatā manastuṣṭiḥ | sugamam anyat || 12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. durnirūhalakṣaṇam āha - āsthāpanasnehabastyo: samyagdāne lakṣaṇam āha - viviktatā ekāntatā, manastuṣṭiḥ manasaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ, snigdhatā sacikkaṇatā, vyādhinigrahaḥ roganāśaḥ | āsthāpitaṃ nirūhaṇaṃ | snehabastiḥ pūrvoktaḥ, tayoḥ samyagdāne idaṃ lakṣaṇam ||12||

nirūhasya bastidānavad deyatām āha -
anena vidhinā yuñjyān nirūhaṃ bastidānavat |
dvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ vā yathocitam || 13||

Āḍhamalla. anena pūrvoktena vidhinā nirūha bastidānavat bastidānatulyaṃ, vāgrahaṇāt prathamam ekaṃ, paścād dvitīyaṃ, tadanantaraṃ tṛtīyaṃ caturthaṃ ca | etena bastipuṭakaṃ kathitam iti bhāvaḥ | caturthaṃ vā yathocitam iti | yathārham iti | nanu tṛtīyādhikapuṭam aniṣiddham | yathā - ‘snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane nirūho dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte | trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ’ iti | naivaṃ, niṣedho bahupuruṣaviṣayatayā prāyikaḥ, caturthapuṭadānaṃ tu kasminn api krūrakoṣṭhe balīyasi bahudoṣe puruṣe, tataḥ kuto virodhaḥ | kecid atrāmuṃ ślokaṃ paṭhanti -
sasneha ekaḥ pavane, pitte dvau payasā saha |
kaṣāyakaṭumūtrāḍhyā:‘rūkṣādyā’ pā. kaphe koṣṇāstrayo hitāḥ || asyārthaḥ pūrvam eva pratipakṣe darśitaḥ tenātra kair api paṭhitaḥ || 13 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anena vidhinā bastidānavit nirūhaṃ yuñjyāt | nirūhasya dvitīyādiyojanavidhim āha - ekaṃ nirūhaṃ dvitīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ nirūhaṃ vā yathocitaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yuñjyāt | tatra nirūhayojane doṣakramam āha - pavane vāte ekaḥ nirūhaḥ sasneha eva | dvau nirūho pitte payasā dugdhena saha | kaṣāyakaṭurūkṣādyāḥ kaphe trayaḥ koṣṇāḥ || 13 ||

atha bhojanakramam āha -
pittaśleṣmānilāviṣṭaṃ kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ kramāt |
nirūhaṃ bhojayitvā ca tatas tam anuvāsayet || 14 ||

Āḍhamalla. pittādīnām atra kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ saha bhojanaṃ kāryam | kramād iti anukrameṇaiva | anukramo yathā - pittāviṣṭaṃ nirūhaṃ kṣīrodanaṃ bhojayitvā paścād anuvāsayet, bṛṃhaṇārtham iti bhāvaḥ | śleṣmāviṣṭaṃ yūṣodanaṃ bhojayitvā paścād anuvāsanaṃ deyam | anilāviṣṭaṃ māṃsarasaudanaṃ bhojayitvā anuvāsayed iti padārthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ’pratyāgate koṣṇajalāvasiktaḥ śālyannam adyāt tanunā rasena | jīrṇe ca sāyaṃ laghu cālpamātraṃ bhukto 'nuvāsya: paribṛṃhaṇārtham’ iti || 14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pittaśleṣmānilāviṣṭaṃ nirūhaṃ yojayet kramāt kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ | pittāviṣṭaṃ kṣīraiḥ, śleṣmāviṣṭaṃ yūṣaiḥ, anilāviṣṭaṃ rasaiḥ | evaṃ nirūhaṃ yojayitvā paścād anuvāsanaṃ kārayet || 14 ||

idānīṃ bālavṛddhayor mṛdubastim āha -
sukumārasya vṛddhasya bālasya ca mṛdur hitaḥ |
bastis tīkṣṇaḥ prayuktas tu teṣāṃ hanyād balāyuṣī ||15||

Āḍhamalla. sukumārādīnāṃ mṛdur bastir hitaḥ | ’tu’ punaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ bastiḥ prayuktaḥ teṣāṃ balāyuṣī hanyāt | tantrāntare viśeṣaḥ | ‘viśeṣāt sukumārāṇāṃ hīna eva kramo hitaḥ | mṛdur bastiḥ prayoktavyo viśeṣād bālavṛddhayoḥ’ iti || 15 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kīdṛśaṃ nirūhaṃ yuñjyāt ? tad āha - sukumārāder mṛdur bastir hitaḥ | tīkṣṇabastis teṣāṃ balāyuṣī ||15||

idānīṃ bastīnāṃ dānakramam āha -
dadyād utkleśanaṃ pūrvaṃ madhye doṣaharaṃ tataḥ |
paścāt saṃśamanīyaṃ ca dadyād bastiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 16 ||
Āḍhamalla. utkleśanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ, doṣaharaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ, saṃśamanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ samīkaraṇāc chamanam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||16||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ādau madhye ante ca kīdṛśaṃ basti yuñjyāt ? tad āha - utkleśanaṃ dadyāt ukleśanaṃ doṣotkleśakaraṃ, madhye doṣaharaṃ vātādidoṣaśamanaṃ, paścāt saṃśamanīyaṃ samasthāpakaṃ upaśamakaram ity arthaḥ || 16 ||

atha teṣāṃ svarūpāṇy āha -- utkleśanabastiḥ |
eraṇḍabījaṃ madhukaṃ pippalī saindhavaṃ vacā |
hapuṣā phalakalkaṃ ca bastir utkleśanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||17||
Āḍhamalla. ayam utkleśanasaṃjño bastiḥ śeṣaṃ sugamam ||17 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. madhukaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, hapuṣā prasiddhā || 17 ||

atha doṣaharabastim āha -
śatāhvā madhukaṃ bilvaṃ kauṭajaṃ phalam eva ca |
sakāñjikaḥ sagomūtro bastir doṣaharo mataḥ || 18||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. madhukaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, kauṭajaṃ phalam indrayavaḥ ||18||

atha teṣāṃ doṣaharam āha --
priyaṅgu madhukaṃ mustaṃ tathaiva ca rasāñjanam |
sakṣīraḥ śasyate bastir doṣāṇāṃ śamanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||19||
Āḍhamalla. ayaṃ doṣasaṃśamano bastiḥ | priyaṅguḥ kāntā, rasāñjanam atra kṛṣṇapāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ dravaviśeṣaḥ | tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ yojyam || 19 ||

śodhanabastim āha - śodhanadravyani:kvāthais tatkalkaiḥ snehsaindhavaiḥ |
yuktyā khajena mathitā bastaya: śodhanā: smṛtā: ||20||

Āḍhamalla. śodhanadravyāṇi nikumbhādīni prasiddhāni | tāni nikumbha-triphalā-gavakṣīra-snuk-śaṃkhinī-nīlinī-tilvakāni, śamyāka-kampillaka-hemadugdhā-dugdhaṃ ca virecanāni ityādīni | ‘khajena’ ity atra ‘kṣaṇena’ iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ || 20 ||

lekhanabastim āha -
triphalākkāthagomūtrakṣaudrakṣārasamāyutāḥ |
uṣakādipratīvāpā bastayo lekhanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||21||
Āḍhamalla. uṣakādiḥ prāg uktaḥ | yathā - oṣakādisaindhavaśilājatukāsīsadvayahiṃgūni truṭakaś ceti | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 21 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athe lekhanabastayaḥ - kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ | uṣakādir gaṇaḥ suśrute | lekhanā medorogādikṛśīkaraṇāt || 21 ||

atha bṛṃhaṇabastīn āha -
bṛṃhaṇadravyaniṣkvāthā: kalkair madhurakair yutāḥ |
sarpirmāṃsarasopetā bastayo bṛṃhaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22 ||
Āḍhamalla. bṛṃhaṇāni kākolī-kṣīrakākolī-jīvakarṣabhaka-medā-mahāmedāprabhṛtīni madhurakair iti | drākṣā-kharjūra-vātāmadīni || śeṣaṃ subodham || 22 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bṛṃhaṇā bastayaḥ matāḥ kathitāḥ || 22 ||

picchilabastim āha -
badaryai-rāvatī-śelu-śālmalī-dhanvanāgarāḥ |
kṣīrasiddhāḥ kṣaudrayuktā nāmrā picchilasaṃjñitāḥ |
ajorabhraiṇarudhirair yuktā deyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 23 ||

Āḍhamalla. badarī prasiddhā (kolam), airāvatī nāgabalā iti bhānumatī, śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ, śālmalī prasiddhā, dhanvanāgaro dhanvadeśajo nāgaramustam | dhanvanāgarasthāne ‘dhanvanākurāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ, dhanvayāsakāṃkurāḥ || ajaḥ chāga:, urabhro meṣa:, eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ | eke suśrutādhyāyino 'tra paṭhanti - ‘varāhamahiṣorabhrabaiḍālaiṇeyakaukkuṭam | sadyaskam asṛgājaṃ vā deyaṃ picchilabastiṣu’ iti | tathā vyākhyānayanti ca | kṣepako 'yam iti manyamānatvāt na samyak likhitaḥ | mātrāpicchilabastīnām iti | dvādaśapalair evātra pūrmoktā hīnamātrā niyatā viśeṣagrahaṇāt ||23||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha picchilabastayaḥ - badarī kolam, airāvatī nāgaraṅgaphalaṃ, śelu gundriṇī, śālmalī prasiddhā, dhanvo yavāsaka:, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī | ajā barkarī, urabhra ūrṇāmeṣaḥ, eṇo mṛgaḥ tadrudhireṇa deyaḥ | tatpramāṇaṃ dvādaśapalam || 23 ||

atha nirūhārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇapūrvakaṃ vidhānam āha -
dattvādau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaḥ prasṛtidvayam || 24 ||

lg.l: ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet ||25||
kṣiptvā vimathya dadyāc ca nirūhaṃ kulaśo bhiṣak ||26||
vāte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyāt snehasya ṣaṭpalam |
pitte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ snehaṃ dadyāt palatrayam || 27 ||
kaphe ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣipet snehaṃ catuṣpalam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atra saindhavaparimāṇaṃ tūttamamātrāyāṃ na gaṇitam ata eva ‘ādau’ iti grahaṇaṃ kṛtam | uttamamātrā viṃśatipalair eva | pūrvam uktaṃ yathā - ‘nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ tu prasthaṃ pādottaraṃ param | madhyamaṃ prastham uddiṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ tu kuḍavās traya’ iti | cakradatte tu -
‘dattvākṣaṃ saindhavasyādau madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam |
vinirmathya tato dadyāt snehasya prasṛtitrayam ||
ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet |
saṃmūrcchitaiḥ kaṣāyaṃ tu catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam ||
kṣiptvā vimathya dadyāc ca nirūhaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak |
vāte catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyāt snehasya ṣaṭpalam ||
pitte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ snehaṃ dadyāt palatrayam |
kaphe ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣipet snehaṃ catuḥpalam || vitarec ca yathāvāpam ante dviprasṛtonmitam | evaṃ prakalpito bastir dvādaśaprasṛto bhavet’ iti | etad api pañcāṅgamānayuktyā samīcīnaṃ darśitam | tathā hi -
‘madhusnehana-kalkākhyakaṣāyāvāpataḥ kramāt |
trīṇi ṣaṭ dve daśa trīṇi palāny anilarogiṇām | pittaṃ catvāri catvari tripañca ca catuṣṭayam || ṣaṭ trīṇi dve daśa trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam’ iti | vātādīnāṃ kevalamadhusnehayor viśeṣamānam āha - vāte catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudram ityādi | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 24-27 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha nirūhaḥ | saindhavasya akṣaṃ dadyāt | madhunā prasṛtidvayaṃ catu:palaṃ snehasya tailāde: prasṛtitrayaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ kalakasya dravyasya prasṛtiḥ dvipalam | saṃmūrcchite paripakve kaṣāye catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam aṣṭapalaṃ kṣiptvā vimathya nirūhaṃ dadyāt, vāte kṣaudraṃ catuḥpalaṃ snehaṃ catuḥpalam evaṃ vibhajya deyam | iti nirūhaṇamātrāvidhi: || 24-27 ||

madhutailikasaṃjñaṃ bastividhānam āha -
eraṇḍakkāthatulyāṃśaṃ madhutailaṃ palāṃśakam || 28 ||

Āḍhamalla. madhutailaṃ palāṃśakam ity asya sthāne madhutailapalāṣṭakam ity eke paṭhanti | tan na, uktaṃ ca tantrāntare -
‘madhutaile same syātāṃ kvāthaś cairaṇḍamūlajaḥ |
palārthaṃ śatapuṣpāyās tato 'rdhaṃ saindhavasya ca |
palenaikena saṃyuktaṃ khajena tu viloḍita: | deya: sukhoṣṇo bhiṣajā madhutailasaṃkara’ iti | malodāvartanāśane ity atra udarodāvartanāśana iti pāṭha: | ayam eva tantrāntare ardhamātrikanirūha: kathita: sa tu tatraiva jñātavya: ||28-30||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śatapuṣpā palārdhena yojyā saindhavārdhena ca saṃyutaṃ | madhutailakasaṃjño 'yaṃ bastir medogulmādiharaḥ | khajaviloḍita iti khajo manthānaviśeṣa:, tena viloḍita: mathitaḥ || 28-30||

atha yāpanabastim āha -
kṣaudrā-jya-kṣīra-tailānāṃ prasṛtaṃ prasṛtaṃ bhavet |
hapuṣāsaindhavākṣāṃśo basti: syād dīpanaḥ para: || 31 ||
Āḍhamalla. hapuṣā vipuṣā || 31 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha yāpanabastim āha - kṣaudrādīnāṃ prasṛtir dvipalaṃ, hapuṣā prasiddhā, saindhavaṃ ca etayor akṣāṃśau dvau dvau akṣau karṣau ||31 ||

atha yuktarathabastim āha -
eraṇḍamūlaniṣkvātho madhutailaṃ sasaindhavam |
eṣa yuktaratho basti: savacāpippallīphalaḥ || 32 ||

Āḍhamalla. kvāthādīnāṃ pariramāṇaṃ tu madhutailikabastivaj jñeyam | tasyāntaḥpātitvāt | ‘yad uktaṃ madhutailaṃ ca kkāthaṃ sarasasaindhavam | phalapippalīsaṃyukto bastir yuktaratha: smṛta:’ iti | atrā'pi pūrvoktam eva | phalam atra madanaphalam | iti yuktarathaḥ || 32 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha yuktarathabasti: - phalo madanaphalaḥ, eṣa yuktaratho nāma bastiḥ || 32 ||

atha siddhabastim āha -
pañcamūlasya niṣkvāthas tailaṃ māgadhikā madhu |
sasaindhava: samadhukaḥ siddhabastir iti smṛta: || 33 ||
Āḍhamalla. sugamam || iti siddhabastinirūha: ||33||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pañcamūlaṃ bṛhadbilvādi:, tasya niṣkvātha:, tailaṃ tilatailaṃ, māgadhikā pippalī, madhu kṣaudraṃ, saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ, madhuko madhukasāra iti nāmnā prasiddhaḥ ||33||

pathyāpathyam āha -
snānam uṣṇodakaiḥ kuryāt divā svapnam ajīrṇatām |
varjayed aparaṃ sarvam, ācaret snehabastivat || 34 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe nirūhabasti- vidhir adhyāya: samāpta: || 6 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha tyājyāny āha - snehabastivad iti | snehabastividhau yad ācaritaṃ tat sarvam ācaret | tat tatraiva jñātavyam || 34 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāṭīkāyāṃ dīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe bastinirūhakalpanādhyāya: samāpta: ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bastau sevyaṃ niṣedhaṃ ca - uṣṇodakena snānaṃ kuryāt iti vihitam | tathā snehabastau yad vihitaṃ tad ācaret | divā svāpam ajīrṇatāṃ ca varjayet || 34 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāṭīkāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi nirūhabastividhir adhyāya: ṣaṣṭha:|| 6||

div.head: atha uttarabastividhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
atha saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ | pāriśeṣyād uttarabastim āha -
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bastim uttarasaṃjñitam |
dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ netraṃ madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. ataḥ paraṃ bastinirūhayor anantaram uttarasaṃjñitaṃ bastiṃ pravakṣyāmi iti | uttarabastinetrasvarūpam āha - madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam iti | madhye ṣaḍaṅgulopari karṇikā mekhalākārā mudrikā | ata eva mūtramārge ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ netraṃ praveśayed ity uktam agre | yantracchidraṃ tu mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ kāryaṃ sarṣapākāram | yantre chidram āha - chidraṃ sarṣapasannibhaṃ nirgamacchidram ity artha: | kecit ‘sarṣapanirgamam’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti | siddhārthakapraveśāgram iti tantrāntare | nanu kvacid api caturdaśāṃgulam api paṭhitaṃ tad yathā - ‘caturdaśāṅgulaṃ netraṃ tatra kāryaṃ vijānatā | mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ kartavyaṃ chidram eva ca’ iti | tat katham atra dvādaśāṃgulam ? ucyate, karṇikārthaṃ tu netraṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam eva sarvasaṃmatam | śeṣaṃ tu carmapuṭakasya samīcīnagrathanārthaṃ kathitam ity adoṣaḥ | carakādau tu dvādaśāṃgulam evoktatvāt, athavā - ‘meḍhrāyāmasamaṃ kecid icchanti khalu tadvida’ ityādi matam ālocya carakamatam eva śārṅgadhareṇa svīkṛtam ity alaṃ vistareṇa || 1 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ataḥ param uttarasaṃjñitaṃ bastiṃ pravakṣyāmi pūrvaṃ vidhānam āha - dvādaśāṃgulikaṃ netraṃ nālikā lakṣaṇaṃ madhye kṛtakarṇikaṃ kamalapatrakarṇikāvanmadhyabhāgaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ sthūlaṃ punaḥ chidre sarṣapanirgamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā chidram || 1 ||

snehamātrām āha -
pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇām adho mātrā dvikārṣikā || 2 ||

lg.l: tad ūrdhvaṃ palamātrā ca snehasyoktā bhiṣagvaraiḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇām adhaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣād adho 'rvāk caturviṃśatiparyantaṃ mātrā snehasya dvikārṣikī | tad ūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśād ūrdhvaṃ palamātrā | bhiṣagvarair iti grahaṇena doṣadeśadehakālānalādy apekṣya nyūnādhikā'pi mātrā yojyā sampradāyadarśanāt | ata evoktaṃ -‘pañcaviṃśativarṣonam adho mātrā dvikārṣikī’ iti kvacit pāṭho 'pi || 2 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vayo 'numānena pramāṇam āha - pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇām adhovayasāṃ snehasya tailāder dvikārṣikī palārdhamānamātrā, tad ūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśater ūrdhvaṃ snehasya palamānā mātrā || 2 ||

athottarabaster vidhānam āha -
athāsthāpanaśuddhasya tṛptasya snānabhojanaiḥ || 3 ||

lg.l: snigdhayā meḍhramārge ca tato netraṃ niyojayet || 4 ||
tato 'vapīḍayed bastiṃ śanair netraṃ ca nirharet || 5 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athaśabda ānantarye | āsthāpanaṃ kaṣāyabastiḥ, kaṣāyair dīyamānatvāt | nirūham evāsthāpanakam ity eke | kasya ? snānabhojanaiḥ tṛptasya, bhojanagrahaṇena ghṛtakṣīramāṃsādīnāṃ grahaṇam | uktaṃ ca - ‘athāntaram upasnigdhaṃ svinnaṃ praśithilāśayam | yavānnaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pītavantaṃ yathābalam’ ityādi | jānumātre pīṭhe iti jānuparimāṇe āsane | uccatayā boddhavyam | uktaṃ ca -‘niṣaṇṇam ājānusame pīṭhe’ ityādi | anviṣya śalākayā iti meḍhramārgaṃ śalākayā anviṣya anveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā | kiṃviśiṣṭayā śalākayā snigdhayā ślakṣṇayā | athavā ghṛtābhyañjanena vā | tato netraṃ niyojayet iti | netraṃ nalikā uttarabastisaṃjñasya |‘athāsthāpanaśuddhasya tṛptasya snānabhojanaiḥ’ asyāgre - ‘svabhyaktabastiśīrṣasya tailenoṣṇena yuktitaḥ | tataḥ samaṃ sthāpayitvā nālam asya praharṣitam’ ity eke paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca, prācīnapustake na dṛṣṭaḥ | atha yantrapīḍanam āha - netraṃ yantraṃ ghṛtābhyaktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ meḍhrarandhre meḍhramārge praveśayed vaidya iti śeṣaḥ | ata evoktaṃ prāk ‘madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam’ iti | tena karṇikāparyantaṃ sasnigdhaṃ meḍhramārge praveśayed ity arthaḥ | tato 'nantaraṃ praveśānantaraṃ bastiṃ snehādisaṃbhṛtaṃ carmapuṭakaṃ śanair yathā syād avapīḍyate yathā'ntaḥ sneho 'ntaḥ praviṣṭo bhavati | netraṃ ca hared iti | punaḥ śanair yathā syāt tathā netraṃ haret mūtramārgādityarthaḥ | snehe pratyāgate snehabastikramaḥ hitaḥ | ‘snehabastikramo hita’ ity asya sthāne -‘aparāhṇe vicakṣaṇaḥ | payasā bhojayed enaṃ yūṣair māṃsarasena vā’ iti kecit, tad api yuktaṃ tantrāntarasaṃvādāt | ‘snehakramo hita’ iti tatra granthakartur ayam āśayaḥ - tatra samyag dattasya liṅgāni bhavanti, vyāpadaś ca tāḥ | tatratyopakramaś ca kartavyaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘samyag dattasya liṅgāni vyāpadaḥ krama eva ca | baster uttarasaṃjñasya samānaḥ snehabastinā’ iti ||3-5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athottarabastidāne yogyam āha - athānantaram āsthāpane tu nirūhaṇena śuddhasya punaḥ snānabhojanais taptasya punaḥ jānumātre pīṭhe sthitasya iṣṭaśalākayā snigdhayā kṛtaṃ netramārgaṃ | tataḥ netram uttarabastinalikāṃ yojayet | śanaiḥ śanair ghṛtābhyaktaṃ ghṛtavyāptaṃ netraṃ meḍhrarandhre ṣaṭ aṅgulāni yojyaṃ, bastinā pīḍayet | punaḥ śanair netraṃ nirharet niṣkāsayet | tataḥ snehe pratyāgate ayaṃ snehabastikramaḥ hitaḥ kathitaḥ || 3-5 ||

puṃsām uttarabastinetram uktvā strīṇām uttarabastim āha -
strīṇāṃ kaniṣṭhikāsthūlanetraṃ kuryād daśāṃgulam || 6 ||

lg.l: dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtramārge ca sūkṣmaṃ netraṃ niyojayet || 7 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kaniṣṭhikā striya eva | daśāṅgulam iti | dairghyeṇa mudgapraveśaṃ randhram iti śeṣaḥ | tena mudgavāhinalikācchidram ity arthaḥ | yonyantaś caturaṅgulam iti | tac ca netram atyarthamārge caturaṅgulapramāṇam antaḥ praveśayed ity arthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - mūtrasrotaḥparīṇāhamudgavāhidaśāṅgulam | tāsām atyarthamārge tu nidadhyāc caturaṅgulam’ iti | dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtramārge ca iti | strīṇām atra mūtramārge jñeyam | tatra dvyaṅgulanetraṃ praveśayed iti bhāvaḥ | tac ca sūkṣmanetraṃ kāryaṃ yathā puruṣameḍhramārgārthaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛttābhaṃ kathitaṃ tadvad atrā'pi jñeyam || 6 || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha strīṇāṃ bastidāne vidhim āha -- strīṇām iti sugamam || 6 || 7 ||

ab.seg:
bālānām api netraparimāṇam āha -
mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu bālānāṃ tv ekam aṅgulam |
śanair niṣkampam ādheyaṃ sūkṣmanetraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 8 ||

Āḍhamalla. mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu iti padaṃ pūrveṇa saṃbandhanīyam | bālānām api vā mūtrakṛcchravikāre 'pi bālaḥ ‘ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyanto bālaḥ’ ekam aṅgulaṃ netreṇa saṃbandhanīyam | sūkṣmanetram ity anena mālatīpuṣpavṛttākāratvāt sūkṣmatvaṃ jñeyam || 8 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha bālānāṃ bastidānapramāṇam āha - mūtrakṛcchreti sugamam || 8 ||

athāpatyamūtramārgayor viṣayatvāt snehaparimāṇam āha -
yonimārgeṣu nārīṇāṃ snehamātrā dvipālikī |
mūtramārge palonmānā bālānāṃ ca dvikārṣikī ||9||
Āḍhamalla. yonyādimārgatrayaṃ strīṇām eva | kiṃ tu punar bālānāṃ dvikarṣapramāṇā iti || 9 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. strīṇāṃ bālānāṃ ca snehamātrāpramāṇam āha - dvipālikī dvipalapramāṇā | bālānāṃ dvikārṣikī dvikarṣamānā || 9 ||

atha strīṇām uttarabastiḥ kathaṃ yojyaḥ ? ity āha -
uttānāyai striyai dadyād ūrdhvajānvai vicakṣaṇaḥ |
apratyāgacchati bhiṣag bastāv uttarasaṃjñite || 10 ||

lg.l: bhūyo bastiṃ nidadhyāc ca saṃyuktaiḥ śodhanairgaṇaiḥ |
phalavartiṃ nidadhyād vā yonimārge dṛḍhāṃ bhiṣak || 11||
dahyamāne tathā bastau dadyād bastiṃ viśāradaḥ || 12 ||
bastiḥ śukrarujaḥ puṃsāṃ strīṇām ārtavajāṃ rujam|| 13||
hanyād uttarabastis tu nocito mehināṃ kkacit |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. vicakṣaṇasthāne samāhita iti vā pāṭhe sa evārthaḥ | asyāgre - ‘anena vidhinā dadyāt bastīn trīn caturo 'pi vā’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | anirgame punar bastir deya ity ata āha - uttarasaṃjñite bastau pratyāgacchati sati bhūyaḥ punar api bastim uttarasaṃjñaṃ nidadhyāt | kiṃbhūtaṃ ? śodhanairgaṇaiḥ saṃyuktam | śodhanagaṇo virecanagaṇaḥ | vā athavā phalavartiṃ nidadhyāt | kva ? yonimārge apatyamārge | kiṃbhūtāṃ ? dṛḍhām aśithilām | ata eva sūtrair vinirmitām | tathā snigdhāṃ tathā śodhanadravyasaṃyutām | śodhanadravyakṛtām ity arthaḥ | vartis tu agre vakṣyamāṇā jñātavyā | asyāgre kecid adhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti tad yathā --
‘payobastiṃ nidadhyāt tu proktaṃ gulmacikitsitam |
praveśayed vā matimān bastidvāre ca peṣaṇī ||
pīḍayed vāpy adho nābher bastinā pariveṣṭitaḥ |
āragvadhasya patreṣu nirguṇḍyā: svarasasya ca ||
kuryād gomūtrapiṣṭeṣu vartiṃ cā'pi sasaindhavām |
mudgailāsarṣapasamāṃ pravibhajya payāṃsi ca || baster āgamanārthāya tan nidadhyāc chalākayā |’ ityādipāṭho bahupustakeṣv adarśanān na vyākhyātaḥ | atha bastidāhacikitsām āha - dravyasyānirgamād bastau mūtrāśaye dahyamāne sati viśārado vaidyakaśāstrakriyākuśalaḥ kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa bastiṃ dadyāt | vā athavā śītalena payasā bastiṃ dadyāt | kṣīravṛkṣā vaṭodumbarādayaḥ | eke kṣīravṛkṣaṃ rājādanam āhuḥ | rāyaṇīti loke | payo 'tra pānīyam āhuḥ | śītaleti | śītaladravyamadhukādiyuktatvena śītalena ity arthaḥ | yad uktaṃ tantrāntare - ‘śarkarāmadhumiśreṇa śītena madhukāmbunā | dahyamāne bhiṣak bastau pāyau bastiṃ pradāpayet’ iti | athānantaraṃ basteḥ prabhāvapūrvakaṃ niṣedham āha - puṃsāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vasādyāśritā rujaḥ rogān strīṇām ārtavajā rujaḥ asṛgdarādayaḥ hanyāt | mehināṃ pramehiṇāṃ nocitaḥ na yuktaḥ | pramehasya bastigatatve 'pi nocitatvam | yathānuvāsanaṃ kuṣṭhapramehināṃ niṣiddham | kecin mehaśabdena madhumeham āhuḥ || 10-13 ||
