Kāśīrāma Vaidya. uttānāyai bhiṣak dadyād iti saṃbandhaḥ | tathā dadyāt yathā snehaḥ pratyāgacchati | bhūyaḥ punaḥ kṛcchre viśeṣavyādhau śodhanairgaṇaiḥ eraṇḍatailādibhir bastiṃ nidadhyāt | yonimārge bastyabhāve phalavartikāṃ nidadhyāt | phalānām eraṇḍabījādīnāṃ vartir yad vā phalasadṛśī vartiḥ phalanāmnī vāsoghanadravyasaṃyutasya sūtreṇa vinirmitāṃ punaḥ snigdhām evaṃbhūtā vartiṃ dadyāt | vartyā dahyamāne bastau mūtrākāśe kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa udumbarādi punaḥ payasā śītalena bastiḥ puṃsāṃ śukradoṣajā rujaḥ strīṇām ārtavajā rujaḥ uttarabastir hanyāt | mehinaḥ kvacit na ucitaḥ || 10-13 ||

uttarabasteḥ snehabastisamānāyāḥ guṇadoṣān āha -
samyag dattasya liṅgāni vyāpadaḥ krama eva ca || 14 ||

Āḍhamalla. uttarasaṃjñasya uttarabasteḥ snehabastinā'nuvāsanena samāni liṅgāni lakṣaṇāni tathā vyāpadaḥ hīnātimithyāyogajaḥ kramaś ca upakramaś ca samānaḥ snehabastinā tulya ity arthaḥ | tantrāntare tu — ‘duṣṭaṃ śukraṃ śoṇitaṃ cāṅganānām asṛgdaraṃ tasya nāśaṃ ca puṣpam |
mūtrāghātaṃ mūtradoṣān pravṛddhān yoner doṣān tatparāyāś ca saṃgam |
śukrāghātaṃ śarkarām aśmarīṃ ca śūlaṃ bastau vaṃkṣaṇe mehane ca | ghorān anyān bastijāṃś cāpi rogān mohād ṛte uttaro hanti bastiḥ’ iti || 14 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. samyagdattalakṣaṇam āha - śamanaṃ śukratvaśamanaṃ bhavati | pramehalakṣaṇaṃ śamanaṃ bhavati || 14 ||

atha pūrvoddiṣṭāṃ phalavartim āha -
ghṛtābhyakte gude kṣepyā ślakṣṇā svāṅguṣṭhasannibhā ||15||
malapravartanī vartiḥ phalavartiś ca sā smṛtā | iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe uttarabastividhir nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. ślakṣṇā komalā, svāṃguṣṭhasannibhā āturāṃguṣṭhatulyā sthūlatayā | malaṃ mūtrapurīṣādikam | malaśabdena strīṇām api rajodoṣādikam | apatyamārge deyā īdṛśī phalavartiḥ smṛtā kathitā || 15 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ cottarakhaṇḍe uttarabastividhir adhyāyaḥ ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. phalavartim āha - tatpramāṇā sā phalavartiḥ, malapravartanī bhavati | phalānāṃ vā nirmitā || 15 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ pañcakarmaṇi uttarabastividhi- radhyāyaḥ saptamaḥ ||

div.head: atha nasyavidhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha nasyavidhiḥ | nasyasya niruktim āha -
nasyaṃ tat kathyate nīrair nāsāgrāhyaṃ yad auṣadham |
nāvanaṃ nasyakarmeti tasya nāmadvayaṃ matam || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha pañcakarmapāriśeṣyān nasyavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte - nasyeti | auṣadhaṃ kvāthasvarasasnehādi, nasyam iti nāsayā dīyate iti nasyam | tasya nasyasya nāmadvayaṃ coktam, nāvanam ekaṃ dvitīyaṃ nasyam iti || 1||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha nasyavidhiḥ | tatra nasyalakṣaṇaṃ dhīrair yat nāsāgrāhyam auṣadhaṃ tat nasyaṃ kathyate | nāvanaṃ nasyakarma ceti tasya nāmadvayam || 1 ||

nasyabhedān āha -
nasyabhedo dvidhā prokto recanaḥ snehanas tathā |
recanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ matam || 2 ||

Āḍhamalla. nāsikayā dīyate yat tat nasyaṃ tasya bhedo dviprakāraḥ, eko recanaḥ dvitīyaḥ snehanaḥ, recanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇam, upakramyasya dvitvāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘upakramyasya hi dvitvād dvidhaivopakramo mataḥ | ekaḥ saṃtarpaṇas tatra dvitīyaś cāpatarpaṇaḥ’ iti | nanu vāgbhaṭena trividhaṃ nasyaṃ saviṣayam uktaṃ tad yathā -
‘virecanaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ jāḍyaṃ spandagalāmaye |
śophagaṇḍakrimigranthiku- ṣṭhāpasmārapīnase ||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātaje śūle sūryāvarte svarakṣaye |
nāsā'syaśoṣe vāksaṃge kṛcchrabodhe 'vabāhuke |
śamanaṃ nīlikāvyaṅgakeśadoṣākṣirājiṣu ||
yathāsvaṃ yaugikaiḥ snehair yathāsvaṃ ca prasādhitaiḥ |
kalkakvāthādibhiś cādyaṃ madhupaṭvāsavair api || bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhanvamāṃsottharasāsṛksvapurair api | śamanaṃ yojayet pūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena ca’ iti, tat katham atra dvividhaṃ coktam ? ucyate - śamanasya bṛṃhaṇe 'ntarbhāvāt | uktaṃ ca - ‘śamanaṃ yojayet pūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena ca’ iti | ata eva raviguptādau pañcabhedās te yathā - ‘nasyaṃ śirovirekaś ca pratimarśo 'vapīḍanam | jñeyaṃ pradhamanaṃ caitan nasyakarma tu pañcadhā’ iti | dṛḍhabale tu dhūmo 'dhiko 'sti na ca śirovireka iti | tad yathā - ‘nāvanaṃ cāvapīḍaś ca dhmāpanaṃ dhūma eva ca | pratimarśaś ca vijñeyo nastakarma tu pañcadhā’ iti | kāśmīrās tu ṣaṭprakāraṃ paṭhanti yathā - ‘avapīḍaṃ pradhamanaṃ nasyaṃ recanatarpaṇam | pratimarśaś ca dhūmaś ca nasyakarma tu ṣaḍvidham’ iti | te 'py atraivāntarbhāvanīyāḥ| te tu granthakṛtā evāgre spaṣṭatayoktāḥ | yathā - śirorecane pradhamanāvapīḍanasaṃjñāv antarbhūtau, te tu karṣaṇatvāt karṣaṇe 'ntarbhūtau, pratimarṣamarṣau tu bṛṃhaṇentarbhūtau, evaṃ dhūmo 'pi śodhanaśamanatvāt yathā svāntarbhāvanīya iti susthitam etat ||2||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. recanasnehananasyabhedadvayam āha - recanas tathā snehana iti dvidhā nasyabhedaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | tatra yad virecanaṃ vātakaphādīnāṃ chedanaṃ yat snehanaṃ tat bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhātuvṛddhikaram || 2 ||

nasyakarmakālam āha -
kaphapittāniladhvaṃse pūrvamadhyāparāhṇake |
dine tu gṛhyate nasyaṃ rātrāv apy utkaṭe gade || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. kaphapittānilānāṃ dhvaṃse vṛddhilakṣaṇe kope, ‘sraṃsudhvaṃsu adhaḥpatane’ ity asya rūpaṃ | kutra kopa ity ata āha - dinasya pūrvamadhyāhne 'parāhṇake, tenā'yam arthaḥ siddhaḥ - dinasya pūrvāhṇe kaphakope, dinasya madhyāhne pittakope, dinasyāparāhṇe vātakope iti | athavā utkaṭe gade rātrāv api nasyaṃ deyam iti | uktaṃ ca - ‘yathā doṣodaye kāle rogiṇe nāvanaṃ bhiṣag’ | iti ata eva svasthāsvasthaviṣayasambandhena kālā darśitās tantrāntare tad yathā - ‘śaraddhemantayoḥ svasthe pūrvāhṇe saṃprayojayet | varṣāsu śītaje grīṣme sāyaṃ madhyaṃdine tathā’ iti ||3||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nasyadāne nasyakālam āha - kaphapittavātadhvaṃse kaphapittavātanāśau krameṇa dinasya pūrvamadhyaparāhṇeke nasyaṃ gṛhyate | kaphanāśārthaṃ dinasya pūrvabhāge, pittanāśārthaṃ dinasya madhyabhāge, vātanāśārthaṃ dinasyāparabhāge | utkaṭe gade rātrāv api nasyaṃ gṛhyate || 3 ||

nasyaṃ yasmin kāle tyājyaṃ yaiś ca tyājyaṃ tān āha -
nasyaṃ tyajed bhojanānte durdine cāpatarpite |
tathā navapratiśyāyī garbhiṇī garadūṣitaḥ || 4 ||

lg.l: vegāvarodhī snātaś ca snātukāmaś ca varjavet |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. durdine meghacchanne 'hni, apatarpite asantarpite puruṣe | saṃtarpaṇaṃ dhātuvṛddhikaraṇārthaṃ tena dhātubalo nasyena vidheyam iti tātparyārthaḥ | cakārād vāgbhaṭoktās te yathā - ‘yojayen na tu nāvanam | toyamadyagarasnehapītānāṃ pātum icchatām ||
bhuktabhaktaśiraḥsnātasnātukāmasrutāsṛjām |
navapīnasavegārtasūtikāśvāsakāsinām || śuddhānāṃ dattabastīnāṃ tathā'nārtavadurdine| anyatrātyayikād vyādheḥ’ iti | navapratiśyāyīti navatvaṃ dvividhanidānabhedena | ekaṃ sadyojanakaṃ dvitīyaṃ doṣacayapūrvakam | tatrādyo yathā - ‘nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso 'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītam atipratāpaḥ | saṃdhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoś ca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānam uktam’ iti | dvitīyo yathā -‘cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāś ca tathaiva śoṇitam | prakupyamānā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇais tataḥ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi’ iti | tena sadyonidānajanakaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ so 'pi navaḥ pratiśyāya iti kecit | anye tv evam āhuḥ - ‘āmapakvabhedena pratiśyāyasya navapurāṇatve kathite | tenāpi yaḥ āmasaṃjñakaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ so 'pi taruṇatvena nasyaviṣaye tyājyaḥ na tu pakva iti bhāvaḥ | garaṃ kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ tena vyāptaḥ | kevalaviṣaprāpte 'vapīḍasyoktatvāt | uktaṃ ca -‘cetovikāraviṣābhipannānāṃ cūrṇaṃ ṣaḍaṅguladvimukhayā nāḍyā deyam’ | anyac ca -
‘viṣābhighātasaṃ- nyāsamūrcchāmohāpatantrake |
mahāpasmāraśokārticintākrodhāmayādiṣu || mānaseṣu ca rogeṣu mūḍhavyākulacetasaḥ | saṃjñāprabodhahetvartham avapīḍaṃ pradāpayet iti | bālavṛddhayor api utkaṭadoṣeṣu nasyaṃ deyam, ‘bhīrustrīkṛśabālānām’ ityādivakṣyamāṇatvāt | snātaḥ śirasnāta:, snātukāmaś ca ity anena pūrvaṃ vidhāya paścāt snānaṃ kuryād ity eke vyākhyānayanti || 4 || 5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yasmin kālai nasyaṃ tyājyaṃ tad āha - durdine meghacchanne 'hni durdinam | apatarpaṇe laṅghane, navapratiśyāyī navapratiśyāyavān | garadūṣitaḥ viṣadūṣitaḥ | pītasnehodakāsavaḥ pītaṃ sneham udakam āsavaṃ madyaṃ yena saḥ | vegāvarodhī mūtrapurīṣakāvarodhī | spaṣṭam anyat || 4 || 5 ||

ab.seg:
nasyārhānarhān āha --
aṣṭavarṣasya bālasya nasyakarma samācaret || 6 ||

lg.l: aśītivarṣād ūrdhvaṃ ca nāvanaṃ naiva dīyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha bālavṛddhayor nasyagrahaṇāgrahaṇaviṣayaṃ darśayann āha - aṣṭavarṣād ūrdhvaṃ nasyaṃ deyam | aṣṭavarṣād upari nasyakarma kuryāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘na nasyam ūnasaptābde nātītāśītivatsare’ iti | aṣṭavarṣād arvāg api doṣodrekād ātyayike vyādhau bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ deyam | uktaṃ ca - ‘bhīrustrīkṛśabālānāṃ nasyata’ iti | evaṃ vṛddhasyā'śītivarṣasyāpi jñeyam || 6 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. yasya nasyaṃ deyaṃ tad apy āha - nāvanaṃ nasyaṃ | sugamam || 6 ||

atha vairecanaṃ nasyam āha -
atha vairecanaṃ nasyaṃ grāhyaṃ tailaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ || 7 ||

lg.l: tīkṣṇabheṣajasiddhair vā snehaiḥ kvāthai rasais tathā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. tailaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ sarṣapādijaiḥ tīkṣṇabheṣajasiddhaiḥ snehair vā | tīkṣṇadravyāṇi maricapippalīśṛṅgaveraśobhāñjanādīni, taiḥ ye siddhā ye snehāḥ kvāthāś ca iti || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha virecanasya vidhānam āha – sugamam ||7||

virecanasya mātrām āha -
nāsikārandhrayor aṣṭau ṣaṭ catvāraś ca bindavaḥ || 8 ||

Āḍhamalla. nāsikārandhrayor iti | dvayor api nāsāpuṭayor nasyaṃ yojanīyam | aṣṭāv ityādi | mukhyamadhyāntyamātrayā iti | aṣṭau bindavaḥ mukhyamātrā | recanasya ṣaṭ bindavaḥ madhyamā | catvāraḥ antyā mātrā hīnamātrā iti | uktaṃ ca - ‘catvāro bindavaḥ ṣaṭ vā tathāṣṭau vā yathābalam | śirovirecane yojyā ūrdhvajatruvikāriṇām’ iti | bindulakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe -
‘pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayān magnasamuddhṛtāt |
yāvat pataty asau bindur daśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te || marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrās tā eva ca kramāt | bindudvayonāḥ kalkādeḥ’ iti || 8 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virecanasya pramāṇam āha - nāsikārandhrayoḥ chidrayoḥ dvayoḥ aṣṭau ṣaṭ catvāraś ca bindavaḥ mukhyamadhyāntyātmamātrayā recane yojyāḥ | aṣṭau bindavaḥ mukhyā mātrā | ṣaṭ madhyā mātrā | catvāro bindavaḥ antyā kaniṣṭhā mātrā || 8 ||

nasyārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇam āha -
nasyakarmaṇi dātavyaṃ śāṇaikaṃ tīkṣṇam auṣadham || 9 ||

lg.l: hiṅgu syād yavamātraṃ tu māṣaikaṃ saindhavaṃ matam |
kṣīraṃ caivāṣṭaśāṇaṃ syāt pānīyaṃ ca trikārṣikam ||10||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. tīkṣṇam iti | maricapippalīhiṃguśṛṅgavera-śobhāñjanatṛvṛtādikam | madhuraṃ dravyaṃ sitāprabhṛtikam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||9|| 10||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nasyakarmaṇi auṣadhapramāṇam āha - nasyakarmaṇīti spaṣṭam || 9 || 10 ||

ab.seg:
atha śirovirecanabhedān āha -
bhavapīḍapradhamanau dvau bhedāv aparau smṛtau || 11 ||
Āḍhamalla. atha śirovirecanasya yau dvau avapīḍapradhamanasaṃjñau tāv āha - yathāyathaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathāmātraṃ vā deyau | tayor vidhānaṃ cāgre vakṣyamāṇaṃ jñeyam || 11 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. virecanasya dvau bhedāv aparāv apy āha - avapīḍaḥ, pradhamanam, etau dvau virecanasya bhedau tau śirovirecanasthāne deyau || 11 ||

athāvapīḍapradhamanayoḥ svarūpam āha -
kalkīkṛtād auṣadhād yaḥ pīḍito niḥsṛto rasaḥ || 12||

lg.l: ṣaḍaṅgulā dvivaktrā yā nāḍī cūrṇaṃ tathā dhamet ||13||
tīkṣṇaṃ kolamitaṃ vakravātaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hi tat |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kalkīkṛtād auṣadhād yaḥ raso niḥsṛtaḥ so 'vapīḍaḥ, kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? pīḍitaḥ āturanāsāpuṭe iti śeṣaḥ | pradhamanaṃ tat, yat dvivakrā nāḍī ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇā tayā cūrṇaṃ pradhamet | kiṃbhūtam ? tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇadravyakṛtam | kolaṃ kolamātram | vakravātair iti vaidyamukhotthaiḥ kṛtvā pradhamed ity arthaḥ || 12 || 13 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. avapīḍalakṣaṇam āha - kalkīkṛtād iti sugamam || 12 || 13 ||

Āḍhamalla. ūrdhvajatrugate virecanaṃ hitam iti | te ca grīvāgalādirogā dṛḍhabale 'pi - ‘stambhāntāḥ suptirudrādyāḥ śleṣmikā ye śirogadāḥ | śirovirecanaṃ teṣu nasyakarma praśasyate’ iti | kapharoge iti | kāsaśvāsādyāḥ | pratiśyāye nāsāsrāve pīnase purāṇe iti ratnaprabhākāraḥ | cakradatte 'pi -
‘śirovirecanaṃ dadyāt rogeṣv eteṣu buddhimān |
gaurave śirasaḥ śūle jāḍye spande galāmaye || śophagaṇḍakṛmigranthikuṣṭhāpasmārapīnase’ iti | anyatrā'py uktaṃ - ‘śirovirecanam api śleṣmaṇā'bhivyāptatālugalaśirasāṃ tathā'rocakaśirogauravaśūlapīnasārdhāvabhedakakṛmipratiśyāyā-pasmārāghrāṇājñāneṣu cordhvajatrugadeṣu śirovirecanadravyasiddhena snehena’ iti || 14 || 15 ||

atha bṛṃhaṇanasyaviṣayam āha -
bhīrustrīkṛśabālānāṃ nasyaṃ snehena śasyate |

Āḍhamalla. snehena nasyam iti | bṛṃhaṇākhyam | yadā recananasyadāne pratipāditarogair abhibhūtānāṃ bhīruprabhṛtīnāṃ recanaṃ dātavyaṃ tadā snehakṛtaśirovirecanaṃ deyam ity api dvitīyo 'rthaḥ sāmpradāyikaḥ ||

ab.seg:
yeṣu avapīḍanaṃ yujyate tān āha -
galaroge sannipāte nidrāyāṃ viṣamajvare || 16 ||
Āḍhamalla. avapīḍananasyasya viṣayam āha - manovikāre iti | madamūrcchā'pasmārasaṃnyāsonmādabhūtonmādādiṣu | kṛmiśabdenātra kṛmijā rogā api grāhyāḥ ||16||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sugamam || 16 ||

yeṣu pradhamanaṃ yujyate tān āha --
atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu visaṃjñeṣu ca dīyate || 17 ||

lg.l: cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ dhīrais tad dhi tīkṣṇataraṃ yataḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. pradhamananasyaviṣayam āha - atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu cetovikāraviṣābhipanneṣv ity arthaḥ | evaṃvidheṣv anyeṣv api visaṃjñeṣu madāpasmārādiṣu | yatas tīkṣṇataram atyantatīkṣṇadravyakṛtaṃ | dhīrair iti vaidyaiḥ | dhīratvaṃ dṛḍhaśāstrābhyāsakarmatvena jñeyam | tīkṣṇadravyato yathā -- ’pippalyaḥ śigrubījāni viḍaṅgamaricāni ca | avapīḍaḥ praśasto 'yaṃ garacetovikāriṇām’ iti || 17 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu mūrcchāpasmārādivisaṃjñeṣu saṃnyāsādiṣu || 17 ||

div.ab:
idānīm avapīḍanapradhamanayoḥ katipayayogān āha - guḍādinasyam |
nasyaṃ syād guḍaśuṇṭhībhyāṃ -
Āḍhamalla. guḍaśuṇṭhībhyām eko yogaḥ |

ab.seg:
pippalyādinasyam |
pippalyāḥ saindhavena vā || 18 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. pippalīsaindhavābhyāṃ dvitīyaḥ | tena nasyenākṣikarṇanāsāśirogadāḥ naśyanti | gadaśabdo 'tra pratyekam abhisambadhyate | tathā manyāhanugalodbhūtā rogā iti śeṣaḥ | bhujapṛṣṭhajā iti | bhujajāś ca bāhukāsaśoṣādayaḥ, pṛṣṭhajāḥ kubjabahirāmādayaḥ | kecid virecanabhedam eva yogadvayam icchanti tadbhedād avapīḍapradhamanayor uktatvāt || 18 || 19 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atitīkṣṇataraṃ virecanam āha - nasyam iti sugamam || 18 || 19 ||

ab.seg:
madhūkasārādinasyam -
madhūkasārakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vacāmaricasaindhavaiḥ |
nasyaṃ koṣṇajale piṣṭaṃ dadyāt saṃjñāprabodhanam ||20||

Āḍhamalla. madhūkasārakṛṣṇābhyām eko yogaḥ | madhūko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, tasya sāraṃ madhyasthitakāṣṭhaviśeṣam | vacāmaricasaindhavaiḥ kṛtvā paraḥ sakaladravyakṛto vā eka eva yogo vyavahārāt | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 20 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. madhūkasāraḥ guḍapuṣpaḥ || 20 ||

tandrāyāṃ saindhavādinasyam -
saindhavaṃ śvetamaricaṃ sarṣapāḥ kuṣṭham eva ca || 21 ||
Āḍhamalla. tandrāyāṃ nasyam āha - śvetamaricam atra śigrubījaṃ tatsaṃjñatvāt | bastaḥ chāgaḥ | piṣṭānīti pūrvoktadravyāṇi iti śeṣaḥ | teṣāṃ tandrānivāraṇaṃ bhavati ||21 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tandrāyāṃ nasyam - śvetamaricaṃ prasiddham, yad vā śigrubījam | bastamūtreṇa || 21 ||

maricādinasyam -
rohitamatsyapittena bhāvitaṃ saindhavaṃ vacā || 22 ||

lg.l: maricaṃ pippalī śuṇṭhī kaṅkolaṃ laśunaṃ puram |
kaṭphalaṃ ceti tac cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ pradhamanaṃ budhaiḥ || 23 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. pradhamanam āha - kaṭphalaṃ vacā ca samatvena pūrvaṃ maricacūrṇaṃ kṛtvā paścād rohitamatsyapittena bhāvanā deyā, paścāc cūrṇaṃ kāryaṃ tac cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ deyam | budhair ity anena paribhāṣoktarītyā pracārayed ity abhiprāyaḥ || 22 || 23 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pradhamananasyam āha - kaṅkolaṃ, maricaṃ, puro gugguluḥ, kaṭphalam etat pradhamanacūrṇaṃ tandrādau deyam iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||22|| 23||

ab.seg:
iti virecananasyakalpanā | atha bṛṃhaṇanasyakalpanām āha –
atha bṛṃhaṇanasyasya kalpanā kathyate 'dhunā |
marśaś ca pratimarśaś ca dvau bhedau snehanī matau || 24 ||

lg.l: marśasya tarpaṇī mātrā mukhyā śāṇaiḥ smṛtā'ṣṭabhiḥ |
madhyamā ca catuḥśāṇair hīnā śāṇamitā smṛtā ||25||
ekaikasmiṃs tu mātreyaṃ deyā nāsāpuṭe budhaiḥ |
ekāntaraṃ dvyantaraṃ vā nasyaṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tryahaṃ pañcāham athavā saptāhaṃ vā suyantritam || 27 ||
marśe śirovireke ca vyāpado vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ |
doṣotkleśāt kṣayāc caiva vijñeyās tā yathākramam ||28||
yujyate bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ snehair vā madhuradravaiḥ |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha virecananasyasya vidhānādikam abhidhāya saṃprati bṛṃhaṇanasyasya bhedaprabhṛtikaṃ darśayann āha - sugamam | tasya bhedān āha - marśaś ceti | snehane bṛṃhaṇākhye nasye dvau bhedāv iti | ekaḥ marśaḥ, dvitīyaḥ pratimarśaḥ | atha marśasya bhedamātrādikam āha - marśasya tarpaṇasnehasya yā mātrā sā aṣṭabhiḥ śāṇair mukhyā smṛtā | madhyamā caturbhiḥ śāṇair hīnā śāṇapramāṇā | cakradatte -
‘nasyasya snaihikasyātha deyās tv aṣṭau tu bindavaḥ |
pratyekaśo nastakayor nṛṇām iti viniścayaḥ || śuktiś ca pāṇiśuktiś ca deyā'tra kuśalair naraiḥ’ iti | binduparimāṇam uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -
‘pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayān magnasamuddhṛtāt |
yāvat pataty asau bindur daśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te |
marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrās tā eva ca kramāt | bindur dvayonāḥ kalpādeḥ’ iti | suśrute 'pi nasyapramāṇaṃ tu ‘aṣṭau bindavaḥ pradeśinīparvadvayaparisrāvo binduḥ, eṣātra prathamā mātrā, dvitīyātra śuktiḥ, tṛtīyā pāṇiśuktiḥ etās tisro mātrā yathābalaṃ prayojyā bhavanti’ iti | śuktiparimāṇaṃ tu ‘dvātriṃśad biṃdavaś cāpi śuktir ity abhidhīyate | dve śuktī pāṇiśuktiś ca deyā'tra kuśalair naraiḥ’ iti | snehanasyaṃ na gilet kiṃtu tyajed eva | tathā hi suśrutaḥ - ‘snehanasyaṃ na copagilet kathaṃcit’ iti | athaitat parimāṇam ekavāraṃ bahuvāraṃ vā deyam iti śaṅkāyāṃ samādhānam āha - ekaiketi | marśasya iyaṃ mātrā pūrvoktā ekaikasmin nāsāpuṭe deyā | etenaikavāraviṣayaṃ darśitam | yad uktaṃ - pratyekaśo nastakayor nṛṇām iti viniścayaḥ’ iti |‘vā’ athavā doṣabalābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvivāraṃ trivāraṃ vā saiva mātrā deyā iti || nasyadānakālamaryādām āha -- ekāntaram iti | vicakṣaṇo vaidyaḥ | ekāntaram ekadivasāntaraṃ vā prayojya saptāhaṃ yāvat paramadānena sātmībhavati | atrā'pi punaḥ punar iti śeṣaḥ | yad uktaṃ - ‘saptāhaṃ tu paraṃ deyaṃ miśritasya punaḥ punaḥ’ iti | vāgrahaṇena navamadivasād upari sātmyaṃ bhavati ity uktatvāt | tathā hi - ‘paraṃ navāham ūrdhvaṃ tu navāhāt sātmyatāṃ vrajet’ iti || marśe doṣotkleśād vyāpado bhavanti ity ata āha - marśe iti | atha tayoś cikitsām āha - doṣotkleśa iti | vamanaśodhanam iti śirovirecanādirūpaṃ nasyam | yathāsvam iti yathādoṣaṃ | bṛṃhaṇam iti snaihikaṃ nasyaṃ | bṛṃhaṇanasya viṣayam āha - śira iti | śirorogādiṣu bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ yujyate || 24-31 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha bṛṃhaṇanasya kalpanā - atheti sugamam | snehavyāpat cikitsām āha - marśe śirovireke iti | vividhā vyāpādas tadrogāḥ smṛtāḥ | taddoṣotkleśakṣayāt dhātukṣayāt jñeyāḥ | doṣotkleśeṣu kiṃ kartavyaṃ ? tad āha yuñjyād vamanaśodhanam iti yeṣu bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ dīyate tān āha - manyā grīvā, aṃsaḥ skandhaḥ, tadgade | snehair ghṛtādyair madhuraiḥ bṛṃhaṇaṃ yojyam || 24-31 ||

kuṅkumanasyam|
saśarkaraṃ paya:piṣṭaṃ bhṛṣṭam ājyena kuṅkumam || 32 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. kuṃkumanasyam āha - śarkarā sitopalā, kuṃkumaṃ keśaraṃ kāśmīrajam | ājyena ghṛtena kṛtvā ghṛtena bharjayitvā saśarkaram iti samānaśarkaram | tadanu kṣīreṇa piṣṭvā nasyaṃ deyam | tad ghṛtaṃ nasyaprayogataḥ bhrūśaḍkhādirujaḥ hanyāt iti || 32 || 33 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sa yathā - saśarkaraṃ sitāsahitaṃ payaḥ dugdham, ājyena ghṛtena kuṅkumaṃ keśaraṃ piṣṭvā tan nasyaprayogataḥ vātaraktādirujaḥ hanyāt || 32 || 33 ||

ab.seg:
anyabṛṃhaṇanasyam āha -
nasyaṃ syād aṇutailena tathā nārāyaṇena vā |
māṣādinā vā sarpirbhis tattadbheṣajasādhitaiḥ || 34 ||

Āḍhamalla. athā'parāṇi bṛṃhaṇanasyādīny āha - aṇutaileneti | aṇutailena nasyaṃ vātaraktabhavā rujo hanyād ity atra saṃbandhaḥ | ‘gavāṃ śakṛt kvāthavipakvam uttamaṃ hitaṃ ca tailaṃ timireṣu nasyataḥ | ghṛtaṃ tathā kevalam eva paittike tathāṇutailaṃ pavanāsṛgucchayo’riti | aṇutailaṃ tu vātavyādhicitsoktam anyatra jñātavyaṃ | keṣāṃcit jñāpanārthaṃ yathā ‘tilapīḍanopakaraṇakāṣṭhāny āhṛtyānalpakālatailaparipītā-nyaṇūni kāṇḍaśaḥ parikalpyātikuṭya ca mahākaṭāhe pānīyenāsrāvya kvāthayet | tataḥ snehamastudṛṣatsarakapāṇyor anyatareṇādāya vātaghnauṣadhapratīvāpaṃ snehapākakalkena vipacet |vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘jīvantī-jala-devarārujalada-tvak-sevyagopīhimam | dārvītvak-madhuka-plavā-guruvarī puṇḍrāhva- bilvotpalam|| dhāvanyau surabhiḥ sthire kṛmiharaṃ patraṃ truṭiṃ śeṇukam | kiñjalkaṃ kamalādbalāṃ śataguṇe divye'mbhasi kvāthayet || tailādrasaṃ daśaguṇaṃ pariśoṣya tena tailaṃ pacet salilakena daśaiva vārān | pāke kṣipecca daśame samabhāgadugdhaṃ vaidyā mahāguṇamuśantyaṇutailametat’ iti varṇitam | etad aṇutailam upadiśanti vātarogeṣv iti’ | nārāyaṇena taileneti śeṣaḥ | māṣādineti | atrā'pi tailena sambandhaḥ | nārāyaṇatailaṃ māṣatailaṃ ca vātavyādhicikitsoktaṃ jñātavyaṃ tattadbheṣajasādhitaiḥ sarpirbhir iti | yāni yāni dravyāṇi vātaraktahṛnnābhicakṣuḥśiraḥkarṇarogāṇāṃ vihitāni tais tair dravyai- reva sādhitāni sarpīṃṣi tatra tatra yojyānīty abhiprāyaḥ || 34 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyad apy āha - aṇutailena atasītailena | sarpirbhir ghṛtaiḥ tadroganāśakair auṣadhaiḥ sādhitaṃ tasya bṛṃhaṇaṃ syāt || 34 ||

lg.l: tailaṃ kaphe syād vāte ca kevale pavane vasām |
dadyān nasyaṃ sadā pitte sarpir majjānam eva ca || 35 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha catuḥsnehasya doṣaviśeṣeṇopādeyatvam āha - tailaṃ kaphe syād vāte ceti | atra savāte iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, kevale vāte svatantre atrāṇutailam eva pradhānaṃ | yad uktaṃ ‘caturvidhas tu snehasya vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | śleṣmasthānavirodhitvāt teṣu tailaṃ viśiṣyata’ iti || 35 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rogabhedena tailādīnāṃ nasyabhedam āha - tailamati | sugamam || 35 ||

māṣādinasyam |
māṣā'tmaguptārāsnābhirbalārubukarohiṣaiḥ |
kṛto 'śvagandhayā kvātho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ || 36 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athāparam api yogam āha - ātmaguptā kapikacchū: rāsnā surabhī balā sāmaśabdavācyā rubuka eraṇḍaḥ | rohiṣo gandhatṛṇaḥ aśvagandhayā saha militvā kvāthaḥ hiṅgusaindhavayoḥ prakṣepaḥ | tadvyavahārato hiṅgu raktikādvayaṃ saindhavaṃ māṣaikaṃ prakṣepaḥ | jayed arditavātaṃ ceti cakāragrahaṇāt karṇanādarujāyāṃ praśasta iti prasiddhiḥ | yad uktaṃ - ‘māṣabalāśūkaśimbīkattṛṇarāsnorubūkāśvagandhānāṃ | kvātho nasyanipīto rāmaṭhalavaṇānvitaḥ koṣṇaḥ | apaharati pakṣāghātaṃ manyāstambhaṃ sakarṇarujam | durjayam arditavātaṃ saptāhāj jayati cāvaśya’miti | iti marśavidhiḥ || 36 || 37 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pakṣavātārditādau nasyam - māṣo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, ātmaguptā kapikacchūḥ, balā prasiddhā, rubukaḥ eraṇḍaḥ, rohiṣaḥ kattṛṇaḥ, aśvagandhā hayagandhā koṣṇaḥ kkātha: sakampanaṃ kampavātaṃ hanyāt || 36 || 37 ||

ab.seg:
atha pratimarśam āha -
pratimarśasya mātrā tu dvidvibindumitā matā |
pratyekaśo nastakayoḥ sneheneti viniścitam || 38 ||

lg.l: snehe granthidvayaṃ yāvan nimagnā coddhṛtā tataḥ |
tarjanīyaṃ sraved binduṃ sā mātrā bindusaṃjñitā ||39||
sa deyo marśanasye tu pratimarśo dvibindukaḥ ||40||
nasye niṣiktaṃ taṃ vidyāt pratimarśaṃ pramāṇataḥ |
ucchindan na pibec caitan niṣṭhīven mukham āgatam || 44 ||
kṣīṇe tṛṣṇāsyaśoṣārte bāle vṛddhe ca yujyate |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. ‘pratyekaśo nastakayor upaiti vadanaṃ yathā | tathaitair vihitaḥ sneho naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyate’ iti pāṭhāntaram | etaiḥ padārthair virahitaḥ sneho yadā bhavati tadāntaḥ na prāpnoti iti bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kenāpy atra paṭhitaḥ || 38-45 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pratimarśam āha - pratimarśasya nasyamātrā dvitribindumitā kathitā | pratyekaśo nāsikayoḥ snehena ghṛtena | bindumātrām āha - evaṃvidhair bindusaṃjñair aṣṭabhiḥ śāṇa ucyate | sneheti sugamaṃ | pratimarśanasyasamayam āha - eṣu caturdaśasamayeṣu pratimarśe nasyaṃ prayujyate | dhamanasya niṣiktalakṣaṇam āha - īṣaducchikkanāt īṣat chikkanāt yadā snehaḥ vaktraṃ mukhaṃ prapadyate nasye niṣiktaṃ dattaṃ pratimāṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ tatas tadā taṃ ucchiṣṭaṃ vidyāt | tatra kiṃ kuryād ity āha - ucchiṣṭaṃ na pibet pratimarśam | anyeṣu keṣu yujyate tān apy āha - kṣīṇe dhātukṣīṇe tathā tṛṣṇā āsyaṃ mukhaṃ tacchoṣārte bāle tathā vṛddhe ca yujyate pratimarśena ete śāmyanti tathā ūrdhvatrujā grīvāmūlordhvajāḥ śāmyanti tathā valīpalito yujyate valī tvakśaithilye palitaṃ keśaśauklyaṃ tathā indriyajaṃ balaṃ bhavet || 38-45 ||

atha palite nasyam |
bibhītanimbakambhārī śivā śeluś ca kākinī ||46||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bibhītaṃ bibhītakamajjānaṃ nimbaṃ nimbabījaṃ kambhārī prasiddhā, tasyā bījaṃ, śivā harītakī majjā, śeluḥ śākhoṭakamajjā, kākinī kikaībījam eṣām ekaikatailalasyena palitaṃ naśyati || 46 ||

atha nasyagrahaṇe nasyavidhim āha --
atha nasyavidhiṃ vakṣye nasyagrahaṇahetave || 47 ||

lg.l: śuktyā vā yatra yuktyā vā plotair vā nasyam ācaret |
na kupyen na prabhāṣeta nocchiden na haset tathā |
etair hi vihitaḥ sneho naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyate || 52 ||
śṛṅgāṭakam abhiplāvya sthāpayen na giled dravam || 53 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vātarajomukte deśe sthāne kṛtadantanigharṣaṇaṃ kṛtadantadhāvanaṃ, dhūmapānena viśuddhaṃ, tathā svinnabhālagalaṃ dhūmapānena | yad vā sveditabhālagalaṃ tathā uttānaśāyinaṃ naraṃ nasyena yojayet | plotaṃ plotakaṃ | spaṣṭam anyat | nasyaniṣikte kathaṃ niṣṭhīved ity āha - nocchiden na kiṃcit kṣodayet | etaiḥ kopādibhiḥ vihitaḥ kṛtaḥ nasyaḥ antarmadhye na prapadyate tataḥ kāsādayaś ca bhavantīty āha - pratiśyāyo nāsāsrāvaḥ | tataḥ koṣādeḥ śṛṅgāṭakādisthāpane śikṣitam āha - śṛṅgāṭakaṃ nāsāvaṃśaṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ āplāvya nasyaṃ draveṇāplutya na sthāpayet | dravaṃ na gilet, spaṣṭam anyat || 47-53 ||

div.ab:
atha nasyadhāraṇārthaṃ mātrāsaṃkhyām āha -
pañca sapta daśaiva syur mātrā nasyasya dhāraṇe |
Āḍhamalla. pañcasaptādisaṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ doṣādibalābalaviṣayam | mātrāpramāṇaṃ tu vāgbhaṭe -‘yāvat paryeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā tu sā smṛtā’ iti ||

ab.seg:
nasyadānānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyam ? ity ata āha -
upaviśyātha niṣṭhīven nāsāvaktragataṃ dravam || 54 ||

lg.l: nīte nasye manastāpaṃ rajaḥ krodhaṃ ca saṃtyajet ||55||
śayīta nidrāṃ tyaktvā ca prottāno vākśataṃ naraḥ |
tathā vairecanaś cānte dhūmo vā kavalo hitaḥ || 56 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athaśabda ānantarye | nasyānantaraṃ nāsādidravam upaviśya niṣṭhīvet | kābhyāṃ ? vāmadakṣiṇapārśvābhyāṃ | kathaṃ ? sammukhaṃ na hi niṣṭhīvet | tiryak niṣṭhīvanāt samyagdravanirgamo bhavati ity arthaḥ | niṣṭhīvanānantaraṃ kartavyam āha - nīte iti | krodhaṃ ceti | caśabdas tantrāntaroktagrahaṇārthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘rajodhūmamanastāpasnānakrodhādi varjayet’ iti | vākśataṃ gurvakṣaroccāraṇaśatamātram | vairecananasyānte iti śirovirecanasyottarakālaṃ, rajo dhūliḥ, dhūmo vā kavalo hitaḥ iti | dhūmaḥ snigdhādir agre vakṣyamāṇaḥ, kavalaḥ prāguktalakṣaṇaḥ hitaḥ pathyas tasmāt kartavya ity arthaḥ || 54-56 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. nasye nīte yat kartavyaṃ tad āha - rajo dhūli: | yathā dhūmapraveśo na bhavet | sa pītanasya uttānaḥ san vākśataṃ bhavet | virecananasyānte dhūmaḥ kavalaś ca hitaḥ deyaḥ || 54-56 ||

atha nasye kati lakṣaṇāni bhavanti ? ity āha -
nasye trīṇy upadiṣṭāni lakṣaṇāni prayogataḥ |
śuddhihīnātiyogāni viśeṣāc chāstracintakaiḥ ||57||
Āḍhamalla. prayogata iti nasyaprayogāt | śāstracintakaiḥ śāstraṃ vaidyakaśāstraṃ tasya cintakāḥ vicārakā iti || 57 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuddhyādibhedena nasye lakṣaṇam āha - nasye iti | spaṣṭam || 57 ||

nasyaśuddhilakṣaṇam āha -
lāghavaṃ manasaḥ śuddhiḥ srotasāṃ vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ |
cittendriyaprasādaś ca śirasaḥ śuddhilakṣaṇam || 58 ||

Āḍhamalla. lāghavam iti śarīrasya | śarīragrahaṇenaiva śirograhaṇe labdhe punaḥ śirograhaṇaṃ dehasyordhvamūlād api lāghavapratipādanārtham | manasaḥ śuddhiḥ manaso hlādakatvāt manasaḥ śuddhiḥ | tathā srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ srotāṃsi prāṇadhātumalāmbho 'nnavāhināṃ śuddhatā | tathā cittendriyaprasādaś ca manasaḥ indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ prasannatā | tathā vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ vyādhayo nasyasādhyā rogāḥ | tantrāntare tu - ‘prasannadṛṣṭir dṛḍhadantakeśaḥ śaśāṅkavakraḥ palitair vihīnaḥ | pikābhikaṇṭhaḥ kamalāsya gandho nasyopasevī bhavatīha martyaḥ’ iti | anyatrāpy uktam -
‘indriyāṇāṃ ca vaimalyaṃ kuryād āsyasugandhatām |
hanudantaśirogrīvātrikabāhūrasāṃ balam || valīpalitakhālityaṃ vyaṅgānām apy asaṃbhavam iti || 58 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śuddhim āha - lāghavaṃ śirasaḥ manasaḥ śuddhir mūrcchādyasrāvatvaṃ srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ, cittaprasādaś ca śirasaḥ śirorogādināśaḥ | prasannatvaṃ śirasaḥ śuddhiḥ idaṃ śuddhilakṣaṇam || 58 ||

atha hīnaśuddher lakṣaṇam āha -
kaṇḍūpadehau gurutā srotasāṃ kaphasaṃsravaḥ |
mūrdhni hīnaviśuddhes tu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam || 59 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha hīnaśuddher lakṣaṇāny āha - hīnaviśuddheḥ śirasi lakṣaṇaṃ | kiṃ tat | kaṇḍūpadehāv iti mukhanāsikādīnām upadehaḥ śleṣmaṇābhiliptam iva mukhaṃ bhavatīti | gurutā cātra śirasaḥ | srotasāṃ kaphādivahānāṃ kaphasaṃsrava iti pracuraśleṣmasaṃbhava iti tātparyārthaḥ || 59 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hīnaviśuddheḥ śirasi lakṣaṇam āha - upadeho liptatā, gurutā gurutvam, srotasāṃ nāsādīnām | kaphasaṃsrāvaḥ | hīnaśuddheḥ alpaśuddheḥ || 59 ||

atiśayaśuddhasya lakṣaṇam āha -
mastuluṅgāgamo vātavṛddhir indriyavibhramaḥ |
śūnyatā śirasaś cāpi mūrdhni gāḍhaṃ virecite ||60||

Āḍhamalla. ativirecitalakṣaṇam āha - mūrdhni śirasi | ativirecite sati mastuluṅgāgamādayo bhavanti | mastuluṅgaṃ mastiṣkam, vātavṛddhir ity atra vātaduṣṭir iti vā pāṭhaḥ | indriyavibhramaḥ indriyanāśaḥ, śirasaḥ śūnyatā mastakaśūnyatā | ‘śūnyatā manasaś cā'pi’ iti pāṭhāntaram || 60 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mastuluṅgāgamo mastikābhyantarāt luṅgo mātuluṅgaḥ tajjalasadṛśo niḥsāraḥ vātavṛddhiḥ, indriyavibhramaḥ, śirasaḥ śūnyatā, idaṃ gāḍhavirecitaśiraso lakṣaṇām ||60 ||

hīnātiśuddhau cikitsām āha -
hīnātiśuddhe śirasi kaphavātaghnam ācaret |
samyak viśuddhe śirasi sarpir nasye niṣecayet ||61||

Āḍhamalla. hīnātiśuddhe śirasi kaphavātaghnaṃ kramād ācared iti jñeyam | hīnaśuddhe śirasi kaphaghnam, atiśuddhe vātaghnaṃ, samyak śuddhe śirasi, nasyena samyak śuddhe sarpir yojayed ity arthaḥ || 61 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. hīnātiśuddhyādau kriyām āha - kaphavātaghnaṃ nasyam ācaret || 61 ||

atisnigdhalakṣaṇacikitsām āha -
kaphaprasekaḥ śiraso gurutendriyavibhramaḥ |
lakṣaṇaṃ tad atisnigdhe tatra rūkṣaṃ pradāpayet || 62 ||

Āḍhamalla. atisnigdhe etal lakṣaṇam | tat kim ? kaphaprasekādi kaphaprasekaḥ srāvaḥ, śirasaḥ gurutā śirojāḍyam, indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ vibhramaḥ | rūkṣam annaṃ pradāpayet | anabhiṣyandi srotasāṃ yallepakaraṃ na bhavati etam ācārikam ādiśet | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe -
‘uṣṇodakopacārī syād brahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ |
na vegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān || pravātapānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitiḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhasvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti || 62 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atisnigdhe lakṣaṇam āha - indriyavibhramaḥ bhrāntitvam ayathārthaśaktiḥ, atisnigdhe idaṃ lakṣaṇam | tatra rūkṣam avacārayet | nasye 'varukṣaṃ dāpayet | nasye bhojanācāram āha - anabhiṣyandi mahiṣīdadhyādi nasyācārikaṃ nasye ye śiṣṭā ācaranti tad ācaret || 62 ||

div.ab:
prakaraṇārtham upasaṃharati -
vamanaṃ recanaṃ nasyaṃ nirūhaś cānuvāsanam |
etāni pañca karmāṇi kathitāni munīśvaraiḥ ||63|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe nasyavidhi- rnāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
Āḍhamalla. tāni kāni vamanadīni || 63 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe nasyavidhir nāmā- ṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pañcakarmasaṃkhyām āha - recanaṃ virekaḥ, nirūhaṃ nirūhaṇabastiḥ | anuvāsanabastiḥ | nanu bastikarma ekavidhaṃ bhavati tat kathaṃ dvividham ? ucyate - anuvāsanasya nirūhasya ca pṛthakkaraṇāt || 63 || iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūrtha- dīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe nasya- varṇanīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha dhūmapānavidhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
navamo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha dhūmapānavidhiḥ | dhūmasaṃkhyā -
dhūmas tuanyatra trividhaḥ proktaḥ | tathāhi carake - ‘prāyogikaḥ snehikaḥ doṣavairecanika:’ iti | tatra prāyogike kāsaharaṃ, vairecanike vāmanīyamantarbhāvyam | vāgbhaṭe'pi snigdho madhyastīkṣṇaśceti | atrā'pi snigdhe śamanavraṇadhūpanabṛṃhaṇānāmantarbhāvaḥ | tīkṣṇe recanavāmayoriti virodhaparihāraḥ || ṣaḍvidhaḥ proktaḥ śamano bṛṃhaṇas tathā |
recanaḥ kāsahā caiva vāmano ghrāṇadhūpanaḥ || 1 ||

lg.l: śamanasya tu paryāyau madhya: prāyogikas tathā |
bṛṃhaṇasyāpi paryāyau snehiko mṛdur eva ca || 2 ||
recanasyāpi paryāyau śodhanas tīkṣṇa eva ca |

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ - yathā nasyena cordhvajatruroganāśas tathā dhūmenā'pi | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe -
‘ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu viśeṣān nasyam iṣyate |
jatrūrdhvaṃ kaphavātotthavikārāṇām ajanmane || ucchedāya ca vātānāṃ pibed dhūmaṃ sadātmavān’ iti | tena nasyādhyāyānantaraṃ dhūmapānādhyāyaḥ || atha evaṃ karmapariśeṣāt śuddhikaratvena nasyānte dhūmapānavidhir ārabhyate | tatra tāvat pūrvaṃ dhūmasaṃkhyām āha - ṣoḍhā dhūmapānaprakāraḥ | tatra śamana iti | duṣṭadoṣasyānirharaṇapūrvakaṃ śamanam | aduṣṭasyānudīraṇaṃ ca | vyādhiśamananena prastutavyādhiśamanam | aprastutavyādher anudīraṇaṃ | tad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe – ‘na śodhayati yad doṣān śamān nodīrayaty api śamīkaroti ca kruddhān tat saṃśamanam ucyata’ iti | doṣaśabdo 'tra doṣeṣu doṣakāryavyādhiṣv api vartate kārye kāraṇopacārāt | bṛṃhaṇa iti | bṛṃhaṇo balakaraḥ | dhātuvṛddhikara ity anye | tadāśrayatvād doṣo balaṃ recana iti | śiro virecayatīti recanaḥ | kāsaheti kāsanivāraṇāya yo dīyate sa kāsahā kathitaḥ | vāmana iti | vāmayatīti vāmanaḥ | atha ghrāṇadhūpana iti | nāsikayā pīto dhūmo ghrāṇadhūpanasaṃjñaḥ | eke ghrāṇadhūpanasthāne vraṇadhūpana iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | etat saṃgatam | atha teṣāṃ keṣāṃcit saṃjñāntarāṇi darśayann āha - ekārthavācakāḥ śabdāḥ parasparaṃ paryāyā ucyante | prayogaḥ svasthasya satatopayogaḥ | tatra sādhuprāyogikāḥ snehā yatra bhavantīti snehikaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tasya ṣaḍvidhatvam āha - śamanādibhedena ṣaḍvidho dhūma: proktaḥ kathitaḥ | śamanabṛṃhaṇarecanaparyāyān āha - śamano doṣaśamanas tasya paryāyau dvau ekaḥ madhyaḥ madhyanāmā aparaḥ prāyogikaḥ prāyogikanāmā | bṛṃhaṇasya dvau paryāyau ekaḥ snehanaḥ eko mṛdu: | recanasyā'pi dvau paryāyau ekaḥ śodhanaḥ aparas tīkṣṇaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg:
yeṣāṃ dhūmo na vihitas tān āha -
adhūmārhāś ca khalv ete śrānto bhītaś ca duḥkhitaḥ ||3||

lg.l: dattabastir viriktaś ca rātrau jāgaritas tathā |
bhuktānnadadhimatsyaś ca bālo vṛddhaḥ kṛśas tathā || 6 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ ye dhūmapāneṣu nārhās tān āha - adhū mārhāś ca khalv ete iti | ete vakṣyamāṇāḥ śrāntādayaḥ te tu na dhūmayogyā ityādi | śrānto bhārādinā | bhīto bhayayuktaḥ | duḥkhito ghanabandhanādinā | dattabastir iti kṛtabastiḥ | bastigrahaṇenānuvāsanāsthāpananirūhabastayo gṛhyante | virikta iti viśeṣeṇa recitaḥ | rātrau jāgarita iti | rātrijāgaraṇena vātavṛddhiḥ syāt | śiro 'bhitāpo śirorogapīḍitaḥ | timirīti mandadṛṣṭiḥ | chardyādhmānaprapīḍita iti | chardipīḍitaḥ, ādhmānapīḍitaś ca, ādhmāna udarāpūraḥ | kṣatoraska iti uraḥkṣatī | pramehārta iti pramehapīḍitaḥ | rūkṣo vātaprakṛtyā | athavā rūkṣā'hāreṇa janitavāyunā pīḍitaḥ | kṣīṇa iti kṣīṇadhātuḥ | abhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudraghṛtāsava iti | abhyavahṛtaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhakṣitaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ yena sa tathā | tatra kṣaudraṃ madhu ete dhūmapānaviṣaye na yogyā ity abhiprāyaḥ | tatheti grahaṇāt īdṛśā anye 'pitantrāntaroktā viṣāśīraktapittīprabhṛtaya:| boddhavyāḥ || 3-6 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ekānte śrāntādayaḥ adhūmārhā dhūmayogyāḥ na | śrāntaḥ śramayukta:, bhīrur bhayayukta:, duḥkhitaḥ duḥkhārtaḥ, kenacit duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ dhananāśādibhiḥ | kṣatoraska iti | yasya abhyavahṛtaṃ bhakṣitaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣaudram āsavo madyaṃ yena saḥ abhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudrāsavaḥ pumān | tathā bhuktānnadadhimatsya: bhuktam annaṃ dadhi matsyāś ca yena saḥ bālaḥ vṛddhaḥ tathā kṛśo durbalaḥ || 3-6 ||

akāle dhūmapāne doṣaṃ tatpratīkāraṃ cāha -
akāle cātipītaś ca dhūmaḥ kuryād upadravāntaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘raktapittāndhyabādhiryatṛṇmūrcchāmadamehakṛt’ iti | |
tatreṣṭaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ nāvanāñjanatarpaṇam || 7 ||

lg.l: sarpir ikṣurasaṃ drākṣāṃ payo vā śarkarāmbu vā |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha yogyapītasya dhūmapānasya doṣam āha - akāla iti | asya kālo virecanokto boddhavyaḥ | atipīta iti | vihitaparimāṇādibhyo 'nyathā pītaḥ svamānād bahupīto vā | nāsādeyas tathā dhūmo yāvatā vartyavasāda ityādi | upadravān atra dhūmopahitajanitān | te tu tṛṣṇādāhajvarakṣavathusadanāghrāṇarogādhmānādayaḥ | tatpratīkāram āha - tatreti | dhūmapānātiśayajanitopadraveṣu | iṣṭaṃ vihitaṃ grāhyam ity arthaḥ | nāsāgatadoṣadūrīkaraṇāt | yato ghreyam apy atra vetti vety upadravatvāt| añjanam apy atra tadvihitam eva | yataḥ | rogopadravaḥ pītalohitatīkṣṇais tannirvarṇatvāt | tarpaṇaṃ santarpaṇaṃ | tṛṣṇādāhajvaropadravatvāt | yata: tṛṣṇādāhajvarādīnāṃ sparśadoṣeṇa sīdatīti | kriyāsu asamartho bhavatīty arthaḥ | ata eva tarpaṇam iti | aparāṇy āha - sārpir ikṣurasam ity eko yogaḥ | drākṣāṃ payo veti dvitīyaḥ | śarkarāmbu veti tṛtīyaḥ | madhurāmlau rasau vāpīti caturthaḥ | vamanāya pradāpayed iti vamanaprābalyam | tantrāntaroktaṃ yathā ‘vamanāt koṣṭhaśuddhiḥ syād dhūmagandhaś ca naśyati | vidhinā'nena śāmyanti sadanaṃ kṣavathujvarāḥ’ ityādi || 7 || 8 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tathā akāle asamaye pīto dhūmaḥ upadravān kuryāt | tatra dhūmopadrave kiṃ vihitaṃ, tatrāha - tatra dhūmopadrave sarpiṣaḥ pānam iṣṭam ucitaṃ nāvanaṃ nasyaṃ tathāñjanatarpaṇaṃ gaṇḍādikaṃ sarpir ghṛtapānam ikṣurasaṃ pauṇḍrakādīnāṃ rasaṃ drākṣā gostanī payo dugdhaṃ gavyaṃ vā, śarkarāmbu vā sitodakaṃ vā, madhurāmlau rasau vā, śamanāya dāpayet, sarpiṣaḥ punaruktir viśeṣaghṛtaprayogārtham | drākṣādimadhudravye gṛhīte 'pi punarmadhuragrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣayogārtham || 7 || 8 ||

ab.seg:
dhūmaḥ kadā gṛhyate ko vā guṇa ity āha -
dhūmas tu dvādaśād varṣād gṛhyate 'śītikān na ca |
kāsaśvāsapratiśyāyān manyāhanuśirorujaḥ || 9 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha dhūmasya vayobhedenopādeyatvam anupādeyatvam āha - dvādaśavarṣād upari arthād bālyāvasthāyāḥ dhūmapāno yojyaḥ | yāvad aśītivarṣāṇi bhavanti upari gṛhyate | aśītivarṣād upari dhūmapāno na vihita ity abhiprāyaḥ | etadviṣayaṃ prāyogikadhūmapāne svasthopayogitvena darśitam | yato 'nyatra sarvair nibandhakārair apaṭhitatvāt | atha samyag yojitasya dhūmapānasya guṇam āha - dhūmaprayogāt iti | samyak pītaḥ | atha dhūmayogena phalam āha | indriyāṇi buddhīndriyāṇi | teṣāṃ prasannatā tadviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyam ity arthaḥ | vākvacanaprāgalbhyaṃ manaḥ indriyatvenobhayātmakatvāt punargrahaṇam | dṛḍhakeśadvijaśmaśrur iti | keśāḥ śiroruhāḥ śmaśru nāsādhogatauṣṭhoparilomaviśeṣaḥ | dvijā dantāḥ | sugandhivadano bhaved ity asya sthāne sugandhiviśadānana iti kecit paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 9 || 10 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dhūmo dvādaśād varṣāt gṛhyate aśītikād varṣān na gṛhyate tathā suyojito dhūmaḥ kāsādīn hanyāt | dhūmopayogāt kīdṛśaḥ puruṣo bhaved ity āha - dṛḍhāḥ keśā dvijā dantāḥ śmaśruḥ mukhakeśāś ca yasya saḥ || 9 || 10 ||

ab.seg:
yayā nāḍyā dhūmo gṛhyate tadvidhānam āha -
dhūmanāḍī bhavet tatra trikhaṇḍā ca triparvikā || 11 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ dhūmapānārthaṃ netrasvarūpam āha - tatreti | dhūmapānaviṣaye dhūmanāḍī dhūmapānārthaṃ nāḍī netrābhidhānā | kathaṃbhūtā trikhaṇḍā | ata eva triparvikā kathitā | trigranthiyutetyādi | kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhety anena gopucchākārā kāryā | gopucchākāratvaṃ ca trikhaṇḍānām iti bhāvaḥ | antare suṣiraṃ tu rājamāṣavad vartulānurūpaṃ kāryam ity aryaḥ | eke antaranāḍikāyāḥ prānte rājamāṣasadṛśaṃ randhraṃ vadanti | mūlamukhaṃ tu rājamāṣāt kiṃcid adhikaṃ bhavati | kaniṣṭhikāpariṇāhākāratvāt | atha nāḍīsvarūpam abhidhāya saṃprati śamanādīnām aṅgulabhedena nāḍīvibhedam āha | daśāṅgulair vāmanīyaḥ etat pañcaprakāraṃ mukhyapānatvena nāḍīviṣayatvād vihitam | ṣoḍhā saṃjñakam avaśiṣṭaṃ yat ghrāṇadhūpanam | tasya nāḍīsvarūpaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | ata eva nāḍībhedenaiva pañcaprakāraṃ pūrvam uktaṃ tad yathā - dhūmanāḍī | śamaneti śamanākhyadhūmapānayogyety arthaḥ | kathaṃbhūtā | āturasya catvāriṃśadaṅgulair dīrghā | nanu tantrāntare aṣṭacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ parimitā nāḍī prāyogikābhidhāne śamanadhūmapāne praśastā tathā ca ‘elādinā kuṣṭhanatoddhṛtena kṣaumaṃ vilipyāṅgulakāṣṭhamānam | prāyogike vartir iyaṃ tu netram aṣṭhāṅgulaṃ ṣaḍguṇitaṃ praśastam’ iti suśrutenoktam | apare tu ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ prāyogike netram āhuḥ | tad uktaṃ ‘sārddhaṃ tryaṃśayutaḥ pūrṇo hastaḥ prāyogikādiṣu’ iti | tat katham atra catvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ parimitaṃ netram ? ucyate | samalasya tu madhyaḥ | prāyogikasya tu dvau bhedau darśitau | tadbhedatvena nāḍībhedam api jānīyān na doṣaḥ | athavā śleṣmaprakṛtau baddhadoṣe ca nare ṣaḍviṃśadaṅgulā mātrā | anyatra tv aṣṭacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaṃ tena virodhaḥ | svamate tv ācāryeṇa viśeṣaṃ vicārya sāmapratipālanārthaṃ madhyabhāvaṃ netraparimāṇaṃ likhitam ity adoṣaḥ | evaṃ vakṣyamāṇaparimāṇeṣu kutracid virodheṣu boddhavyam | mṛdāv iti bṛṃhaṇākhye dhūmapāne dvātriṃśadaṅgulamitaṃ netraṃ bhavati | tīkṣṇa iti recanākhye dhūmapāne caturviṃśatyaṅgulamitaṃ netram atra | kāsaghne dhūmapāne ṣoḍaśāṅgulipramitaṃ | nāḍīviṣaye vāmanīye dhūmapāne daśāṅgulaṃ netram iti | pūrvam uktaṃ vraṇadhūpanārthaṃ nāḍīsvarūpam anyatrāha dhūmanimittam | īdṛśī nāḍikā netrākhyā bhavati | kādṛśī | kalāyamaṇḍalasthūleti | nāḍikā uttaramukhaṃ vraṇalagnārtham | kalāyasadṛśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ kalāyo vartulakalāyaḥ | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtā | kulatthāgamarandhraketi | kulattho 'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tadgamanaśīlo randhraḥ suṣiras tena saṃyuta ity arthaḥ | nāḍikārandhraṃ tu kulatthasadṛśaṃ kāryam iti bhāvaḥ || 11-14 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sāmānyato yā dhūmanāḍī bhavet sā trikhaṇḍā trīṇi khaṇḍāni dorakāni yasyāḥ sā, triparvikā trīṇi parvāṇi granthīr yasyāḥ sā triparvikā kaniṣṭhikāṅgulī | tatparimāṇam āha - sthūlā punaḥ rājamāṣāgamā antare madhye rājamāṣaḥ tadgamaṃ chidram antare bhavati | idānīṃ śamanādau dhūmanāḍīpramāṇam āha - śamane śamanadhūmapāne yā nāḍī nalikā sā rogiṇāṃ catvāriṃśadaṅgulair dīrghā matā | mṛdau mṛdudhūmapāne nāḍī sā dvātriṃśadaṅgulair dīrghā | tīkṣṇe tīkṣṇadhūmapāne caturviṃśair aṅgulair dīrghā | kāsaghne dhūmapāne yā nāḍikā sāpi daśāṅgulair eva dīrghā īdṛśī | sthūlamānam āha | kalāyo vartulakas tat maṇḍalavat sthūlā punā randhre yathā kulatthāgamanaṃ bhavet tadvat ||11-14 ||

idānīṃ dhūmapānārthaṃ īṣikāvidhānam āha -
atheṣikāṃ pralimpec ca suślakṣṇāṃ dvādaśāṅgulām |
dhūmadravyasya kalkena lepaś cāṣṭāṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15||

lg.l: kalkaṃ karṣamitaṃ liptvā chāyāśuṣkaṃ ca kārayet |
aṅgārair dīpitāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā netrasya randhrake |
nāsikābhyāṃ tataḥ pītvā mukhenaiva vamet sudhīḥ |
chidre netraṃ niveśyātha vraṇaṃ tenaiva dhūpayet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ vartividhānaṃ darśayitum āha - atha īṣikāṃ pralimped iti |cakradatte tu - ’oṣadhairvartikāṃ kṛtvā śaragarbhāntaśocitām’ iti śaragrahaṇaṃ, carake'pi -’piṣṭvā limpecchareṣīkāṃ vartiṃ yavajasannibhām’ iti dṛśyate | tasmādīṣikāṇāmalābhe jharakāṇḍena pibet || korthaḥ piṣṭair bheṣajaiḥ karpaṭāvayavaṃ pralikhya tena śarakāṇḍam aṅgulīsamam aṣṭāṅgulamānena veṣṭayitvā tataḥ pariśoṣya vartiḥ kāryā | avaśiṣṭaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ śarakāṇḍagrahaṇārtham uktam | snehakādiṣv api vartikaraṇam | īṣikā kāśam ucyate | ‘ṣāguri’ iti loke | atha kathaṃ vartiḥ prajvālya netre dhāryā tatprakāram āha | adalād iti | dalam atra patralepaṃ | īṣikāvartividhānaṃ ca prāyogike pradhānatamaṃ | ropaṇīyā vartir iyam | ṣaḍbhāgagodhūmena netram āvartyātmānaṃ praśasyata iti | kecit snehenābhyajyed agninā dagdhvā netre niveśya dhūmaḥ peyaḥ | yadā vadanena mukhena kṛtvā dhūmaṃ pibet tadā mukhenaiva tannirgamaṃ kuryāt | nasikābhyāṃ pītam api mukhenaivam eva vamed ity arthaḥ | nāsikābhyām iti dvivacanena nāsikārandhradvayena sambandhaḥ | tata ity anena mukhapītenetaram eva nāsikayā pītam ity arthaḥ | tathā hi ‘mukhena taṃ vamet pūrvaṃ nāsikāyāṃ punaḥ pibet’ iti | nanu tantrāntare nāsikāpītaṃ paścān mukhapītaṃ dhūmaṃ doṣakaraṃ bhavati tathā ca -
‘mukhapītaṃ mukhenaiva nastaḥ pītaṃ ca nastataḥ |
yo vamen nastato dhūmaṃ nastapītaṃ mukhena vā | sa netrakarṇanāsāsyasaṃśrayāt labhate gadān’ iti | tat katham atra nasikābhyāṃ tataḥ pītvā mukhenaiva vamet sudhīr iti grahaṇam | ucyate | sudhīr ity udīraṇenā'tra virodhaparihāraḥ kṛtaḥ | yato dhūmapānabhedena rogaviśeṣe 'pi kutracin mukhapītaṃ kutrāpi nāsikāpītaṃ vā | mukhanāsikāpītam iti | tathā coktaṃ -
‘uraḥkaṇṭhāśraye roge mukhenaiva piben naraḥ |
śiraḥkaṇṭhākṣināsauṣṭhe nāsayā satataṃ pibet |
tiryaktve tu mukhenaiva nāsayā na kathaṃcana | pragāḍhaṃ pānam icchanti dhūmasyāṃśena tadvida’ iti | kathaṃ pibed ity api darśanāt yathā tatra prāyogikaṃ trīṃsnīn ucchvāsān ādadyāt | prāṇena prīṇayet trīṃś caturo veti | ‘snehikaṃ mukhanāsābhyāṃ yāvad aśru pravartanam’ | nāsikābhyāṃ vairecanikam ādoṣadarśanāt | mukhenaiva kāsaharaṃ śvāsaśuddhir lāghavaṃ śirasi samaḥ evaṃ vicārya mukhapītaṃ mukhenaiva vamet | nāsāpītaṃ ca nāsikayaiva | ubhābhyāṃ pītaṃ mukhenaiva vamed ity adoṣaḥ | ata eva sudhīpadanirūpaṇam atra virodhaparihārāya boddhavyam | idānīṃ dhūmapānaviṣayatvena ghrāṇadhūpanam apy āha - kalkam atra nimbavacādīnāṃ vihitam | yataḥ ‘vraṇe nimbavacādīnāṃ dhūpanaṃ saṃpraśasyata’ iti | chidre iti śarāvasaṃpuṭarandhre | netram iti nāḍīviśeṣaḥ | sā dhūmapānārthe kathitaiva tadvad atrāpi jñeyam | vraṇadhūpanaṃ tu vedanāsrāvaśāntaye iti | athavā pūrvam uktaṃ śamanādidhūmabhedaṃ vihitam | athavā - ‘śarāvasaṃpuṭayutaṃ vraṇadhūmaṃ nayed vraṇe | dhūmanetreṇa matimān vedanāsrāvaśāntaye’ iti || 15-18 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. īṣikā śaratṛṇaviśeṣajanyā yā daśāṅgulānāṃ dhūmadravyakalkena limpet punaḥ śuṣke vartisnehoktaṃ kṛtvā īṣikām apanīya dūrīkṛtya netrasya nalikārandhre dhṛtvā dīpitāṃ kṛtvā vadanena dhūmaṃ pibet | vadanenaiva tyajet | tataḥ nāsikābhyām evaṃ kṛtvā vadanenaiva vamet | vraṇadhūmas tu dīpanakalkaśarāve dhṛtvā chidre netraṃ niveśya vraṇaṃ dhūmayet ayaṃ dhūmapānavidhiḥ ||15-18||

śamanadhūmādau yaddravyakalko dhūmārthaṃ deyas tad āha -
elādikalkaṃ śamane snigdhaṃ sarjarasaṃ mṛdau || 19 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha pūrvam uktaṃ śamanādidhūmabhedaṃ ṣaṭprakāraṃ tadarthaṃ katipayāni dravyāṇy āha - śamane prāyogike elādikalkaṃ dhūmapānārtham āhuḥ | elādigaṇam atra suśrutoktaṃ tad yathā -‘elātagarakuṣṭhamāṃsījaladhāmakāṃ tvakpatranāgapuṣpapriyaṅguhareṇukāvyāghrīnakhaśukticaṇḍāghauṇeyaka-śrīveṣṭakacorakabālakaguggulusarjaturuṣkapuṇḍarīkāgaruspṛkkośīrabhadradārukuṅkumāni purāṇakesaraṃ ce’ti | tatra prāyogikanimittatvena kuṣṭha: tayoḥ parityāgaḥ kāryaḥ mastiṣkasrāvabhayāt | yad uktaṃ ‘natakuṣṭhe snāvayato dhūmavartiprayojite | mastuluṅgaprabhāvena tasmāt taṃ na prayojayet’ iti | mṛdāv iti bṛṃhaṇākhye | snigdham ity eraṇḍādiphalamajjāprāyam | athavā snigdham ity anena samastadhūmavidhānaṃ sasnehaṃ kāryam iti pūrvoktatvāt | sārjarasam iti | sarjarasaprāyaṃ prāyogikam ity arthaḥ | tad uktaṃ -‘snigdhabhajjamadhūcchiṣṭasnehaguggulusarjakaiḥ | snehikā bastir ebhis tu netraṃ dvātriṃśadaṅgulam’ iti | recanatīkṣṇakalkam iti | recanam iti śodhanākhyadhūmapāne | tīkṣṇakalkam iti śirovirecanadravyakṛtavartir ity artha: | śirovirecanair vartir netraṃ hastamitam ity uktatvāt | śirovirecanair ity apāmārgabījādibhiḥ | hastamitam iti caturviśadaṅgulaṃ | kāsaghre kṣudrikoṣaṇam iti kāsaghne dhūmapāne | kṣudrikā kaṇṭakārikā | ūṣaṇam atra trikaṭukaṃ grāhyaṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | tad yathā bṛhattryūṣaṇaṃ bṛhatī śṛṅgī ceṅgudītvagmanaḥśilā | eṣā kāsaharā vartir netraṃ ṣoḍaśakāṃgulam’ iti | vāmane snāyucarmādyam iti | vāmane dhūmapāne | snāyucarmādyaṃ vartyai dadyād ity arthaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt asthikhuravallūram api gṛhyate | tad uktaṃ ‘vāmanīye tu ballūrasnāyvasthikhuravarmabhiḥ| vartir daśāṅgule netraṃ dhūmaḥ pañcavidho mata’ iti | vallūraṃ śuṣkamāṃsam iti | eke dhūmasya pānakam ity anena ghrāṇadhūpanasya vyākhyānaṃ kurvanti tatra dhūmasya ghrāṇadhūpanasya pānakam iti tadvihitadravyam ity arthaḥ | iti na sarvamataṃ | ‘dhūmaḥ pañcavidho mata’ ityādivacanāt || 19 || 20 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śamane elādikalkaṃ deyam | elādir elādigaṇaḥ tatrailādinā kuṣṭhavarjeneti suśrutaḥ | tathā elādigaṇo vāgbhaṭe - ‘elāyugmarukkuṣṭhaphalinīmāṃsījaladhyāmakaṃ, spṛkkācorakacocapatrasugurusthauleyajātīrasāḥ | śaktivyāghrinakhomarahvam agaruḥ śrīvāsakaḥ kuṅkumaṃ, caṇḍāgugguludevadhūparavapunnāganāgāhvayāḥ |
elādiko vātakaphau viṣaṃ ca viniyacchati |
varṇaprasādanaḥ kaṇḍūpiḍakākoṣṭhanāśanaḥ’ | eṣā vartiḥ prāyogike prāyogikaṃ tu tri:triśvāsenādadīta viśeṣatas tu prāyogikaṃ ghrāṇenādadīta mṛdau snigdhaṃ sarjarasaṃ snehaphalāsāradhūmocchiṣṭasarjarasagugguluprabhṛtibhiḥ srehamiśraiḥ sneheneti suśrutaḥ | kāsaghne kṣudrikoṣaṇaṃ kṣudrā kaṇṭakārī vyoṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā trikaṭukāsamardaka iṅgudītvagmanaḥśilā chinnaruhā karkaṭaśṛṅgīprabhṛtibhiḥ kāsaharaiś ca kāsaghnair vāmanaiḥ snāyucarmādyaṃ dadyāt | snāyucarmakhuraṃ śṛṅgakakarāsthiśuṣkamatsyavallūrakamiśraprabhṛtibhir vāmanīyaiḥ iti suśrutaḥ | snāyunāḍī suśrute ‘dhūmaḥ pañcavidho bhavatī’tyuktaṃ tad yathā prāyogikaḥ snehano virecanaḥ kāsaghno vāmanīyaś ceti śamanadhūmas tu bhinnaprayoktas tena śārṅgadhareṇa ṣaḍvidho likhitaḥ || 19 || 20 ||

ab.seg:
bālagrahādau dhūmapānam āha - aparājito dhūpaḥ
anye 'pi dhūmā geheṣu kartavyā rogaśāntaye ||21||

lg.l: maricaṃ hiṅgu māṃsī ca bījaṃ kārpāsasaṃbhavam ||22||
geheṣu dhūpanaṃ dattaṃ sarvān bālagrahāñ jayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athānye gṛhadhūmāḥ santi tān api prasaṅgato darśayann āha - ayam aparājitasaṃjño dhūpaḥ prasiddha eva | tatra bṛhatīphalaṃ kaṇṭakārikāphalaṃ | māṃsī jaṭākhyā | ahinirmokaṃ sarpakañculikaṃ | viṣṭhā baiḍālikī mārjārapurīṣam | nanu tantrāntare māheśvaradhūpasaṃjño 'yaṃ katham atrāparājitasaṃjñaḥ | ucyate - tatra māheśvarasaṃjñatvena rudranirmālyābhidhānatvād adoṣaḥ | tad uktaṃ - ‘rudrajaṭāgośṛṅgaviḍālaviṣṭhoragasya nirmokaḥ | madanaphalabhūtakeśīvaṃśatvag iti nirmālyam | yavamasūracandrakacchāgalaromāṇi sarṣapāḥ savacāḥ | hiṅgugajadvijamaricāḥ samabhāgā chāgamūtrasaṃpiṣṭāḥ | dhūpanavidhinā śamayanty ete sarvajvarān niyatam | grahaḍākinīpiśācapretavikārāpaho dhūpa’ iti bahudravyoktakalpanād vā na doṣaḥ || 21-24 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. mayūrapicchaṃ mayūrapakṣam | ahinirmokaṃ sarpakaṃcukam || 21-24 ||

dhūmapāne pathyaṃ, netradravyāṇy āha -
parihāras tu dhūmeṣu kāryo recananasyavat |
netrāṇi dhātujāny āhur nalavaṃśādijāny api || 25 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe dhūmapānavidhir nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha dhūmapānapariharaṃ netrārthaṃ dravyaṃ ca darśayann āha - dhūmeṣv iti | ṣaḍvidhadhūmapānaviṣayeṣu parihāras tyājyābhidhaḥ | sa ca virecananasyavat kāryaḥ | tat tathaiva jñātavyam | athavā parihāras tu dhūmeṣu kāryo recanavat tatheti pāṭhāntaram | yathā virecanokte sati pravātasevāmbusnehāsaṃgamajīrṇatām ityādikaṃ seveta tathā dhūmapānake sati tatra vātasevādiparityāga ity abhiprāyaḥ | netrāṇīti | dhūmapānārthaṃ nāḍīyantrāṇi tāny anuktatvād daśadhātujāni nalavaṃśādijāny api boddhavyāni | dhātavo 'tra suvarṇādyāḥ | ādigrahaṇād anyakāṣṭhadantaśṛṅgaghaṭitānīty arthaḥ || 25 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe dhūmapānādhyāyaḥ || iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadipikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dhūmapāna- nāmādhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha gaṇḍūṣavidhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha gaṇḍūṣakavalapratisāraṇavidhiḥ | ūrṣvagatadoṣaharatvasāmānyāt dhūmapānam abhidhāya saṃprati gaṇḍūṣaṃ kavalaṃ pratisāraṇavidhim ārabhyate ||
caturvidhaḥsuśrute - snehī, prasādī, saṃśodhanaropaṇāvityanyathā caturvidhatvamuktam | tathā tantrāntare vairecanasaṃśamanābhyāṃ ṣadvidhatvamuktaṃ tathāpyatra saṃśodhane vairecanasya prasādane śamanasyāntarbhāvānna virodhaḥ | syād gaṇḍūṣaḥ snaihikaḥ śamanas tathā |
śodhano ropaṇaś caiva kavalaś cāpi tadvidhaḥ || 1 ||

lg.l: snigdhais tu snaihiko vāte svāduśītaiḥ prasādanaḥ |
asaṃcārī mukhe pūrṇe gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaś caraḥ |
tatra draveṇa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kalkena kavalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 ||
dadyād draveṣu cūrṇaṃ ca gaṇḍūṣe kolamātrakam |
karṣapramāṇaḥ kalkaś ca dīyate kavale budhaiḥ || 5 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. kavalaś cāpi tadvidha ity anena kavalo 'pi snehakādicaturbhedair eva boddhavyaḥ | yathā catuḥprakāro gaṇḍūṣas tathaiva kavalaś catuḥprakāro bhavatīty abhiprāyaḥ | atha yac catuḥprakāraṃ tatprakāravidhānam āha - snigdhais tu snaihikam ity asya sthāne suśrute snigdhoṣṇaiḥ snaihike vāta iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | snaihike gaṇḍūṣakavalayor bhedaḥ kārya iti śeṣaḥ | svāduśītaḥ prasādanaḥ pitte praśastaḥ | svādur madhuraḥ śītasparśād vīryād vānnasādano gaṇḍūṣaparyāyaḥ | sa cātra śamanabhedo jñeyaḥ | kadvamlalavaṇair iti saṃśodhanam iti gaṇḍūṣakavalataraparyāyavācakābhidhānaṃ kaphe praśastam | kaiḥ kaṭvāmlādibhir iti | uṣṇair ity asya sthāne rūkṣair iti pāṭhāntaram | kaṣāyatiktamadhurair iti vraṇe mukhajanitapiḍakādirūpe | ropaṇo gaṇḍūṣasaṃjña: | kaṭvamla ity asya sthāne kaṭūṣṇa iti pāṭhaḥ pracarati | ebhiś catuḥprakāraiḥ kṛtvā gaṇḍūṣaḥ kathitaḥ | na kevalaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaś cāpīdṛśo 'vagantavyaḥ | asyānte kecid iti paṭhanti | ‘evaṃ snehaḥ payaḥkṣaudrarasamūtrāmlasaṃsmṛtaḥ | kaṣāyoṣṇodakābhyāṃ ca kavalā doṣato hitā’ iti | bahupustakeṣu na likhitaṃ | sarvoktenaiva kṛtārthatvāt | atha gaṇḍūṣakavalayor bhinnatvapratipādanārthaṃ vidhānam āha - pūrṇe mukhe saṃbhṛtamukhakuhare yo saṃcārī bhavati calanādirahitaḥ sa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kathitaḥ | tadviparītaḥ kavala iti | ata eva dravadravyeṇa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kalkena kavala ity arthaḥ | tathā coktaṃ cakradatte - ‘mukhaṃ saṃcāryate jānumātrā ca kavalena tu | asaṃcāryā tu yā mātrā gaṇḍūṣe sā prakīrtitā’ iti | ayam eva pāṭhaḥ suśrute | gaṇḍūṣakavalayordravyāṇāṃ parimāṇam āha -gaṇḍūṣe gaṇḍūṣakaraṇavidhau cūrṇe vā | gaṇḍūṣe komalamātrakaṃ karṣapramāṇakalkam akavale dīyate budhaiḥ | gaṇḍūṣe gaṇḍūṣakaraṇavidhau cūrṇaṃ vyādhivihitadravyakṛtaṃ rajaḥ komalamātram iti karṣārdham | draveṣu toyakṣīrādiprabhṛtiṣu saṃsrāvya dadyād ity arthaḥ | dravaparimāṇam uktaṃ yāvan mukhapūrṇaṃ bhavati tatparimāṇaṃ caikavāraṃ gaṇḍūṣānimittam | punaḥ punar arthaṃ ca bahutaradravaṃ saṃgṛhya tadanusāreṇa cūrṇam api saṃsrāvya deyam | evaṃ sarvaṃ prajñātavyam | tathā coktaṃ suśrute - ‘tāvac ca dhārayitavyo 'nanyamanasā saṃcārayitavyaś ca | yāvad doṣapratipūrṇagalakapolatvagnāsāsrotonayanapariplavaś ca bhavati| tadā vimoktavya: | punaś cānyo gṛhītavyam’ iti | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 1-5 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. caturvidhatvam āha - ekaḥ snehanaḥ dvitīyaḥ śamanaḥ tṛtīyaḥ śodhanaḥ caturtho ropaṇaḥ evaṃ caturvidhaḥ kavalaḥ | yair dravyair doṣepu snaihikādayo bhavanti tatprakāram āha - vāte snigdhoṣṇair dravyaiḥ snaihikaḥ svādur madhuras tathā śītaḥ pitte taiḥ prasādanaḥ praśamano bhavati | kaṭvamlalavaṇair dravyaiḥ uṣṇaiḥ kaphe saṃśodhanaḥ | vraṇe kīdṛśo deyas tad apy āha - kaṣāyatiktamadhurair dravyaiḥ kaṭūṣṇaḥ vraṇaropaṇa evaṃ caturvidhaś catuḥprakāro gaṇḍūṣaḥ kathitaḥ, kavalaś cāpi tatprakāras tadvidha eva, ato gaṇḍūṣakavalayor lakṣaṇam āha - tatra draveṇa pūrṇe mukhe asaṃcārī asaṃcaraṇaśīlo gaṇḍūṣaḥ kalkataś caraś calanaśīlaḥ kavalaḥ mukha eva | gaṇḍūṣakalkayor auṣadhapramāṇam āha - gaṇḍūṣadravyāt draveṣu cūrṇaṃ kolamātrakaṃ deyaṃ kalāṣṭakadvayānāṃ kavale dravyāt kalkaḥ karṣapramāṇaḥ | karṣaṣṭaṃkacatuṣṭayānām ||1-5||

kasmin vayasi gaṇḍūṣo dhāryate kiyatparimitā gaṇḍūṣāḥ kāryā ity āha -
dhāryante pañcamād varṣād gaṇḍūṣakavalādayaḥ |
gaṇḍūṣān susthitaḥ kuryāt svinnabhālagalādikaḥ ||6||

lg.l: manuṣyas trīṃs tathā pañca sapta vā doṣanāśanāt |
kaphapūrṇāsyatā yāvac chedo doṣasya vā bhavet || 7 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. atha kīdṛśo gaṇḍūṣakavalayogyas tam āha - pañcamād varṣād upari bālyāvasthāyām eva gaṇḍūṣakavalādayo dhāryante | ādigrahaṇāt pratisāraṇasyā'tra saṃgrahaḥ | pañcamavarṣagrahaṇaṃ tantrāntare 'pi darśitaṃ | tad yathā - ‘dhūmo dvādaśavarṣasya kavalaḥ pañcame hitaḥ’ iti | atha kiyatsaṃkhyābhir gaṇḍūṣaviṣayaḥ taṃ darśayann āha - gaṇḍūṣam antaḥsthitaṃ mukhamadhyasthitaṃ yasya sa tathā; punaḥ svinnā bhālagalādayo yasya sa tathā | bhālaḥ kapālaḥ, ādigrahaṇān nāsāsrotonayanādīnāṃ grahaṇam | īdṛśo rogī trivelaṃ pañcavāraṃ vā gaṇḍūṣaṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | athavā doṣanāśanān maryādīkṛtyety arthaḥ | kecin nibandhakārā ‘gaṇḍūṣān susthita’ ity amuṃ ślokaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ‘kaphapūrṇāsyatā’ iti yāvat ślokaṃ ca na paṭhanti | kṣepakāv iti manyamānatvāt | vakṣyamāṇo yathā
‘kaphapūrṇāsyatā yāvac chedo doṣasya vā bhavet |
netraghrāṇasrutir yāvat tāvad gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam’ | asmākaṃ mate tu yuktārthatvena saṃgatāv eva | bahupustakeṣu likhitadarśanāt || 6 || 7 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. gaḍūṣakavalādayaḥ pañcamād varṣād vayasaḥ | gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇapramāṇam āha - susthitaḥ manuṣyaḥ trīn tathā pañca sapta vā doṣanāśanāt gaṇḍūṣān kuryāt | susthitaḥ sukhena sthitaḥ, kiṃbhūtaḥ ? svinnabhālagalādikaḥ svinnaḥ prasvedayukto bhālo galādikaṃ ca yasya saḥ | anyad api gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇe pramāṇam āha - netraghrāṇasrutis trāvo vā yāvat tāvad eva gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam idaṃ vā pramāṇam || 6 || 7 ||

ab.seg:
vāte snaihikagaṇḍūṣam āha -
tilakalkodakaṃ kṣīraṃ sneho vā snaihike hitaḥ ||8||

lg.l: tilā nīlotpalaṃ sarpiḥ śarkarā kṣīram eva ca |
śoṣaṃ mukhasya vairasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ kāñjiko jayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ caturvidhayoḥ kavalagaṇḍūṣayoḥ katipayān yogān āha - snaihike gaṇḍūṣe tilakalkavastraniṣpīḍitam udakam iti | kṣīram atra sāmānyena goprabhṛtijanitaṃ | snehaś cāpy evam | atha kṣārādidagdhavakrasya yogam āha | tiletyādiyogo vyastaḥ samastaś ca yojyaḥ | yad āha kaścit - ‘gaṇḍūṣaḥ śarkarākṣaudrapiṣṭamāṃsapayastilaiḥ | vyastaiḥ samastair yojyas tu mukhe kṣārāditāpita’ iti | ‘saṃdadhāti mukhe vraṇān’ ity asya sthāne ‘saṃnihanti mukhavraṇāni’ti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | dāhatṛṣṇādayo mukhasyeti viṣakṣārāgnidagdhe mukhe iti śeṣaḥ | dhāryam ity anena gaṇḍūṣaviṣayam | aparāṇy āha - tailaṃ kāñjikayogaṃ saindhavaṃ vihāya kṣīradagdhe 'pi pracarati | tathā hy uktaṃ ‘tāmbūlamadhyasthitacūrṇakena dagdhaṃ mukhaṃ yasya bhavet kathaṃcit | tailena gaṇḍūṣamasau vidadhyād amlāranālena punaḥ punar vā’ iti | atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa dravyaviśeṣajanitān pradarśayann āha | siṃdhutrikaṭurājībhir ity anena kavalayogam āhuḥ | saindhavādayo vyastāḥ samastāś ca yojyāḥ | yady etevāṃ gaṇḍūṣas tadā kalkaṃ kṛtvā paṭe visrāvya taddraveṇa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | triphaletyādiyogaḥ kvathito boddhavyaḥ | kalka iti kecit | kaphāsṛkpittaprakopamukhasthitam iti bhāvaḥ || 8-12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. snaihike gaṇḍūṣe tilakalkaḥ udakaṃ jalaṃ kṣīraṃ dugdhaṃ sneho vā tailādikaḥ hitaḥ | vātaroge eva vātasya prayogāt | atha pitte gaṇḍūṣaḥ śamana evocyate nīlādīnāṃ hanuvakrastho gaṇḍūṣo dāhanāśano bhavati | dāho mukhadāhaḥ hanvāśritaṃ vaktraṃ tatrasthaḥ | atha mukhavraṇādau madhugaṇḍūṣaḥ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatvaṃ | nirmalateti yāvat āsye mukhe mukhavraṇān sphoṭān saṃdadhāti saṃdhānaṃ karoti | spaṣṭam anyat | viṣādau gaṇḍūṣān āha - sarpir ghṛtaṃ, payo dugdham | atha dantacāle gaṇḍūṣaḥ tileti spaṣṭaṃ | atha mukhaśoṣe śotheti sugamam | atha kaphe saṃśodhanaḥ rājī prasiddhā | atha kaphāsṛkpitte triphaleti | sugamam || 8-12 ||

atha mukhapāke gaṇḍūṣaḥ - (pratisāraṇacūrṇam)
dārvī guḍūcī triphalā drākṣā jātyāś ca pallavāḥ ||13||

lg.l: śīto mukhe dhṛto hanyān mukhapākaṃ tridoṣajam ||14||
kavalaś cāpi tasyaiva jñeyo 'tra kuśalair naraiḥ || 15 ||
kuṣṭhaṃ dārvī samaṅgā ca pāṭhā tiktā ca pītikā |
tejanī mukhalodhre ca cūrṇaṃ syāt pratisāraṇam ||18||
raktasnutiṃ dantapīḍāṃ śothaṃ dāhaṃ ca nāśayet |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. aparam api mukhapākayogam āha | dārvī dāruharidrā triphalā harītakīvibhītakāmalakasaṃjñā | jātī mālatī | yavāsa ity asya sthāne aṃbaṣṭhā ceti tatkvāthaḥ pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | anyato darśanāt | tathā hi - ‘jātīpatrāmṛtādrākṣāpāṭhādārvīphalatrikaiḥ | kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ śīto gaṇḍūṣo mukhapākanut’ iti | ṣaṣṭhāṃśakṣaudrasaṃyuta iti | kvathitajalasya yat ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ tena samaṃ kṣaudram iti | athavā ṣaṣṭhāṃśakṣaudrasaṃyuta iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno jñeyaḥ | tena kkāthasya pañcabhāgāḥ ṣaṣṭho bhāgaḥ kṣaudrasyeti vyākhyānaṃ samīcīnam | mukhe dhṛta ity anena gaṇḍūṣaviṣaya: | ‘yasyauṣadhasya gaṇḍūṣaḥ tasyaiva pratisāraṇam | kavalaś cāpi tasyaiva jñeyo 'tra kuśalair naraiḥ’ ayaṃ śloko bahupustakeṣu na likhitaḥ | kenacit saṃlikhya svīkṛtaḥ | saṃgatoyam iti manyamānair asmābhir api na tyājyaḥ yuktārthatvāt | atha kavalārthaṃ yogam āha - mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ | tasya keśaraṃ madhyasthitāvayavaviśeṣaṃ loke catūrīnnāmakaṃ vācyaṃ | saindhavoṣaṇacūrṇe manāk deyam | uṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ | jāḍyam iti mukhasyeti | pūrvam uktaṃ pratisāraṇaviṣayaṃ tad idānīṃ darśayann āha | pratisāryate ghṛṣyate aneneti pratisāraṇam | nanu tantrāntare pratisāraṇaviṣayaṃ caturvidhaṃ tad yathā -
‘vibhajya bheṣajaṃ buddhyā kurvīta pratisāraṇaṃ |
kalko rasakriyā kṣaudraṃ cūrṇaṃ ceti caturvidham |
aṃgulyagrapraṇītaṃ tu yathāsvaṃ mukharogiṇām |
tasya yogam ayogaṃ ca kavalāktaṃ vibhāvayet’ | tat katham atra trividham | ucyate | atrāvalehatvena rasakriyā: kṣaudrayos tadantaḥ pracāraḥ | tenāvalehagrahaṇena dvayor api grahaṇam ity adoṣaḥ | atha pratisāraṇacūrṇaṃ darśayann āha - kuṣṭhaṃ ruk, dārvī dāruharidrāsamaṃ gāñjalikārikā, pāṭhā ambaṣṭhā, tiktā kaṭukī, pītikā haridrā tejanī cavikā iti cakraḥ | mūrvā iti kārtikaḥ | mustaṃ meghaḥ, lodhraṃ prasiddham | raktasrutir atra dantamūlagatadoṣasyaiva boddhavyā | śothadāham api mukhajanitam eva || 13-18 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dārvī dāruharidrā jātī mālatīpatrāṇi vāsakaḥ kvāthāt ṣaṣṭhāṃśaḥ kṣaudraṃ madhu yasya gaṇḍūṣasyaiva pratisāraṇaṃ kavalaś cety āha yasyeti sugamaṃ | kavalo yathā mātuluṅgasya bījapūrasya keśaraṃ madhyasthaṃ saindhavaṃ maricam etat kavalo jāḍyaṃ mukhajaḍatām aruciṃ kaphavātajāṃ kaphavātajātāṃ | pratisāraṇaṃ trividhaṃ bhavatīty āha - kalkaḥ avalehaḥ tathā cūrṇaṃ trividhaṃ triprakāraṃ pratisāraṇaṃ bhavati mukharogiṇāṃ yathāsukhaṃ yathādoṣaṃ trividhaṃ pratisāraṇasaṃjñaṃ bhavati | kiṃbhūtam aṃgulyagragṛhītaṃ kalkādyaṃ pratisāraṇaṃ yathā kuṣṭhaṃ, dārvī, dāruharidrā, samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā, pāṭhā tiktā kaṭukī, pītikā haridrā, tejanī tejohvā, mustaṃ bhadramustaṃ, lodhram etat pratisāraṇaṃ cūrṇam aṅgulyagreṇa gharṣayet | raktasrāvādīn nāśayet || 13-18 ||

hīnayogam āha -
hīnayogāt kaphotkleśo rasājñānārucī tathā ||19||

lg.l: atiyogān mukhe pākaḥ śoṣas tṛṣṇā klamo bhavet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ hīnātiyogatvena gaṇḍūṣādīnāṃ doṣam āha - hīnayogāt kaphotkleśa iti | kaphādhikacetotkleśa upasthitavamanonmukhatā rasājñānāruciḥ | tatheti rasānāṃ madhurādīnām ajñānaṃ rasanendriyaviṣayahānir ity abhiprāyaḥ | arucis trividhaḥ | arucir anannābhinandanam | bhaktadveṣa iti | tad yathā satyāṃ bubhukṣāyām abhyavahārāsāmarthyam ity aruciḥ | anabhilaṣitam apy annaṃ dīyamānamabhyavaharatīty annābhinandanam | annasya śravaṇasmaraṇadarśanasparśanair yatrodvejite sa bhaktadveṣa iti | atiyogād iti | gaṇḍūṣakavalādīnām eva | eke hīnātiyogaviṣayaṃ śodhanākhyagaṇḍūṣaṃ mānayanti | tathā coktaṃ ‘śodhanīye viśeṣeṇa bhavaty etat tu lakṣaṇam’ iti || 19 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. gaṇḍūṣādīnāṃ hīnayogāt hīnamātrākaraṇāt kaphokleśaḥ kaphādhikyaṃ rasājñānārucī rasānāṃ madhurādīnām ajñānaṃ yathārthasvādalābhaḥ tathā arucirasāruci atrārucir vā ete bhavataḥ | atiyogāt gaṇḍūṣādīnām atikaraṇāt mukhe pākaḥ śoṣas tṛṣṇāklamo glāniḥ etad bhavet || 19 ||

śuddhagaṇḍūṣalakṣaṇam āha -
vyādher apacayas tuṣṭir vaiśadyaṃ vaktralāghavam || 20 ||
indriyāṇāṃ prasādaś ca gaṇḍūṣe śuddhilakṣaṇam | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe gaṇḍūṣādi- vidhir nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha samyak śīlitasya gaṇḍūṣasya śuddhilakṣaṇaṃ | vyādher apacayo vināśa: | tuṣṭiḥ saṃtoṣaḥ | vaiśadyaṃ mukhasyeti | indriyāṇāṃ śravaṇanayanaghrāṇarasanādīnāṃ prasādaḥ svaviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyam | eke apacayasthāne apanayaḥ, gaṇḍūṣasthāne kavala iti paṭhanti | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ || 20 ||
iti śrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe kavalādhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. gaṇḍūṣe satataṃ śuddhalakṣaṇaṃ samyak kṛtaṃ gaṇḍūṣalakṣaṇaṃ yad vā mukhaśuddhilakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ tallakṣaṇam ity āha - vyādher apacayo nāśaḥ vyādheḥ mukhe kaphaliptatājyādeḥ tuṣṭisaṃtoṣaḥ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatā vaktralāghavaṃ gurutānāśaḥ indriyāṇāṃ rasādīnāṃ prasādaḥ prasannatā etal lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati || 20 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne gaṇḍūṣādividhi- radhyāya: || 10 ||

div.head: atha lepanādividhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha kavalādīnāṃ vidhim abhidhāya saṃprati lepamūrddhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhim ārabhyate | tatra tāvat pralepanāmāny āha -
ālepasya ca nāmāni lipto lepaś ca lepanam |
doṣaghno viṣahā varṇyo mukhalepas tridhā mataḥ || 1 ||

lg.l: ārdro vyādhiharaḥ sa syāc chuṣko dūṣayati cchavim ||2||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. tridhā mata ity anena eko doṣaghnaḥ dvitīyo viṣahā kathitaḥ aparas tu varṇya iti tridhā saṃjño 'smin mate 'nyatrāpi prasiddha eva | sa eva varṇyo mukhalepaḥ kathitaḥ | na tu catvāro bhedāḥ vakṣyamāṇatvāt tripramāṇa iti teṣāṃ doṣaghnādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ traya eva parimāṇā yathā'nukrameṇa boddhavyāḥ | sa kathaṃbhūta: | caturbhāgavibhāgārdhāṅgulonnata iti | etena kim uktaṃ | doṣaghno lepaḥ aṅgulasya caturbhāgapramāṇenotsedhaḥ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ viṣahālepas tu tribhāgotsedhaḥ kāryaḥ | tribhāgatāṅgulasyeti saṃbandhaḥ | varṇyo lepaś cārdhāṅgulonnata eva kuryāt | athārdraśuṣkayoḥ phalam āha | ārdro vyādhihara ityādi | sa pūrvokto lepo yāvad ārdro bhavati tāvad vyādhiharo jñeyaḥ | yadā śuṣko bhavati tadā na vidūṣayati | chaviḥ chāyā sā ca varṇāprabhopalakṣitā | ‘ tathā ca varṇaprabhāśritā yā ca chāyā sā parikīrtite’ti | nanu chāyāprabhayos tu ko bhedaḥ | ucyate ‘varṇamātrapraticchāyā prabhā varṇaprakāśinī | āsannāt lakṣyate chāyā prabhā dūrāc ca lakṣyate’ iti | na kevalaṃ varṇaprabhācchāyānāṃ lakṣaṇabhedaḥ | saṃkhyābhedopy astīti | tad yathā caturdhā varṇaḥ gauraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śyāmaḥ gauraśyāma iti | prabhā ca saptavidhā raktā pītā sitā śyāmā haritā pāṇḍurā siteti | chāyāpi pañcavidhā snigdhā vimalā rūkṣā malinā saṃkṣiptā iti || 1 || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha mūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhiḥ | tatrādau lepaḥ lipto lepaḥ lepanaṃ tāni trīṇi ālepasya nāmāni bhavanti | nāmakathanaṃ saṃjñārthaṃ paryāyakathanārthaṃ ca | sa lepas tridhā triprakāraḥ mataḥ kathitaḥ | ekaḥ doṣaghnaḥ śothādināśakaḥ | doṣaśabdenāpi rogā ucyante | dvitīyo viṣahā bhallātādiviṣanāśakaḥ| tṛtīyo varṇyaḥ mukhavyaṅgādivarṇakaraḥ | evaṃbhūto mukhalepaḥ mukhyo lepaḥ tridhā | mukhaśabdena mukhya ucyate | tathā ca viśvaḥ ‘mukhaṃ ca vadane mukhye ādau dvārābhyupāyayoḥ’ iti | punaḥ lepas tripramāṇaḥ trīṇi pramāṇāni yasya saḥ | tadvidhānam āha - caturbhāgaḥ aṅgulasya catvāro bhāgā yasya saḥ pūrṇāṅgula ity arthaḥ | sa tu doṣaghnaḥ | tribhāgaḥ trīṇi aṅgulāni yasya saḥ tribhāgaḥ sa tu viṣahā | ardhāṅgulottamaḥ ardham aṅgulapramāṇam unnata uccaḥ, sa tu varṇyaḥ varṇakaraḥ | sa ārdraḥ aśuṣkaḥ chaviṃ kāntiṃ dūṣayati || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg:
doṣaghno lepo yathā -
punarnavāṃ dāru śuṇṭhīṃ siddhārthaṃ śigrum eva ca |
piṣṭvā caivāranālena pralepa: sarvaśothajit || 3 ||

Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktaṃ doṣaghno viṣahā varṇyo lepas tridhā | tatra tāvad doṣaghno lepo yathā | siddhārthaṃ sarṣapāḥ śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ āranālaṃ kāñjikabhedaḥ tadabhāve 'mlatakraṃ grāhyam iti sarvatra | ayaṃ lepaḥ sarvaśothajid ity anena vātakaphaprāyaṃ śothaṃ viśeṣeṇa jayatīti pracaratīti | śotho 'tra doṣajanitaḥ śopharogasaṃbhavaḥ | na tu vraṇaśothaḥ tatrāpy āgantujāpīti saṃbandhāt || 3 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. punarnavā dāru devadāru śuṇṭhī siddhārthaṃ sarṣapaḥ śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ āranālena kāñjikena | tadabhāve gomūtreṇa vā lepaḥ kāryaḥ sa lepaḥ sarvaśothahṛd bhavati sarvaśothena ca viṣaśotha: || 3 ||

div.ab:
atha dāhe lepaḥ
vibhītaphalamajjāyā lepo dāhārtināśanaḥ |
Āḍhamalla. athāparaḥ pittajadāhanāśano lepas tam āha - atrāpi āranālena peṣaṇam iti saṃbandho jñeyaḥ ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. bibhītaphalaṃ bibhītakaphalaṃ tasya majjālepaḥ ||

ab.seg:
atha daśāṅgalepo visarpaśothavraṇādau – (daśāṅgalepaḥ)
śirīṣaṃ madhuyaṣṭī ca tagaraṃ raktacandanam || 4 ||

lg.l: elā māṃsī niśāyugmaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vālakam eva ca |
jalena kriyate sujñair daśāṅga iti saṃjñitaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha daśāṅgalepasaṃjñakaṃ lepam apy āha - atra śirīṣaḥ śirīṣavṛkṣatvak | eke pañcāṅgaśirīṣam atra yojayanti prayogāntaradarśanāt | tathā hi - ‘śirīṣapañcāṃgatuṣodakena kalkīkṛtaṃ caiva ghṛtena yuktam | nihanti visphoṭakam ugrarūpaṃ sadāhapākasrutirāgayuktam’ iti | yatra tvaṅmūlapuṣpāṇi phalāny aṅgāni pañca veti | niśāyugmam iti haridrādvayaṃ | pañcamāṃśaghṛtapluta iti | sakaladravyāṇāṃ samabhāgamilitānāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tadanu jalena saṃpiṣya paścāt pañcamāṃśena ghṛtena saṃplāvya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | pañcamāṃśam atra dravyaparimāṇāt || 4-6 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śirīṣaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, niśāyugmaṃ haridrādvayaṃ, vālakam udīcyaṃ, cūrṇāt pañcamāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ daśāṅga iti daśa aṅgāni auṣadhāni yasya saḥ ghṛtaṃ tu prakṣepakadravyaṃ tadbhinnam || 4-6 ||

viṣaghno lepo yathā -
ajādugdhatilair lepo navanītena saṃyutaḥ |
śothamāruṣkaraṃ hanti lepo vā kṛṣṇamṛttikaiḥ ||7||
Āḍhamalla. atha viṣahā lepam āha - āruṣkaro bhallātakaḥ tajjanitaḥ śotha iti || 7 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āruṣkaraṃ bhallātakajanitaṃ | spaṣṭham anyat ||7||

atha kīṭaghnalepaḥ -
lāṅgalyativiṣālābujālinīmūlabījakaiḥ |
lepo dhānyāmbusaṃpiṣṭa: kīṭavisphoṭanāśanaḥ || 8 ||

Āḍhamalla. aparam apy āha - lāṅgalī kalikārikā | ativiṣā ‘atīsa’ śabdavācyā | alābu kaṭutumbī jālinī ‘toraī’ śabdavācyā | mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tasya bījāni | eke alābuprabhṛtīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ bījāni gṛhanti | dhānyāmbusaṃpiṣṭa iti | dhānyāmbu kāñjikabhedaḥ | kīṭavisphoṭaḥ saviṣakīṭadaṣṭajanitavisphoṭa ity arthaḥ | yathā lūtādayaḥ || 8 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. lāṅgalī kalihārī, ativiṣā prasiddhā alābu tumbī jālinī kaṭutumbībījāni mūlakabījāni dhānyāmbu kāñjikam || 8 ||

varṇyo lepo yathā -
raktacandanamañjiṣṭhālodhrakuṣṭhapriyaṅgavaḥ |
vaṭāṅkurā masūrāś ca vyaṅgaghnā mukhakāntidāḥ || 9 ||

lg.l: vyaṅgeṣu cārjunatvag vā mañjiṣṭhā vā samākṣikā || 12||
kuṣṭhaṃ kālīyakaṃ lodhram ebhir lepaṃ prayojayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha viṣahā lepam abhidhāya samprati varṇyalepam āha - raktacandanādīni vyastāni samastāni saṃgṛhya jalenāpiṣya lepaḥ kārya iti saṃbandhaḥ | atra priyaṅgur latāviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ phalāni | vaṭāṅkurā iti vaṭasyābhinavāḥ patramukulāḥ | masūro 'nnaviśeṣaḥ | mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ tasya jaṭā mūlaṃ | śilā manaḥśilā | gośakṛto rasa iti | gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tasya rasa ity arthaḥ | dhānyaṃ dhānaśabdavācyam | tadvad atitāruṇyapiḍakāpahopy ayaṃ lepo boddhavyaḥ | gorocanā prasiddhā siddhārthaka iti | atrāpi tāruṇyapiḍakāpaha iti saṃbandhaḥ | tena siddhārthādidravyacatuṣkair lepo yauvanapiḍakāpaho bhavatīti matāntarāt | arjuno vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ sa ca kauhāśabdavācyaḥ tasya tvak challī | mañjiṣṭhā prasiddhā | samākṣikā dhātumākṣikasaṃyuktā | sa cārjunatvak mañjiṣṭhā vā | tena vikalpatvāt tvaca eko yogaḥ mañjiṣṭhāyā dvitīyo yogaḥ | aśvakhurajanitasya kajjalasya tṛtīya iti | eke śvetā aparājiteti vyākhyānayanti | eke arkakṣīram iti bhinnapadaṃ haridrābhyām iti dvivacanatvena haridrā dāruharidrā yojyeti vyākhyānayanti | etat sarvatra na pracarati tenārkakṣīraharidrābhyām eva yogaḥ sādhuḥ| vaṭasya vaṭavṛkṣasya pāṇḍupatrāṇīti | pariṇatatvāt teṣu pāṇḍuratvaṃ tādṛśānītyarthaḥ | mālatī jātī tasyāḥ patrāṇi kālīyakam agurubhedaṃ pītasāram iti loke | kecid vaṭaś ca pāṇḍupatrāṇītī paṭhanti tatra vaṭa ity anena vaṭavṛkṣasya patrāṇi pāṇḍuḥ paṭolas tasyāpi patrāṇītyarthaḥ | etan na sarvamatam | aprasiddhatvāt || 9-15 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. raktacandaneti sugamaṃ | vyaṅgalepaḥ vyaṅgaś chāyā | atha tāruṇyapiḍakādau - mātuluṅgo bījapūramūlaṃ, sarpir ghṛtaṃ, śilā manaḥśilā gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tadrasaḥ kālaṃ kālimā | atha tāruṇyapiḍakādau - dhānyaṃ prasiddham | siddhārthakaṃ sarṣapāḥ ete trayo yogāḥ piḍakādau | atha vyaṅge-arjunatvak arjunavṛkṣatvak mākṣikaṃ madhu śveto yo 'śvaḥ ghoṭakas tat khurajanyā maṣī bhasma mukhaśyāmatāyāṃ punaḥ - mālatī jātī kālīyakaṃ dāruharidrā || 9-15 ||

athāruṃṣikāyāṃ lepaḥ -
purāṇam atha piṇyākaṃ purīṣaṃ kukkuṭasya ca |
mūtrapiṣṭa: pralepo 'yaṃ śīghraṃ hanyād aruṃṣikām ||16||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. piṇyākaṃ tilakalkajanitaṃ khaliśabdavācyaṃ | tac ca purātanaṃ varṣoṣitaṃ grāhyaṃ | kukkuṭaḥ tāmracūḍaḥ tasya purīṣaṃ | mūtram atra gavyam || 16 || 17 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. priṇyākaṃ tilakhalaḥ anyaṃ ca ariṣṭo nimba: aruṃṣikā apiṭakāḥ || 16 || 17 ||

ab.seg:
dāruṇe lepaḥ -
priyālabījamadhukakuṣṭhamāṣaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ |
kāryo dāruṇake mūrdhni pralepo madhusaṃyutaḥ || 18 ||

lg.l: dugdhena khākhasaṃ bījaṃ pralepād dāruṇaṃ jayet |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. priyālabījaṃ cirauñjīti prasiddham | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu | māṣo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ | madhusaṃyuta ity anena priyālabījādi boddhavyam | jalena saṃpiṣya manāk madhunā saṃsrāvya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | dugdham atra gavyaṃ | khākhasaṃ bījam iti dānaśabdavācyam | āmrabījasya cūrṇam iti | āmraphalamadhyasthitamajjāviśeṣaḥ | śivā harītakī | dāruṇaṃ rogaviśeṣaṃ | dvitīyaṃ dāruṇaṃ duḥsādhyam iti viśeṣaṇam || 18 || 19 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. priyālabījaṃ cirauñjīti prasiddhaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī māṣo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ | khākhasaṃ śivā harītakī dāruṇe || 18 || 19 ||

ab.seg:
athendralupte -
rasas tiktapaṭolasya patrāṇāṃ tadvilepanāt || 20 ||

lg.l: indraluptaṃ śamaṃ yāti tribhir eva dinair dhruvam |
romāṇy anena jāyante lepāt pāṇitaleṣv api |
indraphalaṃ śamaṃ yāti keśāḥ syuḥ saghanā dṛḍhā: |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. tiktapaṭolaḥ kaṭukapaṭolaḥ tasya patrāṇāṃ rasa ity arthaḥ | tadvilepanād iti | tat tasya rasasya lepanāt | tribhir eva dinair ity anenāsya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | nātra tridinair eva niyatapramāṇaṃ yato bahudinasevyo 'yaṃ prayogaḥ | bṛhatīrasa iti pakkabṛhatīphalajanitarasasyaiko yogaḥ | guñjāyā mūlaṃ phalaṃ vā dvitīyo yogaḥ | atrā'pi madhupracāraḥ | bhallātakaphalaṃ tṛtīyo yogaḥ | eke bhallātakarasopi vety asya sthāne 'vikṣīreṇa saṃyutam iti paṭhanti | tena bheḍīdugdhena guñjāphalaṃ saṃghṛṣya lepaḥ kārya iti saṃgataḥ | saṃpradāye tu indraluptasthānaṃ prasthayitvā tadabhāve saṃghṛṣya paścāl lepaḥ kārya iti sādhuḥ | uktam anyatrāpi - ‘bṛhatīphalarasasaṃpiṣṭaṃ guñjāphalamūlam indraluptasya | kanakavighṛṣṭasya tato dātavyaṃ prasthitasya sade’ti | gokṣuraḥ prasiddhaḥ | tilapuṣpāṇi vikhyātāni | tulye sāmye gokṣure satilapuṣpe ity arthaḥ | madhusarpiṣī ca | tulye 'tra grāhye | maṣīkajjalaviśeṣaṃ hastidantaṃ dagdhvā kajjalaṃ kāryam | rasāñjanaṃ dvividham ekaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ dravyaviśeṣam | aparaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavam | tadabhāve dāruharidraiva grāhyā | ayaṃ lepaḥ keśavardhanārtham ity āhuḥ | yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī indīvaraṃ nīlotpalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījam api grāhyam | padmabījaṃ gaṭāśabdavācyam| mṛdvīkā gostanī drākṣā | eke mṛdvīsthāne mūrveti pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tailāni prasiddhāni | ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gopayaḥ | tilājyakṣīrasthāne tilājakṣīralepanair iti pāṭhaḥ | tatrā'jakṣīram ity arthaḥ tilājyakṣīramārkavair ity api pāṭhāntaraṃ saṃgatam | tathā hy uktaṃ ‘madhukendīvaramūrvātilājyagokṣīrabhṛṅgalepena | acirād bhavanti keśā ghanadṛḍhamūlāyatā mṛdava’ iti | catuṣpadāḥ go 'śvāvyajebheṇakharoṣṭrādayaḥ | teṣāṃ tvak carma romanakhaśṛṅgāsthīni prasiddhāni | tena tvagādīnāṃ dagdhvā bhasma kāryaṃ tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavam || 20-25 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. indraluptaṃ keśanāśalakṣaṇam | tiktapaṭolaṃ bṛhatī kaṇṭakārī bhallātakarasaḥ patrarasaḥ | indralupte - madhusarpirdvayaṃ tulyaṃ tulye auṣadhatulye keśaḥ saṃvardhate hastidantaṃ tanmaṣī bhasma rasāñjanaṃ kharparam añjanaṃ vā| pāṇitaleṣu hastatale 'pi romāṇi jāyante | indralupte-yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī indīvaraṃ kamalaṃ mṛdvī drākṣā tailaṃ tilajam ājyaṃ goghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gavyam ājaṃ vā | indralupte catuḥpādānāṃ tvak-roma-nakha-śṛṅga-asthi eṣāṃ bhasmāni tailena lepaḥ romasañjananaḥ indralupte || 20-25 ||

palite lepāḥ
indravāruṇikābījatailenābhyaṅgam ācaret || 26 ||

lg.l: sthitam ikṣurase māsaṃ lepanāt palitaṃ jayet |
piṣṭvā lohamaye bhāṇḍe sthāpayed uṣitaṃ niśi ||29||
māsam ekaṃ tataḥ kuryāc chāgīdugdhena lepanam || 33 ||
svapet prātas tataḥ kuryāt snānaṃ tena ca jāyate || 34 ||
palitasya vināśaś ca tribhir lepair na saṃśayaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. ayorajo lohacūrṇaṃ tadabhāve lohamalam ity eke | ikṣurase ikṣurasapūrite bhāṇḍe māsam ekaṃ yāvat sthitaṃ bhavati | ayaṃ kṛṣṇīkaraṇatvāt palitaṃ jayed ity arthaḥ | kecid atra dhātrīphalādīnām api karṣāṇi grāhyāṇi | lohacūrṇakarṣaparimāṇadarśanāt | tena dhātrīphalānāṃ karṣadvayam | harītakī karṣadvayamitā | karṣaikaṃ bibhītakaphalam | āmrāsthimajjāḥ pañcakarṣā iti naitat sarvasaṃmatam| asmatsaṃpradāye tu dhātrīphaladvayam eva grāhyam | evaṃ harītakīphaladvayam | ekaṃ vibhītakaphalam āmraphalānāṃ pañcasaṃkhyākaṃ majjā evaṃ pracarati | pralepo 'tra jalena | triphalā harītakyādikaṃ | nīlikā nīlinī vikhyātā tasyāḥ patrāṇi lohaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ | bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ samam iti sakalaṃ samamātram | ajāmūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭam ity asya sthāne avimūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭam iti pāṭhaḥ | aviḥ bheḍī | dāḍimatvag ity anena dāḍimaphalasya tvak valkalaṃ grāhyaṃ | bisam iti mṛṇālakamalanālam ity arthaḥ | pratyekaṃ pañcapalikam ity anena triphalāyāḥ pañcadaśapalāni grāhyāṇi | bhṛṅgarājarasasya ṣaṭprasthāḥ | teṣāṃ nava tilāni rasasyetyarthaḥ | etat siddhaṃ yadā bhavati tadā ājadugdhena saha lepanaṃ deyam iti bhāvaḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || 26-34 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. keśakalpe lepaḥ pātālayantreṇa tailena | kālā atiśyāmāḥ | keśakalpe - ayorajo lohacūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ bhṛṅgarājacūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikā taḍāgakardamaḥ etan māsam ikṣurase sthitaṃ lepāt palitaṃ keśaśauklyaṃ jayet | keśakalpe-dhātrī āmalakī phalatrayaṃ pathye harītakyau dve ekaṃ vibhītakaṃ pañca āmrāṇāṃ majjā lohasya karṣaṃ piṣṭvā lohamaye bhāṇḍe sthāpayet | uṣitaṃ niśi sthāpitam acirāt śīghram evākālapalitaṃ svalpadinajanyaṃ keśaśauklyaṃ hanti | keśakalpe-nīlikāpatraṃ nīlapatraṃ bhṛṅgarājo mārkavaḥ aviḥ bheḍaḥ tanmūtreṇa | kṛṣṇīkaraṃ śyāmakaraṃ | keśakalpe-bisaṃ kamalamūlaṃ spaṣṭam anyat || 26-34 ||

atha romaśātane -
śaṅkhacūrṇasya bhāgā dvau haritālaṃ ca bhāgikam ||35||

lg.l: lepo 'yaṃ vāripiṣṭas tu keśān utpāṭya dīyate || 36 ||
nirmūlaṃ keśasthānaṃ syāt kṣapaṇasya śiro yathā ||37||
asyāpi saptabhir lepai romṇāṃ śātanam uttamam || 39 ||

ab.seg:
śvitre lepāḥ |
suvarṇapuṣpī kāsīsaṃ viḍaṅgāni manaḥśilā |
rocanā saindhavaṃ caiva lepanāc chvitranāśanam || 40 ||

lg.l: tālakaṃ śāṇamātraṃ syāc catuḥśāṇā ca bākucī |
rasāñjanam ayaścūrṇaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇās tad ekataḥ || 43 ||
cūrṇayitvā gavāṃ pittaiḥ piṣṭvā ca guṭikā kṛtā |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha romaśātanam āha - śaṅkhacūrṇam atra bharjitaṃ deyam iti saṃpradāyaḥ | haritālasyaiko bhāgaḥ manaḥśilā cārdhabhāgeti | tena ekabhāgāpekṣayārdhabhāgā | eke svarjikā caikabhāgikā iti vā pāṭhaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamaṃ | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ śāṇadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ | kadalīkandatoyena veti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | ravipatrarasena arkapatrasvarasena vā | ayam api śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ pracarati | anyato darśanāt | tathā hi -
‘palāśabhasmākṣitalasya cūrṇaṃ raṃbhāmbumiśrair upalipya bhūyaḥ |
kandarpagehe mṛgalocanānāṃ romāṇi rohanti kadāpi naiva’ | asyāpi saptanirlepād ity anena pūrvavat kāryaḥ || 35-39 ||
gū. - śaṅkhacūrṇasyeti sugamam | anyac ca - ravirarkaḥ śāṇayugmaṃ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ tālakaṃ haritālaṃ palāśasya kṣāraṃ palāśabhasma || 35-39 ||

atha śvitranāśanāyāha - suvarṇapuṣpī sonīśabdavācyo viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tadabhāve bṛhadbalā grāhyā apare ca sthūlakaṃ gṛhṇanti | śīśaṃ sīsakaṃ | sīsakasthāne kāsīsam iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | rocanā gorocanā prasiddhā | lepo 'tra jalena | vāyasī kākamācī | eḍagajaḥ prapunnāṭaḥ tasya bījāni | kṛṣṇā pippalī | vatsa iti govatsaḥ | athavā chāgaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ | tālako haritālaḥ | bākucī somarājī tasyāḥ phalāni prasiddhāni śeṣaṃ sugamam | bākucī prasiddhā vetaso niculaḥ jalavetasa iti loke vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | lākṣā laktakajananī kākondumbarikā kaṭumariśabdavācyā | kaṇā pippalī| rasāñjanaṃ prasiddham |
tadabhāve dāru haridrā grāhyā tatsaṃbhavatvāt | ayaścūrṇaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ | kṛṣṇāstilā iti | śvetatilaniṣedhārtham | gavāṃ pittair iti | goyakṛdekakhaṇḍaikadeśalagnaṃ dravarūpaṃ pittam iti vācyam |
tadabhāve gomūtreṇa pracāraḥ iti sarvatra || 40-44 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha śvitre anyac ca - bākucī vāvacī kākodumbarikā kaṇā pippalī rasāñjanaṃ prasiddham | ayaścūrṇaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ gopittā'bhāve gomūtraṃ deyaṃ śvitre lepaḥ || 40-44||

atha sidhme lepaḥ -
dhātrī sarjarasaś caiva yavakṣāraś ca cūrṇitaḥ |
sauvīreṇa pralepo 'yaṃ prayojyaḥ sidhmanāśane || 45 ||

lg.l: lepo 'yaṃ vāriṇā piṣṭaḥ sidhmanāṃ nāśanaḥ paraḥ ||47||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha sidhmaroge | dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ | sarjarasaḥ rālaḥ sauvīrakaṃ kāñjikabhedaḥ | tac ca godhūmajanitam ity eke | tathā ca ‘sauvīrakaṃ suvīrāmlaṃ jñeyaṃ godhūmasaṃbhavam iti’ | dhātrīrasaḥ sarjarasaḥ iti pāṭhāntaram | tatra raso rasāñjanam iti vyākhyānayanti kecit naitādṛśaḥ kiṃtu pūrveṇa pracāraḥ saṃgata eva | dārvī dārūharidrā | mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tadbījānīti | tālako haritālaḥ | suradāruḥ devadāruḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || || 45-47 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. āmalakī sarjaraso rālaḥ sauvīreṇa kāñjikena lepaḥ sidhma śvetarogaḥ | anyac ca dāruharidrā mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tadbījāni tālakaṃ haritālaṃ suradāru devadāru spaṣṭam anyat | sidhmeṣu lepaḥ ||45-47||

atha netraroge lepaḥ-
harītakī saindhavaṃ ca gairikaṃ ca rasāñjanam |
biḍālako jale piṣṭaḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ || 48 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha netraroge rasāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ | tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ grāhyam tadubhayor alābhe ca dāruharidrā grāhyeti sarvatra pracāraḥ| biḍālaka iti bahirlepasaṃjñaḥ | tenākṣṇor upari lepaḥ kārya iti tātparyārthaḥ | ayaṃ lepo 'bhiṣyandādiroge prāyaśaḥ pracarati | rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tac ca dvividhaṃ vyākhyātam | vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tac ca śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñaṃ peṣaṇam atra jalenānuktatvāt || 48 || 49 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rasāñjanaṃ kharparaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ vā | biḍālako bahirlepaḥ dravyam agre vakṣyati anyac ca rasāñjanaṃ prasiddha vyoṣaṃ trikaṭusaṃpiṣṭaṃ vaṭakīkṛtaṃ etat lepād añjananāmikāṃ kaṇḍūpākānvitāṃ hanti | añjananāmikā netraroge paṭhitā || 48 || 49 ||

ab.seg:
atha kaṇḍvādau lepaḥ |
prapunnāṭasya bījāni bākucī sarṣapās tilāḥ |
kuṣṭhaṃ niśādvayaṃ mustaṃ piṣṭvā takreṇa caikataḥ || 50 ||

lg.l: kaṇḍūś ca rasakaś caiva praśamaṃ yānti vegataḥ || 53 ||
