ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha kaṇḍūdaduprabhṛtīnāṃ ca yogam āha - prapunnāṭaḥ cakramardakaḥ, tasya bījāny atra deyāni | bākucī somarājī prasiddhā tasyā api bījāni | niśādvayaṃ haridrādvayam | śeṣaṃ subodham | cakramardaḥ prasiddhaḥ, loke pamāḍaśabdavācyaḥ | abhayā harītakī | kuṭherako granthiparṇo nijanāmnā prasiddhaḥ | sa ca dvidhā ekaḥ kṣudraparṇaḥ, aparo vaṭapatra iti | niśā haridrā | atrāpi takrapiṣṭo boddhavyaḥ | siddhārthaḥ sarṣapaḥ | rajanī haridrā | prapunnāṭa eḍagajaḥ prasiddhaḥ | etat sakalaṃ jalenāpiṣya paścāt kaṭutailena saṃplāvyodvartanaṃ kāryam iti bhāvaḥ | eke siddhārtharajanīkalkair iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 50-56 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. prapunnāṭaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tadbījāni, bākucī somarājī | siddhārthāḥ sarṣapāḥ, niśādvayaṃ haridrā dāruharidrā ca, mustaṃ bhadramustaṃ takreṇa ekataḥ piṣṭvā lepaḥ kāryaḥ | vicarcikā kuṣṭharogaviśeṣaḥ | atha pāmādau lepaḥ hemakṣīrī kharṇakṣīrī, viḍaṅgaṃ, daradaṃ hiṅgulaṃ, dadrughnaḥ prapunnāṭaḥ | etat samaṃ dhattūrādīnāṃ rasena saṃmardya lepaḥ | rakaso 'pi kṣudrakuṣṭabhedaḥ | anyac ca - dūrvā, abhayā harītakī, cakramardaḥ dadrughnaḥ, kuṭherakaḥ udumbaraḥ, rāmatulasīty anye | spaṣṭam anyat | kaṇḍvādau -niśāyugmaṃ haridrādvayam | kaṇḍūśītapittādau sugamam | iti kaṇḍvādau lepaḥ ||50-56||

atha vātavisarpādau lepāḥ -
rāvā nīlotpalaṃ dāru candanaṃ madhukaṃ balā |
ghṛtakṣīrayuto lepo vātavīsarpanāśanaḥ || 57 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha visarparoge | rāsnā surabhī, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalam, dāru devadāru, candanaṃ raktacandanam, madhukaṃ yaṣṭī, madhukaṃ, balā prasiddhā, loke śīsamaśabdavācyā | bālasthāne vacā iti pāṭhāntaraṃ na manoharam | prasiddhatvāt | ghṛtakṣīre 'tra gosaṃbhave grāhye | mṛṇālaṃ kamalanālam | candanam atra raktam | uśīraṃ gandhamūlaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣaḥ | kamalaṃ raktakamalam utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ | kecid utpalam iti kuṣṭhaṃ vyākhyānayanti | sārivā āsphotā sā ca gopavallīti prasiddhā | āmalakī dhātrīphalaṃ | pathyā harītakī | atrā'pi kṣīreṇa pracāraḥ | anuktatvāj jaleneti sarvatra | triphalā harītakīprabhṛtikaṃ phalatrayam | padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | padmākha iti loke | uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ | samaṅgā lajjālukā mañjiṣṭhā vā, karavīrako hayamārakaḥ | eke karavīrajam iti paṭhanti | tatra karavīrasya mūlaṃ grāhyam | anantā yavāsakaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 57-59 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dāru devadāru, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, balā prasiddhā vātavisarpe | mṛṇālaṃ bisaṃ kamalaṃ śvetam, utpalaṃ raktakamalaṃ, sārivā anantā pittavisarpe | padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā karavīrakaṃ hayamāraḥ nalamūlaṃ, anantā yavāsā || 57-59 ||

vātarakte pittarakte ca yogaḥ -
māṃsī sarjaraso lodhraṃ madhukaṃ sahareṇukam |
mūrvā nīlotpalaṃ padmaṃ śirīṣakusumaiḥ saha || 60 ||

lg.l: jayen mūrdhni pralepena raktaṃ nāsikayā sṛtam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha vātarakte pittarakte ca lepān āha - māṃsī jaṭākhyā, sarjaraso rālaśabdavācyaḥ | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu | hareṇu dravyaviśeṣaṃ hareṇukā iti vācyam | tadabhāve nirguṇḍībījam iti sarvatra | pūrve corasnāyu moraharīti loke | padmam ity atra raktakamalam | śatadhautaghṛtapluta iti | śatavāraṃ yāvat jalena prakṣālitaṃ ghṛtaṃ śatadhautasaṃjñam | āmalaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ piṣṭaṃ kāñjikavāribhir iti kāñjikatoyaiḥ| eke āmalakaṃ ghṛtasaṃsṛṣṭam iti paṭhanti | tatra pūrvaṃ ghṛtena āmalakaṃ manāk bharjayitvā paścāt kāñjikena saha saṃpeṣya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | kāñjikā'bhāve śītalajalam iti sarvatra | atha śiroroge - kuṣṭhaṃ kāñjikena saha saṃpeṣya lepaḥ kāryaḥ kāñjikābhāve śītalajalam iti sarvatra || 60 || 61 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, sarjarasaṃ rālaḥ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, sahareṇuḥ reṇukā, mūrvā prasiddhā, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, padmaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, śirīṣapuṣpāṇi | pittarakte vātarakte ca lepaḥ āmalakaṃ kāñjikā'bhāve takram ||60||61||

ab.seg:
śiroroge yogāḥ |
kuṣṭham eraṇḍatailena lepāt kāñjikapeṣitam || 62 ||

lg.l: śiro 'rtiṃ vātajāṃ hanyāt puṣpaṃ vā mucukundajam |
varī nīlotpalaṃ dūrvā tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ punarnavā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha śiroroge | kuṣṭhaṃ tu kāñjikena saha kalkīkṛtya eraṇḍatailenāplāvya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | eraṇḍatailenety asya sthāne eraṇḍamūleneti pāṭhāntaraṃ samīcīnam | vikalpena mucukundajaṃ puṣpam anenaiva vidhānena tatkāryakaraṃ bhavati | mucukundaḥ kundabhedaḥ prasiddha eva | tau tu śuklaraktapuṣpabhedena jñātavyau | natam atra tagaraṃ | naladaṃ māṃsī | uśīram iti kecit | viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī pūrvaṃ kāñjikena saha saṃpiṣya paścāt snehenāplāvya deyaḥ | sneho 'trāpy eraṇḍasaṃbhavo jñeyaḥ | tadasaṃbhave tilatailam iti | candanaṃ raktacandanam | vyāghranakhaṃ nakhabhedaḥ | śuktikākāraṃ sugandhadravyaviśeṣaḥ | utpalaṃ kamalaviśeṣaḥ| kṣīram atra gavyam ājaṃ vā | dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ kaseruḥ prasiddhaḥ | hrīberaṃ vālakaṃ padmakaṃ | candanaṃ raktam | mūrvośīranālānāṃ trayāṇāṃ mūlāni | tatra mūrvā corasnāyuḥ | uśīraṃ gandhamūla tṛṇabhedaḥ | nalaṃ prathitaṃ | tac ca suṣira... ..kāṇḍaśarākāram | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ kṣīram ity āhur eke | saṃpradāyatas tu anuktatvājjalam iti | hareṇuḥ reṇukāśabdavācyā | nataṃ tagaraṃ, śaileyaṃ śilāpuṣpaṃ hvala iti loke, agaru prasiddhaṃ, māṃsījaṭeti sugandhadravyam | rāsnā surabhī, rubūkam eraṇḍaḥ tasyā'tra sneho grāhyaḥ | kaphārtinud ity anena kaphajanitaśirorogapīḍāṃ nāśayed ity arthaṃ | prapunnāṭaś cakramardaḥ devakāṣṭhaṃ surakāṣṭhaṃ suradāru rohiṣaṃ gandhatṛṇaṃ vikhyātaṃ, mūtram atra gavyam | śeṣaṃ subodham | sārivā gopavallīsaṃjñā āsphotā iti loke | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu | kṛṣṇotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ | tadabhāve kama- labījam iti | eke kṛṣṇotpalaśabdena rīṭhā(ariṣṭakaphalaṃ) śabdadravyaviśeṣaṃ vyākhyānayanti | tan na sarvamatam | lepaḥ sakāñjikaḥ sneha iti | kāñjikasnehābhyāṃ saha lepaḥ kārya ity abhiprāyaḥ | snehagrahaṇenātra sarpiḥsnehaṃ vā yathādoṣāpekṣayā deyam | uktaṃ cānyatra ‘varī nīlotpalaṃ mūrvā tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ punarnavā’ | varṣābhūḥ prasiddha eva | śaṅkhakam anantavātaṃ ca śiroroge paṭhitam || 62-70||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vātaśirovyathāyāṃ lepaḥ - kuṣṭheti spaṣṭam | nataṃ tagaraṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ, naladam uśīraṃ, viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī, snehaḥ eraṇḍatailaḥ pūrvoktatvāt | vātaśiroroge nakhaṃ nakhadravyaviśeṣaḥ, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ, kṣīraṃ gavyam | pittaśiroroge dhātrī āmalakī, kaseru, hrīberaṃ vālakaṃ, padmaṃ kamalaṃ, padmaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, dūrvā, uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ nalamūlam | pittaśiroroge tathā raktapitte lepaḥ-hareṇuḥ reṇukā, nataṃ tagaraṃ, śaileyaṃ, mustaṃ bhadramustam, elā, agaru, devadāru, māṃsī, rāsnā, rubūka eraṇḍaḥ | kaphaśiroruji prapunnāṭaḥ cakramardaḥ, devakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru, rohiṣaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣaḥ | atha sūryāvartārdhabhede śleṣmaśiroroge | lepaḥ | sārivā anantamūlaṃ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, kṛṣṇā pippalī, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ, snehaḥ eraṇḍāditailam | atha śaṅkhake anantavātādau tathā sarvarogeṣu ca lepaḥ kathyate | varī śatāvarī | varā iti pāṭhe triphalā, kṛṣṇā pippalī || 62-70 ||

athānyo lepavidhiḥ kathyate -
atha lepavidhiś cānyaḥ procyate sujñasaṃmataḥ |
dvau tasya kathitau bhedau pralepākhyapradehakau ||71||

lg.l: carmārdraṃ māhiṣaṃ yadvat pronnataṃ sā mitis tayoḥ |
śītas tanur viśoṣī ca pralepaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 72 ||
vīryaṃ samyag viśaty āśu romakūpaiḥ śirāmukhaiḥ |
na rātrau lepanaṃ kuryāc chuṣyamāṇaṃ na dhārayet ||74||
vinā lepena niryāti rātrau no lepayed ataḥ|

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. athānyo lepavidhis tam api darśayann āha - athānyo lepavidhir iti | vraṇaśoṣaprakaraṇe prācuryam asya | tasya lepavidheḥ dvau bhedāv iti | pralepapradehākhyāv ity arthaḥ | atha tayor lakṣaṇāny āha | eke viśoṣīty asya sthāne nirviśoṣīti paṭhanti | nirviśoṣī aviśoṣī apīḍayato vraṇaśothaḥ | viśoṣī pīḍayitavyaḥ | yato 'nyety ācāryāḥ śītas tanur ityādilakṣaṇaṃ pradehasyeti vadanti | tatra tanur iti pattalaḥ ghano nibiḍaḥ saghana ity arthaḥ | eṣa uṣṇaḥ śīto veti viṣayaḥ | tatra vātabahule kapha bahule voṣṇaḥ pittaraktabahule śītaḥ, uṣṇādilakṣaṇaṃ pralepasyeti kecin manyante | yataḥ pralepapradehayor anantaraṃ bhedaḥ | atha tanutvaṃ ghanabhāvaṃ capalasya guṇaḥ | tatra kiyatpramāṇotsedhaṃ tasyādṛśyam āha - tayor ity atra pralepapradehayoḥ | kvacid api prāyeṇa pradehas tu mahiṣārdracarmocchrāyāpekṣayā sthūla iti manyante ghanābhidhānāt | tanutvaṃ dehaguṇaṃ manyante teṣāṃ mate kiṃcin nyūnaṃ pradehaḥ pralepasyaitat prativyavahāraḥ | idānīṃ tatpratilomābhilimpatvena phalam āha - tau tu romābhimukhaṃ yathāvasādau limped ity abhiprāyaḥ | yatas tena samyag auṣadham avatiṣṭhate | ata evātra praviśati ca vīryam auṣadhasyetyarthaḥ | kaiḥ kṛtvety āha | romakūpair iti svedavāhibhiḥ śirāmukhaiḥ | etena romakūpāntargataṃ pralepayed iti tātparyārthaḥ | atha lepaviśeṣam āha | na tu rātrau lepanaṃ kuryād ity anena śaityam api hitoṣmaṇas tannirgamād vikārapravṛttir iti | tathā coktaṃ ‘tamasā pihito hy ūṣmā romakūpamukhe sthitaḥ | vinā lepena niryāti rātrau nālepayed ata’ iti | lepanam ity anenātra pralepasya vidhiḥ sūcyate | nanu pradehasyāyato vā ślaiṣmikapākaśothe tu rātrau pradeha upayoktavyaḥ | tathā vidahyamāne śothe pradeha eva kṣate tu kalkopi rātrau dātavya iti | yathā pittaje śothe vātapittaje ca śatadhautaghṛtābhyaṅgādi dātavyam iti | tathā hi | ‘rātrāv api pralepādividhiḥ kāryo vicakṣaṇaiḥ | apākiśothe gaṃbhīre raktaśleṣmasamudbhava’ iti | śuṣyamāṇaṃ na dhārayed iti | śuṣyamāṇaṃ lepam iti śeṣaḥ | yataḥ śuṣko hy anarthako ruk jvaraś ca bhavati | pradehaṃ tu pīḍanaṃ prati śuṣyamāṇaṃ yāvad upekṣeta | pīḍanaṃ vraṇaviśeṣapīḍanadravyairmiśrakāthyāyokter yo vraṇaḥ pīḍanīyas taṃ pratīty arthaḥ | tasmād anyac chuṣyamāṇaṃ nopekṣetetyarthaḥ | asyāgre kecid iti paṭhanti ‘na ca paryuṣitaṃ dadyād dattaṃ ca patitaṃ tathā | na cāpi mukham ālimpet tena doṣaḥ prasicyate’ iti bahupustakeṣv adṛṣṭatvād asmābhir api na likhitaḥ, na tv asaṃgato 'yaṃ ślokaḥ | granthāntareṣv api likhitaḥ || 71-76 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athānantaraṃ sujñasaṃmataḥ anyo 'pi lepavidhiḥ procyate tasya lepavidher dvau bhedau ekaḥ pralepakākhyaḥ | aparaḥ pradehakaḥ | pralepapradehayoḥ unnatatve pramāṇam āha - yadvad ārdraṃ māhiṣaṃ carma pronnataṃ tāvat parimāṇaṃ tayoḥ sāmyam iti maryādā | ālepapradehayor guṇān āha - śītaḥ śītalaḥ śītavīryo vā, tanuḥ sūkṣmaḥ srotaḥpraveśī viśoṣī viśeṣeṇa śītalaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ pralepaḥ parikīrtitaḥ kathitaḥ | ārdraḥ punaḥ uṣṇavīryaḥ uṣṇāni tāpite vā evaṃbhūtaḥ pradehaḥ śrleṣmavātahā bhavati | pralepapradehau kutra dīyete ity āha - pralepākhyapradehakau etau dvau abhimukhaṃ romasanmukhaṃ ādeyau yataḥ śirāmukhai romakūpaiḥ vīryaṃ samyag viśati | lepadhāraṇe niṣiddham āha - rātrau lepanaṃ na kuryāt śuṣyamāṇaṃ ca na dhārayet | śuṣyamāṇam upekṣeta pradehaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati bhavati pradehaḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ dehe pīḍayati | rātripratiṣedhe hetum āha -tamasā andhakāreṇāpihitaḥ ūṣmā romakūpe mukhe sthito bhavati punaḥ vinā lepanenaiva bahir niryāti tasmād rātrau na lepayet na lepaṃ kuryāt | yeṣāṃ rātrau lepaḥ kriyate tān āha - apākiśothe tathā gambhīre gambhīravraṇe tathā raktaśleṣmasamudbhave śothe rātrāv api pralepādividhiḥ kāryaḥ | niṣedho nāsti || 71-76 ||

idānīṃ vraṇaviṣayakramam āha -
ādau śothaharo lepo dvitīyo raktasecanaḥ || 77 ||

lg.l: pañcamaḥ śodhano bhūyāt ṣaṣṭho ropaṇa iṣyate || 78 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. ādau śothaharo lepa ity asya sthāne ādau vimlāpanaṃ kuryād iti paṭhanti vimlāpanam ity aṅgulyādimardanena śodhavilayanaṃ paramārthatas tu naitat pāṭhāntaram | kiṃtu dvayor evaiko 'bhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ vimlāpanaśabdo bahi: pramārjane śophavilapanakaralepapariṣekābhyaṅgasvedādau vartate | tenādau śothaharo lepa ity atra sādhuḥ dvitīya mavasecanam iti | vimlāpanānantaraṃ jalaukādibhī raktaviśrāpaṇam | vimlāpanaṃ vināpi raktamokṣaṇaṃ pracarati | apare tv iti vadanti | avasecanaśabdo 'tra vamanavirecanaśoṇitaviśrāvaṇādyantarbahiḥpramārjane vartate | na tu kevala eva raktaviśrāvaṇe | upanāho nibandhapācanopanāham api pācane vartate | caturtha: pāṭanakrama iti | pāṭanaṃ śastrādinā | pāṭanasthāne pācanam iti kecit | śodhanam avaropaṇaṃ vraṇasyetyarthaḥ | saptamo varṇakaraṇa iti | savarṇakaraṇaṃ māṃsajananaṃ vetyabhiprāyaḥ | ata eva tantrāntare saptamaṃ vaikṛtāpaham iti vacanāt || 77 || 78 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vraṇe śothaharādayaḥ saptopamās tān āha - ete śothaharādayaḥ sapta lepāḥ vraṇe śarīravraṇe kramād ete kathitāḥ || 77 || 78 ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ sa yathety anena vraṇasya saptaviṣayakramāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ yogān āha -
bījapūrajaṭā hiṃsrā devadāru mahauṣadham || 79 ||

lg.l: madhukaṃ candanaṃ mūrvā nalamūlaṃ ca padmakam || 80 ||
dve niśe candane dve ca śivā dūrvā punarnavā || 82 ||
uśīraṃ padmakaṃ lodhraṃ gairikaṃ ca rasāñjanam |
āgantuje raktaje ca śothe kuryāt pralepanam ||83||
savacaḥ kiṇvam atasī pradehaḥ pācanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||84||

ab.seg:
|
tilasaindhavayaṣṭyāhvanimbapatraniśāyugaiḥ |
trivṛddhṛtayutaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ pralepo vraṇaśodhanaḥ || 88 ||

lg.l: tilaiś ca saha saṃyukto lepaḥ śodhanaropaṇaḥ ||89||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. ayaṃ vimlāpanavāriṇā vātaśothapratyanīkatvāt pralepa iti kāryaḥ | tena tathā kāryo yathā pīḍayitavyo vraṇaśotha ity abhiprāyaḥ | atra hiṃsrā bṛhadhiṃsrā, mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī, rāsnā surabhī, agnimantho 'raṇiḥ prasiddhaḥ, madhukādīny atra prasiddhāni | candanam atra raktam | padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ padmākha iti loke | padmaṃ kamalaṃ | pittaśotha iti pittajanitavraṇaśothe | asyāgre kecid iti paṭhanti | ‘śītalāś ca gaṇāḥ sarve pralepaḥ pittaśothahṛt |’ iti suśrutoktaḥ | ayam api saṃgataḥ | tatra śītalagaṇaḥ kākolyādiḥ | utpalādi nyagrodhādayaḥ suśrutoktā boddhavyāḥ | kṛṣṇā pippalī | eke kṛṣṇety anena kṛṣṇamṛd ity atra pracāraḥ sādhur iti vadanti | purāṇapiṇyākam eti | purāṇaṃ varṣoṣitaṃ tilakalkajanitaṃ khaliśabdavācyaṃ śigru | śobhāñjanakaḥ tasya tvak chllī | sikatā vālukā | śivā harītakī | mūtram atra gavyam | pradeha iti pralepabhedaḥ | sa ca pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam eva | athāgaṃtuje rakte ca vraṇe vimlāpanasaṃjñakaṃ pralepam āha - dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ | candane dve ceti śvetaraktabhedena | śivā harītakī | rasāñjanaṃ kvāthasamudbhavam | eke kṛṣṇapāṣāṇavad dravyaviśeṣaṃ rasāñjanam āmananti | etaddvayor alābhe dviguṇaiva dāruharidrā deyā | śotho 'tra vraṇaśothaḥ, pūrvam uktam upanāham api pācane vartate | tadviṣayatvāt pācanam apy āha - śaṇaḥ paripāke sasvanaphalaḥ prasiddhaḥ | mūlakopi vikhyātaḥ, śigraḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ | eteṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ phalāni grāhyāṇīty arthaḥ| tilasarṣape prasiddhe, kiṇvaṃ tu surābījaṃ, tac ca yad bahiḥ prakṣipyate | savaca ity asya sthāne saktava iti paṭhanti | tatra saktavaḥ śītavīryatvepi saṃyogaviṣeṇa prabhāvaviśeṣāt pācanāḥ | eke saktavaḥ kiṇvam atasīdravyāṇy uktāni pācanam iti paṭhanti | tatroṣṇadravyāṇi uṣṇavīryāṇi dravyāṇi tāni kuṣṭhāguruprabhṛtīni | etenānuktapācanadravyasaṃgraha uktaḥ pācanavraṇaśothasyety abhiprāyaḥ | atha pūrvam uktaṃ caturthaḥ pāṭanaḥ krama: sa ca śastrasādhano bhavati | tadabhāvāt pralepādibhir vidāraṇaṃ kāryam | tadvidhānam āha - dantī loke dātunīvācyaṃ | mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tasya mūlatvak | snuk snuhyarkayoḥ kṣīraṃ sruk sehuṇḍaḥ guḍaḥ pratītaḥ | kāsīsaṃ mṛdviśeṣaḥ bhasmavad alpamṛd | asya bhedaḥ puṣpakāsīsaḥ sa ca kiṃcit pītaḥ dāraṇa iti pralepadvāreṇa pakkavraṇasya pāṭanavad vidāraṇo bhavati | aparam api dāraṇam āha | cirabilvo vṛkṣakarañjaḥ virahula iti loke | āgnikaḥ kalikārikākandaḥ | anye bhallātakam āhuḥ | dantī ‘dātunī’vācyaṃ, citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ | hayamārakaḥ karavīraḥ | kapotakaṃkagṛdhrāṇāṃ malam iti | malaṃ purīṣaṃ kapoto vanavāsī pāṇḍukaśabdavācyaḥ kaṅkamalaṃ tu kākaḥ gṛdhro māṃsāśī pakṣiviśeṣaḥ | kapotakaṅkagṛdhrāṇām iti bahuvacanatvenānyeṣām api purīṣeṇa dāraṇaṃ boddhavyam | yathā dṛśyate hi kukkuṭapārāvatādīnāṃ malena vidāraṇaṃ bhavati | ādigrahaṇād īdṛśāny apy anyāni deyāni | eke kṣāradravyāṇi ‘kṣāro vā dāraṇaṃ’ paripaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tatra kṣāradravyāṇi madhūkakuṭajapalāśāśvakarṇapāribhadrādīni | kṣāro veti | etair dravyai: saṃsiddhaḥ sa ca pratisāraṇīyasaṃjñaḥ kṣāraḥ param iti kṛcchradāraṇam asya prabhāvāt | ata eva bālavṛddhādiṣv api yojanīyaḥ | yataḥ dvividhaṃ hi pakvaśothadāraṇaṃ sukumāraṃ kṛcchraṃ ceti | tatra kapotapurīṣādi sukumāram | kṣuraḥ kṛcchra iti | idānīṃ dāraṇam abhidhāyānantaraṃ śodhanam āha | yaṣṭyāhvaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu niśāyugmaṃ haridrādvayaṃ trivṛn niśothaḥ ghṛtam atra gavyaṃ | peṣaṇam atra jalena boddhavyam | vraṇaśodhanaḥ duṣṭapūyasyety arthaḥ | atha śodhanaropaṇāny āha - kṣaudraṃ madhu | dārvī dāruharidrā | śeṣaṃ sugamam | etadyogaṃ vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā yojyaṃ | tena mākṣikasaindhavaṃ śodhane prāyaśo yojyaṃ | nimbapatraṃ tilāś ca ropaṇe | trivṛddantī ca ropaṇe ceti vyavahāraḥ | duṣṭavraṇaṃ nāḍīvraṇaprabhṛtikam | ata eva nimbapatrādīnāṃ kalkarase vartim āhur eke | śodhanaṃ punar aṣṭavidhaṃ vraṇasyeti | tad yathā | kaṣāyavartikalkaghṛtatailarasakriyācūrṇadhūpanabhedenāṣṭavidhaṃ matam || 79-91 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. te yathā - hiṃsrā prasiddhā mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī agnimantho 'raṇiḥ | vātaśothe madhukaṃ yaṣṭī, mūrvā prasiddhā, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | padmaṃ kamalam | pittaśothe kṛṣṇā pippalī purāṇī, śigru śobhāñjanaṃ tasya tvak valkalaṃ | sikatā vālukā śarkarā vā | śivā harītakī śleṣmaśothe dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā dve candane candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ śivā harītakī mūrvā prasiddhā | punarnavā varṣābhūḥ padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭham | rasāñjanaṃ dārvī kvāthodbhūtam āgantuje prahāraje śothe tathā raktaje pralepaḥ | śaṇādīnāṃ phalāni, śaṇaṃ, mūlakaṃ mūlakabījaṃ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanabījāni | saktavaḥ yavasaktavaḥ kiṭṭaṃ lohabhavam atasībījāni | pācano vraṇapācanapākakārī pradeho lepaḥ | dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, citrakaḥ tasya mūlatvak snuk sehuṇḍa, arkaḥ prasiddhaḥ tayoḥ payasi dugdhe kāsīsaṃ(piṣṭvā lepaḥ kāryaḥ) ayaṃ dāraṇavidīrṇakaraḥ dāraṇe lepaḥ cirabilvaḥ karañjaḥ agniko bhallātaḥ dantī jayapālamūlam | citrakamūlaṃ, hayamāraḥ karavīraḥ kapotaḥ pāṇḍukaḥ, kaṅkapakṣī gṛdhraḥ, eṣāṃ malaṃ purīṣaṃ, pakvavraṇadāraṇe lepaḥ yaṣṭyāhvā madhuyaṣṭī niśā haridrā trivṛt niḥsṛtā eṣāṃ ghṛtayuto lepaḥ vraṇaśodhanaropaṇo lepaḥ | kṣaudraṃ madhu | dārvī dāruharidrā madhukaṃ yaṣṭī śodhanaropaṇe ariṣṭo nimbaḥ nirguṇḍī eṣāṃ lepaḥ laśunasyaikasya vā hiṅgunimbabhavo vā lepaḥ | vraṇe kṛmayaḥ ye kīṭās tān hanyāt | vraṇakṛmiṣu lepaḥ nimbeti sugamaṃ śodhanaropaṇe || 79-91 ||

athodaraśūlādau lepaḥ -
madanasya phalaṃ tiktāṃ piṣṭvā kāñjikavāriṇā |
koṣṇaṃ kuryān nābhilepaṃ śūlaśāntir bhavet tataḥ || 92 ||
Āḍhamalla. ayaṃ madanaphalādiyogaḥ kenāpi bhramatvād atra likhitaḥ | aprasaṃgatvāt | yad vā antargatavidradhijanitaśūlaśāntyarthaṃ kathita ity eke || 92 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. madanasya phalaṃ, tiktā kaṭukī, koṣṇam īṣaduṣṇam || 92 ||

idānīṃ vraṇaropaṇakramadvāreṇa sarveṣāṃ vraṇajātīnāṃ śamanayogān āha tatra tāvat pūrvaṃ vidradhau -
śigruśephālikairaṇḍayavagodhūmamudgakaiḥ |
sukhoṣṇo bahalo lepaḥ prayojyo vātavidradhau ||93||

lg.l: sukhoṣṇa: syāt pradeho 'yaṃ mūtraiḥ syāc chleṣmavidradhau ||95||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. anena svedopanāhaś ca kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | upanāhaḥ koṣṇabahulalepaḥ | tac ca sarpiḥṣu pralepo boddhavyaḥ | svedas tu śālvalasvedavat kāryaḥ | teṣu śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ | śephālikā nirguṇḍī | eraṇḍasya snehaḥ tadabhāve jaṭā | yavagodhūmamudgāś cānnaviśeṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ | paittike iti pittajanitavidradhau sarpiṣā goghṛtena lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavā | tathā dvitīyo yogaḥ payasyośīracandanair iti | atrāpi kṣīrapiṣṭair iti sambandhaḥ | tatra payasyā kṣīravidārī tasyāḥ kandam, uśīraṃ sugandhamūlaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣam | candanaṃ raktaṃ pralepatvāt | iṣṭakā prasiddhā, sikatā vālukā, lohakiṭṭaṃ lohasiṅghāṇakam | gośakṛt gomayaṃ, mūtrairity atra gomūtraiḥ iṣṭakāsikatālohagośakṛttuṣapāṃśubhir iti pāṭhāntaraṃ tan na | lohaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ tuṣayavagodhūmajanitaṃ tvagviśeṣaṃ vyavahāratas tu yavagodhūmā eva deyāḥ | pāṃśubhirity anena mṛd grāhyā | sā cātra pītā kṛṣṇā vā | eke tuṣapāṃśubhirity anena tuṣadagdhabhasmabhir iti vyākhyānayanti | niśā haridrā madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu kṣīraṃ gavyam | āgantujaḥ śastralaguḍādiprahārajanita: ||93-96||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vātavidradhau lepaḥ | śigruḥ śobhāñjanam, nirguṇḍī eraṇḍajaṭāyavagodhūmamudgaiḥ sukhoṣṇo bahulepanaḥ eṣāṃ lepaḥ vātasya yā vidradhiḥ vraṇamedaḥ vadha iti prasiddhaḥ iti vātavidradhau lepaḥ | paittikajanye vidradhau lepaḥ sarṣapāḥ siddhārthāḥ lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyāni madhukaṃ yaṣṭī, śarkarā sitopalā ity ekaprakāraḥ kṣīrapiṣṭair dugdhapeṣitaiḥ | pittavidradhau iṣṭikāsikatāvālukālohakiṭṭaṃ gośakṛt purīṣaṃ śleṣmavidradhau lepaḥ niśā haridrā madhukaṃ yaṣṭī gairikaraktāgantujavidradhau || 93-96 ||

atha galagaṇḍe -
niculaḥ śigrubījāni daśamūlam athāpi vā |
pradeho vātagaṇḍeṣu sukhoṣṇaḥ saṃpradīyate || 97 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha gaṇḍamālāyāṃ | niculo jalavetasaḥ | śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ tasya bījāni | etaddvayena eko yogaḥ | daśamūlena kṛtvā dvitīyaḥ | daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | daśadravyāṇi mūlair militaṃ daśamūlam | tad yathā
‘śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā |
tathā gokṣurako bilvaḥ syonākaḥ pāṭalas tathā | agnimanthaś ca kumbhārī daśamūlam iti smṛta’miti | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ chāgamūtraṃ deyam | vyādhisādharmyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt | asyāgre ‘devadāru viśālaṃ ca kaphagaṇḍe pradehaka’ iti paṭhanti kecit | ‘vātagaṇḍe pradehārtham auṣadhaṃ yad udīritam’ ity asya sthāne ‘chāgamūtreṇa tat piṣṭam apacīghnaṃ pralepanāt’ | vātagaṇḍe dravyaṃ niculaśigrubījāni daśamūlakaṃ | tad atrāpi yojyam | anayor bhedas tu pradehapralepaviṣayatvāt | eko vātagaṇḍe pradehārtham auṣadham | yad udīritamity asya sthāne ‘sarṣapāriṣṭapatrāṇi dagdhabhallātakaiḥ saha’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | ayaṃ lepo granthiṣv api yojyaḥ | sarṣapādayo vikhyātā eva || 97-100 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. niculo jalavetasaḥ, śigrubījāni śobhāñjanabījāni, daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | vātagalagaṇḍe viśālā indravāruṇījaṭā | kaphagalagaṇḍe pradehako lepaḥ | athāpacyāṃ lepaḥ sarṣapādīni dagdhvā chāgamūtreṇa lepaḥ | apacīgaṇḍamālābhedaḥ | athā'rbudādau lepaḥ | atasī prasiddhā | spaṣṭam anyat || 97-100 ||

atha gṛdhrasyādiṣu lepaḥ -
takṣayitvā kṣureṇāṅgaṃ kevalānilapīḍitam |
tatra pradehaṃ dadyāc ca piṣṭaṃ guñjāphalaiḥ kṛtam ||101||

lg.l: anyāpi vātajā pīḍā praśamaṃ yāti vegataḥ ||102||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. apabāhuko viśvācī bāhurogo nidānoktaḥ | gṛdhrasī jaṅghārogaḥ | kecit kevalaviṣeṇaiva śītāṅgādau pradehaṃ kurvanti || 101 || 102 ||

ab.seg:
atha ślīpade -
dhattūrairaṇḍanirguṇḍīvarṣābhūśigrusarṣapaiḥ |
pralepaḥ śrīpadaṃ hanti cirottham api dāruṇam || 103||
Āḍhamalla. atha ślīpade | varṣābhūḥ punarnavāśavdavācyā | pralepo 'tra gomūtreṇa vyavahārāt | tadabhāve jalena pracāraḥ || 103 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. varṣābhūḥ punarnavā śigruḥ śobhāñjanaṃ sarṣapaṃ siddhārthaḥ | nirguṇḍī lepaḥ | ślīpado rogaḥ karakarṇādau bhavati | etair dhattūrādibhir lepaḥ || 103 ||

atha aṇḍavṛddhau lepaḥ |
ajājīhapuṣākuṣṭham eraṇḍabadarānvitam |
kāñjikena tu saṃpiṣṭaṃ kuraṇḍaghnaṃ pralepanam || 104 ||
Āḍhamalla. atha kuraṇḍe | ajājī kṛṣṇajīrakaḥ | hapuṣaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ viṭapasaṃjñaṃ | hanuśabdavācyam vadanty eke badarānvitam iti badaraphalānvitaṃ | ayam api lepo bradhnaroge praśastaḥ || 104 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. ajājī hapuṣā badarī | kuraṇḍo 'ṇḍavṛddhiḥ || 104 ||

athopadaṃśe -
karavīrasya mūlena paripiṣṭena vāriṇā |
asādhyāpi vrajaty astaṃ liṅgotthā ruk pralepanāt ||105||

lg.l: dahet kaṭāhe triphalāṃ sā maṣī madhusaṃyutā |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athopadaṃśe | etenopadaśādijanitavyathā astaṃ vrajanti nāśaṃ yāntīty arthaḥ | asau yogo 'pi liṅgalepāt vīryastambhakaratvena darśitaḥ | drāvaṇayogo 'pi kathitaḥ | kaṭāhe lohapātre triphalāharītakīprabhṛtikam | eke tāṃ maṣīmity asya sthāne samāṣām iti vadanti vyākhyānayanti ca | yathā coktaṃ
‘samāṣāṃ triphalāṃ lohapātre mṛṣṭaṃ vicūrṇayet |
hanti kṣaudreṇa lepo 'sya liṅgadoṣān aśeṣataḥ |
rasāñjanaṃ śirīṣeṇa pathyayā ca samanvitam |
sakṣaudralepanaṃ yojyam upadaṃśagadāpaham’ | rasāñjanam atra dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ grāhyaṃ tadabhāve dāruharidraiva | śirīṣeṇeti śirīṣavṛkṣasya tvacā pathyā harītakī tayā saha | śeṣaṃ subodham ||150-107||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karavīrāṃ hayamāraṃ tasya mūlaṃ vāriṇā piṣṭvā lepaḥ kāryaḥ liṅgotthā ruk upadaṃśaḥ | anyac ca triphalābibhītakyāmalakaharītakyādikaṃ kaṭāhe dahen madhunā lepaḥ | anyac ca rasāñjanaṃ’ dārvī kvāthodbhavaṃ, śirīṣaṃ, harītakī, etad api cūrṇitaṃ sakṣaudraṃ madhuyutaṃ vraṇān upadaṃśavraṇān sadyo ropayati | anyac ca ciṃciṇī amlikā tasyās tvacā cūrṇaṃ madhuyuktam api upadaṃśe ||105-107 ||

athāgnidagdhe -
agnidagdhe tugākṣīrīplakṣacandanagairikaiḥ |
sāmṛtaiḥ sarpiṣā snigdhair ālepaṃ kārayed bhiṣak || 108||

lg.l: yavān dagdhvā maṣī kāryā tailena yutayā tayā ||109||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athāgnidagdhe | tugākṣīrī vāṃsī | plakṣaḥ kṣīravṛkṣaḥ pilukhani iti loke | sāmṛtair iti | amṛtā guḍūcī tayā saha | nanūṣṇavīryā guḍūcī dāhanivāraṇāya kathaṃ samarthā ? | ucyate guḍūcīvyavahārād uṣṇavīryā | sparśāt suśītalaiva | tarhi śītasparśakāñjikādau vidyamānaguḍūcyaiva carakagrāhyeti na vācyam | yataḥ svabhāvād iyaṃ śītasparśeṣu viśeṣeṇa dāhaśamana eva | eṣa bhaṭṭārakahariścandrābhiprāyaḥ | guḍūcyā dāhanirvāpakatvam, iti | cakras tu uṣṇavīryā grāhyāpi guḍūcī ācāryapāṭhānurodhena dravyāntarasaṃyogamahimnā na doṣaḥ | tindukaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasya tvak challī tajjanitakaṣāyair iti | kaṣāyaśabdenātra pañcaprakāraṃ sūcayati | tad yathā | svarasakkāthaphāṇṭahimakalkasvarūpaṃ | ghṛtamiśrair iti pañcaprakāreṣv api ghṛtapracāraḥ | dvitīyayogam āha -yavān ityādi | yavo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ, tān dagdhvā maṣī kajjalaṃ kāryaṃ, tilaiḥ tilatailaṃ | tayā maṣīkṛtayā | dagdhayavā maṣījanitapralepenety arthaḥ | sarvāgnidagdheṣviti | caturvidheṣv agnidagdheṣv ity arthaḥ | yataḥ pluṣṭaṃ durdagdhaṃ samyagdagdhamatidagdhamity eṣāṃ vistaronyatratathāhi suśrute - ‘tatra yadvivarṇaṃ pluṣyate'timātraṃ tat pluṣṭam, yatra uttiṣṭhanti sphoṭāstīvrāścoṣadāharāgapākavedanāścirācca upaśāmyanti taddurdagdham; samyagdagdhamanavagāḍhaṃ tālaphalavarṇaṃ susaṃsthitaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇayuktaṃ ca; atidagdhe māṃsā'valambanaṃ, gātraviśleṣaḥ, sirāsnāyusandhyasthivyāpādanamatimātraṃ jvaradāhapipāsāmūrcchāśca upadravā bhavanti; vraṇaśca asya cireṇa rohati rūḍhaśca vivarṇo bhavati’ iti su. sū 12 | jñātavyaḥ || 108 || 109 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tugākṣīryādyairlepaṃ kārayet | tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanā, plakṣaḥ pīlukhani, amṛtā guḍūcī | āmalakaṃ vā taṇḍulīyakaṃ, tvak tajaḥ, tayoḥ kaṣāyaiḥ | yad vā taṇḍulīyatvakkaṣāyairity ekaṃ padam | anyac ca yavān iti sugamam || 108 || 109 ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ lepaprakaraṇatvād anyān api lepān āha tatrādau bhagasaṃkocaḥ -
palāśodumbaraphalais tilatailasamanvitaiḥ || 110 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. palāśodumbarau prasiddhau | tayoḥ phalāni | śeṣaṃ subodhaṃ | mākandaḥ sahakāraḥ tasya mūlaṃ jaṭā | āmrajaṭety arthaḥ | madhuko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥidaṃ tvasaṅgatam | madhu mākṣikaṃ, karpūraṃ prasiddham etairlepanam | ityevābhiprāyo granthakartu: | , pūralepanād bahalalepanāt tu bhagasaṅkocanaḥ || 110 || 111 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. palāśaḥ prasiddhaḥ udumbaraṃ yonidārḍhye mākandaṃ madhu karpūraṃ ca lepaḥ; yad vā mājūphalacūrṇena yonisaṃkocaḥ || 110 || 111 ||

ab.seg:
atha liṅgavṛddhau yonisaṃkoce -
maricaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā tagaraṃ bṛhatīphalam || 112 ||

lg.l: apāmārgas tilāḥ kuṣṭhaṃ yavā māṣāś ca sarṣapāḥ |
aśvagandhā ca taccūrṇaṃ madhunā saha yojayet || 113||
raktasya karavīrasya kāṣṭhena ca muhur muhuḥ || 116 ||
vacā sauvarcalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rajanyau maricāni ca |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. liṅgalepam āhur eke | ayaṃ ślokaḥ kṣepaka iti manyamānair asmābhir api na svīkṛtaḥ | bahupustakeṣv adṛṣṭatvāt ||112-120||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kṛṣṇā pippalī, bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā, apāmārgaḥ prasiddhaḥ māṣo 'nnaviśeṣaḥ sarṣapāḥ siddhārthakā:, spaṣṭam anyat | stanotsedhaḥ stanavṛddhiḥ tathā bhujakarṇayoḥ saṃhatir vṛddhiḥ | atha liṅgavṛddhau sitāśvagandhā śvetapuṣpā'śvagandhā sindhūtthacchāgakṣīraṃ ghṛtāc caturguṇam etair ghṛtaṃ pacet liṅgavṛddhir bhavati | atha yonidrāve sūtaṃ pāradam indravāruṇikāpatrarasaiḥ raktakaravīrakāṣṭhena mardayet talliptaliṅgasaṃyogāt | atha gātradaurgandhye tāmbūlaṃ nāgavalliḥ tatpatracūrṇaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ śivā harītakī vāriṇā jalena lepaḥ gātradaurgandhyanāśanaṃ bhavati | atha svedadaurgandhye kulatthānāṃ saktavaḥ, kuṣṭhaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī candanajo rajaḥ cūrṇaṃ, caṇakasya bharjitasya saktavaḥ, tvak tajaḥ, asyāvadhūlanāt svedadaurgandhyanāśaḥ jāyate | atha vaśīkaraṇe rajanyau dve haridrā dāruharidrā ||112-120||

atha mūrdhatailam -
abhyaṅgapariṣekaś ca picur bastir iti kramāt |
mūrdhatailaṃ caturdhā syād balavac ca yathottaram || 121 ||

Āḍhamalla. atha mūrdhatailasya vidhānam āha - abhyaṅgeti | abhyaṅgādicatuḥprakāraiḥ kṛtvā mūrdhatailam āhuḥ | tac ca yathottaraṃ balavad boddhavyaṃ yo yasmād uttaro yathottaraḥ | tenābhyaṅgāt pariṣeko balavattaro bhavati | pariṣekaḥ picuḥ picor bastir iti | abhyaṅgaś capaṭanamātraḥ śirasy eva | pariṣekodarādibhiḥ secanarūpaḥ picuḥ plotaḥ sa ca taile tūlapaṭalaṃ niṣicya śirasi deya iti picusaṃjñaḥ | bastiṃr vakṣyamāṇavidhānatvāt pragaṭa eva || 121 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. abhyaṅgaḥ mardanaṃ, pariṣekaḥ tailāvagāhanaṃ, picuḥ plotaḥ tūlavastrādi tailāktadhāraṇaṃ, basticarmajanyā tad vakṣyati mūrdhatailaṃ mastakadhāraṇatailaṃ caturdhā syād bhavet | tac ca yathottaraṃ balavat balakāri mūrdhaprayogāt abhyaṅgaḥ pariṣekāder vaktavyaḥ || 121 ||

athābhyaṅgabastiprakāram āha -
śirobastividhiś cātra procyate sujñasaṃmataḥ ||122||

lg.l: tāvad dhāryas tu yāvat syān nāsākarṇamukhasrutiḥ ||124||
prayojyas tu śirobastiḥ pañcasaptāham eva vā |
vimocya śiraso bastiṃ gṛhṇīyāc ca samantataḥ ||126||
ūrdhvakāyaṃ tataḥ koṣṇanīraiḥ snānaṃ ca kārayet |
anena durjayā rogā vātajā yānti saṃkṣayam ||127||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha caturbhedeṣu bastividhir adhunocyate | śirobastividhir iti śirobastiḥ kartavyavidhānaṃ śirasaś carmanirmitaḥ pātrākāro bastir ity ucyate | sujñasaṃmatety anena svabuddhyā na likhitety abhiprāyaḥ | tad idānīṃ basteḥ svarūpam āha - dvimukha iti ubhayato mukhaḥ| dvādaśāṅgula ity aunnatyena | śiraḥpramāṇam iti vistārabhedena | nanu tantrāntare śirobastipramāṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulotsedhaṃ darśitam | tathā hi - ‘āśiro vyāyataṃ carma prayojyaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam’ iti tat kathaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam uktam | ucyate, tac carma tryaṅgulavastrapaṭṭena śirasi badhvā tad adho māṣakalkena lepayet | uparibhāgaṃ tv ekāṅgulaparimitaṃ carma tailahīnaṃ kāryam iti vyavahāraḥ | tena dvādaśāṅgulaṃ carma tailena pūryate iti bhāvaḥ | yataḥ ‘carmādhas tryaṅgulair hīnaṃ kṛtvordhvaṃ cāṅgulonmitam | ṣoḍaśāṅgulaṃ yac cheṣaṃ tat tailena prapūrayet’ iti saṃpradāyoktatvāt | tasmād atrācāryeṇa tailapūraṇārtham eva dvādaśāṅgulaṃ svīkṛtam | śeṣaṃ tu vyavahārato dṛṣṭvā caturaṅgulaṃ kāryam ity adoṣaḥ | āśu ity anena tatkālam eva tailanikṣepaṇaṃ kuryād yāvan māṣapiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ na bhavatīty āśupadābhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ śuṣkeṇa māṣapiṣṭena tailakṣaraṇaṃ bhavati ārdreṇa tan na bhavatīty arthaḥ | snehair iti yathāvyādhi tais tailaiḥ| atha kiyatkālaṃ bastidhāraṇaṃ tam āha - etadbastidhāraṇasaṃketatrayaṃ doṣakālādiviṣayaṃ | nāsākarṇamukhasrutirity anena tanmalasravaṇaṃ | kutaḥ śiraḥsthitaromakūpagatailaprabhāvāt | doṣasaṃvalanād vā | athavā vedanayā yāvad upaśamaḥ śītas tāvac chirobastir dhārya ity arthaḥ | etaddvitayasya kadācid aniyatatvāt tṛtīyaṃ niyatakālam āha - mātrāṇāṃ vā sahasrakam iti yāvat sahasramātrāṇi bhavanti tāvad eva dhāryaḥ | vāgrahaṇenātrāpi pañcaśatamātrāṣṭaśataṃ vā doṣāpekṣayā'vagantavyā iti pracāraḥ | asyāgne kecid iti paṭhanti ‘dhārayed arujaḥ śānte yāmaṃ yāmārdham eva vā iti | ayaṃ tantrāntarād atra kenacil likhitaḥ | na svamataṃ | pūrveṇaiva kṛtārthatvāt | asya vyākhyā - ā rujaḥ śānter dhārayed vāte pitte yāmaṃ, yāmārdhaṃ kaphe iti | mātrālakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā vāgbhaṭe - ‘yāvat paryeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā'sya sā smṛtā’ iti | atha kasmin kāle śirobasti: kāryas tam āha -vinā bhojanaṃ vinety anena pūrvāhṇe 'sya pracāraḥ samīcīnaḥ | atreti caturdhā mūrdhataile | tena kevalabastir eva bhojanādau kāryaḥ | nābhyaṅgāditritayamity abhiprāyaḥ | atha yāvaddinaparyantaṃ bastiyogo vidheyaḥ tāvaddinasaṃkhyāṃ darśayitum āha - pañcāhaṃ saptāhaṃ yāvad doṣādibalāpekṣayāvagantavyaṃ | pañcasaptadinagrahaṇam atra sāmānyam | vyavahāras tv ekadinam ārabhya yāvad rogasaṃkṣayas tāvaddinaparyantaṃ kārya ity asmadīyasaṃpradāyasyābhiprāyaḥ | atha kena prakāreṇa bastyapanayanaṃ tam āha | śiraso mastakāt basticarmapuṭakaṃ vimocya yatnena dūrīkṛtya samantataḥ parito gṛhṇīyāt tailam iti śeṣaḥ | arthāt pūrvaṃ tadbhṛtatailaśeṣeṇāpi niyatabastiṃ vimocayed iti bhāvaḥ | paścāt kāryam āha - ūrdhvakāyam ityādi | ūrdhvakāyaṃ mastakaṃ koṣṇanīrair itīṣaduṣṇaiḥ | nanūṣṇajalaiḥ śirapariṣeko na pathyatamaḥ | tathā ca ‘uṣṇāmbunādha:kāyasya pariṣeko balāvahaḥ | tenaiva tūttamāṅgasya balahṛt keśacakṣuṣāṃ’miti | tat katham atra vihitam ? ucyate, atra koṣṇairity anena kiṃciduṣṇajalena sakṛd eva snānaṃ, na tu bahaloṣṇajalenety arthaḥ | idānīṃ bastividhānena kṛte sati tadguṇaviśeṣam āha - anena bastividhānena durjayā vātajā rogāḥ śiraḥkampādayaḥ mahārogatvād vātajanitā durjayā eva | vātagrahaṇenaiva pittakaphagatā api rogā veditavyāḥ | tatpradhānatvāt | yataḥ ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvān eva prakopayet’ iti vacanāt | ata eva sarvakāleṣu yujyata iti | sarvakālaṃ śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇaṃ | tena ṣaḍṛtuṣu śirobastiḥ kārya iti tātparyārthaḥ || 122-127 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pūrvaṃ ye uktā abhyaṅgādayas te suprasiddhā lokavihitāḥ | sujñasaṃmataḥ śirobastividhi: | atra procyate tatprakāram āha - śirobasti sugamam | ekaṃ sukhaṃ svalpam upari tailapātanārtham adhomukhaṃ mastakapramāṇam | vastre dhāraṇapramāṇam āha - yāvan nāsānetramukhastrutiḥ jalasrāvaḥ syāt tāvad bastidhāraṇaṃ; vā pakṣāntare yāvad vedanenopaśamaḥ śirorogādināśanaṃ; tāvad dhāraṇaṃ; yāvan mātrāṇāṃ sahasraikaṃ tāvad dhāraṇaṃ; mātrālakṣaṇaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ ‘yā tu maṇḍalam āvṛtye’tyādi | atha bastidhāraṇakālam āha pañcāhaṃ pañcadinaṃ vā prayogaḥ śirobasteḥ | uktakriyām āha - sugamam | atha bastidāne ke rogā yāntīty āha - aneneti sugamam | iti bastikarma || 122-127 ||

pūrvam uktaṃ lepamūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇaṃ tad idānīṃ karṇapūraṇam āha -
svedayet karṇadeśaṃ tu kiñcin nuḥ pārśvaśāyinaḥ ||128||

lg.l: mūtraiḥ snehai rasaiḥ koṣṇais tataḥ śrotraṃ prapūrayet |
karṇaṃ ca pūritaṃ rakṣec chataṃ pañca śatāni vā || 129 ||
eṣā mātrā bhaved ekā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ ||
rasādyai: pūraṇaṃ karṇe bhojanāt prāk praśasyate ||131||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. mūtrair iti | bahuvacanatvenātrāṣṭānāṃ mūtrāṇāṃ madhye 'nyatamena kaduṣṇena karṇapūra: kāryaḥ | tathā ca tantrāntare ‘aṣṭānām api mūtrāṇāṃ mūtreṇānyatamena vā | koṣṇena pūrayet karṇaṃ karṇamūlopaśāṃtaya’ iti | mūtrāṣṭakaṃ yathā - ‘mūtraṃ gonāgamahiṣīhayājāvikharoṣṭraka’miti | snehair iti | ghṛtatailādibhiḥ pakvair apakvair veti pracāraḥ | atrāpi koṣṇair iti saṃbandhaḥ | rasair iti svarasaiḥ | tena sadyorasaiḥ kvathitarasair veti vyavahāraḥ | yatas trividho raso 'tra rasakalpanāyāṃ pratipāditaḥ tat tatraiva jñātavyaṃ atrāpi īṣaduṣṇair iti yojyam | atha yāvatkālaṃ karṇapūraṇaṃ dhāryaṃ tāvatkālapramāṇam āha - pūraṇam atra tailamūtrādibhiḥ | śataṃ pañcaśatāni ceti mātrāviṣayaṃ | mātrālakṣaṇaṃ tu ‘yāvat paryeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇe jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena, samaṃ mātrāsya sā smṛtā’ iti | śrotrakaṇṭhaśirogada iti | śrotragade kaṇṭhagade śirogade iti | etena kim uktaṃ śrotragade śatamātraṃ | kaṇṭhagade pañjaśatamātraṃ | śirogade sahasramātramity abhiprāyaḥ | hadānīṃ karṇapūraṇasya tailarasaviṣayatvāt kālavibhāgam āha - rasādyair ityādigrahaṇāt kvāthakalkapuṭapākādibhiḥ | bhojanāt prāk prātaḥkālādyair iti ādiśabdān mūtraghṛtakṣīrādibhiḥ | bhāskarestam upāgate iti sāyaṃkāle || 128-131 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha karṇapūraṇam | kiṃcit pārśvaśāyinaḥ nuḥ manuṣyasya kīṭadeśaṃ svedayet, tataḥ śrotraṃ karṇaṃ mūtrādyaiḥ prapūrayet | nur iti nṛśabdasya ṣaṣṭhī | mūtraiḥ gomūtrādyaiḥ snehaiḥ tailādyai rasaiḥ auṣadharasaiḥ koṣṇair īṣaduṣṇaiḥ karṇapūritaṃ kiyatkālam ity āha - śrotraṃ karṇaṃ, kaṇṭho galaḥ, śiraḥ prasiddhaṃ tadroge mātrāṇāṃ śataṃ pañcaśatāni vā sahasraṃ vā pūritaṃ karṇaṃ rakṣayet | mātrālakṣaṇam āha - svajānutaḥ kareṇa sparśanāc choṭikayā lakṣaṇayā karāvartaṃ hastasaṃkocaṃ kuryāt | eṣā mātrā ekā bhavet | idaṃ bastikarma ādau tailāvagāhanādau pramāṇam uktaṃ īdṛśī śatamātrā'vadhārayet | rasādinā pūrṇakālam āha - rasādyaiḥ auṣadharasādyaiḥ bhojanāt prāk prathamaṃ tailādyair bhāskare sūrye astaṃ gate prāpte sati praśasyate || 128-131 ||

karṇaśūle yogāḥ -
pītārkapatram ājyena liptaṃ vahnau pratāpayet || 132||

lg.l: śṛṅgaberaṃ ca madhukaṃ madhu saindhavam āmalam || 134 ||
kaduṣṇaṃ karṇayor deyam etad vā vedanāpaham || 135 ||
puṭapākakramaṃ kṛtvā rasais tac ca prapūrayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. saṃprati karṇapūraṇārthaṃ yogavarān āha - pītaṃ pītavarṇaṃ yad arkasya patraṃ tat ājyena ghṛtena liptvā vahnau pratāpya tadraso grāhyaḥ | pītatvam atra paripākād bhavati | karṇaśūlāture śate | atrādipadaṃ luptaṃ jñeyaṃ tena ityādiśabdāt saśabde | karṇaroge 'sya pracāraḥ | śṛṅgaberam ārdrakaṃ, tadabhāve śuṇḍīti sarvatra | madhu cety asya sthāne madhukapāṭhaḥ saṃgataḥ | tatra madhuyaṣṭī śuṇṭhyādīnāṃ pratyekaḥ prayogaḥ kāryaḥ | kecit tu śṛṅgaberaprabhṛtīnāṃ kalkena tailaṃ saṃpācya deyam iti vyākhyānayanti | kapitthādīnāṃ svarasena karṇapūraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tac cātra vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā grāhyam | kapittho dadhiphalaḥ | mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ | amlo 'mlavetasaḥ | śṛṅgaveram ārdrakam | śubhairity anena teṣāṃ sadyorasaiḥ na tu śṛtapīḍanādijanitaiḥ | arkāṅkuro 'tra komalapallavaḥ tatsaṃbhavatvāt | amlapiṣṭān iti | amlaḥ kāñjikaḥ | tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavam | lavaṇaḥ saindhavaḥ, snuhī sehuṇḍaḥ tacchadāḥ sehuṇḍapatrāṇi | puṭapākakramaṃ puṭapākavidhānena boddhavyam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 132-138 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pītārkapatraṃ pītavarṇam arkapatram ājyena lepayet talliptaṃ punaḥ vahnau agnau taptaṃ kārayet punas tadrasaṃ niṣkāsayet tadrasaḥ śravaṇe karṇe kṣiptaḥ śūlaharo bhavati, bastaḥ chāgaḥ karṇasya śūle pāke ca, śṛṅgaberaṃ śuṇṭhī ārdrakaṃ vā, madhu kṣaudraṃ saindhavaṃ lavaṇam āmalam āmalakaṃ tilaparṇī śākavarge, tailaṃ kaṭutailaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ, nimbukadravaḥ nimbūrasaḥ, kaduṣṇam īṣaduṣṇaṃ karṇayoḥ pūraṇe deyam etad vedanāśūlaharam | karṇaśūle mātuluṅgaḥ amlo amlavetasaḥ, śṛṅgaberam ārdrakaṃ, spaṣṭam anyat | karṇaśūle - arkāṅkurān amlapiṣṭān amlaṃ nimbukādi, punaḥ lavaṇānvitān prāptān kṛtvā korite chidrite snuhīkāṇḍe sehuṇḍakāṇḍe tat chadā ghṛte tatpatrāvṛte mṛllipte puṭapākakramaṃ kuryāt tadrasaḥ karṇe pūrayet | iti karṇe rasapūraṇam || 132-138||

dīpikātailam |
mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṇḍāny aṣṭāṅgulāni ca |
kṣaumeṇāveṣṭya saṃsicya tailenādīpayet tataḥ || 139 ||

lg.l: yat tailaṃ cyavate tebhyaḥ sukhoṣṇaṃ tena pūrayet |
jñeyaṃ tad dīpikātailaṃ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||140||
evaṃ syād dīpikātailaṃ kuṣṭhe devatarau tathā |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. mahatpañcamūlasya pratyekam aṣṭāṅgulamitāni kāṣṭhāni | mahatpañcamūlaṃ yathā ‘bilvo 'gnimanthaḥ syonākaḥ kāśmaryaḥ pāṭalā mahat’ iti | devatarur devadāruḥ || 139 || 140 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karṇaśūle - mahataḥ bṛhataḥ bilvādeḥ pañcamūlasya kāṇḍāni aṣṭāṅgulāni kṣaumeṇa veṣṭayet kāryasamaye vā punaḥ tailenā'sicya punar dīpayet jvālayet | tataḥ yat tailaṃ cyavate tad dīpikātailaṃ tena pūrayet ||139|| 140||

ab.seg:
syonākatailam |
tailaṃ syonākamūlena mande 'gnau paripācitam ||141||
Āḍhamalla. syonākamūlasya kalkakvāthenety arthaḥ ||141||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. syonākaḥ araluvṛkṣaḥ tanmūlakalkena tailaṃ pacet iti karṇaśūle syonākatailam || 141 ||

yaṣṭīvasā |
kalkakvāthena yaṣṭyāhvakākolīmāṣadhānyakaiḥ ||142||
Āḍhamalla. kalkakvāthenetyādi yogaḥ, sugamam ||142||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha karṇanāde yaṣṭyādikalkakvāthena kalkena paktvā śūkaravasā snehaḥ karṇanādaharo bhavati | dhānyakaṃ prasiddham | māṣo māṣānnam || 142 ||

svarjikātailam |
svarjikā mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ hiṅgu kṛṣṇāsamanvitam ||143||

lg.l: śatapuṣpā ca tais tailaṃ pakkaṃ sūktacaturguṇam |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. svarjiketyādi | svarjikā kṣāraviśeṣaḥ, mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tac ca śuṣkaṃ grāhyaṃ, kṛṣṇā pippalī, hiṅgu rāmaṭhaṃ, mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ śuktaṃ kāñjikā sā ca caturguṇā grāhyā | svarjikādīnām atra jalena kalkam āhuḥ | eke hiṅgukṛṣṇāsamanvitamity asya sthāne hiṅgukṛṣṇāmahauṣadham iti paṭhanti | mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhīti pracāro 'sādhuḥ || 143 || 144 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karṇanāde - svarjikākṣāraḥ, mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ grāhyam | hiṅgu, kṛṣṇā pippalī, śatapuṣpā | idaṃ kalkadravyaṃ tailāc caturthāṃśaṃ, śuktam amlaviśeṣa āsavoktaḥ | etat tailaṃ vrāṇādīn nāśayet | iti svarjikādyaṃ tailaṃ karṇanādādau | apāmārgabhasmajalaṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā vastrapūtaṃ kārayet tajjalena kṣāram eva kalkitaṃ kākarūpaṃ kṣipet tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ bādhiryaṃ jayet || 143||144 ||

ab.seg:
apāmārgakṣāratailaṃ bādhirye -
apāmārgakṣārajale tatkṣāraṃ kalkitaṃ kṣipet |
tena pakvaṃ jayet tailaṃ bādhiryaṃ karṇanādakam || 145 ||

Āḍhamalla. apāmārgaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya kṣārodake kalkitaṃ tatkṣāram iti | apāmārgapañcāṅgakalkaṃ tatra gholayitvā tena tailaṃ vipācya deyam ity arthaḥ | tantrāntare 'pi apāmārgakṣārajalena tatkṛtakalkena sādhitaṃ tilajam ityādi paribhāṣoktatvāt | kṣārodakaṃ tailāc caturguṇaṃ deyam | kalkaṃ tu caturthāṃśam iti || 145 ||

śambūkatailam -
śambūkasya tu māṃsena pacet tailaṃ tu sārṣapam |
tasya pūraṇamātreṇa karṇanāḍī praśāmyati || 146 ||
Āḍhamalla. śambūko jalaśuktiḥ syāt tanmadhyagatamāṃsaviśeṣeṇa tailāc caturguṇena māṃsakvāthajalenety artha: | māṃsaṃ tu tailasāmyam iti vyavahārāt || 146 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śambūko jalaśuktiḥ, tanmāṃsena tailaṃ pacet tailāc caturthāṃśaṃ māṃsam iti | śambukatailaṃ karṇanāḍīṣu || 146 ||

karṇasrāve yogāḥ -
cūrṇaṃ pañcakaṣāyāṇāṃ kapittharasam eva ca |
karṇasrāve praśaṃsanti pūraṇaṃ madhunā saha || 147 ||

lg.l: tindukāny abhayā lodhraḥ samaṅgā cāmalaky api |
jñeyāḥ pañca kaṣāyās tu karmaṇy asmin bhiṣagvaraiḥ ||148||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. cūrṇaṃ pañcakaṣāyāṇām iti | cūrṇamity eko yogaḥ | kapittharasena madhuyuktena dvitīyaḥ | eke pañcakaṣāyāṇām eva cūrṇaṃ kapittharasenāloḍya madhuyuktaṃ ca karṇapūraṇam āhuḥ | pañcakaṣāyāṇi yathā - tinduketi | eke āragvadhaśirīṣajambūaśvatthasarjānāṃ pañcakaṣāyatvaṃ kathayanti || 147 || 148 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karṇasrāve | tindukaṃ vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ abhayā harītakī lodhraḥ samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā āmalakī ete kaṣāyavṛkṣāḥ eṣāṃ cūrṇam asmin karmaṇi karṇapūraṇe || 147 ||

svarjikārasayogaḥ -
svarjikācūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ bījapūrarasaṃ kṣipet |
karṇastrāvarujādāhāḥ praṇaśyanti na saṃśaya: || 149||
Āḍhamalla. bījapūraphalasvarasaṃ, tatra manāk svarjikākṣāraprakṣiptaṃ deyam || 149 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. svarjikākṣāraḥ, taccūrṇaṃ tathā bījapūrarasam || 149 ||

āmrāditailam |
āmrajambūpravālāni madhukasya vaṭasya ca |
ebhiḥ saṃsādhitaṃ tailaṃ pūtikarṇopaśāntikṛt ||150||

Āḍhamalla. atra jambūpatrāṇi jambvāmrayos taruṇapatrāṇīty artha: | evaṃ madhukasya vaṭasya ceti | tailam atra nimbakarañjasarṣapajanitam api deyam | tathā ca - ‘etaiḥ śṛtaṃ nimbakarañjatailaṃ sasārṣapaṃ srāvaharaṃ pradiṣṭam’ iti | nimbādīnāṃ tailaṃ jalena sādhyaṃ militatvāt ||150||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karṇasrāve - āmrajambūnāṃ patrāṇi madhukasya vaṭasya ca pallavāni ebhiḥ sādhitaṃ kṛtaṃ tailaṃ pūtikarṇarogaśāntikṛt | pūtikarṇe pūraṇam iti sugamam || 150 ||

karṇakīṭe hīratālādiyogaḥ -
pūraṇaṃ haritālena gavāṃ mūtrayutena ca
athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ karṇakīṭaharaṃ param || 151 ||

Āḍhamalla. mūtrayutena haritālenaiko yogaḥ | kevalasārṣapatailena dvitīyaḥ | asmatsaṃpradāye tu gomūtreṇa haritālaṃ saṃpiṣya tena kaṭutailaṃ vipācya tat tailaṃ grāhyam iti pracarati | ‘athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ karṇakaṭiharaṃ param’ ity asya sthāne ‘dhūpanaṃ karṇadaurgandhye gugguluḥ śreṣṭha ucyata’ iti kecit paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 151 ||

karṇakīṭe – śigrusvarasādiyogaḥ -
svarasaṃ śigrumūlasya sūryāvartarasaṃ tathā |
tryūṣaṇaṃ cūrṇitaṃ caiva kapikacchūjaṭārasam || 152 ||
kṛtvaikatra kṣipet karṇe karṇakaṭiharaṃ param | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe lepādividhir nāmai- kādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
Āḍhamalla. sūryāvartā suvarcalā | sā dvidhā ekā mocalīśabdavācyā | aparā brahmasauvarcalīti | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukam | kapikacchū vānarī | śeṣaṃ subodham || 152 ||
iti śrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracite śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe lepamūrdhatailakarṇa- pūraṇā'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. karṇakīṭe - śigru: śobhāñjanam, tasya svarasaḥ sūryāvartā suvarcalā tasyā vā svarasaḥ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭucūrṇaṃ tathā kapikacchū vānarī | sadyoniḥsṛtasvarasaṃ | sudāruṇaṃ karṇakīṭaharaṃ karṇapūraṇāt || 152 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthapikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne lepanādi- vidhir apyāyaḥ ||11||

div.head: atha raktamokṣavidhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha śoṇitavisrāvavidhir adhunā vidhīyate atha śoṇitasrāvavidhiḥ | sambandhaś cāyaṃ yathā lepādayo dehakāntikarās tadvac choṇitavisrāvaṇam api | ataḥ śoṇitasrāvaṇam āha -
śoṇitaṃ srāvayej jantor āmayaṃ prasamīkṣya ca |
prasthaṃ prasthārdhakaṃ vāpi prasyārdhārdham athāpi vā || 1 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. prastham atra sārdhatrayodaśapalāni | tathā coktaṃ ‘vamane ca vireke ca tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe | sārdhatrayodaśapalaṃ prastham āhur manīṣiṇa’ iti | nanu tantrāntare prasthaṃ prasthadvayaṃ ca krameṇa raktasrāvaṃ kathitaṃ tathā hi - ‘jaghanyamadhyaprabaleṣu vegāś catvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍ aṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthas tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe ca’ iti | tat kkātham atra prasthaṃ prasthārdhaṃ ca kathitaṃ, katham ? ucyate | tantrāntare yad idaṃ tad bahudoṣasyāvajinaḥ puruṣasya paraṃ pramāṇam āmananti | atra tu saśeṣadoṣaraktaṃ rakṣaṇīyam ity ālocyācāryeṇa prasthādisaṃgrahaḥ kṛta ity adoṣaḥ | tathā hi ‘raktaṃ svabhāvād ṛtuvihitatvād anāturasyāpi raktasrutiḥ praśastā’ iti | yataḥ pittaṃ śaradi kupyatīti vacanād raktasyāpi kopo bhavatīti niyamaḥ | tathā ca pittaprakopeṇaiva śoṇitaṃ ca prakupyatīti| tasmāc charadi śoṇitavisrāvaṇaṃ vihitam | tatsrāvaṇāt tvagdoṣādayo 'pi na syu: | tvagdoṣā aṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni nyacchanīlikādayaś ca | granthayo vātādimilitvā śirāgranthiś ca | śothā doṣaduṣṭibhavā vraṇaśothādayaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt anye 'pi śoṇitajā rogā raktagulmavidradhivisarpādayaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha śoṇitasrāvavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma: | āmayaṃ raktajanyaṃ kuṣṭādyaṃ rogaṃ prasamīkṣya dṛṣṭvā janto: prāṇinaḥ śoṇitaṃ srāvayet | kiyatparimitaṃ srāvayed ity āha - prasthaṃ mukhyaṃ prasthārdhaṃ madhyaṃ prasthārdhārdhaṃ nyūnaṃ vā kadā raktaṃ srāvayet svabhāvena raktasrāvasvabhāvena śaratkāle raktasrutiṃ srāvaṃ kuryāt, kutaḥ ? tvagdoṣā granthiśothādyā raktasruter yato na syuḥ kuṣṭhavātaraktādayaḥ | granthir vraṇādigranthiḥ || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg:
ādau raktasya rasavarṇaguṇādīn āha -
madhuraṃ varṇato raktam aśītoṣṇaṃ tathā guru |
śoṇitaṃ snigdhavisraṃ syād vidāhaś cāsya pittavat ||3||

lg.l: visratā dravatā rāgaś calanaṃ vilayas tathā |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha śoṇitasya prakṛtiṃ vaktum āha | madhuraṃ varṇata iti | makṣikāpipīlikādīnāṃ prācuryam upasarpaṇān mādhuryam asya pratītam | varṇato raktam iti | raktam āraktam indragopaprakāśam ity eke, tad eva padmālaktaguñjāphalavarṇam apy uktam | athavā vastrādilagnaṃ sat prakṣālyamānam api na vivarṇatāṃ yātīty apare | aśītoṣṇam iti | na caikāntataḥ śītaṃ nātyuṣṇam iti | yato 'gnīṣomīyād raktasya tattulyaguṇayor amlaśītayor abhilāṣo raktakṣaye bhavatīti darśanāt | athavā prakopo 'sya doṣair eva tanmūlatvadoṣānurūpam anuṣṇaśītam | tathā hi - ‘yasmād raktaṃ vinā doṣair na kdācit prakupyati | tasmāt tasya yathādoṣaṃ kālaṃ vidyāt prakopanam’ iti | snigdhavisraṃ syād iti | snigdhaṃ vikṣuṇṇaṃ visram āmagandhi vidāhaś cāsya pittavad iti pittasya yena vastunā yathā vidāhas tena vastunā tathā vidāhaḥ śoṇitasyāpīty arthaḥ | atha śoṇite pāñcabhautikatvaṃ pratipādayann āha - yasmādeti visrādaya: pṛthivyādīnāṃ guṇāḥ śoṇite dṛśyante tasmād raktaṃ pāñcamautikam iti | tatra visratā vigandho bhūmiguṇaḥ dravatā dravabhāgo 'yam ambuguṇaḥ | rāgo raktatā tejoguṇaḥ | calanaṃ naikatra sthitiśīlatvam ayaṃ vātaguṇaḥ sādanam ity apare | vilaya iti vilayanopy ākāśaguṇaḥ | eke vilayasthāne laghuteti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | bhūmyādipañcabhūtānām iti | ādiśabdena aptejovāyvākāśāni gṛhyante ||3 || 4 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. raktam ādau rasato madhuraṃ, varṇato raktaṃ, guṇata aśītoṣṇaṃ, tathā gurumātrayā guru, tathā snigdhaṃ, sacikkaṇaṃ, visram āmagandhi, vidāho dāhakartṛtvaṃ ca asyāpi tad eva | rakte bhūmyādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ guṇāś ca santi tān āha - visratā āmagandhitā bhūmiguṇaḥ sacchidratā vā | ete guṇāḥ bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāṃ kramāt smṛtā: ||3||4||

ab.seg:
duṣṭaraktalakṣaṇe kiṃ bhavatīty āha -
rakte duṣṭe vedanā syāt pāko dāhaś ca jāyate |
raktamaṇḍalatā kaṇḍūḥ śothaś ca piṭikodgamaḥ || 5 ||

lg.l: gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ nidrā mado dāhaś ca jāyate || 6 ||
śaithilyaṃ ca sirāṇāṃ syād vātād unmārgagāmitā ||7||
aruṇaṃ phenilaṃ rūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu śīghragam |
pittena pītaṃ haritaṃ nīlaṃ śyāvaṃ ca visrakam |

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. idānīṃ duṣṭaraktasyā'pi lakṣaṇam āha - rakte duṣṭe iti | vātādidoṣadūṣite vedanā pīḍā pāko dāhaś ca vraṇeṣv eva prācuryam asyābhihitam | raktamaṇḍalateti raktavarṇamaṇḍalotpattiḥ | kaṇḍūḥ pāmāviśeṣaḥ, śotho vraṇaśothaḥ, piḍakā granthādayaḥ | atha raktātivṛddhau satyāṃ kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tad āha -raktāṅganetratvam iti | tena raktāṅganetratā ca bhavati, sirāṇāṃ pūrṇatā tatheti | sirāś cātra raktavahā jñeyāḥ, tāsāṃ pūrṇatā raktatety arthaḥ | medo medovṛddhiḥ prāyeṇātrāsthigatamedovṛddhiḥ syād ity atra viṣayaḥ yataḥ ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tv abhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu satataṃ meda ucyata’ iti | kṣīṇe 'mlamadhurākāṅkṣeti | śoṇitakṣaye sati vātavṛddhau satyāṃ tatpratīkārārthatvād amlarasecchā | tathā raktasya dravatvāt tatkṣaye sati tejovṛddhau satyāṃ madhuraprārthanā | eke kṣīṇe 'mlaśītalākāṅkṣeti paṭhanti | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | tvagvirūkṣateti vātavṛddhitaḥ sirāṇāṃ raktavahānāṃ ca śaithilyaṃ bhavati | atiraktatvāt | ghātāt prahārāt unmārgagamitā raktasyety arthaḥ | idānīṃ duṣṭaraktasya vātādīnāṃ pratyekalakṣaṇāny āha | aruṇādyuktalakṣaṇai: kṛtvā vātadūṣitaṃ raktaṃ jānīyāt | tatrāruṇam īṣadraktaṃ kṛṣṇābhāvaṃ vyākhyānayanti | phenilaṃ phenayuktaṃ paruṣam apicchilaṃ, tanu acchaṃ, śīghragam āśupravṛtti ata evāvaskandādīni | askandi styānarahitam | sūcībhir iva nistodanaṃ gātreṣu pittena yadā duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ syāt tadā etādṛśaṃ bhavati kiṃ tat pītam iti|| pītaṃ pītavarṇam | tac ca nirāmāvasthāyāṃ bhavati | haritaṃ śyāmavatpratibhāsam | nīlaṃ haritaśyāvam | tac ca sāmāvasthāyāṃ bhavati | śyāvaṃ haritakṛṣṇam | visrakam āmagandhikam | askandi ceti styānarahitam | bhakṣikāpipīlikānāniṣṭam iti | aniṣṭam apriyam | yataḥ tāsāṃ mate 'nusaraṇād aniṣṭatvam avagantavyaṃ kaphadūṣitaṃ raktam īdṛśaṃ bhavati śītalaṃ sparśād vīryāt bahalaṃ dhanaṃ gairikodakasannibham iti pāṇḍulohitaṃ kathitam | māṃsapeśīprabham iti styānatvāt | pāṇḍulohitam iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva skandi kathitam | skanditvād evam avargatvam asyoktam | atha saṃsargasannipātānvitaraktavikṛter lakṣaṇāny āha - dvidoṣaduṣṭaṃ śoṇitam iti śeṣaḥ, yato dvābhyāṃ doṣābhyāṃ dūṣitaṃ tat saṃsṛṣṭam iti kathitam | etena dvābhyāṃ lakṣaṇābhyāṃ militaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | triduṣṭaṃ raktaṃ sannipātadūṣitaṃ kathitaṃ tribhir doṣair dūṣitaṃ triduṣṭam | tac ca pūtigandhikaṃ bhavati | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktam iti | sarveṣāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ lakṣaṇair yuktam iti | tad eva kāñjikābhaṃ ca bhavatīti | idānīṃ viṣaduṣṭasya raktasyākṛtiṃ darśayann āha - viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ tena duṣṭaṃ dūṣitam ity arthaḥ | īdṛśaṃ kena lakṣitaṃ tad āha - śyāvam iti | haritakṛṣṇaṃ varṇato bhavati | nāsikonmārgagaṃ tatheti | nāsikayā unmārgagāmi bhavati | tena nādhaḥ pravartate iti tātparyārthaḥ | viṣaprabhāvāt nāsikopalakṣitatvāt tena mukhunetrakarṇair api pravartata iti bhāvaḥ | visram ity āmagandhi | sarvakuṣṭhakaram iti viṣaprabhāvāt | tathā hi ‘viṣeṇa dūṣitaṃ raktaṃ sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ matam’ iti || 5-12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. duṣṭe kupite rakte vedanā pīḍā syāt pākādayaś ca jāyante | raktavṛddhilakṣaṇam āha - vṛddhe rakte raktāṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati raktāṅgatvaṃ raktanetratvaṃ sirāṇāṃ dhamanyādīnāṃ pūraṇaṃ raktenaiva, gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ gurutā, madaḥ pūgabhakṣaṇavat, dāha uṣṇatvam | kṣīṇe rakte kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīty āha -kṣīṇe idaṃ bhavati - amlamadhurākāṅkṣā spṛhā, mūrcchā mūrcchitaṃ kṣīṇe tvaci rūkṣatā śaithilyaṃ vātasyaiva unmārgagāmitā ca | vātaduṣṭaraktalakṣaṇam āha - vātadūṣitaṃ raktam evaṃvidhaṃ syāt | kiṃbhūtaṃ tad āha - aruṇaraktaṃ phenilaṃ phenavat, rūkṣaṃ sneharahitaṃ, tanu adhanaṃ, paruṣaṃ karkaśaṃ, śīghragamanaṃ śīlaṃ askandi, ghanatvarahitaṃ, visrāvaviśeṣaḥ srāvayuktaṃ, pittadūṣitaraktam āha - pittena dūṣitaṃ pītaharitādivarṇaṃ raktaṃ bhavati tad āha - visrakaṃ srāvagandhi askandi cāñcalyarahitaṃ makṣikādīnāṃ aniṣṭakaṃ bhakṣaṇe hitaṃ na | kaphadūṣitaraktam āha - kaphadūṣitaṃ śītalādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīty āha - śītalaṃ śītaguṇaṃ sparśena vā śītalaṃ, bahulaṃ bahutaraṃ, snigdhaṃ sacikkaṇaṃ, gairikodakasannibhaṃ gairikajalasadṛśaṃ, punaḥ māṃsapeśīprabhaṃ granthirūpaṃ, skandi ghanatvasadṛśaṃ, mandagaṃ mandagamanaṃ, dvidoṣatridoṣaduṣṭalakṣaṇam āha – dvidoṣaduṣṭasaṃsṛṣṭadvidoṣalakṣaṇam āha - dvidoṣaduṣṭasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ dvidoṣalakṣaṇayuktaṃ bhavati triduṣṭaṃ tridoṣaduṣṭaṃ pūtigandhaṃ durgandhaṃ tathā kāñjikābhaṃ ca jāyate | viṣaduṣṭam āha - viṣaduṣṭaṃ viṣayuktaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ bhavet nāsikāgandhaṃ tathā unmārgagam | visram āmagandhi, kāñjikasaṃkāśaṃ kāñjikatulyaṃ tathā sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ, tathā bahu adhikam || 5-12 ||

div.ab:
prakṛtistharaktalakṣaṇam āha -
indragopaprabhaṃ jñeyaṃ prakṛtistham asaṃhatam |

Āḍhamalla. atha vikṛtaraktam abhidhāya prakṛtisthaṃ darśayann āha - yaḥ prāvṛṭkālajo jantuviśeṣaḥ indravadhūr iti loke | sa cānekaprakāravarṇaḥ, atra tu rakta eva gṛhyate | asaṃhatam iti nātyacchaṃ nātighanaṃ na styāyatīty anye ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. indragopo vīravadhūṭī tadvat raktaṃ tathā asaṃhatam astyānam evaṃbhūtaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ raktaṃ jñeyam ||

ab.seg:
yeṣu raktasrāvo vihitas tān āha -
śothe dāhe 'ṅgapāke ca raktavarṇe 'sṛjaḥ srutau || 13||

lg.l: pāṇiroge ślīpade pade ca viṣaduṣṭe ca śoṇite || 14 ||
eṣu rogeṣu śṛṅgair vā jalaukālābukair api |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha raktasrāvo yeṣāṃ vihitas tān āha - śothe vraṇaśothe ekāṅgaje 'pi srāvyaḥ | yataḥ sarvāṅgaśotho niṣiddhaś ca sa vāmlabhojananimittaḥ | pāṇḍurogyarśasodariśoṣigarbhiṇīnāṃ ca śvayathau, aṅgadāhe aṅgapāke ca | raktavarṇe 'sṛjaḥ srutāv iti kevalaraktapitte | sapīḍe durjaye 'nile iti | tathā hi - ‘uṣṇāmlalavaṇāder vātaharasyopayogāt kupitena śoṇitenāvṛto vāto yadā vedanākārī tadā sirāvyadha iti | pāṇiroge dāhādau tena bāhurogo 'pi gṛhyate | yad uktaṃ -śoṇitāvṛtavātajanitayor bāhuśoṣāpabāhukayor apy aṃśayor antare sirāvyadhaḥ | apacyām iti | utpannamātrāyām ity arthaḥ | na tu rūḍhāyāṃ tasyām | kṣudrarogeṣu arūṃṣikādiṣu | vidradhāv iti ṣaḍvidhavidradhiṣu madhye pacca visrāvyāḥ tad uktaṃ - ‘srāvyā vidradhayaḥ pañca bhaveyuḥ sarvapādata’ iti | upadaṃśe iti | upadaṃśagrahaṇāt parivartikaśūkadoṣaśukavyāpatsu ca meḍhramadhye sirāvyadhaḥ | raktapittam iti | romakūpodgatam ity eke | śeṣaṃ subodham | atha śoṇitavisrāvaṃ yair vastubhiḥ kuryāt tāni darśayann āha - eṣu pūrvokteṣu śothaprabhṛtiṣu rogeṣu śṛṅgādicatuḥprakārā yathāyogyānurūpato yojyā | śṛṅgaṃ tu gośṛṅgaṃ tac ca saptāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ bhavati | tathā ca
‘srāve tu śvetagośṛṅgaṃ vakraṃ saptāṅgulāyataṃ |
kṣiptvāntaḥ picupeśīkaṃ yojyaṃ vātayute 'sṛji |
aṅguṣṭhamūlavan mūlaṃ chidram agre 'sya mudgavat | vastrapaṭṭāvanaddhaṃ ca raktam ācūṣaṇād dharet’ iti | jalaukāḥ prasiddhāḥ, tāś ca dvādaśadhā bhavanti | tāsāṃ ṣaṭ saviṣā: tāvantya eva nirviṣāś ca | vistāro 'pi tāsām anyatrasaviṣalakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘indrāyudhavicitrordhvarājayo romaśāśca yāḥ| saviṣā varjayettābhiḥ kaṇḍūpākajvarabhramaḥ’ iti | jalamokaḥ sthānaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ | dvividhā striyaḥ puruṣāśca | tanvaṅgyo'tyantamṛdavaḥ striyo viparītāḥ puruṣā | striya: sukumāreṣu asukumāreṣu puruṣā yojyāḥ | jñātavyaḥ | atra granthagauravabhayān na likhitaḥ | alābukā tumbīśabdavācyā | tasyā lakṣaṇaṃ kenacid iti darśitam | tad yathā - aṅguṣṭhāṅgulapariṇāhā ca - turaṅgulā'nāśasaṃmitā sumukhā kṛṣṇamṛdāliptatanuḥ śreṣṭhā raktā ca sevane 'lābūḥ | sāntardīrghamayutā tayā ca visrāvayed raktam iti | śirāmokṣair iti śirā raktavahās tāsāṃ mokṣaḥ śastreṇa kuryād iti | mokṣo rudhirasyeti || 13-18 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śothe dāheti śothādirogeṣu nṛṇāṃ raktasrāvaḥ praśasyata ity anvayaḥ | raktavarṇe dehe asṛjaḥ srutau sādisrāve sapīḍe pīḍāsahite anile durjaye jetum aśakye gātrasādo gātraśaithilyaṃ raktābhiṣyandam āraktanetraṃ, spaṣṭam anyat | eṣu rogeṣu kena raktaṃ srāvayed ity āha - jalaukā nirviṣā purātanāś ca ‘mahyakāṃ vājayavanayājyapautanayā (?) śubhā’ iti suśrutoktatvāt alābu tumbī śirā tadvidhānasthānaṃ taddvidhā nipuṇair vaidyair jñeyam || 13-18 ||

yeṣu sirāmokṣo niṣiddhaḥ tān āha -
na kurvīta sirāmokṣaṃ kṛśasyātivyavāyina:|
klībasya bhīror garbhiṇyāḥ sūtikāpāṇḍurogiṇām ||19||

lg.l: eṣāṃ cātyayike roge jalaukābhis tu nirharet ||22||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha yeṣāṃ sirāmokṣaṇaṃ na syāt tān āha - kṛśasya kṣīṇasya puṃsaḥ | klībo napuṃsakaḥ | pañcakarmeti | vamanavirecananiruhānuvāsananasyāni taiḥ śodhitasya puṃsaḥ | sarvāṅgaśothayuktānām iti | sarvāṅgatvena vraṇaśothā ekāṅgatā api gṛhyante | āghātāt prahārādinā srutaṃ raktaṃ yasya sirāmokṣo dvividhaḥ pracchannaḥ sirāvyadhaś va | ‘na kurvīta sirāmokṣaṃ kṛtasyātivyavāyina’ ityādivyākhyā pūrvaṃ pratipāditā | adhunā'pi viśeṣam āha | kṛśasya garbhiṇīnāṃ copakṣīṇadhātutvād dehabhayāt | ativyavāyino vātaprakopabhayān na vidhyet | klībasya pradhānadhātukṣaye alpasatvena ca niḥsṛtavināśāt | bhīroś ca tamobahulatvāl lohitadarśanena mūrcchābhayān na vidhyet | sūtikāyā garbhiṇīvat | pañcakarmaviśuddhasyetyādi | vāntaviriktayo raktasarjanayor apītasnehayor vamanavirecanānantaram eva vātaprakopabhayāc chirāṃ na vidhyet | āsthāpitajāgaritayor marutprakopabhayān na vidhyet | anuvāsitasya mande 'gnau bhūyo 'gnimāndyabhayāt | anye vyadhā anumānato nirūpaṇīyāḥ | sirāmokṣo na śasyata iti dvirukte sati viśeṣeṇa sirāniṣedhaparatvāt vācyaḥ, ātyayike tu śṛṅgālābujalaukāprabhṛtiparatvāc cāvekṣya | athātyayike kṛśādīnām api śoṇitavisrāvaviṣayaṃ vaktum āha - eṣām iti| pūrvoktānāṃ kṛśādīnām api yadi āthātyayike roge sati tadā jalaukābhir nirharet | paramasukumārayogatvān nirhared visrāvayec choṇitam iti śeṣaḥ | atyayo 'vināśo bhavaty asmād ity ātyayiko vidradhyādir ananyasādhyaḥ | tathā viṣajuṣṭānāṃ puruṣāṇām api jalaukābhis tu nirharaṇaṃ kartavyam | na kevalaṃ jalaukābhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇāpi viṣaprabhāveṇa sakalaśarīradūṣitatvāt sarvaṃ raktaṃ dūṣitam eva | ata eva sirāmokṣaḥ | yataḥ ‘sirā sarvāṅgaśodhinī’ iti vacanāt || 19-22 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. kṛśasya durbalasya ativyavāyinaḥ atistrīsaktasya pañcakarmāṇi vamanadīni tacchuddhasya atisvinnatanoḥ atisveditasya ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣasya bālasya gatasaptatikasya ata ūrdhvaṃ vṛddhasyety arthaḥ | āghrāṇena nāsikayā raktaṃ srutasya eṣāṃ ca ātyayike na kāryaṃ jalaukāmī raktaṃ na haret || 19-22 ||

vātādiduṣṭaṃ kena srāvayed ity āha -
tathā ca viṣaduṣṭānāṃ śirāmokṣo 'pi śasyate |
gośṛṅgeṇa jalaukābhir alābubhir api tridhā || 23 ||

lg.l: dvidoṣābhyāṃ tu saṃduṣṭaṃ tridoṣair api dūṣitam ||24||
śoṇitaṃ srāvayed yuktyā sirāmokṣaiḥ padais tathā |
jalaukā hastamātraṃ tu tumbī ca dvādaśāṅgulam |
yutānāṃ na sraved raktaṃ tathā viṇmūtrasaṅginām ||27||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa śṛṅgādiviṣayaṃ vibhajann āha - bhiṣag iti grahaṇād dṛṣṭakramo jñeyaḥ | tena vātaduṣṭaṃ śṛṅgeṇa, yataḥ ‘uṣṇaṃ samadhuraṃ śṛṅgaṃ gavyaṃ snigdhaṃ prakīrtitam | tasmād vātopasṛṣṭeṣu hitaṃ tad avasecane’ iti | pittaduṣṭaṃ tu rudhiraṃ jalaukābhir nirharet | tathā hi ‘śītādhivāsā madhurā jalaukā vārisaṃbhavā | tasmāt pittopasṛṣṭe tu hitā sā tv avasecane’ iti | kaphaduṣṭaṃ tu - alābubhir iti | athātivyastam abhidhāya pittadoṣaduṣṭasya raktasyāvasecanopāyam āha - dvidoṣābhyām ityādipadaiḥ krūrapradhānaiḥ yuktety anena yathāyogyānurūpaṃ yojyam | tena padopalakṣitatvāc chṛṅgālābupracāro 'vagantavyaḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘sarvāṇi vātapittakaphaduṣṭāni śoṇitāni’ | sarvair iti śṛṅgādibhir yathāyogyam ity abhiprāyaḥ | atha śṛṅgādīnāṃ kiyaddūre pracāras taṃ darśayann āha - daśāṅgulam ity ubhayataḥ | tena caturdikṣu daśāṅgulam iti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra viṣayapadaṃ pracchannam | ata evāha kaścit - ‘avagāḍhe jalaukā syāt pracchannaṃ piṇḍite hitam | sirā ca vyāpake rakte śṛṅgālābu tvaci sthite’ iti | atha śoṇitaṃ na srāvayet tān āha - śīte iti | śīte śītārdite deśe puruṣe ca niranne iti laṅghite | atitandrā nidrānāśaḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘madamūrcchāśramārtānāṃ vātaviṇmūtrasaṅginām | nidrā'bhibhūtabhītānāṃ nṛṇāṃ nā'sṛk pravartate’ iti | viṇmūtrasaṃginām iti | viṇmūtrādīnāṃ saṃgo pravṛttis tadyuktānām ity arthaḥ | viṇmūtragrahaṇenaiva vātasaṃgasyāpy avarodhaḥ || 23-27 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. śṛṅgādīnāṃ śoṇitagrahaṇe pramāṇam āha - sugamam | yeṣāṃ raktaṃ na srāvayet tān āha - śīte śītakāle viṇmūtrasaṃgināṃ apravartinām || 23-27 ||

rakte vidhānam āha -
apravartitarakte ca kuṣṭhatrikaṭusaindhavaiḥ |
mardayed vraṇavaktraṃ ca tena samyak pravartate || 28 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīm apravartitasya śoṇitasya cikitsāyogaṃ vaktum āha - yadā śītādihetubhir na sravet tadā trikaṭukādicūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vraṇaṃ gharṣayet | trikaṭukaṃ śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddhaṃ, saindhavaṃ ca, śeṣaṃ sugamam || 28 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vraṇavaktraṃ vraṇamukhaṃ, śoṇitasamayavidhānaṃ cāha, sugamam || 28 ||

idānīṃ sukhavisrāvaṇārthaṃ hitopadeśam āha -
tasmān na śīte nātyuṣṇe na svinne nātitāpite |
pītvā yavāgūṃ tṛptasya srāvayec choṇitaṃ budhaḥ ||29||

Āḍhamalla. tasmād iti pūrvoktāpravartitaraktaviṣayadarśanāt | na śīte nātyuṣṇeti sādhāraṇakāle | ata evoktaṃ suśrute - ‘vyabhre varṣāsu vidhyeta grīṣmakāle tu śītale | hemantakāle madhyāhne śastrakālās trayo matā’ iti | na svinne iti svedite | nātitāpite iti śramādibhiḥ saṃtapte | sūryatāpād ity anye | pītvā yavāgūṃ tṛptasyeti | yavāgūr atra tilayavāgū: tasyāḥ sadyaḥ snehanīyatvāt | raktotkleśakāritvāc ca | anye tu yavāgūr viraladraveti bahusṛtām | tṛptasyeti kathanāt || 29 ||

atha kena hetunā raktātipravṛttis tad darśayann āha -
atisvinnasyoṣṇakāle tathaivātisirāvyadhāt |
atipravartate raktaṃ tatra kuryāt pratikriyām || 30||

lg.l: mukhaṃ vraṇasya baddhvā ca śītaiś copacared vraṇam || 324||
vidhyed ūrdhvaṃ sirāṃ tāṃ ca dahet kṣāreṇa vāgninā |
vraṇaṃ kaṣāyaḥ saṃdhatte raktaṃ skandayate himam ||23||
vraṇāsyaṃ pācayet kṣāro dāhaḥ saṃkocayet sirām |
dahet sirāṃ vyatyaye tu vāmāṅguṣṭhasirāṃ dahet |
ataḥ srāvyaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ raktaṃ nātikramo hitaḥ ||38||
āndhyam ākṣepakaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ timiraṃ śiraso rujam |
pakṣaghātaṃ śvāsakāsau hikkāṃ dāhaṃ ca pāṇḍutām ||39||
kurute 'tisṛtaṃ raktaṃ maraṇaṃ vā karoti ca |
vinā tena vrajej jīvo rakṣed raktam ato budhaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atisvinnety atyarthaṃ svedite puruṣe deśe vā | soṣṇakāle grīṣmartau śaradṛtau vā | atisirāvyadhād iti ajñaprayuktena śastreṇāvagāḍhavyadhanād raktātisrutir bhavati | pūrvam uktaṃ tatra kuryāt pratikriyām ity ataḥ tāṃ pratikriyāṃ darśayann āha - atra sarjaraso rālaḥ| rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ | yac ca dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ rasāñjanasaṃjñaṃ kecid iti vyākhyānayanti | sarjaḥ śālabhedaḥ | rasāñjanaṃ tad eva | dhavo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | dhanvano dhāmana iti prasiddhaḥ | lodhrādibhiś cūrṇīkṛtābhir vraṇamukham avacūrṇyāṅgulyagreṇāvapīḍayed iti pracāraḥ | sarpanirmokaḥ sarpakañculikā | kṣaumavastrayor bhasmeti | paṭāmbaradagdhabhasma kṣaumam atasībhavam | tad dagdhvā bhasmakāryam evaṃ vastrasya vastragrahaṇāt kārpāsasaṃbhavaṃ bhasmāpi mukhavraṇasya | badhveti yathoktavraṇabandhanadravyair gāḍhaṃ badhnīyād ity arthaḥ | śītaiś copacared vraṇaṃ śītācchādanabhojanāgāraiḥ śītaiḥ pradehapariṣekaiś ca vraṇaṃ śastrādijanitaṃ yady upacaret | vā pakṣāntaraprakāram āha - vidhyed ūrdhvam ityādi | prāktanavyaktāt parasthāne tām eva pūrvaviddhāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet | raktagaticchedanārtham kṣāreṇāgninā vā dahed iti vastrādipadābhiprāyaḥ | atha lodhrādīnāṃ śoṇitātipravṛttau prayuktānāṃ pratyekaphalam āha -kaṣāyo 'tra lodhrasarjarasāñjanaprabhṛtikaḥ | sa ca vraṇagharṣaṇārthaṃ pūrvam evātra darśitaḥ | anye tu harītakyādiḥ pañcavalkalādikaḥ | etena kim uktam, ayaṃ kaṣāyaḥ vraṇaṃ śastrāghātajaṃ rudhiraṃ saṃdhatte nivārayed ity arthaḥ | vraṇagrahaṇena jalaukāmukhakṣatajam api grāhyam | himaṃ śītalam | raktam ity atipravartitaṃ skandayed astyānībhūtaṃ karotīty arthaḥ | kṣāro 'tra vihito 'pāmārgādijanitaḥ kṣaumādijanito vety atra vihitaḥ, sa ca vraṇāsyaṃ vraṇamukhaṃ pācayet | tenātipravartitaraktaṃ saṃsthāpya samyak prarohayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | dāho 'gnikṛtaḥ śalākāpravṛttibhiḥ sa ca śirāṃ raktavahāṃ saṃkocayet | tenātipravartitaṃ samyag avatiṣṭhate | idānīṃ raktātisrāve upadeśaṃ darśayann āha | ataḥ srāvyaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ iti | sāvaśeṣaṃ doṣaraktaṃ punaḥ saṃśamanādibhir jayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | yathātiyoganiḥsṛtasya raktasya vyāpadaṃ darśayann āha | āndhyam andhatām | atrordhvajatrugatarogaṃ śirasy atipravṛttaṃ raktaṃ karoti | śeṣaṃ subodham | atha raktasrāvaṇe bhūyo bhūyotikramo na karaṇīya ity āha | utpattir iti | upasthitipralayeṣu śoṇitam eva hetuḥ śoṇitena | etenaiva dhāryate sthāpyate | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 30-40 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atisvinnasyeti sugamam | atipravṛtte kriyām āha - atipravṛtte rakte evaṃ kuryāt tad āha -lodhraṃ, sarjo rālaḥ, rajāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, yava kāṣṭhadhanvanaḥ | sarpanirmokaṃ sarpakaṃcukaṃ vastraṃ cīraṃ kṣaumaṃ paṭṭavastram | śītaiḥ śītopacāraiḥ tāṃ śirāṃ bāhu ūrdhvaṃ vidhyet | ūrdhvaṃ tasmāt śirābandhāt ūrdhvam | tathā ca vāgbhaṭe ‘tām eva vā śirāṃ vidhyed bandhāt tasmād anantaram’ iti | kṣāreṇa dahet lipet kṣāreṇa ṭaṅkaṇādinā kṣāreṇa vahninā vā dahed dāhaṃ kuryāt | kaṣāyaḥ kaṣāyadravyaṃ rodhrādi vraṇaṃ saṃdhatte saṃnahanaṃ saṃkurute| himaṃ śītalaṃ candanādidravyaṃ raktaṃ skandayate śoṣayati sthāpayati vā, kṣāraḥ vraṇaṃ pācayati, dāhaḥ śirāḥ saṃkocayet dāho yathā sugamam | visūcyām iti sugamam | duṣṭe rakte niḥsṛte kiṃcid avaśiṣṭe 'pi vyādhir na kupyati ataḥ sāvaśeṣaṃ srāvyam | atikramo na hitaḥ | raktasya niśe:ṣasrāve doṣasrāvaṇāt tad āha - atisrutaṃ atiniḥsṛtaṃ raktasya jīvasya sāmye | tad dehasyotpātādīn āha - sugamam || 30-40 ||

srute rakte 'pi doṣakope pratīkāram āha -
śītopacāraiḥ kupite srutaraktasya mārute || 41 ||

lg.l: rasaḥ samucitaḥ pāne kṣīraṃ vā ṣaṣṭhikā hitāḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha śoṇitāvaśeke paścāt karma darśayann āha | śītopacārāḥ sekādyāḥ | etena kim uktaṃ, anatiśītādikaṃ prayatnataḥ upācaraṇīyam iti subodham| ata eva koṣṇena sarpiṣeti | īṣaduṣṇena sarpiṣety arthaḥ | atha raktātikrameṇa kṣīṇasya puruṣasyānantaraṃ bheṣajam āha - kṣīṇasyeti | raktakṣīṇapuruṣasyety arthaḥ | eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ | urabhro meṣaḥ | hariṇas tāmravarṇo mṛgaḥ | eṣāṃ māṃsaiḥ saṃsruto rasa iti| eke hariṇacchāgasaṃbhavaḥ raktaḥ samucita iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kṣīraṃ vā ṣaṣṭhikā hitā iti | kṣīrādisiktam odanaṃ bhuñjītety abhiprāyaḥ || 41 || 42 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. srute rakte vraṇasthāne kupite dāhāditvāt śītopacāraiḥ upacaret srutaraktasya mārute kupite savyathaṃ śothaṃ koṣṇena sarpiṣā secayet | rakte kṣīṇe kriyām āha - kṣīṇasya raktasrāvaṇakṣīṇasya puruṣasya eṇādīnāṃ māṃsarasaḥ hitaḥ | ṣaṣṭhikāyuktaṃ kṣīraṃ vā hitam | eṇo hariṇaḥ, śaśaḥ, urabhro meṣaḥ, hariṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo mṛgaḥ, eṇo raktavarṇaḥ chāgaḥ || 41 || 42 ||

ab.seg:
atha raktasrāvaṇāt samyak śuddhilakṣaṇāny āha -
pīḍāśāntir laghutvaṃ ca vyādher udrekasaṃkṣayaḥ || 43 ||
Āḍhamalla. pīḍāśāṃtir vedanāvyapagamaḥ | laghutvaṃ śarīrasyeti | etac chārīraṃ visrāvitaliṅgam | manaḥsvāsthyam iti manasaḥ prasādaḥ | etena mānasaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam ||43||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. samyak srutaraktalakṣaṇam āha - asṛji rakte samyak visrāvite sati pīḍāśāntyādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti yojanā | pīḍā vyathā tacchānti: laghutvaṃ dehasya vyādheḥ rogasya punaḥ udreka ādhikyaṃ tasya saṃkṣayaḥ samyak nāśaḥ manaḥsvāsthyam || 43 || raktamokṣe niṣedhavargam āha -

lg.l: śokaṃ vādam ajīrṇaṃ ca tyajed ābaladarśanāt || 45 ||

ab.seg: iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitaśārṅga- dharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe śoṇitasrāvavidhi- rnāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ raktasrute: kiṃ tyājyaṃ tad darśayann āha - atrātiśayaṃ niṣiddhaṃ na tu sakṛd eva | śokaṃ dhanabandhunāśādijanitam | vādam ity atibhāṣaṇam | ābaladarśanād iti | raktasrutasya yāvad balo na bhavati tāvad vyāyāmādayo niṣiddhā ity abhiprāyaḥ || 44 ||
45 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe śoṇitavisrāvavidhir adhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. vyāyāmaṃ śramaṃ, maithunaṃ strīsevāṃ, śītaṃ jalaṃ, tena snānaṃ, pravāto bahuvātasevanam, ekāsanam, ekabhojanam, amlo amlarasaḥ, kaṭu kaṭurasaḥ; kṣāro yavakṣārādiḥ, na saindhavaniṣedhaḥ tasya kṣārābhāvāt vādaṃ vāgvādam ajīrṇaṃ bahubhojanajanyaṃ yāvat balādhikyaṃ bhavati tāvat etān tyajet || 44 ||
45 || iti śrīkāśirāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne raktamokṣavidhi- rnāmādhyāyaḥ ||12||

div.head: atha netrakarmavidhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sambandhaś cāyaṃ - śirāvyadhenā'pi netraprasādanaṃ bhavati, tadvat sekādibhir api | ata āha - tāni kāni karmāṇīty āha -
seka āścotanaṃ piṇḍī biḍālas tarpaṇaṃ tathā |
puṭapāko 'ñjanaṃ caibhiḥ kalpair netram upācaret || 1 ||

Āḍhamalla. athedānīṃ netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | seko 'tra dhārādinā svedarūpaḥ | āścyotanaṃ netramadhye tailādikṣepaṇarūpam| nimīlitonmīlanākṣibhedena sekaāścyotanayor bhedam āhuḥ | piṇḍīti prasiddhā | akṣṇor bahirlepaḥ sa biḍālasaṃjñaḥ | tarpaṇam iti netratṛptikaraṃ karma tac ca netrabastir iti prasiddham | puṭapāka iti | puṭapāka uktyā dravyasya raso netraprasādane vihitaḥ sa puṭapākaḥ kathitaḥ | asyāpi dvividhaṃ karma vyācakṣate | ekaṃ tarpaṇavat kāryam aparaṃ āścyotanavad iti | añjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tac ca nānāvidham cakārāt śastrakarmāpy atra boddhavyam iti kecit | na svamatam | tad anyatra jñātavyam || 1||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi | ebhiḥ sekādibhiḥ kalpair netrarogam upācaret | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni vakṣyati || 1 ||

sekavidhiḥ |
sekas tu sūkṣmadhārābhiḥ sarvasminn ayane hitaḥ |
mīlitākṣasya martyasya pradeyaś caturaṅgulāt ||2 ||

lg.l: sa cāpi snehano vāte rakte pitte ca ropaṇaḥ |
lekhanaś ca kaphe kāryas tasya mātrā'dhunocyate || 3 ||
vākśataiś ca tribhiḥ kāryaḥ seko lekhanakarmaṇi ||4||
kāryas tu divase seko rātrau cātyayike gade |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. pūrvam uktaṃ seka āścyotanapiṇḍītyādikam | tatra tāvat sekavidhir adhunā vidhīyate sūkṣmadhārā netrāñjanaśalākā'nurūpaṃ nirgatā dravapātrāt | sarvasminn ayane iti sarvākṣiroge yathā doṣāpekṣayā vā sarvagrahaṇaṃ | samastanetramaṇḍale ity eke | caturaṅgulam iti caturaṅgulaṃ yathā syāt tena caturaṅgulotsedhaṃ dhārāṃ kṛtvā secayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | yad vā yathā sukhotsedhaṃ secayed ity api | athavā caturaṅgulenākṣivistāraṃ yāvat tāvan maryādīkṛtya dravyakalkaṃ kṛtvā karpaṭe badhvākṣisekaḥ kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | tathā hy uktam - ‘avyakte 'kṣigade kāryaṃ plotasthair guṇḍanaṃ bahiḥ’ ityādi | atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa sekasya karmaviśeṣam āha - vāte kevalānilajanite 'kṣirogaḥ, snehanaḥ snehakṛtasvedaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | yathā - ‘sarpirmāsavasāmajjābhedaḥ syād auṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ | snehana iti vikhyātaḥ’| raktapitta iti vyaste milite vā ropaṇaḥ svedaḥ | ropaṇas tu tantrāntare yathā - ‘stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravayācitaḥ | dṛṣṭer balārthaṃ śītaś ca svedaḥ kāryo 'pi ropaṇam’ iti | kaphe kaphaprāye 'kṣiroge lekhanaḥ sveda iti lekhano doṣalekhana iti, sa ca snigdhasya vihitaḥ | tathā hi -
‘sneho hitotirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ|
jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsair lekhanadravasaṃyutaiḥ ||
kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaḍkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ |
samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ | lekhane lekhanasvedo vihitoyaṃ bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ iti | tasyeti trividhasekasya mātrāparimāṇaṃ kāryaṃ kālaṃ vā adhunā idānīṃ tasya mātrā'dhunocyate ity uktaṃ prāk tad idānīṃ tanmātrāviśeṣam āha - srehaḥ teṣu svedeṣu ṣaṭśatavākyāni yāvat bhavanti tāvat snehasvedaḥ kartavya ity abhiprāyaḥ | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā | tathā hi ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsām aṅgulyā cchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | atraikaladhvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāg iti paṭhanti | ropaṇe svedaś caturbhir iti catuḥśatavākyaiḥ lekhanakarmaṇīti lekhanasvede | ekaśatavākyaiḥ kṛtvā tāvat svedaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | athākṣisvedasya kālam āha - ātyantake gade prakupite 'kṣiroge rujādibhiḥ pīḍita ity arthaḥ | rātrau vety atra vāgrahaṇāt niśāyāḥ, prathamo yāmo 'bhipretaḥ | tathā hi -
‘snigdhoṣṇair vātajaḥ pittaraktato mṛduśītalaiḥ |
tīkṣṇarūkṣoṣṇaviśadaiḥ praśāmyati kaphātmakaḥ |
tīkṣṇoṣṇamṛduśītānāṃ vyatyāsāt sānnipātikaḥ | tasya kālo divā sarvo yāmaḥ syāt prathamo niśi’ iti || 2-4 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha sekaḥ | mīlitākṣṇa: mudritanetrasya puruṣasya sekaḥ pradeyaḥ | seka: secanaṃ, sa sekaḥ sarvasminn ayane caturaṅgulāt sūkṣmadhārābhihitaḥ | dhārāśabdo dugdhādivācakaḥ | sekasya snehādibhedena trividhatvam āha - sa eva sekaḥ secanaṃ vāte ca ropaṇaḥ kaphe lekhanaḥ tasya sekasya mātrāpramāṇam adhunā ucyate tāṃ mātrām āha - sneheṣu ṣaḍvākśataiḥ sekaḥ kāryaḥ | caturbhir vākśataiḥ ropaṇe sekaḥ kāryaḥ | lekhanakarmaṇi tribhir vākśataiḥ sekaḥ kārya ity arthaḥ | sekaḥ kadā kārya ity āha -sekas tu divasa eva kāryaḥ | anyad api asādhuko rātrāv api || 2-4 ||

atha trividhākṣisvedānāṃ prayogadvāreṇa karma darśayann āha - sa yathā - sa yathetyādinā darśayati granthakāraḥ |
eraṇḍatvakpatramūlaiḥ śṛtam ājaṃ payo hitam ||5||

lg.l: pariṣeko hito netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam || 6 ||
śuṣkākṣipāke ca hitam idaṃ secanakaṃ sadā |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. eṣa ca vātābhiṣyande praśastaḥ | abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ sarasapākarujaḥ | ayam api sarvākṣirogotpādaka ity arthaḥ | tathā hi ‘vātāt pittāt kaphād raktād abhiṣyandaś caturvidhaḥ | prāyeṇa jāyate ghoraḥ sarvanetrāmayākara’ iti | eraṇḍapatretyādiyoge kṣīrasādhanaṃ kṣīraparibhāṣayaiva boddhavyam | tantrāntare 'yam adhimanthanāmnā vihitaḥ tatra kaṇṭakārīyutam iti paṭhanti | tathā ca -‘kaṇṭakārīśiphairaṇḍamūlatvakpatrasādhitam | kṣīram ājaṃ hitaṃ seke cakṣu:spandādhimanthayoḥ’ iti | anyac ca
‘pariṣeke hitaṃ netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam |
rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam |
vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye |
śuṣkākṣipāke vihitam idaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | pariṣekaṃ sekābhidhānaṃ payotrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā mānuṣam iti kecit | koṣṇam īṣaduṣṇam | saindhavam iti sasaindhavacūrṇaprakṣiptam | athavā rajanīdārusiddhaṃ paya iti yogaḥ | kṣīrapākam atra kṣīraparibhāṣayā kartavyam | rajanī dāruharidrā | eke rajanīdārudravyadvayaṃ vadanti | tatra rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru | mārutaparyāyepi hitam etat | mārutaparyāyaṃ tat sarvāṅgam akṣiroge paṭhanti | tad yathā ‘vāraṃ vāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaś ca vividhās tīvrāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | śuṣkākṣipāke ca idam eva secanaṃ sadā sarvasmin kāle kṛtau vā hitam ity arthaḥ | śuṣkākṣipākam api sa cākṣigata eva boddhavyaḥ | tad yathā ‘yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃlakṣanetrāviladarśanaṃ yat | sarūkṣaṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tad akṣi’iti | idānīṃ raktapittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ yogam āha -pittābhighātobhiṣyanda eva | yaṣṭīmadhu yaṣṭī bhadramustakaḥ śreṣṭhamustaḥ nāgaramothā iti loke piṣṭa iti kalkīkṛtaḥ | ayaṃ poṭṭalakaḥ baddhena chedo vihitaḥ | poṭṭalakadvāreṇaiva tadadharāseka ity anye | tagaraṃ, sārivā āsphotā, puṇḍarīkaṃ kamalaṃ tadabhāve tadbījāny atra gṛhyante | atra kvātharūpeṇa seko boddhavyaḥ | athākṣisādanaharayogam āha | ayaṃ dhārābhidhānopi svedaḥ poṭṭalakena badhvā kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | ambake netre || 5-11 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sa yathā - sukhoṣṇam ājaṃ payaḥ netre secane hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ payaḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlai: śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandam āgataḥ pākaṃ netraṃ | vātābhiṣyande sekaḥ, anyac ca pariṣeke secane sasaindhavaṃ koṣṇaṃ payaś chāgīdugdhaṃ netre hitaṃ, rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru saindhavena samanvitaṃ tatsiddhaṃ ca hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ tathā mārutaparyāyeṇa roge | tathā śuṣkākṣipāke hitaṃ vātābhiṣyande vātaparyaye śuṣkākṣipāke sāvaraṃ lodhraṃ madhukaṃ yaṣṭī etat tulyaṃ saṃcūrṇitaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ chāgīkṣīre sthitaṃ sekāt secanāt pittaraktābhighātajid bhavati | abhighāto netrābhighātaḥ | netrābhighāte sekaḥ śarkarā sitā'bhiṣyande kālānisārivā kalisāri | puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, raktābhiṣyande paṭavisṛtaṃ vastrapūtaṃ, punaḥ uṣṇāmbunā marditam, ambake netre sekāt secanāt śūlaghnaṃ bhavati netraśūleti ||5-11||

āścyotanam |
athāścyotanakaṃ kāryaṃ niśāyāṃ na kathaṃcana ||12||

lg.l: ropaṇe dvādaśa proktās te śīte koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ |
uṣṇe ca śītarūpāḥ syuḥ sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ ||14||
vāte tiktaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ pitte madhuraśītalam |
tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca kaphe kramād āścyotanaṃ hitam ||15||
āścyotanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mātrā syād vākśataṃ hitā |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athāścyotanam āha - āścyotanaṃ netrasecanaṃ, tac cādāv eva sarveṣām akṣirogāṇām | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘sarveṣām akṣirogāṇām ādāv āścyotanaṃ hitam | rūkṣoṣṇakaṇḍūgharṣāśrudāharoganibarhaṇam’ iti | atrādāv iti nirāmāvasthāyāṃ vātapittavaj jñeyam | nirāmāvasthā ca rūkṣādyupalakṣitā jñeyā | uktaṃ ca videhe -
‘abhiṣyande 'vamanthe ca netrayoḥ kaphasaṃbhave |
utpanna eva kartavyaṃ netrayoḥ kaphanāśanam | lākṣyāś cākṣṇoḥ parīṣekas tīkṣṇaś cāścotanādikam iti | atra sāmanirāmalakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā -
‘udīrṇavadanaṃ netraṃ rāgadveṣasamanvitam |
gharṣanistodaśūlāsrayuktam āmānvitaṃ viduḥ |
mandavedanatākaṇḍūḥ saṃrambhas tu prasannatā | praśastavartmatā cākṣṇoḥ saṃpakvaṃ gadam ādiśet’ iti | niśāyāṃ na kathaṃ cana iti | rātrau na kartavyam evety anena divā kartavyatā'sya pratipāditā | dvyaṅgulād iti | dvyaṅgulotsedhaṃ kṛtvā dvyaṅguloccenopādeyam ity arthaḥ | bindubhir iti | binduparimāṇaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘pradeśinyaṅgulaparvadvayān magnasamuddhṛtāt| yāvat pataty asau bindur dṛśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te’ iti | lekhanādiṣu bindusaṃkhyām āha - bindava iti | bindavo lekhane 'ṣṭau, snehane daśa, ropaṇe dvādaśa | te śīte koṣṇarūpiṇa iti | te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle hemante śiśire ca koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ koṣṇāḥ | evam uṣṇakāle śītarūpiṇaḥ | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatra lekhanādau jñeya: | vātādikramāt snigdhādikam āha - vāta iti | vāto 'tra netrābhiṣyandādau tiktarasaprāyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca hitam | pitte madhuraśītalaprāyaṃ, kaphe tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca āścyotanaṃ netrasecanarūpam iti | athā'ścyotanaṃ mātrāsvarūpam āha - āścyotaneṣv iti | sarveṣu lekhanādiṣu vākśatam iti | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk netrasecane tu snehanādiṣu mātrāviśeṣaḥ proktaḥ | atra tu netramadhye bindukṣepaṇatvena sarveṣu vākśatamātram eva | kecid atra mātrālakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti tad yathā -‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsām aṅgulyā choṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu nāsti || 12-16 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athāścyotanam | athānantaram āścyotanaṃ kathyate tat āścyotanaṃ niśāyāṃ rātrau na kāryaṃ kathaṃcana | tallakṣaṇam āha – unmīlita uddhāṭite 'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye dvyaṅgulāt bindubhir yad dīyate tad evāścyotanam | lekhanādau kiyanto bindavo deyās tad āha - te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ uṣṇe uṣṇakāle śītarūpa eṣa niścayaḥ | vātādau kīdṛśā āścyotanā deyās tad āha -sugamam | āścyotananāmāny āha - budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ iyaṃ vāṅmātrā smṛtā | keyaṃ tad āha sarveṣāṃ āścyotanānāṃ vāṅmātrā hitā nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ nimeṣo netranimeṣas tanyaunmeṣakaraṇaṃ tathā aṅgulyā cchoṭikī gurvakṣaro dīrghākṣaras tasyoccāraṇaṃ dvayaṃ vāṅmātrā ekā || 12-16 ||

athāścyotanārthaṃ yogān āha -
bilvādipañcamūlena bṛhatyeraṇḍaśigrubhiḥ || 17 ||

Āḍhamalla. araṇi: agnimanthabhedaḥ tadabhāve agnimantha eva dviguṇaḥ kārya iti paribhāṣoktatvāt | athānyaprakāram āha - lodhro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak tvaca eva lodhrasaṃjñā vikhyātā | atra strīdugdhaṃ saṃmiśryāścyotanaṃ kāryam iti vyavahāraḥ | tantrāntare 'pi ‘nimbasya patraiḥ parilipya lodhnaṃ svedāgninā cūrṇam athāpi kalkam | āścyotanaṃ mānuṣadugdhayuktaṃ pittāsradāhāpaham agryam ukta’miti | aparam api ‘triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam’ | triphalāścyotanam iti kvātharūpam | athavā himakaṣāyarūpaṃ boddhavyaṃ kalkarūpam ity eke | yad uktaṃ
‘jātā rogā vinaśyanti na bhavanti kadācana |
triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa prātar nayanadhāvanaḥ ||
strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit |
kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ cāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet’ | kṣīrasarpir iti dohanamātreṇaivotpannaṃ taṃ haiyaṅgavīnam ity āhuḥ | kṣīram atra gavyam | tathā ca ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpis tarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpi karṣaṇa’miti | yad vā kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīrasarpiḥ ghṛtam iti kevalaṃ gavyam ājaṃ vā grāhyam | strīstanyādiyogoyam api āgantujadoṣe praśasta ity āhuḥ | tantrāntarīyoktatvāt | yad uktam ‘āgantudoṣaṃ prasamīkṣya kāryaṃ vaktroṣmaṇā svedanam āditas tu | āścyotanaṃ strīpayasā ca sadyo yac cāpi pittakṣatajāpahaṃ syāt’ iti || 17-20 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. tad yathā - bilvādipañcamūlena ‘bilvāgnimanthasyonākapāṭalā kumbhakārā bṛhatī kaṇṭakārī vātābhiṣyande ambu jalaṃ tatpiṣṭair nimbapatrair lodhrasya tvacaṃ lepayet | tāṃ tvagninā pratāpya piṣṭvā tadrasaḥ netrapūraṇād abhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet | raktavātapittābhiṣyande kṣīrasarpirdugdhaghṛtaiḥ | ghṛtaṃ manthanotthaṃ, āścyotane abhiṣyandaśūle || 17-20 ||

idānīṃ piṇḍikāvidhānam āha -
piṇḍī kavalikā proktā badhyate paṭṭavastrakaiḥ ||21||

lg.l: aśānte sarvathā manthe bhruvor upari dāhayet |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. vraṇeṣv api nibadhyata iti | vraṇam atra śastrakṣārāgnikṛtaṃ jalaukāpātanakṛtaṃ vā tatraiva boddhavyam | anyad vraṇaṃ ca yan netrayor doṣajanitam | tathāgantuje piṇḍī vihitā athāsyāgre 'bhiṣyandādhimanthayoḥ karmāntaroktaṃ ślokadvayam āhur eke | etad dvayaṃ ca prakaraṇāntaroktatvenāsmābhir api nātra varṇitam | asaṃgatatvāt | atha sarvābhiṣyandipiṇḍikāviṣayam āha - sarveṣv iti | vātapittakapharaktasvarūpeṣu | budhair iti grahaṇena yathāyogyaṃ dravyādikaṃ vicārya badhnīyād ity arthaḥ | ata eva vātābhiṣyande snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā deyā | evaṃ pittaraktādike madhuraśītety abhiprāyaḥ || 21-24 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha piṇḍikā vastrapaṭṭakaiḥ badhyate sā piṇḍikā balikā ca proktā sā netrābhiṣyandayogyā | vraṇeṣv api sā badhyate | athābhiṣyande śirovirecanam āha śleṣmasaṃbhave abhiṣyande tathādhimanthe netraroge snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya puruṣasya śiras tīkṣṇair nasyair virecayet srāvayet | snigdhakṛtatailābhyaṅgasvinnaṃ sveditam uttamāṅgaṃ mastakaṃ yasya saḥ | tasya adhimanthānyākriyām āha - sugamam || 21-24 ||

idānīṃ piṇḍikārthaṃ prayogavarān āha -
vātābhiṣyandaśāntyarthaṃ snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā bhavet |
eraṇḍapatramūlatvaṅnirmitā vātanāśinī || 25 ||
