Āḍhamalla. tatra vātābhiṣyandanāśanī yathā (vāteti) | atrairaṇḍasya patrāṇi mūlaṃ tvak cāṅgatrayaṃ saṃgṛhya kalkam āhuḥ | kalkārthaṃ cātra payaḥ ity apare | sāmānyatvena jalaṃ deyam iti sarvatra | vātanāśinīty anenaiva kevalaṃ vātābhiṣyande kathitaṃ kintu adhimanthādīnāṃ vātarujāyām api śastam etat | evaṃ pittakaphayor api boddhavyam | atha pittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ piṇḍīyogam āha - dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ kāñjikaṃ jalaṃ vā sarvatra | mahānimbo nimbārkaḥ sa ca vakāṇaniṃbaśabdavācyaḥ | atrāpy anukte jalam | eke śigrupatrakṛtetyādikaṃ pāṭham anyathā paṭhanti ‘śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍo śleṣmābhiṣyandahāriṇī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī vātapittavināśinī’ iti śleṣmapittayor iti | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande yogam āha | śigruḥ sobhāñjanakaḥ triphalā haritakyādikam| atrāpi kalkārthaṃ yathāyogyaṃ vihitaṃ dravaṃ deyam | atha raktābhiṣyandārthaṃ yogam āha - piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyeneti | kāñjikadravabhāgena| tadabhāve jalam atra grāhyam | tena pūrvaṃ lodhraṃ kāñjikena saṃpiṣya paścāt ghṛtena saṃpācya piṇḍikā kāryā | athābhiṣyandādīnāṃ śothakaṇḍūharaṇārthaṃ yogottamam āha | atra śuṇṭhīnimbadalāpekṣayā svalpo deyaḥ | svalpasaindhaveti śuṇṭhīmānāl laghutaram saṃyogo piṇḍīviśeṣaṇam | tena saṃyogayuktā vastrapaṭṭādibhiḥ susaṃhatā ity arthaḥ | eke saṃyogād iti pañcamyantaṃ paṭhanti | tatrāsyāḥ saṃyogād eva śothādayo yāntīti bhāvaḥ || 25-29 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athābhiṣyande kriyām āha | atha vātādināśe piṇḍikām āha - mahānimbaphaleti | vāte pitte ca piṇḍī | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande piṇḍī śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ | atha śleṣmapittaraktābhiṣyande piṇḍī ghṛtamṛṣṭā kāñjikapiṣṭā lodhrapiṇḍikā asṛgbhavaṃ raktabhavam abhiṣyandaṃ harati | śothakaṇḍvādau piṇḍī nimbadalaiḥ nimbapatraiḥ | spaṣṭam anyat || 25-29 ||

atha biḍālavidhiḥ |
biḍālako bahirlepo netre pakṣmavivarjitaḥ || 30 ||

Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ biḍālakaviṣayam āha - mukhalepavidhānavad ity anena yathā mukhalepavidhis tadvad atrāpi boddhavyaṃ, mukhalepavidhis tu pūrvādhyāye lepanamūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇākhye jñātavyaḥ || 30 ||

div.ab: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha biḍālaḥ netrapakṣmavivarjite bahirbhāge yo lepaḥ sa biḍālaka ucyate tasya mātrā mukhalepamātrā mukhalepavidhānavad vijñeyā || 30 || atha lepaḥ |

ab.seg:
sa yathā - dī. - atha lepam āha - sa yathety anena yogān darśayati gnanthakāraḥ |
yaṣṭīgairikasindhūtthadārvītārkṣyaiḥ samāṃśakaiḥ ||31||

lg.l: lepanād armaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karoty eṣa prayogarāṭ || 36 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī | eke yaṣṭīsthāne pathyāṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | pathyā harītakī sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ dārvī haridrā tārkṣyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ tadabhāve dāruharidrā dviguṇā grāhyā taddravatvāt aparam api vakṣyamāṇacatuṣṭayaṃ sarvanetrāmaye vihitam iti śeṣaḥ | kiṃ tad āha - rasāñjanena lepa eko yogaḥ | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ dravyaviśeṣaḥ | viśvādalair api pathyā viśvadalair api dvitīyo yogaḥ | pathyā harītakī viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī etayor dalāni patrāṇi athavā dalasthāne jaleti pāṭhaḥ | tatra jalaṃ vālakaṃ | vacā haridrā viśvaiḥ kṛtvā tṛtīyo yogaḥ | nāgaragairikaiś caturthaḥ viśvānāgaraśabdābhyāṃ śuṇṭhī kathitā | badhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭaghṛtapiṣṭam añjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ saindhavam atra manāk deyam | madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sikthakam | loke momaśabdavācyam | ghṛtam atra gavyaṃ lepotra punar jalena pracarati añjanaṃ tu ghṛtenaiva vyavahāraḥ | sadyo netrarujāpaham iti | abhiṣyandodhimanthādīnāṃ vedanāpaham iti | ayaḥ
‘lohapātreṇa saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbūphalodbhavaḥ |
kiṃcid ghano bahirlepo netrabādhaṃ vyapohati’ | nimbūphalarasas tu lohapātre prakṣipya tadanu lohadaṇḍenāpi gharṣayet yāvat ghano bhavati | eke lohapātreṇety asya sthāne kāṃsyapātreṇeti paṭhanti mānayanti ca | netrabādhām iti netravyathāṃ tenābhiṣyandādīnām ity arthaḥ | athārmanāśanārthaṃ yogam āha | keśarājo mārkavaḥ loke ghamarāśabdavācyaḥ | armātiraktārmasaṃjñaṃ, netrābhyantaresya pracāra ity eke | prayogarāṭ prayogaśreṣṭhaḥ |
svinnāṃ bhitvā viniṣpādya bhinnām añjananāmikāṃ
śilailāmanasindhūtthaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet | pratisārayed ity anena śilācūrṇaṃ kṛtvā kṣaudreṇa saṃplāvya yojyaṃ | kutra yojyaṃ tad āha añjananāmikām iti | guhāñjanīti loke | sā ca paṭalante pakṣmasamīpe bhavati | svinnām iti tāṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsvedya paścāt śastreṇa bhitvā vidārya tadanu niṣpīḍyata iti pūyam ānīya paścāt pratisārayet| ata eva bhinnām iti viśeṣaṇam asyāḥ śilailanatasindhūtthair iti śilā manaḥśilā elā kṣudrailā, nataṃ tagaraṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavam || 31-37 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sa yathā - yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, dārvī dāruharidrā, tārkṣyaḥ kharparaṃ, samāṃśakaiḥ samabhāgaiḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ sarve ye netrāmayā abhiṣyandādayas tān hanti | anyac ca rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, pathyā harītakī, viśvā śuṇṭhī, dalaṃ patrajaṃ, kumārī, agnipatraiḥ etaiḥ ṣaḍyogāḥ | anyac ca lodhraṃ saindhavaṃ agnau dagdhvā madhūcchiṣṭe ghṛte kṛtam etat piṣṭam añjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ bhavati | anyac ca sugamam | athārmasu lepaḥ maricaṃ saṃcūrṇayitvā keśarājo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, tasya svarasamardanāt punaḥ lepanāt eṣaḥ prayogarāṭ armaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karoti | arma vraṇaviśeṣaḥ | atha pratisāraṇam añjananāmikāṃ svinnāṃ sveditāṃ punaḥ bhitvā vidārayitvā punaḥ viniṣpīḍya pīḍayitvā śilā elā nataṃ tagaraṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ sakṣaudrair etaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ kuryāt | netrāñjananāmikā netrapiḍakā || 31-37 ||

tarpaṇam |
atha tarpaṇakaṃ vacmi netratṛptikaraṃ param |
yad rūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkaṃ ca netraṃ kuṭilam āvilam || 38 ||

lg.l: nimagnāny akṣipakṣmāṇi yāvat syus tāvad eva hi ||44||
pūrayen mīlite netre tata unmīlayec chanaiḥ |
śukle ca ṣaṭśataṃ kṛṣṇaroge saptaśataṃ matam ||46||
sahasraṃ vātarogeṣu dhāryam evaṃ hi tarpaṇam || 47 ||
ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vāpi pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate param |
nivṛttir vyādhiśāntiś ca kriyālāghavam eva ca ||57||
atha sāśru guru snigdhaṃ netraṃ syād atitarpitam |
rūkṣam asnāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ netraṃ syād dhīnatarpitam || 51 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ tarpaṇavidhānaṃ darśayann āha - athetyādi | biḍālānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanakaṃ karma vacmi | kīdṛśaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇayogyaṃ bhavati tad āha - yad rūpam ityādi | yādṛśaṃ rūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkam iti vātābhiṣyandād eva | āvilaṃ kaluṣaṃ śīrṇapakṣmeti romaśātanaṃ śirotpāta iti yathā - ‘avedanā vāpi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ | muhur virajyaṃti ca yāḥ sa tādṛg vyādhiḥ śirotpāta iti pradiṣṭa’ iti | kṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutam iti kṛcchronmīlanaḥ ākuṃcanasaṃjñaḥ | yathā -‘vātādyā vartmasaṃkocaṃ janayanti gatā yadā | tadā draṣṭuṃ na śaknoti kuṃcanaṃ nāma tad viduḥ’iti | timirārjunaśukrādyair iti timiraṃ tu liṅganāśasya mūlam eva | yataś caturthapaṭalagato doṣas timiraṃ karoti tac ca nānārūpaṃ bhavati | arjunam iti śuklabhāgagatarogaviśeṣaḥ | yad uktaṃ ‘eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamaś ca binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tad arjunaṃ vadantī’ti | śukram iti kṛṣṇabhāgagataṃ tac ca trividhaṃ śuddhaśukraṃ śirāśukraṃ kṣataśukraṃ ceti | śukram atra puṣpaśabdavācyaṃ phūlīti loke | ādigrahaṇād etādṛśair anyair api | abhiṣyandādhimanthakair iti abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ | ayam api sarvanetrarogotpādaka ity arthaḥ | adhimantho netre śotharūpo rujāvāṃś ca bhavati sa ca vṛddhenābhiṣyandenaiva kriyāvatāṃ tatpuruṣāṇāṃ caturvidho jāyate | śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyām iti śuṣkākṣipākaḥ sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ sa yathā - ‘yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃdahyate cāviladarśanaṃ yat | sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tad akṣī’ti | śotha iti | śothajanetrapākaḥ | yataḥ -‘kaṇḍūpadehāśruyutaḥ pakkodumbarasannibhaḥ | saṃraṃbhī pacyate yas tu netrapākaḥ sa śothaja’ iti | vātaviparyayair yuta iti vātaviparyayo netrarogaviśeṣaḥ | ayam api sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ | yathā ‘vāraṃ vāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaś ca vividhās tīkṣṇāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | taṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyam iti yat pūrvoktarogaviśeṣe varṇitaṃ tan netram ity arthaḥ | tarpaṇaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | atha tarpaṇakriyāyām ayogyaviṣayam āha - durdinātyuṣṇaśītair ity anena śītoṣṇavarṣāsvarūpaṃ kālaṃ tarpaṇavihitam | prāptiniṣedhatvāt | durdinam iti varṣā meghavṛṣṭyākulaṃ dinaṃ niṣiddhaṃ nānyat | evam atyuṣṇam iti | grīṣme kharatarakiraṇatāpitadivasam | atiśītaṃ vātādivyāptaṃ dinam iti saṃbhrameṣv iti bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ | aśāṃtopadrave cākṣṇīti | āmadoṣajananopadravasahitaṃ nākṣi tarpayed ity abhiprāyaḥ| tad yathā - ‘udīrṇavedanaṃ netraṃ rāgaśoṣasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāśruyuktam āmānvitaṃ vidu’riti | idānīṃ tarpaṇasya kartavyavidhāv api karmavidhānam āha - tarpaṇārthī puruṣaḥ prathamam eva śobhanaṃ sthānam anvicchet | tatra vātātaparajorahite iti| etayor lakṣaṇatvenāgnidhūmarahite iti grahaṇaṃ | yad uktaṃ - ‘pratisūryāgnirahite nīrujo dhūmamārute | gṛhe sukhe nirābādhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca samācaredi’ti | uttānaśāyinety anena niścalasya vītakrodhatayāsya cāvarodhaḥ tantrāntaradarśanāt ‘uttānaśāyinaḥ kāryaṃ niścalasya yathāsukham | tarpaṇaṃ netrayugale vītakrodhabhayasya ce’ti | atha paścātkarmāha - ādhārau māṣacūrṇena netrakośayor iti netrapuṭayoḥ | dvau ādhārau kuryāt | ādhāro māṣapiṣṭīmayaḥ palīsaṃjñaḥ | klinnena māṣacūrṇeneti | klinnaṃ jalena marditam | kathaṃbhūtāv ādhārāv iti | parimaṇḍalau pari samantato bhāvena maṇḍalākārau tenārdhāṅgulotsedhaḥ dvyaṅgulavistāraṃ yathā syāt kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | tathā hi ‘ardhāṅgulo 'rdhavistāraṃ yathā syān nākṣirodhakṛt’ iti | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtāv ādhārau | samāhitau na viṣamaiḥ | dṛḍhāv iti na śīrṇau | asaṃdhāv iti saṃdhirahitau | etena tannipuṇena kāryāv ity arthaḥ | idānīṃ tarpaṇārthaṃ dravyaviśeṣam āha - pūrayen netrādhārāv iti śeṣaḥ | kena pūrayet tam āha - ghṛtamaṇḍenetyādi | vilīnaghṛtasya ghanībhūtasyoparitano bhāgo ghṛtamaṇḍa ity ucyate | kīdṛśena sukhodakaiḥ kṛtvā vilīne | eke sukhodarkair evākṣipūraṇam āhuḥ | tad asaṃgatam | athavety anena dravyāntaram āha - dhautena sarpiṣety arthaḥ | kṣīramathanāt samudbhūtaṃ navanītaghṛtaṃ kṣīraghṛtam ity ucyate | kṣīram atra gavyaṃ grāhyaṃ tadvihitatvāt | tathā hi - ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpis tarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaśreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpakarṣaṇa’miti | atha kiyatparimāṇena pūraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tam āha - eke tu ‘pakṣmāṇi yāvan majjanti romavattā yadā bhruvo’riti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tata unmīlayec chanair iti | unmīlanaṃ tu śanaiḥ kuryāt | śanair ity anena karmāntaraṃ sūcayati | katham unmīlayet tad āha carakaḥ - ‘tato vastreṇa pītena nīlena haritena vā | patrair ācchādya nayane tataḥ paśyed yathāsukhami’ti | atha tarpaṇasya dhāraṇaṃ kiyatkālena kāryaṃ tad āha - vartmarogeṣv iti kṛcchronmīlanapakṣmaghātaprabhṛtiṣu | vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śatam iti| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk teṣāṃ śatam ity arthaḥ| athavāṅgulyoḥ choṭikāsvarūpaṃ vāṅmātrātmatvena kathitam | tathā ca ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsām aṃgulyā cchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhairi’ti| svasthe kaphe iti prakṛtisthe kaphe athavā svasthe puruṣe nīroge, nirupadrave ity anye ata eva sopadrave doṣe tarpaṇaṃ na vihitam iti pūrvoktam eva | saṃdhirogajalasrāvaprabhṛtike kṛṣṇaroge śuddhaśukraśirāśukrapramukhe kaphe ca vikārābhipanne ata eva ṣaṭśatam ity arthaḥ | pañcaśatān dṛṣṭirogeṣv iti pitte nakulāndhyaprabhṛtiṣu dṛṣṭirogeṣv iti bahuvacanatvena pittaje raktaje vā'ṣṭauśatāni kuryāt | adhimanthe sahasrakam ity asya sthāne adhimanthe navaśatam iti paṭhanti | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣv iti bahuvacanatvenāpi sannipātātmake vyādhau sahasramātraṃ yāvad deyaṃ | tantrāntare saptaśatamātrābhiḥ sannipāte vihitam | tathā ca ‘vācāṃ sahasramātrā syād dhārayen mārutavyathe | pittaje raktaje vā... ...niva | sannipātātmake saptapañca svasthavidhau tathe’ti viṣayovagantavyaḥ | atha kaphasnehopanayanaṃ kuryāt tam āha - idānīṃ doṣādiviśeṣeṇa tarpaṇaviśeṣasya dināntaram āha - ekāham iti | ekadināntaraṃ granthakāradarśanāt| tathā ca - ‘ahany ahani vātotthe pittarakte dināntaram | tarpaṇaṃ sannipātotthadvyantaraṃ tryaṃtaraṃ kaphe’ iti | tatra pittaraktādidoṣe tarpaṇaṃ kāryam | vāgrahaṇena vātotthepi ahany ahani kāryaṃ dvitīyavāgrahaṇenāpi dvyantaraṃ boddhavyaṃ sannipātaviṣayaṃ eke kaṭūṣṇam iti paṭhanti | tryaham iti tridināntaraṃ tac ca kaphety anukte svasthādāv api | pañcāham iti pañcadināntaram | atha tarpaṇaliṅgāni yasya bhavanti tān āha - sukhaṃ yathā syāt | svapnāvabodho bhavati | vaiśadyaṃ netrasyeti | varṇapāṭavam iti varṇaṃ śvetakṛṣṇādikaṃ tasya pāṭavaṃ nirmalatvam etena vyaktavartmane bhavataḥ | nivṛttir avalokanapracāro dṛḍhataro bhavati | kriyālāghavam iti sūkṣmāvalokanepi samarthadṛṣṭir bhavatīty arthaḥ | athātitarpitasya lakṣaṇāny āha - atheti sugamam | atha hīnatarpitasya lakṣaṇam āha - rūkṣam asnigdham, asrāvilam asrair netrajalair āvilaṃ kaluṣīkṛtaṃ rāgam āraktatāṃ hīnatarpitanetram iti | atha hīnātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakāram āha - etayor hīnātitarpitayoḥ | tenātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakārato rūkṣakriyā hīnatarpitā snigdhā kriyety abhiprāyaḥ || 38-51 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha tarpaṇam athānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ cikitsitaṃ vacmi kathayāmi | tarpaṇakaṃ netratṛptikaraṃ | keṣu rogeṣu tarpaṇaṃ kriyate tān āha - yan netraṃ rūkṣaṃ bhavati | śuṣkaṃ kuṭilaṃ vakram āvilaṃ malayuktaṃ śīrṇapakṣma śīrṇaṃ gataṃ | pakṣma netrarogaṃ yasya tat | ete vātaparyantādayo netraroganidāne jñeyāḥ | evaṃbhūtaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ | netrarogaviśāradair vaidyaiḥ yatra tarpaṇaṃ na vihitaṃ tad āha - sugamam | yatra tarpaṇaṃ na hitaṃ yena vidhānena vā tad āha - vātādīnāṃ hīne rahite deśe uttānaśāyinaḥ puruṣasya netrakośayoḥ uparibhāge klinnena ārdreṇa māṣacūrṇena parimaṇḍalau maṇḍalākārau samau dṛḍhau asaṃbādhau kartavyau | tatra netre vilīnena drutena ghṛtagaṇḍena pūrayet | sukhodakair vā athavā | śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrotthitena sarpiṣā vā yāvat akṣipakṣmāṇi nimagnāni bhavanti tāvat kāryaṃ | mīlite netre pūrayet | pūraṇānantaraṃ tataḥ śanaiḥ unmīlayet | dhāraṇe pramāṇam āha - vāṅmātrālakṣaṇaṃ gurvakṣaroccāraṇādikaṃ pūrvoktam eva | sugamaṃ cānyat | tarpaṇe dāhakaphādhikye pratīkāram āha - tataḥ snehavīryeṇa īritam asya kaphasvinnena yavapiṣṭena yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena viśodhayet | tarpaṇaṃ kiyaddinaparyantaṃ kartavyaṃ tad āha - ekāhaṃ tryahaṃ paraṃ pramāṇaṃ pañcāhaṃ vā iṣyate | atha tarpaṇe tṛptilakṣaṇam āha - tarpaṇe netrasya sukhasvapnādīni tṛptiliṅgāni bhāvayet vicārayed iti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | sukhena svapnatvaṃ sukhena bodhatvaṃ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatā netrasya | varṇasya pāṭavaṃ paṭutvaṃ nirvṛttir nirāvṛttiḥ spaṣṭadarśanatvaṃ vyādhiśāntiḥ | kriyālāghavaṃ nimeṣonmeṣakriyālaghutvam | atitarpitam āha - sāsru-asruyuktaṃ guru snigdhaṃ ca | atha hīnatarpitanetram āha - rūkṣam asrāvilaṃ raktāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ rogayuktaṃ hīnatarpitaṃ netram evaṃ syāt | atitarpitahīnatarpitayoḥ pratikāram āha - rūkṣopacāreṇātisnigdhasya na hīnasnigdheneti yāvat || 38-51 ||

puṭapākaḥ | sambandhaś cāyaṃ - tarpaṇoktavidhānakriyāvyāpattisamānadharmatvaṃ puṭapākam āha -
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṭapākasya sādhanam ||52||

lg.l: dvau bilvamātrau māṃsasya piṇḍau snigdhau supeṣitau |
dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo mataḥ ||53||
puṭapākena tat paktvā gṛhṇīyāt tadrasaṃ budhaḥ || 54 ||
snehano lekhanaś caiva ropaṇaś ceti sa tridhā |
snehanaḥ puṭapākaś ca dhāryo dve vākśate dṛśoḥ |
lekhanāt triguṇo dhāryaḥ puṭapākas tu ropaṇaḥ |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha puṭapākavidhānam āha - atha puṭapākasya traividhyam āha - sa puṭapākaḥ | atha teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye kaḥ kasya vihitas tam āha - atirūkṣasya puruṣasya snigdhasyāpi puruṣasyeti śeṣaḥ | lekhano lekhanaḥ puṭapākaḥ | dṛṣṭer balārthaṃ dṛṣṭidṛḍhīkaraṇārtham itaro ropaṇapuṭapākaḥ | sa eva pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | vraṇavātādayo netragatā eva boddhavyā: | idānīṃ snehanapuṭapākam ādau pradarśayann āha - vasāmāṃsāśritaḥ | sneha iti śeṣaḥ | tathā ca ‘śuddhamāṃsabhavaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā’ majjā mastakamajjā sthūlāsthiṣu ca bhavati | bheda udarasthatvagasthiṣu ca | tathā coktaṃ ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tv abhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyata’ iti | dṛśa iti | dṛśi madhye niṣevya iti viṣayaḥ | atha lekhanapuṭapākam āha - jāṅgalānāṃ jantūnāṃ yakṛnmāṃsair iti | yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaḥ | yady api jāṅgalavargo 'ṣṭavidha: kathitaḥ | tad yathā jāṅgalā viṣkirāḥ pratudā guhāśayāḥ | prasahā: parṇamṛgā bileśayā grāmyāś ceti | tathāpi keṣāṃcin mate paṃcaiva śreṣṭhatamā: jāṅgalaviṣkirapratudaparṇamṛgabileśayāś ca te ke jāṅgalādyās tān keṣāṃcit jñāpanārtham āha - eṇahariṇaparṇakuraṅgādayo jāṅgalāḥ | lāvatittirakapiñjalavartīrurvādayaḥ | viṣkirāḥ kapotapārāvatakaliṅgādayaḥ | pratudā: siṃhavyāghravṛ(ṣā?)śvakaśṛgālamārjārādayo guheśayāḥ | kākakaṅkakuraracāṣabhāsādayaḥ | prasahā: mṛdubhūrivakavṛkṣaśāyikāvānaraprabhṛtayaḥ | parṇamṛgāḥ śvāvicchaśagodhānakulādayo bileśayāḥ| aśvāśvataragokharoṣṭrabastorabhramedaḥpucchaprabhṛtayo grāmyā iti jāṅgalavargaḥ samāsena proktaḥ | yady asya doṣasya vihitaṃ tat tatraiva jñātavyam | lekhanadravyasaṃyutair iti lekhanadravyair vakṣyamāṇakṛṣṇaloharajaḥprabhṛtikaiḥ īdṛśaiś cety abhiprāyaḥ | kṛṣṇaloharajaḥ kṛṣṇasāravarṇatāmrarajaś ca vidrumaṃ pravālaṃ siṃdhujaṃ saidhavaṃ kāsīsaṃ dvividham ekaṃ bhasmasadṛśaṃ kiṃcid amlalavaṇarasaṃ, dvitīyaṃ puṣpakāsīsam īṣatpītaṃ tuvaraṃ tadbhavam eva srotoñjanam iti | rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tac ca dvividham | ekaṃ srotoñjanakṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛti dravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākvāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ | mastu dadhnas toyaviśeṣam | tathā ca ‘dadhnas tu yad adhas toyaṃ tan mastu parikīrtita’m iti | athāto ropaṇapuṭapākam āha - stanyaṃ strīdugdhaṃ tadabhāve gavyam ājaṃ vā | jāṅgalaśabdena jāṅgalaprāṇināṃ vasā majjā medo grāhyaṃ ropaṇakriyāyāṃ vihitatvāt | madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakagavyaṃ niṃbaprabhṛtikaṃ lekhanatriguṇo dhārya ity anena vākśatatrayaṃ sūcitam | atha puṭapākavyāpatticikitsām āha - vitared iti | puṭapākavyāpattidarśane hīnātiyoge tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ cikitsāṃ kārayet | etena tāni lakṣaṇāni atrā'pi jñeyāni iti granthakṛtā sūcitam | tathā hi -‘tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyārhe na ca yojayet | yāvanty ahāni yuñjīta dvis tato hitabhāk bhavet’ iti || 52-61 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha puṭapākaḥ | ataḥ ūrdhvam ataḥ paraṃ puṭapākasya sādhanaṃ vakṣyāmi kathayiṣyāmi | tatsādhanam āha - māṃsasya jāṅgalamāṃsasya bilvamātrau dvau piṇḍau snigdhau sucikkaṇau tathā supeṣitau sūkṣmapeṣitau bilvadravyāṇāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ dravaḥ kuḍavayutaḥ | phalaṃ tan māṃsauṣadham ekatvaṃ samāloḍya samyak melayitvā patrair jambvādibhir veṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ mṛttikāṃ veṣṭya puṭapākayuktyā tadrasaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tarpaṇoktavidhānena avacārayet | tasya grahaṇavidhānam āha - saḥ snehādibhedena tridhābhūtaḥ | uttānaśāyino nityaṃ niṣevyaḥ syāt tasya kiṃvidho hitas tad āha - sugamam | sneham āha - sarpir ghṛtaṃ māṃsādīni medāṃtāni jāṅgalāni svādvauṣadhaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ kṛtasnehanas tena puṭapākaḥ īdṛśaḥ iṣyate vāṅmātrā dve śate dhāryāḥ | lekhanam āha - lekhanadravyāṇi kṛṣṇalohādīni kṛṣṇaloharajaś cūrṇaṃ siṃdhusrotoñjanaḥ cūrṇaṃ dadhimastu dadhijalaṃ lekhano vāk śataṃ dhāryaḥ | etāvad eva tasya dhāraṇam | atha ropaṇam āha - stanyaṃ dugdhaṃ jāṅgalaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsaṃ madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakadravyāṇi kaṭukyādīni taiḥ pācitaḥ lekhanāt | ropaṇaḥ triguṇapramāṇo dhāryaḥ | lekhane vākśatādidhāraṇaṃ vyāpattidarśane upadrave tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ vitaret || 52-61 ||

añjanam |
atha saṃpakvadoṣasya prāptam añjanam ācaret |
hemante śiśire caiva madhyāhne 'ñjanam iṣyate ||62||

lg.l: pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe ca grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate |
varṣāsu nābhre nāpy uṣṇe vasante ca sadaiva hi ||63||
lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva tathā syāt snehanāñjanam |
pramāṇaṃ madhyame 'dhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu mṛdau bhavet ||68||
madhyamā dviviḍaṅgā syād dhīnā tv ekaviḍaṅgikā ||69||
mṛdau tu triśalākaṃ syāc catasra: snaihike 'ñjane ||70||
sāyaṃ prātar vāñjanaṃ syāt tat sadā naiva kārayet ||73||
kṛṣṇabhāgād adhaḥ kuryād apāṅgaṃ yāvad añjanam || 74 ||

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. atha añjanaprakāram āha - athaśabdo 'trāmadoṣānantaraṃ sūcyate | tenāparipakvadoṣasya prāptam añjanam apraśastam ity abhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ ‘añjanaṃ pūraṇaṃ kkāthapānam āme na śasyata’ iti | prāptam añjanam iti yady asya samayasyoktaṃ tat tatraiva yojyam iti prāptaśabdena varṇitam | atha katham ācaret tad āha - hemanta ityādyaṃ janaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo yathā | atha trividhāñjanam āha -śukrādiṣu ropaṇaṃ kledakaṇḍūpakṣmaprarohaṇādiṣu snehanaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ tac ca timirādiṣu atha trayāṇāṃ sāmānyena dravyāṇy āha - kṣārādivastunirmitaṃ lekhanāñjanaṃ kathitaṃ kṣāraṃ yavakṣāraprabhṛtikaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ maricādikam amlarasam amlīkamātuluṅgapramukhaṃ ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu | kaṣāyādinirmitaṃ bhavati | kaṣāyo harītakyādiḥ tikto nimbādiḥ | sasneham iti | snehaṃ ghṛtatailādikaṃ prasādāñjanaṃ tu snehanasaṃjñaṃ kathitam | tat tu madhurādinirmitaṃ bhavati | madhuraṃ madhurarasaprāyaṃ dravyam | madhuraṃ ghṛtaguḍādisnehasaṃpannam iti snehārtham | ata eva snehanaṃ kathitam | atha trividhāñjanasya rūpam āha -guṭikārasacūrṇādīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam | tat trividhaṃ tu śalākayā aṅgulyā vā yathāyogyaṃ kuryāt | añjanam iti tāni yathottaraṃ tu hīnāni jñātavyāni yo yasmād uttaraṃ yathottaraṃ tena guṭikāñjanād rasakriyāñjanaṃ hīnaṃ rasāc cūrṇāñjanam iti | atha yeṣāṃ rogiṇām añjanaṃ na praśastaṃ tān āha -śrānte puruṣe | śrāntatā ca chardanavāhanajā bhavati | prarudite prakarṣarodane kṛte | bhīte bhayayukte pītamadye pītaṃ madyaṃ yena ajīrṇe āmājīrṇe viṣṭabdhe tu śūlādau vihitam etat | vegāghāte mūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ cakārād bhuktavati rātrijāgaraṇe ca nāñjanaṃ vihitaṃ tathā coktam - ‘bhuktavāṃs tu śiraḥsnātaśrāntaś chardanavāhanai: | rātrau jāgaritaś cāpi nātijvarita eva ce’ti | athāñjanasya parimāṇam āha - hareṇumātram iti | hareṇus tripuṭaḥ | kalāyaḥ reṇukety apare | madhyame 'ñjane sārdhaikapramāṇaṃ yathā syād vartiṃ kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | mṛdāv ity añjane dviguṇaṃ hareṇudvayaṃ yathā syāt tathā vartiṃ kuryād iti śeṣaḥ | atha rasakriyāñjanam āha - rasakriyā vakṣyamāṇāñjanasamūhāñjanaviśeṣo 'vagantavyaḥ | uttamamātrā mṛdvañjano viḍaṅgo dravyaviśeṣo vyākhyātaḥ | madhyameti na tīkṣṇe mṛdur iti hīneti tīkṣṇāñjana ity arthaḥ | ekaviḍaṅgaparimitā rasakriyā varter mātrā boddhavyā | tad uktaṃ - ‘viḍaṅgamātraṃ tv apare madhyaṃ dvāv uttamatrayaṃ | rasakriyāṇāṃ vartīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam’ iti | athāparāñjanānāṃ mānam anyat tad āha - vairecanikaṃ cūrṇam añjanaprastāve boddhavyaṃ | tac ca tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ kathitam ata eva dviśalākonmitam eva mṛdāv iti mṛducūrṇāñjane snehaneñjane catasraḥ śalākāḥ | tena catuḥśalākonmitāñjanaṃ proktam ity arthaḥ | śalākālakṣaṇaṃ vidhānam api vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | athāñjanaśalākām āha – mukhayor iti | śalākāyā ūrdhvādhobhāgagatayor eva mukhaśabdo vācyaḥ | tau tu kuṇṭhitau vigatadhārau kuryād ity abhiprāyaḥ | tena mukulākārāv ity apare | tathā ca ‘vakrāṃte mukulākārā kalāyaparimaṇḍale’tyādi | ślakṣṇeti | sarvatraiva ślakṣṇā kāryā mṛdutvena sasnigdhety arthaḥ | aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭabhir aṅgulaiḥ kṛtvā parimitā kāryā aśmajā sphaṭikādipāṣāṇaracitā | na kevalaṃ pāṣāṇajanitā dhātujā vā | dhātuśabdena suvarṇādikaṃ gṛhyate | tena suvarṇaraupyatāmrakāṣṭhāsthimayāḥ | kṛtā śalākā añjane śastā aṣṭāṅgulamitā śubhā iti | kalāyaparimaṇḍalety anena parisamantād vartulā kāryā ity abhiprāyaḥ| kalāyo vartulakalāyaḥ || asyāgre kecid iti paṭhanti
‘vāme karatale kṛtvā sajalaṃ nikaṣopalam |
dakṣiṇenāñjanaṃ nītvā kareṇa nikaṣec chanaiḥ ||
tena kalkena matimān śalākāgraṃ pralipya ca |
utthāpya cottaraṃ vartma vāmenāṅguṣṭhaparvaṇā ||
vartma śuklāntare cālpāṃ śalākāṃ supravartayet |
prathamaṃ savyanetraṃ ca paścād añjyāt tu dakṣiṇaṃ | śalākāṃguṣṭhadeśinyā navāṃtarnayanaṃ spṛśet’ ityādi kaiścit taṃtrāntarād avagamyātra likhitaṃ na svamataṃ | lekhane lekhanāñjane snehane snehanāñjane | ropaṇe ropaṇāṃjane | ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu dṛṣṭisādanaṃ | budhair iti grahaṇena yathāyogyam anyavastujanitā śalākā yojyā | athāñjanakarmaṇaḥ kālam āha - sāyaṃprātaḥ ity anena sāyaṃ tīkṣṇāṃjanaṃ kuryāt | prātaḥ gaṇḍūṣānantaraṃ yathā sadācāre rasāṃjanādikaṃ tadvad anyad api sadā sarvakāle tad añjanaṃ na kārayed ity arthaḥ | yataḥ | cakṣus tejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣāt | ‘yojayet saptarātre tu sravaṇārthe rasāñjanami’ti | tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ yathā
‘divā na tu prayoktavyaṃ netrayos tīkṣṇam añjanaṃ |
virekadurbalā dṛṣṭir ādityaṃ prāpya sīdati |
tasmāt sāyaṃ niśāyāṃ tu dhruvam añjanam iṣyate | rātrau svapnaguṇād akṣipuṣṭā hy añjanakarṣiteti’ | na kevalaṃ sarvakālaṃ niṣiddhaṃ kiṃtu yadā atiśītoṣṇavātābhraṃ ca bhavati tadā tasyāṃ velāyām api nāñjanaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ | kutra sthāneñjanaṃ kuryāt tad āha - kṛṣṇabhāgād ityādi sugamam || 62-74 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athāñjanaṃ atha athānantaraṃ pakkadoṣasya puruṣasya divasapañcakānantaram āgatapāke 'kṣṇi añjanam ācaret | idānīṃ sādhāraṇāñjanavidhim āha - hemante ityādau | hemante śiśire madhyāhneñjanam iṣyate grīṣme śaradi ca pūrvāhṇe aparāhṇe varṣāsu anabhre abhrarahite | nātyuṣṇe na uṣṇasamaye vasante sadaiva iṣyate | lekhanādibhedenāñjanabhedān āha - lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ ca prasādanaṃ cety aṃjanabhedaḥ | lekhanaṃ tatra kṣārādirasaiḥ kaṣāyādibhiḥ | prasādanaṃ guṭikādibhiḥ | trividham añjanam āha - guṭikādīni trividhāny aṃjanāni śalākayā aṅgulyā vā kriyate | yeṣu añjanaṃ na deyaṃ tān āha - vegaghāte | mūtrādyavarodhe vartyādau | añjanapramāṇaṃ tīkṣṇe 'ñjane hareṇumātrāṃ vartiṃ kurvīta | hareṇu reṇukā kalāpo vā madhyame tīkṣṇān madhyārdhāṃ hareṇumātrātaḥ ardhārdhaṃ sā hareṇumātrā mṛdau tīkṣṇān mṛdau dviguṇaṃ hareṇuto dviguṇaṃ sakriyā | uttamādi pramāṇam āha - sugamam | vairecanādau kiyantyaḥ śalākā ity āha -yato vairecanikaṃ cūrṇaṃ netre bahusrāvakaraṃ tad vairecanikam añjanaṃ vāradvayaṃ śalākayā dīyate | snehakāle catasra: śalākā vidhīyante | śalākāpramāṇaṃ yathā kasya śalāketi | ca mukhayodvaryoḥ | kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṅgulonmitā | mukhayor dvayoḥ kuṇṭhitā na tīkṣṇā ślakṣṇā sundarā aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇā aśmajā pāṣāṇajā dhātujā svarṇādidhātujā kalāyaparimaṇḍalā | kalāyo vartulakas tatparimāṇā sthūlā | lekhanādau kīdṛśī śalākā vidhīyate tām āha - sugamam | kasmin kasmin samaye kasmin bhāge añjanaṃ kuryād ity āha - sāyaṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ prātaḥ vā añjanaṃ syāt | añjanaṃ tadā na kārayet | tat añjanam atiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ na praśasyate | atiśīte atyuṣṇe kāle nāñjanaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ || 62-74 ||

pūrvam uktaṃ lekhanaropaṇasnehanabhedena trividhāñjaneṣu vartirasacūrṇatrividharūpaṃ, tatrādau lekhanīvartir adhunā vidhīyase | candrodayā |
śaṅkhanābhir vibhītasya majjā pathyā manaḥśilā |
pippalī maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacā ceti samāṃśakam ||75||

lg.l: timiraṃ māṃsavṛddhiṃ ca kācaṃ paṭalam arbudam |
rātryāndhyaṃ vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ vartiś candrodayā jayet ||77||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. iyaṃ candrodayā vartir lekhanī kathitā | rātryañjanayogena candrodayābhidhānam asyāḥ | tīkṣṇāñjanatvāt | śaṅkhanābhir iti madhye āvartatvena laghucakrākāraṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ samudrajaṃ śaṃkhaṃ śaṅkhanābhiśabdena vācyamtanna samīcīnaṃ, sarvatra śaṃkhanābhernetrāṃjanayogyatvāt | śaṃkhanābhiśca śodhitā grāhyā | dī. | athavā śaṅkhasya nābhir madhye grāhyam | atinirmalatvāt | vibhītakasya vibhītakaphalamajjā pathyā harītakī | yavonmiteti | yavaparimāṇāṃ vartiṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | añjanārthaṃ tu hareṇumātrā saṃghṛṣyāñjayet | lekhanāñjanatvāt jalair ity anena pūrvaṃ vartiḥ kṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya kāryā paścād añjanasamaye pānīyena saha ghṛṣyāñjayed iti bhāvaḥ | māṃsavṛddhir armādijanitā śeṣaṃ sugamam || 75-77 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha vartiḥ | śaṅkhanābhiḥ śaṅkhamadhyabhāgā | etān saṃpiṣya yavonmitāṃ vartiṃ kuryāt | hareṇumātrāṃ reṇukāmātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya añjanaṃ kuryāt | asyāñjanasya candrodayāvartir iti saṃjñā timirādīn jayet | vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ varṣaprabhavaṃ jayet | iti candrodayāvartiḥ || 75-77 ||

karañjavartiḥ |
palāśapuṣpasvarasair bahuśaḥsaptavāramityarthaḥ | paribhāvitā |
karañjabījavartis tu dṛṣṭeḥ puṣpaṃ vināśayet ||78||
Āḍhamalla. atha puṣpārthalekhanīvartidvayam āha - palāśapuṣpaṃ kiṃśukābhidhānaṃ bahuśaḥ ity anena saptavāram ity abhiprāyaḥ | karañjabījavartir iti| karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ ||78||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha lekhanīvartiḥ palāśapuṣpasvarasena karañjī bījareṇuḥ bahuśaḥ bhāvitā tadvartiḥ śukrādīn samullikhet dūrīkuryāt || 78 ||

Āḍhamalla. anyad yogam āha - samudraphenetyādi | samudraphenaṃ prasiddhaṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ śaṃkhaṃ prasiddhaṃ dakṣāṇḍavalkalair iti | dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ tasyāṃḍatvag eva grāhyā | eke samudraphena ityādikaṃ viparītaṃ paṭhanti tad yathā - ‘samudraphenadakṣāṇḍatvaksindhūtthaiḥ samākṣikaiḥ |atra saśarkarairiti pāṭhaḥ | caṃdraṭo'pi tathaiva paṭhati | śaṃkhaḥ śaṃkhanābhiḥ | śigrubījayutair vartiḥ śukraghnī śigruvāriṇe’ti | vyākhyānayanti tatra mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ śigruvāriṇā śigrusvarasena śastraval lekhanena lekhanī kathitā || 79 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyac ca samudraphenaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍakukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaiḥ śigru śobhāñjanaṃ tadbījaiḥ tadvartiḥ śukraṃ puṣpaṃ lekhanī vartiḥ || 79 ||

dantavartiḥ |
dantair dantivarāhoṣṭragohayājakhurodbhavaiḥ |
śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutaiḥ sarvair vicūrṇitaiḥmaricapādikairiti paṭhanīyaṃ vāgbhaṭasaṃvādāt | || 80 ||

lg.l: dantavartiḥ kṛtā ślakṣṇā śukrāṇāṃ nāśinī parā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atha lekhanīdantavartim āha - dantī hastīti rūḍhiḥ, varāhaḥ śūkaraḥ, uṣṭraḥ kramelako 'pi govṛṣabho 'pi, hayo ghoṭakaḥ, ajo bastaḥ chāgasaṃjñaḥ | kharo gardabhaḥ eteṣāṃ dantair ity arthaḥ | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutair iti | śaṅkhaśabdena sarvatra śaṅkhanābhir grāhyā | muktā mauktikaṃ ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ ślakṣṇā iti sūkṣmatvena saṃsnigdhā yathā syāt | parā utkṛṣṭā atrānukte peṣaṇārthaṃ jalam eva grāhyam || 80 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha lekhanī dantavartiḥ dantī hastī tadādīnāṃ dantaiḥ ajaḥ chāgaḥ kharo gardabha ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ | dantavartiḥ lekhanīvartiḥ || 80 ||

nīlotpalavartiḥ |
nīlotpalaṃ śigrubījaṃ nāgakeśarakaṃ tathā || 81 ||
Āḍhamalla. nīlotpalam ityādi | iyam api lekhanīvartiḥ kathitā | nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījaṃ grāhyam iti | sarvatra kalkārtham atra jalam āhuḥ | anuktatvāt || 81 ||

div.ab:
puṣpavartiḥ |
tilapuṣpāṇy aśītiḥ syuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulāḥ ||82||
jātī kusuma pañcāśan maricāni ca ṣoḍaśa |
sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭvā jale vartiḥ kṛtā kusumikābhidhā ||83||
timirārjunaśukrāṇāṃ nāśinī māṃsavṛddhihṛt |
(etasyāś cāñjane mātrāprakṣiptam | proktā sārdhahareṇukā ||84||)

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ ropaṇīvartividhānam āha - tileti | iyaṃ ropaṇī kusumikāvartiḥ kathitā | atra tilapuṣpāṇi aśītisaṃkhyākāni pippalītaṃḍulāḥ pippalīmadhyagatabījāni sarṣapākārāṇi ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākāni grāhyāṇi | jātī sumanāḥ tasyāḥ puṣpāṇy api pañcāśad gaṇitāni maricāni ca ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākānīty arthaḥ | jalair iti bahuvacanatvena kutrāpi kṣīreṇa pracāraḥ | timiropalakṣitatvena gataṃ cakṣuḥ nivartayed ity api yojyaṃ ropaṇatvāt | kecid asyāgre iti paṭhanti | etasyāś cāñjane mātrā proktā sārdhahareṇukā etat pūrvaṃ kathitam eva tasmād bahubhir na svīkṛtaṃ paunaruktyabhayāt | eke ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulā ity asya sthāne ‘ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ kaṇāḥ smṛtā’ iti paṭhanti etan na manoharam || 82-84 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha ropaṇīvartiḥ | aśītiḥ tilapuṣpāṇi | kaṇā pippalī tasyāḥ kaṇikāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ | jātīmukulāni puṣpāṇi pañcāśat | iyaṃ kusumikā vartiḥ | tasyā mātrā sārdhahareṇukā | kusumikā vartis timirādau || 82-84 ||

rasāñjanavartiḥ |
rasāñjanaṃ haridre dve mālatīnimbapallavā: |
gośakṛdrasasaṃyuktā vartir naktāndhyanāśinī || 85 ||

Āḍhamalla. athānyāṃ ropaṇīvartim āha - rasāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyaṃ tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ grāhyaṃ | haridre dve haridrā dāruharidrā mālatīpallavā nimbapallavā iti | mālatī jātī nimbaḥ prasiddhaḥ etayoḥ pallavāni komalapatrāṇi | gośakṛdrasa iti gopurīṣasvarasaḥ | śakṛd ity asya sthāne yakṛd iti pāṭhāntaram || 85 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. rasāñjanaṃ dve haridre haridrā, dāruharidrā, mālatī jātī nimbaḥ tayoḥ pallavāḥ komalapatrāṇi gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tadrasaṃ jalaṃ tena vartiḥ kṛtā naktāndhyaṃ rātryāndhyaṃ jayet || 85 ||

dhātryādivartiḥ |
dhātryakṣapathyābījāni ekadvitriguṇāni ca |
piṣṭvā vartiṃ jalaiḥ kuryād añjanaṃ dvihareṇukam || 86 ||

lg.l: netrasrāvaṃ haraty āśu vātaraktarujaṃ tathāasyāgre - pārāvatamalaṃ niṣkaṃ maricaṃ māṣamātrakam | ghṛṣṭvā ca nimbavartīnāṃ toyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ jayet || naktāṃdhyaṃ cirakālasthaṃ haṃti sājyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | śvetaṃ palāṇḍusvarasaṃ haṃti naktāṃdhyamānavam || saurāṣṭrīkarṣamekaṃ tu tatsamaṃ kharpare nyaset| | ṭaṃkārdha tutthakaṃ yojyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kṛtvā sa caikataḥ || kāṃsyapātreṇa tāmreṇa gharṣayennimbukadravaiḥ | caturthadinaparyantaṃ mardayecchodhayetpunaḥ || ghṛtena saṃhitāṃ yustvā vaṭikāṃ kārayedvudhaḥ | nāryāḥ stanyena vartiḥ sā netradṛṣṭiprasādinī || ājanmagatavartmānaḥ punareva bhavaṃti ca | kaṇḍūsrāvaṃ harecchīghraṃ gṛdhradṛṣṭirbhavennaraḥ||’ ityadhikamupalabhyate kutracit || |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ snehanīvartiṃ darśayann āha - dhātryakṣeti | iyaṃ snehanī vartiḥ kathitā | ekadvitriguṇāni yathākramaṃ yojyāni | vātaruktarajaṃ tathety anena vātajanitāṃ raktajanitām abhiṣyandādīnāṃ rujaṃ haratīty anye vyākhyānayanti | saṃmatoyam anyatroktatvāt | yathā ‘pathyākṣadhātrīphalamadhyabījais tridvyekabhāgair vidadhīta vartiḥ | tathāñjayed aśrumatipravṛddham akṣṇor haret kaṣṭam api prakopam iti ||86||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. dhātrī āmalakī akṣaṃ vibhītakaṃ pathyā harītakī krameṇa ekadvitriguṇāni etāni dvihareṇumātram añjanaṃ kuryāt | netrasrāvaṃ harati snehanī vartikā netrasrāve || 86 ||

rasakriyā |
tutthamākṣikasindhūtthaṃ sitāśaṅkamanaḥśilāḥ ||87||

Āḍhamalla. atha rasakriyām āha - iyaṃ ca lekhanīsaṃjñakā rasakriyāñjanārthaṃ vihitā, atra tu mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā śarkarā, śaṅkaṃ śaṅkhanābhi:, udadhiphenaṃ - samudraphenaṃ ceti cūrṇayed iti | anena samānamānam eteṣāṃ grāhyam | saṃyojya madhunā kuryād iti ko 'rthaḥ | etac cūrṇaṃ madhūktaśalākayā saṃgṛhya śukrādideśaṃ gharṣayed ity abhiprāyaḥ | madhuplāvitāṃ vartim āhur eke ||87-88||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha lekhanīrasakriyā tutthaṃ mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā sitopalaṃ, śaṃkhaṃ, manaḥśilā, gairikam, udadhiphenaṃ, maricaṃ, madhunāñjanam imāṃ rasakriyāṃ rasānāṃ tutthakadīnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā, yad vā rasaviśiṣṭā yataḥ puṣpaharī rasakriyāyāṃ dhātuḥ nāsti karpūram evāsti || 87-88 ||

tathā ca lekhanī rasakriyā --
vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyukto mukhyaḥ karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ || 89 ||

lg.l: kṣipram añjanato hanti kusumaṃ tu dvimāsikam |

ab.seg:
Āḍhamalla. athāparāṃ lekhanīṃ rasakriyām āha - karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ karpūrajaḥ śakalaḥ tena karpūraśakalaṃ saṃgṛhya vaṭakṣīreṇa saha saṃghṛṣyāñjayed ity arthaḥ | mukhya ity uttamaḥ | yataḥ kaṃrpūras trividho bhavati | tad yathā ‘īśāvāso himasaṃjñaḥ potāsa iti sa tridhā | apakve kathyate bhedaḥ karpūre tu bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ | lakṣaṇenāpi
‘īśāvāso bhṛśaṃ śveto himasaṃjñas tathāṅkura: |
śvetaḥ potāśrayaḥ sarve rasavīryavipākataḥ |
prabhāvenāpi te proktāḥ pūrvapūrvaguṇādhikāḥ | tatrāpi yo navakṣudra: sphaṭikābhaḥ sa uttamaḥ’ iti mukhyaśabdena vyākhyātaḥ | eke ‘vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyuktaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ karpūrajaṃ rajaḥ | kṣipram añjanato hanti tamaḥ sūryodayād iva’ iti paṭhanti || 89 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha puṣpaharī rasakriyā sugamam || 89 ||

atinidrāyāṃ yogaḥ -
kṣaudrāśvalālāsaṃghṛṣṭair maricair netram añjayet ||90||

lg.l: atinidrā śamaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodayād iva |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. kṣaudraṃ madhu aśvalālā ghoṭakavaktrajanito dravaviśeṣaḥ | atinidrāpi sannipātajvarajanitā boddhavyā | iyam api lekhanī rasakriyā kathitā || 90 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. athātinidrāyām añjanaṃ sugamam || 90 ||

prabodhanāñjanam |
jātīpuṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca maricaṃ kaṭukī vacā || 91 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. tatra jātīpuṣpaṃ, mālatīpuṣṣaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ kaṭukā kaṭurohiṇī, bastamūtraṃ chāgamūtram | śeṣaṃ subodham | iyam api gomūtreṇa kalkīkṛtya vartisvarūpā lekhinī rasakriyā kathitā | athavā kṛṣṇā pippalī | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śirīṣabījādibhiḥ sarasonaśilāvacair iti | rasono hlasunavācyaḥ | śilā manaḥśilā vacā vikhyātā etāni dravyāṇi atra godhūmaṃ vihāya samamātrāṇi grāhyāṇi | gomūtramānaṃ tu kalkārthaṃ yāvat | prabodhāyety anena sannipātajvarajanitaṃ tandrīvināśanāyāñjanam atrāhuḥ || 91 -92 ||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha nidrāyām añjanaṃ, jātī mālatī tasyāḥ puṣpaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ, kaṭukī vacā | bastaś chāgas tanmūtreṇāñjanaṃ, atha sannipāteñjanam | śirīṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tadbījaṃ kṛṣṇā pippalī rasonaḥ lasunaḥ śilā manaḥśilā vacā etair añjanam || 91-92 ||

dārvyādirasakriyā |
dārvī paṭolaṃ madhukaṃ sanimbapadmakotpalam || 93 ||

lg.l: vipācya pādaśeṣaṃ tu śṛtaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet ||94||
śīte tasmin madhu sitāṃ dadyāt pādāṃśikāṃ nara: |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ lekhinīrasakriyām abhidhāya ropaṇīrasakriyām āha - dārvīti | dārvī dāruharidrā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ| padmākha iti loke | yatra padmam asti tatra kamalaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvatra, kamalā'bhāve padmabījam iti | sarvatra caturguṇatā ca kvāthyadravyāṇām | kkāthyadravyaṃ tu dārvyādikaṃ ca samamātraṃ deyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ caturthaṃ suśṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ tac ca pādaśeṣaṃ punaḥ paced ity arthaḥ | sāndrībhūte himasadṛśe tasmin | sitā madhu ca melayitvā pādāṃśaṃ kṣiped iti | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthaśeṣāt | nara iti vaidyaḥ | iti ropaṇī rasakriyā proktā | dāhādayo 'tra netrasyeti saṃbandhaḥ || 93-95||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha ropaṇīrasakriyā | dārvī dāruharidrā, paṭolaṃ, madhukaṃ, yaṣṭī, nimbaṃ, padmakam, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ prapauṃḍarīkaṃ tadraktam; etāni tulyāni caturguṇe toye jale pacet | caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ kkāthaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet | madhusitā sitotpalam | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthāt | eṣā rasakriyā dāhādiharī rasarūpaikā kriyā rasakriyā | yad vā rasānāṃ tutthādidhātūnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā | yad vā dravyāṇāṃ kriyā rasakriyā aśrusrāvādau || 93-95 ||

rasāñjanādirasakriyā |
rasājanaṃ sarjaraso jātīpuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā |
samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca ||96||

Āḍhamalla. iyam api ropaṇīrasakriyāñjanasamūhe vihitā | tatra rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, sarjaraso 'gnivallabhaḥ | loke rāla iti | lavaṇam atra saindhavaṃ netrahitatvāt | tathā ca - ‘madhu yavapādāsaṃga: śatāvarīmudgasaindhavāmalakī cakṣuṣya: saṃkṣepād vargaḥ kathito bhiṣagbhir ayam’ iti | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||96-97||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pakṣmaprarohaṇādau kriyā | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkkāthodbhavam | sarjaraso rālaḥ | jātī mālatī tatpuṣpaṃ praklinnavartmani, kledaḥ klinnatā, spaṣṭam anyat ||96-97||

lg.l: saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ syāt sarvam ekatra mardayet || 98 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. athānyā ropaṇī rasakriyā api darśayann āha - guḍūcīty anena | latāyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyam iti | kṣaudratulyaṃ māṣaparimitaṃ mardanam asya kāṃsye tāmraje vā pātre ity asmadīyasaṃpradāyaḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || 98 || 99 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha pakṣmarogādau timirādau armamasūratimirādau

lg.l: dugdhena kaṇḍūṃ kṣaudreṇa netrasrāvaṃ ca sarpiṣā |
punarnavā jayed āśu bhāskas timiraṃ yathā |

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. atra kṣīrādīnāṃ vyastena kṛtvā sarvaropaṇī rasakriyā jñātavyā dugdhasya strībhavaṃ sarpir atrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavaṃ kāñjikaṃ śuktaviśeṣaṃ prasiddham | punarnaveti punarnavāsvarasaḥ || 100 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha punarnavānupānam añjane punarnavā dugdhādinā kaṇḍvādīn jayet yathā bhāskaras timiram ||100||

babbūlarasakiyā |
babbūladalani:kātho lehībhūtas tadañjanāt || 101 ||

netrasrāvaṃ jayaty eṣa madhuyukto na saṃśayaḥ | hiñjalarasakriyā |
hiñjalasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā pānīye nityam añjanam ||102||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. babbūladalāc caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā niḥkkāthya pādaśeṣaṃ paṭe visrāvya nītā punar vipacet yāvat sāndro bhavati | paścāt pādayuktena madhunā saṃsrāvyāñjayed ity abhiprāya: | iyam api ropaṇī rasakriyā vyākhyātā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ katakaphalam iti prasiddham | etan mahauṣadham iti mahāñjanavaram etad ity artha: | ayam api yogo ropaṇīrasakriyāyāṃ kathitaḥ ||101||102||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha netrasrāve 'nyaḥ prayogaḥ sugamam | babbūladalaṃ patraṃ tasya kvātho lehībhūtaḥ lehākāras tasyāñjanaṃ hijjalo hiṃgoṭhaḥ tatpalaṃ pṛṣṭvā ghṛṣṭvā pānīyenāñjanam || 101 || 102 || idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā

ab.seg:
idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā katakarasakriyā |
katakasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā madhunā netram añjayet || 103 ||

Āḍhamalla. netraprasādanaṃ dṛṣṭisādanam | tasyāḥ prasannatvena netrasyā'pi prasannatvam | tathā coktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena
yathā hi - ‘kanakasthānāṃ maṇīnāṃ vividhātmanām |
dhautānāṃ vimalā śuddhis taile velakarādibhiḥ |
evaṃ netreṣu vartyā ca añjanāścyotanādibhiḥ | dṛṣṭir nirākulā bhāti nirmale nabhasīnduvat’ iti || 103 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha snehanī rasakriyā | katakaphalaṃ nirmalī iti loke prasiddhā | kiṃcit bhīmasenakarpūreṇāñjayet | netraprasādanaṃ netraprasannakaraṃ, netraprasādane || 103 ||

atha śirotpāte rasakriyā |
sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ cāñjanaṃ syāc chirotpātasya śāntaye ||104||
gū. - sarpir ghṛtam || 104 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. sarpir ghṛtam || 104 ||

kṛṣṇasarpavasārasakriyā |
kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkha: katakāt phalam añjanam |
rasakriyeyam acirād andhānāṃ darśanapradā || 105 ||

lekhanāñjanam |
dakṣāṇḍatvakśilākācaśaṅkhacandanasaindhavaiḥ |
dravyair añjanayogo 'yaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanaḥ || 106 ||

kaṇārasakriyā |
kaṇā chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā netrayuge 'ñjitā |
acirād dhanti naktāndhyaṃ tadvat sakṣaudram ūṣaṇam ||107||

cūrṇāñjanam|
śāṇārdhaṃ maricaṃ dvau ca pippalyarṇavaphenayo: |
śāṇārdhaṃ saindhavaṃ śāṇā nava sauvīrakāñjanāt ||108||

lg.l: piṣṭaṃ susūkṣmaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇāñjanam idaṃ śubham |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atra vividharasakriyām amidhāya saṃprati cūrṇāñjanaviṣaye kaiścit pratipāditām ekāṃ rasakriyām āha - añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaprabhṛtīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ sarpavasāktaśalākayā paścāt cūrṇaliptayāñjayed iti bhāvaḥ | kutracid rasāñjanaṃ vinā pracarati tatrāñjanaśabdena kajalam etat kāryam iti śeṣaḥ || 105 || atha lekhanaṃ cūrṇāñjanam āha - dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ, śilā manaḥśilā, candanam atra raktaṃ netrahitakaratvāt | dakṣāṇḍatvag ityādiyogaś cūrṇāñjanam | asmatsaṃpradāye tu madhūktaśalākayā ca gṛhītvāñjanaṃ kāryam evaṃ sarvatra | cūrṇāñjane eke saindhavair ity asya sthāne gairikair iti paṭhanti, dravyair añjanayogo 'yam ity asya sthāne tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyam iti kathayanti | etatpadadvayam api saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt| tathā ca - ‘dakṣāṇḍatvakśilāśaṅkhakācacandanagairikaiḥ | tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanam’ iti || 106 || aparam api lekhanāñjanam āha - kaṇā pippalī, chāgayakṛt chāgakālakhaṇḍam | paktvā | kecit ‘paktvā netrayuge 'ñjitā’ ity asya sthāne ‘paktvā tadrasapeṣitā’ iti paṭhanti | tatra tadrasapeṣiteti tat svedāmbunā piṣṭvā ity abhiprāyaḥ | tadvad iti chāgayakṛnmadhye ca svinnaṃ tadrasasupiṣṭaṃ ca ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ kṣaudram atra yogadvaye 'pi pracarati | kecin madhunā saha bhakṣaṇayogadvayam idam āhuḥ | keṣāṃcin mate yakṛd ity upalakṣaṇatvena tallagnaṃ pittaṃ grāhyam | tanmadhye pippalī maricaṃ melayitvā dhāryaṃ paścāt śuṣkaṃ tan madhunā saṃghṛṣyāñjayed iti na svamatam || 107 || athānyac ca lekhanāñjanam āha - śāṇārdhaṃ māṣakadvayamitaṃ maricam iti pippalyarṇavaphenayoś ca dvau śāṇau tena pratyekaṃ śāṇamitam ity arthaḥ| arṇavaphenaḥ samudraphenaḥ | eke dvāv ity anena militvā śāṇaikam āhuḥ | tan na manoharaṃ | sauvīrakāñcanān nava śāṇā grāhyāḥ | śāṇaṣ ṭaṅkaḥ kathitaḥ | sa caturmāṣakapramito jñeyaḥ | sauvīrāñjanaṃ suvīrāśabdavācyaṃ tac ca kṛṣṇanadīsaṃbhavaṃ bhavati | tadabhāve rasāñjanam eva grāhyaṃ, malaś ca netrasaṃbhava eva ||108 || 109 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha cūrṇāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvak iti | dakṣāṇḍatvak kukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaṃ śilā manaḥśilā, kācaṃ śvetakācaṃ śaṅkhaṃ candanaṃ saindhavam ebhir dravyaiḥ piṣṭair ayam añjanayogaḥ puṣpādilekhanaḥ | puṣpādau naktāndhye - kaṇā pippalī chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā punas tadrasapeṣitā tadrasaḥ yakṛdrasaḥ | acirāt śīghreṇa naktāndhyaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭimandatāṃ hanti | tadvat ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ ca kṛtam | sakṣaudraṃ madhusahitam | naktāndhye cūrṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇarūpam añjanaṃ cūrṇāñjanam | arṇavaphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ maricaṃ śāṇārdhaṃ pippalyarṇavaphenayor dvau śāṇau pratyekaṃ śāṇāṣṭakaḥ saindhavam ardhaśāṇaṃ sauvīrakāñjanaṃ navaśāṇaṃ citrāyāṃ citrānakṣatre sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ bhavati | kaṇḍvādau ||105- 109 ||

ab.seg:
idānīṃ ropaṇacūrṇāñjanam āha - (mṛducūrṇāñjanam)
śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvā samyag āplāvya vāriṇā |
gṛhṇīyāt taj jalaṃ sarvaṃ tyajec cūrṇam adhogatam || 110 ||

lg.l: śuṣkaṃ ca taj jalaṃ sarvaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ bhavet |
añjayen nayane tena sarvadoṣaharaṃ hi tat || 112 ||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. etan mṛducūrṇāñjanatvena ropaṇatvena kathitaṃ śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvetyādi | śilāyāṃ pāṣāṇaghaṭitā peṣaṇārthaṃ pātraviśeṣaḥ | rasakaṃ kharparakaṃ tac ca tutthabhedaḥ | khaparīyāśabdavācyo loke | samyag āplāvya vāriṇā ca | asmāt saṃpradāye tu tad rasakaṃ jalenaiva dṛṣadi saṃpeṣya paścān nirmalapātre bahujale saṃplāvya muhūrtaṃ vilambya tad upari svacchaṃ jalam apanīyādhaḥsthitaṃ tat parpaṭasaṃnibhaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tad grāhyam ity arthaḥ | karpūracūrṇaṃ tu daśamāṃśaṃ parpaṭīsvarūpadravyāt | sarvadoṣam iti vātapittakapharudhiraṃ | sarvarogam iti netrābhiṣyandādhimanthaprabhṛtikaṃ | cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakārīty anena dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ kathitam || 110-112 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha prasādanāñjanaṃ cūrṇam | rasakaṃ kharparaṃ śilāyāṃ piṣṭvā vāriṇā samyak āplāvya cālayitvā vāriṇā jalena tat pātrāntare gṛhṇīyāt | adhogataṃ pāṣāṇādikaṃ tyajet | tat śuṣkaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ punaḥ saṃcūrṇya trivelaṃ triphalārasena bhāvayet | daśamāṃśena karpūrarajaḥ kṣipet | spaṣṭam anyat || 110-112 ||

prasādanāñjanam (sauvīrāñjanam)
agnitaptaṃ hi sauvīraṃ niṣiñcet triphalārasaiḥ ||113||

lg.l: saptavelaṃ tathā stanyaiḥ strīṇāṃ siktaṃ vicūrṇitam |
sarvān akṣivikārāṃs tu hanyād etan na saṃśayaḥ |

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha snehanābhidhaṃ prasādanasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇāñjanam āha - agnitaptaṃ sauvīram iti | sauvīraṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ tac ca suramāśabdavācyaṃ triphalā harītakyādikaṃ tasyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ kvathitaraso vā tathety anena strīdugdhenāpi saptavelam āhuḥ | stanyair iti bahutvenājaṃ gavyaṃ vā kṣīraṃ grāhyaṃ | siktam ity atrāpy agnitaptam iti saṃbandhaḥ || 113 || 114 ||
Kāśīrāma Vaidya. anyac ca sauvīraṃ suramā strīṇāṃ stanyair dugdhaiḥ spaṣṭam anyat || 113 || 114 ||

ab.seg:
atha dṛṣṭiprasādanī nāgaśalākā vikhyātā, tām api darśayann āha -
triphalābhṛṅgaśuṇṭhīnāṃ rasais tadvac ca sarpiṣā ||115||

lg.l: tacchalākā haraty eva sarvān netrabhavān gadān || 116 ||

div.ab:
Āḍhamalla. tadvad ity anena pūrvoktasauvīrāñjanavidhānavad atrāpi | saptavāraṃ pratyekaṃ triphalādidravyeṇa nirvāpaṇam āhuḥ | uktam anyatrāpi - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | anyatroktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati |
‘triphalasalilayoge bhṛṅgarājadraveṇa haviṣi ca viṣamiśre kṣīra ājye madhūke |
pratipadam abhitaptaṃ saptadhā sīsam ekaṃ praṇihitagatipaścāt kārayet tacchalākam || timirapaṭalakaṇḍvāsrāvaraktaprakopām upacitabahu-doṣānnarmasaṃjñāṃs tu rogān | savitur udayakāle sāñjanā vyañjanā vā harati nayanarogān śodhyamānā śalākā’ iti | vāgbhaṭe 'pi -
‘śreṣṭhājalaṃ bhṛṅgarasaṃ saviṣājyam ajāpayaḥ |
yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ saptakṛtva: pṛthak pṛthak || taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā vyañjanā vā | taimiryārmasrāvapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti’ iti ( vā. u. 13|34|35) || 115 || 116 ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha sīsakaśalākā | triphalā bhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ śuṇṭhī eṣāṃ rasaiḥ jalaiḥ sarpiṣā ghṛtena gomūtramadhu ajā kṣīraiḥ etaiḥ sapta saptavāraṃ siktaḥ secito nāgaḥ | sīsakaśalākā netrarujaḥ haret | triphalādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ rasaiḥ sapta saptadhā sikta ity arthaḥ | tathā ca suśrute - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | triphalādīnāṃ samāhāraḥ dvandvāt pratyekaṃ rase niṣecanam iti dhvanitam | iti sīsakaśalākā || 115 || 116 ||

ab.seg:
pratyañjanam |
gatadoṣam apetāśru saṃpaśyan samyag ambhasi |
prakṣālyākṣi yathādoṣaṃ kāryaṃ pratyañjanaṃ tataḥ ||117||

nayanāmṛtāñjanam |
śuddhe nāge drute śuddhaṃ tulyaṃ sūtaṃ vinikṣipet |
kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ tayos tulyaṃ sarvam ekatra cūrṇayet || 119 ||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. idānīṃ cūrṇāñjanāntargataṃ pratyañjanavidhānam āha - akṣi prakṣālya tataḥ pratyañjanaṃ kāryam | netre tīkṣṇapratapte prasādanaṃ cūrṇaṃ hitam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||117 || 118 || atha prasādanaṃ cūrṇāñjanam āha - nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ nāgaśuddhis tu pūrvaṃ dhātuśodhanā'dhyāye kathitā | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ śuddham iti śodhitaṃ | śuddhi rasasya pūrvaṃ rasaśodhanādhyāye pratipāditā | kṛṣṇāñjanam iti rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tac ca dvividham ekaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākkāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ tayos tulyam iti pāradasīsakasāmyaṃ rasāñjanam ity aryaḥ | trayāṇāṃ daśāṃśenātra karpūram iti | idaṃ nayanāmṛtaṃ nāma prasādāñjanacūrṇaṃ prasiddham eva kṛtāñjanasthāne pratyañjanam iti pāṭhāntaram || 119 || 120||

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. pratyañjanakaraṇe vidhānam āha - sīsakaśalākayā vahnitaptayā añjane kṛte doṣanāśe pratyañjanaṃ kartavyam ity āha - gatadoṣaṃ tathā nayanāstraṃ gatanetrajalam akṣi netram ambhasi saṃpaśyan | tataḥ akṣi prakṣālya yathā doṣānurūpaṃ pratyañjanam añjanaṃ sadoṣe netre dhāvanaṃ netram ity apy āha -anirvāntadoṣe 'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ na prayojayet | na kārayet | pratyañjanaṃ kārayet| prakṣālanaṃ vinaiveti dhvanitārtha: | tīkṣṇaṃ tan netre prasādanaś cūrṇo vā kārya: | sa yathā - śuddhe tailādibhi: śuddhe vā śalākākāreṇa śuddhe nāge sīsake sati drutaṃ vahninā drāvitaṃ nāgaṃ śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ hiṅgulotthaṃ aṣṭakarmaśuddhaṃ vā tulyaṃ nikṣipet | tayo: sīsakasūtakayos tulyaṃ kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇayet | tata: sarvam ekatra cūrṇayet | tasmina cūrṇe karpūraṃ bhīmasenākhyaṃ daśamāṃśena pradāpayet | etat pratyañjanaṃ nāma netragadahā nayanāmṛtaṃ pratyañjanaṃ cūrṇam ||117||

sarpaviṣe saṃjīvanāñjanam |
jayapālabhavāṃ majjāṃ bhāvayen nimbukadravai: |
ekaviṃśativelaṃ tu tato vartiṃ prakalpayet ||121||

div.ab: Āḍhamalla. atha netraprakaraṇapāriśeṣyāt viṣaharī vartim āha - jayapālaṃ dantibījaṃ prasiddham | tanmadhyagatā majjā grāhyā | majjeti meṅgīśabdavācyā sarpadaṣṭaviṣam api viṣasādharmyāt sthāvaraviṣatakṣaṇepy asyā: pracāra: | eke sannipātaviṣaye 'ñjanam asyā: pravadanti || 121|| 122 | |

ab.seg: Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha sarpaviṣaharam añjanam | sugamam ||121||

atha dṛṣṭiprasādanārthaṃ sārvakālikaṃ yogadvayam āha -
bhuktvā pāṇitalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā cakṣuṣor dīyate yadi |
jātā rogā vinaśyanti timirāṇi tathaiva ca ||123||

lg.l: śītāmbupūritamukha: prativāsaraṃ ya: kālatrayeṇa nayanadvitayaṃ jalena |
āsiñcati dhruvam asau na kadācid akṣi- rogavyathāvidhuratāṃ bhajate manuṣya: || 124||

ab.seg: Āḍhamalla. bhuktvā pāṇitalam ityādi sugamam | jātārogā ityādi padadvayaṃ kecid anyathā paṭhanti | yathā ‘acireṇaiva tad vāri timirāṇi vyapohatīti’ dvitīyayoge prativāsaraṃ pratidinaṃ kālatrayaṃ prātarmadhyāhṇāparahṇādikam | jaleneti mukhagaṇḍūṣajanitena āsiñcatīty anena vāraṃ vāraṃ secanam abhihitam | tathā coktaṃ ‘jalagaṇḍūṣai: prātar bahuśombhobhiḥ prapūrya mukharandhram | nirdayam añjann akṣi kṣapayati timirāṇi nāsādya’ iti | eke bhuktvā pāṇitalam ityādi yogadvayaṃ nātra paṭhanti | nāsaṅgatam iti manyamānair asmābhir api likhitam || 123-124 ||

div.ab:
atha trikhaṇḍānāṃ pāriśeṣyāt kavir api khaguṇaprakarṣatāṃ solluṇṭhavacanena dyotayati --
āyurvedasamudrasya gūḍhārthamaṇisaṃcayam |
jñātvā kaiścid budhais tais tu kṛtā vividhasaṃhitāḥ ||125||
kiṃcid arthaṃ tato nītvā kṛteyaṃ saṃhitā mayā |
kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepam asyāṃ kurvantu sādhavaḥ || 126 ||
vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ yā hariramaṇīva karoti yogaratnaiḥ |
vilasatu śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā sā kavihṛdayeṣu sarojanirmaleṣu || 127 ||
alpāyuṣām alpadhiyām idānīṃ kṛtaṃ samastaśrutipāṭhaśaktyā |
tad atra yuktaṃ pratibījamātra- mabhyasyatām ātmahitaṃ prayatnāt || 128 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām uttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmavidhi- rnāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ |

Āḍhamalla. atha netraviṣaya-pradhānatvena tadarthaṃ sarvakālaṃ yan na vidheyam iti matvā tat pratipālanārtham upadeśam āha –
‘cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyai- ryatna: kartavyo jīvite yāvad icchā |
vyartho loko 'yaṃ tulyarātrindivānāṃ puṃsām andhānāṃ vidyamāne 'pi vitte ||’ ayam api tantrāntarād āhṛtya kenāpi likhitaḥ na svamatam | asyārthas tu sugama eva || dī. - āyurvedasamudrasya arthamaṇisañcayaḥ | gūḍha eva gūḍho guptaḥ, yathā samudre maṇisamūhaḥ pracchannaḥ sarvair eva na dṛśyaḥ tathā'yurvede 'pi artho 'bhiprāyaḥ | sarvair eva nādhigata ity arthaḥ | ata eva kaiścid budhair jñātaḥ | arthamaṇisaṃcaya iti saṃbandhaḥ | yair eva jñātas tais tu vividhā saṃhitāḥ kṛtāḥ | vividhasaṃhitā hārītasuśrutabhṛgvagniveśādayaḥ | atha kaviḥ svātmīyaviṣayam āha –kiṃcid artham ityādi | tata iti saṃhitāsamūhāt | mayā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa kiṃcid arthaṃ svabuddhyā ekadeśīyaprayojanaṃ nītvā āhṛtya iyaṃ saṃhitā kṛtā nibaddhety abhiprāyaḥ | na tu khakapolakalpitā | etena munipraṇītatvaṃ saṃkṣepatvaṃ ca darśitam | atha kavivijñaptim āha - kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepam ityādi | asyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ sādhavaḥ sajjanāḥ kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kṛpayā kaṭākṣasya dṛṣṭeḥ kiṃcidbhāgasya nikṣepaṃ kurvantu | anumatārthakriyā avaśyam eveti bhāvaṃ sūcayati | tenāvaśyam eva kaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kurvaṃtu | yataḥ kaṭākṣamātrā'valokanenā'pi hṛdayaṃgamā kṣamā bhavati kim uta sakaladṛṣṭyā | etena granthasya samīcīnatā darśitā | idānīṃ kavir eva nijagranthasyotkṛṣṭatvam āha - yā iyaṃ saṃhitā hariramaṇīva lakṣmīr iva yogaratnaiḥ prayogamaṇisamūhaiḥ kṛtvā vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ karoti | vividhagadānāṃ vyādhīnām ārtir eva dāridryaṃ tasya nāśanaṃ yathā lakṣmīr bahudhanapradānena akiṃcanapuruṣasya daridranāśaṃ karoti tathā iyam api saṃhitā suyogaiḥ kṛtvā nānārogajanitapīḍāṃ hantīti bhāvaḥ | etenāsyāḥ prayogasāphalyaṃ darśitam | tat prayogasāphalyasya vyāpāram āha - vilasatv ityādi | sā saṃhitā, saṃhitā niruktis tu pūrvādhyāye darśitā | śārṅgadharācāryasya sā saṃhitā śārṅgadharācāryanirmitā sā ity abhiprāyaḥ | nānyā | etena granthasya sarvamatānubandhatvaṃ darśitaṃ, sarojanirmaleṣu kavihṛdayeṣv iti vilasatu vilāsaṃ karotu kamalanirmalahṛdayapuruṣeṣu sthitiṃ karotv ity abhiprāyaḥ | na tu piśunahṛdayeṣu teṣāṃ hṛdayānām anirmalatvāt na tasyāḥ sthiter avakāśaḥ | yatas te svabhāvavaśagāḥ kathaṃ paraguṇam avadhārayituṃ samarthāḥ | tasmāt sajjanahṛdayeṣv eva vilāsa iti bhāvaḥ | sahṛdayatvāt | etena granthasya nirmalatvaṃ sūcitaṃ yato nirmalasya nirmalaiḥ saha saṃbandhaḥ sukara eva || 125-128 ||
vividhamuninibandhā ye mahatsu prasiddhāḥ, sumatiduravabodhās te mayā naiva dṛṣṭāḥ |
tad api gurusakāśād yac chrutaṃ tad vyalekhi hy aḍhamalabhiṣajā'syāṃ bhāvasiṃhātmajena || 1 || abhinavanibandharacanāṃ śrotuṃ kaḥ ko 'tra lolupo bhavati | yaḥ kṛpayā parakāvyaṃ paśyati sudṛśā sa vai dhīraḥ ||2|| ekādaśasahasrāṇi tathā.... ...... ... | śakānām āḍhamallo hi pañjikāyāṃ vinirmame ||3|| govardhanoddharaṇahṛṣṭasamastagopa- nānāśrutiśravaṇalajjitamānasasya (?) | indukalāsamānaṃ daṃṣṭrodyuti kṣitiharer avatu smitaṃ vaḥ || 4 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātma- jenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharapyaṃhitāyāṃ dīpikāyām uttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmādividhi- radhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||

Kāśīrāma Vaidya. atha samāptau granthakāraḥ svakīyaṃ vinayaṃ karoti | sugamam | vinayaṃ kṛtvā autkṛṣṭyam āha - śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā kavihṛdayeṣu vilasatu viśeṣeṇa lasatu prakāśatu | kathaṃbhūteṣu hṛdayeṣu | sarojanirmaleṣu kamalavat śuddheṣu | sā kā ? yā hariramaṇīva lakṣmīr iva yogaratnair vividhagadārtidaridranāśaṃ karoti | yujyanta iti yogāḥ kvāthacūrṇādīnāṃ gaṇā rasādayaś ca, taiḥ nānāvidhajvarādirogāṇāṃ ārtiḥ pīḍā tasyā yo daridras tannāśaṃ karoti || 125-128 || śrīmat śāhasalemasya rājye kanyāgate ravau | ... .... ..... .. ... .. .... ... .... .. ... .. ... || 1 ||
kāśīrāmabhiṣagvaro madhukaraḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādābjayoḥ prācāṃ granthakṛtāṃ nibandhakusumād āhṛtya mādhvīm iva |
vaidyānām upakārakṛt tanubhṛtāṃ rogaprahāre kṣamāṃ saśrīśārṅgadharaprabandhaviśadavyākhyām akārṣīt svayam|| 2 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne netrakarmaprasādananāmādhyāyaḥ | iti trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ | śārṅgadharasaṃhitā samāptā |
